HP:0005531.definition: A type of actue leukemia with features characteristic of both the myeloid and lymphoid lineages. These leukemias are for this reason are designated mixed-lineage, hybrid or biphenotypic acute leukemias.
HP:0005531.definition_cn: 一种具有髓系和淋巴系特征的急性白血病。因此，这些白血病被命名为混合谱系、杂合性或双表型急性白血病。

HP:0005532.name: Macrocytic dyserythropoietic anemia
HP:0005532.name_cn: 巨红细胞性生成障碍性贫血

HP:0005534.name: Transient myeloproliferative syndrome
HP:0005534.definition: A unique clonal neoplastic disorder that is linked to trisomy 21, is restricted to neonatal period, and spontaneously regresses. It often has characteristics of megakaryocytic lineage and is associated with GATA1 mutations in myeloblasts.
HP:0005534.name_cn: 短暂性骨髓增生综合征
HP:0005534.definition_cn: 一种独特的克隆性肿瘤性疾病，与21三体综合征相关，仅限于新生儿期，并可自发消退。该病常具有巨核细胞系特征，并与原始粒细胞中的GATA1突变相关。

HP:0005535.name: Exercise-induced hemolysis
HP:0005535.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia that can be triggered by exertion.
HP:0005535.definition_cn: 一种可由体力活动诱发的溶血性贫血。

HP:0005537.name: Decreased mean platelet volume
HP:0005537.definition: Average platelet volume below the lower limit of the normal reference interval.
HP:0005537.definition_cn: 平均血小板体积低于正常参考区间下限。

HP:0005539.name: T cell chronic lymphocytic lymphoma/leukemia
HP:0005539.definition: A form of lymphoid leukemia or lymphoma in which too many T-cell lymphoblasts are found in the blood, bone marrow, and tissues. Leukemia or lymphoma classification depends on which feature is more prominent.
HP:0005539.name_cn: T细胞慢性淋巴细胞性淋巴瘤/白血病
HP:0005539.definition_cn: 一种淋巴性白血病或淋巴瘤，其特征为血液、骨髓及组织中存在过多的T淋巴母细胞。白血病或淋巴瘤的分类取决于哪种特征更为显著。

HP:0005540.name: Red blood cell keratocytosis
HP:0005540.definition: A form of poikilocytosis in which the abnormally shaped erythrocytes have notches that results in projections that look like horns.
HP:0005540.definition_cn: 一种异形红细胞症，其中形态异常的红细胞具有缺口，导致形成类似角状突起。

HP:0005541.name: Congenital agranulocytosis
HP:0005541.definition: Congenital onset of a marked decrease in the number of granulocytes.
HP:0005541.definition_cn: 先天性粒细胞显著减少症。

HP:0005542.name: Prolonged whole-blood clotting time
HP:0005542.definition: An abnormal prolongation (delay) in the time required by whole blood to produce a visible clot.
HP:0005542.definition_cn: 全血凝固时间异常延长（延迟）。

HP:0005543.name: Reduced protein C activity
HP:0005543.definition: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of vitamin K-dependent protein C. Protein C is activated to protein Ca by thrombin bound to thrombomodulin. Activated protein C degrades factors VIIIa and Va.
HP:0005543.definition_cn: 与维生素K依赖性蛋白C浓度降低相关的凝血异常。蛋白C通过与血栓调节蛋白结合的血栓素激活为蛋白Ca。激活的蛋白C降解因子VIIIa和Va。

HP:0005547.name: Myeloproliferative disorder
HP:0005547.definition: Proliferation (excess production) of hemopoietically active tissue or of tissue which has embryonic hemopoietic potential.
HP:0005547.definition_cn: 造血活性组织或具有胚胎造血潜能组织的增殖（过度生成）。

HP:0005549.name: obsolete Congenital neutropenia
HP:0005549.name_cn: 过时的先天性中性粒细胞减少症

HP:0005550.name: Chronic lymphatic leukemia
HP:0005550.definition: A chronic lymphocytic/lymphatic/lymphoblastic leukemia (CLL) is a neoplastic disease characterized by proliferation and accumulation (blood, marrow and lymphoid organs) of morphologically mature but immunologically dysfunctional lymphocytes. A CLL is always a B-cell lymphocytic leukemia as there are no reports of cases of T-cell lymphocytic leukemias.
HP:0005550.definition_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞白血病（Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, CLL）是一种以形态学成熟但免疫功能异常的淋巴细胞在血液、骨髓及淋巴器官中增殖和积聚为特征的肿瘤性疾病。CLL始终为B细胞型淋巴细胞白血病，目前尚无T细胞型淋巴细胞白血病的病例报告。

HP:0005556.name: Abnormality of the metopic suture
HP:0005556.definition: The frontal suture divides the two halves of the frontal bone of the skull in infants and children and generally undergoes fusion by the age of six. A persistent frontal suture is referred to as a \
HP:0005556.definition_cn: 额缝将婴儿和儿童颅骨的额骨分为两半，通常在六岁前发生融合。持续存在的额缝被称为“额缝未闭”。

HP:0005557.name: Abnormal zygomatic arch morphology
HP:0005557.definition: An abnormality of the zygomatic arch, also known as the cheek bone.
HP:0005557.definition_cn: 颧弓异常，亦称颊骨异常。

HP:0005558.name: Chronic leukemia
HP:0005558.definition: A slowly progressing leukemia characterized by a clonal (malignant) proliferation of maturing and mature myeloid cells or mature lymphocytes. When the clonal cellular population is composed of myeloid cells, the process is called chronic myelogenous leukemia. When the clonal cellular population is composed of lymphocytes, it is classified as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, hairy cell leukemia, or T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia.
HP:0005558.definition_cn: 一种缓慢进展的白血病，其特征为成熟及成熟中的髓系细胞或成熟淋巴细胞的克隆性（恶性）增殖。当克隆性细胞群由髓系细胞组成时，该过程称为慢性髓性白血病。当克隆性细胞群由淋巴细胞组成时，则分类为慢性淋巴细胞白血病、毛细胞白血病或T细胞大颗粒淋巴细胞白血病。

HP:0005559.name: Abnormality of the kinin-kallikrein system
HP:0005559.name_cn: 激肽-激肽释放酶系统异常

HP:0005560.name: Imbalanced hemoglobin synthesis
HP:0005560.definition: Normal hemoglobin synthesis is characterized by production of equal amounts of alpha and beta globins. This term refers to a deviation from this pattern and is the main characteristic of the various forms of thalassemia.
HP:0005560.definition_cn: 正常的血红蛋白合成以等量的α和β珠蛋白产生为特征。该术语指偏离这一模式的情况，并且是各种类型地中海贫血的主要特征。

HP:0005561.name: Abnormal bone marrow cell morphology
HP:0005561.definition: An anomaly of the form or number of cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0005561.definition_cn: 骨髓细胞形态或数量异常。

HP:0005562.name: Multiple renal cysts
HP:0005562.definition: The presence of many cysts in the kidney.
HP:0005562.definition_cn: 肾脏多囊性病变（Polycystic Kidney Disease, PKD）

HP:0005563.name: Decreased numbers of nephrons
HP:0005563.definition: A reduction in the count of nephrons per kidney.
HP:0005563.definition_cn: 肾单位数量减少（Nephron Reduction per Kidney）。

HP:0005564.name: Absence of renal corticomedullary differentiation
HP:0005564.definition: A lack of differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.
HP:0005564.definition_cn: 影像学检查中肾皮质与肾髓质分界不清。

HP:0005565.name: Reduced renal corticomedullary differentiation
HP:0005565.definition: Reduced differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.
HP:0005565.definition_cn: 诊断影像学上肾皮质与肾髓质分界不清。

HP:0005567.name: Renal magnesium wasting
HP:0005567.definition: High urine magnesium in the presence of hypomagnesemia.

HP:0005571.name: Increased renal tubular phosphate reabsorption
HP:0005571.name_cn: 肾小管磷酸盐重吸收增加

HP:0005572.name: Decreased renal tubular phosphate excretion
HP:0005572.name_cn: 肾小管磷酸盐排泄减少

HP:0005574.name: Non-acidotic proximal tubulopathy
HP:0005574.definition: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption without bicarbonate loss.
HP:0005574.name_cn: 非酸中毒性近端肾小管病
HP:0005574.definition_cn: 一种近端肾小管病变，其特征为重吸收缺陷，导致糖尿、氨基酸尿、肾小管性蛋白尿、肾性低磷血症以及尿酸肾小管低重吸收，但不伴碳酸氢盐丢失。

HP:0005575.name: Hemolytic-uremic syndrome
HP:0005575.definition: A thrombotic microangiopathy with presence of non-immune, intravascular hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia and acute kidney injury. A vicious cycle of complement activation, endothelial cell damage, platelet activation, and thrombosis is the hallmark of the disease.
HP:0005575.definition_cn: 一种血栓性微血管病，伴有非免疫性血管内溶血性贫血、血小板减少和急性肾损伤。补体激活、内皮细胞损伤、血小板激活和血栓形成的恶性循环是该疾病的特征。

HP:0005576.name: Tubulointerstitial fibrosis
HP:0005576.definition: A progressive detrimental connective tissue deposition (fibrosis) on the kidney parenchyma involving the tubules and interstitial tissue of the kidney. Tubulointerstitial injury in the kidney is complex, involving a number of independent and overlapping cellular and molecular pathways, with renal interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (IF/TA) as the final common pathway. However, IF and TA are separable, as shown by the profound TA in renal artery stenosis, which characteristically has little or no fibrosis (or inflammation). For new annotations it is preferable to annotate to the specific HPO terms for Renal interstitial fibrosis and/or Renal tubular atrophy.
HP:0005576.definition_cn: 肾脏实质中逐渐加重的有害结缔组织沉积（纤维化），累及肾小管和肾间质组织。肾小管间质损伤是复杂的，涉及多个独立且重叠的细胞和分子通路，最终以肾间质纤维化和肾小管萎缩（IF/TA）为共同通路。然而，IF和TA是可分离的，如肾动脉狭窄中显著的TA，其特征是几乎没有或没有纤维化（或炎症）。对于新的注释，建议使用特定的HPO术语来注释肾间质纤维化和/或肾小管萎缩。

HP:0005579.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of chloride
HP:0005579.definition: Any impairment of reabsorption of chloride by the kidney.
HP:0005579.name_cn: 肾小管氯离子重吸收功能障碍
HP:0005579.definition_cn: 肾脏对氯离子重吸收功能受损。

HP:0005580.name: Duplication of renal pelvis
HP:0005580.definition: A duplication of the renal pelvis.

HP:0005583.name: Tubular basement membrane disintegration
HP:0005583.definition: DIsruption and breaking up of the basement membrane of the tubules of the kidney.
HP:0005583.definition_cn: 肾小管基底膜破坏与断裂。

HP:0005584.name: Renal cell carcinoma
HP:0005584.definition: A type of carcinoma of the kidney with origin in the epithelium of the proximal convoluted renal tubule.
HP:0005584.definition_cn: 一种起源于近曲小管上皮细胞的肾癌类型。

HP:0005586.name: Hyperpigmentation in sun-exposed areas
HP:0005586.name_cn: 日光暴露区域色素沉着过度

HP:0005587.name: Profuse pigmented skin lesions
HP:0005587.name_cn: 多发性色素性皮肤病变

HP:0005588.name: Patchy palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
HP:0005588.definition: A focal type of palmoplantar keratoderma in which only certain areas of the palms and soles are affected.
HP:0005588.name_cn: 斑片状掌跖角化过度症
HP:0005588.definition_cn: 局灶型掌跖角化病，仅累及手掌和足底的特定区域。

HP:0005592.name: Giant melanosomes in melanocytes
HP:0005592.definition: The presence of large spherical melanosomes (1 to 6 micrometer in diameter) in the cytoplasm of melanocytes.
HP:0005592.name_cn: 黑色素细胞中的巨大黑色素小体
HP:0005592.definition_cn: 黑色素细胞胞质中存在大球形黑色素体（直径1至6微米）。

HP:0005593.name: Macular hypopigmented whorls, streaks, and patches
HP:0005593.name_cn: 黄斑区色素减退性漩涡、条纹及斑片

HP:0005597.name: Congenital alopecia totalis
HP:0005597.definition: Loss of all scalp hair with congenital onset.
HP:0005597.definition_cn: 先天性全头皮毛发缺失症。

HP:0005598.name: Facial telangiectasia in butterfly midface distribution
HP:0005598.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin in a butterfly midface distribution.
HP:0005598.name_cn: 面部毛细血管扩张症，呈蝶形中面部分布
HP:0005598.definition_cn: 位于面部中央呈蝶形分布的皮肤浅表毛细血管扩张（微小扩张的血管）。

HP:0005600.name: Congenital giant melanocytic nevus
HP:0005600.definition: The giant congenital nevus is greater than 8 cm in size, pigmented and often hairy. A giant congenital nevus is smaller in infants and children, but it usually continues to grow with the child.
HP:0005600.name_cn: 先天性巨大黑色素细胞痣
HP:0005600.definition_cn: 巨大先天性色素痣的直径大于8厘米，具有色素沉着且常伴有毛发。在婴幼儿和儿童中，巨大先天性色素痣的尺寸较小，但通常会随着儿童的生长而持续增大。

HP:0005603.name: Numerous congenital melanocytic nevi
HP:0005603.name_cn: 多发性先天性黑素细胞痣

HP:0005605.name: Large cafe-au-lait macules with irregular margins
HP:0005605.definition: Large hypermelanotic macules with jagged borders.
HP:0005605.name_cn: 大面积咖啡牛奶斑伴不规则边缘
HP:0005605.definition_cn: 大面积色素沉着斑，边缘不规则。

HP:0005608.name: Bilobate gallbladder
HP:0005608.definition: The presence of a bilobed gallbladder, related to a duplication of the gallbladder primordium.
HP:0005608.definition_cn: 双叶胆囊的存在，与胆囊原基的重复有关。

HP:0005613.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the femur
HP:0005613.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the femur.
HP:0005613.name_cn: 股骨发育不全/股骨发育不良

HP:0005616.name: Accelerated skeletal maturation
HP:0005616.definition: An abnormally increased rate of skeletal maturation. Accelerated skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.
HP:0005616.definition_cn: 骨骼成熟异常加速。可通过人体特定骨骼的X线片评估骨龄来诊断骨骼成熟加速。

HP:0005619.name: Thoracolumbar kyphosis
HP:0005619.definition: Hyperconvexity of the thoracolumbar spine producing a rounded or humped appearance.
HP:0005619.definition_cn: 胸腰椎过度前凸导致圆形或驼背外观。

HP:0005620.name: Hypermobility of interphalangeal joints
HP:0005620.definition: The ability of the interphalangeal joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.
HP:0005620.definition_cn: 指间关节过伸活动度异常。

HP:0005621.name: Trapezoidal vertebral body
HP:0005621.definition: An anomalous trapezoidal appearance of a vertebral body. A trapezoid is a four-sided shape that has two sides that are parallel and two sides that are not parallel. In this case, the two lateral sides of the vertebra are parallel, and the top and the bottom are slanted with respect to each other such that the vertebra is shorter in the front or back than on the other side.
HP:0005621.definition_cn: 椎体呈现异常的梯形外观。梯形是一种四边形，具有两条平行边和两条非平行边。在此情况下，椎体的两侧边平行，而顶部和底部相互倾斜，导致椎体在前方或后方较另一侧短。

HP:0005622.name: Broad long bones
HP:0005622.definition: Increased cross-section (diameter) of the long bones. Note that widening may primarily affect specific regions of long bones (e.g., diaphysis or metaphysis), but this should be coded separately.
HP:0005622.definition_cn: 长骨横截面（直径）增大。注意增宽可能主要影响长骨的特定区域（例如骨干或干骺端），但应单独编码。

HP:0005623.name: Absent ossification of calvaria
HP:0005623.definition: Acalvaria is an extremely rare congenital malformation characterized by an absence of flat bones of skull, dura mater, and associated muscles in the presence of normal cranial contents and facial bones.
HP:0005623.definition_cn: 颅骨缺失症是一种极为罕见的先天性畸形，其特征为在颅内容物和面部骨骼正常存在的情况下，颅骨扁平骨、硬脑膜及相关肌肉的缺失。

HP:0005625.name: Osteoporosis of vertebrae
HP:0005625.definition_cn: 主要累及椎体的骨质疏松症。

HP:0005626.name: Posterior fusion of lumbosacral vertebrae
HP:0005626.definition: Bony fusion of the posterior part of the L5 vertebral body with the sacrum.
HP:0005626.definition_cn: L5椎体后部与骶骨的骨性融合。

HP:0005627.name: Type D brachydactyly
HP:0005627.definition: This type of brachydactyly is characterized by short and broad terminal phalanges of the thumbs and big toes.
HP:0005627.definition_cn: 此类短指症的特征为拇指和拇趾的末节指骨短而宽。

HP:0005638.name: Decreased anterioposterior diameter of lumbar vertebral bodies

HP:0005639.name: Hyperextensible hand joints
HP:0005639.definition: The ability of the joints of the hand to move beyond their normal range of motion.
HP:0005639.definition_cn: 手部关节活动度超出正常范围的能力。

HP:0005643.name: Short 3rd toe
HP:0005643.definition_cn: 第三趾发育不全（第三趾发育不良）。

HP:0005645.name: Intervertebral disk calcification
HP:0005645.definition: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition of the intervertebral disk.

HP:0005648.name: Bilateral ulnar hypoplasia
HP:0005648.definition: Underdevelopment of the ulna on both sides.

HP:0005650.name: 2-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0005650.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second to the fifth fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0005650.definition_cn: 在前后轴上，第二至第五指之间存在软组织连续性，其远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0005652.name: Cortical sclerosis
HP:0005652.definition: Sclerosis (abnormal hardening) of cortical bone, characterized by increased radiodensity.
HP:0005652.definition_cn: 皮质骨硬化症（异常硬化），以放射性密度增加为特征。

HP:0005653.name: Moderate generalized osteoporosis
HP:0005653.name_cn: 中度全身性骨质疏松症

HP:0005655.name: Multiple digital exostoses
HP:0005655.definition: Multiple exostoses originating in the fingers and toes.
HP:0005655.definition_cn: 多发性外生骨疣起源于手指和足趾。

HP:0005656.name: Positional foot deformity
HP:0005656.definition: A foot deformity resulting due to an abnormality affecting the muscle and soft tissue. In contrast if the bones of the foot are affected the term structural foot deformity applies.
HP:0005656.definition_cn: 由于影响肌肉和软组织的异常导致的足部畸形。相反，如果足部骨骼受到影响，则适用结构性足部畸形的术语。

HP:0005661.name: Salmonella osteomyelitis
HP:0005661.definition: Osteomyelitis caused by infection with the bacteria, salmonella.
HP:0005661.definition_cn: 由沙门氏菌感染引起的骨髓炎。

HP:0005665.name: Massively thickened long bone cortices
HP:0005665.definition: Extreme thickening of the cortex of long bones.

HP:0005667.name: Os odontoideum
HP:0005667.definition: Separation of the odontoid process from the body of the axis.

HP:0005671.name: Bilateral intracerebral calcifications
HP:0005671.definition: Deposition of calcium salts on both sides of the cerebrum.

HP:0005676.name: Rudimentary postaxial polydactyly of hands
HP:0005676.name_cn: 手部轴后型多指畸形（原始型）

HP:0005679.name: Dupuytren contracture
HP:0005679.definition: An abnormality of the hand resulting from contracture of the palmar fascia with a fixed flexion deformity of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints and the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints.
HP:0005679.definition_cn: 由于掌筋膜挛缩导致掌指关节（MCP）和近端指间关节（PIP）固定屈曲畸形的手部异常。

HP:0005680.name: Tongue-like lumbar vertebral deformities
HP:0005680.definition: A tongue-like protusion from the anterior aspect of lumbar vertebral bodies.
HP:0005680.definition_cn: 腰椎椎体前缘舌状突起。

HP:0005684.name: Distal arthrogryposis
HP:0005684.definition: An inherited primary limb malformation disorder characterized by congenital contractures of two or more different body areas and without primary neurologic and/or muscle disease that affects limb function.
HP:0005684.definition_cn: 一种遗传性原发性肢体畸形疾病，其特征为两个或更多不同身体区域的先天性挛缩，且无影响肢体功能的原发性神经系统和/或肌肉疾病。

HP:0005686.name: Patchy osteosclerosis
HP:0005686.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0005686.definition_cn: 斑片状（不规则）骨密度增高。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可呈现多种形态。

HP:0005688.name: Dysplastic distal thumb phalanges with a central hole
HP:0005688.name_cn: 发育不良的远端拇指指骨伴中央孔

HP:0005694.name: Partial fusion of proximal row of carpal bones

HP:0005696.name: Postaxial polydactyly type A
HP:0005696.definition: Supernumerary digits located at the ulnar side of the hand with a complete extra finger and extra metacarpal.
HP:0005696.definition_cn: 位于手部尺侧的多指畸形，伴有一根完整的额外手指及额外的掌骨。

HP:0005700.name: Increased bone density with cystic changes
HP:0005700.name_cn: 骨密度增高伴囊性改变

HP:0005707.name: Bilateral triphalangeal thumbs
HP:0005707.definition: A bilateral form of triphalangeal thumb.

HP:0005720.name: Shortening of all metacarpals
HP:0005720.definition: Abnormal reduction in length of all metacarpal bones.
HP:0005720.definition_cn: 所有掌骨长度异常缩短。

HP:0005722.name: Hyperextensible thumb
HP:0005722.definition: The ability of the thumb joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

HP:0005725.name: Nonopposable triphalangeal thumb
HP:0005725.definition: A form of triphalangeal thumb that cannot be placed opposite the fingers of the same hand.
HP:0005725.definition_cn: 一种三节拇指畸形，无法与同侧手指对掌。

HP:0005726.name: Thumbs hypoplastic with bulbous tips
HP:0005726.name_cn: 拇指发育不全伴杵状指

HP:0005731.name: Cortical irregularity
HP:0005731.definition: An abnormal irregularity of cortical bone.

HP:0005733.name: Spinal stenosis with reduced interpedicular distance
HP:0005733.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the spinal canal related to a reduction in the interpedicular distance (i.e., the distance measured between the pedicles on frontal [coronal] imaging).
HP:0005733.name_cn: 椎管狭窄伴椎弓根间距减小
HP:0005733.definition_cn: 与椎弓根间距（即在正面[冠状]成像上测量的椎弓根之间的距离）减小相关的椎管异常狭窄。

HP:0005736.name: Short tibia
HP:0005736.definition_cn: 胫骨发育不全（尺寸减小）。

HP:0005739.name: Posterior subluxation of radial head
HP:0005739.definition: Partial dislocation of the head of the radius in the posterior direction.

HP:0005743.name: Avascular necrosis of the capital femoral epiphysis
HP:0005743.definition: Avascular necrosis of the proximal epiphysis of the femur occurring in growing children and caused by an interruption of the blood supply to the head of the femur close to the hip joint. The necrosis is characteristically associated with flattening of the femoral head, for which reason the term coxa plana has been used to refer to this feature in the medical literature.
HP:0005743.name_cn: 股骨头骨骺缺血性坏死
HP:0005743.definition_cn: 发生于生长中儿童的股骨近端骨骺缺血性坏死，由靠近髋关节的股骨头血供中断引起。该坏死特征性地与股骨头扁平化相关，因此在医学文献中使用术语“扁平髋”来指代这一特征。

HP:0005744.name: obsolete Generalized osteoporosis with pathologic fractures
HP:0005744.name_cn: 陈旧性全身性骨质疏松伴病理性骨折

HP:0005746.name: Osteosclerosis of the base of the skull
HP:0005746.definition: An increase in bone density affecting the basicranium (base of the skull).

HP:0005747.name: Easily subluxated first metacarpophalangeal joints
HP:0005747.name_cn: 易发生半脱位的第一掌指关节

HP:0005750.name: Lower-limb joint contracture
HP:0005750.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint of the lower limb resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin.
HP:0005750.definition_cn: 下肢关节被动活动范围受限，由于非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊或皮肤）的结构性改变导致关节周围组织弹性丧失所致。

HP:0005756.name: Neonatal epiphyseal stippling
HP:0005756.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more epiphyses during the neonatal period.
HP:0005756.definition_cn: 新生儿期一个或多个骨骺出现异常点状（斑点状、点样）钙化。

HP:0005758.name: Basilar impression
HP:0005758.definition: Abnormal elevation of the floor of the posterior fossa including occipital condyles and foramen magnum.
HP:0005758.definition_cn: 后颅窝底异常抬高，包括枕骨髁和枕骨大孔。

HP:0005759.name: Small flat posterior fossa
HP:0005759.definition: An abnormally small and flat configuration of the posterior cranial fossa.
HP:0005759.definition_cn: 后颅窝异常狭小且扁平。

HP:0005768.name: 2-4 toe cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0005768.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 2, 3, and 4.
HP:0005768.definition_cn: 第2、3、4趾间在前后轴上的软组织连续性。

HP:0005769.name: Fifth finger distal phalanx clinodactyly
HP:0005769.definition: Bending or curvature of the distal phalanx of little finger in the radial direction (i.e., towards the 4th finger).
HP:0005769.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨弯曲畸形
HP:0005769.definition_cn: 小指远节指骨向桡侧（即朝向第四指）弯曲或成角畸形。

HP:0005772.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tibia
HP:0005772.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the tibia.
HP:0005772.name_cn: 胫骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0005773.name: Short forearm
HP:0005773.definition: Underdevelopment of both forearm bones, the ulna and the radius, resulting in a shortened forearm.
HP:0005773.definition_cn: 前臂双骨发育不全，包括尺骨和桡骨，导致前臂缩短。

HP:0005780.name: Absent fourth finger distal interphalangeal crease
HP:0005780.definition: Absence of the distal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fourth finger.
HP:0005780.name_cn: 第四指远侧指间皱褶缺失
HP:0005780.definition_cn: 第四指远端指间关节屈曲皱褶缺失。

HP:0005787.name: Lumbar platyspondyly
HP:0005787.definition: A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates affecting the lumbar spine.
HP:0005787.definition_cn: 腰椎椎体扁平化伴椎体终板间距减小。

HP:0005789.name: Generalized osteosclerosis
HP:0005789.definition: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density with generalized involvement of the skeleton.
HP:0005789.definition_cn: 骨骼广泛受累的骨矿物质密度异常增高。

HP:0005791.name: Cortical thickening of long bone diaphyses
HP:0005791.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the diaphyseal region of long bones.
HP:0005791.definition_cn: 长骨骨干区域皮质异常增厚。

HP:0005793.name: Shortening of all distal phalanges of the toes
HP:0005793.definition: Abnormally short distal phalanx of toe of all toes.
HP:0005793.name_cn: 所有足趾远端指骨缩短
HP:0005793.definition_cn: 所有足趾远端指骨异常短缩。

HP:0005798.name: Posterior radial head dislocation
HP:0005798.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an posterior direction.
HP:0005798.definition_cn: 桡骨头从肘关节窝向后方向脱位。

HP:0005807.name: Absent distal phalanges
HP:0005807.definition_cn: 远端指骨发育不全（缺失）。

HP:0005815.name: Supernumerary ribs
HP:0005815.definition: The presence of more than 12 rib pairs.

HP:0005817.name: Postaxial polysyndactyly of foot
HP:0005817.definition: Combined syndactyly and polydactyly of the foot on the lateral side (i.e., on the side of the little toe).
HP:0005817.name_cn: 足部轴后多指并指畸形
HP:0005817.definition_cn: 足外侧（即小趾侧）并指畸形合并多指畸形。

HP:0005819.name: Short middle phalanx of finger
HP:0005819.definition: Short (hypoplastic) middle phalanx of finger, affecting one or more fingers.
HP:0005819.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨短小（发育不全），累及一个或多个手指。

HP:0005824.name: Clinodactyly of the 2nd toe
HP:0005824.definition: Bending or curvature of a second toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).
HP:0005824.definition_cn: 第二趾向胫侧方向（即朝向拇趾）弯曲或成角畸形。

HP:0005825.name: Mixed sclerosis of humeral metaphyses
HP:0005825.name_cn: 肱骨干骺端混合性硬化症

HP:0005830.name: Flexion contracture of toe
HP:0005830.definition: One or more bent (flexed) toe joints that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0005830.definition_cn: 一个或多个趾关节屈曲畸形，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0005832.name: Dysharmonic delayed bone age
HP:0005832.definition: A type of dysharmonic skeletal maturation in which there is a delay in skeletal maturation whose degree differs markedly in different bones.
HP:0005832.definition_cn: 一种骨骼成熟不协调的类型，表现为骨骼成熟延迟，且不同骨骼的延迟程度显著不同。

HP:0005833.name: obsolete Joint swelling onset late infancy
HP:0005833.name_cn: 过时性关节肿胀，晚婴期发病

HP:0005834.name: obsolete Thumbs hypo/aplastic
HP:0005834.name_cn: 拇指发育不全/拇指缺失

HP:0005837.name: obsolete Joint dislocations in young adult

HP:0005841.name: Calcific stippling of infantile cartilaginous skeleton
HP:0005841.name_cn: 婴儿软骨骨骼钙化斑点

HP:0005844.name: Rounded middle phalanx of finger
HP:0005844.definition: An abnormally round shape of the middle phalanx of the finger.
HP:0005844.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨异常圆形形态。

HP:0005848.name: obsolete Bifid thumb distal phalanx
HP:0005848.name_cn: 废弃的双拇指远节指骨

HP:0005849.name: Diffuse cerebral calcification
HP:0005849.definition: Generalized deposition of calcium salts within the cerebrum.
HP:0005849.definition_cn: 大脑内钙盐的广泛沉积。

HP:0005852.name: Limited elbow extension and supination
HP:0005852.name_cn: 肘关节伸展和旋后受限

HP:0005855.name: Multiple prenatal fractures
HP:0005855.definition: The presence of bone fractures in the prenatal period that are diagnosed at birth or before.
HP:0005855.definition_cn: 产前骨折在出生时或出生前被诊断出的存在。

HP:0005856.name: Ulnar radial head dislocation
HP:0005856.definition: A dislocation of the head of the radius from its socket in the elbow joint in an ulnar direction.
HP:0005856.definition_cn: 桡骨头向尺侧方向从肘关节窝中脱位。

HP:0005863.name: Type E brachydactyly
HP:0005863.definition: In type E brachydactyly, shortening of the fingers is mainly in the metacarpals and metatarsals.
HP:0005863.definition_cn: 在E型短指症中，手指的缩短主要发生在掌骨和跖骨。

HP:0005864.name: Pseudoarthrosis
HP:0005864.definition: A pathologic entity characterized by a developmental defect in a long bone leading to bending and pathologic fracture, with inability to form a normal bony callus with subsequent fibrous nonunion, leading to the pseudarthrosis (or \
HP:0005864.definition_cn: 一种病理实体，其特征为长骨发育缺陷导致弯曲和病理性骨折，无法形成正常骨痂，随后发生纤维性不愈合，最终导致假关节形成（或称“假关节”）。

HP:0005866.name: Opposable triphalangeal thumb
HP:0005866.definition: A form of triphalangeal thumb that can be placed opposite the fingers of the same hand.
HP:0005866.definition_cn: 一种三节拇指畸形，可对置于同侧手指。

HP:0005867.name: 4-5 metacarpal synostosis
HP:0005867.name_cn: 第四至第五掌骨骨性连接

HP:0005868.name: Metaphyseal enchondromatosis
HP:0005868.definition: An enchondroma is a benign growth of cartilage that develops within the medullary cavity of bone. Enchondromatosis refers to the presence of multiple enchondromas, and this term refers to the presence of multiple enchondromas within the medulla of metaphyseal bone. Radiographically an enchondroma presents a an oval, linear, or pyramidal osteolytic (radiolucent) lesion with well defined margins.
HP:0005868.definition_cn: 内生软骨瘤是一种良性软骨增生，发生于骨髓腔内。内生软骨瘤病是指存在多个内生软骨瘤，该术语特指干骺端骨髓内存在多个内生软骨瘤。影像学上，内生软骨瘤表现为椭圆形、线性或锥形的溶骨性（透亮）病变，边缘清晰。

HP:0005871.name: Metaphyseal chondrodysplasia
HP:0005871.definition: An abnormality of skeletal development characterized by a disturbance of the metaphysis and its histological structure with relatively normal epiphyses and vertebrae.
HP:0005871.definition_cn: 一种骨骼发育异常，其特征为干骺端及其组织学结构紊乱，而骨骺和椎体相对正常。

HP:0005872.name: Brachytelomesophalangy
HP:0005872.definition: Disproportionately short middle and distal phalanges compared to the hand/foot.
HP:0005872.definition_cn: 与手/足相比，中节指骨和远节指骨长度不成比例地缩短。

HP:0005873.name: Polysyndactyly of hallux
HP:0005873.definition: Combined syndactyly and polydactyly of the great toe.
HP:0005873.definition_cn: 大趾并指多指畸形综合征。

HP:0005876.name: Progressive flexion contractures
HP:0005876.definition_cn: 进行性加重的关节挛缩。

HP:0005878.name: Enlarged sagittal diameter of the cervical canal

HP:0005879.name: Congenital finger flexion contractures
HP:0005879.definition: Multiple bent (flexed) finger joints that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0005879.definition_cn: 多发性屈曲指关节，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0005880.name: Metacarpophalangeal synostosis
HP:0005880.definition: Fusion of a metacarpal bone with the proximal phalanx of the finger distal to it across the corresponding metacarpophalangeal joint.
HP:0005880.definition_cn: 掌骨与远端指骨近节指骨通过相应的掌指关节融合。

HP:0005885.name: Absent ossification of cervical vertebral bodies
HP:0005885.definition: A lack of bone mineralization of one or more body of cervical vertebra.
HP:0005885.definition_cn: 一个或多个颈椎体骨矿化不足。

HP:0005886.name: Aphalangy of the hands
HP:0005886.definition: Absence of a digit or of one or more phalanges of a finger.
HP:0005886.definition_cn: 指骨缺失或手指一个或多个指节缺失。

HP:0005890.name: Hyperostosis cranialis interna
HP:0005890.definition: Bony overgrowth of the internal (endosteal) surface of the calvaria and the base of skull.
HP:0005890.definition_cn: 颅骨内板（内骨膜）表面及颅底骨质增生。

HP:0005891.name: Progressive forearm bowing
HP:0005891.definition: Progressive bending or abnormal curvature of the forearm skeleton.
HP:0005891.definition_cn: 前臂骨骼进行性弯曲或异常曲度。

HP:0005892.name: Proximal tibial and fibular fusion
HP:0005892.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the abnormal fusion of the proximal tibia and fibula.
HP:0005892.name_cn: 胫骨近端与腓骨融合术
HP:0005892.definition_cn: 胫腓骨近端异常融合的发育缺陷。

HP:0005894.name: Double first metacarpals
HP:0005894.definition: Duplication of the metacarpal I bones.

HP:0005895.name: Radial deviation of thumb terminal phalanx
HP:0005895.name_cn: 拇指末节指骨桡侧偏斜

HP:0005897.name: Severe generalized osteoporosis
HP:0005897.name_cn: 重度全身性骨质疏松症

HP:0005899.name: obsolete Metaphyseal dysostosis
HP:0005899.name_cn: 陈旧性干骺端发育不良

HP:0005900.name: Fifth metacarpal with ulnar notch
HP:0005900.definition: Presence of an angular or V -shaped indentation on the ulnar side of the fifth metacarpal bone (i.e., on the sides towards the fifth finger).
HP:0005900.definition_cn: 第五掌骨尺侧（即朝向第五指的一侧）存在角状或V形凹陷。

HP:0005901.name: obsolete Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis
HP:0005901.name_cn: 陈旧性慢性复发性多灶性骨髓炎

HP:0005905.name: Abnormal cervical curvature
HP:0005905.definition: The presence of an abnormal curvature of the cervical vertebral column.

HP:0005906.name: Delayed pneumatization of the mastoid process
HP:0005906.definition: An abnormally reduced degree of pneumatization (i.e., formation of air cells) in the mastoid process with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0005906.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，乳突气化程度异常降低（即气房形成减少）。

HP:0005910.name: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th finger middle phalanx
HP:0005910.definition: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th (little) finger middle phalanx.
HP:0005910.name_cn: 菱形或三角形第五指中节指骨
HP:0005910.definition_cn: 菱形或三角形的第五指（小指）中节指骨。

HP:0005914.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the metacarpal bones
HP:0005914.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the metacarpal bones.
HP:0005914.name_cn: 掌骨发育不全/掌骨发育不良
HP:0005914.definition_cn: 掌骨发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0005916.name: Abnormal metacarpal morphology
HP:0005916.definition: Any abnormal shape or structure of the metacarpal bones.

HP:0005917.name: Supernumerary metacarpal bones
HP:0005917.definition: The presence of more than the normal number of metacarpal bones.
HP:0005917.definition_cn: 掌骨数目过多（Polydactyly of the metacarpals）

HP:0005918.name: Abnormal finger phalanx morphology
HP:0005918.definition: Abnormalities affecting the phalanx of finger.
HP:0005918.definition_cn: 影响指骨（phalanx of finger）的异常病变。

HP:0005920.name: Abnormal epiphysis morphology of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0005920.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand. Note that this includes the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal. In contrast to the metacarpals 2-5, the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5 (whereas the proximal phalanx of the thumb is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits).
HP:0005920.name_cn: 手部指骨骨骺形态异常
HP:0005920.definition_cn: 手部指骨骨骺一处或多处异常。需注意，此异常包括第一掌骨的骨骺。与第二至第五掌骨不同，第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此其等同于第二至第五指近节指骨（而拇指的近节指骨则等同于其他手指的中节指骨）。

HP:0005921.name: obsolete Abnormal ossification of hand bones

HP:0005922.name: Abnormal hand morphology
HP:0005922.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hand.

HP:0005924.name: Abnormal hand epiphysis morphology
HP:0005924.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphyses of the phalanges or metacarpal bones.
HP:0005924.definition_cn: 指骨或掌骨骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0005926.name: Abnormal hand cortical bone morphology
HP:0005926.definition: An anomaly of the outer shell (cortex) of a hand bone.

HP:0005927.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the hand
HP:0005927.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the bones of the hand.
HP:0005927.name_cn: 手骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0005927.definition_cn: 手部骨骼缺失（由于形成障碍）或发育不全。

HP:0005930.name: Abnormal epiphysis morphology
HP:0005930.definition: An anomaly of epiphysis, which is the expanded articular end of a long bone that developes from a secondary ossification center, and which during the period of growth is either entirely cartilaginous or is separated from the shaft by a cartilaginous disk.
HP:0005930.definition_cn: 骨骺异常，即长骨扩展的关节端，由次级骨化中心发育而来，在生长期间完全为软骨或通过软骨盘与骨干分离。

HP:0005932.name: Abnormal renal corticomedullary differentiation
HP:0005932.definition: An abnormality of corticomedullary differentiation (CMD) on diagnostic imaging such as magnetic resonance imaging, computer tomography, or sonography. CMD is a difference in the visualization of cortex and medulla.
HP:0005932.definition_cn: 在磁共振成像、计算机断层扫描或超声检查等诊断影像中出现的皮质髓质分界异常（CMD）。CMD是指皮质和髓质在影像学上的显像差异。

HP:0005938.name: Abnormal respiratory motile cilium morphology
HP:0005938.definition: Abnormal arrangement of the structures of the motile cilium.
HP:0005938.name_cn: 异常呼吸运动纤毛形态
HP:0005938.definition_cn: 运动纤毛结构异常排列。

HP:0005941.name: Intermittent hyperpnea at rest
HP:0005941.name_cn: 静息时阵发性呼吸过度

HP:0005942.name: Desquamative interstitial pneumonitis
HP:0005942.definition: Diffuse filling of the distal airspaces of the lungs, the alveoli, with macrophages. Desquamative interstitial pneumonitis (DIP) is characterized additionally by thickened alveolar septa and by a sparse inflammatory infiltrate that often includes plasma cells and occasional eosinophils. The alveoli are lined by plump cuboidal pneumocytes. Lymphoid aggregates may be present.
HP:0005942.definition_cn: 肺部远端气腔（肺泡）弥漫性充满巨噬细胞。脱屑性间质性肺炎（DIP）的特征还包括肺泡间隔增厚以及稀疏的炎性浸润，通常包括浆细胞和偶见的嗜酸性粒细胞。肺泡内衬肥大的立方状肺泡上皮细胞。可能存在淋巴样聚集。

HP:0005944.name: Bilateral lung agenesis
HP:0005944.definition: Bilateral lack of development of the lungs.

HP:0005945.name: Laryngeal obstruction
HP:0005945.definition: Blockage of the upper airway at the level of the larynx often accompanied by respiratory distress.
HP:0005945.definition_cn: 喉部水平上呼吸道阻塞常伴呼吸窘迫。

HP:0005946.name: Ventilator dependence with inability to wean
HP:0005946.name_cn: 呼吸机依赖且无法脱机

HP:0005947.name: Decreased sensitivity to hypoxemia
HP:0005947.definition: Reduced tendency to respond to a reduced concentration of oxygen in the blood by increasing respiration.
HP:0005947.definition_cn: 对血液中氧浓度降低的呼吸反应倾向减弱。

HP:0005948.name: Multiple pulmonary cysts
HP:0005948.definition: The presence of multiple lung cysts.

HP:0005949.name: Apneic episodes in infancy
HP:0005949.definition: Recurrent episodes of apnea occurring during infancy.
HP:0005949.definition_cn: 婴儿期反复发作的呼吸暂停。

HP:0005950.name: Laryngeal web
HP:0005950.definition: A membrane-like structure that extends across the laryngeal lumen close to the level of the vocal cords.
HP:0005950.definition_cn: 一种膜状结构，延伸至喉腔内，接近声带水平。

HP:0005956.name: Anteroposteriorly shortened larynx
HP:0005956.definition: Abnormal shortening of the larynx in the anteroposterior (front to back) axis.

HP:0005961.name: Hypoargininemia
HP:0005961.definition: A decreased concentration of arginine in the blood.

HP:0005967.name: Mixed respiratory and metabolic acidosis
HP:0005967.name_cn: 混合性呼吸性和代谢性酸中毒

HP:0005968.name: Temperature instability
HP:0005968.definition: Disordered thermoregulation characterized by an impaired ability to maintain a balance between heat production and heat loss, with resulting instability of body temperature.
HP:0005968.definition_cn: 体温调节障碍，其特征为维持产热与散热之间平衡的能力受损，导致体温不稳定。

HP:0005972.name: Respiratory acidosis
HP:0005972.definition: Acidosis because of respiratory retention of carbon dioxide.
HP:0005972.definition_cn: 由于二氧化碳呼吸滞留导致的酸中毒。

HP:0005973.name: Fructose intolerance
HP:0005973.definition: Reduced intestinal absorption of fructose. Breath testing after ingestion of fructose has been widely adopted as a standard method of identifying fructose malabsorption and intolerance. A dose of 25 g of fructose dissolved in a 10% solution is generally accepted as the appropriate dose of fructose for clinical use of H2 and CH4 breath testing. High levels of hydrogen in exhaled breath subsequent hours indicate fructose intolerance. Presence of malabsorption and reproduction of symptoms during a breath test provides the best objective evidence and symptom correlation for fructose intolerance.
HP:0005973.definition_cn: 果糖肠道吸收减少。摄入果糖后的呼气试验已被广泛采用为识别果糖吸收不良和果糖不耐受的标准方法。通常认为，将25克果糖溶解于10%溶液中作为临床使用的H2和CH4呼气试验的适当剂量。随后几小时内呼出气体中高水平的氢气表明存在果糖不耐受。在呼气试验期间出现吸收不良和症状再现为果糖不耐受提供了最佳的客观证据和症状相关性。

HP:0005974.name: Episodic ketoacidosis
HP:0005974.definition_cn: 间歇性酮症酸中毒发作。

HP:0005978.name: Type II diabetes mellitus
HP:0005978.definition: A type of diabetes mellitus initially characterized by insulin resistance and hyperinsulinemia and subsequently by glucose interolerance and hyperglycemia.
HP:0005978.definition_cn: 一种糖尿病类型，最初以胰岛素抵抗和高胰岛素血症为特征，随后发展为葡萄糖耐受不良和高血糖症。

HP:0005979.name: Metabolic ketoacidosis
HP:0005979.definition: A metabolic acidosis due to accumulation of ketone bodies generally observed in the setting of poor nutritional intake.
HP:0005979.definition_cn: 由于酮体积累导致的代谢性酸中毒，通常见于营养摄入不足的情况下。

HP:0005982.name: Reduced phenylalanine hydroxylase level
HP:0005982.name_cn: 苯丙氨酸羟化酶水平降低
HP:0005982.definition_cn: 苯丙氨酸4-单加氧酶水平降低。

HP:0005984.name: obsolete Elevated maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein
HP:0005984.name_cn: 过时的母体血清甲胎蛋白升高

HP:0005987.name: Multinodular goiter
HP:0005987.definition: Enlargement of the thyroid gland related to multiple nodules in the thyroid gland.
HP:0005987.definition_cn: 甲状腺肿大伴多发性甲状腺结节。

HP:0005988.name: Congenital muscular torticollis
HP:0005988.definition: A congenital form of torticollis resulting from shortening of the sternocleidomastoid muscle and leading to a limited range of motion in both rotation and lateral bending.
HP:0005988.definition_cn: 先天性斜颈，由于胸锁乳突肌缩短导致旋转和侧屈运动范围受限。

HP:0005989.name: Redundant neck skin
HP:0005989.definition: Excess skin around the neck, often lying in horizontal folds.
HP:0005989.definition_cn: 颈部皮肤冗余，常呈水平皱褶状。

HP:0005990.name: Thyroid hypoplasia
HP:0005990.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the thyroid gland.

HP:0005991.name: Limited neck flexion
HP:0005991.definition: Reduced ability to lower the chin towards the chest by bending the neck.
HP:0005991.definition_cn: 颈部屈曲时下颌向胸部靠近的能力减弱。

HP:0005994.name: Nodular goiter
HP:0005994.definition: Enlargement of the thyroid gland related to one or more nodules in the thyroid gland.
HP:0005994.definition_cn: 甲状腺肿大与甲状腺内一个或多个结节相关。

HP:0005995.name: Decreased adipose tissue around neck
HP:0005995.definition: Reduced amount of adipose tissue in the region of the neck.
HP:0005995.definition_cn: 颈部区域脂肪组织减少。

HP:0005999.name: Ureteral atresia
HP:0005999.definition: A developmental defect defined by the failure of the formation of the lumen (tube) of the ureter.
HP:0005999.definition_cn: 输尿管管腔形成障碍性发育缺陷。

HP:0006000.name: Ureteral obstruction
HP:0006000.definition: Obstruction of the flow of urine through the ureter.

HP:0006006.name: Hypotrophy of the small hand muscles

HP:0006009.name: Broad phalanx
HP:0006009.definition: Increased side-to-side width of one or more phalanges of the fingers or toes.
HP:0006009.definition_cn: 指（趾）骨一侧或多侧宽度增加。

HP:0006011.name: Cuboidal metacarpal
HP:0006011.definition: Severely shortened metacarpal with a cuboidal appearance.
HP:0006011.definition_cn: 严重缩短的掌骨，呈立方体状外观。

HP:0006016.name: Delayed phalangeal epiphyseal ossification
HP:0006016.definition: Delay in the process of formation and maturation of the epiphysis of one or more phalanx.
HP:0006016.definition_cn: 一个或多个指骨骨骺形成和成熟过程延迟。

HP:0006019.name: Reduced proximal interphalangeal joint space
HP:0006019.name_cn: 近端指间关节间隙变窄

HP:0006028.name: Metaphyseal cupping of metacarpals
HP:0006028.definition: Metaphyseal cupping affecting the metacarpal bones.

HP:0006035.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of phalanges 2 to 5
HP:0006035.name_cn: 第2至第5指骨的锥形骨骺

HP:0006042.name: Y-shaped metacarpals
HP:0006042.definition: Y-shaped metacarpals are the result of a partial fusion of two metacarpal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metacarpals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.
HP:0006042.definition_cn: Y形掌骨是由于两块掌骨部分融合所致，Y形的两臂向远端方向延伸。Y形掌骨可能伴有多指畸形。

HP:0006048.name: Distal widening of metacarpals
HP:0006048.definition: Abnormal increase in width of the distal region of the metacarpal bones.
HP:0006048.definition_cn: 掌骨远端区域宽度异常增大。

HP:0006059.name: Cone-shaped metacarpal epiphyses
HP:0006059.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the metacarpal bones, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphyses are located at the distal ends of the metacarpal bones.
HP:0006059.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝状”外观。这些骨骺位于掌骨的远端。

HP:0006067.name: Multiple carpal ossification centers
HP:0006067.definition: A delay in the process of formation and maturation of the epiphysis of one or more long bones.
HP:0006067.definition_cn: 一个或多个长骨骨骺形成和成熟过程的延迟。

HP:0006069.name: obsolete Severe carpal ossification delay
HP:0006069.name_cn: 陈旧性严重腕骨骨化延迟

HP:0006070.name: Metacarpophalangeal joint contracture
HP:0006070.definition: A chronic loss of joint motion in metacarpophalangeal joints due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement.
HP:0006070.definition_cn: 由于肌肉、肌腱、韧带或皮肤的结构性改变导致掌指关节正常运动受限的慢性关节活动丧失。

HP:0006077.name: Absent proximal finger flexion creases
HP:0006077.definition: Absence of the proximal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fingers.
HP:0006077.definition_cn: 近端指间关节屈曲皱褶缺失。

HP:0006092.name: Malaligned carpal bone
HP:0006092.definition: Malalignement of carpal bone angles either with respect to each other, to the corresponding metacarpals or with respect to the wrist (radius and ulna).
HP:0006092.definition_cn: 腕骨角度相对于彼此、相对于相应的掌骨或相对于腕部（桡骨和尺骨）的排列不良。

HP:0006095.name: Wide tufts of distal phalanges
HP:0006095.name_cn: 远端指骨宽大簇状突起

HP:0006097.name: 3-4 finger osseus syndactyly
HP:0006097.definition: Fusion of the third (middle) and fourth (ring) finger, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones.
HP:0006097.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）与第四指（环指）的并指畸形，累及软组织并包括指骨的融合。

HP:0006099.name: Metacarpophalangeal joint hyperextensibility
HP:0006099.definition: Increased mobility of one ore more metacarpophalangeal joint.
HP:0006099.definition_cn: 一个或多个掌指关节活动度增加。

HP:0006101.name: Finger syndactyly
HP:0006101.definition: Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as \
HP:0006101.definition_cn: 指蹼或手指融合，仅涉及软组织或包括骨结构。骨性融合被称为“骨性并指”。

HP:0006107.name: Fingerpad telangiectases
HP:0006107.definition: Telangiectasia (small dilated blood vessels) located in the fingerpads at the tips of the fingers.
HP:0006107.definition_cn: 位于指尖指垫处的毛细血管扩张症（微小扩张的血管）。

HP:0006108.name: Tapered metacarpals
HP:0006108.definition: Metacarpal that becomes thinner toward the distal end.
HP:0006108.definition_cn: 向远端逐渐变细的掌骨。

HP:0006109.name: Absent phalangeal crease
HP:0006109.definition: Absence of one or more interphalangeal creases (i.e., of the transverse lines in the skin between the phalanges of the fingers).
HP:0006109.definition_cn: 指间皱褶缺失（即手指指骨间皮肤横纹的缺失）。

HP:0006110.name: Shortening of all middle phalanges of the fingers
HP:0006110.definition: Short, hypoplastic middle phalanx of finger, affecting all fingers.
HP:0006110.name_cn: 所有手指中节指骨短缩
HP:0006110.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨短小、发育不全，累及所有手指。

HP:0006112.name: Expanded phalanges with widened medullary cavities

HP:0006114.name: Multiple palmar creases
HP:0006114.definition: The presence of multiple creases on the palm of the hand (more than the normal three major creases (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, and thenar crease).
HP:0006114.definition_cn: 手掌出现多条皱褶（超过正常的三条主要皱褶：远端横纹、近端横纹和鱼际皱褶）。

HP:0006118.name: Shortening of all distal phalanges of the fingers
HP:0006118.definition: Hypoplasia of all of the distal phalanx of finger.
HP:0006118.name_cn: 所有手指远端指骨缩短
HP:0006118.definition_cn: 手指远节指骨发育不全。

HP:0006119.name: Proximal tapering of metacarpals
HP:0006119.definition: Some or all of the metacarpal bones (i.e., metacarpal II to V) have a pointed proximal appearance.
HP:0006119.definition_cn: 部分或全部掌骨（即第二至第五掌骨）的近端呈现尖状外观。

HP:0006121.name: Acral ulceration
HP:0006121.definition: A type of digital ulcer that manifests as an open sore on the surface of the skin at the tip of a finger or toe.
HP:0006121.definition_cn: 一种表现为指端或趾端皮肤表面开放性溃疡的数字化溃疡类型。

HP:0006127.name: Long proximal phalanx of finger
HP:0006127.definition: Increased length of the proximal phalanx of finger.
HP:0006127.definition_cn: 手指近节指骨长度增加。

HP:0006129.name: Drumstick terminal phalanges
HP:0006129.definition: Rounding and broadening of the tufts of the distal phalanges.
HP:0006129.definition_cn: 远端指骨簇的圆钝化和增宽。

HP:0006134.name: Enlarged metacarpal epiphyses
HP:0006134.definition: Abnormally large size of one or more growth plates (epiphyses) of the metacarpal bones (i.e., the tubular bones of the hand between the carpus and the phalanges).
HP:0006134.definition_cn: 掌骨（即位于腕骨与指骨之间的手部管状骨）的一个或多个生长板（骨骺）异常增大。

HP:0006140.name: Premature fusion of phalangeal epiphyses
HP:0006140.definition: Fusion of the epiphysis and metaphysis of one or more phalanges prior to the normal age or stage of growth.
HP:0006140.definition_cn: 一个或多个指骨的骨骺与干骺端在正常年龄或生长阶段之前发生融合。

HP:0006143.name: Abnormal finger flexion crease
HP:0006143.definition: Anomalous flexion crease (i.e., a transverse line that crosses the skin of a finger).
HP:0006143.definition_cn: 异常屈曲皱褶（即横跨手指皮肤的横向线）。

HP:0006144.name: Shortening of all proximal phalanges of the fingers
HP:0006144.definition: Congenital hypoplasia of proximal phalanx of finger or all fingers.
HP:0006144.name_cn: 所有手指近节指骨缩短
HP:0006144.definition_cn: 先天性手指或全指近节指骨发育不全。

HP:0006145.name: Central Y-shaped metacarpal
HP:0006145.definition: A central Y-shaped metacarpal is the result of a partial fusion of two central metacarpals (i.e., metacarpals 2-4) of the hand, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Central Y-shaped metacarpals may be seen as a result of a central polydactyly with partial fusion of the duplicated metacarpal.
HP:0006145.definition_cn: 中央Y形掌骨是由于手部中央掌骨（即第2至第4掌骨）部分融合所致，Y形的两个臂指向远端方向。中央Y形掌骨可能是由于中央多指畸形伴重复掌骨部分融合的结果。

HP:0006146.name: Broad metacarpal epiphyses
HP:0006146.definition: Increased side-to-side width of the metacarpal epiphyses.
HP:0006146.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺横向宽度增加。

HP:0006147.name: Progressive fusion 2nd-5th pip joints
HP:0006147.name_cn: 第二至第五近端指间关节进行性融合

HP:0006150.name: Swan neck-like deformities of the fingers
HP:0006150.definition: A swan neck deformity describes a finger with a hyperextended PIP joint and a flexed DIP joint. The most common cause for a swan neck-like deformity is a disruption of the end of the extensor tendon. Conditions that loosen the PIP joint and allow it to hyperextend, for example conditions that weaken the volar plate, can produce a swan neck deformity of the finger. One example is rheumatoid arthritis. Another cause are conditions that tighten up the small (intrinsic) muscles of the hand and fingers, for example hand trauma or nerve disorders, such as cerebral palsy, Parkinson's disease, or stroke.
HP:0006150.definition_cn: 天鹅颈畸形描述了一种手指，其特征为近端指间关节（PIP）过伸和远端指间关节（DIP）屈曲。天鹅颈样畸形的最常见原因是伸肌腱末端断裂。导致PIP关节松弛并使其过伸的疾病，例如削弱掌侧板的疾病，可能引发手指的天鹅颈畸形。类风湿性关节炎即为其中一例。另一原因是导致手部和手指小（内在）肌肉紧张的情况，例如手部创伤或神经障碍，如脑性瘫痪、帕金森病或中风。

HP:0006152.name: Proximal symphalangism of hands
HP:0006152.definition: The term proximal symphalangism refers to a bony fusion of the middle and proximal phalanges of the digits of the hand, in other words the proximal interphalangeal joint (PIJ) is missing which can be seen either on x-rays or as an absence of the proximal interphalangeal finger creases.
HP:0006152.name_cn: 手部近端指间关节融合症
HP:0006152.definition_cn: 近端指节融合症（Proximal symphalangism）是指手部指骨的中节与近节发生骨性融合，即近端指间关节（Proximal Interphalangeal Joint, PIJ）缺失，这一现象可通过X线检查观察到，或表现为近端指间关节皮纹的缺失。

HP:0006155.name: Long phalanx of finger
HP:0006155.definition: Increased length of multiple or a single phalanx of finger.
HP:0006155.definition_cn: 多指或单指指骨长度增加。

HP:0006156.name: Ulnar deviation of thumb
HP:0006156.definition: Bending or curvature of a thumb towards the ulnar side (towards the ring finger).
HP:0006156.definition_cn: 拇指向尺侧（朝向无名指）弯曲或屈曲。

HP:0006159.name: Mesoaxial hand polydactyly
HP:0006159.definition: The presence of a supernumerary finger (not a thumb) involving the third or fourth metacarpal with associated osseous syndactyly.
HP:0006159.definition_cn: 存在涉及第三或第四掌骨的多指畸形（非拇指）并伴有骨性并指。

HP:0006160.name: Irregular metacarpals
HP:0006160.definition: Irregular morphology of one or more metacarpal bones.
HP:0006160.definition_cn: 一个或多个掌骨形态不规则。

HP:0006161.name: Short metacarpals with rounded proximal ends

HP:0006162.name: Soft tissue swelling of interphalangeal joints

HP:0006169.name: Decreased mobility 3rd-5th fingers
HP:0006169.name_cn: 第三至第五指活动度降低

HP:0006170.name: Chess-pawn distal phalanges
HP:0006170.definition: A morphological abnormality of distal phalanges such that they have the appearance of chess pawns.
HP:0006170.definition_cn: 远端指骨形态学异常，呈现为国际象棋兵卒样外观。

HP:0006172.name: Flattened, squared-off epiphyses of tubular bones

HP:0006174.name: Metacarpal diaphyseal endosteal sclerosis
HP:0006174.definition: Increase in bone density in the diaphyseal (shaft) region of a metacarpal bone.
HP:0006174.definition_cn: 掌骨骨干（骨干）区域骨密度增加。

HP:0006176.name: Two carpal ossification centers present at birth
HP:0006176.name_cn: 出生时存在两个腕骨骨化中心

HP:0006184.name: Decreased palmar creases
HP:0006184.definition: Poorly defined or shallow palmar creases.

HP:0006191.name: Deep palmar crease
HP:0006191.definition: Excessively deep creases of the palm.

HP:0006192.name: Tapered phalanx of finger
HP:0006192.definition: Phalanges of the fingers becoming thinner toward the distal end.

HP:0006193.name: Thimble-shaped middle phalanges of hand
HP:0006193.definition: The middle phalanx of finger resembles a thimble, a small metal cap to protect the finger while sewing that has a broad (proximal) base and narrower top, whereby both base and top are flat.
HP:0006193.name_cn: 手部中节指骨呈套筒状
HP:0006193.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨形似顶针，即一种用于缝纫时保护手指的小金属帽，其具有宽阔的近端基底和较窄的顶部，且基底和顶部均为平坦结构。

HP:0006201.name: Hypermobility of distal interphalangeal joints
HP:0006201.name_cn: 远端指间关节过度活动

HP:0006203.name: Decreased movement range in interphalangeal joints
HP:0006203.name_cn: 指间关节活动范围减小

HP:0006205.name: Irregular phalanges
HP:0006205.definition: Alteration of the normally smooth radiographic contour of phalanges producing an irregular appearance.
HP:0006205.definition_cn: 指骨正常光滑的放射学轮廓改变，呈现不规则外观。

HP:0006206.name: Hypersegmentation of proximal phalanx of second finger
HP:0006206.definition: Presence of an additional phalanx-like bone, producing an extra, wedge-shaped bone at the base of the proximal phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0006206.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨过度分节
HP:0006206.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨基底部存在一额外的指骨样骨，形成一楔形骨。

HP:0006208.name: Metaphyseal cupping of proximal phalanges
HP:0006208.definition: Metaphyseal cupping affecting the proximal phalanges.
HP:0006208.name_cn: 近节指骨干骺端杯状凹陷
HP:0006208.definition_cn: 近节指骨干骺端杯状畸形。

HP:0006209.name: Partial-complete absence of 5th phalanges
HP:0006209.name_cn: 部分至完全性第五指骨缺失

HP:0006213.name: Thin proximal phalanges with broad epiphyses of the hand
HP:0006213.name_cn: 手部近节指骨纤细伴骨骺增宽

HP:0006216.name: Single interphalangeal crease of fifth finger
HP:0006216.definition: Presence of only one (instead of two, as normal) interphalangeal crease of the fifth finger.
HP:0006216.definition_cn: 第五指仅存在一条（而非正常情况下的两条）指间皱褶。

HP:0006217.name: Limited mobility of proximal interphalangeal joint
HP:0006217.name_cn: 近端指间关节活动受限

HP:0006224.name: Tapering pointed ends of distal finger phalanges
HP:0006224.definition: A reduction in diameter of the distal phalanx of finger towards the distal end such that the tip of the phalanx comes to a point (this feature can be observed on radiograms).
HP:0006224.definition_cn: 远端指骨向远端逐渐变细，使得指骨尖端呈锥形（此特征可在X线片上观察到）。

HP:0006226.name: Osteoarthritis of the first carpometacarpal joint
HP:0006226.name_cn: 第一腕掌关节骨关节炎

HP:0006232.name: Expanded metacarpals with widened medullary cavities

HP:0006233.name: Osteoarthritis of the distal interphalangeal joint
HP:0006233.name_cn: 远端指间关节骨关节炎

HP:0006234.name: Osteolysis involving tarsal bones
HP:0006234.definition: An increased resorption of bone matrix by osteoclasts leading to bony defects involving the tarsal bones.
HP:0006234.definition_cn: 破骨细胞导致的骨基质吸收增加，引发累及跗骨的骨缺损。

HP:0006236.name: Slender metacarpals
HP:0006236.definition: Decreased width of the metacarpal bones (that is, reduced diameter).
HP:0006236.definition_cn: 掌骨宽度减少（即直径缩小）。

HP:0006239.name: Shortening of all middle phalanges of the toes
HP:0006239.definition: Abnormal shortening of all middle phalanges of toes.
HP:0006239.name_cn: 所有足趾中节指骨缩短
HP:0006239.definition_cn: 所有足趾中节指骨异常缩短。

HP:0006248.name: Limited wrist movement
HP:0006248.definition: An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the wrist.
HP:0006248.definition_cn: 腕关节活动度异常受限。

HP:0006254.name: Elevated circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
HP:0006254.definition: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0006254.name_cn: 循环中甲胎蛋白浓度升高
HP:0006254.definition_cn: 血清甲胎蛋白浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0006261.name: Abnormal phalangeal joint morphology of the hand
HP:0006261.name_cn: 手部指间关节形态异常

HP:0006262.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 5th finger
HP:0006262.name_cn: 第五指发育不全/第五指发育不良
HP:0006262.definition_cn: 第五指发育不全/发育不良或缺如/发育不全。

HP:0006263.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0006263.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, middle, and distal phalanges of the 2nd finger.
HP:0006263.definition_cn: 第二指近节、中节及远节指骨骨骺一处或多处异常。

HP:0006264.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 2nd finger
HP:0006264.name_cn: 第二指发育不全/发育不良
HP:0006264.definition_cn: 第二指发育不全/发育不良或缺如/发育不全。

HP:0006265.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of fingers
HP:0006265.name_cn: 手指发育不全/手指发育不良
HP:0006265.definition_cn: 小指/指发育不全或缺如/指发育不全。

HP:0006268.name: Fluctuating splenomegaly
HP:0006268.definition: Intermittently increased size of the spleen.

HP:0006273.name: Pancreatic lymphangiectasis
HP:0006273.definition: The presence of lymphangiectasis in the pancreas.

HP:0006274.name: Reduced pancreatic beta cells
HP:0006274.definition: Reduced number of beta cells in the pancreatic islets of Langerhans.

HP:0006278.name: Ectopic pancreatic tissue
HP:0006278.definition: The presence of pancreatic tissue outside the normal pancreas, in many cases along the foregut and proximal midgut.
HP:0006278.definition_cn: 胰腺组织存在于正常胰腺之外，多数情况下沿前肠和近端中肠分布。

HP:0006282.name: Generalized hypoplasia of dental enamel
HP:0006282.definition: A generalized form of developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.
HP:0006282.definition_cn: 牙釉质发育不全的广义形式。

HP:0006283.name: Multiple unerupted teeth
HP:0006283.definition: The presence of multiple embedded tooth germs which have failed to erupt.
HP:0006283.definition_cn: 多发性埋伏牙胚未萌出。

HP:0006285.name: Enamel hypomineralization
HP:0006285.definition: A decreased amount of enamel mineralization. Hypomineralized enamel has a brown discoloration and brittle aspect.
HP:0006285.definition_cn: 釉质矿化减少。矿化不足的釉质呈现棕色变色和脆性特征。

HP:0006288.name: Advanced eruption of teeth
HP:0006288.definition: Premature tooth eruption, which can be defined as tooth eruption more than 2 SD earlier than the mean eruption age.
HP:0006288.definition_cn: 早萌牙，可定义为牙齿萌出时间比平均萌出年龄提前超过2个标准差。

HP:0006289.name: Agenesis of central incisor
HP:0006289.definition: Agenesis of one or more central incisors, i.e., of lower secondary incisor, lower primary incisor, upper secondary incisor, or of upper central primary incisor.
HP:0006289.definition_cn: 一个或多个中切牙的发育不全，即下颌恒中切牙、下颌乳中切牙、上颌恒中切牙或上颌乳中切牙的缺失。

HP:0006290.name: Discolored lateral incisors
HP:0006290.definition: The presence of discolored lateral incisors.

HP:0006291.name: Marked delay in eruption of permanent teeth

HP:0006293.name: Agenesis of maxillary central incisor
HP:0006293.definition: Agenesis of upper secondary incisor or of upper central primary incisor.
HP:0006293.definition_cn: 上颌侧切牙或上颌乳中切牙发育不全。

HP:0006297.name: Enamel hypoplasia
HP:0006297.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.

HP:0006298.name: Prolonged bleeding after dental extraction
HP:0006298.definition: Prolonged bleeding post dental extraction sufficient to require medical intervention.
HP:0006298.definition_cn: 拔牙后持续性出血，需医疗干预。

HP:0006302.name: Dagger-shaped pulp calcifications
HP:0006302.definition: Dagger-shaped calcifications in the dental pulp.

HP:0006313.name: Widely spaced primary teeth
HP:0006313.definition: Increased space between the primary teeth. Note this phenotype should be distinguished from increased space due purely to microdontia.
HP:0006313.definition_cn: 乳牙间隙增大。注意，此表型应与单纯因小牙症导致的间隙增大相鉴别。

HP:0006315.name: Solitary median maxillary central incisor
HP:0006315.definition: A single maxillary central incisor positioned in the midline with morphological symmetry of the crown and bordered by lateral incisors.
HP:0006315.name_cn: 孤立性正中上颌中切牙
HP:0006315.definition_cn: 位于中线的一颗上颌中切牙，牙冠形态对称，两侧由侧切牙邻接。

HP:0006316.name: Irregularly spaced teeth
HP:0006316.definition: Irregular distribution of the teeth along the dental arch, i.e., and irregular spatial pattern of teeth.
HP:0006316.definition_cn: 牙列不齐，即牙齿沿牙弓分布不规则，表现为牙齿空间排列异常。

HP:0006323.name: Premature loss of primary teeth
HP:0006323.definition: Loss of the primary (also known as deciduous) teeth before the usual age.
HP:0006323.definition_cn: 乳牙早失（Premature loss of primary teeth）

HP:0006326.name: Buried teeth encased in mucopolysaccharide
HP:0006326.name_cn: 被粘多糖包裹的埋伏牙

HP:0006329.name: Alveolar process hypoplasia
HP:0006329.definition: Underdevelopment of the alveolar process (also known as alveolar bone).
HP:0006329.definition_cn: 牙槽突发育不全（亦称牙槽骨发育不全）。

HP:0006332.name: Supernumerary maxillary incisor
HP:0006332.definition: The presence of a supernumerary, i.e., extra, maxillary incisor, either the primary maxillary incisor or the permanent maxillary incisor.
HP:0006332.definition_cn: 上颌额外切牙的存在，即上颌切牙的数目异常增多，包括乳上颌切牙或恒上颌切牙。

HP:0006333.name: Crowded maxillary incisors
HP:0006333.definition: A type of dental misalignment with crowded central incisors, i.e., of maxillary secondary incisor, or of maxillary central primary incisor.
HP:0006333.definition_cn: 一种牙列不齐类型，表现为中切牙拥挤，即上颌侧切牙或上颌乳中切牙拥挤。

HP:0006334.name: Hypoplasia of the primary teeth
HP:0006334.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the primary teeth.

HP:0006335.name: Persistence of primary teeth
HP:0006335.definition: Persistence of the primary teeth beyond the age by which they normally are shed and replaced by the permanent teeth.
HP:0006335.definition_cn: 乳牙滞留（Persistence of the primary teeth beyond the age by which they normally are shed and replaced by the permanent teeth.）

HP:0006336.name: Short dental root
HP:0006336.definition: Tooth root length more than 2 SD below mean, or subjectively apparently decreased tooth root length.
HP:0006336.definition_cn: 牙根长度低于平均值2个标准差，或主观上明显牙根长度缩短。

HP:0006337.name: Premature eruption of permanent teeth
HP:0006337.definition: Premature tooth eruption of the permanent dentition.

HP:0006338.name: Malformation of mandibular premolar
HP:0006338.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of secondary premolar tooth.

HP:0006339.name: Conical mandibular incisor
HP:0006339.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of the primary or permanent mandibular incisors.
HP:0006339.definition_cn: 下颌乳切牙或恒切牙的异常锥形形态。

HP:0006342.name: Peg-shaped maxillary lateral incisors
HP:0006342.definition: A tooth crown with its mesial and distal sides converging or tapering toward the incisal edge causing severe reduction of mesiodistal diameter
HP:0006342.definition_cn: 牙冠的近中面和远中面向切缘方向汇聚或逐渐变细，导致近远中径严重减小。

HP:0006344.name: Abnormal primary molar morphology
HP:0006344.definition: An abnormality of morphology of primary molar.

HP:0006346.name: Screwdriver-shaped incisors
HP:0006346.definition: An abnormality of morphology of the incisor tooth in which the tooth is shaped like a screwdriver blade, i.e., having a rhomboid shape.
HP:0006346.definition_cn: 切牙形态异常，表现为牙体呈螺丝刀刀片状，即具有菱形形态。

HP:0006347.name: Microdontia of primary teeth
HP:0006347.definition: Decreased size of the primary teeth.

HP:0006349.name: Agenesis of permanent teeth
HP:0006349.definition: A congenital defect characterized by the absence of one or more permanent teeth, including oligodontia, hypodontia, and adontia of the of permanent teeth.
HP:0006349.definition_cn: 一种先天性缺陷，表现为一个或多个恒牙缺失，包括恒牙的少牙症、缺牙症和无牙症。

HP:0006350.name: Pulp obliteration
HP:0006350.definition: Mineralized substance filling the entire dental pulp space.
HP:0006350.definition_cn: 矿化物质完全充填牙髓腔。

HP:0006352.name: Failure of eruption of permanent teeth
HP:0006352.definition: Lack of tooth eruption of the secondary dentition.

HP:0006353.name: Hypoplasia of the tooth germ
HP:0006353.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the tooth germ, i.e., of the structure that forms in odontogenesis that will develop into a tooth.
HP:0006353.definition_cn: 牙胚发育不全，即在牙发生过程中形成的将发育成牙齿的结构发育不全。

HP:0006355.name: Agenesis of mandibular central incisor
HP:0006355.definition: Agenesis of lower secondary incisor or lower primary incisor.
HP:0006355.definition_cn: 下颌侧切牙或乳切牙发育不全。

HP:0006357.name: Premature loss of permanent teeth
HP:0006357.definition: Premature loss of the permanent teeth.

HP:0006358.name: Shovel-shaped maxillary central incisors
HP:0006358.definition: A tooth with a crown with marked lingual or palatal marginal ridges causing scooped lingual or palatal surfaces.
HP:0006358.definition_cn: 具有显著舌侧或腭侧边缘嵴的冠牙，导致舌侧或腭侧表面凹陷。

HP:0006367.name: Crumpled long bones
HP:0006367.definition: An crumpled radiographic appearance of the long bones, as if the long bone had been crushed together producing irregularities. This feature is the result of multiple fractures and repeated rounds of ineffective healing, as can be seen for instance in severe forms of osteogenesis imperfecta.
HP:0006367.definition_cn: 长骨呈现皱缩的放射影像学表现，仿佛长骨被挤压在一起导致不规则。这一特征是多发性骨折及反复无效愈合的结果，例如在严重类型的成骨不全症中可见。

HP:0006369.name: Irregular patellae
HP:0006369.definition: An alteration of the normally relatively smooth margins of the kneecap in radiographic images leading to an irregular contour.
HP:0006369.definition_cn: 髌骨在放射影像中通常相对平滑的边缘发生改变，导致轮廓不规则。

HP:0006370.name: Distal ulnar epiphyseal stippling
HP:0006370.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the distal epiphysis of the ulna.
HP:0006370.definition_cn: 尺骨远端骨骺出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。

HP:0006371.name: Broad long bone diaphyses
HP:0006371.definition: Increased width of the diaphysis of long bones.

HP:0006375.name: Dumbbell-shaped femur
HP:0006375.definition: The femur is shortened and displays flaring (widening) of the metaphyses.
HP:0006375.definition_cn: 股骨缩短并显示干骺端增宽（扩张）。

HP:0006380.name: Knee flexion contracture
HP:0006380.definition: A type of knee joint contracture in which the knee is in a fixed bent (flexed) configuration such that it cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0006380.definition_cn: 一种膝关节挛缩类型，表现为膝关节处于固定屈曲位，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0006381.name: Rudimentary fibula
HP:0006381.definition: Absent or nearly absent fibula. (Does not include aplastic)
HP:0006381.definition_cn: 腓骨缺失或几乎缺失。（不包括发育不全）

HP:0006383.name: Progressive bowing of long bones
HP:0006383.definition: Progressive bending or abnormal curvature of a long bone.
HP:0006383.definition_cn: 长骨渐进性弯曲或异常曲度。

HP:0006384.name: Club-shaped distal femur
HP:0006384.definition: An abnormal conformation of the femur that becomes gradually enlarged towards the distal end. This feature affects the distal femoral metaphysis and epiphysis.
HP:0006384.definition_cn: 股骨远端逐渐增大的异常形态。此特征影响股骨远端干骺端及骨骺。

HP:0006385.name: Short lower limbs
HP:0006385.definition: Shortening of the legs related to developmental hypoplasia of the bones of the leg.
HP:0006385.definition_cn: 下肢发育不全相关的下肢短缩。

HP:0006386.name: Hypoplastic distal radial epiphyses
HP:0006386.definition: Underdevelopment of the distal epiphysis of the radius.
HP:0006386.name_cn: 桡骨远端骨骺发育不全
HP:0006386.definition_cn: 桡骨远端骨骺发育不全。

HP:0006387.name: Wide distal femoral metaphysis
HP:0006387.definition: Increased width of the distal part of the shaft (metaphysis) of the femur.

HP:0006389.name: Limited knee flexion
HP:0006389.definition: Reduced ability to flex (bend) the knee joint.

HP:0006390.name: Anterior tibial bowing
HP:0006390.definition: An abnormal anterior bending or curvature of the tibia.

HP:0006391.name: Overtubulated long bones
HP:0006391.definition: Overconstriction, or narrowness of the diaphysis and metaphysis of long bones.
HP:0006391.definition_cn: 骨干和干骺端过度狭窄，即长骨骨干和干骺端狭窄。

HP:0006392.name: Increased density of long bones
HP:0006392.definition: An abnormal increase in the bone density of the long bones.

HP:0006394.name: Limited pronation/supination of forearm
HP:0006394.definition: A limitation of the ability to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces anteriorly (supination) and to place the forearm in a position such that the palm faces posteriorly (pronation).
HP:0006394.definition_cn: 前臂旋前旋后功能障碍。

HP:0006398.name: Flat distal femoral epiphysis
HP:0006398.definition: An abnormal flattening of the distal epiphysis of femur.
HP:0006398.definition_cn: 股骨远端骨骺异常扁平化。

HP:0006406.name: Club-shaped proximal femur
HP:0006406.definition: An abnormal conformation of the femur that becomes gradually enlarged towards the proximal end. This feature affects the proximal femoral metaphysis and epiphysis.
HP:0006406.definition_cn: 股骨近端逐渐增大的异常形态。此特征影响股骨近端干骺端及骨骺。

HP:0006407.name: Irregular distal femoral epiphysis
HP:0006407.definition: Anomaly of the contour of the Distal epiphysis of femur such that its normally smooth appearance is irregular.
HP:0006407.definition_cn: 股骨远端骨骺轮廓异常，其通常光滑的外观呈现不规则形态。

HP:0006409.name: Progressive leg bowing
HP:0006409.definition: Progressive bending or abnormal curvature of the leg.
HP:0006409.definition_cn: 进行性下肢弯曲或异常曲度。

HP:0006414.name: Distal tibial bowing
HP:0006414.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the distal portion of the tibia.
HP:0006414.definition_cn: 胫骨远端弯曲或异常弯曲。

HP:0006415.name: Cortically dense long tubular bones
HP:0006415.definition: Increased density of the compact bone of long bone.

HP:0006420.name: Asymmetric radial dysplasia
HP:0006420.definition: The presence of asymmetric developmental dysplasia of the radius.
HP:0006420.name_cn: 不对称性桡骨发育不良
HP:0006420.definition_cn: 桡骨不对称性发育不良。

HP:0006423.name: Peg-like central prominence of distal tibial metaphyses
HP:0006423.name_cn: 胫骨远端干骺端中央钉状突起

HP:0006429.name: Broad femoral neck
HP:0006429.definition: An abnormally wide femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).
HP:0006429.definition_cn: 股骨颈异常增宽（即连接股骨头与股骨干的骨性结构）。

HP:0006431.name: Abnormal proximal femoral metaphysis morphology
HP:0006431.definition: An anomaly of the metaphysis of the proximal femur (close to the hip).
HP:0006431.name_cn: 股骨近端干骺端形态异常
HP:0006431.definition_cn: 股骨近端（靠近髋部）干骺端异常。

HP:0006433.name: Radial dysplasia
HP:0006433.definition: Radial dysplasia, also known as radial longitudinal deficiency, includes radial clubhand and is a disfiguring, and potentially disabling, congenital limb anomaly. The entire upper limb may be involved, although the defect is most evident in the forearm and hand. Affected children suffer a variable degree of hypoplasia or absence of the preaxial skeleton and soft tissues, in particular the thumb, radius, and dorsoradial soft tissues. The hand is usually radially deviated and subluxated off the distal aspect of the ulna, the ulna may be shortened and have a bow-shaped deformity, and there is no true wrist (radiocarpal) joint in Bayne2 type-III and IV radial dysplasia.
HP:0006433.definition_cn: 桡侧发育不良，也称为桡侧纵向缺陷，包括桡侧棒状手，是一种可能导致畸形的先天性肢体异常，具有潜在的致残性。尽管缺陷在前臂和手部最为明显，但整个上肢可能都会受到影响。受累儿童会出现不同程度的轴前骨骼和软组织发育不全或缺失，特别是拇指、桡骨和背桡侧软组织。手通常向桡侧偏斜并从尺骨远端半脱位，尺骨可能缩短并呈现弓形畸形，在Bayne III型和IV型桡侧发育不良中不存在真正的腕（桡腕）关节。

HP:0006434.name: Hypoplasia of proximal radius
HP:0006434.definition: Proximal radial shortening owing to a congenital defect of development.
HP:0006434.definition_cn: 由于先天性发育缺陷导致的桡骨近端短缩。

HP:0006437.name: Disproportionate prominence of the femoral medial condyle
HP:0006437.name_cn: 股骨内侧髁不成比例突出

HP:0006438.name: Enlargement of the distal femoral epiphysis
HP:0006438.definition: An abnormal enlargement of the distal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0006438.definition_cn: 股骨远端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0006439.name: Radioulnar dislocation
HP:0006439.definition: A dislocation is a separation of the radius and ulna bones where they normally meet. The radioulnar joints are two locations, proximal and distal, in which the radius and ulna articulate in the forearm. Both can dislocate.
HP:0006439.definition_cn: 脱位是指桡骨和尺骨在正常连接处发生分离。桡尺关节包括近端和远端两个部位，位于前臂中桡骨和尺骨的连接处。这两个部位均可能发生脱位。

HP:0006440.name: Increased density of long bone diaphyses

HP:0006442.name: Hypoplasia of proximal fibula
HP:0006442.definition: Underdevelopment or shortening of the end of the fibula (calf bone) nearest the knee.
HP:0006442.definition_cn: 腓骨近端发育不全或短缩。

HP:0006450.name: Multicentric ossification of proximal femoral epiphyses
HP:0006450.name_cn: 股骨近端骨骺多中心骨化

HP:0006453.name: Lateral displacement of the femoral head
HP:0006453.definition: A developmental anomaly with lateral displacement of the femoral head.
HP:0006453.definition_cn: 股骨头外侧移位的发育异常。

HP:0006454.name: Delayed patellar ossification
HP:0006454.definition: Formation of bone in the patella later than normal.

HP:0006456.name: Irregular proximal tibial epiphyses
HP:0006456.definition: Anomaly of the contour of the proximal epiphysis of the tibia such that its normally smooth appearance is irregular.
HP:0006456.definition_cn: 胫骨近端骨骺轮廓异常，导致其通常平滑的外观呈现不规则形态。

HP:0006459.name: Dorsal subluxation of ulna
HP:0006459.definition: Partial dislocation of the ulna in the dorsal direction.

HP:0006461.name: Proximal femoral epiphysiolysis
HP:0006461.definition: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis is defined as a posterior and inferior slippage of the proximal epiphysis of the femur onto the metaphysis (femoral neck), occurring through the physeal plate during the early adolescent growth spurt.
HP:0006461.definition_cn: 股骨头骨骺滑脱症定义为股骨近端骨骺通过生长板在青春期早期生长突增期间向后方和下方滑脱至干骺端（股骨颈）。

HP:0006462.name: Generalized bone demineralization
HP:0006462.definition: A generalized decrease in bone mineral density.

HP:0006465.name: Periosteal thickening of long tubular bones
HP:0006465.definition: Thickening of the periosteum of long bone.

HP:0006467.name: Limited shoulder movement
HP:0006467.definition: A limitation of the range of movement of the shoulder joint.

HP:0006470.name: Thin long bone diaphyses
HP:0006470.definition: Decreased width of the diaphysis of long bones.

HP:0006473.name: Anterior bowing of long bones
HP:0006473.definition: An abnormal anterior curvature of a long bone.

HP:0006476.name: Abnormality of the pancreatic islet cells
HP:0006476.definition: An abnormality of the islet of Langerhans, i.e., of the regions of the pancreas that contain its endocrine cells. These are the alpha cells, which produce glucagon, the beta cells, which produce insulin and amylin, the delta cells, which produce somatostatin, the PP cells, which produce pancreatic polypeptide, and the epsilon cells, which produce ghrelin.
HP:0006476.definition_cn: 胰岛（朗格汉斯岛）异常，即胰腺内分泌细胞所在区域的异常。这些细胞包括：α细胞，分泌胰高血糖素；β细胞，分泌胰岛素和胰淀素；δ细胞，分泌生长抑素；PP细胞，分泌胰多肽；以及ε细胞，分泌胃饥饿素。

HP:0006477.name: Abnormal alveolar ridge morphology
HP:0006477.definition: Any abnormality of the alveolar ridges (on the upper or lower jaws). The alveolar ridges contain the sockets (alveoli) of the teeth.
HP:0006477.definition_cn: 牙槽嵴异常（上颌或下颌）。牙槽嵴包含牙齿的牙槽窝（牙槽）。

HP:0006479.name: Abnormal dental pulp morphology
HP:0006479.definition: An abnormality of the dental pulp.

HP:0006480.name: Premature loss of teeth
HP:0006480.definition: Exfoliation of a tooth more than 2 SD earlier than the normal age for the deciduous teeth and not related to traume or neglect. Exfoliation of a permanent tooth is per se abnormal.
HP:0006480.definition_cn: 牙齿脱落时间比乳牙正常脱落年龄早超过2个标准差，且与创伤或忽视无关。恒牙脱落本身即为异常。

HP:0006481.name: Abnormality of primary teeth
HP:0006481.definition: Any abnormality of the primary tooth.

HP:0006482.name: Abnormal dental morphology
HP:0006482.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of the tooth.

HP:0006483.name: Abnormal number of teeth
HP:0006483.definition: The presence of an altered number of of teeth.

HP:0006486.name: Abnormal dental root morphology
HP:0006486.definition: An abnormality of the dental root.

HP:0006487.name: Bowing of the long bones
HP:0006487.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of a long bone.

HP:0006488.name: Bowing of the arm
HP:0006488.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature affecting a long bone of the arm.
HP:0006488.definition_cn: 肱骨弯曲畸形或肱骨异常弯曲。

HP:0006489.name: Abnormal femoral metaphysis morphology
HP:0006489.definition: An anomaly of the femoral metaphysis.

HP:0006492.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fibula
HP:0006492.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the fibula.
HP:0006492.name_cn: 腓骨发育不全/腓骨发育不良

HP:0006493.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the lower limbs
HP:0006493.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the bones of the lower limbs.
HP:0006493.name_cn: 下肢骨骼发育不全/发育不良
HP:0006493.definition_cn: 下肢骨骼缺失（由于形成障碍）或发育不全。

HP:0006494.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving bones of the feet
HP:0006494.name_cn: 足骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0006495.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ulna
HP:0006495.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the ulna.
HP:0006495.name_cn: 尺骨发育不全/尺骨发育不良

HP:0006496.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the upper limbs
HP:0006496.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the bones of the upper limbs.
HP:0006496.name_cn: 上肢骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0006496.definition_cn: 上肢骨骼缺失（由于形成失败）或发育不全。

HP:0006498.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the patella
HP:0006498.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the patella.
HP:0006498.name_cn: 髌骨发育不全/髌骨发育不良

HP:0006499.name: Abnormal femoral epiphysis morphology
HP:0006499.definition: An anomaly of a growth plate of a femur.

HP:0006500.name: Abnormal lower limb epiphysis morphology
HP:0006500.definition: An anomaly of one or more epiphyses of one or both legs.
HP:0006500.definition_cn: 单侧或双侧下肢一个或多个骨骺异常。

HP:0006501.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the radius
HP:0006501.name_cn: 桡骨发育不全/桡骨发育不良
HP:0006501.definition_cn: 桡骨发育不全/发育不良或缺如/发育不全。

HP:0006502.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the carpal bones
HP:0006502.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the carpal bones.
HP:0006502.name_cn: 腕骨发育不全/腕骨发育不良

HP:0006503.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving forearm bones
HP:0006503.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of one or more forearm bones.
HP:0006503.name_cn: 涉及前臂骨的发育不全/发育不良
HP:0006503.definition_cn: 桡骨或尺骨缺如（由于未能形成）或发育不全。

HP:0006504.name: obsolete Anomaly of the limb diaphyses morphology

HP:0006505.name: Abnormal limb epiphysis morphology
HP:0006505.definition: An anomaly of one or more epiphyses of a limb.
HP:0006505.definition_cn: 肢体一处或多处骨骺异常。

HP:0006507.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the humerus
HP:0006507.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the humerus.
HP:0006507.name_cn: 肱骨发育不全/肱骨发育不良
HP:0006507.definition_cn: 肱骨缺失（由于形成失败）或发育不全。

HP:0006509.name: Diverticulosis of trachea
HP:0006509.definition: Tracheal diverticula are blind-ended outpouchings arising from the trachea. They are usually an incidental finding. Occasionally they can mimic pneumomediastinum. Tracheal diverticula are either congenital or acquired, in the latter case the most common causes are prolonged increased intraluminal pressure, e.g. chronic cough, COPD, tracheomalacia, and iatrogenic (e.g. post-surgical).
HP:0006509.definition_cn: 气管憩室是起源于气管的盲端外突囊袋。它们通常为偶然发现。偶尔可类似纵隔气肿。气管憩室可为先天性或获得性，后者最常见的原因包括长期增加的腔内压力，例如慢性咳嗽、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）、气管软化症，以及医源性因素（如术后）。

HP:0006510.name: Chronic pulmonary obstruction
HP:0006510.definition: An anomaly that is characterized progressive airflow obstruction that is only partly reversible, inflammation in the airways, and systemic effects or comorbities.
HP:0006510.name_cn: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病 (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease, COPD)
HP:0006510.definition_cn: 一种以进行性气流阻塞（仅部分可逆）、气道炎症以及全身效应或合并症为特征的异常。

HP:0006511.name: Laryngeal stridor
HP:0006511.definition: An abnormal high-pitched noisy sound, occurring during inhalation or exhalation caused by the incomplete obstruction in the throat.
HP:0006511.definition_cn: 一种异常高调的嘈杂音，发生于吸气或呼气时，由喉部不完全阻塞引起。

HP:0006516.name: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis
HP:0006516.definition: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis involves inhalation of an antigen. This leads to an exaggerated immune response and a following inflammation of the alveoli within the lungs. The main feature of chronic hypersensitivity pneumonitis on lung biopsies is expansion of the interstitium by lymphocytes accompanied by an occasional multinucleated giant cell or loose granuloma. After exposure to the provoking antigen, following symptoms can be seen: fever, chills, malaise, cough, hemoptysis, chest tightness, dyspnea, rash, swelling and headache and can be completely reversible, based on the duration of the illness, categorized as acute (HP:0011009), subacute (HP:0011011), and chronic (HP:0011010).
HP:0006516.definition_cn: 过敏性肺炎涉及吸入抗原，导致过度免疫反应及随后的肺泡炎症。慢性过敏性肺炎在肺活检中的主要特征是间质因淋巴细胞浸润而扩张，偶见多核巨细胞或松散肉芽肿。接触诱发抗原后，可出现以下症状：发热、寒战、不适、咳嗽、咯血、胸闷、呼吸困难、皮疹、肿胀和头痛。根据病程长短，可分为急性（HP:0011009）、亚急性（HP:0011011）和慢性（HP:0011010），且症状可能完全可逆。

HP:0006517.name: Intraalveolar phospholipid accumulation
HP:0006517.definition: Accumulation of amorphous PAS-positive material in the space between alveolar macrophages, sometimes as condensed form (oval bodies) are typically found in alveolar proteinosis.
HP:0006517.definition_cn: 肺泡蛋白沉积症中，通常在肺泡巨噬细胞之间的间隙中观察到无定形PAS阳性物质的积聚，有时以浓缩形式（卵圆形小体）存在。

HP:0006518.name: Pulmonary venous occlusion
HP:0006518.definition: Substantial narrowing or blockage of small pulmonary veins as a result of disorganized smooth muscle hypertrophy and collagen matrix deposition.
HP:0006518.definition_cn: 由于紊乱的平滑肌肥大和胶原基质沉积导致的肺小静脉显著狭窄或阻塞。

HP:0006521.name: Pulmonary lymphangiectasia
