HP:0006521.definition: Abnormal dilatation of the pulmonary lymphatic vessels. Lymphatic fluid in the lung is derived from normal leakage of fluid out of the blood capillaries in the lung. In pulmonary lymphangiectasia, the pulmonary lymphatics are not properly connected and become dilated with fluid.
HP:0006521.definition_cn: 肺淋巴管异常扩张。肺内淋巴液来源于肺毛细血管的正常渗漏。在肺淋巴管扩张症中，肺淋巴管连接异常并因液体积聚而扩张。

HP:0006524.name: Tracheobronchial leiomyomatosis
HP:0006524.name_cn: 气管支气管平滑肌瘤病

HP:0006527.name: Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia
HP:0006527.definition: Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonitis is a benign lymphoproliferative disorder of the lung that is characterized by the presence of a dense, predominantly lymphocytic interstitial infiltrate (lymphocytes, plasma cells, other elements of the lymphoreticular system) that expands the alveolar septa.
HP:0006527.name_cn: 淋巴细胞性间质性肺炎
HP:0006527.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞性间质性肺炎是一种肺部的良性淋巴增生性疾病，其特征为密集的、以淋巴细胞为主的间质浸润（包括淋巴细胞、浆细胞以及淋巴网状系统的其他成分），导致肺泡间隔增厚。

HP:0006528.name: Chronic lung disease
HP:0006528.definition: According to the definitions of the American and British Thoracic Societies, including pulmonary functional tests, X-rays, and CT scans for items such as fibrosis, bronchiectasis, bullae, emphysema, nodular or lymphomatous abnormalities.
HP:0006528.definition_cn: 根据美国和英国胸科学会的定义，包括肺功能测试、X射线和CT扫描等项目，用于评估纤维化、支气管扩张、肺大泡、肺气肿、结节性或淋巴瘤样异常等病变。

HP:0006529.name: Abnormal pulmonary lymphatics
HP:0006529.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary lymphatic chain.

HP:0006530.name: Abnormal pulmonary interstitial morphology
HP:0006530.definition: Abnormality of the lung parenchyma extending to the pulmonary interstitium and leading to diffuse pulmonary fibrosis.
HP:0006530.definition_cn: 肺实质异常延伸至肺间质并导致弥漫性肺纤维化。

HP:0006532.name: Recurrent pneumonia
HP:0006532.definition: An increased susceptibility to pneumonia as manifested by a history of recurrent episodes of pneumonia.
HP:0006532.definition_cn: 表现为反复发作性肺炎病史的肺炎易感性增加。

HP:0006535.name: Recurrent intrapulmonary hemorrhage
HP:0006535.definition: A recurrent hemorrhage occurring within the lung.

HP:0006536.name: Airway obstruction
HP:0006536.definition: Obstruction of conducting airways of the lung.

HP:0006538.name: Recurrent bronchopulmonary infections
HP:0006538.definition: An increased susceptibility to bronchopulmonary infections as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchopulmonary infections.
HP:0006538.definition_cn: 支气管肺感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作的支气管肺感染病史。

HP:0006541.name: obsolete Chronic obstructive airway disease from birth
HP:0006541.name_cn: 先天性慢性阻塞性气道疾病

HP:0006544.name: Extrapulmonary lobar sequestration
HP:0006544.definition: A type of pulmonary sequestration that is completely enclosed in its own pleural sac, occurring above, within, or below the diaphragm, and without communication with the tracheobronchial tree.
HP:0006544.definition_cn: 一种完全包裹在自身胸膜囊内的肺隔离症，可发生于膈肌上方、内部或下方，且与气管支气管树无交通。

HP:0006548.name: Pulmonary arteriovenous malformation
HP:0006548.definition: Pulmonary arteriovenous malformation, a condition most commonly associated with hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, is an abnormal communication between the pulmonary artery and pulmonary vein without an intervening capillary communication. HRCT images usually show a coarse spidery appearance of the peripheral vascular markings in the lungs. More specific findings are obtained in the pulmonary angiogram where the normally invisible capillary phase is replaced by irregular vascular channels bridging the peripheral branches of pulmonary arteries and veins.
HP:0006548.definition_cn: 肺动静脉畸形，一种最常见与遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症相关的疾病，是指肺动脉与肺静脉之间异常的直接交通，缺乏正常的毛细血管网。高分辨率CT（HRCT）图像通常显示肺部外周血管标记呈粗糙的蜘蛛网状外观。更特异性的发现见于肺血管造影，其中正常情况下不可见的毛细血管期被不规则的血管通道所取代，这些通道连接着肺动脉和肺静脉的外周分支。

HP:0006549.name: Unilateral primary pulmonary dysgenesis
HP:0006549.name_cn: 单侧原发性肺发育不全

HP:0006554.name: Acute hepatic failure
HP:0006554.definition: Hepatic failure refers to the inability of the liver to perform its normal synthetic and metabolic functions, which can result in coagulopathy and alteration in the mental status of a previously healthy individual. Hepatic failure is defined as acute if there is onset of encephalopathy within 8 weeks of the onset of symptoms in a patient with a previously healthy liver.
HP:0006554.definition_cn: 肝衰竭是指肝脏无法执行其正常的合成和代谢功能，可能导致凝血功能障碍和既往健康个体的精神状态改变。如果在既往健康肝脏的患者中，症状出现后8周内发生脑病，则定义为急性肝衰竭。

HP:0006555.name: Diffuse hepatic steatosis
HP:0006555.definition: A diffuse form of hepatic steatosis.

HP:0006558.name: Decreased mitochondrial complex III activity in liver tissue
HP:0006558.definition: Decreased activity of complex III of the mitochondrion in the liver.
HP:0006558.name_cn: 肝组织中线粒体复合物III活性降低
HP:0006558.definition_cn: 肝脏线粒体复合体III活性降低。

HP:0006559.name: Hepatic calcification
HP:0006559.definition: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition in the liver.

HP:0006560.name: Biliary hyperplasia
HP:0006560.definition: Hyperplasia of the biliary tree, as manifested by increased size of bile ducts, dilated lumen, and histologically by an increased number of epithelial cells or hyperplasia.
HP:0006560.definition_cn: 胆道树增生，表现为胆管增大、管腔扩张，组织学上表现为上皮细胞数量增加或增生。

HP:0006562.name: Viral hepatitis
HP:0006562.definition: Inflammation of the liver due to infection with a virus.

HP:0006563.name: Malformation of the hepatic ductal plate

HP:0006564.name: Fluctuating hepatomegaly
HP:0006564.definition: Intermittently increased size of the liver.

HP:0006565.name: Increased hepatocellular lipid droplets
HP:0006565.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of intracellular lipid droplets in hepatocytes.
HP:0006565.definition_cn: 肝细胞内脂滴数量的异常增加。

HP:0006566.name: Neonatal cholestatic liver disease
HP:0006566.name_cn: 新生儿胆汁淤积性肝病

HP:0006568.name: Increased hepatic glycogen content
HP:0006568.definition: An increase in the amount of glycogen stored in hepatocytes compared to normal.
HP:0006568.definition_cn: 肝细胞内糖原储存量相较于正常水平增加。

HP:0006571.name: Reduced number of intrahepatic bile ducts
HP:0006571.definition: The presence of reduced numbers of intrahepatic bile duct than normal.

HP:0006572.name: Subacute progressive viral hepatitis
HP:0006572.name_cn: 亚急性进行性病毒性肝炎

HP:0006573.name: Acute hepatic steatosis
HP:0006573.definition: An acute form of hepatic steatosis.

HP:0006575.name: Intrahepatic cholestasis with episodic jaundice
HP:0006575.name_cn: 肝内胆汁淤积伴间歇性黄疸

HP:0006577.name: Macronodular cirrhosis
HP:0006577.definition: A type of cirrhosis characterized by the presence of large regenerative nodules.
HP:0006577.definition_cn: 一种以存在大再生性结节为特征的肝硬化类型。

HP:0006579.name: Prolonged neonatal jaundice
HP:0006579.definition: Neonatal jaundice refers to a yellowing of the skin and other tissues of a newborn infant as a result of increased concentrations of bilirubin in the blood. Neonatal jaundice affects over half of all newborns to some extent in the first week of life. Prolonged neonatal jaundice is said to be present if the jaundice persists for longer than 14 days in term infants and 21 days in preterm infants.
HP:0006579.definition_cn: 新生儿黄疸是指由于血液中胆红素浓度升高导致新生儿皮肤及其他组织出现黄染的现象。在出生后第一周内，超过半数的新生儿会不同程度地受到新生儿黄疸的影响。若黄疸在足月儿中持续超过14天，或在早产儿中持续超过21天，则称为迁延性新生儿黄疸。

HP:0006580.name: Portal fibrosis
HP:0006580.definition: Fibroblast proliferation and fiber expansion from the portal areas to the lobule.
HP:0006580.definition_cn: 成纤维细胞增殖及纤维从门管区向肝小叶扩展。

HP:0006581.name: Depletion of mitochondrial DNA in liver
HP:0006581.definition: An abnormal reduction in the number of mitochondria in hepatocytes.
HP:0006581.definition_cn: 肝细胞线粒体数量异常减少。

HP:0006582.name: Reye syndrome-like episodes
HP:0006582.definition: Repeated occurrences of acute noninflammatory encephalopathy and fatty degenerative liver failure.
HP:0006582.definition_cn: 复发性急性非炎症性脑病与脂肪变性肝功能衰竭。

HP:0006585.name: Congenital pseudoarthrosis of the clavicle
HP:0006585.definition: The two portions of the clavicle (corresponding to the two primary ossification centers of the clavicle) are connected by a fibrous bridge that is contiguous with the periosteum, and a synovial membrane develops, resulting in a clavicle with a bipartite appearance radiographically. Congenital pseudarthrosis of the clavicle generally presents as a painless mass or swelling over the clavicle.
HP:0006585.definition_cn: 锁骨的两部分（对应于锁骨的两个初级骨化中心）通过一个与骨膜连续的纤维桥连接，并形成滑膜，导致放射学上呈现二分外观的锁骨。先天性锁骨假关节通常表现为锁骨上无痛性肿块或肿胀。

HP:0006587.name: Straight clavicles
HP:0006587.definition: An abnormally straight configuration of the clavicle, a tubular bone which normally is doubly curved .
HP:0006587.definition_cn: 锁骨异常平直，该管状骨通常呈双曲形态。

HP:0006591.name: Absent glenoid fossa
HP:0006591.definition: Lack of development of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.
HP:0006591.definition_cn: 肩胛盂发育不全，也称为肩胛盂窝发育不全，肩胛盂是肩胛骨上与肱骨头形成关节的关节面。

HP:0006595.name: Scapulohumeral synostosis
HP:0006595.definition: Bony fusion between the humerus and scapula, leading to an impairment in mobility of the affected shoulder joint.
HP:0006595.definition_cn: 肱骨与肩胛骨之间的骨性融合，导致受累肩关节活动功能障碍。

HP:0006597.name: Diaphragmatic paralysis
HP:0006597.definition: The presence of a paralyzed diaphragm.

HP:0006598.name: Irregular ossification at anterior rib ends

HP:0006606.name: Irregular chondrocostal junctions
HP:0006606.definition: Irregular surface of the normally relatively smooth border between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.
HP:0006606.definition_cn: 肋骨远端与肋软骨之间通常相对平滑的边界表面不规则，肋软骨为透明软骨条，连接肋骨与胸骨。

HP:0006607.name: Precocious costochondral ossification
HP:0006607.definition: Early ossification of the costochondral junction, which is the joint between the ribs and costal cartilage in the front of the rib cage.
HP:0006607.definition_cn: 肋软骨连接处早期骨化，即肋骨与肋软骨在前胸壁的关节处。

HP:0006608.name: Midclavicular hypoplasia
HP:0006608.definition: Underdevelopment of the middle portion of the clavicle.

HP:0006610.name: Wide intermamillary distance
HP:0006610.definition: A larger than usual distance between the left and right nipple.

HP:0006611.name: Decreased number of sternal ossification centers
HP:0006611.definition: A less than normal number of sternal ossification centers. The sternum is initially formed from bilateral sternal plates that chondrify and begin to fuse with ribs at 10 weeks gestational age. Ossification starts in the manubrium and upper part of the sternal body at the 6th month, in the middle of the sternal body at the 7th month, in the lower part of the body during the 1st postnatal year and in the xiphoid process between years 5 and 18. The number of ossification centers vary up to six, and it is the ossification centers that are visualized by prenatal ultrasound. This term describes a reduction in the number of ossification centers compared with age-related norms.
HP:0006611.name_cn: 胸骨骨化中心数量减少
HP:0006611.definition_cn: 胸骨骨化中心数量低于正常值。胸骨最初由双侧胸骨板形成，在妊娠10周时软骨化并开始与肋骨融合。骨化过程始于第6个月的胸骨柄和胸骨体上部，第7个月时在胸骨体中部，出生后第1年在胸骨体下部，第5至18年期间在剑突。骨化中心数量最多可达六个，产前超声检查可观察到这些骨化中心。该术语描述的是骨化中心数量与年龄相关标准相比减少的情况。

HP:0006615.name: Absent in utero rib ossification
HP:0006615.definition: Lack of formation and mineralization of the ribs in utero.
HP:0006615.definition_cn: 宫内肋骨形成和矿化不全。

HP:0006619.name: Anterior rib punctate calcifications
HP:0006619.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in point-like foci within the anterior portion of one or more ribs.
HP:0006619.definition_cn: 一个或多个肋骨前部点状病灶内钙盐沉积。

HP:0006623.name: Costochondral joint sclerosis
HP:0006623.definition: Abnormal increase in density of the tissue at the costochondral junctions.
HP:0006623.definition_cn: 肋软骨连接处组织密度异常增高。

HP:0006625.name: Multifocal breast carcinoma
HP:0006625.definition: Breast carcinoma that is bilateral or otherwise multifocal.

HP:0006628.name: Absent sternal ossification
HP:0006628.definition: Lack of formation of mineralized bony tissue of the sternum.
HP:0006628.definition_cn: 胸骨矿化骨组织形成不全。

HP:0006631.name: Hypoplastic distal segments of scapulae
HP:0006631.name_cn: 肩胛骨远端节段发育不全

HP:0006633.name: Glenoid fossa hypoplasia
HP:0006633.definition: Underdevelopment of the glenoid fossa, which is the cavity in the lateral part of the scapula which articulates with the head of the humerus.
HP:0006633.definition_cn: 关节盂发育不全，即肩胛骨外侧与肱骨头相连接的关节窝发育不全。

HP:0006634.name: Osteosclerosis of ribs
HP:0006634.definition: Osteosclerosis of ribs (increased density related to increased bone mass).
HP:0006634.definition_cn: 肋骨骨硬化（与骨量增加相关的密度增高）。

HP:0006638.name: Midclavicular aplasia
HP:0006638.definition: Developmental defect resulting in congenital absence of the middle portion of the clavicle.
HP:0006638.definition_cn: 锁骨中段先天性缺失导致的发育缺陷。

HP:0006640.name: Multiple rib fractures
HP:0006640.definition: More than one fracture of the ribs. Callus formation around multiple rib fractures can produce a row of multiple rounded expansions (beadlike prominences) giving the appearance of beaded ribs. Note that rachitic rosary would have one bead per rib (a swelling at the costochondral junction), while beaded ribs in the context of multiple rib fractures have multiple beads (fractures) along the same rib.
HP:0006640.definition_cn: 多发性肋骨骨折。多发性肋骨骨折周围的骨痂形成可产生一系列多发性圆形扩张（珠状突起），呈现珠状肋骨的外观。需注意，佝偻病性串珠（rachitic rosary）每根肋骨仅有一个珠状突起（位于肋软骨交界处的肿胀），而多发性肋骨骨折背景下的珠状肋骨在同一根肋骨上有多个珠状突起（骨折）。

HP:0006645.name: Thin clavicles
HP:0006645.definition: Abnormally reduced diameter (cross section) of the clavicles.

HP:0006646.name: Costal cartilage calcification
HP:0006646.definition: Calcification of the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage found at the anterior ends of the ribs which serve to prolong the ribs forward and contribute to the elasticity of the walls of the thorax.
HP:0006646.definition_cn: 肋软骨钙化，即位于肋骨前端的透明软骨条发生钙化，这些软骨条向前延伸肋骨并有助于胸壁的弹性。

HP:0006649.name: Costochondral pain
HP:0006649.definition: Chest wall pain in the area of the costochondral junctions.
HP:0006649.definition_cn: 肋软骨连接处胸壁疼痛。

HP:0006650.name: Thickening of the lateral border of the scapula

HP:0006660.name: Aplastic clavicle
HP:0006660.definition: Absence of the clavicles as a developmental defect.
HP:0006660.definition_cn: 锁骨缺如作为一种发育缺陷。

HP:0006665.name: Coat hanger sign of ribs
HP:0006665.definition: An abnormal morphology of the ribs consisting of shorted, abnormally curved ribs. On posteroanterior chest radiography, the ribs show a curvature resembling that of a coat hanger (clothes hanger).
HP:0006665.definition_cn: 肋骨形态异常，表现为肋骨缩短及异常弯曲。在后前位胸部X线摄影中，肋骨呈现类似衣架（衣架状）的弯曲形态。

HP:0006677.name: Prolonged QRS complex
HP:0006677.definition: Increased time for the complex comprised of the Q wave, R wave, and S wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).. In adults, normal values are 0.06 - 0.10 sec.
HP:0006677.definition_cn: 心电图（EKG）测量的Q波、R波和S波复合体时间延长。成人正常值为0.06 - 0.10秒。

HP:0006679.name: Granulomatous coronary arteritis
HP:0006679.definition: Inflammation of the coronary arteries involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.
HP:0006679.definition_cn: 冠状动脉炎症伴肉芽肿反应，即一种非特异性炎症反应，涉及肉芽肿，定义为由成熟单核吞噬细胞（包括上皮样细胞和多核巨细胞）组成的紧密有序的集合。

HP:0006682.name: Premature ventricular contraction
HP:0006682.definition: Premature ventricular contractions (PVC) or ventricular extrasystoles are premature contractions of the heart that arise in response to an impulse in the ventricles rather than the normal impulse from the sinoatrial (SA) node.
HP:0006682.definition_cn: 室性早搏（Premature Ventricular Contractions, PVC）或室性期前收缩（Ventricular Extrasystoles）是指由心室而非窦房结（Sinoatrial Node, SA Node）发出的冲动所引发的心脏提前收缩。

HP:0006683.name: Abnormal ventricular filling
HP:0006683.definition: An abnormality of filling of a ventricle with blood during diastole.
HP:0006683.definition_cn: 心室舒张期血液充盈异常。

HP:0006684.name: Ventricular preexcitation with multiple accessory pathways
HP:0006684.definition: A form of ventricular preexcitation due to the presence of multiple accessory pathways for cardiac conduction.
HP:0006684.definition_cn: 一种心室预激形式，由于存在多条心脏传导的附加通路所致。

HP:0006685.name: Endocardial fibrosis
HP:0006685.definition: The presence of excessive connective tissue in the endocardium.
HP:0006685.definition_cn: 心内膜中结缔组织过度增生。

HP:0006687.name: Aortic tortuosity
HP:0006687.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the aorta.
HP:0006687.definition_cn: 主动脉异常迂曲（即扭曲）形态。

HP:0006689.name: Bacterial endocarditis
HP:0006689.definition: A bacterial infection of the endocardium, the inner layer of the heart, which usually involves the heart valves.
HP:0006689.definition_cn: 感染性心内膜炎（Infective Endocarditis），即心内膜（Endocardium）的细菌感染，通常累及心脏瓣膜（Heart Valves）。

HP:0006691.name: Pulmonic valve myxoma
HP:0006691.definition: A benign tumor of connective tissue containing mucous or gelatinous material (myxoma) localized in the pumonic valve.
HP:0006691.definition_cn: 位于肺动脉瓣的含有黏液或胶状物质的结缔组织良性肿瘤（黏液瘤）。

HP:0006692.name: Short chordae tendineae of the tricuspid valve
HP:0006692.definition: Abnormally short chordae tendineae of the tricuspid valve.

HP:0006694.name: Early progressive calcific cardiac valvular disease
HP:0006694.name_cn: 早期进行性钙化性心脏瓣膜病

HP:0006695.name: Atrioventricular canal defect
HP:0006695.definition: A defect of the atrioventricular septum of the heart.

HP:0006696.name: Polymorphic and polytopic ventricular extrasystoles
HP:0006696.name_cn: 多形性和多源性室性期前收缩

HP:0006698.name: Dilatation of the ventricular cavity
HP:0006698.definition: A localized outpouching of ventricular cavity that is generally associated with dyskinesia and paradoxical expansion during systole.
HP:0006698.definition_cn: 心室腔局部性膨出，通常与运动障碍和收缩期反常扩张相关。

HP:0006699.name: Premature atrial contractions
HP:0006699.definition: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites.
HP:0006699.definition_cn: 一种由异位心房部位信号引起的心律失常，表现为房性早搏或房性期前收缩。

HP:0006702.name: Coronary artery dissection
HP:0006702.definition: Acute occurrence of a dissection (tear within the tunica intima and entry of blood into the tunica media) of a coronary artery.
HP:0006702.definition_cn: 冠状动脉急性夹层（内膜层撕裂及血液进入中膜层）的发生。

HP:0006703.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the lungs
HP:0006703.name_cn: 肺发育不全/肺发育不良

HP:0006704.name: Abnormal coronary artery morphology
HP:0006704.definition: Any structural abnormality of the coronary arteries.

HP:0006705.name: Abnormal atrioventricular valve morphology
HP:0006705.definition: An abnormality of an atrioventricular valve.

HP:0006707.name: Abnormality of the hepatic vasculature
HP:0006707.definition: An abnormality of the hepatic vasculature.

HP:0006709.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nipples
HP:0006709.name_cn: 乳头发育不全/乳头发育不良

HP:0006710.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the clavicles
HP:0006710.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the clavicles (collar bones).
HP:0006710.name_cn: 锁骨发育不全/锁骨发育不良

HP:0006711.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving bones of the thorax
HP:0006711.name_cn: 胸廓骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0006712.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ribs
HP:0006712.name_cn: 肋骨发育不全/肋骨发育不良

HP:0006713.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the scapulae
HP:0006713.name_cn: 肩胛骨发育不全/肩胛骨发育不良

HP:0006714.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sternum
HP:0006714.name_cn: 胸骨发育不全/胸骨发育不良

HP:0006716.name: Hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal carcinoma
HP:0006716.name_cn: 遗传性非息肉病性结直肠癌

HP:0006721.name: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
HP:0006721.definition: A form of acute leukemia characterized by excess lympoblasts.
HP:0006721.definition_cn: 一种以淋巴母细胞过度增生为特征的急性白血病。

HP:0006725.name: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma
HP:0006725.definition: The presence of an adenocarcinoma of the pancreas.

HP:0006727.name: T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemias
HP:0006727.definition: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia of T-cell origin. It comprises about 15% of childhood cases and 25% of adult cases. It is more common in males than females.
HP:0006727.name_cn: T细胞急性淋巴细胞白血病
HP:0006727.definition_cn: T细胞来源的急性淋巴细胞白血病。该类型约占儿童病例的15%和成人病例的25%。男性发病率高于女性。

HP:0006729.name: Retroperitoneal paraganglioma
HP:0006729.definition: A paraganglioma (previously referred to as chemodectoma) located in the retroperitoneal space. Paragangliomas (also known as extra-adrenal pheochromocytomas) are rare tumors that arise from extra-adrenal chromaffin cells. Paragangliomas are characterized by secretions of excessive catecholamines, including epinephrine, norepinephrine and dopamine, which may lead to clinical symptoms, including episodic hypertension, tachycardia and diaphoresis. However, between 40 and 50% of paragangliomas are non-functional.
HP:0006729.definition_cn: 位于腹膜后间隙的副神经节瘤（既往称为化学感受器瘤）。副神经节瘤（也称为肾上腺外嗜铬细胞瘤）是一种罕见的肿瘤，起源于肾上腺外的嗜铬细胞。副神经节瘤的特征是分泌过量的儿茶酚胺，包括肾上腺素、去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺，这可能导致临床症状，如阵发性高血压、心动过速和多汗。然而，40%至50%的副神经节瘤是无功能的。

HP:0006731.name: Follicular thyroid carcinoma
HP:0006731.definition: The presence of an follicular adenocarcinoma of the thyroid gland.
HP:0006731.definition_cn: 甲状腺滤泡性腺癌的存在。

HP:0006732.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma type 2
HP:0006732.definition: A type of papillary renal cell carcinoma in which the papillae are covered by large eosinophilic cells with pleomorphic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and nuclear pseudostratification.
HP:0006732.definition_cn: 一种乳头状肾细胞癌，其乳头被大嗜酸性细胞覆盖，这些细胞具有多形性核、显著核仁及核假复层结构。

HP:0006733.name: Acute megakaryocytic leukemia
HP:0006733.definition: A rare subtype of acute myeloid leukemia evolving from primitive megakaryoblasts.
HP:0006733.definition_cn: 一种罕见的急性髓系白血病亚型，起源于原始巨核母细胞。

HP:0006735.name: Renal cortical adenoma
HP:0006735.definition: The presence of an adenoma in the cortex of the kidney.

HP:0006737.name: Extraadrenal pheochromocytoma
HP:0006737.definition: Pheochromocytoma not originating from the adrenal medulla but from another source such as from chromaffin cells in or about sympathetic ganglia.
HP:0006737.definition_cn: 非肾上腺髓质起源的嗜铬细胞瘤，源自交感神经节内或周围的嗜铬细胞。

HP:0006739.name: Squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
HP:0006739.definition: Squamous cell carcinoma of the skin is a malignant tumor of squamous epithelium.
HP:0006739.definition_cn: 皮肤鳞状细胞癌是一种鳞状上皮的恶性肿瘤。

HP:0006740.name: Transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder
HP:0006740.definition: The presence of a carcinoma of the urinary bladder with origin in a transitional epithelial cell.
HP:0006740.definition_cn: 膀胱癌，起源于移行上皮细胞。

HP:0006744.name: Adrenocortical carcinoma
HP:0006744.definition: A malignant neoplasm of the adrenal cortex that may produce hormones such as cortisol, aldosterone, estrogen, or testosterone.
HP:0006744.definition_cn: 肾上腺皮质恶性肿瘤，可分泌皮质醇、醛固酮、雌激素或睾酮等激素。

HP:0006748.name: Adrenal pheochromocytoma
HP:0006748.definition: Pheochromocytoma originating from the adrenal medulla.
HP:0006748.definition_cn: 起源于肾上腺髓质的嗜铬细胞瘤。

HP:0006751.name: Paraspinal neurofibroma
HP:0006751.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized adjacent to the spine.
HP:0006751.definition_cn: 位于脊柱旁的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘瘤）。

HP:0006753.name: Neoplasm of the stomach
HP:0006753.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the stomach.
HP:0006753.definition_cn: 胃肿瘤（胃组织异常增生）

HP:0006755.name: Cutaneous leiomyosarcoma
HP:0006755.definition: The presence of leiomyosarcoma of the skin.
HP:0006755.definition_cn: 皮肤平滑肌肉瘤的存在。

HP:0006758.name: Malignant genitourinary tract tumor
HP:0006758.definition: The presence of a malignant neoplasm of the genital system.
HP:0006758.definition_cn: 生殖系统恶性肿瘤的存在。

HP:0006762.name: Renal pelvic carcinoma
HP:0006762.definition: The presence of a carcinoma in the renal pelvis.

HP:0006765.name: Chondrosarcoma
HP:0006765.definition: A slowly growing malignant neoplasm derived from cartilage cells.
HP:0006765.definition_cn: 一种源自软骨细胞的缓慢生长的恶性肿瘤。

HP:0006766.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
HP:0006766.definition: The presence of renal cell carcinoma in the renal papilla.
HP:0006766.definition_cn: 肾乳头内存在肾细胞癌。

HP:0006767.name: Pituitary prolactin cell adenoma
HP:0006767.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma originating in prolactin secreting cells. This kind of adenoma is characterized by overproduction of prolactin, and may cause loss of menstrual periods and breast milk production in women.
HP:0006767.definition_cn: 一种起源于泌乳素分泌细胞的垂体腺瘤。此类腺瘤以泌乳素过度分泌为特征，可能导致女性月经周期停止及乳汁分泌异常。

HP:0006770.name: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
HP:0006770.definition: A subtype of renal cell carcinoma thought to originate from mature renal tubular cells in the proximal tubule of the nehpron.
HP:0006770.definition_cn: 一种肾细胞癌亚型，被认为起源于肾单位近端小管的成熟肾小管细胞。

HP:0006771.name: Duodenal adenocarcinoma
HP:0006771.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the duodenum.
HP:0006771.definition_cn: 一种起源于十二指肠的具有腺体结构的恶性上皮性肿瘤。

HP:0006772.name: Renal angiomyolipoma
HP:0006772.definition: A benign renal neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.
HP:0006772.definition_cn: 一种由脂肪、血管和平滑肌成分组成的良性肾脏肿瘤。

HP:0006774.name: Ovarian papillary adenocarcinoma
HP:0006774.definition: The presence of a papillary adenocarcinoma of the ovary.
HP:0006774.definition_cn: 卵巢乳头状腺癌的存在。

HP:0006775.name: Multiple myeloma
HP:0006775.definition: A malignant plasma cell tumor growing within soft tissue or within the skeleton.
HP:0006775.definition_cn: 一种恶性浆细胞肿瘤，生长于软组织或骨骼内。

HP:0006778.name: Benign genitourinary tract neoplasm
HP:0006778.definition: A non-malignant neoplasm of the genitourinary system.
HP:0006778.name_cn: 良性泌尿生殖系统肿瘤
HP:0006778.definition_cn: 泌尿生殖系统的良性肿瘤。

HP:0006780.name: Parathyroid carcinoma
HP:0006780.definition: A malignancy of the parathyroid glands. Parathyroid carcinoma usually secretes parathyroid hormone, leading to hyperparathyroidism.
HP:0006780.definition_cn: 甲状旁腺恶性肿瘤。甲状旁腺癌通常分泌甲状旁腺激素，导致甲状旁腺功能亢进症。

HP:0006781.name: Hurthle cell thyroid adenoma
HP:0006781.definition: A kind of thyroid adenoma characterized by the presence of oxyphil cells.
HP:0006781.definition_cn: 一种以嗜酸性细胞存在为特征的甲状腺腺瘤。

HP:0006782.name: Malignant eosinophil proliferation
HP:0006782.name_cn: 恶性嗜酸性粒细胞增殖

HP:0006785.name: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy
HP:0006785.definition: Muscular dystrophy affecting the muscles of the limb girdle (the hips and shoulders).
HP:0006785.definition_cn: 肢带型肌营养不良症（Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, LGMD）。

HP:0006794.name: Loss of ability to walk in first decade
HP:0006794.name_cn: 第一十年内行走能力丧失

HP:0006802.name: Abnormal anterior horn cell morphology
HP:0006802.definition: Any anomaly of the anterior horn cell.

HP:0006803.name: Vivid hallucination
HP:0006803.definition: Perceptual experiences that are vivid, intense, and sensory in nature occur in the absence of corresponding stimuli from the external environment.
HP:0006803.definition_cn: 在没有外部环境相应刺激的情况下，出现生动、强烈且具有感官性质的知觉体验。

HP:0006808.name: Cerebral hypomyelination
HP:0006808.definition: Reduced amount of myelin in the nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis in the white matter of the central nervous system.
HP:0006808.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统白质中髓鞘生成缺陷导致的神经系统髓鞘含量减少。

HP:0006812.name: White mater abnormalities in the posterior periventricular region
HP:0006812.name_cn: 后脑室周围区域白质异常

HP:0006813.name: Focal hemiclonic seizure
HP:0006813.definition: A type of focal clonic seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking rapidly involves one side of the body at seizure onset.
HP:0006813.name_cn: 局灶性半侧阵挛性发作
HP:0006813.definition_cn: 一种局灶性阵挛性发作类型，其特征为发作开始时迅速累及身体一侧的持续性节律性抽动。

HP:0006817.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis
HP:0006817.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the vermis of cerebellum.
HP:0006817.name_cn: 小脑蚓部发育不全/发育不良
HP:0006817.definition_cn: 小脑蚓部缺失或发育不全。

HP:0006818.name: 4-layered lissencephaly
HP:0006818.definition: A form of lissencephaly in which the cortex is thickened and has four more or less disorganized layers rather than six normal layers resulting from incomplete neuronal migration during brain development. At neuropathological examination, a 4-layered cortex consists of an upper molecular layer, a second thin cellular layer containing pyramidal neurons usually observed in layer V, a third pale poorly cellular layer and a fourth thick deep layer made up of neurons which had failed to migrate. Radiologocally would manifest as agyria or pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm.
HP:0006818.definition_cn: 一种无脑回畸形，其皮质增厚，具有四个或多或少紊乱的层次，而非正常的六层结构，这是由于大脑发育过程中神经元迁移不完全所致。在神经病理学检查中，四层皮质包括：上层的分子层，第二层为含有通常在第五层观察到的锥体神经元的薄细胞层，第三层为细胞稀少的苍白层，第四层为未能迁移的神经元组成的厚深层。影像学上表现为无脑回或巨脑回畸形，皮质厚度大于10毫米。

HP:0006821.name: Frontal polymicrogyria
HP:0006821.definition: A type of polymicrogyria with a gradient of severity (anterior more severe than posterior) extending from frontal poles posteriorly to precentral gyrus and inferiorly to frontal operculum.
HP:0006821.definition_cn: 一种多小脑回畸形，其严重程度呈梯度分布（前部较后部更为严重），从前极向后延伸至中央前回，向下延伸至额叶岛盖。

HP:0006825.name: Pallor of dorsal columns of the spinal cord
HP:0006825.definition: An abnormally pale appearance of the dorsal portion of the gray substance of the spinal cord. This finding can be observed by histological examination.
HP:0006825.definition_cn: 脊髓灰质背侧部分异常苍白的表现。此发现可通过组织学检查观察到。

HP:0006829.name: Severe muscular hypotonia
HP:0006829.definition: A severe degree of muscular hypotonia characterized by markedly reduced muscle tone.
HP:0006829.definition_cn: 重度肌张力减退，其特征为显著降低的肌张力。

HP:0006830.name: obsolete Severe neonatal hypotonia in males
HP:0006830.name_cn: 男性新生儿重度肌张力低下

HP:0006834.name: Developmental stagnation at onset of seizures
HP:0006834.definition: A cessation of the development of a child in the areas of motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and/or emotional skills, following the onset of epilepsy.
HP:0006834.name_cn: 癫痫发作时的发育停滞
HP:0006834.definition_cn: 癫痫发作后儿童在运动技能、言语和语言、认知技能以及社交和/或情感技能方面的发育停滞。

HP:0006837.name: Congenital Horner syndrome
HP:0006837.definition: A type of Horner syndrome with congenital onset.
HP:0006837.definition_cn: 一种先天性霍纳综合征。

HP:0006844.name: Absent patellar reflexes
HP:0006844.definition: Absence of the knee jerk reflex, which can normally be elicited by tapping the patellar tendon with a reflex hammer just below the patella.
HP:0006844.definition_cn: 膝跳反射消失，通常可通过在髌骨下方用反射锤轻叩髌腱引出。

HP:0006849.name: Hypodysplasia of the corpus callosum
HP:0006849.definition: Developmental defect characterized by a small and malformed corpus callosum.
HP:0006849.definition_cn: 以胼胝体发育不全和形态异常为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0006850.name: Hypoplasia of the ventral pons
HP:0006850.definition: Underdevelopment of the ventral portion of the pons.

HP:0006851.name: Symmetric spinal nerve root neurofibromas
HP:0006851.definition: Multiple neurofibromas of the spinal nerve roots with a symmetric distribution.
HP:0006851.name_cn: 对称性脊神经根神经纤维瘤
HP:0006851.definition_cn: 脊髓神经根多发性神经纤维瘤，呈对称性分布。

HP:0006852.name: Episodic generalized hypotonia
HP:0006852.definition: The occurrence of repeated episodes of generalized muscular hypotonia.
HP:0006852.name_cn: 发作性全身性肌张力减退
HP:0006852.definition_cn: 反复发作的全身性肌张力减退。

HP:0006855.name: Cerebellar vermis atrophy
HP:0006855.definition: Wasting (atrophy) of the vermis of cerebellum.
HP:0006855.definition_cn: 小脑蚓部萎缩（小脑蚓部消耗性萎缩）。

HP:0006858.name: Impaired distal proprioception
HP:0006858.definition: A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position occurring at distal joints.
HP:0006858.definition_cn: 远端关节本体感觉丧失或受损。

HP:0006863.name: Severe expressive language delay
HP:0006863.definition: A severe delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.
HP:0006863.name_cn: 严重表达性语言发育迟缓
HP:0006863.definition_cn: 严重语言发育迟缓（Severe Language Development Delay）

HP:0006865.name: Sensorimotor polyneuropathy affecting arms more than legs
HP:0006865.name_cn: 上肢重于下肢的感觉运动性多发性神经病

HP:0006866.name: Midline central nervous system lipomas
HP:0006866.name_cn: 中线中枢神经系统脂肪瘤

HP:0006870.name: Lobar holoprosencephaly
HP:0006870.definition: A type of holoprosencephaly in which most of the right and left cerebral hemispheres and lateral ventricles are separated but the most rostral aspect of the telencephalon, the frontal lobes, are fused, especially ventrally.
HP:0006870.definition_cn: 一种前脑无裂畸形，其中大部分左右大脑半球和侧脑室已分离，但端脑的最前部，即额叶，尤其是腹侧部分，发生融合。

HP:0006873.name: Symmetrical progressive peripheral demyelination
HP:0006873.definition: A symmetric and progressive loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0006873.name_cn: 对称性进行性周围神经脱髓鞘病变
HP:0006873.definition_cn: 沿周围神经系统有髓神经纤维的结间区域发生对称性和进行性髓鞘脱失。

HP:0006877.name: obsolete Mental retardation, in some
HP:0006877.name_cn: 智力发育障碍（旧称：精神发育迟滞）

HP:0006879.name: Pontocerebellar atrophy
HP:0006879.definition: Atrophy affecting the pons and the cerebellum.
HP:0006879.definition_cn: 影响脑桥和小脑的萎缩。

HP:0006881.name: Diffuse peripheral demyelination
HP:0006881.definition: A diffuse loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0006881.name_cn: 弥漫性周围神经脱髓鞘
HP:0006881.definition_cn: 沿周围神经系统有髓神经纤维的结间区域发生弥漫性髓鞘脱失。

HP:0006886.name: Impaired distal vibration sensation
HP:0006886.definition: A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration in the distal portions of the limbs.

HP:0006887.name: Intellectual disability, progressive
HP:0006887.definition: The term progressive intellectual disability should be used if intelligence decreases/deteriorates over time.
HP:0006887.definition_cn: 如果智力随时间逐渐减退/恶化，应使用术语“进行性智力障碍”。

HP:0006889.name: Intellectual disability, borderline
HP:0006889.definition: Borderline intellectual disability is defined as an intelligence quotient (IQ) in the range of 70-85.
HP:0006889.definition_cn: 边缘性智力障碍定义为智商（IQ）在70至85之间的范围。

HP:0006892.name: Frontotemporal cerebral atrophy
HP:0006892.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decrease in size of cells or tissue) affecting the frontotemporal cerebrum.
HP:0006892.definition_cn: 额颞叶大脑萎缩（萎缩、细胞或组织体积减小）。

HP:0006893.name: obsolete Severely dysplastic cerebellum
HP:0006893.name_cn: 废弃的严重发育不良小脑

HP:0006896.name: Hypnopompic hallucination
HP:0006896.definition: Brief hallucinations that occur as you wake up in the morning, in a state that falls somewhere between dreaming and being fully awake.
HP:0006896.definition_cn: 晨间幻觉（Hypnopompic hallucinations），即个体在从睡眠向完全清醒状态过渡期间所经历的短暂幻觉现象，处于梦境与清醒意识之间的中间状态。

HP:0006897.name: Abducens palsy
HP:0006897.definition: Malfunction of the abducens nerve as manifested by impairment of the ability of the affected eye to be moved outward. Patients who develop abducens nerve palsy often present with binocular horizontal diplopia, which is a double vision when looking at objects side by side. There will be a notable weakness of the ipsilateral lateral rectus muscle leading to a deficit in of eye abduction on the affected side. Some patients may present with a constant head turning movement to maintain binocular fusion and to lessen the degree of diplopia.
HP:0006897.definition_cn: 外展神经功能障碍表现为患侧眼球外展运动能力受损。发生外展神经麻痹的患者常表现为双眼水平复视，即注视并排物体时出现双重视觉。患侧外直肌明显无力，导致患侧眼球外展功能缺陷。部分患者可能出现持续的头部转动动作，以维持双眼融合并减轻复视程度。

HP:0006901.name: obsolete Impaired thermal sensitivity
HP:0006901.name_cn: 过时的 温度觉受损

HP:0006906.name: Congenital intracerebral calcification
HP:0006906.definition: The presence of calcium deposition within brain structures that is present already at the time of birth.
HP:0006906.definition_cn: 先天性脑内钙质沉积症。

HP:0006915.name: Inability to walk by childhood/adolescence
HP:0006915.name_cn: 儿童期/青春期行走功能障碍

HP:0006916.name: Intraaxonal accumulation of curvilinear autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
HP:0006916.definition: Curvilinear intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material within axons.
HP:0006916.name_cn: 轴突内曲线形自发荧光脂褐素储存物质的积聚
HP:0006916.definition_cn: 轴突内曲线状细胞内自体荧光脂褐素储存物质的积聚。

HP:0006919.name: obsolete Abnormal aggressive, impulsive or violent behavior
HP:0006919.name_cn: 过时的异常攻击性、冲动性或暴力行为

HP:0006921.name: Axial muscle stiffness
HP:0006921.definition: Stiffness (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) of the axial musculature.
HP:0006921.definition_cn: 轴性肌群僵硬（一种在无伴随疼痛或痉挛的情况下，肌肉无法快速活动的状态）。

HP:0006926.name: obsolete Metachromatic leukodystrophy variant
HP:0006926.name_cn: 过时的异染性脑白质营养不良变异型

HP:0006927.name: Unilateral polymicrogyria
HP:0006927.definition: Excessive number of small gyri (convolutions) on the surface of one side of the brain.
HP:0006927.definition_cn: 单侧大脑半球表面脑回（回旋）数量过多。

HP:0006929.name: Hypoglycemic encephalopathy
HP:0006929.definition: Brain damage related to a lowering of blood glucose below a critical level (around 30 mg/dl), which may lead to confusion, lethargy and delirium followed by seizures and coma. Prolonged hypoglycemia may lead to irreversible brain damage.
HP:0006929.definition_cn: 与血糖降至临界水平（约30 mg/dl）相关的脑损伤，可能导致意识模糊、嗜睡和谵妄，随后出现癫痫发作和昏迷。长期低血糖可能导致不可逆的脑损伤。

HP:0006930.name: Frontoparietal cortical dysplasia
HP:0006930.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the cortex of frontal lobe and the cortex of parietal lobe.
HP:0006930.definition_cn: 额叶皮质与顶叶皮质发育不良。

HP:0006931.name: Pericallosal lipoma
HP:0006931.definition: Pericallosal lipomas are congenital soft masses of adipose cells encapsulated by a thin layer of fibrous tissue, appearing adjacent to the corpus callosum of the brain.
HP:0006931.definition_cn: 胼胝体周围脂肪瘤是一种先天性软组织肿块，由脂肪细胞构成，被一层薄纤维组织包裹，通常出现在大脑胼胝体附近。

HP:0006932.name: Transient psychotic episodes
HP:0006932.definition: Relatively short-lived periods of psychosis are characterized by the sudden onset of severe disturbances in perception, thinking, and behavior. These episodes typically last for a brief duration, generally ranging from a few days to a few weeks, and are often triggered by a significant stressor or traumatic event.
HP:0006932.definition_cn: 相对短暂的精神病发作期以感知、思维和行为的严重紊乱突然发作为特征。这些发作通常持续时间较短，一般从几天到几周不等，且常由重大应激源或创伤性事件触发。

HP:0006934.name: Congenital nystagmus
HP:0006934.definition: Nystagmus dating from or present at birth.

HP:0006937.name: Impaired distal tactile sensation
HP:0006937.definition: A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation) on the skin of the distal limbs. This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.
HP:0006937.definition_cn: 远端肢体皮肤触觉减退。通常使用棉絮或细驼毛刷进行测试，要求患者在每次感受到刺激时说出“现在”。

HP:0006938.name: Impaired vibration sensation at ankles
HP:0006938.definition: A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration at the ankles. Clinically, this is usually tested with a tuning fork which vibrates at 128 Hz and is applied to the malleoli of the ankles.
HP:0006938.definition_cn: 踝关节振动觉减退。临床上，通常使用频率为128赫兹的音叉进行测试，将其置于踝关节的踝突处。

HP:0006943.name: Diffuse spongiform leukoencephalopathy
HP:0006943.name_cn: 弥漫性海绵状脑白质病

HP:0006944.name: Abolished vibration sense
HP:0006944.definition: A complete loss of the ability to perceive vibration.

HP:0006946.name: Recurrent meningitis
HP:0006946.definition: An increased susceptibility to meningitis as manifested by a medical history of recurrent episodes of meningitis.
HP:0006946.definition_cn: 表现为反复发作性脑膜炎病史的脑膜炎易感性增加。

HP:0006955.name: Olivopontocerebellar hypoplasia
HP:0006955.definition: Hypoplasia of the cerebellum, pontine nuclei, and inferior olivary nucleus.
HP:0006955.name_cn: 橄榄体脑桥小脑发育不全
HP:0006955.definition_cn: 小脑发育不全、脑桥核发育不全及下橄榄核发育不全。

HP:0006957.name: obsolete Loss of ability to walk

HP:0006958.name: Abnormal auditory evoked potentials
HP:0006958.definition: An abnormality of the auditory evoked potentials, which are used to trace the signal generated by a sound, from the cochlear nerve, through the lateral lemniscus, to the medial geniculate nucleus, and to the cortex.
HP:0006958.definition_cn: 听觉诱发电位异常，用于追踪由声音产生的信号，从耳蜗神经经外侧丘系至内侧膝状体，最终到达大脑皮层。

HP:0006959.name: Proximal spinal muscular atrophy
HP:0006959.definition: Proximal spinal muscular atrophy, i.e., muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.
HP:0006959.definition_cn: 近端脊髓性肌萎缩症，即与脊髓和脑干运动神经元丧失相关的肌无力和肌肉萎缩。

HP:0006960.name: Choroid plexus calcification
HP:0006960.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in the choroid plexus.

HP:0006962.name: Gait instability, worse in the dark

HP:0006964.name: Cerebral cortical neurodegeneration
HP:0006964.name_cn: 大脑皮质神经退行性变

HP:0006970.name: Periventricular leukomalacia
HP:0006970.definition: Periventricular leukomalacia is characterized by diffuse injury of deep cerebral white matter, accompanied in its most severe form by focal necrosis. The neuropathologic hallmarks of PVL are microglial activation and focal and diffuse periventricular depletion of premyelinating oligodendroglia.
HP:0006970.definition_cn: 脑室周围白质软化症的特征是深部脑白质的弥漫性损伤，最严重时伴有局灶性坏死。其神经病理学标志为小胶质细胞活化以及脑室周围前髓鞘少突胶质细胞的局灶性和弥漫性缺失。

HP:0006976.name: Necrotizing encephalopathy
HP:0006976.definition: A type of encephalopathy (brain disease, damage, or malfunction accompanied by an altered mental state) that is characterized by evidence of necrosis of brain tissue.
HP:0006976.definition_cn: 一种脑病（伴随精神状态改变的脑部疾病、损伤或功能障碍），其特征为脑组织坏死的证据。

HP:0006977.name: Deficit in grammar
HP:0006977.definition: Deficit in grammar, including syntax and morphology.
HP:0006977.definition_cn: 语法缺陷，包括句法和形态学方面的障碍。

HP:0006978.name: Dysmyelinating leukodystrophy
HP:0006978.name_cn: 髓鞘形成不良性脑白质营养不良

HP:0006979.name: Sleep-wake cycle disturbance
HP:0006979.definition: Any abnormality of an individual's circadian rhythm that affects the timing of sleeping and being awake is referred to as a sleep-wake disorder.
HP:0006979.definition_cn: 个体昼夜节律异常，影响睡眠和觉醒时间的现象，被称为睡眠-觉醒障碍。

HP:0006980.name: Progressive leukoencephalopathy
HP:0006980.definition: Leukoencephalopathy that gets more severe with time.

HP:0006983.name: obsolete Slowly progressive spastic quadriparesis
HP:0006983.name_cn: 缓慢进展性痉挛性四肢轻瘫

HP:0006984.name: obsolete Distal sensory loss of all modalities
HP:0006984.name_cn: 陈旧性远端感觉丧失（所有感觉模式）

HP:0006988.name: Alobar holoprosencephaly
HP:0006988.definition: A type of holoprosencephaly characterized by the presence of a single ventricle and no separation of the cerebral hemisphere. The single midline ventricle is often greatly enlarged.
HP:0006988.definition_cn: 一种全前脑畸形，其特征为存在单一脑室且大脑半球未分离。该单一中线脑室常显著扩大。

HP:0006989.name: Dysplastic corpus callosum
HP:0006989.definition: Dysplasia and dysgenesis of the corpus callosum are nonspecific descriptions that imply defective development of the corpus callosum. The term dysplasia is applied when the morphology of the corpus callosum is altered as a congenital trait. For instance, the corpus callosum may be hump-shaped, kinked, or a striped corpus callosum that lacks an anatomically distinct genu and splenium.
HP:0006989.definition_cn: 胼胝体发育不良和胼胝体发育不全是指胼胝体发育缺陷的非特异性描述。术语“发育不良”用于描述胼胝体形态发生先天性改变的情况。例如，胼胝体可能呈驼峰状、弯曲或条纹状，且缺乏解剖学上明确的膝部和压部。

HP:0006990.name: Myelin-dependent gliosis
HP:0006990.definition: A type of gliosis that occurs in the vicinity of injured neurons.
HP:0006990.definition_cn: 一种发生在受损神经元周围的胶质增生类型。

HP:0006999.name: Basal ganglia gliosis
HP:0006999.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the basal ganglia.
HP:0006999.definition_cn: 基底神经节胶质细胞局灶性增生。

HP:0007001.name: Loss of Purkinje cells in the cerebellar vermis
HP:0007001.name_cn: 小脑蚓部浦肯野细胞缺失

HP:0007002.name: Motor axonal neuropathy
HP:0007002.definition: Progressive impairment of function of motor axons with muscle weakness, atrophy, and cramps. The deficits are length-dependent, meaning that muscles innervated by the longest nerves are affected first, so that for instance the arms are affected at a later age than the onset of deficits involving the lower leg.
HP:0007002.definition_cn: 运动轴突功能进行性损害，伴随肌无力、萎缩和痉挛。这些缺陷呈长度依赖性，意味着由最长神经支配的肌肉首先受累，因此，例如上肢受累的年龄晚于涉及小腿的缺陷出现的时间。

HP:0007007.name: Cavitation of the basal ganglia
HP:0007007.definition: The formation of small cavities in the tissue of the basal ganglia.
HP:0007007.definition_cn: 基底神经节组织内小腔隙的形成。

HP:0007009.name: Central nervous system degeneration
HP:0007009.name_cn: 中枢神经系统退行性变

HP:0007010.name: Poor fine motor coordination
HP:0007010.definition: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of small muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Fine motor skills are required to mediate movements of the wrists, hands, fingers, feet, and toes.
HP:0007010.definition_cn: 精细运动技能异常，指在执行特定动作时，小肌肉群进行精确运动的能力（技能）出现异常。精细运动技能是调节手腕、手、手指、脚和脚趾运动所必需的。

HP:0007011.name: Fourth cranial nerve palsy
HP:0007011.definition: Paralysis of the fourth cranial (trochlear) nerve manifested as weakness of the superior oblique muscle which causes vertical diplopia that is maximal when the affected eye is adducted and directed inferiorly.
HP:0007011.definition_cn: 第四颅神经（滑车神经）麻痹表现为上斜肌无力，导致垂直性复视，当患眼内收并向下注视时复视最为明显。

HP:0007015.name: Poor gross motor coordination
HP:0007015.definition: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of large muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Gross motor skills are required to mediate movements of the arms, legs, and other large body parts.
HP:0007015.definition_cn: 大运动技能异常，表现为执行特定动作时大肌群精确运动能力（技能）的障碍。大运动技能是调节手臂、腿部及其他大身体部位运动所必需的。

HP:0007018.name: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
HP:0007018.definition: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) manifests at age 2-3 years or by first grade at the latest. The main symptoms are distractibility, impulsivity, hyperactivity, and often trouble organizing tasks and projects, difficulty going to sleep, and social problems from being aggressive, loud, or impatient.
HP:0007018.definition_cn: 注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）通常在2-3岁或最迟在小学一年级时显现。主要症状包括注意力分散、冲动性、多动性，以及常伴有任务和项目组织困难、入睡困难，以及因攻击性、吵闹或缺乏耐心而引发的社交问题。

HP:0007023.name: Antenatal intracerebral hemorrhage
HP:0007023.definition: Cerebral hemorrhage that occurs before birth.

HP:0007024.name: Pseudobulbar paralysis
HP:0007024.definition: Bilateral impairment of the function of the cranial nerves 9-12, which control musculature involved in eating, swallowing, and speech. Pseudobulbar paralysis is characterized clinically by dysarthria, dysphonia, and dysphagia with bifacial paralysis, and may be accompanied by Pseudobulbar behavioral symptoms such as enforced crying and laughing.
HP:0007024.definition_cn: 双侧颅神经IX-XII功能受损，这些神经控制与进食、吞咽和言语相关的肌肉。假性延髓麻痹的临床特征包括构音障碍、发音困难和吞咽困难，伴有双侧面瘫，并可能伴随假性延髓行为症状，如强制性哭笑。

HP:0007027.name: Poorly formed metencephalon
HP:0007027.definition: A morphological abnormality of the metencephalon.

HP:0007029.name: Cerebral berry aneurysm
HP:0007029.definition: A small, sac-like aneurysm (outpouching) of a cerebral blood vessel.
HP:0007029.name_cn: 脑动脉瘤（脑动脉囊状动脉瘤）
HP:0007029.definition_cn: 脑动脉瘤（脑动脉囊状扩张）。

HP:0007033.name: Cerebellar dysplasia
HP:0007033.definition: Cerebellar dysplasia (abnormal growth or development) is defined by abnormal cerebellar foliation, white matter arborization, and gray-white matter junction. Cerebellar dysplasia is a neuroimaging finding that describes abnormalities of both the cerebellar cortex and white matter and is associated with variable neurodevelopmental outcome. Dysplasia may globally involve the cerebellum or affect only one cerebellar hemisphere. In addition, cerebellar dysplasia may be associated with cortical/subcortical cysts.
HP:0007033.definition_cn: 小脑发育不良（异常生长或发育）定义为小脑脑回异常、白质分支异常以及灰白质交界处异常。小脑发育不良是一种神经影像学表现，描述小脑皮质和白质的异常，并与不同的神经发育结局相关。发育不良可能广泛累及整个小脑或仅影响一侧小脑半球。此外，小脑发育不良可能与皮质/皮质下囊肿相关。

HP:0007035.name: Anterior encephalocele
HP:0007035.definition: A type of congenital malformation in which brain tissue protrudes through a defect in the anterior (front) part of the skull.
HP:0007035.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，其中脑组织通过颅骨前部（前侧）的缺损突出。

HP:0007039.name: Symmetric lesions of the basal ganglia

HP:0007041.name: Chronic lymphocytic meningitis
HP:0007041.definition: Meningitis that persists for more than 4 weeks, and lymphocytes are present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0007041.name_cn: 慢性淋巴细胞性脑膜炎
HP:0007041.definition_cn: 病程超过4周的脑膜炎，且脑脊液（CSF）中存在淋巴细胞。

HP:0007047.name: Atrophy of the dentate nucleus
HP:0007047.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of dentate nucleus.
HP:0007047.definition_cn: 齿状核部分或完全萎缩（丧失）。

HP:0007048.name: Large basal ganglia
HP:0007048.definition: Increased size of the basal ganglia.

HP:0007054.name: Proximal hyperreflexia
HP:0007054.definition: Hyperactive stretch reflexes of muscles that move proximal joints (elbow, knee).
HP:0007054.definition_cn: 近端关节（肘关节、膝关节）运动肌群的亢进性牵张反射。

HP:0007058.name: Generalized cerebral atrophy/hypoplasia
HP:0007058.definition: Generalized atrophy or hypoplasia of the cerebrum.
HP:0007058.name_cn: 广泛性脑萎缩/发育不全
HP:0007058.definition_cn: 大脑广泛性萎缩或发育不全。

HP:0007063.name: Aplasia of the inferior half of the cerebellar vermis
HP:0007063.name_cn: 小脑蚓部下段发育不全

HP:0007064.name: Progressive language deterioration
HP:0007064.definition: Progressive loss of previously present language abilities.

HP:0007065.name: Disorganization of the anterior cerebellar vermis

HP:0007066.name: Proximal limb muscle stiffness
HP:0007066.definition: Stiffness of the limbs (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) occurring in the proximal limb muscle.
HP:0007066.definition_cn: 近端肢体肌肉僵硬（一种伴随疼痛或痉挛而无法快速移动肌肉的病症）。

HP:0007067.name: Distal peripheral sensory neuropathy
HP:0007067.definition: Peripheral sensory neuropathy affecting primarily distal sensation.
HP:0007067.name_cn: 远端周围感觉神经病变
HP:0007067.definition_cn: 主要影响远端感觉的周围感觉神经病变。

HP:0007068.name: Inferior cerebellar vermis hypoplasia
HP:0007068.definition: Underdevelopment of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.
HP:0007068.definition_cn: 小脑蚓部下部发育不全。

HP:0007074.name: Thick corpus callosum
HP:0007074.definition: Increased vertical dimension of the corpus callosum. This feature can be visualized by sagittal sections on magnetic resonance tomography imaging of the brain.
HP:0007074.definition_cn: 胼胝体垂直维度增加。该特征可通过脑部磁共振断层成像的矢状切面进行可视化观察。

HP:0007076.name: Extrapyramidal muscular rigidity
HP:0007076.definition: Muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement).
HP:0007076.definition_cn: 肌强直（肌肉持续收缩，伴有对被动运动的恒定阻力）。

HP:0007078.name: Decreased amplitude of sensory action potentials
HP:0007078.definition: A reduction in the amplitude of sensory nerve action potential. This feature is measured by nerve conduction studies.
HP:0007078.name_cn: 感觉动作电位幅度降低
HP:0007078.definition_cn: 感觉神经动作电位振幅降低。该特征通过神经传导研究进行测量。

HP:0007081.name: obsolete Late-onset muscular dystrophy
HP:0007081.name_cn: 过时术语：迟发性肌营养不良症

HP:0007082.name: Dilated third ventricle
HP:0007082.definition: An increase in size of the third ventricle.

HP:0007087.name: obsolete Involuntary jerking movements
HP:0007087.name_cn: 过时的 不自主抽搐运动

HP:0007089.name: Facial-lingual fasciculations
HP:0007089.definition: Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the face.
HP:0007089.definition_cn: 舌肌及面部肌群的肌束震颤。

HP:0007095.name: obsolete Frontoparietal polymicrogyria
HP:0007095.name_cn: 陈旧性额顶叶多小脑回畸形

HP:0007098.name: Paroxysmal choreoathetosis
HP:0007098.definition: Episodes of choreoathetosis that can occur following triggers such as quick voluntary movements.
HP:0007098.name_cn: 阵发性舞蹈手足徐动症
HP:0007098.definition_cn: 由快速自主运动等诱因引发的舞蹈手足徐动症发作。

HP:0007099.name: Chiari type I malformation
HP:0007099.definition: Arnold-Chiari type I malformation refers to a relatively mild degree of herniation of the posteroinferior region of the cerebellum (the cerebellar tonsils) into the cervical canal with little or no displacement of the fourth ventricle. It is characterized by one or both pointed (not rounded) cerebellar tonsils that project 5 mm below the foramen magnum, measured by a line drawn from the basion to the opisthion (McRae Line)
HP:0007099.definition_cn: Arnold-Chiari I型畸形是指小脑后下部区域（小脑扁桃体）相对轻度地疝入颈椎管，第四脑室移位极少或无移位。其特征为一个或两个尖形（非圆形）小脑扁桃体，投影于枕骨大孔下方5毫米处，测量方法为从颅底点（basion）至枕后点（opisthion）所画的连线（McRae线）。

HP:0007103.name: Hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
HP:0007103.definition: A darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter.
HP:0007103.name_cn: 磁共振成像（MRI）显示脑白质低信号
HP:0007103.definition_cn: 磁共振成像中源自脑白质的信号较预期更为低信号。

HP:0007105.name: Infantile encephalopathy
HP:0007105.definition: Encephalopathy with onset in the infantile period.

HP:0007107.name: Segmental peripheral demyelination
HP:0007107.definition: A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers from segments of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0007107.name_cn: 节段性周围神经脱髓鞘
HP:0007107.definition_cn: 周围神经系统节段性髓鞘神经纤维的结间区髓鞘脱失。

HP:0007108.name: Demyelinating peripheral neuropathy
HP:0007108.definition: Demyelinating neuropathy is characterized by slow nerve conduction velocities with reduced amplitudes of sensory/motor nerve conduction and prolonged distal latencies.
HP:0007108.definition_cn: 脱髓鞘性神经病以神经传导速度减慢、感觉/运动神经传导波幅降低及远端潜伏期延长为特征。

HP:0007115.name: Naso-orbital encephalocele
HP:0007115.definition: A type of encephalocele that occurs along the medial orbit wall at the level of the frontal process of the maxilla and the ethmoid-lacrimal bone junction.
HP:0007115.definition_cn: 一种发生于上颌骨额突与筛骨-泪骨交界处内侧眶壁水平的脑膨出。

HP:0007123.name: Subcortical dementia
HP:0007123.definition: A particular type of dementia characterized by a pattern of mental defects consisting prominently of forgetfulness, slowness of thought processes, and personality or mood change.
HP:0007123.definition_cn: 一种特定类型的痴呆症，其特征为以显著遗忘、思维过程迟缓以及人格或情绪改变为主要表现的精神缺陷模式。

HP:0007126.name: Proximal amyotrophy
HP:0007126.definition: Amyotrophy (muscular atrophy) affecting the proximal musculature.
HP:0007126.definition_cn: 近端肌群肌萎缩（肌肉萎缩）。

HP:0007131.name: Acute demyelinating polyneuropathy
HP:0007131.definition: Acute progressive areflexic weakness and mild sensory changes resulting from myelin breakdown and axonal degeneration.
HP:0007131.name_cn: 急性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病
HP:0007131.definition_cn: 急性进行性无反射性肌无力及轻度感觉改变，由髓鞘崩解和轴突变性引起。

HP:0007132.name: Pallidal degeneration
HP:0007132.definition: Neurodegeneration involving the globus pallidus,a part of the basal ganglia that is involved in the regulation of voluntary movement.
HP:0007132.definition_cn: 涉及苍白球的神经退行性病变，苍白球是基底神经节的一部分，参与调节自主运动。

HP:0007149.name: Distal upper limb amyotrophy
HP:0007149.definition: Muscular atrophy of distal arm muscles.

HP:0007153.name: Progressive extrapyramidal movement disorder
HP:0007153.name_cn: 进行性锥体外系运动障碍

HP:0007156.name: Asymmetric limb muscle stiffness
HP:0007156.definition: Stiffness of the limbs (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) occurring in an asymmetric pattern.
HP:0007156.name_cn: 非对称性肢体肌肉僵硬
HP:0007156.definition_cn: 肢体僵硬（一种肌肉在无伴随疼痛或痉挛情况下无法快速活动的状态）呈非对称性分布。

HP:0007158.name: Progressive extrapyramidal muscular rigidity
HP:0007158.definition: A progressive degree of muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement).
HP:0007158.name_cn: 进行性锥体外系肌强直
HP:0007158.definition_cn: 进行性肌强直（肌肉持续收缩伴被动运动时持续阻力）。

HP:0007159.name: Fluctuations in consciousness
HP:0007159.definition: Changes in one's level of awareness and responsiveness to their environment.
HP:0007159.definition_cn: 意识水平和环境反应性的改变。

HP:0007162.name: Diffuse demyelination of the cerebral white matter
HP:0007162.definition: A diffuse loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.
HP:0007162.name_cn: 大脑白质弥漫性脱髓鞘
HP:0007162.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统神经纤维的弥漫性髓鞘脱失。

HP:0007163.name: obsolete Corticospinal tract disease in lower limbs
HP:0007163.name_cn: 陈旧性下肢皮质脊髓束病变

HP:0007165.name: Periventricular heterotopia
HP:0007165.definition: A form of gray matter heterotopia were the mislocalized gray matter is typically located periventricularly, also sometimes called subependymal heterotopia. Periventricular means beside the ventricles. This is by far the most common location for heterotopia. Subependymal heterotopia present in a wide array of variations. There can be a small single node or a large number of nodes, can exist on either or both sides of the brain at any point along the higher ventricle margins, can be small or large, single or multiple, and can form a small node or a large wavy or curved mass.
HP:0007165.definition_cn: 一种灰质异位症的形式，其中错位的灰质通常位于脑室周围，有时也称为室管膜下异位。脑室周围意指位于脑室旁。这是迄今为止最常见的异位位置。室管膜下异位症表现出多种变异形式。可能是一个小的单一结节或大量结节，可以存在于大脑的一侧或两侧，沿着较高脑室边缘的任何位置，可以是小的或大的，单一的或多发的，并且可以形成一个小结节或一个大的波浪状或弯曲的团块。

HP:0007166.name: Paroxysmal dyskinesia
HP:0007166.definition: Episodic bouts of involuntary movements with dystonic, choreic, ballistic movements, or a combination thereof. There is no loss of consciousness during the attacks.
HP:0007166.definition_cn: 发作性不自主运动，包括肌张力障碍性、舞蹈样、投掷样运动或其组合。发作期间无意识丧失。

HP:0007179.name: Absent smooth pursuit
HP:0007179.definition: A complete lack of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.
HP:0007179.definition_cn: 眼球平滑追踪系统完全丧失跟踪物体的能力，这是一种相对缓慢的眼球运动，旨在最小化视网膜目标运动。

HP:0007181.name: Interosseus muscle atrophy
HP:0007181.definition: Atrophy of the interosseus muscles (including the palmar interossei that lie on the anterior aspect of the metacarpals, the dorsal interosseus muscles of the hand, which lie between the intercarpals, the plantar interosseus muscles, which lie underneath the metatarsal bones, and the dorsal interossei, which are located between the metatarsal bones.
HP:0007181.definition_cn: 骨间肌萎缩（包括位于掌骨前侧的掌侧骨间肌、位于腕骨之间的手背侧骨间肌、位于跖骨下方的足底骨间肌以及位于跖骨之间的足背侧骨间肌）。

HP:0007182.name: Peripheral hypomyelination
HP:0007182.definition: Reduced amount of myelin in the nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis in the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0007182.name_cn: 周围神经髓鞘形成不全
HP:0007182.definition_cn: 周围神经系统髓鞘生成缺陷导致的神经系统髓鞘含量减少。

HP:0007183.name: Focal T2 hyperintense basal ganglia lesion
HP:0007183.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the basal ganglia.
HP:0007183.name_cn: 局灶性T2高信号基底节病变
HP:0007183.definition_cn: 基底节区磁共振成像（MRI）上较预期为低的T2信号。该术语指影响基底节特定区域的局部高信号。

HP:0007185.name: Loss of consciousness
HP:0007185.definition: Loss of alertness and orientation to place and time.
HP:0007185.definition_cn: 意识障碍及时间、地点定向力丧失。

HP:0007187.name: Focal lissencephaly
HP:0007187.definition: A congenital absence of the convolutions of the cerebral cortex and a poorly formed sylvian fissure that affects a particular part of the cortex.
HP:0007187.definition_cn: 先天性大脑皮层回缺失及外侧裂发育不良，累及特定皮层区域。

HP:0007188.name: Congenital facial diplegia
HP:0007188.definition: Facial diplegia (that is, bilateral facial palsy) with congenital onset.
HP:0007188.definition_cn: 先天性面部双瘫（即双侧面部麻痹）。

HP:0007190.name: Neuronal loss in the cerebral cortex

HP:0007193.name: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure on awakening
HP:0007193.definition: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure of either generalized or focal onset occurring on or soon after wakening (typically within 90 minutes of waking, regardless of the time of day).
HP:0007193.name_cn: 觉醒期双侧强直-阵挛发作
HP:0007193.definition_cn: 双侧强直-阵挛性发作，无论是全面性还是局灶性起病，均发生在觉醒时或觉醒后不久（通常在觉醒后90分钟内，无论一天中的具体时间）。

HP:0007200.name: Episodic hypersomnia
HP:0007200.definition: Recurrent episodes of severe hypersomnia are accompanied by cognitive and behavioral disturbances, including confusion, derealization, apathy, compulsive eating, and hypersexuality.
HP:0007200.definition_cn: 反复发作的严重嗜睡症伴随认知和行为障碍，包括意识模糊、现实解体、情感淡漠、强迫性进食和性欲亢进。

HP:0007201.name: Cerebral artery atherosclerosis
HP:0007201.definition: The formation of the formation of fibrofatty lesions in the wall of an artery located in the brain.
HP:0007201.definition_cn: 脑动脉壁纤维脂肪斑块的形成。

HP:0007206.name: Hemimegalencephaly
HP:0007206.definition: Enlargement of all or parts of one cerebral hemisphere.
HP:0007206.definition_cn: 单侧大脑半球全部或部分增大。

HP:0007207.name: Photosensitive tonic-clonic seizure
HP:0007207.definition: Generalized-onset tonic-clonic seizures that are provoked by flashing or flickering light.
HP:0007207.name_cn: 光敏性强直-阵挛性发作
HP:0007207.definition_cn: 由闪烁或闪光诱发的全面性强直-阵挛发作。

HP:0007208.name: Irregular myelin loops
HP:0007208.definition: Presence of irregular redundant loops of focally folded myelin in a peripheral nerve.
HP:0007208.definition_cn: 外周神经中存在局部折叠髓鞘的不规则冗余环。

HP:0007209.name: Facial paralysis
HP:0007209.definition: Complete loss of ability to move facial muscles innervated by the facial nerve (i.e., the seventh cranial nerve).
HP:0007209.definition_cn: 完全性面神经（即第七对脑神经）支配的面部肌肉运动功能丧失。

HP:0007210.name: Lower limb amyotrophy
HP:0007210.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting the lower limb.

HP:0007215.name: Periodic hyperkalemic paralysis
HP:0007215.definition: Episodes of muscle weakness associated with elevated levels of potassium in the blood.
HP:0007215.definition_cn: 与高钾血症相关的肌无力发作。

HP:0007229.name: Intracerebral periventricular calcifications
HP:0007229.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in the cerebral white matter surrounding the cerebral ventricles.
HP:0007229.definition_cn: 脑室周围脑白质钙质沉积。

HP:0007230.name: Decreased distal sensory nerve action potential
HP:0007230.definition: A reduction in the amplitude of sensory nerve action potential in distal nerve segments. This feature is measured by nerve conduction studies.
HP:0007230.name_cn: 远端感觉神经动作电位降低
HP:0007230.definition_cn: 远端神经节段感觉神经动作电位振幅降低。该特征通过神经传导研究进行测量。

HP:0007232.name: Spinocerebellar tract disease in lower limbs

HP:0007233.name: Clusters of axonal regeneration
HP:0007233.definition: Groups of small caliber axons in peripheral nerve biospies indicative of axonal regeneration.
HP:0007233.definition_cn: 外周神经活检中观察到的小口径轴突群提示轴突再生。

HP:0007238.name: Nonarteriosclerotic cerebral calcification
HP:0007238.name_cn: 非动脉粥样硬化性脑钙化

HP:0007240.name: Progressive gait ataxia
HP:0007240.definition: A type of gait ataxia displaying progression of clinical severity.
HP:0007240.definition_cn: 一种表现为临床严重程度进展的步态共济失调类型。

HP:0007249.name: Decreased number of small peripheral myelinated nerve fibers
HP:0007249.name_cn: 小周围有髓神经纤维数量减少

HP:0007250.name: Recurrent external ophthalmoplegia
HP:0007250.definition: Alternating and recurrent weakness of the external ocular muscles.
HP:0007250.definition_cn: 眼外肌交替性和复发性肌无力。

HP:0007256.name: Abnormal pyramidal sign
HP:0007256.definition: Functional neurological abnormalities related to dysfunction of the pyramidal tract.
HP:0007256.definition_cn: 与锥体束功能障碍相关的功能性神经异常。

HP:0007258.name: Severe demyelination of the white matter
HP:0007258.definition: A severe loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.
HP:0007258.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统神经纤维髓鞘严重脱失。

HP:0007260.name: Type II lissencephaly
HP:0007260.definition: A form of lissencephaly characterized by an uneven cortical surface with a so called 'cobblestone' appearace. There are no distinguishable cortical layers.
HP:0007260.definition_cn: 一种表现为皮质表面不规则、呈现所谓“鹅卵石”外观的无脑回畸形类型。皮质层无法区分。

HP:0007262.name: Symmetric peripheral demyelination
HP:0007262.definition: A symmetric loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0007262.name_cn: 对称性周围神经脱髓鞘病变
HP:0007262.definition_cn: 周围神经系统有髓神经纤维的结间区域对称性髓鞘脱失。

HP:0007263.name: Spinocerebellar atrophy
HP:0007263.definition: Atrophy affecting the cerebellum and the spinocerebellar tracts of the spinal cord.
HP:0007263.definition_cn: 小脑及脊髓小脑束萎缩。

HP:0007266.name: Cerebral dysmyelination
HP:0007266.definition: Defective structure and function of myelin sheaths of the white matter of the brain.
HP:0007266.definition_cn: 脑白质髓鞘结构和功能缺陷。

HP:0007267.name: Chronic axonal neuropathy
HP:0007267.definition: An abnormality characterized by chronic impairment of the normal functioning of the axons.
HP:0007267.definition_cn: 一种以轴突正常功能慢性受损为特征的异常。

HP:0007269.name: Spinal muscular atrophy
HP:0007269.definition: Muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.
HP:0007269.definition_cn: 与脊髓和脑干运动神经元丧失相关的肌无力和肌萎缩。

HP:0007270.name: Atypical absence seizure
HP:0007270.definition: An atypical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by interruption of ongoing activities and reduced responsiveness. In comparison to a typical absence seizure, changes in tone may be more pronounced, onset and/or cessation may be less abrupt, and the duration of the ictus and post-ictal recovery may be longer. Although not always available, an EEG often demonstrates slow (<3 Hz), irregular, generalized spike-wave activity.
HP:0007270.definition_cn: 非典型失神发作是一种广泛性非运动性（失神）发作，其特征为正在进行活动的突然中断和反应性降低。与典型失神发作相比，肌张力改变可能更为明显，发作开始和/或终止可能不那么突然，发作期和发作后恢复的持续时间可能更长。尽管并非总是可行，但脑电图通常显示为缓慢（<3 Hz）、不规则、广泛性棘慢波活动。

HP:0007272.name: Progressive psychomotor deterioration
HP:0007272.name_cn: 进行性精神运动功能退化

HP:0007274.name: Recurrent bacterial meningitis
HP:0007274.definition: An increased susceptibility to bacterial meningitis as manifested by a medical history of recurrent episodes of bacterial meningitis.
HP:0007274.definition_cn: 表现为反复发作的细菌性脑膜炎病史的细菌性脑膜炎易感性增加。

HP:0007277.name: Paucity of anterior horn motor neurons

HP:0007280.name: Acute infantile spinal muscular atrophy
HP:0007280.name_cn: 急性婴儿型脊髓性肌萎缩症

HP:0007281.name: Developmental stagnation
HP:0007281.definition: A cessation of the development of a child in the areas of motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and/or emotional skills.
HP:0007281.definition_cn: 儿童在运动技能、言语和语言、认知技能以及社交和/或情感技能方面的发育停滞。

HP:0007285.name: Facial palsy secondary to cranial hyperostosis
HP:0007285.definition: Paralysis of the facial nerves on the basis of overgrowth of the cranial bones causing impingement upon the seventh cranial nerve.
HP:0007285.name_cn: 继发于颅骨肥厚的面神经麻痹
HP:0007285.definition_cn: 面神经麻痹，由于颅骨过度生长导致第七对颅神经受压所致。

HP:0007286.name: Horizontal jerk nystagmus
HP:0007286.definition: Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements, in which the movement in one direction is faster than in the other.
HP:0007286.definition_cn: 水平性往返眼球震颤，其中一侧方向的运动速度较另一侧更快。

HP:0007289.name: Limb fasciculations
HP:0007289.definition: Fasciculations affecting the musculature of the arms and legs.
HP:0007289.definition_cn: 影响上肢和下肢肌肉的肌束震颤。

HP:0007291.name: Posterior fossa cyst
HP:0007291.definition: A discrete posterior fossa cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) collection that does not communicate directly with the fourth ventricle.
HP:0007291.definition_cn: 一个不直接与第四脑室相通的孤立性后颅窝脑脊液（CSF）积聚。

HP:0007295.name: Chaotic rapid conjugate ocular movements
HP:0007295.name_cn: 混乱性快速共轭眼球运动

HP:0007299.name: Dysfunction of lateral corticospinal tracts
HP:0007299.name_cn: 外侧皮质脊髓束功能障碍

HP:0007301.name: Oromotor apraxia
HP:0007301.definition: Oral-motor apraxia is the inability to volitionally sequence oral movements of the speech structure for nonspeech tasks in the absence of neuromuscular deficits such as paralysis or muscle weakness. Oral-motor apraxia is diagnosed when, despite intact sensory motor function an individual is unable to use these effector systems under voluntary control.
HP:0007301.definition_cn: 口腔运动失用症是指在无神经肌肉缺陷（如瘫痪或肌无力）的情况下，无法自主序列化执行非言语任务的口腔运动。当个体在感觉运动功能完好的情况下，仍无法在自主控制下使用这些效应器系统时，即可诊断为口腔运动失用症。

HP:0007302.name: Bipolar affective disorder
HP:0007302.definition: Bipolar disorder is an illness of mood characterized by alternating episodes of elevated and depressed moods, which are interspersed with euthymic periods.
HP:0007302.definition_cn: 双相情感障碍是一种以交替出现的情绪高涨和情绪低落为特征的心境障碍，其间穿插着情绪平稳期。

HP:0007305.name: CNS demyelination
HP:0007305.definition: A loss of myelin from nerve fibers in the central nervous system.
HP:0007305.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统神经纤维的髓鞘脱失。

HP:0007314.name: obsolete White matter neuronal heterotopia
HP:0007314.name_cn: 过时的白质神经元异位症

HP:0007316.name: obsolete Involuntary writhing movements
HP:0007316.name_cn: 过时的 不自主的扭动运动

HP:0007321.name: Deep white matter hypodensities
HP:0007321.definition: Multiple areas of darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the deep cerebral white matter.
HP:0007321.definition_cn: 磁共振成像显示深部脑白质区域存在多处信号强度较预期偏低的异常信号。

HP:0007325.name: Generalized dystonia
HP:0007325.definition: A type of dystonia that affects all or most of the body.
HP:0007325.definition_cn: 一种影响全身或大部分躯体的肌张力障碍。

HP:0007326.name: Progressive choreoathetosis
HP:0007326.name_cn: 进行性舞蹈手足徐动症

HP:0007327.name: Mixed demyelinating and axonal polyneuropathy
HP:0007327.name_cn: 混合性脱髓鞘性和轴索性多发性神经病

HP:0007328.name: Impaired pain sensation
HP:0007328.definition: Reduced ability to perceive painful stimuli.

HP:0007330.name: Frontoethmoidal encephalocele
HP:0007330.definition: A type of anterior encephalocele in which there is a protrusion of the contents of the skull through a breach at the point where the frontal and ethmoidal bones meet. Frontoethmoidal encephalocele can be divided further into three distinct categories: nasofrontal, nasoethmoidal, and nasoorbital.
HP:0007330.definition_cn: 一种前脑膨出类型，其中颅内容物通过额骨与筛骨交界处的缺损突出。额筛脑膨出可进一步分为三种不同的类别：鼻额型、鼻筛型和鼻眶型。

HP:0007332.name: Focal hemifacial clonic seizure
HP:0007332.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face.
HP:0007332.name_cn: 局灶性半侧面部阵挛性发作
HP:0007332.definition_cn: 以累及半侧面部的阵挛性运动为起始特征的局灶性癫痫发作。

HP:0007333.name: Hypoplasia of the frontal lobes
HP:0007333.definition: Underdevelopment of the frontal lobe of the cerebrum.

HP:0007334.name: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with focal onset
HP:0007334.definition: A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with focal onset is a focal-onset seizure which progresses into a bilateral tonic-clonic phase.
HP:0007334.name_cn: 双侧强直-阵挛性发作伴局灶性起始
HP:0007334.definition_cn: 双侧强直-阵挛性发作伴局灶性起始是一种由局灶性起始进展为双侧强直-阵挛期的癫痫发作。

HP:0007335.name: Recurrent encephalopathy
HP:0007335.definition: Recurrent episodes of brain dysfunction that may be triggered by factors such as metabolic disturbances or infections.
HP:0007335.definition_cn: 反复发作的脑功能障碍，可能由代谢紊乱或感染等因素诱发。

HP:0007338.name: Hypermetric saccades
HP:0007338.definition: A saccade that overshoots the target with the dynamic saccade.
HP:0007338.definition_cn: 动态扫视中扫视过冲目标。

HP:0007340.name: Lower limb muscle weakness
HP:0007340.definition: Weakness of the muscles of the legs.

HP:0007341.name: Diffuse swelling of cerebral white matter

HP:0007343.name: Abnormal morphology of the limbic system
HP:0007343.definition: Any structural anomaly of the limbic system, a set of midline structures surrounding the brainstem of the mammalian brain, originally described anatomically, e.g., hippocampal formation, amygdala, hypothalamus, cingulate cortex. Although the original designation was anatomical, the limbic system has come to be associated with the system in the brain subserving emotional functions. As such, it is very poorly defined and doesn't correspond closely to the anatomical meaning any longer. [BirnLex].
HP:0007343.definition_cn: 边缘系统的任何结构异常，边缘系统是一组围绕哺乳动物脑干的中线结构，最初从解剖学角度描述，例如海马结构、杏仁核、下丘脑、扣带皮层。尽管最初的命名是基于解剖学的，但边缘系统已逐渐与大脑中负责情绪功能的系统相关联。因此，其定义非常模糊，不再与解剖学意义紧密对应。[BirnLex]

HP:0007350.name: Upper limb hyperreflexia
HP:0007350.definition: Increased intensity of the a reflex in the arm.

HP:0007351.name: Upper limb postural tremor
HP:0007351.definition: A type of tremors that is triggered by holding an arm in a fixed position.
HP:0007351.definition_cn: 一种由保持手臂固定姿势引发的震颤类型。

HP:0007359.name: Focal-onset seizure
HP:0007359.definition: A focal-onset seizure is a type of seizure originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. They may be discretely localized or more widely distributed, and may originate in subcortical structures.
HP:0007359.definition_cn: 局灶性发作是一种起源于局限于一侧半球网络内的癫痫发作。它们可以明确地局限于某一区域，也可以更广泛地分布，并且可能起源于皮层下结构。

HP:0007360.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cerebellum
HP:0007360.name_cn: 小脑发育不全/小脑发育不良

HP:0007361.name: Abnormal pons morphology
HP:0007361.definition: A structural abnormality of the pons.

HP:0007362.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the brainstem
HP:0007362.name_cn: 脑干发育不全/脑干发育不良

HP:0007363.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the pyramidal tract
HP:0007363.name_cn: 锥体束发育不全/锥体束发育不良

HP:0007364.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cerebrum
HP:0007364.name_cn: 大脑发育不全/大脑发育不良

HP:0007365.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the corticospinal tracts
HP:0007365.name_cn: 涉及皮质脊髓束的发育不全/发育不良

HP:0007367.name: Atrophy/Degeneration affecting the central nervous system
HP:0007367.name_cn: 中枢神经系统萎缩/变性

HP:0007369.name: Atrophy/Degeneration affecting the cerebrum
HP:0007369.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebrum, also known as the telencephalon, the largest and most highly developed part of the human brain.
HP:0007369.definition_cn: 大脑（端脑）萎缩（消耗性病变）的存在，大脑是人类脑部最大且高度发达的部分。

HP:0007370.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the corpus callosum
HP:0007370.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the corpus callosum.
HP:0007370.name_cn: 胼胝体发育不全/胼胝体发育不良
HP:0007370.definition_cn: 胼胝体缺失或发育不全。

HP:0007371.name: Corpus callosum atrophy
HP:0007371.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the corpus callosum.
HP:0007371.definition_cn: 胼胝体萎缩（消耗性病变）的存在。

HP:0007375.name: Abnormal septum pellucidum morphology
HP:0007375.definition: An abnormality of the septum pellucidum, which is a thin, triangular, vertical membrane separating the lateral ventricles of the brain.
HP:0007375.definition_cn: 透明隔异常，即分隔大脑侧脑室的薄而呈三角形的垂直膜结构出现异常。

HP:0007376.name: Abnormal choroid plexus morphology
HP:0007376.definition: An abnormality of the choroid plexus, which is the area in the cerebral ventricles in which cerebrospinal fluid is produced by modified ependymal cells.
HP:0007376.definition_cn: 脉络丛异常，即脑室中由特化的室管膜细胞产生脑脊液的区域发生异常。

HP:0007377.name: Abnormality of somatosensory evoked potentials
HP:0007377.definition: An abnormality of somatosensory evoked potentials (SSEP), i.e., of the electrical signals of sensation going from the body to the brain in response to a defined stimulus. Recording electrodes are placed over the scalp, spine, and peripheral nerves proximal to the stimulation site. Clinical studies generally use electrical stimulation of peripheral nerves to elicit potentials. SSEP testing determines whether peripheral sensory nerves are able to transmit sensory information like pain, temperature, and touch to the brain. Abnormal SSEPs can result from dysfunction at the level of the peripheral nerve, plexus, spinal root, spinal cord, brain stem, thalamocortical projections, or primary somatosensory cortex.
HP:0007377.name_cn: 躯体感觉诱发电位异常
HP:0007377.definition_cn: 躯体感觉诱发电位（SSEP）异常，即从身体到大脑的感觉电信号在响应特定刺激时出现异常。记录电极放置在头皮、脊柱以及刺激部位附近的外周神经上。临床研究通常使用外周神经的电刺激来诱发电位。SSEP测试用于确定外周感觉神经是否能够将疼痛、温度和触觉等感觉信息传递至大脑。SSEP异常可能由外周神经、神经丛、脊髓根、脊髓、脑干、丘脑皮质投射或初级躯体感觉皮层的功能障碍引起。

HP:0007378.name: Neoplasm of the gastrointestinal tract
HP:0007378.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the gastrointestinal tract.
HP:0007378.definition_cn: 胃肠道肿瘤（组织异常增生）

HP:0007379.name: Neoplasm of the genitourinary tract
HP:0007379.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the genitourinary system.
HP:0007379.definition_cn: 泌尿生殖系统肿瘤（组织异常增生）。

HP:0007380.name: Facial telangiectasia
HP:0007380.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin of the face.
HP:0007380.definition_cn: 面部皮肤浅表层的毛细血管扩张（微血管扩张）。

HP:0007383.name: Congenital localized absence of skin
HP:0007383.name_cn: 先天性局限性皮肤缺失

HP:0007385.name: Aplasia cutis congenita of scalp
HP:0007385.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin on the scalp.
HP:0007385.definition_cn: 先天性头皮皮肤发育缺陷导致的头皮皮肤缺失。

HP:0007395.name: Postnatal-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma
HP:0007395.definition: A type of ichthyosiform erythroderma with postnatal onset.
HP:0007395.name_cn: 产后发作性鱼鳞病样红皮病
HP:0007395.definition_cn: 一种出生后发病的鱼鳞病样红皮病。

HP:0007396.name: Early cutaneous photosensitivity
HP:0007396.definition: Photosensitivity of the skin occurring early in life.
HP:0007396.definition_cn: 早年发生的皮肤光敏性。

HP:0007397.name: Axillary apocrine gland hypoplasia
HP:0007397.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the apocrine sweat glands in the region of the axilla.
HP:0007397.name_cn: 腋窝顶泌汗腺发育不全
HP:0007397.definition_cn: 腋窝区域顶泌汗腺发育不全。

HP:0007398.name: Asymmetric, linear skin defects
HP:0007398.name_cn: 不对称性线性皮肤缺损

HP:0007401.name: Macular atrophy
HP:0007401.definition: Well-demarcated area(s) of partial or complete depigmentation in the macula, reflecting atrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium with associated retinal photoreceptor loss.
HP:0007401.definition_cn: 黄斑区边界清晰的局部或完全脱色素区域，反映视网膜色素上皮萎缩并伴有视网膜光感受器细胞丧失。

HP:0007402.name: Areas of hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation that do not follow Blaschko lines
HP:0007402.name_cn: 不沿Blaschko线分布的色素减退和色素沉着区域

HP:0007404.name: Nonepidermolytic palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
HP:0007404.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin on the palms and soles charactersized by hyperkeratosis of the stratum corneum with no evidence of epidermolysis characteristic of epidermolytic hyperkeratosis.
HP:0007404.name_cn: 非表皮松解性掌跖角化过度症
HP:0007404.definition_cn: 掌跖皮肤异常增厚，其特征为角质层过度角化，无表皮松解性角化过度症所特有的表皮松解表现。

HP:0007407.name: Excessive skin wrinkling on dorsum of hands and fingers
HP:0007407.name_cn: 手背及手指皮肤过度皱褶

HP:0007408.name: Tegumentary leishmaniasis susceptibility
HP:0007408.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection by the protozan parasite of the genus Leishmania.
HP:0007408.definition_cn: 对利什曼原虫属原虫寄生虫感染的易感性增加。

HP:0007409.name: obsolete Absence of subcutaneous fat over entire body except buttocks, hips, and thighs
HP:0007409.name_cn: 全身皮下脂肪缺失，仅臀部、髋部和大腿除外。

HP:0007410.name: Palmoplantar hyperhidrosis
HP:0007410.definition: An abnormally increased perspiration on palms and soles.
HP:0007410.definition_cn: 掌跖多汗症（Palmar and Plantar Hyperhidrosis）

HP:0007411.name: Hypoplastic-absent sebaceous glands
HP:0007411.name_cn: 发育不全-缺失的皮脂腺

HP:0007412.name: Macular hyperpigmented dermopathy
HP:0007412.name_cn: 黄斑区色素沉着性皮肤病

HP:0007413.name: Nevus flammeus of the forehead
HP:0007413.definition: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the forehead.
HP:0007413.definition_cn: 额部皮肤局限性鲜红斑痣。

HP:0007414.name: Neonatal wrinkled skin of hands and feet

HP:0007417.name: Discoid lupus rash
HP:0007417.definition: Cutaneous lesion that develops as a dry, scaly, red patch that evolves to an indurated and hyperpigmented plaque with adherent scale. Scarring may result in central white patches (loss of pigmentation) and skin atrophy.
HP:0007417.definition_cn: 皮肤病变表现为干燥、鳞屑性红斑，逐渐发展为硬化性、色素沉着过度的斑块，伴有附着鳞屑。瘢痕形成可能导致中央白斑（色素脱失）和皮肤萎缩。

HP:0007420.name: Spontaneous hematomas
HP:0007420.definition: Spontaneous development of hematomas (hematoma) or bruises without significant trauma.
HP:0007420.definition_cn: 无明显外伤情况下自发性血肿（hematoma）或瘀斑（ecchymosis）形成。

HP:0007421.name: Telangiectases of the cheeks
HP:0007421.definition: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin of the cheeks.
HP:0007421.definition_cn: 位于面颊皮肤表层附近的毛细血管扩张（微小的扩张血管）。

HP:0007428.name: Telangiectasia of the oral mucosa
HP:0007428.definition: Telangiectasia (that is, the presence of small dilated superficial blood vessels) of the oral mucosa.
HP:0007428.name_cn: 口腔黏膜毛细血管扩张症
HP:0007428.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜毛细血管扩张症（即存在浅表小血管扩张）。

HP:0007429.name: Few cafe-au-lait spots
HP:0007429.definition: The presence of two to five cafe-au-lait macules.
HP:0007429.definition_cn: 存在两到五个咖啡牛奶斑。

HP:0007430.name: Generalized edema
HP:0007430.definition: Generalized abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin, or in one or more cavities of the body.
HP:0007430.definition_cn: 全身性皮下或体腔内异常液体积聚。

HP:0007431.name: Congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma
HP:0007431.definition: An ichthyosiform abnormality of the skin with congenital onset.
HP:0007431.name_cn: 先天性鱼鳞病样红皮病
HP:0007431.definition_cn: 先天性鱼鳞病样皮肤异常。

HP:0007432.name: Intermittent generalized erythematous papular rash
HP:0007432.name_cn: 间歇性全身性红斑性丘疹

HP:0007434.name: Plaque-like facial hemangioma
