HP:0008322.name: Abnormal mitochondrial morphology
HP:0008322.definition: Any structural anomaly of the mitochondria.

HP:0008323.name: Abnormal light- and dark-adapted electroretinogram
HP:0008323.definition: An abnormality of the combined rod-and-cone response on electroretinogram.
HP:0008323.name_cn: 异常明适应和暗适应视网膜电图
HP:0008323.definition_cn: 视网膜电图（ERG）中杆-锥细胞综合反应异常。

HP:0008326.name: Reduced circulating vitamin B6 circulating
HP:0008326.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.
HP:0008326.definition_cn: 血液循环中维生素B6浓度异常降低。

HP:0008327.name: Microscopic nephrocalcinosis
HP:0008327.definition: The presence of microscopic crystalline calcium precipitates in the form of oxalate and/or phosphate in the renal parenchyma.
HP:0008327.name_cn: 显微镜下肾钙质沉着症
HP:0008327.definition_cn: 肾实质内存在以草酸盐和/或磷酸盐形式存在的微观结晶钙沉淀物。

HP:0008330.name: Reduced von Willebrand factor activity
HP:0008330.definition: Decreased activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.
HP:0008330.name_cn: 血管性血友病因子活性降低
HP:0008330.definition_cn: 血管性血友病因子活性降低。血管性血友病因子介导血小板与暴露于内皮细胞表面的胶原蛋白的黏附。

HP:0008335.name: obsolete Renal aminoaciduria
HP:0008335.name_cn: 过时性肾性氨基酸尿症

HP:0008338.name: Partial functional complement factor D deficiency
HP:0008338.definition: A partial reduction in level of the complement component Factor D in circulation.
HP:0008338.name_cn: 部分功能性补体因子D缺乏症
HP:0008338.definition_cn: 循环中补体成分因子D水平的部分降低。

HP:0008339.name: Diaminoaciduria
HP:0008339.definition: An increased urine level of any amino acid carrying two amino groups (Asparagine, glutamine and lysine, cystine, ornithine).
HP:0008339.definition_cn: 尿液中携带两个氨基的氨基酸（天冬酰胺、谷氨酰胺、赖氨酸、胱氨酸、鸟氨酸）水平升高。

HP:0008341.name: Distal renal tubular acidosis
HP:0008341.definition: A type of renal tubular acidosis characterized by a failure of acid secretion by the alpha intercalated cells of the cortical collecting duct of the distal nephron. The urine cannot be acidified below a pH of 5.3, associated with acidemia and hypokalemia.
HP:0008341.definition_cn: 一种肾小管酸中毒类型，其特征为远端肾单位皮质集合管α插入细胞酸分泌功能障碍。尿液无法酸化至pH值低于5.3，常伴有酸血症和低钾血症。

HP:0008344.name: Elevated circulating branched chain amino acid concentration
HP:0008344.definition: Concentration of a branched chain amino acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0008344.name_cn: 循环支链氨基酸浓度升高
HP:0008344.definition_cn: 血液中支链氨基酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0008345.name: Hypoplasia of the iris dilator muscle

HP:0008346.name: Increased red cell sickling tendency
HP:0008346.name_cn: 红细胞镰状化倾向增加

HP:0008347.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex IV
HP:0008347.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.
HP:0008347.name_cn: 线粒体复合体IV活性降低
HP:0008347.definition_cn: 线粒体呼吸链复合物IV活性降低，该复合物是线粒体电子传递链的组成部分。

HP:0008348.name: Decreased circulating IgG2 concentration
HP:0008348.definition: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG2 subclass in the blood circulation.
HP:0008348.definition_cn: 循环血液中IgG2亚类免疫球蛋白水平降低。

HP:0008352.name: Impaired platelet adhesion
HP:0008352.definition: An abnormality of adhesion of thrombocytes. Normally, platelets adhere to collagen in the vascular subendothelium within seconds of injury via a receptor made up of glycoprotein Ia and IIa and GPVI and to vWF via receptor GPIb/IX/V. The adherent platelets then release granules that lead to platelet activation and aggregation.
HP:0008352.definition_cn: 血小板黏附异常。正常情况下，血小板通过由糖蛋白Ia和IIa以及GPVI组成的受体在损伤后数秒内黏附于血管内皮下胶原，并通过受体GPIb/IX/V黏附于血管性血友病因子（vWF）。黏附的血小板随后释放颗粒，导致血小板活化和聚集。

HP:0008353.name: Neutral hyperaminoaciduria
HP:0008353.definition: The presence of an abnormally increased concentration of neutral amino acids in the urine. The neutral amino acids are tryptophan, alanine, asparagine, glutamine, histidine, isoleucine, leucine, phenylalanine, serine, threonine, tyrosine and valine.
HP:0008353.definition_cn: 尿液中中性氨基酸浓度异常增高。中性氨基酸包括色氨酸、丙氨酸、天冬酰胺、谷氨酰胺、组氨酸、异亮氨酸、亮氨酸、苯丙氨酸、丝氨酸、苏氨酸、酪氨酸和缬氨酸。

HP:0008354.name: Factor X activation deficiency
HP:0008354.definition: Reduced ability to transform factor X into its activated form factor Xa.
HP:0008354.definition_cn: 因子X转化为其活化形式因子Xa的能力降低。

HP:0008356.name: obsolete Combined hyperlipidemia
HP:0008356.name_cn: 陈旧性混合型高脂血症

HP:0008357.name: Reduced factor XIII activity
HP:0008357.definition: Decreased activity of coagulation factor XIII (also known as fibrin stabilizing factor). Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.
HP:0008357.definition_cn: 凝血因子XIII（也称为纤维蛋白稳定因子）活性降低。活化的因子XIII通过交联纤维蛋白聚合物使血凝块固化。

HP:0008358.name: Hyperprolinemia
HP:0008358.definition: An increased concentration of proline in the blood.
HP:0008358.definition_cn: 血液中脯氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0008360.name: Neonatal hypoproteinemia
HP:0008360.definition: A neonatal decreased concentration of proteins in the blood.
HP:0008360.definition_cn: 新生儿低蛋白血症（Neonatal Hypoproteinemia）

HP:0008362.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the hallux
HP:0008362.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the big toe.
HP:0008362.name_cn: 拇趾发育不全/发育不良
HP:0008362.definition_cn: 第一趾缺如或发育不全。

HP:0008363.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tarsal bones
HP:0008363.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the tarsal bones.
HP:0008363.name_cn: 跗骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0008364.name: Abnormality of the calcaneus
HP:0008364.definition: An abnormality of the calcaneus, also known as the heel bone, one of the or heel bone, one of the components of the tarsus of the foot which make up the heel.
HP:0008364.definition_cn: 跟骨异常，即足跟骨异常，跟骨为构成足跟的跗骨组成部分之一。

HP:0008366.name: Foot joint contracture
HP:0008366.definition: Contractures of one or more joints of the feet meaning chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0008366.definition_cn: 足部一个或多个关节的挛缩，意指由于非骨性组织的结构改变导致的关节运动慢性丧失。

HP:0008368.name: Tarsal synostosis
HP:0008368.definition: Synostosis (bony fusion) involving one or more bones of the tarsus (calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, cuneiiform bones).
HP:0008368.definition_cn: 跗骨（跟骨、距骨、骰骨、舟骨、楔骨）中一骨或多骨的骨性融合（骨性连接）。

HP:0008369.name: Abnormal tarsal ossification
HP:0008369.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.
HP:0008369.definition_cn: 跗骨形成和矿化的异常，跗骨包括跟骨、距骨、骰骨、舟骨和楔骨在内的七块足部骨骼。

HP:0008371.name: Abnormal metatarsal ossification
HP:0008371.definition: Any abnormal process of ossification of the metatarsal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metatarsal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metatarsal I). The ossification process begins in the center of the body about the ninth week, and extends toward either extremity. The center for the base of the first metatarsal appears about the third year, and the centers for the heads of the other bones between the fifth and eighth years. They join the bodies between the eighteenth and twentieth years.
HP:0008371.definition_cn: 跖骨骨化过程中的任何异常，正常情况下，每块跖骨由两个骨化中心进行骨化：一个位于体部，另一个位于头部（第二、第三、第四和第五跖骨）或一个位于体部，另一个位于基底部（第一跖骨）。骨化过程大约在第九周时从体部中心开始，并向两端延伸。第一跖骨基底部的骨化中心大约在第三年出现，而其他跖骨头部的骨化中心则在第五至第八年之间出现。这些骨化中心在第十八至第二十年之间与体部融合。

HP:0008372.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin A concentration
HP:0008372.definition: Concentration of vitamin A in the blood circulation outside limits of normal.
HP:0008372.definition_cn: 血清维生素A浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0008373.name: Puberty and gonadal disorders
HP:0008373.name_cn: 青春期与性腺功能障碍

HP:0008383.name: Slow-growing nails
HP:0008383.definition: Nails whose growth is slower than normal.

HP:0008386.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nails
HP:0008386.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the nail.
HP:0008386.name_cn: 甲发育不全/甲发育不良
HP:0008386.definition_cn: 甲发育不全或甲发育不良。

HP:0008390.name: Recurrent loss of toenails and fingernails
HP:0008390.definition: Repeated loss, or shedding, of the nails of the fingers and toes.

HP:0008391.name: Dystrophic fingernails
HP:0008391.definition: The presence of misshapen or partially destroyed nail plates, often with accumulation of soft, yellow keratin between the dystrophic nail plate and nail bed, resulting in elevation of the nail plate.
HP:0008391.definition_cn: 存在畸形或部分破坏的甲板，通常在营养不良的甲板和甲床之间积聚柔软的黄色角蛋白，导致甲板抬高。

HP:0008392.name: Subungual hyperkeratosis
HP:0008392.definition: A thickening of the stratum corneum in the region beneath the nails.

HP:0008393.name: Congenital curved nail of fourth toe

HP:0008396.name: Chronic monilial nail infection
HP:0008396.definition: Chronic infection of the nails by Candida species.
HP:0008396.definition_cn: 甲真菌病（Onychomycosis）由念珠菌属（Candida species）引起的慢性感染。

HP:0008398.name: Hypoplastic fifth fingernail
HP:0008398.definition: A nail of the fifth finger that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped nail of little finger.
HP:0008398.definition_cn: 第五指指甲长度和宽度减小，即小指指甲发育不全。

HP:0008399.name: Circumungual hyperkeratosis
HP:0008399.definition: A thickening of the stratum corneum, the outer layer of the skin, in the region surrounding the nails.

HP:0008400.name: Onycholysis of distal fingernails
HP:0008400.definition: Detachment of the distal fingernails from the nail bed.

HP:0008402.name: Ridged fingernail
HP:0008402.definition: Longitudinal, linear prominences in the fingernail plate.

HP:0008404.name: Nail dystrophy
HP:0008404.definition: Onychodystrophy (nail dystrophy) refers to nail changes apart from changes of the color (nail dyschromia) and involves partial or complete disruption of the various keratinous layers of the nail plate.
HP:0008404.definition_cn: 甲营养不良（onychodystrophy）指的是除颜色改变（甲变色，nail dyschromia）之外的指甲变化，涉及甲板各角蛋白层的部分或完全破坏。

HP:0008419.name: Intervertebral disk degeneration
HP:0008419.definition: The presence of degenerative changes of intervertebral disk.
HP:0008419.definition_cn: 椎间盘退行性改变的存在。

HP:0008420.name: Punctate vertebral calcifications
HP:0008420.definition: The presence of punctiform calcification of the bone of the vertebral bodies.
HP:0008420.definition_cn: 椎体骨内存在点状钙化灶。

HP:0008422.name: Vertebral wedging
HP:0008422.definition: An abnormal shape of the vertebral bodies whereby the vertebral bodies are thick on one side and taper to a thin edge at the other.
HP:0008422.definition_cn: 椎体形态异常，表现为椎体一侧增厚，另一侧逐渐变薄至边缘。

HP:0008423.name: Spinal dysplasia
HP:0008423.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the vertebral column.

HP:0008428.name: Vertebral clefting
HP:0008428.definition: Schisis (cleft or cleavage) of vertebral bodies.

HP:0008430.name: Anterior beaking of lumbar vertebrae
HP:0008430.definition: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the vertebral bodies of the lumbar spine.
HP:0008430.definition_cn: 腰椎椎体前缘舌状突起。

HP:0008432.name: Anterior wedging of L1
HP:0008432.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the lumbar vertebra L1 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).
HP:0008432.definition_cn: 腰椎L1形态异常，呈楔形（前部变窄）。

HP:0008435.name: Absent in utero ossification of vertebral bodies

HP:0008438.name: Vertebral arch anomaly
HP:0008438.definition: A morphological abnormality of the vertebral arch, i.e., of the posterior part of a vertebra.
HP:0008438.definition_cn: 椎弓形态学异常，即椎骨后部结构异常。

HP:0008439.name: Lumbar hemivertebrae
HP:0008439.definition: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the lumbar spine.

HP:0008440.name: C1-C2 vertebral abnormality
HP:0008440.definition: Any abnormality of the atlas and the axis.
HP:0008440.definition_cn: 寰椎和枢椎的任何异常。

HP:0008441.name: Herniation of intervertebral nuclei
HP:0008441.definition: The presence of one or more herniated nucleus pulposus of intervertebral disk.
HP:0008441.definition_cn: 椎间盘一处或多处髓核突出。

HP:0008442.name: Vertebral hyperostosis
HP:0008442.definition: Excessive growth of the bones of the vertebral bodies.

HP:0008443.name: Neuropathic spinal arthropathy
HP:0008443.definition: A progressive disorder of vertebral joint degeneration that occurs in the setting of any condition characterized by decreased afferent innervation, involving loss of deep pain and proprioceptive sensation in the vertebral column. Patients most commonly present with symptoms of lower back pain, sitting imbalance, progressive spinal deformity (usually kyphosis), and an audible clicking sound on changing postures.
HP:0008443.definition_cn: 一种进行性椎关节退行性病变，发生于任何导致传入神经支配减少的疾病背景下，涉及脊柱深部痛觉和本体感觉的丧失。患者最常见的症状包括下背部疼痛、坐姿失衡、进行性脊柱畸形（通常为脊柱后凸）以及改变体位时出现的可闻及的咔嗒声。

HP:0008444.name: Posterior wedging of vertebral bodies
HP:0008444.definition: An abnormality of the shape of vertebrae, such that they are wedge-shaped (narrow towards the back).
HP:0008444.definition_cn: 椎体形态异常，呈楔形（后部变窄）。

HP:0008445.name: Cervical spinal canal stenosis
HP:0008445.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the cervical spinal canal.

HP:0008450.name: Narrow vertebral interpedicular distance
HP:0008450.definition: A reduction of the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.
HP:0008450.definition_cn: 椎弓根间距缩短，椎弓根为两个短而厚的突起，自椎体上部后外侧交界处向后突出，分别位于椎体两侧。

HP:0008454.name: Lumbar kyphosis
HP:0008454.definition: Over curvature of the lumbar region.

HP:0008455.name: Dysplastic sacrum
HP:0008455.definition: A developmental defect of the sacrum characterized by partial or disordered development of the sacrum in which portions of the sacrum, which normally is formed by fusion of five sacral vertebrae S1-S5, fail to form or fail to form normally.
HP:0008455.definition_cn: 骶骨发育缺陷，其特征为骶骨部分或发育紊乱，其中通常由五块骶椎（S1-S5）融合形成的骶骨部分未能形成或未能正常形成。

HP:0008456.name: C2-C3 subluxation
HP:0008456.definition: A partial dislocation of the intervertebral joint between the second and third cervical vertebrae.
HP:0008456.definition_cn: 第二和第三颈椎之间的椎间关节部分脱位。

HP:0008457.name: Caudal interpedicular narrowing
HP:0008457.definition: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column. Note that normally, the interpedicular distances get progressively wider as one proceeds down the spine.
HP:0008457.definition_cn: 椎弓根间距逐渐变窄，并向脊柱尾端（下端）逐渐加重。正常情况下，椎弓根间距随着脊柱向下延伸而逐渐增宽。

HP:0008458.name: Progressive congenital scoliosis
HP:0008458.definition: A progressive form of scoliosis with congenital onset.
HP:0008458.name_cn: 进行性先天性脊柱侧凸
HP:0008458.definition_cn: 先天性进行性脊柱侧凸。

HP:0008459.name: Cervical vertebral agenesis
HP:0008459.definition: Agenesis of one or more vertebrae of the cervical vertebral column.

HP:0008464.name: Absent spinous processes of lower thoracic and lumbar vertebrae
HP:0008464.name_cn: 下胸椎及腰椎棘突缺如

HP:0008465.name: Absent vertebra
HP:0008465.definition: A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies.
HP:0008465.definition_cn: 一种以一个或多个椎体发育不全为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0008467.name: Thoracic hemivertebrae
HP:0008467.definition: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the thoracic spine.

HP:0008468.name: Abnormal sacral segmentation
HP:0008468.definition: An abnormality related to a defect of vertebral separation of sacral vertebrae during development.
HP:0008468.definition_cn: 与发育过程中骶椎椎体分离缺陷相关的异常。

HP:0008469.name: Cervical vertebral dysplasia
HP:0008469.definition: Dysplasia of the cervical vertebral column.

HP:0008470.name: Lower thoracic interpediculate narrowness
HP:0008470.definition: A reduction of the distance between the lower thoracic vertebral pedicles.
HP:0008470.name_cn: 下胸椎椎弓根间距狭窄
HP:0008470.definition_cn: 下胸椎椎弓根间距缩短。

HP:0008473.name: Narrow anterio-posterior vertebral body diameter
HP:0008473.definition: An abnormal reduction of the anterioposterior diameter of the vertebral body.

HP:0008477.name: Poorly ossified cervical vertebrae
HP:0008477.definition: Decreased ossification of the cervical vertebral bodies, i.e., of the Cervical vertebrae set.
HP:0008477.definition_cn: 颈椎椎体骨化减少，即颈椎组骨化减少。

HP:0008478.name: Scheuermann-like vertebral changes
HP:0008478.name_cn: 类似休门氏病的椎体改变

HP:0008480.name: Cervical spondylosis
HP:0008480.definition: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the cervical vertebral column.
HP:0008480.definition_cn: 颈椎病，即颈椎退行性关节病变。

HP:0008483.name: Cervical vertebral bodies with decreased anteroposterior diameter

HP:0008484.name: Thoracolumbar interpediculate narrowness
HP:0008484.definition: A reduction of the distance between thoracolumbar vertebral pedicles.
HP:0008484.name_cn: 胸腰椎椎弓根间距狭窄
HP:0008484.definition_cn: 胸腰椎椎弓根间距缩短。

HP:0008486.name: Lumbar interpedicular narrowing
HP:0008486.definition: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between lumbar vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column.
HP:0008486.definition_cn: 腰椎椎弓根间距逐渐变窄，并向脊柱尾端（下端）逐渐加重。

HP:0008489.name: Spondylolisthesis at L5-S1
HP:0008489.definition: Complete bilateral fractures of the pars interarticularis resulting in the anterior slippage of the fifth lumbar vertebral body (L5) onto the sacrum (level S1).
HP:0008489.definition_cn: 双侧椎弓峡部完全性骨折导致第五腰椎椎体（L5）向前滑脱至骶骨（S1水平）。

HP:0008491.name: Premature anterior fontanel closure
HP:0008491.definition: Early closure (ossification) of the anterior fontanelle, which generally undergoes closure around the 18th month of life.
HP:0008491.definition_cn: 前囟早闭（骨化），通常在前囟于生后第18个月左右闭合。

HP:0008494.name: Inferior lens subluxation
HP:0008494.definition: Partial displacement of the lens in the inferior direction.

HP:0008497.name: Congenital craniofacial dysostosis
HP:0008497.name_cn: 先天性颅面骨发育不全

HP:0008499.name: High hypermetropia
HP:0008499.definition: A severe form of hypermetropia with over +5.00 diopters.
HP:0008499.definition_cn: 一种严重形式的远视，屈光度超过+5.00D。

HP:0008501.name: obsolete Median cleft lip and palate

HP:0008504.name: Moderate sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008504.definition: The presence of a moderate form of sensorineural hearing impairment.
HP:0008504.name_cn: 中度感音神经性听力损失
HP:0008504.definition_cn: 存在中度感音神经性听力障碍。

HP:0008511.name: Central posterior corneal opacity
HP:0008511.definition: Reduced transparency of the central posterior portion of the corneal stroma.
HP:0008511.definition_cn: 角膜基质中央后部透明度降低。

HP:0008513.name: Bilateral conductive hearing impairment
HP:0008513.definition: A bilateral type of conductive hearing impairment.

HP:0008515.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the vertebrae
HP:0008515.name_cn: 椎体发育不全/椎体发育不良

HP:0008516.name: Abnormality of the vertebral spinous processes

HP:0008517.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sacrum
HP:0008517.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the sacral bone.
HP:0008517.name_cn: 骶骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0008517.definition_cn: 骶骨发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0008518.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the vertebral column
HP:0008518.name_cn: 脊柱发育不全/脊柱发育不良

HP:0008519.name: Abnormal coccyx morphology
HP:0008519.definition: Any structural abnormality of the coccyx.

HP:0008523.name: Posterior helix pit
HP:0008523.definition: Permanent indentation on the posteromedial aspect of the helix that may be sharply or indistinctly delineated.
HP:0008523.definition_cn: 耳轮后内侧永久性凹陷，边缘可能清晰或模糊。

HP:0008527.name: Congenital sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008527.definition: A type of hearing impairment caused by an abnormal functionality of the cochlear nerve with congenital onset.
HP:0008527.name_cn: 先天性感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0008527.definition_cn: 一种由先天性耳蜗神经功能异常引起的听力障碍。

HP:0008528.name: Long hairs growing from helix of pinna

HP:0008529.name: Absence of acoustic reflex
HP:0008529.definition: Absence of the acoustic reflex, an involuntary contraction of the stapedius muscle that occurs in response to high-intensity sound stimuli.
HP:0008529.definition_cn: 声反射缺失，即镫骨肌在高强度声音刺激下不出现不自主收缩。

HP:0008537.name: Cleft at the superior portion of the pinna

HP:0008542.name: Low-frequency hearing loss
HP:0008542.definition: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the low frequencies of sound (125 Hz to 1000 Hz).
HP:0008542.definition_cn: 一种主要影响低频声音（125赫兹至1000赫兹）的听力障碍类型。

HP:0008544.name: Abnormally folded helix
HP:0008544.definition: Any structural anomaly of the border of the helix, which usually forms a rolled rim but is highly variable in shape.
HP:0008544.definition_cn: 耳轮边缘的任何结构异常，通常形成卷曲的边缘，但其形状高度可变。

HP:0008554.name: Cochlear malformation
HP:0008554.definition: The presence of a malformed cochlea.

HP:0008555.name: Absent vestibular function
HP:0008555.definition: Complete lack of functioning of the vestibular apparatus.

HP:0008568.name: Vestibular areflexia
HP:0008568.definition: Vestibular areflexia can be measured as the absence of the caloric nystagmus response in electronystagmography.
HP:0008568.definition_cn: 前庭无反射可通过眼震电图检查中冷热试验无眼震反应来测量。

HP:0008569.name: Microtia, second degree
HP:0008569.definition: Median longitudinal length of the ear more than two standard deviations below the mean in the presence of some, but not all, parts of the normal ear.
HP:0008569.definition_cn: 在存在部分但非全部正常耳部结构的情况下，耳部中位纵向长度低于平均值两个标准差以上。

HP:0008573.name: Low-frequency sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008573.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects primarily the lower frequencies.
HP:0008573.name_cn: 低频感音神经性听力损失
HP:0008573.definition_cn: 一种主要影响低频的感音神经性听力损失。

HP:0008577.name: Underfolded helix
HP:0008577.definition: Underdevelopment of the helix that either affects the entire helix, or is localized.
HP:0008577.definition_cn: 耳轮发育不全，可影响整个耳轮或局部区域。

HP:0008583.name: Underfolded superior helices
HP:0008583.definition: A condition in which the superior portion of the helix is folded over to a lesser degree than normal.
HP:0008583.definition_cn: 耳轮上部折叠程度低于正常的状况。

HP:0008587.name: Mild neurosensory hearing impairment
HP:0008587.definition: The presence of a mild form of sensorineural hearing impairment.
HP:0008587.name_cn: 轻度神经感觉性听力障碍
HP:0008587.definition_cn: 轻度感音神经性听力障碍的存在。

HP:0008588.name: Slit-like opening of the exterior auditory meatus
HP:0008588.definition: A type of stenosis of the external auditory meatus in which the opening of the external auditory meatus appears as a vertical slit.
HP:0008588.definition_cn: 一种外耳道狭窄类型，表现为外耳道开口呈垂直裂隙状。

HP:0008589.name: Hypoplastic helices
HP:0008589.definition: Underdevelopment of the helix, i.e., of the outer rim of the pinna.
HP:0008589.definition_cn: 耳轮发育不全，即耳廓外缘发育不全。

HP:0008591.name: Congenital conductive hearing impairment
HP:0008591.definition: A type of conductive deafness with congenital onset.
HP:0008591.name_cn: 先天性传导性听力障碍
HP:0008591.definition_cn: 一种先天性传导性耳聋。

HP:0008593.name: Prominent antitragus
HP:0008593.definition: Increased anterosuperior prominence of the area between the bottom of the incisura and the inner margin of the antihelix.
HP:0008593.definition_cn: 耳屏切迹底部与对耳轮内侧缘之间的区域前上突出度增加。

HP:0008596.name: Postlingual sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008596.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment with onset after the acquisition of speech.
HP:0008596.name_cn: 语后性感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0008596.definition_cn: 一种在语言习得后发生的感音神经性听力障碍。

HP:0008598.name: Mild conductive hearing impairment
HP:0008598.definition: A mild form of conductive hearing impairment.

HP:0008606.name: Supraauricular pit
HP:0008606.definition: Benign congenital lesion of the supraauricular soft tissue consisting of a blind-ending narrow tube or pit.
HP:0008606.definition_cn: 良性先天性耳上软组织病变，由盲端狭窄管或凹陷组成。

HP:0008607.name: Progressive conductive hearing impairment
HP:0008607.definition: A progressive type of conductive deafness.
HP:0008607.name_cn: 进行性传导性听力障碍

HP:0008609.name: Abnormal middle ear morphology
HP:0008609.definition: An abnormality of the morphology or structure of the middle ear.

HP:0008610.name: Infantile sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008610.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment with infantile onset.
HP:0008610.name_cn: 婴儿感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0008610.definition_cn: 一种婴儿期发病的感音神经性听力障碍。

HP:0008615.name: Adult onset sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008615.definition: The presence of sensorineural deafness with late onset.
HP:0008615.name_cn: 成人发病感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0008615.definition_cn: 迟发性感音神经性聋的存在。

HP:0008619.name: Bilateral sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008619.definition: A bilateral form of sensorineural hearing impairment.
HP:0008619.name_cn: 双侧感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0008619.definition_cn: 双侧感音神经性听力障碍。

HP:0008625.name: Severe sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008625.definition: A severe form of sensorineural hearing impairment.
HP:0008625.name_cn: 重度感音神经性听力损失
HP:0008625.definition_cn: 重度感音神经性听力损失。

HP:0008628.name: Abnormal stapes morphology
HP:0008628.definition: An abnormality of the stapes, a stirrup-shaped ossicle in the middle ear.
HP:0008628.definition_cn: 镫骨异常，一种位于中耳的镫骨形状的听小骨异常。

HP:0008629.name: Pulsatile tinnitus
HP:0008629.definition: Pulsatile tinnitus is generally classified a kind of objective tinnitus, meaning that it is not only audible to the patient but also to the examiner on auscultation of the auditory canal and/or of surrounding structures with use of an auscultation tube or stethoscope. Usually, pulsatile tinnitus is heard as a lower pitched thumping or booming, a rougher blowing sound which is coincidental with respiration, or as a clicking, higher pitched rhythmic sensation.
HP:0008629.definition_cn: 搏动性耳鸣通常被归类为一种客观性耳鸣，这意味着不仅患者可以听到，检查者在使用听诊管或听诊器对耳道和/或周围结构进行听诊时也能听到。通常，搏动性耳鸣表现为低频的搏动声或轰鸣声，与呼吸同步的粗糙吹风样声音，或高频的节律性咔嗒声。

HP:0008631.name: Ureteral dysgenesis
HP:0008631.definition: A developmental anomaly of the ureter.

HP:0008633.name: Agonadism
HP:0008633.definition: Absence of sex glands (gonads are the organs that produce gametes; testis in males and ovary in females).
HP:0008633.definition_cn: 性腺缺失（性腺是产生配子的器官；男性为睾丸，女性为卵巢）。

HP:0008635.name: Urinary bladder wall hypertrophy
HP:0008635.definition: Increase in thickness of the wall of the urinary bladder. This finding may be seen in conditions such as bladder outlet obstruction and may be accompanied by increased trabeculation of the bladder wall musculature.
HP:0008635.definition_cn: 膀胱壁增厚。此现象可见于膀胱出口梗阻等疾病，并可能伴随膀胱壁肌层小梁结构增厚。

HP:0008636.name: obsolete Lobular glomerulopathy
HP:0008636.name_cn: 废弃性小叶性肾小球病

HP:0008643.name: Nephroblastomatosis
HP:0008643.definition: Presence of persistent islands of renal blastema in the postnatal kidney. Nephroblastomatosis represents a complex abnormality of nephrogenesis and has been defined as the persistence of metanephricblastema into infancy and childhood.
HP:0008643.definition_cn: 出生后肾脏中存在持续的肾胚基岛。肾母细胞瘤病代表了一种复杂的肾发生异常，被定义为后肾胚基持续存在至婴儿期和儿童期。

HP:0008651.name: Uric acid urolithiasis independent of gout
HP:0008651.name_cn: 非痛风相关性尿酸尿路结石症

HP:0008652.name: Autonomic erectile dysfunction
HP:0008652.definition: Impotence (inability to develop or maintain an erection) resulting from abnormal functioning of the autonomic nervous system.
HP:0008652.name_cn: 自主神经性勃起功能障碍
HP:0008652.definition_cn: 自主神经系统功能障碍导致的勃起功能障碍（无法形成或维持勃起）。

HP:0008653.name: Crescentic glomerulonephritis
HP:0008653.definition: A type of extracapillary glomerulonephritis characterized by the formation of crescent-like cellular proliferation.
HP:0008653.definition_cn: 一种以新月形细胞增生为特征的毛细血管外肾小球肾炎。

HP:0008655.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fallopian tube
HP:0008655.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the fallopian tube.
HP:0008655.name_cn: 输卵管发育不全/输卵管发育不良
HP:0008655.definition_cn: 输卵管发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0008656.name: Incomplete male pseudohermaphroditism
HP:0008656.name_cn: 不完全性男性假两性畸形

HP:0008659.name: Multiple small medullary renal cysts
HP:0008659.definition: The presence of many cysts in the medulla of the kidney.

HP:0008660.name: Renotubular dysgenesis
HP:0008660.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence or poor development of proximal renal tubules.
HP:0008660.definition_cn: 近端肾小管发育不全或发育不良的发育缺陷。

HP:0008666.name: Impaired histidine renal tubular absorption
HP:0008666.name_cn: 组氨酸肾小管吸收障碍

HP:0008668.name: Gonadal dysgenesis, male
HP:0008668.definition: Unusual gonadal development in a person with a 46,XY male karyotype, leading to an unassigned sex differentiation.
HP:0008668.definition_cn: 46,XY男性核型个体中出现的异常性腺发育，导致性别分化未明确。

HP:0008669.name: Abnormal spermatogenesis
HP:0008669.definition: Incomplete maturation or aberrant formation of the male gametes.
HP:0008669.definition_cn: 男性配子不完全成熟或异常形成。

HP:0008672.name: Calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis
HP:0008672.definition: The presence of calcium- and oxalate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.
HP:0008672.definition_cn: 肾脏内存在含钙和草酸盐的结石（肾结石）。

HP:0008676.name: Congenital megaureter
HP:0008676.definition: A developmental disturbance with extreme ureteral dilatation.
HP:0008676.definition_cn: 一种伴有极度输尿管扩张的发育障碍。

HP:0008677.name: Congenital nephrotic syndrome
HP:0008677.definition: Nephrotic syndrome with onset within the first three months of life.
HP:0008677.definition_cn: 出生后前三个月内发病的肾病综合征。

HP:0008678.name: Renal hypoplasia/aplasia
HP:0008678.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the kidney.

HP:0008682.name: Renal tubular epithelial necrosis
HP:0008682.definition: Coagulative necrosis of tubular epithelial cells, defined as cells with increased cytoplasmic eosinophilia and nucleus that has a condensed chromatin pattern with fuzzy nuclear contour or has barely visible nuclear basophilic staining. The extent of cortical tubular necrosis is scoredsemiquantitatively as none, mild (less than 25% tubules with necrosis), moderate (25-50 percent), and severe (over 50%).
HP:0008682.definition_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞凝固性坏死，定义为细胞质嗜酸性增加，核染色质浓缩，核轮廓模糊或核嗜碱性染色几乎不可见。皮质肾小管坏死的程度采用半定量评分，分为无、轻度（坏死小管少于25%）、中度（25%-50%）和重度（超过50%）。

HP:0008683.name: Enlarged labia minora
HP:0008683.definition: Increase in size of the folds of skin between the outer labia.
HP:0008683.definition_cn: 外阴唇间皮肤皱襞增大。

HP:0008684.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the uterus
HP:0008684.definition: Absence or developmental hypoplasia of the uterus.
HP:0008684.name_cn: 子宫发育不全/子宫发育不良

HP:0008689.name: Bilateral cryptorchidism
HP:0008689.definition: Absence of both testes from the scrotum owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.
HP:0008689.definition_cn: 由于睾丸未能通过腹股沟管下降至阴囊，导致双侧睾丸缺失于阴囊内。

HP:0008691.name: Solitary bladder diverticulum
HP:0008691.definition: Presence of a single diverticulum (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urinary bladder.
HP:0008691.definition_cn: 膀胱壁内存在单一憩室（囊袋或囊状结构）。

HP:0008696.name: Renal hamartoma
HP:0008696.definition: A disordered proliferation of mature tissues that are native to the kidneys.
HP:0008696.definition_cn: 肾脏固有成熟组织的异常增生。

HP:0008697.name: Hypoplasia of the fallopian tube
HP:0008697.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the fallopian tube.

HP:0008703.name: Gonadal calcification
HP:0008703.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in gonadal tissue.

HP:0008708.name: Partial development of the penile shaft

HP:0008711.name: Benign prostatic hyperplasia
HP:0008711.definition: The presence of non-malignant hyperplasia of the prostate.
HP:0008711.definition_cn: 良性前列腺增生症的存在。

HP:0008716.name: Urethrovaginal fistula
HP:0008716.definition: The presence of a fistula between the vagina and the urethra.

HP:0008717.name: Unilateral renal atrophy
HP:0008717.definition: A unilateral form of atrophy of the kidney.

HP:0008718.name: Unilateral renal dysplasia
HP:0008718.definition: A unilateral form of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.

HP:0008722.name: Urethral diverticulum
HP:0008722.definition: The presence of a diverticulum (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urethra.
HP:0008722.definition_cn: 尿道壁存在憩室（囊袋或小袋）。

HP:0008723.name: Gonadal dysgenesis with female appearance, male
HP:0008723.definition: Unusual gonadal development in a person with a 46,XY male karyotype, leading to a more female sex differentiation.
HP:0008723.name_cn: 女性表型的性腺发育不全伴男性核型
HP:0008723.definition_cn: 46,XY男性核型个体中出现的异常性腺发育，导致更倾向于女性性别分化。

HP:0008730.name: Female external genitalia in individual with 46,XY karyotype
HP:0008730.definition: The presence of female external genitalia in a person with a male karyotype.
HP:0008730.name_cn: 46,XY 核型个体的女性外生殖器
HP:0008730.definition_cn: 具有男性核型的个体出现女性外生殖器。

HP:0008732.name: Renal hypophosphatemia
HP:0008732.definition: Renal hypophosphatemia is defined as reduced serum phosphate (e.g., below 0.70 mmol/l) and an inappropriately high renal phosphate excretion.
HP:0008732.definition_cn: 肾性低磷血症定义为血清磷酸盐水平降低（例如，低于0.70 mmol/L）以及不适当的高肾磷酸盐排泄。

HP:0008734.name: Decreased testicular size
HP:0008734.definition: Reduced volume of the testicle (the male gonad).
HP:0008734.definition_cn: 睾丸体积缩小（男性性腺萎缩）。

HP:0008738.name: Partially duplicated kidney
HP:0008738.definition: The presence of a partially duplicated kidney.

HP:0008740.name: Longitudinal vaginal septum
HP:0008740.definition: The presence of a longitudinal vaginal septum, thereby creating a vaginal duplication.
HP:0008740.definition_cn: 存在纵向阴道隔膜，从而导致阴道重复畸形。

HP:0008742.name: Prominent prostate median bar
HP:0008742.name_cn: 显著的前列腺中叶隆起

HP:0008743.name: Coronal hypospadias
HP:0008743.definition: A mild form of hypospadias in which the urethra opens just under the corona glandis.
HP:0008743.definition_cn: 一种轻度尿道下裂，尿道开口位于冠状沟下方。

HP:0008744.name: Abnormal aryepiglottic fold morphology
HP:0008744.definition: An abnormality of the aryepiglottic fold.
HP:0008744.name_cn: 异常的杓状会厌襞形态

HP:0008747.name: Cartilaginous ossification of larynx
HP:0008747.definition: Ossification affecting the set of cartilages of larynx.

HP:0008750.name: Laryngeal atresia
HP:0008750.definition: Congenital absence of the lumen of the larynx. Laryngeal atresia is a rare condition. If the laryngeal opening fails to develop, fluid secreted by the lungs cannot be expelled. In a fetus with laryngeal atresia, the lungs are either normal or hyperplastic, not hypoplastic. Mortality is reported as 100%. At obstetric US examination, views of the fetal neck demonstrate a dilated trachea filled with trapped fluid. Views of the fetal chest show enlarged, hyperechoic lungs, with dilated fluid-filled bronchi. Fetal ascites is usually present.
HP:0008750.definition_cn: 先天性喉腔闭锁。喉闭锁是一种罕见疾病。若喉部开口未能发育，肺部分泌的液体无法排出。患有喉闭锁的胎儿，肺部通常正常或增生，而非发育不全。据报道，死亡率达100%。在产科超声检查中，胎儿颈部的视图显示扩张的气管充满滞留液体。胎儿胸部的视图显示肺部增大、回声增强，伴有扩张的充满液体的支气管。通常存在胎儿腹水。

HP:0008751.name: Laryngeal cleft
HP:0008751.definition: Presence of a gap in the posterior laryngotracheal wall with a continuity between the larynx and the esophagus.
HP:0008751.definition_cn: 喉气管后壁存在裂隙，导致喉与食管之间形成连通。

HP:0008752.name: Laryngeal cartilage malformation
HP:0008752.definition: A malformation of the laryngeal cartilage.

HP:0008754.name: Laryngeal calcification
HP:0008754.definition: Calcification (abnormal deposits of calcium) in the laryngeal tissues.
HP:0008754.definition_cn: 喉部组织钙化（钙质异常沉积）。

HP:0008756.name: Bowing of the vocal cords
HP:0008756.definition: Bowing (abnormal curvature) of the vocal folds.

HP:0008757.name: Unilateral vocal cord paralysis
HP:0008757.definition: A loss of the ability to move the vocal fold on one side.

HP:0008760.name: Violent behavior
HP:0008760.definition: Conduct and/or behavior, both verbal and non-verbal, including but not limited to verbal and/or physical aggression, attacks, threats, harassment, intimidation, and other disruptive behaviors in any form or through any medium, that cause or have the potential to cause a reasonable person to fear physical harm from any individual(s) or group(s) towards any person(s) or property. This is commonly defined as a violent act characterized by the use of physical force, anger, or sudden intense activity.
HP:0008760.definition_cn: 行为及/或举止，包括但不限于言语和/或身体攻击、袭击、威胁、骚扰、恐吓以及其他任何形式或通过任何媒介的破坏性行为，这些行为导致或有可能导致一个理性人担心来自任何个人或群体对任何人或财产的物理伤害。这通常被定义为一种以使用物理力量、愤怒或突然剧烈活动为特征的暴力行为。

HP:0008763.name: No social interaction
HP:0008763.definition: Lack of intentional participation in interactions with another person.
HP:0008763.definition_cn: 缺乏有意识地参与与他人互动的行为。

HP:0008765.name: Auditory hallucination
HP:0008765.definition: Perception of sounds without auditory stimulus.

HP:0008767.name: Self-mutilation of tongue and lips due to involuntary movements
HP:0008767.definition: Uncontrolled movements result in tissue damage to the tongue and lips.
HP:0008767.name_cn: 不自主运动导致的舌唇自残
HP:0008767.definition_cn: 不受控制的运动导致舌和唇组织损伤。

HP:0008768.name: Abnormal sexual behavior
HP:0008768.definition: A deviation of sexual behaviors from the personal norms of the individual in the context of socially and culturally recognized patterns of human sexual behaviors.
HP:0008768.definition_cn: 性行为偏离个体在社交和文化认可的人类性行为模式中的个人规范。

HP:0008770.name: Obsessive-compulsive trait
HP:0008770.definition: The presence of one or more obsessive-compulsive personality traits. Obsessions refer to persistent intrusive thoughts, and compulsions to intrusive behaviors, which the affected person experiences as involuntary, senseless, or repugnant.
HP:0008770.definition_cn: 存在一种或多种强迫性人格特质。强迫观念指持续侵入性思维，强迫行为指侵入性行为，患者体验为不由自主、无意义或令人厌恶。

HP:0008771.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ear
HP:0008771.definition: The presence of aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the ear.
HP:0008771.name_cn: 耳发育不全/耳发育不良
HP:0008771.definition_cn: 耳部发育不全或发育不良的存在。

HP:0008772.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the external ear
HP:0008772.definition: The presence of aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of all or part of the external ear.
HP:0008772.name_cn: 外耳发育不全/外耳发育不良
HP:0008772.definition_cn: 外耳全部或部分发育不全或发育不良的存在。

HP:0008773.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle ear
HP:0008773.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of all or part of the middle ear.
HP:0008773.name_cn: 中耳发育不全/中耳发育不良
HP:0008773.definition_cn: 中耳全部或部分发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0008774.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the inner ear
HP:0008774.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the inner ear.
HP:0008774.name_cn: 内耳发育不全/内耳发育不良
HP:0008774.definition_cn: 内耳发育不全或内耳发育不良。

HP:0008776.name: Abnormal renal artery morphology
HP:0008776.definition: Any structural abnormality of the renal artery.

HP:0008777.name: Abnormal vocal cord morphology
HP:0008777.definition: An abnormality of the vocal cord.

HP:0008780.name: Congenital bilateral hip dislocation
HP:0008780.name_cn: 先天性双侧髋关节脱位

HP:0008783.name: Wide proximal femoral metaphysis
HP:0008783.definition: Increased width of the proximal part of the shaft (metaphysis) of the femur.

HP:0008784.name: Wide capital femoral epiphyses
HP:0008784.definition: Abnormally wide morphology of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0008784.definition_cn: 股骨近端骨骺形态异常增宽。

HP:0008785.name: Delayed ossification of pubic rami
HP:0008785.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the rami (branches) of the pubic bone.
HP:0008785.definition_cn: 耻骨支（分支）的成熟和钙化延迟。

HP:0008786.name: Iliac crest serration
HP:0008786.definition: Irregularities of the iliac crest that produce the appearance of a lace border around it.
HP:0008786.definition_cn: 髂嵴不规则导致其周围呈现蕾丝状边缘的外观。

HP:0008788.name: Delayed pubic bone ossification
HP:0008788.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the pubic bone.
HP:0008788.definition_cn: 耻骨成熟延迟及钙化不全。

HP:0008789.name: Cone-shaped capital femoral epiphysis
HP:0008789.definition: A cone-shaped deformity of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0008789.definition_cn: 股骨近端骨骺锥形畸形。

HP:0008794.name: Dysplastic iliac wing
HP:0008794.definition: A general term that describes a congenital defect in the iliac wing resulting from abnormal development.
HP:0008794.definition_cn: 描述髂骨翼先天性缺陷的通用术语，由发育异常引起。

HP:0008796.name: Femoral retroversion
HP:0008796.definition: An abnormal backward rotation of the hip relative to the knee such that the hips are externally rotated with the foot pointed outward instead of straight ahead (out-toeing).
HP:0008796.definition_cn: 髋关节相对于膝关节的异常后旋，导致髋关节外旋，足部向外指向而非正前方（外八字步态）。

HP:0008797.name: Early ossification of capital femoral epiphyses
HP:0008797.definition: Developmental acceleration of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0008797.definition_cn: 股骨近端骨骺骨化发育加速。

HP:0008798.name: Widened greater sciatic notch
HP:0008798.definition: The sacroiliac joint in the bony pelvis connects the sacrum and the ilium of the pelvis, which are joined by strong ligaments. The notch is located directly superior to the joint. This term refers to a increase in the lateral dimension of the notch.
HP:0008798.definition_cn: 骨盆中的骶髂关节连接骶骨和髂骨，两者通过强韧的韧带相连。切迹位于该关节的正上方。此术语指的是切迹横向尺寸的增大。

HP:0008800.name: Limited hip movement
HP:0008800.definition: A decreased ability to move the femur at the hip joint associated with a decreased range of motion of the hip.
HP:0008800.definition_cn: 髋关节活动范围受限伴随股骨运动能力下降。

HP:0008804.name: Broad femoral head
HP:0008804.definition: Increased width of the femoral head.

HP:0008807.name: Acetabular dysplasia
HP:0008807.definition: A smaller than normal acetabulum that has insufficient femoral head coverage leading to abnormal hip joint contact pressures, instability and pain.
HP:0008807.definition_cn: 髋臼发育不良（Acetabular Dysplasia），表现为髋臼小于正常尺寸，股骨头覆盖不足，导致髋关节接触压力异常、不稳定及疼痛。

HP:0008808.name: High iliac wing
HP:0008808.definition: Increased height of the wing (or ala) of the ilium (which is the large expanded portion which bounds the greater pelvis laterally).
HP:0008808.definition_cn: 髂骨翼（即构成大骨盆外侧边界的大扩展部分）高度增加。

HP:0008817.name: Aplastic pubic bone
HP:0008817.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of development of the pubis bone.
HP:0008817.definition_cn: 一种以耻骨发育不全为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0008818.name: Large iliac wing
HP:0008818.definition: Increased size of the ilium ala.

HP:0008819.name: Narrow femoral neck
HP:0008819.definition: An abnormally reduced diameter of the femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).
HP:0008819.definition_cn: 股骨颈直径异常缩小（股骨颈为连接股骨头与股骨干的骨性结构）。

HP:0008820.name: Absent ossification of capital femoral epiphysis
HP:0008820.definition: Lack of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0008820.definition_cn: 股骨近端骨骺骨化不全。

HP:0008822.name: Hypoplastic ischiopubic ramus
HP:0008822.definition: Underdevelopment of the ischiopubic ramus, which is comprised of the inferior pubic ramus and the inferior ramus of the ischium.
HP:0008822.definition_cn: 坐骨耻骨支发育不全，包括耻骨下支和坐骨下支。

HP:0008823.name: Inferior pubic ramus hypoplasia
HP:0008823.definition: Underdevelopment of the lower branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).
HP:0008823.definition_cn: 耻骨下支发育不全（Inferior Pubic Ramus Hypoplasia）。

HP:0008824.name: Hypoplastic iliac body
HP:0008824.definition: Underdevelopment of the body of ilium.

HP:0008826.name: obsolete Dislocation of the femoral head

HP:0008828.name: Delayed proximal femoral epiphyseal ossification
HP:0008828.definition: Developmental delay of ossification of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0008828.name_cn: 股骨近端骨骺骨化延迟
HP:0008828.definition_cn: 股骨近端骨骺骨化发育迟缓。

HP:0008829.name: Delayed femoral head ossification
HP:0008829.definition: Delayed ossification of the femoral head.

HP:0008830.name: Hypoplastic pubic ramus
HP:0008830.definition: Underdevelopment of a ramus (branch) of the pubic bone.

HP:0008835.name: Multicentric femoral head ossification
HP:0008835.definition: There is normally one ossification center in the head of the femur. This term applies if there are multiple such centers.
HP:0008835.definition_cn: 股骨头内通常存在一个骨化中心。若存在多个骨化中心，则称为多发性骨化中心。

HP:0008838.name: Stippled calcification proximal humeral epiphyses
HP:0008838.name_cn: 近端肱骨骨骺点状钙化

HP:0008845.name: Mesomelic short stature
HP:0008845.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by disproportionate shortening of the medial parts of the extremities (forearm or lower leg).
HP:0008845.definition_cn: 一种以肢体内侧部分（前臂或小腿）不成比例缩短为特征的不成比例性矮小症。

HP:0008846.name: Severe intrauterine growth retardation
HP:0008846.definition: Intrauterine growth retardation that is 4 or more standard deviations below average, corrected for sex and gestational age.
HP:0008846.definition_cn: 宫内生长迟缓，校正性别和孕周后，低于平均值4个或更多标准差。

HP:0008848.name: Moderately short stature
HP:0008848.definition: A moderate degree of short stature, more than -3 SD but not more than -4 SD from mean corrected for age and sex.
HP:0008848.definition_cn: 中度身材矮小，年龄和性别校正后的平均值低于-3个标准差但不超过-4个标准差。

HP:0008850.name: Severe postnatal growth retardation
HP:0008850.definition: Severely slow or limited growth after birth, being four standard deviations or more below age- and sex-related norms.
HP:0008850.definition_cn: Severe postnatal growth retardation, defined as growth parameters falling four or more standard deviations below the mean for age and sex.

HP:0008855.name: Moderate postnatal growth retardation
HP:0008855.definition: A moderate degree of slow or limited growth after birth, being between three and four standard deviations below age- and sex-related norms.
HP:0008855.definition_cn: 出生后生长速度中度缓慢或受限，低于年龄和性别相关标准的3至4个标准差。

HP:0008857.name: Neonatal short-trunk short stature
HP:0008857.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with congenital onset recognizable at birth.
HP:0008857.name_cn: 新生儿短躯干型矮小症
HP:0008857.definition_cn: 一种以躯干短小但四肢长度正常为特征的不成比例性身材矮小，属于先天性发病，出生时即可识别。

HP:0008866.name: Failure to thrive secondary to recurrent infections
HP:0008866.definition: Insufficient weight gain or inappropriate weight loss for a child, that is attributed to an endogenous recurrent infections.
HP:0008866.name_cn: 继发于反复感染的生长发育迟缓
HP:0008866.definition_cn: 儿童体重增长不足或不适当的体重减轻，归因于内源性反复感染。

HP:0008872.name: Feeding difficulties in infancy
HP:0008872.definition: Impaired feeding performance of an infant as manifested by difficulties such as weak and ineffective sucking, brief bursts of sucking, and falling asleep during sucking. There may be difficulties with chewing or maintaining attention.
HP:0008872.definition_cn: 婴儿喂养功能障碍表现为吸吮力弱且无效、吸吮短暂且间歇性、吸吮过程中入睡等症状。可能存在咀嚼困难或注意力难以维持的情况。

HP:0008873.name: Disproportionate short-limb short stature
HP:0008873.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short limbs but an average-sized trunk.
HP:0008873.name_cn: 不成比例的短肢型身材矮小
HP:0008873.definition_cn: 一种以肢体短小但躯干大小正常为特征的不成比例性身材矮小症。

HP:0008883.name: Mild intrauterine growth retardation
HP:0008883.definition: Intrauterine growth retardation that is at least 2 standard deviations (SD) below average, but not as low as 3 SD, corrected for sex and gestational age.
HP:0008883.definition_cn: 宫内生长迟缓（Intrauterine Growth Retardation, IUGR），其生长指标至少低于平均值2个标准差（Standard Deviation, SD），但未达到3个SD，已根据性别和孕周进行校正。

HP:0008897.name: Postnatal growth retardation
HP:0008897.definition: Slow or limited growth after birth.
HP:0008897.definition_cn: 出生后生长迟缓或受限。

HP:0008905.name: Rhizomelia
HP:0008905.definition: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of limbs (i.e. the femur and humerus).
HP:0008905.definition_cn: 四肢近端节段（即股骨和肱骨）不成比例缩短。

HP:0008915.name: Childhood-onset truncal obesity
HP:0008915.definition: Truncal obesity with onset during childhood, defined as between 2 and 10 years of age.
HP:0008915.name_cn: 儿童期发病的躯干性肥胖
HP:0008915.definition_cn: 躯干性肥胖，起病于儿童期，定义为2至10岁之间。

HP:0008921.name: Neonatal short-limb short stature
HP:0008921.definition: A type of short-limbed dwarfism that is manifest beginning in the neonatal period.
HP:0008921.name_cn: 新生儿短肢型身材矮小症
HP:0008921.definition_cn: 一种在新生儿期即显现的短肢型侏儒症。

HP:0008922.name: Childhood-onset short-trunk short stature
HP:0008922.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with onset in childhood.
HP:0008922.name_cn: 儿童期发病的短躯干型矮小症
HP:0008922.definition_cn: 一种以躯干短小但四肢长度正常为特征的比例失调性矮小症，通常在儿童期发病。

HP:0008935.name: Generalized neonatal hypotonia
HP:0008935.definition: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) manifesting in the neonatal period and affecting the entire musculature.
HP:0008935.name_cn: 全身性新生儿肌张力低下
HP:0008935.definition_cn: 新生儿期出现的全身性肌张力低下（肌张力异常降低）。

HP:0008936.name: Axial hypotonia
HP:0008936.definition: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) affecting the musculature of the trunk.
HP:0008936.definition_cn: 躯干肌群肌张力低下（肌张力异常降低）。

HP:0008944.name: Distal lower limb amyotrophy
HP:0008944.definition: Muscular atrophy of distal leg muscles.

HP:0008945.name: Loss of ability to walk in early childhood
HP:0008945.name_cn: 儿童早期行走能力丧失

HP:0008946.name: Pelvic girdle amyotrophy
HP:0008946.definition: Atrophy of the muscles of the pelvic girdle (also known as hip girdle), i.e., the gluteal muscles, the lateral rotators, the adductors, the psoas major and the iliacus muscle.
HP:0008946.definition_cn: 骨盆带肌群（亦称髋带肌群）萎缩，包括臀肌、外旋肌群、内收肌群、腰大肌及髂肌。

HP:0008947.name: Infantile muscular hypotonia
HP:0008947.definition: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) manifesting in infancy.
HP:0008947.definition_cn: 婴儿期表现的肌张力低下（肌张力异常降低）。

HP:0008948.name: Proximal upper limb amyotrophy
HP:0008948.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting proximally located muscles of the arms.

HP:0008952.name: Shoulder muscle hypoplasia
HP:0008952.definition: Underdevelopment of muscles of the shoulder.

HP:0008954.name: Intrinsic hand muscle atrophy
HP:0008954.definition: Atrophy of the intrinsic muscle groups of the hand, comprising the thenar and hypothenar muscles; the interossei muscles; and the lumbrical muscles.
HP:0008954.definition_cn: 手部内在肌群萎缩，包括鱼际肌和小鱼际肌；骨间肌；以及蚓状肌。

HP:0008955.name: Progressive distal muscular atrophy
HP:0008955.definition: Progressive muscular atrophy affecting muscles in the distal portions of the extremities.
HP:0008955.definition_cn: 进行性肌萎缩累及四肢远端肌肉。

HP:0008956.name: Proximal lower limb amyotrophy
HP:0008956.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting proximally located muscles of the legs, i.e., of the thigh.
HP:0008956.definition_cn: 近端肌群萎缩，累及下肢近端肌群，即大腿肌群。

HP:0008959.name: Distal upper limb muscle weakness
HP:0008959.definition: Reduced strength of the distal musculature of the arms.

HP:0008962.name: Calf muscle hypoplasia
HP:0008962.definition: Underdevelopment of the muscuklature of the calf.

HP:0008963.name: Tibialis muscle weakness
HP:0008963.definition: Muscle weakness affecting the tibialis anterior muscle.

HP:0008964.name: Nonprogressive muscular atrophy
HP:0008964.definition: Muscular atrophy that does not display a progression in severity with time.

HP:0008967.name: Exercise-induced muscle stiffness
HP:0008967.definition: A type of muscle stiffness that occurs following physical exertion.
HP:0008967.definition_cn: 运动后肌肉强直（Post-exertional muscle stiffness）

HP:0008968.name: Muscle hypertrophy of the lower extremities
HP:0008968.definition: Muscle hypertrophy primarily affecting the legs.
HP:0008968.definition_cn: 下肢为主的肌肉肥大症。

HP:0008972.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
HP:0008972.definition: Decreased activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.
HP:0008972.name_cn: 线粒体呼吸链活性降低
HP:0008972.definition_cn: 线粒体呼吸链活性降低。

HP:0008981.name: Calf muscle hypertrophy
HP:0008981.definition: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the calf muscles.

HP:0008984.name: Neck muscle hypoplasia
HP:0008984.definition: Underdevelopment of muscles of the neck.

HP:0008985.name: Increased intramuscular fat
HP:0008985.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of intramuscular fat tissue.
HP:0008985.definition_cn: 肌内脂肪组织异常增多。

HP:0008986.name: Agenesis of the diaphragm
HP:0008986.definition: Congenital lack, i.e., aplasia of the diaphragm.
HP:0008986.definition_cn: 先天性膈肌缺失，即膈肌发育不全。

HP:0008988.name: Pelvic girdle muscle atrophy
HP:0008988.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting the muscles that attach to the pelvic girdle (the gluteal muscles, the lateral rotators, adductor magnus, adductor brevis, adductor longus, pectineus, and gracilis muscles).
HP:0008988.definition_cn: 影响附着于骨盆带肌肉的肌肉萎缩（臀肌、外旋肌群、大收肌、短收肌、长收肌、耻骨肌和股薄肌）。

HP:0008991.name: Exercise-induced leg cramps
HP:0008991.definition: Sudden and involuntary contractions of one or more muscles of the leg brought on by physical exertion.
HP:0008991.definition_cn: 由体力活动引发的一处或多处腿部肌肉突发性不自主收缩。

HP:0008993.name: Increased intraabdominal fat
HP:0008993.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of intraabdominal fat tissue.
HP:0008993.definition_cn: 腹腔内脂肪组织异常增多。

HP:0008994.name: Proximal muscle weakness in lower limbs
HP:0008994.definition: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles of the legs.

HP:0008997.name: Proximal muscle weakness in upper limbs
HP:0008997.definition: A lack of strength of the proximal muscles of the arms.

HP:0009002.name: Loss of truncal subcutaneous adipose tissue
HP:0009002.definition: Loss (reduction of previously present) of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the region of the trunk.
HP:0009002.name_cn: 躯干皮下脂肪组织减少
HP:0009002.definition_cn: 躯干部位皮下脂肪组织的丧失（先前存在的减少）。

HP:0009003.name: Increased subcutaneous truncal adipose tissue
HP:0009003.definition: The presence of an abnormally increased amount of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the trunk of the body.
HP:0009003.name_cn: 皮下躯干脂肪组织增加
HP:0009003.definition_cn: 躯干部皮下脂肪组织异常增多。

HP:0009005.name: Weakness of the intrinsic hand muscles

HP:0009011.name: Hypoplasia of serratus anterior muscle
HP:0009011.definition: Underdevelopment of the serratus anterior muscle, which is involved in abduction, upward Rotation, and elevation of the scapula.
HP:0009011.definition_cn: 前锯肌发育不全，该肌肉参与肩胛骨的外展、上旋和上提。

HP:0009016.name: Upper limb muscle hypoplasia
HP:0009016.definition: Underdevelopment of muscles of the arm.

HP:0009017.name: Loss of gluteal subcutaneous adipose tissue
HP:0009017.definition: Loss (reduction of previously present) of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the gluteal region.
HP:0009017.definition_cn: 臀部区域皮下脂肪组织的丧失（先前存在的减少）。

HP:0009019.name: Progressive loss of facial adipose tissue
HP:0009019.name_cn: 进行性面部脂肪组织丧失

HP:0009020.name: Exercise-induced muscle fatigue
HP:0009020.definition: An abnormally increased tendency towards muscle fatigue induced by physical exercise.
HP:0009020.definition_cn: 运动诱发的肌肉疲劳异常增加倾向。

HP:0009023.name: Abdominal wall muscle weakness
HP:0009023.definition: Decreased strength of the abdominal musculature.

HP:0009025.name: Increased connective tissue
HP:0009025.definition: The presence of an abnormally increased amount of connective tissue.

HP:0009026.name: Hypoplasia of latissimus dorsi muscle
HP:0009026.definition: Underdevelopment of the latissimus dorsi muscle, which is involved in adduction, extension, internal rotation, and transverse extension of the shoulder and assists in movement of the scapula.
HP:0009026.definition_cn: 背阔肌发育不全，该肌肉参与肩关节的内收、伸展、内旋和横向伸展，并协助肩胛骨的运动。

HP:0009027.name: Foot dorsiflexor weakness
HP:0009027.definition: Weakness of the muscles responsible for dorsiflexion of the foot, that is, of the movement of the toes towards the shin. The foot dorsiflexors include the tibialis anterior, the extensor hallucis longus, the extensor digitorum longus, and the peroneus tertius muscles.
HP:0009027.definition_cn: 负责足背屈的肌肉无力，即脚趾向胫骨方向运动的无力。足背屈肌包括胫骨前肌、拇长伸肌、趾长伸肌和第三腓骨肌。

HP:0009028.name: Generalized weakness of limb muscles
HP:0009028.definition: Generalized weakness of the muscles of the arms and legs.

HP:0009031.name: Amyotrophy of ankle musculature
HP:0009031.definition: Atrophy of the muscles of the ankle.

HP:0009037.name: Segmental spinal muscular atrophy
HP:0009037.name_cn: 节段性脊髓性肌萎缩症

HP:0009049.name: Peroneal muscle atrophy
HP:0009049.definition: Atrophy of the peroneous muscles, peroneus longus (also known as Fibularis longus), Peroneus brevis (also known as fibularis brevis, and Peroneus tertius (also known as fibularis tertius).
HP:0009049.definition_cn: 腓骨肌萎缩，包括腓骨长肌（Fibularis longus）、腓骨短肌（Fibularis brevis）和第三腓骨肌（Fibularis tertius）。

HP:0009050.name: Quadriceps muscle atrophy
HP:0009050.definition: Muscular atrophy involving the quadriceps muscle.

HP:0009051.name: Increased muscle glycogen content
HP:0009051.definition: An increased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.
HP:0009051.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中糖原含量增加。

HP:0009053.name: Distal lower limb muscle weakness
HP:0009053.definition: Reduced strength of the distal musculature of the legs.

HP:0009055.name: Generalized limb muscle atrophy
HP:0009055.definition: Generalized (unlocalized) atrophy affecting muscles of the limbs in both proximal and distal locations.
HP:0009055.definition_cn: 四肢近端和远端肌肉的广泛性（非局限性）萎缩。

HP:0009056.name: Loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue from upper limbs
HP:0009056.name_cn: 上肢皮下脂肪组织丧失

HP:0009058.name: Increased muscle lipid content
HP:0009058.definition: An abnormal accumulation of lipids in skeletal muscle.
HP:0009058.definition_cn: 骨骼肌内脂质异常蓄积。

HP:0009059.name: Congenital generalized lipodystrophy
HP:0009059.name_cn: 先天性全身性脂肪营养不良

HP:0009060.name: Scapular muscle atrophy
HP:0009060.definition: Atrophy of the muscles that are responsible for moving the scapula, which are the levator scapulae, the infraspinatus muscle, the teres major, the teres minor, and the supraspinatus muscle.
HP:0009060.definition_cn: 负责肩胛骨运动的肌肉萎缩，包括肩胛提肌、冈下肌、大圆肌、小圆肌和冈上肌。

HP:0009062.name: Infantile axial hypotonia
HP:0009062.definition: Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) affecting the musculature of the trunk and with onset in infancy.
HP:0009062.definition_cn: 躯干肌群肌张力低下（肌张力异常降低），婴儿期发病。

HP:0009063.name: Progressive distal muscle weakness
HP:0009063.definition: Progressively reduced strength of the distal musculature.
HP:0009063.definition_cn: 远端肌群肌力进行性减退。

HP:0009064.name: Generalized lipodystrophy
HP:0009064.definition: Generalized degenerative changes of the fat tissue.
HP:0009064.definition_cn: 脂肪组织的广泛性退行性改变。

HP:0009067.name: Progressive spinal muscular atrophy
HP:0009067.definition: Progressive spinal muscular atrophy, i.e., muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.
HP:0009067.name_cn: 进行性脊髓性肌萎缩症
HP:0009067.definition_cn: 进行性脊髓性肌萎缩，即与脊髓和脑干运动神经元丧失相关的肌无力和肌萎缩。

HP:0009069.name: Lethal infantile mitochondrial myopathy
HP:0009069.name_cn: 致死性婴儿线粒体肌病

HP:0009071.name: Inflammatory myopathy
HP:0009071.definition: Chronic muscle inflammation accompanied by muscle weakness.

HP:0009072.name: Decreased Achilles reflex
HP:0009072.definition: Decreased intensity of the Achilles reflex (also known as the ankle jerk reflex), which can be elicited by tapping the tendon is tapped while the foot is dorsiflexed.
HP:0009072.definition_cn: 跟腱反射（亦称踝反射）强度减弱，可通过在足背屈时叩击跟腱引出。

HP:0009073.name: Progressive proximal muscle weakness
HP:0009073.definition: Lack of strength of the proximal muscles that becomes progressively more severe.
HP:0009073.definition_cn: 近端肌群肌力进行性减退。

HP:0009077.name: Weakness of long finger extensor muscles

HP:0009084.name: Midline notch of upper alveolar ridge

HP:0009085.name: Alveolar ridge overgrowth
HP:0009085.definition: Increased width of the alveolar ridges.

HP:0009088.name: Speech articulation difficulties
HP:0009088.definition: Impairment in the physical production of speech sounds.

HP:0009098.name: Chronic oral candidiasis
HP:0009098.definition: Chronic accumulation and overgrowth of the fungus Candida albicans on the mucous membranes of the mouth, generally manifested as associated with creamy white lesions on the tongue or inner cheeks, occasionally spreading to the gums, tonsils, palate or oropharynx.
HP:0009098.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜上白色念珠菌的慢性积聚和过度生长，通常表现为舌或颊内侧伴有乳白色病变，偶尔可扩散至牙龈、扁桃体、腭或口咽部。

HP:0009099.name: Median cleft palate
HP:0009099.definition: Cleft palate of the midline of the palate.

HP:0009101.name: Submucous cleft lip
HP:0009101.definition: A cleft of the lip with overlying mucous membrane.

HP:0009102.name: Anterior open-bite malocclusion
HP:0009102.definition: Anterior open bite is a malocclusion characterized by a gap between the anterior teeth (incisors), that is, by a deficiency in the normal vertical overlap between antagonist incisal edges when the posterior teeth are in occlusion.
HP:0009102.definition_cn: 前牙开合是一种错颌畸形，其特征为前牙（切牙）之间存在间隙，即在后牙处于咬合状态时，对颌切牙边缘之间正常的垂直覆盖不足。

HP:0009103.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the pelvis
HP:0009103.name_cn: 骨盆发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009104.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the pubic bone
HP:0009104.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the pubic bone.
HP:0009104.name_cn: 耻骨发育不全/耻骨发育不良

HP:0009105.name: Abnormal ossification of the pubic bone
HP:0009105.definition: Abnormal ossification (bone tissue formation) affecting the pubic bone, also known as the pubis.
HP:0009105.definition_cn: 影响耻骨的异常骨化（骨组织形成），也称为耻骨异常骨化。

HP:0009106.name: Abnormal pelvis bone ossification
HP:0009106.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any bone of the bony pelvis.
HP:0009106.definition_cn: 骨盆骨形成和矿化异常。

HP:0009107.name: Abnormal ossification involving the femoral head and neck
HP:0009107.name_cn: 股骨头及股骨颈异常骨化

HP:0009108.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the femoral head and neck
HP:0009108.name_cn: 股骨头及股骨颈发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009109.name: Denervation of the diaphragm
HP:0009109.definition: Interruption of the innervation of the diaphragm.

HP:0009110.name: Diaphragmatic eventration
HP:0009110.definition: A congenital failure of muscular development of part or all of one or both hemidiaphragms, resulting in superior displacement of abdominal viscera and altered lung development.
HP:0009110.definition_cn: 先天性单侧或双侧部分或全部膈肌发育不全，导致腹腔脏器上移及肺发育异常。

HP:0009112.name: Aplasia of the left hemidiaphragm
HP:0009112.definition: Congenital absence of the left half of the diaphragm.

HP:0009113.name: Diaphragmatic weakness
HP:0009113.definition: A decrease in the strength of the diaphragm.

HP:0009115.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving the skeleton
HP:0009115.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of one or more components of the skeleton.
HP:0009115.name_cn: 骨骼发育不全/骨骼发育不良
HP:0009115.definition_cn: 骨骼系统一个或多个组成部分的缺失（由于形成失败）或发育不全。

HP:0009116.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving bones of the skull
HP:0009116.name_cn: 颅骨发育不全/颅骨发育不良

HP:0009117.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the maxilla
HP:0009117.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the maxilla.
HP:0009117.name_cn: 上颌骨发育不全/上颌骨发育不良
HP:0009117.definition_cn: 上颌骨缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009118.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the mandible
HP:0009118.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the mandible.
HP:0009118.name_cn: 下颌骨发育不全/下颌骨发育不良
HP:0009118.definition_cn: 下颌骨缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009119.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the frontal sinuses
HP:0009119.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of frontal sinus.
HP:0009119.name_cn: 额窦发育不全/额窦发育不良

HP:0009120.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the sinuses
HP:0009120.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of a cranial sinus or sinuses.
HP:0009120.name_cn: 鼻窦发育不全/鼻窦发育不良

HP:0009121.name: Abnormal axial skeleton morphology
HP:0009121.definition: An abnormality of the axial skeleton, which comprises the skull, the vertebral column, the ribs and the sternum.
HP:0009121.definition_cn: 轴骨异常，包括颅骨、脊柱、肋骨和胸骨。

HP:0009122.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia affecting bones of the axial skeleton
HP:0009122.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of bones of the axial skeleton.
HP:0009122.name_cn: 影响中轴骨骼的发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009122.definition_cn: 轴骨骨骼缺失（由于形成失败）或发育不全。

HP:0009123.name: Mixed hypo- and hyperpigmentation of the skin
HP:0009123.name_cn: 皮肤混合性色素减退和色素沉着

HP:0009124.name: Abnormal adipose tissue morphology
HP:0009124.definition: An abnormality of adipose tissue, which is loose connective tissue composed of adipocytes.
HP:0009124.definition_cn: 脂肪组织异常，即由脂肪细胞构成的疏松结缔组织异常。

HP:0009125.name: Lipodystrophy
HP:0009125.definition: Degenerative changes of the fat tissue.

HP:0009126.name: Increased adipose tissue
HP:0009126.definition: An increase in adipose tissue mass by hyperplastic growth (increase in the number of adipocytes) or by hypertrophic growth (increase in the size of adipocytes occurring primarily by lipid accumulation within the cell).
HP:0009126.definition_cn: 脂肪组织质量增加通过增生性生长（脂肪细胞数量增加）或肥大性生长（脂肪细胞体积增加，主要由细胞内脂质积累引起）。

HP:0009127.name: Abnormality of the musculature of the limbs

HP:0009128.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the musculature of the extremities
HP:0009128.name_cn: 四肢肌肉发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009129.name: Upper limb amyotrophy
HP:0009129.definition: Muscular atrophy involving the muscles of the upper limbs.

HP:0009130.name: Hand muscle atrophy
HP:0009130.definition: Muscular atrophy involving the muscles of the hand.

HP:0009131.name: Abnormality of the musculature of the thorax
HP:0009131.definition: A disease or lesion affecting the muscles of the thorax.
HP:0009131.definition_cn: 影响胸廓肌肉的疾病或病变。

HP:0009132.name: Abnormal tarsal bone mineral density
HP:0009132.definition: This term applies to all changes in bone mineral density of the tarsal bones, which (depending on severity) can be seen on x-rays as a change in density and or structure of the bone.
HP:0009132.definition_cn: 该术语适用于跗骨骨矿物质密度的所有变化，这些变化（取决于严重程度）可在X射线上表现为骨密度和/或骨结构的改变。

HP:0009134.name: Osteolysis involving bones of the feet

HP:0009136.name: Duplication involving bones of the feet

HP:0009138.name: Synostosis involving bones of the lower limbs
HP:0009138.definition: An abnormal union between bones or parts of bones lower limbs.
HP:0009138.definition_cn: 下肢骨骼或骨骼部分之间的异常连接。

HP:0009139.name: Osteolysis involving bones of the lower limbs

HP:0009140.name: Synostosis involving bones of the feet

HP:0009141.name: Depletion of mitochondrial DNA in muscle tissue
HP:0009141.name_cn: 肌肉组织中线粒体DNA耗竭

HP:0009142.name: Duplication of bones involving the upper extremities

HP:0009144.name: Supernumerary bones of the axial skeleton

HP:0009145.name: Abnormal cerebral artery morphology
HP:0009145.definition: Any structural anomaly of a cerebral artery. The cerebral arteries comprise three main pairs of arteries and their branches, which supply the cerebrum of the brain. These are the anterior cerebral artery, the middle cerebral artery, and the posterior cerebral artery.
HP:0009145.definition_cn: 任何脑动脉的结构异常。脑动脉包括三对主要动脉及其分支，它们为大脑的脑实质供血。这些动脉分别是大脑前动脉、大脑中动脉和大脑后动脉。

HP:0009147.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009147.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009147.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009147.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第5指远节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009148.name: Small epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009148.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009148.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009148.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第五指远节指骨近端骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009149.name: Triangular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009149.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the little finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009149.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨三角骨骺
HP:0009149.definition_cn: 小指远节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009150.name: Abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009150.definition: Abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the little (5th) finger.
HP:0009150.definition_cn: 小指（第5指）近节指骨异常。

HP:0009152.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009152.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, middle, and distal phalanges of the 5th finger.
HP:0009152.definition_cn: 第五指近节、中节及远节指骨骨骺一处或多处异常。

HP:0009153.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009153.definition: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the fifth finger. This epiphysis is located on the proximal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009153.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺异常
HP:0009153.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺异常。该骨骺位于指骨的近端。

HP:0009154.name: Triangular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009154.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the little finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009154.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨三角骨骺
HP:0009154.definition_cn: 小指近节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009155.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009155.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the little finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009155.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009155.definition_cn: 小指近节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009157.name: Ivory epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009157.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the little finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009157.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨象牙样骨骺
HP:0009157.definition_cn: 小指近节指骨骺硬化，导致X线影像中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009158.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009158.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009158.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009158.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨近端骨骺相对于年龄相关标准异常增大。

HP:0009159.name: Small epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009159.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009159.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009159.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第五指近节指骨近端骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009160.name: Absent epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009160.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009160.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺缺失
HP:0009160.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨近端骨骺缺如。

HP:0009161.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009161.definition: Absence or underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the middle phalanx of the little (5th) finger.
HP:0009161.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009161.definition_cn: 小指（第五指）中节指骨缺失或发育不全（中节指骨发育不良）。

HP:0009162.name: Absent middle phalanx of 5th finger
HP:0009162.definition: Absence of the middle phalanx of the little (5th) finger.
HP:0009162.definition_cn: 小指（第5指）中节指骨缺失。

HP:0009163.name: obsolete Abnormal form of the 5th finger

HP:0009164.name: Abnormal calcification of the carpal bones

HP:0009165.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009165.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009165.name_cn: 第五指远端指骨骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009165.definition_cn: 第五指远端指骨骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009166.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009166.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009166.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009166.definition_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009167.name: Irregular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009167.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009167.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009167.definition_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009168.name: Bullet-shaped middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009168.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the middle phalanx of the 5th finger is affected.
HP:0009168.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨子弹形畸形
HP:0009168.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第五指中指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009169.name: Broad middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009169.definition: Increased width of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009169.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009170.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009170.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009170.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009170.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009171.name: Triangular epiphyses of the metacarpals
HP:0009171.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphyses of the metacarpals. These epiphyses are located at the distal end of the metacarpals.
HP:0009171.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺呈三角形外观。这些骨骺位于掌骨的远端。

HP:0009172.name: Abnormal 4th finger phalanx morphology
HP:0009172.definition: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 4th (ring) finger.

HP:0009173.name: Curved middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009173.definition: Curved appearance of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009173.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨弯曲外观。

HP:0009174.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009174.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, middle, and distal phalanges of the 4th finger.
HP:0009174.definition_cn: 第四指近节、中节及远节指骨骨骺一处或多处异常。

HP:0009175.name: Patchy sclerosis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009175.definition: Patchy increase in bone density of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009175.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009175.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨局部骨密度增高。

HP:0009177.name: Proximal/middle symphalangism of 5th finger
HP:0009177.definition: Fusion of the proximal and middle phalanges of the 5th finger.
HP:0009177.name_cn: 第五指近端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009177.definition_cn: 第五指近节和中节指骨融合。

HP:0009178.name: Symphalangism of middle phalanx of 5th finger
HP:0009178.definition: Fusion of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger with another bone.
HP:0009178.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨指节融合症
HP:0009178.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009179.name: Deviation of the 5th finger
HP:0009179.definition: Displacement of the 5th finger from its normal position.

HP:0009180.name: Ulnar deviation of the 5th finger
HP:0009180.definition: Displacement of the 5th finger towards the ulnar side.

HP:0009182.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009182.definition: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 5th (little) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009182.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009182.definition_cn: 第五指（小指）中节指骨呈三角形。三角形或称为三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009183.name: Joint contracture of the 5th finger
HP:0009183.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in the 5th finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. The term camptodactyly of the 5th finger is used if the distal and/or proximal interphalangeal joints are affected.
HP:0009183.definition_cn: 第五指因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节活动丧失。若远端和/或近端指间关节受累，则使用术语“第五指屈曲畸形”。

HP:0009184.name: Contracture of the distal interphalangeal joint of the 5th finger
HP:0009184.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the distal interphalangeal joint of the 5th finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009184.name_cn: 第五指远侧指间关节挛缩
HP:0009184.definition_cn: 第五指远端指间关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节活动丧失。

HP:0009185.name: Contracture of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 5th finger
HP:0009185.definition: Proximal interphalangeal (PIP) flexion deformity of the little finger. That is, the PIP joint of a little finger is bent (flexed) and cannot be straightened actively or passively. It is thus a chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement.
HP:0009185.name_cn: 第五指近端指间关节挛缩
HP:0009185.definition_cn: 小指近端指间关节（PIP）屈曲畸形。即小指的PIP关节弯曲（屈曲），无法主动或被动伸直。这是由于肌肉、肌腱、韧带或皮肤的结构性改变导致的关节运动慢性丧失，阻碍了正常活动。

HP:0009186.name: Contracture of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 5th finger
HP:0009186.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 5th finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009186.definition_cn: 第五指掌指关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节运动丧失。

HP:0009187.name: Bracket epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009187.definition: An abnormality of the distal phalanx of the fifth finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009187.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺骨折
HP:0009187.definition_cn: 第五指远端指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009188.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009188.definition: A secondary ossification center in the distal phalanx of the fifth finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009188.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009188.definition_cn: 第五指远节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009189.name: Fragmentation of the metacarpal epiphyses
HP:0009189.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the metacarpals.
HP:0009189.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺的碎裂样外观。

HP:0009190.name: Irregular epiphyses of the metacarpals
HP:0009190.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphyses of the metacarpals.
HP:0009190.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009191.name: Ivory epiphyses of the metacarpals
HP:0009191.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses of the metacarpals, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009191.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺硬化，导致X线影像中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009192.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009192.definition: Absence or underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the proximal phalanx of the little (5th) finger.
HP:0009192.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009192.definition_cn: 小指（第5指）近节指骨缺失或发育不全（近节指骨发育不良）。

HP:0009193.name: Metacarpal pseudoepiphysis
HP:0009193.definition: A pseudoepiphysis is a secondary ossification center distinct from the normal epiphysis. The normal metacarpal epiphyses are located at the distal ends of the metacarpal bones. Accessory epiphyses (which are also known as pseudoepiphyses) can also occasionally be observed at the proximal ends of the metacarpals, usually involving the 2nd metacarpal bone.
HP:0009193.definition_cn: 假骨骺是一种与正常骨骺不同的次级骨化中心。正常的掌骨骨骺位于掌骨的远端。副骨骺（也称为假骨骺）偶尔也可在掌骨的近端观察到，通常涉及第二掌骨。

HP:0009194.name: Small epiphyses of the metacarpals
HP:0009194.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphyses located at the distal end of the metacarpals in respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009194.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于掌骨远端的骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009195.name: Epiphyseal stippling of the metacarpals
HP:0009195.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the metacarpals.
HP:0009195.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺内出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。

HP:0009196.name: Absent metacarpal epiphyses
HP:0009196.definition: Absence of the epiphyses of the metacarpal bones, which are normally located at the distal ends of the metacarpals.
HP:0009196.definition_cn: 掌骨骨骺缺失，通常位于掌骨远端。

HP:0009197.name: Bracket epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009197.definition: An abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the fifth finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009197.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009197.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009198.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009198.definition: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the fifth finger. This epiphysis is located on the proximal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009198.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺异常
HP:0009198.definition_cn: 第五指远节指骨骨骺异常。该骨骺位于指骨近端。

HP:0009199.name: Irregular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009199.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009199.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺不规则
