HP:0009199.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨骺区不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009200.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009200.definition: A secondary ossification center in the proximal phalanx of the fifth finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009200.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009200.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009201.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009201.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009201.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009201.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009202.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009202.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009202.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009202.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009203.name: Absent epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009203.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009203.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨骨骺缺失
HP:0009203.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨近端骨骺缺失。

HP:0009204.name: Bracket epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009204.definition: An abnormality of the middle phalanx of the fifth finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009204.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009204.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009205.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009205.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the little finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009205.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009205.definition_cn: 小指中节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009206.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009206.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009206.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨骺增大
HP:0009206.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第五指中节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009207.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009207.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009207.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨骺碎裂
HP:0009207.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009208.name: Irregular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009208.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009208.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009208.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨骺区不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009209.name: Ivory epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009209.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the little finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009209.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨象牙样骨骺
HP:0009209.definition_cn: 小指中节指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009210.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009210.definition: A secondary ossification center in the middle phalanx of the fifth finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009210.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨假性骨骺
HP:0009210.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨中的次级骨化中心，与不参与管状骨纵向生长的正常骨骺不同。

HP:0009211.name: Small epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009211.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009211.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009211.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于第五指中节指骨近端的骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009212.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009212.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009212.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009212.definition_cn: 第五指中节指骨骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009213.name: Triangular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009213.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the little finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009213.name_cn: 第五指中节指骨三角形骨骺
HP:0009213.definition_cn: 小指中节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009214.name: Absent epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009214.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009214.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨骺缺如
HP:0009214.definition_cn: 第四指中节指骨近端骨骺缺失。

HP:0009215.name: Bracket epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009215.definition: An abnormality of the middle phalanx of the fourth finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009215.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009215.definition_cn: 第四指中节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009216.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009216.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the ring finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009216.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨锥形骨骺

HP:0009217.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009217.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009217.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009217.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第四指中节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009218.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009218.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009218.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨骨骺碎裂

HP:0009219.name: Irregular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger

HP:0009220.name: Ivory epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger

HP:0009224.definition_cn: 手无名指中节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009225.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009225.definition: Absence of the proximal phalanx of the little (5th) finger.
HP:0009225.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨发育不全
HP:0009225.definition_cn: 小指（第5指）近节指骨缺失。

HP:0009226.name: Short proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009226.definition: Hypoplastic/small proximal phalanx of the fifth finger.
HP:0009226.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨发育不全/短小。

HP:0009227.name: Broad proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009227.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009227.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009228.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009228.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger is affected.
HP:0009228.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨子弹形畸形
HP:0009228.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第五指近节指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009229.name: Curved proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009229.definition: Curved appearance of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009229.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨弯曲外观。

HP:0009230.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009230.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009230.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009230.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009231.name: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009231.definition: Patchy increase in bone density of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger.
HP:0009231.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009231.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨局部骨密度增高。

HP:0009232.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009232.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger with another bone.
HP:0009232.name_cn: 近节指骨融合症累及第五指近节指骨
HP:0009232.definition_cn: 第五指近节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009233.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 5th finger
HP:0009233.definition: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 5th (little) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009233.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009233.definition_cn: 第五指（小指）近节指骨呈三角形。三角形或称为三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009234.name: Symphalangism of the proximal phalanx of the 5th finger with the 5th metacarpal

HP:0009234.name_cn: 第五指近节指骨与第五掌骨的近节指骨融合症

HP:0009236.name: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th finger proximal phalanx

HP:0009236.name_cn: 菱形或三角形第五指近节指骨

HP:0009237.name: Short 5th finger

HP:0009237.definition_cn: 第五指（小指）发育不全（先天性尺寸减小）。

HP:0009244.definition_cn: 第五指末节指骨与中节指骨融合。

HP:0009245.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 5th finger

HP:0009245.name_cn: 第五指远端指骨的三角形形态

HP:0009246.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the 5th finger

HP:0009246.name_cn: 第五指远节指骨发育不全

HP:0009276.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 4th finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. That is, the PIP joint of a fourth finger is bent (flexed) and cannot be straightened actively or passively. It is thus a chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement.
HP:0009276.name_cn: 第四指近端指间关节挛缩
HP:0009276.definition_cn: 第四指近端指间关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节活动丧失。即第四指近端指间关节呈屈曲状态，无法主动或被动伸直。这是由于肌肉、肌腱、韧带或皮肤的结构性改变导致的慢性关节活动受限，阻碍了正常运动。

HP:0009277.name: Contracture of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 4th finger
HP:0009277.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 4th finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009277.definition_cn: 第四指掌指关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节运动丧失。

HP:0009278.name: Ulnar deviation of the 4th finger
HP:0009278.definition: Displacement of the 4th finger towards the ulnar side (i.e., towards the 5th finger).
HP:0009278.definition_cn: 第四指向尺侧（即向第五指方向）移位。

HP:0009279.name: Radial deviation of the 4th finger
HP:0009279.definition: Displacement of the 4th finger towards the radial side (i.e., towards the thumb).
HP:0009279.definition_cn: 第四指向桡侧（即向拇指方向）移位。

HP:0009280.name: Short 4th finger
HP:0009280.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the fourth finger, also known as the ring finger.
HP:0009280.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）发育不全（先天性尺寸减小）。

HP:0009282.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger

HP:0009283.name: Abnormality of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger

HP:0009284.name: Abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger

HP:0009285.name: Curved phalanges of the 4th finger
HP:0009285.definition: Curved appearance of the phalanges of the 4th (ring) finger.
HP:0009285.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）指骨的弯曲外观。

HP:0009286.name: Curved distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009286.definition: Curved appearance of the distal phalanx of the 4th (ring) finger.
HP:0009286.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）远节指骨弯曲外观。

HP:0009287.name: Curved middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009287.definition: Curved appearance of the middle phalanx of the 4th (ring) finger.
HP:0009287.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）中节指骨的弯曲外观。

HP:0009288.name: Curved proximal phalanx of the 4th finger

HP:0009289.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009289.name_cn: 第四指远节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009290.name: Short distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009290.definition: Hypoplastic/small distal phalanx of the fourth finger.
HP:0009290.definition_cn: 第四指远端指骨发育不全/短小。

HP:0009291.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009291.definition: Absence of the distal phalanx of the ring (4th) finger.
HP:0009291.name_cn: 第四指远节指骨发育不全
HP:0009291.definition_cn: 无名指（第四指）远节指骨缺失。

HP:0009292.name: Broad distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009292.definition: Increased width of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009292.definition_cn: 第四指远节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009293.name: Broad middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009293.definition: Increased width of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009293.definition_cn: 第四指中节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009294.name: Absent middle phalanx of 4th finger
HP:0009294.definition: Absence of the middle phalanx of the ring (4th) finger.
HP:0009294.definition_cn: 无名指（第四指）中节指骨缺失。

HP:0009295.name: Short middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009295.definition: Hypoplastic/small middle phalanx of the 4th finger, also known as the ring finger.
HP:0009295.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）中节指骨发育不全/短小。

HP:0009296.name: Bullet-shaped middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009296.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the middle phalanx of the 4th finger is affected.
HP:0009296.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨子弹形畸形
HP:0009296.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干收缩。该术语用于描述第四指中指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009297.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009297.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009297.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009297.definition_cn: 第四指中节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009298.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009298.definition: Absence of the proximal phalanx of the ring (4th) finger.
HP:0009298.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨发育不全
HP:0009298.definition_cn: 无名指（第四指）近节指骨缺失。

HP:0009299.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009299.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009300.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009300.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009301.name: Short proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009301.definition: Hypoplastic/small proximal phalanx of the fourth finger.
HP:0009301.definition_cn: 第四指近节指骨发育不全/短小。

HP:0009302.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009302.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the distal phalanx of the 4th finger is affected.
HP:0009302.name_cn: 第四指远节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009302.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第四指远端指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009303.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009303.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009303.name_cn: 第四指远节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009303.definition_cn: 第四指远端指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009304.name: Patchy sclerosis of the distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009304.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the distal phalanx of the fourth finger.
HP:0009304.name_cn: 第四指远端指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009304.definition_cn: 第四指远端指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009305.name: Distal/middle symphalangism of 4th finger
HP:0009305.definition: Fusion of the terminal/distal and middle phalanges of the 4th finger.
HP:0009305.name_cn: 第四指远端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009305.definition_cn: 第四指末节/远节指骨与中节指骨融合。

HP:0009306.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009306.definition: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 4th (ring) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009306.name_cn: 第四指远端指骨的三角形形态
HP:0009306.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）远端指骨的三角形形态。三角形或称为三角洲形态的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009307.name: Patchy sclerosis of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009307.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the middle phalanx of the fourth finger.
HP:0009307.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009307.definition_cn: 第四指中节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009308.name: Symphalangism of middle phalanx of 4th finger
HP:0009308.definition: Fusion of the middle phalanx of the 4th finger with another bone.
HP:0009308.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨指关节融合症
HP:0009308.definition_cn: 第四指中节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009309.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009309.definition: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 4th (ring) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009309.name_cn: 第四指中节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009309.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）中节指骨呈三角形。三角形或称为三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺支架术后的典型结果。

HP:0009310.name: Broad proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009310.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009310.definition_cn: 第四指近节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009311.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009311.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger is affected.
HP:0009311.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨子弹形畸形
HP:0009311.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干收缩。该术语用于描述第四指近节指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009312.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009312.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger.
HP:0009312.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009312.definition_cn: 第四指近节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009313.name: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009313.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the proximal phalanx of the fourth finger.
HP:0009313.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009313.definition_cn: 第四指近节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009314.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009314.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger with another bone.
HP:0009314.name_cn: 近节指骨融合症累及第四指近节指骨
HP:0009314.definition_cn: 第四指近节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009315.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 4th finger
HP:0009315.definition: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 4th (ring) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009315.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009315.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）近节指骨的三角形形态。三角形或所谓的三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009316.name: Abnormal 3rd finger phalanx morphology
HP:0009316.definition: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 3rd (middle) finger.

HP:0009317.name: Deviation of the 3rd finger
HP:0009317.definition: Displacement of the 3rd finger from its normal position.

HP:0009318.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 3rd finger
HP:0009318.name_cn: 第三指发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009318.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）发育不全/发育不良或缺如/发育不全。

HP:0009319.name: Joint contracture of the 3rd finger
HP:0009319.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in the 3rd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. The term camptodactyly of the 3rd finger is used if the distal and/or proximal interphalangeal joints are affected.
HP:0009319.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织结构改变导致的第三指关节运动慢性丧失。若远端和/或近端指间关节受累，则使用术语“第三指屈曲畸形”。

HP:0009320.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009320.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, middle, and distal phalanges of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009320.definition_cn: 第三指近节、中节及远节指骨骨骺一处或多处异常。

HP:0009321.name: Absent epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009321.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009321.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺缺如
HP:0009321.definition_cn: 中指近节指骨骨骺缺失。

HP:0009322.name: Bracket epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009322.definition: An abnormality of the middle phalanx of the third finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009322.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009322.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009323.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009323.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009323.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009323.definition_cn: 手第三指中节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关实体“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009324.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009324.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009324.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骺增大
HP:0009324.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第三指中节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009325.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009325.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009325.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009325.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009326.name: Irregular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009326.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009326.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009326.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骺区不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009327.name: Ivory epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009327.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009327.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨象牙质骨骺
HP:0009327.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009328.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009328.definition: A secondary ossification center in the middle phalanx of the third finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009328.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009328.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨中的次级骨化中心，与不参与管状骨纵向生长的正常骨骺不同。

HP:0009329.name: Small epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009329.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009329.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009329.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第三指中节指骨近端骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009330.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009330.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009330.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009330.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009331.name: Triangular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009331.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009331.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨三角形骨骺
HP:0009331.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009332.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009332.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺异常

HP:0009333.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009333.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺异常

HP:0009334.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009334.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨骺异常

HP:0009335.name: Absent epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009335.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009335.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺缺失
HP:0009335.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨近端骨骺缺失。

HP:0009336.name: Bracket epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009336.definition: An abnormality of the distal phalanx of the third finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009336.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009336.definition_cn: 第三指远端指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009337.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009337.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009337.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009337.definition_cn: 手第三指远节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关实体“天使形”骨骺是指显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009338.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009338.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009338.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009338.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第三指远节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009339.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009339.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009339.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009339.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009340.name: Irregular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009340.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009340.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨不规则骨骺
HP:0009340.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009341.name: Ivory epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009341.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009341.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨象牙样骨骺
HP:0009341.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺硬化，导致X线影像中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙色外观）。

HP:0009342.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009342.definition: A secondary ossification center in the distal phalanx of the third finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009342.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009342.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009343.name: Small epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009343.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009343.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009343.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第三指远节指骨近端骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009344.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009344.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009344.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009344.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009345.name: Triangular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009345.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009345.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨三角骨骺
HP:0009345.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009346.name: Absent epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009346.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009346.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺缺失
HP:0009346.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨近端骨骺缺失。

HP:0009347.name: Bracket epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009347.definition: An abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the third finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009347.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009347.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009348.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009348.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009348.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009348.definition_cn: 手第三指近节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关实体“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009349.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009349.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009349.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009349.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第三指近节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009350.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009350.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009350.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009350.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009351.name: Irregular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009351.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009351.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009351.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009352.name: Ivory epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009352.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009352.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨象牙样骨骺
HP:0009352.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骺硬化，导致X线影像中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009353.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009353.definition: A secondary ossification center in the proximal phalanx of the third finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009353.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009353.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺分离，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009354.name: Small epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009354.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009354.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009354.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第三指近节指骨近端骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009355.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009355.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009355.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009355.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺区出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009356.name: Triangular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009356.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009356.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨三角形骨骺
HP:0009356.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009357.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger

HP:0009358.name: Abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger

HP:0009374.name: Broad phalanges of the 5th finger
HP:0009374.definition: Increased width of the phalanges of the 5th finger.

HP:0009375.name: Bullet-shaped phalanges of the 5th finger
HP:0009375.definition: A fifth finger with short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009375.definition_cn: 第五指短而宽的指骨向远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009376.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the 5th finger
HP:0009376.definition: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the 5th finger.
HP:0009376.name_cn: 第五指指骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009376.definition_cn: 第五指指骨发育不全/发育不良。

HP:0009377.name: Patchy sclerosis of 5th finger phalanx
HP:0009377.definition: Uneven increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the 5th finger.
HP:0009377.name_cn: 第五指指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009377.definition_cn: 第五指一个或多个指骨骨密度不均匀性增高。

HP:0009378.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 5th finger
HP:0009378.definition: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 5th (little) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009378.definition_cn: 第五指（小指）呈三角形状的指骨。三角形状或称为德尔塔形状的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009379.name: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th finger distal phalanx
HP:0009379.definition: Rhomboid or triangular shaped 5th (little) finger distal phalanx.
HP:0009379.name_cn: 菱形或三角形第五指远端指骨
HP:0009379.definition_cn: 第五指（小指）远端指骨呈菱形或三角形。

HP:0009380.name: Finger aplasia
HP:0009380.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of fingers (i.e., aplasia of one or more fingers).
HP:0009380.definition_cn: 发育缺陷导致手指数量少于正常数量（即一个或多个手指发育不全）。

HP:0009381.name: Short finger
HP:0009381.definition: Abnormally short finger associated with developmental hypoplasia.
HP:0009381.definition_cn: 发育性指骨发育不全相关的异常短指畸形。

HP:0009382.name: Absent epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009382.definition: Absence of one or more epiphyses of the 5th finger.
HP:0009382.definition_cn: 第五指一个或多个骨骺缺失。

HP:0009383.name: Bracket epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009383.definition: An abnormality of the fifth finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009383.definition_cn: 第五指异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009384.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009384.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the 5th finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of a phalanx.
HP:0009384.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009385.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009385.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009385.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺相对于年龄相关标准异常增大。

HP:0009386.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009386.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the 5th finger.
HP:0009386.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009387.name: Irregular epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009387.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphyses of the 5th finger.
HP:0009387.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009388.name: Ivory epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009388.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses of the 5th finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009388.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009389.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009389.definition: A secondary ossification center in the fifth finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009389.definition_cn: 第五指次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺分离，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009390.name: Small epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009390.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphyses of the 5th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009390.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺相对于年龄相关标准异常缩小。

HP:0009391.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009391.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the 5th finger.
HP:0009391.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺内存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009392.name: Triangular epiphyses of the 5th finger
HP:0009392.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphyses of the 5th finger of the hand.
HP:0009392.definition_cn: 第五指骨骺呈三角形外观。

HP:0009393.name: Absent epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009393.definition: Absence of one or more epiphyses of the 4th finger.
HP:0009393.definition_cn: 第四指一个或多个骨骺缺失。

HP:0009394.name: Bracket epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009394.definition: An abnormality of the fourth finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009394.definition_cn: 第四指异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009395.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009395.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the 4th finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of a phalanx.
HP:0009395.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009396.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009396.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the 4th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009396.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺相对于年龄相关标准的异常增大。

HP:0009397.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009397.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the 4th finger.
HP:0009397.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009398.name: Irregular epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009398.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphyses of the 4th finger.
HP:0009398.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009399.name: Ivory epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009399.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses of the 4th finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009399.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009400.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009400.definition: A secondary ossification center in the fourth finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009400.definition_cn: 第四指中与正常骨骺分离的次级骨化中心，该骨化中心不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009401.name: Small epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009401.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphyses of the 4th finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009401.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第四指骨骺异常小。

HP:0009402.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009402.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the 4th finger.
HP:0009402.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。

HP:0009403.name: Triangular epiphyses of the 4th finger
HP:0009403.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphyses of the 4th finger of the hand.
HP:0009403.definition_cn: 第四指骨骺呈三角形外观。

HP:0009404.name: Broad phalanges of the 4th finger
HP:0009404.definition: Increased width of the phalanges of the 4th finger.

HP:0009405.name: Bullet-shaped phalanges of the 4th finger
HP:0009405.definition: A fourth finger with short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009405.definition_cn: 第四指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009406.name: Patchy sclerosis of 4th finger phalanx
HP:0009406.definition: Uneven increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the fourth (ring) finger.
HP:0009406.name_cn: 第四指指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009406.definition_cn: 第四指（无名指）一个或多个指骨骨密度不均匀增加。

HP:0009407.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 4th finger
HP:0009407.definition: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 4th finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009407.definition_cn: 第四指三角形状指骨。三角形状或称为Delta形状的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009408.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the 4th finger
HP:0009408.name_cn: 第四指指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009410.name: Absent epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009410.definition: Absence of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger.

HP:0009411.name: Bracket epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009411.definition: An abnormality of the third finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009411.definition_cn: 第三指异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009412.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009412.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of a phalanx.
HP:0009412.definition_cn: 手第三指骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。相关实体“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009413.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009413.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009413.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺相对于年龄相关标准的异常增大。

HP:0009414.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009414.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009414.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009415.name: Irregular epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009415.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009415.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺不规则放射学密度增高。

HP:0009416.name: Ivory epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009416.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009416.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009417.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009417.definition: A secondary ossification center in the third finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009417.definition_cn: 第三指中的次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009418.name: Small epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009418.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009418.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺相对于年龄相关标准异常缩小。

HP:0009419.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009419.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009419.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺内存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009420.name: Triangular epiphyses of the 3rd finger
HP:0009420.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphyses of the 3rd finger of the hand.
HP:0009420.definition_cn: 第三指骨骺呈三角形外观。

HP:0009421.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009421.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009422.name: Broad distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009422.definition: Increased width of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009422.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009423.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009423.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger is affected.
HP:0009423.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009423.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第三指远端指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009424.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009424.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009424.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009424.definition_cn: 第三指远端指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009425.name: Patchy sclerosis of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009425.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the distal phalanx of the third finger.
HP:0009425.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009425.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009426.name: Distal/middle symphalangism of 3rd finger
HP:0009426.definition: Fusion of the terminal/distal and middle phalanges of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009426.name_cn: 第三指远端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009426.definition_cn: 第三指末节指骨与中节指骨融合。

HP:0009427.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009427.definition: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 3rd (middle) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009427.name_cn: 第三指远端指骨的三角形形态
HP:0009427.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）远端指骨的三角形形态。三角形或称为三角洲形态的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009428.name: Curved distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009428.definition: Curved appearance of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009428.definition_cn: 第三指远节指骨弯曲外观。

HP:0009429.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009429.definition: Absence of the distal phalanx of the middle (3rd) finger.
HP:0009429.name_cn: 第三指远节指骨发育不全
HP:0009429.definition_cn: 中指（第三指）远节指骨缺失。

HP:0009430.name: Broad middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009430.definition: Increased width of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009430.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009431.name: Bullet-shaped middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009431.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger is affected.
HP:0009431.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009431.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第三指中指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009432.name: Curved middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009432.definition: Curved appearance of the middle phalanx of the 3rd (middle) finger.
HP:0009432.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）中节指骨的弯曲外观。

HP:0009433.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009433.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009433.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009433.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009434.name: Patchy sclerosis of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009434.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the middle phalanx of the third finger.
HP:0009434.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009434.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009435.name: Symphalangism of middle phalanx of 3rd finger
HP:0009435.definition: Fusion of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger with another bone.
HP:0009435.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨并指畸形
HP:0009435.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009436.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009436.definition: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 3rd (middle) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009436.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009436.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）中节指骨的三角形形态。三角形或称为三角洲形态的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009437.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009437.name_cn: 第三指中节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009438.name: Absent middle phalanx of 3rd finger
HP:0009438.definition: Absence of the middle phalanx of the middle (3rd) finger.
HP:0009438.definition_cn: 中指（第三指）中节指骨缺失。

HP:0009439.name: Short middle phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009439.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the middle phalanx of the third finger.
HP:0009439.definition_cn: 第三指中节指骨发育不全（先天性尺寸减小）。

HP:0009440.name: Broad phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009440.definition: Increased width of the phalanges of the 3rd finger.

HP:0009441.name: Bullet-shaped phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009441.definition: A third finger with short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009441.definition_cn: 第三指具有短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009442.name: Curved phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009442.definition: Curved appearance of the phalanges of the 3rd finger.

HP:0009443.name: Osteolytic defects of the phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009443.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the phalanges of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009443.name_cn: 第三指指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009443.definition_cn: 第三指指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009444.name: Patchy sclerosis of 3rd finger phalanx
HP:0009444.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the third finger.
HP:0009444.name_cn: 第三指指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009444.definition_cn: 第三指一个或多个指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009445.name: Symphalangism of the 3rd finger
HP:0009445.definition: Fusion of two or more bones of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009445.name_cn: 第三指指间关节融合症
HP:0009445.definition_cn: 第三指多骨融合（Fusion of two or more bones of the 3rd finger）。

HP:0009446.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009446.definition: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 3rd finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009446.definition_cn: 第三指三角形状指骨。三角形状或称为三角洲形状的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009447.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009447.name_cn: 第三指指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009448.name: obsolete Aplasia of the phalanges of the 3rd finger

HP:0009449.name: obsolete Hypoplastic/small phalanges of the 3rd finger
HP:0009449.name_cn: 第三指发育不全/小指骨

HP:0009450.name: Broad proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009450.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009450.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009451.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009451.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger is affected.
HP:0009451.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009451.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第三指近节指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009452.name: Curved proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009452.definition: Curved appearance of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009452.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨弯曲畸形。

HP:0009453.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009453.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009453.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009453.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009454.name: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009454.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the proximal phalanx of the third finger.
HP:0009454.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009454.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009455.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009455.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger with another bone.
HP:0009455.name_cn: 近节指骨融合症累及第三指近节指骨
HP:0009455.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009456.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009456.definition: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 3rd (middle) finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009456.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009456.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）近节指骨的三角形形态。三角形或称为三角洲形态的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009457.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009457.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009458.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009458.definition: Absence of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009458.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨发育不全

HP:0009459.name: Short proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger
HP:0009459.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the proximal phalanx of the third finger.
HP:0009459.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨发育不全（先天性大小减少）。

HP:0009461.name: Short 3rd finger
HP:0009461.definition_cn: 第三指（中指）发育不全/短小。

HP:0009462.name: Radial deviation of the 3rd finger
HP:0009462.definition: Displacement of the 3rd finger towards the radial side (i.e., towards the thumb).
HP:0009462.definition_cn: 第三指向桡侧（即向拇指方向）移位。

HP:0009463.name: Ulnar deviation of the 3rd finger
HP:0009463.definition: Displacement of the 3rd finger towards the ulnar side (i.e., towards the ring finger).
HP:0009463.definition_cn: 第三指向尺侧（即向环指方向）移位。

HP:0009464.name: Ulnar deviation of the 2nd finger
HP:0009464.definition: Displacement of the 2nd (index) finger towards the ulnar side.
HP:0009464.definition_cn: 第二指（食指）向尺侧移位。

HP:0009465.name: Ulnar deviation of finger
HP:0009465.definition: Bending or curvature of a finger toward the ulnar side (i.e., away from the thumb). The deviation is at the metacarpal-phalangeal joint, and this finding is distinct from clinodactyly.
HP:0009465.definition_cn: 手指向尺侧（即远离拇指方向）弯曲或成角。该偏斜发生在掌指关节处，此表现与指侧弯（clinodactyly）不同。

HP:0009466.name: Radial deviation of finger
HP:0009466.definition: Bending or curvature of a finger toward the radial side (i.e., towards the thumb). The deviation is at the metacarpal-phalangeal joint, and this finding is distinct from clinodactyly.
HP:0009466.definition_cn: 手指向桡侧（即朝向拇指）弯曲或成角。这种偏斜发生在掌指关节处，此表现与斜指畸形不同。

HP:0009467.name: Radial deviation of the 2nd finger
HP:0009467.definition: Displacement of the 2nd finger towards the radial side.

HP:0009468.name: Deviation of the 2nd finger
HP:0009468.definition: Displacement of the 2nd finger from its normal position.

HP:0009469.name: Contracture of the distal interphalangeal joint of the 3rd finger
HP:0009469.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the distal interphalangeal joint of the 3rd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009469.name_cn: 第三指远侧指间关节挛缩
HP:0009469.definition_cn: 第三指远端指间关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节运动丧失。

HP:0009470.name: Contracture of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 3rd finger
HP:0009470.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 3rd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009470.definition_cn: 第三指掌指关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节运动丧失。

HP:0009471.name: Contracture of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 3rd finger
HP:0009471.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 3rd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009471.name_cn: 第三指近端指间关节挛缩
HP:0009471.definition_cn: 第三指近端指间关节因非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节运动丧失。

HP:0009473.name: Joint contracture of the hand
HP:0009473.definition: Contractures of one ore more joints of the hands meaning chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009473.definition_cn: 手部一个或多个关节的挛缩，意指由于非骨性组织的结构改变导致的关节运动慢性丧失。

HP:0009477.name: Proximal/middle symphalangism of 4th finger
HP:0009477.definition: Fusion of the proximal and middle phalanges of the 4th finger.
HP:0009477.name_cn: 第四指近端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009477.definition_cn: 第四指近节和中节指骨融合。

HP:0009478.name: Symphalangism of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger with the 4th metacarpal
HP:0009478.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 4th finger with the 4th metacarpal.
HP:0009478.name_cn: 第四指近节指骨与第四掌骨近端指节融合症
HP:0009478.definition_cn: 第四指近节指骨与第四掌骨融合。

HP:0009482.name: Proximal/middle symphalangism of 3rd finger
HP:0009482.definition: Fusion of the proximal and middle phalanges of the 3rd finger.
HP:0009482.name_cn: 第三指近端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009482.definition_cn: 第三指近节和中节指骨融合。

HP:0009483.name: Symphalangism of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger with the 3rd metacarpal
HP:0009483.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 3rd finger with the 3rd metacarpal.
HP:0009483.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨与第三掌骨近端指节融合症
HP:0009483.definition_cn: 第三指近节指骨与第三掌骨融合。

HP:0009484.name: Deviation of the hand or of fingers of the hand
HP:0009484.definition: Displacement of the hand or of fingers of the hand from their normal position.
HP:0009484.definition_cn: 手或手指从其正常位置的移位。

HP:0009485.name: Radial deviation of the hand or of fingers of the hand
HP:0009485.name_cn: 手部或手指的桡侧偏斜

HP:0009486.name: Radial deviation of the hand
HP:0009486.definition: An abnormal position of the hand in which the wrist is bent toward the radius (i.e., toward the thumb).
HP:0009486.definition_cn: 手部异常姿势，表现为腕部向桡侧（即向拇指方向）屈曲。

HP:0009487.name: Ulnar deviation of the hand
HP:0009487.definition: Divergence of the longitudinal axis of the hand at the wrist in a posterior (ulnar) direction (i.e., towards the little finger).
HP:0009487.definition_cn: 手腕处手部纵轴向后方（尺侧）偏斜（即朝向小指方向）。

HP:0009488.name: Absent epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009488.definition: Absence of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger.

HP:0009489.name: Bracket epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009489.definition: An abnormality of the second finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009489.definition_cn: 第二指异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009490.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009490.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of a phalanx.
HP:0009490.definition_cn: 第二指骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样表现。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009491.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009491.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009491.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第二指骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009492.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009492.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009492.definition_cn: 第二指骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009493.name: Irregular epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009493.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009493.definition_cn: 第二指骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009494.name: Ivory epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009494.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009494.definition_cn: 第二指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009495.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the 2nd finger
HP:0009495.definition: A secondary ossification center in the second finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009495.definition_cn: 第二指中的次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009496.name: Small epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009496.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009496.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第二指骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009497.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009497.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009497.definition_cn: 第二指骨骺内存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009498.name: Triangular epiphyses of the 2nd finger
HP:0009498.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphyses of the 2nd finger of the hand.
HP:0009498.definition_cn: 第二指骨骺呈三角形外观。

HP:0009499.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009499.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺异常

HP:0009500.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009500.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骺异常

HP:0009501.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009501.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨骺异常

HP:0009502.name: Absent epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009502.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009502.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺缺如
HP:0009502.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨近端骨骺缺失。

HP:0009503.name: Bracket epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009503.definition: An abnormality of the distal phalanx of the second finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009503.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009503.definition_cn: 第二指远端指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009504.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009504.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009504.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009504.definition_cn: 手第二指远节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关实体“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009505.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009505.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009505.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009505.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，第二指远节指骨近端骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009506.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009506.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009506.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009506.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺碎裂样改变。

HP:0009507.name: Irregular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009507.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009507.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009507.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨骺区不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0009508.name: Ivory epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009508.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009508.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨象牙样骨骺
HP:0009508.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009509.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009509.definition: A secondary ossification center in the distal phalanx of the second finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009509.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009509.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009510.name: Small epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009510.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009510.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨小骨骺
HP:0009510.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于第二指远节指骨近端的骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009511.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009511.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009511.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009511.definition_cn: 第二指远端指骨骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009512.name: Triangular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009512.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009512.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨三角骨骺
HP:0009512.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009513.name: Absent epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009513.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨骺缺如

HP:0009514.name: Bracket epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009514.definition: An abnormality of the middle phalanx of the second finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009514.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009514.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009515.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009515.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨锥形骨骺

HP:0009516.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009516.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨骺增大

HP:0009517.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009517.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨骺碎裂

HP:0009518.name: Irregular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009518.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨骺不规则

HP:0009519.name: Ivory epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009519.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨象牙样骨骺

HP:0009520.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009520.definition: A secondary ossification center in the middle phalanx of the second finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009520.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009520.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009521.name: Small epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009521.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨小骨骺

HP:0009522.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009522.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨骺点状钙化

HP:0009523.name: Triangular epiphysis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009523.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨三角形骨骺

HP:0009524.name: Absent epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009524.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骺缺如

HP:0009525.name: Bracket epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009525.definition: An abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the second finger in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009525.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009525.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号样形态，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009526.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009526.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨锥形骨骺

HP:0009527.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009527.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨骺增大

HP:0009528.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009528.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨骺碎裂

HP:0009529.name: Irregular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009529.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨骺不规则

HP:0009530.name: Ivory epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009530.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨象牙样骨骺

HP:0009531.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009531.definition: A secondary ossification center in the proximal phalanx of the second finger that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0009531.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨假骨骺
HP:0009531.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨中的次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0009532.name: Small epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009532.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨小骨骺

HP:0009533.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009533.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨骺点状钙化

HP:0009534.name: Triangular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009534.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨三角骨骺

HP:0009536.name: Short 2nd finger
HP:0009536.definition: Hypoplasia of the second finger, also known as the index finger.
HP:0009536.definition_cn: 第二指发育不全，亦称示指发育不全。

HP:0009537.name: Flexion contracture of the 2nd finger
HP:0009537.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in the 2nd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. The term camptodactyly of the 2nd finger is used if the distal and/or proximal interphalangeal joints are affected.
HP:0009537.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织结构改变导致的第二指关节运动慢性丧失。若累及远端和/或近端指间关节，则使用术语“第二指屈曲畸形”。

HP:0009538.name: Contracture of the distal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd finger
HP:0009538.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the distal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009538.name_cn: 第二指远侧指间关节挛缩
HP:0009538.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织结构改变导致的第二指远侧指间关节慢性运动功能丧失。

HP:0009539.name: Contracture of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 2nd finger
HP:0009539.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the 2nd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009539.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织结构改变导致的第二掌指关节慢性运动功能障碍。

HP:0009540.name: Contracture of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd finger
HP:0009540.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0009540.name_cn: 第二指近端指间关节挛缩
HP:0009540.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织结构改变导致的第二指近端指间关节慢性运动功能丧失。

HP:0009541.name: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 2nd finger
HP:0009541.definition: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 2nd (index) finger.

HP:0009542.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger

HP:0009543.name: Abnormality of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger

HP:0009544.name: Abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger

HP:0009545.name: Symphalangism of the 2nd finger
HP:0009545.name_cn: 第二指指间关节融合症

HP:0009546.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 2nd finger
HP:0009546.definition: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 2nd finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009546.definition_cn: 第二指三角形指骨。三角形或称为三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺支架术后的典型结果。

HP:0009548.name: Bullet-shaped phalanges of the 2nd finger
HP:0009548.definition: A second finger with short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009548.definition_cn: 第二指具有短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009550.name: Osteolytic defects of the phalanges of the 2nd finger
HP:0009550.name_cn: 第二指指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0009551.name: Patchy sclerosis of 2nd finger phalanx
HP:0009551.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009551.definition_cn: 第二指一个或多个指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009552.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the 2nd finger
HP:0009552.name_cn: 第二指指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009553.name: Abnormality of the hairline
HP:0009553.definition: The hairline refers to the outline of hair of the head. An abnormality of the hairline can refer to an unusually low or high border between areas of the scalp with and without hair or to abnormal projections of scalp hair.
HP:0009553.definition_cn: 发际线是指头部毛发的轮廓。发际线异常可指有毛区域与无毛区域之间的边界异常低或高，或指头皮毛发异常突出。

HP:0009554.name: Preauricular hair displacement
HP:0009554.definition: An tongue-like extension of hair towards the cheeks, in which hair growth extends in front of the ear to the lateral cheekbones.
HP:0009554.definition_cn: 一种向颊部延伸的舌状毛发分布，其中毛发生长从耳前延伸至侧颧骨。

HP:0009557.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009557.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009558.name: Broad distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009558.definition: Increased width of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009558.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009559.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009559.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger is affected.
HP:0009559.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009559.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第二指远端指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009560.name: Curved distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009560.definition: Curved appearance of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009560.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨弯曲外观。

HP:0009561.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009561.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009561.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009561.definition_cn: 第二指远端指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009562.name: Patchy sclerosis of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009562.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the distal phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0009562.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009562.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009563.name: Distal/middle symphalangism of 2nd finger
HP:0009563.definition: Fusion of the terminal/distal and middle phalanges of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009563.name_cn: 第二指远端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009563.definition_cn: 第二指末节指骨与中节指骨融合。

HP:0009564.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009564.definition: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the 2nd finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009564.name_cn: 第二指远端指骨的三角形形态
HP:0009564.definition_cn: 第二指远端指骨呈三角形。三角形或称为三角洲形的指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009565.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009565.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨发育不全

HP:0009566.name: Short distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009566.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the distal phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0009566.definition_cn: 第二指远节指骨发育不全（先天性体积减小）。

HP:0009568.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009568.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009569.name: Broad middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009569.definition: Increased width of the middle phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0009569.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009570.name: Bullet-shaped middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009570.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger is affected.
HP:0009570.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009570.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第二指中指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009571.name: Curved middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009571.definition: Curved appearance of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009571.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨弯曲畸形。

HP:0009572.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009572.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009572.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009572.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009573.name: Patchy sclerosis of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009573.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the middle phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0009573.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009573.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009574.name: Symphalangism of middle phalanx of 2nd finger
HP:0009574.definition: Fusion of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger with another bone.
HP:0009574.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨并指畸形
HP:0009574.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009575.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009575.definition: Triangular shaped middle phalanx of the 2nd finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009575.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009575.definition_cn: 第二指中节指骨呈三角形。三角形或所谓的三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009576.name: Absent middle phalanx of 2nd finger
HP:0009576.definition: Absence of the middle phalanx of the index (2nd) finger.
HP:0009576.definition_cn: 示指（第二指）中节指骨缺失。

HP:0009577.name: Short middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009577.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the middle phalanx of the second finger, also known as the index finger.
HP:0009577.definition_cn: 第二指（食指）中节指骨发育不全（先天性体积减小）。

HP:0009579.name: Proximal/middle symphalangism of the 2nd finger
HP:0009579.definition: Fusion of the proximal and middle phalanges of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009579.name_cn: 第二指近端/中节指骨融合症
HP:0009579.definition_cn: 第二指近节和中节指骨的融合。

HP:0009580.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009580.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009581.name: Broad proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009581.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009581.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009582.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009582.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger is affected.
HP:0009582.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009582.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述第二指近节指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009583.name: Curved proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009583.definition: Curved appearance of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009583.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨弯曲外观。

HP:0009584.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009584.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009584.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009584.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009585.name: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009585.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the proximal phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0009585.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009585.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增高。

HP:0009586.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009586.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger with another bone.
HP:0009586.name_cn: 近节指骨融合症累及第二指近节指骨
HP:0009586.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009587.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009587.definition: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009587.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009587.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨呈三角形。三角形或称为三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009588.name: Vestibular schwannoma
HP:0009588.definition: A vestibular schwannoma (also known as acoustic neuroma, acoustic neurinoma, or acoustic neurilemoma) is a benign, usually slow-growing tumor that develops from the VIIIth cranial nerve supplying the inner ear.
HP:0009588.definition_cn: 前庭神经鞘瘤（也称为听神经瘤、听神经纤维瘤或听神经鞘膜瘤）是一种良性、通常生长缓慢的肿瘤，起源于供应内耳的第八对脑神经。

HP:0009589.name: Bilateral vestibular schwannoma
HP:0009589.definition_cn: 双侧前庭神经鞘瘤（听神经瘤）。

HP:0009590.name: Unilateral vestibular schwannoma
HP:0009590.definition_cn: 单侧前庭神经鞘瘤（听神经瘤）。

HP:0009591.name: Abnorma vestibulocochlear nerve morphology
HP:0009591.definition: Any structural anomaly of the vestibulocochlear nerve. The vestibulocochlear nerve consists of the vestibular and cochlear nerves, also known as cranial nerve eight (CN VIII). Each nerve has distinct nuclei within the brainstem. The vestibular nerve is primarily responsible for maintaining body balance and eye movements, while the cochlear nerve is responsible for hearing.
HP:0009591.name_cn: 前庭耳蜗神经形态异常
HP:0009591.definition_cn: 前庭蜗神经的任何结构异常。前庭蜗神经由前庭神经和蜗神经组成，也称为第八对脑神经（CN VIII）。每根神经在脑干内都有不同的神经核。前庭神经主要负责维持身体平衡和眼球运动，而蜗神经则负责听觉功能。

HP:0009592.name: Astrocytoma
HP:0009592.definition: Astrocytoma is a neoplasm of the central nervous system derived from astrocytes. Astrocytes are a type of glial cell, and thus astrocytoma is a subtype of glioma.
HP:0009592.definition_cn: 星形细胞瘤是一种源自星形胶质细胞的中枢神经系统肿瘤。星形胶质细胞是胶质细胞的一种，因此星形细胞瘤是胶质瘤的一个亚型。

HP:0009593.name: Peripheral schwannoma
HP:0009593.definition: The presence of a peripheral schwannoma.

HP:0009594.name: Retinal hamartoma
HP:0009594.definition: A hamartoma (a benign, focal malformation consisting of a disorganized mixture of cells and tissues) of the retina.
HP:0009594.definition_cn: 视网膜错构瘤（一种由细胞和组织无序混合构成的良性局灶性畸形）。
