HP:0009596.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009596.definition: Absence of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger.
HP:0009596.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨发育不全

HP:0009597.name: Short proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009597.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the proximal phalanx of the second finger.
HP:0009597.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨发育不全（先天性尺寸减小）。

HP:0009598.name: Symphalangism of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger with the 2nd metacarpal
HP:0009598.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger with the 2nd metacarpal.
HP:0009598.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨与第二掌骨近端指节融合症
HP:0009598.definition_cn: 第二指近节指骨与第二掌骨融合。

HP:0009599.name: Abnormality of thumb epiphysis
HP:0009599.definition: Abnormality of one or all of the epiphyses of the proximal, and distal phalanges of the thumb and/or the 1st metacarpal.
HP:0009599.definition_cn: 拇指近节和/或远节指骨以及/或第一掌骨的一个或多个骨骺异常。

HP:0009600.name: Thumb contracture
HP:0009600.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the thumb joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin. The term camptodactyly is used if the distal and/or proximal interphalangeal joints are affected.
HP:0009600.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊和/或皮肤）的结构性改变导致的拇指关节被动活动范围受限（屈曲、伸展或其他运动受限）。若远端和/或近端指间关节受累，则使用术语“屈曲指畸形”（camptodactyly）。

HP:0009601.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thumb
HP:0009601.name_cn: 拇指发育不全/拇指发育不良
HP:0009601.definition_cn: 拇指发育不良/短小或缺如。

HP:0009602.name: Abnormality of thumb phalanx
HP:0009602.definition: A structural anomaly of one or more phalanges of the thumb.
HP:0009602.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个指骨的结构异常。

HP:0009603.name: Deviation of the thumb
HP:0009603.definition: Displacement of the thumb from its normal position.

HP:0009606.name: Complete duplication of distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009606.definition: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the thumb. On x-ray two separate bones appear side to side.
HP:0009606.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨完全重复畸形
HP:0009606.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨完全重复。X线显示两个独立的骨骼并排排列。

HP:0009608.name: Complete duplication of proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009608.definition: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. On x-ray two separate bones appear side to side. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009608.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨完全重复畸形
HP:0009608.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨完全重复。X线片上可见两块独立的骨骼并排排列。与第2-5指的近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009609.name: Duplication of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0009609.definition: Partail or complete duplication of the first metacarpal bone.
HP:0009609.definition_cn: 第一掌骨部分或完全重复畸形。

HP:0009611.name: Bifid distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009611.definition: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx) to a partially fused appearance of the two bones.
HP:0009611.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨部分重复。根据严重程度的不同，X线表现可从指骨切迹（重复骨几乎完全与指骨融合）到两骨部分融合的外观。

HP:0009612.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009612.definition: Complete or partial duplication of the distal phalanx of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx), a partially fused appearance of the two bones, or two separate bones appearing side to side.
HP:0009612.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨重复畸形
HP:0009612.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨的完全或部分重复。根据严重程度的不同，X线表现可从切迹状指骨（重复的骨骼几乎完全与指骨融合）、部分融合的两块骨骼，或两块并排的独立骨骼。

HP:0009613.name: Duplication of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009613.definition: Complete or partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx), a partially fused appearance of the two bones, or two separate bones appearing side to side. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009613.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨重复畸形
HP:0009613.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨的完全或部分重复。根据严重程度的不同，X线表现可从切迹状指骨（重复的骨骼几乎完全与指骨融合）、部分融合的两块骨骼，或两块并排的独立骨骼。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009614.name: Bifid proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009614.definition: This term applies if the proximal phalanx of the thumb is partially duplicated. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx) to a partially fused appearance of the two bones. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009614.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨分叉畸形
HP:0009614.definition_cn: 该术语适用于拇指近节指骨部分重复的情况。根据严重程度的不同，X线表现可从切迹状指骨（重复的骨骼几乎完全与指骨融合）到两骨部分融合的外观不等。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009615.name: Complete duplication of the first metacarpal
HP:0009615.definition: Complete duplication of the first metacarpal bone.
HP:0009615.definition_cn: 第一掌骨完全重复畸形。

HP:0009616.name: Bifid first metacarpal
HP:0009616.definition: Partial duplication of the first metacarpal bone.

HP:0009617.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009617.definition: Any anomaly of the distal phalanx of thumb.

HP:0009618.name: Abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009618.definition: An anomaly of the shape or form of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009618.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨形态或形状异常。

HP:0009620.name: obsolete Radial deviation of the thumb

HP:0009621.name: obsolete Ulnar deviation of the thumb

HP:0009622.name: Distally placed thumb
HP:0009622.definition: Insertion of thumb at a more distal location than normal.
HP:0009622.definition_cn: 拇指插入位置较正常位置更远端。

HP:0009624.name: Carpometacarpal thumb joint contracture
HP:0009624.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the carpometacarpal joint of the thumb due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. This joint is formed by the first metacarpal and the trapezial bone and is also called Articulatio carpometacarpalis pollicis, carpometacarpal articulation of thumb, carpometacarpal joint of thumb or first carpometacarpal articulation. Seldom referred to as thumb saddle joint.
HP:0009624.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织的结构改变导致的拇指腕掌关节慢性运动功能丧失。该关节由第一掌骨和大多角骨构成，也称为拇指腕掌关节（Articulatio carpometacarpalis pollicis）、拇指腕掌关节（carpometacarpal articulation of thumb）、拇指腕掌关节（carpometacarpal joint of thumb）或第一腕掌关节（first carpometacarpal articulation）。较少被称为拇指鞍状关节（thumb saddle joint）。

HP:0009625.name: Metacarpophalangeal thumb joint contracture
HP:0009625.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the metacarpophalangeal joint of the thumb due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. This joint is also called Articulatio metacarpophalangealis pollicis.
HP:0009625.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织的结构改变导致的拇指掌指关节（Articulatio metacarpophalangealis pollicis）慢性运动功能丧失。

HP:0009626.name: Interphalangeal thumb joint contracture
HP:0009626.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the interphalangeal joint of the thumb due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. This joint is also called Articulatio interphalangealis pollicis.
HP:0009626.definition_cn: 拇指指间关节非骨性组织结构改变导致的慢性关节运动丧失。该关节亦称为拇指指间关节（Articulatio interphalangealis pollicis）。

HP:0009629.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009629.definition: This term applies if the proximal phalanx of the thumb is either small/hypoplastic or absent. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009629.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009629.definition_cn: 该术语适用于拇指近节指骨发育不全或缺失的情况。与第2至第5指的近节指骨不同，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009630.name: Broad proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009630.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009630.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨宽度增加。与第2-5指的近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009631.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009631.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the proximal phalanx of the thumb is affected.
HP:0009631.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨的子弹形结构
HP:0009631.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述拇指近节指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009632.name: Curved proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009632.definition: A deviation from the normal straight shape of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009632.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0009633.name: Osteolytic defect of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009633.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009633.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009633.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009634.name: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009634.definition: An uneven increase in bone density of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009634.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009634.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨密度不均匀性增高。

HP:0009635.name: Synostosis of thumb phalanx
HP:0009635.definition: Fusion of a phalanx of the thumb with another bone.
HP:0009635.definition_cn: 拇指指骨与另一骨融合。

HP:0009636.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009636.definition: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009636.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨的三角形结构
HP:0009636.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨的三角形结构。

HP:0009637.name: Absent proximal phalanx of thumb
HP:0009637.definition: Absence of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009637.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨缺失。与第2-5指的近节指骨不同，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009638.name: Short proximal phalanx of thumb
HP:0009638.definition: Hypoplastic (short) proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009638.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨发育不全（短小）。与第2-5指的近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009640.name: Synostosis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb with the 1st metacarpal
HP:0009640.definition: Fusion of the proximal phalanx of the thumb with the 1st metacarpal.
HP:0009640.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨与第一掌骨骨性连接
HP:0009640.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨与第一掌骨融合。

HP:0009641.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009641.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009642.name: Broad distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009642.definition: Increased width of the distal phalanx of thumb.
HP:0009642.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009643.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009643.definition: Bullet-shaped phalanx refers to a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction. This term is used if the distal phalanx of the thumb is affected.
HP:0009643.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨呈子弹形
HP:0009643.definition_cn: 子弹形指骨（Bullet-shaped phalanx）是指远端逐渐变细的短而宽的指骨。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。该术语用于描述拇指远端指骨受累的情况。

HP:0009644.name: Curved distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009644.definition: A deviation from the normal straight shape of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009644.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0009645.name: Osteolytic defect of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009645.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009645.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨溶骨性缺损
HP:0009645.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009646.name: Patchy sclerosis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009646.definition: An uneven increase in bone density of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009646.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009646.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨密度不均匀性增高。

HP:0009648.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009648.definition: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the thumb. A triangular or so called delta shaped phalanx is a typical result after a bracket epiphysis of the affected phalanx.
HP:0009648.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨呈三角形
HP:0009648.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨呈三角形。三角形或所谓的三角洲形指骨是受累指骨骨骺板损伤后的典型结果。

HP:0009649.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009649.definition: Absence of the distal/terminal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009649.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨发育不全
HP:0009649.definition_cn: 拇指远节/末节指骨缺失。

HP:0009650.name: Short distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009650.definition: Hypoplastic (short) distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009650.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨发育不全（短小）。

HP:0009652.name: Bullet-shaped thumb phalanx
HP:0009652.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more phalanges of the thumb, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009652.definition_cn: 拇指一或多个指骨的形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009653.name: Curved thumb phalanx
HP:0009653.definition: A deviation from the normal straight shape of a thumb phalanx.
HP:0009653.definition_cn: 拇指指骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0009654.name: Osteolytic defect of thumb phalanx
HP:0009654.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of one or more phalanges of the thumb.
HP:0009654.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009655.name: Patchy sclerosis of thumb phalanx
HP:0009655.definition: An uneven increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the thumb.
HP:0009655.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个指骨骨密度不均匀增加。

HP:0009656.name: Symphalangism of the thumb
HP:0009656.definition: Congenital fusion (ankylosis) of the interphalangeal joint of the thumb.
HP:0009656.definition_cn: 拇指指间关节先天性融合（强直）。

HP:0009657.name: Triangular shaped thumb phalanx
HP:0009657.definition: Abnormal shape of one or more phalanges of the thumb such that affected phalanges resemble a triangle.
HP:0009657.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个指骨的形态异常，导致受累指骨呈三角形。

HP:0009658.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the thumb
HP:0009658.name_cn: 拇指指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009659.name: Partial absence of thumb
HP:0009659.definition: The absence of a phalangeal segment of a thumb.

HP:0009660.name: Short phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009660.definition_cn: 拇指指骨发育不全（短指骨）。

HP:0009662.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009662.definition: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb. This epiphysis is located on the proximal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009662.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺异常
HP:0009662.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺异常。该骨骺位于指骨的近端。

HP:0009663.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009663.definition: This term applies if the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb, which is located at the proximal end of the phalanx, does not appear in concordance with gender and age dependant norms as seen on x-rays. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009663.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺异常
HP:0009663.definition_cn: 此术语适用于拇指近节指骨的骨骺，位于指骨近端，在X光片上未显现出与性别和年龄相关的正常表现。与第2至第5指的近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他指骨的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他指骨的近节指骨。

HP:0009664.name: Absent epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009664.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009664.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨近端骨骺缺失。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009665.name: Bracket epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009665.definition: An abnormality of the proximal phalanx of the thumb in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009665.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009665.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号样形态，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009666.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009666.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009666.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009666.definition_cn: 手部拇指近节指骨的骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样外观。该骨骺位于指骨的近端，通常近乎平坦。相关实体“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。与第2-5指的近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009667.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009667.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the thumb with respect to age-dependent norms. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009667.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009667.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于拇指近节指骨近端的骨骺异常增大。与第2-5指的近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009668.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009668.definition: Epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb having multiple bony fragments.
HP:0009668.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009668.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺多发骨碎片。

HP:0009669.name: Irregular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009669.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009669.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009669.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骺区不规则放射学密度影。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009670.name: Ivory epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009670.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009670.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨象牙样骨骺
HP:0009670.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骺硬化，导致X线影像中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙色外观）。

HP:0009671.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009671.definition: A pseudoepiphysis (which is a secondary ossification center distinct from the normal epiphysis) of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009671.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨的假骨骺（即与正常骨骺不同的次级骨化中心）。

HP:0009672.name: Small epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009672.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the proximal phalanx of the thumb with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009672.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于拇指近节指骨近端的骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009673.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009673.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009673.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009673.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骺区存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009674.name: Triangular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009674.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the thumb of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009674.name_cn: 拇指近节指骨三角骨骺
HP:0009674.definition_cn: 拇指近节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨的近端，通常近乎平坦。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他指的近节指骨。

HP:0009675.name: Absent epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009675.definition: Absence of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009675.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺缺失
HP:0009675.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨近端骨骺缺失。

HP:0009676.name: Bracket epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009676.definition: An abnormality of the distal phalanx of the thumb in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009676.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0009676.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009677.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009677.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of the phalanx.
HP:0009677.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨锥形骨骺
HP:0009677.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。相关实体“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009678.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009678.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the thumb with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009678.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺增大
HP:0009678.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于拇指远节指骨近端的骨骺异常增大。

HP:0009679.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009679.definition: Epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb having multiple bony fragments.
HP:0009679.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺碎裂
HP:0009679.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺多发骨碎片。

HP:0009680.name: Irregular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009680.definition: Uneven radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009680.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺不规则
HP:0009680.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺放射学密度不均匀。

HP:0009681.name: Ivory epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009681.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009681.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨象牙骨骺
HP:0009681.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009682.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009682.definition: A pseudoepiphysis (which is a secondary ossification center distinct from the normal epiphysis) of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009682.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨的假骨骺（即与正常骨骺不同的次级骨化中心）。

HP:0009683.name: Small epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009683.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis located at the proximal end of the distal phalanx of the thumb with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009683.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，位于拇指远节指骨近端的骨骺异常缩小。

HP:0009684.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009684.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0009684.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0009684.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺区出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0009685.name: Triangular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb
HP:0009685.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the thumb of the hand. This epiphysis is located at the proximal end of the phalanx and is normally nearly flat.
HP:0009685.name_cn: 拇指远节指骨三角骨骺
HP:0009685.definition_cn: 拇指远节指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。该骨骺位于指骨近端，通常近乎平坦。

HP:0009686.name: Absent epiphyses of the thumb
HP:0009686.definition: Absence of one or more epiphyses of the thumb.
HP:0009686.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个骨骺缺失。

HP:0009687.name: Bracket epiphyses of the thumb
HP:0009687.definition: An abnormality of the thumb in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0009687.definition_cn: 拇指畸形，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0009688.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the thumb
HP:0009688.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the thumb, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of a phalanx.
HP:0009688.definition_cn: 拇指骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0009689.name: Enlarged thumb epiphysis
HP:0009689.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the thumb with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009689.definition_cn: 拇指骨骺相对于年龄相关标准的异常增大。

HP:0009690.name: Fragmentation of thumb epiphysis
HP:0009690.definition: Epiphysis of the thumb having multiple bony fragments.

HP:0009691.name: Irregular thumb epiphysis
HP:0009691.definition: Uneven radiographic opacity of the one or more epiphyses of the thumb.
HP:0009691.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个骨骺的放射学密度不均匀。

HP:0009692.name: Ivory epiphysis of the thumb
HP:0009692.definition: Sclerosis of one or more of the epiphyses of the thumb, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0009692.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个骨骺硬化，导致X线检查中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0009693.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the thumb
HP:0009693.definition: A pseudoepiphysis (which is a secondary ossification center distinct from the normal epiphysis) of one or more phalanges of the thumb.
HP:0009693.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个指骨的假骨骺（即与正常骨骺不同的次级骨化中心）。

HP:0009694.name: Small thumb epiphysis
HP:0009694.definition: Abnormally small size of one or more of the epiphyses of the thumb with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0009694.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个骨骺相对于年龄相关标准的异常小尺寸。

HP:0009695.name: Stippling of thumb epiphysis
HP:0009695.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more of the epiphyses of the thumb.
HP:0009695.definition_cn: 拇指一个或多个骨骺中存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。

HP:0009697.name: Contracture of the distal interphalangeal joint of the fingers
HP:0009697.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in one or more distal interphalangeal joints of the fingers.
HP:0009697.name_cn: 手指远侧指间关节挛缩
HP:0009697.definition_cn: 手指一个或多个远端指间关节的慢性运动丧失。

HP:0009699.name: Osteolytic defects of the hand bones

HP:0009700.name: Finger symphalangism
HP:0009700.definition: An abnormal union between bones or parts of bones of the fingers. The synonymous term \
HP:0009700.definition_cn: 指骨或指骨部分之间的异常联合。同义词为“并指畸形”（Syndactyly）。

HP:0009701.name: Metacarpal synostosis
HP:0009701.definition: Fusion involving two or more metacarpal bones (A synostosis of the first metacarpal and the proximal phalanx of the thumb can also be observed, note that the first metacarpal bone corresponds to a proximal phalanx).
HP:0009701.definition_cn: 涉及两个或更多掌骨的融合（也可观察到第一掌骨与拇指近节指骨的骨性连接，需注意第一掌骨对应于近节指骨）。

HP:0009702.name: Carpal synostosis
HP:0009702.definition: Synostosis (bony fusion) involving one or more bones of the carpus (scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate, pisiform).
HP:0009702.definition_cn: 腕骨（舟骨、月骨、三角骨、大多角骨、小多角骨、头状骨、钩骨、豌豆骨）中一块或多块骨骼的骨性融合（骨性连接）。

HP:0009703.name: Synostosis involving the 1st metacarpal
HP:0009703.definition: Fusion of the 1st metacarpal with another bone. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2 to 5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009703.definition_cn: 第一掌骨与另一骨融合。与第2至第5指近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上等同于其他指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此等同于其他指的近节指骨。

HP:0009704.name: Chronic CSF lymphocytosis
HP:0009704.definition: Chronic cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) lymphocytosis is defined as the finding, in at least two serial CSF examinations, of more than 5 cells per cubic millimeter.
HP:0009704.name_cn: 慢性脑脊液淋巴细胞增多症
HP:0009704.definition_cn: 慢性脑脊液淋巴细胞增多症定义为在至少两次连续的脑脊液检查中，每立方毫米细胞数超过5个。

HP:0009706.name: Synostosis involving the 3rd metacarpal
HP:0009706.name_cn: 涉及第三掌骨的骨性连接

HP:0009709.name: Increased CSF interferon alpha
HP:0009709.definition: Increased concentration of interferon alpha in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0009709.name_cn: 脑脊液α干扰素水平升高
HP:0009709.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中α干扰素浓度升高。

HP:0009710.name: Chilblains
HP:0009710.definition: Chilblains, also called perniosis, are an inflammatory skin condition related to an abnormal vascular response to the cold. We are unaware of a reliable estimate of incidence. It typically presents as tender, pruritic red or bluish lesions located symmetrically on the dorsal aspect of the fingers, toes, ears and nose. Less commonly, reports describe involvement of the thighs and buttocks. The lesions present hours after exposure to cold and usually resolve spontaneously in one to three weeks.
HP:0009710.definition_cn: 冻疮，亦称寒冷性皮炎，是一种与寒冷引起的异常血管反应相关的炎症性皮肤病。目前尚无可靠的发病率估计。该病通常表现为位于手指、足趾、耳部和鼻部背侧的对称性触痛、瘙痒性红斑或青紫色皮损。较少见的情况下，有报道描述大腿和臀部受累。皮损在暴露于寒冷后数小时出现，通常在一至三周内自行消退。

HP:0009711.name: Retinal capillary hemangioma
HP:0009711.definition: A benign vascular tumor of the retina without any neoplastic characteristics.
HP:0009711.definition_cn: 视网膜良性血管瘤，无任何肿瘤特征。

HP:0009713.name: Spinal hemangioblastoma
HP:0009713.definition: A hemangioblastoma of the spinal cord.

HP:0009715.name: Papillary cystadenoma of the epididymis
HP:0009715.definition: A cystadenoma, an epithelial tumor, that originates within the head of the epididymis.
HP:0009715.definition_cn: 一种起源于附睾头部的囊腺瘤，属于上皮性肿瘤。

HP:0009716.name: Subependymal nodules
HP:0009716.definition: Small nodular masses which originate in the subependymal region of the lateral ventricles and protrude into the ventricular cavity. They may represent subependymal hamartomas of tuberous sclerosis.
HP:0009716.definition_cn: 起源于侧脑室室管膜下区并突入脑室腔的小结节状肿块，可能为结节性硬化症的室管膜下错构瘤。

HP:0009717.name: Cortical tubers
HP:0009717.definition: Cortical tubers in the brain are hamartomatous lesions typically located at the gray-white matter interface, commonly in the frontal and parietal lobes. Cortical tubers are composed of abnormal glial and neural cells, and the size, number, and location vary among patients.
HP:0009717.definition_cn: 大脑中的皮质结节是错构瘤性病变，通常位于灰质-白质交界处，常见于额叶和顶叶。皮质结节由异常的胶质细胞和神经细胞组成，其大小、数量和位置在患者之间存在差异。

HP:0009718.name: Subependymal giant-cell astrocytoma
HP:0009718.definition: A demarcated, largely intraventricular tumor in the region of the foramen of Monro composed of spindle to large plump or ganglion-like cells with eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and somewhat pleomorphic nuclei with occasional prominent nucleoli. These tumors are almost always associated with tuberous sclerosis.
HP:0009718.name_cn: 室管膜下巨细胞星形细胞瘤
HP:0009718.definition_cn: 位于孟氏孔区域的一个界限清楚的、主要位于脑室内的肿瘤，由梭形至大型丰满或神经节样细胞组成，细胞质呈嗜酸性至双嗜性，核具有一定程度的多形性，偶见明显的核仁。这些肿瘤几乎总是与结节性硬化症相关。

HP:0009720.name: Adenoma sebaceum
HP:0009720.definition: The presence of a sebaceous adenoma with origin in the sebum secreting cells of the skin.
HP:0009720.definition_cn: 源自皮肤皮脂分泌细胞的皮脂腺瘤的存在。

HP:0009721.name: Shagreen patch
HP:0009721.definition: A plaque representing a connective-tissue nevus. Connective tissue naevi are uncommon skin lesions that occur when the deeper layers of the skin do not develop correctly or the components of these layers occur in the wrong proportion. Shagreen patches are oval-shaped and nevoid, skin-colored or occasionally pigmented, smooth or crinkled. The word shagreen refers to a type of roughened untanned leather.
HP:0009721.definition_cn: 一块代表结缔组织痣的斑块。结缔组织痣是一种罕见的皮肤病变，发生于皮肤深层发育异常或这些层中的成分比例失调时。鲨革斑呈椭圆形，痣样，肤色或偶有色素沉着，表面光滑或皱褶。术语“鲨革”指的是一种未经鞣制的粗糙皮革。

HP:0009722.name: Dental enamel pits
HP:0009722.definition: The presence of small depressions in the dental enamel.
HP:0009722.definition_cn: 牙釉质表面存在微小凹陷。

HP:0009723.name: Abnormality of the subungual region
HP:0009723.definition: A lesion located beneath a fingernail or toenail.

HP:0009724.name: Subungual fibromas
HP:0009724.definition: The presence of fibromata beneath finger or toenails.

HP:0009725.name: Bladder neoplasm
HP:0009725.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the urinary bladder.

HP:0009726.name: Renal neoplasm
HP:0009726.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the kidney.

HP:0009727.name: Achromatic retinal patches
HP:0009727.definition: Areas of the retina lacking pigmentation. Punched out areas of chorioretinal hypopigmentation less than 1 disk diameter in size and tending to be located in the midperiphery of the retina.
HP:0009727.definition_cn: 视网膜色素脱失区域。脉络膜视网膜色素减退的凿除样区域，直径小于1个视盘直径，倾向于位于视网膜中周部。

HP:0009728.name: Neoplasm of striated muscle
HP:0009728.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm (tumor) originating in striated muscle, either skeletal muscle or cardiac muscle.
HP:0009728.definition_cn: 横纹肌肉瘤（Rhabdomyosarcoma），一种起源于横纹肌（骨骼肌或心肌）的良性或恶性肿瘤。

HP:0009729.name: Cardiac rhabdomyoma
HP:0009729.definition: A benign tumor of cardiac striated muscle.

HP:0009730.name: Rhabdomyoma
HP:0009730.definition: A benign tumor of striated muscle.

HP:0009731.name: Cerebral hamartoma
HP:0009731.definition: The presence of a hamartoma of the cerebrum.

HP:0009732.name: Plexiform neurofibroma
HP:0009732.definition: A neurofibroma in which Schwann cells proliferate inside the nerve sheath, producing an irregularly thickened, distorted, tortuous structure.
HP:0009732.definition_cn: 一种神经纤维瘤，其中施万细胞在神经鞘内增殖，形成不规则增厚、扭曲、迂曲的结构。

HP:0009733.name: Glioma
HP:0009733.definition: The presence of a glioma, which is a neoplasm of the central nervous system originating from a glial cell (astrocytes or oligodendrocytes).
HP:0009733.definition_cn: 存在胶质瘤，这是一种源自中枢神经系统胶质细胞（星形胶质细胞或少突胶质细胞）的肿瘤。

HP:0009734.name: Optic nerve glioma
HP:0009734.definition: A glioma originating in the optic nerve or optic chiasm.
HP:0009734.definition_cn: 起源于视神经或视交叉的胶质瘤。

HP:0009735.name: Spinal neurofibroma
HP:0009735.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the spine.
HP:0009735.definition_cn: 位于脊柱的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘瘤）。

HP:0009737.name: Lisch nodules
HP:0009737.definition: The presence of pigmented, oval and dome-shaped raised hamartomatous nevi of the iris..
HP:0009737.definition_cn: 虹膜色素性、椭圆形、穹顶状隆起的错构瘤性痣。

HP:0009741.name: Nephrosclerosis
HP:0009741.definition: Nephrosclerosis refers to thickening or scarring (\
HP:0009741.definition_cn: 肾硬化症（Nephrosclerosis）是指肾脏血管壁增厚或瘢痕形成（\

HP:0009742.name: Stiff shoulders
HP:0009742.definition: Shoulder joint stiffness is a perceived sensation of tightness in shoulders when attempting to move them after a period of inactivity.
HP:0009742.definition_cn: 肩关节僵硬是指在长时间不活动后尝试移动肩部时，感受到的肩部紧绷感。

HP:0009744.name: Abnormal spinal dura mater morphology
HP:0009744.definition: An abnormality of the spinal dura mater, which is the outermost of the three layers of the meninges surrounding the spinal cord.
HP:0009744.definition_cn: 脊髓硬脊膜异常，即围绕脊髓的三层脑膜中最外层的一层发生异常。

HP:0009745.name: Spinal arachnoid cyst
HP:0009745.definition: Presence of arachnoid cysts of the spinal canal extradurally in the epidural space.
HP:0009745.definition_cn: 椎管内硬膜外间隙存在蛛网膜囊肿。

HP:0009746.name: Thick nasal septum
HP:0009746.definition: Abnormally increased thickness of the nasal septum.

HP:0009747.name: Lumbosacral hirsutism
HP:0009747.definition: Abnormally increased hair growth in the lumbosacral region.

HP:0009748.name: Large earlobe
HP:0009748.definition: Increased volume of the earlobe, that is, abnormally prominent ear lobules.
HP:0009748.definition_cn: 耳垂体积增大，即耳垂异常突出。

HP:0009751.name: Aplasia of the pectoralis major muscle
HP:0009751.definition: Absence of the pectoralis major muscle.

HP:0009752.name: Cleft in skull base
HP:0009752.definition: A bony defect in the skull base.

HP:0009754.name: Fibrous syngnathia
HP:0009754.definition: Complete or nearly complete soft tissue fusion of the alveolar ridges.
HP:0009754.name_cn: 纤维性颞下颌关节强直
HP:0009754.definition_cn: 牙槽嵴软组织完全或接近完全融合。

HP:0009755.name: Ankyloblepharon
HP:0009755.definition: Partial fusion of the upper and lower eyelid margins by single or multiple bands of tissue.
HP:0009755.definition_cn: 上、下睑缘部分融合，由单条或多条组织带连接。

HP:0009756.name: Popliteal pterygium
HP:0009756.definition: A pterygium (or pterygia) occurring in the popliteal region (the back of the knee).
HP:0009756.definition_cn: 发生在腘窝区域（膝关节后方）的翼状胬肉（或翼状胬肉）。

HP:0009757.name: Intercrural pterygium
HP:0009757.definition: A pterygium (or pterygia) in the intercrural (groin) region.

HP:0009758.name: Pyramidal skinfold extending from the base to the top of the nails
HP:0009758.definition: Pyramidal skinfold extending from the base to the top of the nails is a rare and distinctive anomaly seen in popliteal pterygia syndrome.
HP:0009758.name_cn: 从甲床基部延伸至甲顶的锥形皮肤皱褶
HP:0009758.definition_cn: 从甲床基部延伸至甲顶的锥形皮肤皱褶是腘窝翼状胬肉综合征中一种罕见且独特的异常表现。

HP:0009760.name: Antecubital pterygium
HP:0009760.definition: Pterygium affecting the elbow. This is a cutaneous web that can lead to severe flexion contracture of the elbow joint. Antecubital pterygium can be unilateral, bilateral, symmetric, or asysmmetric.
HP:0009760.definition_cn: 肘部翼状胬肉。这是一种皮肤蹼状畸形，可导致肘关节严重的屈曲挛缩。肘前翼状胬肉可为单侧、双侧、对称性或非对称性。

HP:0009761.name: Anterior clefting of vertebral bodies
HP:0009761.definition: Anterior schisis (cleft or cleavage) of vertebral bodies.

HP:0009762.name: Facial wrinkling
HP:0009762.definition: Excessive wrinkling of the skin of the face.

HP:0009763.name: Limb pain
HP:0009763.definition: Chronic pain in the limbs with no clear focal etiology.
HP:0009763.definition_cn: 四肢慢性疼痛，无明显局灶性病因。

HP:0009765.name: Low hanging columella
HP:0009765.definition: Columella extending inferior to the level of the nasal base, when viewed from the side.
HP:0009765.definition_cn: 鼻小柱延伸至鼻基底水平以下，侧视观察。

HP:0009767.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0009767.definition: Small or missing phalangeal bones of the fingers of the hand.
HP:0009767.name_cn: 手指指骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009767.definition_cn: 手指指骨发育不全或缺如。

HP:0009768.name: Broad phalanges of the hand
HP:0009768.definition: Increased width of the phalanges of the hand.

HP:0009769.name: Bullet-shaped phalanges of the hand
HP:0009769.definition: The presence of short and wide phalanges which taper distally (\
HP:0009769.definition_cn: 存在短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细（\

HP:0009771.name: Osteolytic defects of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0009771.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the phalanges of the hand.
HP:0009771.definition_cn: 指骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0009772.name: Patchy sclerosis of finger phalanx
HP:0009772.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the hand.
HP:0009772.definition_cn: 单侧或多侧手部指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009773.name: Symphalangism affecting the phalanges of the hand
HP:0009773.definition: Fusion of two or more phalangeal bones of the hand.
HP:0009773.name_cn: 影响手部指骨的指关节融合症
HP:0009773.definition_cn: 手部两个或更多指骨的融合。

HP:0009774.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the hand

HP:0009775.name: Amniotic constriction ring
HP:0009775.definition: Annular constrictions around the digits, limbs, or trunk, occurring congenitally (sometimes causing intrauterine autoamputation) and also associated with a wide variety of disorders. Constrictive amniotic bands are the result of primary amniotic rupture, which can lead to entanglement of fetal tissue (especially limbs) in fibrous amniotic strands.
HP:0009775.definition_cn: 指（趾）、肢体或躯干周围的环状缩窄，可先天发生（有时导致宫内自截），并与多种疾病相关。缩窄性羊膜带是原发性羊膜破裂的结果，可导致胎儿组织（尤其是肢体）被纤维性羊膜带缠绕。

HP:0009776.name: Adactyly
HP:0009776.definition: The absence of all phalanges of all the digits of a limb and the associated soft tissues.
HP:0009776.definition_cn: 四肢所有指（趾）骨及其相关软组织的完全缺失。

HP:0009777.name: Absent thumb
HP:0009777.definition: Absent thumb, i.e., the absence of both phalanges of a thumb and the associated soft tissues.
HP:0009777.definition_cn: 拇指缺如，即拇指的两节指骨及相关软组织缺失。

HP:0009778.name: Short thumb
HP:0009778.definition: Hypoplasia (congenital reduction in size) of the thumb.
HP:0009778.definition_cn: 拇指发育不全（先天性拇指体积减小）。

HP:0009779.name: 3-4 toe syndactyly
HP:0009779.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes three and four.
HP:0009779.name_cn: 第三至第四趾并趾畸形
HP:0009779.definition_cn: 第三和第四趾并趾畸形伴融合。

HP:0009780.name: Iliac horns
HP:0009780.definition: Horn-like malformations of the iliac crests with symmetrical bilateral central posterior iliac processes. A characteristic finding in the Nail-Patella syndrome. Iliac horns are visible on X-ray and may be palpable, but are asymptomatic.
HP:0009780.definition_cn: 髂嵴角状畸形伴双侧对称性中央后髂突。这是甲-髌骨综合征的特征性表现。髂角在X线片上可见，可能可触及，但无症状。

HP:0009781.name: Lester's sign
HP:0009781.definition: A zone of darker pigmentation around the central part of the iris with a roughly cloverleaf or flower shape.
HP:0009781.definition_cn: 虹膜中央区域周围出现较深色素沉着区，呈近似三叶草或花朵形状。

HP:0009782.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the biceps
HP:0009782.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the biceps muscle.
HP:0009782.name_cn: 肱二头肌发育不全/肱二头肌发育不良
HP:0009782.definition_cn: 肱二头肌缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009784.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the triceps
HP:0009784.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the triceps muscle.
HP:0009784.name_cn: 肱三头肌发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009784.definition_cn: 肱三头肌缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009786.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the musculature of the thigh
HP:0009786.definition: Absence or underdevelopment involving the musculature of the thigh.
HP:0009786.name_cn: 大腿肌肉发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009786.definition_cn: 股四头肌发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0009787.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the quadriceps
HP:0009787.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the quadriceps muscle.
HP:0009787.name_cn: 股四头肌发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009787.definition_cn: 股四头肌缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009789.name: Perianal abscess
HP:0009789.definition: The presence of an abscess located around the anus.

HP:0009790.name: Hemisacrum
HP:0009790.definition: A hemisacral defect involving the sacral vertebrae S2 to S5. In hemisacrum, the first sacral vertebra is intact and there is agenesis involving only S2-S5.
HP:0009790.definition_cn: 涉及骶椎S2至S5的半骶骨缺损。在半骶骨中，第一骶椎完整，仅涉及S2至S5的发育不全。

HP:0009791.name: Bifid sacrum
HP:0009791.definition: Presence of a bifid sacral bone.

HP:0009793.name: Presacral teratoma
HP:0009793.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma located anterior to the sacrum and entirely inside the body (Altman type IV).
HP:0009793.definition_cn: 一种位于骶骨前方且完全位于体内的骶尾部畸胎瘤（Altman IV型）。

HP:0009794.name: Branchial anomaly
HP:0009794.definition: Congenital developmental defect arising from the primitive branchial apparatus.
HP:0009794.definition_cn: 原始鳃器发育缺陷导致的先天性发育异常。

HP:0009795.name: Branchial fistula
HP:0009795.definition: A congenital fistula in the neck resulting from incomplete closure of a branchial cleft.
HP:0009795.definition_cn: 颈部先天性瘘管，由鳃裂不完全闭合所致。

HP:0009796.name: Branchial cyst
HP:0009796.definition: A branchial cyst is a remnant of embryonic development resulting from a failure of obliteration of a branchial cleft and consists of a subcutaneous cystic mass. Cysts are located anterior or posterior to the ear or in the submandibular region.
HP:0009796.definition_cn: 鳃裂囊肿是胚胎发育过程中鳃裂未完全闭锁所遗留的残余组织，表现为皮下囊性肿块。囊肿可位于耳前或耳后，或位于下颌下区域。

HP:0009797.name: Cholesteatoma
HP:0009797.definition: Cholesteatoma is a benign but potentially destructive growth consisting of keratinizing epithelium located in the middle ear and/or mastoid process. In cholesteatoma, a skin cyst grows into the middle ear and mastoid. The cyst is not cancerous but can erode tissue and cause destruction of the ear.
HP:0009797.definition_cn: 胆脂瘤是一种良性但具有潜在破坏性的病变，由位于中耳和/或乳突的角化上皮构成。在胆脂瘤中，皮肤囊肿向中耳和乳突生长。该囊肿虽非恶性，但可侵蚀组织并导致耳部结构的破坏。

HP:0009798.name: Euthyroid goiter
HP:0009798.definition: A goiter that is not associated with functional thyroid abnormalities.
HP:0009798.name_cn: 正常甲状腺性甲状腺肿
HP:0009798.definition_cn: 非功能性甲状腺肿（Non-toxic goiter）

HP:0009799.name: Supernumerary spleens
HP:0009799.definition: The presence of two or more accessory spleens.

HP:0009800.name: Maternal diabetes
HP:0009800.definition: Maternal diabetes can either be a gestational, mostly type 2 diabetes, or a type 1 diabetes. Essential is the resulting maternal hyperglycemia as a non-specific teratogen, imposing the same risk of congenital malformations to pregnant women with both type 1 and type2 diabetes.
HP:0009800.definition_cn: 母体糖尿病可以是妊娠期糖尿病（主要为2型糖尿病）或1型糖尿病。关键是由此导致的母体高血糖作为一种非特异性致畸原，对患有1型和2型糖尿病的孕妇均构成相同的先天性畸形风险。

HP:0009802.name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0009802.definition: Absence of one or more of the phalanges of the hand.

HP:0009803.name: Short phalanx of finger
HP:0009803.definition: Short (hypoplastic) phalanx of finger, affecting one or more phalanges.
HP:0009803.definition_cn: 手指短小（指骨发育不全），累及一个或多个指骨。

HP:0009804.name: Tooth agenesis
HP:0009804.definition: The absence of one or more teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop

HP:0009805.name: Low-output congestive heart failure
HP:0009805.definition: A form of heart failure characterized by reduced cardiac output. This may be seen in patients with heart failure owing to ischemic heart disease, hypertension, cardiomyopathy, and other causes.
HP:0009805.name_cn: 低输出性充血性心力衰竭
HP:0009805.definition_cn: 一种以心输出量减少为特征的心力衰竭形式。这种情况可见于因缺血性心脏病、高血压、心肌病及其他原因导致心力衰竭的患者。

HP:0009806.name: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus
HP:0009806.definition: A form of diabetes insipidus caused by failure of the kidneys to respond to vasopressin (AVP).
HP:0009806.definition_cn: 一种由肾脏对抗利尿激素（AVP）无反应引起的尿崩症。

HP:0009808.name: Anomaly of the upper limb diaphyses
HP:0009808.definition: A structural abnormality of a diaphysis of the arm.

HP:0009809.name: Abnormal upper limb metaphysis morphology
HP:0009809.definition: An anomaly of one or more metaphyses of the arms.
HP:0009809.definition_cn: 上肢一处或多处干骺端异常。

HP:0009811.name: Abnormality of the elbow
HP:0009811.definition: An anomaly of the joint that connects the upper and the lower arm.

HP:0009812.name: Amelia involving the upper limbs
HP:0009812.definition: Amelia of one or both upper limbs.
HP:0009812.definition_cn: 单侧或双侧上肢缺肢畸形

HP:0009813.name: Upper limb phocomelia
HP:0009813.definition: Missing or malformed long bones of the upper limbs with the distal parts (the hands) connected to the variably shortened or even absent upper extremity, leading to a flipper-like appearance, as opposed to other forms of limb malformations were either the whole limb is missing (such as amelia), or the distal part of a limb is absent (peromelia).
HP:0009813.definition_cn: 上肢长骨缺失或畸形，远端部分（手部）连接至不同程度缩短甚至缺失的上肢，导致鳍状外观，与其他形式的肢体畸形不同，后者要么整个肢体缺失（如无肢畸形），要么肢体远端部分缺失（残肢畸形）。

HP:0009814.name: Upper limb peromelia
HP:0009814.definition: Peromelia affecting only the upper limbs. That is, the distal parts of the arm are missing leading to stump formation.
HP:0009814.definition_cn: 上肢局限性肢体缺损。即，手臂远端部分缺失导致残肢形成。

HP:0009815.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the extremities
HP:0009815.definition: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the extremities.
HP:0009815.name_cn: 四肢发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009815.definition_cn: 四肢缺失（由于形成失败）或发育不全。

HP:0009816.name: Lower limb undergrowth
HP:0009816.definition: Leg shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the lower extremity.
HP:0009816.definition_cn: 下肢单骨或多骨发育不全导致的肢体短缩。

HP:0009817.name: Aplasia involving bones of the lower limbs

HP:0009818.name: Amelia involving the lower limbs
HP:0009818.definition: Complete or near-complete absence of a leg.
HP:0009818.definition_cn: 完全或近乎完全性下肢缺失。

HP:0009819.name: Lower limb phocomelia
HP:0009819.definition: Phocomelia affecting only the lower limbs.
HP:0009819.definition_cn: 仅累及下肢的海豹肢畸形。

HP:0009820.name: Lower limb peromelia
HP:0009820.definition: Peromelia affecting only the lower limbs. That is, the distal parts of the leg are missing leading to stump formation.
HP:0009820.definition_cn: 仅累及下肢的肢体发育不全。即，下肢远端部分缺失导致残肢形成。

HP:0009821.name: Forearm undergrowth
HP:0009821.definition: Forearm shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the forearm.
HP:0009821.definition_cn: 前臂缩短由于前臂一根或多根骨骼发育不全。

HP:0009823.name: Aplasia involving bones of the upper limbs

HP:0009824.name: Upper limb undergrowth
HP:0009824.definition: Arm shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the upper extremity.
HP:0009824.definition_cn: 上肢单骨或多骨发育不全导致的臂长缩短。

HP:0009825.name: Aplasia involving bones of the extremities

HP:0009826.name: Limb undergrowth
HP:0009826.definition: Limb shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the extremities.
HP:0009826.definition_cn: 由于四肢中一根或多根骨骼发育不全导致的肢体短缩。

HP:0009827.name: Amelia
HP:0009827.definition: Congenital absence (aplasia) of one or more limbs.
HP:0009827.definition_cn: 先天性肢体缺失（发育不全）

HP:0009828.name: Peromelia
HP:0009828.definition: The distal parts of the limbs are missing leading to a stump formation.
HP:0009828.definition_cn: 肢体远端缺失导致残端形成。

HP:0009829.name: Phocomelia
HP:0009829.definition: Missing or malformed long bones of the extremities with the distal parts (such as hands and/or feet) connected to the variably shortened or even absent extremity, leading to a flipper-like appearance, as opposed to other forms of limb malformations were either the hole limb is missing (such as amelia), or the distal part of a limb is absent (peromelia).
HP:0009829.definition_cn: 四肢长骨缺失或畸形，远端部分（如手和/或足）连接至不同程度缩短甚至缺失的肢体，导致鳍状外观，与其他形式的肢体畸形（如完全缺失整个肢体（无肢畸形）或肢体远端缺失（残肢畸形））不同。

HP:0009830.name: Peripheral neuropathy
HP:0009830.definition: Peripheral neuropathy is a general term for any disorder of the peripheral nervous system. The main clinical features used to classify peripheral neuropathy are distribution, type (mainly demyelinating versus mainly axonal), duration, and course.
HP:0009830.definition_cn: 周围神经病变是周围神经系统任何疾病的总称。用于分类周围神经病变的主要临床特征包括分布、类型（主要为脱髓鞘性病变与主要为轴索性病变）、病程和病程进展。

HP:0009831.name: Mononeuropathy
HP:0009831.definition: A focal lesion of a single peripheral nerve. Damage to a sensory nerve is accompanied by sensory impairment of all modalities in the affected anatomic distribution.
HP:0009831.definition_cn: 单一周围神经的局灶性病变。感觉神经损伤伴随受影响解剖分布区域内所有感觉模式的障碍。

HP:0009832.name: Abnormal distal phalanx morphology of finger
HP:0009832.definition: Any anomaly of distal phalanx of finger.
HP:0009832.name_cn: 手指远端指骨形态异常

HP:0009833.name: Abnormal middle phalanx morphology of the hand
HP:0009833.definition: An anomaly of middle phalanx of finger.
HP:0009833.name_cn: 手部中节指骨形态异常

HP:0009834.name: Abnormal proximal phalanx morphology of the hand
HP:0009834.name_cn: 手部近节指骨形态异常

HP:0009835.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009835.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the distal phalanges.
HP:0009835.name_cn: 手远端指骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0009835.definition_cn: 远端指骨缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009836.name: Broad distal phalanx of finger
HP:0009836.definition: Abnormally wide (broad) distal phalanx of finger.
HP:0009836.definition_cn: 手指远端指骨异常增宽（增厚）。

HP:0009837.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009837.definition: Short and wide distal phalanges that taper distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009837.definition_cn: 短而宽的远端指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009838.name: Curved distal phalanges of the hand

HP:0009839.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009839.name_cn: 手部远节指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0009840.name: Patchy sclerosis of distal phalanx of finger
HP:0009840.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of the distal phalanges of the hand.
HP:0009840.name_cn: 手指远节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009840.definition_cn: 手部远端指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009843.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0009843.name_cn: 手部中节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009844.name: Broad middle phalanx of finger
HP:0009844.definition: Increased width of the middle phalanx of finger.
HP:0009844.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009845.name: Bullet-shaped middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0009845.definition: Any of the middle phalanges with short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009845.name_cn: 手部中节指骨的子弹形改变
HP:0009845.definition_cn: 任何中节指骨呈现短而宽且向远端逐渐变细的形态。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009846.name: Curved middle phalanges of the hand

HP:0009847.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0009847.name_cn: 手中节指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0009848.name: Patchy sclerosis of middle phalanx of finger
HP:0009848.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the middle phalanges of the hand.
HP:0009848.name_cn: 手指中节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009848.definition_cn: 手部一个或多个中节指骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0009849.name: Symphalangism of middle phalanx of finger
HP:0009849.definition: Fusion of a middle phalanx of a finger with another bone.
HP:0009849.name_cn: 手指中节指骨并指畸形
HP:0009849.definition_cn: 指骨中节与另一骨融合。

HP:0009850.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0009850.name_cn: 手部中指节骨的三角形形态

HP:0009851.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009851.name_cn: 手近节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0009852.name: Broad proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009852.definition: Increased width of the proximal phalanges of the finger.
HP:0009852.definition_cn: 手指近节指骨宽度增加。

HP:0009853.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009853.definition: Short and wide proximal phalanges that taper distally . Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0009853.definition_cn: 短而宽的近节指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0009854.name: Curved proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0009855.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009855.name_cn: 手近节指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0009856.name: Patchy sclerosis of proximal phalanx of finger
HP:0009856.definition: Uneven increase in bone density of the proximal phalanges of the hand.
HP:0009856.name_cn: 手指近节指骨斑片状硬化
HP:0009856.definition_cn: 手近节指骨骨密度不均匀性增高。

HP:0009857.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0009858.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009858.name_cn: 手部近节指骨的三角形形态

HP:0009875.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009875.name_cn: 手部远端指骨的三角形形态

HP:0009878.name: Cerebellar ataxia associated with quadrupedal gait
HP:0009878.definition: The presence of cerebellar signs and symptoms such as lack of balance associated with quadrupedal gait (locomotion on all four extremities with a 'bear-like' gait with the legs held straight).
HP:0009878.name_cn: 小脑性共济失调伴四足步态
HP:0009878.definition_cn: 小脑体征和症状的存在，例如与四足步态相关的平衡障碍（四肢着地行走，呈“熊样”步态，双腿保持伸直）。

HP:0009879.name: Simplified gyral pattern
HP:0009879.definition: An abnormality of the cerebral cortex with fewer gyri but with normal cortical thickness. This pattern is usually often associated with congenital microcephaly.
HP:0009879.definition_cn: 大脑皮层异常，表现为脑回减少但皮层厚度正常。此模式通常与先天性小头畸形相关。

HP:0009880.name: Broad distal phalanges of all fingers
HP:0009880.definition: Abnormally wide (broad) distal phalanx of finger of all fingers.
HP:0009880.name_cn: 所有手指的远端指骨增宽
HP:0009880.definition_cn: 所有手指远端指骨异常增宽。

HP:0009881.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0009881.name_cn: 手指远端指骨发育不全

HP:0009882.name: Short distal phalanx of finger
HP:0009882.definition: Short distance from the end of the finger to the most distal interphalangeal crease or the distal interphalangeal joint flexion point. That is, hypoplasia of one or more of the distal phalanx of finger.
HP:0009882.definition_cn: 手指末端至最远端指间皱褶或远端指间关节屈曲点的距离缩短。即一个或多个手指远端指骨发育不全。

HP:0009883.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of hand
HP:0009883.definition: This term applies if one or more of the distal phalanges of the hand are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.
HP:0009883.definition_cn: 该术语适用于手部一个或多个远端指骨部分重复，根据严重程度导致指骨呈现宽大或分叉外观，或完全重复的情况。

HP:0009884.name: Tapered distal phalanges of finger
HP:0009884.definition: A reduction in diameter of the distal phalanx of finger towards the distal end.
HP:0009884.name_cn: 手指远端指骨逐渐变细
HP:0009884.definition_cn: 手指远节指骨向远端逐渐变细。

HP:0009886.name: Trichorrhexis nodosa
HP:0009886.definition: Trichorrhexis nodosa is the formation of nodes along the hair shaft through which breakage readily occurs. It is thus a focal defect in the hair fiber that is characterized by thickening or weak points (nodes) that cause the hair to break off easily. The result is defective, abnormally fragile hair.
HP:0009886.definition_cn: 结节性脆发症是指沿毛干形成结节，易于发生断裂。因此，这是一种毛纤维的局灶性缺陷，其特征是增厚或薄弱点（结节），导致毛发易于断裂。其结果是毛发异常脆弱，存在缺陷。

HP:0009887.name: Abnormality of hair pigmentation
HP:0009887.definition_cn: 毛发色素沉着异常（颜色异常）。

HP:0009888.name: Abnormality of secondary sexual hair
HP:0009888.definition: Abnormality of the growth of secondary sexual hair, which normally ensues during puberty. In males, secondary sexual hair usually comprises body hair, including underarm, abdominal, chest, and pubic hair. In females, secondary sexual hair usually comprises a lesser degree of body hair, most prominently underarm and pubic hair.
HP:0009888.definition_cn: 第二性征毛发发育异常，通常发生于青春期。在男性中，第二性征毛发通常包括体毛，如腋毛、腹毛、胸毛和阴毛。在女性中，第二性征毛发通常表现为较少的体毛，最显著的是腋毛和阴毛。

HP:0009889.name: Localized hirsutism
HP:0009889.definition: Abnormally increased hair growth with a localized distribution.
HP:0009889.definition_cn: 局限性毛发异常增多症

HP:0009890.name: High anterior hairline
HP:0009890.definition: Distance between the hairline (trichion) and the glabella (the most prominent point on the frontal bone above the root of the nose), in the midline, more than two SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased distance between the hairline and the glabella.
HP:0009890.definition_cn: 发际线（trichion）与眉间点（glabella，即鼻根上方额骨最突出点）之间的中线距离，超过平均值两个标准差（SD）。或者，发际线与眉间点之间的距离明显增加。

HP:0009891.name: Underdeveloped supraorbital ridges
HP:0009891.definition: Flatness of the supraorbital portion of the frontal bones.

HP:0009892.name: Anotia
HP:0009892.definition: Complete absence of any auricular structures.

HP:0009893.name: Telangiectasia of the ear
HP:0009893.definition: The presence of telangiectasia of the ear.
HP:0009893.definition_cn: 耳部毛细血管扩张症的存在。

HP:0009894.name: Thickened ears
HP:0009894.definition: Increased thickness of the external ear.

HP:0009895.name: Abnormality of the crus of the helix
HP:0009895.definition: An abnormality of the crus of the helix, which is the horizontal piece of cartilage located outside the ear canal that divides the upper and lower parts of the ear.
HP:0009895.definition_cn: 耳轮脚异常，耳轮脚是位于耳道外部的水平软骨结构，将耳部分为上下两部分。

HP:0009896.name: Abnormal antitragus morphology
HP:0009896.definition: An abnormality of the antitragus, which is a small tubercle opposite to the tragus of the ear. The antitragus and the tragus are separated by the intertragic notch.
HP:0009896.definition_cn: 对耳屏异常，即位于耳屏对侧的小结节。对耳屏与耳屏之间由耳屏间切迹分隔。

HP:0009897.name: Horizontal crus of helix
HP:0009897.definition: An abnormal horizontal axis orientation of the crus of the helix. That is, the main axis of the crus of the helix is perpendicular to the medial longitudinal axis of the ear, instead of sloping inferoposteriorly.
HP:0009897.definition_cn: 耳轮脚水平轴异常。即耳轮脚的主轴与耳的内侧纵轴垂直，而非向后下方倾斜。

HP:0009898.name: Underdeveloped crus of the helix
HP:0009898.definition: Developmental hypoplasia of the crus of the helix. That is, flatter and/or shorter crus helix than average.
HP:0009898.definition_cn: 耳轮脚发育不全。即耳轮脚较平均水平更为平坦和/或短小。

HP:0009899.name: Prominent crus of helix
HP:0009899.definition: The presence of an abnormally prominent of the crus of the helix. That is, development of the crus helix to the same degree as an average antihelix stem or helix.
HP:0009899.definition_cn: 耳轮脚异常突出。即耳轮脚发育程度与平均对耳轮脚或耳轮相同。

HP:0009900.name: Unilateral deafness
HP:0009900.definition: A unilateral absence of sensory perception of sound.

HP:0009901.name: Crumpled ear
HP:0009901.definition: Distortion of the course of the normal folds of the ear and the appearance of supernumerary crura and folds.
HP:0009901.definition_cn: 耳部正常皱褶走行扭曲及额外皱褶和嵴的出现。

HP:0009902.name: Cleft helix
HP:0009902.definition: A notched form of the helix of the ear. That is, a defect in the continuity of the helix, which may occur at any point along its length.
HP:0009902.definition_cn: 耳轮切迹。即耳轮连续性的缺损，可发生于耳轮的任何部位。

HP:0009903.name: Conjunctival nodule
HP:0009903.definition: Presence of nodules in the conjunctiva of the eye.

HP:0009905.name: Thin ear helix
HP:0009905.definition: Decreased thickness of the helix of the ear.

HP:0009906.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the earlobes
HP:0009906.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the ear lobes.
HP:0009906.name_cn: 耳垂发育不全/耳垂发育不良

HP:0009907.name: Attached earlobe
HP:0009907.definition: Attachment of the lobe to the side of the face at the lowest point of the lobe without curving upward.
HP:0009907.definition_cn: 耳垂最低点与面部侧面附着，无向上弯曲。

HP:0009908.name: Anterior creases of earlobe
HP:0009908.definition: Sharply demarcated, typically linear and approximately horizontal, indentations in the outer surface of the ear lobe.
HP:0009908.definition_cn: 耳廓外表面清晰界定的、通常呈线性且大致水平的凹陷。

HP:0009909.name: Uplifted earlobe
HP:0009909.definition: An abnormal orientation of the earlobes such that they point out- and upward. That is, the lateral surface of ear lobe faces superiorly.
HP:0009909.definition_cn: 耳垂异常朝向，表现为向外上方倾斜，即耳垂的外侧面朝向上方。

HP:0009910.name: Aplasia of the middle ear ossicles
HP:0009910.definition: Absence of the middle ear ossicles, malleus, incus, and stapes.
HP:0009910.definition_cn: 中耳听小骨缺失，包括锤骨、砧骨和镫骨。

HP:0009911.name: Abnormal temporal bone morphology
HP:0009911.definition: Abnormality of the temporal bone of the skull, which is situated at the sides and base of the skull roughly underlying the region of the face known as the temple.
HP:0009911.definition_cn: 颅骨颞骨异常，颞骨位于颅骨的两侧和底部，大致位于面部称为太阳穴的区域下方。

HP:0009913.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tragus
HP:0009913.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the tragus.
HP:0009913.name_cn: 耳屏发育不全/耳屏发育不良
HP:0009913.definition_cn: 耳屏发育不全或耳屏发育不良。

HP:0009914.name: Cyclopia
HP:0009914.definition: Cyclopia is a congenital abnormality in which there is only one eye. That eye is centrally placed in the area normally occupied by the root of the nose.
HP:0009914.definition_cn: 独眼畸形是一种先天性异常，表现为仅有一只眼睛。该眼位于通常由鼻根占据的区域中央。

HP:0009915.name: Corneal asymmetry
HP:0009915.definition: The presence of a size difference between the left and right cornea.
HP:0009915.definition_cn: 左右角膜大小差异的存在。

HP:0009916.name: Anisocoria
HP:0009916.definition: Anisocoria, or unequal pupil size, may represent a benign physiologic variant or a manifestation of disease.
HP:0009916.definition_cn: 瞳孔不等大（Anisocoria）可能为良性生理变异或疾病表现。

HP:0009917.name: Persistent pupillary membrane
HP:0009917.definition: The presence of remnants of a fetal membrane that persist as strands of tissue crossing the pupil.
HP:0009917.definition_cn: 胎儿膜残留物持续存在，形成跨越瞳孔的组织条索。

HP:0009918.name: Ectopia pupillae
HP:0009918.definition: A malposition of the pupil owing to a developmental defect of the iris.
HP:0009918.definition_cn: 由于虹膜发育缺陷导致的瞳孔异位。

HP:0009919.name: Retinoblastoma
HP:0009919.definition: A tumor of the eye originating from cells of the retina.

HP:0009920.name: Nevus of Ota
HP:0009920.definition: A dermal melanocytic hamartoma that presents as bluish hyperpigmentation on the face along the first or second branches of the trigeminal nerve. Nevus of Ota may involve the sclera.
HP:0009920.definition_cn: 一种表现为沿三叉神经第一或第二分支分布的面部蓝黑色色素沉着的皮肤黑色素细胞错构瘤。太田痣可能累及巩膜。

HP:0009921.name: Duane anomaly
HP:0009921.definition: A condition associated with a limitation of the horizontal ocular movement with retraction of the globe and narrowing of the palpebral fissure on adduction
HP:0009921.definition_cn: 一种与水平眼球运动受限相关的病症，表现为眼球内收时眼球回缩和睑裂变窄。

HP:0009922.name: Vascular remnant arising from the disk
HP:0009922.definition: Persistence of the hyaloid artery, which is the embryonic artery that runs from the optic disc to the posterior lens capsule may persist; the site of attachment may form an opacity. The hyaloid artery is a branch of the ophthalmic artery, and usually regresses completely before birth.
HP:0009922.definition_cn: 玻璃体动脉残留，即从视盘延伸至晶状体后囊的胚胎期动脉可能持续存在；其附着部位可能形成混浊。玻璃体动脉为眼动脉的分支，通常在出生前完全退化。

HP:0009924.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the nose
HP:0009924.definition: Underdevelopment or absence of the nose or parts thereof.
HP:0009924.name_cn: 鼻部发育不全/鼻部发育不良

HP:0009926.name: Epiphora
HP:0009926.definition: Abnormally increased lacrimation, that is, excessive tearing (watering eye).
HP:0009926.definition_cn: 泪液分泌异常增多，即泪溢（泪眼）。

HP:0009927.name: Aplasia of the nose
HP:0009927.definition: Complete absence of all nasal structures.

HP:0009928.name: Thick nasal alae
HP:0009928.definition: Increase in bulk of the ala nasi.

HP:0009929.name: Abnormal columella morphology
HP:0009929.definition: A structural abnormality of the columella.

HP:0009930.name: Asymmetry of the nares
HP:0009930.definition: Asymmetry or size difference between the left and right nostril.
HP:0009930.definition_cn: 左右鼻孔不对称或大小差异。

HP:0009932.name: Single naris
HP:0009932.definition: The presence of only a single nostril.

HP:0009933.name: Narrow naris
HP:0009933.definition: Slender, slit-like aperture of the nostril.

HP:0009934.name: Supernumerary naris
HP:0009934.definition: The presence of more than two nostrils.

HP:0009935.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nasal septum
HP:0009935.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasal septum.
HP:0009935.name_cn: 鼻中隔发育不全/鼻中隔发育不良
HP:0009935.definition_cn: 鼻中隔缺失或发育不全。

HP:0009938.name: Sunken cheeks
HP:0009938.definition: Lack or loss of the soft tissues between the zygomata and mandible.
HP:0009938.definition_cn: 颧骨与下颌骨之间软组织缺失或丧失。

HP:0009940.name: Asymmetry of the mandible
HP:0009940.definition: Lack of symmetry between the left and right mandible.

HP:0009941.name: Asymmetry of the mouth
HP:0009941.definition: The presence of an asymmetric mouth.

HP:0009942.name: Duplication of thumb phalanx
HP:0009942.definition: Complete or partial duplication of the phalanges of the thumb. Depending on the severity, the appearance on x-ray can vary from a notched phalanx (the duplicated bone is almost completely fused with the phalanx), a partially fused appearance of the two bones (bifid), two separate bones appearing side to side, or completely duplicated phalanges (proximal and distal phalanx of the thumb and/or 1st metacarpal). In contrast to the phalanges of the digits 2-5 (proximal, middle and distal), the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0009942.definition_cn: 拇指指骨的完全或部分重复。根据严重程度的不同，X线表现可从切迹状指骨（重复的骨骼几乎完全与指骨融合）、部分融合的两块骨骼（分叉状）、两块并排的独立骨骼，到完全重复的指骨（拇指的近节和远节指骨和/或第一掌骨）。与第2-5指（近节、中节和远节）的指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0009943.name: Complete duplication of thumb phalanx
HP:0009943.definition: A complete duplication affecting one or more of the phalanges of the thumb. As opposed to a partial duplication were there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones, a complete duplication leads to two separate bones appearing side to side (radio-ulnar axis) as seen on x-rays. A duplication leading to an accessory bone appearing in the proximo-distal axis on x-rays, this is actually a different entity called a Pseudoepiphyses (see according terms) sometimes also referred to as Hyperphalangism.
HP:0009943.definition_cn: 完全性拇指指骨重复畸形，影响拇指的一个或多个指骨。与部分性重复畸形不同，后者在重复的骨骼之间仍存在不同程度的融合，而完全性重复畸形则导致在X光片上可见两个独立的骨骼并排出现（桡-尺轴）。若重复畸形导致在X光片上出现一个位于近远轴的副骨，这实际上是一种不同的实体，称为假骨骺（参见相关术语），有时也称为超指骨症。

HP:0009944.name: Partial duplication of thumb phalanx
HP:0009944.definition: A partial duplication, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance, affecting one or more of the phalanges of the thumb. As opposed to a complete duplication there is still a variable degree of fusion between the duplicated bones.
HP:0009944.definition_cn: 部分重复，根据严重程度可能导致拇指指骨呈现宽阔或分叉外观，影响一个或多个指骨。与完全重复不同，重复骨骼之间仍存在不同程度的融合。

HP:0009945.name: Duplication of phalanx of 2nd finger
HP:0009945.definition: This term applies if one or more of the phalanges of the 2nd finger are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.
HP:0009945.definition_cn: 该术语适用于第二指的一节或多节指骨部分重复，根据严重程度导致指骨呈现宽大或分叉外观，或完全重复。

HP:0009947.name: Duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009947.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the second proximal phalanx of hand.
HP:0009947.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨重复畸形
HP:0009947.definition_cn: 手部第二近节指骨部分或完全重复。

HP:0009948.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009948.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the distal phalanx of index finger.
HP:0009948.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨重复畸形
HP:0009948.definition_cn: 食指远节指骨部分或完全重复。

HP:0009949.name: Duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009949.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the middle phalanx of index finger.
HP:0009949.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨重复畸形
HP:0009949.definition_cn: 食指中节指骨部分或完全重复。

HP:0009950.name: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009950.definition: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of index finger.
HP:0009950.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨完全重复畸形
HP:0009950.definition_cn: 食指远节指骨完全重复畸形。

HP:0009951.name: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009951.definition: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of index finger, seen on x-rays as a broad and/or bifid phalanx.
HP:0009951.name_cn: 第二指远节指骨部分重复
HP:0009951.definition_cn: 食指远节指骨部分重复，X线表现为宽大和/或分叉的指骨。

HP:0009952.name: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009952.definition: Complete duplication of the middle phalanx of index finger.
HP:0009952.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨完全重复
HP:0009952.definition_cn: 食指中节指骨完全重复畸形。

HP:0009953.name: Partial duplication of the middle phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009953.definition: Partial duplication of the middle phalanx of index finger, seen on x-rays as a broad and/or bifid phalanx.
HP:0009953.name_cn: 第二指中节指骨部分重复
HP:0009953.definition_cn: 食指中节指骨部分重复，X线表现为宽大和/或分叉的指骨。

HP:0009954.name: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
HP:0009954.definition: Complete duplication of the second proximal phalanx of hand.
HP:0009954.name_cn: 第二指近节指骨完全重复畸形
HP:0009954.definition_cn: 手部第二近节指骨完全重复畸形。

HP:0009955.name: Partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of the 2nd finger
