HP:0010006.name: Duplication of the proximal phalanx of hand
HP:0010006.definition: This term applies if one or more of the proximal phalanges of the hand are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.
HP:0010006.definition_cn: 该术语适用于手部一个或多个近节指骨部分重复，根据严重程度导致指骨呈现宽阔或分叉外观，或完全重复的情况。

HP:0010008.name: Duplication of the middle phalanx of hand
HP:0010008.definition: This term applies if one or more of the middle phalanges of the hand are either partially duplicated, depending on severity leading to a broad or bifid appearance of the phalanges, or completely duplicated.
HP:0010008.definition_cn: 该术语适用于手部一个或多个中节指骨部分重复，根据严重程度导致指骨呈现宽阔或分叉外观，或完全重复的情况。

HP:0010009.name: Abnormal 1st metacarpal morphology
HP:0010009.definition: A structural anomaly of the first metacarpal.

HP:0010010.name: Abnormal 2nd metacarpal morphology
HP:0010010.definition: Any abnormality of the second metacarpal bone.

HP:0010011.name: Abnormal 3rd metacarpal morphology
HP:0010011.definition: Any abnormality of the third metacarpal bone.

HP:0010012.name: Abnormal 4th metacarpal morphology
HP:0010012.definition: Any abnormality of the fourth metacarpal bone.

HP:0010013.name: Abnormal 5th metacarpal morphology
HP:0010013.definition: Any abnormality of the fifth metacarpal bone.

HP:0010014.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010014.definition: In contrast to the metacarpals 2-5, the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5 (whereas the proximal phalanx of the thumb is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits). The epiphysis of the first metacarpal is localized at the proximal end (as seen in the proximal phalanges of the other digits), whereas the epiphyses of the other metacarpal bones are located at the distal end. This term applies if the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal is in any way abnormal, referring to age and gender depending norms, as seen on x-rays.
HP:0010014.definition_cn: 与第2至第5掌骨不同，第1掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于第2至第5指的近节指骨（而拇指的近节指骨则相当于其他手指的中节指骨）。第1掌骨的骨骺位于近端（如其他手指的近节指骨所见），而其他掌骨的骨骺则位于远端。如果第1掌骨的骨骺在任何方面出现异常，根据年龄和性别的相关标准，如X射线所见，则适用此术语。

HP:0010016.name: Bracket epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010016.definition: An epiphysis that curves around from its transverse orientation to a longitudinal one from proximal to distal along one side of the phalanx, thus resembling the letter 'C' and forming a bracket around the diaphysis. This results in a so called delta phalanx characterized by a triangular or trapezoidal shaped bone with a C-shaped epiphyseal plate.
HP:0010016.definition_cn: 骨骺从其横向方向向纵向方向弯曲，从近端到远端沿着指骨的一侧延伸，从而形成类似字母“C”的形状，并在骨干周围形成一个支架。这导致所谓的三角指骨（delta phalanx），其特征为具有三角形或梯形骨块，并伴有C形骨骺板。

HP:0010017.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010017.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance.
HP:0010017.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”样外观。

HP:0010018.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010018.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the 1st metacarpal with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0010018.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺相对于年龄相关标准异常增大。

HP:0010019.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010019.definition: Epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal having multiple bony fragments.
HP:0010019.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺存在多发性骨碎片。

HP:0010020.name: Irregular epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010020.definition: Uneven radiographic opacity of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal.
HP:0010020.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺放射学密度不均匀。

HP:0010021.name: Ivory epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010021.definition: The epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal appears hard and dense like ivory. An ivory epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.
HP:0010021.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺呈现象牙样硬化且致密。在X线片上，象牙样骨骺表现为均匀致密的影像。

HP:0010022.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010022.definition: The epiphysis of the first metacarpal is localized at the proximal end of the metacarpal bone although an accessory epiphysis may be located at the distal end of the metacarpal.
HP:0010022.definition_cn: 第一掌骨的骨骺位于掌骨的近端，尽管副骨骺可能位于掌骨的远端。

HP:0010023.name: Small epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010023.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphysis of the 1st metacarpal with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0010023.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺相对于年龄相关标准的异常缩小。

HP:0010024.name: Epiphyseal stippling of the first metacarpal
HP:0010024.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the first metacarpal bone.
HP:0010024.name_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺点状钙化
HP:0010024.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨骺内存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。

HP:0010026.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010026.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the 1st metacarpal. In contrast to the metacarpals 2-5, the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5 (whereas the proximal phalanx of the thumb is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits).
HP:0010026.name_cn: 第一掌骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010026.definition_cn: 第一掌骨发育不全或发育不良。与第2至第5掌骨不同，第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于第2至第5指的近节指骨（而拇指的近节指骨则相当于其他手指的中节指骨）。

HP:0010027.name: Broad 1st metacarpal
HP:0010027.definition: Increased width of the 1st metacarpal. In contrast to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.
HP:0010027.definition_cn: 第一掌骨宽度增加。与第2-5指近节指骨相比，拇指的近节指骨在胚胎学上相当于其他手指的中节指骨，而第一掌骨在胚胎学上起源于指骨，因此相当于其他手指的近节指骨。

HP:0010028.name: Bullet-shaped 1st metacarpal
HP:0010028.definition: The presence of short and wide 1st metacarpal which tapers distally (\
HP:0010028.definition_cn: 第一掌骨短而宽，远端逐渐变细（\

HP:0010029.name: Curved 1st metacarpal
HP:0010029.definition: A deviation from the normal straight shape of the first metacarpal.
HP:0010029.definition_cn: 第一掌骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0010030.name: Osteolytic defects of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010030.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the 1st metacarpal.
HP:0010030.definition_cn: 第一掌骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0010031.name: Patchy sclerosis of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010031.definition: Uneven increase in bone density within the 1st metacarpal.
HP:0010031.definition_cn: 第一掌骨内骨密度不均匀增高。

HP:0010033.name: Triangular shaped 1st metacarpal
HP:0010033.definition: This term applies to a triangular shaped 1st metacarpal.
HP:0010033.definition_cn: 该术语适用于呈三角形状的第一掌骨。

HP:0010034.name: Short 1st metacarpal
HP:0010034.definition: A developmental defect characterized by reduced length of the first metacarpal (long bone) of the hand.
HP:0010034.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为手部第一掌骨（长骨）长度缩短。

HP:0010035.name: Aplasia of the 1st metacarpal
HP:0010035.definition: Absent first metacarpal (long bone) of the hand.
HP:0010035.definition_cn: 第一掌骨缺失（手部长骨）。

HP:0010036.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 2nd metacarpal
HP:0010036.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the 2nd metacarpal.
HP:0010036.name_cn: 第二掌骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010036.definition_cn: 第二掌骨发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0010037.name: Aplasia of the 2nd metacarpal
HP:0010037.definition: Absence of the second long bone of the hand.

HP:0010038.name: Short 2nd metacarpal
HP:0010038.definition: Short second metacarpal bone because of developmental hypoplasia.
HP:0010038.definition_cn: 由于发育不全导致的第二掌骨短缩。

HP:0010039.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 3rd metacarpal
HP:0010039.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the 3rd metacarpal.
HP:0010039.name_cn: 第三掌骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010039.definition_cn: 第三掌骨发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0010040.name: Aplasia of the 3rd metacarpal
HP:0010040.definition: Absence of the third long bone of the hand.

HP:0010042.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 4th metacarpal
HP:0010042.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the 4th metacarpal.
HP:0010042.name_cn: 第四掌骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010042.definition_cn: 第四掌骨发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0010043.name: Aplasia of the 4th metacarpal
HP:0010043.definition: Absence of the fourth long bone of the hand.

HP:0010045.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 5th metacarpal
HP:0010045.definition: Aplasia or Hypoplasia affecting the 5th metacarpal.
HP:0010045.name_cn: 第五掌骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010045.definition_cn: 第五掌骨发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0010046.name: Aplasia of the 5th metacarpal
HP:0010046.definition: Absence of the fifth long bone of the hand.

HP:0010048.name: Aplasia of metacarpal bones
HP:0010048.definition: Developmental defect associated with absence of one or more metacarpal bones.
HP:0010048.definition_cn: 与一个或多个掌骨缺失相关的发育缺陷。

HP:0010049.name: Short metacarpal
HP:0010049.definition: Diminished length of one or more metacarpal bones in relation to the others of the same hand or to the contralateral metacarpal.
HP:0010049.definition_cn: 单侧或双侧掌骨中一根或多根掌骨长度相对于同侧或对侧掌骨缩短。

HP:0010051.name: Deviation of the hallux
HP:0010051.definition: Displacement of the big toe from its normal position.

HP:0010052.name: Abnormal morphology of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010052.definition: An abnormal shape or form of the proximal phalanx of the big toe.
HP:0010052.name_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨形态异常
HP:0010052.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨形态异常。

HP:0010053.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010054.name: Abnormality of the first metatarsal bone
HP:0010054.definition: An anomaly of the first metatarsal bone.

HP:0010055.name: Broad hallux
HP:0010055.definition: Visible increase in width of the hallux without an increase in the dorso-ventral dimension.
HP:0010055.definition_cn: 足趾宽度明显增加，但背腹侧维度未见增加。

HP:0010056.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the hallux

HP:0010058.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the hallux
HP:0010058.name_cn: 趾骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010059.name: Broad hallux phalanx
HP:0010059.definition: An increase in width in one or more phalanges of the big toe.
HP:0010059.definition_cn: 大趾一个或多个指骨宽度增加。

HP:0010060.name: Bullet-shaped hallux phalanx
HP:0010060.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more phalanges of the big toe, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010060.definition_cn: 大趾一或多个指骨的形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010061.name: Curved hallux phalanx
HP:0010061.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of one or more phalanges of the big toe.
HP:0010061.definition_cn: 一个或多个大脚趾指骨偏离正常直线形态的异常。

HP:0010062.name: Osteolytic defects of the phalanges of the hallux

HP:0010063.name: Patchy sclerosis of hallux phalanx
HP:0010063.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more phalanges of the big toe. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0010063.definition_cn: 大趾一或多个指骨密度呈斑片状（不规则）增高。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可呈现多种形态。

HP:0010064.name: Symphalangism affecting the phalanges of the hallux
HP:0010064.name_cn: 影响拇趾趾骨的指节融合症

HP:0010065.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the hallux

HP:0010066.name: Duplication of phalanx of hallux
HP:0010066.definition: Partial or complete duplication of one or more phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010066.definition_cn: 大趾一个或多个指骨的部分或完全重复。

HP:0010067.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010067.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010067.name_cn: 第一跖骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010067.definition_cn: 第一跖骨缺失或发育不全。

HP:0010068.name: Broad first metatarsal
HP:0010068.definition: Increased side-to-side width of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010068.definition_cn: 第一跖骨横向宽度增加。

HP:0010069.name: Bullet-shaped 1st metatarsal
HP:0010069.definition: An abnormal morphology of the firstmetatarsal bone, which is short and wide and tapers distally, and lacks the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010069.definition_cn: 第一跖骨形态异常，表现为短而宽，远端逐渐变细，且缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010070.name: Curved 1st metatarsal
HP:0010070.definition: A deviation from the normal straight shape of a proximal phalanx of the 1st metatarsal bone.
HP:0010070.definition_cn: 第一跖骨近节趾骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0010071.name: Osteolytic defects of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010071.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the first metatarsal.
HP:0010071.definition_cn: 第一跖骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0010075.name: Duplication of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010075.definition: A developmental defect consisting in the duplication of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010075.definition_cn: 第一跖骨重复发育缺陷。

HP:0010076.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010076.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010077.name: Broad distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010077.definition: An increase in width of the distal phalanx of the big toe.
HP:0010077.definition_cn: 大趾远节趾骨宽度增加。

HP:0010078.name: Bullet-shaped distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010078.definition: An abnormal morphology of the distal phalanx of the big toe, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010078.name_cn: 拇趾远端指骨呈子弹形
HP:0010078.definition_cn: 大趾远节指骨形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010079.name: Curved distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010079.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of the distal phalanx of the big toe.
HP:0010079.definition_cn: 大趾远节趾骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0010080.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010080.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0010081.name: Patchy sclerosis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010081.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨斑片状硬化

HP:0010082.name: Symphalangism affecting the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010082.name_cn: 影响拇趾远节趾骨的指关节融合症

HP:0010083.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010083.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨呈三角形

HP:0010084.name: Duplication of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010084.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨重复畸形

HP:0010085.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010085.name_cn: 近节趾骨发育不全/近节趾骨发育不良

HP:0010086.name: Broad proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010086.definition: Increased width of proximal phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010086.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨宽度增加。

HP:0010087.name: Bullet-shaped proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010087.definition: An abnormal morphology of the proximal phalanx of the big toe, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010087.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨子弹形畸形
HP:0010087.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨形态异常，表现为短而宽的趾骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形趾骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010088.name: Curved proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010088.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of the proximal phalanx of the big toe.
HP:0010088.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨正常直线形态的偏离。

HP:0010089.name: Osteolytic defects of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010089.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0010090.name: Patchy sclerosis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010090.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨斑片状硬化

HP:0010091.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010091.name_cn: 近节趾骨近端趾骨融合症

HP:0010092.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010092.name_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨呈三角形

HP:0010093.name: Duplication of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010093.definition: Partial or complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010093.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨部分或完全重复。

HP:0010094.name: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010094.definition: Complete duplication of the proximal phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010094.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨完全性重复畸形。

HP:0010095.name: Partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010095.definition: Partial duplication of the proximal phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010095.definition_cn: 大趾近节趾骨部分重复。

HP:0010096.name: Complete duplication of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010096.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨完全重复

HP:0010097.name: Partial duplication of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010097.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨部分重复

HP:0010098.name: Complete duplication of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010098.definition: A developmental defect consisting in the complete duplication of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010098.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，表现为第一跖骨完全重复。

HP:0010099.name: Partial duplication of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010099.definition: A developmental defect consisting in the duplication of part of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010099.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，表现为第一跖骨部分重复。

HP:0010100.name: Complete duplication of hallux phalanx
HP:0010100.definition: Complete duplication of one or more phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010100.name_cn: 完全性拇趾指骨重复畸形
HP:0010100.definition_cn: 大趾一或多个指骨的完全重复。

HP:0010101.name: Partial duplication of the phalanges of the hallux

HP:0010102.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010103.name: Short distal phalanx of hallux
HP:0010103.definition: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the distal phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010103.definition_cn: 大趾远节指骨发育不全（远节指骨发育不良）。

HP:0010104.name: Absent first metatarsal
HP:0010104.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the absence of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010104.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为第一跖骨缺失。

HP:0010106.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010107.name: Short proximal phalanx of hallux
HP:0010107.definition: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of the proximal phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010107.definition_cn: 大趾近节指骨发育不全（近节指骨发育不良）。

HP:0010109.name: Short hallux
HP:0010109.definition_cn: 大脚趾发育不全（大脚趾发育不良）。

HP:0010110.name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the hallux

HP:0010111.name: Short phalanx of hallux
HP:0010111.definition: Underdevelopment (hypoplasia) of a phalanx of big toe.
HP:0010111.definition_cn: 大趾指骨发育不全（指骨发育不良）。

HP:0010112.name: Mesoaxial foot polydactyly
HP:0010112.definition: The presence of a supernumerary toe (not a hallux) involving the third or fourth metatarsal with associated osseous syndactyly.
HP:0010112.definition_cn: 存在涉及第三或第四跖骨的额外趾（非拇趾）并伴有骨性并趾畸形。

HP:0010113.name: Absent hallux epiphysis
HP:0010113.definition: Failure to form (agenesis) of one or more epiphyses of the big toe.
HP:0010113.definition_cn: 大趾一个或多个骨骺未形成（骨骺发育不全）。

HP:0010117.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the hallux

HP:0010122.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the hallux
HP:0010122.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the hallux.
HP:0010122.definition_cn: 拇趾骨骺内出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0010124.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010124.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨骨骺异常

HP:0010125.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010125.definition: In contrast to the metatarsals 2-5, the first metatarsal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, whereas the proximal phalanx of the big toe is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits. This term applies to abnormalities of the epiphysis of the first metatarsal bone.
HP:0010125.definition_cn: 与第2至第5跖骨不同，第一跖骨在胚胎学上起源于趾骨，因此相当于第2至第5趾的近节趾骨，而大脚趾的近节趾骨则相当于其他趾的中节趾骨。该术语适用于第一跖骨骺的异常。

HP:0010126.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010126.definition: In contrast to the metatarsals 2-5, the first metatarsal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the digits 2-5, whereas the proximal phalanx of the big toe is equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits. This term applies to abnormalities affecting the proximal phalanx of the hallux.
HP:0010126.name_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨骨骺异常
HP:0010126.definition_cn: 与第2-5跖骨不同，第一跖骨在胚胎学上起源于趾骨，因此相当于第2-5趾的近节趾骨，而大脚趾的近节趾骨则相当于其他趾的中节趾骨。该术语适用于影响拇趾近节趾骨的异常。

HP:0010127.name: Absent epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010127.definition: Failure to form (agenesis) of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux.
HP:0010127.name_cn: 第一近节趾骨骨骺缺失
HP:0010127.definition_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨骺形成障碍（骨骺发育不全）。

HP:0010128.name: Bracket epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010128.definition: The epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux surrounds the diaphysis, having a bracket-like form.
HP:0010128.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨骨骺支架
HP:0010128.definition_cn: 拇趾近节指骨骨骺环绕骨干，呈托架状。

HP:0010129.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010129.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨锥形骨骺

HP:0010130.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010130.name_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨骨骺增大

HP:0010131.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010132.name: Irregular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010132.name_cn: 踇趾近节趾骨骨骺不规则

HP:0010133.name: Ivory epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010133.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨象牙样骨骺

HP:0010134.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010134.definition: A pseudoepiphysis (an accessory epiphysis that does not significantly contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone) located in the proximal phalanx of the big toe.
HP:0010134.definition_cn: 位于大脚趾近节指骨的假骨骺（一种不显著参与管状骨纵向生长的副骨骺）。

HP:0010135.name: Small epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010136.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010136.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the proximal phalanx of the hallux.
HP:0010136.name_cn: 拇趾近节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0010136.definition_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨骨骺区出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0010137.name: Triangular epiphysis of the proximal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010137.name_cn: 拇趾近节趾骨三角形骨骺

HP:0010138.name: Absent epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010138.definition: Failure to form (agenesis) of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux.
HP:0010138.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨骨骺缺失
HP:0010138.definition_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨骨骺形成不全（骨骺发育不全）。

HP:0010139.name: Bracket epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010139.definition: The epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux surrounds the diaphysis, having a bracket-like form.
HP:0010139.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨骨骺支架
HP:0010139.definition_cn: 拇趾远节指骨骨骺环绕骨干，呈托架状。

HP:0010140.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010140.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨锥形骨骺

HP:0010141.name: Enlarged epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010141.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨骨骺增大

HP:0010142.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010142.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨骨骺碎裂

HP:0010143.name: Irregular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010143.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨骨骺不规则

HP:0010144.name: Ivory epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010144.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨象牙样骨骺

HP:0010145.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010146.name: Small epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux

HP:0010147.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010147.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of the distal phalanx of the hallux.
HP:0010147.name_cn: 拇趾远节指骨骺点状钙化
HP:0010147.definition_cn: 拇趾远端指骨骨骺内出现异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化灶。

HP:0010148.name: Triangular epiphysis of the distal phalanx of the hallux
HP:0010148.name_cn: 拇趾远节趾骨三角骨骺

HP:0010149.name: Absent epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010149.definition: Failure to form (agenesis) of the epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal.
HP:0010149.definition_cn: 第一跖骨骨骺形成障碍（骨骺发育不全）。

HP:0010150.name: Bracket epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010150.definition: The epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal surrounds the diaphysis, having a bracket-like form.
HP:0010150.definition_cn: 第一跖骨骨骺环绕骨干，呈托架状。

HP:0010151.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010151.definition: A conical (cone-shaped) appearance of the epiphysis of the first metatarsal of the foot.
HP:0010151.definition_cn: 第一跖骨骨骺呈圆锥形（锥状）外观。

HP:0010153.name: Fragmentation of the epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal

HP:0010155.name: Ivory epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010155.definition: The epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal appears hard and dense like ivory. An ivory epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.
HP:0010155.definition_cn: 第一跖骨骨骺呈现象牙样硬度和密度。在X线片上，象牙样骨骺表现为均匀致密的外观。

HP:0010158.name: Stippling of the epiphysis of the 1st metatarsal
HP:0010158.name_cn: 第一跖骨骨骺点状钙化

HP:0010162.name: Absent epiphyses of the toes
HP:0010162.definition: Absence of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the toes.

HP:0010166.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the toes

HP:0010171.name: Epiphyseal stippling of toe phalanges
HP:0010171.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of phalanges of the toes.
HP:0010171.definition_cn: 趾骨骨骺内出现异常点状（斑点状、点样）钙化灶。

HP:0010173.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the toes
HP:0010173.name_cn: 趾骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010174.name: Broad phalanx of the toes
HP:0010174.definition: Increased width of phalanx of one or more toes.
HP:0010174.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾指骨宽度增加。

HP:0010175.name: Bullet-shaped toe phalanx
HP:0010175.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more phalanges of the toes, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010175.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾指骨的形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010176.name: Curved toe phalanx
HP:0010176.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of one or more toe phalanges.
HP:0010176.definition_cn: 一个或多个趾骨偏离正常直线形态的异常。

HP:0010177.name: Osteolytic defects of the phalanges of the toes

HP:0010178.name: Patchy sclerosis of toe phalanx
HP:0010178.definition: Uneven (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the foot.
HP:0010178.definition_cn: 足部一个或多个趾骨骨密度不均匀（不规则）增加。

HP:0010179.name: Symphalangism affecting the phalanges of the toes

HP:0010180.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the toes

HP:0010181.name: Duplication of phalanx of toe
HP:0010181.definition: Partial/complete duplication of one or more phalanx of toe.
HP:0010181.definition_cn: 部分/完全性趾骨重复畸形。

HP:0010182.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanges of the toes

HP:0010183.name: Abnormality of the middle phalanges of the toes

HP:0010184.name: Abnormality of toe proximal phalanx
HP:0010184.definition: A morphological anomaly of one or more proximal phalanges of one or more toes.
HP:0010184.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾近节趾骨形态学异常。

HP:0010185.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the distal phalanges of the toes
HP:0010185.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the distal phalanges of the toes.
HP:0010185.name_cn: 趾骨远端发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010185.definition_cn: 趾骨远端缺如或发育不全。

HP:0010186.name: Broad distal phalanx of the toes
HP:0010186.definition: Increased width of the distal phalanx of toe of one or more toes.
HP:0010186.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾远节趾骨宽度增加。

HP:0010187.name: Bullet-shaped distal toe phalanx
HP:0010187.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more distal phalanges of the toes, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010187.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾远端指骨的形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010188.name: Curved distal toe phalanx
HP:0010188.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of one or more distal toe phalanges.
HP:0010188.definition_cn: 一个或多个远端趾骨偏离正常直线形态的异常。

HP:0010189.name: Osteolytic defects of the distal phalanges of the toes

HP:0010190.name: Patchy sclerosis of distal toe phalanx
HP:0010190.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the distal phalanges of the toes. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0010190.definition_cn: 趾骨远端一个或多个骨密度斑片状（不规则）增高。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可呈现多种形态。

HP:0010191.name: Symphalangism affecting the distal phalanges of the toes

HP:0010192.name: Triangular shaped distal phalanges of the toes

HP:0010193.name: Duplication of distal phalanx of toe
HP:0010193.definition: A partial or complete duplication of one or more distal phalanx of toe.
HP:0010193.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾远端指骨的部分或完全重复。

HP:0010194.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the middle phalanges of the toes
HP:0010194.name_cn: 趾中节指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010195.name: Broad middle phalanges of the toes

HP:0010196.name: Bullet-shaped middle toe phalanx
HP:0010196.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more middle phalanges of the toes, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010196.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾中节指骨形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010197.name: Curved middle toe phalanx
HP:0010197.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of one or more middle toe phalanges.
HP:0010197.definition_cn: 一个或多个中趾指骨偏离正常直线形态的异常。

HP:0010198.name: Osteolytic defects of the middle phalanges of the toes
HP:0010198.name_cn: 趾中节指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0010199.name: Patchy sclerosis of middle toe phalanx
HP:0010199.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the middle phalanges of the toes. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0010199.definition_cn: 趾中节骨（middle phalanges）一处或多处出现斑片状（不规则）骨密度增高。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可表现为多种形态。

HP:0010200.name: Symphalangism affecting the middle phalanges of the toes
HP:0010200.name_cn: 影响趾中节指骨的指节融合症

HP:0010201.name: Triangular shaped middle phalanges of the toes

HP:0010202.name: Duplication of middle phalanx of toe
HP:0010202.definition: Partial or complete duplication of a middle phalanx of toe.
HP:0010202.definition_cn: 趾中节指骨部分或完全重复。

HP:0010203.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of proximal toe phalanx
HP:0010203.definition: Absence (agenesis) or underdevelopment of the proximal phalanx of the toe.
HP:0010203.name_cn: 近端趾骨发育不全/发育不良
HP:0010203.definition_cn: 趾近节指骨缺失（发育不全）或发育不良。

HP:0010204.name: Broad proximal phalanx of toe
HP:0010204.definition: An increase in width of one ore more proximal toe phalanges.
HP:0010204.definition_cn: 一个或多个近节趾骨宽度增加。

HP:0010205.name: Bullet-shaped proximal toe phalanx
HP:0010205.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more of the proximal phalanges of the toes, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010205.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾近节指骨的形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010206.name: Curved proximal toe phalanx
HP:0010206.definition: A deviation from the normal straight shape of a proximal phalanx of one or more toes.
HP:0010206.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾的近节趾骨偏离正常直线形态的异常。

HP:0010207.name: Osteolytic defect of the proximal toe phalanx
HP:0010207.definition: Dissolution or degeneration of bone tissue of the proximal toe phalanx.
HP:0010207.definition_cn: 近节趾骨骨组织溶解或退行性变。

HP:0010208.name: Patchy sclerosis of proximal toe phalanx
HP:0010208.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the proximal phalanges of the toes. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0010208.definition_cn: 一个或多个足趾近节趾骨密度呈斑片状（不规则）增高。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可呈现多种形态。

HP:0010209.name: Symphalangism affecting the proximal phalanges of the toes

HP:0010210.name: Triangular shaped proximal phalanges of the toes

HP:0010211.name: Duplication of proximal phalanx of toe
HP:0010211.definition: Partial/complete duplication of a proximal phalanx of toe.
HP:0010211.definition_cn: 趾近节指骨部分/完全重复。

HP:0010212.name: Flexion contracture of the hallux
HP:0010212.definition: One or more bent (flexed) joints of the first (big) toe that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010212.definition_cn: 一个或多个第一跖趾关节（大脚趾）屈曲畸形，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010213.name: Contracture of the tarsometatarsal joint of the hallux
HP:0010213.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in the tarsometatarsal joint of the hallux due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. The tarsometatarsal joints of the feet are also called Lisfranc's joints.
HP:0010213.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织的结构改变导致的拇趾跗跖关节慢性运动丧失。足部的跗跖关节也称为Lisfranc关节。

HP:0010214.name: Contracture of the interphalangeal joint of the hallux
HP:0010214.definition: The interphalangeal joint of the big toe cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010214.definition_cn: 拇趾指间关节无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010215.name: Contractures of the metatarsophalangeal joint of the hallux
HP:0010215.definition: The joint between the first metatarsal and the proximal phalanx of the first (big) toe cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010215.definition_cn: 第一跖骨与第一（大）趾近节趾骨之间的关节无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010219.name: Structural foot deformity
HP:0010219.definition: A foot deformity resulting due to an abnormality affecting the bones of the foot (as well as muscle and soft tissue). In contrast if only the muscle and soft tissue are affected the term positional foot deformity applies.
HP:0010219.definition_cn: 由于足部骨骼（以及肌肉和软组织）异常导致的足部畸形。相反，如果仅影响肌肉和软组织，则称为体位性足部畸形。

HP:0010220.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the 2nd metacarpal
HP:0010220.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphysis of the second metacarpal bone.
HP:0010220.definition_cn: 第二掌骨骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010221.name: obsolete Pseudoepiphysis of the 2nd metacarpal
HP:0010221.name_cn: 第二掌骨陈旧性假骨骺

HP:0010222.name: Abnormal 3rd metacarpal epiphysis morphology
HP:0010222.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphysis of the third metacarpal bone.
HP:0010222.definition_cn: 第三掌骨骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010223.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the 3rd metacarpal
HP:0010223.definition: The normal epiphysis of the third metacarpal is localized at the distal end of the metacarpal bone. This term applies if an accessory epiphysis, located at the proximal end of the metacarpal bone, is present.
HP:0010223.definition_cn: 第三掌骨的正常骨骺位于掌骨的远端。若存在位于掌骨近端的副骨骺，则适用此术语。

HP:0010224.name: Abnormal 4th metacarpal epiphysis morphology
HP:0010224.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphysis of the 4th metacarpal bone.
HP:0010224.name_cn: 第四掌骨骨骺形态异常
HP:0010224.definition_cn: 第四掌骨骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010225.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the 4th metacarpal
HP:0010225.definition: The normal epiphysis of the fourth metacarpal is localized at the distal end of the metacarpal bone. This term applies if an accessory epiphysis, located at the proximal end of the metacarpal bone, is present.
HP:0010225.definition_cn: 第四掌骨的正常骨骺位于掌骨远端。若存在位于掌骨近端的副骨骺，则适用此术语。

HP:0010226.name: Abnormal 5th metacarpal epiphysis morphology
HP:0010226.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphysis of the fifth metacarpal bone.
HP:0010226.name_cn: 第五掌骨骨骺形态异常
HP:0010226.definition_cn: 第五掌骨骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010227.name: Pseudoepiphysis of the 5th metacarpal
HP:0010227.definition: The normal epiphysis of the fifth metacarpal is localized at the distal end of the metacarpal bone. This term applies if an accessory epiphysis, located at the proximal end of the metacarpal bone, is present.
HP:0010227.definition_cn: 第五掌骨的正常骨骺位于掌骨远端。若存在位于掌骨近端的副骨骺，则适用此术语。

HP:0010228.name: Absent epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010228.definition: Absence of one or more epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers.

HP:0010229.name: Bracket epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010229.definition: Bracket epiphysis refers to an abnormality in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0010229.definition_cn: Bracket epiphysis（括号状骨骺）是指一种异常现象，其中骨骺围绕指骨，呈括号状形态，并从指骨的近端延伸至远端。

HP:0010230.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010230.definition: A cone-shaped appearance of the epiphyses of the fingers of the hand, producing a 'ball-in-a-socket' appearance. The related entity 'angel-shaped' epiphysis refers to a pronounced cone-shaped epiphysis in combination with a pseudoepiphysis at the distal end of a phalanx.
HP:0010230.definition_cn: 手指骨骺呈锥形外观，形成“球窝”状表现。相关术语“天使形”骨骺指的是显著的锥形骨骺合并指骨远端的假骨骺。

HP:0010231.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010231.definition: Abnormally large size of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0010231.definition_cn: 指骨骨骺相对于年龄相关标准的异常增大。

HP:0010232.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010232.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers.

HP:0010233.name: Irregular epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010233.definition: Irregular radiographic opacity of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers.
HP:0010233.definition_cn: 指骨骨骺不规则放射学密度影。

HP:0010234.name: Ivory epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010234.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0010234.definition_cn: 指骨骨骺硬化，导致X线影像中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙样外观）。

HP:0010235.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010235.definition: A secondary ossification center in the phalanges of the hand that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0010235.definition_cn: 手部指骨中的次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0010236.name: Small epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010236.definition: Abnormally small size of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0010236.definition_cn: 指骨骨骺相对于年龄相关标准异常缩小。

HP:0010237.name: Epiphyseal stippling of finger phalanges
HP:0010237.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in the epiphyses of phalanges of the fingers.
HP:0010237.definition_cn: 手指指骨骨骺内出现异常点状（斑点状、点样）钙化灶。

HP:0010238.name: Triangular epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand
HP:0010238.definition: A triangular appearance of the epiphyses of the phalanges of the fingers of the hand.
HP:0010238.definition_cn: 手指指骨骨骺呈三角形外观。

HP:0010239.name: Aplasia of the middle phalanx of the hand
HP:0010239.definition: Absence of one or more middle phalanx of a finger.

HP:0010241.name: Short proximal phalanx of finger
HP:0010241.definition: Congenital hypoplasia of one or more proximal phalanx of finger.
HP:0010241.definition_cn: 先天性手指近节指骨发育不全。

HP:0010242.name: Aplasia of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010243.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the distal phalanx of finger
HP:0010243.definition: Any anomaly of distal epiphysis of phalanx of finger.
HP:0010243.definition_cn: 手指远节指骨骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010244.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand

HP:0010245.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010246.name: Absent epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010247.name: Bracket epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010247.definition: An abnormality of the distal phalanges of the hand in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0010247.name_cn: 手远节指骨的骨骺支架
HP:0010247.definition_cn: 手部远端指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0010248.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010249.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010249.name_cn: 手部远端指骨骨骺增大

HP:0010250.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010251.name: Irregular epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010251.name_cn: 手远节指骨不规则骨骺

HP:0010252.name: Ivory epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010252.definition: Distal epiphyses of the hand are hard and dense like ivory. Such an epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.
HP:0010252.name_cn: 手远端指骨的象牙骨骺
HP:0010252.definition_cn: 手部远端骨骺坚硬致密如象牙。此类骨骺在X线片上呈现均匀致密的外观。

HP:0010253.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010253.definition: A secondary ossification center in the distal phalanges of the hand that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0010253.definition_cn: 手部远端指骨中的次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0010254.name: Small epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010255.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010255.name_cn: 手部远端指骨骨骺点状钙化

HP:0010256.name: Triangular epiphyses of the distal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010256.name_cn: 手远节指骨三角形骨骺

HP:0010257.name: Absent epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand

HP:0010258.name: Bracket epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010258.definition: An abnormality of the middle phalanges of the hand in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0010258.name_cn: 手中节指骨的骨骺支架
HP:0010258.definition_cn: 手部中节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0010259.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand

HP:0010260.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010260.name_cn: 手部中节指骨骨骺增大

HP:0010261.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010261.definition: Fragmented appearance of the epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand.
HP:0010261.definition_cn: 手部中节指骨骨骺的碎裂样外观。

HP:0010262.name: Irregular epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010262.name_cn: 手中节指骨骨骺不规则

HP:0010263.name: Ivory epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010263.definition: Epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand are hard and dense like ivory. Such an epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.
HP:0010263.name_cn: 手中节指骨的象牙骨骺
HP:0010263.definition_cn: 手部中节指骨的骨骺坚硬且致密，类似象牙。在X线片上，此类骨骺呈现均匀致密的外观。

HP:0010264.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010264.definition: A secondary ossification center in the middle phalanges of the hand that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0010264.name_cn: 手部中节指骨的假骨骺
HP:0010264.definition_cn: 手部中节指骨中的次级骨化中心，与不参与管状骨纵向生长的正常骨骺不同。

HP:0010265.name: Small epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand

HP:0010266.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010266.name_cn: 手部中节指骨骺点状钙化

HP:0010267.name: Triangular epiphyses of the middle phalanges of the hand
HP:0010267.name_cn: 手中节指骨的三角形骨骺

HP:0010268.name: Absent epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010269.name: Bracket epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010269.definition: An abnormality of the proximal phalanges of the hand in which the epiphysis surrounds a phalangeal bone, having a bracket-like form and reaching from the proximal side of a phalanx to the distal side.
HP:0010269.name_cn: 手近节指骨的骨骺支架
HP:0010269.definition_cn: 手近节指骨异常，表现为骨骺环绕指骨，呈括号状，从指骨近端延伸至远端。

HP:0010270.name: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010271.name: Enlarged epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010272.name: Fragmentation of the epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010273.name: Irregular epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010273.name_cn: 手近节指骨骨骺不规则

HP:0010274.name: Ivory epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010274.definition: Epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand are hard and dense like ivory. Such an epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.
HP:0010274.name_cn: 手近节指骨的象牙骨骺
HP:0010274.definition_cn: 手近节指骨的骨骺坚硬且致密，如象牙般。此类骨骺在X线片上呈现均匀致密的外观。

HP:0010275.name: Pseudoepiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010275.definition: A secondary ossification center in the proximal phalanges of the hand that is distinct from the normal epiphysis that does not contribute to the longitudinal growth of a tubular bone.
HP:0010275.definition_cn: 近节指骨次级骨化中心，与正常骨骺不同，不参与管状骨的纵向生长。

HP:0010276.name: Small epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand

HP:0010277.name: Stippling of the epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010277.name_cn: 近节指骨骨骺点状钙化

HP:0010278.name: Triangular epiphyses of the proximal phalanges of the hand
HP:0010278.name_cn: 手近节指骨的三角形骨骺

HP:0010280.name: Stomatitis
HP:0010280.definition: Stomatitis is an inflammation of the mucous membranes of any of the structures in the mouth.
HP:0010280.definition_cn: 口腔炎是指口腔内任何结构黏膜的炎症。

HP:0010281.name: Cleft lower lip
HP:0010281.definition: A gap in the lower lip.

HP:0010282.name: Thin lower lip vermilion
HP:0010282.definition: Height of the vermilion of the medial part of the lower lip more than 2 SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently reduced height of the vermilion of the lower lip in the frontal view (subjective).
HP:0010282.definition_cn: 下唇内侧部唇红高度低于平均值2个标准差以上。或正面观下唇唇红高度明显降低（主观判断）。

HP:0010284.name: Intra-oral hyperpigmentation
HP:0010284.definition: Increased pigmentation, either focal or generalized, of the mucosa of the mouth.
HP:0010284.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜色素沉着增加，可为局灶性或弥漫性。

HP:0010285.name: Oral synechia
HP:0010285.definition: Fibrous band between the mucosal surfaces of the upper and lower alveolar ridges.
HP:0010285.definition_cn: 上下牙槽嵴黏膜表面之间的纤维带。

HP:0010286.name: Abnormal salivary gland morphology
HP:0010286.definition: Any abnormality of the salivary glands, the exocrine glands that produce saliva.
HP:0010286.definition_cn: 唾液腺异常，即产生唾液的外分泌腺出现任何异常。

HP:0010287.name: Abnormality of the submandibular glands
HP:0010287.definition: Any abnormality of the submandibular glands, which are the salivary glands that are located beneath the floor of the mouth, superior to the digastric muscles.
HP:0010287.definition_cn: 下颌下腺异常，即位于口底下方、二腹肌上方的唾液腺出现任何异常。

HP:0010288.name: Abnormality of the sublingual glands
HP:0010288.definition: Any abnormality of the sublingual glands, which are the salivary glands that are located beneath the floor of the mouth anterior to the submandibular glands.
HP:0010288.definition_cn: 舌下腺异常，即位于口腔底部、下颌下腺前方的唾液腺出现任何异常。

HP:0010289.name: Cleft maxillary alveolar ridge
HP:0010289.definition: A gap (cleft) affecting one of the alveolar ridges, which are the protuberances in the mouth that contain the sockets (alveoli) of the teeth. An alveolar cleft can affect all structures of the alveolar ridge, including the gingiva, other mucosa, periosteum, alveolar bone, and teeth. Alveolar cleft occurs in response to divergence from normal development during frontonasal prominence growth, contact, and fusion. The most common alveolar portion of the cleft is located between the lateral incisor and the canine.
HP:0010289.definition_cn: 影响牙槽嵴之一的裂隙（裂口），牙槽嵴是口腔中包含牙齿牙槽（牙槽窝）的突起。牙槽裂可影响牙槽嵴的所有结构，包括牙龈、其他黏膜、骨膜、牙槽骨和牙齿。牙槽裂的发生是由于在额鼻突生长、接触和融合过程中偏离正常发育所致。最常见的牙槽裂部位位于侧切牙和尖牙之间。

HP:0010290.name: Short hard palate
HP:0010290.definition: Distance between the labial point of the incisive papilla to the midline junction of the hard and soft palate more than 2 SD below the mean (objective) or apparently decreased length of the hard palate (subjective).
HP:0010290.definition_cn: 切牙乳头唇侧点至硬腭与软腭中线交界处的距离低于平均值2个标准差（客观）或硬腭长度明显缩短（主观）。

HP:0010291.name: Prominent palatine ridges
HP:0010291.definition: Increased size and/or number of soft tissue folds on the palatal side of the maxillary alveolar ridge.
HP:0010291.definition_cn: 上颌牙槽嵴腭侧软组织皱襞大小和/或数量增加。

HP:0010293.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the uvula
HP:0010293.definition: Underdevelopment or absence of the uvula.
HP:0010293.name_cn: 悬雍垂发育不全/悬雍垂发育不良
HP:0010293.definition_cn: 悬雍垂发育不全或缺如。

HP:0010294.name: Palate fistula
HP:0010294.definition: A fistula which connects the oral cavity and the pharyngeal area via the aspects of the soft palate.
HP:0010294.definition_cn: 连接口腔与咽部区域的瘘管，经由软腭部位。

HP:0010295.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the tongue
HP:0010295.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the tongue.
HP:0010295.name_cn: 舌发育不全/舌发育不良

HP:0010296.name: Ankyloglossia
HP:0010296.definition: Short or anteriorly attached lingual frenulum, associated with limited mobility of the tongue.
HP:0010296.definition_cn: 舌系带过短或附着前移，伴舌活动受限。

HP:0010297.name: Bifid tongue
HP:0010297.definition: Tongue with a median apical indentation or fork.
HP:0010297.definition_cn: 舌正中顶端凹陷或分叉。

HP:0010298.name: Smooth tongue
HP:0010298.definition: Glossy appearance of the entire tongue surface.
HP:0010298.definition_cn: 舌面整体呈现光泽样外观。

HP:0010300.name: Abnormally low-pitched voice
HP:0010300.definition: A persistent (minutes to hours) abnormal decrease in the pitch of the voice for the context or social situation or significantly different from the baseline of the individual.
HP:0010300.definition_cn: 持续性（数分钟至数小时）的语音音调异常降低，与语境或社交情境不符，或显著偏离个体的基线水平。

HP:0010301.name: Spinal dysraphism
HP:0010301.definition: A heterogeneous group of congenital spinal anomalies that result from defective closure of the neural tube early in fetal life.
HP:0010301.definition_cn: 一组异质性先天性脊柱异常，源于胎儿早期神经管闭合缺陷。

HP:0010302.name: Spinal cord tumor
HP:0010302.definition: A neoplasm affecting the spinal cord.

HP:0010303.name: Abnormal spinal meningeal morphology
HP:0010303.definition: Any abnormality of the spinal meninges, the system of membranes (dura mater, the arachnoid mater, and the pia mater) which envelops the spinal cord.
HP:0010303.definition_cn: 脊髓被膜（硬脊膜、蛛网膜和软脊膜）系统的任何异常。

HP:0010304.name: Spinal meningeal diverticulum
HP:0010304.definition: An outpouching of the spinal meninges.

HP:0010305.name: Absence of the sacrum
HP:0010305.definition_cn: 骶骨缺失（骶骨发育不全）。

HP:0010306.name: Short thorax
HP:0010306.definition: Reduced inferior to superior extent of the thorax.

HP:0010307.name: Stridor
HP:0010307.definition: Stridor is a high pitched sound resulting from turbulent air flow in the upper airway.
HP:0010307.definition_cn: 喘鸣是一种由上呼吸道湍流气流引起的高调音。

HP:0010308.name: Asternia
HP:0010308.definition: The congenital absence of the sternum.

HP:0010309.name: Bifid sternum
HP:0010309.definition: The sternal cleft is a rare congenital anomaly resulting from a fusion failure of the sternum.
HP:0010309.definition_cn: 胸骨裂是一种罕见的先天性畸形，由胸骨融合失败所致。

HP:0010310.name: Chylothorax
HP:0010310.definition: Accumulation of excessive amounts of lymphatic fluid (chyle) in the pleural cavity.
HP:0010310.definition_cn: 胸腔内淋巴液（乳糜）过量积聚。

HP:0010311.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the breasts
HP:0010311.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the breasts.
HP:0010311.name_cn: 乳房发育不全/乳房发育不良

HP:0010313.name: Breast hypertrophy
HP:0010313.definition: The presence of hypertrophy of the breast.

HP:0010315.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the diaphragm
HP:0010315.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the diaphragm.
HP:0010315.name_cn: 膈肌发育不全/膈肌发育不良

HP:0010316.name: Ebstein anomaly of the tricuspid valve
HP:0010316.definition: Ebstein's anomaly refers to an abnormally placed and deformed tricuspid valve characterized by apical displacement of the septal and posterior tricuspid valve leaflets, leading to atrialization of the right ventricle with a variable degree of malformation and displacement of the anterior leaflet.
HP:0010316.definition_cn: 埃布斯坦畸形（Ebstein's anomaly）是指三尖瓣位置异常及形态畸形，其特征为三尖瓣隔叶和后叶向心尖部移位，导致右心室心房化，并伴有不同程度的前叶畸形和移位。

HP:0010318.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the abdominal wall musculature
HP:0010318.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the abdominal musculature.
HP:0010318.name_cn: 腹壁肌肉发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010319.name: Abnormal second toe morphology
HP:0010319.definition: An anomaly of the second toe.

HP:0010320.name: Abnormal third toe morphology
HP:0010320.definition: An anomaly of the third toe.

HP:0010321.name: Abnormal fourth toe morphology
HP:0010321.definition: An anomaly of the fourth toe.

HP:0010322.name: Abnormal fifth toe morphology
HP:0010322.definition: An anomaly of the little toe.

HP:0010323.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 2nd toe

HP:0010324.name: Abnormal morphology of phalanx of the 2nd toe
HP:0010324.definition: An anomaly of a phalanx of second toe.

HP:0010325.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 2nd toe
HP:0010325.name_cn: 第二趾发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010327.name: Flexion contracture of the 2nd toe
HP:0010327.definition: One or more bent (flexed) joints of the second toe that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010327.definition_cn: 第二趾一处或多处关节屈曲畸形，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010329.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 3rd toe

HP:0010330.name: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 3rd toe

HP:0010331.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 3rd toe
HP:0010331.name_cn: 第三趾发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010333.name: Flexion contracture of 3rd toe
HP:0010333.definition: One or more bent (flexed) joints of the third toe that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010333.definition_cn: 第三趾一个或多个关节屈曲畸形，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010335.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 4th toe

HP:0010336.name: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 4th toe

HP:0010337.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 4th toe
HP:0010337.name_cn: 第四趾发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010339.name: Flexion contracture of the 4th toe
HP:0010339.definition: One or more bent (flexed) joints of the fourth toe that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010339.definition_cn: 第四趾一处或多处关节屈曲畸形，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010341.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the 5th toe

HP:0010342.name: Abnormality of the phalanges of the 5th toe

HP:0010343.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the 5th toe
HP:0010343.name_cn: 第五趾发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010345.name: Flexion contracture of the 5th toe
HP:0010345.definition: One or more bent (flexed) joints of the fifth toe that cannot be straightened actively or passively.
HP:0010345.definition_cn: 第五趾一个或多个关节屈曲畸形，无法主动或被动伸直。

HP:0010347.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the 2nd toe
HP:0010347.name_cn: 第二趾指骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0010349.name: Bullet-shaped 2nd toe phalanx
HP:0010349.definition: An abnormal morphology of one or more phalanges of the second toe, with a short and wide phalanx that tapers distally. Bullet-shaped phalanges lack the normal diaphyseal constriction.
HP:0010349.definition_cn: 第二趾的一节或多节指骨形态异常，表现为短而宽的指骨，远端逐渐变细。子弹形指骨缺乏正常的骨干缩窄。

HP:0010350.name: Curved 2nd toe phalanx
HP:0010350.definition: A deviation from the normal straight form of one or more phalanges of the second toe.
HP:0010350.definition_cn: 第二趾一个或多个趾骨偏离正常直线形态的畸形。

HP:0010351.name: Osteolytic defects of the phalanges of the 2nd toe
HP:0010351.name_cn: 第二趾指骨溶骨性缺损

HP:0010352.name: Patchy sclerosis of 2nd toe phalanx
HP:0010352.definition: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density of one or more of the phalanges of the second toe. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0010352.definition_cn: 第二趾一或多个指骨的不规则（斑片状）骨密度增加。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可呈现多种形态。

HP:0010353.name: Second toe symphalangism
HP:0010353.definition: Fusion of the interphalangeal joints of the 2nd toe.
HP:0010353.definition_cn: 第二趾趾间关节融合术。

HP:0010354.name: Triangular shaped phalanges of the 2nd toe

HP:0010355.name: Duplication of the phalanges of the 2nd toe
HP:0010355.definition: Partial or complete duplication of a phalanx of second toe.
HP:0010355.definition_cn: 第二趾指骨部分或完全重复。

HP:0010356.name: Abnormality of the distal phalanx of the 2nd toe

HP:0010357.name: Abnormality of the middle phalanx of the 2nd toe

HP:0010438.definition: A structural abnormality of the interventricular septum.

HP:0010440.name: Ectopic accessory toe-like appendage
HP:0010440.definition: In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the fibular side of the foot, next top the little toe), preaxial (on the tibial side of the foot, next to the big toe) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between big and little toe), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).
HP:0010440.definition_cn: 与多指畸形（其中多余指可为发育不全或完全正常的指）位于轴后（足腓侧，邻近小趾）、轴前（足胫侧，邻近大趾）或轴中（位于大趾与小趾之间的中央区域）不同，多余指亦可异位生长，即位于轴后、轴中或轴前以外的任何位置。在文献中，这种情况有时被称为“紊乱样综合征”（OMIM223200）。

HP:0010441.name: Ectopic accessory finger-like appendage
HP:0010441.definition: In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the ulnar side of the hand, next to the little finger), preaxial (on the radial side of the hand, next to the thumb) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between thumb and little finger), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).
HP:0010441.definition_cn: 与多指畸形（其中多余指可为发育不全或完全正常的指）位于轴后（手尺侧，靠近小指）、轴前（手桡侧，靠近拇指）或轴中（位于拇指与小指之间的中央区域）不同，多余指亦可异位生长，即位于轴后、轴中或轴前以外的任何位置。在文献中，这种情况有时被称为“紊乱样综合征”（OMIM223200）。

HP:0010442.name: Polydactyly
HP:0010442.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of supernumerary fingers or toes.
HP:0010442.definition_cn: 一种先天性异常，其特征为存在多指或多趾。

HP:0010443.name: Bifid femur
HP:0010443.definition: A bifid or bifurcated appearance of the femur as seen on x-rays, possible appearing as a more or less severe bowing of the upper leg. Might be associated with hip dysplasia on the affected side.
HP:0010443.definition_cn: X线检查中可见股骨呈现分叉或双叉状外观，可能表现为不同程度的上肢弯曲。可能与患侧的髋关节发育不良相关。

HP:0010444.name: Pulmonic regurgitation
HP:0010444.definition: The retrograde (backwards) flow of blood through the pulmonary valve into the right ventricle during diastole.
HP:0010444.definition_cn: 舒张期肺动脉瓣反流导致血液逆流入右心室。

HP:0010445.name: Primum atrial septal defect
HP:0010445.definition: An ostium primum atrial septal defect is located in the most anterior and inferior aspect of the atrial septum. The ostium primum refers to an anterior and inferior opening (ostium) within the septum primum, which divides the rudimentary atrium during fetal development. The ostium primum is normally sealed by fusion of the superior and inferior endocardial cushions around 5 weeks' gestation. Ostium primum defects result from a failure of the fusion of the embryologic endocardial cushion and septum primum.
HP:0010445.definition_cn: 原发孔型房间隔缺损位于房间隔的最前下方。原发孔是指在原发隔内的一个前下方开口（孔），在胎儿发育期间，原发隔将原始心房分隔开。原发孔通常在妊娠约5周时通过上下心内膜垫的融合而封闭。原发孔型缺损是由于胚胎期心内膜垫与原发隔融合失败所致。

HP:0010446.name: Tricuspid stenosis
HP:0010446.definition: A narrowing of the orifice of the tricuspid valve of the heart.

HP:0010447.name: Anal fistula
HP:0010447.definition: An abnormal connection between the epithelialised surface of the anal canal and the perianal skin.
HP:0010447.definition_cn: 肛管上皮化表面与肛周皮肤之间的异常连接。

HP:0010448.name: Colonic atresia
HP:0010448.definition: A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the colon. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the colon.
HP:0010448.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷导致结肠管腔完全闭塞。即，结肠管状结构出现异常闭合或闭锁。

HP:0010450.name: Esophageal stenosis
HP:0010450.definition: An abnormal narrowing of the lumen of the esophagus.

HP:0010451.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the spleen
HP:0010451.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the spleen.
HP:0010451.name_cn: 脾脏发育不全/脾脏发育不良

HP:0010452.name: Ectopia of the spleen
HP:0010452.definition: An abnormal (non-anatomic) location of the spleen.

HP:0010453.name: Pelvic bone asymmetry
HP:0010453.definition: Pelvic asymmetry refers to asymmetric positioning of landmarks on the two sides of the pelvis and may have a structural or functional etiology.
HP:0010453.definition_cn: 骨盆不对称是指骨盆两侧解剖标志的位置不对称，可能具有结构性或功能性病因。

HP:0010454.name: Acetabular spurs
HP:0010454.definition: The presence of osteophytes (bone spurs), i.e., of bony projections originating from the acetabulum.
HP:0010454.definition_cn: 存在骨赘（骨刺），即源自髋臼的骨性突起。

HP:0010455.name: Steep acetabular roof
HP:0010455.definition: An exaggeration of the normal arched form of the acetabular roof such that it takes on a steep appearance.
HP:0010455.definition_cn: 髋臼顶正常弓形形态的过度夸张，使其呈现陡峭外观。

HP:0010456.name: Abnormal greater sciatic notch morphology
HP:0010456.definition: An abnormality of the sacrosciatic notch, i.e., the deep indentation in the posterior border of the hip bone at the point of union of the ilium and ischium.
HP:0010456.definition_cn: 骶坐骨切迹异常，即髂骨与坐骨结合处髋骨后缘的深凹陷。

HP:0010457.name: obsolete Widening of the sacrosciatic notch

HP:0010458.name: Female pseudohermaphroditism
HP:0010458.definition: Hermaphroditism refers to a discrepancy between the morphology of the gonads and that of the external genitalia. In female pseudohermaphroditism, the genotype is female (XX) and the gonads are ovaries, but the external genitalia are virilized.
HP:0010458.definition_cn: 雌雄同体（Hermaphroditism）指的是性腺形态与外生殖器形态之间的不一致性。在女性假两性畸形（Female Pseudohermaphroditism）中，基因型为女性（XX），性腺为卵巢，但外生殖器呈现男性化特征。

HP:0010459.name: True hermaphroditism
HP:0010459.definition: The presence of both ovarian and testicular tissues either in the same or in opposite gonads. Affected persons have ambiguous genitalia and may have 46,XX or 46,XY karyotypes or 46,XX/XY mosaicism.
HP:0010459.definition_cn: 同一或对侧性腺中同时存在卵巢和睾丸组织。患者表现为生殖器模糊，可能具有46,XX或46,XY核型或46,XX/XY嵌合体。

HP:0010460.name: Abnormality of the female genitalia
HP:0010460.definition: Abnormality of the female genital system.

HP:0010461.name: Abnormality of the male genitalia
HP:0010461.definition: Abnormality of the male genital system.

HP:0010462.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ovary
HP:0010462.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the ovary.
HP:0010462.name_cn: 卵巢发育不全/卵巢发育不良
HP:0010462.definition_cn: 卵巢发育不全或卵巢发育不良。

HP:0010463.name: Aplasia of the ovary
HP:0010463.definition: Aplasia, that is failure to develop, of the ovary.
HP:0010463.definition_cn: 卵巢发育不全（Ovarian Aplasia），即卵巢未能发育。

HP:0010464.name: Streak ovary
HP:0010464.definition: A developmental disorder characterized by the progressive loss of primordial germ cells in the developing ovaries of an embryo, leading to hypoplastic ovaries composed of wavy connective tissue with occasional clumps of granulosa cells, and frequently mesonephric or hilar cells.
HP:0010464.definition_cn: 一种发育障碍，其特征为胚胎发育过程中卵巢内原始生殖细胞进行性丧失，导致卵巢发育不全，由波浪状结缔组织组成，偶见颗粒细胞团块，并常伴有中肾或门细胞。

HP:0010465.name: Precocious puberty in females
HP:0010465.definition: The onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls.
HP:0010465.definition_cn: 女性8岁前出现青春期启动。

HP:0010468.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the testes
HP:0010468.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the testes.
HP:0010468.name_cn: 睾丸发育不全/睾丸发育不良

HP:0010469.name: Absent testis
HP:0010469.definition: Testis not palpable in the scrotum or inguinal canal.
HP:0010469.definition_cn: 睾丸未触及于阴囊或腹股沟管内。

HP:0010470.name: Supernumerary testes
HP:0010470.definition: The presence of more than two testes.

HP:0010471.name: Oligosacchariduria
HP:0010471.definition: Increased urinary excretion of oligosaccharides (low molecular weight carbohydrate chains composed of at least three monosaccharide subunits), derived from a partial degradation of glycoproteins.
HP:0010471.definition_cn: 尿液中寡糖（由至少三个单糖亚基组成的低分子量碳水化合物链）排泄增加，源于糖蛋白的部分降解。

HP:0010472.name: Abnormal circulating porphyrin concentration
HP:0010472.definition: An abnormality in the synthesis or catabolism of heme. Heme is composed of ferrous iron and protoporphyrin IX and is an essential molecule as the prosthetic group of hemeproteins such as hemoglobin, myoglobin, mitochondrial and microsomal cytochromes.
HP:0010472.definition_cn: 血红素合成或分解代谢异常。血红素由二价铁和原卟啉IX组成，是作为血红蛋白、肌红蛋白、线粒体和微粒体细胞色素等血红素蛋白的辅基的重要分子。

HP:0010473.name: Porphyrinuria
HP:0010473.definition: Abnormally increased excretion of porphyrins in the urine.

HP:0010474.name: Bladder stones
HP:0010474.definition: Buildups of minerals that form in the urinary bladder.
HP:0010474.definition_cn: 膀胱内矿物质沉积形成的结石。

HP:0010475.name: Cloacal exstrophy
HP:0010475.definition: Cloacal exstrophy is a severe anterior abdominal wall defect in which the two hemibladders are visible and are separated by a midline intestinal plate, an omphalocele, and an imperforate anus.
HP:0010475.definition_cn: 泄殖腔外翻是一种严重的腹前壁缺损，表现为两个半膀胱可见，并由中线肠板、脐膨出和无肛畸形分隔。

HP:0010476.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the bladder
HP:0010476.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the urinary bladder.
HP:0010476.name_cn: 膀胱发育不全/膀胱发育不良
HP:0010476.definition_cn: 膀胱缺失或膀胱发育不全。

HP:0010477.name: Aplasia of the bladder
HP:0010477.definition_cn: 膀胱发育不全（膀胱缺失）。

HP:0010479.name: Patent urachus
HP:0010479.definition: Persistence of the urachal canal resulting in a canal between the bladder and the umbilicus.
HP:0010479.definition_cn: 脐尿管持续存在导致膀胱与脐部之间形成通道。

HP:0010480.name: Urethral fistula
HP:0010480.definition: The presence of an abnormal connection between the urethra and another organ or the skin.
HP:0010480.definition_cn: 尿道与另一器官或皮肤之间存在异常连接。

HP:0010481.name: Urethral valve
HP:0010481.definition: The presence of an abnormal membrane obstructing the urethra.

HP:0010482.name: Acromelia of the upper limbs
HP:0010482.definition: Shortening of the arms predominantly affecting terminal parts of the arm in relation to the upper and middle limb segments.
HP:0010482.definition_cn: 上肢远端相对于近端和中段肢体节段的缩短。

HP:0010483.name: Amniotic constriction rings of arms
HP:0010483.definition: Amniotic constriction rings affecting the arms.
HP:0010483.definition_cn: 影响上肢的羊膜束带综合征。

HP:0010484.name: Hypertrophy of the upper limb
HP:0010484.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the upper limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).
HP:0010484.definition_cn: 上肢肥大症（由于细胞体积增大所致）。

HP:0010485.name: Hyperextensibility at elbow
HP:0010485.definition: The ability of the elbow joint to move beyond its normal range of motion.
HP:0010485.definition_cn: 肘关节过伸能力（Hyperextension of the elbow joint）

HP:0010486.name: Abnormality of the hypothenar eminence
HP:0010486.definition: An abnormality of the hypothenar eminence, i.e., of the muscles on the ulnar side of the palm of the hand (i.e., on the side of the little finger).
HP:0010486.definition_cn: 小鱼际隆起异常，即手掌尺侧（即小指侧）肌肉异常。

HP:0010487.name: Small hypothenar eminence
HP:0010487.definition: Reduced muscle mass on the ulnar side of the palm, that is, reduction in size of the hypothenar eminence.
HP:0010487.definition_cn: 手掌尺侧肌肉质量减少，即小鱼际隆起的体积缩小。

HP:0010488.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the palmar creases
HP:0010488.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the palmar creases.
HP:0010488.name_cn: 掌纹发育不全/掌纹发育不良

HP:0010489.name: Absent palmar crease
HP:0010489.definition: The absence of the major creases of the palm (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, or thenar crease).
HP:0010489.definition_cn: 掌部主要皱褶缺失（远端横纹、近端横纹或鱼际纹）。

HP:0010490.name: Abnormality of the palmar creases
HP:0010490.definition: An abnormality of the creases of the skin of palm of hand.

HP:0010491.name: Digital constriction ring
HP:0010491.definition: A narrow segment of significantly reduced circumference of a digit.

HP:0010492.name: Osseous finger syndactyly
HP:0010492.definition: Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones.
HP:0010492.definition_cn: 指蹼或手指融合，涉及软组织并包括单个指骨的融合。

HP:0010493.name: Long metacarpals
HP:0010493.definition: An abnormally increased length of the metacarpal bones.

HP:0010494.name: Acromelia of the lower limbs
HP:0010494.definition: Shortening of the legs predominantly affecting terminal parts of the leg in relation to the upper and middle arm segments.
HP:0010494.definition_cn: 下肢缩短主要累及下肢远端部分，相对于上臂和中臂节段。

HP:0010495.name: Amniotic constriction rings of legs
HP:0010495.definition: Amniotic constriction rings affecting the legs.
HP:0010495.definition_cn: 羊膜束带综合征累及下肢。

HP:0010496.name: Hypertrophy of the lower limb
HP:0010496.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the lower limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).
HP:0010496.definition_cn: 下肢肥大（由于细胞体积增大所致）。

HP:0010497.name: Sirenomelia
HP:0010497.definition: A developmental defect in which the legs are fused together.

HP:0010498.name: Bipartite patella
HP:0010498.definition: A developmental defect that occurs if the two halves of the patella fail to fuse in early childhood.
HP:0010498.definition_cn: 髌骨两半在幼儿期未能融合导致的发育缺陷。

HP:0010499.name: Patellar subluxation
HP:0010499.definition: The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar subluxation refers to an unstable kneecap that does not slide centrally within its groove, i.e., a partial dislocation of the patella.
HP:0010499.definition_cn: 髌骨通常位于股骨远端称为滑车的沟槽内，并可在其中上下滑动。髌骨半脱位是指髌骨在其沟槽内未能沿中央滑动，即髌骨的部分脱位。

HP:0010500.name: Hyperextensibility of the knee
HP:0010500.definition: The ability of the knee joint to extend beyond its normal range of motion (the lower leg is moved beyond a straight position with respect to the thigh).
HP:0010500.definition_cn: 膝关节过伸能力（小腿相对于大腿移动超过直线位置）。

HP:0010501.name: Limitation of knee mobility
HP:0010501.definition: An abnormal limitation of knee joint mobility.
HP:0010501.definition_cn: 膝关节活动度异常受限。

HP:0010502.name: Fibular bowing
HP:0010502.definition: A bending or abnormal curvature of the fibula.

HP:0010503.name: Fibular duplication
HP:0010503.definition: Duplication of the fibula. This may occur as a part of diplopodia (accessory tarsal or metatarsal bone). Diplopodia with double fibula is an extremely rare condition.
HP:0010503.definition_cn: 腓骨重复。这可能作为双足畸形（副跗骨或跖骨）的一部分发生。伴有双腓骨的双足畸形是一种极为罕见的病症。

HP:0010504.name: Increased length of the tibia
HP:0010504.definition: An abnormal increase in the length of the tibia.

HP:0010505.name: Limitation of movement at ankles
HP:0010505.definition: An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the ankle joint.
HP:0010505.definition_cn: 踝关节活动度异常受限。

HP:0010506.name: Abnormal plantar dermatoglyphics
HP:0010506.definition: An abnormality of dermatoglyphs on the toes and soles, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of sole of foot.
HP:0010506.definition_cn: 趾跖部皮纹异常，即足底皮肤嵴纹模式异常。

HP:0010507.name: Foot asymmetry
HP:0010507.definition: A difference in size or shape between the left and right foot.
HP:0010507.definition_cn: 左右足大小或形态不对称

HP:0010508.name: Metatarsus valgus
HP:0010508.definition: A condition in which the anterior part of the foot rotates outward away from the midline of the body and the heel remains straight.
HP:0010508.definition_cn: 一种足部前部向外侧旋转远离身体中线而足跟保持直立的病理状态。

HP:0010510.name: Hypermobility of toe joints
HP:0010510.definition: An ability of the toe joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.
HP:0010510.definition_cn: 趾关节活动度超出正常范围的异常活动能力。

HP:0010511.name: Long toe
HP:0010511.definition: Toes that appear disproportionately long compared to the foot.
HP:0010511.definition_cn: 足趾相对于足部呈现比例失调性延长。

HP:0010513.name: Pituitary calcification
HP:0010513.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the pituitary gland.

HP:0010514.name: Hyperpituitarism
HP:0010514.definition: Hypersecretion of one or more pituitary hormones. This can occur in conditions in which deficiency in the target organ leads to decreased hormonal feedback, or as a primary condition most usually in connection with a pituitary adenoma.
HP:0010514.definition_cn: 一种或多种垂体激素的过度分泌。这种情况可能发生在靶器官功能缺陷导致激素反馈减少的疾病中，或作为原发性疾病，最常见于垂体腺瘤相关的情况。

HP:0010515.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thymus
HP:0010515.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the thymus.
HP:0010515.name_cn: 胸腺发育不全/胸腺发育不良

HP:0010517.name: Ectopic thymus tissue
HP:0010517.definition: The presence of ectopic thymus tissue. Normally, cells of the ventral bud of the third pharyngeal pouch detach and migrate in the eighth gestational week caudally and medially towards the location of the mature thyroid. They migrate further retrosternally into the superior mediastinum. There are two main ways ectopic thymus tissue can develop. Either cells detach along the descensus path and proliferate, thereby forming accessory thymus tissue, or the entire gland fails to descend.
HP:0010517.definition_cn: 异位胸腺组织的存在。正常情况下，第三咽囊腹侧芽的细胞在妊娠第八周脱离并沿尾侧和内侧方向迁移至成熟甲状腺的位置。它们进一步向胸骨后迁移进入上纵隔。异位胸腺组织的形成主要有两种途径：一是细胞在下降路径中脱离并增殖，从而形成副胸腺组织；二是整个腺体未能下降。

HP:0010518.name: Thyroglossal cyst
HP:0010518.definition: An abnormality of the thyroid gland owing to the presence of a fibrous cyst resulting from the persistence of the thyroglossal duct.
HP:0010518.definition_cn: 由于甲状舌管持续存在导致的纤维性囊肿引起的甲状腺异常。

HP:0010519.name: Increased fetal movement
HP:0010519.definition: An abnormal increase in quantity or strength of fetal movements.
HP:0010519.definition_cn: 胎儿运动量或强度异常增加。

HP:0010521.name: Gait apraxia
HP:0010521.definition: Gait apraxia affecting the ability to make walking movements with the legs.
HP:0010521.definition_cn: 步态失用症影响下肢行走运动能力。

HP:0010522.name: Dyslexia
HP:0010522.definition: A learning disorder characterized primarily by difficulties in learning to read and spell. Dyslectic children also exhibit a tendency to read words from right to left and to confuse letters such as b and d whose orientation is important for their identification. Children with dyslexia appear to be impaired in phonemic skills (the ability to associate visual symbols with the sounds they represent).
HP:0010522.definition_cn: 一种以阅读和拼写困难为主要特征的学习障碍。诵读困难儿童还表现出从右向左阅读单词的倾向，并混淆字母如b和d，这些字母的方位对其识别至关重要。诵读困难儿童似乎在音素技能（将视觉符号与其所代表的声音相关联的能力）方面存在缺陷。

HP:0010523.name: Alexia
HP:0010523.definition: An acquired type of sensory aphasia where damage to the brain leads to the loss of the ability to read.
HP:0010523.definition_cn: 获得性感觉性失语症，其中脑部损伤导致阅读能力丧失。

HP:0010524.name: Disturbed sensory perception
HP:0010524.definition: Alteration or impairment in the processing or interpretation of sensory information can lead to abnormal perceptions or experiences.
HP:0010524.definition_cn: 感觉信息处理或解释的改变或损害可导致异常感知或体验。

HP:0010525.name: Finger agnosia
HP:0010525.definition: The examiner identified the inability to name, move, or touch specific fingers.
HP:0010525.definition_cn: 检查者发现患者无法命名、移动或触摸特定手指。

HP:0010526.name: Dysgraphia
HP:0010526.definition: A writing disability in the absence of motor or sensory deficits of the upper extremities, resulting in an impairment in the ability to write regardless of the ability to read and not due to intellectual impairment.
HP:0010526.definition_cn: 上肢无运动或感觉障碍情况下的书写障碍，导致书写能力受损，与阅读能力无关，且非由智力障碍引起。

HP:0010527.name: Astereognosis
HP:0010527.definition: Tactile agnosia refers to the inability to recognize objects by touch, while the inability to discriminate shape and size by touch is also a related condition.
HP:0010527.definition_cn: 触觉失认症（Tactile Agnosia）是指通过触觉无法识别物体的能力丧失，而通过触觉无法辨别形状和大小的情况也属于相关病症。

HP:0010528.name: Prosopagnosia
HP:0010528.definition: Inability to recognize faces of familiar persons.

HP:0010529.name: Echolalia
HP:0010529.definition: Echolalia is the automatic imitative repetition of sounds, words, or phrases in the absence of explicit awareness. The repeated words or phrases are typically odd or used in a non-social manner. These can be words or phrases that the affected individual has heard or invented.
HP:0010529.definition_cn: 模仿言语（Echolalia）是指在缺乏明确意识的情况下，自动模仿重复声音、词语或短语的现象。被重复的词语或短语通常显得怪异或以非社交方式使用。这些词语或短语可能是患者听到的或自创的。

HP:0010530.name: Palatal tremor
HP:0010530.definition: Palatal tremor (PT) is an involuntary, rhythmic and oscillatory movement of the soft palate. PT is a rare type of tremor involving the soft palate. It can be unilateral or bilateral.
HP:0010530.definition_cn: 腭震颤（Palatal Tremor, PT）是一种不自主的、节律性的、振荡性的软腭运动。PT是一种罕见的震颤类型，涉及软腭。它可以是单侧或双侧的。

HP:0010531.name: Spinal myoclonus
HP:0010531.definition: Spinal myoclonus is generally due to a tumor, infection, injury, or degenerative process of the spinal cord, and is characterized by involuntary rhythmic muscle contractions, usually at a rate of more than one per second. Myoclonus occurs synchronously in several muscles and can be increased in severity and frequency by fatigue or stress, but is usually unaffected by sensory stimuli. Spinal myoclonus ceases during sleep or anesthesia.
HP:0010531.definition_cn: 脊髓性肌阵挛通常由脊髓肿瘤、感染、损伤或退行性病变引起，其特征为不自主的节律性肌肉收缩，通常频率超过每秒一次。肌阵挛在多个肌肉中同步发生，其严重程度和频率可因疲劳或压力而增加，但通常不受感觉刺激的影响。脊髓性肌阵挛在睡眠或麻醉期间停止。

HP:0010533.name: Spasmus nutans
HP:0010533.definition: The combination of pendular nystagmus, head nodding, and torticollis.
HP:0010533.definition_cn: 摆动性眼球震颤、点头样动作和斜颈的组合。

HP:0010534.name: Transient global amnesia
HP:0010534.definition: A paroxysmal, transient loss of memory function with preservation of immediate recall and remote memory but with a severe impairment of memory for recent events and ability to retain new information.
HP:0010534.definition_cn: 阵发性、短暂性记忆功能丧失，即刻回忆和远期记忆保留，但对近期事件的记忆和保留新信息的能力严重受损。

HP:0010535.name: Sleep apnea
HP:0010535.definition: An intermittent cessation of airflow at the mouth and nose during sleep is known as sleep apnea. Apneas that last at least 10 seconds are considered significant, but individuals with sleep apnea may experience apneas lasting from 20 seconds up to 2 or 3 minutes. Patients may have up to 15 events per hour of sleep.
HP:0010535.definition_cn: 睡眠期间口鼻气流间歇性中断的现象称为睡眠呼吸暂停。持续时间至少10秒的呼吸暂停被认为具有临床意义，但睡眠呼吸暂停患者可能经历持续20秒至2或3分钟的呼吸暂停。患者每小时睡眠中可能发生多达15次此类事件。

HP:0010536.name: Central sleep apnea
HP:0010536.definition: Sleep apnea results from a temporary loss of the central drive to the muscles responsible for breathing.
HP:0010536.definition_cn: 睡眠呼吸暂停是由于中枢驱动暂时丧失导致负责呼吸的肌肉功能失调所致。

HP:0010537.name: Wide cranial sutures
HP:0010537.definition: An abnormally increased width of the cranial sutures for age-related norms (generally resulting from delayed closure).
HP:0010537.definition_cn: 颅缝宽度异常增宽（相对于年龄相关标准，通常由闭合延迟引起）。

HP:0010539.name: Thin calvarium
HP:0010539.definition: The presence of an abnormally thin calvarium.

HP:0010540.name: Advanced pneumatization of cranial sinuses
HP:0010540.definition: A degree of pneumatization that is increased compared to age-related norms.
HP:0010540.definition_cn: 与年龄相关标准相比，气化程度增加。

HP:0010541.name: Cutis gyrata of scalp
HP:0010541.definition: The presence of convoluted folds and furrows formed from thickened skin of the scalp, resembling cerebriform pattern. The scalp has convoluted and elevated folds, 1 to 2 cm in thickness. The convolutions generally cannot be flattened by traction.
HP:0010541.definition_cn: 头皮增厚形成迂曲的皱褶和沟纹，呈脑回状。头皮呈现迂曲且隆起的皱褶，厚度为1至2厘米。这些迂曲的皱褶通常无法通过牵引展平。

HP:0010542.name: Vestibular nystagmus
HP:0010542.definition: Nystagmus due to disturbance of the vestibular system; eye movements are rhythmic, with slow and fast components.
HP:0010542.definition_cn: 前庭系统紊乱引起的眼球震颤；眼球运动呈节律性，包含慢相和快相成分。

HP:0010543.name: Opsoclonus
HP:0010543.definition: Bursts of large-amplitude multidirectional saccades without intersaccadic interval
HP:0010543.definition_cn: 无扫视间期的大幅度多向性扫视爆发

HP:0010544.name: Vertical nystagmus
HP:0010544.definition: Vertical nystagmus may present with either up-beating or down-beating eye movements or both. When present in the straight-ahead position of gaze it is referred to as upbeat nystagmus or downbeat nystagmus.
HP:0010544.definition_cn: 垂直性眼震可表现为上跳性、下跳性或两者兼有的眼球运动。当在直视位出现时，分别称为上跳性眼震或下跳性眼震。

HP:0010545.name: Downbeat nystagmus
HP:0010545.definition: Downbeat nystagmus is a type of fixation nystagmus with the fast phase beating in a downward direction. It generally increases when looking to the side and down and when lying prone.
HP:0010545.definition_cn: 下跳性眼震是一种固定性眼震，其快相向下跳动。通常在侧视、下视及俯卧位时加重。

HP:0010546.name: Muscle fibrillation
HP:0010546.definition: Fine, rapid twitching of individual muscle fibers with little or no movement of the muscle as a whole as ascertained by electromyography (EMG). If a motor neuron or its axon is destroyed, the muscle fibers it innervates undergo denervation atrophy. This leads to hypersensitivity of individual muscle fibers to acetyl choline so that they may contract spontaneously. Isolated activity of individual muscle fibers is generally so fine it cannot be seen through the intact skin, although it can be recorded as a short-duration spike in the EMG.
HP:0010546.definition_cn: 通过肌电图（EMG）检测到的单个肌纤维的细微、快速颤动，而肌肉整体几乎没有或完全没有运动。如果运动神经元或其轴突被破坏，其支配的肌纤维会发生去神经性萎缩。这导致单个肌纤维对乙酰胆碱的超敏反应，从而可能自发收缩。单个肌纤维的孤立活动通常非常细微，无法通过完整的皮肤观察到，尽管可以在肌电图中记录为短时程的尖峰电位。

HP:0010547.name: Muscle flaccidity
