HP:0010547.definition: A type of paralysis in which a muscle becomes soft and yields to passive stretching, which results from loss of all or practically all peripheral motor nerves that innervated the muscle. Muscle tone is reduced and the affected muscles undergo extreme atrophy within months of the loss of innervation.
HP:0010547.definition_cn: 一种瘫痪类型，表现为肌肉变得松弛并易于被动拉伸，这是由于支配该肌肉的所有或几乎所有的外周运动神经丧失所致。肌张力降低，受累肌肉在失去神经支配后的数月内发生极度萎缩。

HP:0010548.name: Percussion myotonia
HP:0010548.definition: A localized myotonic contraction in a muscle in reaction to percussion (tapping with the examiner's finger, a rubber percussion hammer, or a similar object).
HP:0010548.definition_cn: 局部肌强直性收缩（Localized Myotonic Contraction）是指肌肉在受到叩击（如检查者手指、橡胶叩诊锤或类似物体的轻敲）时出现的局部肌张力增高反应。

HP:0010549.name: Weakness due to upper motor neuron dysfunction
HP:0010549.definition: Paralysis of voluntary muscles means loss of contraction due to interruption of one or more motor pathways from the brain to the muscle fibers. Although the word paralysis is often used interchangeably to mean either complete or partial loss of muscle strength, it is preferable to use paralysis or plegia for complete or severe loss of muscle strength, and paresis for partial or slight loss. Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts is related to a lesion in the corticospinal, corticobulbar or brainstem descending (subcorticospinal) neurons.
HP:0010549.name_cn: 上运动神经元功能障碍导致的肌无力
HP:0010549.definition_cn: 随意肌麻痹是指由于从大脑到肌纤维的一条或多条运动通路中断而导致的收缩功能丧失。尽管“麻痹”一词常被互换使用以表示肌力的完全或部分丧失，但更准确的做法是使用“麻痹”或“瘫痪”来表示肌力的完全或严重丧失，而使用“轻瘫”来表示肌力的部分或轻微丧失。由于主要运动传导束病变引起的麻痹与皮质脊髓束、皮质延髓束或脑干下行（皮质下脊髓）神经元的病变相关。

HP:0010550.name: Paraplegia
HP:0010550.definition: Severe or complete weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities.
HP:0010550.definition_cn: 双下肢严重或完全性无力，上肢功能保留。

HP:0010551.name: Paraplegia/paraparesis
HP:0010551.definition: Weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities. Paraplegia refers to a severe or complete loss of strength, whereas paraparesis refers to a relatively mild loss of strength.
HP:0010551.definition_cn: 双下肢无力伴上肢保留。截瘫（Paraplegia）指严重或完全的力量丧失，而轻截瘫（Paraparesis）指相对较轻的力量丧失。

HP:0010553.name: Oculogyric crisis
HP:0010553.definition: An acute dystonic reaction with blepharospasm, periorbital twitches, and protracted fixed staring episodes. There may be a maximal upward deviation of the eyes in the sustained fashion. Oculogyric crisis can be triggered by a number of factors including neuroleptic medications.
HP:0010553.definition_cn: 急性肌张力障碍反应，伴有眼睑痉挛、眶周抽搐及持续性固定凝视发作。可能出现眼球最大程度上偏斜并持续存在。动眼危象可由多种因素引发，包括抗精神病药物。

HP:0010554.name: Cutaneous finger syndactyly
HP:0010554.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal joint of the adjacent fingers.
HP:0010554.definition_cn: 在前后轴方向上，两指之间存在软组织连续性，且该连续性向远端延伸至至少近端指间关节水平；或在前后轴方向上，两指之间存在软组织连续性，且该连续性显著位于相邻手指掌指关节屈曲皱褶的远端。

HP:0010557.name: Overlapping fingers
HP:0010557.definition: A finger resting on the dorsal surface of an adjacent digit when the hand is at rest.
HP:0010557.definition_cn: 手指静息时，一指置于相邻手指背侧表面。

HP:0010558.name: Abnormality of the clivus
HP:0010558.definition: An abnormality of the clivus, which is the inclined bony region of the posterior cranial fossa located between the sella turcica and the foramen magnum.
HP:0010558.definition_cn: 斜坡异常，即位于颅后窝的倾斜骨性区域，介于蝶鞍和枕骨大孔之间。

HP:0010559.name: Vertical clivus
HP:0010559.definition: An abnormal vertical orientation of the clivus (which normally forms a kind of slope from the sella turcica down to the region of the foramen magnum).
HP:0010559.definition_cn: 斜坡异常垂直位（正常情况下，斜坡从蝶鞍向下延伸至枕骨大孔区域，形成一种倾斜结构）。

HP:0010560.name: Undulate clavicles
HP:0010560.definition: An abnormally wavy surface or edge of the clavicles.
HP:0010560.definition_cn: 锁骨表面或边缘异常波浪状改变。

HP:0010561.name: Undulate ribs
HP:0010561.definition: An abnormally wavy surface or edge of the ribs.
HP:0010561.definition_cn: 肋骨表面或边缘异常波浪状改变。

HP:0010564.name: Bifid epiglottis
HP:0010564.definition: A midline anterior-posterior cleft of the epiglottis that involves at least two-thirds of the epiglottic leaf. It is a useful feature for clinical diagnosis because it appears to be very rare in syndromes other than Pallister-Hall-Syndrome and is also rare as an isolated malformation.
HP:0010564.definition_cn: 会厌中线前后裂，累及至少三分之二的会厌叶。这一特征在临床诊断中具有重要价值，因其在除Pallister-Hall综合征外的其他综合征中极为罕见，且作为孤立性畸形亦属罕见。

HP:0010565.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the Epiglottis
HP:0010565.definition: This term applies if the Epiglottis is absent or hypoplastic.
HP:0010565.name_cn: 会厌发育不全/会厌发育不良
HP:0010565.definition_cn: 该术语适用于会厌缺失或发育不全的情况。

HP:0010566.name: Hamartoma
HP:0010566.definition: A disordered proliferation of mature tissues that is native to the site of origin, e.g., exostoses, nevi and soft tissue hamartomas. Although most hamartomas are benign, some histologic subtypes, e.g., neuromuscular hamartoma, may proliferate aggressively such as mesenchymal cystic hamartoma, Sclerosing epithelial hamartoma, Sclerosing metanephric hamartoma.
HP:0010566.definition_cn: 一种起源于原发部位的成熟组织异常增生，例如外生骨疣、痣和软组织错构瘤。尽管大多数错构瘤为良性，但某些组织学亚型，如神经肌肉错构瘤，可能表现出侵袭性增生，例如间叶性囊性错构瘤、硬化性上皮错构瘤、硬化性后肾错构瘤。

HP:0010567.name: Y-shaped metatarsals
HP:0010567.definition: Y-shaped metatarsals are the result of a partial fusion of two metatarsal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metatarsals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.
HP:0010567.definition_cn: Y形跖骨是由于两块跖骨部分融合所致，Y形的两臂向远端方向延伸。Y形跖骨可能与多指（趾）畸形同时出现。

HP:0010568.name: Hamartoma of the eye
HP:0010568.definition: A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) which can originate from any tissue of the eye.
HP:0010568.definition_cn: 错构瘤（成熟组织的无序增生），可起源于眼部的任何组织。

HP:0010569.name: Elevated circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
HP:0010569.definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0010569.name_cn: 循环中7-脱氢胆固醇浓度升高
HP:0010569.definition_cn: 血液循环中7-脱氢胆固醇浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0010570.name: Low maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
HP:0010570.definition: An abnormally low concentration of serum alpha-fetoprotein as compared to normal values for gestational-age.
HP:0010570.name_cn: 母体循环中甲胎蛋白浓度降低
HP:0010570.definition_cn: 与妊娠期正常值相比，血清甲胎蛋白浓度异常降低。

HP:0010571.name: Elevated circulating phytanic acid concentration
HP:0010571.definition: An abnormal elevation of phytanic acid.

HP:0010574.name: Abnormality of the epiphysis of the femoral head
HP:0010574.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0010574.definition_cn: 股骨近端骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010575.name: Dysplasia of the femoral head
HP:0010575.definition: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the femoral head.
HP:0010575.definition_cn: 股骨头发育不良的存在。

HP:0010576.name: Intracranial cystic lesion
HP:0010576.definition: A cystic lesion originating within the brain.

HP:0010579.name: Cone-shaped epiphysis
HP:0010579.definition: Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery.
HP:0010579.definition_cn: 锥形骨骺（亦称锥状骨骺）是指骨骺向杯状干骺端内陷的形态。具体而言，骨骺的远端呈锥形延伸，这是由于骨骺中央部分的生长相对于其周边部分更为显著所致。

HP:0010582.name: Irregular epiphyses
HP:0010582.definition: An alteration of the normally smooth contour of the epiphysis leading to an irregular appearance.
HP:0010582.definition_cn: 骨骺正常光滑轮廓的改变导致不规则外观。

HP:0010583.name: Ivory epiphyses
HP:0010583.definition: Sclerosis of the epiphyses, leading to an increased degree of radiopacity (white or ivory appearance) in X-rays.
HP:0010583.definition_cn: 骨骺硬化，导致X光片中放射密度增加（呈现白色或象牙色外观）。

HP:0010585.name: Small epiphyses
HP:0010585.definition: Reduction in the size or volume of epiphyses.

HP:0010587.name: Triangular epiphysis
HP:0010587.definition: Longitudinal epiphyseal bracket or bracket epiphysis is an uncommon disorder of growth. Alternatively known as a delta phalanx, it is due to an anomalous secondary ossification center that extends longitudinally along the diaphysis. Although rare, longitudinal epiphyseal bracket most commonly manifests in the hands as clinodactyly and in the feet as hallux varus.
HP:0010587.definition_cn: 纵向骨骺支架或支架骨骺是一种罕见的生长障碍。也称为三角指骨，其原因是沿骨干纵向延伸的异常次级骨化中心。尽管罕见，纵向骨骺支架最常见于手部表现为斜指畸形，在足部表现为拇内翻。

HP:0010588.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion
HP:0010588.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at each end of a long bone, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0010588.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即长骨两端干骺端透明软骨板在早于正常年龄时停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0010590.name: Abnormality of the distal femoral epiphysis
HP:0010590.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:0010590.definition_cn: 股骨远端骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010591.name: Abnormality of the proximal tibial epiphysis
HP:0010591.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the tibia.
HP:0010591.definition_cn: 胫骨近端骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010592.name: Abnormality of the distal tibial epiphysis

HP:0010594.name: Abnormality of the proximal fibular epiphysis
HP:0010594.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the fibula.

HP:0010595.name: Abnormality of the distal fibular epiphysis
HP:0010595.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the fibula.
HP:0010595.definition_cn: 腓骨远端骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010596.name: Abnormality of the proximal radial epiphysis
HP:0010596.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the radius.

HP:0010597.name: Abnormality of the distal radial epiphysis
HP:0010597.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the radius.
HP:0010597.definition_cn: 桡骨远端骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010598.name: Abnormality of the proximal humeral epiphysis
HP:0010598.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the humerus.
HP:0010598.definition_cn: 肱骨近端骨骺的任何异常。

HP:0010599.name: Abnormality of the distal humeral epiphysis
HP:0010599.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the humerus.

HP:0010600.name: Abnormal distal ulnar epiphysis morphology
HP:0010600.definition: Any abnormality of the distal epiphysis of the ulna.
HP:0010600.name_cn: 远端尺骨骨骺形态异常

HP:0010601.name: Abnormal proximal ulnar epiphysis morphology
HP:0010601.definition: Any abnormality of the proximal epiphysis of the ulna.
HP:0010601.name_cn: 尺骨近端骨骺形态异常

HP:0010602.name: Type 2 muscle fiber predominance
HP:0010602.definition: An abnormal predominance of type II muscle fibers (in general, this feature can only be observed on muscle biopsy).
HP:0010602.definition_cn: II型肌纤维异常优势（通常，此特征仅能在肌肉活检中观察到）。

HP:0010603.name: Odontogenic keratocysts of the jaw
HP:0010603.definition: A benign uni- or multicystic, intraosseous tumor of odontogenic origin, with a characteristic lining of parakeratinized stratified squamous epithelium and potential for aggressive, infiltrative behavior.
HP:0010603.definition_cn: 一种良性的单囊或多囊性、骨内源性牙源性肿瘤，其特征性内衬为角化不全的复层鳞状上皮，并具有侵袭性和浸润性行为的潜在倾向。

HP:0010605.name: Chalazion
HP:0010605.definition: A chronic epithelioid cell granulomatous inflammation of the meibomian gland caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland. A chalazion or meibomian cyst appears as a painless tuberous swelling in the upper lid without loss of eyelashes.
HP:0010605.definition_cn: 由阻塞的睑板腺引起的慢性上皮样细胞肉芽肿性炎症。睑板腺囊肿或睑板腺囊肿表现为上眼睑无痛性结节性肿胀，无睫毛脱落。

HP:0010606.name: Hordeolum
HP:0010606.definition: An acute purulent infection of the sebaceous glands of Zeis at the base of the eyelashes, of the apocrine sweat glands of Moll or the meibomian sebacious glands often caused by staphylococcus infections. Hordeola can either occur as Hordeola externa affecting the sebaceous glands of Zeis or the apocrine sweat glands of Moll or as Hordeola interna affecting the meibomian sebacious glands. In contrast to chalazia, hordeola are extremely painful and can cause extreme local swelling.
HP:0010606.definition_cn: 急性化脓性感染，累及睫毛根部的Zeis皮脂腺、Moll顶泌汗腺或睑板腺，常由葡萄球菌感染引起。麦粒肿可分为外麦粒肿，累及Zeis皮脂腺或Moll顶泌汗腺；或内麦粒肿，累及睑板腺。与霰粒肿不同，麦粒肿极为疼痛，并可导致严重的局部肿胀。

HP:0010607.name: Hordeolum externum
HP:0010607.definition: Hordeola externa are acute purulent infections affecting the sebaceous glands of Zeis or the apocrine sweat glands of Moll, often caused by staphylococcus infections. In contrast to chalazia, hordeola are extremely painfull and can cause extreme local swelling.
HP:0010607.definition_cn: 外睑腺炎是急性化脓性感染，累及Zeis皮脂腺或Moll顶泌汗腺，通常由葡萄球菌感染引起。与睑板腺囊肿不同，外睑腺炎极为疼痛，并可导致局部严重肿胀。

HP:0010608.name: Hordeolum internum
HP:0010608.definition: Hordeola interna are acute purulent infections affecting the meibomian sebacious glands, often caused by staphylococcus infections. In contrast to chalazia (chronic epithelioid cell granulomatous inflammation of the meibomian gland caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland), hordeola are extremely painfull and can cause extreme local swelling.
HP:0010608.definition_cn: 内睑腺炎是急性化脓性感染，累及睑板腺，通常由葡萄球菌感染引起。与睑板腺囊肿（由阻塞的睑板腺引起的慢性上皮样细胞肉芽肿性炎症）相比，内睑腺炎极为疼痛，并可导致严重的局部肿胀。

HP:0010609.name: Skin tags
HP:0010609.definition: Cutaneous skin tags also known as acrochorda or fibroepithelial polyps are small benign tumors that may either form secondarily over time primarily in areas where the skin forms creases, such as the neck, armpit or groin or may also be present at birth, in which case they usually occur in the periauricular region.
HP:0010609.definition_cn: 皮肤软纤维瘤，亦称皮赘或纤维上皮性息肉，是一种小型良性肿瘤，可继发性地随时间在皮肤皱褶处形成，如颈部、腋窝或腹股沟区域；亦可在出生时即存在，此类情况通常发生于耳周区域。

HP:0010612.name: Plantar pits
HP:0010612.definition: The presence of multiple pits (small, pinpoint-large indentations on the surface of the skin) located on the skin of sole of foot.
HP:0010612.definition_cn: 足底皮肤表面存在多发性凹陷（皮肤表面微小至针尖大小的凹陷）。

HP:0010614.name: Fibroma
HP:0010614.definition: Benign tumors that are composed of fibrous or connective tissue. They can grow in all organs, arising from mesenchyme tissue. The term \
HP:0010614.definition_cn: 由纤维或结缔组织组成的良性肿瘤。它们可生长于所有器官，起源于间充质组织。术语“\

HP:0010615.name: Angiofibromas
HP:0010615.definition: Angiofibroma consist of many often dilated vessels.
HP:0010615.definition_cn: 血管纤维瘤由许多常扩张的血管组成。

HP:0010616.name: Lung fibroma
HP:0010616.definition: The presence of a lung fibroma, a benign neoplasm that can present as a mass causing airway obstruction, cough, and hemoptysis, or present without symptoms as a solitary pulmonary nodule.
HP:0010616.definition_cn: 肺纤维瘤的存在，这是一种良性肿瘤，可表现为导致气道阻塞、咳嗽和咯血的肿块，或作为无症状的孤立性肺结节出现。

HP:0010618.name: Ovarian fibroma
HP:0010618.definition: The presence of a fibroma of the ovary.

HP:0010619.name: Fibroadenoma of the breast
HP:0010619.definition: A benign biphasic tumor of the breast with epithelial and stromal components.
HP:0010619.definition_cn: 乳腺良性双相性肿瘤，包含上皮和间质成分。

HP:0010620.name: Malar prominence
HP:0010620.definition: Prominence of the malar process of the maxilla and infraorbital area appreciated in profile and from in front of the face.
HP:0010620.definition_cn: 颧突及眶下区在侧面观及正面观中均显现突出。

HP:0010621.name: Cutaneous syndactyly of toes
HP:0010621.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between adjacent foot digits that involves at least half of the proximodistal length of one of the two involved digits; or, a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits of the foot that does not meet the prior objective criteria.
HP:0010621.definition_cn: 足趾间在前后轴上存在软组织连续性，涉及两个相邻足趾中至少一个的近远侧长度的二分之一；或足趾间在前后轴上存在软组织连续性，但不符合上述客观标准。

HP:0010622.name: Neoplasm of the skeletal system
HP:0010622.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the skeleton.
HP:0010622.definition_cn: 骨骼肿瘤（骨骼组织的异常增生）。

HP:0010624.name: Aplastic/hypoplastic toenail
HP:0010624.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the toenail.
HP:0010624.name_cn: 再生障碍性/发育不全性趾甲

HP:0010625.name: Anterior pituitary dysgenesis
HP:0010625.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the anterior pituitary gland, also known as the adenohypophysis.
HP:0010625.definition_cn: 前叶垂体缺失或发育不全，亦称腺垂体缺失或发育不全。

HP:0010626.name: Anterior pituitary agenesis
HP:0010626.definition: Absence of the anterior pituitary gland resulting from a developmental defect.
HP:0010626.definition_cn: 先天性前叶垂体缺失症。

HP:0010627.name: Anterior pituitary hypoplasia
HP:0010627.definition: Underdevelopment of the anterior pituitary gland.

HP:0010628.name: Facial palsy
HP:0010628.definition: Facial nerve palsy is a dysfunction of cranial nerve VII (the facial nerve) that results in inability to control facial muscles on the affected side with weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure. This can either be present in unilateral or bilateral form.
HP:0010628.definition_cn: 面神经麻痹是第七对颅神经（面神经）功能障碍，导致患侧面部肌肉无法控制，表现为面部表情肌和眼睑闭合肌无力。该病症可表现为单侧或双侧形式。

HP:0010629.name: Abnormal morphology of the cortex of the humerus
HP:0010629.definition: Any abnormality affecting the cortex of the humerus.

HP:0010630.name: Abnormal metatarsal epiphysis morphology
HP:0010630.definition: Any abnormality of a metatarsal bone epiphysis.

HP:0010631.name: Abnormality of the epiphyses of the feet
HP:0010631.definition: Any abnormality of the epiphyses of the feet.

HP:0010632.name: Total anosmia
HP:0010632.definition: Inability to detect any qualitative olfactory sensation.

HP:0010633.name: Partial anosmia
HP:0010633.definition: Inability to perceive certain odorants (implies that the sense of smell is maintained for other classes of odorants).
HP:0010633.definition_cn: 特定嗅觉刺激感知缺失（暗示对其他类别的嗅觉刺激仍保持感知能力）。

HP:0010634.name: Total hyposmia
HP:0010634.definition: Reduced ability to detect any qualitative olfactory sensation.
HP:0010634.definition_cn: 嗅觉定性感知能力减退。

HP:0010635.name: Partial hyposmia
HP:0010635.definition: Reduced ability to perceive certain odorants (implies that the sense of smell is maintained for other classes of odorants).
HP:0010635.definition_cn: 特定气味感知能力减退（暗示对其他类别气味的嗅觉功能仍保留）。

HP:0010636.name: Schizencephaly
HP:0010636.definition: The presence of a cleft in the cerebral cortex unilaterally or bilaterally, usually located in the frontal area.
HP:0010636.definition_cn: 大脑皮质单侧或双侧存在裂隙，通常位于额叶区域。

HP:0010637.name: Conjunctival amyloidosis
HP:0010637.definition: A form of amyloidosis that affects the conjunctiva.

HP:0010638.name: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of hepatic origin
HP:0010638.definition: An abnormally increased level of liver isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.
HP:0010638.name_cn: 肝源性碱性磷酸酶升高
HP:0010638.definition_cn: 血液中碱性磷酸酶肝同工酶（组织非特异性同工酶）水平异常升高。

HP:0010639.name: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of bone origin
HP:0010639.definition: An abnormally increased level of bone isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.
HP:0010639.name_cn: 骨源性碱性磷酸酶升高
HP:0010639.definition_cn: 血液中碱性磷酸酶骨同工酶（组织非特异性同工酶）水平异常升高。

HP:0010640.name: Abnormal nasal cavity morphology
HP:0010640.definition: Abnormality of the nasal cavity (the cavity includes and starts at the nares and reaches all the way through to the and includes the choanae, the posterior nasal apertures).
HP:0010640.definition_cn: 鼻腔异常（该腔体包括并起始于鼻孔，延伸至并包括后鼻孔，即鼻后孔）。

HP:0010641.name: Abnormality of the midnasal cavity
HP:0010641.definition: Abnormality of the midnasal cavity which includes the cavity between the nares and the choanae.
HP:0010641.definition_cn: 中鼻道异常，包括从鼻孔至后鼻孔之间的腔隙。

HP:0010643.name: Midnasal atresia
HP:0010643.definition: Absence or abnormal closure of the midnasal cavity.
HP:0010643.definition_cn: 中鼻道缺失或异常闭锁。

HP:0010644.name: Midnasal stenosis
HP:0010644.definition: Abnormal narrowing (stenosis) of the midnasal cavity, i.e., of the middle nasal meatus, which in neonates can cause respiratory distress.
HP:0010644.definition_cn: 中鼻道异常狭窄（狭窄），即中鼻道狭窄，在新生儿中可能导致呼吸窘迫。

HP:0010645.name: Aplasia of the distal phalanges of the toes
HP:0010645.definition: Absence of the distal phalanges of the toes.

HP:0010646.name: Cervical spine instability
HP:0010646.definition: An abnormal lack of stability of the cervical spine.

HP:0010647.name: Abnormal elasticity of skin
HP:0010647.definition: Any abnormal increase or reduction in skin elasticity.
HP:0010647.definition_cn: 皮肤弹性的任何异常增加或减少。

HP:0010648.name: Dermal translucency
HP:0010648.definition: An abnormally increased ability of the skin to permit light to pass through (translucency) such that subcutaneous structures such as veins display an increased degree of visibility.
HP:0010648.definition_cn: 皮肤透光性异常增强（半透明性），导致皮下结构（如静脉）的可见度显著增加。

HP:0010649.name: Flat nasal alae
HP:0010649.definition: An abnormal degree of flatness of the Ala of nose, which can be defined as a reduced nasal elevation index (lateral depth of the nose from the tip of the nose to the insertion of the nasal ala in the cheek x 100 divided by the side-to-side breadth of the nasal alae).
HP:0010649.definition_cn: 鼻翼平坦度异常，可定义为鼻部隆起指数降低（从鼻尖至鼻翼与面颊连接处的鼻部侧向深度×100除以鼻翼左右宽度）。

HP:0010650.name: Hypoplasia of the premaxilla
HP:0010650.definition: An abnormality of the premaxilla (the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla) causing it to appear relatively small in size compared to the other parts of the maxilla or other facial structures.
HP:0010650.definition_cn: 前颌骨（形成上颌骨前部的胚胎结构）异常，导致其相对于上颌骨其他部分或面部其他结构显得相对较小。

HP:0010651.name: Abnormal meningeal morphology
HP:0010651.definition: An abnormality of the Meninges, including any abnormality of the Dura mater, the Arachnoid mater, and the Pia mater.
HP:0010651.definition_cn: 脑膜异常，包括硬脑膜、蛛网膜和软脑膜的任何异常。

HP:0010652.name: Abnormal dura mater morphology
HP:0010652.definition: An abnormality of the Dura mater.

HP:0010653.name: Abnormality of the falx cerebri
HP:0010653.definition: An abnormality of the Falx cerebri.

HP:0010654.name: Aplasia of the falx cerebri
HP:0010654.definition: A developmental defect characterized by aplasia of the Falx cerebri.
HP:0010654.definition_cn: 一种以大脑镰发育不全为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0010655.name: Epiphyseal stippling
HP:0010655.definition: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more epiphyses.
HP:0010655.definition_cn: 一个或多个骨骺中存在异常点状（斑点状、点状）钙化。

HP:0010656.name: Abnormal epiphyseal ossification
HP:0010656.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of an epiphysis.

HP:0010657.name: Patchy reduction of bone mineral density
HP:0010657.definition: Patchy (irregular) reduction in bone density. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
HP:0010657.definition_cn: 斑片状（不规则）骨密度降低。根据严重程度和分布情况，其在X线片上可呈现多种形态。

HP:0010658.name: Patchy changes of bone mineral density
HP:0010658.definition: Patchy (irregular) changes in bone mineral density. These changes can either be patchy reduction or increase of mineral density as seen on x-rays. Depending on the pathomechanism and the underlying disease, these changes can either appear solely as reduction or increase or as a combination of both (patches of bone showing an increased density while others are affected by reduction of mineral density).
HP:0010658.name_cn: 骨矿物质密度斑片状改变
HP:0010658.definition_cn: 骨矿物质密度呈斑片状（不规则）改变。这些改变在X线片上可表现为斑片状矿物质密度降低或增高。根据病理机制及基础疾病的不同，这些改变可单独表现为密度降低或增高，亦可两者兼有（部分骨区域显示密度增高，而其他区域则出现矿物质密度降低）。

HP:0010659.name: Patchy variation in bone mineral density
HP:0010659.definition: Patchy (irregular) changes in bone mineral density with patches of bone showing an increased density side to side with patches that are affected by reduction of mineral density. This is sometimes referred to as a moth-eaten appearance on x-rays.
HP:0010659.name_cn: 骨矿物质密度斑片状变异
HP:0010659.definition_cn: 骨矿物质密度呈斑片状（不规则）改变，表现为密度增高的骨斑片与矿物质密度降低的骨斑片相邻。这种现象在X线片上有时被称为“虫蚀样改变”。

HP:0010660.name: Abnormal hand bone ossification
HP:0010660.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any bone of the skeleton of hand.
HP:0010660.definition_cn: 手部骨骼中任何骨骼的形成和矿化异常。

HP:0010661.name: Absence of the third cerebral ventricle
HP:0010661.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the absence of the third ventricle.
HP:0010661.definition_cn: 第三脑室缺失性发育缺陷。

HP:0010662.name: Abnormal diencephalon morphology
HP:0010662.definition: An abnormality of the Diencephalon, which together with the cerebrum (telencephalon) makes up the forebrain.
HP:0010662.definition_cn: 间脑异常，其与大脑（端脑）共同构成前脑。

HP:0010664.name: Fusion of the left and right thalami
HP:0010664.definition: A developmental defect characterized by fusion of the left and right halves of the thalamus.
HP:0010664.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为左右两侧丘脑的融合。

HP:0010665.name: Bilateral coxa valga
HP:0010665.definition: The presence of bilateral coxa valga.

HP:0010666.name: Hypoplasia of the anterior nasal spine
HP:0010666.definition: Underdevelopment of the anterior nasal spine of maxilla.

HP:0010667.name: Aplasia of the maxilla
HP:0010667.definition: A congenital defect characterized by absence of the Maxilla.

HP:0010668.name: Abnormal zygomatic bone morphology
HP:0010668.definition: An abnormality of the zygomatic bone.

HP:0010669.name: Hypoplasia of the zygomatic bone
HP:0010669.definition: Underdevelopment of the zygomatic bone. That is, a reduction in size of the zygomatic bone, including the zygomatic process of the temporal bone of the skull, which forms part of the zygomatic arch.
HP:0010669.definition_cn: 颧骨发育不全。即颧骨体积减小，包括构成颧弓一部分的颅骨颞骨颧突。

HP:0010672.name: Abnormality of the third metatarsal bone
HP:0010672.definition: An abnormality of the third metatarsal bone.

HP:0010674.name: Abnormal curvature of the vertebral column
HP:0010674.definition: The presence of an abnormal curvature of the vertebral column.

HP:0010675.name: Abnormal foot bone ossification
HP:0010675.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any bone of the skeleton of foot.
HP:0010675.definition_cn: 足部骨骼形成和矿化异常。

HP:0010678.name: Enuresis diurna
HP:0010678.definition: Enuresis occurring during waking hours of the day.
HP:0010678.definition_cn: 日间清醒状态下的遗尿症。

HP:0010679.name: Elevated tissue non-specific alkaline phosphatase
HP:0010679.definition: An abnormally increased level of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.
HP:0010679.name_cn: 组织非特异性碱性磷酸酶升高
HP:0010679.definition_cn: 血液中组织非特异性碱性磷酸酶同工酶水平异常升高。

HP:0010680.name: Elevated alkaline phosphatase of renal origin
HP:0010680.definition: An abnormally increased level of kidney isoforms of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.
HP:0010680.name_cn: 肾源性碱性磷酸酶升高
HP:0010680.definition_cn: 血液中碱性磷酸酶肾脏同工酶（组织非特异性同工酶）水平异常升高。

HP:0010681.name: Elevated intestinal alkaline phosphatase
HP:0010681.definition: An abnormally increased level of alkaline phosphatase, intestinal type in the blood.
HP:0010681.definition_cn: 血液中肠型碱性磷酸酶水平异常升高。

HP:0010682.name: Elevated placental alkaline phosphatase
HP:0010682.definition: An abnormally increased level of alkaline phosphatase, placental type in the blood.
HP:0010682.definition_cn: 血液中胎盘型碱性磷酸酶水平异常升高。

HP:0010683.name: Low tissue non-specific alkaline phosphatase
HP:0010683.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase, tissue-nonspecific isozyme in the blood.
HP:0010683.name_cn: 低组织非特异性碱性磷酸酶
HP:0010683.definition_cn: 血液中组织非特异性碱性磷酸酶同工酶水平异常降低。

HP:0010684.name: Low alkaline phosphatase of bone origin
HP:0010684.definition: An abnormally reduced level of bone isoforms of alkaline phosphatase in the blood.
HP:0010684.name_cn: 骨源性碱性磷酸酶降低
HP:0010684.definition_cn: 血液中碱性磷酸酶骨同工酶水平异常降低。

HP:0010685.name: Low alkaline phosphatase of renal origin
HP:0010685.definition: An abnormally reduced level of kidney isoforms of alkaline phosphatase in the blood.
HP:0010685.definition_cn: 血液中碱性磷酸酶肾脏同工酶水平异常降低。

HP:0010686.name: Low alkaline phosphatase of hepatic origin
HP:0010686.definition: An abnormally reduced level of liver isoforms of alkaline phosphatase in the blood.
HP:0010686.definition_cn: 血液中碱性磷酸酶肝同工酶水平异常降低。

HP:0010687.name: Low intestinal alkaline phosphatase
HP:0010687.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase, intestinal type in the blood.
HP:0010687.definition_cn: 血液中肠道型碱性磷酸酶水平异常降低。

HP:0010688.name: Low placental alkaline phosphatase
HP:0010688.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase, placental type in the blood.
HP:0010688.name_cn: 胎盘碱性磷酸酶水平低下
HP:0010688.definition_cn: 血液中胎盘型碱性磷酸酶水平异常降低。

HP:0010689.name: Mirror image polydactyly
HP:0010689.definition: A hand or foot with more than five digits that has a recognizable A/P axis of symmetry. The axis can lie within a normally formed or partially duplicated digit resembling a middle finger, index finger, thumb, toe, or hallux. Alternatively, the axis can be in an interdigital space with a flanking pair of digits that resemble a middle finger, index finger, thumb, toe or hallux. The most lateral digits on each side of the hand/foot typically resemble fifth fingers/toes.
HP:0010689.definition_cn: 手足多指/趾畸形，具有可识别的前后轴对称性。该轴可位于正常形成或部分重复的指/趾内，类似于中指、食指、拇指、足趾或拇趾。或者，该轴可位于指/趾间间隙，两侧伴有类似于中指、食指、拇指、足趾或拇趾的指/趾。手足最外侧的指/趾通常类似于第五指/趾。

HP:0010690.name: Mirror image hand polydactyly
HP:0010690.definition: Mirror image duplication of digits affecting the hands only.
HP:0010690.definition_cn: 仅影响手部的镜像手指重复畸形。

HP:0010691.name: Mirror image foot polydactyly
HP:0010691.definition: Mirror image duplication of digits affecting the feet.
HP:0010691.definition_cn: 足部指（趾）镜像重复畸形。

HP:0010693.name: Pulverulent cataract
HP:0010693.definition: A kind of congenital cataract that is characterized by a hollow sphere of punctate opacities involving the fetal nucleus and that usually occurs bilaterally.
HP:0010693.definition_cn: 一种先天性白内障，其特征为胎儿核内出现空心球状点状混浊，通常为双侧发生。

HP:0010694.name: Lamellar pulverulent cataract
HP:0010694.definition: A Lamellar cataract with a pulverulent (punctate, \
HP:0010694.definition_cn: 板层白内障伴粉末状（点状）混浊

HP:0010695.name: Sutural cataract
HP:0010695.definition: A type of congenital cataract in which the opacity follows the anterior or posterior Y suture.
HP:0010695.definition_cn: 一种先天性白内障类型，其混浊沿前或后Y字缝分布。

HP:0010696.name: Polar cataract
HP:0010696.definition: A type of Congenital cataract in which the opacities occupy the subcapsular cortex at the anterior or posterior pole of the lens.
HP:0010696.definition_cn: 一种先天性白内障，其混浊位于晶状体前极或后极的囊下皮质区域。

HP:0010697.name: Anterior pyramidal cataract
HP:0010697.definition: A type of anterior polar cataract which projects as a conical opacity into the anterior chamber.
HP:0010697.definition_cn: 一种前极性白内障，其呈锥形混浊突入前房。

HP:0010698.name: Nuclear pulverulent cataract
HP:0010698.definition: A type of nuclear cataract involving congenital dust-like (pulverulent) opacity of the embryonal and fetal nucleus.
HP:0010698.definition_cn: 一种核性白内障，涉及胚胎核和胎儿核的先天性粉尘样（粉状）混浊。

HP:0010699.name: Triangular nuclear cataract
HP:0010699.definition: A nuclear cataract with a triangular form.

HP:0010701.name: Abnormal circulating immunoglobulin concentration
HP:0010701.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in blood.
HP:0010701.name_cn: 异常循环免疫球蛋白浓度
HP:0010701.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白水平异常偏离正常值。

HP:0010702.name: Increased circulating antibody concentration
HP:0010702.definition: An increased level of gamma globulin (immunoglobulin) in the blood.
HP:0010702.definition_cn: 血清中γ球蛋白（免疫球蛋白）水平升高。

HP:0010704.name: 1-2 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0010704.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the index finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0010704.definition_cn: 拇指与食指之间沿前后轴方向的软组织连续性，向远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0010705.name: 4-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0010705.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the fourth (ring) to the fifth (little) finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0010705.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）至第五指（小指）之间在前后轴上存在软组织连续性，该连续性向远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0010706.name: 1-3 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0010706.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the middle finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0010706.definition_cn: 在前后轴上，从拇指到中指之间存在软组织连续性，其远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0010707.name: 1-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0010707.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the ring finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0010707.definition_cn: 在前后轴上，从拇指至环指之间存在软组织连续性，其远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0010708.name: 1-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0010708.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the little finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints (complete syndactyly of all fingers of the hand).
HP:0010708.definition_cn: 在前后轴上，从拇指到小指之间存在软组织连续性，远端延伸至至少近端指间关节水平（手部所有手指的完全性并指畸形）。

HP:0010709.name: 2-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0010709.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second (index) to the fourth (ring) finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0010709.definition_cn: 在前后轴上，从第二指（食指）到第四指（无名指）之间存在软组织连续性，该连续性向远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0010710.name: 3-5 finger syndactyly
HP:0010710.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the middle to little fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0010710.definition_cn: 中指至小指在前后轴上存在软组织连续性，向远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:0010711.name: 1-2 toe syndactyly
HP:0010711.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes one and two.
HP:0010711.definition_cn: 并趾畸形伴第一、第二趾融合。

HP:0010712.name: 1-4 toe syndactyly
HP:0010712.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to four.
HP:0010712.definition_cn: 并趾畸形，第一至第四趾融合。

HP:0010713.name: 1-5 toe syndactyly
HP:0010713.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to five (complete syndactyly of all toes of the foot).
HP:0010713.definition_cn: 趾1至5并趾畸形（足部所有趾完全性并趾）。

HP:0010714.name: 2-4 toe syndactyly
HP:0010714.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes two to four.
HP:0010714.definition_cn: 并趾畸形，第二至第四趾融合。

HP:0010715.name: 2-5 toe syndactyly
HP:0010715.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes two to five.
HP:0010715.definition_cn: 并趾畸形，第二至第五趾融合。

HP:0010716.name: 3-5 toe syndactyly
HP:0010716.definition: Syndactyly with fusion of toes three to five.
HP:0010716.name_cn: 第三至第五趾并趾畸形
HP:0010716.definition_cn: 第三至第五趾并趾畸形伴融合。

HP:0010717.name: Osseous syndactyly of toes
HP:0010717.definition: Webbing or fusion of the toes, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual bones of the toes. Bony fusions are referred to as \
HP:0010717.definition_cn: 趾蹼或趾融合，涉及软组织并包括趾骨间的骨性融合。骨性融合被称为“骨性并趾症”。

HP:0010719.name: Abnormality of hair texture
HP:0010719.definition: An abnormality of the texture of the hair.

HP:0010720.name: Abnormal hair pattern
HP:0010720.definition: An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.

HP:0010721.name: Abnormal hair whorl
HP:0010721.definition: An abnormal hair whorl (that is, a patch of hair growing in the opposite direction of the rest of the hair).
HP:0010721.definition_cn: 异常毛涡（即一簇毛发与其余毛发生长方向相反）。

HP:0010722.name: Asymmetry of the ears
HP:0010722.definition: An asymmetriy, i.e., difference in size, shape or position between the left and right ear.
HP:0010722.definition_cn: 左右耳在大小、形状或位置上的不对称性，即双侧耳廓形态或位置差异。

HP:0010724.name: Advanced pneumatization of the mastoid process
HP:0010724.definition: An abnormally advanced degree of pneumatization (i.e., formation of air cells) in the mastoid process with respect to age-dependent norms.
HP:0010724.definition_cn: 相对于年龄相关标准，乳突气化程度异常进展（即气房形成）。

HP:0010726.name: Prominent corneal nerve fibers
HP:0010726.definition: Abnormal prominence of the corneal nerve fibers.
HP:0010726.definition_cn: 角膜神经纤维异常突出。

HP:0010727.name: Spontaneous rupture of the globe
HP:0010727.definition: Rupture of the eyeball not due to trauma.

HP:0010728.name: Aplasia of the retina
HP:0010728.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence of the retina.

HP:0010729.name: Cherry red spot of the macula
HP:0010729.definition: Pallor of the perifoveal macula of the retina with appearance of a small circular reddish choroid shape as seen through the fovea centralis due to relative transparency of the macula.
HP:0010729.definition_cn: 黄斑周围视网膜苍白，由于黄斑相对透明，通过中央凹可见一小圆形红色脉络膜形态。

HP:0010730.name: Double eyebrow
HP:0010730.definition: This may present as a partial or complete duplication of the eyebrows.
HP:0010730.definition_cn: 这可能表现为眉毛的部分或完全重复。

HP:0010731.name: Extension of eyebrows towards upper eyelid
HP:0010731.definition: The eyebrows extend towards - or even all the way down to - the margin of the upper eyelid.
HP:0010731.name_cn: 眉毛向上眼睑方向延伸
HP:0010731.definition_cn: 眉毛延伸至——甚至完全覆盖——上眼睑边缘。

HP:0010732.name: Nodular changes affecting the eyelids
HP:0010732.definition: Nodular changes affecting the eyelids may have many different causes such as cystic lesions (chalaziae, hordeolae), lipogranulomas, melanomas, infectious diseases (Molluscum contagiosum) and many more.
HP:0010732.definition_cn: 影响眼睑的结节性改变可能由多种不同原因引起，例如囊性病变（霰粒肿、麦粒肿）、脂质肉芽肿、黑色素瘤、感染性疾病（传染性软疣）等。

HP:0010733.name: Naevus flammeus of the eyelid
HP:0010733.definition: Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the eyelid.
HP:0010733.definition_cn: 眼睑皮肤局限性鲜红斑痣。

HP:0010734.name: Fibrous dysplasia of the bones
HP:0010734.definition: Tumor-like growths that consist of replacement of the medullary bone with fibrous tissue, causing the expansion and weakening of the areas of bone involved. Especially when involving the skull or facial bones, the lesions can cause externally visible deformities. The skull is often, but not necessarily, affected, and any other bone or bones may be involved. Fibrous dysplasia can either effect isolated bones (Monostotic fibrous dysplasia) or also generalized all bones of the body (Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia).
HP:0010734.definition_cn: 由纤维组织替代髓质骨构成的肿瘤样生长，导致受累骨区域扩张和弱化。尤其当累及颅骨或面骨时，病变可导致外部可见的畸形。颅骨常受累，但并非必然，其他任何骨骼也可能受累。纤维性发育不良可累及单一骨骼（单骨性纤维性发育不良）或全身所有骨骼（多骨性纤维性发育不良）。

HP:0010735.name: Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia
HP:0010735.definition: Fibrous dysplasia of the bones were lesions are localized in many bones throughout of the body. Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia is a cardinal feature of McCune-Albright syndrome.
HP:0010735.name_cn: 多骨性纤维性结构不良
HP:0010735.definition_cn: 多骨性纤维性发育不良（Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia）是McCune-Albright综合征的主要特征之一，表现为病变累及全身多处骨骼。

HP:0010736.name: Monostotic fibrous dysplasia
HP:0010736.definition: Fibrous dysplasia of the bones were lesions are localized in only one bone.
HP:0010736.name_cn: 单骨性纤维性结构不良

HP:0010739.name: Osteopoikilosis
HP:0010739.definition: Osteopoikilosis is a benign, asymptomatic sclerotic dysplasia of the bones. It affects both male and female and may be seen at any age. Radiographically sclerotic circular or ovoid lesions are usually symmetrically distributed in a periarticular location. Lesions can increase or decrease in size and number in serial radiographs or even disappear and do not have increased bone radiotracer uptake.
HP:0010739.definition_cn: 骨斑点症是一种良性的、无症状的骨硬化性发育不良。该病可影响男性和女性，且可见于任何年龄段。影像学上，硬化性圆形或卵圆形病变通常对称分布于关节周围。在连续影像学检查中，病变的大小和数量可增加或减少，甚至消失，且无骨放射性示踪剂摄取增加。

HP:0010740.name: Osteopathia striata
HP:0010740.definition: A lamellar pattern visible on radiographs and mainly localized at the metaphyses of the long tubular bones. Pathologic-anatomical studies revealed that these benign signs on x-rays are the result of a juvenile metaphyseal bone necrosis. Calcifications in the necrotic marrow lead to this lamellar or lattice-like appearance.
HP:0010740.definition_cn: 放射影像上可见层状模式，主要位于长管状骨的干骺端。病理解剖学研究表明，这些X射线上的良性征象是幼年性干骺端骨坏死的结果。坏死骨髓中的钙化导致了这种层状或网格状的外观。

HP:0010741.name: Pedal edema
HP:0010741.definition: An abnormal accumulation of excess fluid in the lower extremity resulting in swelling of the feet and extending upward to the lower leg.
HP:0010741.definition_cn: 下肢异常积聚过多液体导致足部肿胀并向上延伸至小腿。

HP:0010742.name: Edema of the upper limbs
HP:0010742.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin of the arms.
HP:0010742.definition_cn: 上肢皮下组织异常液体积聚。

HP:0010743.name: Short metatarsal
HP:0010743.definition: Diminished length of a metatarsal bone, with resultant proximal displacement of the associated toe.
HP:0010743.definition_cn: 跖骨长度缩短，导致相应足趾近端移位。

HP:0010744.name: Absent metatarsal bone
HP:0010744.definition: A developmental abnormality characterized by the absence (aplasia) of a metatarsal bone.
HP:0010744.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为跖骨缺失（发育不全）。

HP:0010745.name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the toes
HP:0010745.definition: Absence of a digit or of one or more phalanges of a toe.
HP:0010745.definition_cn: 趾骨缺失或趾骨部分缺失。

HP:0010746.name: Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the toes

HP:0010747.name: Medial flaring of the eyebrow
HP:0010747.definition: An abnormal distribution of eyebrow hair growth in the medial direction.
HP:0010747.definition_cn: 内侧眉毛毛发生长异常分布。

HP:0010748.name: Ectopic lacrimal punctum
HP:0010748.definition: Positioning of a lacrimal punctum other than at the medial margins of the eyelid.

HP:0010749.name: Blepharochalasis
HP:0010749.definition: Blepharochalasis is characterized by recurrent, non-painful, nonerythematous episodes of eyelid edema. It has been divided into hypertrophic and atrophic forms. In the hypertrophic form recurrent edema results in orbital fat herniation through a weakened orbital septum. Most patients who have blepharochalasis present in an atrophic condition with atrophy of redundant eyelid skin and superior nasal fat pads.
HP:0010749.definition_cn: 眼睑松弛症的特征是反复发作、无痛、无红斑的眼睑水肿。该病可分为肥厚型和萎缩型两种类型。在肥厚型中，反复发作的水肿导致眶脂肪通过薄弱的眶隔疝出。大多数眼睑松弛症患者表现为萎缩状态，伴有眼睑多余皮肤和鼻上脂肪垫的萎缩。

HP:0010750.name: Dermatochalasis
HP:0010750.definition: Loss of elasticity of the upper and lower eyelids causing the skin to sag and bulge.
HP:0010750.definition_cn: 上睑和下睑弹性丧失导致皮肤松弛和膨出。

HP:0010751.name: Dimple chin
HP:0010751.definition: A persistent midline depression of the skin over the fat pad of the chin.
HP:0010751.definition_cn: 颏部脂肪垫上方皮肤持续性中线凹陷。

HP:0010752.name: Cleft mandible
HP:0010752.definition: Midline deficiency of the mandible and some or all overlying tissues.
HP:0010752.definition_cn: 下颌骨中线缺损及部分或全部覆盖组织缺损。

HP:0010754.name: Abnormality of the temporomandibular joint
HP:0010754.definition: An anomaly of the temporomandibular joint.

HP:0010755.name: Asymmetry of the maxilla
HP:0010755.definition: Asymmetry between the left and right sides of the maxilla.

HP:0010756.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the premaxilla
HP:0010756.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the premaxilla.
HP:0010756.name_cn: 前颌骨发育不全/前颌骨发育不良
HP:0010756.definition_cn: 前颌骨缺失或发育不全。

HP:0010757.name: Aplasia of the premaxilla
HP:0010757.definition: Absence of the premaxilla, which is the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla.
HP:0010757.definition_cn: 前颌骨缺失，即形成上颌骨前部的胚胎结构缺如。

HP:0010758.name: Abnormality of the premaxilla
HP:0010758.definition: An abnormality of the premaxilla, the most anterior part of the maxilla that usually bears the central and lateral incisors and includes the anterior nasal spine and inferior aspect of the piriform rim. The premaxilla contains the bone and teeth of the primary palate.
HP:0010758.definition_cn: 前颌骨异常，前颌骨为上颌骨最前部，通常承载中切牙和侧切牙，并包括前鼻棘和梨状孔下缘。前颌骨包含原腭的骨组织和牙齿。

HP:0010759.name: Prominence of the premaxilla
HP:0010759.definition: Prominent positioning of the premaxilla in relation to the rest of the maxilla, the facial skeleton, or mandible. Not necessarily caused by an increase in size (hypertrophy of) the premaxilla.
HP:0010759.definition_cn: 前颌骨相对于上颌骨其他部分、面部骨骼或下颌骨的显著突出。不一定由前颌骨体积增大（前颌骨肥大）引起。

HP:0010760.name: Absent toe
HP:0010760.definition: Aplasia of a toe. That is, absence of all phalanges of a non-hallux digit of the foot and the associated soft tissues.
HP:0010760.definition_cn: 趾发育不全。即足部非拇趾的趾骨及相关软组织的完全缺失。

HP:0010762.name: Chordoma
HP:0010762.definition: A chordoma is a tumor that arises from embryonic remnants of the notochord along the length of the neuraxis. Chordomas generally occur in the sacrum, intracranially at the clivus, or along the spinal axis.
HP:0010762.definition_cn: 脊索瘤是一种起源于神经轴沿线脊索胚胎残余组织的肿瘤。脊索瘤通常发生于骶骨、颅内斜坡或脊柱轴沿线。

HP:0010763.name: Low insertion of columella
HP:0010763.definition: Insertion of the posterior columella below the nasal base.
HP:0010763.definition_cn: 鼻基底下方后鼻小柱植入术。

HP:0010764.name: Short eyelashes
HP:0010764.definition_cn: 睫毛长度缩短（主观感受）。

HP:0010765.name: Palmar hyperkeratosis
HP:0010765.definition: Abnormal thickening of the skin localized to the palm of the hand.
HP:0010765.definition_cn: 手掌皮肤局限性异常增厚。

HP:0010766.name: Ectopic calcification
HP:0010766.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in a tissue or location in which calcification does not normally occur.

HP:0010767.name: Sacrococcygeal pilonidal abnormality
HP:0010767.definition: The presence of a cyst, fistula, or abscess in the sacrococcygeal region (gluteal crease) characteristically accompanied by hair and skin folds.
HP:0010767.definition_cn: 骶尾区（臀沟）存在囊肿、瘘管或脓肿，特征性伴随毛发和皮肤皱褶。

HP:0010769.name: Pilonidal sinus
HP:0010769.definition: A sinus in the coccygeal region (the region of the intergluteal cleft). A pilonidal sinus often contains hair and skin debris.
HP:0010769.definition_cn: 位于尾骨区域的窦道（臀间裂区域）。藏毛窦通常含有毛发和皮肤碎屑。

HP:0010771.name: Pilonidal abscess
HP:0010771.definition: A hair-containing cyst or sinus usually in the coccygeal region.
HP:0010771.definition_cn: 含有毛发的囊肿或窦道，通常位于骶尾部。

HP:0010772.name: Anomalous pulmonary venous return
HP:0010772.definition: A developmental defect characterized by abnormal connection of one or more pulmonary veins to the superior or inferior vena cava, the right atrium, or the coronary sinus, resulting in a left-to-right shunt of oxygenated blood.
HP:0010772.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为一根或多根肺静脉异常连接至上腔静脉、下腔静脉、右心房或冠状窦，导致氧合血液从左向右分流。

HP:0010773.name: Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return
HP:0010773.definition: A form of anomalous pulmonary venous return in which not all pulmonary veins drain abnormally. Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return frequently involves one or both of the veins from one lung.
HP:0010773.name_cn: 部分性肺静脉异位引流
HP:0010773.definition_cn: 部分性肺静脉异位引流，其中并非所有肺静脉均异常引流。部分性肺静脉异位引流常涉及一侧肺的一支或两支静脉。

HP:0010774.name: Cor triatriatum
HP:0010774.definition: The presence of an additional membrane in the left or right cardiac atrium which results in the subdivision of the affected atrium (and thus in total three atria, whence the name).
HP:0010774.definition_cn: 左心房或右心房内存在额外膜性结构，导致受累心房被分隔（从而形成总共三个心房，因此得名）。

HP:0010775.name: Vascular ring
HP:0010775.definition: A developmental defect of the aortic arch system in which the trachea and esophagus are completely encircled by connected segments of the aortic arch and its branches. This occurs if the normal process of regression and persistence of the bilateral embryonic aortic arches fails.
HP:0010775.definition_cn: 主动脉弓系统发育缺陷，其中气管和食管被主动脉弓及其分支的连接段完全环绕。这种情况发生在双侧胚胎主动脉弓的正常退化和持续过程失败时。

HP:0010776.name: Tracheobronchmegaly
HP:0010776.definition: Marked widening of the trachea and major bronchi that may be predispose to chronic respiratory tract infection.
HP:0010776.definition_cn: 气管及主支气管显著扩张，可能易导致慢性呼吸道感染。

HP:0010777.name: Bronchomegaly
HP:0010777.definition: Marked widening of the major bronchi that may be predispose to chronic respiratory tract infection.
HP:0010777.definition_cn: 主要支气管显著扩张，可能易导致慢性呼吸道感染。

HP:0010779.name: Large pelvis bone
HP:0010779.definition: The presence of an abnormally large pelvis.

HP:0010780.name: Hyperacusis
HP:0010780.definition: Over-sensitivity to certain frequency ranges of sound.
HP:0010780.definition_cn: 对特定频率范围的声音过度敏感。

HP:0010781.name: Skin dimple
HP:0010781.definition: Skin dimples are cutaneous indentations that are the result of tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) causing an indentation.
HP:0010781.definition_cn: 皮肤凹陷（Skin dimples）是指由于皮肤与深层结构（如骨骼）的牵拉作用导致的皮肤表面凹陷。

HP:0010782.name: Shoulder dimple
HP:0010782.definition: A subtype of skin dimples occurring in the shoulder region.

HP:0010783.name: Erythema
HP:0010783.definition: Redness of the skin, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.
HP:0010783.definition_cn: 皮肤红斑，由真皮层毛细血管充血所致。

HP:0010784.name: Uterine neoplasm
HP:0010784.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the uterus.
HP:0010784.definition_cn: 子宫肿瘤（子宫组织异常增生）

HP:0010785.name: Gonadal neoplasm
HP:0010785.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of a gonad.
HP:0010785.definition_cn: 性腺肿瘤（性腺组织异常增生）

HP:0010786.name: Urinary tract neoplasm
HP:0010786.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the urinary system.

HP:0010787.name: Genital neoplasm
HP:0010787.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the genital system.
HP:0010787.definition_cn: 生殖系统肿瘤（组织异常增生）。

HP:0010788.name: Testicular neoplasm
HP:0010788.definition: The presence of a neoplasm of the testis.

HP:0010790.name: Hypoplasia of the Leydig cells
HP:0010790.definition: Underdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone.
HP:0010790.definition_cn: 睾丸间质细胞（Leydig细胞）发育不全。这些细胞负责睾酮的生成。

HP:0010791.name: Hyperplasia of the Leydig cells
HP:0010791.definition: Hypertrophy or overdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone.
HP:0010791.definition_cn: 睾丸间质（Leydig）细胞肥大或过度发育。这些细胞负责产生睾酮。

HP:0010793.name: Bifid nail
HP:0010793.definition: A digit with two nails, with at least some soft tissue between them.
HP:0010793.definition_cn: 具有双指甲的指（趾），且两者之间至少存在部分软组织。

HP:0010794.name: Impaired visuospatial constructive cognition
HP:0010794.definition: Reduced ability affecting mainly visuospatial cognition which may be tested using pattern construction (for example by Differential Ability Scales, which test a person's strengths and weaknesses across a range of intellectual abilities).
HP:0010794.name_cn: 视觉空间构建认知障碍
HP:0010794.definition_cn: 主要影响视觉空间认知的能力减退，可通过模式构建进行测试（例如使用差异能力量表，该量表测试个体在多种智力能力方面的优势和劣势）。

HP:0010797.name: Hemangioblastoma
HP:0010797.definition: A hemangioblastoma is a benign vascular neoplasm that arises almost exclusively in the central nervous system. Hemangioblastomas consist of a tightly packed cluster of small blood vessels forming a mass of up to 1 or 2 cm in diameter.
HP:0010797.definition_cn: 血管母细胞瘤是一种良性血管性肿瘤，几乎仅发生于中枢神经系统。血管母细胞瘤由紧密排列的小血管簇组成，形成直径可达1至2厘米的肿块。

HP:0010798.name: Lip freckle
HP:0010798.definition: Increased focal pigmentation of the vermilion of the lips.
HP:0010798.definition_cn: 唇红部局灶性色素沉着增加。

HP:0010799.name: Pinealoma
HP:0010799.definition: A neoplasm of the pineal gland.

HP:0010800.name: Absent cupid's bow
HP:0010800.definition: Lack of paramedian peaks and median notch of the upper lip vermilion.
HP:0010800.definition_cn: 上唇红缘正中峰缺失及正中切迹缺如。

HP:0010801.name: Underdeveloped nasolabial fold
HP:0010801.definition: Reduced bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion or commissure).
HP:0010801.definition_cn: 鼻唇沟（nasolabial fold）自鼻翼外侧缘（即鼻基底与面部皮肤交界处）延伸至口角外侧（cheilion或commissure）的皮肤皱褶或沟槽的体积减小。

HP:0010802.name: Perioral hyperpigmentation
HP:0010802.definition: Increased pigmentation, either focal or generalized, of the skin surrounding the vermilion of the lips.
HP:0010802.definition_cn: 唇红缘周围皮肤色素沉着增加，可为局灶性或弥漫性。

HP:0010803.name: Everted upper lip vermilion
HP:0010803.definition: Inner aspect of the upper lip vermilion (normally apposing the teeth) visible in a frontal view, i.e., the presence of an everted upper lip.
HP:0010803.definition_cn: 正面观可见上唇红唇内侧（通常与牙齿相对），即存在上唇外翻。

HP:0010804.name: Tented upper lip vermilion
HP:0010804.definition: Triangular appearance of the oral aperture with the apex in the midpoint of the upper vermilion and the lower vermilion forming the base.
HP:0010804.definition_cn: 口裂呈三角形，顶点位于上唇红中点，下唇红构成基底。

HP:0010805.name: Upturned corners of mouth
HP:0010805.definition: Oral commissures positioned superior to the midline labial fissure.
HP:0010805.definition_cn: 口角位于中线唇裂上方。

HP:0010806.name: U-Shaped upper lip vermilion
HP:0010806.definition: Gentle upward curve of the upper lip vermilion such that the center is placed well superior to the commissures.
HP:0010806.definition_cn: 上唇红缘呈现平缓向上的曲线，使得其中点明显高于口角。

HP:0010807.name: Open bite
HP:0010807.definition: Visible space between the dental arches in occlusion.
HP:0010807.definition_cn: 牙弓咬合时可见的间隙。

HP:0010808.name: Protruding tongue
HP:0010808.definition: Tongue extending beyond the alveolar ridges or teeth at rest.
HP:0010808.definition_cn: 舌在静息状态下超出牙槽嵴或牙齿。

HP:0010809.name: Broad uvula
HP:0010809.definition: Increased width of the uvula (subjective finding).
HP:0010809.definition_cn: 悬雍垂宽度增加（主观发现）。

HP:0010813.name: Abnormal number of hair whorls
HP:0010813.definition: More than two clockwise hair whorls.
HP:0010813.definition_cn: 顺时针方向多于两个的毛发涡旋。

HP:0010814.name: Abnormal position of hair whorl
HP:0010814.definition: Hair growth from a single point on the scalp in any location other than lateral to the midline and close to the vertex of the skull.
HP:0010814.definition_cn: 头皮上除中线外侧及颅顶附近区域外，任何部位出现的单点毛发增生。

HP:0010815.name: Nevus sebaceous
HP:0010815.definition: A congenital, hairless plaque consisting of overgrown epidermis, sebaceous glands, hair follicles, apocrine glands and connective tissue. They are a variant of epidermal naevi. Sebaceous naevi most often appear on the scalp, but they may also arise on the face, neck or forehead. At birth, a sevaceous nevus typically appears as a solitary, smooth, yellow-orange hairless patch. Sebaceous naevi become more pronounced around adolescence, often appearing bumpy, warty or scaly.
HP:0010815.definition_cn: 一种先天性无毛斑块，由过度生长的表皮、皮脂腺、毛囊、顶泌汗腺和结缔组织组成。它们是表皮痣的一种变异。皮脂腺痣最常见于头皮，但也可能出现在面部、颈部或前额。出生时，皮脂腺痣通常表现为单一的、光滑的、橙黄色无毛斑块。皮脂腺痣在青春期前后变得更加明显，常呈现为凹凸不平、疣状或鳞屑状。

HP:0010816.name: Epidermal nevus
HP:0010816.definition: Epidermal naevi are due to an overgrowth of the epidermis and may be present at birth (50%) or develop during childhood.
HP:0010816.definition_cn: 表皮痣是由于表皮过度增生所致，可能在出生时即存在（占50%），或在儿童期发展形成。

HP:0010817.name: Linear nevus sebaceous
HP:0010817.definition: A type of nevus sebaceous with a linear form, raised borders and yellowish color.
HP:0010817.definition_cn: 一种呈线性、边界隆起且呈黄色的皮脂腺痣。

HP:0010818.name: Generalized tonic seizure
HP:0010818.definition: A generalized tonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening without a subsequent clonic phase. The tonic activity can be a sustained abnormal posture, either in extension or flexion, sometimes accompanied by tremor of the extremities.
HP:0010818.definition_cn: 全身性强直性发作是一种全身性运动性发作，其特征为双侧肢体强直或抬高，常伴有颈部强直而无后续的阵挛期。强直活动可表现为持续的异常姿势，无论是伸展还是屈曲，有时伴有四肢震颤。

HP:0010819.name: Atonic seizure
HP:0010819.definition: Atonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1 to 2 seconds, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.
HP:0010819.definition_cn: 失张力发作是一种运动性发作，其特征为突然发生的肌张力丧失或减弱，无明显先兆性肌阵挛或强直事件，持续时间约为1至2秒，可累及头部、躯干、下颌或肢体肌群。

HP:0010820.name: Focal emotional seizure with crying
HP:0010820.definition: Focal emotional seizure with crying (dacrystic) is characterized by the presence of stereotyped crying, this may be accompanied by lacrimation, sad facial expression and sobbing. The subjective emotion of sadness may or may not be present.
HP:0010820.name_cn: 局灶性情感性发作伴哭泣
HP:0010820.definition_cn: 局灶性情感性发作伴哭泣（dacrystic）的特征为出现刻板性哭泣，可能伴有流泪、悲伤表情及啜泣。主观上的悲伤情绪可能存在或不存在。

HP:0010821.name: Focal emotional seizure with laughing
HP:0010821.definition: Focal emotional seizure with laughing (gelastic) is characterized by bursts of laughter or giggling, usually without appropriate related emotion of happiness, and described as 'mirthless'.
HP:0010821.name_cn: 局灶性情感性发作伴发笑
HP:0010821.definition_cn: 局灶性情感性发作伴发笑（痴笑性发作）的特征为突发性大笑或咯咯笑，通常缺乏相应的愉悦情感，被描述为“无欢乐感”。

HP:0010822.name: Scintillating scotoma
HP:0010822.definition: A scintillating scotoma is a common visual aura that can precede a migraine, whereby a spot of flickering light near the center of the visual fields occurs. The spot prevents vision, and is thus termed scotoma. The scotoma can extend into one or more shimmering arcs of white or colored flashing lights.
HP:0010822.definition_cn: 闪烁性暗点是一种常见的视觉先兆，可能出现在偏头痛发作之前，表现为视野中心附近出现闪烁光点。该光点阻碍视力，因此被称为暗点。暗点可扩展为一条或多条闪烁的白色或彩色闪光弧。

HP:0010823.name: Ridged cranial sutures
HP:0010823.definition: An overlap of the bony plates of the skull in an infant, with or without early closure.
HP:0010823.definition_cn: 婴儿颅骨骨板重叠，伴或不伴早期闭合。

HP:0010824.name: Abnormal fifth cranial nerve morphology
HP:0010824.definition: Any structural abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve.
HP:0010824.definition_cn: 第五对颅神经的任何结构异常。

HP:0010825.name: Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve
HP:0010825.definition: Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve.

HP:0010826.name: Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve
HP:0010826.definition: Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve.

HP:0010827.name: Abnormal seventh cranial physiology
HP:0010827.definition: Abnormality of the seventh cranial nerve sometimes also referred to as the facial nerve.
HP:0010827.name_cn: 第七颅神经生理功能异常
HP:0010827.definition_cn: 第七颅神经异常，有时也称为面神经异常。

HP:0010828.name: Hemifacial spasm
HP:0010828.definition: Intermittent clonic or tonic contraction of muscles supplied by facial nerve. Muscles are relaxed in between contractions.
HP:0010828.definition_cn: 面神经支配的肌肉出现间歇性阵挛性或强直性收缩。收缩间期肌肉呈松弛状态。

HP:0010829.name: Impaired temperature sensation
HP:0010829.definition: A reduced ability to discriminate between different temperatures.

HP:0010830.name: Impaired tactile sensation
HP:0010830.definition: A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation). This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.
HP:0010830.definition_cn: 触觉减退（tactile hypesthesia）。通常使用棉絮或细驼毛刷进行测试，要求患者在每次感受到刺激时说出“现在”。

HP:0010831.name: Impaired proprioception
HP:0010831.definition: A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position.

HP:0010832.name: Abnormality of pain sensation
HP:0010832.definition: Pain is an unpleasant sensation that can range from mild, localized discomfort to agony, whereby the physical part of pain results from nerve stimulation and is often accompanied by an emotional component. This term groups abnormalities in pain sensation presumed to result from abnormalities related to the specific nerve fibers that carry the pain impulses to the brain.
HP:0010832.definition_cn: 疼痛是一种不愉快的感觉，其程度可从轻微的局部不适到剧烈的痛苦。疼痛的生理部分源于神经刺激，并常伴有情感成分。该术语用于归类与疼痛感觉异常相关的病症，这些异常被认为是由将疼痛冲动传递至大脑的特定神经纤维相关异常所致。

HP:0010833.name: Spontaneous pain sensation
HP:0010833.definition: Spontaneous pain is a kind of neuropathic pain which occurs without an identifiable trigger.
HP:0010833.definition_cn: 自发性疼痛是一种神经病理性疼痛，其发生无明显可识别的诱因。

HP:0010834.name: Trophic changes related to pain
HP:0010834.definition: Trophic changes is a term used to describe abnormalities in the area of pain that include primarily wasting away of the skin, tissues, or muscle, thinning of the bones, and changes in how the hair or nails grow, including thickening or thinning of hair or brittle nails.
HP:0010834.name_cn: 与疼痛相关的营养性改变
HP:0010834.definition_cn: 营养性改变（Trophic changes）是指疼痛区域出现的异常现象，主要包括皮肤、组织或肌肉的萎缩（Wasting away of the skin, tissues, or muscle）、骨质变薄（Thinning of the bones）以及毛发或指甲生长方式的改变（Changes in how the hair or nails grow），如毛发增厚或变薄（Thickening or thinning of hair）以及脆性指甲（Brittle nails）。

HP:0010835.name: Dissociated sensory loss
HP:0010835.definition: A pattern of sensory loss with selective loss of touch sensation and proprioception without loss of pain and temperature, or vice-versa.
HP:0010835.definition_cn: 一种感觉缺失的模式，表现为选择性触觉和本体感觉丧失，而痛觉和温度觉保留，或反之亦然。

HP:0010837.name: Decreased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
HP:0010837.definition: Decreased concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood.
HP:0010837.name_cn: 循环铜蓝蛋白浓度降低
HP:0010837.definition_cn: 血清铜蓝蛋白浓度降低。

HP:0010838.name: High nonceruloplasmin-bound serum copper
HP:0010838.definition: An increased concentration of non ceruloplasmin bound copper in the blood.
HP:0010838.name_cn: 高非铜蓝蛋白结合血清铜
HP:0010838.definition_cn: 血液中非铜蓝蛋白结合铜浓度升高。

HP:0010839.name: Increased urinary copper concentration
HP:0010839.definition: An increased concentration of copper in the urine.

HP:0010841.name: Multifocal epileptiform discharges
HP:0010841.definition: An abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG) and being identified at multiple locations (foci).
HP:0010841.definition_cn: 通过脑电图（EEG）在头皮上记录到的脑电活动异常，并在多个部位（病灶）被识别。

HP:0010843.name: EEG with focal slow activity
HP:0010843.definition: Focal (localized) slow activity reflects focal dysfunction, not diffuse dysfunction (i.e., encephalopathy).
HP:0010843.name_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性慢波活动
HP:0010843.definition_cn: 局灶性（局限性）慢波活动反映的是局灶性功能障碍，而非弥漫性功能障碍（即脑病）。

HP:0010844.name: EEG with multifocal slow activity
HP:0010844.definition: Multifocal slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010844.name_cn: 脑电图显示多灶性慢波活动
HP:0010844.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）记录显示头皮多灶性脑电活动减慢。

HP:0010845.name: EEG with generalized slow activity
HP:0010845.definition: Diffuse slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010845.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性慢波活动
HP:0010845.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）记录显示沿头皮分布的弥漫性脑电活动减慢。

HP:0010846.name: EEG with persistent abnormal rhythmic activity
HP:0010846.name_cn: 脑电图显示持续性异常节律性活动

HP:0010847.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (<2.5 Hz)
HP:0010847.definition: The presence of complexes of slow spikes and slow waves (<2.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010847.name_cn: 脑电图显示棘慢波复合波（<2.5 Hz）
HP:0010847.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）中出现慢棘慢波复合波（<2.5 Hz）。

HP:0010848.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (2.5-3.5 Hz)
HP:0010848.definition: The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (2.5-3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010848.name_cn: 脑电图显示棘慢波复合波（2.5-3.5 Hz）
HP:0010848.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）中出现棘慢波复合波（2.5-3.5 Hz）。

HP:0010849.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (>3.5 Hz)
HP:0010849.definition: The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (>3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010849.name_cn: 脑电图显示棘慢波复合波（>3.5 Hz）
HP:0010849.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）中出现棘慢波综合（>3.5 Hz）。

HP:0010850.name: EEG with spike-wave complexes
HP:0010850.definition: Complexes of spikes (<70 ms) and sharp waves (70-200 ms), which are sharp transient waves that have a strong association with epilepsy, in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010850.name_cn: 脑电图显示棘慢波复合波
HP:0010850.definition_cn: 在通过脑电图（EEG）沿头皮记录的大脑电活动中，尖波复合体（<70毫秒）和尖波（70-200毫秒）是与癫痫有强烈关联的尖锐瞬态波。

HP:0010851.name: EEG with burst suppression
HP:0010851.definition: The burst suppression pattern in electroencephalography refers to a characteristic periodic pattern of low voltage (<10 microvolts) suppressed background and a relatively shorter pattern of higher amplitude slow, sharp, and spiking complexes.
HP:0010851.name_cn: 脑电图显示爆发抑制模式
HP:0010851.definition_cn: 脑电图中的爆发抑制模式是指一种特征性的周期性模式，表现为低电压（<10微伏）的背景抑制和相对较短的高幅慢波、尖波和棘波复合波。

HP:0010852.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response
HP:0010852.definition: EEG abnormalities (epileptiform discharges) evoked by flashing lights or black and white striped patterns.
HP:0010852.name_cn: 脑电图显示光阵发性反应
HP:0010852.definition_cn: 由闪烁光或黑白条纹图案诱发的脑电图异常（癫痫样放电）。

HP:0010853.name: EEG with periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges
HP:0010853.definition: Periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges (PLEDs)are periodic, lateralized, and epileptiform. PLEDs show a relatively constant interval between discharges (0.5 to 3 seconds).
HP:0010853.name_cn: 脑电图显示周期性单侧癫痫样放电
HP:0010853.definition_cn: 周期性偏侧性癫痫样放电（Periodic Lateralized Epileptiform Discharges, PLEDs）具有周期性、偏侧性和癫痫样特征。PLEDs在放电之间显示出相对恒定的间隔（0.5至3秒）。

HP:0010854.name: EEG with generalized low amplitude activity
HP:0010854.definition: An abnormal generalized reduction in amplitude of the cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010854.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性低波幅活动
HP:0010854.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）记录到的沿头皮分布的脑电活动振幅普遍性异常降低。

HP:0010855.name: EEG with localized low amplitude activity
HP:0010855.definition: An abnormal localized reduction in amplitude of the cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010855.name_cn: 脑电图显示局部低幅活动
HP:0010855.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）记录的沿头皮分布的脑电活动振幅局部异常降低。

HP:0010856.name: EEG with periodic complexes
HP:0010856.name_cn: 脑电图显示周期性复合波
HP:0010856.definition_cn: 周期性出现的广泛性周期性复合波。

HP:0010857.name: EEG with periodic abnormalities
HP:0010857.definition: Periodically recurring abnormalities in the EEG.
HP:0010857.name_cn: 脑电图显示周期性异常
HP:0010857.definition_cn: 周期性复发性脑电图异常。

HP:0010858.name: EEG with hyperventilation-induced epileptiform discharges
HP:0010858.definition: Epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0010858.name_cn: 脑电图显示过度换气诱发的癫痫样放电
HP:0010858.definition_cn: 由过度换气（过度呼吸）诱发的癫痫样放电，通过脑电图（EEG）在头皮记录到的脑电活动中观察到。

HP:0010859.name: Frank breech presentation
HP:0010859.definition: A kind of breech presentation in which the hips are flexed and the knees are extended.
HP:0010859.definition_cn: 一种臀先露，其中髋关节屈曲，膝关节伸展。

HP:0010860.name: Complete breech presentation
HP:0010860.definition: A kind of breech presentation in which the hips are flexed and the knees are flexed.
HP:0010860.definition_cn: 一种臀先露，其中髋关节屈曲且膝关节屈曲。

HP:0010861.name: Incomplete breech presentation
HP:0010861.definition: A kind of breech presentation in which one or both hips are extended and one or both of the fetus' feet are pointing down and entering the birth canal.
HP:0010861.definition_cn: 一种臀先露，其中一侧或双侧髋关节伸展，胎儿的一只或两只脚朝下并进入产道。

HP:0010862.name: Delayed fine motor development
HP:0010862.definition: A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the fingers and hands.
HP:0010862.definition_cn: 一种运动发育迟缓，其特征为获得手指和手部控制能力的延迟。

HP:0010863.name: Receptive language delay
HP:0010863.definition: A delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.
HP:0010863.definition_cn: 言语理解能力发育迟缓

HP:0010864.name: Intellectual disability, severe
HP:0010864.definition: Severe mental retardation is defined as an intelligence quotient (IQ) in the range of 20-34.
HP:0010864.definition_cn: 重度智力障碍定义为智商（IQ）在20至34之间。

HP:0010865.name: Oppositional defiant disorder
HP:0010865.definition: An enduring pattern of uncooperative, defiant, and hostile behavior towards authority figures that does not involve major antisocial violations, is not accounted for by the child's developmental stage, and results in significant functional impairment. A certain level of oppositional behavior is common in children and adolescents.
HP:0010865.definition_cn: 一种持久的、针对权威人物的不合作、违抗和敌对行为模式，不涉及重大反社会违规行为，无法用儿童的发展阶段来解释，并导致显著的功能损害。一定程度的对立行为在儿童和青少年中较为常见。

HP:0010866.name: Abdominal wall defect
HP:0010866.definition: An incomplete closure of the abdominal wall.

HP:0010867.name: Dyssynergia
HP:0010867.definition: A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed. With dyssynergia, a voluntary movement appears broken down into its component parts.
HP:0010867.definition_cn: 一种共济失调类型，其特征为无法以适当的顺序和速度流畅地执行自主运动的各个组成部分。在协同失调的情况下，自主运动似乎被分解为其组成部分。

HP:0010868.name: Ocular dyssynergia
HP:0010868.definition: A type of dyssynergia affecting eye movements and characterized by the inability to smoothly follow a visual target across the visual field.
HP:0010868.definition_cn: 一种影响眼球运动的协同失调，其特征为无法在视野范围内平滑追踪视觉目标。

HP:0010869.name: Asynergia
HP:0010869.definition: A type of dyssynergy characterized by the lack of the ability to smoothly perform the elements of a voluntary movement in the appropriate order and speed.
HP:0010869.definition_cn: 一种运动失调，其特征为无法以适当的顺序和速度流畅地执行自主运动的各个组成部分。

HP:0010871.name: Sensory ataxia
HP:0010871.definition: Incoordination of movement caused by a deficit in the sensory nervous system. Sensory ataxia can be distinguished from cerebellar ataxia by asking the patient to close his or her eyes. Persons with cerebellar ataxia show only a minimal worsening of symptoms, whereas persons with sensory ataxia show a marked worsening of symptoms.
HP:0010871.definition_cn: 由感觉神经系统缺陷引起的运动协调障碍。感觉性共济失调可通过让患者闭眼与小脑性共济失调相鉴别。小脑性共济失调患者症状仅轻微加重，而感觉性共济失调患者症状则显著加重。

HP:0010872.name: T-wave inversion
HP:0010872.definition: An inversion of the T-wave (which is normally positive).
HP:0010872.definition_cn: T波倒置（正常情况下为正向）。

HP:0010873.name: Cervical spinal cord atrophy
HP:0010873.definition: Atrophy of the cervical segment of the spinal cord.

HP:0010874.name: Tendon xanthomatosis
HP:0010874.definition: The presence of xanthomas (intra-and extra-cellular accumulations of cholesterol) extensor tendons (typically over knuckles, Achilles tendon, knee, and elbows).
HP:0010874.definition_cn: 黄瘤（细胞内和细胞外胆固醇积聚）存在于伸肌腱（通常位于指关节、跟腱、膝关节和肘关节）。

HP:0010875.name: Chaddock reflex
HP:0010875.definition: A diagnostic reflex elicited by stimulation of the skin over the surface of the lateral malleolus of the foot. The Chaddock refelx is present if there is extension of one or more or all of the toes with or without fanning of them when the external inframalleolar skin is stimulated. The Chaddock sign, similar to the Babinski sign, is taken to be an indication of disease of the spinocortical (pyramidal) tract.
HP:0010875.definition_cn: 一种通过刺激足外踝表面皮肤引发的诊断性反射。当刺激外踝下方皮肤时，若出现一个或多个或全部足趾的伸展，无论是否伴有足趾的扇形展开，即可判定为Chaddock反射阳性。Chaddock征与Babinski征类似，被视为脊髓皮质束（锥体束）病变的指征。

HP:0010876.name: Abnormal circulating protein concentration
HP:0010876.definition: An abnormal level of a circulating protein in the blood.
HP:0010876.definition_cn: 血液中循环蛋白水平异常。

HP:0010877.name: Monocular strabismus
HP:0010877.definition: A type of strabismus in which the fixating eye is always the same one, while the other eye is constantly deviated. Monocular strabismus is to be distinguished from alternating strabismus, in which either of the eyes 'squints' at different times.
HP:0010877.definition_cn: 一种斜视类型，其中注视眼始终为同一只眼，而另一只眼则持续偏斜。单眼斜视应与交替性斜视相区分，后者在不同时间由任一眼“斜视”。

HP:0010878.name: Fetal cystic hygroma
HP:0010878.definition: The presence during the prenatal period of a cystic mass with multiple septa with multiple, asymmetric, thin-walled cysts near the posterior aspect of the neck. Fetal cystic hygroma can be defined as nuchal translucency with or without septations measuring greater than 3.0 mm. Increased NT refers to a measurement above the 95th centile, and the term is used irrespective of whether the collection of fluid is septated or not, and whether it is confined to the neck or envelopes the whole fetus. After 14 weeks, increased NT usually resolves, but in some cases it evolves into nuchal edema or cystic hygromas.
HP:0010878.definition_cn: 产前期间，颈部后方出现多分隔、不对称、薄壁囊肿的囊性肿块。胎儿囊性水瘤可定义为颈项透明层厚度大于3.0毫米，伴或不伴分隔。颈项透明层增厚（Increased NT）指测量值超过第95百分位数，该术语的使用与液体聚集是否分隔、是否局限于颈部或包裹整个胎儿无关。14周后，颈项透明层增厚通常消退，但在某些情况下会演变为颈项水肿或囊性水瘤。

HP:0010880.name: Increased nuchal translucency
HP:0010880.definition: Nuchal translucency is the sonographic appearance of subcutaneous accumulation of liquid in the back of the fetal neck in the first trimester of pregnancy (11-14 gestational weeks of pregnancy).
HP:0010880.definition_cn: 颈项透明层是妊娠早期（孕11-14周）胎儿颈部后方皮下液体积聚的超声影像表现。

HP:0010881.name: Abnormality of the umbilical cord
HP:0010881.definition: An abnormality of the umbilical cord, which is the cord connecting the developing embryo or fetus to the placenta.
HP:0010881.definition_cn: 脐带异常，即连接发育中的胚胎或胎儿与胎盘的脐带出现异常。

HP:0010882.name: Pulmonary valve atresia
HP:0010882.definition: A congenital disorder of the pulmonary valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop.
HP:0010882.definition_cn: 肺动脉瓣先天性发育不全，表现为瓣膜口未能正常发育。

HP:0010883.name: Aortic valve atresia
HP:0010883.definition: A congenital disorder of the aortic valve in which the orifice of the valve fails to develop.
HP:0010883.definition_cn: 主动脉瓣先天性发育不全，表现为瓣膜口未能正常发育。

HP:0010884.name: Acromelia
HP:0010884.definition: Shortening of the extremities affecting primarily the distal parts of the limbs (hands and feet) in relation to the other segments of the limbs.
HP:0010884.definition_cn: 四肢短缩，主要累及肢体的远端部分（手和足），相对于肢体的其他节段。

HP:0010885.name: Avascular necrosis
HP:0010885.definition: A disease where there is cellular death (necrosis) of bone components due to interruption of the blood supply.

HP:0010886.name: Osteochondritis dissecans
HP:0010886.definition: A joint disorder caused by blood deprivation in the subchondral bone causing the subchondral bone to die in a process called avascular necrosis. The bone is then reabsorbed by the body, leaving the articular cartilage it supported prone to damage. The result is fragmentation (dissection) of both cartilage and bone, and the free movement of these osteochondral fragments within the joint space, causing pain and further damage.
HP:0010886.definition_cn: 一种关节疾病，由于软骨下骨血液供应不足导致软骨下骨在称为缺血性坏死的过程中死亡。随后，骨组织被机体吸收，使其支撑的关节软骨易于受损。结果是软骨和骨组织的碎裂（剥离），这些骨软骨碎片在关节腔内自由移动，引起疼痛和进一步损伤。

HP:0010888.name: Morbus Koehler
HP:0010888.definition: Morbus Koehler is a Juvenile aseptic necrosis affecting the Os naviculare pedis.
HP:0010888.definition_cn: Köhler病是一种影响足舟骨的青少年无菌性坏死。

HP:0010889.name: Morbus Kienboeck
HP:0010889.definition: Morbus Kienboeck is a Juvenile aseptic necrosis affecting the Os lunatum.
HP:0010889.definition_cn: Kienböck病是一种影响月骨的青少年无菌性坏死。

HP:0010890.name: Morbus Osgood-Schlatter
HP:0010890.definition: Morbus Osgood-Schlatter is a Juvenile aseptic necrosis affecting the Tuberositas tibiae.
HP:0010890.definition_cn: 奥斯古德-施拉特病是一种影响胫骨结节的青少年无菌性坏死。

HP:0010891.name: Morbus Scheuermann
HP:0010891.definition: A developmental growth retardation of the vertebral end plates that may lead to secondary destruction of the vertebral end plates and protrusion of the nucleus pulposus into the vertebral body (so called Schmorl's nodes as seen on x-rays).
HP:0010891.definition_cn: 椎体终板发育性生长迟缓，可能导致椎体终板的继发性破坏以及髓核突入椎体内（在X线片上可见的所谓许莫氏结节）。

HP:0010892.name: Abnormal circulating branched chain amino acid concentration
HP:0010892.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a branched chain family amino acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010892.name_cn: 异常循环支链氨基酸浓度
HP:0010892.definition_cn: 血液循环中支链氨基酸家族浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0010893.name: Abnormal circulating phenylalanine concentration
HP:0010893.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of phenylalanine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010893.name_cn: 异常循环苯丙氨酸浓度
HP:0010893.definition_cn: 血液中苯丙氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0010894.name: Abnormal circulating serine family amino acid concentration
HP:0010894.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a serine family amino acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010894.name_cn: 异常循环丝氨酸家族氨基酸浓度
HP:0010894.definition_cn: 血液循环中丝氨酸家族氨基酸正常浓度的任何偏离。

HP:0010895.name: Abnormal circulating glycine concentration
HP:0010895.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of glycine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010895.definition_cn: 血液中甘氨酸浓度的任何异常波动。

HP:0010896.name: Hypersarcosinemia
HP:0010896.definition: An elevated plasma concentration of sarcosine.
HP:0010896.definition_cn: 血浆中肌氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0010897.name: Hypersarcosinuria
HP:0010897.definition: An elevated urinary concentration of sarcosine.
HP:0010897.definition_cn: 尿液中肌氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0010898.name: Abnormal circulating sarcosine concentration
HP:0010898.definition: An deviation from the normal concentration of sarcosine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010898.definition_cn: 血液循环中肌氨酸浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0010899.name: Abnormal circulating aspartate family amino acid concentration
HP:0010899.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of an aspartate family amino acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010899.name_cn: 异常循环天冬氨酸家族氨基酸浓度
HP:0010899.definition_cn: 血液循环中天冬氨酸家族氨基酸浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0010900.name: Abnormal circulating threonine concentration
HP:0010900.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of threonine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010900.definition_cn: 血液循环中苏氨酸浓度的任何异常偏离。

HP:0010901.name: Abnormal circulating methionine concentration
HP:0010901.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of methionine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010901.name_cn: 异常循环甲硫氨酸浓度
HP:0010901.definition_cn: 血液中甲硫氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0010902.name: Abnormal circulating glutamine family amino acid concentration
HP:0010902.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a glutamine family amino acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010902.name_cn: 异常循环谷氨酰胺家族氨基酸浓度
HP:0010902.definition_cn: 血液循环中谷氨酰胺家族氨基酸正常浓度的任何偏离。

HP:0010903.name: Abnormal circulating glutamine concentration
HP:0010903.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of glutamine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010903.name_cn: 异常循环谷氨酰胺浓度
HP:0010903.definition_cn: 血液循环中谷氨酰胺浓度的任何异常。

HP:0010904.name: Abnormal circulating histidine concentration
HP:0010904.definition: An abnormality of a histidine metabolic process.

HP:0010906.name: Hyperhistidinemia
HP:0010906.definition: An increased concentration of histidine in the blood.
HP:0010906.definition_cn: 血液中组氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0010907.name: Abnormal circulating proline concentration
HP:0010907.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of proline or a proline metabolite in the blood circulation.
HP:0010907.definition_cn: 血液中脯氨酸或其代谢物浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0010908.name: Abnormal circulating lysine concentration
HP:0010908.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of lysine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010908.definition_cn: 血液中赖氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0010909.name: Abnormal circulating arginine concentration
HP:0010909.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of arginine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010909.definition_cn: 血液循环中精氨酸浓度的任何异常。

HP:0010910.name: Hypervalinemia
HP:0010910.definition: An increased concentration of valine in the blood.
HP:0010910.definition_cn: 血液中缬氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0010911.name: Hyperleucinemia
HP:0010911.definition: An increased concentration of leucine in the blood.
HP:0010911.definition_cn: 血液中亮氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0010912.name: Abnormal circulating isoleucine concentration
HP:0010912.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of isoleucine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010912.name_cn: 异常循环异亮氨酸浓度
HP:0010912.definition_cn: 血液循环中异亮氨酸浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0010913.name: Hyperisoleucinemia
HP:0010913.definition: An increased concentration of isoleucine in the blood.
HP:0010913.definition_cn: 血液中异亮氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0010914.name: Abnormal circulating valine concentration
HP:0010914.definition: Any deviation from the normal circulation of valine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010914.definition_cn: 血液中缬氨酸循环的任何异常。

HP:0010915.name: Abnormal circulating pyruvate family amino acid concentration
HP:0010915.definition: An abnormality of a pyruvate family amino acid metabolic process.
HP:0010915.name_cn: 异常循环丙酮酸家族氨基酸浓度
HP:0010915.definition_cn: 丙酮酸家族氨基酸代谢过程异常。

HP:0010916.name: Abnormal circulating alanine concentration
HP:0010916.definition: An abnormality of an alanine metabolic process.
