HP:0010917.name: Abnormal circulating tyrosine concentration
HP:0010917.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of tyrosine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010917.definition_cn: 血液循环中酪氨酸浓度的任何异常。

HP:0010918.name: Abnormal circulating cysteine concentration
HP:0010918.definition: An abnormality of a cysteine metabolic process.
HP:0010918.name_cn: 异常循环半胱氨酸浓度
HP:0010918.definition_cn: 半胱氨酸代谢过程异常。

HP:0010919.name: Abnormal circulating homocysteine concentration
HP:0010919.definition: An abnormality of a homocysteine metabolic process.
HP:0010919.name_cn: 异常循环同型半胱氨酸浓度
HP:0010919.definition_cn: 同型半胱氨酸代谢过程异常。

HP:0010920.name: Zonular cataract
HP:0010920.definition: Zonular cataracts are defined to be cataracts that affect specific regions of the lens.
HP:0010920.definition_cn: 带状白内障被定义为影响晶状体特定区域的白内障。

HP:0010921.name: Coralliform cataract
HP:0010921.definition: A 'coral-like' pattern of opacity in the lens of the eye. That is, a cataract with an irregular, stellate form.
HP:0010921.definition_cn: 晶状体混浊呈“珊瑚样”模式。即，不规则星形白内障。

HP:0010922.name: Membranous cataract
HP:0010922.definition: A form of cataract in which the lens substance has shrunk, leaving a collapsed, flattened capsule with little or no cortex or epithelium on the lens.
HP:0010922.definition_cn: 一种白内障类型，其中晶状体物质萎缩，导致晶状体囊塌陷、扁平，晶状体皮质或上皮组织极少或完全缺失。

HP:0010923.name: Anterior subcapsular cataract
HP:0010923.definition: A type of cataract affecting the anterior pole of lens immediately adjacent to ('beneath') the lens capsule.
HP:0010923.definition_cn: 一种影响晶状体前极、紧邻（位于）晶状体囊下的白内障类型。

HP:0010924.name: Posterior cortical cataract
HP:0010924.definition: A cataract that affects the posterior part of the cortex of the lens.
HP:0010924.definition_cn: 影响晶状体皮质后部的白内障。

HP:0010926.name: Aculeiform cataract
HP:0010926.definition: A kind of nuclear cataract characterized by fiberglasslike or needlelike crystals projecting in different directions, through or close to the axial region of the lens.
HP:0010926.definition_cn: 一种核性白内障，其特征为玻璃纤维状或针状晶体向不同方向投射，穿过或靠近晶状体的轴区。

HP:0010927.name: Abnormal blood inorganic cation concentration
HP:0010927.definition: An abnormality of divalent inorganic cation homeostasis.
HP:0010927.name_cn: 异常血液无机阳离子浓度
HP:0010927.definition_cn: 二价无机阳离子稳态异常。

HP:0010928.name: obsolete Increased urinary orotic acid concentration
HP:0010928.name_cn: 过时的 尿中乳清酸浓度升高

HP:0010930.name: Abnormal blood monovalent inorganic cation concentration
HP:0010930.definition: An abnormality of monovalent inorganic cation homeostasis.
HP:0010930.name_cn: 异常血单价无机阳离子浓度
HP:0010930.definition_cn: 单价无机阳离子稳态异常。

HP:0010932.name: Abnormal circulating nucleobase concentration
HP:0010932.definition: An abnormality of a nucleobase metabolic process.
HP:0010932.name_cn: 异常循环核苷碱基浓度

HP:0010933.name: Hyperxanthinemia
HP:0010933.definition: An increased level of xanthine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010933.definition_cn: 血液循环中黄嘌呤水平升高。

HP:0010934.name: Xanthinuria
HP:0010934.definition: An increased concentration of xanthine in the urine.
HP:0010934.definition_cn: 尿液中黄嘌呤浓度升高。

HP:0010935.name: Abnormality of the upper urinary tract
HP:0010935.definition: An abnormality of the upper urinary tract.

HP:0010936.name: Abnormality of the lower urinary tract
HP:0010936.definition: An abnormality of the lower urinary tract.

HP:0010937.name: Abnormal nasal skeleton morphology
HP:0010937.definition: An abnormality of the nasal skeleton.

HP:0010938.name: Abnormal external nose morphology
HP:0010938.definition: An abnormality of the external nose.

HP:0010939.name: Abnormal nasal bone morphology
HP:0010939.definition: An abnormality of the nasal bone, comprising the left nasal bone and the right nasal bone.
HP:0010939.definition_cn: 鼻骨异常，包括左侧鼻骨和右侧鼻骨。

HP:0010940.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the nasal bone
HP:0010940.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasal bone.
HP:0010940.name_cn: 鼻骨发育不全/鼻骨发育不良

HP:0010942.name: Echogenic intracardiac focus
HP:0010942.definition: A finding of a focus of increased echogenicity upon prenatal ultrasound examination of the fetus. The foci may be present in one or both ventricles. Echogenic intracardiac focus (EICF) is defined as a focus of echogenicity comparable to bone, in the region of the papillary muscle in either or both ventricles of the fetal heart.
HP:0010942.definition_cn: 产前胎儿超声检查中发现一处回声增强的病灶。该病灶可能存在于一侧或双侧心室。心内强回声灶（Echogenic Intracardiac Focus, EICF）定义为胎儿心脏一侧或双侧心室乳头肌区域内的回声强度与骨骼相当的病灶。

HP:0010943.name: Echogenic fetal bowel
HP:0010943.definition: Echogenic bowel is defined as fetal bowel with homogenous areas of echogenicity that are equal to or greater than that of surrounding bone.
HP:0010943.definition_cn: 回声增强肠管定义为胎儿肠管中出现均匀的回声区域，其回声强度等于或高于周围骨骼的回声强度。

HP:0010944.name: Abnormal renal pelvis morphology
HP:0010944.definition: An abnormality of the renal pelvis.

HP:0010945.name: Fetal pyelectasis
HP:0010945.definition: Mild pyelectasis is defined as a hypoechoic spherical or elliptical space within the renal pelvis that measures at least 5mm and not more than 10 mm. The measurement is taken on a transverse section through the fetal renal pelvis using the maximum anterior-to-posterior measurement.
HP:0010945.definition_cn: 轻度肾盂扩张定义为肾盂内低回声球形或椭圆形空间，其前后径测量值至少为5毫米且不超过10毫米。该测量通过胎儿肾盂的横切面进行，采用最大前后径测量。

HP:0010946.name: Dilatation of the renal pelvis
HP:0010946.definition: The presence of dilatation of the renal pelvis.

HP:0010947.name: Abnormality of ductus venosus blood flow
HP:0010947.definition: A first-trimester prenatal ultrasound finding of abnormal blood flow in the ductus venosus.
HP:0010947.definition_cn: 妊娠早期产前超声检查发现静脉导管血流异常。

HP:0010948.name: Abnormal fetal cardiovascular morphology
HP:0010948.definition: A structural abnormality of the fetal circulation system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0010948.definition_cn: 胎儿循环系统的结构异常。该子层次结构中的术语仅限于在产前期间才能观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0010949.name: Abnormality of umbilical vein blood flow
HP:0010949.definition: A first-trimester prenatal ultrasound finding of abnormal blood flow in the umbilical vein.
HP:0010949.definition_cn: 妊娠早期产前超声检查发现脐静脉血流异常。

HP:0010950.name: Abnormal fourth ventricle morphology
HP:0010950.definition: An abnormality of the fourth ventricle.

HP:0010951.name: Abnormal third ventricle morphology
HP:0010951.definition: An abnormality of the third ventricle.

HP:0010952.name: Mild fetal ventriculomegaly
HP:0010952.definition: A kind of ventriculomegaly occurring in the fetal period and usually diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound. Cerebral ventriculomegaly is defined by atrial measurements 10 mm or more. Mild ventriculomegaly (MVM) is defined as measurements between 10 and 15 mm. Measurements are obtained from an axial plane at the level of the thalamic nuclei just below the standard image to measure the BPD (PMID:16100637).
HP:0010952.definition_cn: 一种发生于胎儿期且通常通过产前超声诊断的脑室扩大。脑室扩大定义为心房测量值≥10毫米。轻度脑室扩大（MVM）定义为测量值在10至15毫米之间。测量值取自丘脑核水平轴位平面，位于标准图像下方，用于测量双顶径（BPD）（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0010953.name: Noncommunicating hydrocephalus
HP:0010953.definition: A form of hydrocephalus in which the flow of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) within the cerebral ventricular system or in the outlets of the CSF to the arachnoid space is obstructed.
HP:0010953.definition_cn: 一种脑积水类型，其中脑室系统内或脑脊液（CSF）向蛛网膜下腔的出口处发生阻塞。

HP:0010954.name: Hypoplastic right heart
HP:0010954.definition: Underdevelopment of the right-sided structures of the heart.

HP:0010955.name: Dilatation of the bladder
HP:0010955.definition: The presence of a dilated urinary bladder.

HP:0010956.name: Fetal megacystis
HP:0010956.definition: Fetal megacystis is an abnormally enlarged bladder identified at any gestational age.
HP:0010956.definition_cn: 胎儿巨膀胱是在任何孕龄期均可识别的膀胱异常增大。

HP:0010957.name: Congenital posterior urethral valve
HP:0010957.definition: A developmental defect resulting in an obstructing membrane in the posterior male urethra.
HP:0010957.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷导致的后尿道梗阻性膜性结构。

HP:0010958.name: Bilateral renal agenesis
HP:0010958.definition: A bilateral form of agenesis of the kidney.

HP:0010959.name: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation
HP:0010959.definition: Congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM) - previously known as congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation (CCAM) - is a relatively rare developmental malformation of the lower respiratory tract. It is a hamartomatous, dysplastic developmental abnormality of the lung characterized by abnormal airway patterning during lung branching morphogenesis and is formed by abnormal branching of the immature bronchioles.
HP:0010959.definition_cn: 先天性肺气道畸形（Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation, CPAM）——既往称为先天性囊性腺瘤样畸形（Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation, CCAM）——是一种相对罕见的呼吸道发育畸形。它是一种肺的错构瘤性、发育不良性异常，特征为肺分支形态发生过程中气道模式的异常，由未成熟细支气管的异常分支形成。

HP:0010960.name: obsolete Bronchopulmonary sequestration
HP:0010960.name_cn: 废弃的支气管肺隔离症

HP:0010963.name: Absence of stomach bubble on fetal sonography
HP:0010963.definition: By the 14th week of gestation it is nearly always possible to visualized the fluid-filled fetal stomach bubble on prenatal sonography. This term refers to the absence of a normal fetal stomach bubble on fetal ultrasonography performed at around 16 to 20 weeks' gestation.
HP:0010963.name_cn: 胎儿超声检查中胃泡缺失
HP:0010963.definition_cn: 在妊娠第14周时，几乎总能在产前超声检查中观察到充满液体的胎儿胃泡。该术语指的是在妊娠约16至20周进行的胎儿超声检查中，未能观察到正常的胎儿胃泡。

HP:0010964.name: Abnormal circulating long-chain fatty-acid concentration
HP:0010964.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a long-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010964.name_cn: 异常循环长链脂肪酸浓度
HP:0010964.definition_cn: 血液循环中长链脂肪酸正常浓度的任何偏离。

HP:0010965.name: Abnormal circulating phytanic acid concentration
HP:0010965.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of phytanic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010965.definition_cn: 血液中植烷酸浓度异常。

HP:0010966.name: Abnormal circulating fatty-acid anion concentration
HP:0010966.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a fatty acid anion in the blood circulation.
HP:0010966.name_cn: 异常循环脂肪酸阴离子浓度
HP:0010966.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂肪酸阴离子浓度的任何异常。

HP:0010967.name: Abnormal circulating carnitine concentration
HP:0010967.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of carnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0010967.definition_cn: 血液循环中肉碱浓度的任何异常。

HP:0010970.name: Blood group antigen abnormality
HP:0010970.definition: An abnormality of an erythrocyte cell surface molecule.

HP:0010971.name: Absence of Lutheran antigen on erythrocytes
HP:0010971.definition: Absence of the Lutheran antigen (a type I integral membrane glycoprotein) from the surface of red blood cells.
HP:0010971.definition_cn: 红细胞表面缺乏Lutheran抗原（一种I型整合膜糖蛋白）。

HP:0010972.name: Anemia of inadequate production
HP:0010972.definition: A kind of anemia characterized by inadequate production of erythrocytes.
HP:0010972.definition_cn: 一种以红细胞生成不足为特征的贫血。

HP:0010975.name: Abnormal B cell count
HP:0010975.definition: A deviation from the normal count of B cells, i.e., the cells that are formed in the bone marrow, migrate to the peripheral lymphatic system, and mature into plasma cells or memory cells.
HP:0010975.definition_cn: B细胞数量异常，即由骨髓生成、迁移至外周淋巴系统并分化为浆细胞或记忆细胞的细胞数量偏离正常范围。

HP:0010976.name: B lymphocytopenia
HP:0010976.definition: An abnormal decrease from the normal count of B cells.

HP:0010977.name: Abnormal phagocytosis
HP:0010977.definition: An abnormal functioning of phagocytosis. Phagocytosis is an elegant but complex process for the ingestion and elimination of pathogens, but it is also important for the elimination of apoptotic cells and hence fundamental for tissue homeostasis. Phagocytosis can be divided into four main steps: (i) recognition of the target particle, (ii) signaling to activate the internalization machinery, (iii) phagosome formation, and (iv) phagolysosome maturation.
HP:0010977.definition_cn: 吞噬功能异常。吞噬作用是一种精细而复杂的过程，用于摄取和清除病原体，同时对于清除凋亡细胞也至关重要，因此对组织稳态具有基础性作用。吞噬作用可分为四个主要步骤：(i) 靶颗粒的识别，(ii) 激活内化机制的信号传导，(iii) 吞噬体形成，以及(iv) 吞噬溶酶体成熟。

HP:0010978.name: Abnormality of immune system physiology
HP:0010978.definition: A functional abnormality of the immune system.
HP:0010978.name_cn: 免疫系统生理功能异常

HP:0010979.name: Abnormality of lipoprotein cholesterol concentration
HP:0010979.definition: An abnormal increase or decrease in the level of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.
HP:0010979.name_cn: 脂蛋白胆固醇浓度异常
HP:0010979.definition_cn: 血液中脂蛋白胆固醇水平的异常升高或降低。

HP:0010980.name: Hyperlipoproteinemia
HP:0010980.definition: An abnormal increase in the level of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.
HP:0010980.definition_cn: 血液中脂蛋白胆固醇水平的异常升高。

HP:0010981.name: Hypolipoproteinemia
HP:0010981.definition: An abnormal decrease in the level of lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.
HP:0010981.definition_cn: 血液中脂蛋白胆固醇水平的异常降低。

HP:0010982.name: Polygenic inheritance
HP:0010982.definition: A mode of inheritance that depends on a mixture of major and minor genetic determinants possibly together with environmental factors. Diseases inherited in this manner are termed complex diseases.
HP:0010982.definition_cn: 一种遗传模式，依赖于主要和次要遗传决定因素的混合，可能与环境因素共同作用。以此方式遗传的疾病被称为复杂疾病。

HP:0010983.name: Oligogenic inheritance
HP:0010983.definition: A type of multifactorial inheritance governed by the simultaneous action of a few gene loci. It is recommended this term be used for traits governed by three loci, although it is noted that usage of this term in the literature is not uniform.
HP:0010983.definition_cn: 一种由多个基因位点同时作用所控制的多因素遗传类型。建议该术语用于由三个基因位点控制的性状，尽管文献中对该术语的使用并不统一。

HP:0010984.name: Digenic inheritance
HP:0010984.definition: A type of multifactorial inheritance governed by the simultaneous action of two gene loci.
HP:0010984.definition_cn: 一种由两个基因位点同时作用控制的多因素遗传类型。

HP:0010987.name: Abnormal cellular immune system morphology
HP:0010987.definition: An abnormality of the morphology or counts of the cells that make up the immune system.
HP:0010987.name_cn: 异常细胞免疫系统形态学
HP:0010987.definition_cn: 免疫系统细胞形态或数量异常。

HP:0010988.name: Abnormality of the extrinsic pathway
HP:0010988.definition: An abnormality of the extrinsic pathway (also known as the tissue factor pathway) of the coagulation cascade.
HP:0010988.definition_cn: 凝血级联反应中外源性途径（也称为组织因子途径）的异常。

HP:0010989.name: Abnormality of the intrinsic pathway
HP:0010989.definition: An abnormality of the intrinsic pathway (also known as the contact activation pathway) of the coagulation cascade.
HP:0010989.definition_cn: 凝血级联反应内源性途径（亦称接触激活途径）异常。

HP:0010990.name: Abnormality of the common coagulation pathway
HP:0010990.definition: An abnormality of blood coagulation, common pathway.
HP:0010990.definition_cn: 血液凝固异常，共同途径。

HP:0010991.name: Abnormal morphology of the abdominal musculature
HP:0010991.definition: An abnormality of the abdominal musculature.

HP:0010992.name: Stress urinary incontinence
HP:0010992.definition: Involuntary urine leakage synchronous with exertion, or actions such as sneezing, or coughing.
HP:0010992.definition_cn: 与用力、打喷嚏或咳嗽等动作同步发生的非自主性尿液漏出。

HP:0010993.name: Abnormal cerebral subcortex morphology
HP:0010993.definition: An abnormality of the cerebral subcortex.

HP:0010994.name: Abnormal corpus striatum morphology
HP:0010994.definition: Abnormality of the striatum, which is the largest nucleus of the basal ganglia, comprising the caudate, putamen and ventral striatum, including the nucleus accumbens.
HP:0010994.definition_cn: 纹状体异常，纹状体为基底神经节中最大的核团，包括尾状核、壳核及腹侧纹状体，其中腹侧纹状体包含伏隔核。

HP:0010995.name: Abnormal circulating dicarboxylic acid concentration
HP:0010995.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a dicarboxylic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010995.definition_cn: 血液循环中二羧酸浓度与正常值的任何偏离。

HP:0010996.name: Abnormal circulating monocarboxylic acid concentration
HP:0010996.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a monocarboxylic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0010996.definition_cn: 血液中单羧酸浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0010997.name: Chromosomal breakage induced by ionizing radiation
HP:0010997.definition: Increased amount of chromosomal breaks in cultured blood lymphocytes or other cells induced by treatment with ionizing radiation.
HP:0010997.name_cn: 电离辐射诱导的染色体断裂
HP:0010997.definition_cn: 电离辐射处理后培养的血液淋巴细胞或其他细胞中染色体断裂数量增加。

HP:0010998.name: Increased susceptibility to spontaneous sister chromatid exchange
HP:0010998.definition: An increase in the number of spontaneous sister chromatid exchanges observed in cell culture of lymphocytes or other cells.
HP:0010998.name_cn: 自发性姐妹染色单体交换易感性增加
HP:0010998.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞或其他细胞培养中观察到的自发姐妹染色单体交换数量增加。

HP:0011000.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the optic tract
HP:0011000.name_cn: 视神经束发育不全/视神经束发育不良

HP:0011001.name: Increased bone mineral density
HP:0011001.definition: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density, that is, of the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones which is often referred to as osteosclerosis. Osteosclerosis can be detected on radiological examination as an increased whiteness (density) of affected bones.
HP:0011001.definition_cn: 骨矿物质密度异常增高，即每立方厘米骨骼中物质含量的增加，通常称为骨硬化症。骨硬化症可通过放射学检查发现，表现为受累骨骼的白色度（密度）增加。

HP:0011002.name: Osteopetrosis
HP:0011002.definition: Abnormally increased formation of dense trabecular bone tissue. Despite the increased density of bone tissue, osteopetrotic bones tend to be more fracture-prone than normal.
HP:0011002.definition_cn: 异常增加的致密骨小梁组织形成。尽管骨组织密度增加，但骨硬化症患者的骨骼往往比正常骨骼更易发生骨折。

HP:0011003.name: High myopia
HP:0011003.definition: A severe form of myopia with greater than -6.00 diopters.

HP:0011004.name: Abnormal systemic arterial morphology
HP:0011004.definition: An abnormality of the systemic arterial tree, which consists of the aorta and other systemic arteries.
HP:0011004.definition_cn: 系统性动脉树异常，包括主动脉及其他系统性动脉。

HP:0011005.name: Mixed cirrhosis
HP:0011005.definition: A type of cirrhosis characterized by the presence of regenerative nodules of a variety of sizes.
HP:0011005.definition_cn: 一种以存在多种大小再生结节为特征的肝硬化类型。

HP:0011006.name: Abnormal morphology of the musculature of the neck
HP:0011006.definition: An abnormality of the neck musculature.
HP:0011006.name_cn: 颈部肌肉组织形态异常

HP:0011008.name: Temporal pattern
HP:0011008.definition: The speed at which disease manifestations appear and develop.
HP:0011008.definition_cn: 疾病临床表现的出现和发展速度。

HP:0011009.name: Acute
HP:0011009.definition: Sudden appearance of disease manifestations over a short period of time.

HP:0011010.name: Chronic
HP:0011010.definition: Slow, creeping onset, slow progress and long continuance of disease manifestations.
HP:0011010.definition_cn: 缓慢、隐匿性起病，病程进展缓慢，疾病表现持续时间长。

HP:0011011.name: Subacute
HP:0011011.definition: Somewhat rapid onset and change of disease manifestations.
HP:0011011.definition_cn: 疾病表现呈较快起病及变化。

HP:0011012.name: Abnormal circulating polysaccharide concentration
HP:0011012.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a polysaccharide in the blood circulation.
HP:0011012.definition_cn: 血液循环中多糖浓度异常。

HP:0011013.name: Abnormal circulating carbohydrate concentration
HP:0011013.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a carbohydrate in the blood circulation.
HP:0011013.name_cn: 异常循环碳水化合物浓度

HP:0011015.name: Abnormal blood glucose concentration
HP:0011015.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of glucose in the blood.

HP:0011016.name: obsolete Abnormality of urine glucose concentration

HP:0011017.name: Abnormal cellular physiology
HP:0011017.definition: An abnormality in a cellular process.

HP:0011018.name: Abnormality of the cell cycle
HP:0011018.definition: An abnormality of the cell cycle.

HP:0011020.name: Abnormality of mucopolysaccharide metabolism
HP:0011020.definition: An abnormality of the metabolism of mucopolysaccharide.

HP:0011021.name: Abnormal circulating enzyme concentration
HP:0011021.definition: The concentration or activity of an enzyme in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of the normal range.
HP:0011021.definition_cn: 血液循环中酶的浓度或活性超出正常范围。

HP:0011022.name: Abnormal circulating unsaturated fatty acid concentration
HP:0011022.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of an unsaturated fatty acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0011022.name_cn: 异常循环不饱和脂肪酸浓度
HP:0011022.definition_cn: 血液循环中不饱和脂肪酸浓度异常。

HP:0011023.name: Abnormal circulating prostaglandin circulation
HP:0011023.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a prostaglandin in the blood circulation.
HP:0011023.name_cn: 异常循环前列腺素循环
HP:0011023.definition_cn: 血液循环中前列腺素浓度的任何异常。

HP:0011024.name: Abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
HP:0011024.definition: An abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract.

HP:0011025.name: Abnormal cardiovascular system physiology
HP:0011025.definition: Abnormal functionality of the cardiovascular system.
HP:0011025.name_cn: 心血管系统生理功能异常

HP:0011026.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the vagina
HP:0011026.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the vagina.
HP:0011026.name_cn: 阴道发育不全/阴道发育不良
HP:0011026.definition_cn: 阴道发育不全或阴道发育不良。

HP:0011027.name: Abnormal fallopian tube morphology
HP:0011027.definition: An abnormality of the fallopian tube.

HP:0011029.name: Internal hemorrhage
HP:0011029.definition: The presence of hemorrhage within the body.
HP:0011029.definition_cn: 体内出血（Hemorrhage within the body）

HP:0011030.name: Abnormal blood transition element cation concentration
HP:0011030.definition: An abnormality of the homeostasis (concentration) of transition element cation.
HP:0011030.name_cn: 异常血液过渡元素阳离子浓度
HP:0011030.definition_cn: 过渡元素阳离子稳态（浓度）异常。

HP:0011031.name: Abnormality of iron homeostasis
HP:0011031.definition: An abnormality of the homeostasis (concentration) of iron cation.
HP:0011031.definition_cn: 铁阳离子稳态（浓度）异常。

HP:0011032.name: Abnormality of fluid regulation
HP:0011032.definition: An abnormality of the regulation of body fluids.

HP:0011033.name: Impairment of fructose metabolism
HP:0011033.definition: An impairment of a fructose metabolic process.

HP:0011034.name: Amyloidosis
HP:0011034.definition: The presence of amyloid deposition in one or more tissues. Amyloidosis may be defined as the extracellular deposition of amyloid in one or more sites of the body.
HP:0011034.definition_cn: 一种或多种组织中存在淀粉样蛋白沉积。淀粉样变性可定义为淀粉样蛋白在身体一个或多个部位的细胞外沉积。

HP:0011035.name: Abnormal renal cortex morphology
HP:0011035.definition: An abnormality of the cortex of the kidney.

HP:0011036.name: Abnormality of renal excretion
HP:0011036.definition: An altered ability of the kidneys to void urine and/or specific substances.
HP:0011036.definition_cn: 肾脏排泄尿液和/或特定物质的能力发生改变。

HP:0011037.name: Decreased urine output
HP:0011037.definition: A decreased rate of urine production.

HP:0011039.name: Abnormal helix morphology
HP:0011039.definition: An abnormality of the helix. The helix is the outer rim of the ear that extends from the insertion of the ear on the scalp (root) to the termination of the cartilage at the earlobe.
HP:0011039.definition_cn: 耳轮畸形。耳轮是指从耳部与头皮连接处（根部）延伸至耳垂软骨末端的外耳边缘。

HP:0011040.name: Abnormal intrahepatic bile duct morphology
HP:0011040.definition: An abnormality of the intrahepatic bile duct.

HP:0011041.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cervical spine
HP:0011041.definition: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the cervical vertebral column.
HP:0011041.name_cn: 颈椎发育不全/颈椎发育不良
HP:0011041.definition_cn: 颈椎发育不全或发育不良。

HP:0011043.name: Abnormal circulating adrenocorticotropin concentration
HP:0011043.definition: An abnormal concentration of corticotropin in the blood.
HP:0011043.name_cn: 异常循环促肾上腺皮质激素浓度
HP:0011043.definition_cn: 血液中促肾上腺皮质激素浓度异常。

HP:0011044.name: Abnormal number of permanent teeth
HP:0011044.definition: The presence of an altered number of of permanent teeth.

HP:0011045.name: Agenesis of permanent maxillary central incisor

HP:0011046.name: Agenesis of primary maxillary central incisor
HP:0011046.definition: Agenesis of upper central primary incisor.

HP:0011047.name: Agenesis of primary mandibular central incisor

HP:0011048.name: Agenesis of permanent mandibular central incisor

HP:0011049.name: Agenesis of primary maxillary lateral incisor
HP:0011049.definition: Agenesis of one or more maxillary lateral incisor, comprising the maxillary lateral primary incisor.
HP:0011049.definition_cn: 上颌侧切牙缺失，包括上颌乳侧切牙。

HP:0011050.name: Agenesis of permanent maxillary lateral incisor
HP:0011050.definition: Agenesis of one or more upper lateral secondary incisor.
HP:0011050.definition_cn: 上颌侧切牙部分或完全缺失。

HP:0011056.name: Agenesis of first permanent molar tooth
HP:0011056.definition: Agenesis of either maxillary first permanent molar or mandibular first permanent molar or both.
HP:0011056.definition_cn: 上颌第一恒磨牙或下颌第一恒磨牙或两者同时发生的发育不全。

HP:0011057.name: Agenesis of second permanent molar
HP:0011057.definition: Agenesis of either mandibular second permanent molar or maxillary second permanent molar.
HP:0011057.definition_cn: 下颌第二恒磨牙或上颌第二恒磨牙发育不全。

HP:0011060.name: Dentinogenesis imperfecta limited to primary teeth
HP:0011060.definition: Developmental dysplasia of dentin affecting only the primary dentition.
HP:0011060.name_cn: 局限于乳牙的牙本质发育不全
HP:0011060.definition_cn: 仅影响乳牙列的牙本质发育不良。

HP:0011061.name: Abnormality of dental structure
HP:0011061.definition: An abnormality of the structure or composition of the teeth.

HP:0011063.name: Abnormal incisor morphology
HP:0011063.definition: An abnormality of morphology of the incisor tooth.

HP:0011064.name: Abnormal number of incisors
HP:0011064.definition: The presence of an altered number of the incisor teeth.

HP:0011065.name: Conical incisor
HP:0011065.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of the incisor tooth.

HP:0011067.name: Mesiodens
HP:0011067.definition: A supernumerary tooth in the midline between the maxillary central incisors.
HP:0011067.definition_cn: 位于上颌中切牙之间的正中多生牙。

HP:0011069.name: Supernumerary tooth
HP:0011069.definition: The presence of one or more teeth additional to the normal number.

HP:0011070.name: Abnormal molar morphology
HP:0011070.definition: An abnormality of morphology of molar tooth.

HP:0011071.name: Abnormal permanent molar morphology
HP:0011071.definition: An abnormality of morphology of permanent molar.

HP:0011073.name: Abnormality of dental color
HP:0011073.definition: A developmental defect of tooth color.

HP:0011074.name: Localized hypoplasia of dental enamel
HP:0011074.definition: A localized form of developmental hypoplasia of the dental enamel.
HP:0011074.name_cn: 局部性牙釉质发育不全
HP:0011074.definition_cn: 局部性牙釉质发育不全。

HP:0011079.name: Impacted tooth
HP:0011079.definition: A tooth that has not erupted because of local impediments (overcrowding or fibrous gum overgrowth).
HP:0011079.definition_cn: 阻生牙（由于局部阻碍因素，如牙列拥挤或牙龈纤维性增生，导致牙齿未能正常萌出）。

HP:0011080.name: Abnormal premolar morphology
HP:0011080.definition: An abnormality of morphology of premolar tooth.

HP:0011081.name: Incisor macrodontia
HP:0011081.definition: Increased size of the incisor tooth.

HP:0011082.name: Conical primary incisor
HP:0011082.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of the primary incisor.
HP:0011082.definition_cn: 原发性切牙异常锥形形态。

HP:0011083.name: Conical maxillary incisor
HP:0011083.definition: An abnormal conical morphology of either maxillary primary incisor tooth or maxillary permanent incisor tooth or both.
HP:0011083.definition_cn: 上颌乳切牙或上颌恒切牙或两者均呈现异常的锥形形态。

HP:0011084.name: Hypocalcification of dental enamel
HP:0011084.definition: A form of hypomineralization of enamel characterized by reduced calcification.
HP:0011084.definition_cn: 一种釉质矿化不全的形式，其特征为钙化程度降低。

HP:0011085.name: Hypomature dental enamel
HP:0011085.definition: A form of hypomineralization of enamel characterized by a chalky appearance of the enamel with orange, brown, or white color.
HP:0011085.definition_cn: 一种釉质矿化不全的形式，其特征为釉质呈现白垩状外观，伴有橙色、棕色或白色改变。

HP:0011086.name: Dentinogenesis imperfecta of primary and permanent teeth
HP:0011086.definition: Developmental dysplasia of dentin or both the primary dentition and the permanent dentition.
HP:0011086.name_cn: 乳牙和恒牙的牙本质发育不全症
HP:0011086.definition_cn: 牙本质发育不良或乳牙列与恒牙列发育不良。

HP:0011087.name: Talon cusp
HP:0011087.definition: Talon cusp is an accessory cusp located near the cingulum (the portion of the lingual or palatal aspect of the tooth that forms a convex protuberance at the cervical third of the anatomic crown).
HP:0011087.definition_cn: 鹰状尖牙是一种位于舌侧隆突附近的副尖牙，舌侧隆突是指牙齿舌侧或腭侧在解剖牙冠颈三分之一处形成的凸起部分。

HP:0011088.name: Dens in dente
HP:0011088.definition: An abnormality of the incisor characterized by invagination of the enamel, giving a radiographic appearance that suggests a tooth within a tooth.
HP:0011088.definition_cn: 切牙异常，其特征为釉质内陷，在影像学上呈现“牙中牙”的外观。

HP:0011089.name: Double tooth
HP:0011089.definition_cn: 邻牙融合（Fusion of two adjacent teeth）

HP:0011090.name: Fused teeth
HP:0011090.definition: The union of two separately developing tooth germs typically leading to one less tooth than normal in the affected dental arch.
HP:0011090.definition_cn: 两个独立发育的牙胚融合，通常导致受影响牙弓中的牙齿数量比正常情况少一颗。

HP:0011091.name: Gemination
HP:0011091.definition: The development of two teeth from a single tooth bud, leading to a larger fused tooth.
HP:0011091.definition_cn: 由单一牙胚发育形成两颗牙齿，导致较大的融合牙。

HP:0011092.name: Mulberry molar
HP:0011092.definition: Mulberry molars are irregular teeth generally affecting the first molars and are characterized by a grossly deformed crown imitating, as the name implies, the surface of a mulberry.
HP:0011092.definition_cn: 桑葚状磨牙是一种不规则牙齿，通常影响第一磨牙，其特征是牙冠严重畸形，正如其名所示，模仿了桑葚的表面形态。

HP:0011093.name: Molarization of premolar
HP:0011093.definition: Increased size and molar morphology of premolar tooth.
HP:0011093.definition_cn: 前磨牙体积增大及磨牙形态学改变。

HP:0011094.name: Increased overbite
HP:0011094.definition: Maxillary teeth cover the mandibular teeth when biting to an increased degree. The feature is defined as a vertical overlap of the maxillary incisors over the mandibular incisors that exceeds 2 mm.
HP:0011094.definition_cn: 上颌牙齿在咬合时覆盖下颌牙齿的程度增加。该特征定义为上颌切牙对下颌切牙的垂直覆盖超过2毫米。

HP:0011095.name: Overjet
HP:0011095.definition: An abnormal anteroposterior extension of the maxillary teeth beyond the plane of the mandibular teeth upon jaw closure.
HP:0011095.definition_cn: 上颌牙在颌骨闭合时超出下颌牙平面的异常前后延伸。

HP:0011096.name: Peripheral demyelination
HP:0011096.definition: A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0011096.definition_cn: 周围神经系统有髓神经纤维的结间区髓鞘脱失。

HP:0011097.name: Epileptic spasm
HP:0011097.definition: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: Grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. Epileptic spasms frequently occur in clusters. Infantile spasms are the best known form, but spasms can occur at all ages
HP:0011097.definition_cn: 一种突然的屈曲、伸展或混合性伸展-屈曲运动，主要涉及近端和躯干肌肉，通常比肌阵挛运动持续时间更长，但不如强直性发作持久。可能出现局限性形式：如面部扭曲、点头或细微的眼球运动。癫痫性痉挛常以丛集形式发生。婴儿痉挛是最为人熟知的形式，但痉挛可发生于任何年龄。

HP:0011098.name: Speech apraxia
HP:0011098.definition: A type of apraxia that is characterized by difficulty or inability to execute speech movements because of problems with coordination and motor problems, leading to incorrect articulation. An increase of errors with increasing word and phrase length may occur.
HP:0011098.definition_cn: 一种构音失用症，其特征是由于协调和运动功能障碍导致难以或无法执行言语运动，从而导致发音错误。随着单词和短语长度的增加，错误可能会增多。

HP:0011099.name: Spastic hemiparesis
HP:0011099.definition: Unilateral paresis (weakness) with spasticity of the affected muscles and increased tendon reflexes.
HP:0011099.definition_cn: 单侧轻瘫（肌力减弱）伴受累肌肉痉挛及腱反射亢进。

HP:0011100.name: Intestinal atresia
HP:0011100.definition: An abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the intestine.
HP:0011100.definition_cn: 肠管结构异常闭锁或闭锁症。

HP:0011102.name: Ileal atresia
HP:0011102.definition: An abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the ileum.
HP:0011102.definition_cn: 回肠管状结构异常闭合或闭锁。

HP:0011103.name: Abnormal left ventricular outflow tract morphology
HP:0011103.definition: An abnormality of the outflow tract of the left ventricle.
HP:0011103.name_cn: 左心室流出道形态异常

HP:0011104.name: Abnormality of blood volume homeostasis
HP:0011104.definition: An abnormality in the amount of volume occupied by intravascular blood.

HP:0011105.name: Hypervolemia
HP:0011105.definition: An increase in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.
HP:0011105.definition_cn: 血管内液体量增加，特别是循环血容量增加。

HP:0011106.name: Hypovolemia
HP:0011106.definition: An decrease in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.
HP:0011106.definition_cn: 血管内液量减少，特别是循环血容量减少。

HP:0011107.name: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis
HP:0011107.definition: Recurrent episodes of ulceration of the oral mucosa, typically presenting as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border.
HP:0011107.definition_cn: 复发性口腔黏膜溃疡，通常表现为疼痛性、边界清晰的纤维蛋白覆盖的黏膜缺损，伴有充血边缘。

HP:0011110.name: Recurrent tonsillitis
HP:0011110.definition: Inflammation of the tonsils that has occurred repeatedly. The definition of recurrent may vary somewhat, but the criteria used recently as a measure of severity were five or more episodes of true tonsillitis per year, symptoms recurring for at least a year, and episodes that are disabling and that prevent normal functioning. In some cases recurrent tonsillitis may be related to immunosusceptibility. Evidence exists for a genetic predisposition for recurrent tonsillitis.
HP:0011110.definition_cn: 复发性扁桃体炎。复发的定义可能略有不同，但近期用于衡量严重程度的标准包括每年发生五次或以上的真正扁桃体炎发作、症状持续至少一年，以及发作导致功能障碍并影响正常生活。在某些情况下，复发性扁桃体炎可能与免疫易感性有关。已有证据表明复发性扁桃体炎存在遗传易感性。

HP:0011111.name: Abnormal immune serum protein physiology
HP:0011111.definition: An abnormality of the concentration or function of circulating immune proteins.
HP:0011111.name_cn: 异常免疫血清蛋白生理学
HP:0011111.definition_cn: 循环免疫蛋白浓度或功能异常。

HP:0011112.name: Abnormal circulating cytokine concentration
HP:0011112.definition: Abnormality of the cytokine levels in the blood, i.e., an abnormality of any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells.
HP:0011112.name_cn: 异常循环细胞因子浓度
HP:0011112.definition_cn: 血液中细胞因子水平异常，即由炎症性白细胞及某些非白细胞细胞产生的非抗体蛋白质中任何一种异常，这些蛋白质可影响其他细胞的行为。

HP:0011113.name: Abnormality of cytokine secretion
HP:0011113.definition: An abnormality in the production or cellular release of a cytokine (i.e., any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells).
HP:0011113.definition_cn: 细胞因子（即由炎症性白细胞和一些非白细胞细胞产生的非抗体蛋白质，能够影响其他细胞的行为）的产生或细胞释放异常。

HP:0011114.name: Defective production of NFKB1-dependent cytokines
HP:0011114.definition: An impairment in the production by leukocytes of NFKB1-dependent cytokines such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha and interferon-alpha.
HP:0011114.name_cn: NFKB1依赖性细胞因子生成缺陷
HP:0011114.definition_cn: 白细胞产生NFKB1依赖性细胞因子（如肿瘤坏死因子-α和干扰素-α）的功能受损。

HP:0011115.name: Abnormal circulating chemokine concentration
HP:0011115.definition: An abnormality in the production or cellular release of a chemokine (a class of cytokines).
HP:0011115.name_cn: 异常循环趋化因子浓度
HP:0011115.definition_cn: 趋化因子（一类细胞因子）产生或细胞释放异常。

HP:0011116.name: Abnormal circulating interferon concentration
HP:0011116.definition: The concentration of an interferon is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0011116.definition_cn: 干扰素浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0011117.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin concentration
HP:0011117.definition: The concentration of an interleukin (a class of cytokines) is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0011117.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素浓度
HP:0011117.definition_cn: 白细胞介素（一类细胞因子）的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0011118.name: Abnormality of tumor necrosis factor secretion
HP:0011118.definition: An abnormality in the production or cellular release of tumor necrosis factor.
HP:0011118.name_cn: 肿瘤坏死因子分泌异常
HP:0011118.definition_cn: 肿瘤坏死因子的生成或细胞释放异常。

HP:0011119.name: Abnormal nasal dorsum morphology
HP:0011119.definition: An abnormality of the nasal dorsum, also known as the nasal ridge.
HP:0011119.definition_cn: 鼻背异常，亦称鼻嵴异常。

HP:0011120.name: Concave nasal ridge
HP:0011120.definition: Nasal ridge curving posteriorly to an imaginary line that connects the nasal root and tip.
HP:0011120.definition_cn: 鼻梁向后弯曲至连接鼻根与鼻尖的假想线。

HP:0011121.name: Abnormal skin morphology
HP:0011121.definition: Any morphological abnormality of the skin.

HP:0011122.name: Abnormality of skin physiology
HP:0011122.definition: Any abnormality of the physiological function of the skin.

HP:0011123.name: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin
HP:0011123.definition: The presence of inflammation of the skin. That is, an abnormality of the skin resulting from the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes.
HP:0011123.definition_cn: 皮肤炎症的存在。即由于局部液体、血浆蛋白和白细胞积聚导致的皮肤异常。

HP:0011124.name: Abnormal epidermal morphology
HP:0011124.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of the epidermis.

HP:0011125.name: Abnormality of dermal melanosomes
HP:0011125.definition: An abnormality of the melanosomes, i.e., of the cellular organelles in which melanin pigments are synthesized and stored within melanocytes (the cells that produce pigment in the dermis).
HP:0011125.definition_cn: 黑色素体异常，即黑色素细胞（真皮层中产生色素的细胞）内合成和储存黑色素色素的细胞器异常。

HP:0011126.name: Nephroptosis
HP:0011126.definition: A significant descent of the kidney as the patient moves from the supine to the erect position.
HP:0011126.definition_cn: 患者从仰卧位转为直立位时，肾脏出现显著下降。

HP:0011127.name: Perioral eczema
HP:0011127.definition: A type of eczema that occurs in the lips and perioral area.
HP:0011127.definition_cn: 一种发生于唇部及口周区域的湿疹类型。

HP:0011128.name: Acute esophageal necrosis
HP:0011128.definition: A condition characterized by necrosis of the mucosal and submucosal layers of the esophagus not related to ingestion of caustic or other injurious agents. Endoscopically, there is a dark lesion ('black esophagus') distributed in a circumferential manner in the distal one-third of the esophagus with or without exudates. There is involvement of the distal esophagus ending sharply at the gastroesophageal junction.
HP:0011128.definition_cn: 一种以食管黏膜层和黏膜下层坏死为特征的疾病，与摄入腐蚀性或其他有害物质无关。内镜下可见远端三分之一食管呈环状分布的暗色病变（“黑食管”），伴或不伴渗出物。病变累及远端食管，并在胃食管连接处突然终止。

HP:0011129.name: Bilateral fetal pyelectasis
HP:0011129.definition: A bilateral form of fetal pyelectasis.

HP:0011130.name: Abnormal renal calyx morphology
HP:0011130.definition: Any abnormality of the morphology of the major calices or minor calices of the kidney.
HP:0011130.definition_cn: 肾大盏或肾小盏形态异常。

HP:0011131.name: Perianal dermatitis
HP:0011131.definition: The presence of a rash (change of color and texture) of the perianal skin.
HP:0011131.definition_cn: 肛周皮肤出现皮疹（颜色和质地改变）。

HP:0011132.name: Chronic furunculosis
HP:0011132.definition: A furuncle (boil) is a skin infection involving an entire hair follicle and nearby skin tissue. Chronic furunculosis refers to recurrent episodes of furuncles, often caused by recurrent staphylococcus infection.
HP:0011132.definition_cn: 疖（furuncle）是一种涉及整个毛囊及邻近皮肤组织的皮肤感染。慢性疖病（chronic furunculosis）是指疖的反复发作，通常由复发性葡萄球菌感染引起。

HP:0011133.name: Increased sensitivity to ionizing radiation
HP:0011133.definition: An abnormally increased sensitivity to the effects of ionizing radiation.
HP:0011133.name_cn: 对电离辐射的敏感性增加
HP:0011133.definition_cn: 对电离辐射效应的异常敏感性增加。

HP:0011134.name: Low-grade fever
HP:0011134.definition: Mild fever that does not exceed 38.5 degrees centigrade.
HP:0011134.definition_cn: 低热，体温不超过38.5摄氏度。

HP:0011135.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sweat glands
HP:0011135.definition: Absence or developmental hypoplasia of the sweat glands.
HP:0011135.name_cn: 汗腺发育不全/汗腺发育不良

HP:0011137.name: Non-pruritic urticaria
HP:0011137.definition: Pale reddish slightly elevated papules and plaques of 0.5-3 cm in diameter and not accompanied by pruritus.
HP:0011137.definition_cn: 直径0.5-3厘米的淡红色轻度隆起性丘疹和斑块，不伴瘙痒。

HP:0011138.name: Abnormal skin adnexa morphology
HP:0011138.definition: An abnormality of the skin adnexa (skin appendages), which are specialized skin structures located within the dermis and focally within the subcutaneous fatty tissue, comprising three histologically distinct structures: (1) the pilosebaceous unit (hair follicle and sebaceous glands); (2) the eccrine sweat glands; and (3) the apocrine glands.
HP:0011138.definition_cn: 皮肤附属器异常，这些附属器是位于真皮层内并局部位于皮下脂肪组织中的特殊皮肤结构，包括三种组织学上不同的结构：（1）毛囊皮脂腺单位（毛囊和皮脂腺）；（2）外泌汗腺；（3）顶泌汗腺。

HP:0011139.name: Gastric duplication
HP:0011139.definition: Gastric duplication is a usually cystic malformation of gastrointestinal tract, usually attached to the greater curvature of the stomach and has no communication with the stomach.
HP:0011139.definition_cn: 胃重复畸形是一种通常呈囊性的胃肠道畸形，通常附着于胃大弯，且与胃腔无交通。

HP:0011140.name: Gastrointestinal duplication
HP:0011140.definition: A spherical hollow structure with a smooth muscle coat, lined by a mucous membrane, and attached to any part of the gastrointestinal tract, from the base of the tongue to the anus.
HP:0011140.definition_cn: 一种球形空腔结构，具有平滑肌层，内衬黏膜，附着于从舌根至肛门的消化道任何部位。

HP:0011141.name: Age-related cataract
HP:0011141.definition: A type of cataract (opacification of the lens) that forms during the course of aging.
HP:0011141.definition_cn: 一种在衰老过程中形成的白内障（晶状体混浊）。

HP:0011142.name: Age-related nuclear cataract
HP:0011142.definition: A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the nucleus of the lens.
HP:0011142.name_cn: 年龄相关性核性白内障
HP:0011142.definition_cn: 一种主要影响晶状体核的年龄相关性白内障。

HP:0011143.name: Age-related cortical cataract
HP:0011143.definition: A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the cortex of the lens.
HP:0011143.name_cn: 年龄相关性皮质性白内障
HP:0011143.definition_cn: 一种主要累及晶状体皮质的年龄相关性白内障。

HP:0011144.name: Age-related posterior subcapsular cataract
HP:0011144.definition: A type of age-related cataract consisting of granular opacities occurring mainly in the central posterior cortex just under the posterior capsule.
HP:0011144.name_cn: 年龄相关性后囊下白内障
HP:0011144.definition_cn: 一种与年龄相关的白内障类型，主要表现为颗粒状混浊，主要发生在后囊膜下方的中央后皮质区域。

HP:0011145.name: Symptomatic seizures
HP:0011145.definition: A seizure that occurs in the context of a brain insult (systemic, toxic, or metabolic) and may not recur when the underlying cause has been removed or the acute phase has elapsed.
HP:0011145.definition_cn: 在脑损伤（系统性、毒性或代谢性）背景下发生的癫痫发作，当潜在病因消除或急性期结束后可能不再复发。

HP:0011146.name: Dialeptic seizure
HP:0011146.definition: A dialeptic seizure is a type of seizure characterized predominantly by reduced responsiveness or awareness and with subsequent at least partial amnesia of the event.
HP:0011146.definition_cn: 失神性癫痫发作是一种以反应性或意识减退为主要特征，并伴有至少部分事件遗忘的癫痫发作类型。

HP:0011147.name: Typical absence seizure
HP:0011147.definition: A typical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by its sudden onset, interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare, possibly a brief upward deviation of the eyes. Usually the patient will be unresponsive when spoken to. Duration is a few seconds to half a minute with very rapid recovery. Although not always available, an EEG would usually show 3 Hz generalized epileptiform discharges during the event.
HP:0011147.definition_cn: 典型失神发作是一种全身性非运动性（失神）发作，其特征为突然发作、活动中断、目光呆滞，可能伴有短暂的双眼上翻。通常患者在发作期间对言语刺激无反应。持续时间从数秒至半分钟不等，且恢复迅速。尽管并非总能获得，但脑电图（EEG）通常会在发作期间显示3 Hz的全身性癫痫样放电。

HP:0011148.name: obsolete Absence seizures with special features
HP:0011148.name_cn: 过时的具有特殊特征的失神发作

HP:0011149.name: Absence seizure with eyelid myoclonia
HP:0011149.definition: An absence with eyelid myoclonia seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by forced upward jerking of the eyelids during an absence seizure.
HP:0011149.name_cn: 眼睑肌阵挛性失神发作
HP:0011149.definition_cn: 眼睑肌阵挛性失神发作是一种全面性非运动性（失神）发作，其特征为在失神发作期间出现强制性眼睑向上抽动。

HP:0011150.name: Myoclonic absence seizure
HP:0011150.definition: Myoclonic absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by an interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare and rhythmic three-per-second myoclonic movements, causing ratcheting abduction of the upper limbs leading to progressive arm elevation, and associated with 3 Hz generalized spike-wave discharges on the electroencephalogram. Duration is typically 10-60 s. Whilst impairment of consciousness may not be obvious the ILAE classified this seizure as a generalized non-motor seizure in 2017.
HP:0011150.definition_cn: 肌阵挛失神发作是一种全面性非运动性（失神）发作，其特征为正在进行的中断活动、目光呆滞以及每秒三次的节律性肌阵挛运动，导致上肢渐进性外展并引起手臂逐渐抬高，同时伴有脑电图上3 Hz的全面性棘慢波放电。发作持续时间通常为10-60秒。尽管意识障碍可能不明显，但国际抗癫痫联盟（ILAE）在2017年将其归类为全面性非运动性发作。

HP:0011151.name: Atypical absence status epilepticus
HP:0011151.definition: Atypical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged atypical absence seizure.
HP:0011151.definition_cn: 非典型失神持续状态是一种广义的非惊厥性持续状态，不伴有昏迷，从症状学上看，它是一种延长的非典型失神发作。

HP:0011152.name: Early onset absence seizures
HP:0011152.definition: Typical absence seizures starting before the age of 4 years.
HP:0011152.definition_cn: 典型失神发作，起始于4岁之前。

HP:0011153.name: Focal motor seizure
HP:0011153.definition: A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by a motor sign as its initial semiological manifestation.
HP:0011153.name_cn: 局灶性运动性癫痫发作
HP:0011153.definition_cn: 一种以运动体征作为初始症状学表现的局灶性发作类型。

HP:0011154.name: Focal autonomic seizure
HP:0011154.definition: An autonomic seizure is a type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by alteration of autonomic nervous system function as the initial semiological feature.
HP:0011154.name_cn: 局灶性自主神经性癫痫发作
HP:0011154.definition_cn: 自主神经性发作是一种局灶性非运动性发作，其特征是以自主神经系统功能改变作为初始症状学表现。

HP:0011155.name: obsolete Focal autonomic seizures with altered responsiveness
HP:0011155.name_cn: 过时的术语：伴反应改变的局灶性自主神经性癫痫发作

HP:0011156.name: obsolete Focal autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness
HP:0011156.name_cn: 过时的局灶性自主神经性发作，无意识改变

HP:0011157.name: Focal sensory seizure
HP:0011157.definition: A focal sensory seizure is a type seizure beginning with a subjective sensation.
HP:0011157.name_cn: 局灶性感觉性癫痫发作
HP:0011157.definition_cn: 局灶性感觉性癫痫发作是一种以主观感觉为起始症状的癫痫发作类型。

HP:0011158.name: Focal sensory seizure with auditory features
HP:0011158.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary auditory phenomena including buzzing, ringing, drumming or single tones as its first clinical manifestation.
HP:0011158.name_cn: 伴有听觉特征的局灶性感觉性癫痫发作
HP:0011158.definition_cn: 以基本听觉现象（包括嗡嗡声、铃声、鼓声或单一音调）为首发临床表现的癫痫发作。

HP:0011159.name: Focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation/nausea/vomiting/other gastrointestinal phenomena
HP:0011159.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by symptoms or signs pertaining to the gastrointestinal system as the initial semiological feature.
HP:0011159.name_cn: 局灶性自主神经性癫痫发作伴上腹部感觉/恶心/呕吐/其他胃肠道现象
HP:0011159.definition_cn: 一种以胃肠道系统相关症状或体征作为初始症状学特征的局灶性自主神经性癫痫发作。

HP:0011160.name: Focal sensory seizure with gustatory features
HP:0011160.definition: A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes as its first clinical manifestation.
HP:0011160.name_cn: 伴有味觉特征的局灶性感觉性癫痫发作
HP:0011160.definition_cn: 以味觉现象（包括酸味、苦味、咸味、甜味或金属味）为首发临床表现的癫痫发作。

HP:0011161.name: Focal sensory seizure with olfactory features
HP:0011161.definition: Seizures characterized by olfactory phenomena as its first clinical manifestation.
HP:0011161.name_cn: 伴有嗅觉特征的局灶性感觉性癫痫发作
HP:0011161.definition_cn: 以嗅觉现象为首发临床表现的癫痫发作。

HP:0011163.name: Focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features
HP:0011163.definition: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move as its first clinical manifestation.
HP:0011163.name_cn: 局灶性感觉性癫痫发作伴躯体感觉特征
HP:0011163.definition_cn: 以感觉现象为首次临床表现的癫痫发作，包括刺痛感、麻木感、电击样感觉、疼痛感、运动感或运动欲望。

HP:0011165.name: Focal sensory seizure with visual features
HP:0011165.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colors, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis as its first clinical manifestation.
HP:0011165.name_cn: 局灶性感觉性癫痫发作伴视觉特征
HP:0011165.definition_cn: 以基本视觉幻觉（如闪光、闪烁的光线/颜色或其他形状）、简单图案、暗点或黑蒙作为首发临床表现的癫痫发作。

HP:0011166.name: Focal myoclonic seizure
HP:0011166.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction(s) of muscles(s) or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.
HP:0011166.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作类型，其特征为突然、短暂（<100毫秒）的不自主单一或多次肌肉或肌群收缩，涉及不同解剖部位（轴性、近端肢体、远端）。肌阵挛的重复性较阵挛更为不规则且持续时间较短。

HP:0011167.name: Focal tonic seizure
HP:0011167.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained increase in muscle contraction, lasting a few seconds to minutes.
HP:0011167.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作，其特征为肌肉收缩持续增强，持续时间从数秒至数分钟。

HP:0011168.name: Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia
HP:0011168.definition: Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia, not eyelid myoclonias in the context of absence seizures.
HP:0011168.name_cn: 局灶性癫痫伴眼睑肌阵挛
HP:0011168.definition_cn: 局灶性发作伴眼睑肌阵挛，而非失神发作背景下的眼睑肌阵挛。

HP:0011169.name: Generalized clonic seizure
HP:0011169.definition: Generalized clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by sustained bilateral jerking, either symmetric or asymmetric, that is regularly repetitive and involves the same muscle groups.
HP:0011169.definition_cn: 全身性强直阵挛发作是一种全身性运动性发作，其特征为持续的双侧抽搐，可为对称性或非对称性，呈规律性重复发作，并累及相同的肌群。

HP:0011170.name: Generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure
HP:0011170.definition: A generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a myoclonic jerk followed by an atonic motor component.
HP:0011170.name_cn: 全身性肌阵挛-失张力性癫痫发作
HP:0011170.definition_cn: 全身性肌阵挛-失张力发作是一种全身性运动性发作，其特征为肌阵挛性抽动后伴随失张力性运动成分。

HP:0011171.name: Simple febrile seizure
HP:0011171.definition: A short generalized seizure, of a duration of <15 min, not recurring within 24 h, occurring during a febrile episode not caused by an acute disease of the nervous system intracranial infection or severe metabolic disturbance.
HP:0011171.definition_cn: 短暂性全面性发作，持续时间小于15分钟，24小时内无复发，发生于非由急性神经系统疾病、颅内感染或严重代谢紊乱引起的发热期间。

HP:0011172.name: Complex febrile seizure
HP:0011172.definition: A febrile seizure that has any of the following features: focal semiology (or associated with post-ictal neurologic abnormalities beyond drowsiness, such as a Todd's paresis), prolonged seizure beyond 15 minutes, or recurring (occurring more than once) in a 24 hour period.
HP:0011172.definition_cn: 具有以下任一特征的发热性惊厥：局灶性症状学（或与嗜睡以外的发作后神经功能异常相关，如Todd麻痹）、持续时间超过15分钟的长时间惊厥，或在24小时内反复发作（发生超过一次）。

HP:0011173.name: Focal behavior arrest seizure
HP:0011173.definition: A type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by an arrest or pause of activities, freezing, or immobilization as the predominant semiological feature throughout the seizure.
HP:0011173.name_cn: 局灶性行为停止性癫痫发作
HP:0011173.definition_cn: 一种以活动停止、冻结或不动为主要半学特征的局灶性非运动性发作类型。

HP:0011174.name: Focal hyperkinetic seizure
HP:0011174.definition: A focal seizure characterized at onset by predominantly proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements, such as pedaling, pelvic thrusting, thrashing, rocking movements.
HP:0011174.name_cn: 局灶性运动过度性癫痫发作
HP:0011174.definition_cn: 一种局灶性癫痫发作，其特征为起始时主要累及近端肢体或轴性肌肉，产生不规则的连续弹道样运动，如蹬踏、骨盆前冲、猛烈摆动、摇摆运动。

HP:0011175.name: Focal motor seizure with version
HP:0011175.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained, forced conjugate ocular, cephalic, and/or truncal rotation or lateral deviation from the midline as the initial semiological manifestation.
HP:0011175.name_cn: 局灶性运动性发作伴扭转
HP:0011175.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作类型，其特征为初始症状学表现为持续的、强制的共轭性眼球、头部和/或躯干旋转或从中线向侧方偏斜。

HP:0011176.name: EEG with constitutional variants
HP:0011176.definition: An EEG with constitutional variants contains waves that are rare or unusual but not generally pathologic.
HP:0011176.name_cn: 脑电图显示体质性变异
HP:0011176.definition_cn: 脑电图显示体质性变异包含罕见或异常的波形，但通常不具有病理意义。

HP:0011177.name: EEG with 4-5/second background activity
HP:0011177.name_cn: 脑电图显示每秒4-5次的背景活动
HP:0011177.definition_cn: 脑电图背景活动为每秒4-5次。

HP:0011178.name: Alpha-EEG
HP:0011178.definition_cn: 脑电图以弥漫性α波（8-13Hz）为主。

HP:0011179.name: Beta-EEG
HP:0011179.definition: EEG dominated by diffuse beta-waves (>13 Hz).
HP:0011179.definition_cn: 脑电图以弥漫性β波（>13 Hz）为主。

HP:0011180.name: Partial beta-EEG
HP:0011180.definition: EEG dominated by diffuse beta waves (>13 Hz) with occipitally localized alpha waves (8-13 Hz).
HP:0011180.definition_cn: 脑电图以弥漫性β波（>13 Hz）为主，伴有枕部局灶性α波（8-13 Hz）。

HP:0011181.name: Low voltage EEG
HP:0011181.definition: EEG with an amplitude less than 30 microvolts without observable occipital alpha rhythm (8-13 Hz).
HP:0011181.definition_cn: 脑电图显示振幅低于30微伏，未见可观察到的枕部α节律（8-13赫兹）。

HP:0011182.name: Interictal epileptiform activity
HP:0011182.definition: Epileptiform activity refers to distinctive EEG waves or complexes distinguished from background activity found in in a proportion of human subjects with epilepsy, but which can also be found in subjects without seizures. Interictal epileptiform activity refers to such activity that occurs in the absence of a clinical or subclinical seizure.
HP:0011182.definition_cn: 癫痫样活动指的是在部分癫痫患者中发现的与背景活动相区别的独特脑电图波形或复合波，但也可在无癫痫发作的个体中发现。发作间期癫痫样活动是指在无临床或亚临床癫痫发作时出现的此类活动。

HP:0011183.name: EEG with hyperventilation-induced focal epileptiform discharges
HP:0011183.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0011183.name_cn: 脑电图显示过度换气诱发的局灶性癫痫样放电
HP:0011183.definition_cn: 过度换气（过度呼吸）诱发的局灶性癫痫样放电，通过脑电图（EEG）沿头皮记录的大脑电活动。

HP:0011184.name: EEG with hyperventilation-induced generalized epileptiform discharges
HP:0011184.definition: Generalized epileptiform discharges induced by hyperventilation (overbreathing) in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0011184.name_cn: 脑电图显示过度换气诱发的全面性癫痫样放电
HP:0011184.definition_cn: 过度换气（过度呼吸）诱发的广泛性癫痫样放电，通过脑电图（EEG）沿头皮记录的大脑电活动。

HP:0011185.name: EEG with focal epileptiform discharges
HP:0011185.definition: EEG discharges recorded in particular areas of a localized (focal) abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).
HP:0011185.name_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性癫痫样放电
HP:0011185.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）记录到沿头皮分布的局部（局灶性）脑电活动异常区域中的脑电放电。

HP:0011186.name: Focal epileptiform discharges with limited propagation to contralateral hemisphere
HP:0011186.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges with spreading to contralateral hemisphere but without secondary generalization.
HP:0011186.name_cn: 局灶性癫痫样放电伴对侧半球传播受限
HP:0011186.definition_cn: 局灶性癫痫样放电扩散至对侧半球但未继发全面性发作。

HP:0011187.name: Focal EEG discharges with propagation to ipsilateral hemisphere
HP:0011187.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges with spreading to the hemisphere on the same side of the brain.
HP:0011187.name_cn: 局灶性脑电图放电伴同侧半球扩散
HP:0011187.definition_cn: 同侧大脑半球扩散的局灶性癫痫样放电。

HP:0011188.name: Focal EEG discharges with secondary generalization
HP:0011188.definition: Focal EEG discharges that secondarily spread to both hemispheres and can then be recorded over the entire scalp.
HP:0011188.name_cn: 局灶性癫痫放电伴继发性全面性发作
HP:0011188.definition_cn: 局灶性脑电图放电继发扩散至双侧半球，随后可在整个头皮记录到。

HP:0011189.name: Bilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
HP:0011189.definition: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in both hemispheres.
HP:0011189.name_cn: 双侧多灶性癫痫样放电
HP:0011189.definition_cn: 双侧半球多个部位检测到癫痫样放电。

HP:0011190.name: Uni- and bilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
HP:0011190.definition: Epileptiform discharges identified at multiple locations temporarily in both hemispheres and temporarily in one hemisphere.
HP:0011190.name_cn: 单侧和双侧多灶性癫痫样放电
HP:0011190.definition_cn: 双侧半球及单侧半球多部位暂时性癫痫样放电。

HP:0011191.name: Unilateral multifocal epileptiform discharges
HP:0011191.definition: Epileptiform discharges being identified at multiple locations in one hemisphere.
HP:0011191.name_cn: 单侧多灶性癫痫样放电
HP:0011191.definition_cn: 单侧半球多部位出现癫痫样放电。

HP:0011192.name: Polymorphic focal epileptiform discharges
HP:0011192.definition: Focal epileptiform discharges of different shapes and frequencies.
HP:0011192.name_cn: 多形性局灶性癫痫样放电
HP:0011192.definition_cn: 不同形态和频率的局灶性癫痫样放电。

HP:0011193.name: EEG with focal spikes
HP:0011193.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.
HP:0011193.name_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性棘波
HP:0011193.definition_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性尖波，持续时间小于80毫秒。

HP:0011194.name: EEG with series of focal spikes
HP:0011194.definition: Focal spikes occurring for several seconds.
HP:0011194.name_cn: 脑电图显示一系列局灶性棘波

HP:0011195.name: EEG with focal sharp slow waves
HP:0011195.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011195.name_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性尖慢波
HP:0011195.definition_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性尖波，持续时间在80至200毫秒之间，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0011196.name: EEG with focal sharp waves
HP:0011196.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.
HP:0011196.name_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性尖波
HP:0011196.definition_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性尖波，持续时间在80至200毫秒之间。

HP:0011197.name: EEG with focal spike waves
HP:0011197.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011197.name_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性棘波
HP:0011197.definition_cn: 脑电图显示局灶性尖波，持续时间小于80毫秒，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0011198.name: EEG with generalized epileptiform discharges
HP:0011198.definition: EEG discharges recorded on the entire scalp typically seen in persons with epilepsy.
HP:0011198.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性癫痫样放电
HP:0011198.definition_cn: 全头皮记录的脑电图放电，通常见于癫痫患者。

HP:0011199.name: EEG with generalized sharp slow waves
HP:0011199.definition: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011199.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性尖慢波
HP:0011199.definition_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性尖波，持续时间在80至200毫秒之间，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0011200.name: EEG with generalized polymorphic epileptiform discharges
HP:0011200.definition: Generalized epileptiform discharges of different shapes and frequencies.
HP:0011200.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性多形性癫痫样放电
HP:0011200.definition_cn: 不同形态和频率的广泛性癫痫样放电。

HP:0011202.name: EEG with diffuse acceleration
HP:0011202.name_cn: 脑电图显示弥漫性加速

HP:0011203.name: EEG with abnormally slow frequencies
HP:0011203.name_cn: 脑电图显示异常慢波频率
HP:0011203.definition_cn: 脑电图显示异常慢波频率。

HP:0011204.name: EEG with continuous slow activity
HP:0011204.definition: EEG showing diffuse slowing without interruption.
HP:0011204.name_cn: 脑电图显示持续性慢波活动
HP:0011204.definition_cn: 脑电图显示弥漫性减慢，无间断。

HP:0011205.name: EEG with intermittent slow activity
HP:0011205.definition: Non-continuous diffuse slowing of electroencephalographic patterns.
HP:0011205.name_cn: 脑电图显示间歇性慢波活动
HP:0011205.definition_cn: 非连续性弥漫性脑电图慢波活动。

HP:0011206.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 1
HP:0011206.definition: Slowing at frequencies between 7.5 and 8.5 Hz.
HP:0011206.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性慢波活动1级
HP:0011206.definition_cn: 频率在7.5至8.5赫兹之间的减慢。

HP:0011207.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 2
HP:0011207.definition: Generalized slowing of EEG activity at frequencies between 4-7 Hz.
HP:0011207.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性慢波活动2级
HP:0011207.definition_cn: 脑电图活动普遍减慢，频率范围为4-7赫兹。

HP:0011208.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 3
HP:0011208.definition: Generalized slowing of EEG activity at frequencies between 0.5-3 Hz.
HP:0011208.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性慢波活动3级
HP:0011208.definition_cn: 广泛性脑电图活动减慢，频率范围为0.5-3赫兹。

HP:0011209.name: EEG with generalized slow activity grade 4
HP:0011209.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性慢波活动，4级。
HP:0011209.definition_cn: 脑电图显示电活动消失。

HP:0011210.name: EEG with occipital slowing
HP:0011210.definition: Slowing in occipital areas of the scalp EEG.
HP:0011210.definition_cn: 枕区头皮脑电图活动减慢。

HP:0011211.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade I
HP:0011211.definition: Occurrence of epileptiform discharges in occipital regions during photic stimulation.
HP:0011211.name_cn: 脑电图显示光阵发性反应Ⅰ级
HP:0011211.definition_cn: 光刺激期间枕区出现癫痫样放电。

HP:0011212.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade II
HP:0011212.definition: Occurrence of epileptiform discharges in occipital and central regions during photic stimulation.
HP:0011212.name_cn: 脑电图显示光阵发性反应II级
HP:0011212.definition_cn: 光刺激期间枕区和中央区出现癫痫样放电。

HP:0011213.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade III
HP:0011213.definition: Occurrence of epileptiform discharges in occipital, central, temporal and parietal regions during photic stimulation.
HP:0011213.name_cn: 脑电图显示光阵发性反应III级
HP:0011213.definition_cn: 光刺激期间枕叶、中央区、颞叶和顶叶出现癫痫样放电。

HP:0011214.name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response grade IV
HP:0011214.definition: Occurrence of generalized epileptiform discharges during photic stimulation.
HP:0011214.name_cn: 脑电图显示光阵发性反应IV级
HP:0011214.definition_cn: 光刺激期间出现广泛性癫痫样放电。

HP:0011215.name: Hemihypsarrhythmia
HP:0011215.definition_cn: 单侧半球性高度节律紊乱。

HP:0011218.name: Abnormal shape of the frontal region
HP:0011218.definition: An abnormal shape of the frontal part of the head.

HP:0011219.name: Short face
HP:0011219.definition: Facial height (length) is more than two standard deviations below the mean (objective); or an apparent decrease in the height (length) of the face (subjective).
HP:0011219.definition_cn: 面部高度（长度）低于平均值两个标准差以上（客观）；或面部高度（长度）明显减少（主观）。

HP:0011220.name: Prominent forehead
HP:0011220.definition: Forward prominence of the entire forehead, due to protrusion of the frontal bone.
HP:0011220.definition_cn: 额骨前突导致的全额前突。

HP:0011221.name: Vertical forehead creases
HP:0011221.definition: Vertical soft tissue creases in the midline of the forehead, often extending from the hairline to the brow, and seen with facial expression or when the face is at rest.
HP:0011221.definition_cn: 额中线垂直软组织皱褶，常从发际线延伸至眉部，可见于面部表情活动或面部静止时。

HP:0011222.name: Depressed glabella
HP:0011222.definition: Posterior positioning of the glabella, i.e., of the midline forehead between the supraorbital ridges.
HP:0011222.definition_cn: 眉间后位，即位于眶上嵴之间的前额中线区域的后移。

HP:0011223.name: Metopic depression
HP:0011223.definition: Linear vertical groove in the midline of the forehead, extending from hairline to glabella.
HP:0011223.definition_cn: 前额中线处自发际线至眉间延伸的线性垂直沟纹。

HP:0011225.name: Epiblepharon
HP:0011225.definition: Redundant eyelid skin pressing the eyelashes against the cornea and/or conjunctiva.
HP:0011225.definition_cn: 冗余眼睑皮肤压迫睫毛接触角膜和/或结膜。

HP:0011226.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the eyelid
HP:0011226.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the eyelid.
HP:0011226.name_cn: 眼睑发育不全/眼睑发育不良

HP:0011227.name: Elevated circulating C-reactive protein concentration
HP:0011227.definition: An abnormal elevation of the C-reactive protein level in the blood circulation.
HP:0011227.name_cn: 循环中C反应蛋白浓度升高
HP:0011227.definition_cn: 血液循环中C反应蛋白水平的异常升高。

HP:0011228.name: Horizontal eyebrow
HP:0011228.definition: An eyebrow that extends straight across the brow, without curve.

HP:0011229.name: Broad eyebrow
HP:0011229.definition: Regional increase in the width (height) of the eyebrow.
HP:0011229.definition_cn: 眉毛宽度（高度）的区域性增加。

HP:0011230.name: Laterally extended eyebrow
HP:0011230.definition: An eyebrow that extends laterally beyond the orbital rim rather than turning gently downward at that location.
HP:0011230.definition_cn: 眉弓向外侧延伸超过眶缘，而非在该处平缓向下转折。

HP:0011231.name: Prominent eyelashes
HP:0011231.definition: Eyelashes that draw the attention of the viewer due to increased density and/or length and/or curl without meeting the criteria of trichomegaly.
HP:0011231.definition_cn: 由于密度增加和/或长度增加和/或卷曲度增加而吸引观察者注意的睫毛，但不符合睫毛过长症（trichomegaly）的诊断标准。

HP:0011232.name: Infra-orbital fold
HP:0011232.definition: Elevated ridge(s) of skin starting well below the medial aspect of the lower lid that curves gradually upward toward and/or across the nasal bridge.
HP:0011232.definition_cn: 皮肤隆起从下眼睑内侧下方开始，逐渐向上弯曲延伸至和/或跨越鼻梁。

HP:0011233.name: Antihelical shelf
HP:0011233.definition: Antihelix protrusion directed more anteriorly than laterally, forming a shelf overlying the posterior concha.
HP:0011233.definition_cn: 对耳轮突出更向前而非向外，形成覆盖耳甲后部的隆起。

HP:0011234.name: Absent antihelix
HP:0011234.definition: No discernible ridge between concha and triangular fossa and helix.
HP:0011234.definition_cn: 耳甲与三角窝及耳轮之间无明显分界。

HP:0011235.name: Additional crus of antihelix
HP:0011235.definition: Supernumerary ridge or crus of the ear arising from the antihelix.
HP:0011235.definition_cn: 耳部副嵴或副脚，源自对耳轮。

HP:0011236.name: Angulated antihelix
HP:0011236.definition: Antihelical ridge that forms an acute angle between the antitragus and its bifurcation (stem) instead of a gently curving arc.
HP:0011236.definition_cn: 在耳屏与对耳屏分叉（茎部）之间形成锐角的对耳轮嵴，而非平缓的弧形曲线。

HP:0011237.name: Broad inferior crus of antihelix
HP:0011237.definition: Increased width of the inferred cross-section of the inferior crus.
HP:0011237.definition_cn: 下脚推断横截面宽度增加。

HP:0011238.name: Prominent inferior crus of antihelix
HP:0011238.definition: Increased protrusion of the inferior crus relative to the prominence of the antihelix stem.
HP:0011238.definition_cn: 下脚相对于对耳轮脚凸出度增加。

HP:0011239.name: Underdeveloped inferior crus of antihelix
HP:0011239.definition: Decreased protrusion of the inferior crus relative to the prominence of the antihelix stem.
HP:0011239.definition_cn: 下脚相对于对耳轮脚隆起的突出度降低。

HP:0011240.name: Prominent stem of antihelix
HP:0011240.definition: Increased protrusion of the antihelical ridge, proximal to its bifurcation, relative to the prominence of the helix.
HP:0011240.definition_cn: 对耳轮嵴在其分叉处近端相对于耳轮凸起的突出度增加。

HP:0011241.name: Serpiginous stem of antihelix
HP:0011241.definition: Posterior curving of the antihelix from its origin at the antitragus, traveling initially almost perpendicular to the descending helix and obscuring some of the concha.
HP:0011241.definition_cn: 从对耳屏起源处开始，对耳轮向后弯曲，最初几乎与降耳轮垂直，并部分遮挡了耳甲腔。

HP:0011242.name: Underdeveloped stem of antihelix
HP:0011242.definition: Decreased protrusion of the antihelical ridge, proximal to its bifurcation, relative to the prominence of a normal helix.
HP:0011242.definition_cn: 对耳轮嵴在其分叉处近端的突出程度降低，相对于正常耳轮的突出程度。

HP:0011243.name: Abnormality of inferior crus of antihelix
HP:0011243.definition: An abnormality of the inferior crus of the antihelix is the lower cartilaginous ridge arising at the bifurcation of the antihelix that ends beneath the fold of the ascending helix, and separates the concha from the triangular fossa.
HP:0011243.definition_cn: 对耳轮下脚异常是指在对耳轮分叉处出现的下方软骨嵴，该嵴终止于耳轮升部皱襞下方，并将耳甲腔与三角窝分隔开。

HP:0011244.name: Abnormality of stem of antihelix
HP:0011244.definition: An abnormality of the stem of the antihelix, which is the part below the bifurcation of the antihelix into the inferior and superior crura.
HP:0011244.definition_cn: 对耳轮干异常，即对耳轮分叉为下脚和上脚以下部分的异常。

HP:0011245.name: Abnormality of superior crus of antihelix
HP:0011245.definition: An abnormality of the superior crus of the antihelix is the upper cartilaginous ridge arising at the bifurcation of the antihelix that ends beneath the fold of the ascending helix, and separates the concha from the triangular fossa.
HP:0011245.definition_cn: 对耳轮上脚异常是指在对耳轮分叉处出现的上软骨嵴，该嵴终止于耳轮升部皱褶下方，并将耳甲与三角窝分隔开。

HP:0011246.name: Underdeveloped superior crus of antihelix
HP:0011246.definition: Decreased protrusion of the superior crus relative to the prominence of a normal antihelix stem.
HP:0011246.definition_cn: 上脚相对于正常对耳轮隆起部的突出度降低。

HP:0011247.name: Prominent superior crus of antihelix
HP:0011247.definition: Increased protrusion of the superior crus relative to the prominence of a normal antihelix stem.
HP:0011247.definition_cn: 上脚相对于正常对耳轮突起的突出度增加。

HP:0011248.name: Everted antitragus
HP:0011248.definition: Positioning of the antitragus at an angle perpendicular to the plane of the ear (oriented away from the plane of the ear).
HP:0011248.definition_cn: 对耳屏定位与耳平面成垂直角度（远离耳平面方向）。

HP:0011249.name: Absent antitragus
HP:0011249.definition: Absence of the anterosuperior prominence of the area between the bottom of the incisura and the inner margin of the antihelix.
HP:0011249.definition_cn: 耳屏切迹底部与对耳轮内侧缘之间区域的前上突缺失。

HP:0011250.name: Bifid antitragus
HP:0011250.definition: Double rather than single peak of the antitragus.

HP:0011251.name: Underdeveloped antitragus
HP:0011251.definition: Reduction in the anterosuperior prominence of the area between the bottom of the incisura and the inner margin of the antihelix.
HP:0011251.definition_cn: 耳屏切迹底部与对耳轮内侧缘之间区域的前上突度减小。

HP:0011252.name: Cryptotia
HP:0011252.definition: Invagination of the superior part of the auricle under a fold of temporal skin.
HP:0011252.definition_cn: 耳廓上部在颞部皮肤皱褶下的内陷。

HP:0011253.name: Type I cryptotia
HP:0011253.definition: A type of cryptotia associated with reduction in size of the antihelix and superior crus.
HP:0011253.definition_cn: 一种与对耳轮和上脚尺寸减小相关的隐耳畸形。

HP:0011254.name: Type II cryptotia
HP:0011254.definition: A type of cryptotia associated with reduction in size of the antihelix and inferior crus that are affected.
HP:0011254.definition_cn: 一种隐耳畸形，伴有对耳轮及下脚发育不全并受累。

HP:0011255.name: Absent crus of helix
HP:0011255.definition: Continuum between the tragus and ascending helix, without any evidence of a posterior extension (crus) towards the concha.
HP:0011255.definition_cn: 耳屏与耳轮脚之间连续，未见向耳甲腔延伸的后支（脚）。

HP:0011256.name: Crus of helix connected to antihelix
HP:0011256.definition: Extension of the ridge of the crus helix across the ear and connection of the crus to the antihelix.
HP:0011256.definition_cn: 耳轮脚嵴向耳部延伸并与对耳轮相连。

HP:0011257.name: Serpiginous crus of helix
HP:0011257.definition: Curving course of the crus of the helix, approaching or joining the antitragus.
HP:0011257.definition_cn: 耳轮脚弯曲的走行，接近或连接对耳屏。

HP:0011258.name: Tragal bridge of crus of helix
HP:0011258.definition: The anterior origin of the crus encompasses the superior margin of the tragus, the crus overrides the upper portion of the conchal cavum and ends at the antihelix.
HP:0011258.definition_cn: 耳轮脚的前缘起始于耳屏上缘，跨越耳甲腔上部，终止于对耳轮。

HP:0011259.name: Expanded terminal portion of crus of helix
HP:0011259.definition: Widening, rather than tapering, of the crus at its posterior border near the antihelix.
HP:0011259.definition_cn: 耳轮脚后缘靠近对耳轮处增宽而非变窄。

HP:0011260.name: Darwin notch of helix
HP:0011260.definition: Small defect of the helical fold that lies at the junction of the superior and descending portions of the helix.
HP:0011260.definition_cn: 位于耳轮上部和下降部交界处的耳轮皱襞小缺损。

HP:0011261.name: Darwin tubercle of helix
HP:0011261.definition: Small expansion of the helical fold at the junction of the superior and descending portions of the helix.
HP:0011261.definition_cn: 耳轮上部和降部交界处螺旋皱襞轻微扩张。

HP:0011262.name: Crimped helix
HP:0011262.definition: Linear, circumferential indentation in the convexity of the outer surface of the helix.
HP:0011262.definition_cn: 耳轮凸面外表面的线性环状凹陷。

HP:0011263.name: Forward facing earlobe
HP:0011263.definition: Positioning of the anterior surface of the ear lobe in a more coronal plane than the remainder of the ear.
HP:0011263.definition_cn: 耳垂前表面相对于耳部其余部分位于更冠状面的位置。

HP:0011264.name: Discontinuous ascending root of helix
HP:0011264.definition: Interruption between the ascending helix and the crus helix, allowing the ascending helix to be attached directly to the mastoid.
HP:0011264.definition_cn: 耳轮脚与耳轮升部之间的中断，使耳轮升部直接附着于乳突。

HP:0011265.name: Cleft earlobe
HP:0011265.definition: Discontinuity in the convexity of the inferior margin of the lobe.

HP:0011266.name: Microtia, first degree
HP:0011266.definition: Presence of all the normal ear components and the median longitudinal length more than two standard deviations below the mean.
HP:0011266.definition_cn: 所有正常耳部结构均存在，且中位纵向长度低于平均值两个标准差以上。

HP:0011267.name: Microtia, third degree
HP:0011267.definition: Presence of some auricular structures, but none of these structures conform to recognized ear components.
HP:0011267.definition_cn: 存在部分耳廓结构，但这些结构均不符合已知的耳部解剖学组成部分。

HP:0011268.name: Absent tragus
HP:0011268.definition: Lack of convexity or prominence of the contour of the ridge between the bottom of the incisura and the confluence of the ascending helix and crus helix.
HP:0011268.definition_cn: 切迹底部与耳轮脚和耳轮升支汇合处之间的嵴轮廓缺乏凸起或突出。

HP:0011269.name: Bifid tragus
HP:0011269.definition: Increased height of the tragal ridge with a shallow indentation at the apex, giving the appearance of a double peak.
HP:0011269.definition_cn: 耳屏嵴高度增加，顶端呈浅凹痕，呈现双峰外观。

HP:0011270.name: Duplicated tragus
HP:0011270.definition: A complete or partial duplication of the tragus; expected to lie anterior to the normal tragus.
HP:0011270.definition_cn: 耳屏完全或部分重复；预期位于正常耳屏前方。

HP:0011271.name: Prominent tragus
HP:0011271.definition: Increase posterolateral protrusion of the tragus.
HP:0011271.definition_cn: 增加耳屏的后外侧突出。

HP:0011272.name: Underdeveloped tragus
HP:0011272.definition: Decreased posterolateral protrusion of the tragus.

HP:0011273.name: Anisocytosis
HP:0011273.definition: Abnormally increased variability in the size of erythrocytes.
HP:0011273.definition_cn: 红细胞大小异常变异性增加。

HP:0011274.name: Recurrent mycobacterial infections
HP:0011274.definition: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of mycobacterial infection.
HP:0011274.definition_cn: 对分枝杆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的分枝杆菌感染。

HP:0011275.name: Recurrent mycobacterium avium complex infections
HP:0011275.definition: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial avium complex infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of mycobacterial infection.
HP:0011275.name_cn: 复发性鸟分枝杆菌复合体感染
HP:0011275.definition_cn: 对鸟分枝杆菌复合体感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的分枝杆菌感染。

HP:0011277.name: Abnormality of the urinary system physiology
HP:0011277.name_cn: 泌尿系统生理功能异常

HP:0011278.name: Intrapulmonary lobar sequestration
HP:0011278.definition: A type of pulmonary sequestration that occurs within the visceral pleura of normal lung tissue, usually without communication with the tracheobronchial tree.
HP:0011278.definition_cn: 一种肺隔离症，发生于正常肺组织的脏层胸膜内，通常不与气管支气管树相通。

HP:0011279.name: Abnormality of urine bicarbonate level
HP:0011279.definition: An abnormal amount of hydrogencarbonate in the urine.
HP:0011279.name_cn: 尿液碳酸氢盐水平异常
HP:0011279.definition_cn: 尿液中碳酸氢盐含量异常。

HP:0011280.name: Abnormality of urine calcium concentration
HP:0011280.definition: An abnormality of calcium concentration in the urine.

HP:0011281.name: Abnormality of urine catecholamine level
HP:0011281.definition: An abnormal amount of urinary catecholamine concentration.
HP:0011281.name_cn: 尿液儿茶酚胺水平异常
HP:0011281.definition_cn: 尿液中儿茶酚胺浓度异常。

HP:0011282.name: Abnormal hindbrain morphology
HP:0011282.definition: An abnormality of the hindbrain, also known as the rhombencephalon.
HP:0011282.definition_cn: 后脑异常，亦称菱脑异常。

HP:0011283.name: Abnormal metencephalon morphology
HP:0011283.definition: An abnormality of the metencephalon. The metencephalon is the part of the hindbrain that consists of the pons and the cerebellum.
HP:0011283.definition_cn: 后脑异常。后脑是后脑的一部分，由脑桥和小脑组成。

HP:0011284.name: Short-segment aganglionic megacolon
HP:0011284.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment does not extend beyond the upper sigmoid.
HP:0011284.name_cn: 短段型无神经节性巨结肠
HP:0011284.definition_cn: 一种无神经节性巨结肠，其无神经节段未延伸至乙状结肠上部。

HP:0011285.name: Long-segment aganglionic megacolon
HP:0011285.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment extends proximal to the sigmoid.
HP:0011285.name_cn: 长段型无神经节性巨结肠
HP:0011285.definition_cn: 一种无神经节性巨结肠，其中无神经节段延伸至乙状结肠近端。

HP:0011286.name: Total colonic aganglionosis
HP:0011286.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment comprises the entire colon.
HP:0011286.name_cn: 全结肠无神经节细胞症
HP:0011286.definition_cn: 一种无神经节性巨结肠，其中无神经节段累及整个结肠。

HP:0011287.name: EEG with occipital sharp slow waves
HP:0011287.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the occipital region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011287.definition_cn: 枕区可见尖慢波。尖慢波为局灶性尖形瞬态波，持续时间介于80至200毫秒，其后跟随一慢波。

HP:0011288.name: EEG with parietal sharp slow waves
HP:0011288.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the parietal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011288.name_cn: 脑电图显示顶区尖慢波
HP:0011288.definition_cn: 顶叶区出现尖慢波的脑电图。尖慢波是一种局灶性尖形瞬态波，持续时间在80至200毫秒之间，随后跟随一个慢波。

HP:0011289.name: EEG with temporal sharp slow waves
HP:0011289.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the temporal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011289.name_cn: 脑电图显示颞区尖慢波
HP:0011289.definition_cn: 颞区可见尖慢波。尖慢波为局灶性尖形瞬态波，持续时间介于80至200毫秒之间，其后跟随一慢波。

HP:0011290.name: EEG with frontal sharp slow waves
HP:0011290.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the frontal region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011290.name_cn: 脑电图显示额区尖慢波
HP:0011290.definition_cn: 额叶区可见尖慢波。尖慢波为局灶性尖形瞬态波，持续时间介于80至200毫秒，随后伴随一慢波。

HP:0011291.name: EEG with central sharp slow waves
HP:0011291.definition: EEG with sharp slow waves in the central region. Sharp slow waves are focal sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0011291.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央尖慢波
HP:0011291.definition_cn: 脑电图显示中央区出现尖慢波。尖慢波是一种局灶性尖形瞬态波，持续时间在80至200毫秒之间，随后伴随一个慢波。

HP:0011292.name: EEG with occipital sharp waves
HP:0011292.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the occipital region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.
HP:0011292.definition_cn: 枕区脑电图显示尖波，即持续时间为80至200毫秒的尖形瞬态波。

HP:0011293.name: EEG with central sharp waves
HP:0011293.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the central region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.
HP:0011293.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央区尖波
HP:0011293.definition_cn: 脑电图显示中央区尖波，即持续时间在80至200毫秒之间的尖形瞬态波。

HP:0011294.name: EEG with frontal sharp waves
HP:0011294.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the frontal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.
HP:0011294.definition_cn: 脑电图显示额区尖波，即持续时间在80至200毫秒之间的尖形瞬态波。

HP:0011295.name: EEG with parietal sharp waves
HP:0011295.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the parietal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.
HP:0011295.definition_cn: 脑电图显示顶叶区域出现尖波，即持续时间为80至200毫秒的尖形瞬态波。

HP:0011296.name: EEG with temporal sharp waves
HP:0011296.definition: EEG with sharp waves in the temporal region, i.e., sharp transient waves of a duration between 80 and 200 msec.
HP:0011296.definition_cn: 颞区出现尖波的脑电图，即持续时间在80至200毫秒之间的尖瞬态波。

HP:0011297.name: Abnormal digit morphology
HP:0011297.definition: A morphological abnormality of a digit, i.e., of a finger or toe.

HP:0011298.name: Prominent digit pad
HP:0011298.definition: A soft tissue prominence of the ventral aspects of the fingertips or toe tips.
HP:0011298.definition_cn: 指尖或趾尖腹侧软组织的隆起。

HP:0011299.name: Partial absence of finger
HP:0011299.definition: The absence of a phalangeal segment of a finger.

HP:0011300.name: Broad fingertip
HP:0011300.definition: Increased width of the distal segment of a finger.

HP:0011301.name: Absent foot
HP:0011301.definition: The total absence of the foot, with no bony elements distal to the tibia or fibula.
HP:0011301.definition_cn: 胫骨或腓骨远端完全缺失，无任何骨性结构存在。

HP:0011302.name: Long palm
