HP:0011302.definition: For children from birth to 16 years of age the length of the palm is more than the 97th centile; or, the length of the palm appears relatively long compared to the finger length or the limb length.
HP:0011302.definition_cn: 对于从出生至16岁的儿童，手掌长度超过第97百分位数；或者，手掌长度相对于手指长度或肢体长度显得相对较长。

HP:0011303.name: Convex contour of sole
HP:0011303.definition: The contour of the foot in lateral profile has a convex shape.

HP:0011304.name: Broad thumb
HP:0011304.definition: Increased thumb width without increased dorso-ventral dimension.
HP:0011304.definition_cn: 拇指宽度增加而无背腹侧维度增加。

HP:0011305.name: Partial absence of toe
HP:0011305.definition: The absence of a phalangeal segment of a toe or hallux.

HP:0011307.name: Splayed toes
HP:0011307.definition: Divergence of digits along the anteroposterior axis (in the plane of the sole).
HP:0011307.definition_cn: 沿前后轴（在足底平面）的指（趾）分离。

HP:0011308.name: Slender toe
HP:0011308.definition: Toes that are disproportionately narrow (reduced girth) for the hand/foot size or build of the individual.
HP:0011308.definition_cn: 相对于个体手/足尺寸或体型而言，足趾周径异常狭窄（周径减小）。

HP:0011309.name: Tapered toe
HP:0011309.definition: The gradual reduction in girth of the toe from proximal to distal.
HP:0011309.definition_cn: 趾部周径从近端向远端逐渐减小。

HP:0011310.name: Bridged palmar crease
HP:0011310.definition: A crease that connects the proximal and distal transverse palmar creases.
HP:0011310.definition_cn: 连接近端掌横纹和远端掌横纹的皱褶。

HP:0011311.name: Sydney crease
HP:0011311.definition: Extension of the proximal transverse crease (five finger crease) to the ulnar edge of the palm.
HP:0011311.definition_cn: 近端横纹（五指横纹）向手掌尺侧缘延伸。

HP:0011312.name: Fused nails
HP:0011312.definition: A nail plate that has a longitudinal separation with partially separated nails, each with a separate lateral radius of curvature.
HP:0011312.definition_cn: 甲板纵向分离，部分指甲分离，每个指甲具有独立的侧向曲率半径。

HP:0011314.name: Abnormal long bone morphology
HP:0011314.definition: An abnormality of size or shape of the long bones.

HP:0011315.name: Unicoronal synostosis
HP:0011315.definition: Synostosis affecting only one of the coronal sutures.

HP:0011316.name: Left unicoronal synostosis
HP:0011316.definition: Synostosis affecting only the left coronal suture.
HP:0011316.definition_cn: 仅累及左侧冠状缝的骨性连接。

HP:0011317.name: Right unicoronal synostosis
HP:0011317.definition: Unicoronal synostosis affecting only the right coronal suture.
HP:0011317.definition_cn: 单侧冠状缝早闭仅累及右侧冠状缝。

HP:0011318.name: Bicoronal synostosis
HP:0011318.definition: Synostosis affecting the right and the left coronal suture.
HP:0011318.definition_cn: 右侧和左侧冠状缝的骨性连接。

HP:0011319.name: Bilambdoid synostosis
HP:0011319.definition: Premature synostosis of both lambdoid sutures.

HP:0011320.name: Unilambdoid synostosis
HP:0011320.definition: Premature synostosis of only one lambdoid suture.

HP:0011321.name: Left unilambdoid synostosis
HP:0011321.definition: Premature synostosis of only the left lambdoid suture.

HP:0011322.name: Right unilambdoid synostosis
HP:0011322.definition: Premature synostosis of only the right lambdoid suture.

HP:0011323.name: Cleft of chin
HP:0011323.definition: Incomplete fusion of the chin, resulting from a developmental defect and manifesting as a midline cleft or fissure of the chin.
HP:0011323.definition_cn: 下颌骨发育不全导致的下颌中线裂或裂隙，表现为下颌不完全融合。

HP:0011324.name: Multiple suture craniosynostosis
HP:0011324.definition: Craniosynostosis involving at least 2 cranial sutures, where the exact pattern of sutures fused has not been precisely specified.
HP:0011324.definition_cn: 涉及至少两条颅缝的颅缝早闭，具体融合的颅缝模式尚未明确指定。

HP:0011326.name: Anterior plagiocephaly
HP:0011326.definition: Asymmetry of the anterior part of the skull.

HP:0011327.name: Posterior plagiocephaly
HP:0011327.definition: Asymmetry of the posterior part of the skull.

HP:0011329.name: Abnormality of cranial sutures
HP:0011329.definition: Any anomaly of a cranial suture, that is one of the six membrane-covered openings in the incompletely ossified skull of the fetus or newborn infant.
HP:0011329.definition_cn: 颅缝异常，即胎儿或新生儿未完全骨化的颅骨中六个膜覆盖开口之一的任何异常。

HP:0011330.name: Metopic synostosis
HP:0011330.definition: Premature fusion of the metopic suture.

HP:0011331.name: Hemifacial atrophy
HP:0011331.definition: Unilateral atrophy of facial tissues, including muscles, bones and skin.
HP:0011331.definition_cn: 单侧面部组织萎缩，包括肌肉、骨骼和皮肤。

HP:0011332.name: Hemifacial hypoplasia
HP:0011332.definition: Unilateral underdevelopment of the facial tissues, including muscles and bones.
HP:0011332.definition_cn: 单侧面部组织发育不全，包括肌肉和骨骼。

HP:0011333.name: Asymmetric crying face
HP:0011333.definition: Asymmetry observed in the face of a neonate or infant whose face appears symmetric at rest and asymmetric during crying as the mouth is pulled downward on one side while not moving on the other side.
HP:0011333.definition_cn: 在新生儿或婴儿面部观察到的不对称现象，表现为静息状态下面部对称，而在哭泣时出现不对称，即一侧嘴角向下牵拉而另一侧无运动。

HP:0011335.name: Frontal hirsutism
HP:0011335.definition: Excessive amount of hair growth on forehead.

HP:0011336.name: Bitemporal forceps marks
HP:0011336.definition: Bilateral temporal scarlike defects, which are said to resemble forceps marks.
HP:0011336.definition_cn: 双侧颞部瘢痕样缺损，据称类似于产钳压痕。

HP:0011338.name: Abnormality of mouth shape
HP:0011338.definition: An abnormality of the outline, configuration, or contour of the mouth.
HP:0011338.definition_cn: 口腔轮廓、形态或外形异常。

HP:0011339.name: Abnormality of upper lip vermillion
HP:0011339.definition: An abnormality of the vermilion border, the sharp demarcation between the lip (red colored) and the adjacent normal skin.
HP:0011339.definition_cn: 唇红缘异常，即唇部（红色区域）与邻近正常皮肤之间的明显分界异常。

HP:0011340.name: Incomplete cleft of the upper lip
HP:0011340.definition: Cleft of the upper lip that does not go all the way from the bottom of the upper lip until the nasal cavity.

HP:0011341.name: Long upper lip
HP:0011341.definition: Increased width of the upper lip.

HP:0011342.name: Mild global developmental delay
HP:0011342.definition: A mild delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.
HP:0011342.definition_cn: 儿童在运动或智力发育领域里程碑的轻度延迟。

HP:0011343.name: Moderate global developmental delay
HP:0011343.definition: A moderate delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.
HP:0011343.definition_cn: 儿童在运动或智力发育领域达到里程碑的适度延迟。

HP:0011344.name: Severe global developmental delay
HP:0011344.definition: A severe delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.
HP:0011344.definition_cn: 儿童在运动或智力发育领域里程碑的严重延迟。

HP:0011345.name: Moderate expressive language delay
HP:0011345.definition: A moderate delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.
HP:0011345.name_cn: 中度表达性语言发育迟缓
HP:0011345.definition_cn: 中度语言表达功能发育迟缓

HP:0011346.name: Mild expressive language delay
HP:0011346.definition: A mild delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.
HP:0011346.name_cn: 轻度表达性语言发育迟缓
HP:0011346.definition_cn: 轻度语言发育迟缓（Mild Language Development Delay）

HP:0011347.name: Abnormality of ocular abduction
HP:0011347.definition: An abnormality involving the movement of the eye outwards.
HP:0011347.definition_cn: 外展运动异常（Abduction abnormality of the eye）。

HP:0011348.name: Abnormal sixth cranial nerve morphology
HP:0011348.definition: Any structural abnormality of the abducens nerve.
HP:0011348.definition_cn: 外展神经的任何结构异常。

HP:0011350.name: Mild receptive language delay
HP:0011350.definition: A mild delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.
HP:0011350.name_cn: 轻度感受性语言发育迟缓
HP:0011350.definition_cn: 轻度言语理解能力发育迟缓

HP:0011351.name: Moderate receptive language delay
HP:0011351.definition: A moderate delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.
HP:0011351.name_cn: 中度接受性语言发育迟缓
HP:0011351.definition_cn: 中度语言理解能力发育迟缓

HP:0011352.name: Severe receptive language delay
HP:0011352.definition: A severe delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.
HP:0011352.name_cn: 重度感受性语言发育迟缓
HP:0011352.definition_cn: 严重性言语理解能力发育迟缓

HP:0011353.name: Arterial intimal fibrosis
HP:0011353.definition: Formation of excess fibrous connective tissue in the tunica intima (innermost layer) of arteries.
HP:0011353.definition_cn: 动脉内膜（最内层）中过量纤维结缔组织的形成。

HP:0011354.name: Generalized abnormality of skin
HP:0011354.definition: An abnormality of the skin that is not localized to any one particular region.
HP:0011354.definition_cn: 皮肤异常，非局限于特定区域。

HP:0011355.name: Localized skin lesion
HP:0011355.definition: A lesion of the skin that is located in a specific region rather than being generalized.

HP:0011356.name: Regional abnormality of skin
HP:0011356.definition: An abnormality of the skin that is restricted to a particular body region.

HP:0011359.name: Dry hair
HP:0011359.definition: Hair that lacks the luster (shine or gleam) of normal hair.
HP:0011359.definition_cn: 毛发缺乏正常毛发的光泽（光泽或光亮）。

HP:0011360.name: Acquired abnormal hair pattern
HP:0011360.definition: An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth that is acquired during the course of life.

HP:0011361.name: Congenital abnormal hair pattern
HP:0011361.definition: A congenital abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.

HP:0011363.name: Abnormality of hair growth rate
HP:0011363.definition: Hair whose growth rate deviates from the norm.

HP:0011364.name: White hair
HP:0011364.definition_cn: 低色素性毛发，呈现白色。

HP:0011365.name: Patchy hypopigmentation of hair
HP:0011365.definition: Reduced pigmentation of hair in patches.

HP:0011368.name: Epidermal thickening
HP:0011368.definition: Thickening of the epidermal layer of the skin.

HP:0011369.name: Mongolian blue spot
HP:0011369.definition: Congenital deep dermal melanosis in the sacral area.
HP:0011369.definition_cn: 骶部先天性真皮深层黑素沉着症。

HP:0011370.name: Recurrent cutaneous fungal infections
HP:0011370.definition: Increased susceptibility to cutaneous fungal infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of cutaneous fungal infections.
HP:0011370.definition_cn: 皮肤真菌感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作的皮肤真菌感染。

HP:0011371.name: Recurrent viral skin infections
HP:0011371.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral skin infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral skin infections.
HP:0011371.name_cn: 复发性病毒性皮肤感染
HP:0011371.definition_cn: 对病毒性皮肤感染的易感性增加，表现为病毒性皮肤感染的反复发作。

HP:0011372.name: Aplasia of the inner ear
HP:0011372.definition: Absence of the inner ear due to a developmental defect.
HP:0011372.definition_cn: 先天性内耳缺失（Congenital absence of the inner ear due to a developmental defect）。

HP:0011373.name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea
HP:0011373.definition: Incomplete formation of the cochlear partition. The scala vestibuli and scala tympani separated by the cochlear partition, except in the apical turn where the two scalae are in continuity via the helicotrema.
HP:0011373.definition_cn: 耳蜗分隔不完全形成。前庭阶和鼓阶由耳蜗分隔分开，但在顶转处，两者通过蜗孔相连。

HP:0011374.name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea type I
HP:0011374.definition: Incomplete partition I is also known as cystic cochleovestibular malformation, where the cochlea has no bony modiolus, resulting in an empty cystic cochlea. This is accompanied by a dilated cystic vestibule with developmental arrest at the fifth week of gestation.
HP:0011374.definition_cn: 不完全分隔I型，亦称囊性耳蜗前庭畸形，其特点为耳蜗缺乏骨性蜗轴，形成空囊状耳蜗结构。此病变常伴发囊性前庭扩张，其发育停滞于妊娠第五周。

HP:0011375.name: Cochlear aplasia
HP:0011375.definition: Absence of the cochlea, a spiral shaped cavity in the inner ear, owing to a developmental defect.
HP:0011375.definition_cn: 耳蜗缺失，由于发育缺陷导致内耳中螺旋形腔体缺失。

HP:0011376.name: Abnormal morphology of the vestibule of the inner ear
HP:0011376.definition: A morphological abnormality of the vestibule, the central part of the osseous labyrinth that is situated medial to the tympanic cavity, behind the cochlea, and in front of the semicircular canals.
HP:0011376.definition_cn: 前庭形态学异常，前庭为骨迷路的中央部分，位于鼓室内侧、耳蜗后方、半规管前方。

HP:0011377.name: Aplasia of the vestibule
HP:0011377.definition: Complete absence of the vestibule of the inner ear.

HP:0011378.name: Hypoplasia of the vestibule of the inner ear
HP:0011378.definition: Underdevelopment of the vestibule of the inner ear.

HP:0011379.name: Dilated vestibule of the inner ear
HP:0011379.definition: Dilatation of the vestibule of the inner ear.

HP:0011380.name: Abnormal semicircular canal morphology
HP:0011380.definition: An abnormality of the morphology of the semicircular canal.

HP:0011383.name: Enlarged semicircular canal
HP:0011383.definition: Increased size of the semicircular canal.

HP:0011384.name: Abnormality of the internal auditory canal
HP:0011384.definition: An abnormality of the Internal acoustic meatus, i.e., of the canal in the petrous part of the temporal bone through which the cranial nerve VII and cranial nerve VIII traverse.
HP:0011384.definition_cn: 内耳道异常，即颞骨岩部中颅神经VII（面神经）和颅神经VIII（前庭蜗神经）穿行的管道异常。

HP:0011385.name: Absent internal auditory canal
HP:0011385.definition: Aplasia of the internal auditory canal.

HP:0011386.name: Narrow internal auditory canal
HP:0011386.definition: Reduction in diameter of the internal auditory canal.

HP:0011387.name: Enlarged vestibular aqueduct
HP:0011387.definition: Increased size of the vestibular aqueduct.

HP:0011388.name: Enlarged cochlear aqueduct
HP:0011388.definition: Increased size of the cochlear duct, i.e., of a duct that communicates between the perilymphatic space and the subarachnoid space, and transmits a vein from the cochlea to join the internal jugular.
HP:0011388.definition_cn: 耳蜗管增大，即连接外淋巴间隙与蛛网膜下腔的管道增大，该管道将耳蜗的静脉输送至颈内静脉。

HP:0011389.name: Functional abnormality of the inner ear
HP:0011389.definition: An abnormality of the function of the inner ear.

HP:0011390.name: Abnormal inner ear morphology
HP:0011390.definition: A structural anomaly of the internal part of the ear.

HP:0011395.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cochlea
HP:0011395.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the cochlea, a spiral shaped cavity in the inner ear, owing to a developmental defect.
HP:0011395.name_cn: 耳蜗发育不全/耳蜗发育不良
HP:0011395.definition_cn: 耳蜗缺失或发育不全，由于发育缺陷导致内耳中螺旋形腔体的缺失或发育不全。

HP:0011396.name: Abnormality of the cochlear nerve
HP:0011396.definition: Any anomaly of the cohclear nerve, which is the part of the vestibulocochlear nerve that is responsible for transmitting auditory signals from the inner ear to the cochlear nuclei within the brainstem and ultimately to the primary auditory cortex within the temporal lobe.
HP:0011396.definition_cn: 耳蜗神经的任何异常，该神经是前庭耳蜗神经的一部分，负责将听觉信号从内耳传递至脑干内的耳蜗核，并最终传递至颞叶内的初级听觉皮层。

HP:0011397.name: Abnormality of the dorsal column of the spinal cord
HP:0011397.definition: An abnormality of the dorsal columns, i.e., of the dorsal portion of the gray substance of the spinal cord. The dorsal column consists of the fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus and itself is part of the dorsal funiculus.
HP:0011397.definition_cn: 脊髓灰质背侧部分的异常，即脊髓灰质背侧柱的异常。背侧柱由薄束和楔束组成，其本身是脊髓背索的一部分。

HP:0011398.name: obsolete Central hypotonia
HP:0011398.name_cn: 陈旧性中枢性肌张力低下

HP:0011399.name: Tibialis anterior muscle atrophy
HP:0011399.definition: Wasting of the tibialis anterior muscle.

HP:0011400.name: Abnormal CNS myelination
HP:0011400.definition: An abnormality of myelination of nerves in the central nervous system.
HP:0011400.name_cn: 中枢神经系统髓鞘形成异常
HP:0011400.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统神经髓鞘形成异常。

HP:0011401.name: Delayed peripheral myelination
HP:0011401.definition: Delayed myelination in the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0011401.name_cn: 迟发性周围神经髓鞘形成
HP:0011401.definition_cn: 周围神经系统髓鞘形成延迟。

HP:0011403.name: Abnormal umbilical cord blood vessel morphology

HP:0011404.name: Lethal short-trunk short stature
HP:0011404.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs that is lethal at birth.
HP:0011404.definition_cn: 一种以躯干短小但四肢长度正常为特征的不成比例性矮小症，通常在出生时即致命。

HP:0011405.name: Childhood onset short-limb short stature
HP:0011405.name_cn: 儿童期发病的短肢型矮小症

HP:0011406.name: Infancy onset short-trunk short stature
HP:0011406.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with onset in infancy.
HP:0011406.name_cn: 婴儿期发病的短躯干型矮小症
HP:0011406.definition_cn: 一种以躯干短小但四肢长度正常为特征的比例失调性矮小症，通常在婴儿期发病。

HP:0011408.name: Moderate intrauterine growth retardation
HP:0011408.definition: Intrauterine growth retardation that is at least 3 standard deviations (SD) below average, but not as low as 4 SD, corrected for sex and gestational age.
HP:0011408.definition_cn: 宫内生长迟缓，校正性别和孕周后，低于平均值至少3个标准差（SD），但未达到4个标准差。

HP:0011409.name: Abnormal placental membrane morphology
HP:0011409.definition: Structural anomaly of the fetal membranes (also known as the amniochorionic or placental membranes), which comprise a vital intrauterine compartment, where they perform mechanical, immune, and endocrine functions to promote growth of the fetus and protection from environmental adversity. Amniochorionic membranes anatomically consist of a single layer of cuboidal amnion epithelial cells, chorionic trophoblasts, and scattered fibroblasts connected by a layer of type IV collagen-rich extracellular matrix.
HP:0011409.definition_cn: 胎儿膜结构异常（也称为羊膜绒毛膜或胎盘膜），其构成一个重要的宫内隔室，执行机械、免疫和内分泌功能，以促进胎儿生长并保护其免受环境不利影响。羊膜绒毛膜在解剖学上由单层立方羊膜上皮细胞、绒毛膜滋养层细胞以及通过富含IV型胶原的细胞外基质连接的散在成纤维细胞组成。

HP:0011410.name: Caesarian section
HP:0011410.definition: Delivery of a fetus through surgical incisions made through the abdominal wall (laparotomy) and the uterine wall (hysterotomy).
HP:0011410.definition_cn: 通过腹壁（剖腹术）和子宫壁（子宫切开术）进行手术切口以娩出胎儿。

HP:0011412.name: Ventouse delivery
HP:0011412.definition: Delivery of newborn by means of a ventouse, a vacuum device used to assist the delivery of a baby when the second stage of labor has not progressed adequately.
HP:0011412.definition_cn: 使用真空吸引器进行新生儿分娩，这是一种在第二产程进展不足时用于辅助分娩的真空装置。

HP:0011413.name: Shoulder dystocia
HP:0011413.definition: Shoulder dystocia occurs when the fetal anterior shoulder impacts against the maternal symphysis following delivery of the vertex.
HP:0011413.definition_cn: 肩难产发生于胎头娩出后，胎儿前肩嵌顿于母体耻骨联合处。

HP:0011414.name: Hydropic placenta
HP:0011414.definition: An abnormality of the placenta in which there are numerous cystic spaces within the placenta as well as placental enlargement.
HP:0011414.definition_cn: 胎盘异常，表现为胎盘内存在多个囊性空间并伴有胎盘增大。

HP:0011417.name: Long umbilical cord
HP:0011417.definition: Increased length of the umbilical cord.

HP:0011418.name: Abnormal insertion of umbilical cord
HP:0011418.definition: Anomalous location of the insertion of umbilical cord in the placenta. Normally, the insertion is at least two centimers distant from the edge of the placenta.
HP:0011418.definition_cn: 胎盘脐带插入位置异常。正常情况下，脐带插入点应距离胎盘边缘至少两厘米。

HP:0011419.name: Placental abruption
HP:0011419.definition: Separation of the placenta from the uterus wall before delivery.

HP:0011420.name: Age of death
HP:0011420.definition: The age group when the cessation of life happens.

HP:0011421.name: Death in adolescence
HP:0011421.definition: Death during adolescence, the period between childhood and adulthood (roughly between the ages of 10 and 19 years).
HP:0011421.definition_cn: 青春期死亡，即介于儿童期与成年期之间的阶段（大致在10至19岁之间）。

HP:0011422.name: Abnormal blood chloride concentration
HP:0011422.definition: An abnormality of chloride homeostasis or concentration in the body.
HP:0011422.definition_cn: 体内氯离子稳态或浓度异常。

HP:0011423.name: Hyperchloremia
HP:0011423.definition: An abnormally increased chloride concentration in the blood.

HP:0011424.name: Increased serum zinc
HP:0011424.definition: An increased concentration of zinc in the blood.

HP:0011425.name: Fetal ultrasound soft marker
HP:0011425.definition: An finding upon obstetric ultrasound examination performed at around 16 to 20 weeks of gestation that is abnormal but not clearly identifiable as a fetal anatomic malformation or growth restriction. Such findings are known as soft markers since they are associated with increased risk for fetal aneuploidy or other disorders.
HP:0011425.definition_cn: 妊娠16至20周左右进行的产科超声检查中发现异常但无法明确识别为胎儿解剖结构畸形或生长受限的发现。此类发现被称为软标记物，因为它们与胎儿非整倍体或其他疾病的风险增加相关。

HP:0011426.name: Fetal choroid plexus cysts
HP:0011426.definition: Fetal choroid plexus cysts (CPCs) are sonographically discrete, small cysts found in the choroid plexus within the lateral cerebral ventricles of the developing fetus at 14 to 24 weeks gestation. Imaging of the choroid plexus is performed in the transverse plane of the fetal head at the same level that the lateral cerebral ventricle is evaluated. The choroid plexus should be inspected bilaterally for the presence of cysts. The size of CPCs is not of clinical relevance (PMID:16100637).
HP:0011426.definition_cn: 胎儿脉络丛囊肿（Choroid Plexus Cysts, CPCs）是在妊娠14至24周期间，通过超声检查在发育中胎儿侧脑室内的脉络丛中发现的离散性小囊肿。脉络丛的成像在胎儿头部的横切面上进行，与评估侧脑室的同一水平。应双侧检查脉络丛是否存在囊肿。脉络丛囊肿的大小无临床相关性（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0011427.name: Enlarged fetal cisterna magna
HP:0011427.definition: The cisterna magna is measured on a transaxial view of the fetal head angled 15 degrees caudal to the canthomeatal line. The anterior/posterior diameter is taken between the inferior/posterior surface of the vermis of the cerebellum to the inner surface of the cranium. An enlarged cisternal magna is defined by an anterior/posterior diameter of 10 mm or more (PMID:16100637).
HP:0011427.definition_cn: 小脑延髓池的测量是在胎儿头部的横轴切面上进行的，该切面与眶耳线呈15度尾侧角度。前后径的测量位于小脑蚓部的下/后表面与颅骨内表面之间。小脑延髓池增大的定义为前后径达到或超过10毫米（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0011428.name: Short fetal femur length
HP:0011428.definition: A short femur length is defined as either a measurement below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or a measurement that is less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The femur should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637).
HP:0011428.definition_cn: 股骨短小定义为测量值低于孕龄的第2.5百分位数或测量值小于通过双顶径预测值的0.9倍。测量股骨时应使骨骼垂直于超声束，并可见骨骺软骨但不包括在测量范围内（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0011429.name: Short fetal humerus length
HP:0011429.definition: A short humerus length is defined as a length below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or as a measurement less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The humerus should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637).
HP:0011429.definition_cn: 肱骨短小定义为肱骨长度低于胎龄的第2.5百分位数，或测量值小于通过双顶径预测值的0.9倍。测量肱骨时，应使骨骼与超声束垂直，并确保骨骺软骨可见但不纳入测量范围（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0011430.name: Hypoplasia of fetal nasal bone
HP:0011430.definition: On prenatal ultrasound, the nasal bone is a thin echogenic line within the bridge of the fetal nose. The fetus is imaged facing the transducer with the fetal face strictly in the midline. The angle of insonation is 90 degrees, with the longitudinal axis of the nasal bone as the reference line. Calibres are placed at each end of the nasal bone. Absence of the nasal bone or measurements below 2.5th percentile are considered significant (PMID:16100637).
HP:0011430.definition_cn: 在产前超声检查中，鼻骨表现为胎儿鼻梁内的一条细长的高回声线。胎儿面向探头成像，胎儿面部严格位于中线位置。声束入射角为90度，以鼻骨纵轴线为参考线。测量标尺置于鼻骨两端。鼻骨缺失或测量值低于第2.5百分位数被认为具有临床意义（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0011431.name: Fetal fifth finger clinodactyly
HP:0011431.definition: Fifth finger clinodactyly is defined by a hypoplastic or absent mid-phalanx of the fifth digit. Ultrasound identification of the fetal hand must first be undertaken and then appropriate magnification accomplished. The evaluation requires stretching of the 5 fingers. The diagnosis is established when the middle phalanx of the fifth finger is markedly smaller than normal or absent, which often causes the finger to be curved inward (PMID:16100637).
HP:0011431.definition_cn: 第五指弯曲畸形（Fifth finger clinodactyly）定义为第五指中节指骨发育不全或缺如。首先需进行胎儿手部的超声检查，并进行适当的放大。评估时需将五指伸展。当第五指中节指骨明显小于正常或缺如时，即可确诊，这种情况常导致手指向内弯曲（PMID:16100637）。

HP:0011432.name: Elevated maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
HP:0011432.definition: Increase in the levels of maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein levels during pregnancy.
HP:0011432.name_cn: 母体循环中甲胎蛋白浓度升高
HP:0011432.definition_cn: 妊娠期母体血清甲胎蛋白水平升高。

HP:0011433.name: High maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
HP:0011433.definition: An abnormally high concentration of maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin as compared to normal values for gestational-age.
HP:0011433.name_cn: 母体循环中绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度升高
HP:0011433.definition_cn: 与妊娠期正常值相比，母体血清人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度异常升高。

HP:0011434.name: Low maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
HP:0011434.definition: An abnormally low concentration of maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin as compared to normal values for gestational-age.
HP:0011434.name_cn: 母体循环绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度降低
HP:0011434.definition_cn: 与妊娠期正常值相比，母体血清人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度异常降低。

HP:0011435.name: Low maternal circulating PAPP-A concentration
HP:0011435.definition: An abnormally low concentration of serum PAPP-A (pregnancy associated plasma protein A), as compared to normal values for gestational-age.
HP:0011435.name_cn: 母体循环中妊娠相关血浆蛋白A（PAPP-A）浓度降低
HP:0011435.definition_cn: 与妊娠期正常值相比，血清PAPP-A（妊娠相关血浆蛋白A）浓度异常降低。

HP:0011436.name: Abnormal maternal serum screening
HP:0011436.definition: An abnormally elevated or decreased level of a maternal serum marker analytes used in screening for aneuploidy.
HP:0011436.definition_cn: 用于非整倍体筛查的母体血清标志物分析物水平异常升高或降低。

HP:0011437.name: Maternal autoimmune disease
HP:0011437.definition: A medical history of a fetus or child born to a mother with an autoimmune disease.
HP:0011437.definition_cn: 母体患有自身免疫性疾病的胎儿或新生儿的病史。

HP:0011438.name: Maternal teratogenic exposure
HP:0011438.definition: A medical history of exposure of the mother of a child or fetus to a teratogenic substance during pregnancy.
HP:0011438.definition_cn: 妊娠期间母亲暴露于致畸物质史的儿童或胎儿。

HP:0011439.name: Anesthetic-induced rhabdomylosis
HP:0011439.name_cn: 麻醉诱导性横纹肌溶解症
HP:0011439.definition_cn: 麻醉诱导的横纹肌溶解症。

HP:0011440.name: Alcohol-induced rhabdomyolysis
HP:0011440.definition: Rhabdomyolysis induced by intake of alcohol.
HP:0011440.definition_cn: 酒精摄入引起的横纹肌溶解症。

HP:0011441.name: Abnormal medulla oblongata morphology
HP:0011441.definition: An abnormality of the medulla oblongata, the lower half of the brainstem.
HP:0011441.definition_cn: 延髓异常，即脑干下半部分的异常。

HP:0011442.name: Abnormal central motor function
HP:0011442.definition: An anomaly of the control or production of movement in the central nervous system.
HP:0011442.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统运动控制或运动产生异常。

HP:0011444.name: Decorticate rigidity
HP:0011444.definition: A type of rigidity in which the arms are in flexion and adduction and the legs are extended. This signifies a lesion in the cerebral white matter, internal capsules, or thalamus.
HP:0011444.definition_cn: 一种强直类型，表现为上肢屈曲和内收，下肢伸直。这提示大脑白质、内囊或丘脑存在病变。

HP:0011445.name: Athetoid cerebral palsy
HP:0011445.definition: A type of cerebral palsy characterized by slow, involuntary muscle movement and mixed muscle tone.
HP:0011445.definition_cn: 一种以缓慢、不自主的肌肉运动及混合性肌张力为特征的脑性瘫痪类型。

HP:0011447.name: Hyposegmentation of neutrophil nuclei
HP:0011447.name_cn: 中性粒细胞核分叶减少
HP:0011447.definition_cn: 低分叶（低分叶化）或双叶中性粒细胞核。

HP:0011448.name: Ankle clonus
HP:0011448.definition: Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Ankle clonus is tested by rapidly flexing the foot upward.
HP:0011448.definition_cn: 阵挛是一种不自主的腱反射，导致足部反复屈曲和伸展。踝阵挛通过快速向上屈曲足部进行测试。

HP:0011449.name: Knee clonus
HP:0011449.definition: Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Knee clonus can be tested by rapidly pushing the patella towards the toes.
HP:0011449.definition_cn: 阵挛是一种不自主的腱反射，导致足部反复屈曲和伸展。膝阵挛可通过快速将髌骨推向足趾进行测试。

HP:0011450.name: Unusual CNS infection
HP:0011450.definition: A type of infection of the central nervous system that can be regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection.
HP:0011450.name_cn: 非典型中枢神经系统感染
HP:0011450.definition_cn: 一种中枢神经系统感染类型，可被视为对感染的病理易感性的标志。

HP:0011451.name: Primary microcephaly
HP:0011451.definition: Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender at birth.
HP:0011451.definition_cn: 出生时头围低于同年龄和性别平均值的2个标准差。

HP:0011452.name: Functional abnormality of the middle ear
HP:0011452.definition: An abnormality of the function of the middle ear.

HP:0011453.name: Abnormal incus morphology
HP:0011453.definition: An abnormality of the incus, an ossicle in the middle ear.
HP:0011453.definition_cn: 砧骨异常，中耳听小骨之一。

HP:0011454.name: Abnormal malleus morphology
HP:0011454.definition: An abnormality of the malleus, an ossicle in the middle ear.
HP:0011454.definition_cn: 锤骨异常，中耳听小骨之一。

HP:0011457.name: Loss of eyelashes
HP:0011457.definition: This term refers to the loss of eyelashes that were previously present.
HP:0011457.definition_cn: 该术语指先前存在的睫毛脱落。

HP:0011458.name: Abdominal symptom
HP:0011458.definition: A subjective manifestation of disease localized to the abdomen.
HP:0011458.definition_cn: 腹部疾病的局部主观表现。

HP:0011459.name: Esophageal carcinoma
HP:0011459.definition: The presence of a carcinoma of the esophagus.

HP:0011460.name: Embryonal onset
HP:0011460.definition: Onset of disease at up to 8 weeks following fertilization (corresponding to 10 weeks of gestation).
HP:0011460.definition_cn: 受精后8周内发病（相当于妊娠10周）。

HP:0011461.name: Fetal onset
HP:0011461.definition: Onset prior to birth but after 8 weeks of embryonic development (corresponding to a gestational age of 10 weeks).
HP:0011461.definition_cn: 发病于出生前但在胚胎发育8周后（对应于孕龄10周）。

HP:0011462.name: Young adult onset
HP:0011462.definition: Onset of disease at the age of between 16 and 40 years.
HP:0011462.definition_cn: 发病年龄介于16至40岁之间。

HP:0011463.name: Childhood onset
HP:0011463.definition: Onset of disease at the age of between 1 and 5 years.
HP:0011463.definition_cn: 疾病发病年龄在1至5岁之间。

HP:0011464.name: Aganglionosis of the small intestine
HP:0011464.definition: A lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) affecting the small intestine.
HP:0011464.definition_cn: 小肠无神经节细胞症（即小肠无神经节细胞段）。

HP:0011465.name: Duodenal aganglionosis
HP:0011465.definition: A lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) affecting the duodenum.
HP:0011465.definition_cn: 十二指肠段肠神经节细胞缺失（即无神经节肠段）。

HP:0011466.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the gallbladder
HP:0011466.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the gallbladder.
HP:0011466.name_cn: 胆囊发育不全/胆囊发育不良
HP:0011466.definition_cn: 胆囊缺如或胆囊发育不全。

HP:0011467.name: Absent gallbladder
HP:0011467.definition: A developmental defect in which the gallbladder fails to form.

HP:0011468.name: Facial tics
HP:0011468.definition: Sudden, repetitive, nonrhythmic motor movements (spasms), involving the eyes and muscles of the face.
HP:0011468.definition_cn: 突发性、重复性、非节律性运动（痉挛），累及眼部和面部肌肉。

HP:0011469.name: Nasal regurgitation
HP:0011469.definition: Regurgitation of milk through the nose.

HP:0011470.name: Nasogastric tube feeding in infancy
HP:0011470.definition: Feeding problem necessitating nasogastric tube feeding.
HP:0011470.definition_cn: 喂养问题需行鼻饲管喂养。

HP:0011471.name: Gastrostomy tube feeding in infancy
HP:0011471.definition: Feeding problem necessitating gastrostomy tube feeding.
HP:0011471.definition_cn: 需要胃造瘘管饲的喂养问题。

HP:0011473.name: Villous atrophy
HP:0011473.definition: The enteric villi are atrophic or absent.

HP:0011474.name: Childhood onset sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0011474.definition: Sensorineural hearing impairment with childhood onset.
HP:0011474.name_cn: 儿童期发病的感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0011474.definition_cn: 儿童期发病的感音神经性听力障碍。

HP:0011475.name: Persistent stapedial artery
HP:0011475.definition: Persistence of the stapedial artery, which normally regresses during embryonic life.
HP:0011475.definition_cn: 镫骨动脉持续存在，该动脉通常在胚胎期退化。

HP:0011476.name: Profound sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0011476.definition: Complete loss of hearing related to a sensorineural defect.
HP:0011476.name_cn: 重度感音神经性听力损失
HP:0011476.definition_cn: 与感音神经性缺陷相关的完全性听力丧失。

HP:0011477.name: Upbeat nystagmus
HP:0011477.definition: In primary position, the eyes drift slowly downward and then spontaneously beat upward. Upward gaze accentuates the nystagmus. The associated oscillopsias are often very irritating, but the symptoms are usually transient.
HP:0011477.definition_cn: 在原发性眼位，眼球缓慢向下漂移，随后自发向上跳动。向上凝视时，眼球震颤加剧。伴随的振动幻视通常非常令人不适，但症状通常是短暂的。

HP:0011478.name: True anophthalmia
HP:0011478.definition: Absence of globe, optic nerve, chiasm and optic tracts. No evidence of ocular tissue on MRI scan or examination.
HP:0011478.definition_cn: 眼球、视神经、视交叉及视束缺如。MRI扫描或检查未见眼组织证据。

HP:0011479.name: Abnormal lacrimal punctum morphology
HP:0011479.definition: An abnormality of the lacrimal punctum, an opening on the eyelid close to the medial canthus that drains tears from the conjunctival sac into the lacrimal duct in the same eyelid.
HP:0011479.definition_cn: 泪点异常，即位于眼睑内侧眦附近的开口，负责将结膜囊中的泪液引流至同侧眼睑的泪管中。

HP:0011480.name: Unilateral microphthalmos
HP:0011480.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of one eye.
HP:0011480.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为单侧眼球异常缩小。

HP:0011481.name: Abnormal lacrimal duct morphology
HP:0011481.definition: An abnormality of the lacrimal duct, a duct that drain tears from the conjunctiva, via the lacrimal puncta, into the lacrimal sac.
HP:0011481.definition_cn: 泪道异常，即泪液从结膜经泪点引流至泪囊的导管出现异常。

HP:0011482.name: Abnormal lacrimal gland morphology
HP:0011482.definition: Abnormality of the lacrimal gland, i.e., of the almond-shaped gland that secretes the aqueous layer of the tear film for each eye.
HP:0011482.definition_cn: 泪腺异常，即分泌每只眼睛泪膜水样层的杏仁形腺体异常。

HP:0011483.name: Anterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
HP:0011483.definition: Adhesions between the iris and the cornea.

HP:0011484.name: Posterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
HP:0011484.definition: Adhesions between the iris and the lens.

HP:0011485.name: Corneolenticular adhesion
HP:0011485.definition: Developmental abnormality in which the lens and cornea are not separated.
HP:0011485.definition_cn: 角膜晶状体未分离发育异常。

HP:0011486.name: Abnormal corneal thickness
HP:0011486.definition: An abnormal anteroposterior thickness of the cornea.

HP:0011487.name: Increased corneal thickness
HP:0011487.definition: A increased anteroposterior thickness of the cornea.

HP:0011488.name: Abnormal corneal endothelium morphology
HP:0011488.definition: Abnormality of the corneal endothelium, that is, the single layer of cells on the inner surface of the cornea.
HP:0011488.definition_cn: 角膜内皮异常，即角膜内表面单层细胞的异常。

HP:0011490.name: Abnormal Descemet membrane morphology
HP:0011490.definition: Abnormality of Descemet's membrane, which is the basement membrane of the corneal endothelium.
HP:0011490.definition_cn: Descemet膜异常，即角膜内皮基底膜异常。

HP:0011491.name: Reduced number of corneal endothelial cells
HP:0011491.definition: A reduction in the number of corneal endothelial cells.
HP:0011491.name_cn: 角膜内皮细胞数量减少
HP:0011491.definition_cn: 角膜内皮细胞数量减少。

HP:0011492.name: Abnormal corneal stroma morphology
HP:0011492.definition: An abnormality of the stroma of cornea, also known as the substantia propria of cornea.
HP:0011492.definition_cn: 角膜基质异常，亦称角膜固有质异常。

HP:0011493.name: Central opacification of the cornea
HP:0011493.definition: Reduced transparency of the central portion of the corneal stroma.
HP:0011493.definition_cn: 角膜基质中央部分透明度降低。

HP:0011494.name: Generalized opacification of the cornea
HP:0011494.definition: Generalized reduced transparency of the stroma of the cornea.
HP:0011494.definition_cn: 角膜基质广泛性透明度降低。

HP:0011495.name: Abnormal corneal epithelium morphology
HP:0011495.definition: Abnormality of the corneal epithelium, that is of the epithelial tissue that covers the front of the cornea.
HP:0011495.definition_cn: 角膜上皮异常，即覆盖角膜前部的上皮组织异常。

HP:0011496.name: Corneal neovascularization
HP:0011496.definition: Ingrowth of new blood vessels into the cornea.

HP:0011497.name: Rubeosis iridis
HP:0011497.definition: Formation of new blood vessels on the iris. The new vessels do not display the typical radially symmertic growth pattern of normal iris blood vessels, but rather appear disorganized. Rubeosis usually starts from the pupillary border with tiny tufts of dilated capillaries or red spots that can only be appreciated with high magnification.
HP:0011497.definition_cn: 虹膜新生血管形成。新生血管未呈现正常虹膜血管典型的放射状对称生长模式，而是表现为无序排列。虹膜红变通常始于瞳孔缘，表现为微小的扩张毛细血管簇或红点，仅在高倍放大下可见。

HP:0011498.name: obsolete Partial aniridia
HP:0011498.name_cn: 陈旧性部分性虹膜缺损

HP:0011501.name: Anterior lenticonus
HP:0011501.definition: A conical projection of the anterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly.
HP:0011501.definition_cn: 晶状体前表面锥形突起，属于发育异常。

HP:0011502.name: Posterior lenticonus
HP:0011502.definition: A conical projection of the posterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly.
HP:0011502.definition_cn: 晶状体后表面锥形突起，属于发育异常。

HP:0011504.name: Bull's eye maculopathy
HP:0011504.definition: Progressive maculopathy characterized by concentric regions of hyper- and hypo-pigmentation.
HP:0011504.definition_cn: 以同心圆区域的色素沉着和色素减退为特征的进行性黄斑病变。

HP:0011505.name: Cystoid macular edema
HP:0011505.definition: Cystoid macular edema (CME) is any type of macular edema that involves cyst formation.
HP:0011505.definition_cn: 囊样黄斑水肿（Cystoid Macular Edema, CME）是指任何涉及囊样结构形成的黄斑水肿类型。

HP:0011506.name: Choroidal neovascularization
HP:0011506.definition: Choroidal neovascularization (CNV) is the creation of new blood vessels in the choroid layer of the eye.
HP:0011506.definition_cn: 脉络膜新生血管（Choroidal Neovascularization, CNV）是指在眼部的脉络膜层中形成的新生血管。

HP:0011507.name: Macular flecks
HP:0011507.definition: Pale often indistinct lesions of the macula.
HP:0011507.definition_cn: 黄斑区苍白且边界不清的病变。

HP:0011508.name: Macular hole
HP:0011508.definition: A macular hole is a small break in the macula, located in the center of the retina.
HP:0011508.definition_cn: 黄斑裂孔是位于视网膜中央的黄斑区出现的小裂孔。

HP:0011509.name: Macular hyperpigmentation
HP:0011509.definition: Increased amount of pigmentation in the macula lutea.

HP:0011510.name: Drusen
HP:0011510.definition: Drusen (singular, 'druse') are tiny yellow or white accumulations of extracellular material (lipofuscin) that build up in Bruch's membrane of the eye.
HP:0011510.definition_cn: 玻璃膜疣（单数形式为“druse”）是微小的黄色或白色细胞外物质（脂褐质）的积聚，沉积于眼部的布鲁赫膜（Bruch's membrane）中。

HP:0011511.name: Macular schisis
HP:0011511.definition: Splitting of the retina in the macular region.

HP:0011513.name: Retinal cavernous hemangioma
HP:0011513.definition: A benign tumor of the retina that appears as a grouping of blood-filled saccules within the inner retinal layers or on the surface of the optic disc. Retinal cavernous angioma are described as having a 'cluster of grapes' appearance.
HP:0011513.definition_cn: 视网膜海绵状血管瘤是一种良性肿瘤，表现为视网膜内层或视盘表面聚集的充满血液的囊状结构。视网膜海绵状血管瘤被描述为具有“葡萄串”样外观。

HP:0011514.name: Abnormality of binocular vision
HP:0011514.definition: An abnormality of binocular vision, that is of the ability to synthesize the visual inputs from both eyes to a single image with perception of depth.
HP:0011514.definition_cn: 双眼视觉异常，即无法将来自双眼的视觉输入合成为具有深度感知的单一图像。

HP:0011515.name: Abnormal stereopsis
HP:0011515.definition: Inability to make fine depth discriminations from parallax provided by the two eyes' different positions on the head.
HP:0011515.definition_cn: 无法通过双眼在头部不同位置提供的视差进行精细深度辨别。

HP:0011516.name: Achromatopsia
HP:0011516.definition: A condition where the retina contains no functional cone cells, so that in addition to the absence of color discrimination, vision in lights of normal intensity is difficult.
HP:0011516.definition_cn: 视网膜锥细胞功能障碍症（Cone Dysfunction Syndrome），表现为视网膜中无功能性锥细胞，导致除色觉辨别缺失外，正常光强下的视觉功能亦显著受损。

HP:0011517.name: Cone monochromacy
HP:0011517.definition: The condition of having both rods and cones, but only a single kind of cone. Affected individuals have good pattern vision in daylight, but cannot distinguish between colors.
HP:0011517.definition_cn: 视杆视锥细胞共存但仅有一种视锥细胞的状况。受影响个体在日光下具有良好的图案视觉，但无法区分颜色。

HP:0011518.name: Dichromacy
HP:0011518.definition: Individuals affected by dichromacy possess only two types of cones, instead of three.
HP:0011518.definition_cn: 患有二色视的个体仅拥有两种类型的视锥细胞，而非三种。

HP:0011519.name: Anomalous trichromacy
HP:0011519.definition: Individuals with anomalous trichromacy possess three types of cones, but one of the three types of cones has an abnormal spectral sensitivity compared to normal cones.
HP:0011519.definition_cn: 异常三色视者拥有三种类型的视锥细胞，但其中一种视锥细胞的光谱敏感性与正常视锥细胞相比存在异常。

HP:0011520.name: Deuteranomaly
HP:0011520.definition: A type of anomalous trichromacy associated with abnormal M photopigment, such that the absorption spectrum is shifted toward L wavelengths. Affected individuals have difficulties distinguishing between red and green.
HP:0011520.definition_cn: 一种与异常M视色素相关的异常三色视觉，其吸收光谱向L波长方向偏移。受累个体在区分红色和绿色方面存在困难。

HP:0011521.name: Deuteranopia
HP:0011521.definition: Complete lack of the M photopigment, which is replaced with the L photopigment. Affected individuals tend to confuse red and green.
HP:0011521.definition_cn: 完全缺乏M视色素，由L视色素替代。受累个体倾向于混淆红色和绿色。

HP:0011522.name: Protanopia
HP:0011522.definition: Blue and green cones only; no functional red cones.
HP:0011522.definition_cn: 仅有蓝色和绿色视锥细胞；无功能性红色视锥细胞。

HP:0011523.name: Iris cyst
HP:0011523.definition: An iris cyst is composed of a single cell layer of epithelium and is filled with fluid.
HP:0011523.definition_cn: 虹膜囊肿由单层上皮细胞构成，内部充满液体。

HP:0011524.name: Iris melanoma
HP:0011524.definition: Malignant tumor of melanocytes affecting the iris.
HP:0011524.definition_cn: 虹膜黑色素细胞恶性肿瘤。

HP:0011525.name: Iris nevus
HP:0011525.definition: A benign brown pigmented area over the iris representing proliferation of melanocyte cells in the stromal layer of the iris. An iris nevus can be flat or occasionally slightly elevated.
HP:0011525.definition_cn: 虹膜基质层黑色素细胞增殖所致的良性棕色色素沉着区域。虹膜痣可为平坦或偶见轻微隆起。

HP:0011526.name: Abnormality of lens shape
HP:0011526.definition: An abnormal shape of the lens.

HP:0011527.name: Lentiglobus
HP:0011527.definition: Exaggerated curvature of the lens of the eye, producing an anterior or posterior spherical bulging.
HP:0011527.definition_cn: 晶状体过度曲率，导致前部或后部球形膨出。

HP:0011528.name: Solitary congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
HP:0011528.definition: Sharply demarcated hyperpigmentation which is congenital found in around 3-5% of the population and of no functional significance.
HP:0011528.name_cn: 孤立性先天性视网膜色素上皮肥大
HP:0011528.definition_cn: 先天性边界清晰的色素沉着过度，约3-5%的人群中存在，无功能性意义。

HP:0011529.name: Multiple bilateral congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
HP:0011529.definition: Sharply demarcated hyperpigmentation which is congenital.
HP:0011529.name_cn: 多发性双侧先天性视网膜色素上皮肥大
HP:0011529.definition_cn: 先天性边界清晰的色素沉着过度。

HP:0011530.name: Retinal hole
HP:0011530.definition: A small break in the retina.

HP:0011531.name: Vitritis
HP:0011531.definition: Inflammation of the vitreous body, characterized by the presence of inflammatory cells and protein exudate in the vitreous cavity.
HP:0011531.definition_cn: 玻璃体炎，其特征为玻璃体腔内存在炎性细胞和蛋白渗出物。

HP:0011532.name: Subretinal exudate
HP:0011532.definition: A type of retinal exudate located in the subretinal space between the sensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:0011532.definition_cn: 一种位于感觉视网膜与视网膜色素上皮之间的视网膜下间隙中的视网膜渗出物。

HP:0011533.name: Snowflake vitreoretinal degeneration
HP:0011533.definition: The appearance of yellow/white crystalline-like (hence the name) spots in the retina and thickening of the peripheral part of the vitreous.
HP:0011533.name_cn: 雪花样玻璃体视网膜变性
HP:0011533.definition_cn: 视网膜中出现黄白色结晶样（因此得名）斑点，以及玻璃体周边部分增厚。

HP:0011534.name: Abnormal spatial orientation of the cardiac segments
HP:0011534.definition: Abnormality of the spatial relationship of the cardiac segments to other components of the heart.
HP:0011534.name_cn: 心脏节段空间定向异常
HP:0011534.definition_cn: 心脏节段与心脏其他组成部分空间关系的异常。

HP:0011535.name: Abnormal atrial arrangement
HP:0011535.definition: Abnormality of the spatial relationship of the atria to other components of the heart.
HP:0011535.definition_cn: 心房与心脏其他组成部分空间关系异常。

HP:0011536.name: Right atrial isomerism
HP:0011536.definition: Right atrial isomerism is characterized by bilateral triangular, morphologically right atrial, appendages, both joining the atrial chamber along a broad front with internal terminal crest.
HP:0011536.definition_cn: 右心房异构症的特征为双侧呈三角形、形态学上为右心房的耳部，两者均沿宽阔的前缘与心房腔相连，内部具有终嵴。

HP:0011537.name: Left atrial isomerism
HP:0011537.definition: In left atrial isomerism there is a bilateral small finger-shaped morphologically left atrial appendage joining the atrial chamber along a narrow front without an internal terminal crest.
HP:0011537.definition_cn: 在左心房异构中，存在双侧小指状形态的左心耳，沿狭窄的前缘与心房腔相连，且内部无终嵴。

HP:0011538.name: Atrial situs inversus
HP:0011538.definition: Mirror image atrial arrangement, with morphologic right atrium on the left hand side and morphologic left atrium on the right hand side.
HP:0011538.definition_cn: 镜像心房排列，形态学右心房位于左侧，形态学左心房位于右侧。

HP:0011539.name: Atrial situs ambiguous
HP:0011539.definition: Common atrium without defining morphologic features.
HP:0011539.definition_cn: 无明确形态学特征的单心房。

HP:0011540.name: Congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries
HP:0011540.definition: The essence of the lesion is the combination of discordant atrioventricular and ventriculo-arterial connections. Thus, the morphologically right atrium is connected to a morphologically left ventricle across the mitral valve, with the left ventricle then connected to the pulmonary trunk. The morphologically left atrium is connected to the morphologically right ventricle across the tricuspid valve, with the morphologically right ventricle connected to the aorta.
HP:0011540.name_cn: 先天性矫正型大动脉转位
HP:0011540.definition_cn: 病变的本质是不一致的房室连接和心室-动脉连接的组合。因此，形态学上的右心房通过二尖瓣连接到形态学上的左心室，左心室再连接到肺动脉干。形态学上的左心房通过三尖瓣连接到形态学上的右心室，形态学上的右心室再连接到主动脉。

HP:0011541.name: Criss-cross atrioventricular valves
HP:0011541.definition: Crossing of the inflow streams of the two ventricles, due to an apparent twisting of the heart about its long axis.
HP:0011541.definition_cn: 由于心脏沿其长轴明显扭转，导致两个心室流入血流的交叉。

HP:0011542.name: Criss-cross atrioventricular valves with superior-inferior ventricles
HP:0011542.definition: Criss-cross atrioventricular valves with a rare cardiac malformation characterized by the two ventricles lying one above the other instead of side by side.
HP:0011542.name_cn: 交叉性房室瓣伴上下心室
HP:0011542.definition_cn: 交叉性房室瓣伴罕见心脏畸形，其特征为两个心室呈上下排列而非左右并列。

HP:0011543.name: Superior-inferior ventricles without criss-cross atrioventricular valves
HP:0011543.name_cn: 上下心室无交叉房室瓣

HP:0011545.name: Abnormal connection of the cardiac segments
HP:0011545.definition: A deviance in the normal connections between two cardiac segments.
HP:0011545.definition_cn: 心脏两节段间正常连接的异常。

HP:0011546.name: Abnormal atrioventricular connection
HP:0011546.definition: An abnormality of the circulatory connection between atria and ventricles.
HP:0011546.definition_cn: 心房与心室之间循环连接的异常。

HP:0011547.name: Absent left sided atrioventricular connection
HP:0011547.definition: A defect where there is no connection between the left atrium and left ventricle.
HP:0011547.definition_cn: 左心房与左心室之间无连接的缺损。

HP:0011548.name: Absent right sided atrioventricular connection
HP:0011548.definition: A defect where there is no connection between the right atrium and right ventricle.
HP:0011548.definition_cn: 右心房与右心室之间无连接的先天性心脏缺陷。

HP:0011549.name: Univentricular heart with absent left sided atrioventricular connection
HP:0011549.name_cn: 单心室伴左侧房室连接缺如

HP:0011550.name: Biventricular heart with straddling right sided atrioventricular valve and absent left sided atrioventricular connection
HP:0011550.name_cn: 双心室心脏伴骑跨右侧房室瓣及左侧房室连接缺如

HP:0011551.name: Right sided atrium to left ventricle and absent left sided atrioventricular connection
HP:0011551.name_cn: 右心房至左心室连接及左侧房室连接缺如

HP:0011552.name: Ambiguous atrioventricular connection
HP:0011552.definition: With left or right cardiac isomerism in a biventricular, the atrioventricular connections are perforce ambiguous, in that one of the connections is concordant (e.g., right-sided morphologic right atrium connected to a morphologic right ventricle) and one of the connections is discordant (e.g., left-sided morphologic right atrium connected to a morphologic left ventricle).
HP:0011552.definition_cn: 在双心室左或右心异构的情况下，房室连接必然是不明确的，因为其中一个连接是一致的（例如，右侧形态学右心房连接到形态学右心室），而另一个连接是不一致的（例如，左侧形态学右心房连接到形态学左心室）。

HP:0011553.name: Discordant atrioventricular connection
HP:0011553.definition: Connection of the right atrium to the left ventricle and of the left atrium to the right ventricle in a biventricular heart.
HP:0011553.definition_cn: 双心室心脏中右心房与左心室相连，左心房与右心室相连。

HP:0011554.name: Double inlet atrioventricular connection
HP:0011554.definition: The condition in which both atria are joined to a single ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve.
HP:0011554.definition_cn: 双心房各自通过其房室瓣连接至单一心室的状态。

HP:0011555.name: Double inlet left ventricle
HP:0011555.definition: The condition in which both atria are joined to the left ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. Usually there is a hypoplastic right ventricle, which may be on the opposite side of the heart as usual.
HP:0011555.definition_cn: 双心房均通过各自的房室瓣连接至左心室的情况。通常存在右心室发育不全，且右心室可能位于心脏的常规对侧位置。

HP:0011556.name: Double inlet right ventricle
HP:0011556.definition: The condition in which both atria are joined to the right ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. Usually, the left ventricle is hypoplastic.
HP:0011556.definition_cn: 双心房均通过各自的房室瓣连接至右心室的情况。通常，左心室发育不全。

HP:0011557.name: Double inlet to single ventricle of indeterminate morphology
HP:0011557.definition: The condition in which both atria are joined to a single ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. The morphology of this ventricle does not allow one to determine if it corresponds to the left or right ventricle.
HP:0011557.name_cn: 形态不确定的单心室双入口
HP:0011557.definition_cn: 双心房各自通过其房室瓣连接至单一心室。该心室的形态学特征无法确定其对应于左心室或右心室。

HP:0011558.name: Double inlet to single ventricle with common atrioventricular orifice
HP:0011558.name_cn: 双入口单心室伴共同房室孔

HP:0011559.name: Double inlet to single ventricle with two atrioventricular valves
HP:0011559.name_cn: 双入口单心室伴双房室瓣

HP:0011560.name: Mitral atresia
HP:0011560.definition: A congenital defect with failure to open of the mitral valve orifice.
HP:0011560.definition_cn: 先天性二尖瓣口闭锁不全。

HP:0011561.name: Overriding atrioventricular valve
HP:0011561.definition: An atrioventricular valve that empties into both ventricles. The valve overrides the interventricular septum above a ventricular septum defect.
HP:0011561.definition_cn: 跨位于室间隔缺损上方的房室瓣，该瓣膜同时排空至双心室。

HP:0011562.name: Straddling atrioventricular valve
HP:0011562.definition: Anomalous insertion of the chordae tendinae or papillary muscles into the contralateral ventricle in the presence of a ventricular septum defect.
HP:0011562.definition_cn: 在室间隔缺损存在的情况下，腱索或乳头肌异常插入对侧心室。

HP:0011563.name: Abnormal ventriculoarterial connection
HP:0011563.definition: An abnormality of the circulatory connection between the ventricles and the pulmonary artery and aorta.
HP:0011563.definition_cn: 心室与肺动脉及主动脉之间循环连接的异常。

HP:0011564.name: Mitral valve arcade
HP:0011564.definition: Anomalous mitral valve arcade is diagnosed based on the following features (1) An adequately sized mitral valve orifice; (2) short, thick, and poorly differentiated chordae with direct union of the papillary muscles to the anterior leaflet; (3) narrow or nearly nonexistent spaces between the abnormal chordae; and (4) greater differentiation of the chordae attached to the posterior papillary muscle.
HP:0011564.definition_cn: 二尖瓣异常弓形结构的诊断依据以下特征：（1）二尖瓣口大小适当；（2）腱索短、厚且分化不良，乳头肌直接与前叶相连；（3）异常腱索之间的间隙狭窄或几乎不存在；（4）附着于后乳头肌的腱索分化程度较高。

HP:0011565.name: Common atrium
HP:0011565.definition: Complete absence of the interatrial septum with common atrioventricular valve and two atrioventricular connections.
HP:0011565.definition_cn: 房间隔完全缺失伴共同房室瓣及双房室连接。

HP:0011566.name: Cor triatriatum dexter
HP:0011566.definition: A congenital anomaly with partitioning of the right atrium to form a triatrial heart caused by persistence of the right valve of the sinus venosus. Typically, the right atrial partition is due to exaggerated fetal eustachian and thebesian valves, which together form an incomplete septum across the lower part of the atrium. This septum may range from a reticulum to a substantial sheet of tissue.
HP:0011566.definition_cn: 一种先天性异常，由于静脉窦右瓣持续存在导致右心房分隔形成三心房心脏。通常，右心房分隔是由于胎儿欧氏瓣和特贝西乌斯瓣过度发育，共同形成横跨心房下部的不完全隔膜。该隔膜可从网状结构到实质性组织片不等。

HP:0011567.name: Sinus venosus atrial septal defect
HP:0011567.definition: An interatrial communication caused by a deficiency of the common wall between the superior vena cava (SVC) and the right-sided pulmonary veins. SVASD is commonly associated with anomalous pulmonary venous connection (APVC) of some or all of the pulmonary veins, which produces additional left-to-right shunting.
HP:0011567.definition_cn: 上腔静脉（SVC）与右侧肺静脉之间的共同壁缺损导致的心房间交通。上腔静脉型房间隔缺损（SVASD）常伴部分或全部肺静脉的异常肺静脉连接（APVC），从而产生额外的左向右分流。

HP:0011568.name: Double orifice mitral valve
HP:0011568.definition: The left atrio-ventricular connection consists of two anatomically distinct orifices separated by accessory fibrous tissue.
HP:0011568.definition_cn: 左房室连接由两个解剖学上独立的开口组成，其间由副纤维组织分隔。

HP:0011569.name: Cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet
HP:0011569.definition: Cleft in the anterior mitral valve leaflet not associated with an atrioventricular canal defect.
HP:0011569.definition_cn: 二尖瓣前叶裂，不伴房室通道缺损。

HP:0011571.name: Parachute mitral valve
HP:0011571.definition: Abnormality of the mitral valve apparatus, whereby chordae attach to a single papillary muscle or hypoplastic papillary muscles.
HP:0011571.definition_cn: 二尖瓣装置异常，表现为腱索附着于单一乳头肌或发育不全的乳头肌。

HP:0011572.name: Supramitral ring
HP:0011572.definition: A congenital stenotic mitral valvular anomaly with a ring of tissue above the mitral valve.
HP:0011572.definition_cn: 先天性二尖瓣狭窄异常伴二尖瓣上方环状组织。

HP:0011573.name: Hypoplastic tricuspid valve
HP:0011573.definition: Congenital defect characterized by underdevelopment of the tricuspid valve.
HP:0011573.definition_cn: 三尖瓣发育不全为特征的先天性缺陷。

HP:0011574.name: Imperforate atrioventricular valve
HP:0011574.definition: An atrioventricular valve that has failed to open (atretic).

HP:0011575.name: Imperforate tricuspid valve
HP:0011575.definition: A tricuspid valve that has failed to open.

HP:0011576.name: Intermediate atrioventricular canal defect
HP:0011576.definition: A specific combination of heart defects with a primum atrial septal defect, cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet, and inlet ventricular defect. There is one valve annulus and two valve orifices.
HP:0011576.definition_cn: 一种特定的心脏缺陷组合，包括原发孔型房间隔缺损、二尖瓣前叶裂和流入道型室间隔缺损。存在一个瓣环和两个瓣口。

HP:0011577.name: Partial atrioventricular canal defect
HP:0011577.definition: A specific combination of heart defects including a primum atrial septal defect and cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet. There is not an inlet ventricular septal defect present. There are two valve annuluses and two valve orifices.
HP:0011577.definition_cn: 一种特定的心脏缺陷组合，包括原发孔型房间隔缺损和二尖瓣前叶裂。不存在流入道型室间隔缺损。存在两个瓣环和两个瓣口。

HP:0011578.name: Transitional atrioventricular canal defect
HP:0011578.definition: A specific combination of heart defects with a primum atrial septal defect, cleft anterior mitral valve leaflet, and an inlet ventricular septal defect. There are two valve annuli and two valve orifices.
HP:0011578.definition_cn: 一种特定的心脏缺陷组合，包括原发孔型房间隔缺损、二尖瓣前叶裂和流入道型室间隔缺损。存在两个瓣环和两个瓣口。

HP:0011579.name: Unbalanced atrioventricular canal defect
HP:0011579.definition: Anatomic features of unbalanced atrioventricular septal defect (AVSD) include varying amounts of ventricular hypoplasia, as well as malalignment of the atrioventricular junction. In complete AVSD, the common AV valve can be situated either equally over the right and left ventricles (balanced) or unequally over the ventricles (unbalanced).
HP:0011579.name_cn: 不平衡性房室通道缺损
HP:0011579.definition_cn: 不平衡性房室间隔缺损（AVSD）的解剖特征包括不同程度的心室发育不全以及房室连接处的错位。在完全性房室间隔缺损中，共同房室瓣可均等地位于左右心室上方（平衡型）或非均等地位于心室上方（不平衡型）。

HP:0011580.name: Short chordae tendineae of the mitral valve
HP:0011580.definition: Abnormally short chordae tendineae of the mitral valve.

HP:0011581.name: Double outlet left ventricle
HP:0011581.definition: A congenital defect of heart development characterized by origin of both pulmonary artery and aorta from the morphological left ventricle.
HP:0011581.definition_cn: 一种心脏发育的先天性缺陷，其特征是肺动脉和主动脉均起源于形态学左心室。

HP:0011582.name: Abdominal ectopia cordis
HP:0011582.definition: Displacement of the heart outside the thoracic cavity and into the abdomen.
HP:0011582.definition_cn: 心脏异位至胸腔外并进入腹腔。

HP:0011583.name: Cervical ectopia cordis
HP:0011583.definition: A type of ectopia cordis with the heart partially in the cervical region and without a defect of the sternum.
HP:0011583.definition_cn: 一种心脏异位类型，其中心脏部分位于颈部区域，且无胸骨缺损。

HP:0011584.name: Thoracocervical ectopia cordis
HP:0011584.definition: A type of ectopia cordis with the heart partially in the cervical region with a defect of the superior portion of the sternum.
HP:0011584.definition_cn: 一种心脏异位症，其中心脏部分位于颈部区域，伴有胸骨上段缺损。

HP:0011585.name: Thoracic ectopia cordis
HP:0011585.definition: Congenital malformation of the thoracic wall with partial or total displacement of the heart outside the thoracic cavity. This feature is associated with sternal cleft or absence of the sternum.
HP:0011585.definition_cn: 先天性胸壁畸形伴心脏部分或全部移位至胸腔外。该特征与胸骨裂或胸骨缺失相关。

HP:0011586.name: Thoracoabdominal ectopia cordis
HP:0011586.definition: Congenital malformation of the ventral wall with partial or total evisceration of the heart outside the thoracic cavity and displacement partially into the abdominal cavity.
HP:0011586.definition_cn: 先天性腹壁畸形伴心脏部分或全部脱出胸腔并部分移位至腹腔。

HP:0011587.name: Abnormal branching pattern of the aortic arch
HP:0011587.definition: A deviance from the norm of the origin or course of the right brachiocephalic artery, the left common carotid artery, the left subclavian artery or the proximal vertebral arteries.
HP:0011587.definition_cn: 右头臂动脉、左颈总动脉、左锁骨下动脉或近端椎动脉的起源或走行偏离正常解剖结构。

HP:0011588.name: Cervical aortic arch
HP:0011588.definition: The aortic arch extends into the soft tissues of the neck before turning down into to become the descending aorta.
HP:0011588.definition_cn: 主动脉弓延伸至颈部软组织后，向下转折形成降主动脉。

HP:0011589.name: Common origin of the right brachiocephalic artery and left common carotid artery
HP:0011589.definition: The left common carotid artery has a common origin with the innominate artery.
HP:0011589.name_cn: 右头臂动脉与左颈总动脉共干
HP:0011589.definition_cn: 左颈总动脉与无名动脉具有共同起源。

HP:0011590.name: Double aortic arch
HP:0011590.definition: A conenital abnormality of the aortic arch in which the two embryonic aortc arches form a vascular ring that surrounds the trachea or esophagus and then join to form the descending aorta. Double aortic arch can cause symptoms because of compression of the esophagus (dysphagia, cyanosis while eating) or trachea (stridor).
HP:0011590.definition_cn: 主动脉弓先天性异常，其中两个胚胎主动脉弓形成一个血管环，环绕气管或食管，然后汇合形成降主动脉。双主动脉弓可因压迫食管（吞咽困难、进食时发绀）或气管（喘鸣）而引起症状。

HP:0011591.name: Left aortic arch with cervical origin of the right subclavian artery
HP:0011591.name_cn: 左位主动脉弓伴右锁骨下动脉颈段起源

HP:0011592.name: Left aortic arch with isolated subclavian artery
HP:0011592.definition: The subclavian artery arises from ductus arteriosus. While the ductus arteriosus is patent its blood supply comes from the ductus, hence from the pulmonary artery. After it closes, the blood supply is retrogradely from the vertebral artery via the circle of Willis.
HP:0011592.name_cn: 左位主动脉弓伴孤立性锁骨下动脉
HP:0011592.definition_cn: 锁骨下动脉起源于动脉导管。在动脉导管未闭时，其血液供应来自动脉导管，进而来自肺动脉。在动脉导管闭合后，血液供应则通过Willis环由椎动脉逆向提供。

HP:0011593.name: Left aortic arch with retroesophageal diverticulum of Kommerell
HP:0011593.definition: A patent ductus arteriosus or ductal ligament completes the ring.
HP:0011593.name_cn: 左主动脉弓伴食管后Kommerell憩室
HP:0011593.definition_cn: 动脉导管未闭或动脉导管韧带完成环状结构。

HP:0011594.name: Right aortic arch with retroesophageal diverticulum of Kommerell
HP:0011594.definition: Aortic arch crosses the right mainstem bronchus. The left carotid artery is the first branch, right carotid artery the second branch and right subclavian artery as the third branch.
HP:0011594.name_cn: 右位主动脉弓伴食管后Kommerell憩室
HP:0011594.definition_cn: 主动脉弓跨越右主支气管。左颈总动脉为第一分支，右颈总动脉为第二分支，右锁骨下动脉为第三分支。

HP:0011595.name: Left aortic arch with retroesophageal right subclavian artery
HP:0011595.definition: Aortic arch crosses the left mainstem bronchus. The first branch is the right carotid artery, the second branch is the left carotid artery, the third branch is the subclavian artery, the fourth branch is the right subclavian artery arising from the posteromedial aspect of the distal aortic arch and continuing posterior to the esophagus to the right hand side of the body.
HP:0011595.name_cn: 左位主动脉弓伴食管后右锁骨下动脉
HP:0011595.definition_cn: 主动脉弓跨越左主支气管。其第一分支为右颈总动脉，第二分支为左颈总动脉，第三分支为锁骨下动脉，第四分支为右锁骨下动脉，起自主动脉弓远端的后内侧，并在食管后方延续至身体的右侧。

HP:0011596.name: Left aortic arch with right descending aorta and right ductus arteriosus
HP:0011596.definition: The ring may be completed by the ductal ligament.
HP:0011596.name_cn: 左位主动脉弓伴右位降主动脉及右位动脉导管未闭
HP:0011596.definition_cn: 环状结构可由导管韧带完成闭合。

HP:0011597.name: Right aortic arch with left descending aorta and left ductus arteriosus
HP:0011597.name_cn: 右位主动脉弓伴左降主动脉及左动脉导管未闭

HP:0011598.name: Right aortic arch with retroesophageal left subclavian artery
HP:0011598.name_cn: 右位主动脉弓伴食管后左锁骨下动脉

HP:0011599.name: Mesocardia
HP:0011599.definition: Mesocardia is an abnormal location of the heart in which the heart is in a midline position and the longitudinal axis of the heart lies in the mid-sagittal plane.
HP:0011599.definition_cn: 中位心是一种心脏位置异常，表现为心脏位于中线位置，且心脏长轴位于矢状面正中。

HP:0011600.name: Abnormal direction of ventricular apex
HP:0011600.definition: Abnormal plane of direction of the heart from the base to the apex. Left sided is normal.
HP:0011600.definition_cn: 心脏从基底到心尖的异常方向平面。左侧为正常。

HP:0011601.name: Rightward direction of ventricular apex
HP:0011601.definition: Abnormal plane of direction of the heart from the base to the apex towards the right. Left sided is normal.
HP:0011601.definition_cn: 心脏从基底到心尖的异常方向平面向右偏移。左侧为正常位置。

HP:0011602.name: Midline direction of ventricular apex
HP:0011602.definition: Abnormal plane of direction of the heart from the base to the apex in the midline. Left sided is normal.
HP:0011602.definition_cn: 心脏从基底到心尖的轴线方向异常，位于中线。左侧为正常位置。

HP:0011603.name: Congenital malformation of the great arteries
HP:0011603.definition: Defect or defects of the morphogenesis of the aorta and pulmonary arteries.
HP:0011603.definition_cn: 主动脉和肺动脉形态发生缺陷。

HP:0011604.name: Aortopulmonary window
HP:0011604.definition: A congenital anomaly with an abnormal connection between the aorta and the main pulmonary artery resulting in an aortopulmonary shunt.
HP:0011604.definition_cn: 一种先天性异常，表现为主动脉与主肺动脉之间存在异常连接，导致主动脉-肺动脉分流。

HP:0011605.name: Congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries with ventricular septal defect
HP:0011605.definition: A congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries with a ventricular septal defect: a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart. The ventricular septal defect is centered around the most superior aspect of the ventricular septum.
HP:0011605.name_cn: 先天性矫正型大动脉转位伴室间隔缺损
HP:0011605.definition_cn: 先天性矫正型大动脉转位伴室间隔缺损：心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞。室间隔缺损位于室间隔的最上端。

HP:0011606.name: obsolete Transposition of the great arteries with intact ventricular septum
HP:0011606.name_cn: 过时的完全性大动脉转位伴完整室间隔

HP:0011607.name: obsolete Transposition of the great arteries with ventricular septal defect
HP:0011607.name_cn: 过时的术语：大动脉转位伴室间隔缺损

HP:0011608.name: Type II truncus arteriosus
HP:0011608.definition: Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) with each pulmonary artery arising separate from each other on the posterior or lateral aspect of the truncus.
HP:0011608.definition_cn: 动脉干（单一的大动脉从心脏底部发出，分出冠状动脉、肺动脉和体循环动脉），其中每支肺动脉分别从动脉干的后侧或外侧独立发出。

HP:0011609.name: Type III truncus arteriosus
HP:0011609.definition: Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) whereby one of the two pulmonary artery branched does not arise from the common pulmonary trunk, but instead from the ductus arteriosus or directly from the aorta.
HP:0011609.definition_cn: 动脉干（单一的大动脉从心脏底部发出，分出冠状动脉、肺动脉和体循环动脉），其中两支肺动脉中的一支并非起源于共同的肺动脉干，而是起源于动脉导管或直接起源于主动脉。

HP:0011610.name: Type IV truncus arteriosus
HP:0011610.definition: Truncus arteriosus (single great artery leaving the base of the heart, giving rise to the coronary, pulmonary, and systemic arteries) whereby the aortic arch is hypoplastic or interrupted, and a large patent ductus arteriosus is present.
HP:0011610.definition_cn: 动脉干（单一的大动脉从心脏底部发出，分出冠状动脉、肺动脉和体循环动脉），其中主动脉弓发育不全或中断，并伴有大型动脉导管未闭。

HP:0011611.name: Interrupted aortic arch
HP:0011611.definition: Non-continuity of the arch of aorta with an atretic point or absent segment.
HP:0011611.definition_cn: 主动脉弓不连续伴闭锁点或节段缺失。

HP:0011612.name: Interrupted aortic arch type A
HP:0011612.definition: Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment at the level of the isthmus.
HP:0011612.definition_cn: 主动脉弓不连续，在峡部水平存在闭锁点或缺如段。

HP:0011613.name: Interrupted aortic arch type B
HP:0011613.definition: Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment between the left carotid and subclavian arteries.
HP:0011613.definition_cn: 主动脉弓不连续，伴左颈动脉与锁骨下动脉之间闭锁点或节段缺失。

HP:0011614.name: Interrupted aortic arch type C
HP:0011614.definition: Non-continuity of the aortic arch with an atretic point or absent segment between the innominate and left carotid arteries.
HP:0011614.definition_cn: 主动脉弓不连续，在无名动脉与左颈总动脉之间存在闭锁点或缺如段。

HP:0011615.name: Abnormal pulmonary situs morphology
HP:0011615.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, which is defined by characteristics such as the number of lobes per lung and the relationship of the pulmonary arteries to their bronchi.
HP:0011615.definition_cn: 肺位异常，即形态学上的右肺和左肺的侧位异常，其定义特征包括每侧肺的肺叶数量以及肺动脉与其支气管的关系。

HP:0011616.name: Pulmonary situs inversus
HP:0011616.definition: Mirror image arrangement of the mainstem bronchi with the right pulmonary artery posterior to the right upper lobe bronchus and the left pulmonary artery anterior to the left upper lobe bronchus.
HP:0011616.definition_cn: 主支气管镜像排列，右肺动脉位于右上叶支气管后方，左肺动脉位于左上叶支气管前方。

HP:0011617.name: Pulmonary situs ambiguus
HP:0011617.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, in which the morphology of both left and right lungs is the same.
HP:0011617.definition_cn: 肺位异常，即形态学右肺和左肺的侧位异常，其中左右肺的形态相同。

HP:0011618.name: Pulmonary situs ambiguus with bilateral morphologic right lungs
HP:0011618.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, in which both lungs have the morphology of a right lung.
HP:0011618.name_cn: 肺位置不明确伴双侧形态学右肺
HP:0011618.definition_cn: 肺位异常，即形态学右肺和左肺的侧位异常，其中双肺均呈现右肺的形态学特征。

HP:0011619.name: Pulmonary situs ambiguus with bilateral morphologic left lungs
HP:0011619.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the morphological right and left lungs, in which both lungs have the morphology of a left lung.
HP:0011619.name_cn: 双侧形态学左肺伴肺位不明确
HP:0011619.definition_cn: 肺位异常，即形态学上的右肺和左肺的侧位异常，其中双肺均呈现左肺的形态。

HP:0011620.name: Abnormality of abdominal situs
HP:0011620.definition: An abnormality of the abdominal situs, i.e., of the sidedness of the abdomen and its organs.
HP:0011620.definition_cn: 腹部位置异常，即腹部及其器官的侧位性异常。

HP:0011621.name: Gerbode ventricular septal defect
HP:0011621.definition: A type of ventricular septal defect communicating directly between the left ventricle and right atrium. This is anatomically possible because the normal tricuspid valve is more apically displaced than the mitral valve.
HP:0011621.definition_cn: 一种直接连通左心室与右心房的心室间隔缺损。从解剖学角度而言，这种缺损之所以可能，是因为正常的三尖瓣相较于二尖瓣更靠近心尖部。

HP:0011622.name: Inlet ventricular septal defect
HP:0011622.definition: A ventricular septal defect that involves the inlet of the right ventricular septum immediately inferior to the AV valve apparatus.
HP:0011622.definition_cn: 累及右心室间隔入口、紧邻房室瓣装置下方的室间隔缺损。

HP:0011623.name: Muscular ventricular septal defect
HP:0011623.definition: The trabecular septum is the largest part of the interventricular septum. It extends from the membranous septum to the apex and superiorly to the infundibular septum. A defect in the trabecular septum is called muscular VSD if the defect is completely rimmed by muscle.
HP:0011623.definition_cn: 小梁间隔是室间隔的最大部分。它从膜性间隔延伸至心尖，并向上延伸至漏斗间隔。如果缺损完全由肌肉环绕，则小梁间隔的缺损称为肌部室间隔缺损（muscular VSD）。

HP:0011624.name: Apical muscular ventricular septal defect
HP:0011624.definition: A muscular ventricular septal defect located at the apex of the heart.
HP:0011624.name_cn: 心尖部肌性室间隔缺损
HP:0011624.definition_cn: 位于心尖部的肌部室间隔缺损。

HP:0011625.name: Multiple muscular ventricular septal defects
HP:0011625.definition: A type of muscular ventricular septal defect characterized by the presence of multiple small defects in the ventricular septum.
HP:0011625.name_cn: 多发性肌部室间隔缺损
HP:0011625.definition_cn: 一种肌部室间隔缺损类型，其特征为室间隔存在多个小型缺损。

HP:0011626.name: Scimitar anomaly
HP:0011626.definition: Right pulmonary venous return to the inferior vena cava.
HP:0011626.definition_cn: 右肺静脉回流至下腔静脉。

HP:0011627.name: Aorto-ventricular tunnel
HP:0011627.definition: Aorto-ventricular tunnel is a congenital, extracardiac channel which connects the ascending aorta above the sinotubular junction to the cavity of the left, or (less commonly) right ventricle.
HP:0011627.definition_cn: 主动脉-心室隧道是一种先天性心外通道，连接窦管交界上方的升主动脉与左心室（或较少见的右心室）腔。

HP:0011628.name: Congenital defect of the pericardium
HP:0011628.definition: A developmental defect of the pericardium with congenital onset.

HP:0011629.name: Total absence of the pericardium
HP:0011629.definition: No pericardium around the heart, occurring as a congenital defect, not the result of a surgical pericardectomy.
HP:0011629.definition_cn: 心脏周围无心包膜，为先天性缺陷所致，非外科心包切除术的结果。

HP:0011630.name: Complete diaphragmatic absence of pericardium
HP:0011630.definition: No pericardium over the diaphragmatic surface of the heart. It is a congenital defect, not the result of a pericardectomy. Pericardium is present on other parts of the heart.
HP:0011630.definition_cn: 心脏膈面心包缺失。此为先天性缺陷，非心包切除术所致。心脏其他部位心包存在。

HP:0011631.name: Complete right sided absence of pericardium
HP:0011631.definition: No pericardium is present on the righthand side of the heart. It is a congenital absence of pericardium rather than the result of a pericardectomy.
HP:0011631.definition_cn: 心脏右侧无心包存在。此为先天性心包缺失，而非心包切除术所致。

HP:0011632.name: Partial right sided absence of pericardium
HP:0011632.definition: A congenital anomaly with lack of part of the pericardium on the righthand side of the heart.
HP:0011632.definition_cn: 先天性心包部分缺失，位于心脏右侧。

HP:0011633.name: Complete left sided absence of pericardium
HP:0011633.definition: A congenital anomaly with complete lack of the pericardium on the lefthand side of the heart.
HP:0011633.definition_cn: 左侧心包完全缺如的先天性畸形。

HP:0011634.name: Partial left sided absence of pericardium
HP:0011634.definition: A congenital anomaly with lack of part of the pericardium on the lefthand side of the heart.
HP:0011634.definition_cn: 左侧心包部分缺如的先天性畸形。

HP:0011635.name: Partial diaphragmatic absence of pericardium
HP:0011635.definition: Lack of a part of the pericardium over the diaphragmatic surface of the heart. It is a congenital defect, not the result of a pericardectomy. Pericardium is present on other parts of the heart.
HP:0011635.definition_cn: 心脏膈面心包部分缺失。此为先天性缺陷，非心包切除术所致。心脏其他部位心包存在。

HP:0011636.name: Abnormal coronary artery origin
HP:0011636.definition: Isolated abnormalities of the coronary artery origins. This may be in associated with other structural heart malformations but not the patterns of complex structural heart malformations which result in abnormal course of the coronary arteries.
HP:0011636.definition_cn: 冠状动脉起源孤立性异常。这可能与其他结构性心脏畸形相关，但不属于导致冠状动脉走行异常的复杂结构性心脏畸形模式。

HP:0011637.name: Anomalous origin of coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
HP:0011637.definition: A coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta.
HP:0011637.name_cn: 冠状动脉起源于肺动脉异常
HP:0011637.definition_cn: 冠状动脉起源于肺动脉而非正常情况下的主动脉根部。

HP:0011638.name: Anomalous origin of left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
HP:0011638.definition: Left main coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta, above the left cusp of the aortic valve.
HP:0011638.name_cn: 左冠状动脉起源于肺动脉异常
HP:0011638.definition_cn: 左冠状动脉主干起源于肺动脉，而非正常情况下的主动脉根部，位于主动脉瓣左冠瓣上方。

HP:0011639.name: Anomalous origin of right coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
HP:0011639.definition: Right coronary artery begins (branches off from) the pulmonary artery rather than as normal from the root of the aorta, above the right cusp of the aortic valve.
HP:0011639.name_cn: 右冠状动脉起源于肺动脉异常
HP:0011639.definition_cn: 右冠状动脉起源于肺动脉，而非正常情况下的主动脉根部，位于主动脉瓣右瓣叶上方。

HP:0011640.name: Single coronary artery origin
HP:0011640.definition: The presence of a single coronary artery ostium from which both coronary arteries arise.
HP:0011640.definition_cn: 单一冠状动脉开口，双侧冠状动脉均由此发出。

HP:0011641.name: Coronary artery fistula
HP:0011641.definition: A congenital malformation with abnormal connection between one of the coronary arteries and a heart chamber or another blood vessel.
HP:0011641.definition_cn: 冠状动脉畸形，即冠状动脉与心腔或其他血管之间存在异常连接的一种先天性畸形。

HP:0011642.name: Abnormal coronary sinus morphology
HP:0011642.definition: An abnormality of the coronary sinus, which is formed by the union of the great cardiac vein and the left marginal vein and terminates in the right atrium. The coronary sinus functions to o collect deoxygenated blood from the myocardium of the heart and drain it into the right atrium.
HP:0011642.definition_cn: 冠状窦异常，冠状窦由心大静脉和左缘静脉汇合而成，终止于右心房。冠状窦的功能是收集心肌的脱氧血液并将其引流至右心房。

HP:0011643.name: Coronary sinus atrial septal defect
HP:0011643.definition: An atrial septal defect characterized by a deficiency in the tissue separating the coronary sinus from the left atrium (LA). This results in partial or complete unroofing of the coronary sinus leading to a predominantly left-to-right shunt through the coronary sinus (LA to coronary sinus to right atrium [RA]). The orifice of the ostium is frequently large because of the increased flow. From the RA side, the defect is located at the level of the coronary sinus ostium and may also include some deficiency in atrial tissue around the ostium. From the LA side, the size can be variable depending on the degree of unroofing of the coronary sinus.
HP:0011643.definition_cn: 一种房间隔缺损，其特征为分隔冠状窦与左心房（LA）的组织缺损。这导致冠状窦部分或完全去顶，从而形成主要通过冠状窦的左向右分流（LA至冠状窦至右心房[RA]）。由于血流增加，开口通常较大。从RA侧观察，缺损位于冠状窦开口水平，并可能包括开口周围心房组织的部分缺损。从LA侧观察，缺损的大小可能因冠状窦去顶程度的不同而有所变化。

HP:0011644.name: Coronary sinus diverticulum
HP:0011644.definition: A venous pouch within the left ventricular wall, with a neck opening into the coronary sinus.
HP:0011644.definition_cn: 左心室壁内的静脉囊，其颈部开口于冠状窦。

HP:0011645.name: Dilatation of the sinus of Valsalva
HP:0011645.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation of one of the anatomic dilations of the ascending aorta, which occurs just above the aortic valve.
HP:0011645.definition_cn: 升主动脉解剖性扩张部位之一的异常外凸或囊状扩张，位于主动脉瓣正上方。

HP:0011646.name: Juxtaductal coarctation of the aorta
HP:0011646.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized at the insertion of the ductus arteriosus, i.e., to the juxtaductal region of aortic arch.
HP:0011646.definition_cn: 主动脉缩窄，位于动脉导管插入处，即主动脉弓的导管旁区域。

HP:0011647.name: Postductal coarctation of the aorta
HP:0011647.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized distal to the ductus arteriosus, i.e., to the postductal region of aortic arch.
HP:0011647.definition_cn: 主动脉缩窄，位于动脉导管远端，即主动脉弓的导管后区域。

HP:0011648.name: Patent ductus arteriosus after birth at term
HP:0011648.definition: Abnormal persistent patency of the ductus arteriosus in postnatal life when birth was at 37 completed weeks of gestation or greater.
HP:0011648.name_cn: 足月出生后动脉导管未闭
HP:0011648.definition_cn: 出生后动脉导管在妊娠满37周或以上时异常持续未闭。

HP:0011649.name: Patent ductus arteriosus after premature birth
HP:0011649.definition: Abnormal persistent patency of the ductus arteriosus when birth was at less than 37 weeks completed gestation.
HP:0011649.definition_cn: 出生时妊娠不足37周，动脉导管未闭异常持续存在。

HP:0011650.name: Bilateral ductus arteriosus
HP:0011650.definition: The presence of both a left and a right ductus arteriosus.

HP:0011651.name: Double outlet right ventricle with doubly committed ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011651.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a subaortic ventricular septal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that extends anterosuperiorly and are closely related to the pulmonary artery as well, are considered to be doubly committed. There is associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011651.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴双动脉下型室间隔缺损及肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011651.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴主动脉下室间隔缺损（位于心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞），该缺损向前上方延伸并与肺动脉密切相关，被认为是双动脉下型。同时存在肺动脉狭窄，即肺动脉主干和/或左、右肺动脉分支的异常狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0011652.name: Double outlet right ventricle with doubly committed ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011652.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a subaortic ventritricular septal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that extends anterosuperiorly and are closely related to the pulmonary artery as well, are considered to be doubly committed. There is not associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011652.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴双动脉下型室间隔缺损，无肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011652.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴主动脉下室间隔缺损（位于心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞），该缺损向前上方延伸，并与肺动脉密切相关，被认为是双重连接。在主肺动脉和/或左、右肺动脉分支中，未伴有肺动脉狭窄，即肺动脉的异常狭窄或收缩。

HP:0011653.name: Double outlet right ventricle with non-committed ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011653.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a non-committed ventricular septal defect (VSD), which is a VSD that is anatomically related to, or close to, neither great vessel, being separated from both by considerable muscle, and also has a pulmonary stenosis; abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011653.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴非对位型室间隔缺损及肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011653.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴非对位性室间隔缺损（VSD），即室间隔缺损在解剖学上与大血管无直接关联或距离较远，两者之间被大量肌性组织分隔，同时合并肺动脉狭窄；肺动脉主干和/或左、右肺动脉分支的异常狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0011654.name: Double outlet right ventricle with non-committed ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
