HP:0011654.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a non-committed ventricular septal defect (VSD), which is a VSD that is anatomically related to, or close to, neither great vessel, being separated from both by considerable muscle, but there is not accompanying pulmonary stenosis; the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011654.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴非对位型室间隔缺损，无肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011654.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴非对位性室间隔缺损（VSD），该VSD在解剖学上与两大血管均无直接关联或邻近，且被大量肌组织分隔，但未伴有肺动脉狭窄；即肺动脉主干和/或左、右肺动脉分支的异常狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0011655.name: Double outlet right ventricle with subaortic ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011655.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the aortic origin. There is associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011655.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴主动脉下室间隔缺损及肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011655.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴室间隔缺损（位于心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞），被认为与主动脉起源密切相关。存在肺动脉狭窄，即肺动脉主干和/或左、右肺动脉分支的异常狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0011656.name: Double outlet right ventricle with subaortic ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011656.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the aortic origin. There is not associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011656.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴主动脉下室间隔缺损，无肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011656.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴室间隔缺损（位于心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞），被认为与主动脉起源密切相关。主肺动脉和/或左、右肺动脉分支中未合并肺动脉狭窄，即肺动脉的异常狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0011657.name: Double outlet right ventricle with subpulmonary ventricular septal defect and pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011657.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the pulmonary origin. There is associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011657.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴肺动脉下室间隔缺损及肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011657.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴室间隔缺损（位于心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞），被认为与肺动脉起源密切相关。存在肺动脉狭窄，即肺动脉主干和/或左、右肺动脉分支的异常狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0011658.name: Double outlet right ventricle with subpulmonary ventricular septal defect without pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011658.definition: A double outlet right ventricle with a ventricular spetal defect (a hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart), that is considered to be closely related to the pulmonary origin. There is not associated pulmonary stenosis, the abnormal narrowing or constriction of the pulmonary artery, in the main pulmonary artery and/or in the left or right pulmonary artery branches.
HP:0011658.name_cn: 右心室双出口伴肺动脉下室间隔缺损，无肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011658.definition_cn: 右心室双出口伴室间隔缺损（位于心脏两个下腔室（心室）之间的孔洞），被认为与肺动脉起源密切相关。主肺动脉和/或左、右肺动脉分支中未合并肺动脉狭窄，即肺动脉的异常狭窄或收缩。

HP:0011659.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent pulmonary valve
HP:0011659.definition: Features of tetralogy of Fallot with either rudimentary ridges or the complete absence of pulmonic valve tissue.
HP:0011659.name_cn: 法洛四联症伴肺动脉瓣缺如
HP:0011659.definition_cn: 法洛四联症伴肺动脉瓣组织发育不全或完全缺失的特征。

HP:0011660.name: Anomalous origin of one pulmonary artery from ascending aorta
HP:0011660.definition: Anomalous origin of one pulmonary artery from the ascending aorta with the contralateral pulmonary artery arising from the right ventricle.
HP:0011660.name_cn: 升主动脉起源异常的一侧肺动脉
HP:0011660.definition_cn: 一侧肺动脉异常起源于升主动脉，对侧肺动脉起源于右心室。

HP:0011661.name: Anomalous origin of left pulmonary artery from ascending aorta
HP:0011661.definition: The left pulmonary artery originates from the ascending aorta in the presence of a pulmonary valve and main pulmonary artery.
HP:0011661.name_cn: 左肺动脉起源于升主动脉异常
HP:0011661.definition_cn: 左肺动脉起源于升主动脉，同时存在肺动脉瓣和主肺动脉。

HP:0011662.name: Tricuspid atresia
HP:0011662.definition: Failure to develop of the tricuspid valve and thus lack of the normal connection between the right atrium and the right ventricle.
HP:0011662.definition_cn: 三尖瓣发育不全，导致右心房与右心室之间缺乏正常连接。

HP:0011663.name: Right ventricular cardiomyopathy
HP:0011663.definition: Right ventricular dysfunction (global or regional) with functional and morphological right ventricular abnormalities, with or without left ventricular disease.
HP:0011663.definition_cn: 右心室功能障碍（整体性或区域性）伴功能性及形态学右心室异常，伴或不伴左心室病变。

HP:0011664.name: Left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
HP:0011664.definition: Left ventricular non-compaction (LVNC) is characterized by prominent left ventricular trabeculae and deep inter-trabecular recesses. The myocardial wall is often thickened with a thin, compacted epicardial layer and a thickened endocardial layer. In some patients, LVNC is associated with left ventricular dilatation and systolic dysfunction, which can be transient in neonates.
HP:0011664.name_cn: 左心室致密化不全性心肌病
HP:0011664.definition_cn: 左心室致密化不全（Left Ventricular Non-compaction, LVNC）的特征为显著的左心室小梁和深陷的小梁间隐窝。心肌壁常增厚，伴有薄而致密的心外膜层和增厚的心内膜层。在某些患者中，LVNC与左心室扩张和收缩功能障碍相关，这在新生儿中可能是暂时性的。

HP:0011665.name: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy
HP:0011665.definition: Transient left ventricular apical ballooning syndrome or takotsubo cardiomyopathy is characterized by transient regional systolic dysfunction involving the left ventricular apex and/or mid-ventricle in the absence of obstructive coronary disease on coronary angiography. Patients present with an abrupt onset of angina-like chest pain, and have diffuse T-wave inversion, sometimes preceded by ST-segment elevation, and mild cardiac enzyme elevation.
HP:0011665.definition_cn: 短暂性左心室心尖球囊综合征或Takotsubo心肌病的特点是在冠状动脉造影中未见阻塞性冠状动脉疾病的情况下，出现涉及左心室心尖和/或心室中部的短暂性区域性收缩功能障碍。患者表现为突发性心绞痛样胸痛，并伴有弥漫性T波倒置，有时先于ST段抬高，以及轻度心肌酶升高。

HP:0011666.name: Absent right superior vena cava
HP:0011666.definition: Absence of the right superior vena cava (RSVC). An absent RSVC is always associated with a persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC). During normal fetal development, the left-sided anterior venous cardinal system regresses, leaving the coronary sinus (CS) and the ligament of Marshall. Failure of the closure of the left anterior cardinal vein results in PLSVC. In general, PLSVC is associated with the right superior vena cava (RSVC) and drains into the RA via a dilated CS. When developmental arrest occurs at an earlier stage, the CS is absent and the PLSVC drains into the left atrium.
HP:0011666.definition_cn: 右位上腔静脉（RSVC）缺如。右位上腔静脉缺如通常与永存左上腔静脉（PLSVC）并存。在正常胎儿发育过程中，左侧前主静脉系统退化，留下冠状窦（CS）和马歇尔韧带。左前主静脉未能闭合导致永存左上腔静脉。一般而言，永存左上腔静脉与右位上腔静脉并存，并通过扩张的冠状窦引流至右心房（RA）。若发育停滞发生在更早阶段，则冠状窦缺如，永存左上腔静脉直接引流至左心房（LA）。

HP:0011667.name: Bilateral superior vena cava with bridging vein
HP:0011667.name_cn: 双侧上腔静脉伴桥接静脉

HP:0011668.name: Bilateral superior vena cava with no bridging vein
HP:0011668.name_cn: 双侧上腔静脉无桥接静脉

HP:0011669.name: Left superior vena cava draining directly to the left atrium
HP:0011669.definition: A persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC) that drains into the left atrium instead of the right atrium via the coronary sinus, resulting in a right to left sided shunt.
HP:0011669.name_cn: 左上腔静脉直接引流至左心房
HP:0011669.definition_cn: 持续性左上腔静脉（PLSVC）直接引流至左心房而非通过冠状窦进入右心房，导致右向左分流。

HP:0011670.name: Left superior vena cava draining to coronary sinus
HP:0011670.definition: A persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC) that drains into the right atrium via the coronary sinus. This is the case in 80-92% of cases of PLSVC and results in no hemodynamic consequence.
HP:0011670.name_cn: 左上腔静脉引流至冠状窦
HP:0011670.definition_cn: 持续性左上腔静脉（PLSVC）通过冠状窦引流至右心房。这种情况占PLSVC病例的80-92%，且不会导致血流动力学异常。

HP:0011671.name: Interrupted inferior vena cava with azygous continuation
HP:0011671.definition: Interrupted inferior vena cava with azygous continuation is the result of connection failure between the right subcardinal vein and the right vitelline vein. Consequently, venous blood from the caudal part of the body reaches the heart via the azygous vein and superior vena cava.
HP:0011671.name_cn: 下腔静脉中断伴奇静脉延续
HP:0011671.definition_cn: 下腔静脉中断伴奇静脉延续是右心下静脉与右卵黄静脉之间连接失败的结果。因此，来自身体尾部的静脉血通过奇静脉和上腔静脉回流至心脏。

HP:0011672.name: Cardiac myxoma
HP:0011672.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) of the heart. Cardiac myxomas consist of stellate to plump, cytologically bland mesenchymal cells set in a myxoid stroma. Cardiac myxomas are of endocardial origin and general project from the endocardium into a cardiac chamber.
HP:0011672.definition_cn: 心脏粘液瘤（原始结缔组织肿瘤）。心脏粘液瘤由星形至丰满、细胞学上温和的间充质细胞组成，这些细胞位于粘液样基质中。心脏粘液瘤起源于心内膜，通常从心内膜向心腔内突出。

HP:0011673.name: Cardiac hemangioma
HP:0011673.definition: Abnormal proliferation of blood vessels within the cardiac cavities attached to the endocardium.
HP:0011673.definition_cn: 心腔内附着于心内膜的血管异常增殖。

HP:0011674.name: Cardiac teratoma
HP:0011674.definition: A teratoma within the heart. Most commonly, these tumors are detected in the pericardial cavity attached to the pulmonary artery and aorta. The tumor size within the heart varies from 2 to 9 cm in diameter, and intrapericardial tumors as large as 15 cm have been reported. Intracardiac tumors arise from the atrial or ventricular wall as nodular masses protruding into the cardiac chambers. Cardiac and pericardial teratomas are easily detected in the fetus and neonate by two-dimensional echocardiography as heterogeneous and encapsulated cystic masses. Histologically, cardiac teratomas contain multiple immature elements including epithelium, neuroglial tissue, thyroid, pancreas, smooth and skeletal muscle, cartilage and bone.
HP:0011674.definition_cn: 心脏内的畸胎瘤。这些肿瘤最常见于心包腔内，附着于肺动脉和主动脉。心脏内肿瘤的直径大小从2厘米到9厘米不等，据报道心包内肿瘤可达到15厘米。心内肿瘤起源于心房或心室壁，呈结节状肿块突入心腔。心脏和心包畸胎瘤在胎儿和新生儿中通过二维超声心动图容易检测到，表现为异质性和有包膜的囊性肿块。组织学上，心脏畸胎瘤包含多种未成熟成分，包括上皮组织、神经胶质组织、甲状腺、胰腺、平滑肌和骨骼肌、软骨和骨。

HP:0011675.name: Arrhythmia
HP:0011675.definition: Any cardiac rhythm other than the normal sinus rhythm. Such a rhythm may be either of sinus or ectopic origin and either regular or irregular. An arrhythmia may be due to a disturbance in impulse formation or conduction or both.
HP:0011675.definition_cn: 任何非正常窦性心律的心律。此类心律可能源于窦性或异位，且可为规律或不规律。心律失常可能由冲动形成或传导障碍或两者共同引起。

HP:0011676.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with absent subarterial conus
HP:0011676.name_cn: 法洛四联症伴动脉干下圆锥缺如

HP:0011677.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with atrioventricular canal defect
HP:0011677.name_cn: 法洛四联症合并房室通道缺损

HP:0011678.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia and major aortopulmonary collateral arteries
HP:0011678.definition: A type of tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia in which all pulmonary blood flow is derived from major aortopulmonary collateral arteries (MAPCA).
HP:0011678.name_cn: 法洛四联症伴肺动脉闭锁及主要体肺侧支动脉
HP:0011678.definition_cn: 一种法洛四联症伴肺动脉闭锁的类型，其中所有肺血流均来自主-肺动脉侧支动脉（MAPCA）。

HP:0011679.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary stenosis
HP:0011679.definition: The commonest form of tetralogy of Fallot characterized by pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, ventricular septum defect, and right ventricular hypertrophy, without pulmonary atresia, absent pulmonary valve, atrioventricular canal defect or absent subarterial conus.
HP:0011679.name_cn: 法洛四联症伴肺动脉狭窄
HP:0011679.definition_cn: 最常见的法洛四联症类型，其特征为肺动脉狭窄、主动脉骑跨、室间隔缺损和右心室肥厚，不伴有肺动脉闭锁、肺动脉瓣缺如、房室通道缺损或动脉下圆锥缺如。

HP:0011681.name: Subarterial ventricular septal defect
HP:0011681.definition: A ventricular septal defect that lies beneath the semilunar valve(s) in the conal or outlet septum.
HP:0011681.definition_cn: 位于圆锥间隔或流出道间隔、半月瓣下方的室间隔缺损。

HP:0011682.name: Perimembranous ventricular septal defect
HP:0011682.definition: A ventricular septal defect that is confluent with and involves the membranous septum and is bordered by an atrioventricular valve, not including the type 3 VSDs.
HP:0011682.definition_cn: 与膜部间隔相连并累及膜部间隔、由房室瓣边界限定、不包括III型室间隔缺损的室间隔缺损。

HP:0011683.name: Restrictive ventricular septal defect
HP:0011683.definition: Any ventricular septal defect (VSD) that is small enough to restrict flow across it such that a pressure gradient exists between the two sides of the VSD.
HP:0011683.definition_cn: 任何室间隔缺损（VSD）若其尺寸足够小，以至于限制了通过缺损的血流，从而在VSD两侧形成压力梯度。

HP:0011684.name: Non-restrictive ventricular septal defect
HP:0011684.definition: Any ventricular septal defect (VSD) that does not restrict flow across it sufficiently to generate a pressure gradient between the two sides of the VSD.
HP:0011684.definition_cn: 任何未限制血流通过其两侧以在室间隔缺损（VSD）两侧产生压力梯度的室间隔缺损（VSD）。

HP:0011685.name: Infra-aortic superior vena cava
HP:0011685.definition: The superior vena cava passes below the aortic arch.
HP:0011685.definition_cn: 上腔静脉行经主动脉弓下方。

HP:0011686.name: Abnormal coronary artery course
HP:0011686.definition: An abnormal path of a coronary artery.

HP:0011687.name: AV nodal tachycardia
HP:0011687.definition: A type of supraventricular tachycardia that originates in the atrioventricular node.
HP:0011687.definition_cn: 一种起源于房室结的室上性心动过速。

HP:0011688.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connection mediated pathway
HP:0011688.definition: Supraventricular tachycardia in which an accessory pathway connecting the atria and ventricles, apart from the AV node, participates as a necessary part of a reentrant mechanism.
HP:0011688.name_cn: 房室折返性心动过速伴旁路传导通路
HP:0011688.definition_cn: 房室折返性心动过速，其中连接心房和心室的旁路（除房室结外）作为折返机制的必要部分参与其中。

HP:0011689.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory connection
HP:0011689.definition: Supraventricular tachycardia with an accessory connection mediated pathway that is called concealed because it is not seen on the ECG during sinus rhythm.
HP:0011689.name_cn: 隐匿性旁路传导的室上性心动过速
HP:0011689.definition_cn: 隐匿性旁路介导的室上性心动过速，因其在窦性心律时心电图不可见而得名。

HP:0011690.name: Permanent junctional reciprocating tachycardia
HP:0011690.definition: An incessant orthodromic tachycardia with anterograde conduction over the atrioventricular node and by retrograde conduction via an accessory pathway usually located in the posteroseptal region with slow and decremental conduction.
HP:0011690.name_cn: 永久性交界性反复性心动过速
HP:0011690.definition_cn: 一种持续的正向性心动过速，通过房室结进行前向传导，并通过通常位于后间隔区域的旁路进行逆向传导，该旁路具有缓慢和递减传导特性。

HP:0011691.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the left free wall
HP:0011691.name_cn: 左侧游离壁隐匿性旁路所致的室上性心动过速

HP:0011692.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the right free wall
HP:0011692.name_cn: 右侧游离壁隐匿性旁路所致的室上性心动过速

HP:0011693.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a concealed accessory pathway on the septum
HP:0011693.name_cn: 室上性心动过速伴间隔隐匿性旁路

HP:0011694.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway
HP:0011694.name_cn: 显性旁路所致的室上性心动过速

HP:0011695.name: Cerebellar hemorrhage
HP:0011695.definition: Hemorrhage into the parenchyma of the cerebellum.

HP:0011696.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the left free wall
HP:0011696.name_cn: 左侧游离壁显性旁路所致的室上性心动过速

HP:0011697.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the right free wall
HP:0011697.name_cn: 右侧游离壁显性旁路所致的室上性心动过速

HP:0011698.name: Supraventricular tachycardia with a manifest accessory pathway on the septum
HP:0011698.name_cn: 室上性心动过速伴间隔显性旁路

HP:0011700.name: Automatic atrial tachycardia
HP:0011700.definition: Chronic supraventricular tachycardia predominantly seen in childhood.
HP:0011700.definition_cn: 慢性室上性心动过速，主要见于儿童期。

HP:0011701.name: Multifocal atrial tachycardia
HP:0011701.definition: Multifocal atrial tachycardia is a rare supraventricular arrhythmia in neonates and young infants that is characterized by multiple P waves with varying P wave morphology and is usually asymptomatic.
HP:0011701.definition_cn: 多灶性房性心动过速是一种罕见的新生儿和婴幼儿室上性心律失常，其特征为多个P波且P波形态多变，通常无症状。

HP:0011702.name: Abnormal electrophysiology of sinoatrial node origin
HP:0011702.definition: An abnormality of the sinoatrial (SA) node in the right atrium. THe SA node acts as the pacemaker of the heart.
HP:0011702.name_cn: 窦房结起源的电生理异常
HP:0011702.definition_cn: 右心房窦房结（SA node）异常。窦房结作为心脏的起搏器。

HP:0011703.name: Sinus tachycardia
HP:0011703.definition: Heart rate of greater than 100 beats per minute.

HP:0011704.name: Sick sinus syndrome
HP:0011704.definition: An abnormality involving the generation of the action potential by the sinus node and is characterized by an atrial rate inappropriate for physiological requirements. Manifestations include severe sinus bradycardia, sinus pauses or arrest, sinus node exit block, chronic atrial tachyarrhythmias, alternating periods of atrial bradyarrhythmias and tachyarrhythmias, and inappropriate responses of heart rate during exercise or stress.
HP:0011704.definition_cn: 窦房结动作电位生成异常，其特征为心房率不符合生理需求。临床表现包括严重窦性心动过缓、窦性停搏或窦性静止、窦房结传出阻滞、慢性房性快速性心律失常、房性缓慢性心律失常与快速性心律失常交替出现，以及运动或应激时心率反应不当。

HP:0011705.name: First degree atrioventricular block
HP:0011705.definition: Delay of conduction through the atrioventricular node, which is manifested as prolongation of the PR interval in the electrocardiogram (EKG). All atrial impulses reach the ventricles.
HP:0011705.definition_cn: 房室传导延迟，表现为心电图（EKG）中PR间期延长。所有心房冲动均能传导至心室。

HP:0011706.name: Second degree atrioventricular block
HP:0011706.definition: An intermittent atrioventricular block with failure of some atrial impulses to conduct to the ventricles, i.e., some but not all atrial impulses are conducted through the atrioventricular node and trigger ventricular contraction.
HP:0011706.definition_cn: 间歇性房室传导阻滞伴部分心房冲动未能传导至心室，即部分而非全部心房冲动通过房室结并触发心室收缩。

HP:0011707.name: Mobitz I atrioventricular block
HP:0011707.definition: Progressive PR interval prolongation with the subsequent occurrence of a single nonconducted P wave that results in a pause. The pause that follows the nonconducted impulse is less than fully compensatory (less than the sum of two normal sinus intervals).
HP:0011707.definition_cn: 进行性PR间期延长，随后出现单个未传导的P波，导致停顿。未传导冲动后的停顿小于完全代偿性（小于两个正常窦性间期的总和）。

HP:0011708.name: Mobitz II atrioventricular block
HP:0011708.definition: A type of second degree atrioventricular (AV) block characterized by sudden failure to conduct an impulse through the AV node without a preceding change in the PR interval.
HP:0011708.definition_cn: 一种二度房室传导阻滞（Second Degree Atrioventricular Block），其特征为房室结（AV Node）突然未能传导冲动，且此前PR间期（PR Interval）无任何变化。

HP:0011709.name: Atrioventricular dissociation
HP:0011709.definition: Atrioventricular (AV) dissociation is present if the atria and the ventricles are under the control of two separate pacemakers. AV dissociation can occur in the absence of a primary AV conduction disturbance.
HP:0011709.definition_cn: 房室分离（Atrioventricular dissociation）是指心房和心室分别由两个独立的起搏点控制。房室分离可在无原发性房室传导障碍的情况下发生。

HP:0011710.name: Bundle branch block
HP:0011710.definition: Block of conduction of electrical impulses along the Bundle of His or along one of its bundle branches.
HP:0011710.definition_cn: 希氏束或其某一束支的传导阻滞。

HP:0011711.name: Left anterior fascicular block
HP:0011711.definition: Conduction block in the anterior division of the left bundle branch of the bundle of His.
HP:0011711.definition_cn: 希氏束左前分支传导阻滞。

HP:0011712.name: Right bundle branch block
HP:0011712.definition: A conduction block of the right branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a prolongation of the QRS complex (greater than 0.12 s) with delayed activation of the right ventricle and terminal delay on the EKG.
HP:0011712.definition_cn: 右束支传导阻滞。表现为QRS波群延长（大于0.12秒），伴有右心室激活延迟及心电图终末延迟。

HP:0011713.name: Left bundle branch block
HP:0011713.definition: A conduction block of the left branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a generalized disturbance of QRS morphology on EKG.
HP:0011713.definition_cn: 左束支传导阻滞。在心电图上表现为QRS波群形态的广泛异常。

HP:0011714.name: Libman-Sacks lesions
HP:0011714.definition: Libman-Sacks valvular lesions are sterile fibrofibrinous vegetations that favor the left-sided heart valves and usually form on the ventricular surface of the mitral valve.
HP:0011714.definition_cn: 利伯曼-萨克斯瓣膜病变是无菌性纤维纤维素性赘生物，好发于左侧心脏瓣膜，通常形成于二尖瓣的心室面。

HP:0011715.name: Trifascicular block
HP:0011715.definition: Abnormal conduction in all three divisions of the intraventricular conducting tissue.
HP:0011715.definition_cn: 心室内传导组织三分支传导异常。

HP:0011716.name: Junctional ectopic tachycardia
HP:0011716.definition: Junctional ectopic tachycardia (JET) is a unique type of supraventricular arrhythmia defined by narrow QRS complex and atrioventricular (AV) dissociation or retrograde atrial conduction in a 1:1 pattern.
HP:0011716.name_cn: 交界性异位性心动过速
HP:0011716.definition_cn: 交界性异位性心动过速（Junctional Ectopic Tachycardia, JET）是一种独特类型的室上性心律失常，其特征为窄QRS波群以及房室（Atrioventricular, AV）分离或1:1模式的逆向心房传导。

HP:0011717.name: Atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
HP:0011717.definition: Accessory pathway-related atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia (AVRT) involves an abnormal electrical conduction of the accessory pathway. The accessory pathway connecting impulses between the atrium and the ventricle can be seen at any site in the AV groove.
HP:0011717.definition_cn: 旁路相关的房室折返性心动过速（AVRT）涉及旁路的异常电传导。连接心房和心室之间的旁路冲动可在房室沟的任何部位观察到。

HP:0011718.name: Abnormality of the pulmonary veins
HP:0011718.definition: An abnormality of the pulmonary veins.

HP:0011719.name: Supracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
HP:0011719.definition: Type 1 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection.
HP:0011719.name_cn: 心上型完全性肺静脉异位连接

HP:0011720.name: Cardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
HP:0011720.definition: Type 2 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection.
HP:0011720.name_cn: 完全性肺静脉异位连接

HP:0011721.name: Infracardiac total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
HP:0011721.definition: Type 3 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection.
HP:0011721.name_cn: 心下型完全性肺静脉异位连接
HP:0011721.definition_cn: 三型完全性肺静脉异位连接。

HP:0011722.name: Mixed total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
HP:0011722.definition: Type 4 total anomalous pulmonary venous connection.
HP:0011722.name_cn: 混合型完全性肺静脉异位连接
HP:0011722.definition_cn: 第四型完全性肺静脉异位连接。

HP:0011723.name: Congenital malformation of the right heart
HP:0011723.definition: Defect or defects of the morphogenesis of the right heart identifiable at birth.
HP:0011723.definition_cn: 出生时可识别的右心形态发生缺陷。

HP:0011724.name: Uhl's anomaly
HP:0011724.definition: Uhl anomaly of the right ventricle refers to the almost complete absence of right ventricular myocardium, normal tricuspid valve, and preserved septal and left ventricular myocardium.
HP:0011724.definition_cn: 右心室Uhl畸形是指右心室心肌几乎完全缺失，三尖瓣正常，室间隔和左心室心肌保留。

HP:0011725.name: Chaotic multifocal atrial tachycardia
HP:0011725.name_cn: 紊乱性多源性房性心动过速

HP:0011726.name: Persistent fetal circulation
HP:0011726.definition: Systemic desaturation of a liveborn baby resulting from persistent pulmonary hypertension with a patent ductus arteriosus and patent foramen ovale, such that the circulation in postnatal life follows the fetal course.
HP:0011726.definition_cn: 活产婴儿因持续性肺动脉高压伴动脉导管未闭和卵圆孔未闭导致的全身性氧饱和度下降，使得出生后循环仍遵循胎儿循环路径。

HP:0011728.name: Elbow clonus
HP:0011728.definition: Clonus at the elbow joint, i.e., an exaggerated phasic stretch reflex characterized by repetitive, rhythmic contractions at the elbow, generated by rapid passive stretch at the elbow joint.
HP:0011728.definition_cn: 肘关节阵挛，即一种夸张的阶段性牵张反射，其特征为肘关节处重复性、节律性收缩，由肘关节快速被动牵张所引发。

HP:0011729.name: Abnormality of joint mobility
HP:0011729.definition: An abnormality in the range and ease of motion of joints across their normal range.
HP:0011729.definition_cn: 关节活动度异常及活动受限。

HP:0011730.name: Abnormal central sensory function
HP:0011730.definition: An abnormality of sensation related to CNS function. Assuming the primary sensory modalities are intact and the patient is alert and cooperative, the presence of an abnormality of sensory function may indicate a lesion of a parietal cortex, the thalamocortical projections to the parietal cortex, or the spinal cord.
HP:0011730.definition_cn: 与中枢神经系统功能相关的感觉异常。假设主要感觉模态完整且患者意识清醒并配合，感觉功能异常的存在可能提示顶叶皮层、丘脑皮层投射至顶叶皮层的通路或脊髓存在病变。

HP:0011731.name: Abnormality of circulating cortisol level
HP:0011731.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of cortisol in the blood.
HP:0011731.definition_cn: 血液中皮质醇浓度异常。

HP:0011732.name: Abnormal adrenal morphology
HP:0011732.definition: Any structural anomaly of the adrenal glands.

HP:0011733.name: Abnormality of adrenal physiology
HP:0011733.definition: A functional abnormality of the adrenal glands.

HP:0011734.name: Central adrenal insufficiency
HP:0011734.definition: A form of adrenal insufficiency related to a lack of ACTH, which leads to a decrease in the production of cortisol by the adrenal glands. Aldosterone production is not usually affected.
HP:0011734.name_cn: 中枢性肾上腺功能不全
HP:0011734.definition_cn: 一种与促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）缺乏相关的肾上腺功能不全，导致肾上腺皮质醇分泌减少。醛固酮的分泌通常不受影响。

HP:0011735.name: Adrenocorticotropin deficient adrenal insufficiency
HP:0011735.definition: Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in ACTH production.
HP:0011735.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素缺乏性肾上腺功能不全
HP:0011735.definition_cn: 继发于促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）生成缺陷的肾上腺功能不全。

HP:0011736.name: Primary hyperaldosteronism
HP:0011736.definition: A form of hyperaldosteronism caused by a defect within the adrenal gland.
HP:0011736.definition_cn: 一种由肾上腺内部缺陷引起的醛固酮增多症。

HP:0011737.name: Corticotropin-releasing hormone deficient adrenal insufficiency
HP:0011737.definition: Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in corticotropin-releasing hormone production.
HP:0011737.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素缺乏性肾上腺功能不全
HP:0011737.definition_cn: 继发于促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素生成缺陷的肾上腺功能不全。

HP:0011738.name: Corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor defect
HP:0011738.definition: Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in the corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor.
HP:0011738.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素受体缺陷
HP:0011738.definition_cn: 继发于促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素受体缺陷的肾上腺功能不全。

HP:0011739.name: Dexamethasone-suppressible primary hyperaldosteronism
HP:0011739.definition: A form of primary hyperaldosteronism in which the overproduction of aldosterone can be suppressed by the administration of dexamethasone.
HP:0011739.name_cn: 地塞米松可抑制性原发性醛固酮增多症
HP:0011739.definition_cn: 一种原发性醛固酮增多症，其醛固酮的过度分泌可通过地塞米松的给药得到抑制。

HP:0011740.name: Glucocortocoid-insensitive primary hyperaldosteronism
HP:0011740.definition: A form of primary hyperaldosteronism in which the overproduction of aldosterone cannot be suppressed by the administration of dexamethasone or similar glucocorticoids.
HP:0011740.name_cn: 糖皮质激素不敏感性原发性醛固酮增多症
HP:0011740.definition_cn: 一种原发性醛固酮增多症，其醛固酮的过度分泌无法通过地塞米松或类似糖皮质激素的给药而抑制。

HP:0011741.name: Secondary hyperaldosteronism
HP:0011741.definition: A form of hyperaldosteronism caused by abnormally increased renin levels.
HP:0011741.definition_cn: 一种由肾素水平异常升高引起的醛固酮增多症。

HP:0011742.name: Ectopic adrenal gland
HP:0011742.definition: Abnormal anatomical location of the adrenal gland.

HP:0011743.name: Adrenal gland agenesis
HP:0011743.definition: Absent development of the adrenal gland.

HP:0011744.name: Secondary hypercortisolism
HP:0011744.definition: Hypercortisolemia associated with a overproduction of ACTH (often from a tumor), leading secondarily to overproduction of cortisol.
HP:0011744.definition_cn: 与促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）过度分泌（通常源于肿瘤）相关的高皮质醇血症，继发性导致皮质醇过度生成。

HP:0011745.name: Non-secretory adrenocortical adenoma
HP:0011745.definition: An hormonally inactive adrenocortical adenoma, that is, an adenoma that does not secrete excessive amounts of adrenal hormones.
HP:0011745.name_cn: 非分泌性肾上腺皮质腺瘤
HP:0011745.definition_cn: 无功能性肾上腺皮质腺瘤，即不分泌过量肾上腺激素的腺瘤。

HP:0011746.name: Secretory adrenocortical adenoma
HP:0011746.definition: An hormonally active adrenocortical adenoma, that is, an adenoma that secretes excessive amounts of adrenal hormones.
HP:0011746.name_cn: 分泌性肾上腺皮质腺瘤
HP:0011746.definition_cn: 一种激素活性肾上腺皮质腺瘤，即分泌过量肾上腺激素的腺瘤。

HP:0011747.name: Abnormality of the anterior pituitary
HP:0011747.definition: An abnormality of the adenohypophysis, which is also known as the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland.
HP:0011747.definition_cn: 腺垂体异常，也称为垂体前叶异常。

HP:0011748.name: Adrenocorticotropic hormone deficiency
HP:0011748.definition: A reduced ability to secrete adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), a hormone that stimulates the adrenal cortex to secrete of glucocorticoids such as cortisol.
HP:0011748.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素缺乏症
HP:0011748.definition_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）分泌能力降低，该激素可刺激肾上腺皮质分泌糖皮质激素，如皮质醇。

HP:0011749.name: Adrenocorticotropic hormone excess
HP:0011749.definition: Overproduction of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), which generally leads secondarily to overproduction of cortisol by the adrenal cortex.
HP:0011749.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素过多症
HP:0011749.definition_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）的过度分泌，通常继发性导致肾上腺皮质过度分泌皮质醇。

HP:0011750.name: Neoplasm of the anterior pituitary
HP:0011750.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the adenohypophysis, which is also known as the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland.
HP:0011750.definition_cn: 腺垂体肿瘤（腺垂体组织异常增生），腺垂体亦称为垂体前叶。

HP:0011751.name: Abnormal posterior pituitary morphogenesis
HP:0011751.definition: An abnormality of the neurohypophysis, which is also known as the posterior lobe of the hypophysis.
HP:0011751.name_cn: 垂体后叶形态发生异常
HP:0011751.definition_cn: 神经垂体异常，也称为垂体后叶异常。

HP:0011752.name: Neoplasm of the posterior pituitary
HP:0011752.definition: The presence of a neoplasm (tumor) in the neurohypophysis, which is also known as the posterior lobe of the hypophysis.
HP:0011752.definition_cn: 神经垂体（即垂体后叶）中存在新生物（肿瘤）。

HP:0011753.name: Posterior pituitary dysgenesis
HP:0011753.definition: Abnormal development of the neurohypophysis during embryonic growth and development.
HP:0011753.definition_cn: 胚胎生长发育过程中神经垂体的异常发育。

HP:0011754.name: Pituicytoma
HP:0011754.definition: A solid, low grade, spindle cell, glial neoplasm of adults that originates in the neurohypophysis or infundibulum. Clinical signs and symptoms include visual disturbance, headache and features of hypopituitarism. Pituicytomas are well-circumscribed, solid masses that can measure up to several centimeters. Histologically, they show a compact architecture consisting of elongate, bipolar spindle cells arranged in interlacing fascicles or assuming a storiform pattern.
HP:0011754.definition_cn: 一种发生于成人的实性、低级别、梭形细胞、胶质源性肿瘤，起源于神经垂体或漏斗部。临床症状和体征包括视觉障碍、头痛以及垂体功能减退的特征。垂体细胞瘤为边界清楚的实性肿块，大小可达数厘米。组织学上，肿瘤呈现致密结构，由细长的双极梭形细胞组成，排列成交织的束状或呈席纹状模式。

HP:0011755.name: Ectopic posterior pituitary
HP:0011755.definition: An abnormal anatomical location of the posterior lobe of the hypophysis, also known as the neurohypophysis. The posterior pituitary is normally present in the dorsal portion of the sella turcica, but when ectopic is usually near the median eminence. This defect is likely to be due to abnormal migration during embryogenesis.
HP:0011755.definition_cn: 垂体后叶（神经垂体）的解剖位置异常。垂体后叶通常位于蝶鞍的背侧部分，但异位时通常靠近正中隆起。这种缺陷可能是由于胚胎发生过程中的异常迁移所致。

HP:0011756.name: Posterior pituitary agenesis
HP:0011756.definition: Absence of the neurohypophysis owing to a developmental defect.
HP:0011756.definition_cn: 神经垂体发育缺陷导致的神经垂体缺失。

HP:0011758.name: Pituitary acidophilic stem cell adenoma
HP:0011758.name_cn: 垂体嗜酸性干细胞腺瘤

HP:0011759.name: Pituitary gonadotropic cell adenoma
HP:0011759.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma that produces gonadotropins.
HP:0011759.name_cn: 垂体促性腺激素细胞腺瘤
HP:0011759.definition_cn: 一种分泌促性腺激素的垂体腺瘤。

HP:0011760.name: Pituitary growth hormone cell adenoma
HP:0011760.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma that produces growth hormone.
HP:0011760.name_cn: 垂体生长激素细胞腺瘤
HP:0011760.definition_cn: 一种分泌生长激素的垂体腺瘤。

HP:0011761.name: Pituitary null cell adenoma
HP:0011761.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma that is of unknown cellular origin and that lacks immunocytochemical or fine structural markers. Null cell adenomas are not associated with hormone excess.
HP:0011761.definition_cn: 一种垂体腺瘤，其细胞来源不明，且缺乏免疫细胞化学或精细结构标志物。无功能细胞腺瘤与激素过量无关。

HP:0011762.name: Pituitary thyrotropic cell adenoma
HP:0011762.definition: A type of pituitary adenoma that produces thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH).
HP:0011762.name_cn: 垂体促甲状腺激素细胞腺瘤
HP:0011762.definition_cn: 一种分泌促甲状腺激素（TSH）的垂体腺瘤。

HP:0011763.name: Pituitary carcinoma
HP:0011763.definition: A pituitary tumor with subarachnoid, brain, or systemic metastasis. The diagnosis of a pituitary carcinoma requires evidence of metastatic disease, either outside the central nervous system (CNS) or as separate noncontiguous foci within the CNS.
HP:0011763.definition_cn: 垂体肿瘤伴蛛网膜下腔、脑或全身转移。垂体癌的诊断需要存在中枢神经系统（CNS）以外的转移性疾病证据，或CNS内非连续性的独立转移灶。

HP:0011764.name: Pituitary spindle cell oncocytoma
HP:0011764.definition: A spindled-to-epithelioid, oncocytic, nonendocrine neoplasm of the anterior hypophysis that manifests in adults and follows a benign clinical course. Pituitary spindle cell oncocytomas are firm, fibrous, and adherent to surrounding structures and are highly vascular.
HP:0011764.name_cn: 垂体梭形细胞嗜酸细胞瘤
HP:0011764.definition_cn: 一种发生于成人、呈梭形至上皮样、嗜酸性、非内分泌性前垂体肿瘤，临床病程良性。垂体梭形细胞嗜酸性瘤质地坚硬、纤维性，与周围结构粘连，且血管丰富。

HP:0011766.name: Abnormal parathyroid morphology
HP:0011766.definition: A structural abnormality of the parathyroid gland.

HP:0011767.name: Abnormality of the parathyroid physiology
HP:0011767.definition: A functional abnormality of the parathyroid gland.
HP:0011767.name_cn: 甲状旁腺生理功能异常

HP:0011768.name: Parathyroid dysgenesis
HP:0011768.definition: Abnormal embryonic development of the parathyroid gland.
HP:0011768.definition_cn: 甲状旁腺胚胎发育异常。

HP:0011769.name: Ectopic parathyroid
HP:0011769.definition: An abnormal anatomical location of the parathyroid gland.
HP:0011769.definition_cn: 甲状旁腺解剖位置异常。

HP:0011770.name: Tertiary hyperparathyroidism
HP:0011770.definition: A type of hyperparathyroidism that occurs following kidney transplantation, which is a treatment for secondary hyperparathyroidism. Although kidney transplantation leads to a normalization of serum calcium and parathyroid hormone in most patients. The state of persistent hypercalcemia and hyperparathyroidism is referred to as tertiary hyperparathyroidism.
HP:0011770.name_cn: 三发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症
HP:0011770.definition_cn: 一种发生于肾移植后的甲状旁腺功能亢进症，该移植术用于治疗继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症。尽管肾移植可使大多数患者的血清钙和甲状旁腺激素水平恢复正常，但持续存在的高钙血症和甲状旁腺功能亢进状态被称为三发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症。

HP:0011771.name: Autoimmune hypoparathyroidism
HP:0011771.definition: A type of hypoparathyroidism with circulating antiparathyroid or anti-calcium sensing receptor antibodies indicative of autoimmunity.
HP:0011771.name_cn: 自身免疫性甲状旁腺功能减退症
HP:0011771.definition_cn: 一种伴有循环抗甲状旁腺或抗钙敏感受体抗体的甲状旁腺功能减退症，提示自身免疫性。

HP:0011772.name: Abnormal thyroid morphology
HP:0011772.definition: A structural abnormality of the thyroid gland.

HP:0011773.name: Uninodular goiter
HP:0011773.definition: Enlargement of the thyroid gland related to a singular nodule in the thyroid gland.
HP:0011773.definition_cn: 甲状腺单发结节相关性甲状腺肿大。

HP:0011776.name: Thyroid microfollicular adenoma
HP:0011776.name_cn: 甲状腺微小滤泡性腺瘤

HP:0011780.name: Thyroid hemiagenesis
HP:0011780.definition: Absence of a lobe of the thyroid gland related to a failure of its embryologic development.
HP:0011780.definition_cn: 甲状腺叶缺失与胚胎发育障碍相关。

HP:0011781.name: Thyroid C cell hyperplasia
HP:0011781.definition: An abnormal growth of parafollicular (C-cells) cells.
HP:0011781.definition_cn: 滤泡旁细胞（C细胞）的异常增生。

HP:0011783.name: Thyrotoxicosis from ectopic thyroid tissue
HP:0011783.name_cn: 异位甲状腺组织引起的甲状腺毒症

HP:0011784.name: Thyrotoxicosis with diffuse goiter
HP:0011784.name_cn: 弥漫性甲状腺肿伴甲状腺毒症

HP:0011785.name: Thyrotoxicosis with toxic multinodular goiter
HP:0011785.name_cn: 甲状腺毒症伴毒性多结节性甲状腺肿

HP:0011786.name: Thyrotoxicosis with toxic single thyroid nodule
HP:0011786.name_cn: 毒性单发甲状腺结节伴甲状腺毒症

HP:0011787.name: Central hypothyroidism
HP:0011787.definition: A type of hypothyroidism due to an insufficient stimulation of an otherwise normal thyroid gland. Central hypothyroidism is caused by either pituitary (secondary hypothyroidism) or hypothalamic (tertiary hypothyroidism) defects.
HP:0011787.name_cn: 中枢性甲状腺功能减退症
HP:0011787.definition_cn: 一种由于对正常甲状腺的刺激不足而导致的甲状腺功能减退症。中枢性甲状腺功能减退症由垂体（继发性甲状腺功能减退症）或下丘脑（三级甲状腺功能减退症）缺陷引起。

HP:0011788.name: Increased circulating free T3
HP:0011788.definition: An elevated concentration of free 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine in the blood circulation.
HP:0011788.name_cn: 循环游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸（Free T3）水平升高
HP:0011788.definition_cn: 血液循环中游离3,3',5-三碘-L-甲状腺素浓度升高。

HP:0011789.name: Impaired sensitivity to thyroid stimulating hormone
HP:0011789.definition: Reduced sensitivity of thyroid follicle cells to stimulation by biologically active thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH).
HP:0011789.name_cn: 甲状腺刺激激素敏感性受损
HP:0011789.definition_cn: 甲状腺滤泡细胞对生物活性甲状腺刺激激素（TSH）的刺激敏感性降低。

HP:0011790.name: Activating thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor defect
HP:0011790.name_cn: 激活型促甲状腺激素受体缺陷
HP:0011790.definition_cn: 功能获得性促甲状腺激素受体（TSHR）缺陷。

HP:0011791.name: Inactivating thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor defect
HP:0011791.name_cn: 甲状腺刺激激素受体失活性缺陷
HP:0011791.definition_cn: 甲状腺刺激激素受体（TSHR）功能丧失性缺陷。

HP:0011792.name: Neoplasm by histology
HP:0011792.definition: Neoplasm categorized according to type of histological abnormality.
HP:0011792.definition_cn: 根据组织学异常类型分类的肿瘤。

HP:0011793.name: Neoplasm by anatomical site
HP:0011793.definition: Neoplasm categorized according to the anatomical site of origin of the neoplasm.
HP:0011793.name_cn: 按解剖部位分类的肿瘤
HP:0011793.definition_cn: 根据肿瘤起源的解剖部位对肿瘤进行分类。

HP:0011794.name: Embryonal renal neoplasm
HP:0011794.definition: The presence of an embryonal neoplasm of the kidney that primarily affects children.
HP:0011794.definition_cn: 肾胚胎性肿瘤的存在，主要影响儿童。

HP:0011795.name: Intralobar nephroblastomatosis
HP:0011795.definition: Presence of persistent islands of renal blastema in the postnatal kidney, anywhere within a renal lobe (a portion of a kidney consisting of a renal pyramid and the renal cortex above it).
HP:0011795.definition_cn: 在出生后肾脏中，肾叶（由肾锥体及其上方的肾皮质组成的肾脏部分）内任何部位存在持续存在的肾胚基岛。

HP:0011796.name: Perilobar nephroblastomatosis
HP:0011796.definition: Abnormally persistent foci of embryonal immature blastema located in the superficial cortical region (perilobar).
HP:0011796.name_cn: 小叶周围肾母细胞瘤病
HP:0011796.definition_cn: 位于浅表皮质区（叶周）的胚胎性未成熟胚基异常持续病灶。

HP:0011797.name: Papillary renal cell carcinoma type 1
HP:0011797.definition: A type of papillary renal cell carcinoma that is characterized by small cuboidal cells covering thin papillae with a single line of uniform nuclei and small nucleoli.
HP:0011797.definition_cn: 一种乳头状肾细胞癌，其特征为小立方细胞覆盖薄乳头，具有单层均匀核和小核仁。

HP:0011798.name: Renal oncocytoma
HP:0011798.definition: A renal tumor originating from an oncocyte, which is an epithelial cell characterized by an excessive amount of mitochondria, resulting in an abundant acidophilic, granular cytoplasm.
HP:0011798.definition_cn: 一种起源于嗜酸细胞（一种以线粒体过度增生为特征的上皮细胞，导致胞质富含嗜酸性颗粒）的肾肿瘤。

HP:0011800.name: Midface retrusion
HP:0011800.definition: Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle.
HP:0011800.definition_cn: 眶下区和鼻翼旁区后位和/或垂直缩短，或面部凹陷增加和/或鼻唇角减小。

HP:0011801.name: Enlargement of parotid gland
HP:0011801.definition: Increased size of the parotid gland.

HP:0011802.name: Hamartoma of tongue
HP:0011802.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the tongue.
HP:0011802.definition_cn: 舌部良性（非癌性）肿瘤样畸形，由异常混合的细胞和组织构成，起源于舌部。

HP:0011803.name: Bifid nose
HP:0011803.definition: Visually assessable vertical indentation, cleft, or depression of the nasal bridge, ridge and tip.
HP:0011803.definition_cn: 鼻梁、鼻嵴及鼻尖处可见的垂直凹陷、裂隙或沟槽。

HP:0011804.name: Abnormal muscle physiology
HP:0011804.definition: A functional abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

HP:0011805.name: Abnormal skeletal muscle morphology
HP:0011805.definition: A structural abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

HP:0011807.name: Type 1 muscle fiber atrophy
HP:0011807.definition: Atrophy (wasting) affecting primary type 1 muscle fibers. This feature in general can only be observed on muscle biopsy.
HP:0011807.definition_cn: 原发性1型肌纤维萎缩（消耗）。此特征通常仅能在肌肉活检中观察到。

HP:0011808.name: Decreased patellar reflex
HP:0011808.definition: Decreased intensity of the patellar reflex (also known as the knee jerk reflex).
HP:0011808.definition_cn: 髌腱反射（亦称膝跳反射）强度减弱。

HP:0011809.name: Paradoxical myotonia
HP:0011809.definition: A type of myotonia that worsens with repeated muscle contractions.
HP:0011809.definition_cn: 一种肌强直类型，其症状随重复肌肉收缩而加重。

HP:0011810.name: Impaired two-point discrimination
HP:0011810.definition: A reduced ability to distinguish tactile sensations at points that are very close to one another. This can be tested by using special calipers whose points can be set from 2mm to several centimeters apart.
HP:0011810.definition_cn: 两点辨别觉减退。可通过使用特殊卡尺进行测试，其尖端间距可调节为2毫米至数厘米不等。

HP:0011811.name: Impaired touch localization
HP:0011811.definition: A reduced ability to identify precisely the site of a touch. This test is usually carried out by asking a patient, whose eyes are closed or covered, to touch the same site with a fingertip.
HP:0011811.definition_cn: 触觉定位能力减退。该测试通常通过要求患者闭眼或遮眼后，用指尖触摸同一部位来进行。

HP:0011812.name: Agraphesthesia
HP:0011812.definition: Impaired ability to recognize letters or numbers drawn by an examiner's fingertip on the patient's skin (the patients eyes are closed or covered throughout this examination).

HP:0011813.name: Increased cerebral lipofuscin
HP:0011813.definition: Lipofuscin (age pigment) is a brown-yellow, electron-dense, autofluorescent material that accumulates progressively over time in lysosomes of postmitotic cells, such as neurons and cardiac myocytes. This term pertains if there is an increase in the accumulation of lipofuscin (also known as autofluorescent lipoprotein) more than expected for the age of the patient.
HP:0011813.definition_cn: 脂褐素（老年色素）是一种棕黄色、电子致密、自发荧光的物质，随着时间的推移在有丝分裂后细胞（如神经元和心肌细胞）的溶酶体中逐渐积累。该术语适用于脂褐素（也称为自发荧光脂蛋白）的积累量超过患者年龄预期水平的情况。

HP:0011814.name: Increased urinary hypoxanthine level
HP:0011814.definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0011814.name_cn: 尿液中次黄嘌呤水平升高
HP:0011814.definition_cn: 尿液中次黄嘌呤浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0011815.name: Cephalocele
HP:0011815.definition: A congenital defect in the skull, whereby there is a protrusion of part of the cranial contents through a congenital defect in the cranium, usually covered with skin or mucous membrane. The term encephalocele refers to a subclass of these lesions in which brain tissue protrudes through the defect.
HP:0011815.definition_cn: 颅骨先天性缺损，即部分颅内容物通过颅骨先天性缺损处突出，通常被皮肤或黏膜覆盖。脑膨出（encephalocele）是指脑组织通过缺损处突出的这类病变的一个亚类。

HP:0011816.name: Parietal encephalocele
HP:0011816.definition: An encephalocele located between bregma and lambda.
HP:0011816.definition_cn: 位于前囟与后囟之间的脑膨出。

HP:0011817.name: Basal encephalocele
HP:0011817.definition: Basal encephalocele is an encephalocele that occurs along the cribriform plate or through the sphenoid bone. The mass may appear in the nasal cavity, nasopharynx, epipharynx, sphenoid sinus, posterior orbit, or pterygopalatine fossa. The important distinction from other types is that no external tumor is visible except in those rare instances of herniations so large that they protrude through the mouth or nares.
HP:0011817.definition_cn: 基底脑膨出是一种沿筛板或通过蝶骨发生的脑膨出。肿块可能出现在鼻腔、鼻咽、咽上部、蝶窦、眶后或翼腭窝。与其他类型的重要区别在于，除非在极少数情况下疝出物过大以至于通过口腔或鼻孔突出，否则外部肿瘤不可见。

HP:0011819.name: Submucous cleft soft palate
HP:0011819.definition: A cleft of the muscular (soft) portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane. Soft-palate submucous clefts are characterized by a midline deficiency or lack of muscle tissue.
HP:0011819.definition_cn: 软腭粘膜下裂，其特征为中线部位肌肉组织缺损或缺失。

HP:0011820.name: Membranous choanal atresia
HP:0011820.definition: Absence of the normal opening of the choana (the posterior nasal aperture) as a result of an obstructing choanal membrane that may be thin and strandlike or thick and pluglike.
HP:0011820.definition_cn: 由于阻塞性后鼻孔膜的存在，导致后鼻孔（鼻腔后孔）正常开口缺失，该膜可能为薄而丝状或厚而栓状。

HP:0011821.name: Abnormal facial skeleton morphology
HP:0011821.definition: An abnormality of one or more of the set of bones that make up the facial skeleton.
HP:0011821.definition_cn: 面部骨骼中一个或多个骨结构的异常。

HP:0011822.name: Broad chin
HP:0011822.definition: Increased width of the midpoint of the mandible (mental protuberance) and overlying soft tissue.
HP:0011822.definition_cn: 下颌骨中点（颏隆突）及覆盖软组织宽度增加。

HP:0011823.name: Chin with horizontal crease
HP:0011823.definition: Horizontal crease or fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin, with the face at rest.
HP:0011823.definition_cn: 位于下唇红缘下方和颏部脂肪垫上方的水平皱褶或折痕，面部处于静息状态。

HP:0011824.name: Chin with H-shaped crease
HP:0011824.definition: H-shaped crease in the fat pad of the chin.

HP:0011825.name: Tented philtrum
HP:0011825.definition: Prominence of a triangular soft tissue area of the philtrum with the apex to the columella.
HP:0011825.definition_cn: 人中三角区软组织隆起，尖端朝向鼻小柱。

HP:0011826.name: Philtrum with midline raphe
HP:0011826.definition: Narrow ridge in the midline of the philtral groove.
HP:0011826.definition_cn: 人中嵴正中线的狭窄隆起。

HP:0011827.name: Malaligned philtral ridges
HP:0011827.definition: Absence of the usual parallel position of philtral ridges.
HP:0011827.definition_cn: 人中嵴平行位置异常缺失。

HP:0011828.name: Midline sinus of philtrum
HP:0011828.definition: Pit in the midline of the philtral groove.

HP:0011829.name: Narrow philtrum
HP:0011829.definition: Distance between the philtral ridges, measured just above the vermilion border, more than 2 standard deviations below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between the ridges of the philtrum.
HP:0011829.definition_cn: 人中嵴间距，在唇红缘上方测量，低于平均值2个标准差以上。或表现为明显的人中嵴间距减小。

HP:0011831.name: Deviated nasal tip
HP:0011831.definition: Nasal tip positioned to one side of the midline.

HP:0011832.name: Narrow nasal tip
HP:0011832.definition: Decrease in width of the nasal tip.

HP:0011833.name: Overhanging nasal tip
HP:0011833.definition: Positioning of the nasal tip inferior to the nasal base.

HP:0011834.name: Moyamoya phenomenon
HP:0011834.definition: A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial carotid arteries owing to the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the circle of Willis.
HP:0011834.definition_cn: 一种非炎症性、进行性的颅内颈动脉闭塞，由于Willis环形成的网状侧支动脉所致。

HP:0011836.name: Delayed talus ossification
HP:0011836.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the talus.
HP:0011836.definition_cn: 距骨成熟延迟及钙化不全。

HP:0011837.name: Partial IgA deficiency
HP:0011837.definition: Detectable but decreased IgA levels that are more than 2 standard deviations below normal age-adjusted means.
HP:0011837.definition_cn: 可检测但降低的IgA水平，低于正常年龄调整均值2个标准差以上。

HP:0011838.name: Sclerodactyly
HP:0011838.definition: Localized thickening and tightness of the skin of the fingers or toes.
HP:0011838.definition_cn: 指（趾）局部皮肤增厚和紧绷。

HP:0011839.name: Abnormal T cell count
HP:0011839.definition: A deviation from the normal count of T cells.

HP:0011840.name: Abnormality of T cell physiology
HP:0011840.definition: A functional anomaly of T cells.

HP:0011841.name: Ventricular flutter
HP:0011841.definition: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia characterized by an extremely rapid, hemodynamically unstable ventricular tachycardia (150-300 beats/min) with a large oscillating sine-wave appearance.
HP:0011841.definition_cn: 一种潜在致命的心律失常，其特征为极快速、血流动力学不稳定的室性心动过速（150-300次/分钟），伴有大幅振荡的正弦波形态。

HP:0011842.name: Abnormal skeletal morphology
HP:0011842.definition: An abnormality of the form, structure, or size of the skeletal system.
HP:0011842.definition_cn: 骨骼系统形态、结构或大小的异常。

HP:0011843.name: Abnormal musculoskeletal physiology
HP:0011843.definition: An abnormality of the function of the skeletal system.

HP:0011844.name: Abnormal appendicular skeleton morphology
HP:0011844.definition: An abnormality of the appendicular skeletal system, consisting of the of the limbs, shoulder and pelvic girdles.
HP:0011844.definition_cn: 附肢骨骼系统异常，包括四肢、肩带和骨盆带。

HP:0011845.name: Short second metatarsal
HP:0011845.definition_cn: 第二跖骨短小（发育不全）。

HP:0011846.name: Osteoblastoma
HP:0011846.definition: A benign, painful, tumor of bone characterized by the formation of osteoid tissue, primitive bone and calcified tissue.
HP:0011846.definition_cn: 一种良性的、疼痛性骨肿瘤，其特征为形成类骨组织、原始骨组织和钙化组织。

HP:0011847.name: Giant cell tumor of bone
HP:0011847.definition: A bone tumor composed of cellular spindle-cell stroma containing scattered multinucleated giant cells resembling osteoclasts.
HP:0011847.definition_cn: 一种由细胞性梭形细胞基质构成的骨肿瘤，其中包含散在的多核巨细胞，类似于破骨细胞。

HP:0011848.name: Abdominal colic
HP:0011848.definition: A type of abdominal pain that comes and goes in waves, most often starting and ending suddenly and being of severe intensity.
HP:0011848.definition_cn: 一种呈阵发性发作的腹痛，通常起病突然、终止迅速且疼痛程度剧烈。

HP:0011849.name: Abnormal bone ossification
HP:0011849.definition: Any anomaly in the formation of bone or of a bony substance, or the conversion of fibrous tissue or of cartilage into bone or a bony substance.
HP:0011849.definition_cn: 骨或骨性物质形成过程中的任何异常，或纤维组织或软骨转化为骨或骨性物质过程中的任何异常。

HP:0011851.name: Hemopericardium
HP:0011851.definition: Accumulation of blood within the pericardial sac.

HP:0011852.name: Chylopericardium
HP:0011852.definition: Accumulation of chyle (the whitish fluid taken up by the lacteals in the intestine, consisting of an emulsion of lymph and triglyceride fat thatpasses into the veins by the thoracic duct) in the pericardium. Chylopericardium is generally caused by obstruction of or trauma to the thoracic duct.
HP:0011852.definition_cn: 乳糜（由肠道中的乳糜管吸收的乳白色液体，由淋巴和甘油三酯脂肪的乳剂组成，通过胸导管进入静脉）在心包内的积聚。乳糜心包通常由胸导管的阻塞或创伤引起。

HP:0011853.name: Serous pericardial effusion
HP:0011853.definition: Accumulation of serous fluid (pale yellow and transparent fluid) in the pericardial sac.
HP:0011853.definition_cn: 心包腔内浆液性液体（淡黄色透明液体）积聚。

HP:0011854.name: Hemoperitoneum
HP:0011854.definition: Accumulation of blood in the peritoneal cavity owing to internal hemorrhage.
HP:0011854.definition_cn: 腹腔内出血导致血液在腹膜腔内积聚。

HP:0011855.name: Pharyngeal edema
HP:0011855.definition: Abnormal accumulation of fluid leading to swelling of the pharynx.
HP:0011855.definition_cn: 咽部液体积聚异常导致的咽部肿胀。

HP:0011856.name: Pica
HP:0011856.definition: An appetite for and the persistent ingestion of non-food substances such as clay. In order to diagnose pica, this behavior must have persisted over a period of at least one month.
HP:0011856.definition_cn: 对非食物物质（如黏土）的食欲及持续摄入行为。为诊断异食癖，该行为必须持续至少一个月。

HP:0011857.name: Plasmacytoma
HP:0011857.definition: A discrete mass of neoplastic monoclonal plasma cells either in the bone marrow or in an extramedullary location.
HP:0011857.definition_cn: 骨髓或髓外部位的单克隆浆细胞肿瘤性离散肿块。

HP:0011858.name: Reduced factor IX activity
HP:0011858.definition: Decreased activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.
HP:0011858.definition_cn: 凝血因子IX活性降低。凝血因子IX本身被因子Xa或因子VIIa激活形成因子IXa，进而激活因子X转化为因子Xa。

HP:0011859.name: Punctate keratitis
HP:0011859.definition: A type of keratitis characterized by inflammation in pinpoint areas of the corneal epithelium.
HP:0011859.definition_cn: 一种以角膜上皮点状区域炎症为特征的角膜炎。

HP:0011860.name: Metaphyseal dappling
HP:0011860.definition: The presence of spots or rounded patches of abnormally increased density of metaphyseal bone.
HP:0011860.definition_cn: 干骺端骨密度异常增高的斑点或圆形斑块。

HP:0011861.name: Bilateral trilobed lung
HP:0011861.definition: Both lungs have three lobes. Normally, the left lung has two lobes, whereas the right lung has three lobes.
HP:0011861.definition_cn: 双肺均具有三叶。正常情况下，左肺具有两叶，而右肺具有三叶。

HP:0011862.name: Abnormal bone collagen fibril morphology
HP:0011862.definition: Any structural anomaly of the connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of bone tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.
HP:0011862.definition_cn: 骨组织细胞外基质中由胶原蛋白构成的结缔组织束的任何结构异常，这些结缔组织束在组织强度和弹性中起重要作用。

HP:0011863.name: Abnormal sternal ossification
HP:0011863.definition: Any anomaly in the formation of the bony substance of the sternum.
HP:0011863.definition_cn: 胸骨骨性结构形成异常。

HP:0011864.name: Elevated plasma pyrophosphate
HP:0011864.definition: An abnormally increased diphosphate(4-) concentration in the blood. Diphosphate(4-), as ester with two phosphate groups, is also known as pyrophosphate.
HP:0011864.definition_cn: 血液中二磷酸盐（4-）浓度异常升高。二磷酸盐（4-）作为含有两个磷酸基团的酯，也被称为焦磷酸盐。

HP:0011867.name: Abnormal iliac wing morphology
HP:0011867.definition: An anomaly of the ilium ala. This is the large expanded portion of the ilum which bounds the greater pelvis laterally.
HP:0011867.definition_cn: 髂骨翼异常。此为髂骨的大扩展部分，其外侧界定了大骨盆。

HP:0011868.name: Sciatica
HP:0011868.definition: Pain in the lower back and hip radiating in the distribution of the sciatic nerve.
HP:0011868.definition_cn: 下腰部及髋部疼痛，沿坐骨神经分布区放射。

HP:0011869.name: Abnormal platelet function
HP:0011869.definition: Any anomaly in the function of thrombocytes.

HP:0011870.name: Impaired arachidonic acid-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011870.definition: Abnormal response to arachidonic acid as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of arachidonic acid.
HP:0011870.name_cn: 花生四烯酸诱导的血小板聚集受损
HP:0011870.definition_cn: 对花生四烯酸的异常反应表现为在添加花生四烯酸后血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0011871.name: Impaired ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011871.definition: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin.
HP:0011871.name_cn: 瑞斯托霉素诱导的血小板聚集功能受损
HP:0011871.definition_cn: 对瑞斯托霉素的异常反应表现为添加瑞斯托霉素后血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0011872.name: Impaired thrombin-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011872.definition: Abnormal response to thrombin or thrombin mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thrombin (or thrombin mimetics).
HP:0011872.name_cn: 凝血酶诱导的血小板聚集受损
HP:0011872.definition_cn: 对凝血酶或凝血酶模拟物的异常反应，表现为在添加凝血酶（或凝血酶模拟物）时血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0011873.name: Abnormal platelet count
HP:0011873.definition: Abnormal number of platelets per volume of blood. In a healthy adult, a normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 per microliter of blood.
HP:0011873.definition_cn: 血小板计数异常。健康成年人的正常血小板计数范围为每微升血液150,000至450,000个。

HP:0011874.name: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia
HP:0011874.definition: Low platelet count following administration of unfractionated or (less commonly) low-molecular weight heparin.
HP:0011874.name_cn: 肝素诱导性血小板减少症
HP:0011874.definition_cn: 使用未分级肝素或（较少见）低分子量肝素后出现的血小板减少症。

HP:0011875.name: Abnormal platelet morphology
HP:0011875.definition: An anomaly in platelet form, ultrastructure, or intracellular organelles.
HP:0011875.definition_cn: 血小板形态、超微结构或细胞内细胞器的异常。

HP:0011876.name: Abnormal platelet volume
HP:0011876.definition: Anomalous size of platelets. Most normal sized platelets are 1.5 to 3 micrometers in diameter. Large platelets are 4 to 7 micrometers. Giant platelets are larger than 7 micrometers and usually 10 to 20 micrometers.
HP:0011876.definition_cn: 血小板大小异常。大多数正常大小的血小板直径为1.5至3微米。大血小板为4至7微米。巨大血小板大于7微米，通常为10至20微米。

HP:0011877.name: Increased mean platelet volume
HP:0011877.definition: Average platelet volume above the upper limit of the normal reference interval.
HP:0011877.definition_cn: 平均血小板体积高于正常参考区间上限。

HP:0011878.name: Abnormal platelet membrane protein expression
HP:0011878.definition: Presence of reduced amount of a membrane protein on the cell membrane of platelets. This feature is typically measured by flow cytometry.
HP:0011878.name_cn: 异常血小板膜蛋白表达
HP:0011878.definition_cn: 血小板细胞膜上膜蛋白数量减少。该特征通常通过流式细胞术进行检测。

HP:0011879.name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein Ib-IX-V
HP:0011879.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of the glycoprotein complex Ib-IX-V.
HP:0011879.definition_cn: 糖蛋白复合物Ib-IX-V的细胞膜浓度降低。

HP:0011880.name: Acute disseminated intravascular coagulation
HP:0011880.definition: An acute form of disseminated intravascular coagulation. Acute DIC can occur following sudden exposure of blood to procoagulants, with the compensatory hemostatic mechanisms becoming overwhelmed.
HP:0011880.name_cn: 急性弥散性血管内凝血
HP:0011880.definition_cn: 急性弥散性血管内凝血。急性DIC可在血液突然暴露于促凝血物质后发生，此时代偿性止血机制被压倒。

HP:0011881.name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein VI
HP:0011881.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein VI.
HP:0011881.definition_cn: 糖蛋白VI在细胞膜上的浓度降低。

HP:0011882.name: Decreased platelet P2Y12 receptor
HP:0011882.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of P2Y12 receptor.

HP:0011883.name: Abnormal platelet granules
HP:0011883.definition: An anomaly of alpha or dense granules or platelet lysosomes.
HP:0011883.definition_cn: α颗粒或致密颗粒或血小板溶酶体的异常。

HP:0011884.name: Abnormal umbilical stump bleeding
HP:0011884.definition: Abnormal bleeding of the umbilical stump following separation of the cord at approximately 7-10 days after birth.
HP:0011884.definition_cn: 脐带残端在出生后约7-10天分离后出现的异常出血。

HP:0011885.name: Hemorrhage of the eye
HP:0011885.definition: Bleeding from vessels of the various tissues of the eye.

HP:0011886.name: Hyphema
HP:0011886.definition: Bleeding in the anterior chamber of the eye.

HP:0011887.name: Choroid hemorrhage
HP:0011887.definition: Hemorrhage from the vessels of the choroid.

HP:0011888.name: Bleeding requiring red cell transfusion
HP:0011888.definition: Bleeding sufficiently severe as to require red cell transfusion (WHO Grade 3 or 4).
HP:0011888.name_cn: 需要红细胞输注的出血
HP:0011888.definition_cn: 出血严重程度达到需要红细胞输注（世界卫生组织分级3级或4级）。

HP:0011889.name: Bleeding with minor or no trauma
HP:0011889.definition: Significant bleeding or hemorrhage without significant precipitating factor.
HP:0011889.definition_cn: 无明显诱因的显著出血或大出血。

HP:0011890.name: Prolonged bleeding following procedure
HP:0011890.definition: Prolonged or protracted bleeding following an invasive procedure or intervention.
HP:0011890.definition_cn: 侵入性操作或干预后出现延长或持续性出血。

HP:0011891.name: Post-partum hemorrhage
HP:0011891.definition: Significant maternal hemorrhage/blood loss following deilvery of a child.

HP:0011892.name: Decreased circulating vitamin K concentration
HP:0011892.definition: The concentration of vitamin K in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0011892.definition_cn: 血液循环中维生素K浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0011893.name: Abnormal leukocyte count
HP:0011893.definition: Number of leukocytes per volume of blood beyond normal limits.
HP:0011893.definition_cn: 白细胞计数超出正常范围。

HP:0011894.name: Impaired thromboxane A2 agonist-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011894.definition: Abnormal response to thromboxane as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thromboxane A2 receptor agonists.
HP:0011894.name_cn: 血栓素A2激动剂诱导的血小板聚集受损
HP:0011894.definition_cn: 对血栓素A2受体激动剂添加后血小板聚集减少或缺失所表现出的血栓素异常反应。

HP:0011895.name: Anemia due to reduced life span of red cells
HP:0011895.definition: A type of anemia related to a reduction in the average life span of red blood cells in the peripheral circulation, which is normally around 120 days.
HP:0011895.name_cn: 红细胞寿命缩短性贫血
HP:0011895.definition_cn: 一种与周围循环中红细胞平均寿命缩短相关的贫血类型，正常情况下红细胞平均寿命约为120天。

HP:0011896.name: Subconjunctival hemorrhage
HP:0011896.definition: Bleeding beneath the mucous membrane that lines the inner surface of the eyelid.

HP:0011897.name: Neutrophilia
HP:0011897.definition: Increased number of neutrophils circulating in blood.
HP:0011897.definition_cn: 外周血中性粒细胞增多症。

HP:0011898.name: Abnormality of circulating fibrinogen
HP:0011898.definition: An abnormality of the level of activity of circulating fibrinogen.
HP:0011898.definition_cn: 循环纤维蛋白原活性水平异常。

HP:0011899.name: Hyperfibrinogenemia
HP:0011899.definition: Increased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.
HP:0011899.definition_cn: 血液中纤维蛋白原浓度升高。

HP:0011900.name: Hypofibrinogenemia
HP:0011900.definition: Decreased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

HP:0011902.name: Abnormal hemoglobin
HP:0011902.definition: Anomaly in the level or the function of hemoglobin, the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes.
HP:0011902.definition_cn: 血红蛋白水平或功能异常，血红蛋白是红细胞中的携氧蛋白。

HP:0011903.name: HbH hemoglobin
HP:0011903.definition: Hemoglobin H (HbH) contains four beta-globin chains. It is normally not present at all in blood, but may make up about 1-40 percent of all hemoglobin in HbH disease, a subform of alpha thalassemia.
HP:0011903.definition_cn: 血红蛋白H（HbH）由四条β-珠蛋白链组成。正常情况下，血液中完全不存在HbH，但在α-地中海贫血的一种亚型——HbH病中，HbH可占全部血红蛋白的约1-40%。

HP:0011904.name: Persistence of hemoglobin F
HP:0011904.definition: Hemoglobin F (HbF) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin gamma chains. It is the main form of hemoglobin in the fetus during the last seven months of intrauterine development and in the half year of postnatal life. In adults it normally makes up less than one percent of all hemoglobin. This term refers to an increase in HbF above this limit. In beta thalassemia major, it may represent over 90 percent of all hemoglobin, and in beta thalassemia minor it may make up between 0.5 to 4 percent.
HP:0011904.name_cn: 胎儿血红蛋白持续存在
HP:0011904.definition_cn: 血红蛋白F（HbF）包含两条珠蛋白α链和两条珠蛋白γ链。它是胎儿在宫内发育的最后七个月以及出生后半年内血红蛋白的主要形式。在成人中，它通常占所有血红蛋白的不到百分之一。该术语指的是HbF超过此限度的增加。在重型β地中海贫血中，它可能占所有血红蛋白的90%以上，而在轻型β地中海贫血中，它可能占0.5%至4%。

HP:0011905.name: Reduced hemoglobin A
HP:0011905.definition: Hemoglobin A (HbA) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin beta chains. HbA is normally the main adult hemoglobin, representing about 96-98 percent of all hemoglobin. This term represents a decreased in the proportion of HbA below this limit, and can be seen in various forms of thalassemia.
HP:0011905.definition_cn: 血红蛋白A（HbA）包含两条球蛋白α链和两条球蛋白β链。HbA通常是成人的主要血红蛋白，约占所有血红蛋白的96-98%。该术语表示HbA比例低于此限度的减少，可见于各种类型的地中海贫血。

HP:0011906.name: Reduced beta/alpha synthesis ratio
HP:0011906.definition: A reduction in the ratio of production of beta globin to that of alpha globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of beta thalassemia.
HP:0011906.definition_cn: β珠蛋白与α珠蛋白生成比例的降低。这是各类β地中海贫血的主要异常表现。

HP:0011907.name: Reduced alpha/beta synthesis ratio
HP:0011907.definition: A reduction in the ratio of production of alpha globin to that of beta globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of alpha thalassemia.
HP:0011907.definition_cn: α珠蛋白与β珠蛋白生成比例的降低。这是各种类型α地中海贫血的主要病理异常。

HP:0011908.name: Unilateral radial aplasia
HP:0011908.definition: Missing radius bone on one side only associated with congenital failure of development.
HP:0011908.definition_cn: 单侧桡骨缺失伴先天性发育不全。

HP:0011909.name: Flattened metacarpal heads
HP:0011909.definition: Abnormally flat shape of the heads of the metacarpal bones.

HP:0011910.name: Shortening of all phalanges of fingers
HP:0011910.definition: Abnormal reduction in length affecting all phalanges.
HP:0011910.definition_cn: 所有指骨长度异常缩短。

HP:0011911.name: Abnormal metacarpophalangeal joint morphology
HP:0011911.definition: An anomaly of a metacarpophalangeal joint.

HP:0011912.name: Abnormality of the glenoid fossa
HP:0011912.definition: An anomaly of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.
HP:0011912.definition_cn: 肩胛盂异常，也称为肩胛盂窝异常，肩胛盂是肩胛骨上与肱骨头相连接的关节面。

HP:0011913.name: Lumbar hypertrichosis
HP:0011913.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the lumbar region.
HP:0011913.definition_cn: 腰部区域毛发过度增生（Hypertrichosis lumbalis）。

HP:0011914.name: Thoracic hypertrichosis
HP:0011914.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the thoracic region.
HP:0011914.definition_cn: 胸廓区域毛发过度增生（Hypertrichosis in the thoracic region）。

HP:0011915.name: Cardiovascular calcification
HP:0011915.definition: Abnormal calcification in the cardiovascular system.

HP:0011916.name: Toe extensor amyotrophy
HP:0011916.definition: Atrophy of the extensor digitorum longus muscles, which mediate extension of the toes.
HP:0011916.definition_cn: 趾长伸肌萎缩，该肌肉负责足趾的伸展功能。

HP:0011917.name: Short 5th toe
HP:0011917.definition_cn: 第五趾发育不全（第五趾发育不良）。

HP:0011918.name: Clinodactyly of the 4th toe
HP:0011918.definition: Bending or curvature of a fourth toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).
HP:0011918.definition_cn: 第四趾向胫侧方向（即朝向拇趾）弯曲或成角畸形。

HP:0011919.name: Pleural empyema
HP:0011919.definition: Accumulation of pus in the pleural cavity.

HP:0011920.name: Transudative pleural effusion
HP:0011920.definition: A type of pleural effusion with a transudate (extravascular fluid with low protein content and a low specific gravity). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH.
HP:0011920.definition_cn: 一种以漏出液（蛋白质含量低且比重低的血管外液体）为特征的胸腔积液。根据Light标准，胸腔积液可分为漏出液和渗出液。若满足以下任一条件，则积液被分类为渗出液：（1）胸腔积液蛋白与血清蛋白的比值大于0.5，（2）胸腔积液乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）与血清LDH的比值大于0.6，或（3）胸腔积液LDH水平大于血清LDH正常上限的三分之二。

HP:0011921.name: Exudative pleural effusion
HP:0011921.definition: A type of pleural effusion with a exudate (extravascular fluid that has exuded out of a tissue or its capillaries due to injury or inflammation). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH.
HP:0011921.definition_cn: 一种伴有渗出液的胸腔积液（由于损伤或炎症而从组织或其毛细血管渗出的血管外液体）。根据Light标准，胸腔积液可分为漏出液和渗出液。如果存在以下一种或多种情况，则积液被分类为渗出液：（1）胸腔积液蛋白与血清蛋白的比值大于0.5，（2）胸腔积液乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）与血清LDH的比值大于0.6，或（3）胸腔积液LDH水平大于血清LDH正常上限的三分之二。

HP:0011922.name: Abnormal activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
HP:0011922.definition: An increased or decreased activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.
HP:0011922.name_cn: 线粒体呼吸链异常活动
HP:0011922.definition_cn: 线粒体呼吸链活性增强或减弱。

HP:0011923.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex I
HP:0011923.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex I, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.
HP:0011923.name_cn: 线粒体复合物I活性降低
HP:0011923.definition_cn: 线粒体呼吸链复合物I活性降低，该复合物是线粒体电子传递链的组成部分。

HP:0011924.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex III
HP:0011924.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.
HP:0011924.name_cn: 线粒体复合体III活性降低
HP:0011924.definition_cn: 线粒体呼吸链复合体III活性降低，该复合体是线粒体电子传递链的组成部分。

HP:0011925.name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial ATP synthase complex
HP:0011925.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, which makes ATP via oxidative phosphorylation, and is sometimes described as Complex V of the electron transport chain.
HP:0011925.name_cn: 线粒体ATP合酶复合体活性降低
HP:0011925.definition_cn: 线粒体质子转运ATP合酶复合体活性降低，该复合体通过氧化磷酸化生成ATP，有时也被称为电子传递链的复合体V。

HP:0011926.name: Proximal placement of hallux
HP:0011926.definition: Proximal mislocalization of the big toe from its normal position.
HP:0011926.definition_cn: 大脚趾从其正常位置向近端错位。

HP:0011927.name: Short digit
HP:0011927.definition: One or more digit that appears disproportionately short compared to the hand/foot, whereby either the entire digit or a specific phalanx is shortened.
HP:0011927.definition_cn: 一个或多个指/趾相对于手/足显得不成比例地短小，表现为整个指/趾或特定指/趾骨缩短。

HP:0011928.name: Short proximal phalanx of toe
HP:0011928.definition: Developmental hypoplasia (shortening) of proximal phalanx of toe.
HP:0011928.definition_cn: 趾近节指骨发育不全（短缩）。

HP:0011929.name: Hypersegmentation of proximal phalanx of third finger
HP:0011929.definition: Presence of an additional phalanx-like bone, producing an extra, wedge-shaped bone at the base of the proximal phalanx of the third finger.
HP:0011929.name_cn: 第三指近节指骨过度分节
HP:0011929.definition_cn: 存在额外的指骨样骨，导致第三指近节指骨基底部出现一个额外的楔形骨。

HP:0011931.name: Abnormal cerebellar peduncle morphology
HP:0011931.definition: An anomaly of the cerebellar peduncles. The superior, middle, and inferior cerebellar peduncles emerge from the cerebellum. The superior cerebellar penduncles connect the cerebellum to the midbrain, the middle cerebellar peduncles connect the cerebellum to the pons, and the inferior cerebellar peduncle connects the medulla spinalis and medulla oblongata with the cerebellum.
HP:0011931.definition_cn: 小脑脚异常。上、中、下小脑脚从小脑发出。上小脑脚连接小脑与中脑，中小脑脚连接小脑与脑桥，下小脑脚连接脊髓和延髓与小脑。

HP:0011932.name: Abnormal superior cerebellar peduncle morphology
HP:0011932.definition: An anomaly of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

HP:0011933.name: Elongated superior cerebellar peduncle
HP:0011933.definition: Increased length of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

HP:0011934.name: Dilatation of mesenteric artery
HP:0011934.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the inferior mesenteric artery or superior mesenteric artery .
HP:0011934.definition_cn: 肠系膜下动脉或肠系膜上动脉壁的异常囊状扩张或囊状膨出。

HP:0011935.name: Decreased urinary urate
HP:0011935.definition: Decreased concentration of urate in the urine.

HP:0011936.name: Decreased plasma total carnitine
HP:0011936.definition: A decreased concentration of total carnitine in the blood.
HP:0011936.definition_cn: 血液中总肉碱浓度降低。

HP:0011937.name: Hypoplastic fifth toenail
HP:0011937.definition: Underdeveloped nails of the fifth toes.

HP:0011939.name: 3-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0011939.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between fingers 3 and 4.
HP:0011939.definition_cn: 第三和第四指间在前后轴方向上的软组织连续性。

HP:0011940.name: Anterior wedging of T12
HP:0011940.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the thoracic vertebra T12 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).
HP:0011940.definition_cn: 胸椎T12形态异常，呈楔形（前部狭窄）。

HP:0011941.name: Anterior wedging of L2
HP:0011941.definition: An abnormality of the shape of the lumbar vertebra L2 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).
HP:0011941.definition_cn: 腰椎L2形态异常，呈楔形（前部变窄）。

HP:0011942.name: Increased urinary sulfite level
HP:0011942.definition: The concentration of SO3(2-), i.e., sulfite, in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0011942.name_cn: 尿中亚硫酸盐水平升高
HP:0011942.definition_cn: 尿液中SO3(2-)（即亚硫酸盐）的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0011943.name: Increased urinary thiosulfate
HP:0011943.definition: Increased concentration of thiosulfate(2-) in the urine.
HP:0011943.definition_cn: 尿液中硫代硫酸盐(2-)浓度升高。

HP:0011944.name: Small vessel vasculitis
HP:0011944.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects blood vessels that are smaller than arteries, i.e., arterioles, venules, and capilllaries.
HP:0011944.definition_cn: 一种影响小于动脉的血管（即小动脉、小静脉和毛细血管）的血管炎（血管壁炎症）。

HP:0011945.name: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia
HP:0011945.definition: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP) is and interstitial lung abnormalitiy characterized histopathologically by plugs of granulation tissue lying within small airways, alveolar ducts, and alveoli and by chronic inflammatory cell infiltration in alveolar walls. Patients with BOOP generally present with subacute illness, including shortness of breath, fever, malaise, and weight loss.
HP:0011945.name_cn: 闭塞性细支气管炎伴机化性肺炎
HP:0011945.definition_cn: 闭塞性细支气管炎伴机化性肺炎（BOOP）是一种间质性肺疾病，其组织病理学特征为细支气管、肺泡管和肺泡内存在肉芽组织栓，以及肺泡壁的慢性炎症细胞浸润。BOOP患者通常表现为亚急性病程，包括呼吸困难、发热、乏力和体重减轻。

HP:0011946.name: Bronchiolitis obliterans
HP:0011946.definition: Inflammation and fibrosis of the bronchioles leading to partial or complete obstruction of these airways.
HP:0011946.definition_cn: 细支气管炎症和纤维化导致部分或完全性气道阻塞。

HP:0011947.name: Respiratory tract infection
HP:0011947.definition: An infection of the upper or lower respiratory tract.
HP:0011947.definition_cn: 上呼吸道或下呼吸道感染。

HP:0011948.name: Recurrent acute respiratory tract infection
HP:0011948.definition: A history of repeated acute infections of the upper or lower respiratory tract.
HP:0011948.name_cn: 复发性急性呼吸道感染
HP:0011948.definition_cn: 反复发作的上呼吸道或下呼吸道急性感染病史。

HP:0011949.name: Acute infectious pneumonia
HP:0011949.definition: Acute inflammation of the lung due to an infection.

HP:0011951.name: Aspiration pneumonia
HP:0011951.definition: Pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

HP:0011952.name: Acute aspiration pneumonia
HP:0011952.definition: An acute episode of pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.
HP:0011952.definition_cn: 由于食物、液体或胃内容物误吸入上呼吸道引起的急性肺炎发作。

HP:0011954.name: Nodular regenerative hyperplasia of liver
HP:0011954.definition: Diffuse benign transformation of the hepatic parenchyma into small regenerative nodules with minimal or no fibrosis.
HP:0011954.definition_cn: 肝实质弥漫性良性转变为小结节再生性增生，伴轻微或无纤维化。

HP:0011955.name: Hepatic granulomatosis
HP:0011955.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the liver as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.
HP:0011955.definition_cn: 根据病理学检查，肝脏中存在多个肉芽肿。肉芽肿是由称为上皮样细胞的修饰巨噬细胞组成的0.5至2毫米的小集合体，通常被淋巴细胞包围。

HP:0011956.name: Intestinal lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
HP:0011956.definition: A lymphoproliferative abnormality of the intestine characterized by numerous visible mucosal nodules measuring up to, and rarely exceeding, 0.5 cm in diameter Histologically, hyperplastic lymphoid follicles with large germinal centers are seen in the lamina propria and superficial submucosa. There is enlargement of the mucosal B cell follicles caused by hyperplasia of the follicle centers; surrounded by a normal appearing mantle zone. Disease may involve the stomach, the entire small intestine, and the large intestine.
HP:0011956.definition_cn: 一种肠道淋巴组织增生性异常，其特征为大量可见的黏膜结节，直径通常不超过0.5厘米，极少超过此范围。组织学上，可见固有层和浅表黏膜下层中增生的淋巴滤泡，伴有较大的生发中心。黏膜B细胞滤泡因滤泡中心增生而增大，周围环绕着外观正常的套区。该病变可能累及胃、整个小肠以及大肠。

HP:0011957.name: Abnormal pectoral muscle morphology
HP:0011957.definition: An abnormality of the pectoral muscle, comprising the pectoralis major, a thick, fan-shaped muscle of the anterior chest and the pectoralis minor, a thin, triangular muscle situated underneath the pectoralis major.
HP:0011957.definition_cn: 胸肌异常，包括胸大肌（一种位于前胸的厚实扇形肌肉）和胸小肌（一种位于胸大肌下方的薄三角形肌肉）。

HP:0011958.name: Retinal perforation
HP:0011958.definition: A small hole through the whole thickness of the retina.

HP:0011959.name: Unilateral hypoplasia of pectoralis major muscle
HP:0011959.definition: Hypoplasia (underdevelopment) of the pectoralis minor on only one side of the chest.

HP:0011960.name: Substantia nigra gliosis
HP:0011960.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the substantia nigra.
HP:0011960.definition_cn: 黑质内胶质细胞的局灶性增生。

HP:0011961.name: Non-obstructive azoospermia
HP:0011961.definition: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from a defect in the production of spermatozoa in the testes. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.
HP:0011961.definition_cn: 精液中未检测到任何可测量水平的精子，由睾丸内精子生成缺陷所致。可通过睾丸活检与梗阻性无精子症相鉴别。

HP:0011962.name: Obstructive azoospermia
HP:0011962.definition: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from post-testicular obstruction or retrograde ejaculation. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.
HP:0011962.definition_cn: 精液中无任何可检测到的精子水平，由睾丸后梗阻或逆行射精引起。可通过睾丸活检与梗阻性无精子症进行鉴别。

HP:0011963.name: Pretesticular azoospermia
HP:0011963.definition: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, due to a hypothalamic or pituitary abnormality diagnosed with hypo-gonadotropic-hypogonadism. The diagnosis is made on the basis of low LH and FSH levels and low or normal testosterone levels.
HP:0011963.definition_cn: 由于下丘脑或垂体异常导致的促性腺激素分泌不足性性腺功能减退症，其精液中未检测到任何可测量水平的精子。该诊断基于低水平的黄体生成素（LH）和卵泡刺激素（FSH）以及低或正常的睾酮水平。

HP:0011964.name: Intermittent painful muscle spasms
HP:0011964.definition: History of repeated intermittent involuntary muscle contractions that were painful.
HP:0011964.definition_cn: 反复发作的间歇性不自主肌肉收缩史，伴有疼痛。

HP:0011965.name: Abnormal circulating citrulline concentration
HP:0011965.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of citrulline in the blood circulation.
HP:0011965.definition_cn: 血液循环中瓜氨酸浓度的任何异常。

HP:0011966.name: Elevated plasma citrulline
HP:0011966.definition: An increased concentration of citrulline in the blood.
HP:0011966.definition_cn: 血液中瓜氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0011967.name: Decreased circulating copper concentration
HP:0011967.definition: A reduced concentration of copper in the blood.

HP:0011968.name: Feeding difficulties
HP:0011968.definition: Impaired ability to eat related to problems gathering food and getting ready to suck, chew, or swallow it.
HP:0011968.definition_cn: 与食物获取困难及准备吸吮、咀嚼或吞咽相关的进食能力受损。

HP:0011969.name: Elevated circulating luteinizing hormone level
HP:0011969.definition: An elevated concentration of luteinizing hormone in the blood.
HP:0011969.name_cn: 循环中黄体生成素水平升高
HP:0011969.definition_cn: 血液中黄体生成素浓度升高。

HP:0011970.name: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy
HP:0011970.definition: Amyloid deposition in the walls of leptomeningeal and cortical arteries, arterioles, and less often capillaries and veins of the central nervous system.
HP:0011970.definition_cn: 淀粉样物质沉积于软脑膜和皮质动脉、小动脉壁，较少见于中枢神经系统的毛细血管和静脉壁。

HP:0011971.name: Dermatographic urticaria
HP:0011971.definition: An exaggerated whealing tendency when the skin is stroked, that is, formation of red, itchy bumps and lines on the skin as a result of pressure on the skin (for instance, stroking the skin with a pen or tongue depressor).
HP:0011971.definition_cn: 皮肤划痕症（Dermographism），即皮肤受到压力（如用笔或压舌板划擦皮肤）时，出现过度风团反应，表现为皮肤上形成红色、瘙痒的隆起和线条。

HP:0011972.name: Hypoglycorrhachia
HP:0011972.definition: Abnormally low glucose concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0011972.definition_cn: 脑脊液葡萄糖浓度异常降低。

HP:0011973.name: Paroxysmal lethargy
HP:0011973.definition: Repeated episodes of sudden-onset and transient lethargy.
HP:0011973.definition_cn: 反复发作的突发性短暂性嗜睡。

HP:0011974.name: Myelofibrosis
HP:0011974.definition: Replacement of bone marrow by fibrous tissue.

HP:0011975.name: Aminoglycoside-induced hearing loss
HP:0011975.definition: Partial or complete loss of hearing following ingestion of aminoglycoside antibiotics.
HP:0011975.name_cn: 氨基糖苷类抗生素诱导的听力损失
HP:0011975.definition_cn: 氨基糖苷类抗生素摄入后导致的听力部分或完全丧失。

HP:0011976.name: Elevated urinary catecholamine level
HP:0011976.definition: The concentration of a catecholamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0011976.name_cn: 尿中儿茶酚胺水平升高
HP:0011976.definition_cn: 尿液中儿茶酚胺浓度经尿液浓度标准化后高于正常上限。

HP:0011977.name: Elevated urinary homovanillic acid
HP:0011977.definition: An increased concentration of homovanillic acid in the urine.
HP:0011977.definition_cn: 尿液中高香草酸浓度升高。

HP:0011978.name: Elevated urinary vanillylmandelic acid
HP:0011978.definition: An increased concentration of vanillylmandelic acid in the urine.
HP:0011978.definition_cn: 尿液中香草扁桃酸浓度升高。

HP:0011979.name: Elevated urinary dopamine level
