HP:0011979.definition: The concentration of dopamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0011979.definition_cn: 尿液中多巴胺浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:0011980.name: Cholesterol gallstones
HP:0011980.definition: Gallstones composed primarily of cholesterol, usually about 2-3 cm in length with an oval form and a yellow or green/brown color.
HP:0011980.definition_cn: 主要由胆固醇构成的胆结石，通常长约2-3厘米，呈椭圆形，颜色为黄色或绿/棕色。

HP:0011981.name: Pigment gallstones
HP:0011981.definition: Gallstones composed primarily of bilirubin and calcium salts (calcium bilirubinate) with a low cholesterol concentration.
HP:0011981.definition_cn: 主要由胆红素和钙盐（胆红素钙）组成且胆固醇浓度较低的胆结石。

HP:0011982.name: Black pigment gallstones
HP:0011982.definition: A type of pigment gallstone that is hard and black, containing calcium carbonate and calcium phosphates.
HP:0011982.definition_cn: 一种黑色坚硬的色素性胆结石，含有碳酸钙和磷酸钙。

HP:0011983.name: Brown pigment gallstones
HP:0011983.definition: A type of pigment gallstone that is brown, containing calcium fatty acids. These stones are softer than black pigment gallstones.
HP:0011983.definition_cn: 一种棕色色素性胆结石，含有钙脂肪酸。此类结石较黑色色素性胆结石质地更为柔软。

HP:0011984.name: Atretic gallbladder
HP:0011984.definition: Failure of formation of the lumen of the gallbladder, often associated with gallbladder hypoplasia.
HP:0011984.definition_cn: 胆囊腔形成失败，常与胆囊发育不全相关。

HP:0011985.name: Acholic stools
HP:0011985.definition: Clay colored stools lacking bile pigment.
HP:0011985.definition_cn: 无胆汁色素的陶土样便。

HP:0011986.name: Ectopic ossification
HP:0011986.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue, i.e., the presence of bone in soft tissue where bone normally does not exist.
HP:0011986.definition_cn: 异位骨化（Heterotopic Ossification），即软组织中出现正常情况下不存在的骨组织。

HP:0011987.name: Ectopic ossification in muscle tissue
HP:0011987.definition: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within muscle tissue.
HP:0011987.name_cn: 肌肉组织中的异位骨化
HP:0011987.definition_cn: 肌肉组织内异常骨组织形成。

HP:0011988.name: Ectopic ossification in tendon tissue
HP:0011988.definition: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within tendon tissue.
HP:0011988.name_cn: 肌腱组织中的异位骨化
HP:0011988.definition_cn: 肌腱组织内异常骨组织形成。

HP:0011989.name: Ectopic ossification in ligament tissue
HP:0011989.definition: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within ligament tissue.
HP:0011989.definition_cn: 韧带组织内异常骨组织的形成。

HP:0011990.name: Abnormality of neutrophil physiology
HP:0011990.name_cn: 中性粒细胞生理功能异常

HP:0011991.name: Abnormal neutrophil count
HP:0011991.definition: A deviation from the normal range of neutrophil cell counts in the circulation.
HP:0011991.definition_cn: 循环中性粒细胞计数偏离正常范围。

HP:0011992.name: Abnormal neutrophil morphology
HP:0011992.definition: An abnormal form or size of neutrophils.
HP:0011992.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞形态或大小异常。

HP:0011993.name: Impaired neutrophil bactericidal activity
HP:0011993.definition: A reduction in the ability of neutrophils to kill bacteria.
HP:0011993.name_cn: 中性粒细胞杀菌活性受损
HP:0011993.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞杀菌能力降低。

HP:0011994.name: Abnormal atrial septum morphology
HP:0011994.definition: An abnormality of the interatrial septum.

HP:0011995.name: Atrial septal dilatation
HP:0011995.definition: A bulging of the interatrial septum towards one side. In adults, atrial septal aneurysm can be defined as a protrusion of the aneurysm of >10 mm beyond the plane of the atrial septum as measured by transesophageal echocardiography.
HP:0011995.definition_cn: 房间隔向一侧膨出。在成人中，房间隔瘤可定义为经食管超声心动图测量时，瘤体突出房间隔平面超过10毫米。

HP:0011996.name: Elevated coagulation factor V activity
HP:0011996.definition: Increased activity of coagulation factor V, Factor V, which is activated to factor Va by means of minute amounts of thrombin (and inactivated by larger amounts of thrombin). Activated factor V (fVa) is a cofactor in the formation of the prothrombinase complex.
HP:0011996.definition_cn: 凝血因子V活性增强，凝血因子V通过微量凝血酶激活为因子Va（并在大量凝血酶作用下失活）。激活的因子V（fVa）是凝血酶原酶复合物形成过程中的辅因子。

HP:0011997.name: Postprandial hyperlactemia
HP:0011997.definition: Abnormally increased level of blood lactate following a meal.
HP:0011997.definition_cn: 餐后血乳酸水平异常升高。

HP:0011998.name: Postprandial hyperglycemia
HP:0011998.definition: An increased concentration of glucose in the blood following a meal.

HP:0011999.name: Paranoia
HP:0011999.definition: The feeling and belief that one is being targeted or is a focus of negative or untoward actions, overt or covert, from others. The affected individual expresses a concern that people are in general against the individual and are engaging in subtle behaviors to make things difficult for them. The origins of such thinking may arise from real events and become amplified over time. Paranoia may also arise in the absence of any action or interaction between the person and their environment.
HP:0011999.definition_cn: 被害妄想（Paranoia）是指个体感受到并坚信自己成为他人公开或隐秘的负面或不利行为的针对对象或焦点。患者表现出一种担忧，认为人们普遍对其怀有敌意，并通过微妙的行为使其处境困难。此类思维可能源于真实事件，并随时间推移而加剧。被害妄想亦可在个体与其环境之间无任何实际行为或互动的情况下发生。

HP:0012000.name: EEG with generalized spikes
HP:0012000.definition: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.
HP:0012000.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性棘波
HP:0012000.definition_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性尖波，持续时间小于80毫秒。

HP:0012001.name: EEG with generalized polyspikes
HP:0012001.definition: EEG with repetitive generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.
HP:0012001.name_cn: 脑电图显示广泛性多棘波
HP:0012001.definition_cn: 脑电图显示重复性广泛性尖波，持续时间小于80毫秒。

HP:0012002.name: Experiential epileptic aura
HP:0012002.definition: Affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual auras with subjective qualities similar to those experienced in life but are recognized by the subject as occurring outside of actual context.
HP:0012002.definition_cn: 情感性、记忆性或复合性感知性先兆，具有与现实生活中经历相似的主观性质，但被主体识别为发生在实际情境之外。

HP:0012003.name: Affective epileptic aura
HP:0012003.definition: Affective auras with subjective qualities similar to those experienced in life but are recognized by the subject as occurring outside of actual context.
HP:0012003.definition_cn: 情感性先兆，其主观性质与生活中所经历的相似，但被主体识别为发生在实际情境之外。

HP:0012004.name: Focal cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
HP:0012004.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by memory phenomena such as feelings of familiarity (deja vu) and unfamiliarity (jamais vu) as the initial semiological manifestation.
HP:0012004.name_cn: 局灶性认知性发作伴似曾相识感/陌生感
HP:0012004.definition_cn: 以记忆现象为初始症状学表现的局灶性认知性癫痫发作，其特征为熟悉感（似曾相识感）和陌生感（旧事如新感）。

HP:0012005.name: Deja vu aura
HP:0012005.definition: A subjective feeling that an experience which is occurring for the first time has been experienced before.

HP:0012006.name: Jamais vu aura
HP:0012006.definition: A subjective feeling that an experience which has occurred before is being experienced for the first time.

HP:0012007.name: Focal cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP:0012007.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by hallucination as the initial semiological manifestation.
HP:0012007.name_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴幻觉
HP:0012007.definition_cn: 以幻觉为初始症状学表现的局灶性认知性癫痫发作。

HP:0012008.name: Focal cognitive seizure with illusion
HP:0012008.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by an alteration of actual perception involving visual, auditory, somatosensory, olfactory, and/or gustatory phenomena as the initial semiological manifestation.
HP:0012008.name_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴错觉
HP:0012008.definition_cn: 一种局灶性认知性癫痫发作，其特征为实际感知的改变，涉及视觉、听觉、体感、嗅觉和/或味觉现象作为初始的症候学表现。

HP:0012009.name: EEG with central focal spike waves
HP:0012009.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the central region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0012009.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央局灶性棘慢波
HP:0012009.definition_cn: 脑电图显示中央区局灶性尖波，即持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0012010.name: EEG with frontal focal spike waves
HP:0012010.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the frontal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0012010.name_cn: 脑电图显示额叶局灶性棘波
HP:0012010.definition_cn: 脑电图显示额区局灶性尖波，即持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0012011.name: EEG with occipital focal spike waves
HP:0012011.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the occipital region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0012011.name_cn: 枕叶局灶性棘波的脑电图
HP:0012011.definition_cn: 脑电图显示枕区局灶性尖波，即持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0012012.name: EEG with parietal focal spike waves
HP:0012012.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the parietal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0012012.name_cn: 脑电图显示顶叶局灶性棘波
HP:0012012.definition_cn: 脑电图显示顶叶区域局灶性尖波，即持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0012013.name: EEG with temporal focal spike waves
HP:0012013.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the temporal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0012013.name_cn: 脑电图显示颞区局灶性棘慢波
HP:0012013.definition_cn: 脑电图显示颞区局灶性尖波，即持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0012014.name: EEG with central focal spikes
HP:0012014.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the central region.
HP:0012014.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央局灶性棘波
HP:0012014.definition_cn: 脑电图显示中央区域出现持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波。

HP:0012015.name: EEG with frontal focal spikes
HP:0012015.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the frontal region.
HP:0012015.name_cn: 脑电图显示额叶局灶性棘波
HP:0012015.definition_cn: 脑电图显示额叶区域出现持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波。

HP:0012016.name: EEG with occipital focal spikes
HP:0012016.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the occipital region.
HP:0012016.name_cn: 枕叶局灶性棘波的脑电图
HP:0012016.definition_cn: 脑电图显示枕叶区域出现持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波。

HP:0012017.name: EEG with parietal focal spikes
HP:0012017.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the parietal region.
HP:0012017.name_cn: 脑电图显示顶叶局灶性棘波
HP:0012017.definition_cn: 脑电图显示顶叶区域出现持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波。

HP:0012018.name: EEG with temporal focal spikes
HP:0012018.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the temporal region.
HP:0012018.name_cn: 脑电图显示颞区局灶性棘波
HP:0012018.definition_cn: 脑电图显示颞区出现持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波。

HP:0012019.name: Lens luxation
HP:0012019.definition: Complete dislocation of the lens of the eye.

HP:0012020.name: Right aortic arch
HP:0012020.definition: Aorta descends on right instead of on the left.
HP:0012020.definition_cn: 主动脉位于右侧而非左侧。

HP:0012021.name: Persistent patent ductus venosus
HP:0012021.definition: Persistence of blood flow through the ductus venosus for longer than the normal time after birth.
HP:0012021.definition_cn: 出生后静脉导管血流持续超过正常时间。

HP:0012022.name: Congenital portosystemic venous shunt
HP:0012022.definition: A congenital defect of the vasculature such that there is a shunt (by-pass) of blood directly from the portal vein to the vena cava (i.e., the blood from the portal vein is not filtered through the liver).
HP:0012022.definition_cn: 一种先天性血管缺陷，导致血液从门静脉直接分流（绕过）至腔静脉（即门静脉血液未经过肝脏过滤）。

HP:0012023.name: Galactosuria
HP:0012023.definition: Elevated concentration of galactose in the urine.
HP:0012023.definition_cn: 尿液中半乳糖浓度升高。

HP:0012024.name: Hypergalactosemia
HP:0012024.definition: Elevated concentration of galactose in the blood.

HP:0012025.name: Abnormal circulating ornithine concentration
HP:0012025.definition: Deviation from the normal concentration of ornithine in the blood circulation.
HP:0012025.definition_cn: 血液中鸟氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0012026.name: Hyperornithinemia
HP:0012026.definition: Increased concentration of ornithine in the blood.
HP:0012026.definition_cn: 血液中鸟氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0012027.name: Laryngeal edema
HP:0012027.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tissues of the larynx.
HP:0012027.definition_cn: 喉部组织中的异常液体积聚和肿胀。

HP:0012028.name: Hepatocellular adenoma
HP:0012028.definition: A benign tumor of the liver of presumably epithelial origin.
HP:0012028.definition_cn: 一种推测为上皮来源的肝脏良性肿瘤。

HP:0012029.name: Abnormal urine hormone level
HP:0012029.definition: An abnormal concentration of a hormone in the urine.

HP:0012030.name: Increased urinary cortisol level
HP:0012030.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of cortisol in the urine.
HP:0012030.definition_cn: 尿液中皮质醇浓度异常升高。

HP:0012032.name: Lipoma
HP:0012032.definition: Benign neoplasia derived from lipoblasts or lipocytes of white or brown fat. May be angiomatous or hibernomatous.
HP:0012032.definition_cn: 源自白色或棕色脂肪的成脂细胞或脂肪细胞的良性肿瘤。可为血管瘤样或冬眠瘤样。

HP:0012033.name: Sacral lipoma
HP:0012033.definition: Presence of a lipoma in the region of the sacrum.

HP:0012034.name: Liposarcoma
HP:0012034.definition: Malignant neoplasms which probably originate in primitive mesenchymal stem cell populations differentiating down a lipomatous pathway.
HP:0012034.definition_cn: 可能起源于原始间充质干细胞群并沿脂肪瘤途径分化的恶性肿瘤。

HP:0012035.name: Steatocystoma multiplex
HP:0012035.definition: Multiple, localized or widespread, asymptomatic or inflammatory dermal cysts involving the pilosebaceous units. Lesions can appear anywhere on the body, but steatocystoma multiplex is more commonly involved with those areas of the skin with a high density of developed pilosebaceous units (e.g., the axilla, groin, neck, and proximal extremities).
HP:0012035.definition_cn: 多发性、局限性或广泛性、无症状或炎症性皮肤囊肿，累及毛囊皮脂腺单位。病变可出现在身体的任何部位，但多发性皮脂腺囊肿更常见于皮肤毛囊皮脂腺单位密度较高的区域（如腋窝、腹股沟、颈部和四肢近端）。

HP:0012036.name: Sternocleidomastoid amyotrophy
HP:0012036.definition: Wasting of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, the muscle in the anterior part of the neck that acts to flex and rotate the head.
HP:0012036.definition_cn: 胸锁乳突肌萎缩，该肌肉位于颈部前侧，主要功能为屈曲和旋转头部。

HP:0012037.name: Pectoralis amyotrophy
HP:0012037.definition: Wasting of the pectoral muscles, i.e., of the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor. This finding is often manifested by prominent axillary creases or double axillary creases.
HP:0012037.definition_cn: 胸肌萎缩，即胸大肌和胸小肌的萎缩。这一体征常表现为明显的腋窝皱褶或双腋窝皱褶。

HP:0012038.name: Corneal guttata
HP:0012038.definition: Corneal guttata are droplet-like accumulations of non-banded collagen on the posterior surface of Descemet's membrane. The presence of focal thickenings of Descemet's membrane histologically named guttae. Cornea guttata can be easily diagnosed in vivo and ex vivo by means of specular microscopy as it gives dark areas where no endothelial cells are visible.
HP:0012038.definition_cn: 角膜滴状变性是后弹力层后表面非带状胶原的滴状积聚。组织学上称为滴状物的后弹力层局部增厚。通过镜面反射显微镜，角膜滴状变性在体内和体外均可轻松诊断，因为其显示无内皮细胞可见的暗区。

HP:0012039.name: Descemet Membrane Folds
HP:0012039.definition: Presence of folds in the Descemet membrane, which is the basement membrane of the endothelial (inner) cell layer of the cornea. Descemet membrane folds are generally a manifestation of inflammation or edema of the cornea.
HP:0012039.definition_cn: Descemet膜皱褶的存在，该膜为角膜内皮（内层）细胞层的基底膜。Descemet膜皱褶通常是角膜炎症或水肿的表现。

HP:0012040.name: Corneal stromal edema
HP:0012040.definition: Abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling of the stroma of cornea.
HP:0012040.definition_cn: 角膜基质液体积聚异常及水肿。

HP:0012042.name: Aspirin-induced asthma
HP:0012042.definition: A type of asthma in which aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) that inhibit cyclooxygen-ase 1 (COX-1) exacerbate bronchoconstriction.
HP:0012042.definition_cn: 一种哮喘类型，其中阿司匹林及其他抑制环氧化酶1（COX-1）的非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）会加剧支气管收缩。

HP:0012043.name: Pendular nystagmus
HP:0012043.definition: Rhythmic, involuntary sinusoidal oscillations of one or both eyes. The waveform of pendular nystagmus may occur in any direction.
HP:0012043.definition_cn: 单眼或双眼节律性、不自主的正弦振荡。摆动性眼球震颤的波形可发生于任何方向。

HP:0012044.name: Seesaw nystagmus
HP:0012044.definition: Seesaw nystagmus is a type of pendular nystagmus where a half cycle consists of the elevation and intorsion of one eye, concurrently with the depression and extortion of the fellow eye. In the other half cycle, there is an inversion of the ocular movements.
HP:0012044.definition_cn: 跷跷板眼震是一种钟摆型眼震，其半周期表现为一眼的上抬和内旋，同时伴有对侧眼的下压和外旋。在另一半周期中，眼球运动发生反转。

HP:0012045.name: Retinal flecks
HP:0012045.definition: Presence of multiple yellowish-white lesions of various size and configuration on the retina not related to vascular lesions.
HP:0012045.definition_cn: 视网膜上存在多个大小和形态各异的黄白色病灶，与血管病变无关。

HP:0012046.name: Areflexia of upper limbs
HP:0012046.definition: Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the upper limbs.

HP:0012047.name: Hemeralopia
HP:0012047.definition: A visual defect characterized by the inability to see as clearly in bright light as in dim light. The word hemeralopia literally means day blindness.
HP:0012047.definition_cn: 昼盲症，其特征为在明亮光线下视力较昏暗光线下降。术语“hemeralopia”字面意义为昼盲。

HP:0012048.name: Oromandibular dystonia
HP:0012048.definition: A kind of focal dystonia characterized by forceful contractions of the face, jaw, and/or tongue causing difficulty in opening and closing the mouth and often affecting chewing and speech.
HP:0012048.definition_cn: 一种局灶性肌张力障碍，其特征为面部、下颌和/或舌部的强力收缩，导致张口和闭口困难，并常影响咀嚼和言语功能。

HP:0012049.name: Laryngeal dystonia
HP:0012049.definition: A form of focal dystonia that affects the vocal cords, associated with involuntary contractions of the vocal cords causing interruptions of speech and affecting the voice quality and often leading to patterned, repeated breaks in speech.
HP:0012049.definition_cn: 一种影响声带的局灶性肌张力障碍，与声带的不自主收缩相关，导致言语中断、影响音质，并常引起模式化、重复性的言语中断。

HP:0012050.name: Anasarca
HP:0012050.definition: An extreme form of generalized edema with widespread and massive edema due to effusion of fluid into the extracellular space.
HP:0012050.definition_cn: 一种极端的全身性水肿形式，由于液体渗入细胞外间隙导致广泛且严重的水肿。

HP:0012051.name: Reactive hypoglycemia
HP:0012051.definition: Hypoglycermia following a meal (or more generally, after intake of glucose).
HP:0012051.definition_cn: 餐后低血糖（或更广泛地说，葡萄糖摄入后低血糖）。

HP:0012052.name: Low serum calcitriol
HP:0012052.definition: A reduced concentration of calcitriol in the blood. Calcitriol is also known as 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol or 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3.
HP:0012052.definition_cn: 血液中骨化三醇浓度降低。骨化三醇也称为1,25-二羟基胆钙化醇或1,25-二羟基维生素D3。

HP:0012053.name: Decreased circulating calcifediol concentration
HP:0012053.definition: A reduced concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as calcidiol, 25-hydroxycholecalciferol and 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3.
HP:0012053.name_cn: 循环中钙二醇浓度降低
HP:0012053.definition_cn: 血液中骨化二醇浓度降低。骨化二醇也称为骨二醇、25-羟基胆钙化醇和25-羟基维生素D3。

HP:0012054.name: Choroidal melanoma
HP:0012054.definition: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the choroid. The classic appearance of choroidal melanoma is a pigmented dome-shaped or collar button-shaped tumor with an associated exudative retinal detachment. Choroidal melanoma is usually pigmented, but can be variably pigmented and even amelanotic (non-pigmented).
HP:0012054.definition_cn: 脉络膜黑色素细胞恶性肿瘤。脉络膜黑色素瘤的典型表现为色素性圆顶状或领扣状肿瘤，伴有渗出性视网膜脱离。脉络膜黑色素瘤通常为色素性，但也可呈现不同程度的色素沉着，甚至为无色素性（非色素性）。

HP:0012055.name: Ciliary body melanoma
HP:0012055.definition: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the ciliary body.
HP:0012055.definition_cn: 睫状体黑色素细胞的恶性肿瘤。

HP:0012056.name: Cutaneous melanoma
HP:0012056.definition: The presence of a melanoma of the skin.

HP:0012057.name: Superficial spreading melanoma
HP:0012057.definition: A type of melanoma that is flat and irregular in shape and color, with different shades of black and brown.
HP:0012057.definition_cn: 一种黑色素瘤，呈扁平状，形状和颜色不规则，呈现不同深浅的黑色和棕色。

HP:0012058.name: Nodular melanoma
HP:0012058.definition: A type of melanoma that starts as a raised area that is usually dark blackish-blue or bluish-red but may not have any color.
HP:0012058.definition_cn: 一种黑色素瘤类型，初始表现为隆起的病灶，通常呈深黑色-蓝色或蓝红色，但也可能无色素沉着。

HP:0012059.name: Lentigo maligna melanoma
HP:0012059.definition: A subtype of melanoma in situ that typically develops on sun-damaged skin. The lesion is typically a large, irregularly pigmented macule that has developed from an ordinary lentigo (a small pigmented spot on the skin with a clearly-defined edge). Change to a malignant lentigo typically takes place over 20 years or more, and many patients accept the change as a consequence of aging.
HP:0012059.name_cn: 恶性雀斑样痣黑色素瘤
HP:0012059.definition_cn: 一种原位黑色素瘤的亚型，通常发生于日光损伤的皮肤。病变通常为从普通雀斑（皮肤上具有清晰边缘的小色素斑）发展而来的大面积、不规则色素性斑疹。恶变为恶性雀斑样痣通常需要20年或更长时间，许多患者将这种变化视为衰老的结果。

HP:0012060.name: Acral lentiginous melanoma
HP:0012060.definition: A type of cutaneous melanoma localized to the palm, sole, or beneath the nail (subungual melanoma). Acral lentiginous melanoma starts as a slowly-enlarging flat patch of discolored skin and usually displays a size above 6 mm and often several centimeters or more in diameter upon diagnosis and variable pigmentation with a mixutre of colors including brown, and blue-grey, black and red. The surface of the lesion is initially smooth but later in the course may become thicker and irregular, and may ulcerate or bleed.
HP:0012060.definition_cn: 一种局限于手掌、足底或甲下（甲下黑色素瘤）的皮肤黑色素瘤。肢端雀斑样黑色素瘤最初表现为缓慢扩大的皮肤变色斑块，通常在诊断时直径超过6毫米，常达数厘米或更大，且色素沉着不均，呈现棕色、蓝灰色、黑色和红色等多种颜色混合。病变表面初期光滑，但在病程后期可能增厚且不规则，并可能出现溃疡或出血。

HP:0012061.name: Urinary excretion of sialylated oligosaccharides
HP:0012061.definition: Excretion of oligosaccharides conjugated to sialic acid in the urine.
HP:0012061.name_cn: 唾液酸化寡糖的尿液排泄
HP:0012061.definition_cn: 尿液中唾液酸结合寡糖的排泄。

HP:0012062.name: Bone cyst
HP:0012062.definition: A fluid filled cavity that develops with a bone.

HP:0012063.name: Aneurysmal bone cyst
HP:0012063.definition: Radiographic features include a dilated, radiolucent lesion typically located eccentrically within the metaphyseal portion of the bone, with fluid levels visible on magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:0012063.definition_cn: 影像学特征包括一个扩张的、透射线的病变，通常位于骨干骺端的偏心位置，磁共振成像可见液平面。

HP:0012064.name: Unicameral bone cyst
HP:0012064.definition: A benign fluid filled simple cyst of bone filled with serous fluid.
HP:0012064.definition_cn: 一种良性、充满液体的单纯性骨囊肿，内含浆液性液体。

HP:0012065.name: Multiple bony cystic lesions
HP:0012065.definition: Presence of multiple cystic changes in multiple areas or multiple bones.
HP:0012065.definition_cn: 多区域或多骨性多发性囊性改变。

HP:0012066.name: Increased urinary disaccharide excretion
HP:0012066.definition: Increased concentration of disaccharide in the urine.

HP:0012067.name: Glycopeptiduria
HP:0012067.definition: Increased excretion of glycopeptides in the urine. Glycopeptides are peptides with carbohydrate moieties covalently attached to the side chains of the amino acid residues.
HP:0012067.definition_cn: 尿液中糖肽排泄增加。糖肽是指碳水化合物部分共价连接到氨基酸残基侧链上的肽类物质。

HP:0012068.name: Aspartylglucosaminuria
HP:0012068.definition: Excretion of excess amounts of aspartylglucosamine in the urine.
HP:0012068.name_cn: 天冬氨酰葡萄糖胺尿症
HP:0012068.definition_cn: 尿液中过量天冬氨酰葡萄糖胺的排泄。

HP:0012069.name: Keratan sulfate excretion in urine
HP:0012069.definition: An increased concentration of keratan sulfate in the urine.
HP:0012069.name_cn: 尿液中硫酸角质素排泄
HP:0012069.definition_cn: 尿液中硫酸角质素浓度升高。

HP:0012070.name: Chondroitin sulfate excretion in urine
HP:0012070.definition: An increased concentration of chondroitin sulfate (CHEBI:37397) in the urine.
HP:0012070.name_cn: 尿液中硫酸软骨素排泄
HP:0012070.definition_cn: 尿液中硫酸软骨素（CHEBI:37397）浓度升高。

HP:0012071.name: Abnormal circulating acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0012071.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an acylcarnitine, which is produced by reversible esterification of the 3-hydroxyl group of carnitine.
HP:0012071.name_cn: 异常循环酰基肉碱浓度
HP:0012071.definition_cn: 血液循环中酰基肉碱浓度的任何异常，该物质由肉碱的3-羟基基团可逆酯化生成。

HP:0012072.name: Aciduria
HP:0012072.definition: Excretion of urine with an acid pH, i.e., having an increased hydrogen ion concentration.
HP:0012072.definition_cn: 酸性尿排泄，即尿液pH值降低，氢离子浓度增加。

HP:0012073.name: Abnormal urinary acylglycine profile
HP:0012073.definition: An abnormal distribution of N-acylglycines in the urine. There are numerous different N-acylglycines, and this term refers to pathological alterations in their level or distribution.
HP:0012073.definition_cn: 尿液中N-酰基甘氨酸的异常分布。存在多种不同的N-酰基甘氨酸，该术语指其水平或分布的病理学改变。

HP:0012074.name: Tonic pupil
HP:0012074.definition: An abnormality of the pupillary light reaction characterized by a marked slowing of the light reaction of usually just one pupil. The pupil tends to be relatively dilated, and there is reduced accommodation.
HP:0012074.definition_cn: 瞳孔光反应异常，其特征为通常仅单侧瞳孔光反应显著迟缓。瞳孔倾向于相对散大，且调节功能减弱。

HP:0012075.name: Personality disorder
HP:0012075.definition: A personality disorder is a deeply ingrained pattern of behavior of a specified kind that deviates markedly from the norms of generally accepted behavior. It is typically apparent by the time of adolescence and causes long-term difficulties in personal relationships or functioning in society.
HP:0012075.definition_cn: 人格障碍是一种根深蒂固的特定行为模式，显著偏离普遍接受的行为规范。通常在青春期显现，并导致长期的人际关系困难或社会功能受损。

HP:0012076.name: Borderline personality disorder
HP:0012076.definition: A personality disorder characterized by impulsive behavior and unpredictable, capricious mood. Affected individuals show a tendency to have outbursts of emotion and an inability to control these behavioral explosions. They generally experience an intense fear of abandonment or instability and also struggle with feelings of emptiness.
HP:0012076.definition_cn: 一种以冲动行为和不可预测、反复无常的情绪为特征的人格障碍。受影响个体表现出情绪爆发倾向，且无法控制这些行为爆发。他们通常经历强烈的被遗弃或不稳定恐惧，并伴有空虚感。

HP:0012077.name: Histrionic personality disorder
HP:0012077.definition: A personality disorder characterized by shallow and labile affectivity, self-dramatization, theatricality, exaggerated expression of emotions, suggestibility, egocentricity, self-indulgence, lack of consideration for others, easily hurt feelings, and continuous seeking for appreciation, excitement and attention.
HP:0012077.definition_cn: 一种以情感肤浅且不稳定、自我戏剧化、表演性、情绪表达夸张、易受暗示、自我中心、自我放纵、缺乏对他人考虑、情感易受伤害以及持续寻求赞赏、刺激和关注为特征的人格障碍。

HP:0012078.name: Motor conduction block
HP:0012078.definition: Blockade of impulses at a focal site along the course of a motor axon.
HP:0012078.definition_cn: 运动轴突沿程特定部位的冲动阻滞。

HP:0012079.name: Abnormality of central motor conduction
HP:0012079.definition: Any anomaly of the conduction of motor nerve impulses in the central nervous system.
HP:0012079.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统运动神经冲动传导异常。

HP:0012080.name: Cerebellar granular layer atrophy
HP:0012080.definition: Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the granular cell layer.
HP:0012080.definition_cn: 小脑萎缩，主要累及颗粒细胞层。

HP:0012081.name: Enlarged cerebellum
HP:0012081.definition: An abnormally increased size of the cerebellum compared to other brain structures.

HP:0012082.name: Cerebellar Purkinje layer atrophy
HP:0012082.definition: Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the Purkinje cell layer.
HP:0012082.name_cn: 小脑浦肯野细胞层萎缩
HP:0012082.definition_cn: 小脑萎缩主要影响浦肯野细胞层。

HP:0012083.name: Ubiquitin-positive cerebral inclusion bodies
HP:0012083.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates that show positive staining with antibodies against ubiquitin within cells of the brain.
HP:0012083.definition_cn: 在大脑细胞内显示泛素抗体阳性染色的核或细胞质聚集物。

HP:0012084.name: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
HP:0012084.definition: Any abnormality of the size of the skeletal muscle cell.

HP:0012085.name: Pyuria
HP:0012085.definition: The presence of 10 or more white cells per cubic millimeter in a urine specimen, 3 or more white cells per high-power field of unspun urine, a positive result on Gram staining of an unspun urine specimen, or a urinary dipstick test that is positive for leukocyte esterase.
HP:0012085.definition_cn: 尿液中每立方毫米存在10个或更多白细胞，未离心尿液每高倍视野存在3个或更多白细胞，未离心尿液标本革兰染色阳性，或尿试纸条检测白细胞酯酶阳性。

HP:0012086.name: Abnormal urinary color
HP:0012086.definition: An abnormal color of the urine, that is, the color of the urine appears different from the usual straw-yellow color.
HP:0012086.definition_cn: 尿液颜色异常，即尿液颜色与通常的淡黄色不同。

HP:0012087.name: Abnormal mitochondrial shape
HP:0012087.definition: An anomaly in the surface contour of mitochondria.

HP:0012088.name: Abnormal urinary odor
HP:0012088.definition: A deviation from the normal odor of the urine.

HP:0012091.name: Abnormality of pancreas physiology
HP:0012091.definition: An anomaly of the function of the pancreas.

HP:0012092.name: Abnormality of exocrine pancreas physiology
HP:0012092.definition: A functional anomaly of the acinar gland portion of the pancreas that secretes digestive enzymes.
HP:0012092.name_cn: 胰腺外分泌生理功能异常
HP:0012092.definition_cn: 胰腺腺泡部分分泌消化酶的功能异常。

HP:0012093.name: Abnormality of endocrine pancreas physiology
HP:0012093.definition: A function abnormality of the endocrine pancreas.
HP:0012093.name_cn: 内分泌胰腺生理功能异常

HP:0012094.name: Abnormal pancreas size
HP:0012094.definition: A deviation from the normal size of the pancreas.

HP:0012096.name: Intracranial epidermoid cyst
HP:0012096.definition: A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from ectodermal cells that normally form skin cells being left behind in the nervous system during development.
HP:0012096.definition_cn: 一种先天性包涵囊肿，源于发育过程中本应形成皮肤细胞的外胚层细胞残留在神经系统内。

HP:0012097.name: Intracranial dermoid cyst
HP:0012097.definition: A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from the inclusion of ectodermally committed cells at the time of neural tube closure (3rd-5th week of embryogenesis). The capsule of dermoid cysts consists of simple epithelium supported by collagen. In thicker parts, the lining is supplemented with dermis containing hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and apocrine glands.
HP:0012097.definition_cn: 一种先天性包涵囊肿，源于神经管闭合时（胚胎发生第3至5周）外胚层定向细胞的包涵。皮样囊肿的囊壁由胶原支撑的简单上皮构成。在较厚的部分，内衬补充有包含毛囊、皮脂腺和顶泌腺的真皮层。

HP:0012098.name: Edema of the dorsum of feet
HP:0012098.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet.
HP:0012098.definition_cn: 足背部皮下组织异常液体积聚。

HP:0012099.name: Abnormality of circulating catecholamine level
HP:0012099.definition: An abnormal catecholamine concentration in the blood.
HP:0012099.name_cn: 循环儿茶酚胺水平异常
HP:0012099.definition_cn: 血液中儿茶酚胺浓度异常。

HP:0012100.name: Abnormal circulating creatinine concentration
HP:0012100.definition: An abnormal concentration of creatinine in the blood.

HP:0012101.name: Decreased serum creatinine
HP:0012101.definition: An abnormally reduced amount of creatinine in the blood.

HP:0012102.name: Abnormal mitochondrial number
HP:0012102.definition: A deviation from the normal number of mitochondria per cell.
HP:0012102.definition_cn: 细胞中线粒体数量异常。

HP:0012103.name: Abnormality of the mitochondrion
HP:0012103.definition: An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration.
HP:0012103.definition_cn: 线粒体异常，线粒体是一种膜性细胞质细胞器，其内部由嵴分隔。线粒体是一种自我复制的细胞器，是组织呼吸的场所。

HP:0012106.name: Rhizomelic leg shortening
HP:0012106.definition: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the leg (i.e. the femur).
HP:0012106.definition_cn: 下肢近端节段（即股骨）不成比例缩短。

HP:0012107.name: Increased fibular diameter
HP:0012107.definition: Increased width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula.

HP:0012108.name: Open angle glaucoma
HP:0012108.definition: A type of glaucoma defined by an open, normal appearing anterior chamber angle and raised intraocular pressure,
HP:0012108.definition_cn: 一种以开放且外观正常的前房角及眼内压升高为特征的开角型青光眼。

HP:0012109.name: Angle closure glaucoma
HP:0012109.definition: A type of glaucomatous optic neuropathy in an eye that has evidence of angle closure (i.e. significant iridotrabecular contact).
HP:0012109.definition_cn: 一种青光眼性视神经病变，其特征为患眼存在房角关闭的证据（即显著的虹膜小梁接触）。

HP:0012111.name: Abnormality of circulating glucocorticoid level
HP:0012111.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of a glucocorticoid in the blood.
HP:0012111.name_cn: 循环糖皮质激素水平异常
HP:0012111.definition_cn: 血液中糖皮质激素浓度异常。

HP:0012112.name: Abnormal circulating corticosterone level
HP:0012112.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of corticosterone in the blood.
HP:0012112.definition_cn: 血液中皮质酮浓度异常。

HP:0012113.name: Abnormal circulating creatine concentration
HP:0012113.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of creatine in the blood circulation. Creatine is a derivative of glycine having methyl and amidino groups attached to the nitrogen. Creatine is naturally produced from amino acids, primarily in liver and kidney, and acts as an energy source for cells, primarily for muscle cells.
HP:0012113.definition_cn: 血液中肌酸浓度偏离正常范围。肌酸是甘氨酸的衍生物，其氮原子上连接有甲基和脒基。肌酸主要由氨基酸在肝脏和肾脏中自然合成，并作为细胞（主要是肌细胞）的能量来源。

HP:0012114.name: Endometrial carcinoma
HP:0012114.definition: A carcinoma of the endometrium, the mucous lining of the uterus.
HP:0012114.definition_cn: 子宫内膜癌（Endometrial carcinoma），即子宫内膜黏膜层的恶性肿瘤。

HP:0012116.name: Abnormal circulating albumin concentration
HP:0012116.definition: Deviation from normal concentration of albumin in the blood.

HP:0012117.name: Hyperalbuminemia
HP:0012117.definition: Elevation in the concentration of albumin in the blood.

HP:0012119.name: Methemoglobinemia
HP:0012119.definition: Abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood. In this form of hemoglobin, there is an oxidized ferric iron (Fe +3) rather than the reduced ferrous form (Fe 2+) that is normally found in hemoglobin. Methemoglobin has a reduced affinity for oxygen, resulting in a reduced ability to release oxygen to tissues.
HP:0012119.definition_cn: 血液中高铁血红蛋白水平异常升高。在这种形式的血红蛋白中，存在氧化型三价铁（Fe +3），而非正常情况下血红蛋白中的还原型二价铁（Fe 2+）。高铁血红蛋白对氧的亲和力降低，导致向组织释放氧的能力下降。

HP:0012120.name: Methylmalonic aciduria
HP:0012120.definition: Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine.
HP:0012120.definition_cn: 尿液中甲基丙二酸浓度升高。

HP:0012121.name: Panuveitis
HP:0012121.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which inflammation affects the anterior chamber, vitreous, retina or choroid.
HP:0012121.definition_cn: 葡萄膜炎，其中炎症累及前房、玻璃体、视网膜或脉络膜。

HP:0012122.name: Anterior uveitis
HP:0012122.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the anterior chamber.
HP:0012122.definition_cn: 前葡萄膜炎（Anterior Uveitis），其中炎症的主要部位位于前房（Anterior Chamber）。

HP:0012123.name: Posterior uveitis
HP:0012123.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the retina or choroid.
HP:0012123.definition_cn: 葡萄膜炎，其中炎症的主要部位是视网膜或脉络膜。

HP:0012124.name: Intermediate uveitis
HP:0012124.definition: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the vitreous.
HP:0012124.definition_cn: 葡萄膜炎，其中炎症的主要部位是玻璃体。

HP:0012126.name: Stomach cancer
HP:0012126.definition: A cancer arising in any part of the stomach.
HP:0012126.definition_cn: 胃部恶性肿瘤（Gastric Malignancy）或胃部癌变（Gastric Carcinoma）。

HP:0012127.name: Uraciluria
HP:0012127.definition: Increased concentration of uracil in the urine.
HP:0012127.definition_cn: 尿液中尿嘧啶浓度升高。

HP:0012128.name: Basal ganglia necrosis
HP:0012128.definition: Death of cells in the basal ganglia. This finding can be confirmed by autopsy. It can be suspected with hyperintensities within the basal ganglia on FLAIR and T2-sequences on magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:0012128.definition_cn: 基底神经节细胞死亡。这一发现可通过尸检确认。在磁共振成像的FLAIR和T2序列上，基底神经节内出现高信号可提示此病变。

HP:0012129.name: Abnormality of bone marrow stromal cells

HP:0012130.name: Abnormal erythroid lineage cell morphology
HP:0012130.definition: An anomaly of erythroid lineage cells, that is, of the erythropoietic cells in the lineage leading to and including erythrocytes.
HP:0012130.name_cn: 异常红细胞系细胞形态
HP:0012130.definition_cn: 红细胞系细胞异常，即红细胞生成细胞在向红细胞分化过程中及包括红细胞在内的细胞系异常。

HP:0012131.name: Abnormal number of erythroid precursors
HP:0012131.definition: A deviation from the normal count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0012131.definition_cn: 骨髓中红系前体细胞（即红系谱系细胞）数量偏离正常范围。

HP:0012132.name: Erythroid hyperplasia
HP:0012132.definition: Increased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0012132.definition_cn: 骨髓中红系前体细胞（即红系细胞）数量增加。

HP:0012133.name: Erythroid hypoplasia
HP:0012133.definition: Decreased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0012133.definition_cn: 骨髓中红系前体细胞（即红系祖细胞）数量减少。

HP:0012135.name: Abnormal granulocytopoietic cell morphology
HP:0012135.definition: An anomaly of cells involved in the formation of a granulocytes, that is, of the granulocytopoietic cell.
HP:0012135.name_cn: 异常粒细胞生成细胞形态学
HP:0012135.definition_cn: 粒细胞生成细胞异常，即粒细胞生成细胞的异常。

HP:0012136.name: Dysplastic granulopoesis
HP:0012136.name_cn: 发育不良性粒细胞生成

HP:0012139.name: Granulocytic hypoplasia
HP:0012139.definition: Decreased number of granulocyte precursors in the bone marrow.
HP:0012139.definition_cn: 骨髓中粒细胞前体细胞数量减少。

HP:0012140.name: obsolete Abnormality of cells of the lymphoid lineage
HP:0012140.name_cn: 过时的淋巴系细胞异常

HP:0012142.name: Pancreatic squamous cell carcinoma
HP:0012142.definition: A subtype of ductal pancreatic carcinoma that is thought to originate from squamous metaplasia of pancreatic ductal epithelium.
HP:0012142.definition_cn: 一种胰腺导管癌亚型，被认为起源于胰腺导管上皮的鳞状上皮化生。

HP:0012143.name: Abnormal megakaryocyte morphology
HP:0012143.definition: Any structural anomaly of megakaryocytes. Mature blood platelets are released from the cytoplasm of megakaryocytes, which are bone-marrow resident cells.
HP:0012143.definition_cn: 巨核细胞的结构异常。成熟的血小板从巨核细胞的细胞质中释放，巨核细胞是骨髓驻留细胞。

HP:0012144.name: Abnormal monocyte morphology
HP:0012144.definition: Any structural anomaly of a myeloid mononuclear recirculating leukocyte that can act as a precursor of tissue macrophages, osteoclasts and some populations of tissue dendritic cells.
HP:0012144.definition_cn: 任何作为组织巨噬细胞、破骨细胞和某些组织树突状细胞前体的髓系单核再循环白细胞的结构异常。

HP:0012145.name: Abnormality of multiple cell lineages in the bone marrow

HP:0012146.name: Abnormality of von Willebrand factor
HP:0012146.definition: Decreased quantity or activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.
HP:0012146.name_cn: 血管性血友病因子异常
HP:0012146.definition_cn: 血管性血友病因子数量或活性降低。血管性血友病因子介导血小板与暴露于内皮细胞表面的胶原蛋白的黏附。

HP:0012147.name: Reduced quantity of Von Willebrand factor
HP:0012147.definition: Decreased quantity of von Willebrand factor.
HP:0012147.name_cn: 血管性血友病因子数量减少
HP:0012147.definition_cn: 血管性血友病因子数量减少。

HP:0012148.name: Multiple lineage myelodysplasia
HP:0012148.definition: Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two or more of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.
HP:0012148.name_cn: 多系别骨髓增生异常综合征
HP:0012148.definition_cn: 两系或以上髓系（红系、粒系、巨核系）发育异常的骨髓增生异常综合征。

HP:0012149.name: Bilineage myelodysplasia
HP:0012149.definition: Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.
HP:0012149.name_cn: 双系骨髓增生异常综合征
HP:0012149.definition_cn: 两系髓系细胞发育异常：红系、粒系、巨核系。

HP:0012150.name: Single lineage myelodysplasia
HP:0012150.definition: Abnormality/dysplasia of a single myeloid cell (erythroid, granulocytic, or megakaryocytic).
HP:0012150.name_cn: 单系骨髓增生异常综合征
HP:0012150.definition_cn: 单一髓系细胞（红系、粒系或巨核系）异常/发育不良。

HP:0012151.name: Hemothorax
HP:0012151.definition: The presence of blood in the pleural space.

HP:0012152.name: Foveoschisis
HP:0012152.definition: Splitting of the retinal layers in the macula.
HP:0012152.definition_cn: 黄斑区视网膜层间分离。

HP:0012153.name: Hypotriglyceridemia
HP:0012153.definition: An decrease in the level of triglycerides in the blood.
HP:0012153.definition_cn: 血液中甘油三酯水平降低。

HP:0012154.name: Anhedonia
HP:0012154.definition: Decreased ability to experience or feel joy or pleasure from any experience that is usually found to be pleasurable by the individual. This applies to any of the senses, e.g., taste, smell, and sound. Food may no longer be tasty, or a musical experience may no longer be enjoyable. Anhedonia also refers to an inability to feel pleasure related to activities that an affected individual previously derived pleasure from.
HP:0012154.definition_cn: 快感缺失（Anhedonia）是指个体从通常被认为愉悦的体验中感受或体验快乐或愉悦的能力下降。这适用于任何感官，例如味觉、嗅觉和听觉。食物可能不再美味，或音乐体验可能不再令人愉悦。快感缺失还指受影响个体无法从先前获得愉悦的活动中感受到快乐。

HP:0012155.name: Decreased corneal sensation
HP:0012155.definition: Reduced ability of the cornea to respond to stimulation.
HP:0012155.definition_cn: 角膜对刺激反应能力降低。

HP:0012156.name: Hemophagocytosis
HP:0012156.definition: Phagocytosis by macrophages of erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets, and their precursors in bone marrow and other tissues.
HP:0012156.definition_cn: 巨噬细胞对骨髓及其他组织中红细胞、白细胞、血小板及其前体细胞的吞噬作用。

HP:0012157.name: Subcortical cerebral atrophy
HP:0012157.definition: Atrophy of the cerebral subcortical white and gray matter, termed subcortical atrophy, reflects loss of nerve cells in the basal ganglia or fibers in the deep white matter.
HP:0012157.definition_cn: 脑皮质下白质和灰质萎缩，称为皮质下萎缩，反映了基底节神经细胞或深部白质纤维的丧失。

HP:0012158.name: Carotid artery dissection
HP:0012158.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the carotid artery wall.

HP:0012159.name: Internal carotid artery dissection
HP:0012159.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the internal carotid artery wall.
HP:0012159.definition_cn: 颈内动脉壁层间分离（夹层）

HP:0012160.name: Intracranial internal carotid artery dissection
HP:0012160.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the intracranial portion of the internal carotid artery wall.
HP:0012160.definition_cn: 颅内段颈内动脉壁层分离（夹层）。

HP:0012161.name: External carotid artery dissection
HP:0012161.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the external carotid artery wall.
HP:0012161.definition_cn: 颈外动脉壁层分离（夹层）。

HP:0012162.name: Common carotid artery dissection
HP:0012162.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the common carotid artery wall.
HP:0012162.definition_cn: 颈总动脉壁层分离（夹层）。

HP:0012163.name: Carotid artery dilatation
HP:0012163.definition: A dilatation (balooning or bulging out of the vessel wall) of a carotid artery.
HP:0012163.definition_cn: 颈动脉扩张（血管壁的球囊样扩张或膨出）。

HP:0012164.name: Asterixis
HP:0012164.definition: A clinical sign indicating a lapse of posture and is usually manifest by a bilateral flapping tremor at the wrist, metacarpophalangeal, and hip joints.
HP:0012164.definition_cn: 一种临床体征，表现为姿势控制丧失，通常以双侧腕关节、掌指关节和髋关节的扑翼样震颤为特征。

HP:0012165.name: Oligodactyly
HP:0012165.definition: A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of digits.
HP:0012165.definition_cn: 发育缺陷导致指（趾）数量少于正常数目。

HP:0012166.name: Skin-picking
HP:0012166.definition: Repetitive and compulsive picking of skin which results in tissue damage.
HP:0012166.definition_cn: 病理性皮肤搔抓（Dermatillomania）或称为强迫性皮肤剥离症（Excoriation Disorder），其特征为反复且强迫性地搔抓皮肤，导致组织损伤。

HP:0012167.name: Hair-pulling
HP:0012167.definition: A phenomenon in which persons repetitively pull out their own hair, resulting in noticeable hair loss.
HP:0012167.definition_cn: 一种表现为个体反复拔除自身毛发，导致显著脱发的现象，称为拔毛癖（Trichotillomania）。

HP:0012168.name: Head-banging
HP:0012168.definition: Habitual striking of one's own head against a surface such as a mattress or wall of a crib.
HP:0012168.definition_cn: 习惯性头部撞击表面行为，如床垫或婴儿床墙壁。

HP:0012169.name: Self-biting
HP:0012169.definition: Habitual biting of one's own body.

HP:0012170.name: Nail-biting
HP:0012170.definition: Habitual biting of one's own fingernails.

HP:0012171.name: Stereotypical hand wringing
HP:0012171.definition: Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.
HP:0012171.definition_cn: 习惯性双手在身体中部紧握并扭绞，类似于洗手动作。

HP:0012172.name: Stereotypical body rocking
HP:0012172.definition: Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.
HP:0012172.definition_cn: 全身性习惯性重复运动，前后或左右摆动。

HP:0012173.name: Orthostatic tachycardia
HP:0012173.definition: An increase in heart rate with standing of 30 beats per minute or more.
HP:0012173.definition_cn: 直立性心动过速（Orthostatic Tachycardia）定义为站立时心率增加≥30次/分钟。

HP:0012174.name: Glioblastoma multiforme
HP:0012174.definition: A tumor arising from glia in the central nervous system with macroscopic regions of necrosis and hemorrhage. Microscopically, glioblastoma multiforme is characterized by regions of pseudopalisading necrosis, pleomorphic nuclei and cells, and microvascular proliferation.
HP:0012174.definition_cn: 一种起源于中枢神经系统胶质细胞的肿瘤，伴有肉眼可见的坏死和出血区域。在显微镜下，多形性胶质母细胞瘤的特征包括假栅栏状坏死区域、多形性核和细胞，以及微血管增生。

HP:0012175.name: Resistance to activated protein C
HP:0012175.definition: Poor anticoagulant response to activated protein C. A plasma is termed 'APC resistant' when the addition of exogenous APC fails to prolong its clotting time in an activated partial thromboplastin time assay.
HP:0012175.definition_cn: 对活化蛋白C的抗凝反应不良。当在活化部分凝血活酶时间测定中外源性活化蛋白C的添加未能延长其凝血时间时，该血浆被称为“APC抵抗”。

HP:0012176.name: Abnormal natural killer cell morphology
HP:0012176.definition: An anomaly of the natural killer cell, which is a lymphocyte that can spontaneously kill a variety of target cells without prior antigenic activation via germline encoded activation receptors. It also regulates immune responses via cytokine release and direct contact with other cells.
HP:0012176.name_cn: 异常自然杀伤细胞形态学
HP:0012176.definition_cn: 自然杀伤细胞异常，该细胞是一种淋巴细胞，能够通过种系编码的激活受体在无需预先抗原激活的情况下自发杀伤多种靶细胞。此外，它还通过细胞因子释放和与其他细胞的直接接触来调节免疫反应。

HP:0012177.name: Abnormal natural killer cell physiology
HP:0012177.definition: A functional anomaly of the natural killer cell.
HP:0012177.name_cn: 异常自然杀伤细胞生理学
HP:0012177.definition_cn: 自然杀伤细胞功能异常。

HP:0012178.name: Reduced natural killer cell activity
HP:0012178.definition: Reduced ability of the natural killer cell to function in the adaptive immune response.
HP:0012178.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞活性降低
HP:0012178.definition_cn: 自然杀伤细胞在适应性免疫应答中的功能能力降低。

HP:0012179.name: Craniofacial dystonia
HP:0012179.definition: A form of focal dystonia affecting the face and especially the jaw that is induced by the act of speaking. It is an involuntary contraction of the masticatory muscles, resulting in dysarthria or dysphagia.
HP:0012179.definition_cn: 一种影响面部特别是下颌的局灶性肌张力障碍，由说话动作诱发。表现为咀嚼肌的不自主收缩，导致构音障碍或吞咽困难。

HP:0012180.name: Cystic medial necrosis
HP:0012180.definition: A disorder of large arteries, in particular the aorta, characterized by an accumulation of basophilic ground substance in the media with cyst-like lesions associated with degenerative changes of collagen, elastin and the vascular smooth muscle cells.
HP:0012180.definition_cn: 大动脉疾病，特别是主动脉疾病，其特征为中层中嗜碱性基质物质的积聚，伴有囊样病变，与胶原、弹性蛋白及血管平滑肌细胞的退行性改变相关。

HP:0012181.name: Entrapment neuropathy
HP:0012181.definition: Malfunction of a peripheral nerve resulting from mechanical compression of the nerve roots from internal or external causes and leading to a conduction block or axonal loss.
HP:0012181.definition_cn: 由于内部或外部原因导致的神经根机械性压迫引起的周围神经功能障碍，导致传导阻滞或轴突丧失。

HP:0012182.name: Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
HP:0012182.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the oropharnyx.
HP:0012182.definition_cn: 起源于口咽部的鳞状细胞癌。

HP:0012183.name: Hyperplastic colonic polyposis
HP:0012183.definition: Presence of multiple hyperplastic polyps in the colon. Hyperplastic polyps are generally about 5 mm in size and show hyperplastic mucosal proliferation.
HP:0012183.definition_cn: 结肠内存在多发性增生性息肉。增生性息肉通常大小约为5毫米，并显示黏膜增生性增殖。

HP:0012184.name: Increased HDL cholesterol concentration
HP:0012184.definition: An elevated concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL) in the blood.
HP:0012184.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度升高
HP:0012184.definition_cn: 血液中高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（HDL）浓度升高。

HP:0012185.name: Constrictive median neuropathy
HP:0012185.definition: Injury to the median nerve caused by its entrapment at the wrist as it traverses through the carpal tunnel. Clinically, constrictive median neuropathy is characterized by pain, paresthesia, and weakness in the median nerve distribution of the hand.
HP:0012185.definition_cn: 腕管综合征（Carpal Tunnel Syndrome），即正中神经在腕部穿过腕管时受到卡压所致的损伤。临床上，腕管综合征的特征性表现为手部正中神经分布区域的疼痛、感觉异常和肌力减弱。

HP:0012186.name: Entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve at elbow
HP:0012186.definition: An entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve in the cubital tunnel (in the elbow) characterized by numbness in the ring and little fingers and weakness of the intrinsic muscles in the hand.
HP:0012186.name_cn: 肘部尺神经卡压性神经病变
HP:0012186.definition_cn: 尺神经在肘管（位于肘部）的卡压性神经病变，其特征为环指和小指麻木以及手部内在肌无力。

HP:0012187.name: Increased erythrocyte protoporphyrin concentration
HP:0012187.definition: Concentration of protoporphyrins in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0012187.name_cn: 红细胞原卟啉浓度升高
HP:0012187.definition_cn: 红细胞中原卟啉浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0012188.name: Hyperemesis gravidarum
HP:0012188.definition: Excessive vomiting in early pregnancy, leading to the loss of 5% or more of body weight.
HP:0012188.definition_cn: 妊娠剧吐（Hyperemesis Gravidarum）导致体重减轻超过5%。

HP:0012189.name: Hodgkin lymphoma
HP:0012189.definition: A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.
HP:0012189.definition_cn: 一种显微镜下以多核Reed-Sternberg细胞为特征的淋巴瘤类型。

HP:0012190.name: T-cell lymphoma
HP:0012190.definition: A type of lymphoma that originates in T-cells.
HP:0012190.definition_cn: 一种起源于T细胞的淋巴瘤。

HP:0012191.name: B-cell lymphoma
HP:0012191.definition: A type of lymphoma that originates in B-cells.
HP:0012191.definition_cn: 一种起源于B细胞的淋巴瘤。

HP:0012192.name: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
HP:0012192.definition: A type of T-cell lymphoma that exhibits malignant infiltration of the skin.
HP:0012192.definition_cn: 一种表现为皮肤恶性浸润的T细胞淋巴瘤。

HP:0012193.name: Anaplastic large-cell lymphoma
HP:0012193.definition: A type of T-cell lymphoma that is characterized by so-called hallmark cells with a pleomorphic appearance that express the CD30 antigen, are lobulated, and have indented nuclei.
HP:0012193.definition_cn: 一种T细胞淋巴瘤，其特征为所谓的标志性细胞，这些细胞具有多形性外观，表达CD30抗原，呈分叶状，并具有凹陷的核。

HP:0012194.name: Episodic hemiplegia
HP:0012194.definition: Transient episodes of weakness of the arm, leg, and in some cases the face on one side of the body.
HP:0012194.definition_cn: 一过性单侧肢体（包括手臂、腿部）及部分病例中面部肌力减弱。

HP:0012196.name: Cheyne-Stokes respiration
HP:0012196.definition: An abnormal pattern of respiration characterized by cycles of respiration that are increasingly deeper then shallower with possible periods of apnea. Affected patients may display a 10 to 20 second episode of hypoventilation or apnea, followed by respiration of increased depth and frequency over the course of about one minute. The cycle repeats every 45 seconds to 3 minutes.
HP:0012196.definition_cn: 一种异常的呼吸模式，其特征为呼吸周期逐渐加深后变浅，可能伴有呼吸暂停期。受影响患者可能表现出10至20秒的低通气或呼吸暂停发作，随后在大约一分钟内出现深度和频率增加的呼吸。该周期每45秒至3分钟重复一次。

HP:0012197.name: Insulinoma
HP:0012197.definition: A type of tumor of the pancreatic beta cells that secretes excess insulin and can result in hypoglycemia.
HP:0012197.definition_cn: 一种胰腺β细胞肿瘤，分泌过量胰岛素，可导致低血糖症。

HP:0012198.name: Juvenile colonic polyposis
HP:0012198.definition: The presence of more than 5 juvenile polyps of the colon. The term juvenile polyps refer to a special histopathology and not the age of onset as the polyp might be diagnosed at all ages. The juvenile polyp has a spherical appearance and is microscopically characterized by overgrowth of an oedematous lamina propria with inflammatory cells and cystic glands.
HP:0012198.definition_cn: 结肠内存在超过5个幼年性息肉。术语“幼年性息肉”指的是特殊的组织病理学特征，而非发病年龄，因为该息肉可在任何年龄被诊断。幼年性息肉呈球形，显微镜下特征为水肿的固有层过度增生，伴有炎性细胞和囊性腺体。

HP:0012199.name: Cluster headache
HP:0012199.definition: A type of headache characterized by repeated attacks of unilateral pain lasting 15 to 180 minutes and associated with local autonomic signs.
HP:0012199.definition_cn: 一种以反复发作的单侧头痛为特征的头痛类型，每次发作持续15至180分钟，并伴有局部自主神经症状。

HP:0012200.name: Abnormality of prothrombin
HP:0012200.definition: An anomaly of clotting factor II, which is known as prothrombin, a vitamin K-dependent proenzyme that functions in the blood coagulation cascade.
HP:0012200.definition_cn: 凝血因子II异常，即凝血酶原异常，其为一种维生素K依赖性酶原，在血液凝固级联反应中发挥功能。

HP:0012201.name: obsolete Reduced prothrombin activity
HP:0012201.name_cn: 过时的 凝血酶原活性降低

HP:0012202.name: Increased serum bile acid concentration
HP:0012202.definition: An increase in the concentration of bile acid in the blood.
HP:0012202.definition_cn: 血液中胆汁酸浓度升高。

HP:0012203.name: Onychomycosis
HP:0012203.definition: A fungal infection of the toenails or fingernails that tends to cause the nails to thicken, discolor, disfigure, and split.
HP:0012203.definition_cn: 甲真菌病，一种累及趾甲或指甲的真菌感染，常导致甲板增厚、变色、畸形及劈裂。

HP:0012204.name: Recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis
HP:0012204.definition: Recurrent infection involving the vulva, vagina, and adjacent crural areas, whereby the causative agent belongs to the genus Candida.
HP:0012204.name_cn: 复发性外阴阴道念珠菌病
HP:0012204.definition_cn: 外阴、阴道及邻近腹股沟区域的复发性感染，其病原体为念珠菌属。

HP:0012205.name: Globozoospermia
HP:0012205.definition: Any structural anomaly of the acrosome resulting in a round sperm head.
HP:0012205.definition_cn: 顶体结构异常导致的圆形精子头部。

HP:0012206.name: Abnormal sperm motility
HP:0012206.definition: An anomaly of the mobility of ejaculated sperm.
HP:0012206.definition_cn: 射精后精子运动能力异常。

HP:0012207.name: Reduced sperm motility
HP:0012207.definition: An abnormal reduction in the mobility of ejaculated sperm.
HP:0012207.definition_cn: 射精后精子活动力异常降低。

HP:0012208.name: Immotile sperm
HP:0012208.definition: A lack of mobility of ejaculated sperm.

HP:0012209.name: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
HP:0012209.definition: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) is a lethal myeloproliferative disease of young childhood characterized clinically by overproduction of myelomonocytic cells and by the in vitro phenotype of hematopoietic progenitor hypersensitivity to granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor.
HP:0012209.name_cn: 幼年型粒单核细胞白血病
HP:0012209.definition_cn: 幼年型粒单核细胞白血病（Juvenile Myelomonocytic Leukemia, JMML）是一种致命的儿童期骨髓增殖性疾病，其临床特征为髓单核细胞过度生成，以及体外造血祖细胞对粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子（Granulocyte-Macrophage Colony-Stimulating Factor, GM-CSF）的超敏反应表型。

HP:0012210.name: Abnormal renal morphology
HP:0012210.definition: Any structural anomaly of the kidney.

HP:0012211.name: Abnormal renal physiology
HP:0012211.definition: An abnormal functionality of the kidney.

HP:0012212.name: Abnormal glomerular filtration rate
HP:0012212.definition: An abnormally increased or reduced amount of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.
HP:0012212.definition_cn: 单位时间内通过肾小球毛细血管壁滤入鲍曼囊的液体量异常增加或减少。

HP:0012213.name: Decreased glomerular filtration rate
HP:0012213.definition: An abnormal reduction in the volume of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.
HP:0012213.definition_cn: 单位时间内通过肾小球毛细血管壁滤入鲍曼囊的液体量异常减少。

HP:0012214.name: Increased glomerular filtration rate
HP:0012214.definition: An abnormal rise in the volume of water filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.
HP:0012214.definition_cn: 单位时间内通过肾小球毛细血管壁滤入鲍曼囊的血浆水容量异常增加。

HP:0012215.name: Testicular microlithiasis
HP:0012215.definition: The deposition of calcium phosphate microliths within the seminiferous tubules.
HP:0012215.definition_cn: 磷酸钙微石在生精小管内的沉积。

HP:0012216.name: Entrapment neuropathy of suprascapular nerve
HP:0012216.definition: An entrapment neuropathy of the suprascapular nerve, presenting with shoulder weakness confined to the supraspinatus muscle (this muscle initiates shoulder abduction) or to the infraspinatus (this muscle externally rotates the arm), as well as with pain in the posterior part of the shoulder and upper periscapular region.
HP:0012216.name_cn: 肩胛上神经卡压性神经病变
HP:0012216.definition_cn: 肩胛上神经卡压性神经病变，表现为局限于冈上肌（该肌负责肩关节外展的启动）或冈下肌（该肌负责手臂外旋）的肩部无力，以及肩后部和肩胛骨周围上区域的疼痛。

HP:0012217.name: Increased urinary porphobilinogen
HP:0012217.definition: The concentration of porphobilinogen in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0012217.definition_cn: 尿液中卟胆原浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0012218.name: Alveolar soft part sarcoma
HP:0012218.definition: A type of soft tissue sarcoma with a histological appearance reminiscent of alveoli because of its reticulated fibrous stroma enclosing groups of sarcoma cells, which resemble epithelial cells and are enclosed in alveoli walled with connective tissue.
HP:0012218.definition_cn: 一种软组织肉瘤，其组织学表现因网状纤维基质包裹肉瘤细胞群而类似于肺泡，这些肉瘤细胞类似于上皮细胞，并被包裹在由结缔组织构成的肺泡壁内。

HP:0012219.name: Erythema nodosum
HP:0012219.definition: An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral.
HP:0012219.definition_cn: 红斑性皮疹通常与药物反应或感染相关，其特征为炎性结节，通常具有压痛、多发且双侧分布。

HP:0012220.name: Non-caseating epithelioid cell granulomatosis
HP:0012220.definition: The presence of multiple epithelioid cell granulomas consist of highly differentiated mononuclear phagocytes (epithelioid cells and giant cells) and lymphocytes, not exhibiting caseation (a form of necrosis in which the tissue changes into a dry, amorphous mass said to resemble cheese).
HP:0012220.name_cn: 非干酪样上皮样细胞肉芽肿病
HP:0012220.definition_cn: 存在多个上皮样细胞肉芽肿，由高度分化的单核吞噬细胞（上皮样细胞和巨细胞）及淋巴细胞组成，未见干酪样坏死（一种坏死形式，组织转变为干燥、无定形的团块，类似奶酪）。

HP:0012221.name: Pretibial blistering
HP:0012221.definition: A type of blistering that affects the skin of the tibial region.
HP:0012221.definition_cn: 一种影响胫骨区域皮肤的水疱性病变。

HP:0012222.name: Arachnoid hemangiomatosis
HP:0012222.definition: The presence of multiple hemangiomas in the arachnoid.
HP:0012222.definition_cn: 蛛网膜内多发性血管瘤。

HP:0012223.name: Splenic rupture
HP:0012223.definition: A breach of the capsule of the spleen.

HP:0012224.name: Circulating immune complexes
HP:0012224.definition: Persistence of immune complexes in the blood circulation.
HP:0012224.definition_cn: 循环血液中免疫复合物的持续存在。

HP:0012226.name: Ovarian teratoma
HP:0012226.definition: The presence of a teratoma in the ovary.

HP:0012227.name: Urethral stricture
HP:0012227.definition: Narrowing of the urethra associated with inflammation or scar tissue.
HP:0012227.definition_cn: 尿道狭窄伴炎症或瘢痕组织形成。

HP:0012228.name: Tension-type headache
HP:0012228.definition: A type of headache that last hours with continuous pain of mild or moderate intensity, bilateral location, a pressing/tightening (non-pulsating) quality and that is not aggravated by routine physical activity such as walking or climbing stairs.
HP:0012228.definition_cn: 一种持续数小时的头痛，表现为轻度或中度强度的持续性疼痛，双侧分布，具有压迫/紧缩感（非搏动性），且不会因日常体力活动（如步行或爬楼梯）而加重。

HP:0012229.name: CSF pleocytosis
HP:0012229.definition: An increased white blood cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0012229.definition_cn: 脑脊液中白细胞计数升高。

HP:0012230.name: Rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
HP:0012230.definition: A type of retinal detachment associated with a retinal tear, that is, with a break in the retina that allows fluid to pass from the vitreous space into the subretinal space between the sensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:0012230.definition_cn: 一种与视网膜裂孔相关的视网膜脱离，即视网膜出现裂口，使液体能够从玻璃体腔进入感觉视网膜与视网膜色素上皮之间的视网膜下间隙。

HP:0012231.name: Exudative retinal detachment
HP:0012231.definition: A type of retinal detachment arising from damage to the outer blood-retinal barrier that allows fluid to access the subretinal space and separate the neurosensory retina from the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:0012231.definition_cn: 一种由外层血-视网膜屏障损伤引起的视网膜脱离，导致液体进入视网膜下间隙，使神经感觉层视网膜与视网膜色素上皮层分离。

HP:0012232.name: Shortened QT interval
HP:0012232.definition: Decreased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).
HP:0012232.definition_cn: Q波起始至T波结束时间缩短，通过心电图（EKG）测量。

HP:0012233.name: Intramuscular hematoma
HP:0012233.definition: Blood clot formed within muscle tissue following leakage of blood into the tissue.
HP:0012233.definition_cn: 肌肉组织内血肿后形成的血栓。

HP:0012234.name: Agranulocytosis
HP:0012234.definition: Marked decrease in the number of granulocytes.

HP:0012235.name: Drug-induced agranulocytosis
HP:0012235.definition: A type of agranulocytosis related to ingestion of a specific medication.
HP:0012235.definition_cn: 一种与摄入特定药物相关的粒细胞缺乏症。

HP:0012236.name: Elevated sweat chloride
HP:0012236.definition: An increased concentration of chloride in the sweat.
HP:0012236.definition_cn: 汗液中氯化物浓度升高。

HP:0012237.name: Urocanic aciduria
HP:0012237.definition: An increased concentration of urocanic acid in the urine.

HP:0012238.name: Increased circulating chylomicron concentration
HP:0012238.definition: Increased plasma concentrations of chylomicrons, the large lipid droplet (up to 100 mm in diameter) of reprocessed lipid synthesized in epithelial cells of the small intestine and containing triacylglycerols, cholesterol esters, and several apolipoproteins.
HP:0012238.name_cn: 循环中乳糜微粒浓度升高
HP:0012238.definition_cn: 血浆中乳糜微粒浓度升高，乳糜微粒为小肠上皮细胞中重新合成的脂质大颗粒（直径可达100微米），含有三酰甘油、胆固醇酯及多种载脂蛋白。

HP:0012239.name: Atransferrinemia
HP:0012239.definition: Absence of transferrin, a protein that transports iron, in the blood.

HP:0012240.name: Increased intramyocellular lipid droplets
HP:0012240.definition: An abnormal increase in intracellular lipid droplets In a muscle. The number and size of these drops can increase with somd disorders of lipid metabolism affecting muscle. See PMID 20691590 for histological images.
HP:0012240.definition_cn: 肌肉细胞内脂滴异常增多。在某些影响肌肉的脂质代谢紊乱中，这些脂滴的数量和大小可能会增加。参见PMID 20691590的组织学图像。

HP:0012241.name: Levator palpebrae superioris atrophy
HP:0012241.definition: Atrophy of the levator palpebrae superioris, the extraocular muscle that elevates the superior eyelid.
HP:0012241.definition_cn: 上睑提肌萎缩，即负责提升上眼睑的眼外肌发生萎缩。

HP:0012242.name: Superior rectus atrophy
HP:0012242.definition: Atrophy of the superior rectus, the extraocular muscle whose primary function is to elevate the globe.
HP:0012242.definition_cn: 上直肌萎缩，该眼外肌的主要功能是使眼球上抬。

HP:0012243.name: Abnormal reproductive system morphology
HP:0012243.definition: A structural or developmental anomaly of any of the tissues involved in the genital system.
HP:0012243.definition_cn: 生殖系统组织结构或发育异常。

HP:0012244.name: Abnormal sex determination
HP:0012244.definition: Anomaly of primary or secondary sexual development or characteristics.
HP:0012244.definition_cn: 原发性或继发性性发育或性特征异常。

HP:0012245.name: Sex reversal
HP:0012245.definition: Development of the reproductive system is inconsistent with the chromosomal sex.
HP:0012245.definition_cn: 生殖系统发育与染色体性别不一致。

HP:0012246.name: Oculomotor nerve palsy
HP:0012246.definition: Reduced ability to control the movement of the eye associated with damage to the third cranial nerve (the oculomotor nerve).
HP:0012246.definition_cn: 与第三脑神经（动眼神经）损伤相关的眼球运动控制能力下降。

HP:0012248.name: Prolonged PR interval
HP:0012248.definition: Increased time for the PR interval (beginning of the P wave to the beginning of the QRS complex).
HP:0012248.definition_cn: PR间期延长（从P波起始至QRS波群起始的时间增加）。

HP:0012249.name: Abnormal ST segment
HP:0012249.definition: An electrocardiographic anomaly of the ST segment, which is the segment that connects the QRS complex and the T wave. The ST segment normally has a duration of 80 to 120 ms, is flat and at the same level (isoelectric) as the PR and TP segment.
HP:0012249.definition_cn: ST段心电图异常，ST段是连接QRS波群和T波的节段。正常情况下，ST段持续时间为80至120毫秒，呈平坦状，并与PR段和TP段处于同一水平（等电位线）。

HP:0012250.name: ST segment depression
HP:0012250.definition: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located inferior to the isoelectric line.

HP:0012251.name: ST segment elevation
HP:0012251.definition: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located superior to the isoelectric line.

HP:0012252.name: Abnormal respiratory system morphology
HP:0012252.definition: A structural anomaly of the respiratory system.

HP:0012253.name: Abnormal respiratory epithelium morphology
HP:0012253.definition: Any structural anomaly of the pseudostratified ciliated epithelium that lines much of the conducting portion of the airway, including part of the nasal cavity and larynx, the trachea, and bronchi.
HP:0012253.definition_cn: 假复层纤毛上皮的结构异常，该上皮覆盖了气道传导部分的大部分区域，包括部分鼻腔和喉部、气管以及支气管。

HP:0012254.name: Ewing sarcoma
HP:0012254.definition: A malignant tumor of the bone which always arises in the medullary tissue, occurring more often in cylindrical bones.
HP:0012254.definition_cn: 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma），一种起源于骨髓组织的恶性肿瘤，多见于长骨。

HP:0012255.name: Dynein arm defect of respiratory motile cilia
HP:0012255.definition: An anomaly of the dynein arms of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.
HP:0012255.name_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛动力蛋白臂缺陷
HP:0012255.definition_cn: 运动纤毛动力蛋白臂异常。该特征通常通过电子显微镜观察。

HP:0012256.name: Absent outer dynein arms
HP:0012256.definition: Absence of the outer dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, which normally are situated outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.
HP:0012256.definition_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛外动力蛋白臂缺失，该结构通常位于运动纤毛外周微管的外侧。此特征通常通过电子显微镜观察确认。

HP:0012257.name: Absent inner dynein arms
HP:0012257.definition: Absence of the inner dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, which normally are situated within the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.
HP:0012257.definition_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛内动力蛋白臂缺失，该结构通常位于运动纤毛外周微管内部。此特征通常通过电子显微镜观察确认。

HP:0012258.name: Abnormal axonemal organization of respiratory motile cilia
HP:0012258.definition: Abnormal arrangement of the structures of the axoneme, which is the cytoskeletal structure that forms the inner core of the motile cilium and displays a canonical 9+2 microtubular pattern of motile cilia studded with dynein arms.
HP:0012258.name_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛轴丝结构异常
HP:0012258.definition_cn: 轴丝结构异常排列，轴丝是构成运动纤毛内部核心的细胞骨架结构，呈现典型的9+2微管模式，运动纤毛上布满动力蛋白臂。

HP:0012259.name: Absent inner and outer dynein arms
HP:0012259.definition: Complete absence of the dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, that is, absence of the inner and the outer dynein arms, which normally are situated inside and outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.
HP:0012259.definition_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛动力蛋白臂完全缺失，即内动力蛋白臂和外动力蛋白臂均缺失，这些动力蛋白臂通常位于运动纤毛外周微管的内侧和外侧。这一特征通常通过电子显微镜观察得以确认。

HP:0012260.name: Abnormal central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilia
HP:0012260.definition: A structural anomaly of the two central microtubules of motile cilia with a 9+2 microtubuluar configuration.
HP:0012260.name_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛中央微管对形态异常
HP:0012260.definition_cn: 具有9+2微管结构的运动纤毛中央微管对的结构异常。

HP:0012261.name: Abnormal respiratory motile cilium physiology
HP:0012261.definition: Any functional anomaly of the respiratory motile cilia.
HP:0012261.name_cn: 异常呼吸运动纤毛生理学
HP:0012261.definition_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛的任何功能性异常。

HP:0012262.name: Abnormal ciliary motility
HP:0012262.definition: Any anomaly of the normal motility of motile cilia. Evaluation of ciliary beat frequency and ciliary beat pattern requires high-speed videomicroscopy of freshly obtained ciliary biopsies that are maintained in culture media under controlled conditions.
HP:0012262.definition_cn: 纤毛运动异常（Any anomaly of the normal motility of motile cilia）。纤毛搏动频率（ciliary beat frequency）和纤毛搏动模式（ciliary beat pattern）的评估需要在受控条件下，对新鲜获取并在培养基中维持的纤毛活检样本进行高速视频显微镜（high-speed videomicroscopy）检查。

HP:0012264.name: Absent central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilia
HP:0012264.definition: Absence of the two central microtubules of motile cilia with a 9+2 microtubuluar configuration.
HP:0012264.name_cn: 呼吸运动纤毛中央微管对缺失形态学
HP:0012264.definition_cn: 运动纤毛的9+2微管结构中缺失两根中央微管。

HP:0012265.name: Ciliary dyskinesia
HP:0012265.definition: A deviation from the normally well coordinated pattern of intracellular and intercellular synchrony of motile cilia. Dyskinetic cilia usually beat out of synchrony relative to neighboring cilia.
HP:0012265.definition_cn: 细胞内和细胞间运动纤毛同步协调模式的异常。运动障碍性纤毛通常与邻近纤毛的节律不同步。

HP:0012266.name: T-wave alternans
HP:0012266.definition: A periodic beat-to-beat variation in the amplitude or shape of the T wave in an EKG.
HP:0012266.definition_cn: 心电图T波振幅或形态的周期性逐搏变异。

HP:0012267.name: Absent respiratory ciliary axoneme radial spokes
HP:0012267.definition: Absence of the radial spokes of the axoneme of the respiratory cilium.
HP:0012267.name_cn: 呼吸纤毛轴丝放射辐缺失
HP:0012267.definition_cn: 呼吸纤毛轴丝放射辐缺失。

HP:0012268.name: Myxoid liposarcoma
HP:0012268.definition: A liposarcoma that contains myxomatous tissue.
HP:0012268.definition_cn: 含有黏液样组织的脂肪肉瘤。

HP:0012269.name: Abnormal muscle glycogen content
HP:0012269.definition: Any anomaly in the amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.
HP:0012269.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中糖原含量的异常。

HP:0012270.name: Decreased muscle glycogen content
HP:0012270.definition: A decreased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.
HP:0012270.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中糖原含量减少。

HP:0012271.name: Episodic upper airway obstruction
HP:0012271.definition: Intermittent episodes of increased resistance to the passage of air in the upper airway.
HP:0012271.definition_cn: 上气道间歇性气流阻力增加发作。

HP:0012272.name: J wave
HP:0012272.definition: The J wave is a positive convex deflection that occurs at the junction of the QRS complex and ST segment, the J-point.
HP:0012272.definition_cn: J波是指在QRS波群与ST段交界处即J点出现的正向凸起性偏移。

HP:0012273.name: Increased carotid artery intimal medial thickness
HP:0012273.definition: An increase in the combined thickness of the intima and media of the carotid artery.
HP:0012273.name_cn: 颈动脉内膜中层厚度增加
HP:0012273.definition_cn: 颈动脉内膜和中膜联合厚度增加。

HP:0012274.name: Autosomal dominant inheritance with paternal imprinting
HP:0012274.definition: A type of autosomal dominant inheritance involving a gene that is imprinted with paternal silencing.
HP:0012274.name_cn: 常染色体显性遗传伴父系印记
HP:0012274.definition_cn: 一种涉及父系印记基因沉默的常染色体显性遗传类型。

HP:0012275.name: Autosomal dominant inheritance with maternal imprinting
HP:0012275.definition: A type of autosomal dominant inheritance involving a gene that is imprinted with maternal silencing.
HP:0012275.name_cn: 常染色体显性遗传伴母源印记
HP:0012275.definition_cn: 一种涉及母源印记基因沉默的常染色体显性遗传类型。

HP:0012276.name: Digital flexor tenosynovitis
HP:0012276.definition: Inflammation of the flexor digitorum tendon, often associated with the Kanavel signs: (i) finger held in slight flexion, (ii) fusiform swelling, (iii) tenderness along the flexor tendon sheath, and (iv) pain with passive extension of the digit.
HP:0012276.definition_cn: 屈指肌腱炎，常与Kanavel征相关：（i）手指呈轻度屈曲位，（ii）梭形肿胀，（iii）沿屈肌腱鞘压痛，（iv）被动伸展手指时疼痛。

HP:0012277.name: Hypoglycinemia
HP:0012277.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of glycine in the blood.

HP:0012278.name: Abnormal circulating serine concentration
HP:0012278.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of serine in the blood circulation.

HP:0012279.name: Hyposerinemia
HP:0012279.definition: Reduced concentration of serine in the blood.
HP:0012279.definition_cn: 血液中丝氨酸浓度降低。

HP:0012280.name: Hepatic amyloidosis
HP:0012280.definition: A form of amyloidosis that affects the liver.
HP:0012280.definition_cn: 一种累及肝脏的淀粉样变性病。

HP:0012281.name: Chylous ascites
HP:0012281.definition: Extravasation of chyle into the peritoneal cavity.

HP:0012282.name: Morbilliform rash
HP:0012282.definition: An exanthema consisting of widespread pink-to-red macules (flat spots of 2-10 mm in diameter) or papules (red bumps) that blanch with pressure. The macules and papules may cluster and merge to form sheets over several days.
HP:0012282.definition_cn: 一种由广泛分布的粉红色至红色斑疹（直径2-10毫米的平坦斑点）或丘疹（红色隆起）组成的皮疹，按压后可褪色。这些斑疹和丘疹可能在数天内聚集并融合形成片状皮疹。

HP:0012283.name: Small distal femoral epiphysis
HP:0012283.definition: Reduced size of the Distal epiphysis of femur.
HP:0012283.definition_cn: 股骨远端骨骺体积缩小。

HP:0012284.name: Small proximal tibial epiphyses
HP:0012284.definition: Reduced size of the proximal epiphysis of the tibia.
HP:0012284.definition_cn: 胫骨近端骨骺体积缩小。

HP:0012285.name: Abnormal hypothalamus physiology
HP:0012285.definition: An abnormal functionality of the hypothalamus.

HP:0012286.name: Abnormal hypothalamus morphology
HP:0012286.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hypothalamus.
HP:0012286.definition_cn: 下丘脑的任何结构异常。

HP:0012287.name: Hypothalamic luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone deficiency
HP:0012287.definition: Decreased secretion of luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone by the hypothalamus.
HP:0012287.name_cn: 下丘脑促黄体生成素释放激素缺乏症
HP:0012287.definition_cn: 下丘脑黄体生成素释放激素分泌减少。

HP:0012288.name: Neoplasm of head and neck
HP:0012288.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the head and neck region with origin in the lip, oral cavity, nasal cavity, paranasal sinuses, pharynx, or larynx.
HP:0012288.definition_cn: 头颈部肿瘤（组织异常增生），起源于唇部、口腔、鼻腔、鼻旁窦、咽部或喉部。

HP:0012289.name: Facial neoplasm
HP:0012289.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the face.
HP:0012289.definition_cn: 面部肿瘤（组织异常增生）

HP:0012292.name: Fusion of gums
HP:0012292.definition: A congenital defect with an abnormal joining of the gums of the upper and lower jaw.

HP:0012293.name: Abnormal genital pigmentation
HP:0012293.definition: An abnormal pigmentation pattern of the external genitalia.
HP:0012293.definition_cn: 外生殖器色素沉着异常模式。

HP:0012294.name: Abnormal occipital bone morphology
HP:0012294.definition: Abnormality of the occipital bone of the skull.

HP:0012295.name: Slender middle phalanx of finger
HP:0012295.definition: Reduced diameter of the middle phalanx of finger.
HP:0012295.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨直径减小。

HP:0012296.name: Slender distal phalanx of finger
HP:0012296.definition: Reduced diameter of the distal phalanx of finger.
HP:0012296.definition_cn: 手指远节指骨直径减小。

HP:0012297.name: Slender proximal phalanx of finger
HP:0012297.definition: Reduced diameter of the proximal phalanx of finger.
HP:0012297.definition_cn: 手指近节指骨直径减小。

HP:0012298.name: Long middle phalanx of finger
HP:0012298.definition: Increased length of the middle phalanx of finger.
HP:0012298.definition_cn: 中指中节指骨长度增加。

HP:0012299.name: Long distal phalanx of finger
HP:0012299.definition: Increased length of the distal phalanx of finger.
HP:0012299.definition_cn: 手指远节指骨长度增加。

HP:0012300.name: Ureteral agenesis
HP:0012300.definition: Failure of the ureter to undergo development.

HP:0012301.name: Type II transferrin isoform profile
HP:0012301.definition: Abnormal transferrin isoform profile consistent with a type II congenital disorder of glycosylation.
HP:0012301.definition_cn: 转铁蛋白同工型谱异常，符合II型先天性糖基化障碍。

HP:0012302.name: Herpes simplex encephalitis
HP:0012302.definition: Infection of the brain parenchyma with herpes simplex virus, resulting in inflammation of the brain parenchyma with neurologic dysfunction.
HP:0012302.definition_cn: 单纯疱疹病毒性脑实质感染，导致脑实质炎症并伴有神经功能障碍。

HP:0012303.name: Abnormal aortic arch morphology
HP:0012303.definition: An anomaly of the arch of aorta.

HP:0012304.name: Hypoplastic aortic arch
HP:0012304.definition: Underdevelopment of the arch of aorta.

HP:0012305.name: Coarctation of the descending aortic arch
HP:0012305.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized to the region of the descending trunk of arch of aorta.
HP:0012305.definition_cn: 主动脉弓降部局部狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0012306.name: Abnormal rib ossification
HP:0012306.definition: An anomaly of the process of rib bone formation.

HP:0012307.name: Spatulate ribs
HP:0012307.definition: Ribs that are increased in width and taper to the posterior ends.
HP:0012307.definition_cn: 肋骨增宽并向后逐渐变细。

HP:0012308.name: Decreased circulating complement C9 concentration
HP:0012308.definition: Concentration of the complement component C9 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0012308.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C9浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0012309.name: Cutaneous amyloidosis
HP:0012309.definition: The presence of amyloid deposition in the superficial dermis.
HP:0012309.definition_cn: 浅层真皮层淀粉样蛋白沉积。

HP:0012310.name: Abnormal monocyte count
HP:0012310.definition: An anomaly in the number of monocytes, which are myeloid mononuclear recirculating leukocyte that can act as a precursor of tissue macrophages, osteoclasts and some populations of tissue dendritic cells.
HP:0012310.definition_cn: 单核细胞数量异常，单核细胞是一种髓系单核再循环白细胞，可作为组织巨噬细胞、破骨细胞及部分组织树突状细胞的前体细胞。

HP:0012311.name: Monocytosis
HP:0012311.definition: An increased number of circulating monocytes.

HP:0012312.name: Monocytopenia
HP:0012312.definition: An decreased number of circulating monocytes.

HP:0012313.name: Heberden's node
HP:0012313.definition: Bony swelling of the distal interphalangeal joint (DIP) associated with the formation of osteophytes (calcific spurs) of the articular (joint) cartilage that are visible radiographically.
HP:0012313.definition_cn: 远端指间关节（DIP）的骨性肿胀，伴随关节软骨的骨赘（钙化性骨刺）形成，影像学上可见。

HP:0012314.name: Bouchard's node
HP:0012314.definition: Bony swelling of the proximal interphalangeal joint (PIP) associated with the formation of osteophytes (calcific spurs) of the articular (joint) cartilage that are visible radiographically.
HP:0012314.definition_cn: 近端指间关节（PIP）的骨性肿胀，伴随关节软骨的骨赘（钙化性骨刺）形成，影像学上可见。

HP:0012316.name: Fibrous tissue neoplasm
HP:0012316.definition: Any neoplasm composed of fibrous tissue.
HP:0012316.definition_cn: 纤维组织构成的任何肿瘤。

HP:0012317.name: Sacroiliac arthritis
HP:0012317.definition: Inflammation of the sacroiliac joint, generally accompanied by lower back pain.
HP:0012317.definition_cn: 骶髂关节炎症，通常伴随下腰痛。

HP:0012318.name: Occipital neuralgia
HP:0012318.definition: A distinct type of headache characterized by piercing, throbbing, or electric-shock-like chronic pain in the upper neck, back of the head, and behind the ears, usually on one side.
HP:0012318.definition_cn: 一种特殊类型的头痛，其特征为上颈部、枕部及耳后区域出现针刺样、搏动性或电击样慢性疼痛，通常为单侧发作。

HP:0012319.name: Absent pigmentation of the abdomen
HP:0012319.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the abdomen.
HP:0012319.definition_cn: 腹部皮肤色素沉着缺失。

HP:0012320.name: Absent pigmentation of the limbs
HP:0012320.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the arms and legs.
HP:0012320.definition_cn: 四肢皮肤色素沉着缺失。

HP:0012321.name: D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria
HP:0012321.definition: An increased concentration of 2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine.
HP:0012321.definition_cn: 尿液中2-羟基戊二酸浓度升高。

HP:0012323.name: Sleep myoclonus
HP:0012323.definition: Myoclonus that occurs during the initial phases of sleep.
HP:0012323.definition_cn: 睡眠初期发生的肌阵挛。

HP:0012324.name: Myeloid leukemia
HP:0012324.definition: A leukemia that originates from a myeloid cell, that is the blood forming cells of the bone marrow.
HP:0012324.definition_cn: 一种起源于髓系细胞的白血病，即骨髓中的造血细胞。

HP:0012325.name: Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
HP:0012325.definition: A myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm which is characterized by persistent monocytosis, absence of a Philadelphia chromosome and BCR/ABL fusion gene, fewer than 20 percent blasts in the bone marrow and blood, myelodysplasia, and absence of PDGFRA or PDGFRB rearrangement.
HP:0012325.name_cn: 慢性粒单核细胞白血病
HP:0012325.definition_cn: 一种骨髓增生异常/骨髓增殖性肿瘤，其特征为持续性单核细胞增多，无费城染色体和BCR/ABL融合基因，骨髓和外周血中原始细胞少于20%，存在骨髓增生异常，且无PDGFRA或PDGFRB重排。

HP:0012326.name: Abnormal celiac artery morphology
HP:0012326.definition: An anomaly of the celiac artery.

HP:0012328.name: Cementoma
HP:0012328.definition: An odontogenic tumor of the cementum of tooth.

HP:0012329.name: Tufted angioma
HP:0012329.definition: A vascular tumor of the skin and subcutaneous tissues and characterized by slow angiomatous proliferation.
HP:0012329.definition_cn: 皮肤及皮下组织的血管肿瘤，其特征为缓慢的血管瘤性增生。

HP:0012330.name: Pyelonephritis
HP:0012330.definition: An inflammation of the kidney involving the parenchyma of kidney, the renal pelvis and the kidney calices.
HP:0012330.definition_cn: 肾脏炎症，累及肾实质、肾盂及肾盏。

HP:0012331.name: Abnormal autonomic nervous system morphology
HP:0012331.definition: A structural abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.
HP:0012331.name_cn: 自主神经系统形态异常
HP:0012331.definition_cn: 自主神经系统结构异常

HP:0012332.name: Abnormal autonomic nervous system physiology
