HP:0012332.definition: A functional abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.
HP:0012332.name_cn: 自主神经系统生理功能异常
HP:0012332.definition_cn: 自主神经系统功能障碍。

HP:0012333.name: Abnormal sudomotor regulation
HP:0012333.definition: An abnormal regulation of the sweat glands by the sympathetic nervous system associated with abnormal perspiration.
HP:0012333.definition_cn: 交感神经系统对汗腺的异常调节，伴随异常出汗。

HP:0012334.name: Extrahepatic cholestasis
HP:0012334.definition: Impairment of bile flow due to obstruction in large bile ducts outside the liver.
HP:0012334.definition_cn: 肝外大胆管梗阻导致的胆汁流动障碍。

HP:0012335.name: Abnormality of folate metabolism
HP:0012335.definition: An abnormality of the metabolism of folic acid, which is also known as vitamin B9.
HP:0012335.definition_cn: 叶酸代谢异常，叶酸亦称为维生素B9。

HP:0012336.name: obsolete Reduced cerebrospinal fluid 5-methyltetrahydrofolate concentration
HP:0012336.name_cn: 过时的 脑脊液5-甲基四氢叶酸浓度降低

HP:0012337.name: Abnormal homeostasis
HP:0012337.definition: An anomaly in the processes involved in the maintenance of an internal equilibrium.
HP:0012337.definition_cn: 内环境稳态维持过程中的异常。

HP:0012338.name: Abnormal energy expenditure
HP:0012338.definition: Any anomaly in the utilization of energy (calories).
HP:0012338.definition_cn: 能量（卡路里）利用过程中的任何异常。

HP:0012339.name: Increased resting energy expenditure
HP:0012339.definition: An increase in the number of calories used per unit time.
HP:0012339.definition_cn: 单位时间内卡路里消耗量的增加。

HP:0012340.name: Decreased resting energy expenditure
HP:0012340.definition: A reduction in the number of calories used per unit time.
HP:0012340.definition_cn: 单位时间内热量消耗减少。

HP:0012341.name: Microprolactinoma
HP:0012341.definition: A pituitary prolactin cell adenoma of less than 10 mm diameter.
HP:0012341.definition_cn: 直径小于10毫米的垂体泌乳素细胞腺瘤。

HP:0012342.name: Macroprolactinoma
HP:0012342.definition: A pituitary prolactin cell adenoma of more than 10 mm diameter.
HP:0012342.definition_cn: 直径超过10毫米的垂体泌乳素细胞腺瘤。

HP:0012343.name: Decreased circulating ferritin concentration
HP:0012343.definition: Abnormally reduced concentration of ferritin, a ubiquitous intracellular protein that stores iron, in the blood.
HP:0012343.definition_cn: 血液中铁蛋白浓度异常降低。铁蛋白是一种广泛存在于细胞内的蛋白质，负责储存铁。

HP:0012344.name: Morphea
HP:0012344.definition_cn: 孤立性皮肤硬化斑块（硬皮病）。

HP:0012345.name: Abnormal glycosylation
HP:0012345.definition: An anomaly of a glycosylation process, i.e., a process involved in the covalent attachment of a glycosyl residue to a substrate molecule.
HP:0012345.definition_cn: 糖基化过程异常，即涉及糖基残基与底物分子共价连接的生物化学过程发生异常。

HP:0012346.name: Abnormal protein glycosylation
HP:0012346.definition: An anomaly of a protein glycosylation process, i.e., of a protein modification process that results in the addition of a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit to a protein amino acid, e.g. the addition of glycan chains to proteins.
HP:0012346.definition_cn: 蛋白质糖基化过程异常，即蛋白质修饰过程中导致碳水化合物或碳水化合物衍生物单位添加到蛋白质氨基酸上的异常，例如将聚糖链添加到蛋白质上。

HP:0012347.name: Abnormal protein N-linked glycosylation
HP:0012347.definition: An anomaly of protein N-linked glycosylation, i.e., an abnormality of the protein glycosylation process in which a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit is added to a protein via a nitrogen atom in an amino acid residue in a protein.
HP:0012347.name_cn: 异常蛋白质N-连接糖基化
HP:0012347.definition_cn: 蛋白质N-连接糖基化异常，即蛋白质糖基化过程中的一种异常现象，其中碳水化合物或碳水化合物衍生物单位通过蛋白质中氨基酸残基的氮原子连接到蛋白质上。

HP:0012348.name: Decreased galactosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012348.definition: A reduction in the amount of galactose residues of N-glycans.
HP:0012348.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化的半乳糖基化减少
HP:0012348.definition_cn: N-聚糖中半乳糖残基数量的减少。

HP:0012349.name: Abnormal sialylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012349.definition: An anomaly of the addition of sialic acids to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012349.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化异常唾液酸化
HP:0012349.definition_cn: 唾液酸添加到N-连接聚糖的异常。

HP:0012350.name: Decreased sialylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012350.definition: Decreased addition of sialic acids to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012350.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化的唾液酸化减少
HP:0012350.definition_cn: N-连接聚糖的唾液酸添加减少。

HP:0012351.name: Increased sialylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012351.definition: Increased addition of sialic acids to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012351.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化中唾液酸化增加
HP:0012351.definition_cn: N-连接聚糖中唾液酸的增加。

HP:0012352.name: Abnormal fucosylation of protein N-linked glycosylation
HP:0012352.definition: An anomaly of the addition of fucose sugar units to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012352.name_cn: 蛋白质N-连接糖基化的异常岩藻糖基化
HP:0012352.definition_cn: N-连接聚糖中岩藻糖单元添加异常。

HP:0012353.name: Decreased fucosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012353.definition: Decreased addition of fucose sugar units to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012353.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化的岩藻糖基化减少
HP:0012353.definition_cn: N-连接聚糖中岩藻糖基化减少。

HP:0012354.name: Increased fucosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012354.definition: Increased addition of fucose sugar units to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012354.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化的岩藻糖基化增加
HP:0012354.definition_cn: N-连接聚糖中岩藻糖糖基单位的增加。

HP:0012355.name: Abnormal mannosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012355.definition: An anomaly of the addition of mannose to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012355.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化中的异常甘露糖基化
HP:0012355.definition_cn: 甘露糖添加到N-连接聚糖的异常。

HP:0012356.name: Decreased mannosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012356.definition: Reduced addition of mannose to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012356.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化中甘露糖基化减少
HP:0012356.definition_cn: 甘露糖向N-连接聚糖的添加减少。

HP:0012357.name: Increased mannosylation of N-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012357.definition: Increased addition of mannose to N-linked glycans.
HP:0012357.name_cn: N-连接蛋白糖基化中甘露糖基化增加
HP:0012357.definition_cn: N-连接聚糖中甘露糖的添加增加。

HP:0012358.name: Abnormal protein O-linked glycosylation
HP:0012358.definition: An anomaly of protein O-linked glycosylation, i.e., of the process in which a carbohydrate or carbohydrate derivative unit is added to a protein via the hydroxyl group of a serine or threonine residue.
HP:0012358.name_cn: 异常蛋白质O-连接糖基化
HP:0012358.definition_cn: 蛋白质O-连接糖基化异常，即碳水化合物或碳水化合物衍生物单位通过丝氨酸或苏氨酸残基的羟基添加到蛋白质的过程异常。

HP:0012359.name: Abnormal fucosylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012359.definition: An anomaly of the addition of fucose sugar units to O-linked glycans.
HP:0012359.name_cn: O-连接蛋白糖基化的异常岩藻糖基化
HP:0012359.definition_cn: 岩藻糖单位添加到O-连接聚糖的异常。

HP:0012360.name: Decreased fucosylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012360.definition: A reduction of the addition of fucose sugar units to O-linked glycans.
HP:0012360.name_cn: O-连接蛋白糖基化的岩藻糖基化减少
HP:0012360.definition_cn: O-连接聚糖中岩藻糖单元添加的减少。

HP:0012361.name: Increased fucosylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012361.definition: Increased addition of fucose sugar units to O-linked glycans.
HP:0012361.name_cn: O-连接蛋白糖基化的岩藻糖基化增加
HP:0012361.definition_cn: O-连接聚糖中岩藻糖糖基单位的增加。

HP:0012362.name: Abnormal sialylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012362.definition: An anomaly of the addition of sialic acids to O-linked glycans.
HP:0012362.name_cn: O-连接蛋白糖基化异常唾液酸化
HP:0012362.definition_cn: 唾液酸添加至O-连接聚糖的异常。

HP:0012363.name: Decreased sialylation of O-linked protein glycosylation
HP:0012363.definition: An reduced addition of sialic acids to O-linked glycans.
HP:0012363.name_cn: O-连接蛋白糖基化的唾液酸化减少
HP:0012363.definition_cn: O-连接聚糖中唾液酸的添加减少。

HP:0012364.name: Decreased urinary potassium
HP:0012364.definition: A decreased concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

HP:0012365.name: Hypophosphaturia
HP:0012365.definition: An abnormally decreased phosphate concentration in the urine.

HP:0012366.name: Basilar invagination
HP:0012366.definition: Projection of the tip of the dens more than 5 mm above a line joining the hard palate to the posterior lip of the foramen magnum (Chamberlain's line) or the tip of the dens is greater than 7 mm above McGregor's line (the back of the hard palate to the lowest point of the occipital squama).
HP:0012366.definition_cn: 齿状突尖端投影超过硬腭至枕骨大孔后唇连线（Chamberlain线）5毫米以上，或齿状突尖端超过硬腭后缘至枕骨鳞部最低点连线（McGregor线）7毫米以上。

HP:0012367.name: Extra fontanelles
HP:0012367.definition: Bony defects situated along the cranial suture lines or at the junction of the bone plates of the skull.
HP:0012367.definition_cn: 位于颅缝线或颅骨骨板交界处的骨缺损。

HP:0012368.name: Flat face
HP:0012368.definition: Absence of concavity or convexity of the face when viewed in profile.
HP:0012368.definition_cn: 面部侧面观无凹陷或凸起。

HP:0012370.name: Prominence of the zygomatic bone
HP:0012370.definition: Large or prominent malar surface of the zygomatic bone of the skull, which is convex and forms the prominence of the 'cheek bones'.
HP:0012370.definition_cn: 颅骨颧骨的大而显著的颧骨表面，呈凸起状，形成“颧骨”的突出部分。

HP:0012371.name: Hyperplasia of midface
HP:0012371.definition: Abnormally anterior positioning of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased convexity of the face, or increased nasolabial angle. The midface includes the maxilla, the cheeks, the zygomas, and the infraorbital and perialar regions of the face
HP:0012371.definition_cn: 眶下区和鼻翼周围区域异常前移，或面部凸度增加，或鼻唇角增大。中面部包括上颌骨、颊部、颧骨以及面部的眶下区和鼻翼周围区域。

HP:0012372.name: Abnormal eye morphology
HP:0012372.definition: A structural anomaly of the globe of the eye, or bulbus oculi.
HP:0012372.definition_cn: 眼球结构异常，或称为眼球（bulbus oculi）结构畸形。

HP:0012373.name: Abnormal eye physiology
HP:0012373.definition: A functional anomaly of the eye.

HP:0012377.name: Hemianopia
HP:0012377.definition: Partial or complete loss of vision in one half of the visual field of one or both eyes.
HP:0012377.definition_cn: 单眼或双眼视野中一半部分或完全丧失视力。

HP:0012378.name: Fatigue
HP:0012378.definition: A subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.
HP:0012378.definition_cn: 主观性疲劳感，表现为能量缺乏和动机减退。

HP:0012379.name: Abnormal circulating enzyme concentration or activity
HP:0012379.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:0012379.name_cn: 异常循环酶浓度或活性
HP:0012379.definition_cn: 酶浓度或活性在血液循环中高于或低于正常范围。

HP:0012380.name: Reduced tissue carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase 2 activity
HP:0012380.definition: Reduced carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase (CPT II; EC 2.3.1.21) activity or level, leading to a reduced activity of the reaction: palmitoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = CoA + L-palmitoylcarnitine. (CPT II activity can be measured in tissues including fibroblasts, lymphoblasts, and skeletal muscle.
HP:0012380.name_cn: 组织肉碱O-棕榈酰转移酶2活性降低
HP:0012380.definition_cn: 肉碱O-棕榈酰转移酶（CPT II；EC 2.3.1.21）活性或水平降低，导致反应活性降低：棕榈酰-CoA + L-肉碱 = CoA + L-棕榈酰肉碱。（CPT II活性可在包括成纤维细胞、淋巴母细胞和骨骼肌在内的组织中测量。）

HP:0012381.name: Delayed self-feeding during toddler years
HP:0012381.definition: A delay in the development of skills required to feed oneself in the toddler period (between one and three years of age).
HP:0012381.definition_cn: 幼儿期（1至3岁）自我进食技能发育迟缓。

HP:0012382.name: Left-to-right shunt
HP:0012382.definition: Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from the left side of the heart to the right.
HP:0012382.definition_cn: 心脏内血流模式偏离正常循环系统从左心至右心的循环路径。

HP:0012383.name: Bidirectional shunt
HP:0012383.definition: Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from both right side of the heart to the left and vice versa.
HP:0012383.definition_cn: 心脏血流模式偏离正常循环系统路径，即从心脏右侧流向左侧或反之。

HP:0012384.name: Rhinitis
HP:0012384.definition: Inflammation of the nasal mucosa with nasal congestion.

HP:0012385.name: Camptodactyly
HP:0012385.definition: The distal interphalangeal joint and/or the proximal interphalangeal joint of the fingers or toes cannot be extended to 180 degrees by either active or passive extension.
HP:0012385.definition_cn: 手指或足趾的远端指间关节和/或近端指间关节无法通过主动或被动伸展达到180度。

HP:0012386.name: Absent hallux
HP:0012386.definition: Aplasia of the hallux, that is, a development defect such that the big toe does not develop.
HP:0012386.definition_cn: 拇趾发育不全，即一种发育缺陷，导致大脚趾未能正常发育。

HP:0012387.name: Bronchitis
HP:0012387.definition: Inflammation of the large airways in the lung including any part of the bronchi from the primary bronchi to the tertiary bronchi.
HP:0012387.definition_cn: 肺部大气道的炎症，包括从主支气管到三级支气管的任何部分。

HP:0012388.name: Acute bronchitis
HP:0012388.definition: Inflammation of the large airways of the lung with rapid onset and short course usually associated with cough, mucus production, shortness of breath, wheezing, and chest tightness.
HP:0012388.definition_cn: 急性支气管炎，通常表现为快速起病和短期病程，常伴有咳嗽、痰液分泌、呼吸困难、喘息和胸闷。

HP:0012389.name: Appendicular hypotonia
HP:0012389.definition: Muscular hypotonia of one or more limbs.
HP:0012389.definition_cn: 单肢或多肢肌张力减退。

HP:0012390.name: Anal fissure
HP:0012390.definition: A small tear in the thin, moist tissue (mucosa) that lines the anus. It appears as a crack or slit in the mucous membrane of the anus.
HP:0012390.definition_cn: 肛门黏膜微小撕裂。表现为肛门黏膜出现裂隙或裂口。

HP:0012391.name: Hyporeflexia of upper limbs
HP:0012391.definition: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in the upper limbs. Reflexes are elicited by stretching the tendon of a muscle, e.g., by tapping.
HP:0012391.definition_cn: 上肢肌腱反射强度减弱。反射通过拉伸肌肉肌腱（例如叩击）引出。

HP:0012392.name: Jaw hyporeflexia
HP:0012392.definition: Reduced intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in jaw.
HP:0012392.definition_cn: 下颌肌腱反射强度减弱。

HP:0012393.name: Allergy
HP:0012393.definition: An allergy is an immune response or reaction to substances that are usually not harmful.
HP:0012393.definition_cn: 过敏是一种对通常无害物质产生的免疫反应或应答。

HP:0012394.name: Iodine contrast allergy
HP:0012394.definition: Allergy to iodine contrast media used in radiological studies.
HP:0012394.definition_cn: 对放射学检查中使用的碘造影剂过敏。

HP:0012395.name: Seasonal allergy
HP:0012395.definition: An allergy experienced at a particular time of year when trees or grasses pollinate and elicit an allergic reaction.
HP:0012395.definition_cn: 季节性过敏性鼻炎（Seasonal Allergic Rhinitis），又称花粉症（Hay Fever），是指在特定季节因树木或草本植物花粉释放而引发的过敏反应。

HP:0012396.name: Biliary dyskinesia
HP:0012396.definition: A motility disorder characterized by biliary colic in the absence of gallstones with a reduced gallbladder ejection fraction.
HP:0012396.definition_cn: 一种以无胆结石性胆绞痛伴胆囊排空分数降低为特征的运动功能障碍。

HP:0012397.name: Aortic atherosclerotic lesion
HP:0012397.definition: The presence of atheromas or atherosclerotic plaques in the aorta.
HP:0012397.definition_cn: 主动脉粥样硬化斑块或动脉粥样硬化斑块的存在。

HP:0012398.name: Peripheral edema
HP:0012398.definition: An abnormal accumulation of interstitial fluid in the soft tissues of the limbs.
HP:0012398.definition_cn: 肢体软组织间质液异常积聚。

HP:0012399.name: Pressure ulcer
HP:0012399.definition: A type of ulcer that is caused when an area of skin is subject to pressure over a prolonged period of time, ranging in range in severity from patches of discolored skin to open wounds that expose the underlying bone or muscle. The most common sites are the sacrum, coccyx, heels and the hips.
HP:0012399.definition_cn: 一种由于皮肤长时间受压而导致的溃疡，其严重程度从皮肤变色斑块到暴露下方骨骼或肌肉的开放性伤口不等。最常见的部位包括骶骨、尾骨、脚跟和髋部。

HP:0012400.name: Abnormal circulating aldolase concentration
HP:0012400.definition: An abnormal concentration of aldolase in the serum. Aldolase is an enzyme responsible for converting fructose 1,6-bisphosphate into the triose phosphates dihydroxyacetone phosphate and glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate.
HP:0012400.definition_cn: 血清中醛缩酶浓度异常。醛缩酶是一种负责将果糖1,6-二磷酸转化为磷酸二羟丙酮和3-磷酸甘油醛的酶。

HP:0012401.name: Abnormal urine alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
HP:0012401.definition: A deviation from normal of the concentration of 2-oxoglutaric acid in the urine.
HP:0012401.name_cn: 尿液α-酮戊二酸浓度异常
HP:0012401.definition_cn: 尿液中2-酮戊二酸浓度异常。

HP:0012402.name: Increased urine alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
HP:0012402.definition: A greater than normal concentration of 2-oxoglutaric acid in the urine.
HP:0012402.name_cn: 尿液中α-酮戊二酸浓度升高
HP:0012402.definition_cn: 尿液中2-酮戊二酸浓度高于正常值。

HP:0012403.name: Decreased urine alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
HP:0012403.definition: A lower than normal concentration of 2-oxoglutaric acid in the urine.
HP:0012403.definition_cn: 尿液中2-酮戊二酸浓度低于正常值。

HP:0012404.name: Abnormal urine citrate concentration
HP:0012404.definition: A deviation from normal of the concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.
HP:0012404.definition_cn: 尿液中柠檬酸根(3-)浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0012405.name: Hypocitraturia
HP:0012405.definition: A lower than normal concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.
HP:0012405.definition_cn: 尿液中柠檬酸盐（3-）浓度低于正常水平。

HP:0012406.name: Hypercitraturia
HP:0012406.definition: A greater than normal concentration of citrate(3-) in the urine.
HP:0012406.definition_cn: 尿液中柠檬酸根离子（Citrate(3-)）浓度高于正常水平。

HP:0012407.name: Scissor gait
HP:0012407.definition: A type of spastic paraparetic gait in which the muscle tone in the adductors is marked. It is characterized by hypertonia and flexion in the legs, hips and pelvis accompanied by extreme adduction leading to the knees and thighs hitting, or sometimes even crossing, in a scissors-like movement. The opposing muscles (abductors) become comparatively weak from lack of use.
HP:0012407.definition_cn: 一种痉挛性截瘫步态，其中内收肌的肌张力显著增强。其特征为下肢、髋部和骨盆的肌张力亢进和屈曲，伴随极度内收，导致膝关节和大腿在剪刀样运动中相互碰撞，有时甚至交叉。拮抗肌（外展肌）因缺乏使用而相对减弱。

HP:0012408.name: Medullary nephrocalcinosis
HP:0012408.definition: The deposition of calcium salts in the parenchyma of the renal medulla (innermost part of the kidney).
HP:0012408.definition_cn: 肾髓质实质（肾脏最内层）中的钙盐沉积。

HP:0012409.name: Cortical nephrocalcinosis
HP:0012409.definition: The deposition of calcium salts in the parenchyma of the renal cortex (the outer portion of the kidney between the renal capsule and the renal medulla).
HP:0012409.definition_cn: 肾皮质实质（位于肾被膜与肾髓质之间的肾脏外层部分）内钙盐沉积。

HP:0012410.name: Pure red cell aplasia
HP:0012410.definition: A type of anemia resulting from suppression of erythropoiesis with little or no abnormality of leukocyte or platelet production. Erythroblasts are virtually absent in bone marrow; however, leukocyte and platelet production show little or no reduction.
HP:0012410.name_cn: 纯红细胞再生障碍性贫血
HP:0012410.definition_cn: 一种由于红细胞生成抑制而导致的贫血类型，白细胞或血小板生成几乎没有异常。骨髓中几乎不存在幼红细胞；然而，白细胞和血小板生成几乎没有减少。

HP:0012411.name: Premature pubarche
HP:0012411.definition: The onset of growth of pubic hair at an earlier age than normal.

HP:0012412.name: Premature adrenarche
HP:0012412.definition: Onset of adrenarche at an earlier age than usual.
HP:0012412.name_cn: 早发性肾上腺功能初现
HP:0012412.definition_cn: 肾上腺功能早现（Adrenarche）提前发生。

HP:0012413.name: Notched primary central incisor
HP:0012413.definition: The presence of a V-shaped indentation (notch) in the primary central incisor.
HP:0012413.definition_cn: 原发性中切牙存在V形切迹（切痕）。

HP:0012414.name: Duodenal atrophy
HP:0012414.definition: Wasting or decrease in size of all or part of the duodenum.
HP:0012414.definition_cn: 十二指肠全部或部分萎缩或体积减小。

HP:0012415.name: Abnormal blood gas level
HP:0012415.definition: An abnormality of the partial pressure of oxygen or carbon dioxide in the arterial blood.
HP:0012415.definition_cn: 动脉血氧分压或二氧化碳分压异常。

HP:0012416.name: Hypercapnia
HP:0012416.definition: Abnormally elevated blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level.

HP:0012417.name: Hypocapnia
HP:0012417.definition: Abnormally reduced blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level.

HP:0012418.name: Hypoxemia
HP:0012418.definition: An abnormally low level of blood oxygen.

HP:0012419.name: Hyperoxemia
HP:0012419.definition: An abnormally high level of blood oxygen.

HP:0012420.name: Meconium stained amniotic fluid
HP:0012420.definition: Amniotic fluid containing the earliest stools of a mammalian infant.

HP:0012421.name: Congenital absence of foreskin
HP:0012421.definition: Congenital lack of the skin of prepuce of penis, that is, of the double-layered fold of skin and mucous membrane that covers the glans penis.
HP:0012421.definition_cn: 先天性阴茎包皮缺失，即覆盖阴茎头部的双层皮肤和粘膜皱襞的缺失。

HP:0012423.name: Colonic inertia
HP:0012423.definition: The inability of the colon to modify stool to an acceptable consistency and move the stool from the cecum to the rectosigmoid area at least once every three days.
HP:0012423.definition_cn: 结肠无法将粪便调节至可接受的稠度，并且无法至少每三天将粪便从盲肠移动至直肠乙状结肠区域。

HP:0012424.name: Chorioretinitis
HP:0012424.definition: An inflammation of the choroid and retina.

HP:0012425.name: Stercoral ulcer
HP:0012425.definition: An ulcer of the colon due to pressure and irritation from retained fecal masses.
HP:0012425.definition_cn: 由于粪便滞留引起的压力和刺激导致的结肠溃疡。

HP:0012426.name: Optic disc drusen
HP:0012426.definition: Optic disc drusen are acellular, calcified deposits within the optic nerve head. Optic disc drusen are congenital and developmental anomalies of the optic nerve head, representing hyaline-containing bodies that, over time, appear as elevated, lumpy irregularities on the anterior portion of the optic nerve.
HP:0012426.definition_cn: 视盘玻璃疣是视神经头内无细胞的钙化沉积物。视盘玻璃疣是视神经头的先天性和发育性异常，表现为含有透明质的小体，随着时间的推移，在视神经前部呈现为隆起、凹凸不平的不规则形态。

HP:0012427.name: Increased femoral anteversion
HP:0012427.definition: An increased degree of femoral version, which is defined as the angular difference between axis of femoral neck and transcondylar axis of the knee. Thus, femoral anteversion is an inward twisting of the femur that causes the knees and feet to turn inward.
HP:0012427.definition_cn: 股骨前倾角增加，定义为股骨颈轴线与膝关节髁间轴线之间的角度差异。因此，股骨前倾是指股骨向内扭转，导致膝关节和足部向内旋转。

HP:0012429.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cerebral white matter
HP:0012429.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.
HP:0012429.name_cn: 脑白质发育不全/脑白质发育不良
HP:0012429.definition_cn: 脑白质缺失或发育不全。

HP:0012430.name: Cerebral white matter hypoplasia
HP:0012430.definition: Underdevelopment of the cerebral white matter.

HP:0012431.name: Episodic fatigue
HP:0012431.definition: Intermittent and recurrent bouts of a subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.
HP:0012431.definition_cn: 间歇性和反复发作的主观疲劳感，其特征为能量和动机的缺乏。

HP:0012432.name: Chronic fatigue
HP:0012432.definition: Subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation that persists for six months or longer.
HP:0012432.definition_cn: 持续性疲劳的主观感受，表现为能量和动机的缺乏，持续六个月或更长时间。

HP:0012433.name: Abnormal social behavior
HP:0012433.definition: An abnormality of actions or reactions of a person taking place during interactions with others.
HP:0012433.definition_cn: 社交互动过程中个体行为或反应异常。

HP:0012434.name: Delayed early-childhood social milestone development
HP:0012434.definition: A failure to meet one or more age-related milestones of social behavior.
HP:0012434.name_cn: 儿童早期社交里程碑发育延迟
HP:0012434.definition_cn: 未能达到一个或多个与年龄相关的社会行为发展里程碑。

HP:0012435.name: Ventral shortening of foreskin
HP:0012435.definition: Reduction in length of the ventral (lower) skin of prepuce of penis.
HP:0012435.definition_cn: 阴茎腹侧（下方）包皮长度缩短。

HP:0012436.name: Nonocclusive coronary artery atherosclerosis
HP:0012436.definition: Coronary disease that has not progressed to the point of causing significant occlusion (blockage) of the coronary arteries.
HP:0012436.name_cn: 非闭塞性冠状动脉粥样硬化
HP:0012436.definition_cn: 未进展至导致冠状动脉显著闭塞（阻塞）的冠状动脉疾病。

HP:0012437.name: Abnormal gallbladder morphology
HP:0012437.definition: A structural anomaly of the gallbladder.

HP:0012438.name: Abnormal gallbladder physiology
HP:0012438.definition: A functional anomaly of the gallbladder.

HP:0012439.name: Abnormal biliary tract physiology
HP:0012439.definition: A functional abnormality of the biliary tree.

HP:0012440.name: Abnormal biliary tract morphology
HP:0012440.definition: A structural abnormality of the biliary tree.

HP:0012441.name: Sphincter of Oddi dyskinesia
HP:0012441.definition: Reduced motility through the sphincter of Oddi, resulting in impedance of bile and pancreatic juice flow from the common bile duct into the duodenum.
HP:0012441.definition_cn: Oddi括约肌运动功能减退，导致胆汁和胰液从胆总管流入十二指肠的流动受阻。

HP:0012442.name: Gallbladder dyskinesia
HP:0012442.definition: Reduced motility of the gallbladder with reduced emptying fraction.
HP:0012442.definition_cn: 胆囊运动功能减退伴排空分数降低。

HP:0012443.name: Abnormal brain morphology
HP:0012443.definition: A structural abnormality of the brain, which has as its parts the forebrain, midbrain, and hindbrain.
HP:0012443.definition_cn: 大脑结构异常，其组成部分包括前脑、中脑和后脑。

HP:0012444.name: Brain atrophy
HP:0012444.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of brain tissue that was once present.
HP:0012444.definition_cn: 部分或完全的脑组织萎缩（丧失），即先前存在的脑组织发生退化。

HP:0012446.name: Decreased CSF 5-methyltetrahydrofolate concentration
HP:0012446.definition: A reduced concentration of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate(2-) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). 5-methyltetrahydrofolate is the active folate metabolite.
HP:0012446.name_cn: 脑脊液5-甲基四氢叶酸浓度降低
HP:0012446.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中5-甲基四氢叶酸(2-)浓度降低。5-甲基四氢叶酸是活性叶酸代谢物。

HP:0012447.name: Abnormal myelination
HP:0012447.definition: Any anomaly in the process by which myelin sheaths are formed and maintained around neurons.
HP:0012447.definition_cn: 髓鞘形成和维持过程中神经元周围出现的任何异常。

HP:0012449.name: Sacroiliac joint synovitis
HP:0012449.definition: Inflammation of the synovial membrane of the sacroiliac joint.

HP:0012450.name: Chronic constipation
HP:0012450.definition: Constipation for longer than three months with fewer than 3 bowel movements per week, straining, lumpy or hard stools, and a sensation of anorectal obstruction or incomplete defecation.
HP:0012450.definition_cn: 便秘持续超过三个月，每周排便次数少于三次，伴有排便费力、粪便呈块状或硬结，以及肛门直肠梗阻感或排便不尽感。

HP:0012451.name: Acute constipation
HP:0012451.definition: Constipation of sudden onset and lasting for less than three months.
HP:0012451.definition_cn: 急性便秘，持续时间少于三个月。

HP:0012452.name: Restless legs
HP:0012452.definition: Restless Leg Syndrome (RLS) is a condition characterized by an uncomfortable and restless sensation in the legs that occurs after going to bed, often leading to insomnia.
HP:0012452.name_cn: 不宁腿综合征（Restless Legs Syndrome, RLS）
HP:0012452.definition_cn: 不宁腿综合征（Restless Leg Syndrome, RLS）是一种以卧床后出现下肢不适感和不安感为特征的疾病，常导致失眠。

HP:0012453.name: Bilateral wrist flexion contracture
HP:0012453.definition: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on the right and left sides.
HP:0012453.definition_cn: 双侧腕关节慢性活动度丧失。

HP:0012454.name: Unilateral wrist flexion contracture
HP:0012454.definition: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on one side only.
HP:0012454.definition_cn: 单侧腕关节慢性运动功能丧失。

HP:0012456.name: Medial arterial calcification
HP:0012456.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of arteries.
HP:0012456.definition_cn: 钙化，即钙盐在动脉中膜的病理性沉积。

HP:0012457.name: Medial calcification of medium-sized arteries
HP:0012457.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of medium-sized (muscular or distributive) arteries.
HP:0012457.name_cn: 中等大小动脉的内膜钙化
HP:0012457.definition_cn: 钙化，即钙盐在中型（肌性或分配性）动脉的中膜层中的病理性沉积。

HP:0012458.name: Medial calcification of small arteries
HP:0012458.definition: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of small arteries.
HP:0012458.definition_cn: 钙化，即钙盐在小动脉中膜的病理性沉积。

HP:0012459.name: Hypnic headache
HP:0012459.definition: A headache disorder that occurs exclusively at night, waking the affected individual from sleep.
HP:0012459.definition_cn: 夜间发作性头痛障碍（Nocturnal Headache Disorder），该病症特指仅在夜间发作的头痛，导致患者从睡眠中醒来。

HP:0012460.name: Dysmorphic inferior cerebellar vermis
HP:0012460.definition: A structural anomaly of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.
HP:0012460.definition_cn: 小脑蚓部下部结构异常。

HP:0012461.name: Bacteriuria
HP:0012461.definition: The presence of bacteria in the urine.

HP:0012462.name: Chin myoclonus
HP:0012462.definition: Involuntary and irregular twitches of the chin.
HP:0012462.definition_cn: 下颌不自主且不规则的抽搐。

HP:0012463.name: Elevated transferrin saturation
HP:0012463.definition: An above normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.
HP:0012463.definition_cn: 血清转铁蛋白铁饱和度高于正常水平。

HP:0012464.name: Decreased transferrin saturation
HP:0012464.definition: A below normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.
HP:0012464.definition_cn: 血清转铁蛋白铁饱和度低于正常水平。

HP:0012465.name: Elevated hepatic iron concentration
HP:0012465.definition: An increased level of iron in liver tissues.

HP:0012466.name: Chronic respiratory acidosis
HP:0012466.definition: Longstanding impairment in ventilation such that the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) is elevated above the upper limit of the reference range (more than 45 mm Hg), with a normal or near-normal pH secondary to renal compensation and an elevated serum bicarbonate levels (more than30 mEq/L).
HP:0012466.definition_cn: 长期通气功能障碍，导致二氧化碳分压（PaCO2）升高超过参考范围上限（大于45 mmHg），由于肾脏代偿作用，pH值正常或接近正常，同时伴有血清碳酸氢盐水平升高（大于30 mEq/L）。

HP:0012467.name: Acute respiratory acidosis
HP:0012467.definition: Sudden onset of impairment in ventilation such that the removal of carbon dioxide by the respiratory system is less than the production of carbon dioxide in the tissues, leading to an elevation of the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) above the normal limits (more than 45 mm Hg) with an accompanying acidemia (pH less than 7.35).
HP:0012467.definition_cn: 急性通气功能障碍，导致呼吸系统清除二氧化碳的能力低于组织内二氧化碳的生成，进而引起二氧化碳分压（PaCO2）升高至正常范围以上（超过45 mmHg），并伴随酸血症（pH值低于7.35）。

HP:0012468.name: Chronic acidosis
HP:0012468.definition: Longstanding abnormal acid accumulation or depletion of base.
HP:0012468.definition_cn: 长期异常酸积聚或碱耗竭。

HP:0012469.name: Infantile spasms
HP:0012469.definition: Infantile spasms represent a subset of \
HP:0012469.definition_cn: 婴儿痉挛症属于癫痫综合征的一个亚型。

HP:0012470.name: Setting-sun eye phenomenon
HP:0012470.definition: An ophthalmologic sign in young children resulting from upward-gaze paresis. In this condition, the eyes appear driven downward, the sclera may be seen between the upper eyelid and the iris, and part of the lower pupil may be covered by the lower eyelid.
HP:0012470.definition_cn: 小儿眼科体征，由上视麻痹所致。此状态下，眼球呈下移趋势，上睑与虹膜间可见巩膜，部分下瞳孔可被下睑遮盖。

HP:0012471.name: Thick vermilion border
HP:0012471.definition: Increased width of the skin of vermilion border region of upper lip.
HP:0012471.definition_cn: 上唇朱红色边界区域皮肤宽度增加。

HP:0012472.name: Eclabion
HP:0012472.definition: A turning outward of the lip or lips, that is, eversion of the lips.

HP:0012474.name: Carotid artery occlusion
HP:0012474.definition: Complete obstruction of a carotid artery.

HP:0012475.name: Decreased circulating level of specific antibody
HP:0012475.definition: The presence of normal overall immunoglobulin levels with deficiency of specific immunoglobulins directed against a specific antigen or microorganism.
HP:0012475.name_cn: 特定抗体循环水平降低
HP:0012475.definition_cn: 总体免疫球蛋白水平正常，但针对特定抗原或微生物的特异性免疫球蛋白缺乏。

HP:0012476.name: Decreased specific pneumococcal antibody level
HP:0012476.definition: The presence of normal overall immunoglobulin levels with deficiency of specific immunoglobulins directed against pneumococci.
HP:0012476.name_cn: 肺炎球菌特异性抗体水平降低
HP:0012476.definition_cn: 总体免疫球蛋白水平正常，但针对肺炎球菌的特异性免疫球蛋白缺乏。

HP:0012477.name: Vocal tremor
HP:0012477.definition: A wavering, unsteady voice that reflects involuntary and approximately sinusoidal oscillation of motor unit firings of laryngeal muscles. Vocal tremor results in low frequency modulations of voice frequency or amplitude and intermittent voice instability.
HP:0012477.definition_cn: 一种波动、不稳定的声音，反映了喉部肌肉运动单位放电的不自主且近似正弦振荡。声带震颤导致声音频率或幅度的低频调制以及间歇性声音不稳定。

HP:0012478.name: Temporomandibular joint ankylosis
HP:0012478.definition: Bony fusion of the mandibular condyle to the base of the skull, resulting in limitation of jaw opening.
HP:0012478.definition_cn: 下颌髁突与颅底骨性融合，导致张口受限。

HP:0012479.name: Temporomandibular joint crepitus
HP:0012479.definition: Noises from the temporomandibular joint during mandibular movement (e.g., chewing). Temporomandibular joint crepitus is often described as a clicking, popping, grating sound.
HP:0012479.definition_cn: 下颌运动（如咀嚼）时颞下颌关节发出的噪音。颞下颌关节捻发音常被描述为咔嗒声、弹响声或摩擦声。

HP:0012481.name: Cerebral venous angioma
HP:0012481.definition: A congenital malformation of veins which drain normal brain characterized by a caput medusae or an umbrellalike convergence of multiple venules on a single, or occasionally multiple, enlarged parenchymal or medullary vein, like the trunk of a tree or the shank of an umbrella. This dilated terminal vein penetrates the cortex to drain either (a) superficially to cortical veins or sinuses, (b) deeply to subependymal veins of the lateral ventricle and then into the galenic system, (c) to the fourth ventricle and then to the pontomesencephalic vein, or (d) to the precentral cerebellar vein and into the galenic system.
HP:0012481.definition_cn: 一种先天性静脉畸形，其特点为正常脑组织的静脉引流呈现“水母头”或“伞状”结构，即多条小静脉汇聚于单一（偶见多条）扩张的实质或髓质静脉，形似树干或伞柄。该扩张的终末静脉穿透皮质，引流至以下部位：(a) 浅层至皮质静脉或静脉窦，(b) 深层至侧脑室室管膜下静脉，随后进入Galen静脉系统，(c) 至第四脑室，随后进入桥脑中脑静脉，或 (d) 至小脑中央前静脉，随后进入Galen静脉系统。

HP:0012482.name: Frontal venous angioma
HP:0012482.definition: A venous angioma of the frontal lobe of the brain.

HP:0012483.name: Abnormal alpha granules
HP:0012483.definition: Defective structure, size or content of alpha granules, platelet organelles that contain several growth factors destined for release during platelet activation at sites of vessel wall injury.
HP:0012483.definition_cn: α颗粒的结构、大小或内容物缺陷，α颗粒是血小板细胞器，含有多种生长因子，这些生长因子在血管壁损伤部位血小板活化时释放。

HP:0012484.name: Abnormal dense granules
HP:0012484.definition: Defective structure, size or content of dense granules, platelet organelles that contain granules proaggregatory factors such as adenosine diphosphate (ADP), adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ionized calcium, histamine and serotonin.
HP:0012484.definition_cn: 致密颗粒结构、大小或内容物缺陷，血小板细胞器含有促聚集因子颗粒，如二磷酸腺苷（ADP）、三磷酸腺苷（ATP）、离子化钙、组胺和5-羟色胺。

HP:0012485.name: Abnormal surface-connected open canalicular system
HP:0012485.definition: An anomaly of the invaginations of the surface membrane that form the open canalicular system (OCS). The OCS serve as the pathway for transport of substances into the cells and as conduits for the discharge of alpha granule products secreted during the platelet release reaction.
HP:0012485.name_cn: 异常表面连接开放小管系统
HP:0012485.definition_cn: 表面膜内陷异常，形成开放管道系统（OCS）。OCS作为物质进入细胞的运输途径，并在血小板释放反应期间作为α颗粒分泌产物的排出通道。

HP:0012487.name: Cerebellopontine angle arachnoid cyst
HP:0012487.definition: An arachnoid cyst located at the margin of the cerebellum and pons.
HP:0012487.name_cn: 小脑桥脑角蛛网膜囊肿
HP:0012487.definition_cn: 位于小脑与脑桥边缘的蛛网膜囊肿。

HP:0012488.name: Intraventricular arachnoid cyst
HP:0012488.definition: An arachnoid cyst located within the ventricular system.
HP:0012488.definition_cn: 位于脑室系统内的蛛网膜囊肿。

HP:0012489.name: Suprasellar arachnoid cyst
HP:0012489.definition: An arachnoid cyst that progressively enlarges from an abnormality in the membrane of Liliequist or in the interpeduncular cistern, and typically, expands from the prepontine space, displacing the floor of the third ventricle upwards, the pituitary stalk and optic chiasm upwards and forwards, and the mammillary bodies upwards and backwards.
HP:0012489.definition_cn: 一种蛛网膜囊肿，由于Liliequist膜或脚间池的异常而逐渐增大，通常从桥前间隙扩展，导致第三脑室底向上移位，垂体柄和视交叉向上向前移位，乳头体向上向后移位。

HP:0012491.name: Abnormal dense tubular system
HP:0012491.definition: An anomaly of the intracellular membrane complexes known as the dense tubular system.
HP:0012491.definition_cn: 细胞内膜复合体异常，即致密管系统异常。

HP:0012492.name: Cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012492.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of a cerebral artery.
HP:0012492.definition_cn: 脑动脉管腔狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0012493.name: Middle cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012493.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the middle cerebral artery.
HP:0012493.definition_cn: 大脑中动脉内腔狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0012494.name: Anterior cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012494.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the anterior cerebral artery.
HP:0012494.definition_cn: 大脑前动脉内腔（管腔）狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0012495.name: Posterior cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012495.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the posterior cerebral artery.
HP:0012495.definition_cn: 大脑后动脉内腔（管腔）狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0012496.name: Reduced maximal inspiratory pressure
HP:0012496.definition: A decrease in the maximum amount of negative pressure a person can generate during an inhalation.
HP:0012496.definition_cn: 吸气时最大负压生成能力下降。

HP:0012497.name: Reduced maximal expiratory pressure
HP:0012497.definition: A decrease in the maximum amount of pressure of expired air achieved by a person after a full inspiration.
HP:0012497.definition_cn: 最大呼气压力降低（Maximum Expiratory Pressure Reduction）

HP:0012498.name: Nuchal cord
HP:0012498.definition: A complication of pregnancy and delivery in which the umbilical cord wraps around the fetal neck once or multiple times.
HP:0012498.definition_cn: 妊娠和分娩并发症，即脐带绕颈一周或多周。

HP:0012499.name: Descending aortic dissection
HP:0012499.definition: A separation of the layers within the wall of the descending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.
HP:0012499.definition_cn: 降主动脉壁层间分离。内膜层撕裂导致血液进入内膜-中层间隙，从而引发夹层（近端或远端）的扩展。

HP:0012500.name: Verrucous papule
HP:0012500.definition: A wartlike (with multiple small elevated projections) papule.
HP:0012500.definition_cn: 疣状（伴有多发小隆起性突起）丘疹。

HP:0012501.name: Abnormal brainstem white matter morphology
HP:0012501.definition: An anomaly of the white matter of brainstem.

HP:0012502.name: Abnormality of the internal capsule
HP:0012502.definition: An anomaly of the internal capsule, which is an area of white matter in the brain that separates the caudate nucleus and the thalamus from the putamen and the globus pallidus.
HP:0012502.definition_cn: 内囊异常，内囊是大脑中的一片白质区域，将尾状核和丘脑与壳核和苍白球分隔开来。

HP:0012503.name: Abnormal pituitary gland morphology
HP:0012503.definition: An anomaly of the pituitary gland.

HP:0012504.name: Abnormal size of pituitary gland
HP:0012504.definition: A deviation from the normal size of the pituitary gland.

HP:0012505.name: Enlarged pituitary gland
HP:0012505.definition: An abnormally increased size of the pituitary gland.

HP:0012506.name: Small pituitary gland
HP:0012506.definition: An abnormally decreased size of the pituitary gland.

HP:0012507.name: Weakness of orbicularis oculi muscle
HP:0012507.definition: Reduced strength of the orbicularis oculi, the circumorbital muscle in the face that closes the eyelid.
HP:0012507.definition_cn: 眼轮匝肌肌力减退，眼轮匝肌为面部环绕眼周的肌肉，负责闭合眼睑。

HP:0012508.name: Metamorphopsia
HP:0012508.definition: A visual anomaly in which images appear distorted. A grid of straight lines appears wavy and parts of the grid may appear blank.
HP:0012508.definition_cn: 一种视觉异常，表现为图像出现扭曲。直线网格呈现波浪状，且网格部分区域可能出现空白。

HP:0012509.name: Reduced thyroxin-binding globulin
HP:0012509.definition: An abnormally decreased amount of thyroxin-binding globulin (TBG) in blood. TBG is responsible for carrying the thyroid hormones thyroxine (T4) and 3,5,3'-triiodothyronine (T3) in the bloodstream.
HP:0012509.name_cn: 甲状腺素结合球蛋白减少
HP:0012509.definition_cn: 血液中甲状腺素结合球蛋白（TBG）异常减少。甲状腺素结合球蛋白负责在血液中运输甲状腺激素甲状腺素（T4）和3,5,3'-三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）。

HP:0012510.name: Extra-axial cerebrospinal fluid accumulation
HP:0012510.definition: An increased amount of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in the subarachnoid space.
HP:0012510.definition_cn: 蛛网膜下腔脑脊液（CSF）量增多。

HP:0012511.name: Temporal optic disc pallor
HP:0012511.definition: A pale yellow discoloration of the temporal (lateral) portion of the optic disc.
HP:0012511.definition_cn: 颞侧（外侧）视盘区域出现淡黄色变色。

HP:0012512.name: Diffuse optic disc pallor
HP:0012512.definition: A pale yellow discoloration of the entire optic disc.
HP:0012512.definition_cn: 整个视盘的淡黄色变色。

HP:0012513.name: Upper limb pain
HP:0012513.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the arm.
HP:0012513.definition_cn: 一种以手臂局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0012514.name: Lower limb pain
HP:0012514.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the leg.
HP:0012514.definition_cn: 一种以腿部局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0012515.name: Hip flexor weakness
HP:0012515.definition: Reduced ability to flex the femur, that is, to pull the knee upward.
HP:0012515.definition_cn: 股骨屈曲能力减退，即无法将膝关节向上抬起。

HP:0012516.name: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia
HP:0012516.definition: An extreme form of tetralogy of Fallot characterized by absence of flow from the right ventricle to the pulmonary arteries.
HP:0012516.name_cn: 法洛四联症伴肺动脉闭锁
HP:0012516.definition_cn: 一种极端的法洛四联症，其特征为右心室至肺动脉的血流完全缺失。

HP:0012517.name: Reduced circulating catalase activity
HP:0012517.definition: Activity or concentration of catalase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0012517.name_cn: 循环过氧化氢酶活性降低
HP:0012517.definition_cn: 血液循环中过氧化氢酶活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0012518.name: Abnormal circle of Willis morphology
HP:0012518.definition: An anomaly of the circle of Willis, also known as the cerebral arterial circle.
HP:0012518.definition_cn: Willis环异常，亦称大脑动脉环异常。

HP:0012519.name: Hypoplastic posterior communicating artery
HP:0012519.definition: A developmental anomnaly characterized by underdevelopment of the posterior communicating artery.
HP:0012519.definition_cn: 一种以大脑后交通动脉发育不全为特征的发育异常。

HP:0012520.name: Dilation of Virchow-Robin spaces
HP:0012520.definition: Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. Perivascular spaces are commonly microscopic, and not visible on conventional neuroimaging. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually magnetic resonance imaging). The dilatations are regular cavities that always contain a patent artery.
HP:0012520.definition_cn: 维罗氏-罗宾间隙（也称为血管周围间隙）的尺寸增加，这些间隙围绕血管壁，从蛛网膜下腔穿过脑实质。血管周围间隙通常为微观结构，在常规神经影像学检查中不可见。此术语指这些间隙的尺寸增大，使其在神经影像学（通常为磁共振成像）中可见。这些扩张为规则的空腔，始终包含一条通畅的动脉。

HP:0012521.name: Optic nerve aplasia
HP:0012521.definition: Congenital absence of the optic nerve.

HP:0012522.name: Spider hemangioma
HP:0012522.definition: A form of telangiectasis characterized by a central elevated red dot the size of a pinhead, representing an arteriole, with numerous small blood vessels that radiate out thereby resembling the legs of a spider. Characteristically, compression of the central arteriole causes the entire lesion to blanch, and the lesion quickly refills once the compression is released.
HP:0012522.definition_cn: 一种毛细血管扩张症，其特征为中央隆起、针头大小的红色斑点，代表小动脉，周围有众多小血管呈放射状分布，形似蜘蛛腿。典型表现为压迫中央小动脉可使整个病变区域变白，一旦解除压迫，病变区域迅速重新充盈。

HP:0012523.name: Oral aversion
HP:0012523.definition: Reluctance or refusal of a child to be breastfed or eat, manifested as gagging, vomiting, turning head away from food, or avoidance of sensation in or around the mouth (i.e. toothbrushing or face-washing).
HP:0012523.definition_cn: 婴儿或儿童拒乳或拒食，表现为作呕、呕吐、转头避开食物或回避口腔及周围感觉刺激（如刷牙或洗脸）。

HP:0012524.name: Abnormal platelet shape
HP:0012524.definition: A deviation from the normal discoid platelet shape.
HP:0012524.definition_cn: 血小板形态异常（偏离正常的盘状形态）。

HP:0012525.name: Abnormal alpha granule distribution
HP:0012525.definition: An anomalous location and arrangement of platelet alpha granules.
HP:0012525.definition_cn: 血小板α颗粒的异常定位和排列。

HP:0012526.name: Absence of alpha granules
HP:0012526.definition: A lack of platelet alpha granules. This typically results in the gray appearance of platelets in giemsa stained blood smears.
HP:0012526.definition_cn: 血小板α颗粒缺乏症。这通常导致吉姆萨染色血涂片中血小板呈现灰色外观。

HP:0012527.name: Abnormal alpha granule content
HP:0012527.definition: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain hemostatic proteins such as fibrinogen, von Willebrand factor, and growth factors such as platelet-derived growth factor.
HP:0012527.definition_cn: 血小板α颗粒内容物异常，正常情况下α颗粒应包含止血蛋白如纤维蛋白原、血管性血友病因子以及生长因子如血小板衍生生长因子。

HP:0012528.name: Abnormal number of alpha granules
HP:0012528.definition: A deviation from the normal count of alpha granules per thrombocyte.
HP:0012528.definition_cn: 血小板内α颗粒数量异常。

HP:0012529.name: Abnormal dense granule content
HP:0012529.definition: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain adenosine triphosphate (ATP), adenosine diphosphate (ADP), serotonin, calcium, and pyrophosphate, which are secreted when platelets are activated.
HP:0012529.definition_cn: 血小板α颗粒内容物异常，正常情况下α颗粒含有三磷酸腺苷（ATP）、二磷酸腺苷（ADP）、5-羟色胺、钙离子和焦磷酸盐，这些物质在血小板激活时被分泌。

HP:0012530.name: Abnormal number of dense granules
HP:0012530.definition: A deviation from the normal count of dense granules per thrombocyte.
HP:0012530.definition_cn: 血小板致密颗粒数量异常。

HP:0012531.name: Pain
HP:0012531.definition: An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.
HP:0012531.definition_cn: 一种与实际或潜在组织损伤相关的不愉快的感觉和情感体验，或以这种损伤为描述依据的体验。

HP:0012532.name: Chronic pain
HP:0012532.definition: Persistent pain, usually defined as pain that has lasted longer than 3 to 6 months.
HP:0012532.definition_cn: 持续性疼痛，通常定义为持续时间超过3至6个月的疼痛。

HP:0012533.name: Allodynia
HP:0012533.definition: Pain due to a stimulus that does not normally provoke pain.
HP:0012533.definition_cn: 由通常不会引起疼痛的刺激所导致的疼痛。

HP:0012534.name: Dysesthesia
HP:0012534.definition: Painful sensations elicited by a nonpainful cutaneous stimulus such as a light touch or gentle stroking over affected areas of the body. Sometimes referred to as hyperpathia or hyperalgesia. Often perceived as an intense burning, dyesthesias may outlast the stimulus by several seconds.
HP:0012534.definition_cn: 由非疼痛性皮肤刺激（如轻触或轻柔抚摸身体受影响区域）引发的疼痛感。有时称为痛觉过敏或痛觉超敏。通常表现为强烈的灼烧感，感觉异常可能持续数秒，超过刺激时间。

HP:0012535.name: Abnormal synaptic transmission
HP:0012535.definition: An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse. This is a four step process, comprising (i) synthesis and storage of neurotransmitters; (ii) neurotransmitter release; (iii) activation of postsynaptic receptors by the neurotransmitter; and (iv) inactivation of the neurotransmitter. Thus, this term is defined as an anomaly of neurotransmitter metabolic process.
HP:0012535.definition_cn: 神经元通过突触向靶细胞传递信息过程中的异常。该过程包括四个步骤：（i）神经递质的合成与储存；（ii）神经递质的释放；（iii）神经递质激活突触后受体；（iv）神经递质的失活。因此，该术语被定义为神经递质代谢过程的异常。

HP:0012536.name: Maternal anticardiolipin antibody positive
HP:0012536.definition: The presence of circulating autoantibodies to anticardiolipin in the mother.
HP:0012536.name_cn: 母体抗心磷脂抗体阳性
HP:0012536.definition_cn: 母体循环中存在抗心磷脂自身抗体。

HP:0012537.name: Food intolerance
HP:0012537.definition: A detrimental reaction to a food, beverage, food additive, or compound found in foods that produces symptoms in one or more body organs and systems that is not mediated by an immune reaction.
HP:0012537.definition_cn: 一种对食物、饮料、食品添加剂或食物中化合物的不良反应，导致一个或多个身体器官和系统出现症状，且该反应并非由免疫反应介导。

HP:0012538.name: Gluten intolerance
HP:0012538.definition: A detrimental reaction to the presence of gluten in food, which may include abdominal pain, fatigue, headaches and paresthesia, or celiac disease.
HP:0012538.definition_cn: 对食物中麸质存在的不良反应，可能包括腹痛、疲劳、头痛和感觉异常，或乳糜泻。

HP:0012539.name: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
HP:0012539.definition: A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by the absence of multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.
HP:0012539.definition_cn: 一种淋巴瘤类型，其显微镜下特征为缺乏多核的里德-斯滕伯格细胞（Reed-Sternberg cells）。

HP:0012540.name: Axillary epidermoid cyst
HP:0012540.definition: An epidermoid cyst in the armpit.

HP:0012541.name: Cephalohematoma
HP:0012541.definition: Hemorrhage between the skull and periosteum of a newborn resulting from rupture of blood vessels that cross the periosteum.
HP:0012541.definition_cn: 新生儿颅骨与骨膜间出血，由跨越骨膜的血管破裂所致。

HP:0012543.name: Hemosiderinuria
HP:0012543.definition: The presence of hemosiderin in the urine.
HP:0012543.definition_cn: 尿液中含铁血黄素的存在。

HP:0012544.name: Elevated circulating aldolase concentration
HP:0012544.definition: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0012544.definition_cn: 血液循环中1,6-二磷酸果糖醛缩酶浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0012545.name: Reduced circulating aldolase concentration
HP:0012545.definition: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0012545.definition_cn: 血液循环中1,6-二磷酸果糖醛缩酶浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0012546.name: Skewed maternal X inactivation
HP:0012546.definition: A deviation from equal (50%) inactivation of each parental X chromosome in maternal cells.
HP:0012546.definition_cn: 母体细胞中每个亲本X染色体偏离均等（50%）失活的现象。

HP:0012547.name: Abnormal involuntary eye movements
HP:0012547.definition: Anomalous movements of the eyes that occur without the subject wanting them to happen.
HP:0012547.definition_cn: 不自主性眼球运动异常。

HP:0012548.name: Fatty replacement of skeletal muscle
HP:0012548.definition: Muscle fibers degeneration resulting in fatty replacement of skeletal muscle fibers
HP:0012548.definition_cn: 肌纤维变性导致骨骼肌纤维脂肪替代

HP:0012549.name: Conjunctival lipoma
HP:0012549.definition: A lipoma (a benign tumor composed of adipose tissue) located in the conjunctiva.
HP:0012549.definition_cn: 结膜脂肪瘤（一种由脂肪组织构成的良性肿瘤）。

HP:0012550.name: Colonic varices
HP:0012550.definition: The presence of varices (enlarged and convoluted blood vessels) in the colon.
HP:0012550.definition_cn: 结肠静脉曲张（结肠内血管扩张和迂曲）。

HP:0012551.name: Absent neutrophil specific granules
HP:0012551.definition: Lack of specific granules in neutrophils.
HP:0012551.name_cn: 中性粒细胞特异性颗粒缺失
HP:0012551.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞特异性颗粒缺乏症。

HP:0012552.name: Increased neutrophil nuclear projections
HP:0012552.definition: Presence of an elevated number of projections from nuclei of neutrophils. These projections can have the shape of hooks, tags, or clubs.
HP:0012552.name_cn: 中性粒细胞核突起增多
HP:0012552.definition_cn: 存在中性粒细胞核突增多。这些核突可呈钩状、标签状或棒状。

HP:0012553.name: Hypoplastic thumbnail
HP:0012553.definition: A thumbnail that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped thumb nail.
HP:0012553.definition_cn: 短小指甲，即指甲长度和宽度均减小，发育不全的拇指指甲。

HP:0012556.name: Hyperbeta-alaninemia
HP:0012556.definition: Increased concentration of beta-alanine in the blood.
HP:0012556.definition_cn: 血液中β-丙氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0012557.name: EEG with centrotemporal focal spike waves
HP:0012557.definition: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the centrotemporal region of the brain (also known as the central sulcus), i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.
HP:0012557.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央颞区局灶性棘慢波
HP:0012557.definition_cn: 脑电图显示大脑中央颞区（即中央沟）局灶性尖波，即持续时间小于80毫秒的局灶性尖波，随后伴随慢波。

HP:0012558.name: Abnormal T3/T4 ratio
HP:0012558.definition: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that deviates from normal.
HP:0012558.name_cn: 异常的三碘甲状腺原氨酸/甲状腺素比值
HP:0012558.definition_cn: 血清三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）与甲状腺素（T4）比值异常。

HP:0012559.name: Increased T3/T4 ratio
HP:0012559.definition: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is higher than normal.
HP:0012559.definition_cn: 血清三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）与甲状腺素（T4）比值高于正常范围。

HP:0012560.name: Decreased T3/T4 ratio
HP:0012560.definition: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is lower than normal.
HP:0012560.definition_cn: 血清三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）与甲状腺素（T4）比值低于正常值。

HP:0012561.name: Unicuspid aortic valve
HP:0012561.definition: The presence of an aortic valve with one instead of the normal three cusps (flaps).
HP:0012561.definition_cn: 主动脉瓣单叶畸形（正常为三叶）。

HP:0012562.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in hand
HP:0012562.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the hand, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0012562.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即手部一个或多个长骨的干骺端透明软骨板在早于正常年龄时停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0012563.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in foot
HP:0012563.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the foot, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0012563.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即足部一处或多处长骨的干骺端透明软骨板在早于正常年龄时停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0012564.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in tibia
HP:0012564.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the tibia, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0012564.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即胫骨一处或多处长骨的干骺端透明软骨板在早于正常年龄时停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0012565.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in fibula
HP:0012565.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the fibula, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0012565.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即位于腓骨等长骨干骺端的透明软骨板在一个或多个长骨中早于正常年龄停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0012566.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in radius
HP:0012566.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the radius, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0012566.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即位于桡骨等长骨干骺端的透明软骨板在一个或多个长骨中早于正常年龄停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0012567.name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in ulna
HP:0012567.definition: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the ulna, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.
HP:0012567.definition_cn: 骨骺板生长停止，即位于尺骨等长骨干骺端的透明软骨板在一个或多个长骨中早于正常年龄停止生长，导致生长停滞及受累骨骼缩短。

HP:0012568.name: Lower eyelid edema
HP:0012568.definition: Edema in the region of the Lower eyelid.

HP:0012569.name: Delayed menarche
HP:0012569.definition: First period after the age of 15 years.

HP:0012570.name: Synovial sarcoma
HP:0012570.definition: A type of mesenchymal tissue cell tumor that exhibits epithelial differentiation, which most frequently arises in the extremities.
HP:0012570.definition_cn: 一种显示上皮分化的间叶组织细胞肿瘤，最常见于四肢。

HP:0012571.name: Ureter fissus
HP:0012571.definition: A partial duplication of the ureter where the duplicated ureters fuse to a single ureter before their insertion into the bladder.
HP:0012571.definition_cn: 输尿管部分重复，其中重复的输尿管在插入膀胱前融合为单一输尿管。

HP:0012572.name: Ureter duplex
HP:0012572.definition: A complete duplication of the ureter, where the duplicated ureters have separate insertions into the bladder.
HP:0012572.definition_cn: 完全性输尿管重复畸形，其中重复的输尿管分别独立插入膀胱。

HP:0012573.name: Global proximal tubulopathy
HP:0012573.definition: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption with bicarbonate loss and resulting acidosis.
HP:0012573.definition_cn: 一种近端肾小管病变，其特征为重吸收功能障碍，导致糖尿、氨基酸尿、肾小管性蛋白尿、肾性低磷血症、尿酸肾小管重吸收减少伴碳酸氢盐丢失及由此引发的酸中毒。

HP:0012574.name: Mesangial hypercellularity
HP:0012574.definition: Increased numbers of mesangial cells per glomerulus, defined as more than 3 nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in one or more mesangial areas, not including perihilar region, on a standard 3-micron-thick tissue section, best evaluated on periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain.
HP:0012574.definition_cn: 每个肾小球中系膜细胞数量增加，定义为在标准3微米厚的组织切片上，一个或多个系膜区域（不包括门周区域）中完全被基质包围的细胞核超过3个，最佳评估方法为过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色。

HP:0012575.name: Abnormal nephron morphology
HP:0012575.definition: A structural anomaly of the nephron.

HP:0012576.name: Glomerular C3 deposition
HP:0012576.definition: The presence of complement 3 deposits in the glomerulus.

HP:0012577.name: Thin glomerular basement membrane
HP:0012577.definition: Decreased thickness of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to a decrease in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations less than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals. May be focal or diffuse, although the term thin GBMs generally implies thinning of over 50% of GBMs.
HP:0012577.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜（GBM）厚度减少，测量自内皮细胞至脏层上皮细胞质膜，主要归因于致密层厚度的减少，通常总体厚度较健康年龄和性别匹配个体的正常平均GBM厚度减少超过2个标准差。可为局灶性或弥漫性，尽管术语“薄GBM”通常暗示超过50%的GBM变薄。

HP:0012578.name: Membranous nephropathy
HP:0012578.definition: A type of glomerulonephropathy characterized by thickening of the basement membrane and deposition of immune complexes in the subepithelial space.
HP:0012578.definition_cn: 一种以基底膜增厚和上皮下间隙免疫复合物沉积为特征的肾小球肾病。

HP:0012579.name: Minimal change glomerulonephritis
HP:0012579.definition: The presence of minimal changes visible by light microscopy but flattened and fused podocyte foot processes on electron microscopy in a person with nephrotic range proteinuria.
HP:0012579.name_cn: 微小病变性肾小球肾炎
HP:0012579.definition_cn: 在肾病范围蛋白尿患者中，光镜下可见微小病变，而电子显微镜下显示足细胞足突扁平融合。

HP:0012580.name: Calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis
HP:0012580.definition: The presence of calcium- and phosphate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.
HP:0012580.definition_cn: 肾脏内存在含钙和磷酸盐的结石（肾结石）。

HP:0012581.name: Simple renal cyst
HP:0012581.definition: An isolated cyst of the kidney.

HP:0012582.name: Bilateral renal dysplasia
HP:0012582.definition: A bilateral form of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.

HP:0012583.name: Unilateral renal hypoplasia
HP:0012583.definition: One sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

HP:0012584.name: Bilateral renal hypoplasia
HP:0012584.definition: Two sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

HP:0012586.name: Bilateral renal atrophy
HP:0012586.definition: A two-sided form of atrophy of the kidney.

HP:0012587.name: Macroscopic hematuria
HP:0012587.definition: Hematuria that is visible upon inspection of the urine.

HP:0012588.name: Steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome
HP:0012588.definition: A form of nephrotic syndrome that does not respond to treatment with steroid medication, defined as persistent proteinuria despite 60mg/m2 or 2mg/kg for 8 weeks, after insuring no infection or non-adherence to medication.
HP:0012588.name_cn: 类固醇抵抗性肾病综合征
HP:0012588.definition_cn: 一种对类固醇药物治疗无反应的肾病综合征形式，定义为在确保无感染或未遵医嘱用药的情况下，尽管使用60mg/m2或2mg/kg剂量持续8周，仍存在持续性蛋白尿。

HP:0012589.name: Multidrug-resistant nephrotic syndrome
HP:0012589.definition: A form of nephrotic syndrome that does not respond to any immunosuppresive treatment.
HP:0012589.name_cn: 多药耐药性肾病综合征
HP:0012589.definition_cn: 一种对任何免疫抑制治疗均无反应的肾病综合征类型。

HP:0012590.name: Abnormal urine output
HP:0012590.definition: An abnormal amount of urine production.

HP:0012591.name: Abnormal urinary electrolyte concentration
HP:0012591.definition: An abnormality in the concentration of electrolytes in the urine.

HP:0012592.name: Albuminuria
HP:0012592.definition: Increased concentration of albumin in the urine.
HP:0012592.definition_cn: 尿液中白蛋白浓度升高。

HP:0012593.name: Nephrotic range proteinuria
HP:0012593.definition: Severely increased amount of excretion of protein in the urine, defined as 3.5 grams per day or more in adults and 40 mg per meter-squared body surface area per hour in children.
HP:0012593.definition_cn: 重度蛋白尿，定义为成人每日尿蛋白排泄量≥3.5克，或儿童每小时每平方米体表面积尿蛋白排泄量≥40毫克。

HP:0012594.name: Moderate albuminuria
HP:0012594.definition: The presence of moderately increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as and albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) of 30 to 299 mg/gm (3.4 to 34 mg/mmol).
HP:0012594.definition_cn: 尿液中白蛋白浓度中度升高，定义为白蛋白-肌酐比值（ACR）为30至299 mg/g（3.4至34 mg/mmol）。

HP:0012595.name: Mild proteinuria
HP:0012595.definition: Mildly increased levels of protein in the urine (150-500 mg per day in adults).
HP:0012595.definition_cn: 轻度蛋白尿（成人每日尿蛋白含量为150-500毫克）。

HP:0012596.name: Moderate proteinuria
HP:0012596.definition: Moderately increased levels of protein in the urine (500-1000 mg per day in adults).
HP:0012596.definition_cn: 中度蛋白尿（成人每日尿蛋白排泄量为500-1000毫克）。

HP:0012597.name: Heavy proteinuria
HP:0012597.definition: Severely increased levels of protein in the urine (1000-3000 mg per day in adults).
HP:0012597.definition_cn: 显著升高的尿蛋白水平（成人每日1000-3000毫克）。

HP:0012598.name: Abnormal urine potassium concentration
HP:0012598.definition: An abnormal concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.
HP:0012598.definition_cn: 尿液中钾离子（K⁺）浓度异常。

HP:0012599.name: Abnormal urine phosphate concentration
HP:0012599.definition: An abnormal phosphate concentration in the urine.

HP:0012600.name: Abnormal urine chloride concentration
HP:0012600.definition: An abnormal concentration of chloride in the urine.
HP:0012600.definition_cn: 尿液中氯离子浓度异常。

HP:0012601.name: Hypochloriduria
HP:0012601.definition: An decreased concentration of chloride in the urine.

HP:0012602.name: Renal chloride wasting
HP:0012602.definition: High urine chloride in the presence of hypochloridemia.

HP:0012603.name: Abnormal urine sodium concentration
HP:0012603.definition: An abnormal concentration of sodium in the urine.

HP:0012604.name: Hyponatriuria
HP:0012604.definition: An abnormally decreased sodium concentration in the urine.

HP:0012605.name: Hypernatriuria
HP:0012605.definition: An increased concentration of sodium(1+) in the urine.

HP:0012606.name: Renal sodium wasting
HP:0012606.definition: An abnormally increased sodium concentration in the urine in the presence of hyponatremia.
HP:0012606.definition_cn: 低钠血症伴尿钠浓度异常升高。

HP:0012607.name: Abnormal urine magnesium concentration
HP:0012607.definition: An abnormal concentration of magnesium the urine.

HP:0012608.name: Hypermagnesiuria
HP:0012608.definition: An increased concentration of magnesium the urine.

HP:0012609.name: Hypomagnesiuria
HP:0012609.definition: An decreased concentration of magnesium the urine.

HP:0012610.name: Abnormality of urinary uric acid level
HP:0012610.definition: Abnormal amount of urate in the urine.

HP:0012611.name: obsolete Increased urinary urate
HP:0012611.name_cn: 过时的 尿酸盐排泄增加

HP:0012612.name: Abnormal urinary sulfate concentration
HP:0012612.definition: Abnormal concentration of sulfate in the urine.
HP:0012612.definition_cn: 尿液中硫酸盐浓度异常。

HP:0012613.name: Increased urinary sulfate
HP:0012613.definition: Elevated concentration of SO4(2-), i.e., sulfate, in the urine.
HP:0012613.definition_cn: 尿液中SO4(2-)（即硫酸盐）浓度升高。

HP:0012614.name: Abnormal urine cytology
HP:0012614.definition: An anomalous finding in the examination of the urine for cells.
HP:0012614.definition_cn: 尿液细胞学检查异常发现。

HP:0012615.name: Cylindruria
HP:0012615.definition: The presence of renal casts (cylindrical, cigar-shaped structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.
HP:0012615.definition_cn: 尿液中存在肾小管管型（由肾脏在某些疾病状态下产生的圆柱形、雪茄状结构）。

HP:0012616.name: Leukocyte cylindruria
HP:0012616.definition: Presence of leukocyte casts (cylindrical structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.
HP:0012616.definition_cn: 尿液中存在白细胞管型（肾脏在某些疾病状态下产生的圆柱状结构）。

HP:0012617.name: Erythrocyte cylindruria
HP:0012617.definition: Presence of erythrocyte casts (cylindrical structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.
HP:0012617.definition_cn: 尿液中存在红细胞管型（肾脏在某些疾病状态下产生的圆柱状结构）。

HP:0012618.name: Urachal cyst
HP:0012618.definition: A cyst located along the allantois canal.
HP:0012618.definition_cn: 位于尿囊管沿线的囊肿。

HP:0012619.name: Multiple bladder diverticula
HP:0012619.definition: Presence of a many diverticula (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urinary bladder.
HP:0012619.definition_cn: 膀胱壁内存在多个憩室（囊袋或小袋）。

HP:0012620.name: Cloacal abnormality
HP:0012620.definition: A developmental anomaly associated with the failure of rectum, vagina, and bladder to separate.
HP:0012620.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，表现为直肠、阴道和膀胱未能分离。

HP:0012621.name: Persistent cloaca
HP:0012621.definition: Developmental anomaly in which the vagina, bladder, and rectum fuse resulting in a common channel.
HP:0012621.definition_cn: 发育异常，其中阴道、膀胱和直肠融合形成共同通道。

HP:0012622.name: Chronic kidney disease
HP:0012622.definition: Functional anomaly of the kidney persisting for at least three months.
HP:0012622.definition_cn: 肾功能异常持续至少三个月。

HP:0012623.name: Stage 1 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012623.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with normal or increased glomerular filtration rate (GFR at least 90 mL/min/1.73 m2).
HP:0012623.definition_cn: 一种慢性肾脏病类型，其肾小球滤过率（GFR）正常或增加（GFR至少为90 mL/min/1.73 m²）。

HP:0012624.name: Stage 2 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012624.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with mildly reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 60-89 mL/min/1.73 m2).
HP:0012624.definition_cn: 一种慢性肾脏病，伴有轻度降低的肾小球滤过率（GFR 60-89 mL/min/1.73 m²）。

HP:0012625.name: Stage 3 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012625.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with moderately reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 30-59 mL/min/1.73 m2).
HP:0012625.definition_cn: 一种慢性肾脏病，伴有中度降低的肾小球滤过率（GFR 30-59 mL/min/1.73 m²）。

HP:0012626.name: Stage 4 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012626.definition: A type of chronic kidney disease with severely reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 15-29 mL/min/1.73 m2).
HP:0012626.definition_cn: 一种慢性肾脏病，伴有严重降低的肾小球滤过率（GFR 15-29 mL/min/1.73 m²）。

HP:0012627.name: Pseudoexfoliation
HP:0012627.definition: Deposition of fibrillar material that can be found on all anterior segment structures bathed by aqueous humor.
HP:0012627.definition_cn: 房水浸润的所有眼前节结构上均可发现纤维样物质沉积。

HP:0012628.name: Abnormal suspensory ligament of lens morphology
HP:0012628.definition: An anomaly of the suspensory ligament of lens, also known as the ciliary zonule. These ligaments represent a series of fibers connecting the ciliary body and lens of the eye, holding the lens in place.
HP:0012628.name_cn: 晶状体悬韧带形态异常
HP:0012628.definition_cn: 晶状体悬韧带异常，亦称睫状小带异常。该韧带为一系列连接睫状体与眼球晶状体的纤维，负责固定晶状体位置。

HP:0012629.name: Phakodonesis
HP:0012629.definition: Tremulousness (trembling) of the lens of the eye.

HP:0012630.name: Abnormal trabecular meshwork morphology
HP:0012630.definition: An anomaly of the trabecular meshwork, which is the porelike structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber at the base of the cornea and near the ciliary body. The trabecular mesh work is responsible for draining the aqueous humor into the canal of Schlemm.
HP:0012630.definition_cn: 小梁网异常，小梁网是一种位于角膜基底部和睫状体附近、环绕前房整个周界的多孔结构，负责将房水引流至Schlemm管。

HP:0012631.name: Pigment deposition in the trabecular meshwork
HP:0012631.definition: Accumulation of abnormal amounts of pigment within the trabecular meshwork.
HP:0012631.definition_cn: 小梁网内异常色素积聚。

HP:0012632.name: Abnormal intraocular pressure
HP:0012632.definition: An anomaly in the amount of force per unit area exerted by the intraocular fluid within the eye.
HP:0012632.definition_cn: 眼内液对单位面积施加的压力异常。

HP:0012633.name: Asymmetry of intraocular pressure
HP:0012633.definition: A difference in the amount of intraocular pressure in the right and left eye.

HP:0012634.name: Iris pigment dispersion
HP:0012634.definition: Shedding of the pigment granules that normally adhere to the back of the iris into the aqueous humor.
HP:0012634.definition_cn: 虹膜后色素颗粒脱落进入房水。

HP:0012635.name: Iris hypoperfusion
HP:0012635.definition: Reduction in the amount of blood flow to the iris.

HP:0012637.name: Renal calcium wasting
HP:0012637.definition: High urine calcium in the presence of hypocalcemia.

HP:0012638.name: Abnormal nervous system physiology
HP:0012638.definition: A functional anomaly of the nervous system.
HP:0012638.name_cn: 神经系统生理功能异常

HP:0012639.name: Abnormal nervous system morphology
HP:0012639.definition: A structural anomaly of the nervous system.

HP:0012640.name: Abnormality of intracranial pressure
HP:0012640.definition: A deviation from the norm of the intracranial pressure.

HP:0012641.name: Decreased intracranial pressure
HP:0012641.definition: A reduction of the pressure inside the cranium (skull) and thereby in the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0012641.definition_cn: 颅内压（颅骨内压力）降低，进而导致脑组织及脑脊液压力下降。

HP:0012642.name: Cerebellar agenesis
HP:0012642.definition: Cerebellar agenesis is defined by the near complete absence of cerebellar tissue with only remnants of the anterior vermis, flocculus, and/or middle cerebellar peduncles.
HP:0012642.definition_cn: 小脑发育不全定义为小脑组织几乎完全缺失，仅残留前蚓部、绒球和/或小脑中脚。

HP:0012643.name: Foveal hypopigmentation
HP:0012643.definition: Decreased amount of pigmentation in the fovea centralis.

HP:0012644.name: Increased caudate lactate level
HP:0012644.definition: An elevated concentration of lactate in the caudate nucleus. This finding can be elicited by magnetic resonance spectroscopy imaging.
HP:0012644.definition_cn: 尾状核内乳酸浓度升高。该发现可通过磁共振波谱成像技术检测。

HP:0012645.name: Enlarged peripheral nerve
HP:0012645.definition: Increase in size of a peripheral nerve. This finding can be appreciated by palpation along the axis of the nerve.
HP:0012645.definition_cn: 周围神经增粗。该体征可通过沿神经轴进行触诊来评估。

HP:0012646.name: Retractile testis
HP:0012646.definition: A testis that is located at the upper scrotum or lower inguinal canal and that can be made to descend completely into the scrotum without resistance by manual reduction but returns to its original position by the cremasteric reflex.
HP:0012646.definition_cn: 位于阴囊上部或腹股沟管下部的睾丸，可通过手法复位无阻力地完全降至阴囊，但因提睾肌反射而返回原位。

HP:0012647.name: Abnormal inflammatory response
HP:0012647.definition: Any anomaly of the inflammatory response, a response to injury or infection characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages.
HP:0012647.definition_cn: 炎症反应异常，即对损伤或感染的反应异常，其特征为局部血管扩张、血浆外渗至细胞间隙以及白细胞和巨噬细胞的积聚。

HP:0012648.name: Decreased inflammatory response
HP:0012648.definition: An abnormal reduction in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.
HP:0012648.definition_cn: 对损伤或感染的炎症反应异常减弱。

HP:0012649.name: Increased inflammatory response
HP:0012649.definition: A abnormal increase in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.
HP:0012649.definition_cn: 对损伤或感染的炎症反应异常增强。

HP:0012650.name: Perisylvian polymicrogyria
HP:0012650.definition: Polymicrogyria (an excessive number of small gyri or convolutions) that is maximal in perisylvian regions (the regions that surround the Sylvian fissures), which may be symmetric or asymmetric and may extend beyond perisylvian regions. The Sylvian fissures often extend posteriorly and superiorly.
HP:0012650.name_cn: 外侧裂周围多小脑回畸形
HP:0012650.definition_cn: 多小脑回畸形（表现为过多的小脑回或脑回卷曲），主要位于外侧裂周围区域（即围绕外侧裂的区域），可为对称性或非对称性，并可延伸至外侧裂区域以外。外侧裂常向后上方延伸。

HP:0012651.name: Abasia
HP:0012651.definition: A severe form of gait ataxia such that an affected person cannot walk at all.
HP:0012651.definition_cn: 严重步态共济失调，导致患者完全无法行走。

HP:0012653.name: Status asthmaticus
HP:0012653.definition: Severe asthma unresponsive to repeated courses of beta-agonist therapy such as inhaled albuterol, levalbuterol, or subcutaneous epinephrine.
HP:0012653.definition_cn: 对反复使用β受体激动剂治疗（如吸入沙丁胺醇、左旋沙丁胺醇或皮下注射肾上腺素）无反应的严重哮喘。

HP:0012654.name: Abnormal CSF dopamine concentration
HP:0012654.definition: Abnormal concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0012654.name_cn: 脑脊液多巴胺浓度异常
HP:0012654.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中多巴胺浓度异常。

HP:0012655.name: Elevated CSF dopamine concentration
HP:0012655.definition: Increased concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0012655.name_cn: 脑脊液多巴胺浓度升高
HP:0012655.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中多巴胺浓度升高。

HP:0012656.name: Reduced CSF dopamine concentration
HP:0012656.definition: Decreased concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0012656.name_cn: 脑脊液多巴胺浓度降低
HP:0012656.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中多巴胺浓度降低。

HP:0012657.name: Abnormal brain positron emission tomography
HP:0012657.definition: A functional brain anomaly detectable by positron emission tomography (PET). PET scanning is a method for functional brain imaging, and its measurements reflect the amount of brain activity in the various regions of the brain.
HP:0012657.name_cn: 脑部正电子发射断层扫描异常
HP:0012657.definition_cn: 一种可通过正电子发射断层扫描（PET）检测到的功能性脑部异常。PET扫描是一种功能性脑成像方法，其测量结果反映了大脑各区域的活动量。

HP:0012658.name: Abnormal brain FDG positron emission tomography
HP:0012658.definition: An anomaly detectable in [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography (PET) brain scans. Glucose uptake measured with FDG-PET is a marker of neuronal metabolic activity.
HP:0012658.name_cn: 脑部FDG正电子发射断层扫描异常
HP:0012658.definition_cn: 在[18F]-氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）正电子发射断层扫描（PET）脑部扫描中可检测到的异常。通过FDG-PET测量的葡萄糖摄取是神经元代谢活动的标志物。

HP:0012659.name: Prefrontal hypometabolism in FDG PET
HP:0012659.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the prefrontal cortex as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.
HP:0012659.name_cn: 前额叶低代谢在氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描中
HP:0012659.definition_cn: 前额叶皮质[18F]-氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）摄取减少，通过正电子发射断层扫描（PET）脑部扫描检测。

HP:0012660.name: Thalamic hypometabolism in FDG PET
HP:0012660.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the thalamus as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.
HP:0012660.name_cn: 丘脑低代谢在氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描中
HP:0012660.definition_cn: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）脑部扫描显示丘脑对[18F]-氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）的摄取减少。

HP:0012661.name: Hypothalamic hypometabolism in FDG PET
HP:0012661.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the hypothalamus as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.
HP:0012661.name_cn: 下丘脑低代谢在氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描中
HP:0012661.definition_cn: 下丘脑[18F]-氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）摄取减少，通过正电子发射断层扫描（PET）脑部扫描检测。

HP:0012662.name: Parietal hypometabolism in FDG PET
HP:0012662.definition: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the parietal cortex as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.
HP:0012662.name_cn: FDG PET显示顶叶代谢减低
HP:0012662.definition_cn: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）脑部扫描显示顶叶皮质对[18F]-氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）的摄取减少。

HP:0012663.name: Mildly reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012663.definition: A small reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle. The normal range in adults is at least 50 percent, and a mild reduction is defined as 40-49 percent.
HP:0012663.name_cn: 轻度左心室射血分数降低
HP:0012663.definition_cn: 左心室射血分数轻度降低。成人正常范围为至少50%，轻度降低定义为40-49%。

HP:0012664.name: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012664.definition: A diminution of the volumetric fraction of blood pumped out of the ventricle with each cardiac cycle.

HP:0012665.name: Moderately reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012665.definition: A medium reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle, defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction of 30-39 percent.
HP:0012665.name_cn: 中度降低的左心室射血分数
HP:0012665.definition_cn: 左心室射血分数中度降低，定义为每次心动周期从左心室泵出的血液比例在30%至39%之间。

HP:0012666.name: Severely reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012666.definition: A large reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle. The normal range in adults is at over 50 percent, and a severe reduction is defined as less than 30 percent.
HP:0012666.name_cn: 左心室射血分数严重降低
HP:0012666.definition_cn: 左心室射血分数显著降低。成人正常范围为超过50%，严重降低定义为低于30%。

HP:0012667.name: Regional left ventricular wall motion abnormality
HP:0012667.definition: An abnormal motion of a segment of the left ventricle during the cardiac cycle.
HP:0012667.name_cn: 区域性左心室壁运动异常
HP:0012667.definition_cn: 左心室节段在心动周期中的异常运动。

HP:0012668.name: Vasovagal syncope
HP:0012668.definition: A vasovagal episode or vasovagal syncope is the most common form of reflex syncope. Reflex syncope is a general term used to describe types of syncope resulting from a failure in autoregulation of blood pressure, and ultimately, in cerebral perfusion pressure resulting in transient loss of consciousness. The mechanisms responsible for this are complex and involve both depression of cardiac output as well as a decrease in vascular tone.
HP:0012668.definition_cn: 血管迷走神经发作或血管迷走神经性晕厥是反射性晕厥的最常见形式。反射性晕厥是一个通用术语，用于描述由于血压自动调节功能失调，最终导致脑灌注压下降而引起的短暂意识丧失的晕厥类型。其机制复杂，涉及心输出量的抑制以及血管张力的降低。

HP:0012669.name: Carotid sinus syncope
HP:0012669.definition: An exaggerated response to carotid sinus baroreceptor stimulation resulting in syncope from transient diminished cerebral perfusion.
HP:0012669.definition_cn: 颈动脉窦压力感受器刺激过度反应导致短暂性脑灌注不足引起的晕厥。

HP:0012670.name: Orthostatic syncope
HP:0012670.definition: Syncope following a quick change in position from lying down to standing.
HP:0012670.definition_cn: 体位性低血压引起的晕厥（Orthostatic Hypotension-Induced Syncope）。

HP:0012671.name: Abulia
HP:0012671.definition: Abulia is characterized by difficulty in initiating and sustaining spontaneous movements; the person often appears frozen but will move hesitantly on request. There are frequently substantial reductions in emotional responsiveness, spontaneous speech, and social interaction. The individual appears to be content to remain still and inactive with minimal movement, but moves or reacts hesitantly in response to interactions.
HP:0012671.definition_cn: 意志缺失症（Abulia）的特征为难以启动和维持自主动作；患者常表现为静止状态，但在要求下会犹豫不决地移动。通常伴有显著的情感反应、自发语言及社交互动的减少。患者似乎满足于保持静止和极少活动的状态，但在互动时会犹豫不决地移动或反应。

HP:0012672.name: Akinetic mutism
HP:0012672.definition: The combined absence of spontaneous movement (akinesia) and speech (mutism). There may be eye movements consistent with visual tracking and the person may remember the events occurring at the time of the experience of stupor.
HP:0012672.definition_cn: 自发性运动缺失（运动不能，akinesia）与言语缺失（缄默症，mutism）的联合表现。可能存在与视觉追踪一致的眼球运动，且个体可能回忆起木僵状态期间发生的事件。

HP:0012673.name: Aplasia of the upper vagina
HP:0012673.definition: A failure to develop of the upper vagina.

HP:0012674.name: Aplasia of the lower vagina
HP:0012674.definition: A failure to develop of the lower part of the vagina.

HP:0012675.name: Iron accumulation in brain
HP:0012675.definition: An abnormal build up of iron (Fe) in brain tissue.
HP:0012675.definition_cn: 脑组织中铁（Fe）的异常积聚。

HP:0012676.name: Copper accumulation in brain
HP:0012676.definition: An anomalous build up of copper (Cu) in the brain.

HP:0012677.name: obsolete Iron accumulation in globus pallidus

HP:0012678.name: Iron accumulation in substantia nigra
HP:0012678.definition: An anomalous build up of iron (Fe) in the substantia nigra.

HP:0012679.name: Widened interpedicular distance
HP:0012679.definition: An increase in the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.
HP:0012679.definition_cn: 椎弓根间距增宽，椎弓根为椎体后外侧交界处上部的两个短而厚的突起，向后突出。

HP:0012680.name: Abnormality of the pineal gland
HP:0012680.definition: An anomaly of the pineal gland,a small endocrine gland in the brain that produces melatonin.
HP:0012680.definition_cn: 松果体异常，松果体是大脑中一个产生褪黑激素的小型内分泌腺。

HP:0012681.name: Abnormal pineal morphology
HP:0012681.definition: A structural abnormality of the pineal gland.

HP:0012682.name: Pineal gland calcification
HP:0012682.definition: Accumulation of calcium salts in the pineal gland.

HP:0012683.name: Pineal cyst
HP:0012683.definition: A glial uniloculated or multiloculated fluid-filled sac that either reside within or completely replace the pineal gland.
HP:0012683.definition_cn: 一种胶质单房或多房性囊性病变，其内充满液体，可位于松果体内或完全取代松果体。

HP:0012684.name: Abnormal pineal volume
HP:0012684.definition: An abnormal increase or decrease in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.
HP:0012684.definition_cn: 松果体三维空间体积的异常增加或减少。

HP:0012685.name: Decreased pineal volume
HP:0012685.definition: An abnormal reduction in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

HP:0012686.name: Increased pineal volume
