HP:0012686.definition: An abnormal elevation in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

HP:0012687.name: Agenesis of pineal gland
HP:0012687.definition: Failure to develop of the pineal gland, defined clinically as the absence of the pineal gland with no indication of the pineal gland even having been present.
HP:0012687.definition_cn: 松果体发育不全，临床定义为松果体缺失且无任何松果体存在迹象。

HP:0012688.name: Abnormality of pineal physiology
HP:0012688.definition: A functional abnormality of the pineal gland.

HP:0012689.name: Abnormal pineal melatonin secretion
HP:0012689.definition: An anomaly in the amount or timing of melatonin secretion by the pineal gland. Note that melatonin is also synthesized by multiple tissues outside of the pineal gland.
HP:0012689.name_cn: 松果体褪黑激素分泌异常
HP:0012689.definition_cn: 松果体分泌褪黑激素的量或时间异常。需注意，褪黑激素亦由松果体外的多种组织合成。

HP:0012690.name: T2 hypointense thalamus
HP:0012690.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting the entire thalamus.
HP:0012690.definition_cn: 丘脑磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。该术语指影响整个丘脑的弥漫性低信号。

HP:0012691.name: Focal T2 hypointense thalamic lesion
HP:0012691.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.
HP:0012691.name_cn: 局灶性T2低信号丘脑病变
HP:0012691.definition_cn: 丘脑磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。该术语指丘脑特定区域的局部低信号。

HP:0012692.name: Focal T2 hyperintense thalamic lesion
HP:0012692.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.
HP:0012692.name_cn: 局灶性T2高信号丘脑病变
HP:0012692.definition_cn: 丘脑磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期减弱。该术语指丘脑特定区域的局部高信号。

HP:0012693.name: Abnormal thalamic size
HP:0012693.definition: Deviation from the normal range of size of the thalamus.
HP:0012693.definition_cn: 丘脑大小偏离正常范围。

HP:0012694.name: Enlarged thalamic volume
HP:0012694.definition: An increase in the quantity of space occupied by the thalamus.

HP:0012695.name: Decreased thalamic volume
HP:0012695.definition: A reduction in the quantity of space occupied by the thalamus.

HP:0012696.name: Abnormal thalamic MRI signal intensity
HP:0012696.definition: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus.
HP:0012696.definition_cn: 丘脑磁共振成像（MRI）信号异常。

HP:0012697.name: Small basal ganglia
HP:0012697.definition: Decreased size of the basal ganglia.

HP:0012698.name: Cerebellar gliosis
HP:0012698.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the cerebellum.
HP:0012698.definition_cn: 小脑胶质细胞局灶性增生。

HP:0012699.name: Anomaly of lower limb diaphyses
HP:0012699.definition: A structural abnormality of a diaphysis of the leg.

HP:0012700.name: Abnormal large intestine physiology
HP:0012700.definition: A functional anomaly of the large intestine.

HP:0012701.name: Bowel urgency
HP:0012701.definition: A sudden, irresistible need to have a bowel movement.

HP:0012702.name: Tenesmus
HP:0012702.definition: A repeated, painful urge to defecate without excreting stool.

HP:0012703.name: Abnormal subarachnoid space morphology
HP:0012703.definition: Abnormality in the space in the meninges beneath the arachnoid membrane and above the pia mater that contains the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0012703.definition_cn: 蛛网膜下腔异常，位于蛛网膜与软脑膜之间，内含脑脊液。

HP:0012704.name: Widened subarachnoid space
HP:0012704.definition: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater.

HP:0012705.name: Abnormal metabolic brain imaging by MRS
HP:0012705.definition: An anomaly of metabolism in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0012705.name_cn: 磁共振波谱成像（MRS）显示脑代谢异常
HP:0012705.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到的大脑代谢异常。

HP:0012706.name: Elevated brain choline level by MRS
HP:0012706.definition: An increase in the level of choline-containing compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0012706.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑胆碱水平升高
HP:0012706.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内含胆碱化合物水平升高。

HP:0012707.name: Elevated brain lactate level by MRS
HP:0012707.definition: An increase in the level of lactate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0012707.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑乳酸水平升高
HP:0012707.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内乳酸水平升高。

HP:0012708.name: Reduced brain N-acetyl aspartate level by MRS
HP:0012708.definition: A decrease in the level of N-acetyl aspartate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0012708.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内N-乙酰天门冬氨酸（NAA）水平降低
HP:0012708.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内N-乙酰天门冬氨酸（N-acetyl aspartate, NAA）水平降低。

HP:0012709.name: Abnormal brain choline/creatine ratio by MRS
HP:0012709.definition: A deviation from normal in the ratio of choline to creatine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0012709.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑胆碱/肌酸比值异常
HP:0012709.definition_cn: 磁共振波谱分析（MRS）检测到脑内胆碱与肌酸比值异常。

HP:0012710.name: Ingrown nail
HP:0012710.definition: Excessive growth of a nail laterally into the nail fold.
HP:0012710.definition_cn: 甲侧缘过度生长嵌入甲襞。

HP:0012711.name: Delayed ossification of vertebral epiphysis
HP:0012711.definition: A delay in the process of formation and maturation of the epiphysis of one or more vertebrae.
HP:0012711.definition_cn: 一个或多个椎体骨骺形成和成熟过程的延迟。

HP:0012712.name: Mild hearing impairment
HP:0012712.definition: The presence of a mild form of hearing impairment.

HP:0012713.name: Moderate hearing impairment
HP:0012713.definition: The presence of a moderate form of hearing impairment.

HP:0012714.name: Severe hearing impairment
HP:0012714.definition: A severe form of hearing impairment.

HP:0012715.name: Profound hearing impairment
HP:0012715.definition: A profound (essentially complete) form of hearing impairment.
HP:0012715.definition_cn: 重度（几乎完全）听力损失。

HP:0012716.name: Moderate conductive hearing impairment
HP:0012716.definition: The presence of a moderate form of conductive hearing impairment.
HP:0012716.definition_cn: 存在中度传导性听力障碍。

HP:0012717.name: Severe conductive hearing impairment
HP:0012717.definition: A severe form of conductive hearing impairment.

HP:0012718.name: Abnormal gastrointestinal tract morphology
HP:0012718.definition: Abnormal structure of the gastrointestinal tract.

HP:0012719.name: Functional abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
HP:0012719.definition: Abnormal functionality of the gastrointestinal tract.

HP:0012720.name: Neoplasm of the nose
HP:0012720.definition: Tumor (An abnormal mass of tissue resulting from abnormally dividing cells) of the nasal cavity.
HP:0012720.definition_cn: 鼻腔肿瘤（由异常分裂细胞形成的异常组织肿块）。

HP:0012721.name: Venous malformation
HP:0012721.definition: A vascular malformation resulting from a developmental error of venous tissue composed of dysmorphic channels lined by flattened endothelium and exhibiting slow turnover. A venous malformation may present as a blue patch on the skin ranging to a soft blue mass. Venous malformations are easily compressible and usually swell in thewhen venous pressure increases (e.g., when held in a dependent position or when a child cries). They may be relatively localized or quite extensive within an anatomic region.
HP:0012721.definition_cn: 静脉畸形是一种由静脉组织发育异常引起的血管畸形，由形态异常的通道组成，内衬扁平内皮细胞，并表现出缓慢的更新。静脉畸形可表现为皮肤上的蓝色斑块，或柔软的蓝色肿块。静脉畸形易于压缩，通常在静脉压力增加时（例如，处于下垂位置或儿童哭泣时）会肿胀。它们可能在解剖区域内相对局限或相当广泛。

HP:0012722.name: Heart block
HP:0012722.definition: Impaired conduction of cardiac impulse occurring anywhere along the conduction pathway.
HP:0012722.definition_cn: 心脏传导通路中任何部位发生的心脏冲动传导障碍。

HP:0012723.name: Sinoatrial block
HP:0012723.definition: Disturbance in the atrial activation that is caused by transient failure of impulse conduction from the sinoatrial node to the cardiac atria.
HP:0012723.definition_cn: 窦房结至心房冲动传导暂时性障碍导致的心房激动异常。

HP:0012724.name: Upper eyelid edema
HP:0012724.definition: Edema in the region of the upper eyelid.

HP:0012725.name: Cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0012725.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal or metatarsophalangeal joint of the adjacent digits.
HP:0012725.definition_cn: 在前后轴方向上，两个指（趾）之间存在软组织连续性，且该连续性向远端延伸至至少近端指（趾）间关节水平；或在前后轴方向上，两个指（趾）之间存在软组织连续性，且该连续性显著位于相邻指（趾）掌指关节或跖趾关节屈曲皱褶的远端。

HP:0012726.name: Episodic hypokalemia
HP:0012726.definition: An abnormally decreased potassium concentration in the blood occurring periodically with a return to normal between the episodes.

HP:0012727.name: Thoracic aortic aneurysm
HP:0012727.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the thoracic aorta.
HP:0012727.definition_cn: 胸主动脉局部异常扩张（扩张症）。

HP:0012728.name: Fusiform descending thoracic aortic aneurysm
HP:0012728.definition: A concentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta that involves the full circumference of the vessel wall
HP:0012728.definition_cn: 降主动脉的同心性异常局限性扩张（扩张），累及血管壁全周。

HP:0012729.name: Saccular descending thoracic aortic aneurysm
HP:0012729.definition: An eccentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta that involves only a portion of the circumference of the vessel wall
HP:0012729.definition_cn: 降主动脉局部偏心性异常扩张，仅累及血管壁部分周径。

HP:0012730.name: Aglossia
HP:0012730.definition: Absence of the tongue owing to a developmental abnormality.

HP:0012731.name: Ectopic anterior pituitary gland
HP:0012731.definition: Abnormal anatomic location of the anterior pituitary gland.
HP:0012731.definition_cn: 垂体前叶解剖位置异常。

HP:0012732.name: Anorectal anomaly
HP:0012732.definition: An abnormality of the anus or rectum.

HP:0012733.name: Macule
HP:0012733.definition: A flat, distinct, discolored area of skin less than 1 cm wide that does not involve any change in the thickness or texture of the skin.
HP:0012733.definition_cn: 直径小于1厘米的皮肤平坦、界限清晰、颜色异常的斑疹，不伴有皮肤厚度或质地的改变。

HP:0012734.name: Ketotic hypoglycemia
HP:0012734.definition: Low blood glucose is accompanied by elevated levels of ketone bodies in the body.
HP:0012734.definition_cn: 低血糖伴随体内酮体水平升高。

HP:0012735.name: Cough
HP:0012735.definition: A sudden, audible expulsion of air from the lungs through a partially closed glottis, preceded by inhalation.
HP:0012735.definition_cn: 咳嗽（Cough）：一种突然的、可闻的通过部分闭合的声门从肺部排出空气的现象，通常伴有吸气。

HP:0012736.name: Profound global developmental delay
HP:0012736.definition: A profound delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.
HP:0012736.name_cn: 严重的全面性发育迟缓
HP:0012736.definition_cn: 儿童在运动或智力发育领域里程碑的显著延迟。

HP:0012737.name: Small intestinal polyp
HP:0012737.definition: A discrete abnormal tissue mass that protrudes into the lumen of the small intestine and is attached to the intestinal wall either by a stalk, pedunculus, or a broad base.
HP:0012737.definition_cn: 一种离散的异常组织肿块，突入小肠管腔，并通过蒂、柄或宽基底附着于肠壁。

HP:0012739.name: Agenesis of the small intestine
HP:0012739.definition: Failure to develop of the small intestine.

HP:0012740.name: Papilloma
HP:0012740.definition: A tumor of the skin or mucous membrane with finger-like projections.
HP:0012740.definition_cn: 皮肤或黏膜的指状突起性肿瘤。

HP:0012741.name: Unilateral cryptorchidism
HP:0012741.definition: Absence of a testis from the scrotum on one side owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.
HP:0012741.definition_cn: 单侧睾丸未降，由于睾丸未能通过腹股沟管下降至阴囊所致。

HP:0012742.name: Thin fingernail
HP:0012742.definition: Fingernail that appears thin when viewed on end.

HP:0012743.name: Abdominal obesity
HP:0012743.definition: Excessive fat around the stomach and abdomen.

HP:0012744.name: Femoral aplasia
HP:0012744.definition: Failure of the femur to develop.

HP:0012745.name: Short palpebral fissure
HP:0012745.definition: Distance between the medial and lateral canthi is more than 2 SD below the mean for age (objective); or, apparently reduced length of the palpebral fissures.
HP:0012745.definition_cn: 内眦与外眦之间的距离低于同年龄组平均值2个标准差以上（客观标准）；或，睑裂长度明显缩短。

HP:0012746.name: Thin toenail
HP:0012746.definition: Toenail that appears thin when viewed on end.
HP:0012746.definition_cn: 末端观察时呈现薄弱的趾甲。

HP:0012747.name: Abnormal brainstem MRI signal intensity
HP:0012747.definition: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem.
HP:0012747.definition_cn: 脑干磁共振成像（MRI）信号异常。

HP:0012748.name: Focal T2 hyperintense brainstem lesion
HP:0012748.definition: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.
HP:0012748.name_cn: 局灶性T2高信号脑干病变
HP:0012748.definition_cn: 脑干磁共振成像（MRI）中较预期为低的T2信号。该术语指影响脑干特定区域的局部高信号。

HP:0012749.name: Focal T2 hypointense brainstem lesion
HP:0012749.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.
HP:0012749.name_cn: 局灶性T2低信号脑干病变
HP:0012749.definition_cn: 脑干磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。该术语指影响脑干特定区域的局部低信号。

HP:0012750.name: T2 hypointense brainstem
HP:0012750.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting the entire brainstem.
HP:0012750.definition_cn: 脑干磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。该术语指影响整个脑干的弥漫性低信号。

HP:0012751.name: Abnormal basal ganglia MRI signal intensity
HP:0012751.definition: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia.
HP:0012751.name_cn: 基底节区磁共振成像信号强度异常
HP:0012751.definition_cn: 基底节区磁共振成像（MRI）信号异常。

HP:0012752.name: Focal T2 hypointense basal ganglia lesion
HP:0012752.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the basal ganglia.
HP:0012752.name_cn: 基底节区局灶性T2低信号病变
HP:0012752.definition_cn: 基底节区磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。该术语指基底节特定区域的局部低信号。

HP:0012753.name: T2 hypointense basal ganglia
HP:0012753.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting all of the basal ganglia.
HP:0012753.definition_cn: 基底节区磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。该术语指影响所有基底节区的弥漫性低信号。

HP:0012754.name: CNS hypermyelination
HP:0012754.definition: Increased amount of myelin in the central nervous system.
HP:0012754.name_cn: 中枢神经系统过度髓鞘化
HP:0012754.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统髓鞘含量增加。

HP:0012755.name: Enlarged brainstem
HP:0012755.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the brainstem.

HP:0012756.name: CSF polymorphonuclear pleocytosis
HP:0012756.definition: An increased polymorphonuclear cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0012756.name_cn: 脑脊液多形核细胞增多
HP:0012756.definition_cn: 脑脊液中多形核白细胞计数增高。

HP:0012757.name: Abnormal neuron morphology
HP:0012757.definition: A structural anomaly of a neuron. Neurons are electrically excitable cells that transmit signals throughout the body. Neurons employ both electrical and chemical components in the transmission of information. Neurons are connected to other neurons at synapses and connected to effector organs or cells at neuroeffector junctions.
HP:0012757.definition_cn: 神经元结构异常。神经元是电兴奋性细胞，负责在全身传递信号。神经元在信息传递过程中同时利用电和化学成分。神经元通过突触与其他神经元连接，并通过神经效应器连接与效应器官或细胞相连。

HP:0012758.name: Neurodevelopmental delay
HP:0012758.definition: Neurodevelopmental delay (NDD) refers to delays in the maturation of the brain and central nervous system; infants and young children with NDD may experience delays in the development of one or more skills including gross motor abilities, fine-motor coordination, language abilities and ability to solve increasingly complex problems.
HP:0012758.definition_cn: 神经发育迟缓（Neurodevelopmental Delay, NDD）是指大脑和中枢神经系统成熟过程的延迟；患有NDD的婴幼儿可能在一种或多种技能的发展上出现延迟，包括粗大运动能力、精细运动协调能力、语言能力以及解决日益复杂问题的能力。

HP:0012759.name: Neurodevelopmental abnormality
HP:0012759.definition: A deviation from normal of the neurological development of a child, which may include any or all of the aspects of the development of personal, social, gross or fine motor, and cognitive abilities.
HP:0012759.definition_cn: 儿童神经发育偏离正常轨迹，可能涉及个人、社交、粗大运动、精细运动及认知能力等各方面发育的异常。

HP:0012760.name: Reduced social responsiveness
HP:0012760.definition: A reduced ability to participate in the back-and-forth flow of social interaction appropriate to culture and developmental level, which is normally characterized by an influence of the behavior of one person on the behavior of another person. This results in difficulty interacting with others through emotional, physical, or verbal communication.
HP:0012760.definition_cn: 社交互动双向交流能力减退，表现为在文化和发展水平相适应的社交互动中，无法有效参与双向交流，通常表现为一个人的行为对另一个人的行为缺乏影响。这导致在情感、身体或语言交流方面与他人互动困难。

HP:0012761.name: Absent mastoid
HP:0012761.definition: A developmental anomaly in which the mastoid process fails to form and is thus found to be congenitally absent.
HP:0012761.definition_cn: 乳突发育不全，表现为乳突先天性缺失。

HP:0012762.name: Cerebral white matter atrophy
HP:0012762.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebral white matter.
HP:0012762.definition_cn: 脑白质萎缩（消耗性改变）的存在。

HP:0012763.name: Paroxysmal dyspnea
HP:0012763.definition: A sudden attack of dyspnea that occurs while the affected person is at rest.
HP:0012763.definition_cn: 静息状态下突发性呼吸困难发作。

HP:0012764.name: Orthopnea
HP:0012764.definition: A sensation of breathlessness in the recumbent position, relieved by sitting or standing.

HP:0012765.name: Widened cerebellar subarachnoid space
HP:0012765.definition: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebellum.
HP:0012765.definition_cn: 小脑周围蛛网膜下腔间隙扩大。

HP:0012766.name: Widened cerebral subarachnoid space
HP:0012766.definition: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebrum.
HP:0012766.definition_cn: 大脑周围区域蛛网膜与软脑膜之间解剖间隙的扩大。

HP:0012767.name: Abnormal placental size
HP:0012767.definition: A deviation from normal size of the placenta.

HP:0012769.name: Abnormal arm span
HP:0012769.definition: A deviation from normal of the length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle)
HP:0012769.definition_cn: 臂展长度异常（指个体双臂平举至肩高，呈180度角时，从一侧指尖至另一侧指尖的距离偏离正常范围）

HP:0012770.name: Reduced arm span
HP:0012770.definition: Decreased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).
HP:0012770.definition_cn: 臂展长度减少（指个体双臂平行于地面，肩高呈180度角伸展时，从一侧指尖至另一侧指尖的测量长度缩短）。

HP:0012771.name: Increased arm span
HP:0012771.definition: Increased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).
HP:0012771.definition_cn: 臂展增加（指个体双臂平举至肩高，呈180度角时，从一侧指尖至另一侧指尖的测量长度增加）。

HP:0012772.name: Abnormal upper to lower segment ratio
HP:0012772.definition: A deviation from normal of the relation between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis.
HP:0012772.definition_cn: 上下身比例异常，其中下身定义为耻骨联合上缘至地面的长度，上身定义为头顶至耻骨联合上缘的长度。

HP:0012773.name: Reduced upper to lower segment ratio
HP:0012773.definition: Decreased ratio between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis. Consider the term Disproportionate tall stature (HP:0001519) if tall stature is also present.
HP:0012773.definition_cn: 上下段比例降低，其中下段定义为耻骨联合上缘至地面的长度，上段定义为头顶至耻骨联合上缘的长度。若同时存在身材高大，可考虑使用术语“不成比例的身材高大”（HP:0001519）。

HP:0012774.name: Increased upper to lower segment ratio
HP:0012774.definition: Elevated ratio between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis.
HP:0012774.definition_cn: 上下段比例增高，其中下段定义为耻骨联合上缘至地面的长度，上段定义为头顶至耻骨联合上缘的长度。

HP:0012775.name: Stellate iris
HP:0012775.definition: A lacy pattern or iris pigmentation that resembles the spokes of a bicycle wheel.
HP:0012775.definition_cn: 一种呈蕾丝样或虹膜色素沉着，类似自行车轮辐条状的模式。

HP:0012776.name: Abnormal ciliary body morphology
HP:0012776.definition: A structural anomaly of the ciliary body.

HP:0012777.name: Retinal neoplasm
HP:0012777.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the retina.
HP:0012777.definition_cn: 视网膜肿瘤（视网膜组织异常增生）

HP:0012778.name: Retinal astrocytic hamartoma
HP:0012778.definition: A glial tumor of the retinal nerve fiber layer arising from a retinal astrocyte.
HP:0012778.name_cn: 视网膜星形细胞错构瘤
HP:0012778.definition_cn: 视网膜神经纤维层胶质瘤，起源于视网膜星形胶质细胞。

HP:0012779.name: Transient hearing impairment
HP:0012779.definition: Hearing loss that occurs acutely and resolves completely.

HP:0012780.name: Neoplasm of the ear
HP:0012780.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ear.
HP:0012780.definition_cn: 耳部肿瘤（组织异常增生）。

HP:0012781.name: Mid-frequency hearing loss
HP:0012781.definition: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the middle frequencies of sound (1000 Hz to 3000 Hz).
HP:0012781.definition_cn: 一种主要影响中频声音（1000赫兹至3000赫兹）的听力障碍类型。

HP:0012782.name: Perilobar nephrogenic rest
HP:0012782.definition: A type of nephrogenic rest associated with multiple lesions in the periphery of the renal lobe.
HP:0012782.definition_cn: 一种与肾叶周围多发性病变相关的肾源性残余。

HP:0012783.name: Intralobar nephrogenic rest
HP:0012783.definition: A type of nephrogenic rest usually representing single lesions within the renal lobe, renal sinus, or calyceal walls.
HP:0012783.definition_cn: 一种肾源性残余，通常表现为肾叶、肾窦或肾盏壁内的单一病变。

HP:0012784.name: Perinephritis
HP:0012784.definition: Inflammation of the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney.
HP:0012784.definition_cn: 肾周结缔组织和脂肪组织炎症。

HP:0012785.name: Flexion contracture of finger
HP:0012785.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in a finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0012785.definition_cn: 指关节慢性运动功能障碍，由非骨性组织结构改变所致。

HP:0012786.name: Recurrent cystitis
HP:0012786.definition: Repeated infections of the urinary bladder.

HP:0012788.name: Reticulate pigmentation of oral mucosa
HP:0012788.definition: A net-like pattern of increased pigmentation of the oral cavity.
HP:0012788.name_cn: 口腔黏膜网状色素沉着
HP:0012788.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜色素沉着呈网状模式。

HP:0012790.name: Abnormal intramembranous ossification
HP:0012790.definition: An anomaly in the process of intramembranous ossification by which flat bones (cranial bones of the skull, i.e., the frontal, parietal, occipital, and temporal bones, and the clavicles) are formed.
HP:0012790.definition_cn: 膜内成骨过程中出现的一种异常现象，导致扁平骨（颅骨，包括额骨、顶骨、枕骨和颞骨，以及锁骨）的形成异常。

HP:0012791.name: Abnormal humeral ossification
HP:0012791.definition: An anomaly of the process of formation of bone in the humerus.

HP:0012792.name: Absent ossification of thoracic vertebral bodies
HP:0012792.definition: A lack of bone mineralization of one or more body of thoracic vertebra.
HP:0012792.definition_cn: 一个或多个胸椎体骨矿化不足。

HP:0012793.name: Kinked brainstem
HP:0012793.definition: A kinked appearance of the brainstem, i.e., an exaggerated flexure.
HP:0012793.definition_cn: 脑干呈现弯曲形态，即过度屈曲。

HP:0012794.name: Periventricular white matter hypodensities
HP:0012794.definition: Multiple areas of darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the cerebral ventricles.
HP:0012794.name_cn: 脑室周围白质低密度影
HP:0012794.definition_cn: 脑室周围脑白质区域在磁共振成像上显示多处信号较预期暗。

HP:0012795.name: Abnormal optic disc morphology
HP:0012795.definition: A morphological abnormality of the optic disc, i.e., of the portion of the optic nerve clinically visible on fundoscopic examination.
HP:0012795.definition_cn: 视盘形态学异常，即眼底镜检查中临床可见的视神经部分形态异常。

HP:0012796.name: Increased cup-to-disc ratio
HP:0012796.definition: An elevation in the ratio of the diameter of the cup of the optic disc to the total diameter of the disk. The optic disc has an orange-pink rim with a pale center (the cup) that does not contain neuroretinal tissue. An increase in this ratio therefore may indicate a decrease in the quantity of healthy neuroretinal cells.
HP:0012796.definition_cn: 视盘杯盘比（Cup-to-Disc Ratio, CDR）增大。视盘边缘呈橙红色，中心区域（视杯）颜色较浅，且不含神经视网膜组织。因此，该比值的增加可能提示健康神经视网膜细胞数量的减少。

HP:0012797.name: Lymphatic vessel neoplasm
HP:0012797.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the lymphatic vessels.
HP:0012797.definition_cn: 淋巴管良性或恶性肿瘤。

HP:0012798.name: Pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis
HP:0012798.definition: Infiltration of smooth muscle-like cells in lymph vessels as well as the lung (pleura, alveolar septa, bronchi, pulmonary vessels and lymphatics as well as lymph nodes, especially in posterior mediastinum and retroperitoneum). Focal emphysema can develop because of airway narrowing, and the thoracic duct may be obliterated. Pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis may lead to multiple small cysts with a hamartomatous proliferation of smooth muscle in their walls.
HP:0012798.definition_cn: 淋巴管及肺部（胸膜、肺泡隔、支气管、肺血管及淋巴管，以及淋巴结，尤其是后纵隔和腹膜后）平滑肌样细胞浸润。由于气道狭窄可发生局灶性肺气肿，胸导管可能闭塞。肺淋巴管平滑肌瘤病可导致多发性小囊肿，其壁内平滑肌呈错构瘤样增生。

HP:0012799.name: Unilateral facial palsy
HP:0012799.definition: One-sided weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure.
HP:0012799.definition_cn: 单侧面部表情肌及眼轮匝肌无力。

HP:0012800.name: Accessory cranial suture
HP:0012800.definition: A cranial suture that is in addition to canonical membrane-covered openings in the incompletely ossified skull of the fetus or newborn infant.
HP:0012800.definition_cn: 胎儿或新生儿未完全骨化的颅骨中，除典型膜覆盖开口之外的额外颅缝。

HP:0012801.name: Narrow jaw
HP:0012801.definition: Bigonial distance (lower facial width) more than 2 standard deviations below the mean (objective); or an apparently decreased width of the lower jaw (mandible) when viewed from the front (subjective).
HP:0012801.definition_cn: 双侧下颌角间距离（下面部宽度）低于平均值超过2个标准差（客观）；或从正面观察时，下颌骨宽度明显减小（主观）。

HP:0012802.name: Broad jaw
HP:0012802.definition: Bigonial distance (lower facial width) more than 2 SD above the mean (objective); or an apparently increased width of the lower jaw (mandible) when viewed from the front (subjective).
HP:0012802.definition_cn: 双侧下颌角间距（下面部宽度）超过平均值2个标准差以上（客观）；或从正面观察时，下颌骨（下颌）宽度明显增加（主观）。

HP:0012803.name: Anisometropia
HP:0012803.definition: Inequality of refractive power of the two eyes.

HP:0012804.name: Corneal ulceration
HP:0012804.definition: Disruption of the epithelial layer of the cornea with involvement of the underlying stroma.
HP:0012804.definition_cn: 角膜上皮层破坏并累及下方基质层。

HP:0012805.name: Iris transillumination defect
HP:0012805.definition: Transmission of light through the iris as visualized upon slit lamp examination or infrared iris transillumination videography. The light passes through defects in the pigmentation of the iris.
HP:0012805.definition_cn: 裂隙灯检查或红外线虹膜透照录像中观察到的光线通过虹膜的传输。光线通过虹膜色素沉着缺陷处。

HP:0012806.name: Proboscis
HP:0012806.definition: A fleshy, tube-like structure usually located in the midline of the face or just to one side of the midline.
HP:0012806.definition_cn: 肉质管状结构，通常位于面部中线或中线一侧。

HP:0012807.name: High insertion of columella
HP:0012807.definition: Insertion of the posterior columella superior to the nasal base.
HP:0012807.definition_cn: 将后鼻小柱插入至鼻基底上方。

HP:0012808.name: Abnormal nasal base norphology
HP:0012808.definition: An anomaly of the nasal base, which can be conceived of as an imaginary line between the most lateral points of the external inferior attachments of the alae nasi to the face.
HP:0012808.definition_cn: 鼻基底异常，可视为鼻翼外侧下附着点至面部的最外侧点之间的假想连线。

HP:0012809.name: Narrow nasal base
HP:0012809.definition: Decreased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.
HP:0012809.definition_cn: 鼻翼附着点与面部之间的距离缩短。

HP:0012810.name: Wide nasal base
HP:0012810.definition: Increased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.
HP:0012810.definition_cn: 鼻翼附着点与面部之间的距离增加。

HP:0012811.name: Wide nasal ridge
HP:0012811.definition: Increased width of the nasal ridge.

HP:0012812.name: Fullness of paranasal tissue
HP:0012812.definition: Increased bulk of tissue alongside the nose. The fullness can be caused by both bony and soft tissues.
HP:0012812.definition_cn: 鼻旁组织体积增大。该丰满度可由骨性组织和软组织共同引起。

HP:0012813.name: Unilateral breast hypoplasia
HP:0012813.definition: Underdevelopment of the breast on one side only.

HP:0012814.name: Bilateral breast hypoplasia
HP:0012814.definition: Underdevelopment of the breast on both sides.

HP:0012815.name: Hypoplastic female external genitalia
HP:0012815.definition: Underdevelopment of part or all of the female external reproductive organs (which include the mons pubis, labia majora, labia minora, Bartholin glands, and clitoris).
HP:0012815.name_cn: 女性外生殖器发育不全
HP:0012815.definition_cn: 女性外生殖器部分或全部发育不全（包括阴阜、大阴唇、小阴唇、前庭大腺和阴蒂）。

HP:0012816.name: Right ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
HP:0012816.definition: A predominantly right ventricular variant of isolated noncompaction cardiomyopathy.
HP:0012816.name_cn: 右心室致密化不全性心肌病
HP:0012816.definition_cn: 孤立性非致密化心肌病的以右心室为主的变异型。

HP:0012817.name: Noncompaction cardiomyopathy
HP:0012817.definition: A type of cardiomyopathy characterized anatomically by deep trabeculations in the ventricular wall, which define recesses communicating with the main ventricular chamber.
HP:0012817.definition_cn: 一种心肌病类型，解剖学特征为心室壁深部小梁形成，这些小梁与主心室腔相通形成凹陷。

HP:0012818.name: Biventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
HP:0012818.definition: Noncompaction cardiomyopathy that affects both ventricles.
HP:0012818.name_cn: 双心室致密化不全性心肌病
HP:0012818.definition_cn: 双心室受累的非致密性心肌病。

HP:0012820.name: Bilateral vocal cord paralysis
HP:0012820.definition: A loss of the ability to move the vocal fold on both sides.
HP:0012820.definition_cn: 双侧声带运动功能丧失。

HP:0012821.name: Unilateral vocal cord paresis
HP:0012821.definition: Decreased strength of the vocal fold on one side.

HP:0012822.name: Bilateral vocal cord paresis
HP:0012822.definition: Decreased strength of the vocal fold on both sides.

HP:0012823.name: Clinical modifier
HP:0012823.definition: This subontology is designed to provide terms to characterize and specify the phenotypic abnormalities defined in the Phenotypic abnormality subontology, with respect to severity, laterality, age of onset, and other aspects.
HP:0012823.definition_cn: 该子本体旨在提供术语，以表征和指定表型异常子本体中定义的表型异常，涉及严重程度、侧向性、发病年龄及其他方面。

HP:0012824.name: Severity
HP:0012824.definition: The intensity or degree of a manifestation.

HP:0012825.name: Mild
HP:0012825.definition: Having a relatively minor degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between two and three standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.
HP:0012825.definition_cn: 具有相对较轻的严重程度。对于数量性状，与适当人群均值的偏差在二至三个标准差之间。

HP:0012826.name: Moderate
HP:0012826.definition: Having a medium degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between three and four standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.
HP:0012826.definition_cn: 中度严重。对于数量性状，与适当人群均值的偏差在三到四个标准差之间。

HP:0012827.name: Borderline
HP:0012827.definition: Having a minor degree of severity that is considered to be on the boundary between the normal and the abnormal ranges. For quantitative traits, a deviation of that is less than two standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.
HP:0012827.definition_cn: 具有轻微程度的严重性，被认为处于正常和异常范围之间的边界。对于定量性状，其偏离适当群体均值的程度小于两个标准差。

HP:0012828.name: Severe
HP:0012828.definition: Having a high degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between four and five standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.
HP:0012828.definition_cn: 具有高度严重性。对于数量性状，与相应群体均值的偏离在四至五个标准差之间。

HP:0012829.name: Profound
HP:0012829.definition: Having an extremely high degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of more than five standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.
HP:0012829.definition_cn: 具有极高的严重程度。对于数量性状，其偏离相应群体均值超过五个标准差。

HP:0012830.name: Position
HP:0012830.definition: The anatomical localization of the specified phenotypic abnormality.
HP:0012830.definition_cn: 特定表型异常的解剖学定位。

HP:0012831.name: Laterality
HP:0012831.definition: The localization with respect to the side of the body of the specified phenotypic abnormality.
HP:0012831.definition_cn: 特定表型异常相对于身体侧位的定位。

HP:0012832.name: Bilateral
HP:0012832.definition: Being present on both sides of the body.

HP:0012833.name: Unilateral
HP:0012833.definition: Being present on only the left or only the right side of the body.

HP:0012834.name: Right
HP:0012834.definition: Being located on the right side of the body.

HP:0012835.name: Left
HP:0012835.definition: Being located on the left side of the body.

HP:0012836.name: Spatial pattern
HP:0012836.definition: The pattern by which a phenotype affects one or more regions of the body.
HP:0012836.definition_cn: 表型影响身体一个或多个区域的模式。

HP:0012837.name: Generalized
HP:0012837.definition: Affecting all regions without specificity of distribution.
HP:0012837.definition_cn: 非特异性分布，影响所有区域。

HP:0012838.name: Localized
HP:0012838.definition: Being confined or restricted to a particular location.
HP:0012838.definition_cn: 被限制或局限于特定位置。

HP:0012839.name: Distal
HP:0012839.definition: Localized away from the central point of the body.
HP:0012839.definition_cn: 远离身体中心点的局部化。

HP:0012840.name: Proximal
HP:0012840.definition: Localized close to the central point of the body.
HP:0012840.definition_cn: 靠近身体中心点的局部区域。

HP:0012841.name: Retinal vascular tortuosity
HP:0012841.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the retinal blood vessels.
HP:0012841.definition_cn: 视网膜血管迂曲度增加。

HP:0012842.name: Skin appendage neoplasm
HP:0012842.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the hair follicles, sebaceous glands, or sweat glands.
HP:0012842.definition_cn: 一种起源于毛囊、皮脂腺或汗腺的良性或恶性肿瘤。

HP:0012843.name: Hair follicle neoplasm
HP:0012843.definition: An uncontrolled autonomous cell-proliferation originating in a hair follicle, which is an epidermal adnexal structures responsible for hair growth.
HP:0012843.definition_cn: 一种起源于毛囊的失控性自主细胞增殖，毛囊是负责毛发生长的表皮附属结构。

HP:0012844.name: Trichilemmoma
HP:0012844.definition: A benign tumor originating from the outer root sheath of the hair follicle.
HP:0012844.definition_cn: 一种起源于毛囊外根鞘的良性肿瘤。

HP:0012845.name: Single trichilemmoma
HP:0012845.definition: Presence of a unitary trichilemmoma, a benign tumor originating from the outer root sheath of the hair follicle.
HP:0012845.definition_cn: 存在单一毛鞘瘤，一种源自毛囊外根鞘的良性肿瘤。

HP:0012846.name: Multiple trichilemmomata
HP:0012846.definition: Presence of multiple trichilemmomata, a benign tumor originating from the outer root sheath of the hair follicle.
HP:0012846.definition_cn: 存在多个毛鞘瘤，一种源自毛囊外根鞘的良性肿瘤。

HP:0012847.name: Epilepsia partialis continua
HP:0012847.definition: Epilepsia partialis continua (also called Kojevnikov's or Kozhevnikov's epilepsia) is a type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated stereotyped simple motor manifestations such as jerks, typically of a limb or the face, recurring every few seconds or minutes for extended periods (days or years).
HP:0012847.definition_cn: 持续性部分性癫痫（也称为Kojevnikov癫痫或Kozhevnikov癫痫）是一种局灶性运动性癫痫持续状态，其特征为反复出现的刻板简单运动表现，如抽搐，通常涉及肢体或面部，每隔几秒或几分钟发作一次，持续时间较长（数天或数年）。

HP:0012848.name: Small intestinal stenosis
HP:0012848.definition: The narrowing or partial blockage of a portion of the small intestine.
HP:0012848.definition_cn: 小肠部分狭窄或部分梗阻。

HP:0012850.name: Small intestinal dysmotility
HP:0012850.definition: Abnormal small intestinal contractions, such as spasms and intestinal paralysis related to the loss of the ability of the gut to coordinate muscular activity because of endogenous or exogenous causes.
HP:0012850.definition_cn: 小肠运动异常，如痉挛和肠麻痹，与因内源性或外源性原因导致的肠道协调肌肉活动能力丧失相关。

HP:0012851.name: Colonic stenosis
HP:0012851.definition: A narrowing of a segment of colon whereby bowel continuity is maintained.
HP:0012851.definition_cn: 结肠节段性狭窄，但肠道连续性得以维持。

HP:0012852.name: Hepatic bridging fibrosis
HP:0012852.definition: Hepatic fibrosis that reaches from a portal area to another portal area.
HP:0012852.definition_cn: 门脉区至门脉区的肝纤维化。

HP:0012853.name: Scrotal hypospadias
HP:0012853.definition: Hypospadias with location of the urethral meatus in the scrotum.
HP:0012853.definition_cn: 尿道下裂伴尿道口位于阴囊。

HP:0012854.name: Midshaft hypospadias
HP:0012854.definition: Hypospadias with location of the urethral meatus in the middle of the inferior shaft of the penis.
HP:0012854.definition_cn: 尿道下裂，尿道口位于阴茎下段中部。

HP:0012855.name: Scrotal hyperpigmentation
HP:0012855.definition: Increased pigmentation (skin color) of the scrotum.

HP:0012856.name: Abnormal scrotal rugation
HP:0012856.definition: Anomaly of the folded ridges (wrinkles) of skin of the scrotum.

HP:0012857.name: Increased scrotal rugation
HP:0012857.definition: Increased number or density of the folded ridges (wrinkles) of skin of the scrotum.
HP:0012857.definition_cn: 阴囊皮肤皱褶（皱纹）数量或密度增加。

HP:0012858.name: Decreased scrotal rugation
HP:0012858.definition: Decreased number or density of the folded ridges (wrinkles) of skin of the scrotum.
HP:0012858.definition_cn: 阴囊皮肤皱褶数量或密度减少。

HP:0012859.name: Esophageal leukoplakia
HP:0012859.definition: A white patch or plaque occurring on the surface of the esophageal mucous membranes that cannot be rubbed off and cannot be characterized clinically as any other disease.
HP:0012859.definition_cn: 食管黏膜表面出现的白色斑块或斑片，无法擦拭去除，且无法在临床上归类为其他任何疾病。

HP:0012860.name: Testicular fibrosis
HP:0012860.definition: Formation of excess connective tissue in the testicle.
HP:0012860.definition_cn: 睾丸内结缔组织过度增生。

HP:0012861.name: Ovotestis
HP:0012861.definition: A gonad that contains both ovarian follicles and testicular tubular elements.
HP:0012861.definition_cn: 一种包含卵巢滤泡和睾丸小管成分的性腺。

HP:0012862.name: Abnormal germ cell morphology
HP:0012862.definition: Any structural anomaly of a reproductive cell.

HP:0012863.name: Abnormal male germ cell morphology
HP:0012863.definition: A structural anomaly of a male reproductive cell.
HP:0012863.name_cn: 异常男性生殖细胞形态学
HP:0012863.definition_cn: 男性生殖细胞的结构异常。

HP:0012865.name: Abnormal sperm head morphology
HP:0012865.definition: A structural abnormality of the sperm head.

HP:0012866.name: Abnormal sperm neck morphology
HP:0012866.definition: A structural abnormality of the sperm neck.

HP:0012867.name: Abnormal sperm mid-piece morphology
HP:0012867.definition: A structural abnormality of the sperm mid-piece.

HP:0012868.name: Abnormal sperm tail morphology
HP:0012868.definition: A structural abnormality of the sperm tail.

HP:0012869.name: Acephalic spermatozoa
HP:0012869.definition: Spermatozoa with very small cranial ends devoid of any nuclear material, that is, lacking a typical sperm head.
HP:0012869.definition_cn: 头部极小而缺乏任何核物质的精子，即缺乏典型精子头部的精子。

HP:0012870.name: Vanishing testis
HP:0012870.definition: A condition which is considered to be due to the subsequent atrophy and disappearance in fetal life of an initially normal testis. In the presence of spermatic cord structures is evidence of the presence of the testis in early intrauterine life. When associated with a blind-ending spermatic cord, this entity is named as his absence of a testis in an otherwise normal 46XY male is usually unilateral and is assumed to be a consequence of intrauterine or perinatal torsion or infarction.
HP:0012870.definition_cn: 一种被认为由于胎儿期初始正常的睾丸随后发生萎缩和消失所导致的病症。精索结构的存在是早期宫内生活存在睾丸的证据。当与盲端精索相关时，该实体被称为睾丸缺失，在染色体为46XY的正常男性中通常为单侧，并被认为是宫内或围产期扭转或梗死的后果。

HP:0012871.name: Varicocele
HP:0012871.definition: A varicocele is a widening of the veins along the spermatic cord, leading to enlarged, twisted veins in the scrotum, and manifested clinically by a painless testicle lump, scrotal swelling, or bulge in the scrotum.
HP:0012871.definition_cn: 精索静脉曲张是指沿精索静脉的扩张，导致阴囊内静脉增粗、迂曲，临床表现为无痛性睾丸肿块、阴囊肿胀或阴囊内隆起。

HP:0012872.name: Abnormal vas deferens morphology
HP:0012872.definition: A structural anomaly of the secretory duct of the testicle that carries spermatozoa from the epididymis to the prostatic urethra where it terminates to form ejaculatory duct.
HP:0012872.definition_cn: 睾丸分泌管的结构异常，该管道将精子从附睾输送至前列腺尿道，并在该处终止形成射精管。

HP:0012873.name: Absent vas deferens
HP:0012873.definition: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the vas deferens.
HP:0012873.definition_cn: 输精管发育不全（先天性缺失）。

HP:0012874.name: Abnormal male reproductive system physiology
HP:0012874.definition: An abnormal functionality of the male genital system.
HP:0012874.name_cn: 男性生殖系统生理异常
HP:0012874.definition_cn: 男性生殖系统功能异常。

HP:0012875.name: Abnormal ejaculation
HP:0012875.definition: Abnormality in the process of ejection of semen (usually carrying sperm) from the male reproductive tract.
HP:0012875.definition_cn: 射精过程异常（通常携带精子的精液从男性生殖道排出）。

HP:0012876.name: Premature ejaculation
HP:0012876.definition: The emission of semen and seminal fluid during the act of preparation for sexual intercourse, i.e. before there is penetration, or shortly after penetration.
HP:0012876.definition_cn: 在性交准备阶段，即尚未进行插入或插入后不久，精液和精浆的排出。

HP:0012877.name: Retrograde ejaculation
HP:0012877.definition: The emission of semen and seminal fluid into the bladder instead of through the penis during orgasm.

HP:0012878.name: Retarded ejaculation
HP:0012878.definition: Difficulty of a male in achieving orgasm.
HP:0012878.definition_cn: 男性性高潮障碍（Male Orgasmic Disorder）

HP:0012880.name: Abnormal labia minora morphology
HP:0012880.definition: An anomaly of the labia minora, the folds of skin between the outer labia.
HP:0012880.definition_cn: 小阴唇异常，即位于外阴唇之间的皮肤皱襞异常。

HP:0012881.name: Abnormal labia majora morphology
HP:0012881.definition: An anomaly of the outer labia.

HP:0012883.name: Fallopian tube cyst
HP:0012883.definition: A fluid filled sac located in the Fallopian tube.

HP:0012884.name: Fallopian tube torsion
HP:0012884.definition: A twisting of the Fallopian tube. Sudden onset with sharp, colicky pelvic pain associated with nausea, vomiting, bowel, and bladder symptoms is the usual presentation.
HP:0012884.definition_cn: 输卵管扭转。通常表现为突发性剧烈绞痛，伴有恶心、呕吐、肠道及膀胱症状。

HP:0012885.name: Fallopian tube duplication
HP:0012885.definition: The presence of a supernumerary Fallopian tube.

HP:0012886.name: Hemorrhagic ovarian cyst
HP:0012886.definition: An abdominal mass formed by bleeding into a follicular ovarian cyst or corpus luteum cyst.
HP:0012886.definition_cn: 由出血进入卵泡性卵巢囊肿或黄体囊肿形成的腹部肿块。

HP:0012887.name: Ovarian serous cystadenoma
HP:0012887.definition: A cystic tumor of the ovary, containing thin, clear, yellow serous fluid and varying amounts of solid tissue.
HP:0012887.definition_cn: 卵巢囊性肿瘤，内含稀薄、清亮、黄色的浆液性液体及不同数量的实性组织。

HP:0012888.name: Abnormal uterine cervix morphology
HP:0012888.definition: An anomaly of the neck of the uterus (lower part of the uterus), called the uterine cervix.
HP:0012888.definition_cn: 子宫颈（子宫下部）的异常。

HP:0012889.name: Cervical endometriosis
HP:0012889.definition: Abnormal growth of endometrial cells (which are normally limited to the uterus) within the cervix.
HP:0012889.definition_cn: 宫颈内子宫内膜细胞（通常仅限于子宫）的异常增生。

HP:0012891.name: High posterior hairline
HP:0012891.definition: Hair on the neck extends less inferiorly than usual.
HP:0012891.definition_cn: 颈部毛发向尾侧延伸较正常情况减少。

HP:0012892.name: Facial muscle hypertrophy
HP:0012892.definition: Hypertrophy of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).
HP:0012892.definition_cn: 面神经（第七对颅神经）支配的一处或多处肌肉肥大。

HP:0012893.name: Neck muscle hypertrophy
HP:0012893.definition: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the muscles of the neck.

HP:0012894.name: Paraspinal muscle hypertrophy
HP:0012894.definition: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the paraspinal muscles.
HP:0012894.definition_cn: 影响椎旁肌的肌肉肥大。

HP:0012895.name: Scapular muscle hypertrophy
HP:0012895.definition: Muscle hypertrophy affecting the scapular muscles.
HP:0012895.definition_cn: 影响肩胛肌的肌肉肥大。

HP:0012896.name: Abnormal motor evoked potentials
HP:0012896.definition: An anomaly identified by motor evoked potentials (MEPs). MEPs are measured following single-pulse or repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and can be used for the assessment of the excitability of the motor cortex and the integrity of conduction along the central and peripheral motor pathways.
HP:0012896.definition_cn: 运动诱发电位（MEPs）检测到的异常。MEPs通过单脉冲或重复经颅磁刺激后测量，可用于评估运动皮层的兴奋性以及中枢和外周运动传导通路的完整性。

HP:0012897.name: Abnormal upper-limb motor evoked potentials
HP:0012897.definition: An anomaly identified by motor evoked potentials (MEPs) in the arm.
HP:0012897.name_cn: 上肢运动诱发电位异常
HP:0012897.definition_cn: 手臂运动诱发电位（MEPs）检测到的异常。

HP:0012898.name: Abnormal lower-limb motor evoked potentials
HP:0012898.definition: An anomaly identified by motor evoked potentials (MEPs) in the leg.
HP:0012898.name_cn: 下肢运动诱发电位异常
HP:0012898.definition_cn: 下肢运动诱发电位（MEPs）检测异常。

HP:0012899.name: Handgrip myotonia
HP:0012899.definition: Difficulty releasing one's grip associated with prolonged first handgrip relaxation times.
HP:0012899.definition_cn: 握持释放困难伴首次握持放松时间延长。

HP:0012900.name: Myotonia of the face
HP:0012900.definition: Slowed relaxation of muscles in the face.

HP:0012901.name: Myotonia of the jaw
HP:0012901.definition: Slowed relaxation of muscles in the jaw.

HP:0012902.name: Myotonia of the lower limb
HP:0012902.definition: Slowed relaxation of muscles in the leg.

HP:0012903.name: Myotonia of the upper limb
HP:0012903.definition: Slowed relaxation of muscles in the arm.

HP:0012904.name: Cold-sensitive myotonia
HP:0012904.definition: An involuntary and painless delay in the relaxation of skeletal muscle following contraction or electrical stimulation that is induced by exposure to cold.
HP:0012904.definition_cn: 由寒冷暴露引起的骨骼肌在收缩或电刺激后出现无意识且无痛性的松弛延迟。

HP:0012905.name: Euryblepharon
HP:0012905.definition: Euryblepharon is a congenital eyelid anomaly characterized by horizontal enlargement of the palpebral fissure. The eyelid is shortened vertically compared with the horizontal dimension, with associated lateral canthal malpositioning and lateral ectropion abnormally wide lid opening.
HP:0012905.definition_cn: 睑裂狭小综合征是一种先天性眼睑异常，其特征为睑裂水平方向扩大。与水平维度相比，眼睑在垂直方向上缩短，伴有外眦错位和外眦外翻，导致眼睑异常宽大。

HP:0020001.name: Clinical anophthalmos
HP:0020001.definition: Congenital anophthalmos is a rare ocular anomaly in which histologically detectable eyeball structures are absent due to poor development of the primary optic nerve vesicle. However, with appropriate imaging or intraoperatively, rudimentary remains of this structure can usually be detected. Therefore, the term clinical congenital anophthalmos seems more appropriate and denotes a phenotypic range between microphthalmos and anophthalmos.
HP:0020001.definition_cn: 先天性无眼畸形是一种罕见的眼部异常，由于原始视泡发育不良导致组织学上可检测的眼球结构缺失。然而通过适当的影像学检查或术中探查，通常仍可发现该结构的原始残留组织。因此临床先天性无眼畸形这一术语似乎更为准确，它表征了介于小眼畸形与无眼畸形之间的表型谱系。

HP:0020002.name: Ileal stricture
HP:0020002.definition: A pathological narrowing of the ileum that is caused by the development of a ring of scar tissue that constricts the ileal lumen.
HP:0020002.definition_cn: 回肠病理性狭窄，由瘢痕组织环形成导致回肠管腔缩窄所致。

HP:0020003.name: Embryo developmental arrest
HP:0020003.definition: A failure of an embryo to progress through the early stages of preimplantation development (typically from fertilization, i.e., 1-cell zygote, to blastocyst on day 5-6), and is used clinically when embryos fail to reach transferable stages in assisted reproductive technologies (ARTs) such in vitro fertilization (IVF). Arrested embryo development is characterized by downregulation of metabolic activity and cessation of cell division. In order for an embryo to be characterized as non-viable, i.e., arrested, it should present with a lack of cleaving activity and fail to show a sign of mitotic cellular division for at least 24 hours. One can observe failure of a zygote to cleave, cleavage stage arrest either on day 2 or day 3 when the embryo is expected to be between the 2 and 8-cell stage, failure to compact to morula, or failure to form a blastocyst.
HP:0020003.definition_cn: 胚胎发育停滞是指胚胎未能完成植入前早期发育阶段（通常指从受精即单细胞合子阶段至第5-6天囊胚阶段的发育过程），在辅助生殖技术（如体外受精）中特指胚胎未能达到可移植阶段。该病理状态以代谢活动下调及细胞分裂停滞为特征。临床判定胚胎失活（即发育停滞）需满足以下标准：至少24小时内无卵裂活动且未见有丝分裂迹象。具体表现为：合子未能发生卵裂、第2-3天预期发育至2-8细胞阶段时出现卵裂期停滞、未能形成桑椹胚或未能形成囊胚等发育异常现象。

HP:0020004.name: Abnormal CSF guanidinoacetic acid concentration
HP:0020004.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0020004.name_cn: 脑脊液胍基乙酸浓度异常
HP:0020004.definition_cn: 脑脊液中胍基乙酸浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0020005.name: Decreased CSF guanidinoacetic acid concentration
HP:0020005.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0020005.name_cn: 脑脊液胍基乙酸浓度降低
HP:0020005.definition_cn: 脑脊液中胍基乙酸浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0020006.name: Ciliary body coloboma
HP:0020006.definition: A coloboma of the ciliary body.

HP:0020007.name: Abnormal affect regulation
HP:0020007.definition: A disturbance in the processes by which emotional responses are initiated, modulated, sustained, or terminated in a contextually appropriate manner. Abnormal affect regulation involves maladaptive patterns in the generation, intensity, or control of affective experience and expression, leading to inconsistent, excessive, or insufficient modulation of emotion relative to situational demands.
HP:0020007.definition_cn: 情感反应调节障碍是指个体在情境适宜性情感反应的启动、调控、维持或终止过程中出现的功能紊乱。异常情感调节表现为情感体验与表达的产生、强度或控制方面存在适应不良模式，导致情绪调节与情境需求不相匹配，出现不一致、过度或不足的调控现象。

HP:0020008.name: History of disease onset in winter
HP:0020008.definition: The initial manifestation of a disease or symptom occurring during the winter season.

HP:0020009.name: History of disease onset in summer
HP:0020009.definition: The initial manifestation of a disease or symptom occurring during the summer season.

HP:0020010.name: Cutaneous lesion morphology
HP:0020010.definition: A description of structural or physical characteristics of a skin lesion, describing how the lesion appears or is composed.
HP:0020010.definition_cn: 皮肤病变的结构或物理特征描述，阐述病变的外观表现或组成方式。

HP:0020011.name: Bleeding into skin lesions
HP:0020011.definition: Presence of bleeding within (pre-existing) cutaneous lesions such as blisters or vesicles, resulting in blood-filled lesions.
HP:0020011.definition_cn: （原有）皮肤病变（如水疱或囊泡）内出现出血，导致病变内充满血液。

HP:0020012.name: Crusted skin lesions
HP:0020012.definition: Lesions covered by a hardened layer of dried exudate, blood, or serum.
HP:0020012.definition_cn: 覆盖干燥渗出物、血液或血清硬化层的病变。

HP:0020013.name: Slough
HP:0020013.definition: Slough is a type of necrotic skin lesion that is characterized as being yellow, tan, green or brown in color and may be moist, loose and stringy in appearance.
HP:0020013.definition_cn: 腐肉是一种坏死性皮肤病变，其特征为黄色、棕褐色、绿色或棕色外观，可呈现湿润、松软且呈丝状形态。

HP:0020014.name: Local paresthesia at bite site
HP:0020014.definition: Abnormal tingling, burning, or itching sensation localized to the site of an animal bite, typically occurring after the wound has healed.
HP:0020014.name_cn: 咬伤部位局部感觉异常
HP:0020014.definition_cn: 动物咬伤部位局部异常刺痛、灼热或瘙痒感，通常发生于伤口愈合后。

HP:0020015.name: Amyloid deposition by anatomical site
HP:0020015.definition: Amyloid deposition categorized according to the anatomical site of deposition.
HP:0020015.name_cn: 解剖部位淀粉样蛋白沉积
HP:0020015.definition_cn: 淀粉样物质沉积根据解剖学沉积部位分类。

HP:0020016.name: Amyloid deposition by type of amyloid
HP:0020016.definition: Amyloid deposition categorized according to the category of pathological amyloid fiber being deposited.
HP:0020016.name_cn: 淀粉样沉积按淀粉样蛋白类型分类
HP:0020016.definition_cn: 淀粉样物质沉积根据所沉积的病理淀粉样纤维类别进行分类。

HP:0020017.name: Transthyretin amyloid deposition
HP:0020017.definition: Deposition of misfolded transthyretin (TTR) protein in tissue.
HP:0020017.name_cn: 转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样沉积
HP:0020017.definition_cn: 组织中错误折叠转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）的沉积

HP:0020018.name: Cerebral transthyretin amyloid deposition
HP:0020018.definition: Accumulation of misfolded transthyretin protein in brain tissue.
HP:0020018.name_cn: 脑转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样沉积
HP:0020018.definition_cn: 错误折叠转甲状腺素蛋白在脑组织中的积聚。

HP:0020019.name: Abnormal CSF 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid concentration
HP:0020019.definition: The concentration of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above or below the limits of normal.
HP:0020019.name_cn: 脑脊液5-羟吲哚乙酸浓度异常
HP:0020019.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中5-羟吲哚乙酸浓度高于或低于正常范围。

HP:0020020.name: Decreased CSF 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid concentration
HP:0020020.definition: The concentration of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0020020.name_cn: 脑脊液5-羟吲哚乙酸浓度降低
HP:0020020.definition_cn: 脑脊液中5-羟吲哚乙酸浓度低于正常值下限

HP:0020021.name: Hip external rotation contracture
HP:0020021.definition: A condition where the hip joint is limited in its range of motion due to the shortening of muscles that externally rotate the hip, causing the leg and foot to point outward when standing or walking. The knee is turned past neutral in the direction moving away from the midline, where the neutral position for the hip is with knee pointing directly anteriorly.
HP:0020021.definition_cn: 一种因髋关节外旋肌群缩短导致髋关节活动范围受限的病理状态，表现为站立或行走时下肢及足部呈外旋位。膝关节偏离中线向外侧旋转超过中立位（髋关节中立位定义为膝关节正指向前方）。

HP:0020022.name: Hip abduction contracture
HP:0020022.definition: Abduction contracture of the hip is characterized by the limitation of active and/or passive adduction of the hip joint in the coronal plane; a chronic reduction in the ability to move the proximal segment of the lower extremity actively or passively medially towards the body midline past the sagittal plane of the body.
HP:0020022.definition_cn: 髋关节外展挛缩的特征为冠状面上髋关节主动和/或被动内收活动受限；即下肢近端节段主动或被动向身体中线内侧移动越过身体矢状面的能力长期下降。

HP:0020023.name: Hip adduction contracture
HP:0020023.definition: Inability of hip to bring from medial side to neutral position, where the neutral position for the hip is with the thigh segment in line with the anatomic plane of the pelvis, both in the coronal and sagittal planes.
HP:0020023.definition_cn: 髋关节无法从内侧位恢复至中立位，其中髋关节中立位定义为大腿节段在冠状面和矢状面上均与骨盆解剖平面对齐。

HP:0020024.name: Hip extension contracture
HP:0020024.definition: Inability to flex the hip past the extension range from the neutral position, where the neutral position for the hip is with the hip and thigh segment in line in the same coronal plane as the pelvis.
HP:0020024.definition_cn: 髋关节无法从中立位屈曲超过伸展范围，其中髋关节的中立位为髋部与大腿段位于与骨盆同一冠状面的直线上。

HP:0020025.name: Hip flexion contracture
HP:0020025.definition: The inability to bring a flexed hip to neutral in the sagittal plane, where the neutral position for the hip is with the thigh segment in line with the anatomic plane of the pelvis, both in the coronal and sagittal planes.
HP:0020025.definition_cn: 在矢状面上无法将屈曲的髋关节恢复至中立位，其中髋关节的中立位定义为大腿节段与骨盆的解剖平面在冠状面和矢状面上均对齐。

HP:0020026.name: Positive Coombs test
HP:0020026.definition: A positive (abnormal) result of the direct antiglobulin test (DAT; sometimes referred to as the Coombs test). The test is a method of demonstrating the presence of antibody or complement bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction. The DAT tests for antibodies or complement bound directly to erythrocytes, indicating in vivo sensitization.
HP:0020026.name_cn: 直接抗球蛋白试验阳性
HP:0020026.definition_cn: 直接抗人球蛋白试验（DAT；有时称为库姆斯试验）阳性（异常）结果。该试验是一种通过使用抗人球蛋白形成可见凝集反应来证明红细胞（RBC）膜上结合有抗体或补体的检测方法。DAT检测直接结合于红细胞的抗体或补体，表明存在体内致敏现象。

HP:0020027.name: Direct antiglobulin test positive for IgG
HP:0020027.definition: Demonstration of the presence of IgG antibodies bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction.
HP:0020027.name_cn: 直接抗球蛋白试验IgG阳性
HP:0020027.definition_cn: 通过使用抗人球蛋白形成可见凝集反应来证实红细胞（RBC）膜上结合的IgG抗体存在。

HP:0020028.name: Direct antiglobulin test positive for IgM
HP:0020028.definition: Demonstration of the presence of IgM antibodies bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction.
HP:0020028.name_cn: 直接抗球蛋白试验IgM阳性
HP:0020028.definition_cn: 通过使用抗人球蛋白形成可见凝集反应来证实红细胞（RBC）膜上结合的IgM抗体存在。

HP:0020029.name: Abnormal spinal cord white matter morphology
HP:0020029.definition: Any structural abnormality affecting the white matter of the spinal cord, including sensory tracts (dorsal columns) and motor tracts (corticospinal tracts). Abnormalities may involve myelin, axons, or tract organization and can result in sensory, motor, or autonomic deficits.
HP:0020029.definition_cn: 累及脊髓白质的任何结构异常，包括感觉传导束（后索）和运动传导束（皮质脊髓束）。病变可涉及髓鞘、轴突或传导束组织结构，并可能导致感觉、运动或自主神经功能障碍。

HP:0020030.name: Abnormal spinal cord lateral corticospinal tract morphology
HP:0020030.definition: Any structural abnormality affecting the lateral corticospinal tracts of the spinal cord, which may involve axonal loss, demyelination, or tract degeneration, and can result in motor deficits such as weakness, spasticity, or impaired voluntary movement.
HP:0020030.name_cn: 脊髓侧索皮质脊髓束形态异常
HP:0020030.definition_cn: 累及脊髓外侧皮质脊髓束的任何结构性异常，可能涉及轴突缺失、脱髓鞘或束路变性，可导致运动功能障碍如肌力减退、痉挛或随意运动受损。

HP:0020031.name: Direct antiglobulin test positive for C3d
HP:0020031.definition: Demonstration of the presence of C3d complement fragments bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes using anti-human globulin (Coombs reagent), which produces a visible agglutination reaction.
HP:0020031.name_cn: 直接抗球蛋白试验C3d阳性
HP:0020031.definition_cn: 通过抗人球蛋白（Coombs试剂）检测结合在红细胞膜上的C3d补体片段，产生肉眼可见的凝集反应。

HP:0020032.name: Hyperreflective retinal dots on OCT
HP:0020032.definition: Abnormal hyperreflective dots (HRDs) detected in Optical coherence tomography (OCT) scans. The HRDs are scattered, punctiform, small in size, mainly located in the outer retinal layers and/or around pockets of fluid accumulation and are typically not confluent.
HP:0020032.definition_cn: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）检测到异常高反射点（HRDs）。这些HRDs呈散在分布、点状、体积微小，主要位于视网膜外层和/或液体积聚区域周围，通常不融合。

HP:0020033.name: Irregularity of the retinal pigment epithelium layer on OCT
HP:0020033.definition: Lack of uniformity in the morphology of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) layer observed on optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging. The RPE lies between the neurosensory retina (photoreceptors) and Bruch membrane/choroid, and normally appears as a thin, hyperreflective (bright) band on OCT imaging. This term comprises irregularities which may manifest as thickening, thinning, undulations, or loss of normal reflectivity, potentially affecting retinal structure or function.
HP:0020033.name_cn: OCT显示视网膜色素上皮层不规则
HP:0020033.definition_cn: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）成像观察到视网膜色素上皮（RPE）层形态学的不均一性。RPE位于神经感觉视网膜（光感受器）与Bruch膜/脉络膜之间，在OCT成像中通常表现为一条纤细的高反射（明亮）带。该术语涵盖可能表现为增厚、变薄、波浪状改变或正常反射性丧失的异常征象，这些改变可能影响视网膜结构或功能。

HP:0020034.name: Diffuse
HP:0020034.definition: A spatial pattern that is spread out, i.e., not localized.
HP:0020034.definition_cn: 一种空间分布模式，即弥散性分布，而非局限性分布。

HP:0020035.name: Lower limb dysmetria
HP:0020035.definition: A lack of coordination of leg movement manifested by undershoot or overshoot of the intended position of the leg.
HP:0020035.definition_cn: 下肢运动协调障碍，表现为下肢未达或超过预期位置。

HP:0020036.name: Upper limb dysmetria
HP:0020036.definition: A lack of coordination of arm movement manifested by undershoot or overshoot of the intended position of the arm.
HP:0020036.definition_cn: 上肢运动协调障碍，表现为上肢运动未达或超过目标位置。

HP:0020037.name: Astasia
HP:0020037.definition: A postural abnormality characterized by the inability to stand without external support despite having sufficient muscle strength.
HP:0020037.definition_cn: 一种姿势异常，其特征为尽管具备足够的肌力，但在无外部支撑的情况下无法站立。

HP:0020038.name: Vertebrobasilar dolichoectasia
HP:0020038.definition: Elongation, dilatation, and/or tortuosity of the vertebrobasilar segment. The definition of VBD includes: (i) diameter of basilar or vertebral artery over 4.5 mm; or (ii) deviation of any portion more than 10 mm from the shortest expected course; and (iii) length of basilar artery over 29.5 mm or length of intracranial vertebral artery over 23.5 mm.
HP:0020038.name_cn: 椎基底动脉延长扩张症
HP:0020038.definition_cn: 椎基底动脉节段的延长、扩张和/或迂曲。椎基底动脉扩张症（VBD）的定义包括：（i）基底动脉或椎动脉直径超过4.5毫米；或（ii）任何部分偏离预期最短路径超过10毫米；以及（iii）基底动脉长度超过29.5毫米或颅内椎动脉长度超过23.5毫米。

HP:0020039.name: Retinal thickening on OCT
HP:0020039.definition: Anteroposterior thickness of the retina above the upper limit of normal. This phenotype can be appreciated by retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT).
HP:0020039.definition_cn: 视网膜前后径超过正常上限。该表型可通过视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）进行评估。

HP:0020040.name: Abnormal anteroposterior retina thickness on OCT
HP:0020040.definition: Anteroposterior thickness of the retina outside the limits of normal. This phenotype can be appreciated by retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT).
HP:0020040.name_cn: OCT显示视网膜前后厚度异常
HP:0020040.definition_cn: 视网膜前后径超出正常范围。该表型可通过视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）检测。

HP:0020041.name: Double elevator palsy
HP:0020041.definition: A type of incomitant strabismus in which both elevator muscles (i.e., the inferior oblique and superior rectus muscles) of the same eye are weak leading to restricted elevation and hypotropia.
HP:0020041.definition_cn: 一种非共同性斜视，其中同一眼的两条上转肌（即下斜肌和上直肌）均出现肌力减弱，导致上转受限和下斜视。

HP:0020042.name: Double depressor palsy
HP:0020042.definition: An ocular movement abnormality characterized by simultaneous weakness of the inferior rectus muscle and superior oblique muscle of the same eye.
HP:0020042.definition_cn: 同侧眼下直肌与上斜肌同时出现肌力减弱的眼球运动异常。

HP:0020043.name: Vertical incomitant strabismus
HP:0020043.definition: A type of incomitant strabismus in which the angle of deviation varies as the patient's gaze shifts upwards and/or downwards.
HP:0020043.definition_cn: 一种非共同性斜视，其偏斜角度随患者向上和/或向下注视而变化。

HP:0020045.name: Esodeviation
HP:0020045.definition: A manifest or latent ocular deviation in which one or both eyes tends to deviate nasally.
HP:0020045.definition_cn: 显性或隐性眼位偏斜，其中单眼或双眼倾向于向鼻侧偏斜。

HP:0020046.name: Accommodative esotropia
HP:0020046.definition: A form of esotropia (convergent deviation of the eyes) associated with activation of the accommodative reflex.
HP:0020046.definition_cn: 一种与调节反射激活相关的内斜视（眼球会聚性偏斜）形式。

HP:0020047.name: Abnormal myeloid cell morphology
HP:0020047.definition: Any structural anomaly of a cell of the monocyte, granulocyte, mast cell, megakaryocyte, or erythroid lineage.
HP:0020047.definition_cn: 单核细胞、粒细胞、肥大细胞、巨核细胞或红系细胞谱系的任何结构异常。

HP:0020048.name: Reduced bone-marrow pro-B cell count
HP:0020048.definition: A reduction in the numbers of pro-B cells (defined by coexpression of CD34 and CD19). Earlier B-cell precursors are defined by expressing surface CD34 and cytoplasmic TdT in the absence of CD19.
HP:0020048.definition_cn: 前B细胞数量减少（通过CD34和CD19共表达定义）。更早期的B细胞前体通过表达表面CD34和胞质末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶（TdT）且不表达CD19来定义。

HP:0020049.name: Exodeviation
HP:0020049.definition: A manifest or latent ocular deviation in which one or both eyes tends to deviate temporally.
HP:0020049.definition_cn: 显性或隐性眼球偏斜，其中单眼或双眼倾向于向颞侧偏斜。

HP:0020050.name: Anti-granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor antibody positivity
HP:0020050.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor.
HP:0020050.name_cn: 抗粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子抗体阳性
HP:0020050.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子的自身抗体。

HP:0020051.name: Abnormal seminiferous tubule morphology
HP:0020051.definition: Any anomaly in the structure or density (count of tubules per volume) of the seminiferous tubules, i.e., the coiled structures within the testis that contain Sertoli cells, which support and nurture germ cells as they develop into mature spermatozoa.
HP:0020051.definition_cn: 生精小管结构或密度（单位体积内小管数量）的任何异常。生精小管是睾丸内的盘曲结构，内含支持细胞（Sertoli细胞），这些细胞在生殖细胞发育为成熟精子的过程中提供支持和营养。

HP:0020052.name: Necrotizing lymph node granuloma
HP:0020052.definition: A granuloma located within a lymph node that is associated with necrosis. Usually, the necrosis is surrounded by collections of histiocytes. A granuloma is a focal aggregate of immune cells that forms in response to a persistent inflammatory stimulus. It characteristically demonstrates the compact organization of mature macrophages, which may or may not be associated with other inflammatory cell types.
HP:0020052.definition_cn: 淋巴结内伴坏死的肉芽肿。通常坏死周围可见组织细胞聚集。肉芽肿是由免疫细胞局灶性聚集形成的病变，是对持续性炎症刺激的反应。其特征性表现为成熟巨噬细胞的紧密排列结构，可伴有或不伴有其他炎性细胞类型。

HP:0020053.name: Abnormal marker expression
HP:0020053.definition: Aberrant marker expression is a phenomenon of abnormal gain or loss of lineage specific or associated antigens. It involves changes in the presence, absence, quantity, or localization of molecular or immunohistochemical markers.
HP:0020053.definition_cn: 异常标志物表达是指谱系特异性或相关抗原异常获得或丢失的现象。其涉及分子或免疫组织化学标志物的存在、缺失、数量或定位的改变。

HP:0020054.name: Abnormal erythrocyte physiology
HP:0020054.definition: Any functional abnormality of erythrocytes (red-blood cells).

HP:0020055.name: Diminished MLH1 expression
HP:0020055.definition: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product mutL homolog 1 (MLH1).
HP:0020055.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学（IHC）检测显示错配修复基因产物mutL同源物1（MLH1）表达缺失。

HP:0020056.name: Diminished MSH2 expression
HP:0020056.definition: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product mutS homolog 2 (MSH2).
HP:0020056.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学（IHC）检测显示错配修复基因产物mutS同源物2（MSH2）表达缺失。

HP:0020057.name: Diminished MSH6 expression
HP:0020057.definition: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product mutS homolog 6 (MSH6).
HP:0020057.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学（IHC）显示错配修复基因产物mutS同源物6（MSH6）表达缺失。

HP:0020058.name: Abnormal red blood cell count
HP:0020058.definition: Any deviation from the normal number of red blood cells per volume in the circulation.
HP:0020058.definition_cn: 红细胞计数异常（Erythrocyte Count Abnormality）

HP:0020059.name: Increased red blood cell count
HP:0020059.definition: An abnormal elevation above the normal number of red blood cells per volume in the circulation.
HP:0020059.definition_cn: 循环血液中每单位体积红细胞数量异常升高。

HP:0020060.name: Decreased red blood cell count
HP:0020060.definition: An abnormal reduction below the normal number of red blood cells per volume in the circulation.
HP:0020060.definition_cn: 循环血液中红细胞数量低于正常值的异常减少。

HP:0020061.name: Abnormal hemoglobin concentration
HP:0020061.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of hemoglobin in the blood.
HP:0020061.definition_cn: 任何血液中血红蛋白浓度的异常。

HP:0020062.name: Decreased hemoglobin concentration
HP:0020062.definition: An abnormal reduction below normal hemoglobin concentration in the circulation.
HP:0020062.definition_cn: 循环系统中血红蛋白浓度低于正常值的异常减少。

HP:0020063.name: obsolete Increased hemoglobin concentration
HP:0020063.name_cn: 过时的血红蛋白浓度升高

HP:0020064.name: Abnormal eosinophil count
HP:0020064.definition: Any deviation from the normal number of eosinophils per volume in the blood circulation.
HP:0020064.name_cn: 嗜酸性粒细胞计数异常
HP:0020064.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常循环血液中嗜酸性粒细胞数量的情况。

HP:0020065.name: Diminished PMS2 expression
HP:0020065.definition: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) demonstrating loss of expression of the mismatch repair gene product PMS1 homolog 2 (PMS2).
HP:0020065.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学（IHC）检测显示错配修复基因产物PMS1同源物2（PMS2）表达缺失。

HP:0020066.name: Pathological inclusion body by subcellular location
HP:0020066.name_cn: 按亚细胞定位的病理包涵体

HP:0020067.name: Pathological inclusion body by anatomical location
HP:0020067.name_cn: 按解剖部位分类的病理性包涵体

HP:0020068.name: Intranuclear inclusion bodies
HP:0020068.definition: Inclusion bodies (deposits of stainable material, usually misfolded proteins) localized in the nucleus.
HP:0020068.definition_cn: 核内包涵体（可染色物质沉积，通常为错误折叠蛋白）

HP:0020069.name: Appendicular location
HP:0020069.definition: Applies to a lesion that is localized on the arm or leg.
HP:0020069.definition_cn: 适用于位于上肢或下肢的局限性病变。

HP:0020070.name: Exposure to humid conditions
HP:0020070.definition: A history of living in an environment characterized by excess moisture and heat, tropical conditions, or muggy weather.
HP:0020070.definition_cn: 有长期处于潮湿闷热、热带或湿热环境中的生活史。

HP:0020071.name: Viremia
HP:0020071.definition: The presence of virus in the blood.

HP:0020072.name: Persistent EBV viremia
HP:0020072.definition: Persistent presence of Epstein-Barr virus in the blood.
HP:0020072.definition_cn: 血液中持续存在爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒（Epstein-Barr virus, EBV）。

HP:0020073.name: Hypopigmented macule
HP:0020073.definition: A white or lighter patch of skin that may appear anywhere on the body and are caused by decreased skin pigmentation.
HP:0020073.definition_cn: 皮肤色素减退导致的白色或较浅色斑块，可出现在身体任何部位。

HP:0020074.name: Crystalluria
HP:0020074.definition: The presence of crystals in the urine.

HP:0020075.name: Leucine crystalluria
HP:0020075.definition: The presence of leucine crystals in the urine.
HP:0020075.definition_cn: 尿液中亮氨酸结晶的存在。

HP:0020076.name: Wrist ganglion
HP:0020076.definition: A benign soft tissue tumor of the wrist usually found in the dorsal aspect of the wrist and communicate with the joint via a pedicle. This pedicle usually originates not only at the scapholunate ligament, but also may arise from a number of other sites over the dorsal aspect of the wrist capsule.
HP:0020076.definition_cn: 腕部良性软组织肿瘤，通常位于腕背侧，并通过蒂与关节相连。该蒂通常不仅起源于舟月韧带，还可能起源于腕背侧关节囊的其他多个部位。

HP:0020077.name: Carnitinuria
HP:0020077.definition: An elevated level of carnitine in the urine.

HP:0020078.name: Alaninuria
HP:0020078.definition: An increased level of alanine in the urine.

HP:0020079.name: Beta-alaninuria
HP:0020079.definition: The amount of beta-alanine in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020079.definition_cn: 尿液中β-丙氨酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0020080.name: Erythrocyte inclusion bodies
HP:0020080.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of substances in red blood cells.
HP:0020080.definition_cn: 红细胞内物质在核或细胞质中的聚集。

HP:0020081.name: Pappenheimer bodies
HP:0020081.definition: A type of erythrocyte inclusion characterized by basophilic stippling of erythrocytes, that is, by numerous very small coarse or fine blue granules within the cytoplasm with the additional stipulation that the stippled particles are due to iron granules (demonstrable by the Prussian blue stain).
HP:0020081.definition_cn: 一种红细胞包涵体类型，其特征为红细胞嗜碱性点彩，即胞质内存在大量非常细小的粗糙或细腻的蓝色颗粒，且这些点彩颗粒由铁颗粒组成（可通过普鲁士蓝染色证实）。

HP:0020082.name: Heinz bodies
HP:0020082.definition: A type of erythrocyte inclusion composed of denatured hemoglobin.
HP:0020082.definition_cn: 一种由变性血红蛋白组成的红细胞包涵体。

HP:0020083.name: Furuncle
HP:0020083.definition: An infection of a hair follicle that extends subcutaneously, forming an abscess.
HP:0020083.definition_cn: 毛囊感染向皮下组织扩展，形成脓肿。

HP:0020084.name: Carbuncle
HP:0020084.definition: A pustular lesion of the skin emerging from group of infected hair follicles, characterized by a deep location and dissecting through tissue planes. A carbuncle is larger and deeper than a furuncle.
HP:0020084.definition_cn: 皮肤脓疱性病变，起源于一组感染的毛囊，特征为深部定位并沿组织平面分离。痈比疖更大且更深。

HP:0020085.name: Infection following live vaccination
HP:0020085.definition: An infection resulting from live attenuated vaccines (LAV), that is, a vaccine prepared from living viruses or bacteria that have been weakened under laboratory conditions. LAV vaccines will replicate in a vaccinated individual and produce an immune response but usually cause mild or no disease. are derived from disease-causing pathogens.
HP:0020085.definition_cn: 由减毒活疫苗（Live Attenuated Vaccines, LAV）引起的感染，即一种由在实验室条件下被减弱的活病毒或细菌制备的疫苗。减毒活疫苗在接种者体内会复制并产生免疫反应，但通常仅引起轻微或无症状的疾病。这些疫苗源自致病性病原体。

HP:0020086.name: BCGitis
HP:0020086.definition: Local or regional infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination.
HP:0020086.definition_cn: 接种卡介苗（Bacillus Calmette-Guérin, BCG）后局部或区域感染。

HP:0020087.name: BCGosis
HP:0020087.definition: Distant, or disseminated infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination associated with failure to contain thebacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination leading to spread of BCG to many sites in the body. The tuberculosis vaccine BCG contains live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis.
HP:0020087.definition_cn: 卡介苗（Bacillus Calmette-Guérin, BCG）接种后发生的播散性感染，与接种后未能有效控制卡介苗的增殖相关，导致卡介苗在体内多个部位播散。结核病疫苗卡介苗含有减毒活牛分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium bovis）。

HP:0020088.name: Post-vaccination measles
HP:0020088.definition: Infection with the measles virus of the live-attenuated vaccine. This is an extremely rare event and may indicate immunocompromise in some cases.
HP:0020088.definition_cn: 减毒活疫苗麻疹病毒感染。此事件极为罕见，在某些情况下可能提示免疫功能低下。

HP:0020089.name: Post-vaccination rubella
HP:0020089.definition: Infection with the rubella virus of the live-attenuated vaccine.
HP:0020089.definition_cn: 减毒活疫苗中的风疹病毒感染。

HP:0020090.name: Post-vaccination polio
HP:0020090.definition: Infection with live attenuated polio vaccine following vaccination. This is an extremely rare event that may indicate immunocompromise.
HP:0020090.name_cn: 疫苗接种后脊髓灰质炎
HP:0020090.definition_cn: 接种后发生减毒活脊髓灰质炎疫苗相关感染。此事件极为罕见，可能提示免疫功能低下。

HP:0020091.name: Post-vaccination rotavirus infection
HP:0020091.definition: Infection with live attenuated rotavirus vaccine following vaccination.
HP:0020091.name_cn: 疫苗接种后轮状病毒感染
HP:0020091.definition_cn: 接种减毒活轮状病毒疫苗后感染。

HP:0020092.name: Histopathological abnormality
HP:0020092.definition: Any microscopic alteration in the cellular or tissue morphology of a biospecimen, identified through histologic examination, including changes in differentiation, organization, or cytologic features.
HP:0020092.definition_cn: 通过组织学检查发现的生物样本细胞或组织形态学的任何微观改变，包括分化、排列或细胞学特征的异常。

HP:0020093.name: Recurrent deep organ abscess formation
HP:0020093.definition: Repeated episodes of the formation of abscesses in organs. An abscess is a circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma or an organ.
HP:0020093.name_cn: 复发性深部器官脓肿形成
HP:0020093.definition_cn: 器官内反复发作的脓肿形成。脓肿是指实质或器官内局限性的脓液或坏死组织区域。

HP:0020094.name: Squamous metaplasia
HP:0020094.definition: Metaplasia of an epithelium (normally a unilayer of cuboidal or columnar cells) with squamous epithelium (squamous means scale-like). Metaplastic squamous epithelium becomes stratified (i.e., has multiple layers).
HP:0020094.definition_cn: 上皮（通常为单层立方或柱状细胞）化生为鳞状上皮（鳞状意指鳞片样）。化生的鳞状上皮变为复层（即具有多层结构）。

HP:0020095.name: Prolonged need of intravenous antibiotic therapy
HP:0020095.definition: Clinical assessment of a requirement to treat with intravenous antibiotics over an unusually prolonged period of time.
HP:0020095.name_cn: 长期静脉抗生素治疗需求
HP:0020095.definition_cn: 对需要长时间静脉注射抗生素治疗的临床评估。

HP:0020096.name: Recurrent streptococcal infections
HP:0020096.definition: Increased susceptibility to streptococcal infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of streptococcal infections.
HP:0020096.definition_cn: 链球菌感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作的链球菌感染。

HP:0020097.name: Infection due to encapsulated bacteria
HP:0020097.definition: An infection by an encapsulated bacterial agent. Isolates which cause invasive disease are usually surrounded by a polysaccharide capsule, which is a major virulence factor and the key antigen in protective protein-polysaccharide conjugate vaccines.
HP:0020097.definition_cn: 由被膜细菌引起的感染。引起侵袭性疾病的分离株通常被多糖荚膜包围，该荚膜是主要的毒力因子，也是保护性蛋白-多糖结合疫苗中的关键抗原。

HP:0020099.name: Severe norovirus infection
HP:0020099.definition: An unusually severe course of infection with Human norovirus, previously known as Norwalk virus. Norovirus, an RNA virus of the family Caliciviridae, is a human enteric pathogen. Norovirus infection-associated illness may also be more prolonged and severe in immunocompromised individuals and may be associated with remarkably persistent viral excretion in some of these individuals.
HP:0020099.definition_cn: 一种异常严重的人类诺如病毒感染病程，该病毒先前被称为诺沃克病毒。诺如病毒属于杯状病毒科的一种RNA病毒，是人类肠道病原体。在免疫功能低下的个体中，诺如病毒感染相关疾病可能更为持久和严重，并且在某些个体中可能与显著的持续性病毒排泄相关。

HP:0020100.name: Unusual fungal infection
HP:0020100.definition: An unusual fungal infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a fungal agent.
HP:0020100.definition_cn: 一种罕见的真菌感染，被视为对真菌病原体易感性的病理学标志。

HP:0020101.name: Invasive fungal infection
HP:0020101.definition: Fungal infection characterized by invasion of host tissues.
HP:0020101.definition_cn: 侵袭性真菌感染（Invasive Fungal Infection, IFI）

HP:0020102.name: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
HP:0020102.definition: An opportunistic disease caused by invasion of unicellular fungus Pneumocystis jirovecii. Transmission of P. jirovecii cysts takes place through the airborne route, and usually, its presence in lungs is asymptomatic. However, people with impaired immunity, especially those with CD4+ T cell count below 200/microliter, are still at risk of the development of Pneumocystis pneumonia due to P. jirovecii invasion. Symptoms induced by this disease are not specific: progressive dyspnea, non-productive cough, low-grade fever, arterial partial pressure of oxygen below 65 mmHg, and chest radiographs demonstrating bilateral, interstitial shadowing.
HP:0020102.definition_cn: 由单细胞真菌耶氏肺孢子菌（Pneumocystis jirovecii）侵入引起的机会性感染疾病。耶氏肺孢子菌包囊通过空气传播途径传播，通常其在肺部的存在是无症状的。然而，免疫功能受损的人群，尤其是CD4+ T细胞计数低于200/微升的患者，仍存在因耶氏肺孢子菌侵入而发展为肺孢子菌肺炎的风险。该疾病引发的症状无特异性：进行性呼吸困难、干咳、低热、动脉血氧分压低于65 mmHg，以及胸部X线片显示双侧间质性阴影。

HP:0020103.name: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis
HP:0020103.definition: Infection of the lungs with aspergillus. In the respiratory mucosa, the spores may germinate into hyphae, which in turn can invade the mucosa leading to invasive pulmonary aspergillosis.
HP:0020103.definition_cn: 肺部曲霉菌感染。在呼吸道黏膜中，孢子可萌发成菌丝，进而侵入黏膜，导致侵袭性肺曲霉病。

HP:0020104.name: Unusual protozoan infection
HP:0020104.definition: An unusual protozoan infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a protozoal agent.
HP:0020104.definition_cn: 一种罕见的原虫感染，被视为对原虫病原体感染的病理易感性的标志。

HP:0020105.name: Severe toxoplasmosis
HP:0020105.definition: Toxoplasmosis is a widespread parasitic infection that is frequently asymptomatic in immunocompetent patients. However, this obligate intracellular protozoan parasite can evade the immune system and persist for the life of its host in cyst form, predominantly in the brain, retina, and muscles. Reactivation of latent cysts may occur when the immune system fails to maintain cytokine pressure, which mainly relies on gamma interferon (IFN-gamma). Toxoplasmosis is a life-threatening infection in immunocompromised patients (ICPs).
HP:0020105.definition_cn: 弓形虫病是一种广泛传播的寄生虫感染，在免疫功能正常的患者中通常无症状。然而，这种专性细胞内原虫寄生虫能够逃避免疫系统，并以包囊形式在宿主体内持续存在，主要存在于大脑、视网膜和肌肉中。当免疫系统无法维持主要依赖γ干扰素（IFN-γ）的细胞因子压力时，潜伏包囊可能重新激活。在免疫功能低下患者（ICPs）中，弓形虫病是一种危及生命的感染。

HP:0020106.name: Severe giardiasis
HP:0020106.definition: An unusually severe infection due to Giardia lamblia, also called Giardia duodenalis or Giardia intestinalis, which is a protozoan parasite of the small intestine that causes extensive morbidity worldwide.
HP:0020106.definition_cn: 由蓝氏贾第虫（Giardia lamblia），又称十二指肠贾第虫（Giardia duodenalis）或肠贾第虫（Giardia intestinalis）引起的异常严重感染，这是一种寄生于小肠的原生动物寄生虫，在全球范围内导致广泛的发病率。

HP:0020107.name: Unusual helminthic infection
