HP:0020107.definition: An unusual helminthic infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a worm (helminth).
HP:0020107.definition_cn: 一种罕见的蠕虫感染，被视为对蠕虫（寄生虫）感染的病理易感性的标志。

HP:0020108.name: Unusual parasitic infection
HP:0020108.definition: An unusual parasitic infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a parasite.
HP:0020108.definition_cn: 一种罕见的寄生虫感染，被视为对寄生虫感染的病理易感性的标志。

HP:0020109.name: Glomerular basement membrane duplication
HP:0020109.definition: Glomerular basement membrane duplication (GBM-DP) can be seen with Periodic acid-Schiff and silver stains. This appearance results from the presence of subendothelial deposits and the so-called mesangial interposition whereby mesangial cells, infiltrating mononuclear cells, or even portions of endothelial cells interpose themselves between the endothelium and basement membrane, with new, inner GBM-like material being laid down. This produces a double contour or tram-track appearance on light or electron microscopy. This finding often reflects splitting of the lamina densa and is associated with disease processes such as membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis, transplant glomerulopathy, and diabetic nephropathy.
HP:0020109.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜复层化（GBM-DP）可通过过碘酸-雪夫染色及银染色观察到。此现象源于内皮下沉积物的存在以及所谓的系膜插入现象——即系膜细胞、浸润的单核细胞甚至部分内皮细胞插入内皮细胞与基底膜之间，同时伴有新的内层GBM样物质沉积。在光镜或电镜下呈现双轨征或电车轨道样外观。该表现通常反映致密层分裂，常见于膜增生性肾小球肾炎、移植肾小球病及糖尿病肾病等疾病过程。

HP:0020110.name: Bone fracture
HP:0020110.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the continuity of a bone.

HP:0020111.name: Abnormal CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cell proportion
HP:0020111.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells in circulation, relative to another population of cells.
HP:0020111.definition_cn: 循环中CD4阳性、CD25阳性、αβ调节性T细胞相对于另一细胞群的比例偏离正常范围。

HP:0020112.name: Increased proportion of CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cells
HP:0020112.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells in circulation, relative to another population of cells.
HP:0020112.definition_cn: 循环中CD4阳性、CD25阳性、α-β调节性T细胞比例异常增高，相对于另一细胞群体。

HP:0020113.name: Decreased proportion of CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cells
HP:0020113.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells in circulation, relative to another population of cells.
HP:0020113.definition_cn: 循环中CD4阳性、CD25阳性、α-β调节性T细胞比例异常降低，相对于另一细胞群。

HP:0020114.name: Persistent human papillomavirus infection
HP:0020114.definition: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are small oncogenic viruses. HPV has been shown to cause a variety of lesions and malignancies, which predominantly affect the anogenital region. Low-risk, non-oncogenic HPV types are associated with anogenital warts and recurrent respiratory papillomatosis while high-risk, oncogenic types are associated with cervical, penile, anal, vaginal, vulvar, and oropharyngeal cancers. Infection with anogenital HPV is usually asymptomatic and resolves spontaneously without consequences in the immunocompetent host. When disease does occur, the most common manifestation is genital warts, which may be small papules, or flat, smooth or pedunculated lesions. This resolution of HPV lesions is not generally seen in the immunosuppressed, resulting in severe, persistent and extensive manifestations of HPV disease.
HP:0020114.name_cn: 持续性人乳头瘤病毒感染
HP:0020114.definition_cn: 人乳头瘤病毒（Human papillomaviruses, HPVs）是一种小型致癌病毒。HPV已被证实可引发多种病变和恶性肿瘤，主要累及肛门生殖器区域。低风险、非致癌型HPV与肛门生殖器疣和复发性呼吸道乳头状瘤病相关，而高风险、致癌型HPV则与宫颈癌、阴茎癌、肛门癌、阴道癌、外阴癌及口咽癌相关。肛门生殖器HPV感染通常无症状，在免疫功能正常的宿主中可自行消退而不产生后果。当疾病发生时，最常见的表现为生殖器疣，可能表现为小丘疹或扁平、光滑或有蒂的病变。HPV病变的消退在免疫抑制患者中通常不常见，导致HPV疾病呈现严重、持续和广泛的表现。

HP:0020115.name: Abnormal CD8+ T cell subset proportion
HP:0020115.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of any CD8+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD8+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
HP:0020115.name_cn: CD8+ T细胞亚群比例异常
HP:0020115.definition_cn: 与特定性别和年龄组的参考范围相比，血液中CD8+ T细胞亚群占总CD8+ T细胞百分比的异常升高或降低。

HP:0020116.name: Subcutaneous abscess
HP:0020116.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris located in the subcutaneous tissue (subcutaneous fat layer), below the dermis.
HP:0020116.definition_cn: 位于皮下组织（皮下脂肪层）、真皮层以下的局限性脓液或坏死组织积聚区域。

HP:0020117.name: Hypoplastic dermoepidermal hemidesmosomes
HP:0020117.definition: Underdeveloped hemidesmosomes at the dermoepidermal junction. Hemidesmosomes are the specialized junctional complexes, that contribute to the attachment of epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane in stratified and other complex epithelia, such as the skin.
HP:0020117.name_cn: 发育不良的真皮-表皮半桥粒
HP:0020117.definition_cn: 真皮-表皮连接处半桥粒发育不全。半桥粒是特化的连接复合体，在复层和其他复杂上皮（如皮肤）中，有助于上皮细胞与下方基底膜的附着。

HP:0020118.name: Radial artery aplasia
HP:0020118.definition: Congenital absence of the radial artery.

HP:0020119.name: Abnormal retinal nerve fiber layer morphology
HP:0020119.definition: A structural abnormality of the retinal nerve fiber layer
HP:0020119.name_cn: 视网膜神经纤维层形态异常
HP:0020119.definition_cn: 视网膜神经纤维层结构异常

HP:0020120.name: Retinal nerve fiber edema
HP:0020120.definition: Swelling (edema) of the retinal nerve fibers.
HP:0020120.name_cn: 视网膜神经纤维层水肿
HP:0020120.definition_cn: 视网膜神经纤维层水肿（Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer Edema）。

HP:0020121.name: Conception by assisted reproductive technology
HP:0020121.definition: A history of conception by an assisted reproductive technology such as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), and cryopreservation.
HP:0020121.definition_cn: 辅助生殖技术（Assisted Reproductive Technology, ART）受孕史，包括体外受精（In Vitro Fertilization, IVF）、卵胞浆内单精子注射（Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection, ICSI）及冷冻保存技术（Cryopreservation）。

HP:0020122.name: Bite cells
HP:0020122.definition: Red blood cells that appear to have parts of them bitten away.
HP:0020122.definition_cn: 红细胞呈现部分被咬噬的形态。

HP:0020123.name: Tympanosclerosis
HP:0020123.definition: A stiffening of the tympanic membrane due to calcification, typically presents as white plaque-like lesions, involving discrete regions of the tympanic membrane and/or middle ear.
HP:0020123.definition_cn: 鼓膜钙化导致的鼓膜硬化，通常表现为白色斑块样病变，累及鼓膜和/或中耳的离散区域。

HP:0020125.name: Spontaneous conjunctival filtering bleb
HP:0020125.definition: Avascular cystic elevations of the superior conjunctiva not related to ocular surgery or trauma.
HP:0020125.definition_cn: 与眼部手术或创伤无关的上部结膜无血管性囊性隆起。

HP:0020126.name: Prostate mass
HP:0020126.definition: A lump detected in the prostate. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction.
HP:0020126.definition_cn: 在前列腺中检测到的肿块。在此背景下，肿块是一个通用术语，指可能由细胞异常增生、囊肿、激素变化或免疫反应引起的肿块或生长物。

HP:0020127.name: Periarticular soft-tissue mass
HP:0020127.definition: A lump detected in the region that surrounds a joint. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction.
HP:0020127.definition_cn: 在关节周围区域检测到的肿块。在此上下文中，肿块是一个通用术语，指可能由细胞异常增生、囊肿、激素变化或免疫反应引起的肿块或增生。

HP:0020128.name: Aplasia of the olfactory tract
HP:0020128.definition: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the olfactory tract, which causes anosmia, a complete loss of the sense of smell.
HP:0020128.definition_cn: 嗅觉束发育不全（先天性缺失），导致嗅觉缺失症，即完全丧失嗅觉功能。

HP:0020129.name: Abnormal urine protein level
HP:0020129.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of one or more proteins in the urine.
HP:0020129.definition_cn: 尿液中一种或多种蛋白质浓度的任何偏离。

HP:0020130.name: Increased urinary neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin
HP:0020130.definition: An increased concentration of neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin in the urine (there is no generally accepted threshold, but some studies choose a threshold of above 150 nanogram per milliliter).
HP:0020130.name_cn: 尿中性粒细胞明胶酶相关脂质运载蛋白升高
HP:0020130.definition_cn: 尿液中中性粒细胞明胶酶相关脂质运载蛋白浓度升高（目前尚无普遍接受的阈值，但部分研究选择高于150纳克/毫升作为阈值）。

HP:0020131.name: Abnormal tubular basement membrane morphology
HP:0020131.definition: Abnormal structure of the basement membrane of the renal tubulus.
HP:0020131.name_cn: 肾小管基底膜形态异常
HP:0020131.definition_cn: 肾小管基底膜结构异常。

HP:0020132.name: Thickening of the tubular basement membrane
HP:0020132.definition: Increase in thickness of the basement membrane of the tubulus of the kidney.

HP:0020133.name: Podocyte hypertrophy
HP:0020133.definition: Increased visceral epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets.
HP:0020133.definition_cn: 内脏上皮细胞体积增大，伴或不伴胞质蛋白滴。

HP:0020134.name: Increased urine neutrophil count
HP:0020134.definition: Abnormally increased count of neutrophils in urine.
HP:0020134.name_cn: 尿中性粒细胞计数升高
HP:0020134.definition_cn: 尿液中嗜中性粒细胞异常增多。

HP:0020135.name: Myofibromatosis
HP:0020135.definition: A mesenchymal neoplasm characterized by solitary or multiple nodules involving the skin, striated muscles, bones and, sometimes, viscera. It usually appears as a subcutaneous nodule, but can also appear as an ulcer, pedunculated lesion, or similar to a hemangioma. Histology shows well-circumscribed tapered cell lobes, resembling smooth muscle cells. At its center, perivascular round cells (hemangiopericitoides) are usually observed, giving a biphasic appearance.
HP:0020135.definition_cn: 一种间叶性肿瘤，其特征为皮肤、横纹肌、骨骼以及有时内脏中出现单发或多发结节。通常表现为皮下结节，但也可表现为溃疡、带蒂病变或类似血管瘤的病变。组织学检查显示界限清楚的锥形细胞小叶，类似于平滑肌细胞。其中心通常可见血管周围圆形细胞（血管周细胞样细胞），呈现双相性外观。

HP:0020136.name: Anticardiolipin IgG antibody positivity
HP:0020136.definition: The presence of circulating IgG autoantibodies to cardiolipin.
HP:0020136.definition_cn: 循环性抗心磷脂IgG自身抗体的存在。

HP:0020137.name: Anticardiolipin IgM antibody positivity
HP:0020137.definition: The presence of circulating IgM autoantibodies to cardiolipin.
HP:0020137.definition_cn: 循环性抗心磷脂IgM自身抗体的存在。

HP:0020138.name: History of recent animal bite
HP:0020138.definition: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an animal.

HP:0020139.name: History of recent insect bite
HP:0020139.definition: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an insect.
HP:0020139.definition_cn: 昆虫叮咬所致近期咬伤病史。

HP:0020140.name: History of recent tick bite
HP:0020140.definition: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to a tick.
HP:0020140.definition_cn: 近期蜱虫叮咬损伤的病史。

HP:0020141.name: Blood pressure substantially higher in legs than arms
HP:0020141.definition: An abnormal blood pressure discrepancy between the upper and lower extremities with the blood pressure measured in the legs being much higher than the blood pressure measure in the arms. In healthy individuals, ankle systolic blood pressures are only slightly higher than the systolic blood pressure measured in the arm.
HP:0020141.name_cn: 下肢血压显著高于上肢血压
HP:0020141.definition_cn: 上下肢血压异常差异，表现为下肢血压显著高于上肢血压。在健康个体中，踝部收缩压仅略高于上肢收缩压。

HP:0020142.name: Blood pressure substantially higher in arms than legs
HP:0020142.definition: An abnormal blood pressure discrepancy between the upper and lower extremities with the blood pressure measured in the arms being much higher than the blood pressure measure in the legs. In healthy individuals, ankle systolic blood pressures are only slightly higher than the systolic blood pressure measured in the arm.
HP:0020142.name_cn: 上肢血压显著高于下肢血压
HP:0020142.definition_cn: 上下肢血压异常差异，表现为上肢血压显著高于下肢血压。在健康个体中，踝部收缩压仅略高于上肢收缩压。

HP:0020143.name: Tracheal duplication cyst
HP:0020143.definition: A cyst in the trachea, whose wall is made up by tissue similar to the bronchial tree, including cartilage and smooth muscle, and is lined by secretory respiratory epithelium composed of cuboid or columnar ciliated epithelium.
HP:0020143.definition_cn: 气管囊肿，其囊壁由类似于支气管树的组织构成，包括软骨和平滑肌，内衬分泌性呼吸上皮，由立方或柱状纤毛上皮组成。

HP:0020144.name: Calcium phosphate crystalluria
HP:0020144.definition: The presence of calcium phosphate crystals in the urine.
HP:0020144.definition_cn: 尿液中磷酸钙结晶的存在。

HP:0020145.name: Calcium oxalate crystalluria
HP:0020145.definition: The presence of calcium oxalate crystals in the urine.
HP:0020145.definition_cn: 尿液中草酸钙结晶的存在。

HP:0020146.name: Calcium carbonate crystalluria
HP:0020146.definition: The presence of calcium carbonate crystals in the urine.
HP:0020146.definition_cn: 尿液中碳酸钙结晶的存在。

HP:0020147.name: 2-Methylbutyryl glycinuria
HP:0020147.definition: Increased concentration of 2-methylbutyryl glycine in the urine.
HP:0020147.definition_cn: 尿液中2-甲基丁酰甘氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0020148.name: Increased circulating mead acid level
HP:0020148.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration od mead acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0020148.name_cn: 循环中二十碳三烯酸水平升高
HP:0020148.definition_cn: 血液循环中花生三烯酸浓度异常升高。

HP:0020149.name: Elevated circulating succinate
HP:0020149.definition: An increase concentration of succinate in the blood circulation.
HP:0020149.definition_cn: 血液循环中琥珀酸浓度升高。

HP:0020150.name: Elevated urinary uromodulin level
HP:0020150.definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020150.name_cn: 尿液中尿调节素水平升高
HP:0020150.definition_cn: 尿液中尿调节素（亦称Tamm-Horsfall蛋白）的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0020151.name: Anti-dsDNA antibody positivity
HP:0020151.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against double-stranded DNA.
HP:0020151.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对双链DNA的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0020152.name: Distal joint hypermobility
HP:0020152.definition: Lack of stability of a distal joint (e.g., finger).
HP:0020152.definition_cn: 远端关节（例如手指）稳定性缺失。

HP:0020153.name: Positive blood 1,3 beta glucan test
HP:0020153.definition: Beta-1,3-glucan is a major constituent of all of the characterized fungal cell walls, making up between 30-80 percent of the mass of the wall. It is a biomarker of fungal infections such as invasive pulmonary aspergillosis.
HP:0020153.definition_cn: β-1,3-葡聚糖是所有已表征真菌细胞壁的主要成分，占细胞壁质量的30%-80%。它是侵袭性肺曲霉病等真菌感染的生物标志物。

HP:0020154.name: Nevus comedonicus
HP:0020154.definition: A type of epidermal nevus characterized by closely arranged, dilated follicular openings with keratinous plugs resembling classical comedones.
HP:0020154.definition_cn: 一种以紧密排列、扩张的毛囊开口伴角蛋白栓为特征的表皮痣，类似于典型的粉刺。

HP:0020155.name: Abnormal oocyte morphology
HP:0020155.definition: An abnormal structure of the female germ cell (egg cell).
HP:0020155.definition_cn: 女性生殖细胞（卵细胞）结构异常。

HP:0020156.name: Abnormal zona pellucida morphology
HP:0020156.definition: Abnormal structure of the oocyte extracellular matrix region known as the zona pellucida.
HP:0020156.definition_cn: 卵母细胞细胞外基质区域（即透明带）结构异常。

HP:0020157.name: Thin zona pellucida
HP:0020157.definition: Reduced thickness of the zona pellucida.

HP:0020158.name: Increased circulating adrenic acid concentration
HP:0020158.definition: An increased concentration of adrenic acid (also known as cis-7,10,13,16-Docosatetraenoic acid) in the blood circulation.
HP:0020158.name_cn: 循环中肾上腺酸浓度升高
HP:0020158.definition_cn: 血液循环中肾上腺酸（也称为顺式-7,10,13,16-二十二碳四烯酸）浓度升高。

HP:0020159.name: Reduced response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0020159.definition: Failure of the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulation test to induce an appropriate increased in luteinizing hormone (LH), follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels.
HP:0020159.name_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素刺激试验反应减弱
HP:0020159.definition_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素（GnRH）刺激试验未能诱导黄体生成素（LH）和卵泡刺激素（FSH）水平的适当升高。

HP:0020160.name: GM1-ganglioside accumulation
HP:0020160.definition_cn: GM1神经节苷脂的细胞蓄积。

HP:0020161.name: Branch retinal artery occlusion
HP:0020161.definition: Blockage of a branch of the retinal artery. This can cause loss of a section of visual field.
HP:0020161.definition_cn: 视网膜动脉分支阻塞。这可能导致部分视野缺损。

HP:0020162.name: Abnormal neoplastic cell morphology
HP:0020162.definition: A morphological abnormality of of tumor or neoplastic cells, characterized by atypical size, shape, cytoplasmic or nuclear features, or other deviations from normal cellular architecture.
HP:0020162.definition_cn: 肿瘤或肿瘤细胞的形态学异常，其特征为细胞大小、形状、胞质或核特征的非典型性，或与正常细胞结构的其他偏差。

HP:0020163.name: Cilioretinal artery occlusion
HP:0020163.definition: Blockage of the cilioretinal artery. The central retinal artery supplies the inner retina and the surface of the optic nerve. In some individuals, the cilioretinal artery, a branch of the ciliary circulation, may supply a portion of the retina including the macula. In cilioretinal artery occlusion, vision loss results from cell death in the inner retinal layers (mainly ganglion cells) despite relative sparing of the outer layers.
HP:0020163.definition_cn: 睫状视网膜动脉阻塞。视网膜中央动脉供应视网膜内层及视神经表面。在某些个体中，睫状视网膜动脉作为睫状循环的分支，可能供应包括黄斑在内的部分视网膜区域。在睫状视网膜动脉阻塞时，尽管视网膜外层相对保留，但视网膜内层（主要为神经节细胞）的细胞死亡导致视力丧失。

HP:0020164.name: Ophthalmic artery occlusion
HP:0020164.definition: A partial or complete obstruction of the ophthalmic artery (branch of the internal carotid artery) that may lead to severe ischemia of the affected globe and associated ocular tissues. It can present with a similar picture to central retinal artery occlusion; however, profound choroidal ischaemia also occurs.
HP:0020164.definition_cn: 眼动脉（颈内动脉分支）部分或完全阻塞，可能导致受累眼球及相关眼组织的严重缺血。其临床表现可能与视网膜中央动脉阻塞相似；然而，同时还会发生严重的脉络膜缺血。

HP:0020165.name: Branch retinal vein occlusion
HP:0020165.definition: Blockage of a branch of the retinal vein. It may present with sudden-onset of painless vision loss or visual field defect correlating to the area of perfusion of the obstructed vessels.
HP:0020165.definition_cn: 视网膜静脉分支阻塞。可能表现为突发性无痛性视力丧失或与阻塞血管灌注区域相对应的视野缺损。

HP:0020166.name: Central retinal vein occlusion
HP:0020166.definition: Central retinal vein occlusion is an occlusion of the main retinal vein posterior to the lamina cribrosa of the optic nerve and is typically caused by thrombosis.
HP:0020166.definition_cn: 视网膜中央静脉阻塞是视神经筛板后部主要视网膜静脉的阻塞，通常由血栓形成引起。

HP:0020167.name: Hemiretinal vein occlusion
HP:0020167.definition: A variant of central retinal vein occlusions that involves the superior or inferior half of the retina.
HP:0020167.definition_cn: 视网膜中央静脉阻塞的一种变异型，累及视网膜上半部或下半部。

HP:0020168.name: Tumor signet ring cell
HP:0020168.definition: A signet ring has a flattened surface at the top of the ring with an engraved or raised symbol, historically used to stamp a seal into correspondence. Comparatively, these cells acquire a signet cell morphology due to accumulation of abundant mucin in cytoplasm, leading to nuclei dislocation to the periphery.
HP:0020168.definition_cn: 印戒环顶部具有平坦表面，带有雕刻或凸起的符号，历史上用于在信函上盖章。相比之下，这些细胞由于胞质内大量黏液积聚导致核移位至边缘，从而形成印戒细胞形态。

HP:0020169.name: Abnormal drug response
HP:0020169.definition: An anomalous response to a medication related to individual variation in metabolic or immune response to drugs varying from potentially from potentially life-threatening adverse drug reactions to alteration of therapeutic efficacy.
HP:0020169.definition_cn: 药物异常反应，与个体代谢或免疫反应的变异相关，可能从潜在危及生命的药物不良反应到治疗效果的改变。

HP:0020170.name: Increased blood drug concentration
HP:0020170.definition: High plasma concentration of a drug as compared to previously measured thresholds given the expected concentration for the applied dosage regime.
HP:0020170.definition_cn: 与先前测量的阈值相比，药物血浆浓度高于预期给药方案下的预期浓度。

HP:0020171.name: Decreased blood drug concentration
HP:0020171.definition: Low plasma concentration of a drug as compared to previously measured thresholds given the expected concentration for the applied dosage regime.
HP:0020171.definition_cn: 与先前测量的阈值相比，血浆药物浓度低于预期给药方案下的预期浓度。

HP:0020172.name: Adverse drug response
HP:0020172.definition: An unpleasant or harmful reaction resulting from treatment with a drug.
HP:0020172.definition_cn: 药物不良反应（Adverse Drug Reaction, ADR）

HP:0020173.name: Reduced drug efficacy
HP:0020173.definition: Decreased response to a drug intervention in comparison to the expected response.
HP:0020173.definition_cn: 药物干预反应降低，与预期反应相比。

HP:0020174.name: Refractory drug response
HP:0020174.definition: Absent or significantly reduced efficacy of drug intervention characterized by lack of measurable benefit or deterioration of disease course.
HP:0020174.definition_cn: 药物干预无效或疗效显著降低，表现为缺乏可测量的获益或疾病病程恶化。

HP:0020175.name: Reduced circulating cholinesterase activity
HP:0020175.definition: Activity or concentration of cholinesterase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0020175.name_cn: 循环胆碱酯酶活性降低
HP:0020175.definition_cn: 血液循环中胆碱酯酶活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0020176.name: Cholesterol crystalluria
HP:0020176.definition: The presence of cholesterol crystals in the urine.
HP:0020176.definition_cn: 尿液中胆固醇结晶的存在。

HP:0020177.name: Abnormal proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta TEMRA T cells
HP:0020177.definition: An abnormal proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta effector memory RA TEMRA T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.
HP:0020177.name_cn: CD8阳性αβ型终末分化效应记忆T细胞比例异常
HP:0020177.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性、αβ效应记忆RA TEMRA T细胞比例异常。这些细胞具有CD45RA阳性、CD45RO阴性和CCR7阴性的表型。

HP:0020178.name: Abnormal dendritic cell count
HP:0020178.definition: A deviation from the normal count of dendritic cells in the peripheral blood circulation. Dendritic cells are of hematopoietic origin, typically resident in particular tissues, specialized in the uptake, processing, and transport of antigens to lymph nodes for the purpose of stimulating an immune response via T cell activation. These cells are lineage negative (CD3-negative, CD19-negative, CD34-negative, and CD56-negative).
HP:0020178.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中树突状细胞数量偏离正常值。树突状细胞起源于造血系统，通常定位于特定组织，专门负责抗原的摄取、加工并将其转运至淋巴结，通过激活T细胞来刺激免疫反应。这些细胞为谱系阴性（CD3阴性、CD19阴性、CD34阴性和CD56阴性）。

HP:0020179.name: Abnormal circulating haptoglobin concentration
HP:0020179.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation.
HP:0020179.name_cn: 异常循环触珠蛋白浓度
HP:0020179.definition_cn: 血液中触珠蛋白浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0020180.name: Elevated haptoglobin level
HP:0020180.definition: An abnormally high concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation. Haptoglobin is an acute-phase reactant whose levels can become elevated in the presence of infection and inflammation.
HP:0020180.definition_cn: 血液循环中触珠蛋白浓度异常升高。触珠蛋白是一种急性期反应物，在感染和炎症存在时其水平可升高。

HP:0020181.name: Reduced haptoglobin level
HP:0020181.definition: An abnormally low concentration of haptoglobin in the blood circulation. Decreased haptoglobin in conjunction with increased reticulocyte count and anemia may indicate hemolysis. Decreased haptoglobin levels can also occur in the absence of hemolysis, due to cirrhosis of the liver, disseminated ovarian carcinomatosis, pulmonary sarcoidosis, and elevated estrogen state.
HP:0020181.definition_cn: 血液循环中触珠蛋白浓度异常降低。触珠蛋白降低伴随网织红细胞计数增加和贫血可能提示溶血。触珠蛋白水平降低也可能在无溶血的情况下发生，原因包括肝硬化、播散性卵巢癌病、肺结节病以及雌激素水平升高状态。

HP:0020182.name: Abnormal circulating A-type atrial natriuretic peptide concentration
HP:0020182.definition: A measurable change in circulating levels of Atrial natriuretic peptide hormone, a protein which plays an important role in the regulation of body fluid volume and blood pressure.
HP:0020182.name_cn: 异常循环A型心房利钠肽浓度
HP:0020182.definition_cn: 循环中心房利钠肽激素水平的可测量变化，该蛋白质在体液容量和血压调节中起重要作用。

HP:0020183.name: Increased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide concentration
HP:0020183.definition: A measurable elevation in circulating levels of Atrial natriuretic peptide hormone, a protein which plays an important role in the regulation of body fluid volume and blood pressure.
HP:0020183.name_cn: 循环中A型利钠肽浓度升高
HP:0020183.definition_cn: 可测量的循环心房利钠肽激素水平升高，该蛋白质在体液容量和血压调节中起重要作用。

HP:0020184.name: Decreased circulating A-type natriuretic peptide concentration
HP:0020184.definition: A measurable reduction in circulating levels of Atrial natriuretic peptide hormone, a protein which plays an important role in the regulation of body fluid volume and blood pressure.
HP:0020184.name_cn: 循环中A型利钠肽浓度降低
HP:0020184.definition_cn: 循环中心房利钠肽激素水平可测量的降低，该蛋白质在体液容量和血压调节中起重要作用。

HP:0020185.name: Superior cerebellar dysplasia
HP:0020185.definition: Abnormal morphological development of the superior part of the cerebellum.
HP:0020185.definition_cn: 小脑上部形态发育异常。

HP:0020186.name: Multilobulated spleen
HP:0020186.definition: The fetal spleen is lobulated, and these lobules normally disappear before the birth. Lobulation of the spleen may persist into adult life and be typically seen along the medial part of the spleen. A persisting lobule results in a variation in shape of the spleen.
HP:0020186.definition_cn: 胎儿脾脏呈分叶状，这些分叶通常在出生前消失。脾脏的分叶可能持续至成年期，并通常沿脾脏内侧部分可见。持续存在的分叶会导致脾脏形态的变异。

HP:0020187.name: Thick pachygyria
HP:0020187.definition: Pachygyria with a very thick cerebral cortex measuring 10-20 mm. Note that cortical thickness cannot be measured reliably on scans done between 3 and 24 months of age.
HP:0020187.definition_cn: 巨脑回畸形伴显著增厚的脑皮质，厚度为10-20毫米。需注意，在3至24个月龄期间进行的扫描中，皮质厚度无法可靠测量。

HP:0020188.name: Anterior predominant pachygyria with 5-10 mm cortical thickness
HP:0020188.definition: Pachygyria with cortical thickness between 5 and 10 mm with and a posterior predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically over 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Posterior predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe other the occipital lobes but also includes a rare perisylvian-predominant pachygyria and a temporal predominant pachygyria.
HP:0020188.name_cn: 前部为主的巨脑回畸形，皮质厚度为5-10毫米
HP:0020188.definition_cn: 巨脑回畸形，皮质厚度介于5至10毫米之间，且具有后部为主的严重程度梯度。严重程度梯度根据脑回宽度确定，在更严重受累区域，脑回宽度通常超过5毫米。后部为主的梯度表明巨脑回畸形在枕叶更为严重，但也包括罕见的以侧裂周围为主的巨脑回畸形和以颞叶为主的巨脑回畸形。

HP:0020189.name: Posterior predominant thick cortex pachygyria
HP:0020189.definition: Pachygyria with cortical thickness above 10 mm with and a posterior predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically wider than 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Posterior predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe other the occipital lobes but also includes a rare perisylvian-predominant pachygyria and a temporal predominant pachygyria.
HP:0020189.name_cn: 后部为主的厚皮质巨脑回畸形
HP:0020189.definition_cn: 巨脑回畸形，皮质厚度超过10毫米，且具有后部为主的严重程度梯度。严重程度梯度基于脑回宽度确定，在更严重受累区域，脑回宽度通常超过5毫米。后部为主的梯度表明巨脑回畸形在枕叶更为严重，但也包括罕见的以侧裂周围为主的巨脑回畸形和以颞叶为主的巨脑回畸形。

HP:0020190.name: Perisylvian predominant thick cortex pachygyria
HP:0020190.definition: Pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm and a perisylvian predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically wider than 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Perisylvian predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe other the occipital lobes but also includes a rare perisylvian-predominant pachygyria and a temporal predominant pachygyria.
HP:0020190.name_cn: 外侧裂周围为主的皮质增厚型巨脑回畸形
HP:0020190.definition_cn: 巨脑回畸形，皮质厚度大于10毫米，以侧裂周围为主的严重程度梯度。严重程度梯度根据脑回宽度确定，在更严重受累区域，脑回宽度通常大于5毫米。以侧裂周围为主的梯度表明巨脑回畸形在枕叶更为严重，但也包括罕见的以侧裂周围为主的巨脑回畸形和以颞叶为主的巨脑回畸形。

HP:0020191.name: Anterior predominant thick cortex pachygyria
HP:0020191.definition: Pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm and an anterior predominant severity gradient. The severity gradient is determined based on the gyral width, with gyri typically wider than 5mm over the more severely affected regions. Anterior predominant gradient indicates pachygyria more severe over the frontal and temporal lobes.
HP:0020191.name_cn: 前部优势型厚皮质巨脑回畸形
HP:0020191.definition_cn: 巨脑回畸形伴皮质厚度大于10毫米，且以前部为主的严重程度梯度。严重程度梯度基于脑回宽度确定，在更严重受累区域，脑回宽度通常大于5毫米。前部为主的梯度表明巨脑回畸形在额叶和颞叶更为严重。

HP:0020192.name: Pachygyria with 5-10 mm cortical thickness
HP:0020192.definition: Pachygyria with a mildly thickened cerebral cortex measuring 5-10 mm. Note that cortical thickness cannot be measured reliably on scans done between 3 and 24 months of age.
HP:0020192.name_cn: 巨脑回畸形伴5-10毫米皮质厚度
HP:0020192.definition_cn: 脑回肥厚伴轻度增厚的脑皮质，厚度为5-10毫米。请注意，在3至24个月龄期间进行的扫描中，皮质厚度无法可靠测量。

HP:0020193.name: Prolonged reptilase time
HP:0020193.definition: An abnormally increased duration of the reptilase time. Reptilase time is a functional plasma clotting assay, which is based on the enzymatic activity of batroxobin. By specifically cleaving fibrinogen A from fibrinogen, batroxobin leads to the formation of a stable fibrin clot. The time, starting from the addition of batroxobin to the plasma sample, until clot formation is the reptilase time and is given in seconds.
HP:0020193.definition_cn: 爬虫酶时间异常延长。爬虫酶时间是一种功能性血浆凝血检测，基于巴曲酶的酶活性。巴曲酶通过特异性裂解纤维蛋白原A，导致稳定纤维蛋白凝块的形成。从将巴曲酶加入血浆样本到凝块形成的时间即为爬虫酶时间，以秒为单位表示。

HP:0020194.name: IgA heavy chain paraproteinemia
HP:0020194.definition: An abnormal IgA heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0020194.definition_cn: 循环中异常的IgA重链，通常由B细胞来源的浆细胞克隆群体产生。

HP:0020195.name: IgG heavy chain paraproteinemia
HP:0020195.definition: An abnormal IgG heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0020195.definition_cn: 循环中异常IgG重链，通常由B细胞来源的浆细胞克隆群体产生。

HP:0020196.name: IgM heavy chain paraproteinemia
HP:0020196.definition: An abnormal IgM heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0020196.definition_cn: 循环中异常的IgM重链，通常由B细胞来源的浆细胞克隆群体产生。

HP:0020197.name: Increased circulating arachidonic acid concentration
HP:0020197.definition: An increased circulation of arachidonic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0020197.name_cn: 循环中花生四烯酸浓度升高
HP:0020197.definition_cn: 血液中花生四烯酸循环增加。

HP:0020198.name: Abnormal circulating 18-hydroxycorticosterone level
HP:0020198.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of 18-Hydroxycorticosterone level in the blood circulation.
HP:0020198.name_cn: 循环18-羟基皮质酮水平异常
HP:0020198.definition_cn: 血液循环中18-羟基皮质酮浓度偏离正常水平的任何异常。

HP:0020199.name: Decreased circulating 18-hydroxycortisone level
HP:0020199.definition: A subnormal concentration of 18-Hydroxycorticosterone level in the blood circulation.
HP:0020199.name_cn: 循环18-羟基皮质酮水平降低
HP:0020199.definition_cn: 血液循环中18-羟基皮质酮水平低于正常浓度。

HP:0020200.name: Increased circulating 18-hydroxycortisone level
HP:0020200.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration of 18-Hydroxycorticosterone level in the blood circulation.
HP:0020200.name_cn: 循环中18-羟基皮质酮水平升高
HP:0020200.definition_cn: 血液循环中18-羟基皮质酮浓度异常升高。

HP:0020201.name: Abnormal sarcomere morphology
HP:0020201.definition: Any structural anomaly of the sarcomere, which is unit of a myofibril in a muscle cell, composed of an array of overlapping thick and thin filaments between two adjacent Z disks.
HP:0020201.definition_cn: 肌节结构异常。肌节是肌细胞内肌原纤维的基本单位，由两个相邻Z盘之间重叠排列的粗肌丝和细肌丝组成。

HP:0020202.name: Abnormal Z disk morphology
HP:0020202.definition: Any structural anomaly of the Z disk, which is the platelike region of a muscle sarcomere to which the plus ends of actin filaments are attached.
HP:0020202.definition_cn: Z盘结构异常，即肌节板状区域的结构异常，该区域为肌动蛋白丝正端附着处。

HP:0020203.name: Z-band streaming
HP:0020203.definition: Streaming or smearing of the Z band, which is then no longer confined to a narrow zone which bisects the I band. The Z disk may extend across the I band or the entire sarcomere in a zigzag manner. Focal thickening, smudging, and blurring of the Z band takes place concurrently. Myofibrillar disorganization is a frequent but not invariable accompanying change.
HP:0020203.definition_cn: Z带出现流变或涂抹现象，不再局限于横跨I带的狭窄区域。Z盘可能以锯齿状方式延伸跨越I带或整个肌节。同时，Z带出现局灶性增厚、模糊和不清。肌原纤维紊乱是常见的伴随改变，但并非必然发生。

HP:0020204.name: Tubulointerstitial bacterial infiltration
HP:0020204.definition: Tubulointerstitial infiltration of bacteria identified on routine and/or special (Brown-Hopps) stains.
HP:0020204.definition_cn: 在常规和/或特殊（Brown-Hopps）染色中发现的肾小管间质细菌浸润。

HP:0020205.name: Tubulointerstitial fungal infiltration
HP:0020205.definition: Tubulointerstitial infiltration of yeast or hyphal-microrganisms identified on routine and/or special (PAS, silver) stains.
HP:0020205.definition_cn: 在常规和/或特殊染色（PAS染色、银染）中观察到肾小管间质中存在酵母菌或菌丝微生物的浸润。

HP:0020206.name: Simple ear
HP:0020206.definition: The pinna has fewer folds and grooves than usual.
HP:0020206.definition_cn: 耳廓的皱褶和沟回较正常减少。

HP:0020207.name: Reflex seizure
HP:0020207.definition_cn: 外源性刺激诱发的癫痫发作。

HP:0020208.name: Eating-induced seizure
HP:0020208.definition: A seizure precipitated by aspects of anticipating food, eating itself, or the post-prandial period.
HP:0020208.definition_cn: 由预期进食、进食本身或餐后期间诱发的癫痫发作。

HP:0020209.name: Hot water-induced seizure
HP:0020209.definition: A seizure precipitated by pouring cupfuls of very hot water (40 to 50 degrees Celsius) in rapid succession over the head. Bathing in this manner is the most common trigger.
HP:0020209.definition_cn: 由连续快速将大量热水（40至50摄氏度）倾倒在头部引发的癫痫发作。以此种方式沐浴是最常见的诱因。

HP:0020210.name: Praxis-induced seizure
HP:0020210.definition: A seizure precipitated by complex, cognition-guided tasks often involving visuomotor coordination and decision-making.
HP:0020210.definition_cn: 由复杂的、认知引导的任务引发的癫痫发作，通常涉及视觉运动协调和决策制定。

HP:0020211.name: Proprioceptive-induced seizure
HP:0020211.definition: A seizure precipitated by movement or a change in posture.
HP:0020211.name_cn: 本体感觉诱发性癫痫发作
HP:0020211.definition_cn: 运动或体位改变诱发的癫痫发作。

HP:0020213.name: Somatosensory-induced seizure
HP:0020213.definition: A somatosensory reflex seizure is a seizure precipitated by somatic stimulation of a specific part of the body in the absence of startle or surprise.
HP:0020213.name_cn: 躯体感觉诱发性癫痫发作
HP:0020213.definition_cn: 躯体感觉反射性癫痫发作是指在无惊吓或意外情况下，由特定身体部位的躯体刺激引发的癫痫发作。

HP:0020214.name: Startle-induced seizure
HP:0020214.definition: Startle-induced seizures are triggered by multiple and non-specific stimuli (auditory, somatosensory, and rarely visual) and are characterized by their sudden unexpected nature. Sudden noise rather than pure sound is the most effective acoustic stimulus.
HP:0020214.definition_cn: 惊厥性发作由多种非特异性刺激（听觉、体感，罕见视觉）触发，其特征为突发性和不可预测性。突发噪音而非纯音是最有效的听觉刺激。

HP:0020215.name: Thinking-induced seizure
HP:0020215.definition: Seizures induced by thinking and decision-making.
HP:0020215.definition_cn: 认知决策诱发性癫痫发作。

HP:0020216.name: Visually-induced seizure
HP:0020216.definition: Seizures evoked by visual stimuli. This includes clinical seizures induced by strobe lighting, television and other screens, flickering environmental lighting and self-induction by causing a strobe effect.
HP:0020216.definition_cn: 视觉刺激诱发的癫痫发作。包括由闪光灯、电视及其他屏幕、环境闪烁灯光以及通过制造闪光效应自我诱导引发的临床癫痫发作。

HP:0020217.name: Focal aware motor seizure
HP:0020217.definition: A type of focal motor seizure in which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP:0020217.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性运动性癫痫发作
HP:0020217.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作，在整个发作过程中意识保持清醒。

HP:0020218.name: Focal aware atonic seizure
HP:0020218.definition: A type of focal atonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0020218.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性失张力发作
HP:0020218.definition_cn: 一种局灶性失张力发作，在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0020219.name: Motor seizure
HP:0020219.definition: A motor seizure is a type of seizure that is characterized at onset by involvement of the skeletal musculature. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement.
HP:0020219.definition_cn: 运动性癫痫发作是一种以骨骼肌系统受累为初始特征的癫痫发作类型。运动事件可能包括肌肉收缩的增加（阳性）或减少（阴性），从而产生运动。

HP:0020220.name: Focal atonic seizure
HP:0020220.definition: A focal seizure characterized at onset by sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic activity, typically lasting more than 500 ms but less than 2 seconds. It may involve the head, trunk, jaw or limb musculature.
HP:0020220.definition_cn: 一种局灶性癫痫发作，其特征为发作时突然出现肌张力丧失或减弱，无明显先兆性肌阵挛或强直活动，通常持续超过500毫秒但少于2秒。可能累及头部、躯干、下颌或肢体肌肉群。

HP:0020221.name: Clonic seizure
HP:0020221.definition: A clonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking, that is regularly repetitive.
HP:0020221.definition_cn: 阵挛性发作是一种运动性发作，其特征为持续、有节律的抽搐，且呈规律性重复。

HP:0020222.name: Hypohomocysteinemia
HP:0020222.definition: A decreased concentration of homocysteine in the blood.
HP:0020222.definition_cn: 血液中同型半胱氨酸浓度降低。

HP:0020223.name: Dermal sinus tract
HP:0020223.definition: A dermal sinus tract is an abnormality present at birth over the dorsal midline where an abnormal epithelialized connection from the skin tracks inwards towards the spine, most commonly seen in the lumbosacral region.
HP:0020223.definition_cn: 皮肤窦道是一种先天性异常，位于背侧中线，表现为皮肤与脊柱之间异常上皮化的连接，最常见于腰骶部。

HP:0020224.name: Mammary duct ectasia
HP:0020224.definition: A non-proliferative inflammatory disorder of the large duct (milk duct) of the breast; as such, it affects nipple and areola complex. The condition is characterized by focal dilatation of the lactiferous duct system is due to endoluminal changes, as well as the loss of duct wall elastin, leading to abnormally dilated and tortuous lactiferous ducts with associated periductal inflammation and fibrosis. Mammary duct ectasia may present with nipple discharge or palpable mass.
HP:0020224.definition_cn: 乳腺导管扩张症是一种非增殖性炎症性疾病，主要影响乳腺大导管（乳管），因此涉及乳头和乳晕复合体。该病的特征是由于管腔内变化以及导管壁弹性蛋白的丧失，导致乳腺导管系统局部扩张，形成异常扩张和迂曲的乳腺导管，并伴有导管周围炎症和纤维化。乳腺导管扩张症可能表现为乳头溢液或可触及的肿块。

HP:0020225.name: Breast abscess
HP:0020225.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the breast.

HP:0020226.name: Nipple tenderness
HP:0020226.definition: Pain or discomfort produced by touching the nipple.
HP:0020226.definition_cn: 乳头触痛或乳头触诊不适。

HP:0020227.name: Floating gallbladder
HP:0020227.definition: An abnormal configuration in which the gallbladder is pedunculated, hanging free of the liver, and attached only by the cystic mesentery,
HP:0020227.definition_cn: 胆囊异常形态，其中胆囊呈蒂状，游离于肝脏之外，仅通过胆囊系膜附着。

HP:0020228.name: Biospecimen phenotypic feature
HP:0020228.definition: A phenotypic abnormality obvserved in a biospecimen such as a biopsy or an extirpated tumor or tissue.
HP:0020228.definition_cn: 在生物样本（如活检、切除的肿瘤或组织）中观察到的表型异常。

HP:0020229.name: Abnormal lymph-node biospecimen
HP:0020229.definition: Any abnormal phenotypic feature observed in a biospecimen derived from a lymph node, generally obtained by lymph node biopsy (removal of lymph node tissue for microscopic examination).
HP:0020229.definition_cn: 在源自淋巴结的生物样本中观察到的任何异常表型特征，通常通过淋巴结活检（切除淋巴结组织进行显微镜检查）获得。

HP:0020230.name: Abnormal lymph-node tissue architecture
HP:0020230.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality of the architecture of the tissue of a lymph node.
HP:0020230.definition_cn: 淋巴结组织结构表型异常。

HP:0020231.name: Abnormal lymph-node cellular finding
HP:0020231.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality within cells located in a lymph node.
HP:0020231.name_cn: 异常淋巴结细胞学发现
HP:0020231.definition_cn: 淋巴结内细胞的任何表型异常。

HP:0020232.name: Abnormal Q wave
HP:0020232.definition: An anomaly of the Q wave of the electrocardiogram.

HP:0020233.name: Abnormal lymph-node cellular antigen expression
HP:0020233.definition: Abnormal expression of an antigen (marker) that by cells located in a lymph node.
HP:0020233.name_cn: 淋巴结细胞抗原表达异常
HP:0020233.definition_cn: 淋巴结内细胞抗原（标志物）的异常表达。

HP:0020234.name: Altered lymph-node tissue architecture
HP:0020234.definition: An alteration that affects multiple components of the architecture of a lymph node.
HP:0020234.definition_cn: 影响淋巴结结构多个组成部分的病变。

HP:0020235.name: Effaced lymph-node architecture
HP:0020235.definition: Effacement of architecture typically refers to a cellular infiltrate destroying the normal follicular architecture of a lymph node. This effacement may result in sheets of cells that do not form clear architecture (seen in many lymphomas) or may lead to replacement of the normal architecture by atypical architecture, for example effacement of normal lymph node architecture (including normal follicles and patent lymph node sinuses) by many abnormal follicles in follicular lymphoma.
HP:0020235.definition_cn: 结构消失通常指的是细胞浸润破坏淋巴结的正常滤泡结构。这种结构消失可能导致形成无明显结构的细胞片（见于许多淋巴瘤），或可能导致正常结构被非典型结构所取代，例如在滤泡性淋巴瘤中，许多异常滤泡取代了正常淋巴结结构（包括正常滤泡和开放的淋巴结窦）。

HP:0020236.name: Vaguely nodular lymph-node architecture
HP:0020236.definition: In contrast to normal lymph node architecture or that of follicular lymphoma, where follicles are typically distinct and readily identifiable on H&E stained biopsy sections, the cells within an atypical lymph node may show what appear to groups of cells forming vague nodules but not forming clear follicles.
HP:0020236.name_cn: 模糊结节性淋巴结结构
HP:0020236.definition_cn: 与正常淋巴结结构或滤泡性淋巴瘤相比，在H&E染色的活检切片中，滤泡通常明显且易于识别，而在非典型淋巴结中，细胞可能表现为形成模糊结节但未形成清晰滤泡的细胞群。

HP:0020237.name: Lymph-node capsular invasion by lymphocytes
HP:0020237.definition: Migration of substantial numbers of lymphocytes into the capsule of a lymph node.
HP:0020237.name_cn: 淋巴细胞浸润淋巴结被膜
HP:0020237.definition_cn: 大量淋巴细胞迁移至淋巴结被膜内。

HP:0020238.name: Lymph-node extracapsular extension by lymph-node lymphocytes
HP:0020238.definition: Migration of lymphocytes into the soft tissues surrounding the lymph node.
HP:0020238.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞导致的淋巴结包膜外侵犯
HP:0020238.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞迁移至淋巴结周围软组织。

HP:0020239.name: Increased lymph-node epithelioid histiocyte count
HP:0020239.definition: Number of epithelioid histiocytes (histiocytes are tissue-resident macrophages) located within a lymph node above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020239.name_cn: 淋巴结上皮样组织细胞计数增加
HP:0020239.definition_cn: 位于淋巴结内的上皮样组织细胞（组织细胞为组织驻留巨噬细胞）数量超过正常上限。

HP:0020240.name: Scattered lymph node individual epithelioid histiocytes
HP:0020240.definition: Many individual (not clustered) epithelioid histiocytes throughout at least part of a lymph node.
HP:0020240.name_cn: 散在淋巴结内个别上皮样组织细胞
HP:0020240.definition_cn: 在至少部分淋巴结中可见多个散在（非簇状）的上皮样组织细胞。

HP:0020241.name: Clustered lymph node epithelioid histiocytes
HP:0020241.definition: Formation of clusters (group of cells positioned near each other) of epithelioid histiocytes within a lymph node.
HP:0020241.name_cn: 簇状淋巴结上皮样组织细胞
HP:0020241.definition_cn: 淋巴结内上皮样组织细胞簇（彼此邻近的细胞群）的形成。

HP:0020242.name: Abnormal lymph-node follicle architecture
HP:0020242.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality of the architecture of follicles of a lymph node.
HP:0020242.definition_cn: 淋巴结滤泡结构表型异常。

HP:0020243.name: Floral-pattern lymph node follicles
HP:0020243.definition: Atypical lymph node follicles that have mantle zone cells invaginating/infiltrating into the follicle centers, which is said to confer a flower-like appearance.
HP:0020243.definition_cn: 非典型淋巴结滤泡，其套区细胞内陷/浸润至滤泡中心，形成所谓的花样外观。

HP:0020244.name: Colonization of follicles by lymphoma cells
HP:0020244.definition: In contrast to follicular lymphoma, which typically is a lymphoma that forms follicles or potentially completely replaces normal follicles, some lymphomas (most commonly marginal zone lymphoma) can infiltrate normal follicles so both normal lymphocytes and the infiltrating lymphoma cells are present. This is called colonization of follicles by the lymphoma cells.
HP:0020244.name_cn: 淋巴瘤细胞对滤泡的定植
HP:0020244.definition_cn: 与滤泡性淋巴瘤（follicular lymphoma）不同，后者通常形成滤泡或可能完全取代正常滤泡，某些淋巴瘤（最常见的是边缘区淋巴瘤，marginal zone lymphoma）可以浸润正常滤泡，因此正常淋巴细胞和浸润的淋巴瘤细胞同时存在。这种现象称为淋巴瘤细胞对滤泡的定植（colonization of follicles by the lymphoma cells）。

HP:0020245.name: Crowded lymph-node follicles
HP:0020245.definition: Reduction in the average distance between adjacent lymph node follicles.
HP:0020245.definition_cn: 相邻淋巴结滤泡间平均距离缩短。

HP:0020246.name: Lymph-node follicular lysis
HP:0020246.definition: An abnormal morphology of hyperplastic lymph node follicles characterized by distortion of the follicular architecture by tongues and clusters of dark blue mantle cells impinging on and invading the reactive germinal center (Mostly T cells and mantle-zone B cells).
HP:0020246.definition_cn: 增生性淋巴结滤泡的异常形态学特征表现为滤泡结构的扭曲，由深蓝色套细胞形成的舌状和簇状结构侵犯并侵入反应性生发中心（主要为T细胞和套区B细胞）。

HP:0020247.name: Non-polarized lymph node germinal centers
HP:0020247.definition: A loss of the typical polarization of the architecture of a lymph node germinal center.
HP:0020247.name_cn: 非极化淋巴结生发中心
HP:0020247.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心结构典型极化的丧失。

HP:0020248.name: Irregularly shaped lymph node germinal centers
HP:0020248.definition: A deviation from the typically fairly round or oval form of a lymph node germinal center.
HP:0020248.name_cn: 不规则形态的淋巴结生发中心
HP:0020248.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心形态偏离典型圆形或椭圆形。

HP:0020249.name: Abnormal lymph-node marginal or mantle zone morphology
HP:0020249.definition: An abnormality of the structure of the mantle or marginal zone of a lymph node.
HP:0020249.name_cn: 淋巴结边缘区或套区形态异常
HP:0020249.definition_cn: 淋巴结被膜或边缘区结构异常。

HP:0020250.name: Abnormal lymph node marginal zone morphology
HP:0020250.name_cn: 异常淋巴结边缘区形态

HP:0020251.name: Abnormal lymph node mantle zone morphology

HP:0020252.name: Abnormal bursal fluid morphology
HP:0020252.definition: An anomaly of the synovial-like fluid found within a bursa, which is a small, closed sac lined by synovial membrane that reduces friction between tissues such as tendons, muscles, ligaments, and bones.
HP:0020252.definition_cn: 滑囊内滑膜样液体异常。滑囊是一种由滑膜衬里的封闭小囊，可减少肌腱、肌肉、韧带与骨骼等组织间的摩擦。

HP:0020253.name: Lymph node with expanded mantle zones
HP:0020253.definition: Enlargement of the typical outer ring of small lymphocytes (mantle zone) surrounding a germinal center of a lymph node.
HP:0020253.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心周围典型小淋巴细胞外环（套区）增厚。

HP:0020254.name: Lymph node with poorly defined germinal center borders
HP:0020254.definition: Reduced demarcation of the border between germinal centers and mantle zones. This border is typically seen as a crisp line on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained lymph node sections.
HP:0020254.name_cn: 淋巴结生发中心边界模糊不清
HP:0020254.definition_cn: 生发中心与套区之间的界限模糊不清。在苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色的淋巴结切片中，该界限通常呈现为一条清晰的线条。

HP:0020255.name: Abnormal lymph-node germinal center morphology
HP:0020255.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality of germinal centers of a lymph node.
HP:0020255.name_cn: 淋巴结生发中心形态异常
HP:0020255.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心表型异常。

HP:0020256.name: Elevated bursal fluid leukocyte count
HP:0020256.definition: The count of leukocytes per unit volume in a bursa aspirate specimen is above the uppper limit of normal.
HP:0020256.name_cn: 滑囊液白细胞计数升高
HP:0020256.definition_cn: 滑囊穿刺液标本中每单位体积白细胞计数高于正常上限。

HP:0020257.name: Mantle zone pattern
HP:0020257.definition: This refers to an architectural pattern of infiltration where atypical lymphocytes surround germinal centers, often expanding the mantle zones but without effacing architecture.
HP:0020257.definition_cn: 此描述指一种浸润的架构模式，其中非典型淋巴细胞围绕生发中心，常使套区扩张但不破坏组织结构。

HP:0020258.name: Germinal centers with absent marginal zones

HP:0020259.name: Decreased biparietal diameter
HP:0020259.definition: Fetal head width measurement, taken between the outer edge of the proximal parietal bone and the inner edge of the distal parietal bone, below the lower limit of normal, usually taken to be two standard deviations below the norm or above the 3rd percentile for the gestational age.
HP:0020259.definition_cn: 胎儿头围宽度测量，取近端顶骨外缘与远端顶骨内缘之间的距离，低于正常下限值，通常定义为低于同孕龄均值两个标准差或低于第3百分位数。

HP:0020260.name: Increased biparietal diameter
HP:0020260.definition: Fetal head width measurement, taken between the outer edge of the proximal parietal bone and the inner edge of the distal parietal bone, above the upper limit of normal, usually taken to be two standard deviations above the norm or above the 97th percentile for the gestational age.
HP:0020260.definition_cn: 胎儿头宽测量，取近端顶骨外缘与远端顶骨内缘之间的距离，高于正常值上限，通常定义为超过该孕周平均值两个标准差或高于第97百分位数。

HP:0020261.name: Poorly defined primary lymph-node follicles
HP:0020261.definition: Lack of the typical easily recognized delineation of primary follicles within lymph nodes.
HP:0020261.name_cn: 边界不清的原发性淋巴结滤泡
HP:0020261.definition_cn: 淋巴结内初级滤泡缺乏典型的清晰可辨的边界。

HP:0020262.name: Progressive transformation of germinal centers
HP:0020262.definition: This is a condition sometimes seen in a subset of germinal centers of reactive lymph nodes where germinal centers become enlarged and infiltrated by benign mantle zone cells and some T cells.
HP:0020262.definition_cn: 这是一种有时见于反应性淋巴结生发中心亚群中的病理状态，其中生发中心增大并被良性套区细胞及部分T细胞浸润。

HP:0020263.name: Absent germinal center tingible body macrophages
HP:0020263.definition: Lack of observable tingible body macrophages (TBMs) in germinal centers (GCs) of secondary lymphoid follicles. TBMs represent unique, large phagocytic cells that reside and are a subset of mononuclear phagocytes.
HP:0020263.name_cn: 生发中心缺乏可染小体巨噬细胞
HP:0020263.definition_cn: 次级淋巴滤泡生发中心中缺乏可观察到的可染小体巨噬细胞（TBMs）。可染小体巨噬细胞是一种独特的、大型的吞噬细胞，属于单核吞噬细胞的一个亚群。

HP:0020264.name: Lack of germinal center mitotic figures
HP:0020264.definition: Absence of extreme paucity of mitotic figures in a lymph node germinal center.
HP:0020264.name_cn: 生发中心有丝分裂象缺失
HP:0020264.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心未见极少数有丝分裂象。

HP:0020265.name: Non-polarized mantle zones
HP:0020265.definition: Lack of the typical polarization of the outer ring of small lymphocytes (mantle zone) surrounding a germinal center of a lymph node.
HP:0020265.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心周围小淋巴细胞外环（套区）典型极化缺失。

HP:0020266.name: Hyalinized lymph-node vessels
HP:0020266.definition: Hyalinized means to become clear/translucent such as collagen becoming more pale staining (collagen is typically quite eosinophilic, meaning attracted to the pink/red dye eosin); however, with regard to vessels in the lymph node, hyalinization is often used to describe vessel walls that appear markedly thickened or surrounded by eosinophilic material such as collagen, not necessarily translucent appearing.
HP:0020266.definition_cn: 透明化（Hyalinization）是指组织变得透明或半透明，例如胶原蛋白染色变浅（胶原蛋白通常具有明显的嗜酸性，即对粉红色/红色染料伊红有亲和力）；然而，在淋巴结血管方面，透明化通常用于描述血管壁显著增厚或被嗜酸性物质（如胶原蛋白）包围，而不一定表现为透明外观。

HP:0020267.name: Lymph-node follicular sclerosis
HP:0020267.definition: Collagen deposition, typically with decreased cellularity, within lymph-node follicles.
HP:0020267.definition_cn: 淋巴结滤泡内胶原沉积，通常伴随细胞数量减少。

HP:0020268.name: Compressed lymph-node sinuses
HP:0020268.definition: Loss of the typical patency (openness) of lymph node sinuses.
HP:0020268.definition_cn: 淋巴结窦典型通畅性（开放性）丧失。

HP:0020269.name: Lymph-node proliferation centers
HP:0020269.definition: Proliferation centers are a finding specific to chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma where regions (typically relatively small, comparable to the size of a lymph node follicle) appear more pale on H&E stained sections (though they may become enlarged to merge together). These areas contain increased numbers of enlarged lymphoma cells with nucleoli (prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts) and show a higher proliferation rate (readily visualized with a Ki-67 immunohistochemical stain) than surrounding lymphoma cells. They can be mistaken as vague follicle formation and are therefore sometimes referred to as pseudofollicles.
HP:0020269.definition_cn: 增殖中心是慢性淋巴细胞白血病/小淋巴细胞淋巴瘤的特异性表现，在H&E染色切片上，这些区域（通常相对较小，与淋巴结滤泡大小相当）显得更为苍白（尽管它们可能增大并融合在一起）。这些区域含有数量增多的具有核仁的增大的淋巴瘤细胞（前淋巴细胞和副免疫母细胞），并显示出比周围淋巴瘤细胞更高的增殖率（通过Ki-67免疫组织化学染色易于观察）。它们可能被误认为模糊的滤泡形成，因此有时被称为假滤泡。

HP:0020270.name: Cytologic atypia in mantle cells
HP:0020270.definition: Lymphocytes in the mantle zones of lymph node secondary follicles show cellular atypia such as enlarged size, increased cytoplasm, atypical distribution of chromatin, or irregular nuclear contours.
HP:0020270.name_cn: 套细胞中的细胞学异型性
HP:0020270.definition_cn: 淋巴结次级滤泡套区淋巴细胞显示细胞异型性，如细胞体积增大、胞浆增多、染色质分布异常或核轮廓不规则。

HP:0020271.name: Increased lymph-node eosinophils
HP:0020271.definition: Eosinophils count within a lymph node above normal limits.
HP:0020271.name_cn: 淋巴结嗜酸性粒细胞增多
HP:0020271.definition_cn: 淋巴结内嗜酸性粒细胞计数超出正常范围。

HP:0020272.name: Increased lymph-node plasma cells
HP:0020272.definition: Number of plasma cells per lymph node above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020272.definition_cn: 淋巴结内浆细胞数量超过正常上限。

HP:0020273.name: High lymph node non-germinal center mitotic activity
HP:0020273.definition: Increased numbers of mitotic figures outside of germinal centers.
HP:0020273.name_cn: 高淋巴结非生发中心有丝分裂活性
HP:0020273.definition_cn: 生发中心外有丝分裂象数量增加。

HP:0020274.name: Lymph-node lymphocyte monocytoid morphology
HP:0020274.definition: Lymphocytes that show morphologic features resembling monocytes, such as increased cytoplasm and slightly enlarged nuclei that are more irregular than most lymph node lymphocytes.
HP:0020274.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞单核细胞样形态
HP:0020274.definition_cn: 具有单核细胞样形态特征的淋巴细胞，表现为胞浆增多，核轻度增大且较大多数淋巴结淋巴细胞更为不规则。

HP:0020275.name: Reduced lymph node lymphocyte morphological variability
HP:0020275.definition: Decreased morphological variability of lymph node lymphocytes as compared to the typically somewhat heterogeneous morphology of populations of benign lymph node lymphocytes.
HP:0020275.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞形态学变异性降低
HP:0020275.definition_cn: 与良性淋巴结淋巴细胞群体通常具有一定异质性的形态相比，淋巴结淋巴细胞的形态变异性降低。

HP:0020276.name: Increased large lymphocytes in lymph node
HP:0020276.definition: An increased number of large lymphocytes within a lymph node compared to a normal non-reactive lymph node.
HP:0020276.name_cn: 淋巴结中大淋巴细胞增多
HP:0020276.definition_cn: 与正常非反应性淋巴结相比，淋巴结内大淋巴细胞数量增多。

HP:0020277.name: Hodgkin morphology cells
HP:0020277.definition: Hodgkin cells are typically large and often show very large nucleoli and sometimes binucleation or multinucleation. Reed-Sternberg cells are a type of Hodgkin cell that is binucleated with very large nucleoli that stains slightly red on H&E stained sections (often said to mimic owl eyes). Other Hodgkin cell morphologies include cells that are dying with dark basophilic (blue) nuclei that appear somewhat smudged (mummified cells) and cells with a large space around or adjacent to the nuclei and retracted cytoplasm after tissue fixation (lacunar cells). Hodgkin cells are characteristic of Hodgkin lymphoma, however several non-Hodgkin lymphomas and noN-neoplastic conditions are known to sometimes show a few similar morphology cells.
HP:0020277.definition_cn: 霍奇金细胞通常较大，常显示非常大的核仁，有时可见双核或多核现象。里德-斯滕伯格细胞（Reed-Sternberg cells）是一种双核的霍奇金细胞，具有非常大的核仁，在H&E染色切片中呈轻微红色（常被描述为类似猫头鹰眼睛）。其他霍奇金细胞形态包括具有深嗜碱性（蓝色）核的濒死细胞，核看起来有些模糊（木乃伊化细胞），以及在组织固定后核周围或邻近区域出现大空隙且胞质回缩的细胞（陷窝细胞）。霍奇金细胞是霍奇金淋巴瘤的特征性表现，然而，已知某些非霍奇金淋巴瘤和非肿瘤性病变有时也会出现少数形态相似的细胞。

HP:0020278.name: Abnormal lymph-node lymphoctye nuclear morphology
HP:0020278.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞核形态异常

HP:0020279.name: Irregular lymph-node lymphocyte nuclei
HP:0020279.definition: Lymph node lymphocyte nuclei that are more irregular than the typical round to slightly oval shapes of the majority of lymph node lymphocytes.
HP:0020279.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞核不规则
HP:0020279.definition_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞核形态较典型圆形至轻微椭圆形的大多数淋巴结淋巴细胞更为不规则。

HP:0020280.name: Lymph-node Dutcher bodies
HP:0020280.definition: Dutcher bodies are collections of immunoglobulin protein that overlie or invaginate into the nucleus of plasma cells. These nuclear pseudoinclusions can occasionally be seen in reactive states and may be increased in specific neoplastic conditions.
HP:0020280.definition_cn: Dutcher小体是聚集在浆细胞核表面或内陷的免疫球蛋白蛋白。这些核假包涵体偶尔可在反应性状态下观察到，并在特定肿瘤性疾病中可能增多。

HP:0020281.name: Finely dispersed lymph node lymphocyte chromatin
HP:0020281.definition: Nuclei of lymphocytes with less dense, evenly distributed chromatin than the normal densely packed, often clumped chromatin of mature lymphocytes.
HP:0020281.name_cn: 细密分布的淋巴结淋巴细胞染色质
HP:0020281.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞核的染色质较正常成熟淋巴细胞的致密、常呈团块状分布的染色质更为稀疏且均匀分布。

HP:0020282.name: Abnormal lymph-node lymphocyte chromatin
HP:0020282.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality of the chromatin (complex of DNA and protein which comprises chromosomes) of lymphocytes that are located within a lymph node.
HP:0020282.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞染色质异常
HP:0020282.definition_cn: 淋巴结内淋巴细胞染色质（由DNA和蛋白质组成的染色体复合物）的任何表型异常。

HP:0020283.name: Clumping of lymph node lymphocyte chromatin
HP:0020283.definition: Nuclei of lymphocytes show multiple small densely packed areas of chromatin that appear as relatively evenly spaced clumps of basophilic (blue) staining within the nuclei on Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained sections.
HP:0020283.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞染色质凝集
HP:0020283.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞核在苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色切片中显示出多个小而密集的染色质区域，这些区域表现为核内相对均匀分布的嗜碱性（蓝色）染色团块。

HP:0020284.name: Abnormal lymph-node lymphocyte cytoplasm morphology
HP:0020284.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality of the cytoplasm (material located within the cell membrane but excluding the nucleus) of lymphocytes that are located within a lymph node.
HP:0020284.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞胞质形态异常
HP:0020284.definition_cn: 淋巴结内淋巴细胞胞质（位于细胞膜内但不包括细胞核的物质）的任何表型异常。

HP:0020285.name: Decreased lymph node lymphocyte cytoplasm
HP:0020285.definition: The amount of cytoplasm in lymphocytes is even less than the relatively little cytoplasm found in the majority of lymphocytes within lymph nodes.
HP:0020285.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞胞质减少
HP:0020285.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞中的细胞质含量甚至少于淋巴结内大多数淋巴细胞中相对较少的细胞质。

HP:0020286.name: Increased lymph node lymphocyte cytoplasm
HP:0020286.definition: Increased amount of cytoplasm compared to the majority of lymphocytes in a benign lymph node.
HP:0020286.name_cn: 淋巴结淋巴细胞胞质增多
HP:0020286.definition_cn: 与良性淋巴结中大多数淋巴细胞相比，细胞质数量增加。

HP:0020287.name: Abnormal level of lymph-node cellular CD19 expression
HP:0020287.definition: Detection of an abnormal level of CD19 on the cell(s) of interest in a lymph node with the use of anti-CD19 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0020287.name_cn: 淋巴结细胞CD19表达水平异常
HP:0020287.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD19抗体检测淋巴结中目标细胞上CD19的异常表达水平。

HP:0020288.name: Abnormal lymph-node cellular B-cell marker expression
HP:0020288.definition: Abnormal expression of an antigen (marker) that is normally expressed by B lymphocytes.
HP:0020288.name_cn: 异常淋巴结细胞B细胞标志物表达
HP:0020288.definition_cn: B淋巴细胞通常表达的抗原（标志物）的异常表达。

HP:0020289.name: Abnormal level of lymph-node cellular CD20 expression
HP:0020289.definition: Detection of abnormal levels of CD20 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD20 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0020289.name_cn: 淋巴结细胞CD20表达水平异常
HP:0020289.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD20抗体检测目标细胞中CD20的异常表达水平。

HP:0020290.name: CD79a expression
HP:0020290.definition: Detection of the presence of CD79a on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD79a antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0020290.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD79a抗体检测目标细胞上CD79a的存在。

HP:0020291.name: Increased lymph-node cellular CD20 expression
HP:0020291.definition: Increased levels of CD20 expression compared to normal B cells.
HP:0020291.definition_cn: 与正常B细胞相比，CD20表达水平升高。

HP:0020292.name: Decreased lymph-node cellular CD20 expression
HP:0020292.definition: Decreased levels of CD20 expression compared to normal B cells.
HP:0020292.definition_cn: 与正常B细胞相比，CD20表达水平降低。

HP:0020293.name: Decreased lymph-node cellular CD19 expression
HP:0020293.definition: Decreased levels of CD19 expression compared to normal B cells.
HP:0020293.definition_cn: 与正常B细胞相比，CD19表达水平降低。

HP:0020294.name: Increased lymph-node cellular CD19 expression
HP:0020294.definition: Increased levels of CD19 expression compared to normal B cells.
HP:0020294.definition_cn: 与正常B细胞相比，CD19表达水平升高。

HP:0020295.name: PAX5 expression
HP:0020295.definition: Detection of the presence of PAX5 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-PAX5 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry).
HP:0020295.definition_cn: 使用与色原体结合的抗PAX5抗体检测目标细胞中PAX5的存在（用于免疫组织化学）。

HP:0020296.name: Germinal center B-lymphocyte BCL2 expression
HP:0020296.definition: Positive staining for BCL2 apoptosis regulator protein in lymph-node germinal center B cells.
HP:0020296.name_cn: 生发中心B淋巴细胞BCL2表达
HP:0020296.definition_cn: 淋巴结生发中心B细胞中BCL2凋亡调节蛋白呈阳性染色。

HP:0020297.name: Abnormal occipitofrontal diameter
HP:0020297.definition: Abnormal occipitofrontal diameter (OFD) refers to a fetal head width measurement, taken between the root of the nose to the most prominent part of the occiput on an ultrasound image that lies outside the expected range for a given gestational age. The expected range typically falls between the 3rd percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations below the mean) and the 97th percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations above the mean).
HP:0020297.definition_cn: 异常枕额径（OFD）是指通过超声图像测量的胎儿头部宽度值，该测量值位于鼻根至枕骨最突出部位之间，超出特定孕周预期范围。正常参考范围通常介于第3百分位数（或低于均值2个标准差以上）至第97百分位数（或高于均值2个标准差以上）之间。

HP:0020298.name: Decreased occipitofrontal diameter
HP:0020298.definition: Occipitofrontal diameter, measured with fetal sonography, below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0020298.definition_cn: 超声测量胎儿枕额径低于正常下限。

HP:0020299.name: Increased occipitofrontal diameter
HP:0020299.definition: Occipitofrontal diameter, measured with fetal sonography, above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020299.definition_cn: 超声测量胎儿枕额径超过正常上限。

HP:0020300.name: Abnormal elbow morphology
HP:0020300.definition: A structural anomaly of the joint that connects the upper and the lower arm.
HP:0020300.definition_cn: 连接上臂和前臂的关节结构异常。

HP:0020301.name: Abnormal elbow physiology
HP:0020301.definition: A functional anomaly of the joint that connects the upper and the lower arm.
HP:0020301.definition_cn: 上臂与前臂连接关节的功能异常。

HP:0020302.name: Restrictive eating
HP:0020302.definition: A behavioral pattern characterized by a deliberate and sustained limitation of food intake, often involving avoidance of certain foods, restriction of portion size, or prolonged fasting, resulting in reduced energy or nutrient consumption relative to physiological needs.
HP:0020302.definition_cn: 一种以刻意且持续限制食物摄入为特征的行为模式，常涉及回避特定食物、控制进食分量或长期禁食，导致能量或营养素摄入低于生理需求。

HP:0020303.name: Abnormal fetal abdominal circumference
HP:0020303.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the fetal abdominal circumference, which is typically measured sonographically in a transverse view using the outer borders of the skin line at the plane where the fetal stomach, umbilical vein and portal sinus is visible. Abnormal fetal abdominal circumference is defined as less than the 10th or greater than the 90th percentile for gestational age.
HP:0020303.definition_cn: 胎儿腹围的正常范围是指在超声横切面下，于可见胎儿胃泡、脐静脉及门静脉窦的平面，沿皮肤外缘测量的数值。胎儿腹围异常定义为低于同孕龄第10百分位数或高于第90百分位数。

HP:0020304.name: Increased fetal abdominal circumference
HP:0020304.definition: The distance around the abdomen of a fetus, generally as measured by prenatal sonography, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020304.definition_cn: 胎儿腹围超出正常值上限，通常通过产前超声检查测量。

HP:0020305.name: Abnormal fetal head circumference
HP:0020305.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the fetal head circumference, which is typically measured sonographically in the axial plane at the level of the thalami and cavum septic pellucidi, using the outer border of the bony calvarium. Abnormal fetal head circumference is defined as less than the thrid percentile or 2 standard deviations below the mean or greater than the 97the percentile or 2 standard deviations above the mean.
HP:0020305.definition_cn: 胎儿头围测量通常在丘脑和透明隔腔水平的轴平面上通过超声检查进行，以颅骨外板为界。胎儿头围异常定义为低于第3百分位数或均值减2个标准差，或高于第97百分位数或均值加2个标准差。

HP:0020306.name: Decreased fetal head circumference
HP:0020306.definition: Fetal head circumference less than the third percentile or 2 standard deviations below the mean.
HP:0020306.definition_cn: 胎儿头围小于第三百分位数或低于平均值2个标准差。

HP:0020307.name: Increased fetal head circumference
HP:0020307.definition: Fetal head circumference above the 97th percentile or 2 standard deviations above the mean.
HP:0020307.definition_cn: 胎儿头围超过第97百分位数或高于平均值2个标准差。

HP:0020308.name: Increased anteroposterior lens thickness
HP:0020308.definition: Increase in the anteroposterior (axial) dimension of the crystalline lens relative to the overall length of the globe.
HP:0020308.definition_cn: 晶状体前后（轴向）径相对于眼球总长度的增加。

HP:0020309.name: Ankle instability
HP:0020309.definition: Failure of ligamentous and muscular structures of the ankle to maintain normal joint alignment during movement, resulting in excessive motion that causes manifestations such as subjective or objective feeling of clunking/clicking in the ankle with movement, ankle 'giving way' or sensation of ankle dislocating.
HP:0020309.definition_cn: 踝关节韧带及肌肉结构在运动中无法维持正常关节对位，导致活动过度，从而引发一系列临床表现，包括运动时踝部主观或客观的弹响感、踝关节“打软腿”或踝关节脱位感。

HP:0020310.name: Retinal phlebitis
HP:0020310.definition: Inflammation of retinal venules as manifested by perivascular sheathing or cuffing, vascular leakage and/or occlusion.
HP:0020310.definition_cn: 视网膜小静脉炎症，表现为血管周围鞘形成或套袖样改变、血管渗漏和/或闭塞。

HP:0020311.name: Ophthalmic artery hypoperfusion
HP:0020311.definition: Chronic hypoperfusion due to large vessel disease e.g. carotid artery stenosis, Takayasu disease. Typically presents dilated veins, low retinal arterial pressure, peripheral microaneurysms, ocular hypotension and may lead to iris neovascularisation. Patients may have postural hypotension.
HP:0020311.definition_cn: 大血管疾病（如颈动脉狭窄、大动脉炎）导致的慢性低灌注。典型表现为静脉扩张、视网膜动脉压降低、周边微动脉瘤、低眼压，并可能导致虹膜新生血管形成。患者可能出现体位性低血压。

HP:0020312.name: Focal hyperpigmented area associated with subretinal scar tissue
HP:0020312.definition: Localized hyperpigmented areas, in the context of subretinal scar tissue, as seen after subretinal neovascularisation.
HP:0020312.name_cn: 局灶性色素沉着区伴视网膜下瘢痕组织
HP:0020312.definition_cn: 局部色素沉着区域，见于视网膜下新生血管形成后的视网膜下瘢痕组织背景下。

HP:0020313.name: Discrete fundus hypopigmentation
HP:0020313.definition: Well-demarcated areas of the fundus, with relative reduction in pigment, with respect to the rest of the fundus.
HP:0020313.definition_cn: 眼底边界清晰的区域，相对于眼底其他部位色素相对减少。

HP:0020314.name: Macular pseudohole
HP:0020314.definition: A macular pseudohole is a partial-thickness gap in a normal-thickness fovea, located in the center of the macula.
HP:0020314.definition_cn: 黄斑假性裂孔是位于黄斑中心、正常厚度中心凹内的部分厚度缺损。

HP:0020315.name: Lamellar macular hole
HP:0020315.definition: A lamellar macular hole is a structural abnormality of the macula, characterized by a partial-thickness gap in a thinner fovea, located in the center of the macula.
HP:0020315.definition_cn: 板层黄斑裂孔是一种黄斑结构异常，其特征为位于黄斑中心区的较薄中心凹处出现部分厚度的裂隙。

HP:0020316.name: Middle cerebral artery berry aneurysm
HP:0020316.definition: A small, sac-like aneurysm (outpouching) of the middle cerebral artery (MCA). MCA berry aneurysms may occur at the MCA bifurcation, on the anterior communicant artery, the anterior cerebral artery, the internal carotid artery, or on the posterior communicant artery.
HP:0020316.name_cn: 大脑中动脉囊状动脉瘤
HP:0020316.definition_cn: 大脑中动脉（MCA）的小囊状动脉瘤（膨出）。MCA浆果状动脉瘤可发生于大脑中动脉分叉处、前交通动脉、大脑前动脉、颈内动脉或后交通动脉。

HP:0020317.name: Abnormal abdominal aorta branch artery morphology
HP:0020317.definition: A structural anomaly of an artery that originates from the abdominal aorta.
HP:0020317.name_cn: 腹主动脉分支动脉形态异常
HP:0020317.definition_cn: 腹主动脉起源动脉的结构性异常。

HP:0020318.name: Posterior humeral circumflex artery occlusion
HP:0020318.definition: Blockage of the posterior circumflex humeral artery (PCHA), which arises from the third part of the axillary artery and supplies the shoulder joint and a number of its associated muscles. The lesion can be ascertained angiographically, whereby dye is injected both with patient's humerus at the side of the body and again with shoulder held in abduction and external rotation. Test is positive if there is evidence of PCHA occlusion with arm in abduction and external rotation but artery is patent when arm is held at the side.
HP:0020318.definition_cn: 旋肱后动脉（PCHA）起源于腋动脉第三段，为肩关节及其部分相关肌肉提供血液供应。该动脉的闭塞可通过血管造影术确诊，具体方法是在患者上肢自然下垂状态下注入造影剂进行初次显影，随后在肩关节外展外旋状态下再次注入造影剂进行显影。若血管造影显示手臂处于外展外旋位时旋肱后动脉出现闭塞，而上肢自然下垂时动脉保持通畅，则判定为阳性结果。

HP:0020319.name: Scapulothoracic incongruity
HP:0020319.definition: A lack of smooth, physiological alignment or movement between the scapula (shoulder blade) and the posterior thoracic wall (the rib cage). The scapulothoracic joint is unique, as it lacks true synovial articulation and is dynamically controlled through surrounding muscular contractions. The scapula glides on the posterior thorax covered with muscle layers rather than a cartilaginous surface. This feature can be ascertained by radiography or CT scan of the scapula showing incongruity of the scapulothoracic space.
HP:0020319.definition_cn: 肩胛骨与胸后壁之间缺乏平滑的生理性对线或运动。肩胛胸壁关节具有独特性，因其缺乏真正的滑膜关节结构，主要通过周围肌肉收缩进行动态调控。肩胛骨并非在关节软骨表面滑动，而是贴附多层肌肉组织在胸后壁上移动。这一特征可通过肩胛骨X线片或CT扫描证实，影像学表现为肩胛胸壁间隙对合不良。

HP:0020320.name: Latissimus dorsi rupture
HP:0020320.definition: A tear of the latissimus dorsi (LD). Injury to the LD can occur at various locations, from the tendon to the muscle belly. The LD is a broad, flat muscle occupying most of the lower posterior thorax. The muscle's primary function is to move the upper extremity, but it is also considered an accessory muscle of respiration.
HP:0020320.definition_cn: 背阔肌（LD）撕裂。背阔肌损伤可发生在从肌腱到肌腹的不同部位。背阔肌是一块宽阔扁平的肌肉，占据下背部胸腔的大部分区域。该肌肉的主要功能是移动上肢，同时也被视作呼吸辅助肌。

HP:0020321.name: Distal clavicular osteolysis
HP:0020321.definition: Degeneration and resorption of the distal part of the clavicle near the acromioclavicular (AC) joint. Distal clavicular osteolysis (DCO) is an atypical injury occurring most often in athletes and weight lifters, specifically those who perform repetitive overhead movements. DCO results from repetitive excess load to the AC joint, typically through horizontal adduction, adduction, internal rotation, and forward/lateral flexion of the shoulder, such as bench pressing or overhead lifting. Imaging (AP clavicle and/or Zanca view of the AC joint) of DCO often demonstrates microcysts, loss of subchondral bone detail, and osteolysis of the distal clavicle.
HP:0020321.definition_cn: 锁骨远端靠近肩锁（AC）关节部位的变性和吸收。锁骨远端骨溶解症（DCO）是一种非典型损伤，最常见于运动员和举重者，尤其是那些反复进行过头动作的人群。DCO源于AC关节反复承受过量负荷，通常由肩部的水平内收、内旋及前/侧屈动作导致，如卧推或过头举重。DCO的影像学表现（锁骨前后位和/或AC关节Zanca投照位）常显示微囊肿、软骨下骨细节缺失以及锁骨远端的骨溶解。

HP:0020322.name: Abnormal breast-tissue biospecimen
HP:0020322.definition: Any abnormal phenotypic feature observed in a biospecimen derived from breast tissue.
HP:0020322.name_cn: 异常乳腺组织生物标本
HP:0020322.definition_cn: 乳腺组织生物样本中观察到的任何异常表型特征。

HP:0020323.name: Abnormal breast-tissue cellular antigen expression
HP:0020323.definition: Abnormal expression of an antigen (marker) by cells located in breast tissue.
HP:0020323.name_cn: 乳腺组织细胞抗原表达异常
HP:0020323.definition_cn: 乳腺组织中细胞抗原（标志物）的异常表达。

HP:0020324.name: Increased breast-tissue HER2 expression
HP:0020324.definition: Increased level of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) expression in breast tissue.
HP:0020324.definition_cn: 乳腺组织中人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）表达水平升高。

HP:0020325.name: Increased breast-tissue estrogen receptor expression
HP:0020325.definition: Increased level of estrogen receptor expression in breast tissue.
HP:0020325.name_cn: 乳腺组织雌激素受体表达增加
HP:0020325.definition_cn: 乳腺组织中雌激素受体表达水平升高。

HP:0020326.name: Increased breast-tissue progesterone receptor expression
HP:0020326.name_cn: 乳腺组织孕激素受体表达增加

HP:0020327.name: Abnormal breast-tissue cellular finding
HP:0020327.definition: Any phenotypic abnormality within cells located in breast tissue.
HP:0020327.name_cn: 乳腺组织细胞学异常发现
HP:0020327.definition_cn: 乳腺组织内细胞的任何表型异常。

HP:0020328.name: Mammary ductal epithelial cell hyperplasia
HP:0020328.definition: Abnormal (increased) proliferation of epithelial cells in a mammary duct. Intraductal papilloma is a benign tumor found within breast ducts. The abnormal proliferation of ductal epithelial cells causes growth. A solitary intraductal papilloma is usually found centrally posterior to the nipple, affecting the central duct.
HP:0020328.name_cn: 乳腺导管上皮细胞增生
HP:0020328.definition_cn: 乳腺导管内上皮细胞异常增生（增殖）。导管内乳头状瘤是发现于乳腺导管内的良性肿瘤。导管上皮细胞的异常增殖导致肿物形成。单发性导管内乳头状瘤通常位于乳头后方中央区，影响中央导管。

HP:0020329.name: Mammary ductal apocrine metaplasia
HP:0020329.definition: A biopsy finding in breast tissue of enlarged epithelial cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm that can show apical snouting. Metaplastic apocrine cells within the breast are similar to normal axillary, areolar and perineal apocrine cells, having apocrine secretions and identical staining reactions. One of the reasons, however, that these are often not regarded as normal components is that examples of gradual metaplastic change from the normal cuboidal epithelium can be seen and cells with intermediate features can also be discerned on careful examination, suggesting that these are true metaplasia.
HP:0020329.definition_cn: 乳腺组织活检见上皮细胞增大伴丰富颗粒状嗜酸性胞浆，可显示顶端浆突起。乳腺内化生的大汗腺样细胞与正常腋窝、乳晕及会阴部大汗腺样细胞相似，具有大汗腺分泌特征及相同的染色反应。然而，这些细胞常不被视为正常组织成分的原因之一在于：仔细观察时可见正常立方上皮逐渐发生化生性改变的过程，并能辨识出具有中间特征的细胞，提示这是真正的化生现象。

HP:0020330.name: Abnormal circulating inorganic anion concentration
HP:0020330.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of inorganic anion in the blood circulation.
HP:0020330.name_cn: 循环无机阴离子浓度异常
HP:0020330.definition_cn: 血液循环系统中无机阴离子浓度出现异常升高或降低。

HP:0020331.name: Blue-field entoptic phenomenon
HP:0020331.definition: Unremitting, positive visual phenomena, present in the entire visual field and characterized by uncountable tiny flickering dots interposed between the person's vision and the background. The dots are said to resemble static and are typically black and white but can also be colored, flashing, or transparent. In addition to the static, or snow, patients can experience additional visual symptoms of either direct neurological origin, such as palinopsia, photophobia, and nyctalopia (i.e., impaired night vision), or that arise from the optic apparatus.
HP:0020331.definition_cn: 持续性阳性视觉现象，表现为整个视野内遍布无数微小闪烁光点，介于患者视觉与背景之间。这些光点据描述类似于电视雪花样现象，通常呈黑白双色，亦可呈彩色、闪烁或透明状。除电视雪花样现象（即雪盲样症状）外，患者还可能经历其他视觉症状，其源于直接神经病变（如视觉后像、畏光及夜盲症），或产生于视觉装置病变。

HP:0020332.name: Phosphene
HP:0020332.definition: A phosphene is the perception of light without light actually entering the eye, for instance caused by pressure applied to the closed eyes.
HP:0020332.definition_cn: 光幻视（phosphene）是指在没有实际光线进入眼睛的情况下感知到光的现象，例如闭眼时施加压力所引发的情况。

HP:0020333.name: Palinopsia
HP:0020333.definition: Palinopsia refers to visual images that persist despite removal of the eliciting object; plainopsia presents as persistent afterimages of stationary objects or trailing of images behind moving objects.
HP:0020333.definition_cn: 视觉后像持续症是指诱发刺激物移除后视觉影像仍持续存在的现象；视觉残留症则表现为静态物体的持久后像或移动物体后方出现的影像拖尾。

HP:0020334.name: Positive scapular compression test
HP:0020334.definition: A type of function test in which the examiner uses one hand to apply a posterior to anterior force is directly over the scapula and the anterior chest wall is stabilized with the other hand. Test is positive if this scapular stabilization allows for increased shoulder flexion compared to when no stabilization is applied.
HP:0020334.definition_cn: 这是一种功能测试，检查者用一只手直接对肩胛骨施加从后向前的力，同时用另一只手稳定前胸壁。如果这种肩胛骨稳定使得肩部屈曲比未施加稳定时增加，则测试为阳性。

HP:0020335.name: Pectoralis major tear
HP:0020335.definition: Injury with partial or complete tear of the pectoralis major tendon, muscle, or myotendinous junction.
HP:0020335.definition_cn: 胸大肌肌腱、肌肉或肌腱肌肉连接处的部分或完全撕裂损伤。

HP:0020336.name: Increased urinary 18-oxocortisol level
HP:0020336.definition: The amount of 18-oxocortisol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020336.name_cn: 尿液18-氧皮质醇水平升高
HP:0020336.definition_cn: 尿液中经浓度校正后的18-氧皮质醇含量高于正常值上限。

HP:0020337.name: Increased urinary 18-hydroxycortisol level
HP:0020337.definition: The amount of 18-hydroxycortisol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0020337.name_cn: 尿18-羟基皮质醇排泄量增高
HP:0020337.definition_cn: 经尿液浓度校正后，尿液中18-羟基皮质醇的含量高于正常值上限。

HP:0020338.name: Malignant melanotic nerve sheath tumor
HP:0020338.definition: Malignant melanotic nerve sheath tumors (MMNSTs) are uncommon pigmented tumors of Schwann cell origin, most often found along the spinal nerves. MMNSTs were formerly known as melanotic schwannoma. Although MMNSTs can occur along cranial nerves, they tend to grow along the dorsal spinal nerve roots, and patients often present with indolent pain, weakness, or paresthesia along a corresponding dermatome. On imaging, spinal MMNSTs generally appear similar to the appearance presented in the current case: intradural, extramedullary tumors. In the spine, the tumors typically grow along spinal nerve roots, sometimes assuming a dumbbell configuration if they extend through a foramen. Tumors demonstrate enhancement on CT and are FDG-avid on PET.
HP:0020338.name_cn: 恶性黑色素性神经鞘瘤
HP:0020338.definition_cn: 恶性黑色素神经鞘瘤是一种罕见的施万细胞源性色素性肿瘤，最常沿脊神经分布。该肿瘤既往被称为黑色素性神经鞘瘤。虽然MMNST可沿颅神经发生，但其更倾向于沿脊神经背侧根生长，患者常表现为相应皮节区的隐痛、肌无力或感觉异常。影像学上，脊髓MMNST通常呈现与本病例相似的表现：硬膜内髓外肿瘤。在脊柱，肿瘤常沿神经根生长，若经椎间孔延伸可形成哑铃状形态。CT检查显示肿瘤强化，PET扫描表现为FDG摄取增高。

HP:0020339.name: Increased mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion
HP:0020339.definition: An increased proportion of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells among peripheral blood T lymphocytes, above the upper reference limit for age. MAIT cells are innate-like T cells that recognise riboflavin metabolite antigens presented by MR1.
HP:0020339.name_cn: 黏膜相关恒定T细胞比例升高
HP:0020339.definition_cn: 外周血T淋巴细胞中黏膜相关恒定T细胞比例超过年龄相关参考范围上限。MAIT细胞为固有样T细胞，通过MR1分子识别核黄素代谢物抗原。

HP:0020340.name: Abnormal mucosal-associated invariant T cell proportion
HP:0020340.definition: An increased or decreased proportion of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells among peripheral blood T lymphocytes, above the upper reference limit for age. MAIT cells are innate-like T cells that recognise riboflavin metabolite antigens presented by MR1.
HP:0020340.name_cn: 黏膜相关恒定T细胞比例异常
HP:0020340.definition_cn: 外周血T淋巴细胞中黏膜相关恒定T细胞（MAIT细胞）比例升高或降低，超过年龄上限参考值。MAIT细胞是一种固有样T细胞，能够识别由MR1分子呈递的核黄素代谢物抗原。

HP:0020343.name: Unusual pharyngitis
HP:0020343.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the pharynx, as manifested by recurrent or severe episodes of pharyngitis.
HP:0020343.definition_cn: 咽喉部感染易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重咽炎发作。

HP:0020344.name: Abnormal mental imagery
HP:0020344.definition: A deviation from the typical ability to voluntarily generate, maintain, or experience mental images representing sensory properties of objects or events without a direct external stimulus.
HP:0020344.definition_cn: 偏离于典型自发生成、维持或体验表征物体或事件感觉属性之心理意象的能力（无需直接外部刺激）。

HP:0020345.name: Aphantasia
HP:0020345.definition: Absence or near-absence of voluntary visual mental imagery, such that an individual is unable to intentionally generate visual images in the mind.
HP:0020345.definition_cn: 完全性或近乎完全性的自主视觉心理意象缺失，表现为个体无法有意识地在脑海中生成视觉图像。

HP:0020346.name: Hyperphantasia
HP:0020346.definition: Exceptionally vivid voluntary visual mental imagery, in which internally generated images are experienced as vivid, despite intact reality testing and the absence of sensory hallucinations.
HP:0020346.definition_cn: 异常生动的自主视觉心像，其特征为个体产生的内部图像体验极为鲜明，但现实检验能力完好且不存在感官幻觉。

HP:0020347.name: Abnormal circulating monosaccharide concentration
HP:0020347.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a monosaccharide in the blood circulation.
HP:0020347.definition_cn: 血液循环中单糖浓度异常。

HP:0020348.name: Abnormal circulating disaccharide concentration
HP:0020348.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a disaccharide in the blood circulation.
HP:0020348.definition_cn: 血液循环中双糖浓度偏离正常水平。

HP:0020349.name: Abnormal circulating sugar alcohol concentration
HP:0020349.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a sugar alcohol in the blood circulation.
HP:0020349.definition_cn: 血循环中糖醇浓度的异常。

HP:0020350.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin concentration
HP:0020350.definition: The concentration of one or more vitamins is outside the reference range.
HP:0020350.definition_cn: 一种或多种维生素浓度超出参考范围。

HP:0020351.name: Abnormal CSF folate concentration
HP:0020351.definition: The concentration of folate or one of its metabolites in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0020351.definition_cn: 脑脊液中叶酸或其代谢物的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0020352.name: Lisfranc injury
