HP:0020352.definition: Lisfranc injuries refer to bony or ligamentous compromise of the tarsometatarsal and intercuneiform joint complex and include a spectrum of injuries ranging from a stable, partial sprain to a grossly displaced and unstable fracture or fracture-dislocation of the midfoot. Foot x-ray shows either widening of the space between the 1st and 2nd metatarsal to over 2mm at the base, dorsal displacement of the base of the 1st or 2nd metatarsal, discontinuity of a line drawn from the medial base of the 2nd metatarsal to the medial side of the medial cuneiform, irregularity between the medial side of the 5th metatarsal base and the medial side of the cuboid, or disruption of the line connecting the medial aspect of the navicular bone to the medial cuneiform.
HP:0020352.definition_cn: Lisfranc损伤是指跖跗关节及楔间关节复合体的骨或韧带损伤，涵盖从稳定的轻度扭伤到明显移位的不稳定骨折或中足骨折脱位等系列损伤。足部X线检查可见以下表现：第一、二跖骨基底部间隙增宽超过2mm，第一或第二跖骨基底部背侧移位，第二跖骨内侧基底至内侧楔骨内侧缘连线中断，第五跖骨基底部内侧缘与骰骨内侧缘对位不齐，或舟骨内侧缘至内侧楔骨连线中断。

HP:0025002.name: Abnormal cecum morphology
HP:0025002.definition: A structural anomaly of the cecum, which is the proximal blind pouch of the ascending colon, is located at the ileocecal junction in the right iliac fossa.
HP:0025002.definition_cn: 盲肠结构异常，其为升结肠近端的盲囊，位于右髂窝的回盲部交界处。

HP:0025003.name: Flail chest
HP:0025003.definition: Flail chest is a physical exam finding that can be present in the setting of chest wall trauma or injury. When multiple adjacent ribs are fractured in 2 or more places, this can create a focal \
HP:0025003.definition_cn: 连枷胸是一种体格检查发现，可出现在胸壁创伤或损伤的情况下。当多根相邻肋骨在两处或更多处发生骨折时，可形成局部

HP:0025004.name: Hallux rigidus
HP:0025004.definition: Osteoarthritis of the metatarsophalangeal joint of the first toe.
HP:0025004.definition_cn: 第一跖趾关节骨关节炎。

HP:0025005.name: Thickening of glomerular capillary wall
HP:0025005.definition: Widening of the wall of capillary blood vessels in the glomerulus. This feature may be produced by deposits and other changes affecting either subepithelial and subendothelial regions or the glomerular basement membrane itself.
HP:0025005.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管壁增厚
HP:0025005.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管壁增厚。此特征可能由沉积物及其他病变引起，这些病变可影响上皮下和内皮下的区域，或肾小球基底膜本身。

HP:0025006.name: Abnormal glomerular capillary morphology
HP:0025006.definition: A structural anomaly of the capillary blood vessels in the renal glomerulus.
HP:0025006.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管形态异常
HP:0025006.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管结构异常。

HP:0025007.name: Ectopic fovea
HP:0025007.definition: An abnormal anatomic position of the fovea, the small, central pit composed of closely packed cones that is located in the macula of the retina.
HP:0025007.definition_cn: 黄斑中心凹解剖位置异常，黄斑中心凹是由紧密排列的视锥细胞组成的中央小凹，位于视网膜黄斑区。

HP:0025008.name: Tracheal tug on inspiration
HP:0025008.definition: Downward movement of the trachea during inspiration due to downward traction on the tracheobronchial tree.
HP:0025008.definition_cn: 吸气时由于气管支气管树向下牵引导致气管向下移动。

HP:0025009.name: Forward slanting upper incisors
HP:0025009.definition: The upper incisors deviate from the normal angle of being roughly parallel to the surface of the face and instead slant outwards.
HP:0025009.definition_cn: 上切齿偏离与面部表面大致平行的正常角度，呈现外倾。

HP:0025010.name: Foveal atrophy
HP:0025010.definition: Partial or complete loss of foveal tissue that was once present.
HP:0025010.definition_cn: 部分或完全丧失曾经存在的中心凹组织。

HP:0025011.name: Pyriform aperture stenosis
HP:0025011.definition: Narrowing of the anterior nasal aperture (piriform or pyriform aperture), which is a pear-shaped opening in the skull that forms the bony inlet of the nose.
HP:0025011.definition_cn: 前鼻孔狭窄（梨状孔或梨形孔），即颅骨中呈梨形的开口，构成鼻腔的骨性入口。

HP:0025012.name: Status cribrosum
HP:0025012.definition: Diffusely widened perivascular spaces in the basal ganglia, affecting especially the corpus striatum. Status cribrosum is usually symmetrical, with the perivascular spaces showing CSF signal and without diffusion restriction. The word cribriform means sievelike, with multiple perforations.
HP:0025012.definition_cn: 基底节区弥漫性扩大的血管周围间隙，尤其累及纹状体。筛状状态通常呈对称性，血管周围间隙显示脑脊液信号且无扩散受限。术语“筛状”意指多孔状，具有多个穿孔。

HP:0025013.name: Decerebrate rigidity
HP:0025013.definition: A type of rigidity that is manifested by an exaggerated extensor posture of all extremities.
HP:0025013.definition_cn: 一种表现为所有肢体过度伸展姿势的强直类型。

HP:0025014.name: Subcutaneous spheroids
HP:0025014.definition: Small, hard cyst-like nodules, freely moveable in the subcutis over the bony prominences of the legs and arms, which have an outer calcified layer with a translucent core on x-ray.
HP:0025014.definition_cn: 皮下可自由移动的小而硬的囊性结节，位于四肢骨性突起处，X线检查显示外层钙化，核心呈半透明状。

HP:0025016.name: Abnormal capillary morphology
HP:0025016.definition: A structural anomaly of the tiny blood vessels that connect arterioles with venules and whose walls act as semipermeable membranes that mediate the diffusion of fluids and gases between the blood circulation and body tissues.
HP:0025016.definition_cn: 连接小动脉与小静脉的微血管结构异常，其管壁作为半透膜介导血液循环与体组织之间液体和气体的扩散。

HP:0025017.name: Capillary fragility
HP:0025017.definition: Reduced resistance to rupture of capillary blood vessels. Capillary fragility may manifest as a bleeding diathesis with spontaneous ecchymoses (bruises).
HP:0025017.definition_cn: 毛细血管抗破裂能力降低。毛细血管脆性可表现为自发性瘀斑（淤青）的出血倾向。

HP:0025018.name: Abnormal capillary physiology
HP:0025018.definition: A functional anomaly of the tiny blood vessels that connect arterioles with venules and whose walls act as semipermeable membranes that mediate the diffusion of fluids and gases between the blood circulation and body tissues.
HP:0025018.definition_cn: 连接小动脉与小静脉的微血管功能异常，其管壁作为半透膜，介导血液循环与体组织之间液体和气体的扩散。

HP:0025019.name: Arterial rupture
HP:0025019.definition: Sudden breakage of an artery leading to leakage of blood from the circulation.
HP:0025019.definition_cn: 动脉破裂导致血液循环中的血液外漏。

HP:0025020.name: Elevated prostate-specific antigen level
HP:0025020.definition: An increased concentration of prostate specific antigen (PSA) in the circulation.
HP:0025020.name_cn: 前列腺特异性抗原水平升高
HP:0025020.definition_cn: 循环中前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）浓度升高。

HP:0025021.name: Abnormal erythrocyte sedimentation rate
HP:0025021.definition: A deviation from normal range of the erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. The ESR is a nonspecific finding. An elevation may indicate inflammation or may be caused by any condition that elevates fibrinogen. A decreased ESR may be seen in polycythemia or in certain blood diseases in which red blood cells have an irregular or smaller shape that causes slower settling.
HP:0025021.definition_cn: 红细胞沉降率（ESR）偏离正常范围，该测试用于测量在重力作用下，抗凝血液垂直柱中红细胞在一小时内沉降的距离。ESR是一种非特异性指标。其升高可能提示炎症，或由任何导致纤维蛋白原升高的疾病引起。ESR降低可见于红细胞增多症或某些血液疾病，这些疾病中红细胞的形态异常或较小，导致沉降速度减慢。

HP:0025022.name: Decreased erythrocyte sedimentation rate
HP:0025022.definition: A reduced erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR). The ESR is a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. The ESR is a nonspecific finding. A decreased ESR may be seen in polycythemia or in certain blood diseases in which red blood cells have an irregular or smaller shape that causes slower settling.
HP:0025022.definition_cn: 红细胞沉降率（ESR）降低。红细胞沉降率（ESR）是一种检测方法，用于测量在重力作用下，抗凝血液垂直柱中红细胞在一小时内沉降的距离。ESR是一种非特异性指标。ESR降低可见于红细胞增多症或某些血液疾病，这些疾病中红细胞的形态异常或较小，导致沉降速度减慢。

HP:0025023.name: Rectal atresia
HP:0025023.definition: A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the rectum. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the rectum.
HP:0025023.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷导致直肠管腔完全闭塞。即，直肠管状结构出现异常闭合或闭锁。

HP:0025024.name: Megarectum
HP:0025024.definition: An abnormal dilation of the rectum. There is a large filled rectum as a result of underlying innervation or muscular abnormalities, which remains after disimpaction of the rectum.
HP:0025024.definition_cn: 直肠异常扩张。由于潜在的神经支配或肌肉异常导致直肠显著充盈，即使在直肠嵌塞解除后仍持续存在。

HP:0025025.name: Rectovestibular fistula
HP:0025025.definition: A congenital malformation characterized by an abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the vulval vestibule, at the lower aspect of the vaginal opening.
HP:0025025.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，其特征为直肠与阴道开口下方的外阴前庭之间存在异常连接（瘘管）。

HP:0025026.name: H-type rectovestibular fistula
HP:0025026.definition: Rectovestibular fistula with a normal anus is known as H-type fistula or double termination of the alimentary tract.
HP:0025026.definition_cn: 直肠前庭瘘伴正常肛门被称为H型瘘管或消化道双末端畸形。

HP:0025027.name: Osteoma cutis
HP:0025027.definition: The term osteoma refers to the anomalous presence of ossification (bone formation) in the interior of the dermis or epidermis. The dermal or subcutaneous bone formation presents as stony hard nodules. The osteomata appear as irregular, hardened small nodules that are well circumscribed and generally of the same color as the skin.
HP:0025027.definition_cn: 骨瘤（osteoma）一词指的是在真皮或表皮内部异常出现的骨化（ossification）现象。真皮或皮下骨化表现为石样坚硬的结节（nodules）。骨瘤呈现为不规则、硬化的小结节，边界清晰，通常与皮肤颜色一致。

HP:0025028.name: Abnormal enteric nervous system morphology
HP:0025028.definition: A structural anomaly of nerves of the enteric nervous system.
HP:0025028.name_cn: 肠道神经系统形态异常
HP:0025028.definition_cn: 肠神经系统神经结构异常。

HP:0025030.name: Enteric neuronal degeneration
HP:0025030.definition: Deterioration of enteric neurons with impairment of enteric neuronal structure. Typical neuropathological findings include qualitative (e.g., neuronal swelling, intranuclear inclusions, axonal degeneration) and quantitative (e.g., reduction in the number of neurons) abnormalities of the enteric neurons.
HP:0025030.definition_cn: 肠神经元结构受损伴随肠神经元退化。典型的神经病理学发现包括肠神经元的定性异常（如神经元肿胀、核内包涵体、轴突变性）和定量异常（如神经元数量减少）。

HP:0025032.name: Abnormality of digestive system physiology
HP:0025032.definition: A functional anomaly of the digestive system.
HP:0025032.name_cn: 消化系统生理功能异常

HP:0025033.name: Abnormal digestive system morphology
HP:0025033.definition: A structural anomaly of the digestive system.

HP:0025034.name: Abnormal morphology of erythroid progenitor cell
HP:0025034.definition: Abnormal form of the progenitor cells committed to the erythroid lineage.

HP:0025035.name: Abnormal proerythroblast morphology
HP:0025035.definition: Anomalous form of the proerythroblast, i.e., the immature, nucleated erythrocyte occupying the stage of erythropoeisis that follows formation of erythroid progenitor cells. This cell is CD71-positive, has both a nucleus and a nucleolus, and lacks hematopoeitic lineage markers.
HP:0025035.definition_cn: 异常形态的原红细胞，即占据红细胞生成阶段、位于红系祖细胞形成之后的未成熟有核红细胞。该细胞呈CD71阳性，具有细胞核和核仁，但缺乏造血谱系标志物。

HP:0025036.name: Type I radial ray deficiency
HP:0025036.definition: A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by short distal radius. The distal radial epiphysis is present but delayed in appearance. The growth of the distal radial epiphysis is decreased causing a normal appearing but short radius. There is little radial deviation of the hand due to adequate radial carpal support. The radius has normal proximal epiphyseal growth. Thumb hypoplasia is almost always present.
HP:0025036.definition_cn: 一种以桡骨远端短缩为特征的桡侧列发育不全。桡骨远端骨骺存在但出现延迟。由于桡骨远端骨骺生长受限，导致桡骨外观正常但长度缩短。由于腕部桡侧支撑结构完整，手部桡偏程度较轻。桡骨近端骨骺生长正常。拇指发育不良几乎总是伴随存在。

HP:0025037.name: Hypothalamic gliosis
HP:0025037.definition: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the hypothalamus.
HP:0025037.definition_cn: 下丘脑胶质细胞局灶性增生。

HP:0025038.name: Intratesticular abscess
HP:0025038.definition: A collection of pus within a testicle. Ultrasonographic features include shaggy, irregular walls, intratesticular location, low-level internal echoes, and occasionally, hypervascular margins.
HP:0025038.definition_cn: 睾丸内脓液积聚。超声特征包括毛糙、不规则的壁，睾丸内位置，低水平内部回声，偶尔可见高血管边缘。

HP:0025039.name: Basal ganglia edema
HP:0025039.definition: Swelling within the basal ganglia due to the accumulation of fluid.
HP:0025039.definition_cn: 基底神经节内因液体潴留导致的肿胀。

HP:0025040.name: Thalamic edema
HP:0025040.definition: Swelling within the thalamus due to the accumulation of fluid.
HP:0025040.definition_cn: 丘脑内因液体潴留导致的肿胀。

HP:0025042.name: Abnormality of mesenteric lymph nodes
HP:0025042.definition: A morphological anomaly of lymph nodes in the mesenteric root or throughout the mesentery.
HP:0025042.definition_cn: 肠系膜根部或整个肠系膜内淋巴结的形态学异常。

HP:0025043.name: Enlarged mesenteric lymph node
HP:0025043.definition: Increase in size of one or more mesenteric lymph nodes.
HP:0025043.definition_cn: 一个或多个肠系膜淋巴结体积增大。

HP:0025044.name: Lung abscess
HP:0025044.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in lung parenchyma, which leads to a cavity, and after formation of bronchopulmonary fistula, can manifest as an air-fluid level inside the cavity.
HP:0025044.definition_cn: 肺实质内局限性脓液或坏死组织区域，导致空洞形成，并在支气管肺瘘形成后，可表现为空洞内气液平面。

HP:0025045.name: Abnormal brain lactate level by MRS
HP:0025045.definition: A deviation from normal of the level of lactate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025045.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内乳酸水平异常
HP:0025045.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到的脑内乳酸水平异常。

HP:0025046.name: Reduced brain lactate level by MRS
HP:0025046.definition: A decrease in the level of lactate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025046.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑乳酸水平降低
HP:0025046.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内乳酸水平降低。

HP:0025047.name: Abnormal brain choline level by MRS
HP:0025047.definition: A deviation from normal in the level of choline-containing compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025047.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）检测显示脑内胆碱水平异常
HP:0025047.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到的大脑中含胆碱化合物水平的异常。

HP:0025048.name: Reduced brain choline level by MRS
HP:0025048.definition: An decrease in the level of choline-containing compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025048.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑胆碱水平降低
HP:0025048.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内胆碱类化合物（Choline-Containing Compounds, Cho）水平降低。

HP:0025049.name: Abnormal brain creatine level by MRS
HP:0025049.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内肌酸水平异常

HP:0025050.name: Elevated brain creatine level by MRS
HP:0025050.definition: An increase in the level of creatine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025050.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内肌酸水平升高
HP:0025050.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内肌酸（Creatine）水平升高。

HP:0025051.name: Reduced brain creatine level by MRS
HP:0025051.definition: A decrease in the level of creatine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025051.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内肌酸水平降低
HP:0025051.definition_cn: 磁共振波谱分析（MRS）检测到脑内肌酸水平降低。

HP:0025052.name: Abnormal brain N-acetyl aspartate level by MRS
HP:0025052.definition: A deviation from normal in the level of N-acetyl aspartate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025052.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内N-乙酰天门冬氨酸水平异常
HP:0025052.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到大脑中N-乙酰天门冬氨酸（N-acetyl aspartate, NAA）水平异常。

HP:0025053.name: Elevated brain N-acetyl aspartate level by MRS
HP:0025053.definition: An increase in the level of N-acetyl aspartate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025053.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内N-乙酰天门冬氨酸（NAA）水平升高
HP:0025053.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内N-乙酰天门冬氨酸（N-acetyl aspartate, NAA）水平升高。

HP:0025054.name: Type II radial ray deficiency
HP:0025054.definition: A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by a hypoplastic radius. The radius has both proximal and distal epiphyses but growth is defective in both. This type is essentially a radius in miniature. Growth of the radius proceeds at a decreased rate.
HP:0025054.definition_cn: 一种以桡骨发育不全为特征的桡侧列缺损类型。该桡骨同时存在近端和远端骨骺，但两者生长均存在缺陷。此类桡骨本质上呈微型化表现，其生长速率显著降低。

HP:0025055.name: Type III radial ray deficiency
HP:0025055.definition: A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by partial absence of the radius. The radius is partially absent. The defect can be in the proximal, middle, or distal third. All have been reported , but the most frequent is the absence of the distal one or two thirds. The hand is radially displaced . The ulna is thickened, shortened , and bowed radially, and the wrist is unsupported.
HP:0025055.definition_cn: 一种以桡骨部分缺失为特征的桡侧列缺损。桡骨部分缺失，缺损可位于近端、中段或远端三分之一。所有部位均有报道，但最常见的是远端三分之一或三分之二的缺失。手部向桡侧偏移，尺骨增粗、短缩并向桡侧弯曲，腕关节失去支撑。

HP:0025056.name: Type IV radial ray deficiency
HP:0025056.definition: A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by total absence of the radius. This represents the most common type of radial deficiency. The hand is unsupported and is usually severely radially displaced.
HP:0025056.definition_cn: 一种以桡骨完全缺失为特征的桡侧列缺损。这是最常见的桡侧缺损类型。手部缺乏支撑且通常严重向桡侧移位。

HP:0025057.name: Abnormal olfactory lobe morphology
HP:0025057.definition: A structural anomaly of the olfactory lobe, the structure within the brain that receives neural input from the nasal cavity and thereby processes the sense of smell.
HP:0025057.definition_cn: 嗅叶结构异常，即大脑中接收来自鼻腔神经输入并处理嗅觉信息的结构出现异常。

HP:0025058.name: Hypothalamic atrophy
HP:0025058.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of hypothalamus tissue that was once present.
HP:0025058.definition_cn: 部分或完全的下丘脑组织萎缩（丧失），该组织先前存在。

HP:0025059.name: Splenic abscess
HP:0025059.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma of the spleen.
HP:0025059.definition_cn: 脾实质内局限性脓液或坏死组织区域。

HP:0025060.name: Multifocal splenic abscess
HP:0025060.definition: Multiple abscess lesions in the spleen.

HP:0025062.name: Geophagia
HP:0025062.definition: The practice of eating earth or soil-like substrates such as clay or chalk.

HP:0025063.name: Scaphoid abdomen
HP:0025063.definition: The anterior abdominal wall is sunken and presents a concave rather than a convex contour.
HP:0025063.definition_cn: 腹前壁凹陷，呈现凹面而非凸面轮廓。

HP:0025065.name: Abnormal mean corpuscular volume
HP:0025065.definition: A deviation from normal of the mean corpuscular volume, or mean cell volume (MCV) of red blood cells, usually taken to be 80 to 100 femtoliters.
HP:0025065.definition_cn: 红细胞平均体积（Mean Corpuscular Volume, MCV）偏离正常值，通常正常范围为80至100飞升（femtoliters）。

HP:0025066.name: Decreased mean corpuscular volume
HP:0025066.definition: A reduction from normal of the mean corpuscular volume, or mean cell volume (MCV) of red blood cells (usually defined as an MCV below 80 femtoliters).
HP:0025066.definition_cn: 红细胞平均体积（Mean Corpuscular Volume, MCV）或平均细胞体积（Mean Cell Volume）低于正常值（通常定义为MCV低于80飞升）。

HP:0025067.name: Recurrent sepsis
HP:0025067.definition: Repeated bouts of sepsis, defined as life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection.
HP:0025067.definition_cn: 反复发作的脓毒症，定义为由宿主对感染失调反应引起的危及生命的器官功能障碍。

HP:0025068.name: Incomitant strabismus
HP:0025068.definition: Strabismus in which the angle of deviation differs depending upon the direction of gaze or according to which eye is fixing, associated with: (i) defective movement of the eye, (ii) asymmetrical accommodative effort.
HP:0025068.definition_cn: 斜视，其偏斜角度因注视方向或固定眼的不同而有所差异，伴随以下情况：（i）眼球运动缺陷，（ii）调节力不对称。

HP:0025069.name: Concomitant strabismus
HP:0025069.definition: Strabismus in which the angle of deviation of the squiting eye remains the same in relation to the other eye, in all directions of gaze, and whichever eye is fixing.
HP:0025069.definition_cn: 共同性斜视，即斜视眼的偏斜角度在所有注视方向上以及无论哪只眼注视时，相对于另一只眼保持不变。

HP:0025070.name: Abnormal U wave
HP:0025070.definition: An anomaly of the U wave of the electrocardiogram (EKG). The U wave is a small (0.5 mm) deflection immediately following the T wave, usually in the same direction as the T wave. It is best seen in leads V2 and V3.
HP:0025070.definition_cn: 心电图（EKG）U波异常。U波是紧随T波之后的一个小（0.5毫米）偏转，通常与T波方向一致。在V2和V3导联中最为明显。

HP:0025071.name: U wave inversion
HP:0025071.definition: Direction of the U wave opposite to the T wave (i.e., below baseline) in leads with upright T waves.
HP:0025071.definition_cn: 在T波直立的导联中，U波方向与T波相反（即位于基线以下）。

HP:0025072.name: Prominent U wave
HP:0025072.definition: Increased amplitude of the U wave, defined as an amplitude greater than 1-2mm or 25 percent of the height of the T wave.
HP:0025072.definition_cn: U波振幅增高，定义为振幅大于1-2毫米或超过T波高度的25%。

HP:0025073.name: Exercise-induced U wave inversion
HP:0025073.definition: U wave inversion that is induced by exercise stress testing.
HP:0025073.definition_cn: 运动负荷试验诱发的U波倒置。

HP:0025074.name: Abnormal QRS complex
HP:0025074.definition: An anomaly of the complex formed by the Q, R, and S waves, which occur in rapid succession on the electrocardiogram.
HP:0025074.definition_cn: QRS波群复合波异常，该波群在心电图上快速连续出现。

HP:0025075.name: Increased QRS voltage
HP:0025075.definition: Elevation of the voltage (height) of the QRS complex. There are several criteria in use, but the most common is the Sokolov-Lyon criterion (S wave depth in V1 + tallest R wave height in V5-V6 greater than 35 mm).
HP:0025075.definition_cn: QRS波群电压（高度）增高。目前有多种诊断标准，但最常用的是Sokolov-Lyon标准（V1导联S波深度加上V5-V6导联最高R波高度大于35毫米）。

HP:0025076.name: Abnormal QRS voltage
HP:0025076.definition: Abnormal amplitude of the QRS complex of the electrocardiogram (EKG).

HP:0025077.name: Decreased QRS voltage
HP:0025077.definition: Reduced amplitude (height) of the QRS complex of the electrocardiogram (EKG), defined as amplitudes of all the QRS complexes in the limb leads are less than 5 mm or amplitudes of all the QRS complexes in the precordial leads less than 10 mm.
HP:0025077.definition_cn: 心电图（EKG）QRS波群振幅（高度）降低，定义为肢体导联所有QRS波群振幅小于5毫米或胸导联所有QRS波群振幅小于10毫米。

HP:0025078.name: Electrical alternans
HP:0025078.definition: The QRS complexes of the electrocardiogram alternate in height.

HP:0025079.name: Pancreatic abscess
HP:0025079.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma of the pancreas.
HP:0025079.definition_cn: 胰腺实质内局限性脓液或坏死组织区域。

HP:0025080.name: Orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis
HP:0025080.definition: A form of hyperkeratosis characterized by thickening of the cornified layer without retained nuclei.
HP:0025080.name_cn: 正角化过度性角化过度症
HP:0025080.definition_cn: 一种角化过度症，其特征为角质层增厚但无核残留。

HP:0025081.name: Darier's sign
HP:0025081.definition: A skin change elicited by briskly rubbing the skin lesion in urticaria pigmentosa (UP), whereby the area begins to itch and becomes raised and surrounded by erythema. Unlike other forms of dermatographism, Darier's sign refers to urtication that is limited to the UP involved areas and, as in this case, spares the skin unaffected by UP.
HP:0025081.definition_cn: 在色素性荨麻疹（Urticaria Pigmentosa, UP）中，通过快速摩擦皮损部位引发的皮肤变化，表现为该区域开始瘙痒、隆起并伴有红斑环绕。与其他形式的皮肤划痕症不同，Darier征特指仅限于UP受累区域的荨麻疹样反应，且如本例所示，未受UP影响的皮肤不受累及。

HP:0025082.name: Abnormal cutaneous elastic fiber morphology
HP:0025082.definition: Any structural anomaly of the elastic fibers of the skin. Elastic fibers are the essential extracellular matrix macromolecules comprising an elastin core surrounded by a mantle of fibrillin-rich microfibrils.
HP:0025082.name_cn: 皮肤弹性纤维形态异常
HP:0025082.definition_cn: 皮肤弹性纤维的任何结构异常。弹性纤维是构成细胞外基质的重要大分子，其核心为弹性蛋白，周围包裹着富含原纤维蛋白的微纤维鞘。

HP:0025083.name: Elevated dermal desmosine content
HP:0025083.definition: An increased amount of desmosine measure in the skin. Desmosine is a cross-linking amino acid formed from lysyl residues in elastin.
HP:0025083.definition_cn: 皮肤中脱锁氨酸（desmosine）含量增加。脱锁氨酸是一种由弹性蛋白中的赖氨酸残基形成的交联氨基酸。

HP:0025084.name: Folliculitis
HP:0025084.definition: Inflammatory cells within the wall and ostia of the hair follicle, creating a follicular-based pustule.
HP:0025084.definition_cn: 毛囊壁及开口处的炎症细胞，形成毛囊性脓疱。

HP:0025085.name: Bloody diarrhea
HP:0025085.definition: Passage of many stools containing blood.

HP:0025086.name: Bloody mucoid diarrhea
HP:0025086.definition: Passage of many stools containing blood and mucus.

HP:0025087.name: Delayed recoil upon stretching of skin
HP:0025087.definition: Area of skin requiring an increased amount of time to return to its original shape after being stretched.
HP:0025087.definition_cn: 皮肤区域在被拉伸后需要较长时间恢复至其原始形态。

HP:0025088.name: Onychomadesis
HP:0025088.definition: Complete shedding (separation) of the nail from the proximal matrix. Onychomadesis is the proximal separation of the nail plate from the nail matrix due to a temporary cessation of nail growth.
HP:0025088.definition_cn: 指甲从近端基质完全脱落（分离）。甲剥离是指由于指甲生长暂时停止，导致甲板从甲床近端分离。

HP:0025089.name: Feculent vomiting
HP:0025089.definition: Vomiting of material that is of fecal origin.

HP:0025090.name: Abnormal large intestinal mucosa morphology
HP:0025090.definition: A structural anomaly of the mucous lining of the large intestine.

HP:0025091.name: Wrist sign
HP:0025091.definition: The wrist sign is positive when the tip of the thumb covers the entire fingernail of the fifth finger when wrapped around the contralateral wrist.
HP:0025091.definition_cn: 腕征阳性表现为当拇指环绕对侧手腕时，其尖端可完全覆盖第五指指甲。

HP:0025092.name: Epidermal acanthosis
HP:0025092.definition: Diffuse hypertrophy or thickening of the stratum spinosum of the epidermis (prickle cell layer of the skin).
HP:0025092.definition_cn: 表皮棘层弥漫性肥大或增厚（皮肤棘细胞层）。

HP:0025093.name: Peripapillary exudate
HP:0025093.definition: A retinal exudate in the area surrounding the optic nerve head.
HP:0025093.definition_cn: 视神经乳头周围区域的视网膜渗出物。

HP:0025094.name: Disciform macular scar
HP:0025094.definition: A subretinal scar with a disc-like shape in the region of the macula.
HP:0025094.definition_cn: 黄斑区盘状视网膜下瘢痕。

HP:0025095.name: Sneeze
HP:0025095.definition: A sudden violent, spasmodic, audible expiration of breath through the nose and mouth.
HP:0025095.definition_cn: 突发性剧烈、痉挛性、可闻的经鼻和口的气体呼出。

HP:0025096.name: Paroxysmal sneezing
HP:0025096.definition_cn: 自发性病理性爆发性喷嚏。

HP:0025097.name: Eyelid myoclonus
HP:0025097.definition: Marked, involuntary jerking of the eyelids.
HP:0025097.definition_cn: 明显的眼睑不自主抽搐。

HP:0025098.name: Dysgenesis of the hypothalamus
HP:0025098.definition: Structural abnormality of the hypothalamus related to defective development.
HP:0025098.definition_cn: 下丘脑结构异常与发育缺陷相关。

HP:0025099.name: Dysgenesis of the thalamus
HP:0025099.definition: Structural abnormality of the thalamus related to defective development.
HP:0025099.definition_cn: 与发育缺陷相关的丘脑结构异常。

HP:0025100.name: Abnormal hippocampus morphology
HP:0025100.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hippocampus,

HP:0025101.name: Dysgenesis of the hippocampus
HP:0025101.definition: Structural abnormality of the hippocampus related to defective development.
HP:0025101.definition_cn: 海马体结构异常与发育缺陷相关。

HP:0025102.name: Dysgenesis of the basal ganglia
HP:0025102.definition: Structural abnormality of the basal ganglia related to defective development.
HP:0025102.definition_cn: 与发育缺陷相关的基底节结构异常。

HP:0025103.name: Umbilicated nodule
HP:0025103.definition: A type of skin nodule that has a small depression that resembles a navel (i.e., is umbilicated).
HP:0025103.definition_cn: 一种皮肤结节，其表面具有类似脐部的小凹陷（即脐状凹陷）。

HP:0025104.name: Capillary malformation
HP:0025104.definition: A capillary malformation is a flat, sharply defined vascular stain of the skin. It may cover a large surface area or it may be scattered and appear as little islands of color. In a capillary maformation, the predominant vessels are small, slow-flow vessels (i.e., arterioles and postcapillary venules).
HP:0025104.definition_cn: 毛细血管畸形是一种平坦、边界清晰的皮肤血管性色素沉着。它可能覆盖大面积皮肤表面，也可能呈散在分布，表现为小片状色素沉着区域。在毛细血管畸形中，主要受累的血管为细小、血流缓慢的血管（即小动脉和毛细血管后微静脉）。

HP:0025105.name: Nevus anemicus
HP:0025105.definition: A congenital skin lesion characterized by irregular hypopigmented macules that coalesce to form plaques and occur particularly on the chest. It is generally present at birth or develops in the first days of life. It is more common in females. Diagnosis is confirmed by applying gentle friction to the lesion and the surrounding skin and checking that the erythema produced in the healthy skin does not appear in the hypopigmented lesion. This pale macule becomes more conspicuous when the lesion and its surroundings are rubbed. The margin of the naevus is ill-defined and consists of an archipelago of small anemic spots.
HP:0025105.definition_cn: 一种先天性皮肤病变，其特征为不规则的低色素斑块融合形成斑块，尤其好发于胸部。通常在出生时即存在或在出生后数日内出现。女性更为常见。诊断通过在病变及周围皮肤上施加轻柔摩擦，确认健康皮肤产生的红斑在低色素病变中不出现。当病变及其周围被摩擦时，这种苍白斑块变得更加明显。痣的边缘模糊不清，由一系列小贫血斑点组成。

HP:0025106.name: Nevus roseus
HP:0025106.definition: A variant of port-wine stain characterized by a pale red or even pink tone, in contrast to the darker hue of the port-wine stain. By analogy with the term port-wine stain, this variant rose-wine stain, or nevus roseus. Nevus roseus, however, cannot be definitely diagnosed until adulthood as port-wine stains are sometimes pink in children. While the natural history of port-wine stains includes hypertrophy, darkening, and nodularity, nevus roseus remains unchanged for life.
HP:0025106.definition_cn: 一种葡萄酒色斑的变异类型，其特征为淡红色甚至粉红色色调，与葡萄酒色斑的深色色调形成对比。类比于葡萄酒色斑这一术语，这种变异类型被称为玫瑰葡萄酒色斑或玫瑰痣（nevus roseus）。然而，玫瑰痣在成年之前无法明确诊断，因为儿童时期的葡萄酒色斑有时也呈现粉红色。虽然葡萄酒色斑的自然病程包括肥大、颜色加深和结节形成，但玫瑰痣终生保持不变。

HP:0025107.name: Cutis marmorata telangiectatica congenita
HP:0025107.definition: A congenital vascular malformation that presents as localized or generalized erythematous-telangiectatic lesions with a reticular pattern; the lesions are almost always present at birth or develop in the first days of life. Cutis marmorata telangiectatica congenita (CMTC) appears as marble-like pattern (mottling) on the surface of the skin. In contrast to cutis marmorata, the marbling is more severe and always visible.
HP:0025107.name_cn: 先天性毛细血管扩张性大理石样皮肤
HP:0025107.definition_cn: 先天性毛细血管扩张性大理石样皮肤（Cutis marmorata telangiectatica congenita, CMTC）是一种先天性血管畸形，表现为局部或广泛的红斑-毛细血管扩张性病变，呈网状模式；病变几乎总是在出生时即存在或在生命最初几天内发展。CMTC在皮肤表面呈现大理石样图案（斑驳）。与大理石样皮肤（cutis marmorata）相比，其斑驳更为严重且始终可见。

HP:0025108.name: Angioma serpentinum
HP:0025108.definition: Angioma serpiginosum consists of punctate, tightly packed telangiectatic lesions. Characteristic histopathological features are dilated and tortuous capillaries involving the uppermost part of the dermis.
HP:0025108.definition_cn: 匍行性血管瘤由点状、紧密排列的毛细血管扩张性病变组成。其特征性组织病理学表现为真皮最上层扩张且迂曲的毛细血管。

HP:0025109.name: Reduced red cell pyruvate kinase level
HP:0025109.definition: Decrease in the level of pyruvate kinase (PK) within erythrocytes. PK catalyzes the reaction: ATP + pyruvate = ADP + phosphoenolpyruvate.
HP:0025109.name_cn: 红细胞丙酮酸激酶水平降低
HP:0025109.definition_cn: 红细胞内丙酮酸激酶（Pyruvate Kinase, PK）水平降低。丙酮酸激酶催化以下反应：三磷酸腺苷（ATP）+ 丙酮酸（Pyruvate）= 二磷酸腺苷（ADP）+ 磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸（Phosphoenolpyruvate）。

HP:0025110.name: Placoid macular lesion
HP:0025110.definition: Yellow/white, sharply delineated lesion, typically of inflammatory nature, involving the macula.
HP:0025110.definition_cn: 黄白色、边界清晰的病变，通常为炎症性质，累及黄斑区。

HP:0025111.name: Acquired aphakia
HP:0025111.definition: Absence of the crystalline lens in the eye known to be the result of a non-congenital condition, e.g., following surgical removal of the lens for cataracts or trauma.
HP:0025111.definition_cn: 已知因非先天性原因导致的眼内晶状体缺失，例如白内障手术摘除晶状体或外伤后所致。

HP:0025113.name: Misophonia
HP:0025113.definition: Misophonia is characterized by strong physiological, emotional, and behavioral reactions to auditory, visual, and/or kinesthetic stimuli of different nature regardless of their physical characteristics. These misophonic responses include anger, general discomfort, disgust, anxiety, and avoidance and escape behaviors.
HP:0025113.definition_cn: 恐音症（Misophonia）的特征是对不同性质的听觉、视觉和/或动觉刺激产生强烈的生理、情绪和行为反应，无论其物理特性如何。这些恐音反应包括愤怒、普遍不适、厌恶、焦虑以及回避和逃避行为。

HP:0025114.name: Hypergranulosis
HP:0025114.definition: Hypergranulosis is an increased thickness of the stratum granulosum.
HP:0025114.definition_cn: 颗粒层增厚是指颗粒层厚度增加。

HP:0025115.name: Civatte bodies
HP:0025115.definition: Eosinophilic hyaline ovoid bodies which are often found in the subepidermal papillary regions or sometimes in the epidermis. Civatte bodies (CBs) are seen as rounded, homogenous, eosinophilic masses on routine H and E staining lying in the deeper parts of epidermis/epithelium and more frequently in dermis/connective tissue. They are known as CBs (in epithelium/epidermis), colloid bodies, or hyaline bodies (in connective tissue). They are 10-25 micrometers in diameter and situated mostly within or above the inflammatory cell infiltrate. In lichen planus, the number of necrotic keratinocytes may be so large that they are seen lying in clusters in the uppermost dermis. These bodies show a positive periodic acid Schiff reaction and are diastase resistant
HP:0025115.definition_cn: 嗜酸性透明卵圆形小体常位于表皮下乳头区域，有时也可见于表皮内。Civatte小体（CBs）在常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色中表现为圆形、均质、嗜酸性团块，位于表皮/上皮的深层，更常见于真皮/结缔组织中。它们被称为CBs（在上皮/表皮中）、胶样小体或透明小体（在结缔组织中）。其直径为10-25微米，主要位于炎症细胞浸润内或上方。在扁平苔藓中，坏死角质形成细胞的数量可能非常多，以至于它们在上部真皮层中呈簇状分布。这些小体显示过碘酸希夫（PAS）反应阳性，并且对淀粉酶具有抗性。

HP:0025116.name: Fetal distress
HP:0025116.definition: An intrauterine state characterized by suboptimal values in the fetal heart rate, oxygenation of fetal blood, or other parameters indicative of compromise of the fetus. Signs of fetal distress include repetitive variable decelerations, fetal tachycardia or bradycardia, late decelerations, or low biophysical profile.
HP:0025116.definition_cn: 宫内状态，其特征为胎儿心率、胎儿血氧饱和度或其他指示胎儿受损的参数值低于最佳水平。胎儿窘迫的征象包括反复性变异减速、胎儿心动过速或心动过缓、晚期减速或生物物理评分低。

HP:0025117.name: Rete ridge flattening
HP:0025117.definition: Rete pegs (or ridges) are the epithelial extensions that project into the underlying connective tissue in both skin and mucous membranes. Rete ridge flattening refers to the loss of these projections so that the skin epithelium acquires a relatively flat appearance.
HP:0025117.definition_cn: 网状嵴（或称为网状突起）是皮肤和黏膜中上皮细胞向下方结缔组织延伸的突起结构。网状嵴扁平化是指这些突起的丧失，导致皮肤上皮呈现出相对平坦的外观。

HP:0025118.name: Lip discoloration
HP:0025118.definition: Lightening or darkening of the lips from their usual coloring.
HP:0025118.definition_cn: 唇部色素沉着或色素减退。

HP:0025119.name: Violet lip discoloration
HP:0025119.definition: An alteration of the color of the lip to take on a violet color. This term does not include cyanosis.
HP:0025119.definition_cn: 唇部颜色改变呈现紫色。此术语不包括发绀。

HP:0025120.name: Abnormal circulating reverse T3 concentration
HP:0025120.definition: Concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation is ouside of the limits of normal.
HP:0025120.name_cn: 异常循环反三碘甲状腺原氨酸浓度
HP:0025120.definition_cn: 循环血液中反T3（3,3',5'-三碘甲状腺原氨酸或rT3）浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0025121.name: obsolete Simple partial occipital seizures
HP:0025121.name_cn: 过时的简单部分性枕叶癫痫发作

HP:0025122.name: Sawtooth acanthosis
HP:0025122.definition: A type of epidermal acanthosis characterized by a jagged (sawtooth) appearance of the rete ridges of the epidermis.
HP:0025122.definition_cn: 一种表皮棘层增厚类型，其特征为表皮网嵴呈锯齿状（锯齿形）外观。

HP:0025123.name: White streaks/specks on enamel.
HP:0025123.definition: Areas of white discoloration visible on the surface of the teeth (enamel) in the form of streaks or specks.
HP:0025123.name_cn: 釉质上的白色条纹/斑点。
HP:0025123.definition_cn: 牙齿表面（牙釉质）可见白色变色区域，呈条纹状或斑点状。

HP:0025124.name: Fragile teeth
HP:0025124.definition: A tendency of teeth to fracture as manifested by a history of repeated fracture of the dental enamel without adequate trauma.
HP:0025124.definition_cn: 牙釉质反复断裂倾向，表现为无明显外伤史情况下牙釉质多次断裂。

HP:0025125.name: White lesion of the oral mucosa
HP:0025125.definition: White lesions of the oral mucosa are generally caused by a condition that increases the thickness of the epithelium. This increases the distance to the vascular bed and thereby tends to change the usual reddish color of the oral mucosa to white. Common causes include hyperkeratosis (thickening of the keratin layer), acanthosis (thickening of the spinous cell layer), increased edema in the epithelium (leukoedema), and reduced vascularity of the underlying lamina propria. Additionally, fibrin caps or surface ulcerations and collapsed bullae can appear white.
HP:0025125.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜白色病变通常由导致上皮增厚的病理状态引起。这种增厚增加了与血管床的距离，从而倾向于将口腔黏膜的通常红色改变为白色。常见病因包括角化过度（角质层增厚）、棘层增厚（棘细胞层增厚）、上皮内水肿增加（白水肿）以及固有层血管减少。此外，纤维蛋白帽或表面溃疡和塌陷的大疱也可呈现白色。

HP:0025126.name: Oral hairy leukoplakia
HP:0025126.definition: A corrugated white lesion of the oral mucosa that usually occurs on the lateral or ventral surfaces of the tongue and may have a shaggy or frayed appearance.
HP:0025126.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜的白色皱褶病变，通常发生于舌的侧缘或腹侧表面，可能呈现蓬松或磨损的外观。

HP:0025127.name: Actinic keratosis
HP:0025127.definition: A scaly, crusty lesion caused by damage from the ultraviolet radiation of the sun, with typical location on sun-exposed areas of the skin. Actinic keratosis lesions are often elevated, rough, and wartlike, and may be red, or occasionally tan, pink, or flesh-toned in color.
HP:0025127.definition_cn: 由太阳紫外线辐射损伤引起的鳞屑性、结痂性皮损，典型部位位于皮肤日光暴露区域。光化性角化病皮损常呈隆起、粗糙、疣状，颜色可为红色，偶见棕褐色、粉红色或肉色。

HP:0025128.name: Reduced intraabdominal adipose tissue
HP:0025128.definition: An abnormally reduced amount of adipose tissue in the abdominal cavity.
HP:0025128.definition_cn: 腹腔内脂肪组织异常减少。

HP:0025129.name: Abnormal small intestinal mucosa morphology
HP:0025129.definition: A structural anomaly of the mucous lining of the small intestine.

HP:0025130.name: Decreased small intestinal mucosa lactase level
HP:0025130.definition: Lactase is produced in the small intestine in humans, Lactase is a member of the beta-galactosidase family of enzymes, and hydrolyzes D-lactose to form D-galactose and D-glucose, which can be absorbed by the small intestine. There are many ways of assessing lactase activity. In one test, an endoscopic biopsy from the postbulbar duodenum is incubated with lactose on a test plate, and a color reaction develops within 20 min as a result of hydrolyzed lactose (a positive result) in patients with normolactasia, whereas no reaction (a negative result) develops in patients with severe hypolactasia. Other, less direct, tests include the hydrogen breath test, and blood tests following lactose challenges.
HP:0025130.name_cn: 小肠黏膜乳糖酶水平降低
HP:0025130.definition_cn: 乳糖酶在人类的小肠中产生，属于β-半乳糖苷酶家族，能够水解D-乳糖生成D-半乳糖和D-葡萄糖，这些产物可被小肠吸收。评估乳糖酶活性的方法有多种。其中一种检测方法是将从十二指肠球后部获取的内镜活检组织与乳糖在测试板上孵育，正常乳糖酶活性的患者会在20分钟内因乳糖水解而出现显色反应（阳性结果），而严重乳糖酶缺乏的患者则无反应（阴性结果）。其他较为间接的检测方法包括氢呼气试验以及乳糖负荷后的血液检测。

HP:0025131.name: Finger swelling
HP:0025131.definition: Enlargement of the soft tissues of one or more fingers.
HP:0025131.definition_cn: 单指或多指软组织肥大。

HP:0025132.name: Abnormal circulating estrogen level
HP:0025132.definition: A deviation from normal concentration of the hormone estrogen in the blood circulation.
HP:0025132.definition_cn: 血液中雌激素浓度异常偏离正常值。

HP:0025133.name: Abnormal serum estradiol
HP:0025133.definition: A deviation from normal concentrations of estradiol in the circulation.
HP:0025133.definition_cn: 循环中雌二醇浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0025134.name: Increased serum estradiol
HP:0025134.definition: An elevation above normal limits of the concentration of estradiol in the circulation.
HP:0025134.definition_cn: 循环中雌二醇浓度超出正常范围升高。

HP:0025135.name: Abnormal serum estriol
HP:0025135.definition: A deviation from normal concentration of estriol in the circulation.
HP:0025135.definition_cn: 循环中雌三醇浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0025136.name: Increased serum estriol
HP:0025136.definition: An elevation above normal limits of estriol concentration in the circulation.
HP:0025136.definition_cn: 循环中雌三醇浓度超出正常范围升高。

HP:0025137.name: Decreased serum estriol
HP:0025137.definition: A reduction below normal limits of estriol in the circulation.
HP:0025137.definition_cn: 循环中雌三醇水平低于正常范围。

HP:0025138.name: Abnormal serum estrone
HP:0025138.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of circulating estrone.

HP:0025139.name: Increased serum estrone
HP:0025139.definition: An elevation above normal limits of the concentration of estrone in the circulation.
HP:0025139.definition_cn: 循环中雌酮浓度超出正常范围升高。

HP:0025140.name: Decreased serum estrone
HP:0025140.definition: A reduction below normal limits of the concentration of estrone in the circulation.
HP:0025140.definition_cn: 循环中雌酮浓度低于正常限值的降低。

HP:0025141.name: Gingival calcification
HP:0025141.definition: Ectopic deposition of calcium salts found in the gingiva.

HP:0025142.name: Constitutional symptom
HP:0025142.definition: A symptom or manifestation indicating a systemic or general effect of a disease and that may affect the general well-being or status of an individual.
HP:0025142.definition_cn: 一种症状或表现，表明疾病的系统性或全身性影响，可能影响个体的整体健康状况或状态。

HP:0025143.name: Chills
HP:0025143.definition: A sudden sensation of feeling cold.
HP:0025143.definition_cn: 突发性寒战（Sudden Onset of Chills）

HP:0025144.name: Shivering
HP:0025144.definition: Involuntary contraction or twitching of the muscles.
HP:0025144.definition_cn: 不自主性肌肉收缩或抽搐。

HP:0025145.name: Rigors
HP:0025145.definition: Severe chills with violent shivering. A rigor is an episode of shaking or exaggerated shivering which can occur with a high fever.
HP:0025145.definition_cn: 严重寒战伴剧烈颤抖。寒战是一种发作性颤抖或过度寒战，可伴随高热发生。

HP:0025146.name: Foveal degeneration
HP:0025146.definition: Deterioration of the tissue of the fovea, i.e.,the region of sharpest vision within the macula of the retina.
HP:0025146.definition_cn: 黄斑中心凹组织退化，即视网膜黄斑区内视觉最敏锐区域的病变。

HP:0025147.name: Beaten bronze macular sheen
HP:0025147.definition: A shiny appearance of the macula, which is often called a beaten bronze appearance.
HP:0025147.definition_cn: 黄斑区呈现光泽外观，通常称为青铜色样外观。

HP:0025148.name: Dark choroid
HP:0025148.definition: A fluorescein angiographic finding of absence of the normal background fluorescence (a dark choroid).
HP:0025148.definition_cn: 荧光素血管造影显示正常背景荧光缺失（暗脉络膜）。

HP:0025149.name: Atrophic muscularis propria
HP:0025149.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of muscularois propria tissue that was once present. The atrophy may involve a marked vacuolar degeneration of myocytes, loss of muscle fibers and some cases a highly characteristic honeycomb fibrosis.
HP:0025149.definition_cn: 部分或完全性的固有肌层组织萎缩（丧失）。该萎缩可能涉及肌细胞的显著空泡变性、肌纤维丧失，以及在某些病例中出现高度特征性的蜂窝状纤维化。

HP:0025150.name: Hypoganglionosis
HP:0025150.definition_cn: 稀疏且小的肌间神经节

HP:0025151.name: Ganglioneuromatosis
HP:0025151.definition: Hyperplastic submucosal and myenteric plexus containing an increased number of ganglion cells, glial cells and nerve fibers.
HP:0025151.definition_cn: 增生的黏膜下神经丛和肌间神经丛，包含数量增加的神经节细胞、胶质细胞和神经纤维。

HP:0025152.name: Poor visual behavior for age
HP:0025152.definition: Lack of visual responsiveness or decrease in visual capabilities suggesting a lack of visual responsiveness or decrease in visual capabilities in an infant or young child in which visual behavior fails to meet normal developmental milestones.
HP:0025152.name_cn: 与年龄不符的视觉行为异常
HP:0025152.definition_cn: 视觉反应缺失或视觉功能减退，提示婴儿或幼儿存在视觉反应缺失或视觉功能减退，其视觉行为未能达到正常发育里程碑。

HP:0025153.name: Transient
HP:0025153.definition: Short-lived and not permanent. This term applies to a phenotypic abnormality that is temporary and of short duration.
HP:0025153.definition_cn: 短暂性且非永久性。该术语适用于表型异常，其为暂时性且持续时间较短。

HP:0025154.name: Portosystemic collateral veins
HP:0025154.definition: Presence of biliary veins that serve as a collateral channel to the systemic circulation
HP:0025154.definition_cn: 存在作为体循环侧支通道的胆道静脉

HP:0025155.name: Abnormality of hepatobiliary system physiology
HP:0025155.definition: A functional anomaly of the hepatobiliary system
HP:0025155.name_cn: 肝胆系统生理功能异常

HP:0025156.name: Dependency on intravenous nutrition
HP:0025156.definition: Inability to be weaned from intravenous (parenteral) nutrition, as judged by the hydration status (urine output, blood urea nitrogen, creatinine, urine sodium concentration), ability to maintain weight, stool output, and serum electrolyte status.
HP:0025156.definition_cn: 无法脱离静脉（肠外）营养，依据为水合状态（尿量、血尿素氮、肌酐、尿钠浓度）、体重维持能力、排便量及血清电解质状态。

HP:0025157.name: Increased urinary sedoheptulose
HP:0025157.definition: An increased concentration of sedoheptulose in the urine. Sedoheptulose is a monosaccharide with seven carbon atoms and a ketone functional group.
HP:0025157.name_cn: 尿液中景天庚酮糖水平升高
HP:0025157.definition_cn: 尿液中景天庚酮糖浓度升高。景天庚酮糖是一种具有七个碳原子和酮基官能团的单糖。

HP:0025158.name: Hyperautofluorescent retinal lesion
HP:0025158.definition: Increased amount of autofluorescence in the retina as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.
HP:0025158.name_cn: 高自发荧光视网膜病变
HP:0025158.definition_cn: 通过眼底自发荧光成像检测到视网膜内自发荧光量增加。

HP:0025159.name: Hypoautofluorescent retinal lesion
HP:0025159.definition: Decreased amount of autofluorescence in the retina as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.
HP:0025159.name_cn: 视网膜低自发荧光病变
HP:0025159.definition_cn: 眼底自发荧光成像显示视网膜自发荧光强度降低。

HP:0025160.name: Abnormal temper tantrums
HP:0025160.definition: Temper tantrums are brief episodes of extreme, unpleasant, and sometimes aggressive behaviors in response to frustration or anger, which are a normal part of development in toddlers. Temper tantrums that occur more frequently in a given time and/or are more severe in symptomatology and/or longer in duration and/or inappropriate for the given age compared to a temper tantrum that naturally occurs as a part of the developmental process are classified as abnormal temper tantrums.
HP:0025160.definition_cn: 情绪爆发（Temper tantrums）是指幼儿在遭遇挫折或愤怒时出现的短暂、极端、不愉快且有时具有攻击性的行为，这是幼儿发育过程中的正常现象。与作为发育过程自然出现的情绪爆发相比，若在特定时间内发作频率更高、症状学表现更严重、持续时间更长或与特定年龄不相符的情绪爆发，则被归类为异常情绪爆发（Abnormal temper tantrums）。

HP:0025161.name: Frequent temper tantrums
HP:0025161.definition: Temper tantrums that occur more frequently compared to the temper tantrums that are a part of the normal developmental process.
HP:0025161.definition_cn: 与正常发育过程中的情绪爆发相比，发生频率更高的情绪爆发。

HP:0025162.name: Severe temper tantrums
HP:0025162.definition: Temper tantrums, which occur with more severe symptomatology compared to a temper tantrum that occurs as a part of normal developmental process.
HP:0025162.name_cn: 严重的情绪爆发（Severe temper tantrums）
HP:0025162.definition_cn: 与作为正常发育过程一部分的脾气发作相比，具有更严重症状学的情绪爆发。

HP:0025163.name: Abnormal optic chiasm morphology
HP:0025163.definition: A structural abnormality of the optic chiasm.The optic chiasm, located below the hypothalamus, is a partial crossing of the optic nerves.
HP:0025163.definition_cn: 视交叉结构异常。视交叉位于下丘脑下方，是视神经的部分交叉结构。

HP:0025164.name: Increased number of elastic fibers in the dermis
HP:0025164.definition: An elevated number of elastic fibers, that is of bundles of proteins and glycoproteins in the extracellular matrix in the reticular dermis. Elastic fibers can stretch and recoil back to their original length. This feature can be appreciated on histology with hematoxylin and eosin or other staining methods.
HP:0025164.name_cn: 真皮层弹性纤维数量增多
HP:0025164.definition_cn: 真皮网状层细胞外基质中弹性纤维数量增加，即蛋白质和糖蛋白束增多。弹性纤维具有拉伸和回弹至原始长度的特性。这一特征可通过苏木精-伊红染色或其他染色方法在组织学上观察到。

HP:0025165.name: Clumping of elastic fibers in the dermis
HP:0025165.definition: Formation of clumps or aggregates that make up small protuberances from elastic fibers within the dermis (especially the reticular dermis).
HP:0025165.definition_cn: 真皮层（特别是网状真皮层）内弹性纤维形成团块或聚集体，构成小的突起。

HP:0025166.name: Thickened elastic fibers in the dermis
HP:0025166.definition: An increase of the diameter of elastic fibers in the dermis.
HP:0025166.definition_cn: 真皮层弹性纤维直径增加。

HP:0025167.name: Fragmented elastic fibers in the dermis
HP:0025167.definition: Elastic fibers in the dermis exhibit an increased number of breaks associated with disorganization of the structure of the elastic fibers.
HP:0025167.definition_cn: 真皮层中的弹性纤维显示出断裂数量增加，伴随弹性纤维结构的紊乱。

HP:0025168.name: Left ventricular diastolic dysfunction
HP:0025168.definition: Abnormal function of the left ventricule during left ventricular relaxation and filling.
HP:0025168.definition_cn: 左心室舒张和充盈期间左心室功能异常。

HP:0025169.name: Left ventricular systolic dysfunction
HP:0025169.definition: Abnormality of left ventricular contraction, often defined operationally as an ejection fraction of less than 40 percent.
HP:0025169.definition_cn: 左心室收缩功能异常，通常操作性地定义为射血分数低于40%。

HP:0025170.name: Neuronal/glioneuronal neoplasm of the central nervous system
HP:0025170.definition: A central nervous system neoplasm with neuronal and, less consistently, glial differentiation.
HP:0025170.name_cn: 中枢神经系统神经元/胶质神经元肿瘤
HP:0025170.definition_cn: 一种中枢神经系统肿瘤，具有神经元分化，且较少一致地伴有胶质细胞分化。

HP:0025171.name: Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor
HP:0025171.definition: A tumor of the central nervous system that has components of both neurocytic and glial areas, whereby usually the glial component of the tumor predominates. Rossette-forming glioneuronal tumors (RGNT) have biphasic cytoarchitecture with two elements; neurocytic rosettes resembling Homer-Wright rosettes, and astrocytic component resembling a pilocytic astrocytoma. RGNTs are low-grade tumors that lack histopathological signs of malignancy.
HP:0025171.name_cn: 玫瑰花结形成性胶质神经元肿瘤
HP:0025171.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统肿瘤，具有神经细胞和胶质细胞区域的双重成分，通常以胶质成分为主。玫瑰花结形成性胶质神经元肿瘤（RGNT）具有双相细胞结构，包含两种成分：类似于Homer-Wright玫瑰花结的神经细胞玫瑰花结，以及类似于毛细胞型星形细胞瘤的星形细胞成分。RGNT为低级别肿瘤，缺乏恶性组织病理学特征。

HP:0025172.name: Smooth septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025172.definition: Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with a smooth appearance of the interlobular septa.
HP:0025172.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT上的平滑间隔增厚
HP:0025172.definition_cn: 高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示肺小叶间隔增厚，小叶间隔呈光滑外观。

HP:0025173.name: Nodular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025173.definition: Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with a nodular or beaded appearance of the interlobular septa.
HP:0025173.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT上的结节性间隔增厚
HP:0025173.definition_cn: 高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示肺小叶间隔增厚，呈结节状或串珠样改变。

HP:0025174.name: Irregular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025174.definition: Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with an irregular appearance of the interlobular septa. THis feature is often associated with distortion of lung architecture.
HP:0025174.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT（HRCT）显示间隔不规则增厚
HP:0025174.definition_cn: 高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示肺小叶间隔增厚，伴小叶间隔形态不规则。此特征常与肺结构扭曲相关。

HP:0025175.name: Honeycomb lung
HP:0025175.definition: Honeycombing represents destroyed and fibrotic lung tissue containing numerous cystic airspaces with thick fibrous walls, representing the late stage of various lung diseases, with complete loss of acinar architecture. The cysts range in size from a few millimeters to several centimeters in diameter, have variable wall thickness, and are lined by metaplastic bronchiolar epithelium. On chest radiographs, honeycombing appears as closely approximated ring shadows, typically 3-10 mm in diameter with walls 1-3 mm in thickness, that resemble a honeycomb; the finding implies end-stage lung disease. On CT scans, the appearance is of clustered cystic air spaces, typically of comparable diameters on the order of 3-10 mm but occasionally as large as 2.5 cm. Honeycombing is usually subpleural and is characterized by well-defined walls. It is a CT feature of established pulmonary fibrosis. Because honeycombing is often considered specific for pulmonary fibrosis and is an important criterion in the diagnosis of usual interstitial pneumonia, the term should be used with care, as it may directly impact patient care.
HP:0025175.definition_cn: 蜂窝状改变代表破坏和纤维化的肺组织，其中包含多个囊性气腔，囊壁厚且纤维化，标志着多种肺部疾病的晚期阶段，并伴有腺泡结构的完全丧失。这些囊肿的直径从几毫米到几厘米不等，囊壁厚度不一，内衬化生的细支气管上皮。在胸部X线片上，蜂窝状改变表现为紧密排列的环形阴影，通常直径为3-10毫米，壁厚1-3毫米，形似蜂窝；这一发现提示终末期肺病。在CT扫描中，蜂窝状改变表现为成簇的囊性气腔，通常直径在3-10毫米之间，但偶尔可达2.5厘米。蜂窝状改变通常位于胸膜下，其特征为边界清晰的囊壁。它是已确立的肺纤维化的CT特征。由于蜂窝状改变常被认为对肺纤维化具有特异性，并且是诊断寻常型间质性肺炎的重要标准，因此在使用该术语时应谨慎，因为它可能直接影响患者的治疗决策。

HP:0025176.name: Intralobular interstitial thickening
HP:0025176.definition: A fine reticular pattern on high-resolution computed tomography, with the visible lines separated by a few millimeters. Regions of the lung with intralobular interstitial thickening characteristically show a fine lacelike or netlike appearance.
HP:0025176.definition_cn: 高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示细网状影，可见线条间隔数毫米。肺小叶间隔增厚的区域特征性地呈现细密的花边状或网状外观。

HP:0025177.name: Peribronchovascular interstitial thickening
HP:0025177.definition: Thickening of the peribronchovascular interstitium, a connective tissue sheath that surrounds the central bronchi and pulmonary arteries. The peribronchovascular interstitium extends from the level of the pulmonary hila into the peripheral lung. This feature may be ascertained on high-resolution computer tomography.
HP:0025177.name_cn: 支气管血管周围间质增厚
HP:0025177.definition_cn: 支气管血管周围间质增厚，支气管血管周围间质是围绕中央支气管和肺动脉的结缔组织鞘。该结构从肺门水平延伸至外周肺组织。此特征可通过高分辨率计算机断层扫描进行确认。

HP:0025178.name: Subpleural interstitial thickening
HP:0025178.definition: Increase in thickness of the subpleural interstitium.

HP:0025179.name: Ground-glass opacification
HP:0025179.definition: On chest radiographs, ground-glass opacity appears as an area of hazy increased lung opacity, usually extensive, within which margins of pulmonary vessels may be indistinct. On CT scans, it appears as hazy increased opacity of lung, with preservation of bronchial and vascular margins. It is caused by partial filling of airspaces, interstitial thickening (due to fluid, cells, and/or fibrosis), partial collapse of alveoli, increased capillary blood volume, or a combination of these, the common factor being the partial displacement of air. Ground-glass opacity is less opaque than consolidation, in which bronchovascular margins are obscured.
HP:0025179.definition_cn: 在胸部X线片上，磨玻璃影表现为肺部模糊的密度增高区域，通常范围广泛，其中肺血管的边界可能不清晰。在CT扫描中，磨玻璃影表现为肺部模糊的密度增高，但支气管和血管的边界仍可辨认。其病因包括肺泡部分填充、间质增厚（由于液体、细胞和/或纤维化）、肺泡部分塌陷、毛细血管血容量增加或这些因素的组合，共同特点是空气的部分置换。磨玻璃影的密度低于实变，在实变中支气管血管的边界会被遮蔽。

HP:0025180.name: Centrilobular ground-glass opacification on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025180.definition: A hazy area of increased attenuation in centrilobular areas of the lung with preserved bronchial and vascular markings seen on a computer tomography scan. Centrilobular refers to a location that is central within secondary pulmonary lobules.
HP:0025180.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT显示小叶中心性磨玻璃样影
HP:0025180.definition_cn: 计算机断层扫描显示肺部小叶中心区域出现模糊的密度增高影，伴支气管和血管纹理保留。小叶中心指的是位于次级肺小叶中央的位置。

HP:0025181.name: Abdominal aseptic abscess
HP:0025181.definition: An abscess-like lesion located within the abdomen. The lesions are localized in the spleen, liver, abdominal lymph nodes. The lesions represent visceral sterile collections of mature neutrophils that do not respond to antibiotics but regress quickly when treated with corticosteroids, but relapses occur frequently.
HP:0025181.definition_cn: 腹腔内脓肿样病变。病变局限于脾脏、肝脏及腹腔淋巴结。病变表现为内脏无菌性成熟中性粒细胞聚集，对抗生素治疗无反应，但在使用糖皮质激素治疗后迅速消退，但复发频繁。

HP:0025182.name: Localized area of pendulous skin
HP:0025182.definition: A confined region of lax skin that hangs below the level of the surrounding skin. Histopatholigically, there is a loss of elastic fibers in the dermis of the affected region.
HP:0025182.definition_cn: 局部皮肤松弛区域，其皮肤下垂至周围皮肤水平以下。组织病理学上，受累区域真皮层弹性纤维缺失。

HP:0025183.name: Abnormal CD4+ T cell proportion
HP:0025183.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.
HP:0025183.definition_cn: 辅助性CD3+CD4+ T细胞异常增多或减少，以血液中CD3+ T细胞总数的百分比表示，与特定性别和年龄组的参考范围相比较。此类检测通常在TCR α/β阳性细胞群中进行测定。

HP:0025184.name: Arousal parasomnia
HP:0025184.definition: An altered state of arousal during sleep that may be reported by the individual or an observation of others.
HP:0025184.definition_cn: 睡眠期间觉醒状态的改变，可由个体自述或他人观察记录。

HP:0025186.name: Marcus Gunn jaw winking synkinesis
HP:0025186.definition: Unilateral ptosis with associated upper eyelid contraction and contraction of either the external or the internal pterygoid muscle. It is thought to occur because of congenital miswiring of a branch of the fifth cranial nerve into the branch of the third cranial nerve supplying the levator muscle. In Marcus Gunn jaw winking synkinesis, elevation and even retraction of the affected eyelid is triggered by chewing, suction, lateral mandible movement, smiling, sternocleidomastoid contraction, protruding tongue, Valsalva maneuver and even by breathing.
HP:0025186.name_cn: 马库斯·冈恩颌动瞬目联带运动
HP:0025186.definition_cn: 单侧上睑下垂伴上睑收缩及外翼肌或内翼肌收缩。据认为，这是由于第五颅神经分支与第三颅神经分支（支配提上睑肌）的先天性错接所致。在Marcus Gunn颌动瞬目联带运动中，咀嚼、吸吮、下颌侧向运动、微笑、胸锁乳突肌收缩、伸舌、Valsalva动作甚至呼吸均可触发患侧眼睑的上提甚至回缩。

HP:0025187.name: Sleep talking
HP:0025187.definition: Vocalization (production of recognizable words or other sounds) during sleep with lack of awareness.
HP:0025187.definition_cn: 睡眠中发声（产生可识别的词语或其他声音）伴意识缺失。

HP:0025188.name: Retinal vasculitis
HP:0025188.definition: Inflammation of retinal blood vessels as manifested by perivascular sheathing or cuffing, vascular leakage and/or occlusion.
HP:0025188.definition_cn: 视网膜血管炎症表现为血管周围鞘形成或套袖样改变、血管渗漏和/或闭塞。

HP:0025189.name: Hypnic jerks
HP:0025189.definition: Hypnic jerks are characterized by sudden and brief (less than 1 second), non-periodic simultaneous contractions of the whole body or one or more extremities at the onset of sleep.
HP:0025189.definition_cn: 入睡抽动表现为睡眠开始时突然、短暂（小于1秒）、非周期性的全身或一个及以上肢体的同步收缩。

HP:0025190.name: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset
HP:0025190.definition: A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset is a type of bilateral tonic-clonic seizure characterized by generalized onset; these seizures rapidly engage networks in both hemispheres at the start of the seizure.
HP:0025190.name_cn: 双侧强直-阵挛性发作，全面性起始
HP:0025190.definition_cn: 双侧强直-阵挛性发作伴全面性起始是一种以全面性起始为特征的双侧强直-阵挛性发作；此类发作在起始时迅速累及双侧大脑半球的神经网络。

HP:0025191.name: obsolete Segmental myoclonic seizures
HP:0025191.name_cn: 过时性节段性肌阵挛发作

HP:0025192.name: Subtentorial periventricular white matter hyperdensity
HP:0025192.definition: Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the fourth cerebral ventricle (which is located beneath the tentorium of the cerebellum).
HP:0025192.name_cn: 幕下脑室周围白质高密度影
HP:0025192.definition_cn: 磁共振成像中信号强度高于预期的区域，源自第四脑室（位于小脑幕下方）周围的脑白质。

HP:0025193.name: Posterolateral diaphragmatic hernia
HP:0025193.definition: A posterolateral defect in the diaphragm, commonly referred to as a Bochdalek hernia, which is often accompanied by herniation of the stomach, intestines, liver, and/or spleen into the chest cavity.
HP:0025193.definition_cn: 膈肌后外侧缺损，通常称为Bochdalek疝，常伴有胃、肠、肝和/或脾脏疝入胸腔。

HP:0025194.name: Morgagni diaphragmatic hernia
HP:0025194.definition: An anterior retrosternal or parasternal hernia that can result in the herniation of liver or intestines into the chest cavity.
HP:0025194.definition_cn: 一种胸骨后或胸骨旁前疝，可导致肝脏或肠管疝入胸腔。

HP:0025195.name: Central diaphragmatic hernia
HP:0025195.definition: A congenital diaphragm defect involving the central tendinous (e.g., amuscular) portion of the diaphragm, whereby the entire rim of diaphragmatic musculature is present.
HP:0025195.definition_cn: 先天性膈肌缺损，涉及膈肌的中心腱性（例如，无肌性）部分，其中膈肌肌性边缘完整存在。

HP:0025196.name: Increased total iron binding capacity
HP:0025196.definition: An elevation in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. A high TIBC corresponds to a high transferrin concentration. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity.
HP:0025196.definition_cn: 总铁结合力（Total-Iron Binding Capacity, TIBC）升高，表示在加入过量放射性铁的情况下，血清铁的结合量增加。高TIBC对应于高转铁蛋白浓度。潜在（或游离）铁结合力是TIBC与实测血清铁之间的差值，对应于未与铁结合的转铁蛋白，即游离铁结合力。

HP:0025197.name: Inclusion body fibromatosis
HP:0025197.definition: A benign tumor made up of mostly myofibroblasts that appears almost exclusively on the digits of the hands and feet, rarely involving the thumb or big toe. The lesion displays a proliferation of bland intradermal spindle cells arranged in whorls, fascicles, or a storiform pattern in a collagenous background of varying degrees. Also usually present are perpendicular tumor cell fascicles that extend to the epidermis. The small intracytoplasmic inclusions are said to appear similar to red blood cells. The inclusion bodies have been shown to be made up of densely packed vimentin and actin filaments. The tumor often causes a dome-shaped elevation of the overlying structures, forming a protuberant or polypoid nodule. The overlying epidermis can display a host of changes, including acanthosis, hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, rete ridge flattening, entrapment of adnexal structures, and, rarely, ulceration.
HP:0025197.definition_cn: 一种主要由肌纤维母细胞组成的良性肿瘤，几乎仅见于手指和足趾，极少累及拇指或大脚趾。病变表现为在不同程度的胶原背景下，排列成漩涡状、束状或席纹状的温和的皮内梭形细胞增生。通常还可见垂直于表皮延伸的肿瘤细胞束。据称，细胞质内的小包涵体与红细胞相似。这些包涵体已被证实由密集排列的波形蛋白和肌动蛋白丝组成。肿瘤常导致覆盖结构呈圆顶状隆起，形成突出或息肉样结节。覆盖的表皮可显示多种变化，包括棘皮症、角化过度、角化不全、网状嵴扁平化、附属器结构陷闭，以及罕见的溃疡形成。

HP:0025198.name: Inflammatory cap polyp
HP:0025198.definition: A non-malignant sessile or pedunculated polyp in the colon and rectum that displays a cap of inflammatory granulation tissue with fibrinopurulent exudate that covers the polyp.
HP:0025198.definition_cn: 结肠和直肠中的一种非恶性无蒂或有蒂息肉，其表面覆盖有炎性肉芽组织，并伴有纤维蛋白脓性渗出物。

HP:0025199.name: Fragmented sleep
HP:0025199.definition: Sleep characterized by frequent interruptions, stopping and starting, which disrupt the normal progression of sleep stages.
HP:0025199.definition_cn: 睡眠特征表现为频繁中断、时断时续，干扰睡眠阶段的正常进程。

HP:0025200.name: Muscle fiber actin filament accumulation
HP:0025200.definition: Accumulation in muscle cells of filaments composed of actin.
HP:0025200.name_cn: 肌纤维肌动蛋白丝积聚
HP:0025200.definition_cn: 肌细胞内由肌动蛋白组成的微丝积聚。

HP:0025201.name: Abnormal circulating apolipoprotein concentration
HP:0025201.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration in blood of an apolipoprotein, i.e., of a protein that binds lipids to form lipoprotein and is thereby responsible for the transport of lipids in the blood and lymph circulation.
HP:0025201.name_cn: 异常循环载脂蛋白浓度
HP:0025201.definition_cn: 载脂蛋白（apolipoprotein）在血液中的浓度偏离正常值，即一种与脂质结合形成脂蛋白（lipoprotein）的蛋白质，从而负责脂质在血液和淋巴循环中的运输。

HP:0025202.name: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein A-IV concentration
HP:0025202.definition: An increased concentration in blood of apolipoprotein A-IV, a major component of HDL and chylomicrons that has a role in VLDL secretion and catabolism and is required for efficient activation of lipoprotein lipase by ApoC-II.
HP:0025202.name_cn: 循环载脂蛋白A-IV浓度升高
HP:0025202.definition_cn: 血液中载脂蛋白A-IV浓度升高，该蛋白是高密度脂蛋白（HDL）和乳糜微粒的主要成分，在极低密度脂蛋白（VLDL）的分泌和分解代谢中发挥作用，并且是载脂蛋白C-II（ApoC-II）有效激活脂蛋白脂肪酶所必需的。

HP:0025203.name: Caput medusae
HP:0025203.definition: Distended and engorged umbilical veins which are seen radiating from the umbilicus across the abdomen to join systemic veins.
HP:0025203.definition_cn: 扩张且充盈的脐静脉，可见其从脐部放射状延伸至腹部，并与体循环静脉相连接。

HP:0025204.name: Triggered by
HP:0025204.definition: A trigger is defined as an external factor that leads to the manifestation of a sign or symptom in a person with a susceptibility to developing that manifestation.
HP:0025204.definition_cn: 触发因素被定义为一种外部因素，其导致具有易感性个体出现某种体征或症状的表现。

HP:0025205.name: Triggered by breast feeding
HP:0025205.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by breast feeding in an infant.
HP:0025205.definition_cn: 适用于由母乳喂养引发或引起的婴儿体征或症状。

HP:0025206.name: Triggered by cold
HP:0025206.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to cold surroundings.
HP:0025206.definition_cn: 适用于因暴露于寒冷环境而诱发或引发的体征或症状。

HP:0025207.name: Triggered by dehydration
HP:0025207.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by being dehydrated, i.e., by a deficit in total body water.
HP:0025207.definition_cn: 适用于由脱水（即总体水分不足）引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025208.name: Triggered by carbohydrate ingestion
HP:0025208.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking carbohydrates.
HP:0025208.name_cn: 由碳水化合物摄入引发
HP:0025208.definition_cn: 适用于由摄入碳水化合物引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025209.name: Triggered by fructose ingestion
HP:0025209.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking fructose.
HP:0025209.definition_cn: 适用于由摄入果糖引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025210.name: Triggered by glucose ingestion
HP:0025210.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking glucose.
HP:0025210.definition_cn: 适用于由摄入或饮用葡萄糖引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025211.name: Triggered by ethanol ingestion
HP:0025211.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by drinking or otherwise ingesting ethanol.
HP:0025211.definition_cn: 适用于由饮用或摄入乙醇引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025212.name: Triggered by fasting
HP:0025212.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by abstaining from eating food (fasting).
HP:0025212.definition_cn: 适用于因禁食（空腹）而诱发或引发的体征或症状。

HP:0025213.name: Triggered by galactose ingestion
HP:0025213.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking galactose. Galactose usually is ingested as lactose, which is composed of equimolar amounts of glucose and galactose.
HP:0025213.definition_cn: 适用于由摄入或饮用半乳糖引发的体征或症状。半乳糖通常以乳糖形式摄入，乳糖由等摩尔量的葡萄糖和半乳糖组成。

HP:0025214.name: Triggered by heat
HP:0025214.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to heat.
HP:0025214.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于高温引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025215.name: Triggered by febrile illness
HP:0025215.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by febrile illness.
HP:0025215.definition_cn: 适用于由发热性疾病引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025216.name: Triggered by heavy meal
HP:0025216.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating large quantities of food, for instance, by a heavy meal.
HP:0025216.definition_cn: 适用于因摄入大量食物（例如，暴饮暴食）而诱发或引发的体征或症状。

HP:0025217.name: Triggered by high-fat diet
HP:0025217.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating a diet high in lipids.
HP:0025217.definition_cn: 适用于由高脂饮食诱发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025218.name: Triggered by hyperventilation
HP:0025218.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by excessively rapid and deep breathing.
HP:0025218.definition_cn: 适用于由过度快速和深呼吸引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025219.name: Triggered by vaccination
HP:0025219.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a vaccination.
HP:0025219.definition_cn: 适用于由疫苗接种引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025220.name: Triggered by menstruation
HP:0025220.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by menstruation in a female.
HP:0025220.definition_cn: 适用于由女性月经引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025221.name: Triggered by pregnancy
HP:0025221.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by pregnancy in a female.
HP:0025221.definition_cn: 适用于由女性妊娠引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025222.name: Triggered by sleep deprivation
HP:0025222.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a lack of sufficient sleep.
HP:0025222.definition_cn: 适用于由睡眠不足引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025223.name: Triggered by smoking
HP:0025223.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by smoking.
HP:0025223.definition_cn: 适用于由吸烟引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025224.name: Triggered by sodium ingestion
HP:0025224.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking sodium.
HP:0025224.definition_cn: 适用于由摄入钠盐引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025225.name: Triggered by sound
HP:0025225.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to sound or noise.
HP:0025225.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于声音或噪音引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025226.name: Triggered by stress
HP:0025226.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a physical, mental, or emotional factor associated with bodily or mental tension.
HP:0025226.definition_cn: 适用于由与身体或精神紧张相关的生理、心理或情感因素引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0025227.name: Triggered by excitement
HP:0025227.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a a state of excitement or by being startled.
HP:0025227.definition_cn: 适用于由兴奋状态或惊吓引发的体征或症状。

HP:0025228.name: Triggered by sudden movement
HP:0025228.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a sudden movement.
HP:0025228.definition_cn: 适用于由突然运动引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025229.name: Triggered by vestibular stimulation
HP:0025229.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by vestibular stimulation, including head turning, cold calorics, postural changes, or rotating chair.
HP:0025229.definition_cn: 适用于由前庭刺激引发或引起的体征或症状，包括头部转动、冷热试验、体位改变或旋转椅试验。

HP:0025231.name: Abnormal synovial bursa morphology
HP:0025231.definition: A structural anomaly of a synovial bursa.

HP:0025233.name: Sleep paralysis
HP:0025233.definition: An inability to move the body at the onset of sleep or upon awakening from sleep, lasting for seconds to a few minutes.
HP:0025233.definition_cn: 睡眠起始或觉醒时躯体运动不能，持续数秒至数分钟。

HP:0025234.name: Parasomnia
HP:0025234.definition: An undesirable physical event or experience that occurs during the process of falling asleep, while asleep, or when waking up from sleep.
HP:0025234.definition_cn: 睡眠期间发生的不良身体事件或体验，包括入睡过程中、睡眠期间或从睡眠中醒来时。

HP:0025235.name: NREM parasomnia
HP:0025235.definition: A parasomnia that occurs during non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep.
HP:0025235.name_cn: 非快速眼动睡眠期异态睡眠
HP:0025235.definition_cn: 一种发生于非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠期的异态睡眠。

HP:0025236.name: Somnambulism
HP:0025236.definition: Ambulation or other complex motor behaviors may occur after getting out of bed in a sleep-like state. During sleepwalking episodes, the individual who is somnambulating appears confused or dazed, with their eyes usually open. They may mumble or give inappropriate answers to questions, and occasionally appear agitated.
HP:0025236.definition_cn: 在类似睡眠状态下起床后，可能出现行走或其他复杂的运动行为。在梦游发作期间，梦游者表现出困惑或茫然，通常睁着眼睛。他们可能喃喃自语或对问题做出不恰当的回答，偶尔显得激动不安。

HP:0025237.name: Confusional arousal
HP:0025237.definition: A nocturnal episode is characterized by disorientation, grogginess, and, at times, significant agitation upon awakening from slow-wave sleep or following forced awakenings.
HP:0025237.definition_cn: 夜间发作的特征是在从慢波睡眠中醒来或被迫醒来后出现定向障碍、昏昏沉沉，有时伴有显著的激越状态。

HP:0025238.name: Foot pain
HP:0025238.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the foot.
HP:0025238.definition_cn: 一种以足部局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0025239.name: Subhyaloid hemorrhage
HP:0025239.definition: A localized detachment of the vitreous from the retina due to the accumulation of blood. When localized in the macular area, it results in sudden profound loss of vision. Subhyaloid premacular hemorrhage is typically characterized by a circumscribed, round or dumb-bell shaped, bright red mound of blood beneath the internal limiting membrane (ILM) or between the ILM and hyaloid face, in or near to the central macular area.
HP:0025239.definition_cn: 由于血液积聚导致的玻璃体与视网膜局部脱离。当局限于黄斑区时，会导致突然的严重视力丧失。黄斑前玻璃体下出血的典型特征是在内界膜（ILM）下方或内界膜与玻璃体面之间，位于或接近中央黄斑区，形成一个界限清楚、圆形或哑铃形的鲜红色血肿。

HP:0025240.name: Preretinal hemorrhage
HP:0025240.definition: An accumulation of blood between the neurosensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) arising from the choroidal or retinal circulation.
HP:0025240.definition_cn: 神经感觉视网膜与视网膜色素上皮（RPE）之间由于脉络膜或视网膜循环引起的血液积聚。

HP:0025241.name: Flame-shaped retinal hemorrhage
HP:0025241.definition: A type of retinal hemorrhage that is located within the nerve fiber layer (NFL) of the retina and that exhibits a characteristic flame shape which results from constraints by the structure of the NFL (axons of the ganglion cells).
HP:0025241.definition_cn: 一种位于视网膜神经纤维层（NFL）内的视网膜出血，其呈现出特征性的火焰状形态，这是由于神经纤维层（神经节细胞轴突）的结构限制所致。

HP:0025242.name: Dot-and-blot retinal hemorrhage
HP:0025242.definition: Accumulation of blood located in the retina's inner nuclear and outer plexiform layers, and having a dot-like or blot-like shape. THe shape results from intraretinal compression, restricting the hemorrhages within a specific location.
HP:0025242.name_cn: 点状和斑状视网膜出血
HP:0025242.definition_cn: 位于视网膜内核层和外丛状层的血液积聚，呈点状或斑片状。其形状由视网膜内压迫所致，将出血限制在特定位置。

HP:0025243.name: Subretinal hemorrhage
HP:0025243.definition: Accumulation of blood located beneath the neurosensory retina in the space between the neurosensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:0025243.definition_cn: 神经感觉视网膜与视网膜色素上皮之间的间隙内，神经感觉视网膜下方积血。

HP:0025244.name: Subretinal pigment epithelium hemorrhage
HP:0025244.definition: An accumulation of blood located between the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and Bruch's membrane.
HP:0025244.name_cn: 视网膜下色素上皮层出血
HP:0025244.definition_cn: 位于视网膜色素上皮（RPE）与布鲁赫膜（Bruch's membrane）之间的血液积聚。

HP:0025245.name: Cutaneous cyst
HP:0025245.definition: A hollow mass located in the skin that is surrounded by an epithelium-lined wall and is well demarcated from the adjacent tissue. Cysts are often said to be sac-like and may contain serous liquid or semisolid material.
HP:0025245.definition_cn: 位于皮肤内的囊性肿块，其壁由上皮细胞衬里，与邻近组织界限清晰。囊肿常被描述为囊状结构，内部可能含有浆液性液体或半固体物质。

HP:0025246.name: Trichilemmal cyst
HP:0025246.definition: Nontender, round and firm, but slightly compressible, intradermal or subcutaneous cyst measuring 0.5-5 cm in diameter. Trichilemmal cysts are acquired rather than congenital, and tend to appear on the scalp rather than the face, and to be intradermal rather than subcutaneous.
HP:0025246.definition_cn: 无压痛、圆形且坚实但略可压缩的皮内或皮下囊肿，直径0.5-5厘米。毛鞘囊肿为后天获得性而非先天性，通常出现在头皮而非面部，且多位于皮内而非皮下。

HP:0025247.name: Dermoid cyst
HP:0025247.definition: A congenital subcutaneous cyst that arises from entrapment of skin along the lines of embryonic fusion. In contrast to epidermal cysts, dermoid cysts tend to contain various adnexal structures such as hair, sebaceous, eccrine or apocrine glands. Dermoid cysts are present at birth, and are indolent, firm, deep, subcutaneous nodules. They are often located on the head and neck, and rarely in the anogenital area. Dermoid cysts are slowly progressive and can grow to a size of 1 to 4 cm.
HP:0025247.definition_cn: 一种先天性皮下囊肿，源于胚胎融合线处皮肤组织的嵌顿。与表皮囊肿不同，皮样囊肿通常包含多种附属器结构，如毛发、皮脂腺、外泌汗腺或顶泌汗腺。皮样囊肿在出生时即存在，表现为无痛、坚硬、深在的皮下结节。其常见于头颈部，罕见于肛生殖区。皮样囊肿进展缓慢，可生长至1至4厘米大小。

HP:0025248.name: Eruptive vellus hair cyst
HP:0025248.definition: A cutaneous cyst that is small (one or two millimeters in diameter) and painless, presenting as a follicular papule that usually is skin colored but may have a reddish or brownish tinge.
HP:0025248.definition_cn: 一种小型（直径为一至两毫米）且无痛的皮肤囊肿，表现为毛囊性丘疹，通常呈肤色，但可能带有微红或微褐色调。

HP:0025249.name: Comedo
HP:0025249.definition: A clogged cutaneous sebaceous follicle, which is a cutaneous gland that secretes sebum (usually into a hair follicle).
HP:0025249.definition_cn: 阻塞的皮肤皮脂腺毛囊，这是一种分泌皮脂（通常进入毛囊）的皮肤腺体。

HP:0025250.name: Closed comedo
HP:0025250.definition: A comedo in which the top of the pore is not stretched open and thus does not expose the clogged portion (which would appear black), hence the name whitehead.
HP:0025250.definition_cn: 一种粉刺，其毛孔顶部未扩张开放，因此未暴露堵塞部分（通常呈黑色），故称为白头粉刺。

HP:0025251.name: Open comedo
HP:0025251.definition: A comedo in which the part of the pore at the surface of the skin is stretched and open, exposing the contents of the comedo, which appear black.
HP:0025251.definition_cn: 开放性粉刺，其皮肤表面毛孔部分扩张并开放，暴露粉刺内容物，呈现黑色。

HP:0025252.name: Geographic tongue
HP:0025252.definition: An anomaly of the tongue characterized by loss (atrophy) of filiform papillae of the tongue, leaving areas of erythema (redness), surrounded by a serpiginous, white, hyperkeratotic border. The name geographic tongue refers to an appearance that is said to be similar to a map.
HP:0025252.definition_cn: 一种舌部异常，其特征为舌丝状乳头萎缩，导致红斑区域形成，周围环绕着蜿蜒的白色角化过度边缘。地图舌这一名称源于其外观被认为类似于地图。

HP:0025253.name: Claustrophobia
HP:0025253.definition: An abnormal fear of being in a closed or narrow space with no escape is called claustrophobia.
HP:0025253.definition_cn: 对处于封闭或狭窄空间且无法逃脱的异常恐惧称为幽闭恐惧症（Claustrophobia）。

HP:0025254.name: Ameliorated by
HP:0025254.definition: An ameliorating factor is defined as an external factor that leads to a sign or symptom that is already present improving or becoming more bearable
HP:0025254.definition_cn: 缓解因素被定义为一种外部因素，其导致已存在的体征或症状改善或变得更为可耐受。

HP:0025255.name: Ameliorated by pregnancy
HP:0025255.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by pregnancy in a female.
HP:0025255.definition_cn: 适用于女性在妊娠期间症状或体征得到改善或缓解的情况。

HP:0025256.name: Ameliorated by heat
HP:0025256.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by heat (including fever).
HP:0025256.definition_cn: 适用于通过热（包括发热）改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0025257.name: Ameliorated by carbohydrate ingestion
HP:0025257.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by eating or drinking carbohydrates including glucose (sugar).
HP:0025257.name_cn: 碳水化合物摄入后症状缓解
HP:0025257.definition_cn: 适用于通过摄入碳水化合物（包括葡萄糖）而得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0025258.name: Stiff neck
HP:0025258.definition: A sensation of tightness in the neck when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity. Neck stiffness often involves soreness and difficulty moving the neck, especially when trying to turn the head to the side.
HP:0025258.definition_cn: 颈部活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间静止后。颈部僵硬常伴随疼痛及活动受限，特别是在尝试侧向转动头部时。

HP:0025259.name: Stiff elbow
HP:0025259.definition: A sensation of tightness in the elbow joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025259.definition_cn: 肘关节活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间静止后更为明显。

HP:0025260.name: Stiff wrist
HP:0025260.definition: A sensation of tightness in the wrist joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025260.definition_cn: 腕关节活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间静止后。

HP:0025261.name: Stiff finger
HP:0025261.definition: A sensation of tightness in a finger joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025261.definition_cn: 手指关节在尝试活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间静止后。

HP:0025262.name: Stiff hip
HP:0025262.definition: A sensation of tightness in the hip joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025262.definition_cn: 髋关节活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间不活动后。

HP:0025263.name: Stiff knee
HP:0025263.definition: A sensation of tightness in the knee joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025263.definition_cn: 膝关节活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间静止后。

HP:0025264.name: Stiff ankle
HP:0025264.definition: A sensation of tightness in the ankle joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025264.definition_cn: 踝关节活动时出现紧绷感，尤其在长时间静止后更为明显。

HP:0025265.name: Stiff toe
HP:0025265.definition: A sensation of tightness in a toe joint when attempting to move it, especially after a period of inactivity.
HP:0025265.definition_cn: 尝试活动趾关节时，尤其是在一段时间的静止后，出现关节紧绷感。

HP:0025267.name: Snoring
HP:0025267.definition: Deep, noisy breathing during sleep, accompanied by hoarse or harsh sounds, is caused by the vibration of respiratory structures, especially the soft palate. This vibration results in sound due to obstructed air movement during breathing while sleeping.
HP:0025267.definition_cn: 睡眠期间出现的深沉、嘈杂的呼吸声，伴随嘶哑或刺耳的声音，是由于呼吸结构（尤其是软腭）的振动所致。这种振动是由于睡眠期间呼吸时气流受阻而产生的。

HP:0025268.name: Stuttering
HP:0025268.definition: Disruptions in the production of speech sounds, with involuntary repetitions of words or parts of words, prolongations of speech sounds, or complete blockage of speech production for several seconds.
HP:0025268.definition_cn: 言语发声障碍，表现为不自主的单词或部分单词重复、语音延长，或言语产生完全阻塞持续数秒。

HP:0025269.name: Panic attack
HP:0025269.definition: A sudden episode of intense fear in a situation where there is no danger or apparent cause.
