HP:0025270.name: Abnormal esophagus physiology
HP:0025270.definition: Any physiological abnormality of the esophagus.

HP:0025271.name: Esophageal spasms
HP:0025271.definition: Involuntary contractions of the esophagus that are irregular, uncoordinated, and painful.
HP:0025271.definition_cn: 食管不自主性、不规则、不协调且疼痛的收缩。

HP:0025272.name: Melasma
HP:0025272.definition_cn: 对称性、斑片状、棕褐色面部色素沉着。

HP:0025274.name: Ovarian dermoid cyst
HP:0025274.definition: An cystic ovarian teratoma composed of dermal and epidermal elements and containing tissue components including hair, teeth, bone, thyroid, and others.
HP:0025274.definition_cn: 一种囊性卵巢畸胎瘤，由真皮和表皮成分组成，并包含多种组织成分，如毛发、牙齿、骨骼、甲状腺等。

HP:0025275.name: Lateral
HP:0025275.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is located farther from the median plane or midline of the body or of the referenced structure.
HP:0025275.definition_cn: 适用于位于远离身体或参考结构的中线或正中平面的异常。

HP:0025276.name: Abnormality of skin adnexa physiology
HP:0025276.definition: Any functional anomaly of the skin adnexa (skin appendages), which are specialized skin structures located within the dermis and focally within the subcutaneous fatty tissue, comprising three histologically distinct structures: (1) the pilosebaceous unit (hair follicle and sebaceous glands); (2) the eccrine sweat glands; and (3) the apocrine glands.
HP:0025276.name_cn: 皮肤附属器生理功能异常
HP:0025276.definition_cn: 皮肤附属器（皮肤附件）的任何功能性异常，这些附属器是位于真皮层内并局部位于皮下脂肪组织中的特殊皮肤结构，包括三种组织学上不同的结构：（1）毛囊皮脂腺单位（毛囊和皮脂腺）；（2）外泌汗腺；（3）顶泌汗腺。

HP:0025277.name: Gustatory sweating
HP:0025277.definition: Hyperhidrosis that occurs with gustatory stimulation (e.g., moisture on face from sweating that occurs after eating).
HP:0025277.definition_cn: 味觉刺激引发的多汗症（例如，进食后面部因出汗而出现的湿润现象）。

HP:0025278.name: Cold-induced sweating
HP:0025278.definition: Sweating provoked by cold temperature rather than by heat.
HP:0025278.definition_cn: 低温诱发的汗液分泌而非高温所致。

HP:0025280.name: Pain characteristic
HP:0025280.definition: A pain characteristic is defined as a subjective category or type of pain.
HP:0025280.definition_cn: 疼痛特征被定义为主观类别或类型的疼痛。

HP:0025281.name: Sharp
HP:0025281.definition: Applied to pain that is described as sharp, i.e., sudden and severe.
HP:0025281.definition_cn: 适用于描述为锐痛（即突发且剧烈的疼痛）。

HP:0025282.name: Dull
HP:0025282.definition: Applied to pain that is dull, i.e., not severe but that continues over a long period of time.
HP:0025282.definition_cn: 适用于钝痛，即疼痛程度不剧烈但持续时间较长。

HP:0025283.name: Tender
HP:0025283.definition: Applied to pain that is tender, i.e., elicited by touching the affected body part.
HP:0025283.definition_cn: 应用于触痛，即通过触摸受影响的身体部位引发的疼痛。

HP:0025284.name: Sleep-interrupting
HP:0025284.definition: Applied to pain that wakes the affecting individual from sleep.
HP:0025284.definition_cn: 应用于导致患者从睡眠中醒来的疼痛。

HP:0025285.name: Aggravated by
HP:0025285.definition: An aggravating factor is defined as an external factor that leads to a sign or symptom that is already present getting worse or becoming more severe.
HP:0025285.definition_cn: 加重因素被定义为一种外部因素，导致已经存在的体征或症状恶化或变得更加严重。

HP:0025286.name: Aggravated by activity
HP:0025286.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by activity, exertion, or exercise.
HP:0025286.definition_cn: 应用于因活动、用力或运动而加重的体征或症状。

HP:0025287.name: Axial
HP:0025287.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the central part of the body, in the head and trunk as distinguished from the limbs.
HP:0025287.definition_cn: 适用于位于身体中央部分、头部和躯干的异常，与四肢相区别。

HP:0025288.name: Excessive sleep
HP:0025288.definition: A clinical phenomenon characterized by sleeping longer than what is typical or necessary for a person's age and context, or by recurrent episodes of sleep that intrude upon the waking hours. Excessive sleep is identified through self-reports or observations and may involve prolonged nighttime sleep, frequent daytime naps, or episodes of unintentional sleep.
HP:0025288.definition_cn: 一种临床现象，其特征为睡眠时间超过个体年龄及环境所需的典型或必要时长，或反复出现侵入觉醒时段的睡眠发作。过度睡眠可通过自我报告或观察发现，可能表现为夜间睡眠时间延长、频繁日间小睡或非意愿性睡眠发作。

HP:0025289.name: Cervical lymphadenopathy
HP:0025289.definition: Enlarged lymph nodes in the neck.

HP:0025290.name: Upper-body predominance
HP:0025290.definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the arms, trunk, head more than the legs.
HP:0025290.definition_cn: 适用于主要影响上肢、躯干和头部而非下肢的异常情况。

HP:0025291.name: Lower-body predominance
HP:0025291.definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the legs more than the arms, trunk, head.
HP:0025291.definition_cn: 适用于主要累及下肢而非上肢、躯干或头部的异常病变。

HP:0025292.name: Acral
HP:0025292.definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the distal portions of limbs (hand, foot) and head (ears, nose).
HP:0025292.definition_cn: 适用于影响肢体远端部分（手、足）和头部（耳、鼻）的异常情况。

HP:0025293.name: Distributed along Blaschko lines
HP:0025293.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose localization corresponds to the lines of Blaschko, which correspond to the lineage of epithelia cells. Blaschko lines are normally invisible but may become apparent with certain skin diseases and then can be seen to be distributed in lines horizontal to the body.
HP:0025293.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常，其定位对应于Blaschko线，这些线与上皮细胞的谱系相对应。Blaschko线在正常情况下不可见，但在某些皮肤病中可能显现，并可见其以水平于身体的方式分布。

HP:0025294.name: Dermatomal
HP:0025294.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose localization corresponds to the dermatomes, i.e., the nerve root distribution.
HP:0025294.definition_cn: 适用于异常定位与皮节相对应的病变，即神经根分布区域。

HP:0025295.name: Herpetiform
HP:0025295.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles that of the grouped umbilicated vesicles seen in herpes simplex and herpes zoster infections.
HP:0025295.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常病变，其分布和外观类似于单纯疱疹和带状疱疹感染中出现的成簇脐凹状水疱。

HP:0025296.name: Morbilliform
HP:0025296.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles that of measles, i.e., maculopapular lesions that are red and roughly 2 to 10 mm in diameter and may be partially confluent.
HP:0025296.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常病变，其分布和外观类似于麻疹，即表现为红色斑丘疹，直径约为2至10毫米，部分可能融合。

HP:0025297.name: Prolonged
HP:0025297.definition: Applied to an abnormality whose duration is extended over a longer period of time than is expected or usual (e.g., prolonged fever lasts longer than one usually sees with an infection).
HP:0025297.definition_cn: 应用于持续时间超过预期或通常情况的异常（例如，长期发热持续时间超过感染时通常所见）。

HP:0025298.name: Extended nighttime sleep
HP:0025298.definition: Sleeping for a longer duration than usual during the night.

HP:0025299.name: Frequent napping
HP:0025299.definition: Regular episodes of sleep that occur during the day outside of the main sleep period.

HP:0025300.name: Malar rash
HP:0025300.definition: An erythematous (red), flat facial rash that affects the skin in the malar area (over the cheekbones) and extends over the bridge of the nose.
HP:0025300.definition_cn: 一种红斑性（红色）、平坦的面部皮疹，累及颧骨区域（位于颧骨上方）的皮肤，并延伸至鼻梁。

HP:0025301.name: Nocturnal
HP:0025301.definition: Applies to an abnormality that occurs in or is exacerbated during the night.
HP:0025301.definition_cn: 适用于夜间发生或加重的异常情况。

HP:0025302.name: Diurnal
HP:0025302.definition: Applies to a sign, symptom, or other abnormality that occurs in or is exacerbated in the day time.
HP:0025302.definition_cn: 适用于在白天发生或加重的体征、症状或其他异常表现。

HP:0025303.name: Episodic
HP:0025303.definition: Applied to a sign, symptom, or other manifestation that occurs multiple times at usually irregular intervals. The occurrences are separated by an interval in which the sign, symptom, or manifestation is not present.
HP:0025303.definition_cn: 应用于一种体征、症状或其他表现，其在通常不规则的间隔内多次发生。这些发生之间由一段间隔期分隔，在此期间该体征、症状或表现不存在。

HP:0025304.name: Periodic
HP:0025304.definition: Applies to a sign, symptom, or other manifestation that recurs with a fixed time interval, i.e., the symptom-free periods are always of the same length.
HP:0025304.definition_cn: 适用于以固定时间间隔复发的体征、症状或其他表现，即无症状期始终具有相同的持续时间。

HP:0025305.name: Quotidian
HP:0025305.definition: Applies to a sign, symptom, or other manifestation that is episodic with a fixed time interval of one day (24 hours).
HP:0025305.definition_cn: 适用于以固定时间间隔（24小时）为周期发作的体征、症状或其他临床表现。

HP:0025306.name: Acute emergence over minutes
HP:0025306.definition: Acute appearance of disease manifestations in a period of minutes.
HP:0025306.definition_cn: 疾病表现在数分钟内急性发作。

HP:0025307.name: Acute emergence over hours
HP:0025307.definition: Acute appearance of disease manifestations in a period of hours.
HP:0025307.definition_cn: 疾病表现在数小时内急性发作。

HP:0025308.name: Acute emergence over days
HP:0025308.definition: Acute appearance of disease manifestations in a period of days.
HP:0025308.definition_cn: 疾病表现在数日内急性发作。

HP:0025309.name: Abnormal pupil shape
HP:0025309.definition: A deviation from the normal circular shape of the pupil
HP:0025309.definition_cn: 瞳孔形态异常（偏离正常圆形）

HP:0025310.name: Oval pupil
HP:0025310.definition: An abnormal pupil shape that is elliptical, i.e., egg-like.
HP:0025310.definition_cn: 椭圆形瞳孔异常，即卵圆形瞳孔。

HP:0025311.name: Anterior chamber cyst
HP:0025311.definition: A closed sac, having a distinct membrane and division compared to the nearby tissue located within the anterior chamber. The sac that may contain air, fluids, or semi-solid material.
HP:0025311.definition_cn: 位于前房内的一个封闭囊状结构，具有明显的膜性分隔，与周围组织界限清晰。该囊内可能含有气体、液体或半固体物质。

HP:0025312.name: Esophoria
HP:0025312.definition: A form of strabismus with both eyes turned inward to a relatively mild degree, usually defined as less than 10 prism diopters.
HP:0025312.definition_cn: 一种内斜视形式，双眼向内偏斜程度相对较轻，通常定义为小于10棱镜屈光度。

HP:0025313.name: Exophoria
HP:0025313.definition: A form of strabismus with one or both eyes deviated outward to a milder degree than with exotropia.
HP:0025313.definition_cn: 一种斜视形式，表现为单眼或双眼向外偏斜，但偏斜程度较外斜视轻微。

HP:0025314.name: Choroidal nevus
HP:0025314.definition: A benign, flat or slightly elevated melanocytic lesions of the posterior uveawith clearly defined margins. Choroidal nevi tend they remain stable in size, and to display features such as overlying drusen as well as retinal pigment epithelial atrophy, hyperplasia or fibrous metaplasia.
HP:0025314.definition_cn: 一种位于后葡萄膜的良性、平坦或轻微隆起的黑色素细胞病变，边界清晰。脉络膜痣通常保持大小稳定，并可能表现出覆盖的玻璃膜疣以及视网膜色素上皮萎缩、增生或纤维化等特征。

HP:0025315.name: Exacerbated by head trauma
HP:0025315.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is worsened, aggravated, or exacerbated by head trauma.
HP:0025315.name_cn: 头部创伤导致的病情加重
HP:0025315.definition_cn: 适用于因头部创伤而加重、恶化或加剧的体征或症状。

HP:0025317.name: Cubitus varus
HP:0025317.definition: A deformity of the elbow in which there is a deviation of the forearm toward the midline of the body.
HP:0025317.definition_cn: 肘关节畸形，表现为前臂向身体中线偏斜。

HP:0025318.name: Ovarian carcinoma
HP:0025318.definition: A malignant neoplasm originating from the surface ovarian epithelium.
HP:0025318.definition_cn: 源自卵巢表面上皮的恶性肿瘤。

HP:0025320.name: Leakage of dye on fundus fluorescein angiography
HP:0025320.definition: Leakage of fluorescein dye observed upon retinal fluorescein angiography. Areas of leakage can be appreciated as showing gradual enlargement with blurring of margins.
HP:0025320.name_cn: 眼底荧光素血管造影中的染料渗漏
HP:0025320.definition_cn: 视网膜荧光素血管造影中观察到荧光素渗漏。渗漏区域表现为逐渐扩大且边缘模糊。

HP:0025321.name: Copper accumulation in liver
HP:0025321.definition: An anomalous build up of copper (Cu) in the liver.

HP:0025322.name: Venous occlusion
HP:0025322.definition: Blockage of venous return (flow of blood from the periphery back towards the right atrium) in a vein.
HP:0025322.definition_cn: 静脉回流阻塞（血液从外周回流至右心房的过程在静脉中受阻）。

HP:0025324.name: Arterial occlusion
HP:0025324.definition: Blockage of blood flow through an artery.

HP:0025325.name: Sparse medial eyebrow
HP:0025325.definition: Decreased density/number and/or decreased diameter of medial eyebrow hairs.
HP:0025325.definition_cn: 内侧眉毛毛发密度/数量减少和/或直径减小。

HP:0025326.name: Retinal arterial occlusion
HP:0025326.definition: Blockage of the retinal artery, generally associated with interruption of blood flow and oxygen delivery to the retina.
HP:0025326.definition_cn: 视网膜动脉阻塞，通常与视网膜血流中断及氧供中断相关。

HP:0025327.name: Decreased renal parenchymal thickness
HP:0025327.definition: Reduced dimension of the solid part of the kidney (parenchyma, the renal cortex and medulla) as measured from the collecting system (renal calyces and pelvis) to the border of the kidney. This measurement can be performed by measuring the thickness of the parenchyma in computed tomography scans.
HP:0025327.definition_cn: 肾脏实性部分（肾实质，包括肾皮质和肾髓质）的尺寸减小，测量范围从集合系统（肾盏和肾盂）至肾脏边界。该测量可通过计算机断层扫描中肾实质厚度的测量来完成。

HP:0025328.name: Antepartum hemorrhage
HP:0025328.definition: Significant maternal hemorrhage/bleed in the second half of pregnancy and prior to the birth of the baby.
HP:0025328.definition_cn: 妊娠晚期及分娩前显著母体出血。

HP:0025329.name: Anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase antibody positivity
HP:0025329.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against glutamic acid decarboxylase.
HP:0025329.name_cn: 抗谷氨酸脱羧酶抗体阳性
HP:0025329.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对谷氨酸脱羧酶的自身体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0025330.name: Downgaze palsy
HP:0025330.definition: A limitation of the ability to direct one's gaze below the horizontal meridian.
HP:0025330.definition_cn: 水平子午线下注视能力受限。

HP:0025331.name: Upgaze palsy
HP:0025331.definition: A limitation of the ability to direct one's gaze above the horizontal meridian.
HP:0025331.definition_cn: 水平子午线上方注视能力受限。

HP:0025332.name: Abnormality of foot cortical bone
HP:0025332.definition: An anomaly of the outer shell (cortex) of a foot bone.

HP:0025333.name: Cortical thinning of foot bones
HP:0025333.definition: A reduction in the thickness of the outer shell (cortex) of foot bones.

HP:0025334.name: Triggered by emotion
HP:0025334.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by a strong spontaneously arising mental state, reaction or feeling (emotion).
HP:0025334.definition_cn: 适用于由强烈的自发性心理状态、反应或情感（情绪）引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0025335.name: Delayed ability to stand
HP:0025335.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to stand up at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children begin to walk alone at 11 to 15 months of age. On average, children can stand while holding on at the age of 9 to 10 months, can pull up to stand and walk with one hand being held at 12 months, and can stand alone and walk well at 18 months.
HP:0025335.definition_cn: 未能达到适龄发育阶段的站立能力。大多数儿童在11至15个月大时开始独立行走。平均而言，儿童在9至10个月大时能够扶物站立，12个月大时能够扶物站起并在单手扶持下行走，18个月大时能够独立站立并行走良好。

HP:0025336.name: Delayed ability to sit
HP:0025336.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to sit at an appropriate developmental stage. Most children sit with support at 6 months of age and sit steadily without support at 9 months of age.
HP:0025336.definition_cn: 在适当发育阶段未能获得坐立能力。大多数儿童在6个月大时可在辅助下坐立，在9个月大时可独立稳定坐立。

HP:0025337.name: Red eye
HP:0025337.definition: A reddish appearance over the white part (sclera) of the eye ranging from a few enlarged blood vessels appearing as wiggly lines over the sclera to a bright red color completely covering to sclera.
HP:0025337.definition_cn: 眼球白色部分（巩膜）呈现红色外观，范围从巩膜上出现几条增粗的血管，表现为蜿蜒的线条，到完全覆盖巩膜的鲜红色。

HP:0025338.name: Circumlimbal hyperemia
HP:0025338.definition: A ring of redness at the limbus of the eye, the border between the cornea and the sclera.
HP:0025338.definition_cn: 角膜缘处出现一圈红斑，即角膜与巩膜交界处。

HP:0025339.name: Superficial episcleral hyperemia
HP:0025339.definition: Prominence of blood vessels of the superficial episcleral tissues.
HP:0025339.definition_cn: 表层巩膜组织血管突出。

HP:0025340.name: Deep episcleral hyperemia
HP:0025340.definition: Prominence of blood vessels of the deep episcleral tissues.
HP:0025340.definition_cn: 深层巩膜组织血管突出。

HP:0025341.name: Corneal keratic precipitates
HP:0025341.definition: An inflammatory cellular deposit deposited on the corneal endothelium and visible as spots on the cornea.
HP:0025341.definition_cn: 角膜内皮上沉积的炎性细胞沉积物，在角膜上可见为斑点。

HP:0025342.name: Central retinal artery occlusion
HP:0025342.definition: Blockage of the main artery in the retina. The typical presentation is one of profound monocular visual loss.
HP:0025342.definition_cn: 视网膜中央动脉阻塞。典型表现为单眼视力严重丧失。

HP:0025343.name: Lupus anticoagulant
HP:0025343.definition: Presence of lupus anticoagulant (LA) autoantibodies. LA represent a heterogeneous group of autoantibodies, IgG, IgM, or a mixture of both classes, that interfere with standard phospholipid-based coagulant tests (this is only an in vitro phenomenon, LA do not cause reduction of coagulation in vivo). The antibodies are directed against plasma proteins which also bind to phospholipid surfaces.
HP:0025343.definition_cn: 存在狼疮抗凝物（Lupus Anticoagulant, LA）自身抗体。LA代表了一组异质性自身抗体，包括IgG、IgM或两者混合，这些抗体干扰基于标准磷脂的凝血试验（这仅是一种体外现象，LA不会导致体内凝血功能降低）。这些抗体针对与磷脂表面结合的血浆蛋白。

HP:0025344.name: Interlobular bile duct destruction
HP:0025344.definition: Damage to and obliteration of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts).
HP:0025344.definition_cn: 肝内胆管损伤及闭塞（肝内胆管负责在赫令管与叶间胆管之间输送胆汁）。

HP:0025345.name: Abnormality of circulating beta-2-microglobulin level
HP:0025345.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of beta-2-microglobulin in the blood.
HP:0025345.name_cn: 循环β2-微球蛋白水平异常
HP:0025345.definition_cn: 血液中β2-微球蛋白浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0025346.name: Increased circulating beta-2-microglobulin level
HP:0025346.definition: Elevated concentration of beta-2-microglobulin in the blood.
HP:0025346.name_cn: 循环中β2-微球蛋白水平升高
HP:0025346.definition_cn: 血清中β-2-微球蛋白浓度升高。

HP:0025347.name: Decreased circulating beta-2-microglobulin level
HP:0025347.definition: Reduced concentration of beta-2-microglobulin in the blood.
HP:0025347.name_cn: 循环β2-微球蛋白水平降低
HP:0025347.definition_cn: 血液中β2-微球蛋白浓度降低。

HP:0025348.name: Abnormal corneal limbus morphology
HP:0025348.definition: An anomaly of the margin of the cornea overlapped by the sclera.
HP:0025348.definition_cn: 角膜边缘被巩膜重叠的异常。

HP:0025349.name: Limbal edema
HP:0025349.definition: Swelling of the margin of the cornea overlapped by the sclera.
HP:0025349.definition_cn: 巩膜覆盖的角膜缘肿胀。

HP:0025350.name: Giant conjunctival papillae
HP:0025350.definition: Conjunctival papillae with a diameter greater than 1 millimeter. They characteristically have flattened tops which sometimes demonstrate staining with fluorescein.
HP:0025350.definition_cn: 直径大于1毫米的结膜乳头。其特征为顶部扁平，有时可见荧光素染色。

HP:0025351.name: Recurrent interdigital mycosis
HP:0025351.definition: A history of repeated fungal infections located between the fingers or toes, usually manifested by scaling, maceration, and itching. The toes are more commonly affected than the fingers.
HP:0025351.definition_cn: 指间或趾间反复真菌感染病史，通常表现为鳞屑、浸渍和瘙痒。趾部较指部更常受累。

HP:0025352.name: Typically de novo
HP:0025352.definition: Description of conditions that are exclusively or predominantly observed to display de novo variants. In some cases, this may be due to the limited reproductive fitness of affected individuals.
HP:0025352.definition_cn: 描述那些主要或完全表现为新生变异的疾病状况。在某些情况下，这可能是由于受影响个体的生殖适应性受限所致。

HP:0025353.name: Anti-multiple nuclear dots antibody positivity
HP:0025353.definition: A type of antinuclear antibody (ANA) positivity revealed by indirect immunofluorescence (IFL). The multiple nuclear dots (MND) pattern is immunomorphologically characterized by the staining of 3-20 dots of variable size distributed all over the cell nucleus, but sparing the nucleoli, and, in contrast to the anticentromere pattern, MND reactivity does not stain the chromosomes in mitotic cells.
HP:0025353.definition_cn: 一种通过间接免疫荧光法（IFL）检测到的抗核抗体（ANA）阳性类型。多核点（MND）模式在免疫形态学上表现为细胞核内分布着3至20个大小不一的点状染色，但核仁不被染色。与抗着丝粒模式不同，MND反应性在有丝分裂细胞中不会对染色体进行染色。

HP:0025354.name: Abnormal cellular phenotype
HP:0025354.definition: An anomaly of cellular morphology or physiology.
HP:0025354.definition_cn: 细胞形态学或生理学异常

HP:0025355.name: Retinal arterial macroaneurysms
HP:0025355.definition: Acquired focal dilatations of branches of the retinal artery, usually second-order retinal arterioles, that range in size from 100 to 200 micrometers in diameter. Macroaneurysms are generally located at the temporal retina and may be hemorrhagic or exudative.
HP:0025355.definition_cn: 获得性视网膜动脉分支局灶性扩张，通常为二级视网膜小动脉，直径范围为100至200微米。大动脉瘤通常位于颞侧视网膜，可能为出血性或渗出性。

HP:0025356.name: obsolete Psychomotor retardation
HP:0025356.name_cn: 过时的精神运动性迟缓

HP:0025357.name: Erratic myoclonus
HP:0025357.definition: A type of myoclonus in which the myoclonias shift from body region to another in a random and asynchronous fashion. Erratic myoclonus can affect the face or limbs, are brief, single or repetitive, very frequent and nearly continuous.
HP:0025357.definition_cn: 一种肌阵挛类型，其中肌阵挛以随机和异步的方式从一个身体区域转移到另一个身体区域。不规则肌阵挛可影响面部或四肢，表现为短暂、单次或重复发作，频率极高且几乎持续不断。

HP:0025358.name: Uveal ectropion
HP:0025358.definition: Presence of iris pigment epithelium on the anterior surface of the iris.
HP:0025358.definition_cn: 虹膜前表面存在虹膜色素上皮。

HP:0025359.name: Polygonal renal calices
HP:0025359.definition: An abnormal polygonal shape of the calices of the kidney (which normally have a rounded or cup-shaped appearance).
HP:0025359.definition_cn: 肾盏异常多边形形态（通常呈圆形或杯状外观）。

HP:0025360.name: Polycalycosis
HP:0025360.definition: Increased number of calices of the kidney.

HP:0025361.name: Abnormal medullary pyramid morphology
HP:0025361.definition: A structural anomaly of the pyramid of the adult kidney, cone-shaped structures with a broad base adjacent to the renal cortex and the narrow apex that is termed papilla.
HP:0025361.definition_cn: 成人肾脏锥体结构异常，呈锥形结构，其宽基底邻近肾皮质，狭窄的尖端称为乳头。

HP:0025362.name: Renal medullary pyramid hypoplasia
HP:0025362.definition: Undergrowth of the pyramid of the adult kidney, cone-shaped structures with a broad base adjacent to the renal cortex and the narrow apex that is termed papilla.
HP:0025362.definition_cn: 成人肾脏锥体的下结构，呈锥形，其宽基底邻近肾皮质，狭窄的顶端称为乳头。

HP:0025363.name: Glomerular endocapillary hypercellularity
HP:0025363.definition: Hypercellularity due to increased number of cells within glomerular capillary lumina, causing narrowing of the lumina.
HP:0025363.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管内细胞增生
HP:0025363.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管腔内细胞数量增多导致的高细胞性，引起管腔狭窄。

HP:0025364.name: Glomerular extracapillary hypercellularity
HP:0025364.definition: Hypercellularity (increased number of cells) in the renal glomerulus but external to the glomerular capillaries, i.e., in the Bowman space or more than one layer of parietal or visceral epithelial cells.
HP:0025364.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管外细胞增生
HP:0025364.definition_cn: 肾小球内细胞增多（细胞数量增加），位于肾小球毛细血管外部，即鲍曼囊腔或壁层上皮细胞或脏层上皮细胞超过一层。

HP:0025365.name: Free-running sleep pattern
HP:0025365.definition: A condition in which the intrinsic circadian rhythm is no longer entrained to the 24-h schedule. Normal individuals who are exposed to an environment devoid of zeitgebers develop free-running rhythms with a period longer than 24 h.
HP:0025365.definition_cn: 一种内在昼夜节律不再与24小时周期同步的状态。正常个体在缺乏授时因子的环境中会形成周期长于24小时的自激节律。

HP:0025367.name: Trichoepithelioma
HP:0025367.definition: A benign hair follicle tumor whose tumor cells form rudimentary hair follicles but not actual hair shafts. A trichoepithelioma is usually less than one centimeter, firm, round, and shihy with yellow, pink, brown, or bluish color. They may occur multiply, usually on the face, and may gradually increase in number with age.
HP:0025367.definition_cn: 一种良性毛囊肿瘤，其肿瘤细胞形成原始毛囊但不形成实际毛干。毛发上皮瘤通常直径小于一厘米，质地坚实，呈圆形，表面光滑，颜色可为黄色、粉红色、棕色或蓝色。它们可多发，通常位于面部，并可能随着年龄增长而逐渐增多。

HP:0025368.name: Abnormal growth plate morphology
HP:0025368.definition: A structural anomaly of the growth plates (epiphyseal plates), areas of cartilage located near the ends of long bones that are located between the metaphysis (widened part of the shaft of the bone) and the epiphysis (end of the bone) and in which growth occurs in the developing bone. After conclusion of bone growth, the growth plates ossify (harden into solid bone).
HP:0025368.definition_cn: 生长板（骨骺板）的结构异常，生长板是位于长骨末端附近的软骨区域，位于干骺端（骨干的增宽部分）和骨骺（骨端）之间，在发育中的骨骼中发生生长。骨骼生长结束后，生长板骨化（硬化成实心骨）。

HP:0025369.name: Thick growth plates
HP:0025369.definition: Increased thickness (dimension along the axis of the bone) of the growth plate.
HP:0025369.definition_cn: 生长板厚度（沿骨轴方向的尺寸）增加。

HP:0025370.name: Abnormal ossification of the sacrum
HP:0025370.definition: Abnormal bone tissue formation (ossification) affecting the sacrum.
HP:0025370.definition_cn: 骶骨异常骨组织形成（骨化）。

HP:0025371.name: Delayed ossification of the sacrum
HP:0025371.definition: Formation of the sacrum bone tissue occurs later than age-adjusted norms.
HP:0025371.definition_cn: 骶骨骨组织的形成晚于年龄调整标准。

HP:0025372.name: Loud snoring
HP:0025372.definition: Snoring at a particularly loud or abnormally high volume.
HP:0025372.definition_cn: 异常高音量的鼾声（Abnormally Loud Snoring）

HP:0025373.name: Interictal EEG abnormality
HP:0025373.definition: Interictal refers to a period of time between epileptic seizures. Electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns are important in the differential diagnosis of epilepsy, and the EEG is almost always abnormal during a seizure. Some persons with seizures may show EEG abnormalities between seizures, while others do not. In some cases, multiple interictal EEGs must be recorded before an abnormality is observed. In most cases the electrographic pattern of seizure onset is completely different from the activity recorded during interictal discharge.
HP:0025373.definition_cn: 发作间期（Interictal）指的是癫痫发作之间的时间段。脑电图（Electroencephalographic, EEG）模式在癫痫的鉴别诊断中具有重要意义，且在癫痫发作期间，脑电图几乎总是异常的。部分癫痫患者在发作间期可能表现出脑电图异常，而另一些则不会。在某些情况下，可能需要记录多次发作间期脑电图才能观察到异常。在大多数情况下，癫痫发作起始的电图模式与发作间期放电期间记录的活动完全不同。

HP:0025374.name: Duplicated odontoid process
HP:0025374.definition: The presence of two distinct odontoid processes. The odontoid process, also known as the dens of the axis, is a protuberance of the C2 vertebral body around which the first vertebra rotates.
HP:0025374.definition_cn: 存在两个独立的齿状突。齿状突，也称为枢椎齿突，是C2椎体的突起，第一椎体围绕其旋转。

HP:0025375.name: Orthotopic os odontoideum
HP:0025375.definition: Os odontoideum is classified into two anatomic types (orthotopic and dystopic). Os odontoideum is defined as an ossicle that consists of smooth and separate caudal portions of the odontoid process.With dystopic os odontoideum, the ossicle is located near the basion or is fused with the clivus.
HP:0025375.definition_cn: 齿状突骨（Os odontoideum）被分为两种解剖类型（正位型和异位型）。齿状突骨被定义为由齿状突的平滑且分离的尾侧部分组成的骨片。在异位型齿状突骨中，骨片位于颅底点（basion）附近或与斜坡（clivus）融合。

HP:0025376.name: Hyperglutaminuria
HP:0025376.definition: An increased concentration of glutamine in the urine.
HP:0025376.definition_cn: 尿液中谷氨酰胺浓度升高。

HP:0025377.name: Triggered by exertion
HP:0025377.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exertion or physical exercise.
HP:0025377.definition_cn: 适用于由体力活动或体育锻炼诱发或引发的体征或症状。

HP:0025379.name: Anti-thyroid peroxidase antibody positivity
HP:0025379.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against thyroid peroxidase.
HP:0025379.name_cn: 抗甲状腺过氧化物酶抗体阳性
HP:0025379.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对甲状腺过氧化物酶的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0025380.name: Increased circulating androstenedione concentration
HP:0025380.definition: Increased concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation.
HP:0025380.name_cn: 循环中雄烯二酮浓度升高
HP:0025380.definition_cn: 血液循环中雄烯二酮浓度升高。

HP:0025381.name: Anti-pituitary antibody positivity
HP:0025381.definition: Circulating antipituitary antibodies (APA) are markers of autoimmune hypophysitis, which may cause deficient pituitary function.
HP:0025381.definition_cn: 循环抗垂体抗体（Circulating Antipituitary Antibodies, APA）是自身免疫性垂体炎（Autoimmune Hypophysitis）的标志物，可能导致垂体功能减退（Deficient Pituitary Function）。

HP:0025382.name: Hypodipsia
HP:0025382.definition: Reduced fluid intake (drinking) in a clinical situation where the plasma molarity or sodium concentration normally would induce greater fluid intake.
HP:0025382.definition_cn: 在临床情况下，血浆摩尔浓度或钠浓度通常会引发更多的液体摄入，但此时液体摄入量减少。

HP:0025383.name: Dorsocervical fat pad
HP:0025383.definition: An area of fat accumulation at the back of the neck in the form of a hump.
HP:0025383.definition_cn: 颈后部脂肪堆积形成的驼峰样区域。

HP:0025384.name: Diet-resistant subcutaneous adipose tissue
HP:0025384.definition: Areas of subcutanous fat tissue that are resistant to (do not respond as expected to) diet, life-style alteration, or bariatric surgery.
HP:0025384.name_cn: 饮食抵抗性皮下脂肪组织
HP:0025384.definition_cn: 对饮食、生活方式改变或减重手术反应不佳（未达到预期效果）的皮下脂肪组织区域。

HP:0025385.name: Diet-resistant subcutaneous adipose tissue below waist
HP:0025385.definition: Areas of subcutanous fat tissue below the waist that are resistant to (do not respond as expected to) diet, life-style alteration, or bariatric surgery.
HP:0025385.name_cn: 腰围以下抗饮食性皮下脂肪组织
HP:0025385.definition_cn: 腰部以下皮下脂肪组织区域对饮食、生活方式改变或减重手术无反应（未达到预期效果）。

HP:0025386.name: Bitemporal hollowing
HP:0025386.definition: Depression of profile in both temporal regions.

HP:0025387.name: Pill-rolling tremor
HP:0025387.definition: A type of resting tremor characterized by simultaneous rubbing movements of thumb and index fingers against each other.
HP:0025387.definition_cn: 一种静止性震颤，其特征为拇指和食指相互摩擦的同步运动。

HP:0025388.name: Thyroid nodule
HP:0025388.definition: A nodular lesion that develops in the thyroid gland. The term \
HP:0025388.definition_cn: 甲状腺内发生的结节性病变。术语“\

HP:0025389.name: Pulmonary interstitial high-resolution computed tomography abnormality
HP:0025389.definition: High-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) can distinguish findings that characterize characterize interstitial lung diseases in a way not possible with other modalities.
HP:0025389.name_cn: 肺间质高分辨率计算机断层扫描异常
HP:0025389.definition_cn: 高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）能够以其他影像学方法无法实现的方式区分间质性肺疾病的特征性表现。

HP:0025390.name: Reticular pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025390.definition: On pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography, reticular pattern is characterized by innumerable interlacing shadows suggesting a mesh.
HP:0025390.name_cn: 肺部高分辨率CT上的网状影
HP:0025390.definition_cn: 在肺部高分辨率计算机断层扫描中，网状模式的特征是无数交织的阴影，呈现出网状结构。

HP:0025391.name: Crazy paving pattern
HP:0025391.definition: The so-called crazy paving pattern appears as thickened interlobular septa and intralobular lines superimposed on a background of ground-glass opacity, resembling irregularly shaped paving stones. The crazy-paving pattern is often sharply demarcated from more normal lung and may have a geographic outline. It was originally reported in patients with alveolar proteinosis and is also encountered in other diffuse lung diseases that affect both the interstitial and airspace compartments, such as lipoid pneumonia.
HP:0025391.definition_cn: 所谓的“碎石路征”表现为在磨玻璃影背景下增厚的小叶间隔和小叶内线，类似于不规则形状的铺路石。碎石路征通常与正常肺组织界限分明，可能具有地图样轮廓。该征象最初在肺泡蛋白沉积症患者中报道，也见于其他同时累及间质和气腔的弥漫性肺疾病，如脂质性肺炎。

HP:0025392.name: Nodular pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025392.definition: A nodular pattern is characterized on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography by the presence of numerous rounded opacities that range from 2 mm to 1 cm in diameter, with micronodules defined as smaller than 3 mm in diameter.
HP:0025392.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT（HRCT）上的结节样模式
HP:0025392.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描中，结节样模式的特征表现为存在大量直径在2毫米至1厘米之间的圆形致密影，其中微结节定义为直径小于3毫米的病变。

HP:0025393.name: Reticulonodular pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025393.definition: Co-occurrence of reticular and micronodular patterns on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography.
HP:0025393.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT上的网状结节影
HP:0025393.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描中网状和微结节模式的共存。

HP:0025394.name: Cystic pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025394.definition: On pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography, the cystic pattern is composed by well-defined, round and circumscribed air-containing parenchymal spaces with a well-defined wall and interface with normal lung. The wall of the cysts may be uniform or varied in thickness, but usually is thin (less than 2 mm) and occurs without associated emphysema.
HP:0025394.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT上的囊性病变模式
HP:0025394.definition_cn: 在肺部高分辨率计算机断层扫描中，囊性模式由边界清晰、圆形且局限的含气实质空间组成，这些空间具有明确的壁和与正常肺组织的界面。囊壁的厚度可能均匀或变化，但通常较薄（小于2毫米），并且不伴有肺气肿。

HP:0025395.name: Combined cystic and ground-glass pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025395.definition: Co-occurrence of the cystic pattern and the ground-glass pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography,
HP:0025395.name_cn: 肺部高分辨率CT（HRCT）上显示的囊性和磨玻璃样混合型病变
HP:0025395.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描中囊性病变与磨玻璃影共存，

HP:0025396.name: Decreased attenuation pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025396.definition: Areas of low density corresponding to parenchymal destruction and reduced perfusion, and attenuation of the pulmonary vasculature, as visualized on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography.
HP:0025396.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT（HRCT）上显示的低衰减模式
HP:0025396.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）显示，低密度区域对应于实质破坏和灌注减少，以及肺血管系统的衰减。

HP:0025397.name: Mosaic attenuation pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025397.definition: A patchwork of intermingled areas of increased and decreased attenuation visualized on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography.
HP:0025397.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT（HRCT）上的马赛克衰减模式
HP:0025397.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描中可见混杂的密度增高和密度减低区域呈斑片状分布。

HP:0025398.name: Nodular-perilymphatic pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025398.definition: A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography that has a perilymphatic distribution.
HP:0025398.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT（HRCT）上的结节-淋巴管周围型分布模式
HP:0025398.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示结节样病变，呈淋巴管周围分布。

HP:0025399.name: Nodular-centrilobular with tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025399.definition: A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography that displays a tree-in-bud pattern, representing centrilobular branching structures that resemble a budding tree.
HP:0025399.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT显示结节性小叶中心性分布伴树芽征。
HP:0025399.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）上呈现树芽征的结节样模式，代表类似于发芽树木的细支气管中心性分支结构。

HP:0025400.name: Nodular-random pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0025400.definition: A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography that has an apparently random pattern.
HP:0025400.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT上的结节-随机分布模式
HP:0025400.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描显示结节样病变，呈明显随机分布模式。

HP:0025401.name: Staring gaze
HP:0025401.definition: An abnormality in which the eyes are held permanently wide open.

HP:0025402.name: Square-wave jerks
HP:0025402.definition: Square wave jerks are saccadic eye movements which, when recorded with open eyes are considered to be a pathological sign, caused by fixation instability, and pointing to a central neurological lesion.
HP:0025402.definition_cn: 方波急动是眼球的快速扫视运动，在睁眼记录时被视为一种病理体征，由注视不稳定引起，并提示存在中枢神经系统病变。

HP:0025403.name: Stooped posture
HP:0025403.definition: A habitual positioning of the body with the head and upper back bent forward.
HP:0025403.definition_cn: 头部和上背部前倾的体位习惯。

HP:0025404.name: Abnormal visual fixation
HP:0025404.definition: Any anomaly in the process of ocular fixation, which is the maintaining of the visual gaze on a single location.
HP:0025404.definition_cn: 眼球固视过程中的任何异常，即维持视觉注视于单一位置的能力出现障碍。

HP:0025405.name: Visual fixation instability
HP:0025405.definition: A deficit in the ability to fixate eye movements in order to stabilize images on the retina
HP:0025405.definition_cn: 眼球运动固视能力缺陷，导致视网膜成像不稳定

HP:0025406.name: Asthenia
HP:0025406.definition: A state characterized by a feeling of weakness and loss of strength leading to a generalized weakness of the body.
HP:0025406.definition_cn: 一种以虚弱感和力量丧失为特征的状态，导致全身性乏力。

HP:0025407.name: Rectourethral fistula
HP:0025407.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the urethra.

HP:0025408.name: Abnormal spleen morphology
HP:0025408.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the spleen.

HP:0025409.name: Abnormal spleen physiology
HP:0025409.definition: Any anomaly of the function of the spleen.

HP:0025410.name: Splenogonadal fusion
HP:0025410.definition: Joining of the spleen and a gonad during embryological development.
HP:0025410.definition_cn: 胚胎发育过程中脾脏与性腺的融合。

HP:0025413.name: Fossa navicularis urethral stricture
HP:0025413.definition: A type of urethral stricture affecting the fossa navicularis, which is the spongy part of the male urethra located at the glans penis.
HP:0025413.definition_cn: 一种影响舟状窝的尿道狭窄，舟状窝是位于男性阴茎头部的尿道海绵体部分。

HP:0025414.name: Pendulous urethral stricture
HP:0025414.definition: A type of urethral stricture affecting the pendulous urethra, which is straight and fixed to the corpora cavernosa.
HP:0025414.definition_cn: 一种影响悬垂尿道的尿道狭窄类型，该段尿道笔直且固定于海绵体。

HP:0025415.name: Bulbar urethral stricture
HP:0025415.definition: A type of urethral stricture affecting the bulbar urethra, which is the part of the urethra that traverses the root of the penis.
HP:0025415.definition_cn: 一种影响尿道球部的尿道狭窄，尿道球部是尿道穿过阴茎根部的部分。

HP:0025416.name: Vaginal stricture
HP:0025416.definition: A narrowing of the vagina owing to scar formation.

HP:0025417.name: Patulous urethra
HP:0025417.definition: Urethra more open or expanded than normal.

HP:0025418.name: Renal cortical necrosis
HP:0025418.definition: Patchy or diffuse ischemic destruction of all the elements of renal cortex resulting from significantly diminished renal arterial perfusion. Coagulative necrosis may be present, involving all tubular segments and glomeruli. Nuclei may be pale and pyknotic, or may no longer be apparent. Thrombi may be present in vessels at the edge of the infarct.
HP:0025418.definition_cn: 肾皮质斑片状或弥漫性缺血性破坏，由肾动脉灌注显著减少所致。可能存在凝固性坏死，累及所有肾小管节段和肾小球。细胞核可能苍白且固缩，或可能不再明显。梗死边缘的血管中可能存在血栓。

HP:0025419.name: Pulmonary pneumatocele
HP:0025419.definition: A pneumatocele is a thin walled, gas-filled space in the lung. It is most frequently caused by acute pneumonia, trauma, or aspiration of hydrocarbon fluid and is usually transient. The mechanism is believed to be a combination of parenchymal necrosis and check-valve airway obstruction. A pneumatocele appears as an approximately round, thin-walled airspace in the lung.
HP:0025419.definition_cn: 肺气囊是一种位于肺内的薄壁、气体填充的空间。其最常见的原因包括急性肺炎、创伤或碳氢化合物液体吸入，通常为暂时性。其机制被认为是实质坏死和单向活瓣性气道阻塞的共同作用。肺气囊在肺部表现为近似圆形、薄壁的气腔。

HP:0025420.name: Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage
HP:0025420.definition: A type of of pulmonary hemorrhage that originates from the pulmonary microcirculation, including the alveolar capillaries, arterioles, and venules. It presents with hemoptysis, anemia, diffuse lung infiltration, and acute respiratory failure. The diagnosis is confirmed by the observation of the accumulation of red blood cells, fibrin, or hemosiderin-laden macrophage in the alveolar space on pathologic biopsy. Hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, appears at least 48-72 hours after bleeding and is helpful in distinguishing diffuse alveolar hemorrhage from surgical trauma. Mild interstitial thickening, organizing pneumonia, or diffuse alveolar damage can also be seen.
HP:0025420.definition_cn: 一种源自肺微循环的肺出血类型，包括肺泡毛细血管、小动脉和小静脉。临床表现包括咯血、贫血、弥漫性肺浸润和急性呼吸衰竭。通过病理活检观察到肺泡腔内红细胞、纤维蛋白或含铁血黄素巨噬细胞的积聚可确诊。含铁血黄素是血红蛋白降解的产物，在出血后至少48-72小时出现，有助于区分弥漫性肺泡出血与手术创伤。轻度间质增厚、机化性肺炎或弥漫性肺泡损伤也可能出现。

HP:0025421.name: Pneumomediastinum
HP:0025421.definition: The presence of free air in the mediastinum.

HP:0025422.name: Pleural cyst
HP:0025422.definition: A closed sac-like structure originating from the pleura that contains a liquid, gaseous, or semisolid substance.
HP:0025422.definition_cn: 胸膜源性囊性结构，内含液体、气体或半固体物质。

HP:0025423.name: Abnormal larynx morphology
HP:0025423.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the larynx.

HP:0025424.name: Abnormal larynx physiology
HP:0025424.definition: Any anomaly of the function of the larynx.

HP:0025425.name: Laryngospasm
HP:0025425.definition: A spasm (involuntary contraction) of the vocal cords that can make it difficult to speak or breathe.
HP:0025425.definition_cn: 声带痉挛（不自主收缩），可能导致言语或呼吸困难。

HP:0025426.name: Abnormal bronchus morphology
HP:0025426.definition: Any structural anomaly of the bronchi, i.e., of the airways leading from the trachea to the lungs.
HP:0025426.definition_cn: 支气管结构异常，即从气管到肺部的气道存在任何结构上的异常。

HP:0025427.name: Abnormal bronchus physiology
HP:0025427.definition: Any anomaly of the function of the bronchi.

HP:0025429.name: Abnormal cry
HP:0025429.definition: Any anomaly of the vocalizing of an infant's crying, i.e.,the typically loud voice production that is accompanied by tears and agitation.
HP:0025429.definition_cn: 婴儿哭闹发声异常，即通常伴随眼泪和躁动的响亮声音产生。

HP:0025430.name: High-pitched cry
HP:0025430.definition: A type of crying in an abnormally high-pitched voice.
HP:0025430.definition_cn: 一种以异常高音调为特征的啼哭。

HP:0025431.name: Staccato cry
HP:0025431.definition: A type of cry that is abnormal because it is consists of unusually shortened and detached vocalizations.
HP:0025431.definition_cn: 一种异常哭声，其特征为异常缩短且分离的发声。

HP:0025432.name: Acanthoma
HP:0025432.definition: A benign epithelial skin tumor manifesting as a slightly elevated circular plaque or nodule with a red, pink or brown color and a diameter up to 22 mm.
HP:0025432.definition_cn: 一种良性上皮性皮肤肿瘤，表现为轻微隆起的圆形斑块或结节，呈红色、粉红色或棕色，直径可达22毫米。

HP:0025433.name: Decreased lecithin cholesterol acyl transferase level
HP:0025433.definition: Reduced level of the enzyme lecithin cholesterol acyl transferase.
HP:0025433.name_cn: 卵磷脂胆固醇酰基转移酶水平降低
HP:0025433.definition_cn: 卵磷脂胆固醇酰基转移酶水平降低。

HP:0025434.name: Reduced circulating CH50 activity
HP:0025434.definition: A diminished activity of the classical complement pathway as measured by the assay for 50% haemolytic complement (CH50) activity of serum.
HP:0025434.definition_cn: 通过血清50%溶血补体（CH50）活性测定，显示经典补体途径活性降低。

HP:0025435.name: Increased circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
HP:0025435.definition: An elevated level of the enzyme lactate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation.
HP:0025435.name_cn: 循环乳酸脱氢酶浓度升高
HP:0025435.definition_cn: 血液循环中乳酸脱氢酶水平升高。

HP:0025436.name: Elevated serum 11-deoxycortisol
HP:0025436.definition: Increased concentration of 11-deoxycortisol in the circulation. 11-deoxycorticosterone, which is also known as simply deoxycorticosterone and 21-hydroxyprogesterone, is a steroid hormore that is produces in the adrenals and is a precursor to aldosterone.
HP:0025436.definition_cn: 循环中11-脱氧皮质醇浓度升高。11-脱氧皮质酮，也称为脱氧皮质酮和21-羟基孕酮，是一种在肾上腺中产生的类固醇激素，是醛固酮的前体。

HP:0025437.name: Macrozoospermia
HP:0025437.definition: Increased size of the head of sperm.

HP:0025439.name: Pharyngitis
HP:0025439.definition: Inflammation (due to infection or irritation) of the pharynx.
HP:0025439.definition_cn: 咽炎（由感染或刺激引起的炎症）。

HP:0025440.name: Warm reactive autoantibody positivity
HP:0025440.definition: Warm reactive autoantibodies are RBC-directed immune responses that are maximally reactive at 37 degrees C.
HP:0025440.name_cn: 温反应性自身抗体阳性
HP:0025440.definition_cn: 温反应性自身抗体是在37摄氏度时反应性最强的针对红细胞的免疫反应。

HP:0025441.name: Achilles tendon calcification
HP:0025441.definition: Ectopic deposition of calcium salts in the Achilles tendon.

HP:0025443.name: Abnormal cardiac atrial physiology
HP:0025443.definition: An abnormality of the function of the cardiac atria.

HP:0025444.name: Reduced amygdala volume
HP:0025444.definition: A decrease in the volume (size) of the amygdyla.

HP:0025445.name: Abnormal papillary muscle morphology
HP:0025445.definition: Any structural anomaly of the papillary muscles of the left ventricle.
HP:0025445.definition_cn: 左心室乳头肌的任何结构异常。

HP:0025446.name: Anomalous insertion of papillary muscle directly into anterior mitral leaflet
HP:0025446.definition: A congenital malformation in which one or both of the papillary muscles (posteromedial or anterolateral) insert directly (that is, without interpositioned chordae tendineae) into the anterior mitral leaflet.
HP:0025446.name_cn: 乳头肌异常直接插入二尖瓣前叶
HP:0025446.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，其中一个或两个乳头肌（后内侧或前外侧）直接（即无腱索介入）插入二尖瓣前叶。

HP:0025447.name: Displacement of the papillary muscles
HP:0025447.definition: Abnormal location of the insertion of a papillary muscle into the left ventricular wall.
HP:0025447.definition_cn: 乳头肌插入左心室壁的位置异常。

HP:0025448.name: Anterior displacement of the papillary muscles
HP:0025448.definition: Abnormally anterior location of the papillary muscles of the left ventricle.
HP:0025448.definition_cn: 左心室乳头肌异常前位。

HP:0025449.name: Apically displaced anterolateral papillary muscle
HP:0025449.definition: Abnormal location of the insertion of the anterolateral papillary muscle near to the apex of the left ventricle. This feature may be appreciated by noting that this muscle is usually not seen in the apical level of the parasternal short-axis echocardiographic view,
HP:0025449.name_cn: 心尖移位的侧前乳头肌
HP:0025449.definition_cn: 前外侧乳头肌插入位置异常，靠近左心室心尖部。这一特征可通过观察心尖水平的胸骨旁短轴超声心动图切面中通常未见该肌肉来识别。

HP:0025451.name: Testicular adrenal rest tumor
HP:0025451.definition: Testicular adrenal rest tumor (TART) is a abenign tumor of the testis. TART generally occurs multiply and bilaterally within the rete testis. Histologically, TART resemble adrenocortical tissue, which led to the name. The tumous are not encapsulated and consist of sheets or confluent cords of large polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm.
HP:0025451.definition_cn: 睾丸肾上腺残余瘤（Testicular Adrenal Rest Tumor, TART）是一种睾丸良性肿瘤。TART通常多发且双侧出现在睾丸网内。组织学上，TART类似于肾上腺皮质组织，因此得名。肿瘤无包膜，由大片或融合的索状大多边形细胞组成，细胞质富含嗜酸性物质。

HP:0025452.name: Pyoderma gangrenosum
HP:0025452.definition: A deep skin ulcer with a well defined border, which is usually violet or blue. The ulcer edge is often undermined (worn and damaged) and the surrounding skin is erythematous and indurated. The ulcer often starts as a small papule or collection of papules, which break down to form small ulcers with a so called cat's paw appearance. These coalesce and the central area then undergoes necrosis to form a single ulcer.
HP:0025452.definition_cn: 一种边界清晰的深部皮肤溃疡，通常呈紫罗兰色或蓝色。溃疡边缘常呈潜行性（磨损和损伤），周围皮肤红斑和硬化。溃疡通常始于小丘疹或丘疹群，随后破溃形成具有所谓“猫爪样”外观的小溃疡。这些溃疡融合后，中央区域发生坏死，形成单一溃疡。

HP:0025453.name: Delayed adrenarche
HP:0025453.definition: Occurrence of adrenarche at a later than normal age. Adrenarche normally occurs between six and eight years of age with increased adrenal androgen secretion; its exact biologic role is not well understood. It is accompanied by changes in pilosebaceous units, a transient growth spurt and the appearance of axillary and pubic hair in some children, but no sexual development.
HP:0025453.name_cn: 迟发性肾上腺功能初现
HP:0025453.definition_cn: 肾上腺功能初现延迟。肾上腺功能初现通常发生在6至8岁之间，伴随肾上腺雄激素分泌增加；其确切的生物学作用尚不明确。该过程伴随毛囊皮脂腺单位的变化、短暂的生长加速以及部分儿童腋毛和阴毛的出现，但无性发育。

HP:0025454.name: Abnormal CSF metabolite concentration
HP:0025454.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of concentration of a metabolite in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0025454.name_cn: 脑脊液代谢物浓度异常
HP:0025454.definition_cn: 脑脊液中代谢物浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0025455.name: Decreased CSF 5-hydroxyindolacetic acid concentration
HP:0025455.definition: 5-HIAA (5-hydroxyindolacetic acid) concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0025455.name_cn: 脑脊液5-羟吲哚乙酸浓度降低
HP:0025455.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中5-羟基吲哚乙酸（5-HIAA）浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0025456.name: Abnormal CSF protein concentration
HP:0025456.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of a protein concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0025456.definition_cn: 脑脊液蛋白质浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0025457.name: Decreased CSF protein concentration
HP:0025457.definition: CSF total protein level is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0025457.definition_cn: 脑脊液总蛋白水平低于正常值下限。

HP:0025458.name: Decreased CSF albumin concentration
HP:0025458.definition: CSF albumin level is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0025458.name_cn: 脑脊液白蛋白浓度降低
HP:0025458.definition_cn: 脑脊液白蛋白水平低于正常下限。

HP:0025459.name: Increased CSF/serum albumin ratio
HP:0025459.definition: An increase above normal limits of the ratio of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) albumin concentration to serum albumin concentration.
HP:0025459.name_cn: 脑脊液/血清白蛋白比值升高
HP:0025459.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）白蛋白浓度与血清白蛋白浓度比值超出正常范围升高。

HP:0025460.name: High myoinositol in brain by MRS
HP:0025460.definition: An elevated level of myoinositol in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025460.name_cn: 脑磁共振波谱（MRS）显示高肌醇水平
HP:0025460.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内肌醇（Myoinositol）水平升高。

HP:0025462.name: obsolete Abnormal cellular physiology
HP:0025462.name_cn: 过时的异常细胞生理学

HP:0025463.name: Abnormality of redox activity
HP:0025463.definition: An abnormality of the processes that maintain the redox environment of a cell or compartment within a cell, that is, the balance between reduction and oxidation chemical reactions.
HP:0025463.definition_cn: 细胞内或细胞器内维持氧化还原环境过程的异常，即还原与氧化化学反应之间的平衡失调。

HP:0025464.name: Increased reactive oxygen species production
HP:0025464.definition: An accumulation of free radical groups in the body inadequately neutralized by antioxidants, which creates a potentially unstable and damaging cellular environment linked to tissue damage.
HP:0025464.definition_cn: 体内自由基基团积累，抗氧化剂未能充分中和，导致潜在的细胞环境不稳定和破坏性，与组织损伤相关。

HP:0025465.name: Abnormal circulating beta globulin level
HP:0025465.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of beta globulin. The beta globulins are a group of globular (globe-shaped) proteins in blood.
HP:0025465.definition_cn: β球蛋白浓度异常。β球蛋白是一组存在于血液中的球状蛋白质。

HP:0025466.name: Beta 2-microglobulinuria
HP:0025466.definition: Increased level of beta 2-microglobulins in the urine.
HP:0025466.definition_cn: 尿液中β2-微球蛋白水平升高。

HP:0025469.name: Anagen effluvium
HP:0025469.definition: An abnormal loss of anagen (growth phase) hairs.

HP:0025470.name: Telogen effluvium
HP:0025470.definition: A type of hair loss characterized by an abnormal increase in dormant, telogen stage hair follicles.
HP:0025470.definition_cn: 一种以休止期毛囊异常增加为特征的脱发类型。

HP:0025471.name: Congenital panfollicular nevus
HP:0025471.definition: A hamartomatous proliferation containing malformed hair follicles in various stages of development. Panfolliculomas are well-circumscribed lesions demonstrating all stages of follicular differentiation.
HP:0025471.definition_cn: 一种包含不同发育阶段畸形毛囊的错构瘤性增生。全毛囊瘤是一种边界清晰的病变，展示了毛囊分化的所有阶段。

HP:0025472.name: Recurrent plantar mycosis
HP:0025472.definition: A history of repeated fungal infections located on the sole of the foot, usually manifested by scaling, maceration, and itching.
HP:0025472.definition_cn: 既往有反复发作的足底真菌感染史，通常表现为鳞屑、浸渍和瘙痒。

HP:0025473.name: Hyperpigmented papule
HP:0025473.definition: A papule (circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point) that exhibits increased pigmentation (is darker) compared to the surrounding skin.
HP:0025473.definition_cn: 色素沉着性丘疹（一种界限清楚、无可见液体的皮肤实性隆起，大小从针尖至最宽处直径小于10毫米不等，与周围皮肤相比色素沉着增加（颜色更深））。

HP:0025474.name: Erythematous plaque
HP:0025474.definition: A plaque (a solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter) with a red or reddish color often associated with inflammation or irritation.
HP:0025474.definition_cn: 斑块（一种直径大于1厘米的实性、隆起、平台状（平顶）皮损），呈红色或微红色，通常与炎症或刺激相关。

HP:0025475.name: Erythematous macule
HP:0025475.definition: A macule (flat, distinct, discolored area of skin less than 1 cm wide that does not involve any change in the thickness or texture of the skin) with a red or reddish color often associated with inflammation or irritation.
HP:0025475.definition_cn: 红斑（一种平坦、界限清晰、直径小于1厘米的皮肤变色区域，不伴有皮肤厚度或质地的改变），呈红色或微红色，通常与炎症或刺激相关。

HP:0025476.name: Testicular lipomatosis
HP:0025476.definition: Multiple foci of adipocytes within the testicular interstitium, usually presenting as multiple bilateral ill-defined hyperechoic intratesticular lesions of different sizes but generally with maximum diameter of 4 mm.
HP:0025476.definition_cn: 睾丸间质内多灶性脂肪细胞，通常表现为双侧睾丸内多发性边界不清的高回声病变，大小不一，但最大直径一般不超过4毫米。

HP:0025477.name: Periarticular calcification
HP:0025477.definition: Calcified deposits in soft tissue structures outside a joint.
HP:0025477.definition_cn: 关节外软组织结构的钙化沉积。

HP:0025478.name: Atrial standstill
HP:0025478.definition: Atrial standstill or silent atrium is a rare condition presenting with the absence of electrical and mechanical activity in the atria. It presents with the absence of P waves, bradycardia, and wide QRS complex in the electrocardiogram.
HP:0025478.definition_cn: 心房静止或静默心房是一种罕见病症，表现为心房电活动和机械活动的缺失。在心电图上表现为P波缺失、心动过缓和宽QRS波群。

HP:0025479.name: Self-neglect
HP:0025479.definition: A pathological neglect of personal needs and well-being that includes attending to self-grooming, personal care and the attention to cleanliness of personal space.
HP:0025479.definition_cn: 一种病理性忽视个人需求和福祉的状态，包括对自我修饰、个人护理以及个人空间清洁的关注缺失。

HP:0025480.name: Lipomyelomeningocele
HP:0025480.definition: A type of spinal dysraphism presenting as a subcutaneous fatty mass, that is, a spinal defect associated with lipomatous tissue, and covered by skin. The most usual location for lipomyelomeningocele is at the gluteal cleft.
HP:0025480.definition_cn: 一种表现为皮下脂肪性肿块的脊柱裂，即与脂肪组织相关的脊柱缺陷，并被皮肤覆盖。脂肪脊髓脊膜膨出最常见的部位位于臀裂。

HP:0025481.name: Cervical hemivertebrae
HP:0025481.definition: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the cervical spine.

HP:0025482.name: Positive perchlorate discharge test
HP:0025482.definition: An abnormal result of the perchlorate discharge test. In this test, first radioactive iodine is administered, sufficient time is allowed to pass so that the radioactive iodine is captured by the thyroid,and then, perchlorate is administered orally. The perchlorate displaces non-organified iodide from the thyroid. The perchlorate discharge test is considered positive (abnormal) if there is an abnormally rapid loss of radioactive iodine from the thyroid.
HP:0025482.name_cn: 高氯酸盐排泄试验阳性
HP:0025482.definition_cn: 高氯酸盐释放试验结果异常。在该试验中，首先给予放射性碘，待足够时间使放射性碘被甲状腺摄取后，再口服高氯酸盐。高氯酸盐会将甲状腺中未有机化的碘离子置换出来。若甲状腺中放射性碘异常迅速丢失，则高氯酸盐释放试验被视为阳性（异常）。

HP:0025483.name: Abnormal circulating thyroglobulin concentration
HP:0025483.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of thyroglobulin, a protein produced in the thyroid gland that acts as a precursor to thyrroid hormones.
HP:0025483.name_cn: 异常循环甲状腺球蛋白浓度
HP:0025483.definition_cn: 甲状腺球蛋白浓度异常。甲状腺球蛋白是一种由甲状腺产生的蛋白质，作为甲状腺激素的前体。

HP:0025484.name: Increased circulating thyroglobulin concentration
HP:0025484.definition: An abnormal elevation of the concentration of thyroglobulin, a protein produced in the thyroid gland that acts as a precursor to thyrroid hormones.
HP:0025484.name_cn: 循环甲状腺球蛋白浓度升高
HP:0025484.definition_cn: 甲状腺球蛋白浓度异常升高，甲状腺球蛋白是一种在甲状腺中产生的蛋白质，作为甲状腺激素的前体。

HP:0025485.name: Vaginal adenosis
HP:0025485.definition: Vaginal adenosis is defined by the presence of metaplastic cervical or endometrial epithelium within the vaginal wall, thought to be derived from persistent M眉llerian (synonymous with paramesonephric) epithelium islets in postembryonic life.
HP:0025485.definition_cn: 阴道腺病定义为阴道壁内存在化生的宫颈或子宫内膜上皮，被认为来源于胚胎后生活中持续存在的苗勒管（与副中肾管同义）上皮岛。

HP:0025486.name: Fused labia majora
HP:0025486.definition: The outer labia are sealed together.

HP:0025487.name: Abnormal bladder morphology
HP:0025487.definition: Any structural anomaly of the bladder.

HP:0025488.name: Detrusor sphincter dyssynergia
HP:0025488.definition: A urodynamic anomaly characterized by bladder outlet obstruction from detrusor muscle contraction with concomitant involuntary urethral sphincter activation.
HP:0025488.name_cn: 逼尿肌括约肌协同失调
HP:0025488.definition_cn: 一种尿动力学异常，其特征为膀胱出口梗阻，由逼尿肌收缩伴随不自主尿道括约肌激活所致。

HP:0025489.name: Bladder duplication
HP:0025489.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of two bladders.

HP:0025490.name: Myocardial bridging
HP:0025490.definition: A congenital variant of a coronary artery in which a portion of an epicardial coronary artery (most frequently the middle segment of the left anterior descending artery) takes an intramuscular course.
HP:0025490.definition_cn: 冠状动脉先天性变异，其中一部分心外膜冠状动脉（最常见于左前降支中段）走行于心肌内。

HP:0025491.name: Venous stenosis
HP:0025491.definition: Narrowing of a vein due to intimal hyperplasia and fibrosis.
HP:0025491.definition_cn: 静脉狭窄由于内膜增生和纤维化。

HP:0025492.name: Microcoria
HP:0025492.definition: A small pupil (typically diameter less than 2 mm) that dilates poorly or not at all in response to topically administered mydriatic drugs.
HP:0025492.definition_cn: 瞳孔缩小（通常直径小于2毫米），在局部应用散瞳药物后扩张不良或完全不扩张。

HP:0025493.name: Palmoplantar erythema
HP:0025493.definition: Redness of the skin of the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.
HP:0025493.definition_cn: 手掌和足底皮肤因真皮层毛细血管充血导致的红斑。

HP:0025494.name: Coated aorta
HP:0025494.definition: Regular circumferential periaortic fibrosis involving the whole aorta and leading to a coated aorta appearance on computed tomography scans
HP:0025494.definition_cn: 常规性环周主动脉周围纤维化累及整个主动脉，导致计算机断层扫描中出现“被覆主动脉”表现。

HP:0025495.name: Descending aorta hypoplasia
HP:0025495.definition: Significant luminal narrowing of a long segment of the descending aorta.
HP:0025495.definition_cn: 降主动脉长段显著管腔狭窄。

HP:0025496.name: Abnormal coronary artery physiology
HP:0025496.definition: Any anomaly of the function of a coronary artery.

HP:0025497.name: Coronary artery spasm
HP:0025497.definition: A brief and sudden narrowing of a coronary artery.
HP:0025497.definition_cn: 冠状动脉短暂性急性狭窄

HP:0025498.name: Aceruloplasminemia
HP:0025498.definition: Absence of ceruloplasmin in the blood.

HP:0025499.name: Class I obesity
HP:0025499.definition: Obesity with a body mass index of 30 to 34.9 kg per square meter.
HP:0025499.definition_cn: 体重指数为30至34.9千克每平方米的肥胖症。

HP:0025500.name: Class II obesity
HP:0025500.definition: Obesity with a body mass index of 35 to 39.9 kg per square meter.
HP:0025500.definition_cn: 体重指数为35至39.9千克每平方米的肥胖症。

HP:0025501.name: Class III obesity
HP:0025501.definition: Obesity with a body mass index of 40 kg per square meter or higher.
HP:0025501.definition_cn: 重度肥胖，体重指数（BMI）≥40 kg/m²。

HP:0025502.name: Overweight
HP:0025502.definition: Increased body weight with a body mass index of 25-29.9 kg per square meter.
HP:0025502.definition_cn: 体重增加，体重指数为25-29.9千克每平方米。

HP:0025503.name: Anomalous coronary artery arising from the opposite sinus
HP:0025503.definition: Origin of the right coronary artery (RCA) from the left sinus of Valsalva or of the left main (LM) or left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery from the right sinus of Valsalva.
HP:0025503.name_cn: 起源于对侧窦的冠状动脉异常
HP:0025503.definition_cn: 右冠状动脉（RCA）起源于左Valsalva窦，或左主干（LM）或左前降支（LAD）冠状动脉起源于右Valsalva窦。

HP:0025505.name: Anomalous origin of the circumflex artery from the right sinus of Valsalva
HP:0025505.definition: The circumflex coronary artery originates from the right aortic sinus of Valsalva.
HP:0025505.name_cn: 冠状动脉回旋支起源于右冠状窦异常
HP:0025505.definition_cn: 回旋支冠状动脉起源于右主动脉窦（Valsalva窦）。

HP:0025506.name: Coronary artery sandwich anomaly
HP:0025506.definition: Origin of the right coronary artery (RCA) from the left sinus of Valsalva or of the left main (LM) or left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery from the right sinus of Valsalva, with the additional feature that the artery passes between the two great arteries. This carries a risk of the artery being compressed by these two vessels,
HP:0025506.definition_cn: 右冠状动脉（RCA）起源于左冠状窦，或左主干（LM）或左前降支（LAD）冠状动脉起源于右冠状窦，并伴有动脉在两大动脉之间穿行的特征。这种情况存在动脉被这两条大血管压迫的风险。

HP:0025508.name: Gottron's papules
HP:0025508.definition: Violaceous papules overlying the dorsal and lateral aspects of the metacarpophalangeal and proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:0025508.definition_cn: 掌指关节和近端指间关节背侧及外侧覆盖的紫罗兰色丘疹。

HP:0025509.name: Piezogenic pedal papules
HP:0025509.definition: Flesh-colored or yellowish papules, 2 mm or larger, that are responses to internal mechanical pressure and weakness in the connective tissue in the dermis, appear commonly over the medial aspect of the heel, but in some cases on the wrists. They are thought to represent herniations of adipose tissue through the plantar fascia retinaculum.
HP:0025509.definition_cn: 肉色或淡黄色丘疹，直径2毫米或更大，是对内部机械压力和真皮层结缔组织薄弱性的反应，常见于足跟内侧，但在某些情况下也可出现在手腕。这些丘疹被认为代表脂肪组织通过足底筋膜支持带的疝出。

HP:0025510.name: Nevus spilus
HP:0025510.definition: A tan, regularly bordered patch with darker macules within the lesion.
HP:0025510.definition_cn: 一块呈棕褐色、边界规则的斑块，其内部可见较深的斑疹。

HP:0025511.name: Nevus sebaceus
HP:0025511.definition: A solitary yellow-orange slightly raised plaque typically on scalp or face. The plaque typically thickens and becomes more verrucous or pebbly during childhood.
HP:0025511.definition_cn: 一种孤立的黄橙色轻微隆起的斑块，通常出现在头皮或面部。该斑块在儿童期通常会增厚，并变得更加疣状或鹅卵石样。

HP:0025512.name: Skin-colored papule
HP:0025512.definition: A papule with the same color as the surrounding skin.
HP:0025512.definition_cn: 与周围皮肤颜色相同的丘疹。

HP:0025514.name: Morning glory anomaly
HP:0025514.definition: An abnormality of the optic nerve in which the optic nerve is large and funneled and displays a conical excavation of the optic disc. The optic disc appears dysplastic.
HP:0025514.definition_cn: 视神经异常，表现为视神经增大、呈漏斗状，并显示视盘锥形凹陷。视盘呈现发育不良。

HP:0025515.name: Delayed thelarche
HP:0025515.definition: Later than normal development of the breasts.
HP:0025515.definition_cn: 乳房发育延迟（Delayed Breast Development）

HP:0025516.name: Coronary-pulmonary artery fistula
HP:0025516.definition: A congenital malformation with abnormal connection between one of the coronary arteries and the pulmonary artery.
HP:0025516.definition_cn: 冠状动脉-肺动脉瘘（Coronary Artery-Pulmonary Artery Fistula）。

HP:0025518.name: Visual gaze preference
HP:0025518.definition: An abnormality of gaze that can be observed following an acute supranuclear cerebral lesion (e.g., stroke) that is characterized by an acute inability to direct gaze contralateral to the side of the lesion and is accompanied by a tendency for tonic deviation of the eyes toward the side of the lesion.
HP:0025518.definition_cn: 急性核上性脑病变（如卒中）后可观察到的一种凝视异常，其特征为急性无法将凝视指向病变对侧，并伴有眼球向病变侧强直性偏斜的倾向。

HP:0025519.name: Multiple biliary hamartomas
HP:0025519.definition: Multiple biliary hamartomas are a rare clinicopathologic entity, consisting of small (less than 1.5cm), usually multiple and nodular cystic lesions in the liver.
HP:0025519.definition_cn: 多发性胆管错构瘤是一种罕见的临床病理实体，由肝脏内通常多发且呈结节状的囊性病变组成，其大小通常小于1.5厘米。

HP:0025520.name: Calcinosis cutis
HP:0025520.definition: Deposition of calcium in the skin.

HP:0025521.name: Increased body fat percentage
HP:0025521.definition: The percentage of fat as a part of total body weight above the norm, usually defined as 32% for females and 25% for males.
HP:0025521.definition_cn: 体脂百分比超出正常范围，通常定义为女性超过32%，男性超过25%。

HP:0025522.name: Elongated chordae tendinae of the mitral valve
HP:0025522.definition: Abnormal increased in length of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve.
HP:0025522.definition_cn: 二尖瓣腱索长度异常增加。

HP:0025523.name: Abnormal morphology of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve
HP:0025523.definition: A structural anomaly of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve, whose main function is to transmit the contraction and relaxation of the papillary muscles during the cardiac cycle, thus ensuring the closing of the leaflets of the mitral valve.
HP:0025523.definition_cn: 二尖瓣腱索结构异常，其主要功能是在心脏周期中传递乳头肌的收缩和舒张，从而确保二尖瓣瓣叶的闭合。

HP:0025524.name: Palmoplantar scaling skin
HP:0025524.definition: Loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes localized to the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot.
HP:0025524.definition_cn: 手掌和足底局部出现大片鳞屑状表皮外层脱落。

HP:0025525.name: Scaling skin on fingertip
HP:0025525.definition: Loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes localized to one or more fingertips.
HP:0025525.definition_cn: 局限于一个或多个指尖的表皮外层以大片鳞屑状剥脱。

HP:0025526.name: Psoriasiform lesion
HP:0025526.definition: A skin lesions that resembles the lesions observed in psoriasis, viz., an erythematous plaque covered by fine silvery scales. Psoriasiform lesions can be observed in psoriasis as well as in other conditions including allergic contact dermatitis, seborrhoeic dermatitis, Atopic dermatitis, pityriasis rubra, and lichen simplex chronicus.
HP:0025526.definition_cn: 一种类似于银屑病所观察到的皮损，即覆盖有细薄银白色鳞屑的红斑性斑块。银屑病样皮损可见于银屑病以及其他疾病，包括过敏性接触性皮炎、脂溢性皮炎、特应性皮炎、红糠疹和慢性单纯性苔藓。

HP:0025527.name: Serpiginous cutaneous lesion
HP:0025527.definition: A skin lesion with a snake- or serpent-like distribution.
HP:0025527.definition_cn: 蛇形或蜿蜒状分布的皮肤病变。

HP:0025528.name: Annular cutaneous lesion
HP:0025528.definition: A lesion of the skin with a ring-like distribution.

HP:0025529.name: Hyperpigmented nodule
HP:0025529.definition: A nodule of the skin that exhibits an increased amount of pigmentation.
HP:0025529.definition_cn: 皮肤结节伴色素沉着增加。

HP:0025530.name: Xanthomas of the palmar creases
HP:0025530.definition: The presence of multiple xanthomas (xanthomata) in the skin distributed in the creases of the palm of the hand. Xanthomas are yellowish, firm, lipid-laden nodules in the skin.
HP:0025530.definition_cn: 手掌皱褶处皮肤出现多发性黄色瘤（xanthomata）。黄色瘤为皮肤内富含脂质的黄色、坚实结节。

HP:0025531.name: Harlequin phenomenon
HP:0025531.definition: The Harlequin phenomenon consists of a sudden change in skin color, resulting in two different body colors, one on each half of the body.
HP:0025531.definition_cn: Harlequin现象表现为皮肤颜色的突然改变，导致身体两侧呈现两种不同的肤色。

HP:0025532.name: Positive pathergy test
HP:0025532.definition: With the pathergy test, a small, sterile needle is inserted into the skin of the forearm. The site of injectionis circuled and observed after one and two days. If a small red bump or pustule at the site of needle insertion occurs, the pathergy test is considered to have a positive (abnormal) result.
HP:0025532.definition_cn: 在针刺试验中，将一根无菌小针插入前臂皮肤。注射部位被标记，并在一天和两天后观察。如果在针头插入部位出现小红斑或脓疱，则针刺试验被认为呈阳性（异常）结果。

HP:0025534.name: Ocular melanocytosis
HP:0025534.definition: A congenital lesion of the sclera characterized by unilateral patchy but extensive slate-gray or bluish discoloration of the sclera . The conjunctiva are spared.
HP:0025534.definition_cn: 先天性巩膜病变，特征为单侧斑片状但广泛的石板灰色或青蓝色巩膜变色，结膜未受累。

HP:0025535.name: Shawl sign
HP:0025535.definition: Erythematous, poikilodermatous macules distributed in a shawl pattern over the shoulders, arms and upper back.
HP:0025535.definition_cn: 肩部、手臂和上背部呈披肩状分布的红斑性、异色性斑疹。

HP:0025536.name: V-sign
HP:0025536.definition: Erythematous, poikilodermatous macules distributed in a V-shaped distribution over the anterior neck and chest.
HP:0025536.definition_cn: 红斑性、异色性斑疹呈V形分布于前颈部和胸部。

HP:0025537.name: Plantar edema
HP:0025537.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on sole of the foot.
HP:0025537.definition_cn: 足底皮下组织异常液体积聚。

HP:0025538.name: Palmar edema
HP:0025538.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the palm of the hand.
HP:0025538.definition_cn: 手掌皮下组织异常液体积聚。

HP:0025540.name: Abnormal T cell subset distribution
HP:0025540.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion T cells subsets relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0025540.definition_cn: T细胞亚群相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0025541.name: obsolete Decreased activity of complement receptor

HP:0025546.name: Abnormal mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration
HP:0025546.definition: A deviation from the normal range of the average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell (27 to 31 picograms/cell). A reduced mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH) may indicate a hypochromic anemia, but the MCH may be normal if both the total hemoglobin and the red blood cell count are reduced.
HP:0025546.name_cn: 平均红细胞血红蛋白浓度异常
HP:0025546.definition_cn: 平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）偏离正常范围（27至31皮克/细胞）。平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）降低可能提示低色素性贫血，但如果总血红蛋白量和红细胞计数均降低，MCH可能仍在正常范围内。

HP:0025547.name: Decreased mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration
HP:0025547.definition: A reduction from the normal range of the average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell (27 to 31 picograms/cell). A reduced mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH) may indicate a hypochromic anemia, but the MCH may be normal if both the total hemoglobin and the red blood cell count are reduced.
HP:0025547.name_cn: 平均红细胞血红蛋白浓度降低
HP:0025547.definition_cn: 平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）低于正常范围（27至31皮克/细胞）。平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）降低可能提示低色素性贫血，但如果总血红蛋白量和红细胞计数均降低，则MCH可能仍在正常范围内。

HP:0025548.name: Increased mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration
HP:0025548.definition: An elevation over the normal range of the average amount of hemoglobin per red blood cell (27 to 31 picograms/cell).
HP:0025548.name_cn: 平均红细胞血红蛋白浓度升高
HP:0025548.definition_cn: 平均红细胞血红蛋白含量（MCH）高于正常范围（27至31皮克/细胞）。

HP:0025549.name: Eccentric visual fixation
HP:0025549.definition: A uniocular condition in which there is fixation of an object by a point other than the fovea. This point adopts the principal visual direction. The degree of the eccentric fixation is defined by its distance from the fovea in degrees.
HP:0025549.definition_cn: 单眼偏心注视，即物体通过非黄斑中心凹的点进行固定。该点采用主要视觉方向。偏心注视的程度由其与黄斑中心凹的距离（以度数表示）来定义。

HP:0025550.name: Elevated circulating ribitol concentration
HP:0025550.definition: The concentration of ribitol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025550.definition_cn: 血液中核糖醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0025551.name: Optic nerve misrouting
HP:0025551.definition: Abnormal decussation of the visual pathways, typically identified using visual evoked potentials (VEP) (asymmetrical distribution of the VEP over the posterior scalp).
HP:0025551.definition_cn: 视觉通路异常交叉，通常通过视觉诱发电位（VEP）进行识别（VEP在头皮后部的不对称分布）。

HP:0025552.name: Periorbital purpura
HP:0025552.definition: Multiple red/purple spots on the skin that surrounds the eyes that do not blanch (whiten) upon pressure. Purpura is caused by subcutaneous bleeding.
HP:0025552.definition_cn: 眼周皮肤出现多个红色/紫色斑点，按压后不褪色（不变白）。紫癜是由皮下出血引起的。

HP:0025553.name: Periorbital ecchymosis with tarsal plate sparing
HP:0025553.definition: Subcutaneous bleeding with a diameter greater than 1 cm (ecchymosis). The bleeding does not extend into the tarsal plate (the comparatively thick, elongated plates of dense connective tissue within the eyelid) due to an anatomic structure called the orbital septum, which limits extravasation of blood beyond the tarsal plate.
HP:0025553.definition_cn: 直径大于1厘米的皮下出血（瘀斑）。由于解剖结构称为眶隔的存在，出血未延伸至睑板（眼睑内相对较厚、细长的致密结缔组织板），眶隔限制了血液向睑板以外的外渗。

HP:0025554.name: Yellow nodule
HP:0025554.definition: A type of skin nodule (a lesions that is greater than either 10mm in both width and depth, and most frequently centered in the dermis or subcutaneous fat) with a yellowish coloration (that reflects a high lipid content of the lesion).
HP:0025554.definition_cn: 一种皮肤结节（病变宽度和深度均大于10毫米，最常见于真皮层或皮下脂肪组织），呈黄色（反映病变内脂质含量较高）。

HP:0025555.name: Periungual teleangiectasia
HP:0025555.definition: Telangiectasia (small dilated blood vessels) located near to the fingernails or toenails.
HP:0025555.definition_cn: 甲周毛细血管扩张症（位于指甲或趾甲附近的微小扩张血管）。

HP:0025558.name: Lamellar cataract with riders
HP:0025558.definition: Lamellar cataracts with associated linear lens opacities radially extending towards the periphery of the lens.
HP:0025558.definition_cn: 板层白内障伴放射状向晶状体周边延伸的线性晶状体混浊。

HP:0025559.name: Coronary cataract
HP:0025559.definition: A type of cataract characterized by club-shaped and dot opacities distributed radially in the deep cortex. These lens opacities surround the nucleus in an appearance that is though to resemble a crown.
HP:0025559.definition_cn: 一种白内障类型，其特征为深皮质层内呈放射状分布的棒状和点状混浊。这些晶状体混浊围绕核部，外观类似于冠状结构。

HP:0025560.name: Anterior chamber cells
HP:0025560.definition: Tiny deposits corresponding to cells floating in the anterior chamber of the eye. This appearance is typically associated with intraocular inflammation leading to breakdown of the blood-aqueous barrier and resulting in an increase in the number of cells and in the aqueous humor. Grading (SUN Working Group) is performed by estimating the number of cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025560.definition_cn: 与漂浮在眼前房中的细胞相对应的微小沉积物。这种表现通常与眼内炎症相关，导致血-房水屏障破坏，从而导致细胞数量和房水中的细胞数量增加。分级（SUN工作组）通过在裂隙灯上使用适当的光强度和放大倍数，估计1毫米×1毫米裂隙光束视野中的细胞数量来进行。

HP:0025561.name: Anterior chamber cells grade 1+
HP:0025561.definition: Anterior chamber cells with 6-15 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025561.definition_cn: 前房细胞计数为6-15个，在1毫米×1毫米裂隙光束视野下，使用适当的光强度和放大倍率于裂隙灯检查。

HP:0025562.name: Anterior chamber cells grade 0.5+
HP:0025562.definition: Anterior chamber cells with 1-5 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025562.definition_cn: 前房细胞计数为1-5个，在裂隙灯下使用适当的光强度和放大倍数，于1毫米×1毫米的裂隙光束视野内观察。

HP:0025563.name: Anterior chamber cells grade 0
HP:0025563.definition: Anterior chamber cells with less than one cell in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025563.definition_cn: 前房细胞少于1个/1mm×1mm裂隙光束视野，使用适当的光强度和放大倍率于裂隙灯下观察。

HP:0025564.name: Anterior chamber cells grade 2+
HP:0025564.definition: Anterior chamber cells with 16-25 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025564.definition_cn: 前房细胞计数为16-25个/1mm×1mm裂隙光束视野，使用适当的光强度和放大倍数于裂隙灯下观察。

HP:0025565.name: Anterior chamber cells grade 3+
HP:0025565.definition: Anterior chamber cells with 26-50 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025565.definition_cn: 前房细胞计数为26-50个，在1毫米×1毫米裂隙光束视野下，使用适当的光强度和放大倍数于裂隙灯检查。

HP:0025566.name: Anterior chamber cells grade 4+
HP:0025566.definition: Anterior chamber cells with more than 50 cells in a 1 mm by 1 mm slit beam field, employing adequate light intensity and magnification on a slit lamp.
HP:0025566.definition_cn: 前房细胞计数在1毫米×1毫米裂隙光束视野下超过50个，使用适当的光强度和放大倍率于裂隙灯检查。

HP:0025567.name: Central serous chorioretinopathy
HP:0025567.definition: An anomaly of the retina with serous detachment of the neurosensory retina secondary to one or more focal lesions of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), and associated with blurred vision, usually in one eye only and perceived typically by the patient as a dark spot in the center of the visual field with associated micropsia and metamorphopsia. Normal vision often recurs spontaneously within a few months.
HP:0025567.name_cn: 中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变
HP:0025567.definition_cn: 视网膜异常，表现为神经感觉层视网膜浆液性脱离，继发于视网膜色素上皮（RPE）一处或多处局灶性病变，并伴有视力模糊，通常仅累及单眼，患者常主诉视野中央出现暗点，伴随视物变小症（micropsia）和视物变形症（metamorphopsia）。视力通常可在数月内自发恢复正常。

HP:0025568.name: Abnormal morphology of the choroidal vasculature

HP:0025569.name: Polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy
HP:0025569.definition: The presence of aneurysmal polypoidal lesions in the choroidal vasculature. The aneurysmal dilatations, also known as polyps, may be found at subfoveal, juxtafoveal, extrafoveal, peripapillary or even peripheral regions. These polypoidal dilatations may be visible as reddish-orange subretinal nodules during ophthalmoscopic examination. The polypoidal lesions are best detected on indocyanine green angiography (ICGA) and might be associated with a branching vascular network (BVN) of neovascularization.
HP:0025569.name_cn: 息肉样脉络膜血管病变
HP:0025569.definition_cn: 脉络膜血管系统中存在动脉瘤性息肉样病变。这些动脉瘤性扩张，也称为息肉，可能位于中心凹下、中心凹旁、中心凹外、视盘周围甚至周边区域。在眼底镜检查中，这些息肉样扩张可能表现为红橙色的视网膜下结节。息肉样病变在吲哚菁绿血管造影（ICGA）中最为明显，并可能与新生血管的分支血管网络（BVN）相关。

HP:0025570.name: Choroidal vascular hyperpermeability
HP:0025570.definition: Increased tendency of choiroidal blood vessels to allow fluids to leak characterized by multifocal choroidal hyperfluorescence on indocyanine green angiography (ICGA).
HP:0025570.definition_cn: 脉络膜血管渗漏倾向增加，表现为吲哚菁绿血管造影（ICGA）上的多灶性脉络膜高荧光。

HP:0025571.name: Christmas tree cataract
HP:0025571.definition: A type of cataract that shows a spectacular display of multiple colors that glitters with the change of incident light like an illuminated Christmas tree.
HP:0025571.definition_cn: 一种表现为多色炫彩的晶状体混浊类型，其随入射光变化而闪烁，宛如被点亮的圣诞树。

HP:0025572.name: Punctal stenosis
HP:0025572.definition: Punctal stenosis is a condition in which the external opening of the lacrimal canaliculus is narrowed or occluded.
HP:0025572.definition_cn: 泪点狭窄是指泪小管外部开口变窄或阻塞的一种病症。

HP:0025573.name: Mild myopia
HP:0025573.definition: A mild form of myopia with up to -3.00 diopters.
HP:0025573.definition_cn: 轻度近视，屈光度不超过-3.00D。

HP:0025574.name: Macular hemorrhage
HP:0025574.definition: Bleeding occurring within the macula lutea of the retina.

HP:0025575.name: Abnormal superior vena cava morphology
HP:0025575.definition: Any structural anomaly of the principal vein draining blood from the upper portion of the body and delivering it to the right ventricle of the heart.
HP:0025575.definition_cn: 上腔静脉结构异常，即负责将上半身血液引流至心脏右心室的主要静脉存在任何结构异常。

HP:0025576.name: Abnormal inferior vena cava morphology
HP:0025576.definition: Any structural anomaly of the principal vein draining blood from the lower portion of the body.
HP:0025576.definition_cn: 下腔静脉主要引流静脉的结构异常。

HP:0025578.name: Aortic valve prolapse
HP:0025578.definition: Aortic valve prolapse can be diagnosed when either or both of the right or non-coronary aortic valve cusps (seen in the cross sectional echocardiographic long axis view) show backward bowing towards the left ventricle beyond a line joining the points of attachment of the aortic valve leaflets to the annulus.
HP:0025578.definition_cn: 主动脉瓣脱垂的诊断标准为：在经胸超声心动图长轴切面中，右冠瓣或无冠瓣（或两者）向后弯曲，超过主动脉瓣叶附着点与瓣环连线的范围，朝向左心室方向突出。

HP:0025579.name: Abnormal left atrium morphology
HP:0025579.definition: Any structural abnormality of the left atrium.

HP:0025580.name: Abnormal right atrium morphology
HP:0025580.definition: Any structural abnormality of the right atrium.

HP:0025582.name: Submacular hemorrhage
HP:0025582.definition: Bleeding between the neurosensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) arising from the choroidal or retinal circulation.
HP:0025582.definition_cn: 源自脉络膜或视网膜循环的神经感觉层视网膜与视网膜色素上皮（RPE）之间的出血。

HP:0025583.name: Tapetal-like fundal reflex
HP:0025583.definition: Golden, scintillating, particulate reflection noted on fundus examination (typically in the macula and sparing the fovea). The term tapetal is used to describe this 'metallic' sheen appearance as it is thought to be similar to the 'tapetal' reflex seen in the eyes of certain animals.
HP:0025583.definition_cn: 眼底检查中观察到金色、闪烁的颗粒状反射（通常位于黄斑区，但中心凹未受累）。术语“毯层样”用于描述这种“金属”光泽外观，因其被认为与某些动物眼中观察到的“毯层样”反射相似。

HP:0025584.name: Hypotropia
HP:0025584.definition: A form of manifest strabismus (heterotropia) in which one eye is deviated downwards when both eyes are open.
HP:0025584.definition_cn: 一种显性斜视（显性斜视）的表现形式，其中当双眼睁开时，一只眼睛向下偏斜。

HP:0025585.name: Hyperphoria
HP:0025585.definition: Tendency for the visual axis of one eye to be higher than that of the other.
HP:0025585.definition_cn: 单眼视轴高于对侧眼的倾向性。

HP:0025586.name: Hypertropia
HP:0025586.definition: A type of strabismus characterized by permanent upward deviation of the visual axis of one eye.
HP:0025586.definition_cn: 一种斜视类型，其特征为单眼视轴持续性向上偏斜。

HP:0025587.name: Hyperdeviation
HP:0025587.definition: A type of strabismus in which the visual axis of one eye is higher than that of the other.
HP:0025587.definition_cn: 一种斜视类型，其中一只眼的视轴高于另一只眼。

HP:0025588.name: Hypodeviation
HP:0025588.definition: A type of strabismus in which the visual axis of one eye is lower than that of the other.
HP:0025588.definition_cn: 一种斜视类型，其中一只眼的视轴低于另一只眼。

HP:0025589.name: Cyclodeviation
HP:0025589.definition: Cyclodeviation is defined as the rotation of an eyeball along the anteroposterior axis and cyclotropia as a misalignment of cyclodeviation between the two eyes.
HP:0025589.definition_cn: 旋转偏斜（Cyclodeviation）定义为眼球沿前后轴的旋转，而旋转斜视（Cyclotropia）则指双眼间旋转偏斜的错位。

HP:0025590.name: Abnormal extraocular muscle physiology
HP:0025590.definition: A functional anomaly of the muscles of the eye.

HP:0025591.name: Abnormal superior oblique muscle physiology
HP:0025591.definition: A functional anomaly of the superior oblique muscle, a fusiform muscle that originates in the upper, medial side of the orbit. The superior oblique muscle abducts, depresses and internally rotates the eye, and is the only extraocular muscle innervated by the fourth cranial nerve.
HP:0025591.definition_cn: 上斜肌功能异常，该肌为梭形肌，起源于眼眶上内侧。上斜肌具有外展、下转和内旋眼球的功能，且是唯一由第四对脑神经（滑车神经）支配的眼外肌。

HP:0025592.name: Superior oblique muscle weakness
