HP:0025592.definition: Decreased strength of the superior oblique muscle.

HP:0025593.name: Superior oblique muscle restriction
HP:0025593.definition: Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the superior oblique muscle.
HP:0025593.definition_cn: 上斜肌运动范围的机械性限制。

HP:0025594.name: Superior oblique muscle overaction
HP:0025594.definition: An ocular motility abnormality characterized by an overacting superior oblique muscle resulting to vertical incomitance of the eyes in lateral gaze. On examination, this is commonly seen as a downshoot of the adducting eye occurring when gaze is directed into the field of action of the inferior oblique muscle, producing a greater downward excursion of the adducted eye than of the abducted eye.
HP:0025594.definition_cn: 一种眼动异常，其特征为上斜肌功能亢进，导致侧视时双眼垂直不协调。在检查中，通常表现为当注视方向进入下斜肌作用范围时，内收眼出现下移现象，导致内收眼的下移幅度大于外展眼。

HP:0025595.name: Superior oblique muscle underaction
HP:0025595.definition: Reduced ocular movement of the superior oblique muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy.
HP:0025595.definition_cn: 上斜肌眼球运动受限，在测试眼外肌运动时有所改善，通常与神经源性麻痹相关。

HP:0025596.name: Abnormal inferior oblique muscle physiology
HP:0025596.definition: A functional anomaly of the inferior oblique muscle, an extraocular muscle that has its origin on the maxillary bone just posterior to the inferior medial orbital rim and lateral to the nasolacrimal canal and that is innervated by the inferior branch of the oculomotor nerve.
HP:0025596.definition_cn: 下斜肌功能异常，该眼外肌起自眶下缘内侧后方、鼻泪管外侧的上颌骨，由动眼神经下支支配。

HP:0025597.name: Inferior oblique muscle restriction
HP:0025597.definition: Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the inferior oblique muscle.
HP:0025597.definition_cn: 下斜肌运动范围的机械性限制。

HP:0025598.name: Inferior oblique muscle weakness
HP:0025598.definition: Decreased strength of the inferior oblique muscle.

HP:0025599.name: Inferior oblique muscle overaction
HP:0025599.definition: A common ocular motility disorder characterized by vertical incomitance of the eyes in lateral gaze. In primary inferior oblique muscle overaction, an upshoot of the adducting eye occurs when gaze is directed into the field of action of the inferior oblique muscle, producing a greater upward excursion of the adducted eye than of the abducted eye.
HP:0025599.definition_cn: 一种常见的眼球运动障碍，其特征为侧向注视时双眼垂直方向的不一致性。在原发性下斜肌功能亢进中，当注视方向进入下斜肌作用范围时，内转眼出现上移现象，导致内转眼的上移幅度大于外转眼。

HP:0025600.name: Abnormal inferior rectus muscle physiology
HP:0025600.definition: A functional anomaly of the inferior rectus muscle, which is innervated by the inferior division of oculomotor nerve and functions in the depression, adduction, and lateral rotation (extortion) of the eye.
HP:0025600.definition_cn: 下直肌功能障碍，该肌肉由动眼神经下支支配，功能为眼球下转、内收及外旋（外展）。

HP:0025601.name: Inferior rectus muscle weakness
HP:0025601.definition: Decreased strength of the inferior rectus muscle.

HP:0025602.name: Inferior rectus muscle restriction
HP:0025602.definition: Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the inferior rectus muscle.
HP:0025602.definition_cn: 下直肌运动范围的机械性限制。

HP:0025603.name: Abnormal superior rectus muscle physiology
HP:0025603.definition: A functional anomaly of the superior rectus muscle, an extraocular muscle that is innervated by the superior division of the oculomotor nerve, and whose primary function is the elevation of the globe.
HP:0025603.definition_cn: 上直肌功能异常，该眼外肌由动眼神经上支支配，其主要功能为眼球上抬。

HP:0025604.name: Orbital schwannoma
HP:0025604.definition: A schwannoma (benign, usually encapsulated slow growing tumor composed of Schwann cells) located in the orbit.
HP:0025604.definition_cn: 位于眼眶的神经鞘瘤（良性，通常为包膜性、生长缓慢的肿瘤，由施万细胞构成）。

HP:0025605.name: Lid lag on downgaze
HP:0025605.definition: Delayed descent of the upper eyelid on downgaze. Also described by some authors as von Graefe sign.
HP:0025605.definition_cn: 上睑下视延迟。部分作者亦称之为冯·格雷费征（von Graefe sign）。

HP:0025606.name: Abnormal medial rectus muscle physiology
HP:0025606.definition: A functional anomaly of the medial rectus muscle, an extraocular muscle that is innervated by the inferior division of the oculomotor nerve and whose sole action is the adduction of the eyeball.
HP:0025606.name_cn: 内侧直肌生理功能异常
HP:0025606.definition_cn: 内侧直肌功能异常，该肌为眼外肌，由动眼神经下支支配，其唯一功能为眼球内收。

HP:0025607.name: Upper eyelid entropion
HP:0025607.definition: An inward turning (inversion) of the margin of the upper eyelid.

HP:0025608.name: Cicatricial ectropion
HP:0025608.definition: An outward turning (eversion) or rotation of the eyelid margin (i.e., ectropion) caused by shortening or contraction of the anterior or middle lamellae related to scarring.
HP:0025608.definition_cn: 由前层或中层板层瘢痕相关缩短或收缩引起的眼睑边缘外翻（外翻）或旋转（即睑外翻）。

HP:0025609.name: Anterior blepharitis
HP:0025609.definition: A type of blepharitis that affects the eyelid skin, base of the eyelashes, and the eyelash follicles.
HP:0025609.definition_cn: 一种累及眼睑皮肤、睫毛根部及睫毛毛囊的睑缘炎。

HP:0025610.name: Posterior blepharitis
HP:0025610.definition: A type of blepharitis that affects the meibomian glands and meibomian gland orifices. This abnormality can be associated with a spectrum of appearances ranging from meibomian seborrhoea (foaming meibomian gland secretions) and meibomianitis (inflamed meibomian glands), to chalazia.
HP:0025610.definition_cn: 一种影响睑板腺及睑板腺开口的睑缘炎。该异常可伴随一系列临床表现，包括睑板腺脂溢（睑板腺分泌物呈泡沫状）、睑板腺炎（睑板腺炎症）以及霰粒肿。

HP:0025611.name: Epicanthus superciliaris
HP:0025611.definition: A type of epicanthus in which more extensive epicanthal folds with their origins in the eyebrow cover, pass in front of and lateral to the medial canthus (middle corner of the eye).
HP:0025611.definition_cn: 一种内眦赘皮类型，其特征为起源于眉部的较广泛的内眦皱襞覆盖并经过内眦（眼内角）的前方和外侧。

HP:0025612.name: Corneal astigmatism
HP:0025612.definition: A type of refractive error related abnormal curvatures on the anterior or posterior surface of the cornea.
HP:0025612.definition_cn: 一种与角膜前表面或后表面异常曲率相关的屈光不正类型。

HP:0025613.name: Focal emotional seizure
HP:0025613.definition: Seizures presenting with an emotion or the appearance of having an emotion as an early prominent feature, such as fear, spontaneous joy or euphoria, laughing (gelastic), or crying, (dacrystic). These emotional seizures may occur with or without objective clinical signs of a seizure evident to the observer.
HP:0025613.name_cn: 局灶性情感性癫痫发作
HP:0025613.definition_cn: 以情绪或情绪表现为早期显著特征的癫痫发作，例如恐惧、自发性愉悦或欣快、笑（笑性发作）或哭（哭性发作）。这些情绪性癫痫发作可能伴随或不伴随观察者可见的客观临床癫痫体征。

HP:0025615.name: Abscess
HP:0025615.definition: An abscess is a localized collection of purulent material surrounded by inflammation and granulation.
HP:0025615.definition_cn: 脓肿是一种由炎症和肉芽组织包围的局部化脓性物质积聚。

HP:0025616.name: Sterile abscess
HP:0025616.definition: An abscess not caused by infection with pyogenic bacteria. Operationally, a sterile abscess is inferred if investigations of an abscess fail to reveal evidence of pathogenic organisms.
HP:0025616.definition_cn: 无菌性脓肿（Sterile Abscess），非由化脓性细菌感染引起的脓肿。在临床操作中，若对脓肿的检查未能发现病原微生物的证据，则可推断为无菌性脓肿。

HP:0025617.name: Abnormal plasma cell count
HP:0025617.definition: An abnormal number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies.
HP:0025617.definition_cn: 血液循环中浆细胞数量异常。浆细胞是专门负责大量抗体生成的效应细胞。

HP:0025618.name: Reduced plasma cell count
HP:0025618.definition: An abnormally low number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies.
HP:0025618.definition_cn: 循环血液中浆细胞数量异常减少。浆细胞是专职产生大量抗体的效应细胞。

HP:0025619.name: Elevated plasma cell count
HP:0025619.definition: An abnormally high number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies.
HP:0025619.definition_cn: 循环血液中浆细胞数量异常增多。浆细胞是专职产生大量抗体的效应细胞。

HP:0025620.name: Abnormal proportion of CD4+ central memory cells
HP:0025620.definition: An abnormal proportion of central memory CD4+ T cells. These are memory cells that are located in the secondary lymphoid organs. These cells may have a CD3/CD4/CD62L+/CD45RA- phenotype.
HP:0025620.name_cn: CD4+中央记忆细胞比例异常
HP:0025620.definition_cn: 中央记忆性CD4+ T细胞比例异常。这些记忆细胞位于次级淋巴器官中。这些细胞可能具有CD3/CD4/CD62L+/CD45RA-表型。

HP:0025621.name: obsolete Increased proportion of CD4+ central memory cells
HP:0025621.name_cn: 过时的 CD4+ 中央记忆细胞比例增加

HP:0025622.name: obsolete Decreased proportion of CD4+ central memory cells
HP:0025622.name_cn: CD4+中央记忆细胞比例降低

HP:0025623.name: Abnormal proportion of CD4+ effector memory cells
HP:0025623.definition: An abnormal proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells have the phenotype CD3-positive, CD4-positive, CD62L-negative, CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0025623.name_cn: CD4+效应记忆细胞比例异常
HP:0025623.definition_cn: 血液中效应记忆CD4+ T细胞与总T细胞数量的比例异常。这些记忆细胞为短寿命细胞，迁移至感染部位并试图清除病原体。这些细胞具有CD3阳性、CD4阳性、CD62L阴性、CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型。

HP:0025624.name: Reduced proportion of CD4+ effector memory T cells
HP:0025624.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells have the phenotype CD3-positive, CD4-positive, CD62L-negative, CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0025624.name_cn: CD4+效应记忆T细胞比例降低
HP:0025624.definition_cn: 与外周血中T细胞总数相比，效应记忆CD4+ T细胞比例异常降低。这些记忆细胞为短寿命细胞，可迁移至感染部位并试图清除病原体。此类细胞表型为CD3阳性、CD4阳性、CD62L阴性、CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性及CD25阴性。

HP:0025625.name: Elevated proportion of CD4+ effector memory T cells
HP:0025625.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells may have a CD3/CD4/CD62L-/CD45RA phenotype.
HP:0025625.name_cn: CD4+效应记忆T细胞比例升高
HP:0025625.definition_cn: 效应记忆CD4+ T细胞比例异常增高。这些记忆细胞为短寿命细胞，迁移至感染部位并试图清除病原体。这些细胞可能具有CD3/CD4/CD62L-/CD45RA表型。

HP:0025626.name: Increased circulating oleate level
HP:0025626.definition: An abnormally high concentration of oleic acid (oleate) in the blood circulation.
HP:0025626.definition_cn: 血液循环中油酸（油酸盐）浓度异常升高。

HP:0025627.name: Increased circulating octadecanoate level
HP:0025627.definition: An abnormally high concentration of octadecanoate in the blood circulation. Octadecanoate is a fatty acid anion 18:0 that is the conjugate base of octadecanoic acid (stearic acid).
HP:0025627.name_cn: 循环中十八烷酸水平升高
HP:0025627.definition_cn: 血液循环中十八烷酸酯浓度异常升高。十八烷酸酯是一种脂肪酸阴离子18:0，是十八烷酸（硬脂酸）的共轭碱。

HP:0025628.name: Increased circulating myristoleate level
HP:0025628.definition: An abnormally high concentration of myristoleate in the blood circulation.
HP:0025628.name_cn: 循环中肉豆蔻油酸水平升高
HP:0025628.definition_cn: 血液循环中肉豆蔻油酸浓度异常升高。

HP:0025629.name: Anti-myelin-associated glycoprotein antibody positivity
HP:0025629.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against myelin-associated glycoprotein (MAG).
HP:0025629.name_cn: 抗髓鞘相关糖蛋白抗体阳性
HP:0025629.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对髓鞘相关糖蛋白（myelin-associated glycoprotein, MAG）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0025630.name: Argininosuccinic aciduria
HP:0025630.definition: Increased amount of argininosuccinate in the urine.
HP:0025630.definition_cn: 尿液中精氨酰琥珀酸含量升高。

HP:0025631.name: Alpha-aminobutyric aciduria
HP:0025631.definition: Increased amount of alpha-aminobutyric acid in the urine.
HP:0025631.definition_cn: 尿液中α-氨基丁酸含量升高。

HP:0025632.name: Reduced reactive oxygen species production in neutrophils
HP:0025632.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of reactive oxygen produced by neutrophils in the respiratory burst.
HP:0025632.name_cn: 中性粒细胞中活性氧生成减少
HP:0025632.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞在呼吸爆发过程中产生的活性氧量异常减少。

HP:0025633.name: Abnormal ureter morphology
HP:0025633.definition: A structural abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder.
HP:0025633.definition_cn: 输尿管结构异常。输尿管是尿液从肾脏输送至膀胱的导管。

HP:0025634.name: Abnormal ureter physiology
HP:0025634.definition: A functional abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder.
HP:0025634.definition_cn: 输尿管功能异常。输尿管是尿液从肾脏输送至膀胱的管道。

HP:0025635.name: Ureteral polyp
HP:0025635.definition: A growth protruding from the mucous membrane of the ureter. Ureteral polyps can be attached to the ureter by a broad base or a thin stalk.
HP:0025635.definition_cn: 输尿管黏膜上突出的增生性病变。输尿管息肉可通过宽基底或细蒂附着于输尿管。

HP:0025636.name: Endometritis
HP:0025636.definition: Inflammation of the inner lining of the uterus (endometrium).

HP:0025637.name: Vasospasm
HP:0025637.definition: Narrowing of an artery due to constriction of the blood vessels.
HP:0025637.definition_cn: 动脉狭窄（Arterial Stenosis）由于血管收缩（Vasoconstriction）所致。

HP:0025638.name: Elevated urinary N-butyrylglycine
HP:0025638.definition: An increased level of N-butyrylglycine in the urine.
HP:0025638.definition_cn: 尿液中N-丁酰甘氨酸水平升高。

HP:0025639.name: Increased urinary zinc level
HP:0025639.definition: An abnormally elevated amount of zinc in the urine, typically as assessed by a 24 hour urine collection.
HP:0025639.definition_cn: 尿锌异常升高，通常通过24小时尿液收集进行评估。

HP:0025640.name: Abnormal urinary mineral level
HP:0025640.definition: An abnormal concentration or amount of a mineral in the urine. Medically relevant minerals include calcium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, chloride, magnesium, iron, zinc, iodine, chromium, copper, fluoride, molybdenum, manganese, and selenium.
HP:0025640.definition_cn: 尿液中矿物质浓度或量的异常。医学相关矿物质包括钙、磷、钾、钠、氯、镁、铁、锌、碘、铬、铜、氟、钼、锰和硒。

HP:0025641.name: Elevated circulating glycolate concentration
HP:0025641.definition: The concentration of glycolate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025641.name_cn: 循环中乙醇酸盐浓度升高
HP:0025641.definition_cn: 血液中乙醇酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0025643.name: Tarlov cyst
HP:0025643.definition: A cerebrospinal fluid-filled nerve root cyst most often localized in the sacral spine.
HP:0025643.definition_cn: 一种充满脑脊液的神经根囊肿，最常见于骶椎区域。

HP:0025644.name: Fixation-off epileptiform discharges
HP:0025644.definition: Fixation off sensitivity (FOS) is characterized by posterior or generalized epileptiform discharges that consistently occur with conditions that eliminate central vision, such as closed eyes, complete darkness, modified Ganzfeld stimulation (using a large white surface without visual cues), and Frenzel lenses. The FOS electroencephalogram (EEG) pattern usually consists of spikes/polyspikes and waves localized in occipital regions (bilateral or unilateral) or generalized discharges. It is usually inhibited by fixation of gaze, observing patterns, or intermittent photic stimulation (e.g., flashing light or patterns used as stimuli during the recording of the EEG).
HP:0025644.definition_cn: 注视关闭敏感性（Fixation Off Sensitivity, FOS）的特征是在消除中央视觉的条件下，如闭眼、完全黑暗、改良的Ganzfeld刺激（使用无视觉线索的大面积白色表面）以及Frenzel镜片，持续出现后部或广泛性癫痫样放电。FOS的脑电图（Electroencephalogram, EEG）模式通常包括局限于枕区（双侧或单侧）的棘波/多棘波和慢波，或广泛性放电。该模式通常通过注视固定、观察图案或间歇性光刺激（例如在EEG记录过程中使用的闪光或图案刺激）被抑制。

HP:0025646.name: Bilateral polymicrogyria
HP:0025646.definition: Polymicrogyria that affects all or some of both cerebral hemispheres.
HP:0025646.definition_cn: 双侧大脑半球全部或部分受累的多小脑回畸形。

HP:0025647.name: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome
HP:0025647.definition: A type of nephrotic syndrome in which complete remission (albumin urine dipstick negative/trace or proteinuria <4mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio <200mg/g (<20 mg/mmol) for 3 consecutive days) is achieved within initial 4 weeks of corticosteroid therapy.
HP:0025647.name_cn: 类固醇敏感性肾病综合征
HP:0025647.definition_cn: 一种肾病综合征类型，其特征为在糖皮质激素治疗初始4周内达到完全缓解（连续3天尿白蛋白试纸阴性/微量或蛋白尿<4mg/m²/d或尿蛋白与肌酐比值<200mg/g（<20mg/mmol））。

HP:0025648.name: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with infrequent relapses
HP:0025648.definition: A type of steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome in which relapses occur at a frequency of one relapse (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria over 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) within 6 months of initial response, or one to three relapses in any 12-month period.
HP:0025648.name_cn: 类固醇敏感性肾病综合征伴罕见复发
HP:0025648.definition_cn: 一种类固醇敏感性肾病综合征，其特征为在初始治疗反应后6个月内复发一次（尿白蛋白试纸至少3+或蛋白尿超过40 mg/m²/d或尿蛋白与肌酐比值至少2000 mg/g，持续3天），或在任何12个月期间复发1至3次。

HP:0025649.name: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with frequent relapses
HP:0025649.definition: A type of steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome in which relapses occur at a frequency of two or more relapses (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria over 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) within 6 months of initial response or four or more relapses in any 12-month period.
HP:0025649.name_cn: 类固醇敏感性肾病综合征伴频繁复发
HP:0025649.definition_cn: 一种类固醇敏感性肾病综合征，其特征为在初始治疗反应后6个月内复发频率达到两次或以上（尿白蛋白试纸至少3+，或蛋白尿超过40 mg/m²/d，或尿蛋白与肌酐比值至少2000 mg/g，持续3天），或在任何12个月期间复发频率达到四次或以上。

HP:0025650.name: Steroid-dependent nephrotic syndrome
HP:0025650.definition: A type of nephrotic syndrome in which two consecutive relapses (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria greater than 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) occur during corticosteroid therapy, or within 14 days of ceasing therapy.
HP:0025650.name_cn: 类固醇依赖性肾病综合征
HP:0025650.definition_cn: 一种肾病综合征类型，其特征为在糖皮质激素治疗期间或停药后14天内连续两次复发（尿蛋白试纸至少3+，或蛋白尿大于40 mg/m2/d，或连续3天尿蛋白与肌酐比值至少为2000 mg/g）。

HP:0025652.name: Abnormal placental adhesion into the uterine wall
HP:0025652.definition: Abnormal placental adhesion is characterized by an anomalous adherence of the placenta to the uterine wall. Based on the degree of adhesion, placental invasion can be classified into accreta, increta, or percreta.
HP:0025652.definition_cn: 异常胎盘粘连的特征是胎盘与子宫壁的异常附着。根据粘连程度，胎盘侵入可分为胎盘粘连（accreta）、胎盘植入（increta）或胎盘穿透（percreta）。

HP:0025653.name: Placenta percreta
HP:0025653.definition: Placenta percreta is a rare form of morbidly adherent placenta with penetration through the myometrium reaching serosa and even adjacent pelvic organs.
HP:0025653.definition_cn: 胎盘穿透是一种罕见的病理性胎盘植入类型，其特点是胎盘穿透子宫肌层，达到浆膜层甚至邻近盆腔器官。

HP:0025654.name: Placenta accreta
HP:0025654.definition: Abnormally firm adherence of the placenta to the uterine wall.
HP:0025654.definition_cn: 胎盘异常牢固地附着于子宫壁。

HP:0025655.name: Placenta increta
HP:0025655.definition: Abnormal placental pentration into but not beyond the uterine wall.
HP:0025655.definition_cn: 胎盘异常侵入子宫壁但未穿透子宫壁。

HP:0025656.name: Prenatal double bubble sign
HP:0025656.definition: Sonographic detection of a double bubble sign in the upper abdomen is strongly indicative of duodenal obstruction. One bubble represents fetal stomach, and the other is attributed to a dilated proximal part of the duodenum; continuity between both bubbles is required for the sign.
HP:0025656.definition_cn: 上腹部超声检测到双泡征强烈提示十二指肠梗阻。其中一个泡代表胎儿胃部，另一个泡则归因于十二指肠近端扩张；该征象要求两个泡之间存在连续性。

HP:0025658.name: obsolete Abnormal umbilical artery Doppler pattern in pregnancy
HP:0025658.name_cn: 妊娠期异常脐动脉多普勒波形

HP:0025659.name: Decreased circulating creatine kinase concentration
HP:0025659.definition: A reduction in the level of the enzyme creatine kinase (also known as creatine phosphokinase (CK; EC 2.7.3.2) in the blood.
HP:0025659.name_cn: 循环肌酸激酶浓度降低
HP:0025659.definition_cn: 血液中肌酸激酶（也称为肌酸磷酸激酶，CK；EC 2.7.3.2）水平降低。

HP:0025660.name: Chiari type II malformation
HP:0025660.definition: A type of Chiari malformation that consists of brainstem herniation and a towering cerebellum in addition to the herniated cerebellar tonsils and vermis due to an open distal spinal dysraphism/myelomeningocele.
HP:0025660.definition_cn: 一种Chiari畸形类型，其特征包括脑干疝出、小脑高耸，以及由于远端脊柱裂/脊髓脊膜膨出导致的疝出的小脑扁桃体和蚓部。

HP:0025661.name: Chiari type III malformation
HP:0025661.definition: A type of Chiari malformation that involves herniation of the hindbrain (cerebellum with or without the brainstem) into a low occipital or high cervical meningoencephalocele.
HP:0025661.definition_cn: 一种Chiari畸形类型，涉及后脑（小脑伴或不伴脑干）疝入低位枕部或高位颈部脑膜脑膨出。

HP:0025662.name: Abnormal fetal skeletal morphology
HP:0025662.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal skeleton. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other terms from the skeletal hierarchy can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0025662.definition_cn: 胎儿骨骼结构异常发现。此亚层次中的术语仅限于在产前期间可观察到的发现。骨骼层次中的其他术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0025663.name: Reduced fetal femur/foot length ratio
HP:0025663.definition: This ratio relates the length of the fetal femur to that of the fetal foot. The ratio is approximately 1 throughout the age range of 14 to 40 weeks of gestation. A substantial reduction in the raio can help differentiate fetuses that have dysplastic limb reduction from those whose limbs are short because of constitutional factors or IUGR. It can reduce the problem of an unknown gestational age and help to distinguish between fetal skeletal dysplasia and intrauterine growth retardation caused by other factors.
HP:0025663.definition_cn: 该比值涉及胎儿股骨长度与胎儿足部长度的关系。在妊娠14至40周的整个年龄范围内，该比值约为1。比值的显著降低有助于区分因肢体发育不良导致的肢体短缩与因体质因素或宫内生长受限（IUGR）导致的肢体短缩。该比值可减少孕龄未知的问题，并有助于区分胎儿骨骼发育不良与其他因素引起的宫内生长迟缓。

HP:0025664.name: Moderate to late preterm birth
HP:0025664.definition: Birth at 32 to 36 completed weeks of gestation.

HP:0025665.name: Extremely preterm birth
HP:0025665.definition: Birth before 28 completed weeks of gestation (up to and including 27 weeks and 6 days of gestation).
HP:0025665.definition_cn: 妊娠28周前分娩（包括妊娠27周6天）。

HP:0025666.name: Very preterm birth
HP:0025666.definition: Birth before 32 completed weeks of gestation (28 up to but not including 32 weeks).
HP:0025666.definition_cn: 妊娠32周前分娩（28周至但未满32周）。

HP:0025667.name: Fetal neck anomaly
HP:0025667.definition: A structural anomaly in the fetal neck region. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0025667.definition_cn: 胎儿颈部区域的结构异常。此子层次结构中的术语仅限于在产前期间可观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0025668.name: Abnormal neck morphology
HP:0025668.definition: Any structural anomaly of the neck region.

HP:0025669.name: Abnormal neck physiology
HP:0025669.definition: Any functional anomaly of the neck region.

HP:0025670.name: Syntelencephaly
HP:0025670.definition: Syntelencephaly is a rare malformation that consists of an abnormal midline connection of the cerebral hemispheres in the posterior frontal and parietal regions, with interhemispheric separation of the basal forebrain, anterior frontal lobes, and occipital regions.
HP:0025670.definition_cn: 前脑无裂畸形是一种罕见的畸形，其特征为大脑半球在额叶后部和顶叶区域存在异常的中间连接，同时基底前脑、额叶前部和枕叶区域存在半球间分离。

HP:0025671.name: Fetal pericardial effusion
HP:0025671.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid in which the heart is partially or completely surrounded by fluid that is seen in all views and the thickness of the fluid as observed by prenatal ultrasound is above age-dependent norms.
HP:0025671.definition_cn: 心包积液异常积聚，表现为心脏部分或完全被液体包围，在所有切面均可见，且产前超声观察到的液体厚度超过年龄相关正常值。

HP:0025672.name: Fetal skin edema
HP:0025672.definition: A separation of skin in one or more regions of the body or even along the entire length of body wall (to a degree greater than gestational-age related norms) related to pathologically increased fluid accumulation in the subcutaneous tissue.
HP:0025672.definition_cn: 身体一个或多个区域甚至沿整个体壁长度（程度超过与胎龄相关的正常范围）的皮肤分离，与皮下组织中病理性增加的液体积聚相关。

HP:0025673.name: Loculated ascites
HP:0025673.definition: A type of ascites (peritoneal fluid collection) that is divided into loculi (compartments) by septa (fibrous walls). Ascites fluid can become loculated when confined by adhesions, malignancy or infection.
HP:0025673.definition_cn: 一种腹水（腹腔积液）类型，其被分隔（纤维性壁）分割成多个小腔室（分隔腔）。当腹水被粘连、恶性肿瘤或感染所限制时，可形成分隔性腹水。

HP:0025674.name: Meconium pseudocyst
HP:0025674.definition: A meconium-containing cyst in the peritoneal space . Meconium pseudocysts form in the presence of meconium peritonitis, which is defined as a sterile peritonitis caused by escape of meconium from the intestinal tract into the general peritoneal cavity during the fetal or perinatal period. When the extruded meconium becomes walled off, it can form a rim-calcified mass representing the meconium pseudocyst.
HP:0025674.definition_cn: 腹膜腔内含有胎粪的囊肿。胎粪假性囊肿形成于胎粪性腹膜炎的情况下，胎粪性腹膜炎定义为胎儿期或围产期胎粪从肠道逸出至腹腔引起的无菌性腹膜炎。当排出的胎粪被包裹时，可形成边缘钙化的肿块，即胎粪假性囊肿。

HP:0025675.name: Premature closure of the ductus arteriosus
HP:0025675.definition: A prenatal partial or complete closure of the ductus arteriosus (i.e., prior to delivery).
HP:0025675.definition_cn: 产前动脉导管部分或完全闭合（即分娩前）。

HP:0025676.name: Fetal pleural effusion
HP:0025676.definition: Fetal pleural effusion is the accumulation of excess fluid in the layers of tissue (pleura) lining the lungs and wall of the chest. It may be primary, also termed hydrothorax, occurring as an isolated finding or it may be secondary, most commonly resulting from non-immune hydrops.
HP:0025676.definition_cn: 胎儿胸腔积液是指液体在肺部和胸壁之间的组织层（胸膜）中异常积聚。它可以是原发性的，也称为水胸，作为孤立性表现出现；也可以是继发性的，最常见的原因是非免疫性水肿。

HP:0025677.name: Fetal chylothorax
HP:0025677.definition: The presence of chyle (a type of lipid-rich lymph) in the pleural space (the space surrounding the lung) as observed in a fetus.
HP:0025677.definition_cn: 胎儿胸腔内乳糜（一种富含脂质的淋巴液）的存在。

HP:0025678.name: Fetal hydrothorax
HP:0025678.definition: Accumulation of lymphatic fluid in the pleural space. This finding is usually observed by prenatal sonography. Once neonatal feeding is established and the lymphatic fluid contains chyle, transformation to chylothorax may be observed.
HP:0025678.definition_cn: 胸腔内淋巴液积聚。此现象通常通过产前超声检查观察到。一旦新生儿开始喂养且淋巴液中含有乳糜，可能转化为乳糜胸。

HP:0025679.name: Diskitis
HP:0025679.definition: Inflammation of an intervertebral disk or disk space.

HP:0025680.name: Compound muscle action potential amplitude facilitation
HP:0025680.definition: Compound muscle action potential amplitude (CMAP) facilitation denotes an increase in tendon reflexes, strength, or CMAP amplitude after 10 seconds of maximal voluntary contraction.
HP:0025680.name_cn: 复合肌肉动作电位振幅易化
HP:0025680.definition_cn: 复合肌肉动作电位振幅（CMAP）增强现象是指在最大自主收缩持续10秒后，腱反射、肌力或CMAP振幅的增加。

HP:0025681.name: Distal clavicular thinning
HP:0025681.definition: Abnormally reduced diameter (cross section) of the clavicles that is limited to the distal region.
HP:0025681.definition_cn: 锁骨远端区域异常缩小的直径（横截面）。

HP:0025682.name: Crouch gait
HP:0025682.definition: A gait disturbance that is characterized by excessive ankle dorsiflexion, knee and hip flexion during the stance phase.
HP:0025682.definition_cn: 一种步态障碍，其特征为在站立相期间出现踝关节过度背屈、膝关节和髋关节过度屈曲。

HP:0025683.name: Abnormal amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
HP:0025683.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Amyloid beta is a peptide of 36-43 amino acids that is processed from the Amyloid precursor protein. ABeta42, which is 42 amino acids in length, is the longer form.
HP:0025683.name_cn: 异常β淀粉样蛋白42肽脑脊液浓度
HP:0025683.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中β淀粉样蛋白42肽（Amyloid Beta 42 Peptide）浓度的任何异常。β淀粉样蛋白是一种由36至43个氨基酸组成的肽，由淀粉样前体蛋白（Amyloid Precursor Protein）加工而成。ABeta42是由42个氨基酸组成的较长形式。

HP:0025684.name: Decreased amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
HP:0025684.definition: A reduction from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0025684.name_cn: 脑脊液中β淀粉样蛋白42肽浓度降低
HP:0025684.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中β淀粉样蛋白42肽浓度低于正常水平。

HP:0025685.name: Increased amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
HP:0025685.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0025685.name_cn: 脑脊液中β淀粉样蛋白42肽浓度升高
HP:0025685.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中β淀粉样蛋白42肽浓度高于正常水平。

HP:0025686.name: Abnormal amyloid beta 40 peptide CSF concentration
HP:0025686.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Amyloid beta is a peptide of 36-43 amino acids that is processed from the Amyloid precursor protein. ABeta40, which is 40 amino acids in length, is the shorter form.
HP:0025686.name_cn: 异常β淀粉样蛋白40肽脑脊液浓度
HP:0025686.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中β淀粉样蛋白42肽（Amyloid beta 42 peptide）浓度的任何异常。β淀粉样蛋白是一种由36至43个氨基酸组成的肽，由淀粉样前体蛋白（Amyloid precursor protein）加工而成。其中，由40个氨基酸组成的β淀粉样蛋白40（ABeta40）是其较短的形式。

HP:0025687.name: Increased amyloid beta 40 peptide CSF concentration
HP:0025687.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of amyloid beta 40 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0025687.name_cn: 淀粉样β40肽脑脊液浓度升高
HP:0025687.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中β淀粉样蛋白40肽浓度高于正常水平。

HP:0025688.name: Abnormal amyloid beta peptide CSF concentration
HP:0025688.definition: Any anomaly in the concentration of a cleaved APP amyloid beta protein fragment in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0025688.name_cn: 异常β淀粉样蛋白肽脑脊液浓度
HP:0025688.definition_cn: 脑脊液中裂解的淀粉样前体蛋白β片段浓度异常。

HP:0025689.name: Extra-abdominal umbilical vein varix
HP:0025689.definition: Focal dilatation of the extra-abdominal portion of the umbilical vein. An extra-abdominal umbilical varix is difficult to diagnose prenatally as it can appear like a cyst on ultrasound prior to birth.
HP:0025689.definition_cn: 脐静脉腹外段局部扩张。腹外脐静脉曲张在产前难以诊断，因为其在出生前的超声检查中可能呈现为囊肿样表现。

HP:0025690.name: Fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix
HP:0025690.definition: Fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix (FIUVV) is defined by the focal dilatation of the fetal umbilical vein between its entry in the abdomen and its ending in the portal system. The dilatation can be defined using one of the following criteria: a portion of intra-abdominal umbilical vein that is at least 50% wider than the non-dilated portion; a dilatation of 9 mm or more, or a dilatation greater than 2 SD above the mean value for gestational age.
HP:0025690.name_cn: 胎儿腹腔内脐静脉曲张
HP:0025690.definition_cn: 胎儿腹腔内脐静脉瘤（Fetal Intra-abdominal Umbilical Vein Varix, FIUVV）定义为胎儿脐静脉在进入腹部至汇入门静脉系统之间的局部扩张。扩张可通过以下任一标准进行定义：腹腔内脐静脉的某一部分比非扩张部分至少宽50%；扩张直径达到或超过9毫米；或扩张直径大于该孕周平均值的2个标准差（2 SD）。

HP:0025691.name: Impaired fasting glucose
HP:0025691.definition: Impaired fasting glucose (IFG) is indicated by a fasting plasma glucose above normal but below the diabetic range. Levels between 110 mg/dl (6.1 mmol/l) to 125 mg/dl (6.9 mmol/l) are diagnostic of IFG.
HP:0025691.definition_cn: 空腹血糖受损（Impaired Fasting Glucose, IFG）是指空腹血浆葡萄糖水平高于正常范围但低于糖尿病诊断标准。空腹血糖水平在110 mg/dl（6.1 mmol/l）至125 mg/dl（6.9 mmol/l）之间可诊断为IFG。

HP:0025692.name: Atelencephaly
HP:0025692.definition: A defect of development of the brain characterized by absence of the telencephalon (embryonic structure from which the mature cerebrum develops).
HP:0025692.definition_cn: 一种大脑发育缺陷，其特征为端脑缺失（端脑是成熟大脑发育的胚胎结构）。

HP:0025693.name: Pituitary macroadenoma
HP:0025693.definition: A pituitary gland adenoma that is larger than 10mm.
HP:0025693.definition_cn: 直径大于10毫米的垂体腺瘤。

HP:0025694.name: Pituitary microadenoma
HP:0025694.definition: A pituitary adenoma that is less than 10 mm in diameter.
HP:0025694.definition_cn: 直径小于10毫米的垂体腺瘤。

HP:0025695.name: Mucus plug
HP:0025695.definition: Mucus that is abnormally thick in consistency (ie, inspissated) and plugs the airway is known as a mucus plug. Mucus plugs consist of mucins and cells and can partially or completely obstruct one or more airways and cause serious consequences, including atelectasis and recurrent infection.
HP:0025695.definition_cn: 粘液栓是指粘稠度异常增厚（即浓缩）并堵塞气道的粘液。粘液栓由粘蛋白和细胞组成，可部分或完全阻塞一个或多个气道，并导致严重后果，包括肺不张和反复感染。

HP:0025696.name: Airway casts
HP:0025696.definition: A replicate of airways from accumulated and condensed mucous and cellular material. These semisolid occlusions take the shape of the airway within they are formed, leading to obstruction of the tracheobronchial tree with consecutive respiratory insufficiency. Based on their principal composition, one can differentiate fibrin casts and mucin casts. Plastic bronchitis is the name of the condition characterized by the formation of airway casts.
HP:0025696.definition_cn: 由积聚和浓缩的黏液及细胞物质形成的气道复制物。这些半固体阻塞物在形成时呈现其所在气道的形状，导致气管支气管树阻塞，进而引发呼吸功能不全。根据其主要成分，可分为纤维蛋白管型和黏液管型。塑型性支气管炎是指以气道管型形成为特征的疾病状态。

HP:0025697.name: Fibrin casts
HP:0025697.definition: A type of airway casts that consist of plasma components and inflammatory cells.
HP:0025697.definition_cn: 一种由血浆成分和炎性细胞组成的气道铸型。

HP:0025698.name: Mucin casts
HP:0025698.definition: A type of airway casts that consist of impacted mucus.
HP:0025698.definition_cn: 一种由嵌塞黏液组成的气道铸型。

HP:0025699.name: Perisylvian FDG hypermetabolism
HP:0025699.definition: 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography and computed tomography (FDG-PET/CT) evaluates the glucose metabolism of the brain. FDG uptake is interpreted to represent glycolysis. This term therefore represents an abnormally increased FDG uptake (increased glucose metabolism) in the region of the brain that surrounds the Sylvian fissure.
HP:0025699.definition_cn: 18F-氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）正电子发射断层扫描与计算机断层扫描（FDG-PET/CT）用于评估大脑的葡萄糖代谢。FDG摄取被解释为糖酵解的体现。因此，该术语表示在大脑外侧裂周围区域出现异常增高的FDG摄取（葡萄糖代谢增强）。

HP:0025700.name: Anhydramnios
HP:0025700.definition: A complete or near-complete lack of amniotic fluid surrounding a fetus. This finding can be observed sonographically in the third trimesters if the deepest pocket of amniotic fluid is less than or equal to 2 cm.
HP:0025700.definition_cn: 胎儿周围羊水完全或接近完全缺失。在妊娠晚期，如果超声检查显示羊水最深暗区小于或等于2厘米，可观察到这一现象。

HP:0025701.name: Distended jugular lymphatic sacs
HP:0025701.definition: The jugular lymphatic sacs (JLS) are a physiological and temporary part of fetal lymphatic development. They are formed from small buds of lymphatic endothelial cells arising from the internal jugular veins. By 14 weeks gestation they have developed into lymphatic nodes which drain into the systemic circulation. Visibility of JLS on ultrasound past 14 weeks of gestation implies distension and this may be associated with raised nuchal translucency.
HP:0025701.definition_cn: 颈淋巴囊（Jugular Lymphatic Sacs, JLS）是胎儿淋巴系统发育过程中的一个生理性、暂时性结构。它们由颈内静脉的淋巴内皮细胞小芽形成。至妊娠14周时，这些结构已发育为淋巴结，并引流至体循环。妊娠14周后超声检查中可见的颈淋巴囊提示其扩张，这可能与颈项透明层增厚相关。

HP:0025702.name: Type 1 schizencephaly
HP:0025702.definition: A type of Schizencephaly in which there is a trans-mantle column of abnormal gray matter but no evidence of a CSF-containing cleft on MR imaging.
HP:0025702.definition_cn: 一种类型的脑裂畸形，其中存在跨越脑皮质的异常灰质柱，但在磁共振成像（MRI）上未见含有脑脊液（CSF）的裂隙。

HP:0025703.name: Type 2 schizencephaly
HP:0025703.definition: A type of Schizencephaly in which CSF-containing cleft is present with abutting lining lips of abnormal gray matter that are opposed to each other.
HP:0025703.definition_cn: 一种类型的脑裂畸形，其中包含脑脊液的裂隙存在，且邻近的异常灰质边缘相互对合。

HP:0025704.name: Type 3 schizencephaly
HP:0025704.definition: A type of Schizencephaly in which CSF-containing cleft present with non-abutting lining lips of abnormal gray matter.
HP:0025704.definition_cn: 一种类型的脑裂畸形，其中含有脑脊液的裂隙存在，且其边缘由不连续的异常灰质构成。

HP:0025705.name: Abnormal fetal nasal bone visualization
HP:0025705.definition: Abnormal appearance or non-visualization (apparent absence) of the nasal bone of a fetus in first trimester sonographic screening. Assessment of the fetal nasal bone is generally performed at 11-14 weeks gestational age.
HP:0025705.definition_cn: 胎儿早孕期超声筛查中鼻骨异常形态或未显示（明显缺失）。胎儿鼻骨评估通常在孕周11-14周进行。

HP:0025706.name: Absent fetal nasal bone
HP:0025706.definition: The nasal bone is considered absent when it is not visualized on a midsagittal view of the profile. In the second trimester, a true midsagittal view of the fetal profile is obtained and magnified to fill the majority of the image space. The nasal bone appears as an echogenic linear structure below the skin edge. The optimal angle of insonation is 45 degrees to the longitudinal axis of the fetal nasal bone. If the angle of insonation is 0 or 180 degrees, the nasal bone may appear artificially absent. The presence or absence of the nasal bone may be determined at the time of the 11- to 14-week ultrasound examination and used as part of the risk assessment for aneuploidy.
HP:0025706.definition_cn: 鼻骨在正中矢状面视图中未显示时被视为缺失。在妊娠中期，获取胎儿轮廓的真实正中矢状面视图并放大以占据图像空间的大部分。鼻骨表现为皮肤边缘下方的回声线性结构。最佳入射角度为与胎儿鼻骨纵轴成45度。如果入射角度为0度或180度，鼻骨可能人为地显示为缺失。鼻骨的存在或缺失可在11至14周超声检查时确定，并作为非整倍体风险评估的一部分。

HP:0025707.name: Hypoplastic fetal nasal bone
HP:0025707.definition: Length of the nasal bone below a predetermined cut-off as seen on antenatal ultrasound using standard imaging techniques.
HP:0025707.definition_cn: 产前超声检查中，采用标准成像技术观察到的鼻骨长度低于预设截断值。

HP:0025708.name: Early young adult onset
HP:0025708.definition: Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 16 to under 19 years.
HP:0025708.definition_cn: 发病年龄大于或等于16岁至未满19岁。

HP:0025709.name: Intermediate young adult onset
HP:0025709.definition: Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 19 to under 25 years.
HP:0025709.definition_cn: 发病年龄大于或等于19岁至25岁以下。

HP:0025710.name: Late young adult onset
HP:0025710.definition: Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 25 to under 40 years.
HP:0025710.definition_cn: 发病年龄大于或等于25岁至40岁以下。

HP:0025711.name: Convergence-retraction nystagmus
HP:0025711.definition: Convergence-retraction nystagmus is an irregular, jerky nystagmus in which both eyeballs rhythmically converge and retract into the orbit, particularly on attempting an upward gaze.
HP:0025711.definition_cn: 会聚-回缩性眼球震颤是一种不规则的、急动性的眼球震颤，表现为双眼球在试图向上注视时，有节奏地向内会聚并回缩至眼眶内。

HP:0025712.name: Spontaneous chorioamniotic separation
HP:0025712.definition: Persistence separation of the chorionic and amnionic membranes after the 16th week of gestation (not as a result of a procedure such as amniocentesis).
HP:0025712.name_cn: 自发性绒毛膜羊膜分离
HP:0025712.definition_cn: 妊娠16周后绒毛膜和羊膜持续分离（非羊膜穿刺术等操作所致）。

HP:0025713.name: Neurite dystrophy
HP:0025713.definition: Dystrophic neurites are abnormal neuronal processes characterized microscopically by aberrant sprouting, dystrophic expansion, and accumulation of various cellular organelles and cytoskeletal/signaling proteins.
HP:0025713.definition_cn: 营养不良性神经突是异常的神经元突起，其显微镜下特征为异常出芽、营养不良性扩张以及多种细胞器和细胞骨架/信号蛋白的积聚。

HP:0025714.name: Cerebral cortical microinfarct
HP:0025714.definition: An infarct located on the outer layer of the cerebrum that can only be observed microscopically. Cerebral microinfarcts are typically defined as sharply delimited microscopic regions of cellular death or tissue necrosis, sometimes with cavitation (that is, a central fluid-filled cavity). The term microscopic denotes that these lesions are not visible by gross inspection of the brain but seen by light microscopy. The term infarct is most commonly used for ischemia-related tissue loss, and indeed the pathologic appearance of microinfarcts is consistent with that of known ischemic infarctions.
HP:0025714.definition_cn: 位于大脑皮层外层、仅能通过显微镜观察到的梗死灶。脑微梗死通常定义为界限清晰的微观区域内的细胞死亡或组织坏死，有时伴有空洞形成（即中央充满液体的腔隙）。术语“显微镜下”表示这些病变在肉眼观察大脑时不可见，但通过光学显微镜可见。术语“梗死”最常用于与缺血相关的组织丧失，事实上，微梗死的病理学表现与已知的缺血性梗死一致。

HP:0025715.name: Abnormal umbilical artery doppler waveform during pregnancy
HP:0025715.definition: Abnormal waveforms the Doppler sonographic examination of bloodflow in the umbilical artery. vUmbilical arterial Doppler assessment is used in surveillance of fetal health in the third trimester.
HP:0025715.name_cn: 妊娠期脐动脉多普勒波形异常
HP:0025715.definition_cn: 脐动脉多普勒超声检查显示血流波形异常。脐动脉多普勒评估用于妊娠晚期胎儿健康的监测。

HP:0025716.name: Fetal anemia
HP:0025716.definition: Low hemoglobin/hematocrit in a fetus as evidenced by percutaneous umbilical cord sampling and Doppler ultrasonographic assessment of the peak velocity of systolic blood flow in the middle cerebral artery.
HP:0025716.definition_cn: 经皮脐带血采样及大脑中动脉收缩期血流峰值速度的多普勒超声评估证实胎儿存在低血红蛋白/低血细胞比容。

HP:0025717.name: Skeletal muscle autophagosome accumulation
HP:0025717.definition: Abnormal accumulation of autophagosomes in skeletal muscle tissue.
HP:0025717.definition_cn: 骨骼肌组织中自噬体的异常积聚。

HP:0025718.name: Skeletal muscle hyperechogenicity
HP:0025718.definition: An increased echo intensity of muscle tissue on sonography, defined as an increased amount of returning echoes per square area of muscle tissue. On cross-section, normal muscle appears as a relatively anechoic structure with hyperechoic speckles within the tissue representing perimysial septa, giving it a starry night appearance. The boundaries of each muscle are delineated by the presence of hyperechoic fascia. In muscle disorders, one of the hallmark findings is replacement of healthy muscle with fat and fibrosis, manifested by an increase in echogenicity from higher sound transitions in the muscle. This increase in echogenicity is most distinct in conditions that lead to chronic pathology, such as long-standing muscle inflammation, dystrophy, or denervation.
HP:0025718.definition_cn: 超声检查中肌肉组织回声强度增加，定义为每平方单位肌肉组织内返回的回声量增加。在横切面上，正常肌肉表现为相对无回声的结构，其内部有高回声斑点，代表肌束膜间隔，呈现出星空样外观。每块肌肉的边界由高回声筋膜勾勒。在肌肉疾病中，标志性发现之一是健康肌肉被脂肪和纤维组织替代，表现为由于肌肉内声波过渡增加而导致的回声增强。这种回声增强在导致慢性病理改变的疾病中最为明显，如长期肌肉炎症、肌营养不良或去神经支配。

HP:0025719.name: Maternal vascular malperfusion
HP:0025719.definition: Gross findings of maternal vascular malperfusion include placental hypoplasia, placental infarction, and retroplacental hemorrhage. If information is available, it is preferable to annotate using the HPO terms that corresponding to the specific abnormalities.
HP:0025719.definition_cn: 母体血管灌注不良的肉眼检查结果包括胎盘发育不全、胎盘梗死和胎盘后出血。如可获得相关信息，建议使用人类表型本体论（HPO）术语对具体异常进行标注。

HP:0025720.name: Limited horizontal extraocular movement
HP:0025720.definition: Limited mobility of the eye to move from side to side (horizontally) within its socket.
HP:0025720.definition_cn: 眼球在眼眶内水平方向（侧向）运动受限。

HP:0025721.name: Limited vertical extraocular movement
HP:0025721.definition: Limited mobility of the eye to move up and down (vertically) within its socket.
HP:0025721.name_cn: 垂直方向眼球运动受限
HP:0025721.definition_cn: 眼球在眼眶内上下（垂直）运动受限。

HP:0025722.name: Cerebral infarct
HP:0025722.definition: A necrotic lesion in the cerebrum resulting from a sudden insufficiency of arterial or venous blood supply due to emboli, thrombi or mechanical factors.
HP:0025722.definition_cn: 大脑坏死性病变，由栓塞、血栓或机械因素导致的动脉或静脉血液供应突然不足引起。

HP:0025723.name: Abnormal fetal skin morphology
HP:0025723.definition: Any structural anomaly of the skin of the fetus or newborn. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0025723.definition_cn: 胎儿或新生儿皮肤的任何结构异常。该子层次中的术语仅限于在产前期间可观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0025724.name: Caseous vernix-like desquamation
HP:0025724.definition: Vernix caseosa is a physiological, viscous biofilm that is produced by desquamated fetal skin and sebaceous glands covering the fetus at the third trimester in-utero. The substance's gross morphology in post-partum is described by the etymology, as vernix means varnish, and caseosa means cheesy-like matter. This finding refers to an abnormally thick and greasy vernix caseosa-like scale present at birth.
HP:0025724.definition_cn: 胎脂（Vernix caseosa）是一种生理性、黏稠的生物膜，由胎儿皮肤脱落的角质层和皮脂腺在妊娠晚期于子宫内覆盖胎儿表面所产生。该物质在产后的宏观形态可通过其词源学描述，其中“vernix”意为清漆，“caseosa”意为奶酪样物质。此发现指的是出生时存在异常增厚且油腻的胎脂样鳞屑。

HP:0025725.name: Type 1 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
HP:0025725.definition: A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by multiple large cysts or a single dominant cyst.
HP:0025725.definition_cn: 一种先天性肺气道畸形，其特征为多发性大囊肿或单一主囊肿。

HP:0025726.name: Type 2 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
HP:0025726.definition: A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by multiple evenly spaced cysts (sponge-like appearance).
HP:0025726.definition_cn: 一种先天性肺气道畸形，其特征为多个均匀分布的囊肿（呈海绵状外观）。

HP:0025727.name: Type 3 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
HP:0025727.definition: A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by a bulky firm mass with an adenomatoid appearance.
HP:0025727.definition_cn: 一种先天性肺气道畸形，其特征为体积庞大、质地坚实的肿块，呈腺瘤样外观。

HP:0025728.name: Periventricular pseudocyst
HP:0025728.definition: Pseudocysts that lack an epithelial lining, PVPCs are frequently observed in the caudothalamic groove or in the infero-lateral aspect of the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles, but may also be located elsewhere along the periventricular germinal matrix, as in the temporal or occipital horns.
HP:0025728.definition_cn: 缺乏上皮内衬的假性囊肿，即室周假性囊肿（PVPCs），常见于尾状核丘脑沟或侧脑室前角的下外侧部，但也可能位于脑室周围生发基质的其他部位，如颞角或枕角。

HP:0025729.name: Fetal vascular malperfusion
HP:0025729.definition: The term fetal vascular malperfusion (FVM) is used to describe placental pathology that is thought to result from an obstruction in fetal blood flow that could result from a number of conditions (eg, umbilical cord lesions, hypercoagulability, complications of fetal cardiac dysfunction, such as hypoxia, etc.).
HP:0025729.definition_cn: 胎儿血管灌注不良（Fetal Vascular Malperfusion, FVM）这一术语用于描述被认为由胎儿血流受阻引起的胎盘病理改变，此类血流受阻可能由多种情况导致（例如，脐带病变、高凝状态、胎儿心功能不全的并发症，如缺氧等）。

HP:0025730.name: Foramen ovale aneurysm
HP:0025730.definition: Foramen ovale aneurysm (FOA) or atrial septal aneurysm is abnormal redundancy of the atrial septum primum, with bulging of the septum by at least half the width of the atrial chamber, or by at least 10 mm beyond the level of the atrial septum. The abnormal protrusion of the interatrial septum results in decreased left atrial volume. On color Doppler there is reduced left ventricular inflow.
HP:0025730.definition_cn: 卵圆孔瘤（Foramen Ovale Aneurysm, FOA）或房间隔瘤（Atrial Septal Aneurysm）是指房间隔原发隔的异常冗余，表现为房间隔向心房腔内膨出至少达到心房腔宽度的一半，或超出房间隔平面至少10毫米。房间隔的异常突出导致左心房容积减少。彩色多普勒超声显示左心室流入量减少。

HP:0025731.name: Anti-glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1 antibody positivity
HP:0025731.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1.
HP:0025731.name_cn: 抗糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定高密度脂蛋白结合蛋白1抗体阳性
HP:0025731.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定高密度脂蛋白结合蛋白1的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0025732.name: Abnormal social development
HP:0025732.definition: A substantial lag in the ahcievement of or divergence from typical milestones in social interaction and communication skills. Social-emotional competencies in young children include helping, sharing, comforting, and exhibiting empathy and compliance.
HP:0025732.definition_cn: 在社交互动和沟通技能方面，典型里程碑的达成或偏离存在显著滞后。幼儿的社会情感能力包括帮助、分享、安慰以及表现出同理心和顺从性。

HP:0025733.name: Streak gonad
HP:0025733.definition: A type of gonadal dysgenesis in which the gonadal tissue is underdeveloped and appears as fibrous, streak-like structures instead of fully formed ovaries or testes.
HP:0025733.definition_cn: 一种性腺发育不全类型，其中性腺组织发育不全，呈现为纤维状、条索状结构，而非完全形成的卵巢或睾丸。

HP:0025734.name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid level
HP:0025734.definition: The amount of 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025734.name_cn: 尿中5-羟基己酸水平升高
HP:0025734.definition_cn: 尿液中5-羟基己酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限值。

HP:0025735.name: Abnormal third cranial nerve morphology
HP:0025735.definition: Any structural abnormality of the third (oculomotor) cranial nerve.
HP:0025735.definition_cn: 第三（动眼）颅神经的任何结构异常。

HP:0025736.name: Long-bone fracture
HP:0025736.definition: A partial or complete breakage of a lone bone (e.g., the femur, tibia, fibula, humerus, radius, and ulna).
HP:0025736.definition_cn: 单骨（如股骨、胫骨、腓骨、肱骨、桡骨和尺骨）的部分或完全断裂。

HP:0025737.name: Abnormal subthalamic nucleus morphology
HP:0025737.definition: Any structural anomaly of the subthalamic nucleus, a small lens-shaped structure located within the diencephalon near the junction with the midbrain. The subthalamic nucleus composes the majority of the subthalamus along with the subthalamic fasciculus, ansa lenticularis, and several other smaller structures.
HP:0025737.definition_cn: 位于间脑与中脑交界处附近的小型透镜状结构——丘脑底核的任何结构异常。丘脑底核与丘脑底束、豆状核袢以及其他几个较小的结构共同构成了丘脑底部的主要部分。

HP:0025738.name: Ring-enhancing cerebral lesion
HP:0025738.definition: An abnormal neuroimaging finding consisting in an area of decreased density surrounded by a bright rim from concentration of the enhancing contrast dye.
HP:0025738.definition_cn: 异常神经影像学表现，表现为密度降低区域，周围环绕着由增强对比剂浓聚形成的明亮边缘。

HP:0025739.name: Optic nerve mass
HP:0025739.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the optic nerve. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0025739.definition_cn: 视神经局部肿胀或增大。在诊断工作初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0025740.name: Elevated brain succinate level by MRS
HP:0025740.definition: An increase in the level of succinate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0025740.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内琥珀酸水平升高
HP:0025740.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到大脑中琥珀酸（Succinate）水平升高。

HP:0025741.name: Brainstem lucency
HP:0025741.definition: A lesion located in the brainstem that appears areas less dense on magnetic resonance imaging or lighter on computed tomography.
HP:0025741.definition_cn: 位于脑干的一处病变，在磁共振成像上表现为低密度区域，或在计算机断层扫描上呈现为高信号区域。

HP:0025742.name: Elevated urine L-xylulose level
HP:0025742.definition: The amount of L-xylulose in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025742.name_cn: 尿液中L-木酮糖水平升高
HP:0025742.definition_cn: 尿液中L-木酮糖的含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:0025743.name: Elevated urine biliverdin level
HP:0025743.definition: The amount of biliverdin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025743.definition_cn: 尿液中胆绿素含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:0025744.name: Elevated urine dodecanedioic acid level
HP:0025744.definition: The amount of dodecanedioic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025744.name_cn: 尿十二烷二酸水平升高
HP:0025744.definition_cn: 尿液中十二烷二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0025746.name: Diminished urine glutamine level
HP:0025746.definition: The amount of glutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0025746.definition_cn: 尿液中谷氨酰胺含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:0025747.name: Tongue spasticity
HP:0025747.definition: Spasticity (velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes with increased muscle tone and hyperexcitable tendon reflexes) in the muscles of the tongue.
HP:0025747.definition_cn: 舌肌痉挛（速度依赖性张力性牵张反射增强伴肌张力增高及腱反射亢进）。

HP:0025748.name: Restricted tongue movement
HP:0025748.definition: Limited ability to move the tongue related to mechanical restrictions such as akyloglossia and not associated with tongue muscle weakness.
HP:0025748.definition_cn: 与机械性限制（如舌系带过短）相关的舌运动能力受限，且不伴有舌肌无力。

HP:0025749.name: Asymmetric blood pressure between limbs
HP:0025749.definition: A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left limb (arm or leg or both).
HP:0025749.definition_cn: 左右肢体（上肢或下肢或两者）之间血压存在显著差异（例如，20 mmHg）。

HP:0025750.name: Asymmetric blood pressure between legs
HP:0025750.definition: A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left legs.
HP:0025750.definition_cn: 左右下肢血压存在显著差异（例如，20 mmHg）。

HP:0025751.name: Reduced anterior scleral thickness
HP:0025751.definition: A reduction in the height of the anterior portion of the sclera.

HP:0025752.name: Reduced posterior scleral thickness
HP:0025752.definition: A reduction in the height of the posterior portion of the sclera.

HP:0025753.name: Elevated urinary 2-aminoisobutyric acid
HP:0025753.definition: The amount of 2-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0025753.name_cn: 尿液中2-氨基异丁酸水平升高
HP:0025753.definition_cn: 尿液中2-氨基异丁酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:0025754.name: Reduced beta-hexosaminidase A activity
HP:0025754.definition: The concentration or activity of beta hexosaminidase A in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0025754.definition_cn: 循环血液中β-己糖胺酶A的浓度或活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0025755.name: Abnormal nail shape
HP:0025755.definition: An abnormality affecting the outline (shape) or contour of the nail.
HP:0025755.definition_cn: 影响指甲轮廓（形状）或外形的异常。

HP:0025756.name: Abnormal nail attachment
HP:0025756.definition: An anomaly of the connection of the nail to the nailbed.

HP:0025757.name: Abnormal nail surface
HP:0025757.definition: An anomaly of the surface of the nail.

HP:0025758.name: Characteristic of mass
HP:0025758.definition: A mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction. This term refers to a property (characteristic) of a mass.
HP:0025758.definition_cn: 肿块是指由细胞异常增生、囊肿、激素变化或免疫反应引起的局部隆起或增生的统称。该术语指肿块的一种属性（特征）。

HP:0025759.name: Mobile lump
HP:0025759.definition: This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that can be moved or shifted under the skin when pressed or manipulated.
HP:0025759.definition_cn: 该修饰语适用于体表可触及的肿块或肿胀，在按压或操作时可在皮下移动或移位。

HP:0025760.name: Immobile lump
HP:0025760.definition: This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that cannot be moved or shifted under the skin when pressed or manipulated.
HP:0025760.definition_cn: 该修饰语适用于体表可触及的肿块或肿胀，在按压或操作时无法在皮下移动或移位。

HP:0025761.name: Painless mass
HP:0025761.definition: This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that does not elicit pain upon palpation.
HP:0025761.definition_cn: 该修饰词适用于体表可触及的肿块或肿胀，且在触诊时未引发疼痛。

HP:0025762.name: Anti-ganglionic acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
HP:0025762.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against acetylcholine receptors of the ganglionic type.
HP:0025762.name_cn: 抗神经节乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性
HP:0025762.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对神经节型乙酰胆碱受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0025763.name: Positive urine anion gap
HP:0025763.definition: The urine anion gap (UAG), calculated as [(Na+ + K+) - (Cl-)] has been used to roughly estimate whether urine ammonium is increased or decreased in the evaluation of hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis. The more ammonium in the urine, the lower the UAG is, which achieves negative values within a wide range (0 to -200 mEq/L) during hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis. In patients with distal renal tubular acidosis (RTA) of several etiologies, the UAG is positive, despite the prevailing metabolic acidosis, and this is a useful bedside diagnostic index of impaired ammonium excretion.
HP:0025763.definition_cn: 尿阴离子间隙（UAG）的计算公式为[(Na+ + K+) - (Cl-)]，用于在评估高氯性代谢性酸中毒时粗略估计尿铵的增减情况。尿中铵离子越多，UAG越低，在高氯性代谢性酸中毒期间，UAG可在较宽范围内达到负值（0至-200 mEq/L）。在多种病因导致的远端肾小管酸中毒（RTA）患者中，尽管存在明显的代谢性酸中毒，UAG仍为正值，这是铵排泄受损的有用床边诊断指标。

HP:0025764.name: Nasoethmoidal encephalocele
HP:0025764.definition: A type of encephalocele that is characterized by herniation through the foramen cecum into the prenasal space and nasal cavity under the nasal bones and above the nasal septum.
HP:0025764.definition_cn: 一种脑膨出类型，其特征为通过盲孔疝入鼻前间隙和鼻腔，位于鼻骨下方和鼻中隔上方。

HP:0025765.name: Rubber-like lump
HP:0025765.definition: This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that has a rubber-like consistency, that is, it is soft and somewhat compressible.
HP:0025765.definition_cn: 该修饰语用于描述体内可触及的肿块或肿胀，其质地类似橡胶，即柔软且具有一定程度的可压缩性。

HP:0025766.name: Abnormal affect
HP:0025766.definition: An anomaly in intensity, frequency, or duration of the verbal or behavioral expression of emotions, feelings, or thoughts.
HP:0025766.definition_cn: 情绪、情感或思维在言语或行为表达上的强度、频率或持续时间的异常。

HP:0025767.name: Abnormal positive emotional state
HP:0025767.definition: Persistent and pathologically elevated emotional experiences, preoccupations, or internal state that may arise spontaneously or may be related to positive perceptions of self, the world, and the future.
HP:0025767.definition_cn: 持续且病理性升高的情绪体验、专注或内在状态，可能自发产生，也可能与对自我、世界和未来的积极认知相关。

HP:0025768.name: Inappropriate elation
HP:0025768.definition: A feeling of cheerfulness expressed in speech or actions, including facial expressions, movements, or gesticulations, that is considered beyond the norm for the context and interactions. It is a sustained elevated emotional state that is generally not responsive to contextual cues and frequently stands out for being inappropriate or out of place in a social circumstance.
HP:0025768.definition_cn: 一种在言语或行为中表现出的愉悦感，包括面部表情、动作或手势，这些表现被认为超出了特定情境和互动的正常范围。这是一种持续性的情绪高涨状态，通常对情境线索无反应，并且在社交场合中常因不恰当或不合时宜而显得突出。

HP:0025769.name: Disordered formal thought process
HP:0025769.definition: An abnormality in the dynamic mode, rate, or form of thought processes as recognized from the flow of ideas expressed in speech. Successive thoughts and speech are easily diverted by external stimuli or internal superficial associations. Unable to maintain a constant train of thought and loose themselves in side issues, losing the thread and are unable to recover it. Superficial connections appear to drive the subject matter.
HP:0025769.definition_cn: 思维过程动态模式、速率或形式的异常，表现为言语中表达的观念流异常。连续思维和言语易受外部刺激或内部浅层联想的影响而偏离。无法维持连贯的思维进程，陷入次要问题，失去主线且无法恢复。浅层联系似乎主导了主题内容。

HP:0025771.name: Ruminations
HP:0025771.definition: Recurrent thoughts that have a thematic thread that is typically familiar to the individual and are often willfully brought forth or occur in the context of an anxious preoccupation or worry about a relevant concern which may be out of proportion to the context. Ruminations may be of normal thinking rate and are characterized by a recurring theme that usually has a negative connotation.
HP:0025771.definition_cn: 反复出现的思维，其主题线索通常为个体所熟悉，且常常在焦虑性先占观念或对相关担忧的背景下有意引发或发生，这种担忧可能与情境不成比例。反刍思维可能以正常思维速度出现，其特征为反复出现的主题，通常具有负面含义。

HP:0025772.name: Abnormal lexical patterns
HP:0025772.definition: A persistent abnormality in patterns or meanings of expressed language. Words and phrases are disorganized in relationship to each other and often used incorrectly or inappropriately for the context and background culture of the person.
HP:0025772.definition_cn: 表达性语言模式和意义的持续性异常。词语和短语之间的关系紊乱，且常根据个体的背景文化和语境被错误或不恰当地使用。

HP:0025773.name: Abnormal semantics
HP:0025773.definition: Odd use of words that are out of context and inappropriate for the social situation.
HP:0025773.definition_cn: 语境不当且与社会情境不符的词语使用异常。

HP:0025774.name: Idiosyncratic use of words
HP:0025774.definition: Words or phrases and their expression that are used in a manner that is not consistent with the current and accepted meaning for the context and social circumstance. This does not apply to peer or culture driven novel uses of words that are accepted within the given social circles.
HP:0025774.definition_cn: 在特定语境和社会环境中，词语或短语的使用方式与当前公认的含义不一致。这不适用于在特定社交圈内被接受的、由同行或文化驱动的新颖词语用法。

HP:0025775.name: Tangential speech
HP:0025775.definition: Patterns of expressed speech that have many words to describe a feature, but are themselves vague and approximations. The speech does not get to the point, but rather seems to go around and around and is inconcise and difficult to grasp the primary issue or purpose of the communicated words.
HP:0025775.definition_cn: Circumstantial speech characterized by excessive verbalization, tangentiality, and lack of conciseness, resulting in difficulty in identifying the primary issue or purpose of the communication.

HP:0025776.name: Thought insertion
HP:0025776.definition: The experience that thoughts are forced into the conscious awareness by external and foreign entities. The affected individual typically does not recognize the thoughts as coming from themselves and may develop secondary delusional ideas to explain the source of the process.
HP:0025776.definition_cn: 思维被外部及异己实体强行插入意识体验。患者通常无法识别这些思维源自自身，并可能发展出继发性妄想观念以解释该过程的来源。

HP:0025777.name: Thought broadcasting
HP:0025777.definition: The experience that thoughts are being broadcasted from their head/conscious experience, some report that their thoughts are escaping, while others may believe that their thoughts are being picked up by a nearby receiver only to be further propagated. The person subsequently believes that everyone knows what they are thinking and feels that they have no privacy.
HP:0025777.definition_cn: 体验到思维从头部/意识中被广播的感觉，一些人报告称他们的思维正在逃逸，而另一些人可能认为他们的思维被附近的接收器捕捉并进一步传播。患者随后认为所有人都知道他们在想什么，并感到自己毫无隐私。

HP:0025778.name: Thought echo
HP:0025778.definition: The personal experience that thoughts are echoing around them and that they are hearing their own thoughts as they are experiencing them internally.
HP:0025778.definition_cn: 个体体验到思维在周围回响，并在内部经历时听到自己的思维。

HP:0025779.name: Disorder of thought content
HP:0025779.definition: Thought content disorders are characterized by abnormal beliefs and convictions (that are to be assessed given the culture and personal background of the affected individual).
HP:0025779.definition_cn: 思维内容障碍的特征表现为异常的信念和确信（需根据受影响个体的文化和个人背景进行评估）。

HP:0025780.name: Abnormal volitional state
HP:0025780.definition: An abnormality of internal states of motivation or drive that compromise, or interfere with, the ability of the person to attend to basic personal, social, or vocational activities.
HP:0025780.definition_cn: 动机或驱动力内部状态的异常，损害或干扰个体关注基本个人、社交或职业活动的能力。

HP:0025781.name: Abnormally rapid thought process
HP:0025781.definition: Increased rate or speed of thoughts.

HP:0025782.name: Abnormal syntax
HP:0025782.definition: Persistent abnormalities in sentence structure exceeding that of the context and background culture of the person.
HP:0025782.definition_cn: 句子结构持续异常，超出个体的语境和背景文化范围。

HP:0025783.name: Diagnostic behavioral phenotype
HP:0025783.definition: The Human Phenotype Ontology provides terms to describe specific phenotypic abnormalities rather than disease diagnoses. Nevertheless, it is common for descriptions such as 'Autism' to be used to describe individuals affected with Mendelian forms of neurodevelopmental disease and many other conditions. If possible, we recommend annotation using specific terms in other branchs of the Atypical behavior subontology, but if this is not possible, then terms from this branch may be used.
HP:0025783.definition_cn: 人类表型本体论提供了用于描述特定表型异常而非疾病诊断的术语。然而，诸如“自闭症”等描述通常被用于描述受孟德尔形式神经发育疾病及许多其他病症影响的个体。如有可能，我们建议使用非典型行为子本体论其他分支中的特定术语进行注释，但若无法实现，则可使用该分支中的术语。

HP:0025784.name: Word salad
HP:0025784.definition: Speech that consists of a series of recognizable words that are randomly strung together with no meaningful connection.
HP:0025784.definition_cn: 言语由一系列可识别的单词随机串联而成，缺乏有意义的联系。

HP:0025785.name: Abnormal preoccupation
HP:0025785.definition: Preoccupations refers to being absorbed in any particular thought, activity, or concern that captures the attention of the individual. It may have a positive or negative connotation.
HP:0025785.definition_cn: 专注（Preoccupations）指的是个体被某一特定思维、活动或关注点所吸引并全神贯注的状态。该术语可能具有积极或消极的语义内涵。

HP:0025786.name: Intraosseous lipoma
HP:0025786.definition: Intraosseous lipomas are rare benign lesions composed of mature fat that reside within the intramedullary canal.
HP:0025786.definition_cn: 骨内脂肪瘤是一种罕见的良性病变，由成熟的脂肪组织构成，位于骨髓腔内。

HP:0025787.name: Paraphilia
HP:0025787.definition: Intense and typically recurring sexual arousal to atypical objects, fantasies, places, or individuals that frequently, but not always, lead to engagement of non-conventional sexual acts. This is a broad class of desires and behaviors that may include innocuous fetish behavior to illegal behaviors involving non-consenting individuals.
HP:0025787.definition_cn: 强烈且通常反复出现的对非典型物体、幻想、地点或个体的性唤起，这些情况经常（但并非总是）导致参与非常规性行为。这是一大类欲望和行为，可能包括无害的恋物行为，也可能涉及未经同意的个体的非法行为。

HP:0025788.name: Radiographic modifier
HP:0025788.definition: A characteristic of a lesion on radiography.
HP:0025788.definition_cn: 放射影像学中病变的特征。

HP:0025789.name: Radiolucent
HP:0025789.definition: Applies to a lesion that allows x-rays to penetrate through them and expose the receptor (radiolucency). Soft tissues appear black or dark on the processed radiograph and are called radiolucent.
HP:0025789.definition_cn: 适用于允许X射线穿透并暴露受体的病变（透射性）。在处理的放射影像中，软组织呈现黑色或深色，称为透射性。

HP:0025790.name: Radiodense
HP:0025790.definition: Applies to a lesion that attenuates X-rays and appears radiodense (white) on a radiograph.
HP:0025790.definition_cn: 适用于在X射线下衰减并呈现放射致密（白色）的病变。

HP:0025791.name: Delusion of guilt
HP:0025791.definition: Delusional belief of one's personal guilt for an event, real or imagined, and that one caused an outcome that is somehow catastrophic. It is generally impossible or fantastical that this could have happened in the manner believed by the person, that they were somehow responsible for an event despite not be anywhere near where it allegedly occurred.
HP:0025791.definition_cn: 自责妄想（Delusional guilt）是指个体对某一真实或虚构事件产生病态的罪恶感，坚信自己导致了某种灾难性后果。尽管个体实际上并未接近或参与该事件，却仍坚信自己负有责任，且这种信念通常与现实情况完全不符或极度荒谬。

HP:0025793.name: Abnormal change in sexual drive
HP:0025793.definition: An abnormal change in libido (sexual desire), typically accompanied by an altered frequency of sexual activity compared to from a person's previous norm.
HP:0025793.definition_cn: 性欲异常改变，通常伴随性活动频率与个体既往基线相比发生显著变化。

HP:0025794.name: Reduced MHC I cell surface expression
HP:0025794.definition: Expression of major histocompatibility complex class I molecules at the cell surface is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0025794.name_cn: MHC I类分子细胞表面表达降低
HP:0025794.definition_cn: 主要组织相容性复合体I类分子在细胞表面的表达低于正常下限。

HP:0025795.name: Positive urine infectious agent test
HP:0025795.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the urine positive (abnormal).
HP:0025795.definition_cn: 尿液病原体检测阳性（异常）。

HP:0025796.name: Positive urine Legionella pneumophila antigen test
HP:0025796.definition: Demonstration of an antigen specific to Legionella pneumophila in urine.
HP:0025796.name_cn: 尿军团菌抗原检测阳性
HP:0025796.definition_cn: 尿液中检出嗜肺军团菌特异性抗原。

HP:0025797.name: Unilateral sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0025797.definition: A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects one ear.
HP:0025797.name_cn: 单侧感音神经性听力障碍
HP:0025797.definition_cn: 单侧感音神经性听力损失

HP:0025798.name: Abnormal wrist morphology
HP:0025798.definition: Any structural anomaly of the wrist.

HP:0025799.name: Abnormal wrist physiology
HP:0025799.definition: Any functional anomaly of the wrist.

HP:0025800.name: Wrist instability
HP:0025800.definition: Subjective or objective feeling of clunking/clicking in the wrist with movement, wrist giving way or difficulty twisting objects.
HP:0025800.definition_cn: 主观或客观感觉手腕活动时出现咔哒/弹响、手腕无力或扭转物体困难。

HP:0025801.name: Nail elevation
HP:0025801.definition: Elevation of the nail from the nail bed.

HP:0025802.name: Talipes varus
HP:0025802.definition: Inversion of the foot, resulting in the outer side of the sole only touching the ground; usually some degree of talipes equinus is associated with it, and often talipes cavus.
HP:0025802.definition_cn: 足内翻，导致仅足底外侧接触地面；通常伴有不同程度的马蹄内翻足，且常合并高弓足。

HP:0025803.name: Mucocutaneous lesion painful
HP:0025803.definition: Applies to pain that colocalizes with lesions in the skin or mucous membranes.
HP:0025803.definition_cn: 适用于与皮肤或黏膜病变共定位的疼痛。

HP:0025804.name: Painful lymphadenopathy
HP:0025804.definition: Applies to pain that is localizes to a swollen lymph node.
HP:0025804.definition_cn: 适用于局限于肿胀淋巴结的疼痛。

HP:0025805.name: Absent circulating T cells
HP:0025805.definition: Absence of detectable circulating T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells. Usually, less than 50 T cells per microlitre is considered to be an absence.
HP:0025805.definition_cn: 血液中检测不到可循环的T细胞，通常以CD3+淋巴细胞为特征。这些可能包括TCR α/β和γ/δ T细胞。通常，每微升少于50个T细胞被视为缺失。

HP:0025806.name: Abnormal total B cell count
HP:0025806.definition: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microliter is above or below the upper limits of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.
HP:0025806.definition_cn: 血液中每微升B细胞的绝对计数高于或低于相应性别和年龄组参考范围正常值上限。

HP:0025807.name: Decreased natural killer cell degranulation
HP:0025807.definition: Abnormal decrease of NK cell degranulation in response to stimulation, commonly measured through surface CD107a expression in response to cocultivation with a murine cell line. Other methods may be used by different laboratories.
HP:0025807.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞脱颗粒减少
HP:0025807.definition_cn: 对刺激反应中NK细胞脱颗粒异常减少，通常通过与小鼠细胞系共培养后表面CD107a表达水平进行检测。不同实验室可能采用其他检测方法。

HP:0025808.name: Decreased natural killer cell-induced killing of target cells
HP:0025808.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞介导的靶细胞杀伤作用减弱

HP:0025809.name: Generalized scaling
HP:0025809.definition: Desquamation (scaling) involving nearly all of the surface of the skin.
HP:0025809.definition_cn: 皮肤表面几乎全部受累的脱屑（鳞屑形成）。

HP:0025810.name: Ichthyosis linearis circumflexa
HP:0025810.definition: A type of ichthyosis characterized by migratory, annular and polycyclic erythematous patches with double-edged scales at the periphery of the lesions.
HP:0025810.definition_cn: 一种以游走性、环状和多环状红斑斑块为特征的鱼鳞病，皮损边缘伴有双层鳞屑。

HP:0025811.name: Trichorrhexis invaginata
HP:0025811.definition: A type of hair shaft dysmorphology in which the proximal part of the hair shaft overlaps the distal part, showing a bamboo-like appearance. This feature is pathognomic for Netherton syndrome, and can be ascertained by light microscopy.
HP:0025811.definition_cn: 一种毛干形态异常，表现为毛干近端部分覆盖远端部分，呈现竹节样外观。此特征为Netherton综合征的病理特异性表现，可通过光学显微镜检查确诊。

HP:0025812.name: Seborrheic scales on scalp
HP:0025812.definition_cn: 头皮上出现细小的白色油腻鳞屑。

HP:0025813.name: Eyebrow scaling skin
HP:0025813.definition: Loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in the area of the eyebrow in large, scale-like flakes.
HP:0025813.definition_cn: 眉毛区域表皮外层以大片鳞屑状脱落。

HP:0025814.name: Patchy stratum granulosum of epidermis
HP:0025814.definition: The stratum granulosum of the epidermis (granular layer) displays areas of discontinuity.
HP:0025814.definition_cn: 表皮颗粒层（颗粒层）呈现不连续区域。

HP:0025815.name: Absent stratum granulosum of epidermis
HP:0025815.definition: The stratum granulosum of the epidermis (granular layer) cannot be observed.
HP:0025815.definition_cn: 表皮颗粒层（颗粒层）不可见。

HP:0025816.name: Hypogranulosis
HP:0025816.definition: The height (thickness) of the stratum granulosum of the epidermis (granular layer) is below the lower limit of normal but the stratum granulosum is visible.
HP:0025816.definition_cn: 表皮颗粒层（颗粒层）高度（厚度）低于正常下限，但颗粒层可见。

HP:0025817.name: Psoriasiform acanthosis
HP:0025817.definition: A type of epidermal acanthosis characterized by regular elongated rete ridges.
HP:0025817.definition_cn: 一种以规则性延长的表皮突为特征的表皮棘层增厚类型。

HP:0025818.name: Intraepidermal microabscess formation
HP:0025818.definition: Infiltrating neutrophils in the epidermis, mostly into the stratum corneum. Characteristic for psoriasis.
HP:0025818.definition_cn: 表皮内中性粒细胞浸润，主要集中于角质层。为银屑病的特征性表现。

HP:0025819.name: Palmoplantar pealing
HP:0025819.definition: Splitting within the the upper lyer (stratum corneum) of the epidermis clinically characterized by shedding of dead cells from the outermost layer of skin.
HP:0025819.definition_cn: 表皮上层（角质层）分裂，临床特征为皮肤最外层死细胞脱落。

HP:0025820.name: Offspring of consanguineous relationship
HP:0025820.definition: The parents of the index patient are related as second cousins or closer.
HP:0025820.definition_cn: 先证者的父母为二级表亲或更近亲缘关系。

HP:0025821.name: Lower eyelid erythema
HP:0025821.definition: Redness of the skin of the lower eyelid, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.
HP:0025821.definition_cn: 下睑皮肤发红，由皮肤深层毛细血管充血所致。

HP:0025822.name: Upper eyelid erythema
HP:0025822.definition: Redness of the skin of the upper eyelid, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.
HP:0025822.definition_cn: 上睑皮肤发红，由皮肤深层毛细血管充血所致。

HP:0025823.name: Positive provocative functional shoulder test
HP:0025823.definition: Abnormal result of a physical test of the shoulder that attempts to provoke pain in order to diagnosis a specific injury.
HP:0025823.name_cn: 阳性激发性肩关节功能试验
HP:0025823.definition_cn: 肩部体格检查异常结果，旨在通过诱发疼痛以诊断特定损伤。

HP:0025824.name: Decreased neutrophil phagocytosis
HP:0025824.definition: Abnormal decrease of neutrophil phagocytic activity, commonly measured after stimulation with E. coli using flow cytometry.
HP:0025824.name_cn: 中性粒细胞吞噬作用降低
HP:0025824.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞吞噬活性异常降低，通常通过流式细胞术在经大肠杆菌刺激后测定。

HP:0025825.name: Decreased neutrophil adhesion
HP:0025825.definition: Abnormal decrease of neutrophil adhesion capacity, commonly measured as surface expression of CD18, CD11a or CD11b using flow cytometry.
HP:0025825.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞黏附能力异常降低，通常通过流式细胞术检测CD18、CD11a或CD11b的表面表达水平进行测定。

HP:0025826.name: Severely decreased neutrophil count
HP:0025826.definition: Severe decrease in circulating neutrophils, usually characterized as fewer than 500 neutrophils per microlitre.
HP:0025826.name_cn: 中性粒细胞计数严重减少
HP:0025826.definition_cn: 循环中性粒细胞严重减少，通常定义为每微升血液中中性粒细胞数量少于500个。

HP:0025827.name: Abnormal Th1 T cell proportion
HP:0025827.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of Th1 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IFNg or surface expression of CXCR3, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies or the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025827.definition_cn: Th1细胞异常增多或减少，通常通过IFNγ的细胞内合成或CXCR3的表面表达来表征，以总CD3+CD4+ T细胞的比例进行测量，通常在刺激后进行。刺激通常是非特异性的，可能包括使用抗CD3微珠或抗体，或使用佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-乙酸酯（PMA）联合离子霉素。不同实验室间孵育时间和刺激强度可能存在差异。

HP:0025828.name: Increased Th1 T cell proportion
HP:0025828.definition: Abnormal increase of Th1 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IFNg or surface expression of CXCR3, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies or the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025828.definition_cn: Th1细胞异常增多，通常以IFNγ的细胞内合成或CXCR3的表面表达为特征，测量方法为刺激后CD3+CD4+ T细胞总数的比例。刺激通常是非特异性的，可能包括使用抗CD3微珠或抗体，或使用佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-乙酸酯（PMA）联合离子霉素。孵育时间和刺激强度可能因实验室而异。

HP:0025829.name: Decreased Th1 T cell proportion
HP:0025829.definition: Abnormal decrease of Th1 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IFNg or surface expression of CXCR3, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies or the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025829.definition_cn: Th1细胞异常减少，通常通过IFNγ的细胞内合成或CXCR3的表面表达来表征，以总CD3+CD4+ T细胞的比例进行测量，通常在刺激后进行。刺激通常是非特异性的，可能包括使用抗CD3微珠或抗体，或使用佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-乙酸酯（PMA）与离子霉素的组合。孵育时间和刺激强度可能因实验室而异。

HP:0025830.name: Abnormal Th17 T cell proportion
HP:0025830.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of Th17 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IL-17 or surface expression of CCR6, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies, the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin, or staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB). Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025830.definition_cn: Th17细胞的异常增多或减少，通常通过细胞内IL-17合成或CCR6表面表达来表征，以刺激后CD3+CD4+ T细胞总数的百分比进行测量。刺激通常是非特异性的，可能包括使用抗CD3微珠或抗体、佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-乙酸酯（PMA）联合离子霉素，或金黄色葡萄球菌肠毒素B（SEB）。不同实验室的孵育时间和刺激强度可能存在差异。

HP:0025831.name: Increased Th17 T cell proportion
HP:0025831.definition: Abnormal increase of Th17 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IL-17 or surface expression of CCR6, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies, the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin, or staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB). Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025831.definition_cn: Th17细胞异常增多，通常通过细胞内IL-17合成或CCR6表面表达来表征，以总CD3+CD4+T细胞的比例进行测定，通常在刺激后进行。刺激通常是非特异性的，可能包括使用抗CD3微珠或抗体、佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-乙酸酯（PMA）联合离子霉素，或葡萄球菌肠毒素B（SEB）。不同实验室的孵育时间和刺激强度可能有所不同。

HP:0025832.name: Decreased Th17 T cell proportion
HP:0025832.definition: Abnormal decrease of Th17 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IL-17 or surface expression of CCR6, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies, the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin, or staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB). Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025832.definition_cn: Th17细胞异常减少，通常通过细胞内IL-17合成或CCR6表面表达来表征，以总CD3+CD4+T细胞比例进行测定（通常在刺激后）。刺激方式通常为非特异性，可能包括使用抗CD3微珠或抗体、佛波醇12-肉豆蔻酸酯13-乙酸酯（PMA）联合离子霉素、或葡萄球菌肠毒素B（SEB）。不同实验室间孵育时间和刺激强度可能存在差异。

HP:0025833.name: Decreased PMA/ionomycin-induced T-cell proliferation
HP:0025833.definition: Abnormal decrease of T cell proliferation in response to phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) and ionomycin stimulation. This is commonly measured through intracellular expression of Ki67, decreasing surface expression of carboxyfluorescein diacetate (CFSE), or 3H-thymidine incorporation. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025833.name_cn: PMA/离子霉素诱导的T细胞增殖减弱
HP:0025833.definition_cn: 佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸-13-乙酸酯（PMA）和离子霉素刺激下T细胞增殖反应异常降低。该指标通常通过Ki67的胞内表达水平、羧基荧光素二乙酸酯（CFSE）表面表达降低或3H-胸腺嘧啶核苷掺入法进行检测。不同实验室间孵育时间及刺激强度可能存在差异。

HP:0025834.name: Decreased PHA-induced T-cell proliferation
HP:0025834.definition: Abnormal decrease of T cell proliferation in response to stimulation with phytohaemagglutinin. This is commonly measured through intracellular expression of Ki67, decreasing surface expression of carboxyfluorescein diacetate (CFSE), or 3H-thymidine incorporation. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.
HP:0025834.definition_cn: 植物血凝素刺激后T细胞增殖异常减弱。通常通过Ki67的胞内表达、羧基荧光素二乙酸酯（CFSE）表面表达降低或3H-胸腺嘧啶核苷掺入法进行检测。不同实验室间孵育时间和刺激强度可能存在差异。

HP:0025835.name: Decreased CD8+ T cell degranulation
HP:0025835.definition: Abnormal decrease of CD8-positive T cell degranulation in response to stimulation, commonly measured through surface CD107a expression in response to cocultivation with a murine cell line. Other methods may be used by different laboratories.
HP:0025835.definition_cn: 对刺激反应中CD8阳性T细胞脱颗粒异常降低，通常通过与小鼠细胞系共培养后表面CD107a表达水平进行检测。不同实验室可能采用其他检测方法。

HP:0025836.name: Increased CD8+ T cell proportion
HP:0025836.definition: Abnormal increase of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.
HP:0025836.definition_cn: 细胞毒性CD3+CD8+ T细胞异常增多（以血液中CD3+ T细胞总数的百分比表示），超出特定性别和年龄组的参考范围。此类检测通常在TCR α/β阳性细胞群中进行测定。

HP:0025837.name: Abnormal proportion of RTE CD4+ T cells
HP:0025837.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of the recent thymic emmigrant (RTE) CD4+ T cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD45RA+, CD45RO-, or CD27+, with the necessary expression of CD31+, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
