These cells are sometimes also characterized as CD62L+ and CCR7+.
HP:0025837.name_cn: RTE CD4+ T细胞比例异常
HP:0025837.definition_cn: 近期胸腺迁出细胞（RTE）CD4+ T细胞亚群的异常增多或减少，通常以CD45RA+、CD45RO-或CD27+为特征，且必须表达CD31+，以占血液中总CD4+ T细胞的百分比表示，并与特定性别和年龄组的参考范围进行比较。这些细胞有时也以CD62L+和CCR7+为特征。

HP:0025838.name: Increased proportion of RTE CD4+ T cells
HP:0025838.definition: Abnormal increase of the recent thymic emmigrant (RTE) CD4+ T cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD45RA+, CD45RO-, or CD27+, with the necessary expression of CD31+, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These cells are sometimes also characterized as CD62L+ and CCR7+.
HP:0025838.name_cn: RTE CD4+ T细胞比例增加
HP:0025838.definition_cn: 近期胸腺迁出细胞（RTE）CD4+ T细胞亚群异常增多，该细胞群通常以CD45RA+、CD45RO-或CD27+为特征标志，且必须表达CD31+。检测结果为该细胞群占外周血CD4+ T细胞总数的百分比，需与同性别、同年龄组的参考范围进行比对。此类细胞有时亦可表现为CD62L+和CCR7+的表型特征。

HP:0025839.name: Decreased proportion of RTE CD4+ T cells
HP:0025839.definition: Abnormal decrease of the recent thymic emmigrant (RTE) CD4+ T cell subpopulation, commonly characterized as CD45RA+, CD45RO-, or CD27+, with the necessary expression of CD31+, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These cells are sometimes also characterized as CD62L+ and CCR7+.
HP:0025839.name_cn: RTE CD4+ T细胞比例降低
HP:0025839.definition_cn: 近期胸腺迁出细胞（RTE）CD4+ T细胞亚群异常减少，通常以CD45RA+、CD45RO-或CD27+为特征，且必须表达CD31+，以占血液中总CD4+ T细胞的百分比表示，并与特定性别和年龄组的参考范围进行比较。这些细胞有时也以CD62L+和CCR7+为特征。

HP:0025840.name: Abnormal HLA DR+ CD4+ T cell proportion
HP:0025840.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of the activated HLA-DR+ CD4+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
HP:0025840.name_cn: HLA DR+ CD4+ T细胞比例异常
HP:0025840.definition_cn: 活化HLA-DR+ CD4+ T细胞亚群相对于特定性别和年龄组参考范围出现异常增高或降低（以占外周血CD4+ T细胞百分比计）。

HP:0025841.name: Decreased HLA DR+ CD4+ T cell proportion
HP:0025841.definition: Abnormal reduction of the activated HLA-DR+ CD4+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
HP:0025841.name_cn: HLA DR+ CD4+ T细胞比例降低
HP:0025841.definition_cn: 活化HLA-DR+ CD4+ T细胞亚群比例异常降低（以占外周血CD4+ T细胞百分比计），低于同性别、同年龄组参考值范围。

HP:0025842.name: Abnormal HLA DR+ CD8+ T cell proportion
HP:0025842.definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of the activated HLA-DR+ CD8+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD8+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
HP:0025842.name_cn: HLA DR+ CD8+ T细胞比例异常
HP:0025842.definition_cn: 活化HLA-DR+ CD8+ T细胞亚群（以占外周血CD8+ T细胞百分比计）较同性别、同年龄组参考范围出现异常升高或降低。

HP:0025843.name: Increased HLA DR+ CD8+ T cell proportion
HP:0025843.definition: Abnormal increase of the activated HLA-DR+ CD8+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD8+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
HP:0025843.name_cn: HLA DR+ CD8+ T细胞比例增高
HP:0025843.definition_cn: 与特定性别和年龄组的参考范围相比，血液中HLA-DR+ CD8+ T细胞亚群（以占CD8+ T细胞总数的百分比计）出现异常增高。

HP:0025844.name: Decreased HLA DR+ CD8+ T cell proportion
HP:0025844.definition: Abnormal decrease of the activated HLA-DR+ CD8+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD8+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.
HP:0025844.name_cn: HLA DR+ CD8+ T细胞比例降低
HP:0025844.definition_cn: 与特定性别和年龄组的参考范围相比，血液中HLA-DR+ CD8+ T细胞活化亚群（以占CD8+ T细胞总数的百分比计）出现异常降低。

HP:0025845.name: Abnormal TCR repertoire
HP:0025845.definition: Abnormal distribution of the TCR repertoire expressed on T cells. This usually means oligoclonality (fewer TCR clonotypes compared to a healthy age-matched control) or monoclonality (one dominant TCR clone detected). This may be measured through different methods depending on the lab, but commonly include TCR spectratyping or TCRB CDR3 sequencing.
HP:0025845.definition_cn: T细胞表面表达的TCR谱系异常分布。通常表现为寡克隆性（与健康同龄对照相比TCR克隆型减少）或单克隆性（检测到一个优势TCR克隆）。具体检测方法因实验室而异，常用技术包括TCR谱型分析或TCRβ链CDR3区测序。

HP:0025846.name: Decreased natural killer cell perforin expression
HP:0025846.definition: Abnormal decrease of intracellular expression of perforin within NK cells, commonly characterized as CD3-CD19- and CD16+ or CD56+ lymphocytes, ex vivo.
HP:0025846.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞穿孔素表达降低
HP:0025846.definition_cn: NK细胞（通常特征为CD3-CD19-和CD16+或CD56+淋巴细胞）离体状态下穿孔素胞内表达的异常降低。

HP:0025847.name: Fish allergy
HP:0025847.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against fish.
HP:0025847.definition_cn: 对鱼类产生不良反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0025848.name: Shellfish allergy
HP:0025848.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against shellfish (an aquatic shelled mollusc such as an oyster or mussel, or a crustacean such as a crab or shrimp).
HP:0025848.definition_cn: 对甲壳类水生动物（如牡蛎、贻贝等软体动物或蟹、虾等甲壳类动物）产生的不良免疫反应形式之超敏反应。

HP:0025849.name: Localized along nerve distribution
HP:0025849.definition: Refers to findings sich as paresthesias or weakness that are distributed according to the anatomical location of a periperipheral nerve.
HP:0025849.definition_cn: 指感觉异常或无力等表现，其分布符合周围神经的解剖定位。

HP:0030000.name: EMG
HP:0030000.definition: Abnormality observed upon electromyography when nerve studied is electrically stimulated six to ten times at 2 or 3 Hertz.
HP:0030000.definition_cn: 在2或3赫兹频率下对神经进行6至10次电刺激时，肌电图观察到异常。

HP:0030001.name: Lagophthalmos
HP:0030001.definition: A condition in which the eyelids do not close to cover the eye completely.

HP:0030002.name: Nocturnal lagophthalmos
HP:0030002.definition: The inability to close the eyelids during sleep.
HP:0030002.definition_cn: 睡眠期间眼睑闭合不全（Nocturnal Lagophthalmos）。

HP:0030003.name: Paralytic lagophthalmos
HP:0030003.definition: A type of lagophthalmos that occurs in association with facial nerve palsy.
HP:0030003.definition_cn: 一种与面神经麻痹相关的兔眼症。

HP:0030004.name: Cicatricial lagophthalmos
HP:0030004.definition: A type of lagophthalmos that occurs following trauma or surgery.
HP:0030004.definition_cn: 创伤性或术后性兔眼症。

HP:0030005.name: Capillary leak
HP:0030005.definition: An acute phenomenon characterized by hypotension and anasarca due to the loss of plasma volume into peripheral tissues, with evidence of decreased plasma volume (hemoconcentration) and protein loss from the intravascular space (hypoalbuminemia) during acute episodes.
HP:0030005.definition_cn: 一种急性现象，其特征是由于血浆容量流失至外周组织而导致的低血压和全身性水肿，在急性发作期间有血浆容量减少（血液浓缩）和血管内蛋白质丢失（低白蛋白血症）的证据。

HP:0030006.name: Single fiber EMG abnormality
HP:0030006.definition: Abnormality in single fiber EMG recording, a technique that allows identification of action potentials (APs) from individual muscle fibers.
HP:0030006.definition_cn: 单纤维肌电图记录异常，该技术可识别来自单个肌纤维的动作电位（APs）。

HP:0030007.name: EMG
HP:0030007.definition: These are spontaneous firing action potentials stimulated by needle movement of an injured muscle fiber. There is propagation to, but not past, the needle tip. This inhibits the display of the negative deflection of the waveform.
HP:0030007.definition_cn: 这些是由受损肌纤维的针运动刺激的自发放电动作电位。其传播至针尖但未超过针尖。这抑制了波形负向偏转的显示。

HP:0030008.name: Cervical agenesis
HP:0030008.definition: Congenital absence of the uterine cervix.

HP:0030009.name: Cervical insufficiency
HP:0030009.definition: A cervix that shows a painless dilation and shortening during the second trimester of pregnancy with resultant recurrent pregnancy loss or delivery is considered incompetent
HP:0030009.definition_cn: 妊娠中期出现无痛性宫颈扩张和缩短，导致复发性妊娠丢失或早产，称为宫颈机能不全。

HP:0030010.name: Hydrometrocolpos
HP:0030010.definition: Hydrometrocolpos is an accumulation of uterine and vaginal secretions as well as menstrual blood in the uterus and vagina.
HP:0030010.definition_cn: 子宫阴道积液（Hydrometrocolpos）是指子宫和阴道内积聚的子宫分泌物、阴道分泌物以及经血。

HP:0030011.name: Imperforate hymen
HP:0030011.definition: A congenital disorder where the hymen (a membrane that surrounds or partially covers the external vaginal opening) does not have an opening and completely obstructs the vagina.
HP:0030011.definition_cn: 先天性处女膜闭锁（Congenital imperforate hymen），即处女膜（一种围绕或部分覆盖阴道外口的膜性结构）无开口，完全阻塞阴道。

HP:0030012.name: Abnormal female reproductive system physiology
HP:0030012.name_cn: 女性生殖系统生理异常

HP:0030013.name: obsolete Endometriosis
HP:0030013.name_cn: 陈旧性子宫内膜异位症

HP:0030014.name: Female sexual dysfunction
HP:0030014.definition: A problem occurring during any phase of the female sexual response cycle that prevents the individual from experiencing satisfaction from the sexual activity
HP:0030014.definition_cn: 女性性反应周期中任何阶段出现的问题，导致个体无法从性活动中获得满足感。

HP:0030015.name: Female anorgasmia
HP:0030015.definition: The persistent of recurrent difficulty, delay in, or absence of attaining orgasm following sufficient sexual stimulation and arousal.
HP:0030015.definition_cn: 持续性或反复出现的在充分性刺激和性唤起后难以达到、延迟达到或无法达到性高潮。

HP:0030016.name: Dyspareunia
HP:0030016.definition: Recurrent or persistent genital pain associated with sexual intercourse.
HP:0030016.definition_cn: 复发性或持续性性交相关生殖器疼痛。

HP:0030017.name: Vaginismus
HP:0030017.definition: Recurrent or persistent involuntary spasms of the musculature of the outer third of the vagina that interferes with vaginal penetration, and which causes personal distress.
HP:0030017.definition_cn: 复发性或持续性阴道外三分之一肌肉群的不自主痉挛，导致阴道插入困难，并引起个人痛苦。

HP:0030018.name: Decreased female libido
HP:0030018.definition_cn: 女性性欲减退（Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder, HSDD）

HP:0030022.name: Question mark ear
HP:0030022.definition: Cleft between the helix and the lobe.
HP:0030022.name_cn: 耳廓畸形（耳轮上部向前卷曲，形似问号）
HP:0030022.definition_cn: 耳轮与耳垂之间的裂隙。

HP:0030023.name: Quelprud nodule
HP:0030023.definition: Small cartilaginous prominence on the posterior concha.
HP:0030023.definition_cn: 耳甲后部的小软骨突起。

HP:0030024.name: Pretragal ectopia
HP:0030024.definition: Variably shaped, cartilage-containing tissue anterior to the external auditory meatus.
HP:0030024.definition_cn: 外耳道前方含有软骨的形态可变组织。

HP:0030025.name: Auricular pit
HP:0030025.definition: Small indentation in the lower part of the ascending helix, concha, or in the crus helix.
HP:0030025.definition_cn: 耳轮脚、耳甲腔或耳轮升支下缘的小凹陷。

HP:0030026.name: Squared superior portion of helix
HP:0030026.definition: Flattening instead of curving or rounded superior helix, allowing the superior helix to run more horizontally than usual.
HP:0030026.definition_cn: 上耳轮扁平而非弯曲或圆润，导致上耳轮较通常更为水平延伸。

HP:0030027.name: Abnormal nasal cartilage morphology
HP:0030027.definition: A morphological anomaly of the nasal cartilage.

HP:0030028.name: Absent nasal cartilage
HP:0030028.definition: Lack of a palpable nasal cartilage.

HP:0030029.name: Splayed fingers
HP:0030029.definition: Divergence of digits along the A/P axis (in the plane of the palm).
HP:0030029.definition_cn: 沿掌平面内前/后轴方向的指间分离。

HP:0030030.name: Absent ray
HP:0030030.definition: The absence of all phalanges of a digit and the associated metacarpal /metatarsal.
HP:0030030.definition_cn: 指骨完全缺失并伴有相应的掌骨/跖骨缺失。

HP:0030031.name: Small toe
HP:0030031.definition: Significant reduction in both length and girth of the toe compared to the contralateral toe, or alternatively, compared to a typical toe size for an age-matched individual.
HP:0030031.definition_cn: 与对侧足趾相比，或与年龄匹配个体的典型足趾尺寸相比，足趾的长度和周径均显著减小。

HP:0030032.name: Partial absence of foot
HP:0030032.definition: An incomplete absence of the foot, with no bony elements distal to the tarsals, but with preservation of some or all of the tarsals.
HP:0030032.definition_cn: 足部不完全缺失，跗骨远端无骨性结构，但部分或全部跗骨保留。

HP:0030033.name: Small finger
HP:0030033.definition: Significant reduction in both length and girth of the finger compared to the contralateral finger, or alternatively, compared to a typical finger size for an age-matched individual.
HP:0030033.definition_cn: 与对侧手指相比，或与年龄匹配个体的典型手指尺寸相比，手指的长度和周径均显著减小。

HP:0030034.name: Glomerular basement membrane lamellation
HP:0030034.definition: Presence of abnormal additional layers of the basement membrane of the glomerulus.
HP:0030034.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜层状结构
HP:0030034.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜异常附加层存在。

HP:0030035.name: Struvite nephrolithiasis
HP:0030035.definition: Presence of struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate) containing calculi (kidney stones).
HP:0030035.definition_cn: 存在含鸟粪石（磷酸铵镁）成分的结石（肾结石）。

HP:0030036.name: Isothenuria
HP:0030036.definition: Inability of the kidneys to produce either concentrated or dilute urine.
HP:0030036.definition_cn: 肾脏无法生成浓缩或稀释尿液。

HP:0030038.name: Enchondroma
HP:0030038.definition: A solitary, benign, intramedullary cartilage tumor that is often found in the short tubular bones of the hands and feet, distal femur, and proximal humerus.
HP:0030038.definition_cn: 一种孤立性、良性、髓内软骨肿瘤，常见于手足短管状骨、股骨远端及肱骨近端。

HP:0030039.name: Fused thoracic vertebrae
HP:0030039.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more thoracic vertebral bodies with one another.
HP:0030039.definition_cn: 一种先天性异常，其特征为两个或更多胸椎椎体相互融合。

HP:0030040.name: Fused lumbar vertebrae
HP:0030040.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more lumbar vertebral bodies with one another.
HP:0030040.definition_cn: 一种先天性异常，其特征为两个或更多腰椎椎体相互融合。

HP:0030041.name: Schmorl's node
HP:0030041.definition: A Schmorl's node is the herniation of nucleus pulposus through the cartilaginous and bony end plate into the body of the adjacent vertebra.
HP:0030041.definition_cn: 施莫尔结节（Schmorl's node）是指髓核通过软骨终板和骨性终板突出进入相邻椎体内部的现象。

HP:0030042.name: Incomplete ossification of pubis
HP:0030042.definition: Failure to complete ossification (maturation and calcification) of the pubic bone.
HP:0030042.definition_cn: 耻骨骨化不全（成熟与钙化障碍）。

HP:0030043.name: Hip subluxation
HP:0030043.definition: A partial dislocation of the hip joint, whereby the head of the femur is partially displaced from the socket.
HP:0030043.definition_cn: 髋关节半脱位，即股骨头部分从髋臼中移位。

HP:0030044.name: Flexion contracture of digit
HP:0030044.definition: A bent (flexed) finger or toe joint that cannot be straightened actively or passively. It is thus a chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement of joints.
HP:0030044.definition_cn: 屈曲畸形（Flexion Deformity）是指手指或脚趾关节呈弯曲状态，无法通过主动或被动方式伸直。这是由于肌肉、肌腱、韧带或皮肤的结构性改变导致的关节运动功能慢性丧失，从而阻碍了关节的正常活动。

HP:0030046.name: Hypoglycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan
HP:0030046.definition: A reduction in the degree of glycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan in muscle tissue.
HP:0030046.name_cn: α-肌营养不良蛋白聚糖的低糖基化
HP:0030046.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中α-肌营养不良聚糖的糖基化程度降低。

HP:0030047.name: Abnormal lateral ventricle morphology
HP:0030047.definition: A morphological anomaly of the lateral ventricle.

HP:0030048.name: Colpocephaly
HP:0030048.definition: Colpocephaly is an anatomic finding in the brain manifested by occipital horns that are disproportionately enlarged in comparison with other parts of the lateral ventricles.
HP:0030048.definition_cn: Colpocephaly（脑室后角扩大症）是一种脑部解剖学表现，其特征为侧脑室后角（occipital horns）相对于侧脑室其他部分不成比例地扩大。

HP:0030049.name: Brain abscess
HP:0030049.definition: A collection of pus, immune cells, and other material in the brain.

HP:0030050.name: Narcolepsy
HP:0030050.definition: An abnormal phenomenon characterized by a classic tetrad of excessive daytime sleepiness with irresistible sleep attacks, cataplexy (sudden bilateral loss of muscle tone), hypnagogic hallucinations, and sleep paralysis.
HP:0030050.definition_cn: 一种异常现象，其特征为经典四联征：日间过度嗜睡伴不可抗拒的睡眠发作、猝倒（突发性双侧肌张力丧失）、入睡前幻觉和睡眠麻痹。

HP:0030051.name: Tip-toe gait
HP:0030051.definition: An abnormal gait pattern characterized by the failure of the heel to contact the floor at the onset of stance during gait.
HP:0030051.definition_cn: 一种异常步态模式，其特征为步态周期中站立相初期足跟未能接触地面。

HP:0030052.name: Inguinal freckling
HP:0030052.definition: The presence in the inguinal region (groin) of an increased number of freckles, small circular spots on the skin that are darker than the surrounding skin because of deposits of melanin.
HP:0030052.name_cn: 腹股沟雀斑样色素沉着
HP:0030052.definition_cn: 腹股沟区域（groin）出现数量增多的雀斑，即皮肤上因黑色素沉积而形成的较周围皮肤颜色更深的小圆形斑点。

HP:0030054.name: Perifollicular fibrosis
HP:0030054.definition: Presence of excess fibrous connective tissue surrounding hair follicules.
HP:0030054.definition_cn: 毛囊周围存在过量的纤维结缔组织。

HP:0030055.name: Hyperconvex toenail
HP:0030055.definition: When viewed on end (with the tip of the toe pointing toward the examiner's eye) the curve of the toenail forms a tighter curve of convexity.
HP:0030055.definition_cn: 当从末端观察（脚趾尖端指向检查者的眼睛）时，趾甲的曲率形成更紧密的凸面曲线。

HP:0030056.name: Uncombable hair
HP:0030056.definition: Hair that is disorderly, stands out from the scalp, and cannot be combed flat.
HP:0030056.definition_cn: Disheveled hair, trichorrhexis, and alopecia areata with unmanageable hair texture.

HP:0030057.name: Autoimmune antibody positivity
HP:0030057.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against the organism's own cells or tissues.
HP:0030057.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对机体自身细胞或组织的抗体。

HP:0030058.name: Sickled erythrocytes
HP:0030058.definition: An irreversible distortion of the morphology of an erythrocyte such that the cells are elongated and curved, resembling the blade of a sickle (the hand-held agricultural tool traditionally used to harvest grains).
HP:0030058.definition_cn: 一种不可逆的红细胞形态学改变，其特征为细胞伸长并弯曲，形似镰刀（传统上用于收割谷物的手持农具）的刀刃。

HP:0030059.name: Mitochondrial depletion
HP:0030059.definition: An abnormal reduction in mitochondrial DNA content of cells.
HP:0030059.definition_cn: 细胞线粒体DNA含量异常减少。

HP:0030060.name: Nervous tissue neoplasm
HP:0030060.definition: A neoplasm derived from nervous tissue (not necessarily a neoplasm located in the nervous system).
HP:0030060.definition_cn: 源自神经组织的新生物（不一定是位于神经系统内的新生物）。

HP:0030061.name: Neuroectodermal neoplasm
HP:0030061.definition: A neoplasm arising in the neuroectoderm, the portion of the ectoderm of the early embryo that gives rise to the central and peripheral nervous systems, including some glial cells.
HP:0030061.definition_cn: 一种起源于神经外胚层的肿瘤，神经外胚层是早期胚胎外胚层的一部分，负责形成中枢和周围神经系统，包括部分胶质细胞。

HP:0030062.name: Craniopharyngioma
HP:0030062.definition: A benign pituitary-region neoplasm that originates from Rathke's pouch. Craniopharyngiomas are benign slow growing tumors that are located within the sellar and para sellar region of the central nervous system.
HP:0030062.definition_cn: 一种起源于拉特克囊的良性垂体区肿瘤。颅咽管瘤是位于中枢神经系统鞍区及鞍旁区的良性缓慢生长的肿瘤。

HP:0030063.name: Neuroepithelial neoplasm
HP:0030063.definition: A neoplasm composed of neural epithelium, not necessarily a neoplasm located in the neural epithelium or neuroepithelium.
HP:0030063.definition_cn: 由神经上皮构成的肿瘤，不一定位于神经上皮或神经上皮组织内。

HP:0030064.name: Neurocytoma
HP:0030064.definition: A benign brain tumor composed of neural elements which most often arise from the septum pellucidum and the walls of the lateral ventricles.
HP:0030064.definition_cn: 一种由神经成分构成的良性脑肿瘤，通常起源于透明隔和侧脑室壁。

HP:0030065.name: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor
HP:0030065.definition: A tumor that originates in cells from the primitive neural crest. This group of tumors is characteirzed by the presence of primitive cells with elements of neuronal and/or glial differentiation.
HP:0030065.definition_cn: 一种起源于原始神经嵴细胞的肿瘤。这类肿瘤的特征是存在具有神经元和/或胶质细胞分化成分的原始细胞。

HP:0030066.name: Ependymoblastoma
HP:0030066.definition: A highly malignant embryonal tumor of infancy and young childhood characterized by neuroectodermal elements organized in distinctive multilayered rosettes. Ependymoblastomas are large lesions that occur in the supratentorial compartment, typically displaying a physical connection to the ventricular system.
HP:0030066.definition_cn: 一种高度恶性的婴幼儿期胚胎性肿瘤，其特征为神经外胚层成分以独特的多层菊形团结构排列。室管膜母细胞瘤为发生于幕上区的大型病变，通常与脑室系统存在解剖学连接。

HP:0030067.name: Peripheral primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm
HP:0030067.definition: A primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm that occurs extracranially in soft tissue and bone.
HP:0030067.name_cn: 外周原始神经外胚层肿瘤
HP:0030067.definition_cn: 一种发生于颅外软组织和骨的原始神经外胚层肿瘤。

HP:0030068.name: Olfactory esthesioneuroblastoma
HP:0030068.definition: A malignant olfactory neuroblastoma arising from the olfactory epithelium of the superior nasal cavity and cribriform plate.
HP:0030068.definition_cn: 一种起源于上鼻腔和筛板嗅上皮的恶性嗅神经母细胞瘤。

HP:0030069.name: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
HP:0030069.definition: A form of extranodal, high-grade non-Hodgkin B-cell neoplasm, usually large cell or immunoblastic type that originates in the brain, leptomeninges, spinal cord, or eyes and typically remains confined to the CNS.
HP:0030069.name_cn: 原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤
HP:0030069.definition_cn: 一种结外性、高级别非霍奇金B细胞肿瘤，通常为大细胞型或免疫母细胞型，起源于脑、软脑膜、脊髓或眼睛，通常局限于中枢神经系统（CNS）。

HP:0030070.name: Central primitive neuroectodermal tumor
HP:0030070.definition: A primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm that occurs in the central nervous system.
HP:0030070.name_cn: 中枢原始神经外胚层肿瘤
HP:0030070.definition_cn: 一种发生于中枢神经系统的原始神经外胚层肿瘤。

HP:0030071.name: Medulloepithelioma
HP:0030071.definition: A primitive neuroectodermal tumor that originates from the cells of the embryonic medullary canal.
HP:0030071.definition_cn: 一种起源于胚胎髓管细胞的原始神经外胚层肿瘤。

HP:0030072.name: Paranasal sinus neoplasm
HP:0030072.definition: A tumor that originates in the paranasal sinus.

HP:0030074.name: Chemodectoma
HP:0030074.definition: A usually benign neoplasm originating in the chemoreceptor tissue of the carotid body, glomus jugulare, glomus tympanicum, aortic bodies, or the female genital tract.
HP:0030074.definition_cn: 一种通常为良性的肿瘤，起源于颈动脉体、颈静脉球、鼓室球、主动脉体或女性生殖道的化学感受器组织。

HP:0030075.name: Ductal carcinoma in situ
HP:0030075.definition: Presence of abnormal cells inside a milk duct, that is, non-invasive breast cancer. Ductal carcinoma in situ is considered to be a precursor lesion to invasive breast cancer.
HP:0030075.definition_cn: 乳腺导管内存在异常细胞，即非浸润性乳腺癌。导管原位癌被认为是浸润性乳腺癌的前驱病变。

HP:0030077.name: Bronchial neoplasm
HP:0030077.definition: A tumor originating in a bronchus.

HP:0030079.name: Cervix cancer
HP:0030079.definition: A tumor of the uterine cervix.

HP:0030080.name: Burkitt lymphoma
HP:0030080.definition: A form of undifferentiated malignant lymphoma commonly manifested as a large osteolytic lesion in the jaw or as an abdominal mass.
HP:0030080.definition_cn: 一种未分化型恶性淋巴瘤，通常表现为颌骨大范围溶骨性病变或腹部肿块。

HP:0030081.name: Punctate periventricular T2 hyperintense foci
HP:0030081.definition: Multiple pointlike areas of high T2 signal observed upon magnetic resonance imaging of the periventricular cerebral white matter.
HP:0030081.name_cn: 点状脑室周围T2高信号灶
HP:0030081.definition_cn: 磁共振成像显示脑室周围白质内存在多个点状高T2信号区域。

HP:0030082.name: Abnormal drinking behavior
HP:0030082.definition: Abnormal consumption of fluids with excessive or insufficient consumption of fluid or any other abnormal pattern of fluid consumption.
HP:0030082.definition_cn: 液体摄入异常，包括液体摄入过多或不足，或任何其他异常的液体摄入模式。

HP:0030083.name: Salt craving
HP:0030083.definition: Hypersalivation, also known as salt craving, refers to an excessive desire to consume salt (sodium chloride) or salty foods.
HP:0030083.definition_cn: 唾液分泌过多，亦称嗜盐症，是指对摄入盐（氯化钠）或咸味食物产生过度渴望的病理状态。

HP:0030084.name: Clinodactyly
HP:0030084.definition: An angulation of a digit at an interphalangeal joint in the plane of the palm (finger) or sole (toe).
HP:0030084.definition_cn: 指（趾）间关节在掌面（手指）或足底（足趾）平面上的成角畸形。

HP:0030085.name: Abnormal CSF lactate concentration
HP:0030085.definition: Abnormal concentration of lactate in the cerebrospinal fluid.

HP:0030086.name: Reduced CSF lactate
HP:0030086.definition: Decreased concentration of lactate in the cerebrospinal fluid.

HP:0030087.name: Abnormal circulating testosterone concentration
HP:0030087.definition: An anomalous concentration of testosterone in the blood.

HP:0030088.name: Increased serum testosterone level
HP:0030088.definition: An elevated circulating testosterone level in the blood.
HP:0030088.definition_cn: 血液中循环睾酮水平升高。

HP:0030089.name: Abnormal muscle fiber protein expression
HP:0030089.definition: An anomalous amount of protein present in or on the surface of muscle fibers. This feature may be appreciate upon immunohistochemical investigation of muscle biopsy tissue.
HP:0030089.definition_cn: 肌纤维表面或内部存在异常量的蛋白质。这一特征可通过肌肉活检组织的免疫组织化学检查得以识别。

HP:0030090.name: Abnormal muscle fiber merosin expression
HP:0030090.definition: An anomalous amount of merosin in muscle fibers. Merosin is a basement membrane-associated protein found in placenta, striated muscle, and peripheral nerve.
HP:0030090.name_cn: 肌纤维层粘连蛋白表达异常
HP:0030090.definition_cn: 肌纤维中异常量的层粘连蛋白-2（merosin）。层粘连蛋白-2是一种基底膜相关蛋白，存在于胎盘、横纹肌及周围神经中。

HP:0030091.name: Absent muscle fiber merosin
HP:0030091.definition: Lack of merosin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030091.definition_cn: 肌肉活检中缺乏层粘连蛋白。

HP:0030092.name: Reduced muscle fiber merosin
HP:0030092.definition: A reduced amount of merosin in muscle fibers. This feature is usually assessed by immunohistochemical examination of muscle biopsy tissue.
HP:0030092.definition_cn: 肌纤维中层粘连蛋白（merosin）含量减少。该特征通常通过肌肉活检组织的免疫组织化学检查进行评估。

HP:0030093.name: Abnormal muscle fiber laminin beta 1
HP:0030093.definition: A deviation from normal of the amount of laminin beta 1 in muscle fiber tissue. Laminin 2 is a major component of the basal lamina of skeletal muscle cells. It is a heterotrimer composed of 3 chains: merosin (laminin alpha 2 chain), beta 1, and gamma 1.
HP:0030093.name_cn: 异常肌纤维层粘连蛋白β1
HP:0030093.definition_cn: 肌纤维组织中层粘连蛋白β1含量的异常。层粘连蛋白2是骨骼肌细胞基底膜的主要成分，它是由3条链组成的异源三聚体：merosin（层粘连蛋白α2链）、β1和γ1。

HP:0030094.name: Reduced muscle fiber laminin beta 1
HP:0030094.definition: A reduced amount of laminin beta 1 in muscle fiber tissue. Laminin 2 is a major component of the basal lamina of skeletal muscle cells. It is a heterotrimer composed of 3 chains: merosin (laminin alpha 2 chain), beta 1, and gamma 1.
HP:0030094.name_cn: 肌纤维层粘连蛋白β1减少
HP:0030094.definition_cn: 肌纤维组织中层粘连蛋白β1含量减少。层粘连蛋白2是骨骼肌细胞基底膜的主要成分，它是由3条链组成的异源三聚体：merosin（层粘连蛋白α2链）、β1链和γ1链。

HP:0030095.name: Reduced muscle collagen VI
HP:0030095.definition: A decreased amount of collagen VI in muscle tissue. Collagen VI is a primarily associated with the extracellular matrix of skeletal muscle.
HP:0030095.definition_cn: 骨骼肌组织中胶原蛋白VI含量减少。胶原蛋白VI主要与骨骼肌的细胞外基质相关。

HP:0030096.name: Abnormal muscle fiber dystrophin expression
HP:0030096.definition: A deviation from normal in the amount of dystrophin in muscle fiber tissue. Dystrophin is located at the muscle sarcolemma in a membrane-spanning protein complex that connects the cytoskeleton to the basal lamina.
HP:0030096.name_cn: 异常肌纤维抗肌萎缩蛋白表达
HP:0030096.definition_cn: 肌纤维组织中肌营养不良蛋白含量的异常。肌营养不良蛋白位于肌纤维膜上，属于跨膜蛋白复合物，连接细胞骨架与基底膜。

HP:0030097.name: Absent muscle dystrophin expression
HP:0030097.definition: Lack of dystrophin in muscle tissue. Immunohistochemistry reveals absent dystrophin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030097.name_cn: 肌肉营养不良蛋白表达缺失
HP:0030097.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中缺乏抗肌萎缩蛋白。免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中抗肌萎缩蛋白缺失。

HP:0030098.name: Reduced muscle dystrophin expression
HP:0030098.definition: A decreased amount of dystrophin in muscle fiber tissue.
HP:0030098.name_cn: 肌肉营养不良蛋白表达减少
HP:0030098.definition_cn: 肌纤维组织中肌营养不良蛋白含量减少。

HP:0030099.name: Reduced muscle fiber alpha dystroglycan
HP:0030099.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced alpha dystroglycan protein in the muscle biopsy. Alpha-dystroglycan is a heavily glycosylated peripheral-membrane component of the dystrophin-associated glycoprotein complex (DAPC), which, in addition to laminin alpha2, binds perlecan and agrin in the extracellular matrix, whereas beta-dystroglycan, derived from the same gene, is a transmembrane protein that links to dystrophin intracellularly.
HP:0030099.name_cn: 肌纤维α-抗肌萎缩蛋白糖基化降低
HP:0030099.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中α-肌营养不良聚糖蛋白减少。α-肌营养不良聚糖是肌营养不良相关糖蛋白复合物（DAPC）中高度糖基化的外周膜成分，除了与层粘连蛋白α2结合外，还在细胞外基质中与基底膜蛋白聚糖和聚集蛋白结合；而β-肌营养不良聚糖源自同一基因，是一种跨膜蛋白，在细胞内与肌营养不良蛋白相连。

HP:0030100.name: Abnormal muscle fiber alpha sarcoglycan
HP:0030100.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of alpha sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.
HP:0030100.definition_cn: 肌肉中α-肌聚糖含量的异常。α、β、γ和δ-肌聚糖是肌营养不良蛋白复合体的组成部分。它们均为N-糖基化的跨膜蛋白，具有一个短的细胞内结构域、一个单一的跨膜区域和一个包含保守半胱氨酸簇的较大的细胞外结构域。

HP:0030101.name: Absent muscle fiber alpha sarcoglycan
HP:0030101.definition: Lack of alpha sarcoglycan in muscle. Immunohistochemistry reveals absent alpha sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030101.definition_cn: 肌肉中α-肌聚糖缺乏。免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中α-肌聚糖蛋白缺失。

HP:0030102.name: Reduced muscle fiber alpha sarcoglycan
HP:0030102.definition: A decreased amount of alpha sarcoglycan in muscle. Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced alpha sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030102.definition_cn: 肌肉中α-肌聚糖含量减少。免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中α-肌聚糖蛋白表达降低。

HP:0030103.name: Abnormal muscle fiber beta sarcoglycan
HP:0030103.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of beta sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.
HP:0030103.definition_cn: 肌肉中β-肌聚糖含量异常。α、β、γ和δ-肌聚糖是肌营养不良蛋白复合体的组成部分。它们均为N-糖基化跨膜蛋白，具有一个短的细胞内结构域、一个单一的跨膜区域和一个包含保守半胱氨酸簇的较大的细胞外结构域。

HP:0030104.name: Abnormal muscle fiber gamma sarcoglycan
HP:0030104.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of gamma sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.
HP:0030104.definition_cn: 肌肉中γ-肌聚糖量的异常。α、β、γ和δ-肌聚糖是肌营养不良蛋白复合体的组成部分。它们均为N-糖基化的跨膜蛋白，具有一个短的细胞内结构域、一个单一的跨膜区和一个包含保守半胱氨酸簇的大细胞外结构域。

HP:0030105.name: Abnormal muscle fiber delta sarcoglycan
HP:0030105.definition: Deviation from normal in the amount of delta sarcoglycan in muscle. The alpha, beta, gamma, and delta sarcoglycans are components of the dystrophin-complex. They are all N-glycosylated transmembrane proteins with a short intra-cellular domain, a single transmembrane region and a large extra-cellular domain containing a cluster of conserved cysteines.
HP:0030105.definition_cn: 肌肉中δ-肌聚糖含量的异常。α、β、γ和δ-肌聚糖是肌营养不良蛋白复合体的组成部分。它们均为N-糖基化的跨膜蛋白，具有一个短的细胞内结构域、一个单一的跨膜区域以及一个包含保守半胱氨酸簇的较大的细胞外结构域。

HP:0030106.name: Absent muscle fiber beta sarcoglycan
HP:0030106.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of beta sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030106.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中β-肌聚糖蛋白完全缺失。

HP:0030107.name: Reduced muscle fiber beta sarcoglycan
HP:0030107.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced beta sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030107.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中β-肌聚糖蛋白表达降低。

HP:0030108.name: Reduced muscle fiber gamma sarcoglycan
HP:0030108.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced gamma sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030108.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中γ-肌聚糖蛋白表达减少。

HP:0030109.name: Absent muscle fiber gamma sarcoglycan
HP:0030109.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of gamma sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030109.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中γ-肌聚糖蛋白完全缺失。

HP:0030110.name: Absent muscle fiber delta sarcoglycan
HP:0030110.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of delta sarcoglycan protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030110.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检组织中δ-肌聚糖蛋白完全缺失。

HP:0030111.name: Reduced muscle fiber delta sarcoglycan
HP:0030111.definition: Abnormally reduced amount of delta sarcoglycan in muscle.
HP:0030111.definition_cn: 肌肉中δ-肌聚糖异常减少。

HP:0030112.name: Abnormal muscle fiber alpha dystroglycan
HP:0030112.definition: A deviation from normal of muscle alpha-dystroglcan expression. Alpha-dystroglycan is a heavily glycosylated peripheral-membrane component of the dystrophin-associated glycoprotein complex (DAPC), which, in addition to laminin alpha2, binds perlecan and agrin in the extracellular matrix, whereas beta-dystroglycan, derived from the same gene, is a transmembrane protein that links to dystrophin intracellularly.
HP:0030112.name_cn: 异常肌纤维α-抗肌萎缩相关糖蛋白
HP:0030112.definition_cn: 肌肉α-抗肌萎缩相关糖蛋白（alpha-dystroglycan）表达异常。α-抗肌萎缩相关糖蛋白是一种高度糖基化的外周膜成分，属于抗肌萎缩相关糖蛋白复合物（DAPC）的一部分。除了与层粘连蛋白α2结合外，它还在细胞外基质中与基底膜蛋白聚糖（perlecan）和聚集蛋白（agrin）结合。而β-抗肌萎缩相关糖蛋白（beta-dystroglycan）源自同一基因，是一种跨膜蛋白，在细胞内与抗肌萎缩蛋白（dystrophin）相连。

HP:0030113.name: Abnormal muscle fiber dysferlin
HP:0030113.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of dysferlin in muscle tissue. Dysferlin is an ubiquitous 230-kDa transmembrane protein involved in calcium-mediated sarcolemma resealing.
HP:0030113.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中 dysferlin 表达异常。Dysferlin 是一种普遍存在的 230 kDa 跨膜蛋白，参与钙介导的肌膜修复。

HP:0030114.name: Absent muscle fiber dysferlin
HP:0030114.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of dysferlin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030114.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中完全缺乏肌营养不良蛋白。

HP:0030115.name: Reduced muscle fiber dysferlin
HP:0030115.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced dysferlin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030115.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中dysferlin蛋白表达减少。

HP:0030116.name: Abnormal muscle fiber emerin
HP:0030116.definition: A deviation from normal of the amount of the inner nuclear membrane protein emerin in muscle tissue.
HP:0030116.name_cn: 异常肌纤维埃默里蛋白
HP:0030116.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中内核膜蛋白emerin含量的异常。

HP:0030117.name: Absent muscle fiber emerin
HP:0030117.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows complete lack of emerin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030117.name_cn: 肌纤维埃默林蛋白缺失
HP:0030117.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中emerin蛋白完全缺失。

HP:0030118.name: Reduced muscle fiber emerin
HP:0030118.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced emerin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030118.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中emerin蛋白表达减少。

HP:0030119.name: Abnormal muscle fiber calpain-3
HP:0030119.definition: A deviation from normal in the amount of calpain-3 in muscle tissue. Calpains are intracellular nonlysosomal cysteine proteases modulated by calcium ions. A typical calpain is a heterodimer composed of two distinct subunits, one large (over 80 kDa) and the other small (30 kDa). While only one gene encoding the small subunit has been demonstrated, there are many genes for the large one. CAPN3 is similar to ubiquitous Calpain 1 and 2 (m-calpain and micro-calpain), but contains specific insertion sequences (NS, IS1 and IS2). Calpains cleave target proteins to modify their properties, rather than breaking down the substrates.
HP:0030119.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中钙蛋白酶-3（calpain-3）含量的异常。钙蛋白酶是一类由钙离子调节的细胞内非溶酶体半胱氨酸蛋白酶。典型的钙蛋白酶是由两个不同亚基组成的异二聚体，一个是大亚基（超过80 kDa），另一个是小亚基（30 kDa）。虽然目前仅发现一个编码小亚基的基因，但大亚基的基因则有多样性。CAPN3与普遍存在的钙蛋白酶1和2（m-calpain和micro-calpain）相似，但包含特定的插入序列（NS、IS1和IS2）。钙蛋白酶通过切割靶蛋白来改变其特性，而非完全降解底物。

HP:0030120.name: Absent muscle fiber calpain-3
HP:0030120.definition: Western blot shows complete lack of calpain-3 protein in the muscle biopsy tissue.
HP:0030120.definition_cn: 蛋白质印迹法显示肌肉活检组织中完全缺乏钙蛋白酶-3蛋白。

HP:0030121.name: Reduced muscle fiber calpain-3
HP:0030121.definition: Western blot reveals reduced calpain-3 protein in the muscle biopsy tissue.
HP:0030121.definition_cn: 蛋白质印迹法显示肌肉活检组织中钙蛋白酶-3蛋白表达降低。

HP:0030122.name: Reduced muscle fiber perlecan
HP:0030122.definition: Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced perlecan protein in the muscle biopsy. Perlecan is a basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein (HSPG) also known as heparan sulfate proteoglycan 2 (HSPG2).
HP:0030122.name_cn: 肌纤维基底膜蛋白聚糖减少
HP:0030122.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中基底膜特异性硫酸乙酰肝素蛋白聚糖核心蛋白（HSPG），即硫酸乙酰肝素蛋白聚糖2（HSPG2），也称为perlecan蛋白的表达减少。

HP:0030123.name: Abnormal muscle fiber lamin A/C
HP:0030123.definition: A deviation from the normal amount of lamin A/C in muscle tissue. The LMNA gene gives rise to at least three splicing isoforms including the two main isoforms, lamin A and lamin C. These are constitutive components of the fibrous nuclear lamina and have different roles, ranging from mechanical nuclear membrane maintenance to gene regulation.
HP:0030123.name_cn: 异常肌纤维层粘连蛋白A/C
HP:0030123.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中核纤层蛋白A/C（lamin A/C）含量偏离正常值。LMNA基因至少产生三种剪接异构体，其中包括两种主要异构体，即核纤层蛋白A（lamin A）和核纤层蛋白C（lamin C）。这些是核纤层（nuclear lamina）的组成成分，具有多种功能，包括维持核膜的机械稳定性以及参与基因调控。

HP:0030124.name: Reduced muscle fiber lamin A/C
HP:0030124.definition: A decreased amount of lamin A/C in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.
HP:0030124.name_cn: 肌纤维层粘连蛋白A/C减少
HP:0030124.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中核纤层蛋白A/C（Lamin A/C）含量减少。该特征可通过肌肉组织的免疫组织化学染色（Immunohistochemistry）或蛋白质印迹法（Western Blotting）进行检测。

HP:0030125.name: Sacralization of the fifth lumbar vertebra
HP:0030125.definition: A congenital anomaly, in which the transverse process of the last lumbar vertebra (L5) fuses to the sacrum on one side or both, or to ilium, or both.
HP:0030125.definition_cn: 一种先天性异常，其中最后一节腰椎（L5）的横突在一侧或两侧与骶骨融合，或与髂骨融合，或同时与两者融合。

HP:0030126.name: Abnormal endometrium morphology
HP:0030126.definition: An anomaly of the inner mucous membrane of the uterus.

HP:0030127.name: Endometriosis
HP:0030127.definition: The growth of endometrial tissue outside the uterus.

HP:0030129.name: Impaired ristocetin cofactor assay activity
HP:0030129.definition: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin to platelet-poor plasma.
HP:0030129.name_cn: 瑞斯托霉素辅因子测定活性受损
HP:0030129.definition_cn: 对瑞斯托霉素的异常反应表现为在向血小板贫乏血浆中添加瑞斯托霉素后，血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0030130.name: Impaired von Willebrand factor collagen binding activity
HP:0030130.definition: Reduced ability of von Willebrand factor (vWF) to bind collagen. Abnormal response to collagen as manifested by reduced or lacking ability of plasma von WIllebrand Factor to bind collagen. An ELISA-based assay is typically used; the test is sensitive to loss of von Willebrand Factor high molecular weight multimers.
HP:0030130.name_cn: 血管性血友病因子胶原结合活性受损
HP:0030130.definition_cn: 血管性血友病因子（vWF）与胶原结合能力降低。表现为血浆血管性血友病因子与胶原结合能力减弱或缺失的异常反应。通常采用基于酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）的检测方法；该检测对血管性血友病因子高分子量多聚体的丢失具有敏感性。

HP:0030131.name: Abnormal von Willebrand factor multimer distribution
HP:0030131.definition: Deviation from the normal von Willebrand factor multimer pattern.
HP:0030131.name_cn: 异常血管性血友病因子多聚体分布
HP:0030131.definition_cn: 正常血管性血友病因子多聚体模式的偏离。

HP:0030132.name: Absence of large von Willebrand factor multimers
HP:0030132.definition: Absence of large von Willebrand Factor multimers on gel electrophoresis.
HP:0030132.name_cn: 大分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体缺失
HP:0030132.definition_cn: 凝胶电泳中未检测到大分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体。

HP:0030133.name: Abnormal presence of ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers
HP:0030133.definition: Detection of abnormal ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers.
HP:0030133.name_cn: 超大血管性血友病因子多聚体异常存在
HP:0030133.definition_cn: 检测异常超大型血管性血友病因子多聚体。

HP:0030134.name: Total absence von Willebrand factor multimers
HP:0030134.definition: Complete absence of all von Willebrand factor multimers.
HP:0030134.name_cn: 完全缺乏血管性血友病因子多聚体
HP:0030134.definition_cn: 所有血管性血友病因子多聚体完全缺失。

HP:0030135.name: Absence of intermediate von Willebrand factor multimers
HP:0030135.definition: Lack of intermediate von Willebrand Factor multimers on gel electrophoresis.
HP:0030135.name_cn: 中间型血管性血友病因子多聚体缺失
HP:0030135.definition_cn: 凝胶电泳中缺乏中间型血管性血友病因子多聚体。

HP:0030136.name: Enhanced ristocetin cofactor assay activity
HP:0030136.definition: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by increased aggregation of platelets upon addition of low-dose ristocetin to platelet-rich plasma.
HP:0030136.name_cn: 增强型瑞斯托霉素辅因子测定活性
HP:0030136.definition_cn: 对瑞斯托霉素的异常反应表现为在富含血小板的血浆中加入低剂量瑞斯托霉素后血小板聚集增加。

HP:0030137.name: Prolonged bleeding following circumcision
HP:0030137.definition: Bleeding that persists for a longer than usual time following circumcision.
HP:0030137.name_cn: 包皮环切术后持续性出血
HP:0030137.definition_cn: 包皮环切术后出血时间延长。

HP:0030138.name: Excessive bleeding from superficial cuts
HP:0030138.definition: An abnormally increased degree of bleeding following a superficial injury to the surface of the skin.
HP:0030138.definition_cn: 皮肤表面浅表损伤后异常增加的出血程度。

HP:0030139.name: Excessive bleeding after a venipuncture
HP:0030139.definition: An abnormal high amount of bleeding following the procedure of taking a blood sample.
HP:0030139.definition_cn: 采血术后异常大量出血。

HP:0030140.name: Oral cavity bleeding
HP:0030140.definition: Recurrent or excessive bleeding from the mouth.
HP:0030140.definition_cn: 复发性或过度性口腔出血。

HP:0030141.name: Abnormality of the posterior hairline
HP:0030141.definition: An anomaly in the placement or shape of the hairline (trichion) on the back of the head (neck), that is, the border between skin on the back of the head that has head hair.
HP:0030141.definition_cn: 头部后侧（颈部）发际线（trichion）位置或形态异常，即头部后侧有头发的皮肤与无头发皮肤之间的边界异常。

HP:0030142.name: Abnormal bowel sounds
HP:0030142.definition: An anomaly of the amount or nature of abdominal sounds. Abdominal sounds (bowel sounds) are made by the movement of the intestines as they promote passage of abdominal contents by peristalsis.
HP:0030142.definition_cn: 腹部声音（肠鸣音）的数量或性质异常。腹部声音（肠鸣音）是由肠道蠕动推动腹部内容物通过时产生的。

HP:0030143.name: Hyperactive bowel sounds
HP:0030143.definition: Abnormally increased gurgling/rumbling sounds made by the movement of fluid and gas in the intestines.

HP:0030144.name: Hypoactive bowel sounds
HP:0030144.definition: An decreased amount of bowel sounds.

HP:0030145.name: Lack of bowel sounds
HP:0030145.definition: Complete lack of abdominal sounds as assayed by examination of the abdomen with a stethoscope.
HP:0030145.definition_cn: 经腹部听诊检查发现肠鸣音完全消失。

HP:0030146.name: Abnormal liver parenchyma morphology
HP:0030146.definition: A structural anomaly of the liver located predominantly in the hepatocytes as opposed to stromal cells.
HP:0030146.definition_cn: 一种主要位于肝细胞而非基质细胞的肝脏结构异常。

HP:0030147.name: Truncal titubation
HP:0030147.definition: Tremor of the trunk in an anterior-posterior plane at 3-4 Hz.
HP:0030147.definition_cn: 躯干在前后平面以3-4赫兹频率的震颤。

HP:0030148.name: Heart murmur
HP:0030148.definition: An extra or unusual sound heard during a heartbeat caused vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart.
HP:0030148.definition_cn: 心脏杂音（Heart murmur），即由于血液流经心脏时产生的振动所引发的额外或异常心音。

HP:0030149.name: Cardiogenic shock
HP:0030149.definition: Severely decreased cardiac output with evidence of inadequate end-organ perfusion (i.e., tissue hypoxia) in the presence of adequate intravascular volume.
HP:0030149.definition_cn: 严重心输出量减少伴终末器官灌注不足（即组织缺氧）的证据，且血管内容量充足。

HP:0030150.name: Plasmacytosis
HP:0030150.definition: An abnormally increased number of plasma cells in tissues, exudates, or blood
HP:0030150.definition_cn: 组织中、渗出物或血液中浆细胞数量异常增多

HP:0030151.name: Cholangitis
HP:0030151.definition: Inflammation of the biliary ductal system, affecting the intrahepatic or extrahepatic portions, or both.
HP:0030151.definition_cn: 胆道系统炎症，累及肝内或肝外部分，或两者兼有。

HP:0030153.name: Cholangiocarcinoma
HP:0030153.definition: Cholangiocarcinoma is a primary cancer originating in the biliary epithelium i.e., the cholangiocytes, of the extrahepatic and intrahepatic biliary ducts. It is extremely invasive, develops rapidly, often metastasizes, and has a very poor prognosis. They are slow growing tumors which spread longitudinally along the bile ducts with neural, perineural and subepithelial extension.
HP:0030153.definition_cn: 胆管癌是一种起源于胆道上皮细胞（即胆管细胞）的原发性癌症，可发生于肝外和肝内胆管。该肿瘤具有极强的侵袭性，发展迅速，常发生转移，且预后极差。胆管癌为生长缓慢的肿瘤，沿胆管纵向扩散，伴有神经、神经周围及上皮下的浸润。

HP:0030154.name: Gallbladder perforation
HP:0030154.definition: Rupture of the wall of the gallbladder.

HP:0030155.name: Scrotal pain
HP:0030155.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the scrotum.
HP:0030155.definition_cn: 一种以局限于阴囊的躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0030156.name: Bence Jones Proteinuria
HP:0030156.definition: The presence of free monoclonal immunoglobulin light chains in the urine.
HP:0030156.definition_cn: 尿液中游离单克隆免疫球蛋白轻链的存在。

HP:0030157.name: Flank pain
HP:0030157.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the flank.
HP:0030157.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，并感知为起源于胁腹。

HP:0030158.name: Cervical ectropion
HP:0030158.definition: Cervical ectropion occurs when eversion of the endocervix exposes columnar epithelium to the vaginal milieu
HP:0030158.definition_cn: 宫颈外翻发生时，宫颈内膜外翻使柱状上皮暴露于阴道环境中。

HP:0030159.name: Cervical polyp
HP:0030159.definition: Abnormal growth of tissue projecting from a mucous membrane of the endocervix.
HP:0030159.definition_cn: 宫颈内膜黏膜组织异常增生性突起。

HP:0030161.name: Vaginal pruritus
HP:0030161.definition: A sensation of itching in the vagina.

HP:0030164.name: Jaw claudication
HP:0030164.definition: Pain in the jaw or ear induced by chewing or otherwise moving the jaw.
HP:0030164.definition_cn: 颞下颌关节紊乱综合征（Temporomandibular Joint Disorder, TMJ）引起的咀嚼或下颌运动时诱发的颌部或耳部疼痛。

HP:0030165.name: Temporal artery tortuosity
HP:0030165.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the temporal artery.

HP:0030166.name: Night sweats
HP:0030166.definition: Occurrence of excessive sweating during sleep.

HP:0030167.name: Antimitochondrial antibody positivity
HP:0030167.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against mitochondria.
HP:0030167.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对线粒体反应的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0030168.name: Dilated superficial abdominal veins
HP:0030168.definition: Increase in diameter of the veins located underneath the skin of the abdomen.

HP:0030169.name: Gastric varix
HP:0030169.definition: Extreme dilation of the submucusoal veins in the stomach.
HP:0030169.definition_cn: 胃黏膜下静脉极度扩张。

HP:0030170.name: Cystic artery pseudoaneurysm
HP:0030170.definition: Presence of a pseudoaneurysm in the artery that supplies the gallbladder and cystic duct with blood. A pseudoaneurysm, also known as a false aneurysm, forms when blood leaks through a breach of the arterial wall but is contained by the adventitia or surrounding perivascular soft tissue.
HP:0030170.definition_cn: 胆囊及胆囊管供血动脉内存在假性动脉瘤。假性动脉瘤，亦称假性动脉瘤，系因动脉壁破裂导致血液外渗，但被外膜或周围血管旁软组织包裹而形成。

HP:0030171.name: Perirenal hematoma
HP:0030171.definition: A collection of clotted blood surrounding the kidney.

HP:0030172.name: Peripheral amyelination
HP:0030172.definition: Congenital absence of the myelin sheath on a nerve.

HP:0030173.name: Peripheral hypermyelination
HP:0030173.definition_cn: 周围神经髓鞘形成增加。

HP:0030174.name: Increased peripheral myelin thickness
HP:0030174.definition: Elevated thickness of the myelin sheath of peripheral nerves, in a regular and concentric fashion.
HP:0030174.definition_cn: 周围神经髓鞘厚度呈规则性同心圆样增厚。

HP:0030175.name: Myelin tomacula
HP:0030175.definition: The presence of multiple sausage-shaped swellings of the myelin sheath (The Latin tomaculum means sausage).
HP:0030175.definition_cn: 髓鞘出现多个香肠样肿胀（拉丁语“tomaculum”意为香肠）。

HP:0030176.name: Asymmetric peripheral demyelination
HP:0030176.definition: Loss of myelin from peripheral nerves in a pattern that differs between right and left.
HP:0030176.name_cn: 不对称性周围神经脱髓鞘
HP:0030176.definition_cn: 周围神经髓鞘脱失，表现为左右侧不对称模式。

HP:0030177.name: Abnormality of peripheral nervous system electrophysiology
HP:0030177.definition: An abnormality of the function of the electrical signals with which peripheral nerve cells communicate with each other or with muscles.
HP:0030177.name_cn: 周围神经系统电生理异常
HP:0030177.definition_cn: 周围神经细胞之间或与肌肉之间电信号传导功能异常。

HP:0030178.name: Abnormality of central nervous system electrophysiology
HP:0030178.name_cn: 中枢神经系统电生理异常

HP:0030179.name: Abnormal peripheral action potential amplitude
HP:0030179.definition: An anomaly in the magnitude of the action potential along a peripheral nerve, that is, of the rapid rise and fall of the electrical membrane potential of the nerve.
HP:0030179.name_cn: 周围神经动作电位幅度异常
HP:0030179.definition_cn: 周围神经动作电位幅度的异常，即神经膜电位的快速上升和下降。

HP:0030180.name: Oppenheim reflex
HP:0030180.definition: Dorsiflexion of the big toe, sometimes accompanied by fanning of the other toes, elicited by stroking along the medial side of the tibia (the normal response would be no movement of the big toe).
HP:0030180.definition_cn: 沿胫骨内侧缘轻划引发的大脚趾背屈，有时伴随其他脚趾的扇形展开（正常反应应为大脚趾无运动）。

HP:0030181.name: Gordon reflex
HP:0030181.definition: Dorsal extension of the big toe, sometimes accompanied by fanning of the other toes, elicited by compressing the calf muscles (a normal response is no movement of the big toe).
HP:0030181.definition_cn: 大趾背伸，有时伴有其他足趾扇形展开，通过挤压小腿肌肉诱发（正常反应为大趾无运动）。

HP:0030182.name: Tetraplegia/tetraparesis
HP:0030182.definition: Loss of strength in all four limbs. Tetraplegia refers to a complete loss of strength, whereas Tetraparesis refers to an incomplete loss of strength.
HP:0030182.definition_cn: 四肢肌力丧失。四肢瘫痪（Tetraplegia）指肌力完全丧失，而四肢轻瘫（Tetraparesis）指肌力部分丧失。

HP:0030183.name: Impaired visually enhanced vestibulo-ocular reflex
HP:0030183.definition: The vestibulo-ocular reflex is responsible for the stabilization of the retinal image during movement. The visual vestibular ocular reflex (VVOR) or visual enhanced VOR, maintains ocular stability during head motion by generating compensatory eye movement opposite to head movement, and is a major component of visual vestibular interaction. This feature is an impairment of this reflex, manifested as the combined impairment of the three compensatory eye movement reflexes, namely the vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR), smooth pursuit (SP) and optokinetic reflex (OKR).
HP:0030183.name_cn: 视觉增强前庭眼反射受损
HP:0030183.definition_cn: 前庭眼反射负责在运动过程中稳定视网膜图像。视觉前庭眼反射（VVOR）或视觉增强前庭眼反射，通过产生与头部运动相反的补偿性眼球运动来维持头部运动时的眼球稳定性，是视觉前庭相互作用的主要组成部分。此特征为该反射的损害，表现为三种补偿性眼球运动反射的联合损害，即前庭眼反射（VOR）、平滑追踪（SP）和视动反射（OKR）。

HP:0030185.name: Isometric tremor
HP:0030185.definition: An isometric tremor occurs with muscle contraction against a rigid stationary object (e.g., when making a fist).
HP:0030185.definition_cn: 等长性震颤发生于肌肉对抗刚性静止物体收缩时（例如，握拳时）。

HP:0030186.name: Kinetic tremor
HP:0030186.definition: Tremor that occurs during any voluntary movement. It may include visually or non-visually guided movements. Tremor during target directed movement is called intention tremor.
HP:0030186.definition_cn: 任何自主运动期间发生的震颤。可能包括视觉引导或非视觉引导的运动。目标导向运动期间的震颤称为意向性震颤。

HP:0030187.name: Titubation
HP:0030187.definition: Nodding movement of the head or body.
HP:0030187.definition_cn: 头部或身体的点头运动。

HP:0030188.name: Tremor by anatomical site
HP:0030188.definition: Tremor classified by the affected body part.
HP:0030188.name_cn: 按解剖部位分类的震颤
HP:0030188.definition_cn: 震颤按受累身体部位分类。

HP:0030190.name: Oral motor hypotonia
HP:0030190.definition: Reduced muscle tone of oral musculature. In infants, this feature may be associated with difficulties in breast feeding, and may affect the latch, jaw motions, tongue placement, lip seal, suck/swallow/breathe pattern and overall feeding behavior.
HP:0030190.definition_cn: 口腔肌肉张力减退。在婴儿中，此特征可能与母乳喂养困难相关，并可能影响吸吮、下颌运动、舌位、唇密封、吸吮/吞咽/呼吸模式及整体喂养行为。

HP:0030191.name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system synaptic transmission
HP:0030191.definition: An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse in the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0030191.name_cn: 周围神经系统突触传递异常
HP:0030191.definition_cn: 周围神经系统突触中神经元向靶细胞传递信息的异常。

HP:0030192.name: Fatigable weakness of bulbar muscles
HP:0030192.definition: A type of weakness of the bulbar muscles (muscles of the mouth and throat responsible for speech and swallowing) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030192.definition_cn: 一种延髓肌（负责言语和吞咽的口咽部肌肉）无力类型，表现为肌肉群使用后出现无力，休息后症状减轻。即，重复肌肉动作后肌力减弱。

HP:0030193.name: Fatigable weakness of chewing muscles
HP:0030193.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in chewing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030193.definition_cn: 一种涉及咀嚼肌的肌无力类型，表现为肌肉群使用后出现肌力减弱，休息后症状缓解。即，重复性肌肉动作导致肌力减退。

HP:0030194.name: Fatigable weakness of speech muscles
HP:0030194.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in speech that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030194.definition_cn: 一种涉及言语肌肉的肌无力类型，在肌肉群使用后出现，并在肌肉群得到休息后减轻。即，随着重复性肌肉动作，肌力逐渐减弱。

HP:0030195.name: Fatigable weakness of swallowing muscles
HP:0030195.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in swallowing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030195.definition_cn: 一种涉及吞咽肌群的肌无力类型，表现为肌群在使用后出现无力，并在肌群得到适当休息后减轻。即，随着重复性肌肉动作，肌力逐渐减弱。

HP:0030196.name: Fatigable weakness of respiratory muscles
HP:0030196.definition: A type of weakness of the muscles involved in breathing (respiration) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030196.definition_cn: 一种涉及呼吸肌的肌无力类型，在肌肉群使用后出现，并在肌肉群得到适当休息后减轻。即，随着重复肌肉动作，肌力逐渐减弱。

HP:0030197.name: Fatigable weakness of skeletal muscles
HP:0030197.definition: A type of weakness of skeletal muscle that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030197.definition_cn: 一种骨骼肌无力类型，表现为肌群使用后出现无力，休息后症状减轻。即，重复肌肉动作导致肌力减退。

HP:0030198.name: Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles
HP:0030198.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of distal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030198.name_cn: 远端肢体肌肉易疲劳性无力
HP:0030198.definition_cn: 一种肢体远端骨骼肌无力类型，发生于肌群使用后，并在肌群得到休息后减轻。即，重复肌肉动作导致肌力减弱。

HP:0030199.name: Fatigable weakness of neck muscles
HP:0030199.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle in the neck that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030199.name_cn: 颈部肌肉易疲劳性无力
HP:0030199.definition_cn: 一种颈部骨骼肌无力类型，表现为肌肉群使用后出现肌力减弱，休息后症状缓解。即，重复性肌肉活动导致肌力减退。

HP:0030200.name: Fatiguable weakness of proximal limb muscles
HP:0030200.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of proximal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.
HP:0030200.name_cn: 近端肢体肌肉易疲劳性无力
HP:0030200.definition_cn: 一种肢体近端骨骼肌的无力类型，在肌肉群使用后出现，并在肌肉群得到休息后减轻。即，随着重复肌肉动作，肌力逐渐减弱。

HP:0030201.name: Response to drugs acting on neuromuscular transmission
HP:0030201.definition: Specific drugs interfere selectively with the different cellular mechanisms involved in neuromuscular transmission (synthesis, storage, release, action and inactivation of transmitter). The response of a patient to a specific drug can therefore be useful information for the differential diagnosis.
HP:0030201.name_cn: 对作用于神经肌肉传递的药物反应
HP:0030201.definition_cn: 特定药物选择性地干扰神经肌肉传递过程中涉及的不同细胞机制（神经递质的合成、储存、释放、作用及失活）。因此，患者对特定药物的反应可作为鉴别诊断的有用信息。

HP:0030202.name: Favorable response of weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
HP:0030202.definition: Improvement of muscle strength in response to administration of an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor.
HP:0030202.name_cn: 对乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂的虚弱症状呈现良好反应
HP:0030202.definition_cn: 乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂给药后肌力改善。

HP:0030203.name: Unfavorable response of muscle weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
HP:0030203.definition: Lack of improvement of muscle strength in response to administration of an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor.
HP:0030203.name_cn: 对乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂的肌肉无力反应不良
HP:0030203.definition_cn: 对乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂给药后肌力无改善。

HP:0030205.name: Increased jitter at single fiber EMG
HP:0030205.definition: The variation in the time interval between the two action potentials of the same motor unit is called jitter. This term therefore applies to increased variability in the interval between successive action potentials of the same motor unit, which is measured by electromyography (EMG).
HP:0030205.name_cn: 单纤维肌电图中的抖动增加
HP:0030205.definition_cn: 同一运动单位两次动作电位间的时间间隔变异称为抖动（jitter）。因此，该术语适用于通过肌电图（EMG）测量的同一运动单位连续动作电位间间隔的变异性增加。

HP:0030206.name: EMG
HP:0030206.definition: A compound muscle action potential (CMAP) is a type of electromyography (EMG). CMAP refers to a group of almost simultaneous action potentials from several muscle fibers in the same area evoked by stimulation of the supplying motor nerve and are recorded as one multipeaked summated action potential. This abnormality refers to an abnormal increase in the amplitude during the course of the investigation.
HP:0030206.definition_cn: 复合肌肉动作电位（Compound Muscle Action Potential, CMAP）是一种肌电图（Electromyography, EMG）类型。CMAP指的是通过刺激支配的运动神经在同一区域内诱发的多个肌纤维几乎同时产生的动作电位，这些电位被记录为一个多峰的综合动作电位。此异常是指在检查过程中振幅的异常增加。

HP:0030207.name: Paradoxical respiration
HP:0030207.definition: Breathing movements in which the chest wall moves in on inspiration and out on expiration, in reverse of the normal movements. It may be seen in children with respiratory distress of any cause, which leads to indrawing of the intercostal spaces during inspiration. Patients with chronic airways obstruction also show indrawing of the lower ribs during inspiration, due to the distorted action of a depressed and flattened diaphragm. Crush injuries of the chest, with fractured ribs and sternum, can lead to a severe degree of paradoxical breathing.
HP:0030207.definition_cn: 反常呼吸运动，即吸气时胸壁内陷而呼气时胸壁外凸，与正常呼吸运动相反。此现象可见于任何原因导致呼吸窘迫的儿童，表现为吸气时肋间隙内陷。慢性气道阻塞患者由于膈肌下移和扁平化导致功能异常，吸气时下肋部也会出现内陷。胸部挤压伤伴肋骨和胸骨骨折可导致严重的反常呼吸运动。

HP:0030208.name: Anti-neuromuscular Junction acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
HP:0030208.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against neuromuscular junction acetylcholine receptors.
HP:0030208.name_cn: 抗神经肌肉接头乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性
HP:0030208.definition_cn: 循环血液中存在针对神经肌肉接头乙酰胆碱受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0030209.name: Calcium channel antibody positivity
HP:0030209.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against voltage-gated calcium channels.
HP:0030209.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对电压门控钙通道的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0030210.name: Anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase antibody
HP:0030210.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against muscle specific kinase (anti-MuSK Ab).
HP:0030210.name_cn: 抗肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶抗体
HP:0030210.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对肌肉特异性激酶（anti-MuSK Ab）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0030211.name: Slow pupillary light response
HP:0030211.definition: Reduced velocity and acceleration in the pupillary light response.
HP:0030211.definition_cn: 瞳孔光反射速度和加速度降低。

HP:0030212.name: Collectionism
HP:0030212.definition: Excessive or pathological tendency to save and collect possessions.

HP:0030213.name: Emotional dearth
HP:0030213.definition: The inability to feel or express emotions. It is generally recognized by the person who often complains that they are unable to feel anything; sadness, joy, or contentment are not experienced, rather a sense of nothingness prevails. This may be dimensional, ranging from limited ability to experience emotions to the perceived complete inability to feel emotions.
HP:0030213.definition_cn: 情感麻木或情感淡漠（Emotional Numbness or Emotional Blunting）。该症状通常由患者自我报告，主诉无法感受到任何情绪；悲伤、喜悦或满足感均无法体验，取而代之的是一种虚无感。此症状可能呈维度性变化，从情感体验能力受限到完全无法感知情绪不等。

HP:0030215.name: Inappropriate crying
HP:0030215.definition: Uncontrolled episodes of crying occur without any apparent motivating stimuli.
HP:0030215.definition_cn: 无明显诱因的无法控制的哭泣发作。

HP:0030216.name: Inertia
HP:0030216.definition: Reduction of goal-directed behaviors linked to the impairment in frontal executive functions (planning of an action for example).
HP:0030216.definition_cn: 目标导向行为减少与额叶执行功能损害（例如行动规划）相关。

HP:0030217.name: Limb apraxia
HP:0030217.definition: Difficulty in performing the correct execution of limbs movements in absence of motor impairment.
HP:0030217.definition_cn: 在无运动功能障碍的情况下，肢体运动执行困难。

HP:0030218.name: Punding
HP:0030218.definition: Punding is a stereotypical motor behavior characterized by an intense fascination with repetitive, excessive and non-goal oriented handling, and examining of objects.
HP:0030218.definition_cn: 刻板行为（Punding）是一种刻板运动行为，其特征为对重复性、过度性及非目标导向性的物品操作和检查表现出强烈的迷恋。

HP:0030219.name: Semantic dementia
HP:0030219.definition: A progressive loss of the ability to remember the meaning of words, faces and objects.
HP:0030219.definition_cn: 进行性失认症（Progressive Agnosia），表现为对词语、面孔及物体意义的记忆能力逐渐丧失。

HP:0030220.name: Socially inappropriate behavior
HP:0030220.definition: Behavior that is not in line with social norms.
HP:0030220.definition_cn: 不符合社会规范的行为。

HP:0030221.name: Sweet craving
HP:0030221.definition: Excessive desire to eat sweet foods.
HP:0030221.definition_cn: 嗜糖症（Glycophilia）或糖类渴求症（Carbohydrate Craving）。

HP:0030222.name: Visual agnosia
HP:0030222.definition: The condition is known as visual agnosia, which refers to the inability to recognize objects that are visually presented, even though the individual may have normal visual field, acuity, color vision, brightness discrimination, language, and memory.
HP:0030222.definition_cn: 该病症称为视觉失认症，指个体在视觉呈现正常、视野、视力、色觉、亮度辨别、语言及记忆功能均正常的情况下，无法识别视觉呈现的物体。

HP:0030223.name: Perseverative thought
HP:0030223.definition: The repetitive production of the same response to different commands.
HP:0030223.definition_cn: 对不同指令产生相同反应的重复性行为。

HP:0030224.name: Abnormal muscle fiber desmin
HP:0030224.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of desmin in muscle tissue. Desmin is an 53-kDa protein.
HP:0030224.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中结蛋白表达异常。结蛋白是一种53千道尔顿的蛋白质。

HP:0030225.name: Accumulation of muscle fiber desmin
HP:0030225.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of desmin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030225.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中结蛋白（desmin）的积累。

HP:0030226.name: Abnormal muscle fiber myotilin
HP:0030226.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of myotilin in muscle tissue. Myotilin is a 57kDa cytoskeletal protein.
HP:0030226.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中肌联蛋白（Myotilin）表达异常。肌联蛋白是一种57kDa的细胞骨架蛋白。

HP:0030227.name: Accumulation of muscle fiber myotilin
HP:0030227.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of myotilin protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030227.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌活检中肌联蛋白的积累。

HP:0030228.name: Abnormal muscle fiber valosin-containing protein
HP:0030228.definition: A deviation from normal in the expression of valosin-containing protein in muscle tissue. Valosin-containing protein is an ubiquitously expressed multifunctional 100-kD protein that is a member of the AAA+ (ATPase associated with various activities) protein family.
HP:0030228.name_cn: 异常肌纤维含缬酪肽蛋白
HP:0030228.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中含缬酪肽蛋白表达异常。含缬酪肽蛋白是一种广泛表达的多功能100-kD蛋白，属于AAA+（与多种活性相关的ATP酶）蛋白家族成员。

HP:0030229.name: Accumulation of muscle fiber valosin-containing protein
HP:0030229.definition: Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of valosin-containing protein in the muscle biopsy.
HP:0030229.name_cn: 肌纤维含缬酪肽蛋白的积聚
HP:0030229.definition_cn: 免疫组织化学显示肌肉活检中存在含缬酪肽蛋白的积聚。

HP:0030230.name: Central core regions in muscle fibers
HP:0030230.definition: The presence of disorganized areas called cores in the center of muscle fibers. There is a typical appearance of the biopsy on light microscopy, where the muscle cells have cores that are devoid of mitochondria and specific enzymes. Cores are typically well demarcated and centrally located, but may occasionally be multiple and of eccentric.
HP:0030230.definition_cn: 肌纤维中心存在称为核心的无组织区域。在光学显微镜下，活检标本呈现典型外观，其中肌细胞核心区域缺乏线粒体和特定酶。核心通常界限清晰且位于中央，但偶尔可能为多个且偏心分布。

HP:0030231.name: Glycogen accumulation in muscle fiber lysosomes
HP:0030231.definition: An increased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue found specifically in lysosomes.
HP:0030231.name_cn: 肌纤维溶酶体中的糖原蓄积
HP:0030231.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中溶酶体内糖原含量增加。

HP:0030232.name: Increased sarcoplasmic glycogen
HP:0030232.definition: Elevated glycogen content in the sarcoplasm (cytoplasm) of muscle fibers.
HP:0030232.definition_cn: 肌纤维肌浆（细胞质）内糖原含量升高。

HP:0030233.name: Bethlem sign
HP:0030233.definition: Limitation of wrist and finger extension on asking patient to form a prayer sign. This is a result of progressive wrist and finger flexion contractures.
HP:0030233.definition_cn: 要求患者做出祈祷手势时，腕部和手指伸展受限。这是由于进行性腕部和手指屈曲挛缩所致。

HP:0030234.name: Highly elevated creatine kinase
HP:0030234.definition: An increased CPK level between 4X and 50X above the upper normal level.
HP:0030234.definition_cn: 肌酸磷酸激酶（CPK）水平升高至正常上限的4倍至50倍之间。

HP:0030235.name: Extremely elevated creatine kinase
HP:0030235.definition: An increased creatine kinase level more than 50X above the upper normal level.
HP:0030235.definition_cn: 肌酸激酶水平超过正常上限的50倍以上。

HP:0030236.name: Abnormality of muscle size
HP:0030236.definition: Abnormalities of the overall muscle bulk based on clinical observation.
HP:0030236.definition_cn: 基于临床观察的总体肌肉体积异常。

HP:0030237.name: Hand muscle weakness
HP:0030237.definition: Reduced strength of the musculature of the hand.

HP:0030239.name: Hypoplasia of the upper arm musculature
HP:0030239.definition: Underdevelopment of the musculature of the upper arm, which may include the deltoid, the triceps, the biceps, and the brachioradialis.
HP:0030239.definition_cn: 上臂肌群发育不全，可能涉及三角肌、肱三头肌、肱二头肌及肱桡肌。

HP:0030242.name: Portal vein thrombosis
HP:0030242.definition: Thrombosis of the portal vein and/or its tributaries, which include the splenic vein and the superior and inferior mesenteric veins.
HP:0030242.definition_cn: 门静脉及其属支（包括脾静脉、肠系膜上静脉和肠系膜下静脉）血栓形成。

HP:0030243.name: Hepatic vein thrombosis
HP:0030243.definition: An obstruction in the veins of the liver caused by a blood clot (thrombosis).
HP:0030243.definition_cn: 肝静脉血栓形成（Hepatic Vein Thrombosis）导致的肝静脉阻塞。

HP:0030244.name: Maternal fever in pregnancy
HP:0030244.definition: The occurrence of an elevated body temperature of the mother during pregnancy.

HP:0030245.name: Intrapartum fever
HP:0030245.definition: The occurrence of maternal fever during labor.
HP:0030245.definition_cn: 产程中母体发热的发生。

HP:0030246.name: Maternal first trimester fever
HP:0030246.definition: The occurrence of fever in a mother during the first trimester of pregnancy.
HP:0030246.definition_cn: 妊娠早期母体发热的发生。

HP:0030247.name: Splanchnic vein thrombosis
HP:0030247.definition: The term splanchnic vein thrombosis encompasses Budd-Chiari syndrome (hepatic vein thrombosis), extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO), and mesenteric vein thrombosis; the word splanchnic is used to refer to the visceral organs (of the abdominal cavity).
HP:0030247.definition_cn: 内脏静脉血栓形成这一术语包括布加综合征（肝静脉血栓形成）、肝外门静脉阻塞（EHPVO）和肠系膜静脉血栓形成；“内脏”一词用于指代（腹腔的）内脏器官。

HP:0030248.name: Mesenteric venous thrombosis
HP:0030248.definition: A clot that obstructs blood flow in a mesenteric vein (the superior and the inferior mesenteric vein drain blood from the small and large intestine).
HP:0030248.definition_cn: 肠系膜静脉血栓形成（肠系膜上静脉和肠系膜下静脉负责引流小肠和大肠的血液）。

HP:0030249.name: Enanthema
HP:0030249.definition: A sudden eruption (rash) of the surface of a mucous membrane of the mouth or pharynx.
HP:0030249.definition_cn: 口腔或咽部黏膜表面的突发性皮疹（疹）。

HP:0030250.name: Pulmonary granulomatosis
HP:0030250.definition: The presence of multiple granulomata (small nodular inflammatory lesions containing grouped mononuclear phagocytes) in the lung.
HP:0030250.definition_cn: 肺部存在多发性肉芽肿（由聚集的单核吞噬细胞组成的小结节性炎性病变）。

HP:0030251.name: Absence of memory B cells
HP:0030251.definition: Complete lack of memory B cells, that is, of mature B cell type that is long-lived, readily activated upon re-encounter of its antigenic determinant, and has been selected for expression of higher affinity immunoglobulin.
HP:0030251.definition_cn: 完全缺乏记忆B细胞，即缺乏长寿命的成熟B细胞类型，这些细胞在再次遇到其抗原决定簇时易于激活，并且已被选择表达更高亲和力的免疫球蛋白。

HP:0030252.name: Absent circulating B cells
HP:0030252.definition: Complete lack of mature B cells, that is, of B cells that have left the bone marrow.
HP:0030252.definition_cn: 完全缺乏成熟B细胞，即已离开骨髓的B细胞。

HP:0030253.name: Defective T cell proliferation
HP:0030253.definition: A reduced ability of a T cell population to expand by cell division following T cell activation.
HP:0030253.definition_cn: T细胞激活后，T细胞群体通过细胞分裂进行扩增的能力降低。

HP:0030254.name: Nail bed hemorrhage
HP:0030254.definition: Small areas of bleeding (hemorrhage) under the fingernail or toenail.
HP:0030254.definition_cn: 甲下小面积出血（甲下出血）。

HP:0030255.name: Large intestinal polyposis
HP:0030255.definition: The presence of multiple polyps in the large intestine.

HP:0030256.name: Small intestinal polyposis
HP:0030256.definition: The presence of multiple polyps in the small intestine.

HP:0030257.name: Freckled genitalia
HP:0030257.definition: One or more brown punctate macules on the skin of the genitalia.
HP:0030257.definition_cn: 生殖器皮肤上出现一处或多处棕色点状斑疹。

HP:0030258.name: Hyperpigmented genitalia
HP:0030258.definition: Localized or generalized increased genital pigmentation.
HP:0030258.name_cn: 色素沉着过度的生殖器
HP:0030258.definition_cn: 局部性或广泛性生殖器色素沉着增加。

HP:0030259.name: Hypopigmented genitalia
HP:0030259.definition: Localized or generalized decreased genital pigmentation.
HP:0030259.definition_cn: 局部或全身性生殖器色素减退。

HP:0030260.name: Microphallus
HP:0030260.definition: Length of penis more than 2 SD below the mean for age accompanied by hypospadias.
HP:0030260.definition_cn: 阴茎长度低于同龄平均值2个标准差以上，并伴有尿道下裂。

HP:0030262.name: Narrow penis
HP:0030262.definition: Penile width more than 2 standard deviations (SD) below the mean for age. Alternatively circumference of the flaccid penis more than 2 SD below the mean for age. Alternatively, apparently decreased penile width for age.
HP:0030262.definition_cn: 阴茎宽度低于同龄平均值2个标准差（SD）。或松弛状态下阴茎周长低于同龄平均值2个标准差。或明显低于同龄的阴茎宽度。

HP:0030263.name: Torsion of the penis
HP:0030263.definition: Rotated position of the glans, with or without the penile shaft, of 30 degrees or more.
HP:0030263.definition_cn: 阴茎头旋转位置，伴或不伴阴茎干，旋转角度为30度或以上。

HP:0030264.name: Webbed penis
HP:0030264.definition: Ventral skinfold extending from penis to scrotum.
HP:0030264.definition_cn: 从阴茎延伸至阴囊的腹侧皮褶。

HP:0030265.name: Wide penis
HP:0030265.definition: Distance between left and right side of the flaccid penis at the attachment to the skin above the pubic symphysis more than 2 standard deviations above the mean for age.
HP:0030265.definition_cn: 耻骨联合上方皮肤附着处松弛阴茎左右两侧距离超过同龄平均值2个标准差以上。

HP:0030266.name: obsolete Abnormality of the sacroiliac notch

HP:0030267.name: Calcification of the interosseus membrane of the forearm
HP:0030267.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the fibrous sheet that connects the radius and the ulna.
HP:0030267.definition_cn: 桡骨和尺骨之间的纤维板中钙盐沉积。

HP:0030268.name: Hyperplastic callus formation
HP:0030268.definition: Increased growth of callus, the bony and cartilaginous material that forms a connecting bridge across a bone fracture during fracture healing.
HP:0030268.definition_cn: 骨痂增生，即在骨折愈合过程中形成的骨性和软骨性物质，跨越骨折部位形成连接桥。

HP:0030269.name: Increased circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 concentration
HP:0030269.definition: An elevated level of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) in the blood circulation.
HP:0030269.name_cn: 循环中胰岛素样生长因子1浓度升高
HP:0030269.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰岛素样生长因子1（IGF1）水平升高。

HP:0030270.name: Elevated red cell adenosine deaminase activity
HP:0030270.definition: Increase in the level of adenosine deaminase (ADA), an enzyme involved in purine metabolism, within erythrocytes. ADA is involved in the catabolism of adenosine.
HP:0030270.name_cn: 红细胞腺苷脱氨酶活性升高
HP:0030270.definition_cn: 红细胞内腺苷脱氨酶（Adenosine Deaminase, ADA）水平升高，该酶参与嘌呤代谢。ADA在腺苷的分解代谢中起重要作用。

HP:0030271.name: Reduced erythrocyte 2,3-diphosphoglycerate concentration
HP:0030271.definition: This term refers to an inappropriate low 2,3-DPG concentration in erythrocytes. 2,3-diphosphoglycerate (2,3-DPG) controls the movement of oxygen from red blood cells to tissues. Anemia is usually accompanied by an increased level of 2,3-DPG in order to promote tissue oxygenation.
HP:0030271.name_cn: 红细胞2,3-二磷酸甘油酸浓度降低
HP:0030271.definition_cn: 该术语指红细胞中2,3-二磷酸甘油酸（2,3-DPG）浓度异常降低。2,3-二磷酸甘油酸（2,3-DPG）调控氧气从红细胞向组织的释放。贫血通常伴随2,3-DPG水平升高，以促进组织氧合。

HP:0030272.name: Abnormal erythrocyte enzyme concentration or activity
HP:0030272.definition: An altered level of any enzyme to act as catalysts within erythrocytes. This term includes changes due to altered activity of an enzyme.
HP:0030272.name_cn: 异常红细胞酶浓度或活性
HP:0030272.definition_cn: 红细胞内任何酶作为催化剂的水平改变。该术语包括由于酶活性改变引起的变化。

HP:0030273.name: Reduced red cell adenosine deaminase level
HP:0030273.definition: Decrease in the level of adenosine deaminase (ADA), an enzyme involved in purine metabolism, within erythrocytes. ADA is involved in the catabolism of adenosine.
HP:0030273.name_cn: 红细胞腺苷脱氨酶水平降低
HP:0030273.definition_cn: 红细胞内腺苷脱氨酶（ADA）水平降低，该酶参与嘌呤代谢。ADA在腺苷的分解代谢中发挥作用。

HP:0030274.name: Accessory scrotum
HP:0030274.definition: Additional scrotum, or part of a scrotum in an abnormal location.
HP:0030274.definition_cn: 异位阴囊或部分阴囊异常位置。

HP:0030275.name: Ectopic scrotum
HP:0030275.definition: Scrotum in a position other than the usual position inferior to the base of the penis.
HP:0030275.definition_cn: 阴囊位于阴茎基底下方以外的异常位置。

HP:0030277.name: Abnormal vertebral pedicle morphology
HP:0030277.definition: Abnormal morphology of a vertebral pedical.

HP:0030279.name: Hypoplastic L5 vertebral pedicle
HP:0030279.definition: Underdeveloped pedicle of the fifth lumbar vertebra.
HP:0030279.definition_cn: 第五腰椎椎弓根发育不全。

HP:0030280.name: Rib gap
HP:0030280.definition: Radiolucent focal defect of a rib shaft.
HP:0030280.definition_cn: 肋骨骨干透亮性局灶性缺损。

HP:0030281.name: Cervical C3/C4 vertebral fusion
HP:0030281.definition: Fusion of cervical vertebrae at C3 and C4, caused by a failure in the normal segmentation or division of the cervical vertebrae during the early weeks of fetal development.
HP:0030281.definition_cn: C3和C4颈椎融合，由胎儿发育早期颈椎正常分节或分割失败所致。

HP:0030282.name: Posterior rib gap
HP:0030282.definition: Radiolucent focal defect of the posterior portion of a rib shaft. The 'gaps' may lead to flail chest.
HP:0030282.definition_cn: 肋骨后部透亮性局灶性缺损。此类“缺损”可能导致连枷胸。

HP:0030283.name: Partial absence of the septum pellucidum
HP:0030283.definition: Only part of the septum pellucidum (a thin, triangular, vertical membrane separating the lateral ventricles of the brain) is present. This feature can be appreciated on magnetic resonance tomography or computed tomography of the brain.
HP:0030283.definition_cn: 仅部分透明隔（一种薄而呈三角形的垂直膜，分隔大脑的侧脑室）存在。此特征可通过脑部磁共振断层扫描或计算机断层扫描观察到。

HP:0030284.name: Triangular tongue
HP:0030284.definition: A form of macrogloassia (increased size of the tongue) characterized by a broad based root of the tongue but a small tongue tip, giving the appearance of a triangle.
HP:0030284.definition_cn: 一种巨舌症（舌体增大）的表现形式，其特征为舌根宽大而舌尖细小，呈现三角形外观。

HP:0030285.name: Splayed superior cerebellar peduncle
HP:0030285.definition: Abnormal splayed configuration (spreading out) of the superior cerebellar peduncle.
HP:0030285.definition_cn: 小脑上脚异常外展形态（扩散）。

HP:0030286.name: Atrophic superior cerebellar peduncle
HP:0030286.definition: Atrophy of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

HP:0030289.name: Flattened femoral epiphysis
HP:0030289.definition: An abnormal flattening of an epiphysis of femur.

HP:0030290.name: Unossified sacrum
HP:0030290.definition: Lack of ossification of the sacrum.

HP:0030291.name: Lower-limb metaphyseal irregularity
HP:0030291.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of one or more metaphyses of a bone of the leg.
HP:0030291.definition_cn: 下肢骨一处或多处干骺端正常光滑表面不规则。

HP:0030292.name: Tibial metaphyseal irregularity
HP:0030292.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of a metaphysis of a tibia.
HP:0030292.definition_cn: 胫骨干骺端正常光滑表面不规则。

HP:0030293.name: Fibular metaphyseal irregularity
HP:0030293.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of a metaphysis of a fibula.
HP:0030293.definition_cn: 腓骨干骺端正常光滑表面不规则。

HP:0030299.name: Abnormal distal femoral metaphysis morphology
HP:0030299.definition: An anomaly of the metaphysis of the distal femur (close to the knee).
HP:0030299.name_cn: 股骨远端干骺端形态异常
HP:0030299.definition_cn: 股骨远端干骺端异常（靠近膝关节）。

HP:0030300.name: 10 pairs of ribs
HP:0030300.definition: Presence of only 10 (instead of the usual 12) pairs of ribs.
HP:0030300.definition_cn: 仅存在10对肋骨（而非通常的12对）。

HP:0030301.name: Abnormality of the anterior commissure
HP:0030301.definition: An anomaly of the anterior commissure, a bundle of nerve fibers that connect the two cerebral hemispheres across the midline. The anterior commissure plays a role in pain sensation and contains decussating fibers from the olfactory tracts.
HP:0030301.definition_cn: 前连合异常，前连合为一束跨越中线连接两侧大脑半球的神经纤维束，在痛觉感知中发挥作用，并包含来自嗅束的交叉纤维。

HP:0030304.name: Abnormal number of vertebrae
HP:0030304.definition: A deviation from the normal number of vertebrae in the spinal column.

HP:0030306.name: 11 thoracic vertebrae
HP:0030306.definition: The presence of 11 instead of the normal 12 thoracic vertebrae.
HP:0030306.definition_cn: 胸椎数量异常，表现为11节而非正常的12节。

HP:0030307.name: Flared lower limb metaphysis
HP:0030307.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of one or more long bones of the leg.
HP:0030307.definition_cn: 下肢一或多根长骨干骺端呈扇形（即外展）改变。

HP:0030308.name: Flared distal tibial metaphysis
HP:0030308.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the distal tibia.
HP:0030308.definition_cn: 胫骨远端干骺端节段呈外展（即外翻）形态。

HP:0030309.name: Flared distal fibular metaphysis
HP:0030309.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the distal fibula.
HP:0030309.definition_cn: 远端腓骨干骺端呈外展（即，外翻）形态。

HP:0030310.name: Upper extremity joint dislocation
HP:0030310.definition: Displacement or malalignment of one or more joints in the upper extremity (arm).
HP:0030310.definition_cn: 上肢（臂部）一处或多处关节的脱位或错位。

HP:0030311.name: Lower extremity joint dislocation
HP:0030311.definition: Displacement or malalignment of one or more joints in the lower extremity (leg).
HP:0030311.definition_cn: 下肢（腿部）一处或多处关节的脱位或错位。

HP:0030312.name: Obliteration of the calvarial diploe
HP:0030312.definition: Absence of the spongy bone structure (or tissue) of the internal part of the skull cap (i.e., of the calvarial diploe).
HP:0030312.definition_cn: 颅盖骨（即颅骨穹窿）内部松质骨结构（或组织）缺失。

HP:0030313.name: Abnormal periosteum morphology
HP:0030313.definition: An anomalous structure of the periosteum, i.e., of the membrane that covers the outer surface of bones.
HP:0030313.definition_cn: 骨膜异常结构，即覆盖骨骼外表面的膜层异常。

HP:0030318.name: Angular cheilitis
HP:0030318.definition: A type of inflammation of the lips involving one or both of the corners of the mouth.

HP:0030319.name: Weakness of facial musculature
HP:0030319.definition: Reduced strength of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).
HP:0030319.definition_cn: 由面神经（第七对颅神经）支配的一处或多处肌肉力量减弱。

HP:0030320.name: Increased intervertebral space
HP:0030320.definition: An increase in the vertical distance between adjacent vertebral bodies, observed as an increase in the intervertebral disk space.
HP:0030320.definition_cn: 相邻椎体间垂直距离增加，表现为椎间盘间隙增宽。

HP:0030321.name: Abnormal vertebral artery morphology
