HP:0030321.definition: An anomaly of the vertebral artery, the major artery of the neck that originates from the subclavian artery and merges to form the single midline basilar artery in a complex called the vertebrobasilar system.
HP:0030321.definition_cn: 椎动脉异常，椎动脉是颈部的主要动脉，起源于锁骨下动脉，并在称为椎基底动脉系统的复杂结构中汇合形成单一的中线基底动脉。

HP:0030323.name: Unilateral vertebral artery hypoplasia
HP:0030323.definition: Underdevelopment of the vertebral artery on one side.

HP:0030324.name: Bilateral vertebral artery hypoplasia
HP:0030324.definition: Underdevelopment of the vertebral artery on both sides.

HP:0030325.name: Cervicomedullary schisis
HP:0030325.definition: Fissure within the spinal cord of the neck.

HP:0030326.name: Abnormal macrophage count
HP:0030326.definition: An anomaly in the number of macrophages.

HP:0030327.name: Abnormal osteoclast count
HP:0030327.definition: An anomaly in the number of osteoclasts in bone tissue, bone-resorbing cells that develop from macrophages. This finding can be observed by histological examination of bone tissue.
HP:0030327.definition_cn: 骨组织中破骨细胞数量异常，破骨细胞是由巨噬细胞发育而来的骨吸收细胞。这一发现可通过骨组织的组织学检查观察到。

HP:0030328.name: Decreased osteoclast count
HP:0030328.definition: Decreased number of osteoclasts in bone tissue.
HP:0030328.definition_cn: 骨组织中破骨细胞数量减少。

HP:0030329.name: Retinal thinning
HP:0030329.definition: Reduced anteroposterior thickness of the retina. This phenotype can be appreciated by retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT).
HP:0030329.definition_cn: 视网膜前后径厚度减少。该表型可通过视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）进行评估。

HP:0030330.name: Multinucleated giant chondrocytes in epiphyseal cartilage
HP:0030330.definition: The presence of cartilage cells (chondrocytes) that are substantially increased in size and contain more than one nucleus and are located within the resting zone of the epiphyseal cartilage.
HP:0030330.name_cn: 骨骺软骨中的多核巨软骨细胞
HP:0030330.definition_cn: 在骨骺软骨的静止区内存在显著增大的软骨细胞（软骨细胞），这些细胞含有多个细胞核。

HP:0030331.name: Impaired stimulus-induced skin wrinkling
HP:0030331.definition: A reduced ability of the skin of the fingertips to wrinkle when exposed to stimuli such as soaking in water or application of EMLA cream (the fingertip remains smooth).
HP:0030331.name_cn: 刺激诱导性皮肤皱褶功能障碍
HP:0030331.definition_cn: 指尖皮肤在受到刺激（如浸泡在水中或应用EMLA乳膏）时出现皱纹的能力降低（指尖保持光滑）。

HP:0030332.name: obsolete Abnormal T cell morphology
HP:0030332.name_cn: 过时的异常T细胞形态学

HP:0030333.name: Abnormal alpha-beta T cell morphology
HP:0030333.definition: A structuraly anomaly of T cells that express an alpha-beta T cell receptor.
HP:0030333.definition_cn: 表达α-β T细胞受体的T细胞结构异常。

HP:0030334.name: Abnormal CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell morphology
HP:0030334.definition: A structural anomaly of a CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta T cell. These cells are regulatory T cells.
HP:0030334.name_cn: 异常的CD4阳性、CD25阳性、αβ调节性T细胞形态
HP:0030334.definition_cn: CD4阳性、CD25阳性、αβ T细胞的结构异常。这些细胞为调节性T细胞。

HP:0030335.name: Abnormal CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell count
HP:0030335.definition: A deviation from the normal count of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells.
HP:0030335.name_cn: 异常的CD4阳性、CD25阳性、α-β调节性T细胞计数
HP:0030335.definition_cn: CD4阳性、CD25阳性、αβ调节性T细胞数量异常。

HP:0030336.name: Absence of CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cells
HP:0030336.definition: Lack of CD4+CD25+ T regulatory cells.
HP:0030336.name_cn: CD4阳性、CD25阳性调节性T细胞缺失

HP:0030337.name: Elevated CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cell count
HP:0030337.definition: An increased number of CD4-positive, CD25-positive regulatory T cells.
HP:0030337.name_cn: CD4阳性、CD25阳性调节性T细胞计数升高
HP:0030337.definition_cn: CD4阳性、CD25阳性调节性T细胞数量增加。

HP:0030338.name: Abnormal circulating gonadotropin concentration
HP:0030338.definition: An anomaly of the circulating level of a gonadotropin, that is, of a protein hormone secreted by gonadotrope cells of the anterior pituitary of vertebrates. The primary gonadotropins are luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).
HP:0030338.name_cn: 异常循环促性腺激素浓度
HP:0030338.definition_cn: 一种促性腺激素循环水平的异常，即由脊椎动物垂体前叶的促性腺激素细胞分泌的蛋白质激素。主要的促性腺激素包括黄体生成素（LH）和卵泡刺激素（FSH）。

HP:0030339.name: Decreased circulating gonadotropin concentration
HP:0030339.definition: A reduction of the circulating level of a gonadotropin, that is, of a protein hormone secreted by gonadotrope cells of the anterior pituitary of vertebrates. The primary gonadotropins are luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).
HP:0030339.name_cn: 循环促性腺激素浓度降低
HP:0030339.definition_cn: 促性腺激素循环水平的降低，即由脊椎动物垂体前叶的促性腺激素细胞分泌的蛋白质激素。主要的促性腺激素包括黄体生成素（LH）和卵泡刺激素（FSH）。

HP:0030340.name: obsolete Increased circulating gonadotropin level
HP:0030340.name_cn: 过时的 循环促性腺激素水平升高

HP:0030341.name: Decreased circulating follicle stimulating hormone concentration
HP:0030341.definition: A reduction of the circulating level of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).
HP:0030341.name_cn: 循环中促卵泡激素浓度降低
HP:0030341.definition_cn: 循环中促卵泡激素（FSH）水平的降低。

HP:0030344.name: Decreased circulating luteinizing hormone level
HP:0030344.definition: A reduction in the circulating level of luteinizing hormone (LH).
HP:0030344.name_cn: 循环黄体生成素水平降低
HP:0030344.definition_cn: 循环中黄体生成素（LH）水平降低。

HP:0030345.name: Abnormal circulating luteinizing hormone concentration
HP:0030345.definition: An anomaly of the circulating level of luteinizing hormone (LH).
HP:0030345.name_cn: 异常循环黄体生成素浓度
HP:0030345.definition_cn: 循环黄体生成素（LH）水平异常。

HP:0030346.name: Abnormal circulating follicle-stimulating hormone concentration
HP:0030346.definition: An anomaly of the circulating level of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).
HP:0030346.name_cn: 异常循环促卵泡激素浓度
HP:0030346.definition_cn: 循环中促卵泡激素（FSH）水平的异常。

HP:0030347.name: Abnormal circulating androgen level
HP:0030347.definition: An anomaly in the blood concentration of an androgen, that is, of a steroid hormone that controls development and maintenance of masculine characteristics. The androgens include testosterone and Dehydroepiandrosterone.
HP:0030347.definition_cn: 雄激素（即控制男性特征发育和维持的类固醇激素）在血液浓度中的异常。雄激素包括睾酮和脱氢表雄酮。

HP:0030348.name: Increased circulating androgen concentration
HP:0030348.definition: An elevation of the blood concentration of an androgen, that is, of a steroid hormone that controls development and maintenance of masculine characteristics. The androgens include testosterone and Dehydroepiandrosterone.
HP:0030348.definition_cn: 血液中雄激素浓度升高，即控制男性特征发育和维持的类固醇激素水平上升。雄激素包括睾酮和脱氢表雄酮。

HP:0030349.name: Decreased circulating androgen concentration
HP:0030349.definition: A reduction in the blood concentration of an androgen, that is, of a steroid hormone that controls development and maintenance of masculine characteristics. The androgens include testosterone and Dehydroepiandrosterone.
HP:0030349.definition_cn: 雄激素（即控制男性特征发育和维持的类固醇激素）在血液中的浓度降低。雄激素包括睾酮（Testosterone）和脱氢表雄酮（Dehydroepiandrosterone）。

HP:0030350.name: Erythematous papule
HP:0030350.definition: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid that is reddish (erythematous) in color.
HP:0030350.definition_cn: 局限性、实性皮肤隆起，无可见液体，呈红色（红斑性）。

HP:0030351.name: Urticarial plaque
HP:0030351.definition: A well-circumscribed, intensely pruritic, raised wheal (edema of the superficial skin) typically 1 to 2 cm in diameter.
HP:0030351.definition_cn: 边界清晰、剧烈瘙痒、隆起的风团（浅表皮肤水肿），直径通常为1至2厘米。

HP:0030352.name: Abnormal serum insulin-like growth factor 1 level
HP:0030352.definition: An anomalous level of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) in the blood circulation.
HP:0030352.name_cn: 血清胰岛素样生长因子1水平异常
HP:0030352.definition_cn: 血液循环中胰岛素样生长因子1（IGF1）水平异常。

HP:0030353.name: Decreased serum insulin-like growth factor 1
HP:0030353.definition: A reduced level of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) in the blood circulation.
HP:0030353.name_cn: 血清胰岛素样生长因子1降低
HP:0030353.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰岛素样生长因子1（IGF1）水平降低。

HP:0030354.name: obsolete Abnormal circulating interferon concentration
HP:0030354.name_cn: 过时的异常循环干扰素浓度

HP:0030355.name: Abnormal circulating interferon-gamma concentration
HP:0030355.definition: Abnormal levels of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.
HP:0030355.definition_cn: 循环血液中干扰素γ水平异常。

HP:0030356.name: Increased circulating interferon-gamma concentration
HP:0030356.definition: An elevation in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.
HP:0030356.definition_cn: 循环血液中干扰素γ浓度升高。

HP:0030357.name: Small cell lung carcinoma
HP:0030357.definition: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a type of highly malignant lung cancer that is composed of small ovoid cells. In the past, SCLC was called oat cell carcinoma because the microscopic appearance of the cells was felt to resemble oats. SLCLC usually originates near the bronchi and in many cases may grow and metastasize quickly.
HP:0030357.definition_cn: 小细胞肺癌（Small Cell Lung Cancer, SCLC）是一种由小型卵圆形细胞组成的高度恶性肺癌。过去，SCLC被称为燕麦细胞癌（Oat Cell Carcinoma），因为其细胞在显微镜下的形态被认为类似于燕麦。SCLC通常起源于支气管附近，并且在许多情况下可能迅速生长和转移。

HP:0030359.name: Squamous cell lung carcinoma
HP:0030359.definition: A type of non-small cell lung carcinoma that is derived from stratified squamous epithelial cells.
HP:0030359.definition_cn: 一种源自复层鳞状上皮细胞的非小细胞肺癌。

HP:0030360.name: Large cell lung carcinoma
HP:0030360.definition: A type of non-small cell lung carcinoma that is derived from undifferentiated malignant neoplasms originating from transformed epithelial cells in the lung, and which is differentiate from small-cell lung carcinoma by the larger size of the anaplastic cells, a higher cytoplasmic-to-nuclear size ratio, and a lack of salt-and-pepper appearance of the chromatin.
HP:0030360.definition_cn: 一种非小细胞肺癌，源自肺内转化的上皮细胞未分化恶性肿瘤，与小细胞肺癌的区别在于其未分化细胞体积较大、胞质与核大小比例较高，且染色质缺乏“椒盐样”外观。

HP:0030361.name: Abnormal circulating eicosanoid concentration
HP:0030361.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an icosanoid (also known as eicosanoids). These are signaling molecules derived from oxidation of 20-carbon fatty acids. Most are produced from arachidonic acid, a 20-carbon polyunsaturated fatty acid (5,8,11,14-eicosatetraenoic acid).
HP:0030361.name_cn: 异常循环类二十烷酸浓度
HP:0030361.definition_cn: 血液中二十烷类（也称为类二十烷酸）浓度的任何异常。这些信号分子源自20碳脂肪酸的氧化。大多数二十烷类由花生四烯酸（一种20碳多不饱和脂肪酸，即5,8,11,14-二十碳四烯酸）生成。

HP:0030362.name: Reduced muscle carnitine level
HP:0030362.definition: A reduction in the level of carnitine in muscle tissue.
HP:0030362.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中肉碱水平降低。

HP:0030363.name: Primary Caesarian section
HP:0030363.definition: Delivery by Caesarian section representing the first time the mother has delivered by Caesarian section.

HP:0030364.name: Secondary Caesarian section
HP:0030364.definition: Delivery by Caesarian section representing where the mother has already had a previous Cesarean delivery, and this is a repeat Cesarean birth.
HP:0030364.definition_cn: 剖宫产分娩，指母亲既往已有剖宫产史，此次为重复剖宫产分娩。

HP:0030365.name: Vaginal birth after Caesarian
HP:0030365.definition: Vaginal birth after Caesarian (VBAC) refers to the situation where the mother has had a previous Cesarean delivery but has now delivered vaginally.
HP:0030365.definition_cn: 剖宫产后阴道分娩（VBAC）指产妇既往有剖宫产史，但此次经阴道分娩的情况。

HP:0030366.name: Delivery by Odon device
HP:0030366.definition: The Odon device is an instrument for assisted vaginal deliveries that is applied on the head of the baby and used to apply traction to assist the birth process.
HP:0030366.name_cn: 使用奥登装置进行分娩
HP:0030366.definition_cn: Odon装置是一种用于辅助阴道分娩的器械，其作用于胎儿头部，通过施加牵引力以协助分娩过程。

HP:0030367.name: Finger hyperphalangy
HP:0030367.definition: Hyperphalangy is a digit morphology in which increased numbers of phalanges are arranged linearly within a digit. That is, there is an accessory phalanx that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges.
HP:0030367.definition_cn: 多指节畸形是一种指（趾）形态学异常，表现为指（趾）内线性排列的指（趾）骨数量增加。即存在一个与其它指（趾）骨线性排列的副指（趾）骨。

HP:0030368.name: Hyperphalangy of the 2nd finger
HP:0030368.definition: An accessory phalanx of the index (second) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy of the index finger results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint, resulting in radial deviation of the index finger. Note that this term refers only to this type of hyperphalangy.
HP:0030368.definition_cn: 食指（第二指）的副指骨与其他指骨呈线性排列。食指的多指畸形是由于掌指关节处的副骨化中心所致，导致食指的桡侧偏斜。请注意，该术语仅指此类多指畸形。

HP:0030369.name: Induced vaginal delivery
HP:0030369.definition: Vaginal delivery following induction of labor, a procedure used to stimulate uterine contractions during pregnancy before labor begins on its own.
HP:0030369.definition_cn: 引产后的阴道分娩，一种在自然分娩开始前用于刺激妊娠期间子宫收缩的医疗程序。

HP:0030370.name: Abnormal proportion of naive B cells
HP:0030370.definition: A deviation in the normal proportion of naive B cells (CD19+/CD27-/IgD+/IgM+) relative to the total number of B cells. Naive B cells represent one of the subtypes of B cells in the peripheral blood, and are B cells that have not been exposed to antigen.
HP:0030370.definition_cn: 初始B细胞（CD19+/CD27-/IgD+/IgM+）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例出现偏差。初始B细胞是外周血中B细胞的亚型之一，指尚未接触抗原的B细胞。

HP:0030371.name: Increased proportion of naive B cells
HP:0030371.definition: An elevation above the normal proportion of naive B cells (CD19+/CD27-/IgD+/IgM+) relative to total number of B cells. Naive B cells represent one of the subtypes of B cells in the peripheral blood, and are B cells that have not been exposed to antigen.
HP:0030371.definition_cn: 相对于B细胞总数，初始B细胞（CD19+/CD27-/IgD+/IgM+）比例高于正常水平。初始B细胞是外周血中B细胞的一种亚型，指尚未接触抗原的B细胞。

HP:0030372.name: Decreased proportion of naive B cells
HP:0030372.definition: A reduction below normal proportion of naive B cells (CD19+/CD27-/IgD+/IgM+) relative to total number of B cells. Naive B cells represent one of the subtypes of B cells in the peripheral blood, and are B cells that have not been exposed to antigen.
HP:0030372.definition_cn: 相对于B细胞总数，初始B细胞（CD19+/CD27-/IgD+/IgM+）比例低于正常水平。初始B细胞是外周血中B细胞的一种亚型，指尚未接触抗原的B细胞。

HP:0030373.name: Abnormal proportion of memory B cells
HP:0030373.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of memory B cells in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Memory B cells develop from naive B cells. Upon antigen rechallenge, memory B cells rapidly expand and differentiate into plasma cells under the cognate control of memory Th cells (Phase IV).
HP:0030373.definition_cn: 循环中记忆B细胞相对于B细胞总数的正常比例发生偏离。记忆B细胞由初始B细胞发育而来。在抗原再次刺激下，记忆B细胞在记忆Th细胞的同源控制下迅速扩增并分化为浆细胞（第四阶段）。

HP:0030374.name: Decreased proportion of memory B cells
HP:0030374.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Memory B cells develop from naive B cells. Upon antigen rechallenge, memory B cells rapidly expand and differentiate into plasma cells under the cognate control of memory Th cells (Phase IV).
HP:0030374.definition_cn: 循环中记忆B细胞（CD19+/CD27+）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例降低。记忆B细胞由初始B细胞发育而来。在抗原再次刺激下，记忆B细胞在记忆Th细胞的同源控制下迅速扩增并分化为浆细胞（第四阶段）。

HP:0030375.name: Increased proportion of memory B cells
HP:0030375.definition: An elevation in the proportion of memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Memory B cells develop from naive B cells. Upon antigen rechallenge, memory B cells rapidly expand and differentiate into plasma cells under the cognate control of memory Th cells (Phase IV).
HP:0030375.definition_cn: 循环中记忆B细胞（CD19+/CD27+）相对于B细胞总数的比例升高。记忆B细胞由初始B细胞发育而来。在抗原再次刺激下，记忆B细胞在记忆Th细胞的同源控制下迅速扩增并分化为浆细胞（第四阶段）。

HP:0030376.name: Abnormal proportion of immature B cells
HP:0030376.definition: A deviation from normal proportion of immature B cells (CD19+/ CD21low) in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Immature B cells (IgM+) are still in final stages of development within the bone marrow. Naive B cells are those which have left the bone marrow, before they bind to the antigen for which they're specific (IgM+/IgD+).
HP:0030376.definition_cn: 循环中未成熟B细胞（CD19+/CD21low）相对于B细胞总数的比例异常。未成熟B细胞（IgM+）仍处于骨髓内发育的最后阶段。初始B细胞是指已离开骨髓但尚未与其特异性抗原结合的B细胞（IgM+/IgD+）。

HP:0030377.name: Increased proportion of immature B cells
HP:0030377.definition: An elevation in the proportion above normal of immature B cells (CD19+/ CD21low) in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Immature B cells (IgM+) are still in final stages of development within the bone marrow. Naive B cells are those which have left the bone marrow, before they bind to the antigen for which they're specific (IgM+/IgD+).
HP:0030377.definition_cn: 循环中未成熟B细胞（CD19+/CD21low）相对于B细胞总数的比例升高。未成熟B细胞（IgM+）仍处于骨髓内发育的最后阶段。初始B细胞是指那些已离开骨髓、但尚未与其特异性抗原结合（IgM+/IgD+）的B细胞。

HP:0030378.name: Decreased proportion of immature B cells
HP:0030378.definition: A reduction in normal proportion of immature B cells (CD19+/ CD21low)in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Immature B cells (IgM+) are still in final stages of development within the bone marrow. Naive B cells are those which have left the bone marrow, before they bind to the antigen for which they're specific (IgM+/IgD+).
HP:0030378.definition_cn: 循环中未成熟B细胞（CD19+/CD21low）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例降低。未成熟B细胞（IgM+）仍在骨髓内处于发育的最后阶段。初始B细胞是指那些已离开骨髓、但尚未与其特异性抗原结合（IgM+/IgD+）的B细胞。

HP:0030379.name: Abnormal proportion of transitional B cells
HP:0030379.definition: A deviation in the normal proportion of transitional B cells (CD19+/CD38high/IgMhigh) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. B cells originate from precursors in the bone marrow, and the first cells which migrate to the peripheral blood have been classified as transitional B cells.
HP:0030379.definition_cn: 循环中过渡性B细胞（CD19+/CD38高表达/IgM高表达）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例出现偏差。B细胞起源于骨髓中的前体细胞，迁移至外周血的首批细胞被归类为过渡性B细胞。

HP:0030380.name: Decreased proportion of transitional B cells
HP:0030380.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of transitional B cells (CD19+/CD38high/IgMhigh) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. B cells originate from precursors in the bone marrow, and the first cells which migrate to the peripheral blood have been classified as transitional B cells.
HP:0030380.definition_cn: 循环中过渡性B细胞（CD19+/CD38高表达/IgM高表达）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例降低。B细胞起源于骨髓中的前体细胞，迁移至外周血的首批细胞被归类为过渡性B细胞。

HP:0030381.name: Increased proportion of transitional B cells
HP:0030381.definition: An elevation in the normal proportion of transitional B cells (CD19+/CD38high/IgMhigh) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. B cells originate from precursors in the bone marrow, and the first cells which migrate to the peripheral blood have been classified as transitional B cells.
HP:0030381.definition_cn: 循环中过渡性B细胞（CD19+/CD38高表达/IgM高表达）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例升高。B细胞起源于骨髓中的前体细胞，迁移至外周血的首批细胞被归类为过渡性B细胞。

HP:0030383.name: Abnormal proportion of marginal zone B cells
HP:0030383.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of marginal zone B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.
HP:0030383.definition_cn: 循环中边缘区B细胞（CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例发生偏离。

HP:0030384.name: Decreased proportion of marginal zone B cells
HP:0030384.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of marginal zone B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.
HP:0030384.definition_cn: 循环中边缘区B细胞（CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例降低。

HP:0030385.name: Increased proportion of marginal zone B cells
HP:0030385.definition: An elevation in the normal proportion of marginal zone B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.
HP:0030385.definition_cn: 循环中边缘区B细胞（CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例升高。

HP:0030386.name: Abnormal proportion of class-switched memory B cells
HP:0030386.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM-/IgD-) in circulation relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA.
HP:0030386.name_cn: 类别转换记忆B细胞比例异常
HP:0030386.definition_cn: 循环中类别转换记忆B细胞（CD19+/CD27+/IgM-/IgD-）相对于B细胞总数的正常比例发生偏离。边缘区B细胞经历有限的体细胞超突变，并产生高亲和力的IgM和部分IgG，而类别转换记忆B细胞则合成IgG、IgM和IgA。

HP:0030387.name: Increased proportion of class-switched memory B cells
HP:0030387.definition: An increase in the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA.
HP:0030387.name_cn: 类别转换记忆B细胞比例增加
HP:0030387.definition_cn: 正常比例中类别转换记忆B细胞（CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+）相对于B细胞总数的增加。边缘区B细胞经历有限的体细胞超突变并产生高亲和力的IgM和部分IgG，而类别转换记忆B细胞则合成IgG、IgM和IgA。

HP:0030388.name: Decreased proportion of class-switched memory B cells
HP:0030388.definition: A reduction in the normal proportion of class-switched memory B cells (CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+) relative to the total number of B cells. Marginal zone B cells undergo limited somatic hypermutation and produce high-affinity IgM and some IgG, whereas class-switched memory B cells synthetize IgG, IgM, and IgA.
HP:0030388.name_cn: 类别转换记忆B细胞比例降低
HP:0030388.definition_cn: 相对于B细胞总数，类别转换记忆B细胞（CD19+/CD27+/IgM+/IgD+）的正常比例降低。边缘区B细胞经历有限的体细胞超突变，并产生高亲和力的IgM和部分IgG，而类别转换记忆B细胞则合成IgG、IgM和IgA。

HP:0030389.name: Abnormal circulating thromboxane concentration
HP:0030389.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of a thromboxane. Thromboxanes are derived from prostaglandin precursors in platelets, and stimulate aggregation of platelets and constriction of blood vessels.
HP:0030389.definition_cn: 血液中血栓素浓度的任何异常。血栓素来源于血小板中的前列腺素前体，能够刺激血小板聚集和血管收缩。

HP:0030390.name: Reduced circulating leukotriene C4 concentration
HP:0030390.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of leukotriene C4 in the blood circulation.
HP:0030390.definition_cn: 血液循环中白三烯C4浓度异常降低。

HP:0030391.name: Spoken word recognition deficit
HP:0030391.definition: Reduced ability of lexical discrimination, which refers to the process of distinguishing a stimulus word from other phonologically similar words. Lexical discrimination can be defined as the process of correctly identifying words in the mental lexicon to match the phonological input of a stimulus.
HP:0030391.definition_cn: 词汇辨别能力降低，指的是将刺激词与其他语音相似的词进行区分的过程。词汇辨别可定义为在心理词汇库中正确识别词汇以匹配刺激的语音输入的过程。

HP:0030392.name: Choroid plexus carcinoma
HP:0030392.definition: Intraventricular papillary neoplasm derived from choroid plexus epithelium. Plexus tumors are most common in the lateral and fourth ventricles; while 80% of lateral ventricle tumors present in children, fourth ventricle tumors are evenly distributed in all age groups. Clinically, choroid plexus tumors tend to cause hydrocephalus and increased intracranial pressure. Histologically, choroid plexus papillomas correspond to WHO grade I, choroid plexus carcinomas to WHO grade III.
HP:0030392.definition_cn: 源自脉络丛上皮的脑室内乳头状肿瘤。脉络丛肿瘤最常见于侧脑室和第四脑室；其中80%的侧脑室肿瘤发生于儿童，而第四脑室肿瘤在各年龄组中分布均匀。临床上，脉络丛肿瘤常导致脑积水和颅内压增高。组织学上，脉络丛乳头状瘤对应于WHO I级，脉络丛癌对应于WHO III级。

HP:0030393.name: Endolymphatic sac tumor
HP:0030393.definition: A low-grade papillary epithelial neoplasm (adenocarcinoma) with a slow growth pattern. The endolymphatic duct emerges from the posterior wall of the saccule (of the inner ear) and ends in a blind pouch, the endolymphatic sac. Endolymphatic sac tumors (ELSTs) are known under different names in the literature (Heffner tumor, aggressive papillary middle ear tumor, and low-grade adenocarcinoma of endolymphatic sac origin).
HP:0030393.definition_cn: 一种低级别乳头状上皮性肿瘤（腺癌），具有缓慢生长模式。内淋巴管从内耳球囊的后壁发出，终止于一个盲端囊袋，即内淋巴囊。内淋巴囊肿瘤（ELSTs）在文献中有不同的名称（Heffner肿瘤、侵袭性乳头状中耳肿瘤和内淋巴囊起源的低级别腺癌）。

HP:0030394.name: Fallopian tube carcinoma
HP:0030394.definition: Carcinoma that originates in the Fallopian tube. It may be located in the wall or within the lumen as a growth attached to the wall by a stalk.
HP:0030394.definition_cn: 起源于输卵管的癌。可位于管壁内或管腔内，呈附着于管壁的带蒂生长物。

HP:0030396.name: Abnormal platelet granule secretion
HP:0030396.definition: Platelets are replete with secretory granules, which are critical to normal platelet function. Among the three types of platelet secretory granules - alpha-granules, dense granules, and lysosomes - the alpha-granule is the most abundant. Granule contents must be released from their intracellular repository in order to achieve their physiologic function, and this term refers to a functional defect in granule secretion.
HP:0030396.definition_cn: 血小板富含分泌颗粒，这些颗粒对正常的血小板功能至关重要。在三种类型的血小板分泌颗粒——α颗粒、致密颗粒和溶酶体中，α颗粒的含量最为丰富。颗粒内容物必须从其细胞内储存库中释放出来才能实现其生理功能，而该术语指的是颗粒分泌的功能缺陷。

HP:0030397.name: Abnormal platelet dense granule secretion
HP:0030397.definition: Abnormal release of dense granules from platelets.
HP:0030397.name_cn: 异常血小板致密颗粒分泌
HP:0030397.definition_cn: 血小板致密颗粒异常释放。

HP:0030398.name: Abnormal platelet ATP dense granule secretion
HP:0030398.definition: Abnormal secretion of the platelet dense-granule content adenosine triphosphate (ATP).
HP:0030398.name_cn: 异常血小板ATP致密颗粒分泌
HP:0030398.definition_cn: 血小板致密颗粒内容物三磷酸腺苷（ATP）的异常分泌。

HP:0030399.name: Abnormal platelet alpha granule secretion
HP:0030399.definition: Abnormal release of alpha granule contents from platelets.
HP:0030399.definition_cn: 血小板α颗粒内容物异常释放。

HP:0030400.name: Abnormal platelet lysosome secretion
HP:0030400.definition: Abnormal release of lysosome contents from platelets.
HP:0030400.name_cn: 异常血小板溶酶体分泌
HP:0030400.definition_cn: 血小板溶酶体内容物异常释放。

HP:0030401.name: Abnormal platelet dense granule ATP/ADP ratio
HP:0030401.definition: Deviation from normal of the ratio of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) to adenosine diphosphate (ADP) within platelets.
HP:0030401.name_cn: 异常血小板致密颗粒ATP/ADP比值
HP:0030401.definition_cn: 血小板内三磷酸腺苷（ATP）与二磷酸腺苷（ADP）比值偏离正常值。

HP:0030402.name: Abnormal platelet aggregation
HP:0030402.definition: An abnormality in the rate and degree to which platelets aggregate after the addition of an agonist that stimulates platelet clumping. Platelet aggregation is measured using aggregometer to measure the optical density of platelet-rich plasma, whereby platelet aggregation causes the plasma to become more transparent.
HP:0030402.definition_cn: 在添加刺激血小板聚集的激动剂后，血小板聚集的速率和程度出现异常。血小板聚集通过使用聚集仪测量富含血小板血浆的光密度来评估，其中血小板聚集导致血浆变得更加透明。

HP:0030403.name: Spontaneous platelet aggregation
HP:0030403.definition: Clumping together of platelets in the blood in a platelet aggregation test without addition of agents normally used to induce aggregation.
HP:0030403.definition_cn: 在未添加通常用于诱导聚集的试剂的情况下，血小板聚集试验中血液中血小板的聚集现象。

HP:0030404.name: Glucagonoma
HP:0030404.definition: An endocrine tumor of the pancreas that secretes excessive amounts of glucagon.
HP:0030404.definition_cn: 胰腺内分泌肿瘤，分泌过量胰高血糖素。

HP:0030405.name: Pancreatic endocrine tumor
HP:0030405.definition: A neuroendocrine tumor originating in a hormone-producing cell (islet cell) of the pancreas.
HP:0030405.definition_cn: 一种起源于胰腺激素生成细胞（胰岛细胞）的神经内分泌肿瘤。

HP:0030406.name: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
HP:0030406.definition: A type of cancer that originates in the peritoneum. It is to be distinguished from metastatic cancer of the peritoneum. Peritoneal cancer can occur anywhere in the abdominal space, and affects the surface of organs contained inside the peritoneum.
HP:0030406.definition_cn: 一种起源于腹膜的原发性癌症。需与腹膜转移性癌症相区分。腹膜癌可发生于腹腔内的任何部位，并累及腹膜内包含的器官表面。

HP:0030407.name: Pineocytoma
HP:0030407.definition: A type of pineal parenchymal cell neoplasm that is a mature well-differentiated tumor (WHO grade I).
HP:0030407.definition_cn: 一种松果体实质细胞肿瘤，属于成熟且分化良好的肿瘤（WHO I级）。

HP:0030408.name: Pineoblastoma
HP:0030408.definition: Pineoblastoma is a rare primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising in the pineal gland. Pineoblastomas are classified as a WHO grade IV tumor and comprise one-fourth to one-half of pineal parenchymal tumors. Pineoblastoma is a highly cellular tumor originating in the pineal gland and containing small, poorly differentiated cells.
HP:0030408.definition_cn: 松果体母细胞瘤是一种罕见的原始神经外胚层肿瘤（PNET），起源于松果体。松果体母细胞瘤被归类为世界卫生组织（WHO）IV级肿瘤，占松果体实质肿瘤的四分之一至二分之一。松果体母细胞瘤是一种高度细胞化的肿瘤，起源于松果体，包含小而分化不良的细胞。

HP:0030409.name: Renal transitional cell carcinoma
HP:0030409.definition: A malignant tumor that arises from the transitional (urothelial) epithelial cells lining the urinary tract from the renal calyces to the ureteral orifice.
HP:0030409.definition_cn: 一种恶性肿瘤，起源于从肾盏至输尿管口的尿路上皮（移行上皮）细胞。

HP:0030410.name: Sebaceous gland carcinoma
HP:0030410.definition: A carcinoma that arises in a sebaseous gland (an exocrine gland of the skin that secretes sebum, a waxy substance)
HP:0030410.definition_cn: 起源于皮脂腺（一种分泌皮脂，即蜡质物质的皮肤外分泌腺）的癌。

HP:0030411.name: Jejunal adenocarcinoma
HP:0030411.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the jejunum.
HP:0030411.definition_cn: 一种起源于空肠的具有腺体结构的恶性上皮肿瘤。

HP:0030412.name: Ileal adenocarcinoma
HP:0030412.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the ileum.
HP:0030412.definition_cn: 一种起源于回肠的具有腺体结构的恶性上皮肿瘤。

HP:0030413.name: Squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue
HP:0030413.definition: A carcinoma derived from a squamous epithelial cell of the tongue.
HP:0030413.definition_cn: 源自舌部鳞状上皮细胞的癌。

HP:0030414.name: Verrucous cell carcinoma of the tongue
HP:0030414.definition: A low-grade variant of squamous cell carcinoma of the tongue with a warty (verrucous) appearance.
HP:0030414.definition_cn: 一种低级别变异型舌鳞状细胞癌，呈疣状（疣状）外观。

HP:0030415.name: Sarcomatoid carcinoma of the tongue
HP:0030415.definition: Sarcomatoid (spindle cell) carcinomas of the tongue is a variant of squamous carcinoma of tongue that is monoclonal, having evolved from a conventional squamous carcinoma with dedifferentiation associated with sarcomatoid transformation.
HP:0030415.definition_cn: 舌部肉瘤样（梭形细胞）癌是舌鳞状细胞癌的一种变异类型，具有单克隆性，由传统鳞状细胞癌通过去分化伴随肉瘤样转化演变而来。

HP:0030416.name: Vulvar neoplasm
HP:0030416.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the female external genital tract (vulva).
HP:0030416.definition_cn: 女性外生殖道（外阴）肿瘤（组织异常增生）。

HP:0030417.name: Squamous cell carcinoma of the vulva
HP:0030417.definition: A cancer that originates in the squamous cells that line the surface of the vulva.
HP:0030417.definition_cn: 一种起源于外阴表面鳞状细胞的癌症。

HP:0030418.name: Vulvar melanoma
HP:0030418.definition: A type of vulvar cancer that originates from melanocytes of the vulva.
HP:0030418.definition_cn: 一种源自外阴黑色素细胞的外阴癌。

HP:0030419.name: Bartholin gland carcinoma
HP:0030419.definition: A cancer arising in a cell of the Bartholin gland, a racemose gland located slightly posterior to the opening of the vagina.
HP:0030419.definition_cn: 巴氏腺癌，起源于巴氏腺细胞，巴氏腺为一种葡萄状腺体，位于阴道开口稍后方。

HP:0030420.name: Vulvar adenocarcinoma
HP:0030420.definition: An adenocarcinoma arising in the vulva.

HP:0030421.name: Epididymal neoplasm
HP:0030421.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the epididymis, an duct that transports spermatozoa from the testis to the vas deferens.
HP:0030421.definition_cn: 附睾肿瘤（组织异常增生），附睾为将精子从睾丸输送至输精管的管道。

HP:0030422.name: obsolete Papillary cystadenoma of the epididymis
HP:0030422.name_cn: 陈旧的附睾乳头状囊腺瘤

HP:0030423.name: Splenic cyst
HP:0030423.definition: A closed sac located in the spleen.
HP:0030423.definition_cn: 脾脏内封闭性囊性病变。

HP:0030424.name: Epididymal cyst
HP:0030424.definition: A smooth, extratesticular, spherical cyst in the head of the epididymis.
HP:0030424.definition_cn: 位于附睾头部的平滑、睾丸外、球形的囊肿。

HP:0030425.name: Calcified ovarian cyst
HP:0030425.definition: A cyst of the ovary that exhibits deposition of calcium salts.

HP:0030426.name: Ossifying fibroma
HP:0030426.definition: A benign central bone tumor composed of fibrous connective tissue within which bone is formed.
HP:0030426.definition_cn: 一种良性中央骨肿瘤，由纤维结缔组织构成，其中形成骨组织。

HP:0030427.name: Ossifying fibroma of the jaw
HP:0030427.definition: A benign central bone tumor of the jaw composed of fibrous connective tissue within which bone is formed.
HP:0030427.definition_cn: 颌骨中心性良性骨肿瘤，由纤维结缔组织构成，其中形成骨组织。

HP:0030428.name: Cutaneous myxoma
HP:0030428.definition: A myxoma originating in the skin.

HP:0030429.name: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
HP:0030429.definition: A benign but highly vascular nasopharyngeal neoplasm. The tumor originates from the sphenopalatine foramen and involves both the pterygopalatine fossa and the posterior nasal cavity.
HP:0030429.name_cn: 青少年鼻咽血管纤维瘤
HP:0030429.definition_cn: 一种良性但高度血管化的鼻咽部肿瘤。该肿瘤起源于蝶腭孔，并累及翼腭窝和后鼻腔。

HP:0030430.name: Neuroma
HP:0030430.definition: A tumor made up of nerve cells and nerve fibers.
HP:0030430.definition_cn: 由神经细胞和神经纤维组成的肿瘤。

HP:0030431.name: Osteochondroma
HP:0030431.definition: A cartilage capped bony outgrowth of a long bone. Osteochondroma arises on the external surface of bone containing a marrow cavity that is continuous with that of the underlying bone.
HP:0030431.definition_cn: 长骨上的软骨帽状骨性突起。骨软骨瘤发生于骨的外表面，其内含有与下方骨相连续的骨髓腔。

HP:0030432.name: Chondroblastoma
HP:0030432.definition: A usually benign tumor composed of cells which arise from chondroblasts or their precursors and which tend to differentiate into cartilage cells.
HP:0030432.definition_cn: 一种通常为良性的肿瘤，由源自软骨母细胞或其前体细胞的细胞组成，这些细胞倾向于分化为软骨细胞。

HP:0030433.name: Osteoid osteoma
HP:0030433.definition: A bening tumor of bone composed of a central zone named nidus which is an atypical bone completely enclosed within a well vascularized stroma and a peripheral sclerotic reaction zone.
HP:0030433.definition_cn: 一种良性骨肿瘤，由中心区域（称为病灶）组成，病灶为完全包绕在富含血管的基质内的非典型骨组织，周围伴有硬化反应带。

HP:0030434.name: Pilomatrixoma
HP:0030434.definition: Pilomatricoma is an asymptomatic slowly growing benign cutaneous tumor, differentiating towards the hair matrix of the hair follicle. It is covered by normal or hyperemic skin, and usually varies in size from 0.5 to 3 cm.
HP:0030434.definition_cn: 毛母质瘤是一种无症状、缓慢生长的良性皮肤肿瘤，向毛囊的毛基质分化。其表面覆盖正常或充血的皮肤，通常大小在0.5至3厘米之间。

HP:0030436.name: Fibrofolliculoma
HP:0030436.definition: Fibrofolliculoma is a clinically asymptomatic, 2-4 mm, skin-colored, dome-shaped smooth papule. It usually arises in the form of multiple lesions in adults in different areas such as the scalp, forehead, face, and neck. According to histology, the lesion is a fibrotic hamartoma characterized by infundibular epithelial proliferation and perifollicular fibrous proliferation.
HP:0030436.definition_cn: 纤维毛囊瘤是一种临床无症状、直径2-4毫米、肤色、圆顶形光滑丘疹。通常以多发性病变的形式出现在成年人的头皮、前额、面部和颈部等不同区域。根据组织学特征，该病变为纤维性错构瘤，其特征为漏斗部上皮增生和毛囊周围纤维增生。

HP:0030438.name: Anal canal squamous cell carcinoma
HP:0030438.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the anal canal.
HP:0030438.definition_cn: 起源于肛管的鳞状细胞癌。

HP:0030439.name: Anal canal adenocarcinoma
HP:0030439.definition: An adenoma carcinoma that originates in the anal canal.
HP:0030439.definition_cn: 一种起源于肛管的腺癌。

HP:0030440.name: Anal margin neoplasm
HP:0030440.definition: A tumor of the anal margin.

HP:0030441.name: Anal margin Paget's disease
HP:0030441.definition: An intraepithelial adenocarcinoma originating in the anal margin and characterized by presence of typical Paget's cells, appearing as large rounded vacuolated cells.
HP:0030441.definition_cn: 一种起源于肛缘的上皮内腺癌，其特征为存在典型的佩吉特细胞，表现为大而圆形的空泡化细胞。

HP:0030442.name: Anal margin squamous cell carcinoma
HP:0030442.definition: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the skin of the anal margin.
HP:0030442.definition_cn: 起源于肛缘皮肤的鳞状细胞癌。

HP:0030443.name: Anal margin basal cell carcinoma
HP:0030443.definition: A basal cell carcinoma that originates in the anal margin.
HP:0030443.definition_cn: 起源于肛缘的基底细胞癌。

HP:0030444.name: Anal margin melanoma
HP:0030444.definition: A melanoma that originates in the anal margin.
HP:0030444.definition_cn: 起源于肛缘的黑色素瘤。

HP:0030445.name: Pulmonary carcinoid tumor
HP:0030445.definition: A malignant neuroendocrine tumor of the lung. According to histopathologic criteria (WHO 2004), carcinoids are divided into four groups i.e. typical and atypical carcinoids, large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma and small cell lung carcinoma.
HP:0030445.definition_cn: 肺恶性神经内分泌肿瘤。根据组织病理学标准（WHO 2004），类癌分为四类，即典型类癌、非典型类癌、大细胞神经内分泌癌和小细胞肺癌。

HP:0030447.name: Merkel cell skin cancer
HP:0030447.definition: A malignant cutaneous tumor of the elderly that is characterized by an aggressive course with regional nodal involvement, distant metastases and a high rate of recurrence. Most patients present with rapidly growing, painless, firm, non-tender, dome-shaped red, occasionally ulcerated skin nodules, which have a red or bluish color, measuring up to several centimeters, on predominantly sun-exposed areas of the body. The overlying skin is smooth and shiny, sometimes exhibiting ulcerative, acneiform or telangiectatic features.
HP:0030447.definition_cn: 一种老年恶性皮肤肿瘤，其特征为病程侵袭性强，伴有区域淋巴结受累、远处转移及高复发率。多数患者表现为快速生长的无痛性、质硬、无压痛、圆顶状红色皮肤结节，偶见溃疡，呈红色或蓝紫色，直径可达数厘米，主要发生于身体日光暴露部位。表面皮肤光滑有光泽，有时呈现溃疡性、痤疮样或毛细血管扩张特征。

HP:0030448.name: Soft tissue sarcoma
HP:0030448.definition: A type of sarcoma (A connective tissue neoplasm formed by proliferation of mesodermal cells) that develops from soft tissues like fat, muscle, nerves, fibrous tissues, blood vessels, or deep skin tissues.
HP:0030448.definition_cn: 一种肉瘤（由中胚层细胞增殖形成的结缔组织肿瘤），起源于脂肪、肌肉、神经、纤维组织、血管或深层皮肤组织等软组织。

HP:0030449.name: Therapeutic abortion
HP:0030449.definition: Delivery by means of therapeutic termination of pregnancy. Therapeutic abortion may be done to end a pregnancy if the mother's life is in danger or if the baby has abnormalities involving the major organ systems and is not expected to survive after birth or by choice.
HP:0030449.definition_cn: 通过治疗性终止妊娠进行分娩。治疗性流产可在母亲生命受到威胁、胎儿存在主要器官系统异常且预计无法在出生后存活或根据选择的情况下进行。

HP:0030450.name: Neoplasm of the autonomic nervous system
HP:0030450.definition: A tumor that arises from an element of the autonomic nervous system.
HP:0030450.definition_cn: 起源于自主神经系统成分的肿瘤。

HP:0030451.name: Mesenteric cyst
HP:0030451.definition: A closed fluid filled sac originating from the mesentary.
HP:0030451.definition_cn: 源自肠系膜的闭合性囊性病变，内含液体。

HP:0030452.name: Chylolymphatic mesenteric cyst
HP:0030452.definition: A type of mesenteric cyst that is lined with a thin endothelium or mesothelium and filled with chylous and lymphatic fluid.
HP:0030452.name_cn: 乳糜淋巴性肠系膜囊肿
HP:0030452.definition_cn: 一种由薄层内皮或间皮衬里并充满乳糜液和淋巴液的肠系膜囊肿。

HP:0030454.name: Abnormal electrooculogram
HP:0030454.definition: The clinical electro-oculogram (EOG) is an electrophysiological test of function of the outer retina and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) in which changes in electrical potential across the RPE are recorded during successive periods of dark and light adaptation.
HP:0030454.definition_cn: 临床眼电图（Electro-oculogram, EOG）是一种用于评估外层视网膜及视网膜色素上皮（Retinal Pigment Epithelium, RPE）功能的电生理学检测方法，通过记录在连续暗适应和光适应期间跨RPE电位的变化来进行评估。

HP:0030455.name: Abnormality of pattern visual evoked potentials
HP:0030455.name_cn: 模式视觉诱发电位异常

HP:0030456.name: Abnormality of pattern onset/offset visual evoked potentials
HP:0030456.name_cn: 模式起始/终止视觉诱发电位异常

HP:0030457.name: Abnormal amplitude of pattern onset/offset visual evoked potentials
HP:0030457.name_cn: 模式起始/终止视觉诱发电位振幅异常

HP:0030458.name: Abnormal timing of pattern onset/offset visual evoked potentials
HP:0030458.name_cn: 模式起始/终止视觉诱发电位异常时序

HP:0030460.name: Abnormal timing of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
HP:0030460.name_cn: 模式反转视觉诱发电位异常时序

HP:0030461.name: Abnormal timing of flash visual evoked potentials
HP:0030461.name_cn: 闪光视觉诱发电位时程异常

HP:0030462.name: Abnormal amplitude of flash visual evoked potentials
HP:0030462.name_cn: 闪光视觉诱发电位振幅异常

HP:0030463.name: Asymmetrical distribution of flash visual evoked potentials
HP:0030463.name_cn: 闪光视觉诱发电位不对称分布

HP:0030464.name: Asymmetrical distribution of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
HP:0030464.name_cn: 模式反转视觉诱发电位不对称分布

HP:0030465.name: Undetectable light-adapted electroretinogram
HP:0030465.definition: No detectable response to the light-adapted 3.0 ERG (single-flash cone response). This type of ERG measures responses of the cone system; a-waves arise from cone photoreceptors and cone off-bipolar cells; the b-wave comes from On- and Off-cone bipolar cells.
HP:0030465.name_cn: 不可检测的光适应视网膜电图
HP:0030465.definition_cn: 对光适应3.0 ERG（单闪锥体反应）无检测到反应。此类ERG测量锥体系统的反应；a波源自锥体感光细胞和锥体关闭双极细胞；b波源自开启和关闭锥体双极细胞。

HP:0030466.name: Abnormal full-field electroretinogram
HP:0030466.name_cn: 异常全视野视网膜电图

HP:0030467.name: Abnormal pattern electroretinogram
HP:0030467.definition: An anomalous response to a pattern electroretinogram (PERG), a particular kind of ERG obtained in response to contrast modulation of patterned visual stimuli at constant mean luminance-typically contrast-reversing gratings or checkerboards-whose characteristics are fundamentally different from those of the traditional ERG in response to diffuse flashes of light.
HP:0030467.definition_cn: 对模式视网膜电图（Pattern Electroretinogram, PERG）的异常反应，这是一种特定类型的视网膜电图（ERG），通过恒定平均亮度下模式视觉刺激的对比度调制获得，通常为对比度反转光栅或棋盘格，其特征与传统ERG对弥散光闪光的反应有根本性差异。

HP:0030469.name: Abnormal dark-adapted electroretinogram
HP:0030469.name_cn: 异常暗适应视网膜电图

HP:0030470.name: Abnormal dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram
HP:0030470.name_cn: 异常暗适应强闪光视网膜电图

HP:0030471.name: Abnormal dark-adapted dim flash electroretinogram
HP:0030471.name_cn: 暗适应弱闪光视网膜电图异常

HP:0030472.name: Abnormal light-adapted single flash electroretinogram
HP:0030472.name_cn: 异常光适应单次闪光视网膜电图

HP:0030473.name: Abnormal light-adapted flicker electroretinogram
HP:0030473.name_cn: 异常光适应闪烁视网膜电图

HP:0030474.name: Undetectable dark-adapted electroretinogram
HP:0030474.name_cn: 不可检测的暗适应视网膜电图

HP:0030475.name: Abnormal timing of dark-adapted dim flash electroretinogram
HP:0030475.name_cn: 暗适应弱闪光视网膜电图时间异常

HP:0030476.name: Abnormal amplitude of dark-adapted dim flash electroretinogram
HP:0030476.name_cn: 暗适应弱闪光视网膜电图振幅异常

HP:0030477.name: Abnormal timing of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram
HP:0030477.name_cn: 暗适应亮闪光视网膜电图时间异常

HP:0030478.name: Abnormal amplitude of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram
HP:0030478.name_cn: 暗适应亮闪光视网膜电图振幅异常

HP:0030479.name: Abnormal amplitude of light-adapted flicker electroretinogram
HP:0030479.name_cn: 光适应闪烁视网膜电图振幅异常

HP:0030480.name: Abnormal timing of light-adapted flicker electroretinogram
HP:0030480.name_cn: 光适应闪烁视网膜电图时间异常

HP:0030481.name: Abnormal amplitude of light-adapted single flash electroretinogram
HP:0030481.name_cn: 光适应单次闪光视网膜电图振幅异常

HP:0030482.name: Abnormal timing of light-adapted single flash electroretinogram
HP:0030482.name_cn: 光适应单次闪光视网膜电图时间异常

HP:0030483.name: Reduced amplitude of dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram a-wave
HP:0030483.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amplitude of the a-wave.
HP:0030483.name_cn: 暗适应强闪光视网膜电图a波振幅降低

HP:0030484.name: Supernormal dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram b-wave
HP:0030484.name_cn: 超常暗适应强闪光视网膜电图b波

HP:0030485.name: Abnormal amplitude of pattern electroretinogram
HP:0030485.name_cn: 模式视网膜电图振幅异常

HP:0030486.name: Abnormal timing of pattern electroretinogram
HP:0030486.name_cn: 模式视网膜电图时序异常

HP:0030487.name: Abnormal P50/N95 ratio of pattern electroretinogram
HP:0030487.name_cn: 模式视网膜电图P50/N95比值异常

HP:0030488.name: Abnormal central response of multifocal electroretinogram
HP:0030488.name_cn: 多焦视网膜电图中心反应异常

HP:0030489.name: Abnormal paracentral response of multifocal electroretinogram
HP:0030489.name_cn: 多焦视网膜电图异常旁中心反应

HP:0030490.name: Exudative vitreoretinopathy
HP:0030490.name_cn: 渗出性玻璃体视网膜病变

HP:0030491.name: Choriocapillaris atrophy
HP:0030491.definition: Atrophy of the capillary lamina of choroid.
HP:0030491.definition_cn: 脉络膜毛细血管层萎缩。

HP:0030493.name: Abnormality of foveal pigmentation
HP:0030493.definition: An anomaly of the pigmentation in the fovea centralis.

HP:0030494.name: Macular microaneurysm/hemorrhage
HP:0030494.definition: Small, red dots in the superficial retinal layers (it is difficult to distinguish between small hemorrhages and microaneurysms).
HP:0030494.definition_cn: 视网膜浅层出现的小红点（难以区分小出血灶和微动脉瘤）。

HP:0030495.name: Abnormality morphology of the macular vasculature
HP:0030495.definition: Any structural anomaly of the blood vessels of the macula.

HP:0030496.name: Macular exudate
HP:0030496.definition: Yellow-white intraretinal deposits in the macula typically associated with damaged outer blood-retina barrier and exudation of serous fluid and lipids from the retinal microvasculature.
HP:0030496.definition_cn: 黄白色视网膜内沉积物位于黄斑区，通常与外层血-视网膜屏障受损以及视网膜微血管渗出的浆液和脂质相关。

HP:0030497.name: Macular cotton wool spot
HP:0030497.definition: Fluffy white patch on the macula, representing localized areas of dense white swelling of the retinal nerve fiber layer. They often have a zigzag internal structure, a feathered edge but an otherwise well-delineated form and an approximately 1 mm dimension; they project slightly into the vitreous and sometimes deflect retinal vessels.
HP:0030497.definition_cn: 黄斑区可见蓬松的白色斑块，代表视网膜神经纤维层局部致密的白色肿胀区域。其内部结构常呈锯齿状，边缘呈羽毛状，但整体形态清晰，直径约1毫米；略微向玻璃体突出，有时可导致视网膜血管偏转。

HP:0030498.name: Macular thickening
HP:0030498.definition: Abnormal increase in retinal thickness in the macular area observed on fundoscopy or fundus imaging.
HP:0030498.definition_cn: 黄斑区视网膜厚度异常增厚，通过眼底镜检查或眼底成像观察到。

HP:0030499.name: Macular drusen
HP:0030499.definition: Drusen (singular, 'druse') are tiny yellow or white accumulations of extracellular material (lipofuscin) that build up in Bruch's membrane of the eye. This class refers to the presence of Drusen in the macula.
HP:0030499.definition_cn: 玻璃膜疣（单数形式为“druse”）是微小的黄色或白色细胞外物质（脂褐质）的积聚，沉积于眼部的Bruch膜中。本类别特指黄斑区存在玻璃膜疣。

HP:0030502.name: Retinoschisis
HP:0030502.definition: Splitting of the neuroretinal layers of the retina.
HP:0030502.definition_cn: 视网膜神经视网膜层的分离。

HP:0030504.name: Grouped congenital hypertrophy of retinal pigment epithelium
HP:0030504.name_cn: 视网膜色素上皮先天性肥大簇状病变

HP:0030505.name: Nummular pigmentation of the fundus
HP:0030505.definition: Clumped pigmentary changes of nummular appearance (i.e., thought to resemble the shape of a coin or multiple coins stuck together) at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:0030505.definition_cn: 视网膜色素上皮水平出现的呈钱币状外观的簇状色素改变（即被认为类似于单个或多个硬币粘在一起的形状）。

HP:0030508.name: obsolete Retinal cavernous hemangioma
HP:0030508.name_cn: 陈旧性视网膜海绵状血管瘤

HP:0030510.name: Combined hamartoma of the retinal pigment epithelium and retina
HP:0030510.name_cn: 视网膜色素上皮和视网膜联合错构瘤

HP:0030511.name: Bradyopsia
HP:0030511.definition_cn: 动态视力障碍 (Dynamic Visual Impairment)

HP:0030512.name: Difficulty adjusting to changes in luminance

HP:0030513.name: Difficulty adjusting from light to dark

HP:0030514.name: Difficulty adjusting from dark to light

HP:0030515.name: Moderately reduced visual acuity
HP:0030515.definition: Moderate reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 6/18 but at least 6/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 20/70 but at least 20/200. On the decimal visual acuity scale, moderate reduction is defined as less than 0.3 but at least 0.1.
HP:0030515.definition_cn: 中度视力减退。在6米视力表上，中度视力减退定义为视力低于6/18但至少为6/60。在20英尺视力表上，中度视力减退定义为视力低于20/70但至少为20/200。在小数视力表上，中度视力减退定义为视力低于0.3但至少为0.1。

HP:0030522.name: Mild constriction of peripheral visual field
HP:0030522.definition: A diminution of the peripheral visual field whereby at least 50 degrees of central field are preserved in all meridians.
HP:0030522.definition_cn: 周边视野缩小，但所有子午线上至少保留50度的中心视野。

HP:0030523.name: obsolete Peripheral visual field constriction with 40-50 degrees central field preserved
HP:0030523.name_cn: 陈旧性周边视野缩窄伴40-50度中心视野保留

HP:0030524.name: obsolete Peripheral visual field constriction with 30-39 degrees central field preserved
HP:0030524.name_cn: 陈旧性周边视野缩窄伴30-39度中心视野保留

HP:0030525.name: Moderate constriction of peripheral visual field
HP:0030525.definition: Peripheral visual field constriction with 20-49 degrees binocular visual field preserved.
HP:0030525.definition_cn: 周边视野缩窄，双眼视野保留20-49度。

HP:0030526.name: Severe constriction of peripheral visual field
HP:0030526.definition: Peripheral visual field constriction with 10-19 degrees central field preserved.
HP:0030526.definition_cn: 周边视野缩窄，中心视野保留10-19度。

HP:0030527.name: Very severe constriction of peripheral visual field
HP:0030527.definition: Peripheral visual field constriction with <10 degrees central field preserved.
HP:0030527.definition_cn: 周边视野缩窄，中心视野保留小于10度。

HP:0030529.name: Ring scotoma
HP:0030529.definition: An annular field defect centered on fixation.
HP:0030529.definition_cn: 以注视点为中心的环形视野缺损。

HP:0030534.name: Abnormal best corrected visual acuity test
HP:0030534.name_cn: 异常最佳矫正视力测试

HP:0030551.name: Visual acuity light perception with projection

HP:0030552.name: Visual acuity light perception without projection

HP:0030587.name: Abnormal Hardy-Rand-Rittler plate test
HP:0030587.name_cn: 异常哈迪-兰德-里特勒色觉检查

HP:0030588.name: Abnormal visual field test
HP:0030588.definition: Abnormal result of a test designed to test an individual's central and peripheral vision by determining the ability of the individual to perceive objects at differing locations of the visual field.
HP:0030588.definition_cn: 视野检查异常结果，该检查通过评估个体在不同视野位置感知物体的能力，以测试其中央和周边视力。

HP:0030590.name: Abnormal Amsler grid test
HP:0030590.name_cn: 异常阿姆斯勒方格表测试

HP:0030593.name: Abnormal manual kinetic perimetry test
HP:0030593.name_cn: 异常手动动态视野检查

HP:0030594.name: Abnormal automated kinetic perimetry test
HP:0030594.name_cn: 异常自动动态视野检查

HP:0030595.name: Abnormal static automated perimetry test
HP:0030595.name_cn: 异常静态自动视野检查

HP:0030599.name: Abnormal Esterman grid perimetry test
HP:0030599.definition: The Esterman grid test assays scores visual acuity. The grid consists of 100 units whose unequal size and distribution reflect the unequal functional value of different parts of the field-in effect a weighted or relative-value scale. Because each unit equals 1 percent, a simple count of units yields the functional score in percent.
HP:0030599.name_cn: 异常埃斯特曼方格视野检查
HP:0030599.definition_cn: 埃斯特曼方格测试（Esterman grid test）用于评估视力功能。该方格由100个单元组成，其大小和分布不均反映了视野不同区域功能价值的不均等性，实质上是一种加权或相对值量表。由于每个单元代表1%，通过简单计数单元即可得出功能评分，以百分比表示。

HP:0030602.name: Abnormal fundus autofluorescence imaging
HP:0030602.definition: Fundus autofluorescence (FAF) is a non-invasive retinal imaging modality used in clinical practice to provide a density map of lipofuscin, the predominant ocular fluorophore, in the retinal pigment epithelium. Autofluorescent patterns result from the complex interaction of fluorophores such a lipofuscin, which release an autofluorescent signal, and elements such as melanin and rhodopsin, which absorb the excitation beam and attenuate autofluorescence. Other structures such as retinal vessels and the crystalline lens may also influence autofluorescence through blocking and interference.
HP:0030602.name_cn: 异常眼底自发荧光成像
HP:0030602.definition_cn: 眼底自发荧光（Fundus Autofluorescence, FAF）是一种非侵入性视网膜成像技术，在临床实践中用于提供视网膜色素上皮中主要眼内荧光团——脂褐素的密度分布图。自发荧光模式是由荧光团（如脂褐素）释放的自发荧光信号与吸收激发光束并减弱自发荧光的元素（如黑色素和视紫红质）之间复杂的相互作用所产生。其他结构，如视网膜血管和晶状体，也可能通过遮挡和干扰影响自发荧光。

HP:0030603.name: Abnormal optical coherence tomography
HP:0030603.name_cn: 异常光学相干断层扫描

HP:0030604.name: Abnormal fundus fluorescein angiography
HP:0030604.definition: An abnormality observed by retinal fluorescein angiography, which involves the intravenous injection of fluorescein dye followed by fluorescent imaging of the fundus immediately after injection and for up to ten minutes thereafter. It can be used to study various retinal abnormalities including especially anomalies of the choroidal and retinal circulation.
HP:0030604.name_cn: 眼底荧光血管造影异常
HP:0030604.definition_cn: 视网膜荧光素血管造影术观察到的异常，该检查涉及静脉注射荧光素染料，随后在注射后立即进行眼底荧光成像，并持续至注射后十分钟。该技术可用于研究多种视网膜异常，尤其是脉络膜和视网膜循环的异常。

HP:0030605.name: Abnormal indocyanine green angiography
HP:0030605.name_cn: 异常吲哚菁绿血管造影

HP:0030606.name: Abnormal OCT-measured macular thickness
HP:0030606.name_cn: 异常光学相干断层扫描（OCT）测量的黄斑厚度

HP:0030607.name: Reduced OCT-measured macular thickness
HP:0030607.name_cn: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）测量的黄斑厚度降低

HP:0030609.name: Photoreceptor layer loss on macular OCT
HP:0030609.definition: Loss of the outer nuclear layer (photoreceptor layer) as assessed by ocular coherence tomography.
HP:0030609.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示光感受器层缺失
HP:0030609.definition_cn: 通过光学相干断层扫描评估发现外层核层（光感受器层）缺失。

HP:0030610.name: Photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular OCT
HP:0030610.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示光感受器外节段缺失

HP:0030611.name: Retinal pigment epithelial loss on macular OCT
HP:0030611.name_cn: 黄斑区光学相干断层扫描显示视网膜色素上皮层缺失

HP:0030612.name: Abnormal retinal morphology on macular OCT
HP:0030612.name_cn: 黄斑区光学相干断层扫描（OCT）显示视网膜形态异常

HP:0030613.name: Abnormal foveal morphology on macular OCT
HP:0030613.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹形态异常

HP:0030614.name: Foveal photoreceptor layer loss on macular OCT
HP:0030614.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹光感受器层缺失

HP:0030615.name: Foveal photoreceptor outer segment loss on macular OCT
HP:0030615.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹光感受器外节段缺失

HP:0030616.name: Foveal retinal pigment epithelial loss on macular OCT
HP:0030616.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹视网膜色素上皮层缺失

HP:0030617.name: Abnormal OCT-measured foveal thickness
HP:0030617.name_cn: 异常光学相干断层扫描（OCT）测量的中心凹厚度

HP:0030618.name: Increased OCT-measured foveal thickness
HP:0030618.name_cn: OCT测量的黄斑中心凹厚度增加

HP:0030619.name: Reduced OCT-measured foveal thickness
HP:0030619.name_cn: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）测量的中心凹厚度降低

HP:0030620.name: Inner retinal layer loss on macular OCT
HP:0030620.name_cn: 黄斑区光学相干断层扫描显示内层视网膜缺失

HP:0030621.name: Foveal inner retinal layer loss on macular OCT
HP:0030621.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹内层视网膜缺失

HP:0030622.name: Abnormal foveal pit on macular OCT
HP:0030622.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹凹陷异常

HP:0030623.name: Intraretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
HP:0030623.name_cn: 黄斑OCT上的视网膜内低反射区

HP:0030624.name: Subretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
HP:0030624.name_cn: 黄斑OCT下的视网膜下低反射腔

HP:0030625.name: Hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
HP:0030625.name_cn: 黄斑区光学相干断层扫描低反射区

HP:0030626.name: Foveal intraretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
HP:0030626.name_cn: 黄斑OCT上的中心凹视网膜内低反射间隙

HP:0030627.name: Foveal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
HP:0030627.name_cn: 黄斑OCT中的中心凹低反射区

HP:0030628.name: Foveal subretinal hyporeflective spaces on macular OCT
HP:0030628.name_cn: 黄斑OCT显示中心凹下视网膜低反射间隙

HP:0030629.name: Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence
HP:0030629.name_cn: 中心凹周围高自发荧光环

HP:0030630.name: Irregular central macular autofluorescence
HP:0030630.name_cn: 不规则中心凹自发荧光

HP:0030631.name: Hyperautofluorescent macular lesion
HP:0030631.definition: Increased amount of autofluorescence in the macula as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.
HP:0030631.name_cn: 高自发荧光性黄斑病变
HP:0030631.definition_cn: 黄斑区自发荧光增强，经眼底自发荧光成像确认。

HP:0030632.name: Hypoautofluorescent macular lesion
HP:0030632.definition: Decreased amount of autofluorescence in the macula as ascertained by fundus autofluorescence imaging.
HP:0030632.definition_cn: 黄斑区自发荧光强度降低，经眼底自发荧光成像确认。

HP:0030633.name: Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by normal autofluorescence
HP:0030633.name_cn: 中心凹周围高自发荧光环，周围为正常自发荧光

HP:0030634.name: Perifoveal ring of hyperautofluorescence surrounded by abnormal autofluorescence
HP:0030634.name_cn: 中心凹周围高自发荧光环伴异常自发荧光

HP:0030635.name: Retinal dystrophy with early macular involvement
HP:0030635.name_cn: 早期黄斑受累的视网膜营养不良

HP:0030636.name: Occult macular dystrophy
HP:0030636.definition: Occult macular dystrophy is a, typically hereditary, abnormality of the macula associated with progressive foveal cone dysfunction and no apparent fundoscopic, full-field electroretinogram (ERG), or fluorescein angiogram abnormalities.
HP:0030636.definition_cn: 隐匿性黄斑营养不良是一种通常为遗传性的黄斑异常，与进行性中心凹视锥细胞功能障碍相关，且无明显眼底镜检查、全视野视网膜电图（ERG）或荧光素血管造影异常。

HP:0030637.name: Congenital stationary cone dysfunction
HP:0030637.definition: Retinal phenotype characterized by cone photoreceptor dysfunction and preserved rod system. The abnormality is typically stationary or very slowly progressive and findings may include reduced central vision, color vision abnormalities, nystagmus and photophobia.
HP:0030637.name_cn: 先天性静止性视锥细胞功能障碍
HP:0030637.definition_cn: 视网膜表型特征为视锥细胞功能障碍而视杆系统功能保留。该异常通常为静止性或极缓慢进展性，临床表现可能包括中心视力下降、色觉异常、眼球震颤及畏光。

HP:0030638.name: Congenital stationary night blindness with normal fundus
HP:0030638.name_cn: 先天性静止性夜盲伴正常眼底

HP:0030639.name: Congenital stationary night blindness with abnormal fundus
HP:0030639.name_cn: 先天性静止性夜盲伴眼底异常

HP:0030640.name: Complete congenital stationary night blindness
HP:0030640.name_cn: 完全性先天性静止性夜盲症

HP:0030641.name: Incomplete congenital stationary night blindness
HP:0030641.name_cn: 不完全性先天性静止性夜盲症

HP:0030645.name: Central
HP:0030645.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is located close to the median plane or midline of the body or of the referenced structure.
HP:0030645.definition_cn: 适用于位于身体或参考结构的中线或正中平面附近的异常。

HP:0030652.name: Vitreous haze
HP:0030652.definition: Vitreous haze is the obscuration of fundus details by vitreous cells and protein exudation.
HP:0030652.definition_cn: 玻璃体混浊是指由于玻璃体细胞和蛋白质渗出导致眼底细节模糊不清。

HP:0030654.name: Umbilical cord cyst
HP:0030654.definition: Any cystic lesion associated with the umbilical cord.

HP:0030655.name: Umbilical cord knot
HP:0030655.definition: An entwining of a segment of umbilical cord, usually without obstructing fetal circulation and commonly result from fetal slippage through a loop of the cord.
HP:0030655.definition_cn: 脐带缠绕，通常不会阻碍胎儿血液循环，常见于胎儿滑过脐带环所致。

HP:0030656.name: Umbilical vein varix
HP:0030656.definition: Focal dilation of the umbilical vein.

HP:0030657.name: Umbilical cord hematoma
HP:0030657.definition: Bleeding from the vessels of the cord with extravasation of blood into the Wharton jelly surrounding the umbilical cord vessels.
HP:0030657.definition_cn: 脐带血管出血伴血液外渗至脐带血管周围的华通胶。

HP:0030658.name: Marginal umbilical cord insertion
HP:0030658.definition: Insertion of the umbilical cord within 2 cm from the placental edge.
HP:0030658.definition_cn: 脐带插入点距胎盘边缘2厘米以内。

HP:0030659.name: Velamentous cord insertion
HP:0030659.definition: Insertion of the umbilical cord into the chorio-amniotic membranes of the placenta.
HP:0030659.definition_cn: 脐带插入胎盘绒毛膜羊膜。

HP:0030660.name: Furcate cord insertion
HP:0030660.definition: Branching of the umbilical cord before its insertion into the placenta.
HP:0030660.definition_cn: 脐带在插入胎盘前的分支。

HP:0030661.name: Vitreous snowballs
HP:0030661.definition: Yellow-white inflammatory aggregates in the vitreous that are found in the midvitreous and inferior periphery.
HP:0030661.definition_cn: 玻璃体内黄白色炎性团块，位于玻璃体中部及下方周边部。

HP:0030662.name: Vitreous inflammatory cells
HP:0030662.definition: The presence of inflammatory cells such as lymphocytes and macrophages in the vitreous.
HP:0030662.definition_cn: 玻璃体内存在淋巴细胞和巨噬细胞等炎性细胞。

HP:0030663.name: Optically empty vitreous
HP:0030663.definition: Vestigial vitreous gel occupying the immediate retrolental space and minimal to no discernible gel in the central vitreous cavity, giving the appearance of an empty vitreous cavity.
HP:0030663.definition_cn: 晶状体后间隙内残留的玻璃体凝胶，中央玻璃体腔内极少或无可见凝胶，呈现为玻璃体腔空虚的外观。

HP:0030664.name: Beevor's sign
HP:0030664.definition: Weakness of the inferior portion of the rectus abdominal muscle, which is ascertained clinically as follows. When a patient sits up or raises the head from a recumbent position, the umbilicus is displaced toward the head. This is the result of paralysis of the inferior portion of the rectus abdominal muscle, so that the upper fibers predominate pulling upwards the umbilicus.
HP:0030664.definition_cn: 腹直肌下部肌力减弱，临床表现为：当患者从仰卧位坐起或抬头时，脐部向头部方向移位。这是由于腹直肌下部麻痹所致，导致上部肌纤维占优势，将脐部向上牵拉。

HP:0030665.name: Rubral tremor
HP:0030665.definition: Rubral tremor is characterized by a slow coarse tremor at rest that is exacerbated by postural adjustments and by guided voluntary movements.
HP:0030665.definition_cn: 红核震颤的特征为静止时出现缓慢粗大的震颤，该震颤在姿势调整和引导性自主运动时加重。

HP:0030666.name: Retinal neovascularization
HP:0030666.definition: In wound repair, neovascularization (NV) involves the sprouting of new vessels from pre-existent vessels to repair or replace damaged vessels. In the retina, NV is a response to ischemia. The NV adheres to the inner surface of the retina and outer surface of the vitreous. NV are deficient in tight junctions and hence leak plasma into surrounding tissue including the vitreous. Plasma causes the vitreous gel to degenerate, contract, and eventually collapse which pulls on the retina. Since retinal NV is adherent to both retina and vitreous, as the vitreous contracts the NV may be sheared resulting in vitreous hemorrhage or the NV may remain intact and pull the retina with the vitreous resulting in retinal elevation referred to as traction retinal detachment.
HP:0030666.definition_cn: 在伤口修复过程中，新生血管形成（Neovascularization, NV）涉及从已有血管中萌发新血管，以修复或替代受损血管。在视网膜中，NV是对缺血的一种反应。新生血管附着于视网膜内表面和玻璃体外表面。新生血管缺乏紧密连接，因此血浆会渗漏到周围组织，包括玻璃体。血浆导致玻璃体凝胶变性、收缩，最终塌陷，从而牵拉视网膜。由于视网膜新生血管同时附着于视网膜和玻璃体，当玻璃体收缩时，新生血管可能被剪切，导致玻璃体出血；或者新生血管保持完整，随玻璃体牵拉视网膜，导致视网膜隆起，称为牵拉性视网膜脱离（Traction Retinal Detachment）。

HP:0030667.name: Peripheral retinal neovascularization
HP:0030667.definition: A type of retinal neovascularization that affects the periphery of the retina.
HP:0030667.name_cn: 周边视网膜新生血管形成
HP:0030667.definition_cn: 一种影响视网膜周边区域的视网膜新生血管形成。

HP:0030668.name: Periorbital dermoid cyst
HP:0030668.definition: A cyst that is localized in the region of the orbit and exhibits an epithelial lining with a keratin-filled lumen. Hair follicles are one of the adnexal structures that are commonly found in walls of dermoid cysts.
HP:0030668.definition_cn: 位于眼眶区域的囊肿，具有上皮衬里且腔内充满角蛋白。毛囊是皮样囊肿壁中常见的附属结构之一。

HP:0030669.name: Abnormal ocular adnexa morphology
HP:0030669.definition: A structural anomaly of the adjacent structures (i.e., adnexa) of the eye, defined as the lacrimal apparatus, the extraocular muscles and the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows and the conjunctiva.
HP:0030669.definition_cn: 眼附属器（即眼附属结构）的结构异常，定义为泪器、眼外肌、眼睑、睫毛、眉毛及结膜的结构异常。

HP:0030670.name: Hamartoma of the orbital region
HP:0030670.definition: A hamartoma (disordered proliferation of mature tissues) which can originate from any tissue of the orbital region.
HP:0030670.definition_cn: 错构瘤（成熟组织的无序增生），可起源于眼眶区域的任何组织。

HP:0030671.name: Abnormal common tendinous ring morphology
HP:0030671.definition: Any anomaly of the ring of fibrous tissue that surrounds the optic nerve at its entrance at the apex of the orbit. The common tendinous ring, also known as the annulus of Zinn or annular tendon, is the origin for five of the seven extraocular muscles.
HP:0030671.definition_cn: 视神经入口处纤维组织环的任何异常，该纤维组织环位于眼眶顶部的视神经入口处。共同腱环，也称为Zinn环或环形肌腱，是七条眼外肌中五条的起源。

HP:0030672.name: Asteroid hyalosis
HP:0030672.definition: The presence of small, white vitreous opacities consisting of calcium phosphate and complex, layered lipid deposits.
HP:0030672.definition_cn: 存在由磷酸钙和复杂的层状脂质沉积物组成的微小白色玻璃体混浊。

HP:0030673.name: Erosive vitreoretinopathy
HP:0030673.definition: A form of vitreoretinopathy characterized by thinning (erosion) of the retinal pigment epithelium that permits increased visualization of the choroidal vessels.
HP:0030673.name_cn: 侵蚀性玻璃体视网膜病变
HP:0030673.definition_cn: 一种玻璃体视网膜病变，其特征为视网膜色素上皮变薄（侵蚀），导致脉络膜血管的可见性增加。

HP:0030675.name: Contracture of proximal interphalangeal joints of 2nd-5th fingers
HP:0030675.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion of the proximal interphalangeal joint of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th fingers due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
HP:0030675.name_cn: 第二至第五指近端指间关节挛缩
HP:0030675.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织的结构改变导致的第二、第三、第四和第五指近端指间关节慢性运动功能丧失。

HP:0030676.name: Satyr ear
HP:0030676.definition: Sharp pointed superior portion of the ear, with variable overfolding of the helix.
HP:0030676.definition_cn: 耳廓尖部锐利，伴有不同程度的耳轮过度折叠。

HP:0030677.name: Mozart ear
HP:0030677.definition: A congenital auricular deformity, which is mainly characterized by a bulging appearance of the anterosuperior portion of the auricle, a convexly protruded cavum conchae, and a slit-like narrowing of the orifice of the external auditory meatus.
HP:0030677.definition_cn: 先天性耳廓畸形，主要表现为耳廓前上部隆起、耳甲腔凸出以及外耳道口呈裂隙状狭窄。

HP:0030679.name: Ash-leaf spot
HP:0030679.definition: A hypopigmented spot in the shape of a leaf from the mountain ash tree.
HP:0030679.definition_cn: 呈现白蜡树叶形状的低色素斑。

HP:0030680.name: Abnormal cardiovascular system morphology
HP:0030680.definition: Any structural anomaly of the heart and blood vessels.
HP:0030680.definition_cn: 心血管系统的任何结构异常。

HP:0030681.name: Abnormal morphology of myocardial trabeculae
HP:0030681.definition: Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the right and left ventricles of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).
HP:0030681.definition_cn: 心脏左右心室内表面突出的肌性柱（心肌小梁，肉柱）的任何结构异常。

HP:0030682.name: Left ventricular noncompaction
HP:0030682.definition: Left ventricular noncompaction (LVNC) is defined by 3 markers: prominent left ventricular (LV) trabeculae, deep intertrabecular recesses, and the thin compacted layer.
HP:0030682.definition_cn: 左心室致密化不全（Left Ventricular Noncompaction, LVNC）的诊断依据包括三个标志：显著的左心室（Left Ventricular, LV）小梁结构、深陷的小梁间隐窝以及薄层致密化心肌。

HP:0030683.name: Vaginitis
HP:0030683.definition: Inflammation of the vagina that can result from a spectrum of conditions that cause vaginal and sometimes vulvar symptoms, such as itching, burning, irritation, odor, and vaginal discharge.
HP:0030683.definition_cn: 阴道炎，可由多种病因引起，导致阴道及有时外阴症状，如瘙痒、灼热、刺激、异味及阴道分泌物异常。

HP:0030684.name: Abnormal adiponectin level
HP:0030684.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue, and that plays a crucial role in the regulation of insulin sensitivity and glucose metabolism.
HP:0030684.definition_cn: 一种与正常循环浓度偏离的脂联素异常，脂联素是一种30 kDa的补体C1相关蛋白，是脂肪组织中表达最丰富的分泌蛋白，在胰岛素敏感性和葡萄糖代谢的调节中起关键作用。

HP:0030685.name: Decreased adiponectin level
HP:0030685.definition: A reduced circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue.
HP:0030685.definition_cn: 循环中脂联素浓度降低，脂联素是一种30 kDa的补体C1相关蛋白，是脂肪组织中表达最丰富的分泌蛋白。

HP:0030686.name: Increased adiponectin level
HP:0030686.definition: An elevated circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue.
HP:0030686.definition_cn: 循环中升高的脂联素浓度，脂联素是一种30 kDa的补体C1相关蛋白，是脂肪组织中表达最丰富的分泌蛋白。

HP:0030687.name: Abnormal glucagon level
HP:0030687.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.
HP:0030687.definition_cn: 血液循环中胰高血糖素浓度异常。

HP:0030688.name: Increased glucagon level
HP:0030688.definition: An elevated concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.
HP:0030688.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰高血糖素浓度升高。

HP:0030689.name: Decreased glucagon level
HP:0030689.definition: A reduced concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.
HP:0030689.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰高血糖素浓度降低。

HP:0030690.name: Gingival cleft
HP:0030690.definition: A fissure in the gingiva (gums), i.e., the mucosal tissue that lies over the mandible and maxilla.
HP:0030690.definition_cn: 牙龈裂（Gingival Fissure），即覆盖于下颌骨（Mandible）和上颌骨（Maxilla）上的黏膜组织（Mucosal Tissue）出现的裂隙。

HP:0030691.name: Divergence nystagmus
HP:0030691.definition: A condition in which both eyes beat outward simultaneously.
HP:0030691.definition_cn: 双眼同时外展性眼震（Bilateral Abducting Nystagmus）。

HP:0030692.name: Brain neoplasm
HP:0030692.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from or metastasizes to the brain.
HP:0030692.definition_cn: 起源于脑部或转移至脑部的良性或恶性肿瘤。

HP:0030693.name: Supratentorial neoplasm
HP:0030693.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that occurs within the intracranial cavity above the tentorium cerebelli.
HP:0030693.definition_cn: 一种良性或恶性肿瘤，发生于小脑幕上方的颅内腔。

HP:0030706.name: Ranula
HP:0030706.definition: A ranula is a mucocele that occurs in the floor of the mouth and usually involve the major salivary glands. Specifically, the ranula originates in the body of the sublingual gland, in the ducts of the sublingual gland, in the Wharton's duct of the submandibular gland or infrequently from the minor salivary glands at this location.
HP:0030706.definition_cn: 舌下囊肿是一种发生于口腔底部的黏液囊肿，通常涉及主要唾液腺。具体而言，舌下囊肿起源于舌下腺体、舌下腺导管、下颌下腺的沃顿管，或较少见地起源于该部位的次要唾液腺。

HP:0030707.name: Unilateral lung agenesis
HP:0030707.definition: Lack of development of one lung.
HP:0030707.definition_cn: 单侧肺发育不全（Unilateral Pulmonary Hypoplasia）

HP:0030708.name: Myeloschisis
HP:0030708.definition: The severe form of a neural tube defect where the open neural tube appears as a flattened, plate-like mass of nervous tissue with no overlying membrane.
HP:0030708.definition_cn: 神经管缺陷的严重形式，表现为开放的神经管呈扁平、板状的神经组织团块，且无覆盖膜。

HP:0030709.name: Myelocystocele
HP:0030709.definition: Myelocystocele is characterized by a large, ependyma-lined, cystic dilation of the caudal end of the central canal of the spinal cord; it projects dorsally through a lamina defect, with overlying varying amounts of lipomatous subcutaneous tissue. Myelocystoceles are associated with a tethered cord and meningocele, which communicates with the spinal subarachnoid space, but not with the central canal cyst.
HP:0030709.definition_cn: 脊髓囊肿性脊膜膨出（Myelocystocele）的特征是脊髓中央管尾端出现由室管膜衬里的大型囊性扩张；该扩张通过椎板缺损向背侧突出，表面覆盖有不同量的脂肪性皮下组织。脊髓囊肿性脊膜膨出常伴有脊髓栓系（tethered cord）和脊膜膨出（meningocele），后者与脊髓蛛网膜下腔相通，但与中央管囊肿不相通。

HP:0030710.name: Lipomeningocele
HP:0030710.definition: A form of closed neural tube defect in which the spinal tissue lies within the spinal cord having a junction between the spinal cord and the lipoma. Intact skin covers the defect. Neurologic findings first appear during the second year of life.
HP:0030710.definition_cn: 一种闭合性神经管缺陷，其中脊髓组织位于脊髓内，脊髓与脂肪瘤之间存在连接。皮肤完整覆盖缺陷。神经系统症状通常在生命的第二年首次出现。

HP:0030711.name: Hydrocolpos
HP:0030711.definition: Distention of the vagina caused by accumulation of fluid due to congenital vaginal obstruction.
HP:0030711.definition_cn: 先天性阴道梗阻导致液体潴留引起的阴道扩张。

HP:0030712.name: Uterine synechiae
HP:0030712.definition: Adhesions or scar tissue that form inside the cavity of the uterus.
HP:0030712.definition_cn: 宫腔内粘连或瘢痕组织形成。

HP:0030713.name: Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation
HP:0030713.definition: Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation is a choroidal type of arteriovenous malformation that develops between 6 and 11 weeks of gestation. It results from 1 or more arteriovenous fistulas shunting blood toward the prosencephalic vein of Markowski, the embryonic precursor of the vein of Galen. This abnormal shunt leads to progressive dilation of the vein and prevents its involution and subsequent development into the vein of Galen.
HP:0030713.definition_cn: Galen静脉动脉瘤样畸形是一种脉络膜型动静脉畸形，发生于妊娠6至11周之间。其病因是由于一个或多个动静脉瘘将血液分流至Markowski前脑静脉，即Galen静脉的胚胎前体。这种异常分流导致静脉进行性扩张，并阻碍其退化和后续发育为Galen静脉。

HP:0030714.name: Subchorionic thrombohematoma
HP:0030714.definition: A large maternal clot that separates the chorionic plate from the villous chorion.
HP:0030714.definition_cn: 一个巨大的母体血块将绒毛膜板与绒毛膜绒毛分离。

HP:0030715.name: Bronchial atresia
HP:0030715.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by focal obliteration of the proximal segment of a bronchus. The bronchial pattern is entirely normal distal to the site of stenosis.
HP:0030715.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为支气管近端节段的局灶性闭塞。狭窄部位远端的支气管结构完全正常。

HP:0030716.name: Acrania
HP:0030716.definition: Partial or complete absence of the flat bones of the cranial vault. The condition is frequently, though not always, associated with anencephaly.
HP:0030716.definition_cn: 颅穹窿扁平骨部分或完全缺失。该情况常与无脑畸形相关，但并非总是如此。

HP:0030717.name: Meconium peritonitis
HP:0030717.definition: Peritonitis caused by intrauterine intestinal rupture and spillage of fetal meconium into the fetal peritoneal cavity. Intra-peritoneal meconium usually calcifies, sometimes within 24 hours. Ultrasound findings may include intraabdominal calcifications.
HP:0030717.definition_cn: 宫内肠破裂导致胎粪溢入胎儿腹腔引起的腹膜炎。腹腔内胎粪通常会发生钙化，有时在24小时内即可出现。超声检查结果可能包括腹腔内钙化灶。

HP:0030718.name: Right atrial enlargement
HP:0030718.definition: Increase in size of the right atrium.

HP:0030719.name: Unguarded tricuspid valve
HP:0030719.definition: A form of agenesis of the tricuspid valve in which (although the normal orifice between the right atrium and right ventricle exists) there is no tricuspid valvular tissue.
HP:0030719.definition_cn: 一种三尖瓣发育不全的形式，其中（尽管右心房和右心室之间的正常开口存在）没有三尖瓣组织。

HP:0030720.name: Subchorionic septal cyst
HP:0030720.definition: Cyst on the surface of the placenta consisting of amnion and chorion.
HP:0030720.definition_cn: 胎盘表面由羊膜和绒毛膜组成的囊肿。

HP:0030722.name: Ectopic liver
HP:0030722.definition: Ectopic liver is a rare developmental anomaly in which liver tissue is situated outside the liver. Thus, ectopic liver refers to autonomous islands of normal liver parenchyma located outside the liver. The term ectopic liver is also used, to include liver appendices attached to the native liver by a thin stalk although being fully separated from the latter.
HP:0030722.definition_cn: 异位肝是一种罕见的发育异常，其中肝组织位于肝脏外部。因此，异位肝指的是位于肝脏外部的正常肝实质的独立岛状结构。术语“异位肝”也用于包括通过细蒂附着于原生肝脏的肝附属物，尽管其与后者完全分离。

HP:0030723.name: Congenital megalourethra
HP:0030723.definition: Dilation and elongation of the penile urethra associated with absence or hypoplasia of the corpora spongiosa and cavernosa.
HP:0030723.definition_cn: 阴茎尿道扩张与延长，伴随海绵体及海绵体发育不全或缺失。

HP:0030724.name: Central nervous system cyst
HP:0030724.definition: A fluid-filled sac (cyst) located within the central nervous system.
HP:0030724.definition_cn: 位于中枢神经系统内的液性囊状结构（囊肿）。

HP:0030725.name: Neurenteric cyst
HP:0030725.definition: The neurenteric cyst is a rare lesion composed of heterotopic endodermal tissue. During the third week of human embryogenesis, the neurenteric canal unites the yolk sac and the amniotic cavity as it traverses the primitive notochordal plate. Persistence of the normally transient neurenteric canal prevents appropriate separation of endoderm and notochord. This results in a variable degree of communication between neural and enteric epithelium.
HP:0030725.definition_cn: 神经肠囊肿是一种由异位内胚层组织构成的罕见病变。在人类胚胎发育的第三周，神经肠管穿过原始脊索板，将卵黄囊与羊膜腔连接起来。正常情况下短暂的神经肠管持续存在，阻碍了内胚层与脊索的适当分离。这导致神经上皮与肠上皮之间形成不同程度的交通。

HP:0030726.name: Spinal neurenteric cyst
HP:0030726.definition: A neurenteric cyst located in the spine.
HP:0030726.definition_cn: 位于脊柱的神经肠源性囊肿。

HP:0030727.name: Intracranial neurenteric cyst
HP:0030727.definition: A neurenteric cyst located within the skull.
HP:0030727.definition_cn: 位于颅内的神经肠源性囊肿。

HP:0030728.name: Meromelia
HP:0030728.definition: Partial absence of a free limb (excluding girdle). It can refer to the proximal, middle or distal segment of the upper or lower limb. The deficiency may be transverse or longitudinal. Thus, meromelia is a lack of a part, but not all, of one or more limbs with the presence of a hand or foot.
HP:0030728.definition_cn: 部分肢体缺失（不包括肢带）。可指上肢或下肢的近端、中段或远端节段。缺失可为横向或纵向。因此，部分肢体缺失是指一个或多个肢体的部分而非全部缺失，且存在手或足。

HP:0030729.name: Frontoethmoidal meningocele
HP:0030729.definition: A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull at the junction of the frontal and ethmoidal bones.
HP:0030729.definition_cn: 通过颅骨额骨与筛骨交界处先天性骨缺损的脑膜疝。

HP:0030730.name: Parietal meningocele
HP:0030730.definition: A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull in the parietal region.
HP:0030730.definition_cn: 顶骨区先天性颅骨缺损导致的脑膜膨出。

HP:0030731.name: Carcinoma
HP:0030731.definition: A malignant tumor arising from epithelial cells. Carcinomas that arise from glandular epithelium are called adenocarcinomas, those that arise from squamous epithelium are called squamous cell carcinomas, and those that arise from transitional epithelium are called transitional cell carcinomas (NCI Thesaurus).
HP:0030731.definition_cn: 起源于上皮细胞的恶性肿瘤。起源于腺上皮的癌称为腺癌，起源于鳞状上皮的癌称为鳞状细胞癌，起源于移行上皮的癌称为移行细胞癌（NCI 同义词库）。

HP:0030732.name: Dysplastic tricuspid valve
HP:0030732.definition: A congenital malformation of the tricuspid valve characterized by leaflet deformation.
HP:0030732.definition_cn: 三尖瓣先天性畸形，其特征为瓣叶变形。

HP:0030733.name: Vesicoallantoic abdominal wall defect
HP:0030733.definition: An abdominal wall defected related to a developmental anomaly of the allantois, which is an embryonic structure that develops as a diverticulum off the yolk sac at about 16 days post fertilization. During further development, the allantois becomes incorporated into the body of the embryo, connecting the ventral aspect of the urogenital sinus (which will develop into the upper pole of the urinary bladder) to the external portion of the umbilicus. Upon further development, the lumen of the allantois becomes obliterated and forms a thick fibrous cord called the urachus, which connects the apex of the bladder to the umbilicus. In adults, the urachus is known as the median umbilical ligament. Failure of the allantoic cavity to obliterate can result of one of four conditions: 1) congenital patent urachus (a completely open connection between bladder and umbilicus); 2) vesicourachal diverticulum (a diverticulum off the bladder but not communicating with the umbilicus); umbilical cyst and sinus (not communicating with the bladder); and 4) alternating urachal sinus. An abdominal wall defect can be associated with a urachal cyst.
HP:0030733.definition_cn: 腹壁缺损与尿囊的发育异常相关，尿囊是一种胚胎结构，在受精后约16天作为卵黄囊的憩室发育而成。在进一步发育过程中，尿囊被纳入胚胎体内，连接泌尿生殖窦的腹侧（将发育为膀胱的上极）与脐部的外部。随着进一步发育，尿囊的管腔逐渐闭塞，形成一条称为脐尿管的厚纤维索，连接膀胱顶端与脐部。在成人中，脐尿管被称为脐正中韧带。尿囊腔未能完全闭塞可能导致以下四种情况之一：1）先天性脐尿管未闭（膀胱与脐部之间完全开放的连接）；2）膀胱脐尿管憩室（膀胱的憩室，但不与脐部相通）；3）脐囊肿和窦道（不与膀胱相通）；以及4）交替性脐尿管窦道。腹壁缺损可能与脐尿管囊肿相关。

HP:0030735.name: Ureterovesical junction obstruction
HP:0030735.definition: Blockage at the level of the bladder and the ureter caused by stenosis of the ureteral valves or failure of a narrow juxtavesical ureteral segment to dilate due to segmented fibrosis or localized absence of muscle.
HP:0030735.name_cn: 输尿管膀胱连接部梗阻
HP:0030735.definition_cn: 膀胱和输尿管水平的梗阻，由输尿管瓣膜狭窄或由于节段性纤维化或局部肌肉缺失导致的狭窄膀胱旁输尿管段未能扩张引起。

HP:0030736.name: Sacrococcygeal teratoma
HP:0030736.definition: A teratoma arising in the sacro-coccygeal region.

HP:0030737.name: Altman type I sacrococcygeal teratoma
HP:0030737.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external and projects from the sacrococcygeal region and presents with distortion of the buttocks.
HP:0030737.definition_cn: 一种主要外生性、从骶尾区突出并伴有臀部畸形的骶尾部畸胎瘤。

HP:0030738.name: Altman type II sacrococcygeal teratoma
HP:0030738.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external but has a large intrapelvic component.
HP:0030738.definition_cn: 一种以外部为主但具有较大盆腔内成分的骶尾部畸胎瘤。

HP:0030739.name: Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma
HP:0030739.definition: A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly intrapelvic with a small external, buttock mass.
HP:0030739.definition_cn: 一种以盆腔内为主、伴有一小部分外部臀部肿块的骶尾部畸胎瘤。

HP:0030740.name: Anomalous muscle bundle of the right ventricle
HP:0030740.definition: An accessory (not normally present) muscle bundle in the right ventricle which obstructs the right ventricular outflow tract.
HP:0030740.definition_cn: 右心室异常肌束（通常不存在），导致右心室流出道梗阻。

HP:0030741.name: Mediastinal teratoma
HP:0030741.definition: A teratoma located within the mediastinum (the cavity between the pleural sacs that contains the heart and all of the thoracic viscera except the lungs).
HP:0030741.definition_cn: 位于纵隔内的畸胎瘤（纵隔为胸膜囊之间的腔隙，内含心脏及除肺以外的所有胸腔脏器）。

HP:0030742.name: Glial remnants posterior to lens
HP:0030742.definition: This anomaly, also known as Mittendorf dot, is a benign, nonprogressive recognizable lesion that does not cause visual impairment. However, it can resemble a pathological congenital or acquired cataract lesion which may enlarge and cause visual impairment. The dot appears as a black speck that ranges in size from the dot made by a sharp pencil point to the size of a poppy seed. It is usually well defined, although occasionally there may be irregular, fine lines radiating outward from the dot.
HP:0030742.name_cn: 晶状体后神经胶质残留
