HP:0031045.definition: Bullae (defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls) of the skin with an acral distribution (affecting peripheral regions such as hands and feet).
HP:0031045.definition_cn: 皮肤大疱（定义为直径超过5毫米、壁薄的充满液体的水疱），呈肢端分布（累及手足等外周区域）。

HP:0031046.name: Absent soft palate
HP:0031046.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of a soft palate.
HP:0031046.definition_cn: 一种以软腭缺失为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0031047.name: Paraproteinemia
HP:0031047.definition: An abnormal immunoglobulin or part of an Ig (light chain) in the circulation. Paraproteins are typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0031047.definition_cn: 循环中出现异常免疫球蛋白或免疫球蛋白部分（轻链）。副蛋白通常由B细胞衍生的浆细胞克隆群体产生。

HP:0031048.name: Light-chain paraproteinemia
HP:0031048.definition: An abnormal immunoglobulin light chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0031048.definition_cn: 循环中的异常免疫球蛋白轻链，通常由B细胞衍生的浆细胞克隆群体产生。

HP:0031049.name: Heavy-chain paraproteinemia
HP:0031049.definition: An abnormal immunoglobulin heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0031049.definition_cn: 循环中异常免疫球蛋白重链，通常由B细胞来源的浆细胞克隆群体产生。

HP:0031050.name: Whole-immunoglobulin paraproteinemia
HP:0031050.definition: An abnormal immunoglobulin (heavy and light chain) in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.
HP:0031050.name_cn: 全免疫球蛋白副蛋白血症
HP:0031050.definition_cn: 循环中异常免疫球蛋白（重链和轻链），通常由克隆性B细胞来源的浆细胞产生。

HP:0031051.name: Tarsal sclerosis
HP:0031051.definition: An elevation in bone density in one or more tarsal bones of the foot. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.
HP:0031051.definition_cn: 足部一处或多处跗骨骨密度增高。硬化通常在X线片上表现为局部密度增高区域。

HP:0031052.name: Elevated vascular endothelial growth factor level
HP:0031052.definition: Increased blood concentration of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF).
HP:0031052.name_cn: 血管内皮生长因子水平升高
HP:0031052.definition_cn: 血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）血液浓度升高。

HP:0031053.name: Coarctation in the transverse aortic arch
HP:0031053.definition: Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized to the region of the transverse aortic arch.
HP:0031053.definition_cn: 主动脉缩窄局限于横弓区域。

HP:0031054.name: Long segment coarctation of the aorta
HP:0031054.definition: Coarctation of the aorta is a narrowing or constriction of a long segment of the arch of the aorta.
HP:0031054.definition_cn: 主动脉缩窄是指主动脉弓长段出现狭窄或缩窄。

HP:0031055.name: Abnormal branching pattern of left aortic arch
HP:0031055.definition: A deviance from the norm of the origin or course of the right brachiocephalic artery, the left common carotid artery, the left subclavian artery or the proximal vertebral arteries, whereby the aortic arch descends on the left as normal (as opposed to right aortic arch).
HP:0031055.name_cn: 左主动脉弓异常分支模式
HP:0031055.definition_cn: 右头臂动脉、左颈总动脉、左锁骨下动脉或近端椎动脉的起源或走行偏离正常，而主动脉弓仍正常位于左侧下降（与右位主动脉弓相反）。

HP:0031056.name: Fusiform cerebral aneurysm
HP:0031056.definition: A localized circumferential (i.e., bulges on all sides) dilatation or ballooning of a cerebral artery.
HP:0031056.definition_cn: 脑动脉局部环周性扩张或球囊样膨出。

HP:0031057.name: Skin fissure
HP:0031057.definition: A clearly-defined and roughly linear cleavage in the skin that usually extends to the dermis.
HP:0031057.definition_cn: 皮肤中清晰可见且大致呈线性的裂口，通常延伸至真皮层。

HP:0031058.name: Impairment of activities of daily living
HP:0031058.definition: Difficulty in performing one or more activities normally performed every day, such as eating, bathing, dressing, grooming, work, homemaking, and leisure.
HP:0031058.name_cn: 日常生活活动能力受损
HP:0031058.definition_cn: 执行日常活动功能障碍，包括进食、沐浴、穿衣、梳妆、工作、家务及休闲活动等一项或多项能力受限。

HP:0031059.name: Impaired ability to bathe oneself
HP:0031059.definition: This term applies to an individual who requires help to bathe more than one part of the body, get in or out of the tub or shower, or who requires total bathing.
HP:0031059.definition_cn: 该术语适用于需要协助清洗身体多个部位、进出浴缸或淋浴间，或需全程协助进行沐浴的个体。

HP:0031060.name: Impaired ability to dress oneself
HP:0031060.definition: This applies to an individual who needs help with dressing or needs to be completely dressed.
HP:0031060.definition_cn: 此情况适用于需要协助穿衣或完全依赖他人进行穿衣的个体。

HP:0031061.name: Impaired toileting ability
HP:0031061.definition: This term applies to an individual who requires help transferring to the toilet, cleaning self or who uses bedpan or commode.
HP:0031061.definition_cn: 该术语适用于需要协助如厕转移、个人清洁或使用便盆或便椅的个体。

HP:0031062.name: Impaired transferring ability
HP:0031062.definition: Applies to an individual who needs help in moving from bed to chair or requires a complete transfer.
HP:0031062.definition_cn: 适用于需要协助从床转移到椅子或需要完全转移的个体。

HP:0031063.name: Impaired feeding ability
HP:0031063.definition: Applies to an individual who needs partial or total help with feeding or requires parenteral feeding.
HP:0031063.definition_cn: 适用于需要部分或完全辅助进食或需进行肠外营养的个体。

HP:0031064.name: Impaired continence
HP:0031064.definition: Partial or total incontinence of bowel or bladder.
HP:0031064.definition_cn: 部分或完全性肠道或膀胱失禁。

HP:0031067.name: Empty ovarian follicle
HP:0031067.definition: A failure to collect oocytes after an apparently normal controlled ovarian hyperstimulation cycle for in vitro fertilization.
HP:0031067.definition_cn: 在体外受精过程中，经过看似正常的控制性卵巢刺激周期后未能成功采集卵母细胞。

HP:0031069.name: Abnormal femoral torsion
HP:0031069.definition: Femoral torsion, also known as femoral rotation or femoral version, refers to the twist between the proximal and distal parts of the femur on the transverse plane. Femoral anteversion averages between 30-40 degrees at birth, and between 8-14 degrees in adults. This term applies if the amount of femoral torsion deviates from this range.
HP:0031069.definition_cn: 股骨扭转，亦称股骨旋转或股骨版本，指的是股骨在横断面上近端与远端之间的扭转。出生时股骨前倾角平均为30-40度，成人则为8-14度。若股骨扭转角度偏离此范围，则适用此术语。

HP:0031071.name: Abnormal endocrine morphology
HP:0031071.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of an organ ofthe endocrine system.
HP:0031071.definition_cn: 内分泌系统器官结构的任何异常。

HP:0031072.name: Abnormal endocrine physiology
HP:0031072.definition: Any anomaly of the function of the endocrine system.

HP:0031073.name: Abnormal response to endocrine stimulation test
HP:0031073.definition: An anomalous response to a test that is designed to probe the function of the endocrine system.
HP:0031073.name_cn: 内分泌刺激试验异常反应
HP:0031073.definition_cn: 对旨在探测内分泌系统功能的测试出现异常反应。

HP:0031074.name: Abnormal response to ACTH stimulation test
HP:0031074.definition: An anomalous response to stimulation by administration of the adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH). ACTH stimulation normally stimulates the adrenal glands to release cortisol and adrenaline.
HP:0031074.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素刺激试验异常反应
HP:0031074.definition_cn: 对促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）刺激的异常反应。ACTH刺激通常促使肾上腺释放皮质醇和肾上腺素。

HP:0031075.name: Abnormal response to insulin tolerance test
HP:0031075.definition: An anomalous response to the insulin tolerance test (ITT), in which insulin is administered intravenously and blood glucose and potentially other compounds are measured at intervals. Insulin administration is intended to induce extreme hypoglycemia (bloodgluoce below 40 mg/dl), which in turn induces release of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) and growth hormone (GH). ACTH induces the adrenal gland to release cortisol, which together with GH opposes the action of insulin on the blood glucose level.
HP:0031075.name_cn: 胰岛素耐量试验异常反应
HP:0031075.definition_cn: 胰岛素耐量试验（Insulin Tolerance Test, ITT）中的异常反应，即通过静脉注射胰岛素，并间隔测量血糖及可能的其他化合物。胰岛素注射旨在诱发极度低血糖（血糖低于40 mg/dl），进而促使促肾上腺皮质激素（Adrenocorticotropic Hormone, ACTH）和生长激素（Growth Hormone, GH）的释放。ACTH促使肾上腺释放皮质醇，皮质醇与GH共同对抗胰岛素对血糖水平的作用。

HP:0031076.name: Impaired cortisol response to insulin stimulation test
HP:0031076.definition: Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the insulin tolerance test (ITT).
HP:0031076.name_cn: 胰岛素刺激试验中皮质醇反应受损
HP:0031076.definition_cn: 胰岛素耐受试验（ITT）中皮质醇水平未能充分（通过增加）作出反应。

HP:0031077.name: Abnormal response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0031077.definition: An anomalous response to the corticotropin releasing hormone (CRH) stimulation test. Normally,CRH is released by the hypothalamus to induce adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) release by the anterior pituitary. In the stimulation test, CRH is administered intravenously and ACTH and cortisol are measured at intervals.
HP:0031077.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素刺激试验异常反应
HP:0031077.definition_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素（CRH）刺激试验的异常反应。正常情况下，下丘脑释放CRH以诱导垂体前叶释放促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）。在刺激试验中，静脉注射CRH，并间隔测量ACTH和皮质醇水平。

HP:0031078.name: Impaired cortisol response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0031078.definition: Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test.
HP:0031078.name_cn: 促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素刺激试验中皮质醇反应受损
HP:0031078.definition_cn: 皮质醇水平对促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素刺激试验未能充分反应（未出现升高）。

HP:0031079.name: Impaired growth-hormone response to insulin stimulation test
HP:0031079.definition: Failure of growth hormone levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the insulin tolerance test (ITT).
HP:0031079.name_cn: 胰岛素刺激试验中生长激素反应受损
HP:0031079.definition_cn: 生长激素水平对胰岛素耐受试验（ITT）未能充分反应（未出现升高）。

HP:0031080.name: Abnormal response to glucagon stimulation test
HP:0031080.definition: An anomalous response to the glucagon stimulation test, which like the insulin tolerance test (ITT) stimulates the release of both adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) and growth hormone (GH).
HP:0031080.name_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验异常反应
HP:0031080.definition_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验的异常反应，类似于胰岛素耐量试验（ITT），可刺激促肾上腺皮质激素（ACTH）和生长激素（GH）的释放。

HP:0031081.name: Impaired cortisol response to glucagon stimulation test
HP:0031081.definition: Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the glucagon stimulation test.
HP:0031081.name_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验中皮质醇反应受损
HP:0031081.definition_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验中皮质醇水平未能充分（通过升高）反应。

HP:0031082.name: Impaired growth-hormone response to glucagon stimulation test
HP:0031082.definition: Failure of growth hormone levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the glucagon stimulation test.
HP:0031082.name_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验中生长激素反应受损
HP:0031082.definition_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验中生长激素水平未能充分反应（未升高）。

HP:0031083.name: Abnormal response to human chorionic gonadotrophin stimulation test
HP:0031083.definition: An anomalous response to intravenous stimulation by human chorionic gonadotrophin. Stimulation with hCG stimulates testicular Leydig cells to secrete androgens via the Leydig hormone receptors.
HP:0031083.name_cn: 人绒毛膜促性腺激素刺激试验异常反应
HP:0031083.definition_cn: 人绒毛膜促性腺激素静脉刺激的异常反应。hCG刺激通过Leydig细胞激素受体促进睾丸Leydig细胞分泌雄激素。

HP:0031084.name: Excessive insulin response to glucagon test
HP:0031084.definition: An abnormally high increase in insulin levels following a glucagon stimulation test.
HP:0031084.name_cn: 胰高血糖素试验中胰岛素反应过度
HP:0031084.definition_cn: 胰高血糖素刺激试验后胰岛素水平异常升高。

HP:0031085.name: Decreased circulating prealbumin concentration
HP:0031085.definition: Concentration of prealbumin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Prealbumin, also known as transthyretin, has a half-life in plasma of about 2 days, much shorter than that of albumin. Prealbumin is therefore more sensitive to changes in protein-energy status than albumin, and its concentration closely reflects recent dietary intake rather than overall nutritional status.
HP:0031085.name_cn: 循环前白蛋白浓度降低
HP:0031085.definition_cn: 血清前白蛋白浓度低于正常值下限。前白蛋白，亦称转甲状腺素蛋白，其血浆半衰期约为2天，远短于白蛋白。因此，前白蛋白对蛋白质-能量状态变化的敏感性高于白蛋白，其浓度更能反映近期膳食摄入情况而非整体营养状况。

HP:0031086.name: Ectopic ovary
HP:0031086.definition: Undescended or ectopic ovaries are characterized by the attachment of the upper pole of the ovary to an area above the level of the common iliac vessels.
HP:0031086.definition_cn: 未降卵巢或异位卵巢的特征是卵巢上极附着于髂总血管水平以上的区域。

HP:0031087.name: Absent pubertal growth spurt
HP:0031087.definition: The abrupt and transient increase in the annual growth rate normally observed in adolescent individuals does not occur.
HP:0031087.definition_cn: 青春期个体通常观察到的年生长速率的突发性和短暂性增加未出现。

HP:0031089.name: Palatal edema
HP:0031089.definition: Swelling related to fluid accumulation within the palate.
HP:0031089.definition_cn: 与腭部液体潴留相关的水肿。

HP:0031090.name: Finger dactylitis
HP:0031090.definition: Fingers appear swollen and plump owing to inflammation of the complete finger.
HP:0031090.definition_cn: 由于全指炎症导致手指出现肿胀和丰满。

HP:0031091.name: Toe dactylitis
HP:0031091.definition: Toes appear swollen and plump owing to inflammation of the complete toe.
HP:0031091.definition_cn: 由于足趾整体炎症反应，足趾呈现肿胀及饱满外观。

HP:0031092.name: Spindle-shaped finger
HP:0031092.definition: Swelling of the hand at the knuckles, that gives the fingers a spindle shape (i.e., a round stick with tapered end and a broader base).
HP:0031092.definition_cn: 掌指关节处的手部肿胀，导致手指呈梭形（即末端渐细、基部较宽的圆棒状）。

HP:0031093.name: Abnormal breast morphology
HP:0031093.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the breast.

HP:0031094.name: Abnormal breast physiology
HP:0031094.definition: Any anomaly of the function of the breast.

HP:0031095.name: Abnormal humerus morphology
HP:0031095.definition: Any structural anomaly of the structure of the humerus (i.e., upper arm bone).
HP:0031095.definition_cn: 肱骨结构异常（即上臂骨结构异常）。

HP:0031096.name: Delayed vertebral ossification
HP:0031096.definition: A decrease in the amount of mineralized bone in one or more vertebrae compared with that expected for a given developmental age.
HP:0031096.definition_cn: 与特定发育年龄预期值相比，一个或多个椎体矿化骨量减少。

HP:0031097.name: Abnormal thyroid-stimulating hormone level
HP:0031097.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland.
HP:0031097.name_cn: 甲状腺刺激激素水平异常
HP:0031097.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常水平的促甲状腺激素（TSH）的异常，该激素由垂体前叶分泌并刺激甲状腺功能。

HP:0031098.name: Decreased thyroid-stimulating hormone level
HP:0031098.definition: Reduced amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland.
HP:0031098.name_cn: 促甲状腺激素水平降低
HP:0031098.definition_cn: 促甲状腺激素（TSH）水平降低，该激素由垂体前叶分泌，具有刺激甲状腺功能的作用。

HP:0031099.name: Abnormal circulating inhibin level
HP:0031099.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of inhibins, which are heterodimeric protein hormones secreted by granulosa cells of the ovary in females and Sertoli cells of the testis in males. Inhibins suppress the secretion of pituitary follicle-stimulating hormone.
HP:0031099.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常浓度的抑制素（inhibins）的情况，抑制素是由女性卵巢颗粒细胞（granulosa cells）和男性睾丸支持细胞（Sertoli cells）分泌的异二聚体蛋白激素（heterodimeric protein hormones）。抑制素通过抑制垂体促卵泡激素（pituitary follicle-stimulating hormone, FSH）的分泌来发挥其生理作用。

HP:0031100.name: Decreased circulating inhibin B concentration
HP:0031100.definition: The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0031100.definition_cn: 血清中抑制素B浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0031101.name: Abnormal circulating antimullerian hormone concentration
HP:0031101.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the antimullerian hormone, a peptide produced by the granulosa cells of follicles. Anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH), also known as Mullerian inhibiting substance, is produced by the granulosa cells of small antral follicles of the ovary. AMH has an inhibiting role in the ovary, contributing to follicular arrest. AMH levels in women are low until the age of 8, rise rapidly until puberty and decline steadily from the age of 25 until menopause, when AMH production ceases.
HP:0031101.name_cn: 异常循环抗缪勒管激素浓度
HP:0031101.definition_cn: 任何偏离抗缪勒管激素（Anti-Mullerian Hormone, AMH）正常范围的情况，该激素是由卵泡颗粒细胞产生的一种肽类物质。抗缪勒管激素（AMH），也称为缪勒管抑制物质，由卵巢小窦卵泡的颗粒细胞产生。AMH在卵巢中具有抑制作用，有助于卵泡停滞。女性在8岁之前AMH水平较低，青春期前迅速上升，25岁后稳步下降，直至绝经期停止产生。

HP:0031102.name: Increased circulating antimullerian hormone concentration
HP:0031102.definition: An elevation above the normal range of the antimullerian hormone in the circulation.
HP:0031102.name_cn: 循环中抗缪勒管激素浓度升高
HP:0031102.definition_cn: 循环中抗缪勒管激素水平高于正常范围。

HP:0031103.name: Decreased circulating antimullerian hormone circulation
HP:0031103.definition: A reduction below the normal range of the antimullerian hormone in the circulation.
HP:0031103.name_cn: 循环抗缪勒管激素水平降低
HP:0031103.definition_cn: 循环中抗缪勒管激素水平低于正常范围。

HP:0031104.name: Insulin receptor antibody positivity
HP:0031104.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the insulin receptor.
HP:0031104.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对胰岛素受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0031105.name: Abnormal uterus morphology
HP:0031105.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the uterus

HP:0031106.name: T-shaped uterus
HP:0031106.definition: An abnormality of the uterus characterized by a normal uterine outline but with an abnormal T-shaped uterine cavity with narrowing cavity due to thickened lateral walls with a correlation 2/3 uterine corpus and 1/3 cervix. The abnormlaity is said to resemble the letter T in hysterosalpingographic imaging.
HP:0031106.definition_cn: 子宫异常，其特征为子宫轮廓正常，但宫腔呈异常T形，由于侧壁增厚导致宫腔狭窄，宫体与宫颈的比例为2/3:1/3。该异常在子宫输卵管造影成像中形似字母T。

HP:0031107.name: Decreased fibular diameter
HP:0031107.definition: Reduced width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula.
HP:0031107.definition_cn: 腓骨横截面直径宽度减小。

HP:0031108.name: Triceps weakness
HP:0031108.definition: A lack of strength in the triceps muscle, which normally is responsible for extending (straightening) the elbow and mediating certain shoulder movements.
HP:0031108.definition_cn: 肱三头肌肌力减退，该肌肉通常负责肘关节伸展（伸直）及介导特定肩关节运动。

HP:0031109.name: Agalactia
HP:0031109.definition: Failure of secretion of milk following childbirth associated with an inability to breastfeed an infant.
HP:0031109.definition_cn: 产后泌乳功能障碍，导致无法进行母乳喂养。

HP:0031110.name: Twin-to-twin transfusion
HP:0031110.definition: As a result of sharing a single placenta, the blood supplies of monochorionic twin fetuses can become connected, so that they share blood circulation: although each fetus uses its own portion of the placenta, the connecting blood vessels within the placenta allow blood to pass from one twin to the other.Depending on the number, type and direction of the interconnecting blood vessels (anastomoses), blood can be transferred disproportionately from one twin (the donor) to the other (the recipient). This state of transfusion causes the donor twin to have decreased blood volume, retarding the donor's development and growth. The blood volume of the recipient twin is increased, which can strain the fetus's heart and eventually lead to heart failure.
HP:0031110.definition_cn: 由于共享单一胎盘，单绒毛膜双胎胎儿的血液供应可能相互连接，从而共享血液循环：尽管每个胎儿使用其自身的胎盘部分，但胎盘内的连接血管允许血液从一个胎儿流向另一个胎儿。根据相互连接血管（吻合支）的数量、类型和方向，血液可能不成比例地从一个胎儿（供血者）转移到另一个胎儿（受血者）。这种输血状态导致供血胎儿血容量减少，阻碍其发育和生长。受血胎儿的血容量增加，可能对胎儿心脏造成负担，最终导致心力衰竭。

HP:0031111.name: Cutaneous hamartoma
HP:0031111.definition: A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the skin.
HP:0031111.definition_cn: 皮肤错构瘤（由构成成分异常混合形成的组织畸形）。

HP:0031117.name: Purely bicuspid aortic valve
HP:0031117.definition: A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by two equal-sized cusps, with no raphe and only two commissures. There is a lateral arrangement of the free edge of the cusps. Note that this differs from some other forms of BAV in which there are three commissures and two of the three cusps are joined by a raphe forming two functional leaflets. This type of BAV often is associated with aortic stenosis.
HP:0031117.name_cn: 单纯性二叶式主动脉瓣
HP:0031117.definition_cn: 一种二叶式主动脉瓣（BAV）类型，其特征为两个大小相等的瓣叶，无融合嵴，仅有两个交界。瓣叶游离缘呈侧向排列。需注意，此类型与其他形式的BAV不同，后者具有三个交界，其中两个瓣叶通过融合嵴相连，形成两个功能性瓣叶。此类BAV常与主动脉瓣狭窄相关。

HP:0031118.name: Single raphe bicuspid aortic valve
HP:0031118.definition: A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of a single raphe that extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps, resulting in two leaflets of unequal size.
HP:0031118.definition_cn: 一种二叶式主动脉瓣（BAV），其特征为存在单一嵴，从连合处延伸至两个发育不全的联合瓣叶的自由缘，导致两个大小不等的瓣叶。

HP:0031119.name: Bicuspid aortic valve with right-left cusp fusion
HP:0031119.definition: A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the right and left cusps (RL fusion pattern). This results in two leaflefts with an anterior-posterior leaflet orientation (also called the typical pattern). There is thus one completely developed noncoronary cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped left and right coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure.
HP:0031119.name_cn: 二叶式主动脉瓣伴左右瓣叶融合
HP:0031119.definition_cn: 一种二叶式主动脉瓣（BAV）类型，其特征为右冠瓣与左冠瓣之间有一单一融合嵴（RL融合模式）。这导致形成两片瓣叶，呈前后瓣叶方向（也称为典型模式）。因此，存在一片完全发育的无冠瓣、两片完全发育的瓣膜交界，以及一片位于发育不全的左冠瓣与右冠瓣之间的融合嵴，延伸至相应的畸形交界处。

HP:0031120.name: Bicuspid aortic valve with right-noncoronary cusp fusion
HP:0031120.definition: A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the right and noncoronary cusps (RN fusion pattern). This results in two leaflets with right-left leaflet orientation (also called the atypical pattern). There is thus one completely developed left cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped right and noncoronary coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure.
HP:0031120.name_cn: 二叶式主动脉瓣伴右冠瓣-无冠瓣融合
HP:0031120.definition_cn: 一种二叶式主动脉瓣（BAV），其特征为右冠瓣与非冠瓣之间具有单一融合嵴（RN融合模式）。这导致形成具有左右瓣叶定向的两个瓣叶（也称为非典型模式）。因此，存在一个完全发育的左冠瓣、两个完全发育的连合部，以及一个位于发育不全的右冠瓣与非冠瓣之间的融合嵴，延伸至相应的畸形连合部。

HP:0031121.name: Bicuspid aortic valve with left-noncoronary cusp fusion
HP:0031121.definition: A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the left and noncoronary cusps (LN fusion pattern). There is thus one completely developed right cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped left and noncoronary coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure.
HP:0031121.name_cn: 二叶式主动脉瓣伴左-无冠瓣融合
HP:0031121.definition_cn: 一种二叶式主动脉瓣（BAV）类型，其特征为左冠瓣与非冠瓣之间单一融合嵴（LN融合模式）。因此，存在一个完全发育的右冠瓣、两个完全发育的瓣膜交界，以及一个位于发育不全的左冠瓣与非冠瓣之间的融合嵴，延伸至相应的畸形交界处。

HP:0031122.name: Two-raphe bicuspid aortic valve
HP:0031122.definition: A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of two raphes that each extend from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV has developmental anlagen of three cusps, commissures, and sinuses, but two commissures are more or less malformed and obliterated, giving rise to a raphe, a fibrous ridge, which extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV is typically associated with a high degree of aortic stenosis.
HP:0031122.definition_cn: 一种二叶式主动脉瓣（BAV），其特征为存在两条嵴，每条嵴从连合处延伸至两个发育不全的联合瓣叶的自由缘。此类BAV具有三个瓣叶、连合处和窦的发育原基，但两个连合处存在不同程度的畸形和闭塞，形成一条纤维性嵴，从连合处延伸至两个发育不全的联合瓣叶的自由缘。此类BAV通常与严重的主动脉瓣狭窄相关。

HP:0031123.name: Recurrent gastroenteritis
HP:0031123.definition: Increased susceptibility to gastroenteritis, an infectious inflammationof the stomach and small intestines manifested by signs and symptoms such as diarheas and abdominal pain, as manifested by recurrent episodes of gastroenteritis.
HP:0031123.definition_cn: 对胃肠炎的易感性增加，胃肠炎是一种由感染引起的胃和小肠炎症，表现为腹泻和腹痛等症状和体征，具体表现为反复发作的胃肠炎。

HP:0031124.name: Decreased platelet thromboxane A2 receptor
HP:0031124.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of thromboxane A2 receptor that is stimulated by thromboxane A2 (TBXA2).
HP:0031124.name_cn: 血小板血栓素A2受体减少
HP:0031124.definition_cn: 由血栓素A2（TBXA2）刺激的血栓素A2受体在细胞膜上的浓度降低。

HP:0031125.name: Decreased platelet alpha-2A-adrenergic receptor
HP:0031125.definition: Decreased cell membrane concentration of alpha-2A adrenergic receptor that is stimulated by epinephrine.
HP:0031125.name_cn: 血小板α-2A肾上腺素能受体减少
HP:0031125.definition_cn: 肾上腺素刺激的α-2A肾上腺素能受体在细胞膜上的浓度降低。

HP:0031126.name: Impaired clot retraction
HP:0031126.definition: Platelets contain contractile proteins (actin and myosin) that induce clot retraction. As the platelets contract, they pull on the surrounding fibrin strands, squeezing serum form the mass, compacting the clot and drawing the ruptured edges of the blood vessel more closely together. Clot retraction is directly proportional to the platelet count and inversely proportional to the fibrinogen concentration.
HP:0031126.definition_cn: 血小板含有收缩蛋白（肌动蛋白和肌球蛋白），可诱导血块回缩。当血小板收缩时，它们会牵拉周围的纤维蛋白丝，从血块中挤出血清，使血块更加致密，并将血管破裂的边缘拉得更近。血块回缩与血小板计数成正比，与纤维蛋白原浓度成反比。

HP:0031127.name: Impaired convulxin-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0031127.definition: Abnormal response to convulxin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of convulxin.
HP:0031127.name_cn: 受损的康维素诱导的血小板聚集
HP:0031127.definition_cn: 对康维辛的异常反应表现为在添加康维辛后血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0031128.name: Impaired collagen-related peptide-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0031128.definition: Abnormal response to collagen-related peptide (CRP) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of CRP.
HP:0031128.name_cn: 胶原相关肽诱导的血小板聚集受损
HP:0031128.definition_cn: 对胶原相关肽（CRP）的异常反应，表现为添加CRP后血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0031129.name: Impaired phorbol myristate acetate-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0031129.definition: Abnormal response to phorbol myristate acetate (PMA) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of PMA.
HP:0031129.name_cn: 乙酸肉豆蔻佛波酯诱导的血小板聚集受损
HP:0031129.definition_cn: 对佛波醇肉豆蔻酸酯（PMA）的异常反应，表现为添加PMA后血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0031130.name: Impaired calcium ionophore-induced platelet aggregation
HP:0031130.definition: Abnormal response to calcium Ionophore (such as A23187) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of the ionophore.
HP:0031130.name_cn: 钙离子载体诱导的血小板聚集受损
HP:0031130.definition_cn: 对钙离子载体（如A23187）的异常反应，表现为添加离子载体后血小板聚集减少或缺失。

HP:0031131.name: Abnormal platelet phosphatidylserine exposure
HP:0031131.definition: An abnormality of phosphatidylserine (PS) on activated platelets. PS is normally located on the cytoplasmic face of the resting platelet membrane but appears on the plasma-oriented surface of discrete membrane vesicles that derive from activated platelets. Thrombin, the central molecule of coagulation, is produced from prothrombin by a complex (prothrombinase) between factor Xa and its protein cofactor (factor V(a)) that forms on platelet-derived membranes. This complex enhances the rate of activation of prothrombin to thrombin by roughly 150,000 fold relative to factor X(a) in solution. The negatively charged surface of PS-containing platelet-derived membranes is at least partly responsible for this rate enhancement.
HP:0031131.name_cn: 异常血小板磷脂酰丝氨酸暴露
HP:0031131.definition_cn: 活化血小板上的磷脂酰丝氨酸（PS）异常。PS通常位于静息血小板膜的胞质面，但在源自活化血小板的离散膜囊泡的面向血浆的表面出现。凝血的核心分子凝血酶由凝血酶原通过因子Xa与其蛋白辅因子（因子V(a)）在血小板来源的膜上形成的复合物（凝血酶原酶复合物）产生。该复合物将凝血酶原激活为凝血酶的速率相对于溶液中的因子X(a)提高了约150,000倍。含PS的血小板来源膜的负电荷表面至少部分负责这种速率增强。

HP:0031132.name: Impaired annexin V binding to platelet phosphatidylserine
HP:0031132.definition: Reduced binding of annexin V to platelet membrane, which is mediated by exposed phosphatidylserine. This can be measured by flow cytometry.
HP:0031132.name_cn: 膜联蛋白V与血小板磷脂酰丝氨酸结合受损
HP:0031132.definition_cn: 膜联蛋白V与血小板膜结合减少，该过程由暴露的磷脂酰丝氨酸介导。可通过流式细胞术进行检测。

HP:0031133.name: Increased annexin V binding to platelet phosphatidylserine
HP:0031133.definition: Elevated binding of annexin V to platelet membrane, which is mediated by exposed phosphatidylserine. This can be measured by flow cytometry.
HP:0031133.name_cn: 膜联蛋白V与血小板磷脂酰丝氨酸结合增加
HP:0031133.definition_cn: 膜联蛋白V与血小板膜的结合增加，该过程由暴露的磷脂酰丝氨酸介导。可通过流式细胞术进行检测。

HP:0031134.name: Cor triatriatum sinister
HP:0031134.definition: A developmental anomaly of the heart characterized by the presence of three atria because the left atrium is divided by an abnormal septum.
HP:0031134.definition_cn: 一种心脏发育异常，其特征为存在三个心房，这是由于左心房被异常间隔分隔所致。

HP:0031135.name: Triggered by physical trauma
HP:0031135.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a trauma (injury to tissue).
HP:0031135.definition_cn: 适用于由创伤（组织损伤）暴露引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0031136.name: Decreased acrosin in sperm head
HP:0031136.definition: A reduced amount of the enzyme acrosin in the sperm head acrosome. The acrosome is an organelle in the anterior half of the head of spermatozoa, and acrosin is a protease that contributes to the digestation of the zona pellucida in the fertilization process.
HP:0031136.name_cn: 精子头部顶体酶活性降低
HP:0031136.definition_cn: 精子头部顶体中顶体酶含量减少。顶体是位于精子头部前半部分的细胞器，顶体酶是一种蛋白酶，在受精过程中参与透明带的消化。

HP:0031137.name: Storage in hepatocytes
HP:0031137.definition: Hepatocytes (liver parenchymal cells) exhibit a bloated appearance because of expansion of the cytoplasm by accumulated material.
HP:0031137.definition_cn: 肝细胞（肝脏实质细胞）由于胞质内物质积聚而呈现肿胀外观。

HP:0031138.name: Abnormal circulating B-type natriuretic peptide concentration
HP:0031138.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP).
HP:0031138.name_cn: 异常循环B型利钠肽浓度
HP:0031138.definition_cn: B型钠尿肽（BNP）循环浓度的异常偏离。

HP:0031139.name: Frog-leg posture
HP:0031139.definition: A type of rest posture in an infant that indicated a generalized reduction in muscle tone. The hips are flexed and the legs are abducted to an extent that causes the lateral thigh to rest upon the supporting surface. This posture is said to resemble the legs of a frog.
HP:0031139.definition_cn: 一种婴儿休息体位，提示全身性肌张力减退。髋关节屈曲，下肢外展至大腿外侧接触支撑面。此体位被称为“蛙腿样姿势”。

HP:0031140.name: Abnormal liver sonography
HP:0031140.definition: An abnormal appearance of the liver or any of its components on sonography (ultrasound).
HP:0031140.definition_cn: 肝脏或其任何组成部分在超声检查（超声波）中呈现异常表现。

HP:0031141.name: Increased hepatic echogenicity
HP:0031141.definition: Increased echogenicity of liver tissue on sonography, manifested as an increased amount of white on the screen of the sonography device.
HP:0031141.definition_cn: 超声检查中肝组织回声增强，表现为超声设备屏幕上白色区域增多。

HP:0031142.name: Abnormal hepatic echogenicity
HP:0031142.definition: Any deviation from the normal degree of echogenicity of the liver on sonography. Echogenicity refers to the ability of a tissue to reflect or transmit ultrasound waves in the context of surrounding tissues. Whenever there is an interface of structures with different echogenicities, a visible difference in contrast will be apparent on the screen. Based on echogenicity, a structure can be characterized as hyperechoic (white on the screen), hypoechoic (gray on the screen) and anechoic (black on the screen).
HP:0031142.definition_cn: 肝脏超声检查中任何偏离正常回声强度的异常表现。回声强度（Echogenicity）是指组织在周围组织背景下反射或透射超声波的能力。当不同回声强度的结构界面存在时，屏幕上将显现出明显的对比度差异。根据回声强度，结构可被描述为高回声（屏幕上呈白色）、低回声（屏幕上呈灰色）和无回声（屏幕上呈黑色）。

HP:0031143.name: Decreased hepatic echogenicity
HP:0031143.definition: Reduced echogenicity of liver tissue on sonography, manifested as an increased amount of black on the screen of the sonography device.
HP:0031143.definition_cn: 超声检查中肝组织回声减低，表现为超声设备屏幕上黑色区域增多。

HP:0031144.name: Coarsened hepatic echotexture
HP:0031144.definition: The appearance of the liver in sonographic images is normally uniform. This term applies when there is an irregular or non-uniform appearance of the liver parenchyma in liver sonography.
HP:0031144.definition_cn: 肝脏在超声图像中的表现通常为均匀一致。当肝脏超声检查中肝实质呈现不规则或非均匀表现时，使用此术语。

HP:0031145.name: Starry sky appearance on hepatic sonography
HP:0031145.definition: An abnormal echotexture visible in liver ultrasound manifesting as a diffuse hyperechoic liver echotexture with multiple, small hypoechoic lesions. The appearance is said to resemble a starry sky (multiple white spots on a dark background).
HP:0031145.name_cn: 肝超声检查中的星夜征象
HP:0031145.definition_cn: 肝脏超声检查中可见异常回声结构，表现为弥漫性高回声肝实质伴多发小低回声病灶。其外观被描述为“星空征”（在暗背景下出现多个白点）。

HP:0031146.name: Impaired oral bolus formation
HP:0031146.definition: An abnormality of swallowing characterized by reduced tongue coordination to form bolus after chewing. Food material spreads over the oral cavity instead of being concentrated into a bolus that is easily swallowed.
HP:0031146.definition_cn: 咀嚼后舌部协调性降低导致食团形成障碍的吞咽异常。食物物质在口腔内分散，而非集中形成易于吞咽的食团。

HP:0031150.name: Vitreomacular adhesion
HP:0031150.definition: Perifoveal vitreous separation with remaining vitreomacular attachment and unperturbed foveal morphologic features. It is an OCT finding that is almost always the result of normal vitreous aging, which may lead to pathologic conditions.
HP:0031150.definition_cn: 黄斑旁玻璃体分离伴残留的玻璃体黄斑附着及未受干扰的黄斑形态特征。这是一种光学相干断层扫描（OCT）发现，几乎总是正常玻璃体老化的结果，可能导致病理状况。

HP:0031151.name: Vitreomacular traction
HP:0031151.definition: Vitreomacular traction is characterized by anomalous posterior vitreous detachment accompanied by anatomic distortion of the fovea, which may include pseudocysts, macular schisis, cystoid macular edema, and subretinal fluid. Vitreomacular traction can be subclassified by the diameter of vitreous attachment to the macular surface as measured by OCT, with attachment of 1500 micrometers or less defined as focal and attachment of more than 1500 micrometers as broad.
HP:0031151.definition_cn: 玻璃体黄斑牵拉症的特征是异常的后玻璃体脱离伴随黄斑中心凹的解剖学变形，可能包括假性囊肿、黄斑劈裂、囊样黄斑水肿和视网膜下液。玻璃体黄斑牵拉症可根据光学相干断层扫描（OCT）测量的玻璃体与黄斑表面附着直径进行亚分类，附着直径在1500微米或以下定义为局灶性，附着直径超过1500微米则定义为广泛性。

HP:0031152.name: Full-thickness macular hole
HP:0031152.definition: Full-thickness macular hole (FTMH) is defined as a foveal lesion with interruption of all retinal layers from the internal limiting membrane to the retinal pigment epithelium. Full-thickness macular hole is primary if caused by vitreous traction or secondary if directly the result of pathologic characteristics other than vitreomacular traction. Full-thickness macular hole is subclassified by size of the hole as determined by OCT and the presence or absence of vitreomacular traction.
HP:0031152.definition_cn: 全层黄斑裂孔（Full-thickness macular hole, FTMH）定义为从内界膜至视网膜色素上皮层的所有视网膜层中断的中央凹病变。全层黄斑裂孔若由玻璃体牵引引起则称为原发性，若直接由玻璃体黄斑牵引以外的病理特征引起则称为继发性。全层黄斑裂孔根据光学相干断层扫描（OCT）确定的裂孔大小以及是否存在玻璃体黄斑牵引进行亚分类。

HP:0031153.name: Membranous vitreous appearance
HP:0031153.definition: Vitreous humor of the eye displaying consisting of a vestigial gel in the retrolental space bounded by a convoluted membrane.
HP:0031153.definition_cn: 眼球玻璃体显示为由晶状体后间隙内的退化性凝胶组成，并由一曲折的膜所包绕。

HP:0031154.name: Beaded vitreous appearance
HP:0031154.definition: Vitreous humor of the eye displaying beaded bundles of irregular diameters.
HP:0031154.definition_cn: 玻璃体显示不规则直径的串珠状束。

HP:0031155.name: Increased Arden ratio of electrooculogram
HP:0031155.definition: An abnormal increase in the Arden ratio, which is the ratio between the light peak and the dark trough of the smoothed (physiologic) EOG record.
HP:0031155.definition_cn: Arden比值异常增高，即平滑（生理性）眼电图（EOG）记录中光峰与暗谷之间的比值异常升高。

HP:0031156.name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein Ib
HP:0031156.definition: Decreased platelet cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein Ib.
HP:0031156.definition_cn: 血小板细胞膜糖蛋白Ib浓度降低。

HP:0031157.name: Carotid cavernous fistula
HP:0031157.definition: An abnormal connection between a carotid artery and the cavernous sinus.
HP:0031157.definition_cn: 颈动脉与海绵窦之间的异常连接。

HP:0031158.name: Widened atrophic scar
HP:0031158.definition: An atrophic scar (fibrous connective tissue resulting from incomplete healing of a wound) that has stretched (gotten wider), a manifestation of tissue fragility.
HP:0031158.definition_cn: 萎缩性瘢痕（由于伤口不完全愈合而形成的纤维结缔组织）发生扩张（变宽），是组织脆性的一种表现。

HP:0031159.name: Thinning of Descemet membrane
HP:0031159.definition: A reduction in the thickness of Descemet's membrane.

HP:0031160.name: Myelokathexis
HP:0031160.definition: Impaired egress of mature neutrophils from bone marrow causing neutropenia.
HP:0031160.definition_cn: 成熟中性粒细胞从骨髓中排出受损导致中性粒细胞减少症。

HP:0031161.name: Reduced brain glutamate level by MRS
HP:0031161.definition: An decrease in the level of glutamate (Glu) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0031161.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内谷氨酸水平降低
HP:0031161.definition_cn: 磁共振波谱分析（MRS）检测到脑内谷氨酸（Glu）水平降低。

HP:0031162.name: Impaired oropharyngeal swallow response
HP:0031162.definition: Delay or absence of the swallow response, reflexes triggered by the contact the food bolus makes with the anterior faucial pillars.
HP:0031162.definition_cn: 吞咽反应延迟或缺失，由食团与前腭弓接触引发的反射。

HP:0031163.name: Low femoral bone density
HP:0031163.definition: Reduced bone mineral density of the femur.

HP:0031164.name: Growth arrest lines
HP:0031164.definition: Growth arrest lines are alternating transverse rings of sclerosis at the metaphysis of a long bone.
HP:0031164.definition_cn: 生长停滞线是长骨干骺端交替出现的横向硬化环。

HP:0031165.name: Multifocal seizures
HP:0031165.definition: Seizures that start from several different areas of the brain (i.e., with multiple ictal onset locations).
HP:0031165.definition_cn: 起源于大脑多个不同区域的癫痫发作（即具有多个发作起始部位）。

HP:0031166.name: Eyelid myokymia
HP:0031166.definition: Involuntary, fine, continuous, undulating contractions of the eyelid.
HP:0031166.definition_cn: 眼睑不自主、细微、持续、波动的收缩。

HP:0031167.name: Triggered by ingestion of potassium-rich food
HP:0031167.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking foods rich in potassium.
HP:0031167.name_cn: 由摄入富含钾的食物引发
HP:0031167.definition_cn: 适用于因摄入富含钾的食物或饮料而诱发或引发的体征或症状。

HP:0031169.name: Postterm pregnancy
HP:0031169.definition: A pregnancy that extends to 42 weeks of gestation or beyond.

HP:0031170.name: Female fetal virilization
HP:0031170.definition: Fetal masculinization of female external genitalia.
HP:0031170.definition_cn: 女性外生殖器的胎儿男性化。

HP:0031171.name: Femoral spur
HP:0031171.definition: A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from the femur, often in the medial femoral neck.
HP:0031171.definition_cn: 起源于股骨的骨性突起（骨刺、骨赘），通常位于股骨颈内侧。

HP:0031172.name: Sectoral retinitis pigmentosa
HP:0031172.definition: A variant of retinitis pigmentosa in which there is a regional distribution of the retinal degeneration.
HP:0031172.name_cn: 节段性视网膜色素变性
HP:0031172.definition_cn: 一种视网膜色素变性的变异型，其特征为视网膜退行性病变呈区域性分布。

HP:0031173.name: Tibial spur
HP:0031173.definition: A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from the tibia.
HP:0031173.definition_cn: 起源于胫骨的骨性突起（骨刺，骨赘）。

HP:0031174.name: Double-layered patella
HP:0031174.definition: An anomaly of the patella characterized by two layers visible on lateral knee X-ray such that one layer is in front of the other in the sagittal orientation (See Figure 2A and 3B of PMID:12966518). This finding persists into adulthood.
HP:0031174.definition_cn: 髌骨异常，其特征为在膝关节侧位X线片上可见两层结构，其中一层在矢状位上位于另一层前方（参见PMID:12966518的图2A和3B）。此发现持续至成年期。

HP:0031175.name: Absent cervical vertebra
HP:0031175.definition: A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies of the cervical spine.
HP:0031175.definition_cn: 一种以颈椎一个或多个椎体发育不全为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0031176.name: Absent thoracic vertebra
HP:0031176.definition: A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies of the thoracic spine.
HP:0031176.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为胸椎一个或多个椎体发育不全。

HP:0031177.name: Finger flexor weakness
HP:0031177.definition: Reduced ability to flex (bend) the fingers. This can manifest as incomplete closure of the hand due to weakness in finger flexion.
HP:0031177.definition_cn: 手指屈曲（弯曲）能力减退。可表现为由于手指屈肌无力导致的手部不完全闭合。

HP:0031178.name: Fixed head retroflexion
HP:0031178.definition: Head is bent in the posterior direction in a permanent fashion.

HP:0031179.name: Nuchal rigidity
HP:0031179.definition: Resistance of the extensor muscles of the neck to being bent forwards (i.e., impaired neck flexion) as a result of muscle spasm of the extensor muscles of the neck. Nuchal rigidity is not a fixed rigidity. Nuchal rigidity has been used as a bedside test for meningism, although its sensitivity for this purpose has been debated.
HP:0031179.definition_cn: 颈部伸肌群因肌肉痉挛导致前屈阻力增加（即颈部屈曲受限）。颈强直并非固定性强直。颈强直已被用作脑膜刺激征的床边检查，尽管其敏感性尚存争议。

HP:0031180.name: Erythema migrans
HP:0031180.definition: An expanding erythematous (red) skin lesion, usually round or oval, by definition at least 5 cm in size (in largest diameter).
HP:0031180.definition_cn: 扩展性红斑性皮肤病变，通常呈圆形或椭圆形，根据定义其最大直径至少为5厘米。

HP:0031181.name: Necrolytic migratory erythema
HP:0031181.definition: Acral or periorificial lesions that evolve in recurrent crops, with an annular and migratory distribution.
HP:0031181.name_cn: 坏死松解性游走性红斑
HP:0031181.definition_cn: 肢端或口周病变，呈复发性簇状演变，具有环形和游走性分布。

HP:0031185.name: Increased circulating NT-proBNP concentration
HP:0031185.definition: An elevated level of circulating N-terminal part of the prohormone of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP).
HP:0031185.definition_cn: 循环中B型利钠肽原激素（BNP）的N末端部分水平升高。

HP:0031186.name: Abnormal circulating deoxycorticosterone level
HP:0031186.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of deoxycorticosterone in the blood. Deoxycorticosterone comprises 11-deoxycorticosterone and 21-deoxycorticosterone.
HP:0031186.name_cn: 异常循环脱氧皮质酮水平
HP:0031186.definition_cn: 血液中脱氧皮质酮浓度异常。脱氧皮质酮包括11-脱氧皮质酮和21-脱氧皮质酮。

HP:0031187.name: Abnormal circulating pregnenolone concentration
HP:0031187.definition: An abnormality of the concentration of pregnenolone in the blood.
HP:0031187.name_cn: 异常循环孕烯醇酮浓度
HP:0031187.definition_cn: 血液中孕烯醇酮浓度异常。

HP:0031188.name: Genital edema
HP:0031188.definition: A buildup of fluid that causes swelling in the soft tissues of the genital area.
HP:0031188.definition_cn: 生殖器区域软组织水肿导致的液体积聚。

HP:0031189.name: Wrist drop
HP:0031189.definition: A condition in which the affected individual cannot extend the wrist, which hangs flaccidly.
HP:0031189.definition_cn: 腕关节伸展功能障碍，表现为腕部松弛下垂。

HP:0031190.name: Superficial dermal perivascular inflammatory infiltrate
HP:0031190.definition: Numerous lymphocytes surrounding blood vessels in the superficial part of the dermis.
HP:0031190.name_cn: 浅表真皮血管周围炎性浸润
HP:0031190.definition_cn: 真皮浅层血管周围大量淋巴细胞浸润。

HP:0031191.name: Deep dermal perivascular inflammatory infiltrate
HP:0031191.definition: Numerous lymphocytes surrounding blood vessels in the deep part of the dermis.
HP:0031191.name_cn: 真皮深层血管周围炎性浸润
HP:0031191.definition_cn: 真皮深层血管周围大量淋巴细胞浸润。

HP:0031192.name: Abnormal morphology of left ventricular trabeculae
HP:0031192.definition: Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).
HP:0031192.definition_cn: 左心室内表面突出的肌性柱（心小梁，肉柱）的任何结构异常。

HP:0031193.name: Abnormal morphology of right ventricular trabeculae
HP:0031193.definition: Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the right ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).
HP:0031193.definition_cn: 右心室内表面突出的肌性小梁（心小梁、肉柱）的任何结构异常。

HP:0031194.name: Increased density of left ventricular trabeculae
HP:0031194.definition: An increased density (number and tightness) of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricles of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).
HP:0031194.definition_cn: 左心室内表面肌小梁（心肌小梁，肉柱）的密度（数量和紧密度）增加。

HP:0031195.name: Apical hypertrabeculation of the left ventricle
HP:0031195.definition: An increased number and density of the trabeculae in the apex (tip) of the left ventricle.
HP:0031195.name_cn: 左心室心尖部过度小梁化
HP:0031195.definition_cn: 左心室心尖部小梁数量及密度增加。

HP:0031196.name: Thin myocardium compact layer
HP:0031196.definition: Reduced thickness of the outer, dense layer of the myocardium.
HP:0031196.definition_cn: 心肌外层致密层厚度减少。

HP:0031197.name: Cellular urinary casts
HP:0031197.definition: A type of urinary cast composed of cells incorporated in a protein matrix. The cells can be those found in the urinary sediment (erythrocytes, leuklocytes, renal tubular epithelial cells).
HP:0031197.definition_cn: 一种由细胞嵌入蛋白质基质组成的尿沉渣管型。这些细胞可能包括尿沉渣中常见的细胞（红细胞、白细胞、肾小管上皮细胞）。

HP:0031198.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell casts
HP:0031198.definition: A type of cellular urinary cast composed of renal tubular epithelial cells.
HP:0031198.definition_cn: 一种由肾小管上皮细胞组成的细胞性管型。

HP:0031199.name: Acellular urinary casts
HP:0031199.definition: A type of urinary cast composed of a proteinaceous matrix without a substantial number of cells.
HP:0031199.definition_cn: 一种由蛋白质基质组成且无明显细胞成分的尿沉渣管型。

HP:0031200.name: Hyaline casts
HP:0031200.definition: A type of acellular urinary cast that are composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein, a fact which explains their low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends.
HP:0031200.definition_cn: 一种无细胞尿管型，仅由Tamm-Horsfall糖蛋白组成，这一特性解释了其低折射率。透明管型可呈现多种形态，包括蓬松型、致密型、卷曲型或皱褶型。透明管型质地光滑，通常具有平行的侧面、清晰的边缘和钝圆的两端。

HP:0031201.name: Granular casts
HP:0031201.definition: A type of acelluar casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented.
HP:0031201.definition_cn: 一种无细胞管型，其表面由颗粒组成，颗粒大小不一。这些颗粒可能具有显著的异质性，从细小（细颗粒管型）到粗大（粗颗粒管型），颜色可呈深色、透明或色素沉着。

HP:0031202.name: Waxy casts
HP:0031202.definition: A type of acellular urinary casts that display a melted wax (waxy) appearance, which gives them a high refractive index. They are frequently dark, with blunt extremities, indented and cracked edges and a large size, which is often several times that of other types of casts.
HP:0031202.definition_cn: 一种无细胞管型，呈现熔蜡样外观，具有高折射率。此类管型通常颜色较深，末端钝圆，边缘凹陷且裂纹明显，体积较大，常为其他类型管型的数倍。

HP:0031203.name: Fatty casts
HP:0031203.definition: A type of acellular urinary casts that contain lipid droplets, oval fat bodies or cholesterol crystals, and are often associated with the free forms of these elements. Their identification may require the use of polarized light microscopy, under which fatty particles embedded into the cast matrix appear as Maltese crosses.
HP:0031203.definition_cn: 一种无细胞尿管型，内含脂滴、卵圆脂肪体或胆固醇结晶，常与这些元素的游离形式相关。其识别可能需要使用偏光显微镜，在此镜下嵌入管型基质中的脂肪颗粒呈现为马耳他十字形。

HP:0031204.name: Bacterial cell casts
HP:0031204.definition: A type of urinary cast that contain bacteria. Bacterial casts can be difficult to identify and can be distinguished from other types of casts using phase contrast microscopy. Bacterial casts are diagnostic of acute pyelonephritis or intrinsic renal infection.
HP:0031204.definition_cn: 一种含有细菌的尿圆柱体。细菌圆柱体难以识别，可通过相差显微镜与其他类型的圆柱体区分。细菌圆柱体是急性肾盂肾炎或肾脏内感染的诊断依据。

HP:0031205.name: Reduced lysosomal acid lipase activity
HP:0031205.definition: Reduction in the activity of lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) in the blood. Lysosomal lipase activity is measured. LAL hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters derived from cell internalization of plasma lipoproteins.
HP:0031205.name_cn: 溶酶体酸性脂肪酶活性降低
HP:0031205.definition_cn: 血液中溶酶体酸性脂肪酶（Lysosomal Acid Lipase, LAL）活性降低。溶酶体脂肪酶活性被测定。LAL水解源自血浆脂蛋白细胞内化的胆固醇酯。

HP:0031206.name: Striatal T2 hyperintensity
HP:0031206.definition: Abnormally bright T2 signal from the striatum on brain magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:0031206.definition_cn: 脑磁共振成像显示纹状体T2信号异常高信号。

HP:0031207.name: Hepatic hemangioma
HP:0031207.definition: A congenital vascular malformation in the liver composed of masses of blood vessels that are atypical or irregular in arrangement and size.
HP:0031207.definition_cn: 肝脏先天性血管畸形，由排列和大小异常或不规则的血管团块组成。

HP:0031208.name: Increased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
HP:0031208.definition: An increased concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081). This alpha subunit is common to luteinizing hormone (LH) , follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) , thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), which are glycoprotein hormones composed of an identical alpha subunit together with a beta subunit that confers biological specificity. The alpha subunit is used as a marker for tumors that produce these hormones.
HP:0031208.name_cn: 垂体糖蛋白激素α亚单位水平升高
HP:0031208.definition_cn: 循环中糖蛋白激素α多肽浓度升高（NCBI基因1081）。该α亚单位与促黄体生成素（LH）、促卵泡激素（FSH）、促甲状腺激素（TSH）和人绒毛膜促性腺激素（hCG）共有，这些糖蛋白激素均由相同的α亚单位与赋予生物特异性的β亚单位组成。α亚单位被用作产生这些激素的肿瘤的标志物。

HP:0031209.name: Decreased circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
HP:0031209.definition: Reduction in the level of lipoprotein lipase in the blood.
HP:0031209.name_cn: 循环脂蛋白脂肪酶浓度降低
HP:0031209.definition_cn: 血液中脂蛋白脂肪酶水平降低。

HP:0031210.name: Abnormal circulating hyaluronic acid concentration
HP:0031210.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of hyaluronic acid in the blood.
HP:0031210.name_cn: 异常循环透明质酸浓度
HP:0031210.definition_cn: 血液中透明质酸浓度异常。

HP:0031211.name: Elevated cholesterol ester level
HP:0031211.definition: An elevated concentration of circulating cholesterol esters, which are fatty acid esters of cholesterol and make up about two-thirds of total plasma cholesterol.
HP:0031211.definition_cn: 循环中胆固醇酯浓度升高，胆固醇酯是胆固醇的脂肪酸酯，约占血浆总胆固醇的三分之二。

HP:0031213.name: Elevated circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
HP:0031213.definition: An increased level of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood. 17-hydroxyprogesterone is an intermediate steroid in the adrenal biosynthetic pathway from cholesterol to cortisol and is the substrate for steroid 21-hydroxylase.
HP:0031213.name_cn: 循环中17-羟孕酮浓度升高
HP:0031213.definition_cn: 血液中17-羟孕酮水平升高。17-羟孕酮是从胆固醇到皮质醇的肾上腺生物合成途径中的一种中间类固醇，是类固醇21-羟化酶的底物。

HP:0031214.name: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
HP:0031214.name_cn: 循环中脱氢表雄酮浓度降低

HP:0031215.name: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate concentration
HP:0031215.definition: A reduced concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood.
HP:0031215.name_cn: 循环中硫酸脱氢表雄酮浓度降低
HP:0031215.definition_cn: 血液中脱氢表雄酮硫酸盐浓度降低。

HP:0031216.name: Increased circulating progesterone
HP:0031216.definition: An elevated concentration of progesterone in the blood.

HP:0031217.name: Hot flashes
HP:0031217.definition: Sudden feelings of warmth that are generally most pronounced over the face, neck and chest.
HP:0031217.definition_cn: 突发性潮热感，通常以面部、颈部和胸部最为显著。

HP:0031218.name: Inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
HP:0031218.definition: A state of increased circulating antidiuretic hormone despite hyponatremia and hypo-osmolality with normal or increased plasma volume.
HP:0031218.name_cn: 抗利尿激素分泌异常综合征
HP:0031218.definition_cn: 在低钠血症和低渗透压状态下，尽管血浆容量正常或增加，仍出现循环抗利尿激素水平升高的状态。

HP:0031219.name: Reduced radioactive iodine uptake
HP:0031219.definition: A decreased amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.
HP:0031219.definition_cn: 放射性碘摄取试验（RAIU）显示摄取量减少，该试验利用放射性碘同位素测量甲状腺从血液中吸收的碘量。放射性标记物在给药后4-6小时进行测量，在某些情况下还需在24小时后进行测量。

HP:0031220.name: Increased radioactive iodine uptake
HP:0031220.definition: An elevated amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.
HP:0031220.definition_cn: 放射性碘摄取试验（RAIU）显示摄取量升高，该试验利用放射性碘同位素测量甲状腺从血液中吸收的碘量。放射性标记物在给药后4-6小时进行测量，在某些情况下还需在24小时后进行测量。

HP:0031221.name: Abnormal radioactive iodine uptake test result
HP:0031221.definition: Any deviation from normal in the amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.
HP:0031221.name_cn: 放射性碘摄取试验结果异常
HP:0031221.definition_cn: 放射性碘摄取率（RAIU）测试中摄取量的任何异常，该测试利用放射性碘同位素来测量甲状腺从血液中吸收的碘量。放射性标记物在给药后4-6小时进行测量，在某些情况下也在24小时后进行测量。

HP:0031222.name: Increased circulating thyroxine-binding globulin level
HP:0031222.definition: An elevated concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood.
HP:0031222.name_cn: 循环中甲状腺素结合球蛋白水平升高
HP:0031222.definition_cn: 血液中甲状腺素结合球蛋白（Thyroxine-Binding Globulin, TBG）浓度升高。

HP:0031223.name: Focal pancreatic islet hyperplasia
HP:0031223.definition: Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans that affects only certain regions of the pancreas and not others.
HP:0031223.definition_cn: 胰岛朗格汉斯细胞增生症，仅累及胰腺特定区域而非全胰腺。

HP:0031224.name: Diffuse pancreatic islet hyperplasia
HP:0031224.definition: Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans with a generalized distribution.
HP:0031224.definition_cn: 胰岛（Langerhans岛）增生，呈弥漫性分布。

HP:0031225.name: Intrapulmonary shunt
HP:0031225.definition: Blood flow through a region of the lung in which little or no ventilation takes place, resulting in reduced oxygenation of the blood leaving the lungs.
HP:0031225.definition_cn: 肺内血流通过通气不足或无通气的区域，导致离开肺部的血液氧合作用降低。

HP:0031226.name: Perinephric fluid collection
HP:0031226.definition: An accumulation of fluid in one or more of the perinephric spaces, which consist of the subcapsular, perirenal, anterior and posterior pararenal spaces. This abnormality can be demonstrated by cross-sectional imaging, particularly computed tomography.
HP:0031226.definition_cn: 肾周间隙（包括肾包膜下、肾周、肾前和肾后间隙）内一处或多处液体积聚。该异常可通过横断面成像，尤其是计算机断层扫描（CT）进行显示。

HP:0031227.name: Nasopharyngeal teratoma
HP:0031227.definition: A teratoma arising in the nasopharyngeal region.

HP:0031228.name: Abnormal incisura morphology
HP:0031228.definition: An abnormal shape of the incisura, defined as the narrowed downward continuation of the conchal space bounded anteriorly by the borders of the tragus, posteriorly by the antitragus, and along its lower lateral margins and inferior boundary by the connection between the first two. The upper boundary is a somewhat arbitrary line crossing from the apices of the antitragus and the tragus.
HP:0031228.definition_cn: 切迹形态异常，定义为耳甲腔向下延续的狭窄部分，前界为耳屏边缘，后界为对耳屏，下外侧缘及下界为前两者之间的连接处。上界为一条从对耳屏和耳屏顶点穿过的相对任意的界线。

HP:0031229.name: Increased incisura length
HP:0031229.definition: The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is greater than that observed in the average population.
HP:0031229.definition_cn: 切迹从上缘到下缘的长度大于在普通人群中观察到的长度。

HP:0031230.name: Decreased incisura length
HP:0031230.definition: The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is less than that observed in the average population.
HP:0031230.definition_cn: 切迹从上缘到下缘的长度小于在普通人群中观察到的长度。

HP:0031231.name: Narrow incisura width
HP:0031231.definition: Width of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border less than that observed in the average population.
HP:0031231.definition_cn: 切迹从前缘到后缘的宽度小于在普通人群中观察到的平均值。

HP:0031232.name: Increased incisura width
HP:0031232.definition: Breadth of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border greater than that observed in the average population.
HP:0031232.definition_cn: 切迹从前缘到后缘的宽度大于普通人群的平均值。

HP:0031233.name: Horizontal inferior border of scapula
HP:0031233.definition: A morphological abnormality of the scapula in which there is a flat (horizontal) inferior edge of the scapula. The entire scapula is said to resemble a square, leading to the designation sqaring of the scapula (in Figure 1 of PMID:24706940 the scapulae have a roughly rectangular shape).
HP:0031233.definition_cn: 肩胛骨形态异常，表现为肩胛骨下缘呈扁平（水平）状。整个肩胛骨呈现方形，因此被称为肩胛骨方形化（在PMID:24706940的图1中，肩胛骨大致呈矩形）。

HP:0031234.name: Neutrophilic infiltration of the skin
HP:0031234.definition: A predominantly neutrophilic infiltrate of the dermis and or epidermis (i.e., a large number of neutrophils inferred to have migrated into the skin).
HP:0031234.definition_cn: 真皮和/或表皮以中性粒细胞为主的浸润（即推测大量中性粒细胞迁移至皮肤）。

HP:0031235.name: Predominantly epidermal neutrophilic infiltrate
HP:0031235.definition: Collection of neutrophils in the epidermis.
HP:0031235.name_cn: 主要表皮中性粒细胞浸润
HP:0031235.definition_cn: 表皮内中性粒细胞聚集。

HP:0031236.name: Predominantly dermal neutrophilic infiltrate
HP:0031236.definition: Collection of neutrophils in the dermis.
HP:0031236.name_cn: 主要皮肤中性粒细胞浸润
HP:0031236.definition_cn: 真皮层中性粒细胞聚集。

HP:0031237.name: Internally nucleated skeletal muscle fibers
HP:0031237.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of nuclei of sarcomeres with an internal localization. Individual muscle fibers are syncytia, formed by embryonic fusion of many myoblasts or later, myosatellite cells. Each muscle fiber contains many nuclei, peripherally positioned immediately adjacent to the sarcolemmal membrane. In healthy muscle only 3-5% of fibers contain nuclei that are located internally, within the cell, but many disease processes lead to internal nuclei.
HP:0031237.name_cn: 内部核化的骨骼肌纤维
HP:0031237.definition_cn: 肌节核内定位比例异常增加。单个肌纤维为合胞体，由胚胎期多个成肌细胞或后期的肌卫星细胞融合形成。每根肌纤维含有多个细胞核，通常位于紧邻肌膜的外周位置。在健康肌肉中，仅有3-5%的纤维含有位于细胞内部的细胞核，但许多疾病过程会导致核内定位现象。

HP:0031238.name: Necklace skeletal muscle fibers
HP:0031238.definition: A histological alteration of muscle fibers that resembles a necklace (necklace fibers). A substantial proportion of fibers (4-20% in PMID:19084976) show internalized nuclei aligned in a basophilic ring (necklace) at 3 micrometers beneath the sarcolemma. Ultrastructurally, such necklaces consist of myofibrils of smaller diameter, in oblique orientation, surrounded by mitochondria, sarcoplasmic reticulum and glycogen granules.
HP:0031238.definition_cn: 肌纤维的组织学改变，类似于项链（项链纤维）。相当比例的纤维（PMID:19084976中为4-20%）显示出内化的细胞核，排列在肌膜下3微米处的嗜碱性环（项链）中。在超微结构上，此类项链由直径较小的肌原纤维组成，呈斜向排列，周围环绕着线粒体、肌浆网和糖原颗粒。

HP:0031239.name: Extrafoveal choroidal neovascularization
HP:0031239.definition: A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 200 to 1500 micrometers from the center of the fovea.
HP:0031239.name_cn: 中心凹外脉络膜新生血管
HP:0031239.definition_cn: 一种脉络膜新生血管类型，其中新生血管区域最近边缘位于黄斑中心凹200至1500微米处。

HP:0031240.name: Juxtafoveal choroidal neovascularization
HP:0031240.definition: A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 1 to 199 micrometers from the center of the fovea.
HP:0031240.name_cn: 旁中心凹脉络膜新生血管
HP:0031240.definition_cn: 一种脉络膜新生血管类型，其中新生血管区域最近边缘位于黄斑中心凹中心1至199微米处。

HP:0031241.name: Subfoveal choroidal neovascularization
HP:0031241.definition: A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the area of neovascularization overlaps with the center of the fovea.
HP:0031241.name_cn: 黄斑下脉络膜新生血管形成
HP:0031241.definition_cn: 一种脉络膜新生血管类型，其中新生血管区域与黄斑中心凹中心重叠。

HP:0031242.name: Decreased circulating chylomicron concentration
HP:0031242.definition: Reduced plasma concentrations of chylomicrons, the large lipid droplet (up to 100 mm in diameter) of reprocessed lipid synthesized in epithelial cells of the small intestine and containing triacylglycerols, cholesterol esters, and several apolipoproteins.
HP:0031242.name_cn: 循环乳糜微粒浓度降低
HP:0031242.definition_cn: 乳糜微粒血浆浓度降低，乳糜微粒为小肠上皮细胞中重新合成的脂质大颗粒（直径可达100微米），含有三酰甘油、胆固醇酯及多种载脂蛋白。

HP:0031243.name: Decreased VLDL cholesterol concentration
HP:0031243.definition: A reduction in the amount of very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.
HP:0031243.name_cn: 极低密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度降低
HP:0031243.definition_cn: 血液中极低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平降低。

HP:0031244.name: Swollen lip
HP:0031244.definition: Enlargement of the lip typically due to fluid buildup or inflammation.
HP:0031244.definition_cn: 唇部肿大通常由液体潴留或炎症引起。

HP:0031245.name: Productive cough
HP:0031245.definition: A cough that produces phlegm or mucus.

HP:0031246.name: Nonproductive cough
HP:0031246.definition: A cough that does not produce phlegm or mucus.

HP:0031247.name: Whooping cough
HP:0031247.definition: A type of cough characterized by a burst of numerous and rapid coughs followed by a long inhaling effort that is accompanied by a high-pitched whooping sound produced by the inhalation of air.
HP:0031247.definition_cn: 一种以一系列快速而频繁的咳嗽为特征的咳嗽类型，随后伴随长时间的吸气努力，并在吸气时产生高调的哮吼音。

HP:0031248.name: Palmar pruritus
HP:0031248.definition: Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the palm(s) of the hand.
HP:0031248.definition_cn: 瘙痒症是一种引起患者搔抓欲望的痒感或不适感。该术语特指手掌部位异常增强的瘙痒感觉。

HP:0031249.name: Parageusia
HP:0031249.definition: A distortion of the sense of taste, often characterized by the sensation of a metallic taste.
HP:0031249.definition_cn: 味觉障碍，常表现为金属味觉异常。

HP:0031250.name: Lip fissure
HP:0031250.definition: A severe crack in a lip. A lip fissure may be painful, may bleed and often is a recurring manifestation.
HP:0031250.definition_cn: 严重的唇部裂口。唇裂可能伴有疼痛，可能出血，且常为反复发作的表现。

HP:0031251.name: Abnormal subclavian artery morphology
HP:0031251.definition: Any anomaly of a subclavian artery.

HP:0031252.name: Dilated left subclavian artery
HP:0031252.definition: Abnormally increased caliber of the left subclavian artery.
HP:0031252.definition_cn: 左侧锁骨下动脉管径异常增宽。

HP:0031253.name: Anomalous origin of left subclavian artery
HP:0031253.definition: Origin of the left subclavian artery from an anomalous anatomical location.
HP:0031253.name_cn: 左锁骨下动脉起源异常
HP:0031253.definition_cn: 左锁骨下动脉起源于解剖学异常位置。

HP:0031254.name: Thalamic arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031254.definition: An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the thalamus.
HP:0031254.definition_cn: 动静脉畸形是一种正常血管模式的破坏，其中动脉或小动脉直接连接到静脉收集系统，绕过任何毛细血管床。该术语指的是位于丘脑的动静脉畸形。

HP:0031255.name: Hypothalamic arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031255.definition: An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the hypothalamus.
HP:0031255.definition_cn: 下丘脑动静脉畸形是指动脉或小动脉直接连接至静脉收集系统，绕过任何毛细血管床，导致正常血管模式破坏的一种病变。

HP:0031256.name: Optic nerve arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031256.definition: An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the optic nerve.
HP:0031256.definition_cn: 动静脉畸形是指动脉或小动脉直接与静脉收集系统相连，绕过任何毛细血管床，导致正常血管模式的破坏。该术语指的是位于视神经的动静脉畸形。

HP:0031257.name: Arteriovenous malformation of the maxilla
HP:0031257.definition: An arteriovenous malformation is a disruption of the normal vascular pattern in which arteries or arterioles connect directly to the venous collection system, bypassing any capillary bed. This term refers to an arteriovenous malformation located in the maxilla.
HP:0031257.definition_cn: 动静脉畸形是指动脉或小动脉直接与静脉收集系统相连，绕过任何毛细血管床，导致正常血管模式中断。该术语指位于上颌骨的动静脉畸形。

HP:0031258.name: Delirium
HP:0031258.definition: A state of sudden and severe confusion.

HP:0031259.name: Oophoritis
HP:0031259.definition: An inflammation of the ovary or ovaries.

HP:0031260.name: Triangular tibia
HP:0031260.definition: A short, dysplastic tibia with a triangular shape. Instead of the normal shaft configuration of the tibia, the tibia forms a triangle with the longest side corresponding to the proximal-distal dimension, and the apex of the triangle directed laterally.
HP:0031260.definition_cn: 短小、发育不良的胫骨，呈三角形。胫骨未呈现正常的骨干形态，而是形成一个三角形，其最长边对应于近远侧维度，三角形的顶点指向外侧。

HP:0031261.name: Bladder polyp
HP:0031261.definition: An abnormal growth that projects from the mucous membrane of the urinary bladder.
HP:0031261.definition_cn: 膀胱黏膜异常增生性突起。

HP:0031263.name: Abnormal renal corpuscle morphology
HP:0031263.definition: Any anomalous structure of the renal corpuscle, which is the initial component of the nephron that filters blood. The renal corpuscle consists of a knot of capillaries (glomerulus) that is surrounded by a double-walled capsule (Bowman capsule) that opens into a renal tubule.
HP:0031263.definition_cn: 肾小球的任何异常结构，肾小球是肾单位中负责过滤血液的初始组成部分。肾小球由一团毛细血管（肾小球）组成，周围被双层壁的囊（鲍曼囊）所包围，该囊开口于肾小管。

HP:0031264.name: Abnormal Bowman capsule morphology
HP:0031264.definition: A structural anomaly of the double-walled capsule (Bowman capsule) that opens into a renal tubule.
HP:0031264.definition_cn: 肾小球囊（Bowman囊）结构异常，该囊开口于肾小管。

HP:0031265.name: Abnormal glomerular visceral epithelial cell morphology
HP:0031265.definition: Any structural anomaly of the podocyte, which is a highly specialized cell of the Bowman capsule and which forms multiple interdigitating foot processes. Podocytes are interconnected by slit diaphragms and cover the exterior basement membrane surface of the glomerular capillary.
HP:0031265.name_cn: 肾小球脏层上皮细胞形态异常
HP:0031265.definition_cn: 足细胞（podocyte）是肾小囊（Bowman capsule）中高度特化的细胞，其结构异常可表现为多个相互交错的足突（foot processes）的形态改变。足细胞通过裂隙隔膜（slit diaphragms）相互连接，并覆盖在肾小球毛细血管（glomerular capillary）的外基底膜（basement membrane）表面。

HP:0031266.name: Podocyte foot process effacement
HP:0031266.definition: An anomaly of podocyte morphology characterized by the loss of the interdigitating foot process pattern (generally called foot process effacement; FPE). The term FPE designates the loss of the usual interdigitating pattern of foot processes of neighboring podocytes, leading to relatively broad expanses of podocyte processes covering the glomerular basement membrane (GBM). It is widely viewed as a pathological derangement that is associated with leakage of macromolecules such as albumin through the glomerular filtration barrier.
HP:0031266.definition_cn: 足细胞形态异常，其特征为相互交错的足突模式丧失（通常称为足突消失；FPE）。术语FPE指相邻足细胞间通常相互交错的足突模式丧失，导致足细胞突起相对广泛地覆盖于肾小球基底膜（GBM）上。它被广泛视为一种病理紊乱，与白蛋白等大分子物质通过肾小球滤过屏障的渗漏相关。

HP:0031267.name: Abnormal CD69 upregulation upon TCR activation
HP:0031267.definition: Any abnormality in the upregulation of CD69 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR). Upregulation of CD69 is one of the earliest and most sensitive measures of antigen recognition in the periphery, and transient expression of CD69 is associated with positive selection in the thymus.
HP:0031267.definition_cn: T细胞通过T细胞受体（TCR）激活后，CD69上调的任何异常。CD69的上调是外周抗原识别最早且最敏感的指标之一，而CD69的瞬时表达与胸腺中的阳性选择相关。

HP:0031268.name: Decreased CD69 upregulation upon TCR activation
HP:0031268.definition: Reduced or impaired upregulation of CD69 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR).
HP:0031268.definition_cn: 通过T细胞受体（TCR）激活后，T细胞上CD69的上调减少或受损。

HP:0031269.name: Abnormal CD25 upregulation upon TCR activation
HP:0031269.definition: Any abnormality in the upregulation of CD25 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR). CD25 is the alpha chain of the IL2 receptor. Ligation of the T cell antigen receptor leads to the induction of CD25 expression.
HP:0031269.definition_cn: T细胞受体（TCR）激活后，T细胞上CD25上调的任何异常。CD25是IL2受体的α链。T细胞抗原受体的结合导致CD25表达的诱导。

HP:0031270.name: Decreased CD25 upregulation upon TCR activation
HP:0031270.definition: Decreased or impaired upregulation of CD25 on T cells after activation via the T cell receptor (TCR).
HP:0031270.definition_cn: T细胞受体（TCR）激活后，T细胞上CD25的上调减少或受损。

HP:0031271.name: Absent ankle pulse
HP:0031271.definition: The pulsation of the posterior tibial artery behind the internal malleolus, or of the dorsalis pedis artery, cannot be detected on physical examination.
HP:0031271.definition_cn: 内踝后方胫后动脉或足背动脉的搏动在体格检查中无法触及。

HP:0031272.name: Pulmonary arterial atherosclerosis
HP:0031272.definition: Accumulation of lipids and inflammatory cells along the inner walls of the pulmonary artery.
HP:0031272.definition_cn: 肺动脉内膜脂质及炎性细胞积聚。

HP:0031273.name: Shock
HP:0031273.definition: The state in which profound and widespread reduction of effective tissue perfusion leads first to reversible, and then if prolonged, to irreversible cellular injury.
HP:0031273.definition_cn: 有效组织灌注广泛且严重减少的状态，首先导致可逆性细胞损伤，若持续存在，则进一步发展为不可逆性细胞损伤。

HP:0031274.name: Hypovolemic shock
HP:0031274.definition: A state of shock characterized by decreased circulating blood volume in relation to total vascular capacity. This type of shock is characterized by a reduction of diastolic filling pressures.
HP:0031274.definition_cn: 一种以循环血容量相对于总血管容量减少为特征的休克状态。此类休克的特征是舒张期充盈压降低。

HP:0031275.name: Distributive shock
HP:0031275.definition: A hyperdynamic process resulting from excessive vasodilatation. Impaired blood flow causes inadequate tissue perfusion, which can lead to end-organ damage
HP:0031275.definition_cn: 由于过度血管扩张引起的高动力过程。血流受损导致组织灌注不足，可能引发终末器官损伤。

HP:0031276.name: Obstructive shock
HP:0031276.definition: A type of shock characterized by inadequate cardiac preload due to obstructed venous return (e.g. pericardial tamponade, tension pneumothorax, abdominal compartment) or obstruction of arterial blood flow (e.g. pulmonary embolism).
HP:0031276.definition_cn: 一种以心脏前负荷不足为特征的休克类型，由于静脉回流受阻（如心包填塞、张力性气胸、腹腔间隔室综合征）或动脉血流阻塞（如肺栓塞）所致。

HP:0031278.name: Abnormal thoracic duct morphology
HP:0031278.definition: Any structural anomaly of the thoracic duct.

HP:0031279.name: Abnormal response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0031279.definition: An abnormal response to the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulation test. This test typically involves intravenous administration of GnRH followed by repeated blood sampling at various time points to measure the levels of luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH).
HP:0031279.name_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素刺激试验异常反应
HP:0031279.definition_cn: 对促性腺激素释放激素（GnRH）刺激试验的异常反应。该试验通常包括静脉注射GnRH，随后在不同时间点重复采集血液样本以测量黄体生成素（LH）和卵泡刺激素（FSH）的水平。

HP:0031280.name: Increased LH response to gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0031280.definition: An abnormally high amount of luteinizing hormone (LH) is released upon gonadotropin-releasing hormone stimulation test.
HP:0031280.name_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素刺激试验中黄体生成素反应增强
HP:0031280.definition_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素刺激试验中释放出异常高水平的黄体生成素（LH）。

HP:0031282.name: Malalignment of the great toenail
HP:0031282.definition: A lateral deviation of the nail plate of the great toe along the longitudinal axis due to the lateral rotation of the nail matrix. The nail plate grows out in ridges.
HP:0031282.definition_cn: 大趾甲板沿纵轴发生侧向偏斜，由甲母质侧向旋转所致。甲板呈脊状生长。

HP:0031283.name: Tufted hairs
HP:0031283.definition: The presence of tufts of 8-15 hairs that appear to emerge from a single follicular orifice.
HP:0031283.definition_cn: 存在8-15根毛发簇，似乎从单一毛囊口处生长。

HP:0031284.name: Flushing
HP:0031284.definition: Recurrent episodes of redness of the skin together with a sensation of warmth or burning of the affected areas of skin.
HP:0031284.definition_cn: 复发性皮肤红斑伴受累区域温热感或灼热感。

HP:0031285.name: Abnormal perifollicular morphology
HP:0031285.definition: Any structural anomaly in the areas surrounding the hair follicles.
HP:0031285.definition_cn: 毛囊周围区域的结构异常。

HP:0031287.name: Seborrheic keratosis
HP:0031287.definition: A raised growth on the skin of older individuals. The lesion usually is initially light tan and may darken to dark brown or nearly black. The consistent feature of seborrheic keratoses is their waxy, pasted-on or stuck-on look.
HP:0031287.definition_cn: 老年患者皮肤上的隆起性病变。该皮损最初通常呈浅棕色，可能逐渐加深至深棕色或接近黑色。脂溢性角化病的典型特征是其蜡样、粘贴或附着的外观。

HP:0031288.name: Cobblestone-like hyperkeratosis
HP:0031288.definition: The presence of verrucous, cobblestone-like papules and nodules in a region of skin that is said to have an appearance like that of cobblestones.
HP:0031288.definition_cn: 皮肤区域出现疣状、鹅卵石样丘疹和结节，其外观被描述为类似鹅卵石。

HP:0031290.name: Tuberous xanthoma
HP:0031290.definition: A type of xanthoma characterized by a nodular form. Tuberous xanthomas are firm subcutaneous nodules,whereby the overlying skin can have red or red-yellow color changes.
HP:0031290.definition_cn: 一种以结节形式为特征的黄色瘤。结节性黄色瘤为坚硬的皮下结节，其上覆皮肤可出现红色或红黄色改变。

HP:0031291.name: Ichthyosis follicularis
HP:0031291.definition: Ichthyosis follicularis is characterized by widespread non inflammatory thorn-like follicular projections. Dyskeratotic papules are most pronounced over the extensor extremities and scalp and are symmetrically distributed.
HP:0031291.definition_cn: 鱼鳞病样毛囊角化症的特征为广泛分布的非炎症性棘状毛囊突起。角化不良性丘疹在四肢伸侧和头皮最为明显，且呈对称性分布。

HP:0031292.name: Cutaneous abscess
HP:0031292.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the skin.
HP:0031292.definition_cn: 皮肤局限性脓液或坏死组织积聚。

HP:0031293.name: Digital pitting scar
HP:0031293.definition: Pinhole-sized concave depressions with hyperkeratosis in the skin of a finger or toe.
HP:0031293.definition_cn: 指（趾）皮肤出现针孔状凹陷伴角化过度。

HP:0031294.name: Hypoplastic right atrium
HP:0031294.definition_cn: 右心房发育不全，右心房过小。

HP:0031295.name: Left atrial enlargement
HP:0031295.definition: Increase in size of the left atrium.

HP:0031296.name: Atrial septal hypertrophy
HP:0031296.definition: An abnormal increase in the thickness of the atrial septum.

HP:0031297.name: Unroofed coronary sinus
HP:0031297.definition: Unroofed coronary sinus (CS) is a rare congenital cardiac anomaly in which there is partial (either focal or fenestrated) or complete absence of the roof of the CS, which results in a communication between the CS and the LA. Unroofed CS is the rarest type of atrial septal defect. It is often associated with persistent left superior vena cava (LSVC) and other forms of complex congenital heart disease, usually heterotaxia syndromes. The morphological types have been classified into 4 groups: Type I, completely unroofed with persistent LSVC; type II, completely unroofed without persistent LSVC; type III, partially unroofed mid portion; and type IV, partially unroofed terminal portion.
HP:0031297.definition_cn: 无顶冠状静脉窦（Unroofed Coronary Sinus, CS）是一种罕见的先天性心脏畸形，其特征为冠状静脉窦顶部部分（局灶性或筛孔状）或完全缺失，导致冠状静脉窦与左心房之间存在交通。无顶冠状静脉窦是最为罕见的房间隔缺损类型。该畸形常与永存左上腔静脉（Persistent Left Superior Vena Cava, LSVC）及其他复杂先天性心脏病（通常为异位综合征）相关。其形态学类型可分为四类：I型，完全无顶伴永存左上腔静脉；II型，完全无顶不伴永存左上腔静脉；III型，中部部分无顶；IV型，末端部分无顶。

HP:0031298.name: Coronary sinus enlargement
HP:0031298.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the coronary sinus.

HP:0031299.name: Elevated left atrial pressure
HP:0031299.definition: An abnormal increase in magnitude of the pressure in the left atrium.

HP:0031300.name: Abnormal circulating properdin level
HP:0031300.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of properdin in the blood.
HP:0031300.definition_cn: 血液中备解素浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0031301.name: Peripheral arterial calcification
HP:0031301.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall.
HP:0031301.definition_cn: 动脉壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031302.name: Lower extremity peripheral arterial calcification
HP:0031302.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the leg.
HP:0031302.definition_cn: 下肢血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031303.name: Femoral arterial calcification
HP:0031303.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the femoral artery.
HP:0031303.definition_cn: 股动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031304.name: Iliac arterial calcification
HP:0031304.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the iliac artery.
HP:0031304.definition_cn: 髂动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031305.name: Tibial arterial calcification
HP:0031305.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the tibial artery.
HP:0031305.definition_cn: 胫动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031306.name: Intracranial arterial calcification
HP:0031306.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in an artery that is located within the skull (intracranial).
HP:0031306.definition_cn: 颅内动脉壁内膜或中膜层钙盐和磷酸盐沉积导致的矿物质积聚。

HP:0031307.name: Internal carotid artery calcification
HP:0031307.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the internal carotid artery.
HP:0031307.definition_cn: 颈内动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层中钙和磷酸盐的沉积，伴随矿物质沉积。

HP:0031308.name: Vertebral artery calcification
HP:0031308.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the vertebral artery.
HP:0031308.definition_cn: 椎动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031309.name: Cerebral artery calcification
HP:0031309.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a cerebral artery.
HP:0031309.definition_cn: 脑动脉壁内膜或中膜层钙盐和磷酸盐沉积导致的矿物质积聚。

HP:0031310.name: Basilar artery calcification
HP:0031310.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the basilar artery.
HP:0031310.definition_cn: 基底动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031311.name: Middle cerebral artery calcification
HP:0031311.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the middle cerebral artery.
HP:0031311.definition_cn: 大脑中动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031313.name: Abdominal aortic calcification
HP:0031313.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in abdominal aorta.
HP:0031313.definition_cn: 腹主动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031314.name: Carotid artery calcification
HP:0031314.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a carotid artery.
HP:0031314.definition_cn: 颈动脉壁内膜或中膜层中钙和磷酸盐的沉积，伴有矿物质沉积。

HP:0031315.name: External carotid artery calcification
HP:0031315.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the external carotid artery.
HP:0031315.definition_cn: 颈外动脉血管壁内膜或中膜层矿物质沉积导致的钙和磷酸盐积聚。

HP:0031316.name: Abnormal ventricular myocardium morphology
HP:0031316.definition: A structural anomaly of the muscle layer of the heart wall of a cardiac ventricle.

HP:0031317.name: Fatty replacement of ventricular myocardial tissue
HP:0031317.definition: Presence of an increased amount of fat tissue within a cardiac ventricle with corresponding reduction of muscle tissue.
HP:0031317.name_cn: 心室心肌组织的脂肪替代
HP:0031317.definition_cn: 心室脂肪组织增多伴心肌组织相应减少。

HP:0031318.name: Myofiber disarray
HP:0031318.definition: A nonparallel arrangement of cardiac myocytes.

HP:0031319.name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophy
HP:0031319.definition: An increase in cell size, enhanced protein synthesis, and heightened organization of the sarcomere within cardiac myocytes.
HP:0031319.definition_cn: 心肌细胞肥大、蛋白质合成增强以及肌节组织化程度提高。

HP:0031320.name: Cardiomyocyte mitochondrial proliferation
HP:0031320.definition: An abnormal increase in the number of mitochondria per cardiac myocyte.
HP:0031320.definition_cn: 心肌细胞中线粒体数量的异常增加。

HP:0031321.name: Myocardial immune cell infiltration
HP:0031321.definition: An increase in the number of immune cells in myocardial tissue (which can be assumed to have migrated into the myocardium).
HP:0031321.definition_cn: 心肌组织中免疫细胞数量增加（可推测为迁移至心肌内）。

HP:0031322.name: Myocardial lymphocytic infiltration
HP:0031322.definition: An increase in the number of lymphocytes in myocardial tissue.
HP:0031322.definition_cn: 心肌组织中淋巴细胞数量增加。

HP:0031323.name: Myocardial eosinophilic infiltration
HP:0031323.definition: An increase in the number of eosinophils in myocardial tissue.
HP:0031323.name_cn: 心肌嗜酸性粒细胞浸润
