HP:0031323.definition_cn: 心肌组织中嗜酸性粒细胞数量增加。

HP:0031324.name: Myocardial multinucleated giant cells
HP:0031324.definition: The presence of extremely large cells with multiple nuclei. The so-called giant cells are thought to be of macrophage origin.
HP:0031324.definition_cn: 存在具有多个细胞核的极大细胞。所谓的巨细胞被认为来源于巨噬细胞。

HP:0031325.name: Myocardial granulomatous infiltrates
HP:0031325.definition: The presence of multiple granulomata (small nodular inflammatory lesions containing grouped mononuclear phagocytes) in the myocardium.
HP:0031325.definition_cn: 心肌内存在多个肉芽肿（由聚集的单核吞噬细胞组成的小结节性炎症病变）。

HP:0031326.name: Monoclonal light chain cardiac amyloidosis
HP:0031326.definition: A type of cardiac amyloidosis related to deposition of an immunoglobulin light chain. The current gold standard of amyloid typing is to determine the precursor protein using laser microdissection mass spectrometry.
HP:0031326.name_cn: 单克隆轻链心脏淀粉样变性
HP:0031326.definition_cn: 一种与免疫球蛋白轻链沉积相关的心脏淀粉样变性。目前淀粉样变分型的金标准是使用激光显微切割质谱法确定前体蛋白。

HP:0031327.name: Transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis
HP:0031327.definition: A type of cardiac amyloidosis related to deposition of transthyretin (TTR), which is identified by immunohistochemical staining.
HP:0031327.name_cn: 转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变性
HP:0031327.definition_cn: 一种与转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）沉积相关的心脏淀粉样变性，通过免疫组织化学染色进行鉴定。

HP:0031328.name: Perivascular cardiac fibrosis
HP:0031328.definition: A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in perivascular spaces.
HP:0031328.definition_cn: 一种以血管周围空间过度弥漫性胶原沉积为特征的心肌纤维化类型。

HP:0031329.name: Interstitial cardiac fibrosis
HP:0031329.definition: A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in interstitial spaces.
HP:0031329.definition_cn: 一种以间质内弥漫性胶原过度沉积为特征的心肌纤维化类型。

HP:0031330.name: Perivascular myocardial immune cell infiltration
HP:0031330.definition: An increase in the number of immune cells in myocardial tissue concentrated in the spaces surrounding blood vessels.
HP:0031330.name_cn: 血管周围心肌免疫细胞浸润
HP:0031330.definition_cn: 心肌组织中免疫细胞数量增加，主要集中在血管周围间隙。

HP:0031331.name: Abnormal cardiomyocyte morphology
HP:0031331.definition: Any structural anomaly of cardiomyocytes, which are terminally differentiated muscle cells in the heart that are interconnected end to end by gap junctions, which allows coordinated contraction of heart tissue.
HP:0031331.definition_cn: 心肌细胞（终末分化的心脏肌肉细胞）的任何结构异常，这些细胞通过间隙连接（gap junctions）端对端相互连接，从而实现心脏组织的协调收缩。

HP:0031332.name: Cardiomyocyte degeneration
HP:0031332.definition: Deterioration of cardiomyocyte characterized by abnormal features such as loss of myofilaments, occurrence of cellular sequestration, decreased mitochondrial sizes and cellular debris.
HP:0031332.definition_cn: 心肌细胞退行性变，其特征为异常表现，包括肌丝丧失、细胞隔离现象、线粒体体积减小及细胞碎片形成。

HP:0031333.name: Myocardial sarcomeric disarray
HP:0031333.definition: A disruption of the structure of the sarcomeres of cardiomyocytes. The sarcomere is the repeating unit between two Z lines comprised largely of myosin and actin that mediates contractility, and normally sarcomeres are aligned with the long axis of cells, with the Z bands being in register throughout the length of the cardiac myocytes.
HP:0031333.definition_cn: 心肌细胞肌节结构的破坏。肌节是位于两条Z线之间的重复单位，主要由肌球蛋白和肌动蛋白组成，介导收缩功能。正常情况下，肌节与细胞长轴对齐，Z带在心肌细胞全长范围内保持对齐。

HP:0031334.name: Cardiomyocyte inclusion bodies
HP:0031334.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within cardiomyocytes.
HP:0031334.definition_cn: 心肌细胞内可染色物质的核内或胞质内聚集物。

HP:0031335.name: Abnormal cardiomyocyte mitochondrial morphology
HP:0031335.definition: An anomaly of the structure of mitochondria within cardiomyocytes.
HP:0031335.name_cn: 异常心肌细胞线粒体形态
HP:0031335.definition_cn: 心肌细胞内线粒体结构异常。

HP:0031336.name: Intranuclear cardiomyocyte mitochondria
HP:0031336.definition: Abnormal localization of mitochondria within the nuclei of cardiomyocytes.
HP:0031336.definition_cn: 心肌细胞核内线粒体异常定位。

HP:0031337.name: Abnormal cardiomyocyte connexin43 staining
HP:0031337.definition: Anomalous staining of Connexin43 in cardiomyocytes. Connexin43 (Cx43) is the primary gap junction protein in the working myocardium. Cx43 exhibits increased localization at the lateral membranes of cardiomyocytes in a variety of heart diseases.
HP:0031337.name_cn: 异常心肌细胞连接蛋白43染色
HP:0031337.definition_cn: 心肌细胞中连接蛋白43的异常染色。连接蛋白43（Cx43）是工作心肌中的主要间隙连接蛋白。在多种心脏疾病中，Cx43在心肌细胞侧膜的定位增加。

HP:0031338.name: Abnormal cardiomyocyte plakoglobin staining
HP:0031338.definition: Anomalous staining of plakoglobin in cardiomyocytes. Plakoglobin is a component of desmosomes in cardiomyocytes.
HP:0031338.name_cn: 异常心肌细胞斑珠蛋白染色
HP:0031338.definition_cn: 心肌细胞中斑珠蛋白的异常染色。斑珠蛋白是心肌细胞中桥粒的组成部分。

HP:0031339.name: Abnormal cardiomyocyte dystrophin staining
HP:0031339.definition: Anomalous staining of dystrophin in cardiomyocytes.
HP:0031339.name_cn: 异常心肌细胞抗肌萎缩蛋白染色
HP:0031339.definition_cn: 心肌细胞中肌营养不良蛋白的异常染色。

HP:0031340.name: Abnormal lysosomal morphology
HP:0031340.definition: A structural anomaly of lysosomes, membrane-enclosed organelles that contain an array of enzymes capable of catabolizing proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids.
HP:0031340.definition_cn: 溶酶体结构异常，溶酶体为膜包被的细胞器，内含一系列能够分解蛋白质、核酸、碳水化合物和脂质的酶类。

HP:0031341.name: Gastric arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031341.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the stomach.
HP:0031341.definition_cn: 胃部动静脉畸形（Arteriovenous Malformation, AVM），即动脉血未经毛细血管直接分流至静脉的血管异常结构。

HP:0031342.name: Duodenal arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031342.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the duodenum.
HP:0031342.definition_cn: 十二指肠动静脉畸形（Arteriovenous Malformation, AVM），即动脉血直接分流至静脉而未经过毛细血管的异常血管构型。

HP:0031343.name: Jejunal arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031343.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the jejunum.
HP:0031343.definition_cn: 空肠动静脉畸形（Arteriovenous Malformation, AVM），即动脉血液直接分流至静脉而未经过毛细血管的异常血管构型，位于空肠。

HP:0031344.name: Pelvic arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031344.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the pelvis.
HP:0031344.definition_cn: 一种异常的血管构型，导致动脉血直接分流至静脉而不经过毛细血管，且位于盆腔内。

HP:0031345.name: Colonic arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031345.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the colon.
HP:0031345.definition_cn: 结肠动静脉畸形（Arteriovenous Malformation, AVM），即动脉血液未经毛细血管直接分流至静脉的血管异常结构。

HP:0031346.name: Rectal arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031346.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the rectum.
HP:0031346.definition_cn: 直肠动静脉畸形（Arteriovenous Malformation, AVM），即动脉血未经毛细血管直接分流至静脉的血管异常结构。

HP:0031347.name: Uterine arteriovenous malformation
HP:0031347.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the uterus.
HP:0031347.definition_cn: 子宫动静脉畸形（Uterine Arteriovenous Malformation, Uterine AVM）

HP:0031348.name: Dextrotransposition of the great arteries
HP:0031348.definition: A type of transposition of the great arteries (TGA) in which aorta is in front of and primarily to the right of the pulmonary artery. This is the most common kind of TGA.
HP:0031348.definition_cn: 一种大动脉转位（Transposition of the Great Arteries, TGA），其中主动脉位于肺动脉前方并主要偏右。这是最常见的TGA类型。

HP:0031349.name: Levotransposition of the great arteries
HP:0031349.definition: A type of transposition of the great arteries (TGA) in which aorta is in front of and primarily to the left of the pulmonary artery.
HP:0031349.definition_cn: 一种大动脉转位（TGA）类型，其中主动脉位于肺动脉前方且主要偏左。

HP:0031350.name: Cardiac sarcoma
HP:0031350.definition: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the heart.

HP:0031351.name: Calcified amorphous tumor of the heart
HP:0031351.definition: A non-neoplastic cardiac tumor characterized by calcification and eosinophilic amorphous material in the background of dense collagenous fibrous tissue.
HP:0031351.name_cn: 心脏钙化性无定形肿瘤
HP:0031351.definition_cn: 一种非肿瘤性心脏肿瘤，其特征为在致密胶原纤维组织背景下出现钙化和嗜酸性无定形物质。

HP:0031352.name: Chest tightness
HP:0031352.definition: An unpleasant sensation of tightness or pressure in the chest.
HP:0031352.definition_cn: 胸部紧缩感或压迫感的不适症状。

HP:0031353.name: Otitis media with effusion
HP:0031353.definition: Otitis media characterized by thick or sticky fluid behind the tympanic membrane.
HP:0031353.definition_cn: 中耳炎以鼓膜后粘稠或粘液性积液为特征。

HP:0031354.name: Sleep onset insomnia
HP:0031354.definition: Difficulty initiating sleep, that is, increased sleep onset latency, refers to the condition where it takes 30 minutes or more to fall asleep.
HP:0031354.definition_cn: 入睡困难，即睡眠潜伏期延长，是指需要30分钟或更长时间才能入睡的状况。

HP:0031355.name: Maintenance insomnia
HP:0031355.definition: Individuals affected by abnormal difficulty in staying asleep tend to wake up at night and struggle to return to sleep. This condition typically involves spending more than 30 minutes awake during the night.
HP:0031355.definition_cn: 患有异常睡眠维持困难的患者通常会在夜间醒来并难以重新入睡。这种情况通常涉及夜间清醒时间超过30分钟。

HP:0031356.name: Terminal insomnia
HP:0031356.definition: A type of insomnia characterized by waking up too early in the morning is known as early morning awakening. The termination of sleep must occur at least 30 minutes before the desired time.
HP:0031356.definition_cn: 一种以清晨过早醒来为特征的失眠类型被称为早醒性失眠。睡眠终止必须比预期时间至少提前30分钟。

HP:0031357.name: Glomeruloid hemangioma
HP:0031357.definition: A histologically distinctive, cutaneous, benign vascular tumor that is characterized by a solitary or multiple blue-red papules and histologically resembles renal glomeruli.
HP:0031357.definition_cn: 一种组织学上独特的、皮肤良性血管肿瘤，其特征为单发或多发的蓝红色丘疹，组织学上类似于肾小球。

HP:0031358.name: Vegetative state
HP:0031358.definition: The absence of wakefulness and consciousness, but in contrast to a coma, there is involuntary opening of the eyes and movements such as teeth grinding, yawning, or thrashing of the extremities.
HP:0031358.definition_cn: 无觉醒和意识状态，但与昏迷不同，存在不自主睁眼及磨牙、打哈欠或四肢抽动等动作。

HP:0031359.name: Cutaneous sclerotic plaque
HP:0031359.definition: A solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter that is characterized by hardening (sclerosis) of the affected skin area (related to collagen thickening).
HP:0031359.definition_cn: 一种直径大于1厘米的坚实、隆起、平台状（平顶）的病变，其特征为受累皮肤区域的硬化（硬化症），与胶原增厚相关。

HP:0031360.name: Yellow skin plaque
HP:0031360.definition: A solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter and that has a yellow color.
HP:0031360.definition_cn: 直径大于1厘米的实性、隆起、平台状（平顶）病变，呈黄色。

HP:0031361.name: Zebra bodies
HP:0031361.definition: Intralysosomal, osmiophilic, lamellated and sometimes concentric cytoplasmic inclusions comprised of broad transversely-stacked myelinoid membranes and said to resemble a zebra in electron microscopic images.
HP:0031361.definition_cn: 溶酶体内，嗜锇性，层状且有时呈同心圆排列的胞质内含物，由宽大的横向堆叠的髓鞘样膜组成，在电子显微镜图像中被称为类似斑马条纹。

HP:0031362.name: obsolete Sex-limited autosomal recessive inheritance
HP:0031362.name_cn: 过时的性限常染色体隐性遗传

HP:0031363.name: Palpable purpura
HP:0031363.definition: A type of purpura in which the lesions are raised (and can therefore be appreciated upon palpation).
HP:0031363.definition_cn: 一种紫癜类型，其皮损呈隆起状（因此可通过触诊感知）。

HP:0031364.name: Ecchymosis
HP:0031364.definition: A purpuric lesion that is larger than 1 cm in diameter.
HP:0031364.definition_cn: 直径大于1厘米的紫癜性病变。

HP:0031365.name: Macular purpura
HP:0031365.definition: Purpura that is flat (non-palpable, not raised).
HP:0031365.definition_cn: 平坦性紫癜（非可触及性，无隆起）。

HP:0031366.name: Palate neoplasm
HP:0031366.definition: A neoplasm that affects the hard palate, soft palate, or uvula.
HP:0031366.definition_cn: 累及硬腭、软腭或悬雍垂的肿瘤。

HP:0031367.name: Metaphyseal striations
HP:0031367.definition: Longitudinal densities on radiographs located in a metaphysis (the narrow region of a long bone between the epiphysis and the diaphysis).
HP:0031367.definition_cn: 位于干骺端（长骨骨骺与骨干之间的狭窄区域）的放射影像上的纵向密度影。

HP:0031368.name: Intestinal perforation
HP:0031368.definition: A hole (perforation) in the wall of the intestine.

HP:0031369.name: Colon perforation
HP:0031369.definition: A hole (perforation) in the wall of the colon.

HP:0031370.name: Small intestinal perforation
HP:0031370.definition: A hole (perforation) in the wall of the small intestine.

HP:0031371.name: Rectal perforation
HP:0031371.definition: A hole (perforation) in the wall of the rectum.

HP:0031372.name: Cold paresis
HP:0031372.definition: Increased muscle weakness upon exposure to cold temperatures.
HP:0031372.definition_cn: 暴露于低温环境后肌肉无力加重。

HP:0031373.name: Stiff tongue
HP:0031373.definition: Increased rigidity and reduced mobility of the tongue.
HP:0031373.definition_cn: 舌体僵硬度增加及活动度降低。

HP:0031374.name: Ankle weakness
HP:0031374.definition: Reduced strength of the muscles that lift or otherwise move the foot at the ankle.
HP:0031374.definition_cn: 踝关节背屈肌群肌力减退。

HP:0031375.name: Refractory
HP:0031375.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is difficult to treat or cure.
HP:0031375.definition_cn: 适用于难以治疗或治愈的体征或症状。

HP:0031377.name: Abnormal cell proliferation
HP:0031377.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of cells, which may result in the expansion of a cell population.
HP:0031377.definition_cn: 细胞增殖或复制过程中的任何异常，可能导致细胞群体的扩增。

HP:0031378.name: Abnormal lymphocyte proliferation
HP:0031378.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of lymphocytes, which results in the expansion of a cell population.
HP:0031378.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞增殖或复制过程中的任何异常，导致细胞群体扩增。

HP:0031379.name: Abnormal T cell proliferation
HP:0031379.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of T cells, which results in the expansion of a cell population.
HP:0031379.definition_cn: T细胞增殖或复制过程中的任何异常，导致细胞群扩增。

HP:0031380.name: Abnormal B cell proliferation
HP:0031380.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of B cells, which results in the expansion of a cell population.
HP:0031380.definition_cn: B细胞增殖或复制过程中的任何异常，导致细胞群体的扩增。

HP:0031381.name: Decreased lymphocyte proliferation in response to mitogen
HP:0031381.definition: A decreased proliferative response of lymphocytes in vitro or in vivo, when stimulated with mitogens, such as phytohemagglutinin (PHA).
HP:0031381.name_cn: 有丝分裂原刺激下淋巴细胞增殖减少
HP:0031381.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞在体外或体内受到有丝分裂原（如植物血凝素，PHA）刺激后，其增殖反应减弱。

HP:0031382.name: Decreased lymphocyte proliferation in response to anti-CD3
HP:0031382.definition: A decreased proliferative response of lymphocytes in vitro or in vivo, when stimulated with an anti-CD3 antibody against the T-cell co-receptor, CD3.
HP:0031382.name_cn: 抗CD3刺激下淋巴细胞增殖减少
HP:0031382.definition_cn: 在体外或体内，当使用针对T细胞共受体CD3的抗CD3抗体刺激时，淋巴细胞增殖反应减弱。

HP:0031383.name: Abnormal lymphocyte surface marker expression
HP:0031383.definition: Abnormal amount of a protein that is normally present on the cell surface of lymphocytes.
HP:0031383.name_cn: 淋巴细胞表面标志物表达异常
HP:0031383.definition_cn: 淋巴细胞表面正常存在的蛋白质数量异常。

HP:0031384.name: Reduced T cell CD40 expression
HP:0031384.definition: A deficiency in the expression of the CD40 ligand on the surface of activated T-lymphocytes.
HP:0031384.definition_cn: 活化T淋巴细胞表面CD40配体表达缺陷。

HP:0031385.name: Megakaryocyte nucleus hypolobulation
HP:0031385.definition: The presence of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow whose nuclei are less lobulated than expected for the size of the nucleus.
HP:0031385.definition_cn: 骨髓中巨核细胞核分叶程度低于其核大小预期水平。

HP:0031386.name: Increased micromegakaryocyte count
HP:0031386.definition: The presence of abnormally high numbers of micromegakaryocytes in the bone marrow. Micromegakaryocytes are mononuclear diploid cells, with a nucleus similar in size to that of a myeloblast or promyelocyte with the cell being less than 30 micrometers in diameter.
HP:0031386.definition_cn: 骨髓中存在异常高数量的微巨核细胞。微巨核细胞为单核二倍体细胞，其细胞核大小与原始粒细胞或早幼粒细胞相似，细胞直径小于30微米。

HP:0031387.name: Increased multinucleated megakaryocyte count
HP:0031387.definition: The presence of abnormally high numbers of multinucleated megakaryocytes in the bone marrow.
HP:0031387.name_cn: 多核巨核细胞计数增加
HP:0031387.definition_cn: 骨髓中出现异常增多的多核巨核细胞。

HP:0031388.name: Megakaryocyte nucleus hyperlobulation
HP:0031388.definition: The presence of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow whose nuclei are more lobulated than expected for the size of the nucleus.
HP:0031388.definition_cn: 骨髓中巨核细胞核分叶程度超过其核大小预期范围。

HP:0031389.name: Abnormal MHC II surface expression
HP:0031389.definition: A deviation from the normal level of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules expressed at the cell surface.
HP:0031389.name_cn: 异常MHC II类分子表面表达
HP:0031389.definition_cn: 细胞表面表达的主要组织相容性复合体II类分子水平偏离正常值。

HP:0031390.name: Reduced MHC II surface expression
HP:0031390.definition: A reduction from the normal level of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules expressed at the cell surface.
HP:0031390.name_cn: MHC II类分子表面表达降低
HP:0031390.definition_cn: 细胞表面表达的主要组织相容性复合体II类分子水平低于正常值。

HP:0031391.name: Elevated MHC II surface expression
HP:0031391.definition: An increase above the normal level of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules expressed at the cell surface.
HP:0031391.name_cn: MHC II 表面表达升高
HP:0031391.definition_cn: 细胞表面主要组织相容性复合体II类分子表达水平高于正常值。

HP:0031392.name: Abnormal proportion of CD4-positive T cells
HP:0031392.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of CD4-positive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0031392.definition_cn: CD4阳性T细胞与T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0031393.name: Abnormal proportion of CD8-positive T cells
HP:0031393.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of CD8 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0031393.definition_cn: CD8 T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0031394.name: Abnormal CD4:CD8 ratio
HP:0031394.definition: Any abnormality in the relative amount of CD4+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes.
HP:0031394.definition_cn: CD4+与CD8+ T淋巴细胞相对数量的任何异常。

HP:0031396.name: Abnormal proportion of naive T cells
HP:0031396.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of naive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0031396.definition_cn: 初始T细胞（Naive T Cells）相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0031397.name: Decreased proportion of naive T cells
HP:0031397.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of naive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0031397.definition_cn: 初始T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常降低。

HP:0031398.name: Increased proportion of naive T cells
HP:0031398.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of naive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0031398.definition_cn: 初始T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常增高。

HP:0031399.name: Abnormal proportion of double-negative alpha-beta regulatory T cell
HP:0031399.definition: An abnormal proportion of CD4-negative, CD8-negative (double negative or DN) alpha-beta regulatory T cells (Tregs) as compared to total number of T cells.
HP:0031399.name_cn: 双阴性αβ调节性T细胞比例异常
HP:0031399.definition_cn: 与总T细胞数量相比，CD4阴性、CD8阴性（双阴性或DN）α-β调节性T细胞（Tregs）比例异常。

HP:0031401.name: Reduced proportion of CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta regulatory T cells
HP:0031401.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of CD4-negative, CD8-negative (double negative or DN) alpha-beta regulatory T cells (Tregs) as compared to total number of T cells.
HP:0031401.name_cn: CD4阴性、CD8阴性、α-β调节性T细胞比例降低
HP:0031401.definition_cn: 与总T细胞数量相比，CD4阴性、CD8阴性（双阴性或DN）α-β调节性T细胞（Tregs）比例异常降低。

HP:0031402.name: Reduced antigen-specific T cell proliferation
HP:0031402.definition: Impaired proliferation and expansion of a T cell population following activation by an antigenic stimulus.
HP:0031402.name_cn: 抗原特异性T细胞增殖减少
HP:0031402.definition_cn: 抗原刺激激活后T细胞群增殖和扩增受损。

HP:0031403.name: Impaired pathogen-specific CD8 cytoxicity
HP:0031403.definition: Impaired response of CD8 T cells to pathogens. CD8 T cells direct the killing of a target cell through the release of granules containing cytotoxic mediators or through the engagement of death receptors.
HP:0031403.name_cn: 病原体特异性CD8细胞毒性功能受损
HP:0031403.definition_cn: CD8 T细胞对病原体的反应受损。CD8 T细胞通过释放含有细胞毒性介质的颗粒或通过结合死亡受体来直接杀伤靶细胞。

HP:0031404.name: Impaired antigen-specific response
HP:0031404.definition: An impaired immune response mediated by cells expressing specific receptors for antigen produced through a somatic diversification process, and allowing for an enhanced secondary response to subsequent exposures to the same antigen (immunological memory).
HP:0031404.definition_cn: 一种由表达特定抗原受体的细胞介导的免疫应答受损，这些受体通过体细胞多样化过程产生，并允许对后续相同抗原暴露的增强二次应答（免疫记忆）。

HP:0031405.name: Poroma
HP:0031405.definition: A benign, well circumscribed sweat gland neoplasm with eccrine or apocrine differentiation. It usually presents as a solitary, dome-shaped papule, nodule, or plaque on acral sites. It is characterized by a proliferation of uniform basaloid cells in the dermis and it is associated with the presence of focal ductal and cystic structures [NCIT:C27273].
HP:0031405.definition_cn: 一种良性、边界清晰的汗腺肿瘤，具有小汗腺或大汗腺分化特征。通常表现为肢端部位的单发性、圆顶状丘疹、结节或斑块。其特征为真皮层内均匀基底样细胞的增生，并伴有局灶性导管和囊性结构的存在 [NCIT:C27273]。

HP:0031406.name: Abnormal cytokine signaling
HP:0031406.definition: Any abnormality in the series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a cytokine to a receptor on the surface of a cell, and ending with regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.
HP:0031406.name_cn: 细胞因子信号传导异常
HP:0031406.definition_cn: 由细胞因子与细胞表面受体结合引发的一系列分子信号传导过程中的任何异常，最终导致下游细胞过程（如转录）的调控异常。

HP:0031407.name: Impaired cytokine signaling
HP:0031407.definition: A defect or impairment in the series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a cytokine to a receptor on the surface of a cell, and ending with regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.
HP:0031407.name_cn: 细胞因子信号传导受损
HP:0031407.definition_cn: 由细胞因子与细胞表面受体结合引发的一系列分子信号传导缺陷或功能障碍，最终导致下游细胞过程（如转录）的调控异常。

HP:0031408.name: Increased proportion of CD25+ mast cells
HP:0031408.definition: An increased proportion of mast cells are positive for the cell surface marker CD25 (also called interleukin-2 receptor alpha chain).
HP:0031408.definition_cn: 肥大细胞表面标志物CD25（也称为白细胞介素-2受体α链）的阳性比例增加。

HP:0031410.name: Abnormal distribution of CD56 bright/dim natural killer cells
HP:0031410.definition: An abnormal distribution in the number of CD56 bright NK cells, as measured by flow cytometry. CD56, an adhesion molecule mediating homotypic adhesion, is used as a functional marker for NK cells.
HP:0031410.name_cn: CD56明亮/暗淡自然杀伤细胞异常分布
HP:0031410.definition_cn: 流式细胞术检测显示CD56 bright NK细胞数量分布异常。CD56作为一种介导同型粘附的粘附分子，被用作NK细胞的功能性标志物。

HP:0031411.name: Abnormal chromosome morphology
HP:0031411.definition: Any structural anomaly of a chromosome, which is a thread like molecule consisting of DNA and proteins (chromatin) that contains DNA sequences for genes and other genetic elements in linear order.
HP:0031411.definition_cn: 染色体结构异常，即染色体（一种由DNA和蛋白质（染色质）组成的线状分子，包含基因和其他遗传元件的线性DNA序列）的任何结构异常。

HP:0031413.name: Short telomere length
HP:0031413.definition: An abnormal reduction in telomere length. Telomeres are non-coding, repetitive sequences of DNA at the ends of the chromosomes of eukaryotic cells which become shorter as cells divide, and when telomere attrition reaches its limit, cell proliferation arrest, senescence, and apoptosis can occur.
HP:0031413.definition_cn: 端粒长度异常缩短。端粒是真核细胞染色体末端的非编码、重复DNA序列，随着细胞分裂而逐渐缩短，当端粒损耗达到极限时，可导致细胞增殖停滞、衰老和凋亡。

HP:0031414.name: High serum calcifediol
HP:0031414.definition: An increased concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as 25-hydroxycholecalciferol or 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3.
HP:0031414.definition_cn: 血液中骨化二醇浓度升高。骨化二醇也称为25-羟基胆钙化醇或25-羟基维生素D3。

HP:0031415.name: High serum calcitriol
HP:0031415.definition: An increased concentration of calcitriol in the blood. Calcitriol is also known as 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol or 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3.
HP:0031415.definition_cn: 血液中骨化三醇浓度升高。骨化三醇也称为1,25-二羟基胆钙化醇或1,25-二羟基维生素D3。

HP:0031416.name: Abnormal nasal mucus secretion
HP:0031416.definition: Any deviation from the normal quantity of secretion of nasal mucus, a thick viscous liquid produced by the mucous membranes of the nose.
HP:0031416.definition_cn: 鼻粘液分泌量的任何异常，鼻粘液是由鼻粘膜产生的粘稠液体。

HP:0031417.name: Rhinorrhea
HP:0031417.definition: Increased discharge of mucus from the nose.

HP:0031418.name: Increased body mass index
HP:0031418.definition: Abnormally increased weight-to-height squared ratio, calculated by dividing the individual's weight in kilograms by the square of the individual's height in meters and used as an indicator of overweight compared to averages.
HP:0031418.definition_cn: 体重指数（Body Mass Index, BMI）异常升高，通过将个体体重（千克）除以身高（米）的平方计算得出，作为与平均值相比超重的指标。

HP:0031419.name: Reduced sex -hormone binding protein level
HP:0031419.definition: A decreased concentration of sex-hormone binding protein in the circulation.
HP:0031419.name_cn: 性激素结合球蛋白水平降低
HP:0031419.definition_cn: 循环中性激素结合蛋白浓度降低。

HP:0031420.name: Small yellow foveal lesion with surrounding gray zone
HP:0031420.definition: A lesion that is observed following light damage to the macula. Damage to the retinal by exposure to intense visible light, usually the sun. Intense light exposure such as staring at the sun causes fine structural anomalies in the outer segments of the photoreceptors and the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) cells of the macula. Symptoms usually develop within 1 to 4 h after exposure and include decreased vision, metamorphopsia, micropsia, and central or paracentral scotomas. Fundus examination typically shows a small yellow spot with a surrounding gray zone in the foveolar or parafoveolar area. Spontaneous evolution leads to the improvement of visual acuity.
HP:0031420.name_cn: 小黄斑中心凹病变伴周围灰区
HP:0031420.definition_cn: 黄斑光损伤后观察到的病变。由于暴露于强可见光（通常是太阳光）导致的视网膜损伤。强光暴露（如直视太阳）会引起黄斑区光感受器外节和视网膜色素上皮（RPE）细胞的细微结构异常。症状通常在暴露后1至4小时内出现，包括视力下降、视物变形、视物变小以及中心或旁中心暗点。眼底检查通常显示在中心凹或旁中心凹区域有一个小的黄色斑点，周围环绕灰色区域。自发性演变通常会导致视力改善。

HP:0031421.name: Small superior frontal cortex
HP:0031421.definition: Reduced size of the superior frontal portion of the cerebral cortex.
HP:0031421.definition_cn: 额叶上部皮质体积缩小。

HP:0031422.name: Abnormal cerebellar cortex morphology
HP:0031422.definition: Any structural anomaly of the cortex of the cerebellum.

HP:0031423.name: Small cerebellar cortex
HP:0031423.definition: Reduced size of the cerebellar cortex.

HP:0031424.name: Abnormal circulating beta-C-terminal telopeptide concentration
HP:0031424.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen in the blood circulation, a marker of the rate of bone turnover.
HP:0031424.definition_cn: 血液循环中I型胶原β-C末端交联肽浓度异常，作为骨转换率的标志物。

HP:0031425.name: Increased circulating beta-C-terminal telopeptide concentration
HP:0031425.definition: A abnormal elevation above the normal concentration of beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen in the blood circulation.
HP:0031425.name_cn: 循环中β-C末端端肽浓度升高
HP:0031425.definition_cn: 血液循环中I型胶原β-C末端交联肽浓度异常升高。

HP:0031426.name: Decreased circulating beta-C-terminal telopeptide concentration
HP:0031426.definition: A reduction from the normal concentration of beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen in the blood circulation.
HP:0031426.name_cn: 循环β-C末端交联端肽浓度降低
HP:0031426.definition_cn: 血液中I型胶原β-C末端交联肽的正常浓度降低。

HP:0031427.name: Abnormal circulating osteocalcin level
HP:0031427.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of osteocalcin in the blood circulation.
HP:0031427.definition_cn: 血液循环中骨钙素浓度异常。

HP:0031428.name: Increased circulating osteocalcin level
HP:0031428.definition: An elevated level of osteocalcin in the blood.
HP:0031428.definition_cn: 血液中骨钙素水平升高。

HP:0031429.name: Decreased circulating osteocalcin level
HP:0031429.definition: A reduced level of osteocalcin in the blood.
HP:0031429.definition_cn: 血液中骨钙素水平降低。

HP:0031430.name: Oligoclonal T cell expansion
HP:0031430.definition: The presence of a population of T cells with a restricted T cell receptor (TCR) repertoire derived from a limited number of TCR clones.
HP:0031430.definition_cn: 存在一组具有受限T细胞受体（TCR）库的T细胞群体，这些T细胞来源于有限数量的TCR克隆。

HP:0031431.name: Persistent repetition of sounds
HP:0031431.definition: Repetition of sounds with no meaning.

HP:0031432.name: Restricted or repetitive behaviors or interests
HP:0031432.definition: A broad range of compulsive behaviors are repeated, including simple motor stereotypies and tics, as well as more complex repetitive movements or compulsions.
HP:0031432.name_cn: 限制性或重复性行为或兴趣
HP:0031432.definition_cn: 广泛范围的强迫性行为被重复执行，包括简单的运动刻板行为和抽动症，以及更复杂的重复性运动或强迫行为。

HP:0031433.name: Alexithymia
HP:0031433.definition: Alexithymia is characterized by an impaired ability to be aware of, explicitly identify, and describe one's feelings.
HP:0031433.definition_cn: 述情障碍（Alexithymia）的特征为个体在感知、明确识别及描述自身情感方面存在显著功能障碍。

HP:0031434.name: Abnormal prosody
HP:0031434.definition: Prosody refers to the patterns of rhythm, stress, and intonation in spoken language. Abnormal prosody refers to abnormalities in the patterns of rhythm, stress, or intonation of speech or vocalization that can be heard by the observer. In general, this refers to overt and clear deviations in patterns from culturally accepted norms but many also include differences noted in comparison to the usual patterns of the individual (a quiet person suddenly becomes loud or vice versa).
HP:0031434.definition_cn: 韵律（Prosody）是指口语中的节奏、重音和语调模式。异常韵律（Abnormal Prosody）是指观察者可听到的言语或发声在节奏、重音或语调模式上的异常。通常，这指的是与文化接受规范相比明显且清晰的模式偏差，但也可能包括与个体通常模式相比的差异（例如，一个安静的人突然变得大声，反之亦然）。

HP:0031435.name: Monotonic speech
HP:0031435.definition: A speech pattern characterized by a persistently abnormal lack of tone in the voice. Monotonic speech is typically ongoing, lasting throughout the day, but may have a diurnal variation in the pattern, i.e. slower at specific times of the day.
HP:0031435.definition_cn: 一种以持续异常缺乏音调为特征的言语模式。单调性言语通常持续存在，全天持续，但其模式可能存在昼夜变化，即在一天中的特定时间更为缓慢。

HP:0031436.name: Singsong Intonation
HP:0031436.definition: A speech pattern characterized by abnormal fluctuations in the pitch of the voice.
HP:0031436.definition_cn: 一种以声音音调异常波动为特征的言语模式。

HP:0031437.name: Pregnancy exposure
HP:0031437.definition: Exposure of pregnant women to toxins from any source, such as environmental toxins or chemicals, that may potentially cause problems such as miscarriage, preterm delivery, low birth weight, and, in some cases, developmental delays in infants.
HP:0031437.definition_cn: 孕妇暴露于任何来源的毒素，如环境毒素或化学物质，可能导致流产、早产、低出生体重，在某些情况下还可能导致婴儿发育迟缓。

HP:0031438.name: Abnormal sex hormone-binding globulin level
HP:0031438.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration in the circulation of sex hormone-binding globulin, a circulating glycoprotein that transports testosterone and other steroids in the blood.
HP:0031438.name_cn: 性激素结合球蛋白水平异常
HP:0031438.definition_cn: 性激素结合球蛋白（Sex Hormone-Binding Globulin, SHBG）在循环中的浓度偏离正常范围，该循环糖蛋白负责在血液中运输睾酮及其他类固醇激素。

HP:0031439.name: Abnormal angiostatin level
HP:0031439.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration in the circulation of angiostatin, an endogenous angiogenesis inhibitor, which blocks the growth of new blood vessels.
HP:0031439.definition_cn: 血管抑素（一种内源性血管生成抑制剂）在循环中的浓度偏离正常值，该物质可抑制新生血管的生长。

HP:0031440.name: obsolete Abnormal tricuspid valve morphology
HP:0031440.name_cn: 废弃的三尖瓣形态异常

HP:0031441.name: Abnormal tricuspid valve annulus morphology
HP:0031441.definition: Any structural anomaly of the annulus of the tricuspid valve. The annulus is a ring composed of fibrous and myocardial tissue and is the structure onto which the cusps of the valve attach.
HP:0031441.definition_cn: 三尖瓣环的任何结构异常。瓣环是由纤维组织和心肌组织构成的环状结构，是瓣膜瓣叶附着的结构。

HP:0031442.name: Abnormal tricuspid chordae tendinae morphology
HP:0031442.definition: Any structural anomaly of the chordae tendinae of the tricuspid valve. The chordae tendineae connect the papillary muscles to the tricuspid valve.
HP:0031442.definition_cn: 三尖瓣腱索的任何结构异常。腱索将乳头肌与三尖瓣相连。

HP:0031443.name: Abnormal tricuspid valve leaflet morphology
HP:0031443.definition: Any structural anomaly of the leaflets (also known as cusps) of the tricuspid valve.
HP:0031443.definition_cn: 三尖瓣瓣叶（亦称瓣尖）的任何结构异常。

HP:0031444.name: Dilatation of the tricuspid annulus
HP:0031444.definition: An increase in the diameter of the ring (annulus) of the tricuspid valve.

HP:0031445.name: Oral mucosa nodule
HP:0031445.definition: A palpable, solid lesion greater than 5mm in diameter. that is located in the mucosa of the mouth.
HP:0031445.definition_cn: 直径大于5毫米的可触及、实性病变，位于口腔黏膜内。

HP:0031446.name: Erosion of oral mucosa
HP:0031446.definition: Loss of the superficial layer of the oral mucosa usually resulting in a shallow or crusted lesion.
HP:0031446.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜表层缺失，通常导致浅表性或结痂性病变。

HP:0031447.name: Penile freckling
HP:0031447.definition: Multiple pigmented macules located on the skin of the penis.
HP:0031447.definition_cn: 阴茎皮肤上出现多发性色素性斑疹。

HP:0031448.name: Herpetiform vesicles
HP:0031448.definition: Multiple vesicles distributed in multiple distinct groups consisting of multiple adjacent vesicles.
HP:0031448.definition_cn: 多发性水疱呈多组分布，每组由多个相邻水疱组成。

HP:0031449.name: Perineal hemangioma
HP:0031449.definition: Hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the perineal region, i.e., the region between the anus and the genitals.
HP:0031449.definition_cn: 血管瘤，一种血管内皮细胞的良性肿瘤，位于会阴区，即肛门与生殖器之间的区域。

HP:0031450.name: Polycyclic
HP:0031450.definition: A distribution of skin lesions resembling multiple merged circles. For instance, this can be seen with multiple urticarial wheals as the individual, circular wheals resolve and merge.
HP:0031450.definition_cn: 皮肤病变呈多发性融合性环状分布。例如，在多个荨麻疹性风团消退并融合时可见此现象。

HP:0031451.name: Lower extremity subcutanous fat hypertrophy
HP:0031451.definition: An abnormal increase in the amount of subcutaneous fat in the legs.
HP:0031451.definition_cn: 下肢皮下脂肪异常增多。

HP:0031452.name: Lichenoid skin lesion
HP:0031452.definition: Multiple skin lesions resembling those characteristic of the disease lichen planus. These lesions are violaceous (reddish-purple), shiny, isolated, flat-topped papules and plaques.
HP:0031452.definition_cn: 多发性皮肤病变，类似于扁平苔藓的特征性病变。这些病变呈紫红色（红紫色）、有光泽、孤立、平顶的丘疹和斑块。

HP:0031453.name: Oral lichenoid lesion
HP:0031453.definition: Multiple lesions of the oral mucosa resembling those characteristic of the disease lichen planus. These are symmetric reticular lesions that resemble a white, lacelike network, as well as by papules, plaques, erythematous lesions, and erosions.
HP:0031453.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜多发性病变，类似于扁平苔藓的典型特征。这些病变呈对称性网状分布，表现为白色、蕾丝样网状结构，并伴有丘疹、斑块、红斑性病变及糜烂。

HP:0031454.name: Apocrine hidrocystoma
HP:0031454.definition: A cystic lesions that forms a benign tumor of an apocrine sweat gland.
HP:0031454.definition_cn: 一种囊性病变，形成顶泌汗腺的良性肿瘤。

HP:0031455.name: Presacral ganglioneuroma
HP:0031455.definition: A gangioleneuroma originating from sympathetic ganglion cells in the abdomen.
HP:0031455.definition_cn: 起源于腹部交感神经节细胞的神经节细胞瘤。

HP:0031456.name: Ectopic pregnancy
HP:0031456.definition: A pregnancy in which the fertilized egg inserts in a location outside of the main cavity of the uterus (usually in the Fallopian tube).
HP:0031456.definition_cn: 异位妊娠（Ectopic Pregnancy），指受精卵在子宫主腔外着床（通常位于输卵管）。

HP:0031457.name: Pulmonary opacity
HP:0031457.definition: Opacity refers to any area that preferentially attenuates the x-ray beam and therefore appears more opaque than the surrounding area. It is a nonspecific term that does not indicate the size or pathologic nature of the abnormality.
HP:0031457.definition_cn: 不透明区（Opacity）是指任何优先衰减X射线束的区域，因此比周围区域显得更加不透明。这是一个非特异性术语，并不表明异常的大小或病理性质。

HP:0031458.name: Adenoiditis
HP:0031458.definition: An inflammation of the adenoid tissue.

HP:0031459.name: Soft tissue neoplasm
HP:0031459.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) that arises from the soft tissue. The most common types are lipomatous (fatty), vascular, smooth muscle, fibrous, and fibrohistiocytic neoplasms.
HP:0031459.definition_cn: 起源于软组织的肿瘤（组织异常增生）。最常见的类型包括脂肪瘤性（脂肪性）、血管性、平滑肌性、纤维性及纤维组织细胞性肿瘤。

HP:0031460.name: Benign muscle neoplasm
HP:0031460.definition: A benign mesenchymal neoplasm arising from smooth, skeletal, or cardiac muscle tissue [NCIT:C4882].
HP:0031460.definition_cn: 一种源自平滑肌、骨骼肌或心肌组织的良性间叶性肿瘤 [NCIT:C4882]。

HP:0031461.name: Intramuscular Myxoma
HP:0031461.definition: A benign tumor that is usually solitary, painless, palpable mass that is firm in consistency and slightly movable and often fluctuant. It can occur in any location, but tends to involve the muscles of the thighs, buttocks, and shoulders. On microscopic examination, there is abundant mucoid material and relative hypo cellularity and loose reticulin fibers. Vascular structures are sparse. The cells have a stellate shape with small hyper chromatic pyknotic nuclei and scanty cytoplasm. Some myxomas may show focal areas of hyper cellularity. However absence of nuclear atypia, mitotic figures or necrosis helps to rule out malignancy.
HP:0031461.definition_cn: 一种良性肿瘤，通常为孤立性、无痛性、可触及的肿块，质地坚实，轻微可移动且常有波动感。可发生于任何部位，但常累及大腿、臀部和肩部的肌肉。显微镜下检查可见大量黏液样物质，相对细胞稀少及疏松的网状纤维。血管结构稀疏。细胞呈星形，具有小而深染的固缩核及稀少的细胞质。部分黏液瘤可能显示局部细胞增多区域。然而，缺乏核异型性、有丝分裂象或坏死有助于排除恶性病变。

HP:0031462.name: Musculotendinous retraction
HP:0031462.definition: Abnormal reduction in length of a tendon which tends to pull (retract) the attached muscle tissue with shortening of the muscle fibers often accompanied by atrophy and fatty degeneration of the affected muscle tissue.
HP:0031462.definition_cn: 肌腱长度异常缩短，导致附着肌肉组织受到牵拉（回缩），伴随肌纤维缩短，常伴有受累肌肉组织的萎缩和脂肪变性。

HP:0031463.name: Esophageal squamous papilloma
HP:0031463.definition: A rare benign epithelial tumor that is usually asymptomatic but can present with pyrosis and epigastric discomfort with or without dysphagia. Histopathologically, esophageal squamous papilloma has fingerlike projections lined with acanthotic stratified squamous epithelium with conservation of normal cellular with or without cellular atypia.
HP:0031463.definition_cn: 一种罕见的良性上皮肿瘤，通常无症状，但可能表现为烧心和上腹不适，伴或不伴吞咽困难。组织病理学上，食管鳞状乳头瘤具有指状突起，表面覆盖棘层增厚的复层鳞状上皮，细胞形态正常，伴或不伴细胞异型性。

HP:0031464.name: Genital blistering
HP:0031464.definition: The presence of one or more bullae on the skin of the genital region, defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls.
HP:0031464.definition_cn: 生殖器区域皮肤上出现一个或多个大疱，定义为直径超过5毫米、壁薄的充满液体的水疱。

HP:0031465.name: Abnormal vasa vasorum morphology
HP:0031465.definition: A structural anomaly of vasa vasorum, which are defined as small blood vessels that supply or drain the walls of larger arteries and veins, delivering nutrients and oxygen as well as removing systemic waste products.
HP:0031465.definition_cn: 血管滋养管结构异常，血管滋养管定义为供应或引流较大动脉和静脉壁的小血管，负责输送营养物质和氧气，并清除全身代谢废物。

HP:0031466.name: Impairment in personality functioning
HP:0031466.definition: A maladaptive personality trait characterized by moderate or greater impairment in personality (self /interpersonal) functioning.
HP:0031466.definition_cn: 一种适应不良的人格特质，其特征为在人格（自我/人际）功能方面存在中度或更严重的损害。

HP:0031467.name: Abnormal negative emotional state
HP:0031467.definition: An aversive emotional state characterized by negative emotional experiences, preoccupations, or internal states that are often related to negative perceptions of the self, the world, or the future.
HP:0031467.definition_cn: 一种以负面情绪体验、强迫性思维或内在状态为特征的厌恶情绪状态，通常与对自我、世界或未来的消极认知相关。

HP:0031468.name: Separation insecurity
HP:0031468.definition: Fears of rejection by and/or separation from significant others are associated with fears of excessive dependency and complete loss of autonomy.
HP:0031468.definition_cn: 对被重要他人拒绝和/或分离的恐惧与对过度依赖和完全丧失自主性的恐惧相关。

HP:0031469.name: Low self-esteem
HP:0031469.definition: Persistent, excessively negative, and critical thoughts of one's personal abilities, attributes, or any feature related to the self and self-attitude. The affected individual believes they are a lesser being compared to others in their social peer group.
HP:0031469.definition_cn: 持续、过度消极且对个人能力、特质或任何与自我及自我态度相关特征的批判性思维。患者认为自己在社会同龄群体中处于较低地位。

HP:0031472.name: Risky behavior
HP:0031472.definition: Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments).
HP:0031472.definition_cn: 从事危险、高风险及潜在自我损害的活动，且不考虑后果，包括身体、健康相关及财务行为。此类行为涉及对自身局限的忽视及对个人危险的否认。尽管后果可能不会发生，但风险极高（例如超速驾驶、无保护措施的随意性行为或高风险投资）。

HP:0031473.name: Anger
HP:0031473.definition: Persistent or frequent inner feelings of anger, irritability, or resentment that may be in response to an action or statement by others that is perceived to be a slight or challenge to the person regardless of the nature. Anger may also occur or arise spontaneously in the absence of any provocation and can be directed to another person or social entity.
HP:0031473.definition_cn: 持续或频繁的内在愤怒、易怒或怨恨情绪，可能是对他人行为或言论的反应，无论其性质如何，这些行为或言论被感知为对个人的轻视或挑战。愤怒也可能在没有任何挑衅的情况下自发产生，并可能指向另一个人或社会实体。

HP:0031474.name: Pulmonary chondroma
HP:0031474.definition: A benign cartilaginous tumors of the lung.

HP:0031475.name: Status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms
HP:0031475.definition: There is inconclusive evidence to precisely define the duration of the seizure; however, based on current evidence an operational threshold of 10 minutes is appropriate as beyond this a seizure is likely to be more prolonged. The individual may or may not be aware or in coma.
HP:0031475.name_cn: 非惊厥性癫痫持续状态
HP:0031475.definition_cn: 目前尚无确凿证据精确定义癫痫发作的持续时间；然而，基于现有证据，10分钟的操作阈值是合适的，因为超过此时间，癫痫发作可能更为持久。患者可能意识清醒或处于昏迷状态。

HP:0031476.name: Abnormal buccal mucosa cell morphology
HP:0031476.definition: Any structural anomaly of the cells of the mucosa of the oral cavity in the region of the cheek (buccal mucosa cells).
HP:0031476.name_cn: 异常颊黏膜细胞形态学
HP:0031476.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜颊部区域（颊黏膜细胞）的任何细胞结构异常。

HP:0031477.name: obsolete Abnormal mitral valve morphology
HP:0031477.name_cn: 过时的异常二尖瓣形态

HP:0031478.name: Abnormal mitral valve annulus morphology
HP:0031478.definition: Any structural anomaly of the annulus of the mitral valve. The annulus is a ring composed of fibrous and myocardial tissue and is the structure onto which the cusps of the valve attach.
HP:0031478.definition_cn: 二尖瓣环的任何结构异常。瓣环是由纤维组织和心肌组织构成的环状结构，是瓣膜瓣叶附着的结构。

HP:0031479.name: Dilatation of the mitral annulus
HP:0031479.definition: An increase in the diameter of the ring (annulus) of the mitral valve.

HP:0031480.name: Abnormal mitral valve leaflet morphology
HP:0031480.definition: Any structural anomaly of the leaflets (also known as cusps) of the mitral valve.
HP:0031480.definition_cn: 二尖瓣瓣叶（亦称瓣尖）的任何结构异常。

HP:0031481.name: Abnormal mitral valve physiology
HP:0031481.definition: Any functional anomaly of the mitral valve.

HP:0031482.name: Abnormal regional left ventricular contraction
HP:0031482.definition: A wall motion abnormality observed upon left ventricular contraction that affects a specific region of the left ventricle.
HP:0031482.name_cn: 左心室区域性收缩异常
HP:0031482.definition_cn: 左心室收缩期间观察到的局部室壁运动异常，影响左心室的特定区域。

HP:0031483.name: Reduced contraction of the left ventricular apex
HP:0031483.definition: Reduced wall motion (contraction) of the apex of the left ventricle. This manifestation can be observed on echocardiography.
HP:0031483.name_cn: 左心室心尖部收缩功能减弱
HP:0031483.definition_cn: 左心室心尖部室壁运动（收缩）减弱。该表现可通过超声心动图观察到。

HP:0031484.name: Cold-induced hemolysis
HP:0031484.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia that can be triggered by cold temperatures.
HP:0031484.definition_cn: 一种可由低温引发的溶血性贫血。

HP:0031485.name: Subperiosteal bone formation
HP:0031485.definition: The formation of new bone along the cortex and underneath the periosteum of a bone.
HP:0031485.definition_cn: 沿骨皮质和骨膜下方形成的新骨。

HP:0031486.name: Vascular malformation of the lip
HP:0031486.definition: An anomaly of blood vessels located in the lip.

HP:0031487.name: Capillary malformation of the lip
HP:0031487.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is characterized by ectatic papillary dermal capillaries and postcapillary venules in the upper reticular dermis.
HP:0031487.definition_cn: 位于唇部的血管畸形，其特征为真皮网状层上部扩张的乳头状真皮毛细血管及毛细血管后微静脉。

HP:0031488.name: Arteriovenous malformation of the lip
HP:0031488.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is characterized by direct blood shunting from an artery to a vein due to the absence of a capillary bed. The artery and vein can be directly connected by a fistula or indirectly connected by an abnormal vessel channel termed a nidus.
HP:0031488.definition_cn: 位于唇部的血管畸形，其特征是由于缺乏毛细血管床，导致血液直接从动脉分流至静脉。动脉和静脉可通过瘘管直接连接，或通过称为巢的异常血管通道间接连接。

HP:0031489.name: Venous malformation of the lip
HP:0031489.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is related to abnormal vascular morphogenesis.
HP:0031489.definition_cn: 位于唇部的血管畸形，与异常血管形态发生相关。

HP:0031490.name: Hemangioma of the lip
HP:0031490.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is related to vascular endothelial cell hyperplasia.
HP:0031490.definition_cn: 位于唇部的血管畸形，与血管内皮细胞增生相关。

HP:0031491.name: Continuous spike and waves during slow sleep
HP:0031491.definition: Diffuse, bilateral and recently also unilateral or focal localization spike-wave occurring in slow sleep or non-rapid eye movement sleep.
HP:0031491.name_cn: 慢波睡眠期持续性棘慢波发放
HP:0031491.definition_cn: 弥漫性、双侧性以及近期出现的单侧性或局灶性定位的棘慢波，发生于慢波睡眠或非快速眼动睡眠期。

HP:0031492.name: Epithelial neoplasm
HP:0031492.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from and is composed of epithelial cells. This category include adenomas, papillomas, and carcinomas [NCIT:C3709].
HP:0031492.definition_cn: 一种起源于上皮细胞并由上皮细胞组成的良性或恶性肿瘤。该类别包括腺瘤、乳头状瘤和癌 [NCIT:C3709]。

HP:0031493.name: Glandular cell neoplasm
HP:0031493.definition: A tumor that arises from a gland cell.

HP:0031494.name: Ovarian mucinous tumor
HP:0031494.definition: Ovarian mucinous neoplasms consist of borderline tumors (tumors of low malignant potential, or LMP tumors), intraepithelial (non-invasive) carcinoma, and invasive carcinoma.
HP:0031494.definition_cn: 卵巢黏液性肿瘤包括交界性肿瘤（低度恶性潜能肿瘤，或LMP肿瘤）、上皮内（非浸润性）癌和浸润性癌。

HP:0031496.name: Mucinous cystic neoplasm of the pancreas
HP:0031496.definition: Mucin-producing and septated cyst-forming epithelial neoplasia of the pancreas with a distinctive ovarian-type stroma.
HP:0031496.definition_cn: 胰腺黏液分泌性及分隔性囊性上皮性肿瘤伴特征性卵巢样间质。

HP:0031497.name: Mucinous colorectal carcinoma
HP:0031497.definition: A subtype of colorectal carcinoma with mucin lakes.
HP:0031497.definition_cn: 一种伴有黏液湖的结直肠癌亚型。

HP:0031498.name: Mucinous gastric carcinoma
HP:0031498.definition: A poorly differentiated type of gastric carcinoma with a substantial amount of extracellular mucus (over 50% of tumor volume) within the tumor.
HP:0031498.definition_cn: 一种低分化的胃癌类型，肿瘤内含有大量细胞外黏液（超过肿瘤体积的50%）。

HP:0031499.name: Appendiceal mucinous neoplasm
HP:0031499.definition: An epithelial neoplasm originating in the appendix and often associated with cystic dilation of the appendix due to accumulation of gelatinous material, morphologically referred to as mucoceles.
HP:0031499.definition_cn: 一种起源于阑尾的上皮性肿瘤，常因凝胶样物质积聚导致阑尾囊性扩张，形态学上称为黏液囊肿。

HP:0031500.name: Abdominal mass
HP:0031500.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen.

HP:0031501.name: Pelvic mass
HP:0031501.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the pelvic region.

HP:0031502.name: Trophoblastic tumor
HP:0031502.definition: A gestational or non-gestational neoplasm composed of neoplastic trophoblastic cells [NCIT:C3422].
HP:0031502.definition_cn: 一种由肿瘤性滋养层细胞组成的妊娠性或非妊娠性肿瘤 [NCIT:C3422]。

HP:0031503.name: Night gasping
HP:0031503.definition: Waking up at night gasping for breath.

HP:0031504.name: Foamy urine
HP:0031504.definition: Urine has an increased amount of frothy fine bubbles.
HP:0031504.definition_cn: 尿液中出现大量泡沫性细小气泡。

HP:0031505.name: Abnormal circulating T4 concentration
HP:0031505.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of thyroxine in the blood. Thyroxine (also known as T4) is the main hormone secreted by the thyroid gland into the blood. It can be converted into the active form triiodothyronine (also known as T3).
HP:0031505.name_cn: 异常循环甲状腺素（T4）浓度
HP:0031505.definition_cn: 血液中甲状腺素浓度偏离正常值。甲状腺素（亦称T4）是由甲状腺分泌至血液中的主要激素，可转化为活性形式的三碘甲状腺原氨酸（亦称T3）。

HP:0031506.name: Increased circulating T4 concentration
HP:0031506.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of thyroxine in the blood. Thyroxine (also known as T4) is the main hormone secreted by the thyroid gland into the blood. It can be converted into the active form triiodothyronine (also known as T3).
HP:0031506.name_cn: 循环中甲状腺素（T4）浓度升高
HP:0031506.definition_cn: 血液中甲状腺素浓度高于正常水平。甲状腺素（也称为T4）是由甲状腺分泌到血液中的主要激素。它可以转化为活性形式的三碘甲状腺原氨酸（也称为T3）。

HP:0031507.name: Decreased circulating T4 concentration
HP:0031507.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of thyroxine in the blood. Thyroxine (also known as T4) is the main hormone secreted by the thyroid gland into the blood. It can be converted into the active form triiodothyronine (also known as T3).
HP:0031507.definition_cn: 血液中甲状腺素浓度低于正常水平。甲状腺素（也称为T4）是由甲状腺分泌到血液中的主要激素。它可以转化为活性形式的三碘甲状腺原氨酸（也称为T3）。

HP:0031508.name: Abnormal circulating thyroid hormone concentration
HP:0031508.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the hormones produced by the thyroid gland.
HP:0031508.name_cn: 异常循环甲状腺激素浓度

HP:0031509.name: Dry nipple
HP:0031509.definition: Abnormally dry skin in the area of the nipple of the breast.
HP:0031509.definition_cn: 乳头区域皮肤异常干燥。

HP:0031510.name: Linear earlobe crease
HP:0031510.definition: A transverse linear fissure (crease) in the lobule of the ear.
HP:0031510.definition_cn: 耳垂横向线性裂隙（皱褶）。

HP:0031511.name: Diagonal earlobe crease
HP:0031511.definition: Diagonal earlobe creases run from the lower pole of the external meatus, diagonally backwards to the edge of the lobe at approximately 45 degrees.
HP:0031511.definition_cn: 对角耳垂皱褶从外耳道下极开始，以大约45度角向后斜向延伸至耳垂边缘。

HP:0031512.name: Abnormal cutaneous collagen fibril morphology
HP:0031512.name_cn: 皮肤胶原纤维形态异常

HP:0031513.name: Luse bodies
HP:0031513.definition: Fusiform collagen fibers with abnormally long spacing (exceeding 100 nm) between electron-dense bands.
HP:0031513.definition_cn: 具有异常长间距（超过100纳米）的电子致密带之间的梭形胶原纤维。

HP:0031514.name: Increased proportion of exhausted T cells
HP:0031514.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of exhausted T cells (Tex) among circulating T cells. T cell exhaustion is a distinct differentiation state that can be distinguished from naive, effector, and memory T cells. Compared to effector (TE) and memory (TMEM) T cells, exhausted T cells (TEX) display impaired effector functions (e.g., rapid production of effector cytokines, cytotoxicity). TEX have limited proliferative potential, especially compared to some subsets of TMEM and naive T cells.
HP:0031514.definition_cn: 循环T细胞中耗竭T细胞（Tex）比例异常升高。T细胞耗竭是一种独特的分化状态，可与初始T细胞、效应T细胞和记忆T细胞区分开来。与效应T细胞（TE）和记忆T细胞（TMEM）相比，耗竭T细胞（TEX）表现出效应功能受损（例如，快速产生效应细胞因子、细胞毒性）。TEX的增殖潜力有限，尤其是与某些TMEM亚群和初始T细胞相比。

HP:0031515.name: Abnormal meiosis
HP:0031515.definition: Any anomaly of meiosis, a type of cell division that reduces the number of chromosomes in the parent cell by half and produces four gamete cells.
HP:0031515.definition_cn: 减数分裂异常，即一种细胞分裂过程中出现的任何异常，该过程将亲代细胞的染色体数目减半并产生四个配子细胞。

HP:0031516.name: Oocyte arrest at metaphase I
HP:0031516.definition: Failure of oocytes to proceed through the stages of meiosis with stoppage at the first metaphase stage.
HP:0031516.name_cn: 卵母细胞停滞于第一次减数分裂中期
HP:0031516.definition_cn: 卵母细胞在减数分裂过程中停滞于第一次减数分裂中期阶段，未能继续完成后续分裂过程。

HP:0031517.name: Verruciform xanthoma
HP:0031517.definition: A papillary or cauliflower-like growth characterized by the presence of foamy histiocytes within the elongated dermal papillae forms.
HP:0031517.definition_cn: 一种乳头状或菜花状生长物，其特征为在延长的真皮乳头结构内存在泡沫状组织细胞。

HP:0031518.name: Absent posterior alpha rhythm
HP:0031518.definition: Lack of normal alpha rhythm in the EEG. Alpha rhythm has been defined as a rhythm at 8-13 Hz occurring during wakefulness over the posterior regions of the head, generally with higher voltage over the occipital areas. Amplitude is variable but is mostly below 50 microvolt in adults. It is best seen with eyes closed and under conditions of physical relaxation and relative mental inactivity. It is blocked or attenuated by attention, especially visual and mental effort. One should here note the difference between the terms alpha rhythm and alpha activity: Alpha activity refers to activity in the range of 8-13 Hz and alpha rhythm is the activity of 8-13 Hz with specific characteristics as defined above.
HP:0031518.definition_cn: 脑电图（EEG）中缺乏正常的α节律。α节律被定义为在清醒状态下，头部后部区域出现的8-13 Hz的节律，通常在枕区具有较高的电压。振幅是可变的，但在成人中大多低于50微伏。在闭眼、身体放松和相对精神不活跃的条件下最为明显。它会被注意力（尤其是视觉和脑力活动）阻断或减弱。此处应注意α节律和α活动之间的区别：α活动指的是8-13 Hz范围内的活动，而α节律是具有上述特定特征的8-13 Hz活动。

HP:0031519.name: Cauliflower deformity of dermal collagen fibrils
HP:0031519.definition: An anomaly of collagen fibers of the skin that is said to resemble a cauliflower and can be appreciated by electron microscopy.
HP:0031519.name_cn: 皮肤胶原纤维的菜花状畸形
HP:0031519.definition_cn: 皮肤胶原纤维异常，其形态类似花椰菜，可通过电子显微镜观察。

HP:0031520.name: Groin pain
HP:0031520.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the groin region.
HP:0031520.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或钝痛），局限于腹股沟区域。

HP:0031521.name: Vaginal clear cell adenocarcinoma
HP:0031521.definition: A type of adenocarcinoma originating in the vagina and characterized by large cells with moderate to abundant clear cytoplasm.
HP:0031521.definition_cn: 一种起源于阴道的腺癌，其特征为具有中等至丰富透明胞浆的大细胞。

HP:0031522.name: Cervical clear cell adenocarcinoma
HP:0031522.definition: A type of adenocarcinoma originating in the cervix and characterized by large cells with moderate to abundant clear cytoplasm.
HP:0031522.definition_cn: 一种起源于宫颈的腺癌，其特征为具有中等至丰富透明胞浆的大细胞。

HP:0031523.name: Salivary gland oncocytoma
HP:0031523.definition: A benign epithelial neoplasm composed of layers of oncocytes (small round nucleus, micro-granular, eosinophilic cytoplasm with numerous tightly-packed mitochondria)
HP:0031523.definition_cn: 一种良性上皮性肿瘤，由多层嗜酸性细胞（具有小圆形细胞核、微颗粒状、嗜酸性胞质，内含大量紧密排列的线粒体）构成。

HP:0031524.name: Ampulla of Vater carcinoma
HP:0031524.definition: A carcinoma originating in the ampulla of Vater (also known as the hepatopancreatic duct), which is formed by the union of the pancreatic duct and the common bile duct.
HP:0031524.definition_cn: 一种起源于Vater壶腹（也称为肝胰管）的癌，该结构由胰管和胆总管汇合形成。

HP:0031525.name: Keratoacanthoma
HP:0031525.definition: Keratoacanthoma (KA) is a common benign epithelial tumor that originates from the pilosebaceous glands. In most cases, it is characterized by rapid evolution, followed by spontaneous resolution over 4 to 6 months. KA usually presents as a solitary flesh-coloured nodule with a central keratin plug on the sun-exposed skin of elderly individuals.
HP:0031525.definition_cn: 角化棘皮瘤（Keratoacanthoma, KA）是一种常见的良性上皮性肿瘤，起源于毛囊皮脂腺。在大多数情况下，其特征为快速进展，随后在4至6个月内自发消退。KA通常表现为老年患者日光暴露皮肤上的孤立性肉色结节，中央伴有角蛋白栓。

HP:0031526.name: Subretinal fluid
HP:0031526.definition: Edema/fluid accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane.
HP:0031526.definition_cn: 视网膜色素上皮与布鲁赫膜之间的水肿/液体积聚。

HP:0031527.name: Retinal edema
HP:0031527.definition: Accumulation of fluid within the layers of the retina not limited to the macular region.
HP:0031527.definition_cn: 视网膜各层间液体积聚，不局限于黄斑区。

HP:0031528.name: Subretinal deposits
HP:0031528.definition: Deposits accumulating between the outer retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:0031528.definition_cn: 视网膜外层与视网膜色素上皮层之间的沉积物积聚。

HP:0031529.name: Focal subretinal deposits
HP:0031529.definition: Deposits accumulating between the outer retina and the retinal pigment epithelium and that have a focal distribution.
HP:0031529.name_cn: 局灶性视网膜下沉积物
HP:0031529.definition_cn: 沉积物积聚于外层视网膜与视网膜色素上皮之间，呈局灶性分布。

HP:0031530.name: Multifocal subretinal deposits
HP:0031530.definition: Deposits accumulating between the outer retina and the retinal pigment epithelium and that are distributed with multiple foci.
HP:0031530.name_cn: 多灶性视网膜下沉积物
HP:0031530.definition_cn: 沉积物积聚于外层视网膜与视网膜色素上皮之间，并呈多灶性分布。

HP:0031531.name: Sub-RPE deposits
HP:0031531.definition: Deposits accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane.
HP:0031531.name_cn: 视网膜色素上皮下沉积物
HP:0031531.definition_cn: 视网膜色素上皮与布鲁赫膜之间的沉积物积聚。

HP:0031532.name: Focal sub-RPE deposits
HP:0031532.definition: Deposits accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane and that are distributed in a single focus.
HP:0031532.name_cn: 局灶性视网膜色素上皮下沉积物
HP:0031532.definition_cn: 沉积物积聚于视网膜色素上皮层与布鲁赫膜之间，并以单一病灶形式分布。

HP:0031533.name: Multifocal sub-RPE deposits
HP:0031533.definition: Deposits accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane and that are distributed in multiple foci.
HP:0031533.name_cn: 多灶性视网膜色素上皮下沉积物
HP:0031533.definition_cn: 视网膜色素上皮与布鲁赫膜之间积聚的沉积物，呈多灶性分布。

HP:0031534.name: Passive dorsiflexion of the 5th finger more than 90 degrees
HP:0031534.definition: An abnormally increased ability to bend (dorsiflex) one's fifth finger. To assess this feature, the examiner requests to proband to extend the elbows,to bend the wrist back so that it forms a ninety degree angle to the forearm, and to extend the fingers. Then, the proband is requested to bend the fifth finger back as far as is possible without discomfort. If the angle of the fifth finger exceeds 90 degrees, this is considered to be abnormal.
HP:0031534.name_cn: 第五指被动背屈超过90度
HP:0031534.definition_cn: 第五指背屈能力异常增强。为评估此特征，检查者要求受试者伸展肘部，使腕部背屈至与前臂呈90度角，并伸展手指。随后，受试者被要求尽可能无不适地背屈第五指。若第五指背屈角度超过90度，则视为异常。

HP:0031535.name: Increased theta frequency activity in EEG
HP:0031535.definition: Increased frequency of theta wave activity in the electroencephalogram. Theta waves have a frequency of 3.5-7.5 Hertz, and are present in very small amounts in healthy waking adult EEGs. Theta activity is normal in small very amounts in the healthy waking adult EEG in a symmetrical distribution.
HP:0031535.name_cn: 脑电图（EEG）中θ频段活动增强
HP:0031535.definition_cn: 脑电图中θ波活动频率增加。θ波的频率为3.5-7.5赫兹，在健康清醒成人的脑电图中仅存在极少量。在健康清醒成人的脑电图中，θ活动在对称分布下以极少量存在是正常的。

HP:0031536.name: Separate origin of the left anterior descending and left circumflex artery
HP:0031536.definition: Anomalous coronary origin whereby the left anterior descending (LAD) and the left circumflex artery (LCX) arise separately. Normally, these arteries arise from a common stem, the left main coronary artery (LMCA).
HP:0031536.name_cn: 左前降支和左回旋支的独立起源
HP:0031536.definition_cn: 冠状动脉起源异常，其中左前降支（LAD）和左回旋支（LCX）分别独立起源。正常情况下，这些动脉起源于共同的干，即左主干冠状动脉（LMCA）。

HP:0031537.name: Anomalous origin of the left circumflex artery from the right coronary artery
HP:0031537.definition: An abnormal origin of the left circumflex artery (LCX) from the right coronary artery. Normally, the left anterior descending (LAD) and the LCX arise from a common stem, the left main coronary artery (LMCA).
HP:0031537.name_cn: 左回旋支起源于右冠状动脉的异常
HP:0031537.definition_cn: 左回旋支（LCX）起源于右冠状动脉的异常。正常情况下，左前降支（LAD）和左回旋支（LCX）共同起源于左主干冠状动脉（LMCA）。

HP:0031538.name: Abnormal dermoepidermal junction morphology
HP:0031538.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the acellular zone that is between the dermis and the epidermis and which functions to bind the epidermis to the dermis and to serve as a selective barrier allowing the control of molecular and cellular exchanges between the two compartments.
HP:0031538.name_cn: 真皮表皮连接处形态异常
HP:0031538.definition_cn: 位于真皮与表皮之间的无细胞区结构异常，该区域功能为将表皮与真皮结合，并作为选择性屏障，控制两个区域之间的分子和细胞交换。

HP:0031539.name: Linear IgA deposits along the epidermal basement membrane zone
HP:0031539.definition: Presence of IgA antibodies in the dermoepidermal junction that are distributed in a linear pattern. This feature can be appreciated by immunofluorescence microscopy.
HP:0031539.name_cn: 沿表皮基底膜带线性IgA沉积
HP:0031539.definition_cn: 真皮表皮交界处存在呈线性分布的IgA抗体。此特征可通过免疫荧光显微镜观察到。

HP:0031540.name: Linear IgG deposits along the epidermal basement membrane zone
HP:0031540.definition: Presence of IgG antibodies in the dermoepidermal junction that are distributed in a linear pattern. This feature can be appreciated by immunofluorescence microscopy.
HP:0031540.name_cn: 沿表皮基底膜带线性IgG沉积
HP:0031540.definition_cn: 真皮表皮交界处存在呈线性分布的IgG抗体。此特征可通过免疫荧光显微镜观察。

HP:0031541.name: Linear C3 deposits along the epidermal basement membrane zone
HP:0031541.definition: Presence of complement C3 in the dermoepidermal junction that are distributed in a linear pattern. This feature can be appreciated by immunofluorescence microscopy.
HP:0031541.name_cn: 沿表皮基底膜区线性C3沉积
HP:0031541.definition_cn: 真皮-表皮交界处存在呈线性分布的补体C3。该特征可通过免疫荧光显微镜观察到。

HP:0031542.name: Myelin-like whorls in vacuolated fibers
HP:0031542.definition: Muscle fibers contain one or more vacuoles (membrane-bound cavity) associated with collections of membranes arranged in a whorl-like (spiral or circular) manner.
HP:0031542.name_cn: 空泡化纤维中的髓鞘样涡旋结构
HP:0031542.definition_cn: 肌纤维内包含一个或多个液泡（膜结合腔），这些液泡与呈涡旋状（螺旋或环形）排列的膜集合体相关联。

HP:0031544.name: Elevated circulating palmitoleylcarnitine concentration
HP:0031544.definition: An elevated level of propionylcarnitine in the circulation. Propionylcarnitine is present in high abundance in the urine of patients with Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase (MUT) deficiency.
HP:0031544.name_cn: 循环棕榈酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0031544.definition_cn: 循环中丙酰肉碱水平升高。丙酰肉碱在甲基丙二酰辅酶A变位酶（MUT）缺乏症患者的尿液中含量较高。

HP:0031545.name: Abnormally low T cell receptor excision circle level
HP:0031545.definition: Reduced level of T cell receptor excision circle (TRECs) as measured by the TREC assay. Late in maturation, 70% of thymocytes that will ultimately express alpha/beta-T cell receptors form a circular DNA TREC from the excised TCRdelta gene that lies within the TCRalpha genetic locus. The circles are stable but do not increase following cell division and, therefore, become diluted as T cells proliferate. A quantitative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) reaction across the joint of the circular DNA provides the TREC copy number, a marker of newly-formed, antigenically-na茂ve thymic emigrant T cells.
HP:0031545.name_cn: 异常低水平的T细胞受体切除环水平
HP:0031545.definition_cn: 通过TREC检测法测得的T细胞受体切除环（TRECs）水平降低。在成熟后期，70%最终表达α/β-T细胞受体的胸腺细胞会从位于TCRα基因座内的切除TCRδ基因形成环状DNA TREC。这些环状结构稳定，但在细胞分裂后不会增加，因此随着T细胞的增殖而被稀释。通过定量聚合酶链反应（PCR）对环状DNA连接处进行反应，可提供TREC拷贝数，这是新形成的、抗原未接触的胸腺迁出T细胞的标志物。

HP:0031546.name: Cardiac conduction abnormality
HP:0031546.definition: Any anomaly of the progression of electrical impulses through the heart.

HP:0031547.name: Abnormal QT interval
HP:0031547.definition: Any anomaly of the time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).
HP:0031547.definition_cn: QT间期异常（即心电图（EKG）测量的Q波起始至T波结束的时间间隔的任何异常）。

HP:0031548.name: Follicular infundibulum tumor
HP:0031548.definition: A cutaneous adnexal neoplasm with variable clinical presentation. It tends to be located in the head and neck and the presentation is papulonodular, scaly, asymptomatic, measuring up to 1-2cm, simulating a basal cell carcinoma.
HP:0031548.definition_cn: 一种临床表现多样的皮肤附属器肿瘤。其好发于头颈部，表现为丘疹结节状、鳞屑性、无症状，大小可达1-2厘米，类似于基底细胞癌。

HP:0031549.name: Lymphocytoma cutis
HP:0031549.definition: Lymphocytoma cutis, or Spiegler-Fendt sarcoid, is classed as one of the pseudolymphomas, referring to inflammatory disorders in which the accumulation of lymphocytes on the skin resemble, clinically and histopathologically, cutaneous lymphomas. Careful clinical evaluation, histopathological and immunohistochemical exams may be needed to make the correct diagnosis.
HP:0031549.definition_cn: 皮肤淋巴细胞瘤，或称施皮格勒-芬特肉样瘤，被归类为假性淋巴瘤之一，指的是在皮肤上淋巴细胞积聚的炎症性疾病，在临床和组织病理学上与皮肤淋巴瘤相似。为了做出正确的诊断，可能需要进行仔细的临床评估、组织病理学和免疫组织化学检查。

HP:0031550.name: Abnormal flow cytometry test result
HP:0031550.definition: Any abnormal result of flow cytometry, a method that suspends cells in a stream of fluid and passes them through an electronic detection apparatus in order to assess cell count or measure biomarkers or surface molecules.
HP:0031550.name_cn: 流式细胞术检测结果异常
HP:0031550.definition_cn: 流式细胞术检测结果异常。流式细胞术是一种将细胞悬浮于流体中并通过电子检测装置以评估细胞计数或测量生物标志物或表面分子的方法。

HP:0031551.name: Reduced cell surface marker level
HP:0031551.definition: Reduced level of a protein that is normally present on the cell surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031551.name_cn: 细胞表面标志物水平降低
HP:0031551.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估，细胞表面正常存在的蛋白质水平降低。

HP:0031552.name: Reduced fibroblast surface marker level
HP:0031552.definition: Reduced level of a protein that is normally present on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031552.name_cn: 成纤维细胞表面标志物水平降低
HP:0031552.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估，成纤维细胞表面正常存在的蛋白质水平降低。

HP:0031553.name: Reduced granulocyte surface marker level
HP:0031553.definition: Reduced level of a protein that is normally present on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031553.name_cn: 粒细胞表面标志物水平降低
HP:0031553.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估，粒细胞表面正常存在的蛋白质水平降低。

HP:0031554.name: Reduced granulocyte CD55 level
HP:0031554.definition: Reduced level of CD55 on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031554.definition_cn: 流式细胞术检测显示粒细胞表面CD55水平降低。

HP:0031555.name: Reduced granulocyte CD59 level
HP:0031555.definition: Reduced level of CD59 on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031555.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估，粒细胞表面CD59水平降低。

HP:0031556.name: Reduced granulocyte CD16 level
HP:0031556.definition: Reduced level of CD16 on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031556.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估，粒细胞表面CD16水平降低。

HP:0031557.name: Reduced fibroblast CD55 level
HP:0031557.definition: Reduced level of CD55 on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031557.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估的成纤维细胞表面CD55水平降低。

HP:0031558.name: Reduced fibroblast CD59 level
HP:0031558.definition: Reduced level of CD59 on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031558.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估的成纤维细胞表面CD59水平降低。

HP:0031559.name: Reduced fibroblast CD16 level
HP:0031559.definition: Reduced level of CD16 on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0031559.definition_cn: 通过流式细胞术评估，成纤维细胞表面CD16水平降低。

HP:0031560.name: Coronary cameral fistula
HP:0031560.definition: An abnormal communication between coronary artery and a cardiac chamber.
HP:0031560.definition_cn: 冠状动脉与心腔之间的异常交通。

HP:0031561.name: Coronary cameral fistula to right ventricle
HP:0031561.definition: An abnormal communication between the terminus of a coronary artery, bypassing the myocardial capillary bed and entering the right ventricle.
HP:0031561.definition_cn: 冠状动脉末端与右心室之间的异常交通，绕过心肌毛细血管床。

HP:0031562.name: Balanced double aortic arch
HP:0031562.definition: A type of double aortic arch in which the two branches are of equal size. In most cases of double aortic arch, the right aortic arch is larger and located higher than the left aortic arch.
HP:0031562.definition_cn: 一种双主动脉弓类型，其中两个分支大小相等。在大多数双主动脉弓病例中，右主动脉弓较大且位置高于左主动脉弓。

HP:0031563.name: Coronary arteriovenous fistula
HP:0031563.definition: An abnormal communication between the terminus of a coronary artery, bypassing the myocardial capillary bed and entering any segment of the systemic or pulmonary circulation.
HP:0031563.definition_cn: 冠状动脉末端与体循环或肺循环任何节段之间的异常交通，绕过心肌毛细血管床。

HP:0031564.name: Bronchial isomerism
HP:0031564.definition: An anomalous mirror-imaged arrangement of some bronchial structures. Right isomerism is defined as a subset of heterotaxy where some paired structures on opposite sides of the left-right axis of the body are symmetrical mirror images of each other, and have the morphology of the normal right-sided structures (vice versa for left isomerism).
HP:0031564.definition_cn: 一种异常的镜像排列的支气管结构。右同构性被定义为异位症的一个亚型，其中身体左右轴两侧的一些成对结构彼此呈对称镜像，并具有正常右侧结构的形态（左同构性则相反）。

HP:0031565.name: Abdominal situs ambiguus
HP:0031565.definition: An abnormality in which the abdominal organs are positioned in such a way with respect to each other and the left-right axis as to be not clearly lateralised and thus have neither the usual, or normal (situs solitus), nor the mirror-imaged (situs inversus) arrangements.
HP:0031565.definition_cn: 一种异常情况，其中腹部器官相对于彼此和左右轴的位置不明确，因此既不具有通常或正常的排列（正位，situs solitus），也不具有镜像排列（反位，situs inversus）。

HP:0031566.name: Abnormal pulmonary valve cusp morphology
HP:0031566.definition: Any structural anomaly of the pulmonary valve leaflets.

HP:0031567.name: Abnormal aortic valve cusp morphology
HP:0031567.definition: Any structural anomaly of the aortic valve leaflets.

HP:0031568.name: Thickened aortic valve cusp
HP:0031568.definition: An abnormally increased thickness of a leaflet of the aortic valve.

HP:0031569.name: Absent aortic valve cusps
HP:0031569.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the lack of aortic valve cusps (leaflets). There may be remnants of the aortic valve in form of a nonobstructive fibrous ridge or rudimentary leaflets or sinuses of Valsalva.
HP:0031569.definition_cn: 一种以主动脉瓣瓣叶缺失为特征的发育缺陷。可能存在主动脉瓣残余，表现为非梗阻性纤维嵴或原始瓣叶或Valsalva窦。

HP:0031570.name: Tessier number 0 facial cleft
HP:0031570.definition: A Number 0 Tessier cleft is a true median cleft lip with a broad columella and bifid nasal tip. The alveolar cleft is between the central incisors. The nasal septum may be thickened, duplicated, or absent. The nasal bridge is usually broad with associated orbital hypertelorism. The midline soft tissue anomaly may range from a mild broadening of the philtrum or there may be a true median cleft lip. The columella and nasal tip are typically bifid and broadened with a midline depression. The alae nasi are intact but laterally displaced. The nose appears shortened in the vertical dimension.
HP:0031570.definition_cn: 0号Tessier裂隙是一种真正的正中唇裂，伴有宽阔的鼻小柱和分叉的鼻尖。牙槽裂位于中切牙之间。鼻中隔可能增厚、重复或缺失。鼻梁通常宽阔，伴有眶距增宽。中线软组织异常可能表现为人中轻度增宽，也可能出现真正的正中唇裂。鼻小柱和鼻尖通常分叉并增宽，伴有中线凹陷。鼻翼完整但向外侧移位。鼻子在垂直方向上显得缩短。

HP:0031571.name: Paramedian facial cleft
HP:0031571.definition: A type of facial cleft located near to but not directly on the midline of the face.
HP:0031571.definition_cn: 一种位于面部中线附近但未直接位于面部中线的面裂类型。

HP:0031572.name: Tessier number 1 facial cleft
HP:0031572.definition: As seen in a typical cleft lip, a cleft of the lip is found in the region of the cupid's bow. The nostril is cleft through the alar dome and extends above onto the nasal dorsum. It passes medial to a normal, but dys- topic, medial canthus. There is an alveolar cleft between the central and lateral incisors that extends above through the pyriform margin lateral to the anterior nasal spine; the nasal septum is not involved. The bony cleft extends through the nasal bone or between the junction of the nasal bone and frontal process of the maxilla. Above the cleft lip, the clefting of the alar dome is associated with deviation to the opposite side of the shortened and broadened columella and nasal tip. Extension of the soft tissue cleft onto the nasal dorsum can be manifest as a series of vertical soft tissue furrows and ridges. Vertical inner canthal dysto- pia and severe telecanthus mark the superior aspect of the Number 1 facial cleft. A cranial soft tissue extension characterized by a tongue-like projection of the frontal hairline delineates the number 13 cleft. Skeletal clefting of the maxilla may extend posteriorly to form a complete cleft of the hard and soft palate. The maxilla is hypoplastic in all three dimensions. There is a keel-shaped alveolus and anterior open bite. Normal septation is preserved between the nasal cavity and the hypoplastic maxillary antrum on the affected side. Distortion of the nasal skeleton produces gross flattening of the nasal dorsum. There is asymmetry of the pterygoid plates, of the greater and lesser wings of the sphenoid, and of the floor of the anterior cranial fossa. The distortion of the cranial base may result in a mild plagiocephaly.
HP:0031572.definition_cn: 在典型的唇裂中，唇裂位于丘比特弓区域。鼻孔通过鼻翼穹窿裂开并延伸至鼻背上方。裂口通过正常但异位的内眦内侧。中央切牙与侧切牙之间存在牙槽裂，裂口向上延伸至前鼻棘外侧的梨状孔边缘；鼻中隔未受累。骨性裂口穿过鼻骨或位于鼻骨与上颌骨额突交界处。在唇裂上方，鼻翼穹窿的裂开与对侧缩短和增宽的鼻小柱及鼻尖的偏斜相关。软组织裂口延伸至鼻背可表现为一系列垂直的软组织沟和脊。垂直内眦异位和严重的内眦间距增宽标志着1号面部裂的上部特征。颅骨软组织延伸表现为额发际线的舌状突起，标志着13号裂的特征。上颌骨的骨性裂口可能向后延伸，形成硬腭和软腭的完全裂。上颌骨在三个维度上均发育不全。存在龙骨状牙槽和前牙开合。患侧鼻腔与发育不全的上颌窦之间的正常分隔得以保留。鼻骨架的扭曲导致鼻背显著扁平。翼突板、蝶骨大翼和小翼以及前颅窝底存在不对称。颅底扭曲可能导致轻度斜头畸形。

HP:0031573.name: Tessier number 2 facial cleft
HP:0031573.definition: As is typically seen in isolated cleft cases, a cleft of the lip is present. There is hypoplasia, but not true notching of the ala nasi with flattening of the lateral part of the nose. The nasal root is broadened, with lateral displacement of the inner canthus. The palpebral fissure and lacrimal drainage system are not disturbed. The alveolar cleft is through the lateral incisor area and extends to the pyriform aperture. There is normal septation between the nasal cavity and maxillary sinus. Notching at the junction between the nasal bone is present, as is a broad, flat frontal process of the maxilla. Transverse ethmoid enlargement produces orbital hypertelorism. Above the cleft of the lip and palate is a true broad cleft of the nostril that is medial to the intact, but laterally displaced, tail of the alar cartilage. A shallow soft tissue groove extends superiorly to the asymmetrically widened nasal root. The lacrimal system, palpebral fissures, and eyebrows remain intact. The alveolar cleft extends posteriorly as a complete unilateral cleft of the hard and soft palate. The nasal septum is intact but deviated to the opposite side. The nasal cavity remains separated from the normally pneumatized, although hypoplastic, maxilla on the cleft side. Above the nasomaxillary notching, the ethmoid sinus is less well developed, and there is no pneumatization of the frontal sinus on this side. Anterior rotation of the greater and lesser wings of the sphenoid occurs on the cleft side in relation to the narrower orbit and smaller ethmoid sinus. There is mild asymmetry of the anterior cranial fossa, which is narrower on the cleft side. The cranium is brachycephalic with marked occipital flattening.
HP:0031573.definition_cn: 在典型的孤立性唇裂病例中，可见唇裂存在。鼻翼发育不全，但未形成真正的切迹，且鼻外侧部分扁平。鼻根增宽，内眦向外侧移位。睑裂和泪道引流系统未受干扰。牙槽裂通过侧切牙区域延伸至梨状孔。鼻腔与上颌窦之间的分隔正常。鼻骨交界处存在切迹，上颌骨的额突宽而扁平。筛骨横向扩大导致眶距增宽。在唇腭裂上方，鼻孔存在真正的宽裂，位于完整但向外侧移位的鼻翼软骨尾部内侧。一条浅的软组织沟向上延伸至不对称增宽的鼻根。泪道系统、睑裂和眉毛保持完整。牙槽裂向后延伸为完全性单侧硬腭和软腭裂。鼻中隔完整但偏向对侧。鼻腔与患侧虽发育不全但气化正常的上颌骨保持分隔。在鼻上颌切迹上方，筛窦发育较差，且该侧额窦未气化。蝶骨大翼和小翼在患侧相对于较窄的眶和较小的筛窦发生前旋。前颅窝存在轻度不对称，患侧较窄。颅骨呈短头型，枕部明显扁平。

HP:0031574.name: Orbital cleft
HP:0031574.definition: A facial cleft characterized by involvement of the orbit.
HP:0031574.definition_cn: 一种以眼眶受累为特征的面裂畸形。

HP:0031575.name: Tessier number 3 facial cleft
HP:0031575.definition: As in the Number 1 and Number 2 clefts, this cleft extends through the lip in the region of the typical cleft lip; however, it does not extend through the base. The cleft continues superiorly to involve the inner canthus and lower eyelid medial to the inferior lacrimal punctum, thereby disrupting the nasolacrimal system. Microphthalmia may be present. The alveolar cleft is between the lateral incisor and the canine. Absent septation between the nasal cavity and maxillary antrum, together with the distortion of the frontal process of the maxilla and lacrimal fossa, produces direct communication between the orbit, maxillary sinus, and nose. There is hypoplasia of the soft tissue margins of the cleft in the vertical dimension. This produces extreme soft tissue deficiency between the alar base and the cleft of the medial aspect of the lower eyelid. The inferior lacrimal punctum is evident at the lateral margin of the lower eyelid cleft. The lacrimal drainage system ends as an opening directly onto the cheek without communication into the nasal cavity. The globe is normal in size, but it is displaced inferiorly and laterally. The nasal septum shows the characteristic distortion seen in typical cleft lip and palate. There is absence of septation between the nasal cavity on the cleft side and the maxilla. The maxilla is hypoplastic in three dimensions, with a marked reduction in pneumatization. Superior extension of the skeletal clefting into the medial portion of the orbital floor and into the inferior orbital rim in the region of the frontal process of the maxilla allows direct communication between the orbit above and the nasomaxillary region below. There is mild narrowing of the ethmoid sinus and of the body of the sphenoid on the cleft side. The pterygoid process appears anatomically normal, but less displaced from the midline compared with that of the noncleft side. Both the orbit and the floor of the anterior cranial fossa are inferiorly displaced.
HP:0031575.definition_cn: 与第1号和第2号裂隙相似，该裂隙延伸至典型唇裂区域的唇部；然而，它并未延伸至基底。裂隙向上延伸，累及内眦及下泪点内侧的下眼睑，从而破坏了鼻泪系统。可能存在小眼畸形。牙槽裂隙位于侧切牙与尖牙之间。鼻腔与上颌窦之间的分隔缺失，加上上颌骨额突和泪囊窝的变形，导致眼眶、上颌窦和鼻腔之间直接相通。裂隙的软组织边缘在垂直方向上发育不全。这导致鼻翼基底与下眼睑内侧裂隙之间的软组织极度缺乏。下泪点明显位于下眼睑裂隙的外侧边缘。泪液引流系统末端直接开口于颊部，未与鼻腔相通。眼球大小正常，但向下和向外侧移位。鼻中隔显示出典型唇腭裂中常见的特征性变形。裂隙侧的鼻腔与上颌骨之间的分隔缺失。上颌骨在三维方向上发育不全，气化显著减少。骨骼裂隙向上延伸至眼眶底内侧部分及上颌骨额突区域的眶下缘，使得上方眼眶与下方鼻上颌区域直接相通。裂隙侧的筛窦和蝶窦体部轻度狭窄。翼突在解剖学上看似正常，但与未裂隙侧相比，偏离中线的程度较小。眼眶和前颅窝底均向下移位。

HP:0031576.name: Tessier number 4 facial cleft
HP:0031576.definition: The cleft lip is midway between the philtral ridge and the commissure of the mouth. The cleft is lateral to the normally shaped and placed nasal ala and passes onto the cheek. The cleft extends through the lower eyelid lateral to the punctum. The lacrimal system and inner canthus are normal. Microphthalmia may be present. The alveolar cleft passes between the lateral incisor and canine, as in the Number 3 cleft. The cleft passes around the pyriform aperture and continues through the portion of the maxillary sinus medial to the infraorbital foramen. The cleft terminates at the medial end of the inferior orbital rim. There is severe vertical soft tissue deficiency in a Number 4 cleft, with the medial margins of the cleft lip extending directly into the medially placed cleft of the lower eyelid. Within the medial segment of the right-sided cleft lip, muscle elements are apparently absent. Muscle bunching is noted in the ipsilateral lateral lip segment, as is seen in a typical unilateral cleft lip. The anatomically normal nasal ala is superiorly displaced in association with a severe deficiency in the overall nasal length. Marked dystopia of the right globe results in its inferior displacement into the medially deficient orbital floor and inferior rim. Both globes are otherwise normal. The complete palatal cleft passes through the maxilla medial to the infraorbital foramen and extends to the medial portion of the inferior orbital rim without evidence of an intact maxillary sinus. Bony septation persists medially, thereby separating the nasal cavity from the orbit, maxillary sinus, and mouth, which are contiguous. Marked midfacial hypoplasia is present. The cleft is manifest as asymmetry of the body of the sphenoid; it is smaller on the right, with asymmetric placement of the pterygoid plates relative to the midline. The orbital floor cleft has no communication with the inferior orbital fissure. The cleft does not extend to the skull base, but there is marked facial asymmetry associated with plagiocephaly.
