HP:0032094.definition_cn: 血液循环中表面活性蛋白浓度升高。肺表面活性物质是一种高度表面活性的蛋白质和脂质混合物，由II型上皮细胞合成并分泌到肺泡上。表面活性物质的蛋白质部分由四种表面活性蛋白（SP）组成，即SP-A、SP-B、SP-C和SP-D。SP-A和SP-D是亲水性蛋白，调节表面活性物质的代谢并具有免疫功能。这两种蛋白可在血液中检测到，其水平升高可能反映特发性肺纤维化。

HP:0032096.name: Abnormal manganese concentration
HP:0032096.definition: A deviation from the normal range of manganese in the blood circulation.
HP:0032096.definition_cn: 血液循环中锰水平偏离正常范围。

HP:0032097.name: Hypermanganesemia
HP:0032097.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of manganese in the blood.

HP:0032098.name: Hypomanganesemia
HP:0032098.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of manganese in the blood.

HP:0032099.name: Perioral radial furrowing
HP:0032099.definition: The presence of radial grooves in the skin surrounding the mouth (see Figure 4 of PMID:27833976).
HP:0032099.definition_cn: 口周皮肤存在放射状沟纹（参见PMID:27833976图4）。

HP:0032100.name: Abnormal doll's eye reflex
HP:0032100.definition: The doll's eye reflex (also known as oculocephalic reflex) is a test of brain function that is performed in comatose patients by elevating the head roughly 30 degrees and rapidly rotating the head from side to side with the eyes kept open. A normal response is for the eyes to move in the opposite direction. If the eyes do not move in the opposite direction this may indicate severe brain damage.
HP:0032100.definition_cn: 玩偶眼反射（亦称眼头反射）是一种用于评估昏迷患者脑功能的检查方法。操作时，将患者头部抬高约30度，保持双眼睁开，并迅速将头部向两侧旋转。正常反应为眼球向相反方向移动。若眼球未向相反方向移动，则可能提示严重脑损伤。

HP:0032101.name: Unusual infection
HP:0032101.definition: A type of infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection. There are five general subtypes. (i) Opportunistic infection, meaning infection by a pathogen that is not normally able to cause infection in a healthy host (e.g., pneumonia by Pneumocystis jirovecii or CMV); (ii) Unusual location (focus) of an infection (e.g., an aspergillus brain abscess); (iii) a protracted course or lack of adequate response to treatment (e.g., chronic rhinosinusitis); (iv) Unusual severity or intensity of an infection; and (v) unusual recurrence of infections.
HP:0032101.definition_cn: 一种被视为病理性易感性标志的感染类型。其可分为五种主要亚型：(i) 机会性感染，即由通常无法在健康宿主中引起感染的病原体所致感染（例如，由耶氏肺孢子菌或巨细胞病毒引起的肺炎）；(ii) 感染的异常部位（病灶）（例如，曲霉菌性脑脓肿）；(iii) 病程迁延或对治疗缺乏充分反应（例如，慢性鼻窦炎）；(iv) 感染的异常严重性或强度；以及(v) 感染的异常复发。

HP:0032102.name: Wilson sign
HP:0032102.definition: Wilson sign is defined as the elicitation of pain by internally rotating the patient's tibia during knee extension between 90 degrees and 30 degrees of flexion and then relieving that pain by externally rotating the tibia.
HP:0032102.definition_cn: 威尔逊征（Wilson sign）定义为在膝关节屈曲90度至30度之间进行伸展时，通过内旋患者胫骨引发疼痛，随后通过外旋胫骨缓解该疼痛。

HP:0032104.name: Saccadic oscillation
HP:0032104.definition: An involuntary abnormality of fixation in which there is an abnormal saccade away from fixation followed by an immediate corrective saccade.
HP:0032104.definition_cn: 一种不自主的注视异常，表现为从注视点异常扫视偏离后立即进行纠正性扫视。

HP:0032105.name: Macrosaccadic oscillations
HP:0032105.definition: A type of saccadic oscillations with brief periods of fixation between saccades (intersaccadic interval approximately 200 msec). Macrosaccadic oscillations (up to 40 degrees) straddle the intended fixation position and show a crescendo-decrescendo pattern.
HP:0032105.definition_cn: 一种类型的扫视振荡，在扫视之间有短暂的固视期（扫视间期约为200毫秒）。大扫视振荡（可达40度）跨越目标固视位置，并呈现渐强-渐弱模式。

HP:0032106.name: Conjunctival icterus
HP:0032106.definition: Conjunctival icterus is a condition where there is yellowing of the whites of the eyes. This is most commonly seen in patients who have liver disease.
HP:0032106.definition_cn: 结膜黄疸是一种表现为眼白部分黄染的病症，最常见于肝病患者。

HP:0032107.name: Limbal stem cell deficiency
HP:0032107.definition: A condition characterized by a loss or deficiency of the stem cells in the limbus that are vital for re-population of the corneal epithelium and to the barrier function of the limbus.
HP:0032107.definition_cn: 一种以角膜缘干细胞缺失或缺乏为特征的疾病，这些干细胞对于角膜上皮的再生和角膜缘的屏障功能至关重要。

HP:0032108.name: Mildly reduced contrast sensitivity
HP:0032108.definition: A mild reduction in the ability to perceive visual contrast characterized by 0.20-0.59 log unit contrast sensitivity loss.
HP:0032108.definition_cn: 轻度视觉对比感知能力下降，特征为0.20-0.59对数单位的对比敏感度损失。

HP:0032109.name: Moderately reduced contrast sensitivity
HP:0032109.definition: A moderate reduction in the ability to perceive visual contrast characterized by 0.60-0.99 log unit contrast sensitivity loss.
HP:0032109.definition_cn: 中度视觉对比感知能力下降，特征为0.60-0.99对数单位的对比敏感度损失。

HP:0032110.name: Severely reduced contrast sensitivity
HP:0032110.definition: A severe reduction in the ability to perceive visual contrast characterized by 1.00 log unit or more contrast sensitivity loss.
HP:0032110.name_cn: 严重降低的对比敏感度
HP:0032110.definition_cn: 严重的视觉对比感知能力下降，其特征为对比敏感度损失达到或超过1.00对数单位。

HP:0032111.name: Abnormal Vistech contrast sensitivity test
HP:0032111.definition: An abnormality in perception of contrast as measured by the Vistech wall chart sine wave grating test.
HP:0032111.definition_cn: 通过Vistech壁挂式正弦波光栅测试检测到的对比度感知异常。

HP:0032112.name: Abnormal Pelli Robson contrast sensitivity chart test
HP:0032112.definition: An abnormality in perception of contrast as measured by the Pelli-Robson contrast sensitivity chart, which is a large wall-mounted chart, with letters of a fixed size (comprising spatial frequencies appropriate for estimating peak contrast sensitivity) that decrease in contrast.
HP:0032112.name_cn: Pelli-Robson对比敏感度图表测试异常
HP:0032112.definition_cn: 通过Pelli-Robson对比敏感度图表测量的对比感知异常，该图表为大型壁挂式图表，包含固定大小的字母（由适合估计峰值对比敏感度的空间频率组成），其对比度逐渐降低。

HP:0032113.name: Semidominant inheritance
HP:0032113.definition: A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on chromosomes in which a trait can manifest in a monoallelic (e.g. heterozygotes) and biallelic (e.g. homozygotes, compound heterozygotes) state, with similar or differing phenotype severity present dependent on the number of alleles affected.
HP:0032113.definition_cn: 一种遗传模式，其特征与染色体上编码的基因相关，该特征可在单等位基因（如杂合子）和双等位基因（如纯合子、复合杂合子）状态下表现，其表型严重程度可能相似或不同，具体取决于受影响的等位基因数量。

HP:0032114.name: Saccadic intrusion
HP:0032114.definition: An involuntary abnormality of fixation in which there is an abnormal saccade away from fixation followed by a delayed corrective saccade.
HP:0032114.definition_cn: 一种不自主的注视异常，表现为从注视点异常扫视后伴随延迟的纠正性扫视。

HP:0032116.name: Macrosquare-wave jerks
HP:0032116.definition: Horizontal 10-40 degree excursions from fixation and back again.
HP:0032116.definition_cn: 从注视点水平偏移10-40度并返回。

HP:0032118.name: Retinitis
HP:0032118.definition: Inflammation of the retina of the eye.

HP:0032120.name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system physiology
HP:0032120.definition: Any functional abnormality of the part of the nervous system that consists of the nerves and ganglia outside of the brain and spinal cord.
HP:0032120.name_cn: 异常周围神经系统生理学
HP:0032120.definition_cn: 周围神经系统功能障碍（Peripheral Nervous System Dysfunction）

HP:0032121.name: Froment sign
HP:0032121.definition: An abnormal result of a physical examination of the the hand that tests for palsy of the ulnar nerve. This nerve innervates the adductor pollicis and interossei muscles and thereby enables adduction of the thumb and extension of the interphalangeal joint. An abnormal result consists in reduced functionality and muscular weakness in the pinch grip between the thumb and index finger of the affected hand as the patient attempts to pinch a piece of paper that the examiner tries to pull away. The flexor pollicis longus muscle tries to compensate for the weakness by flexing the tip of the thumb at the interphalangeal joint.
HP:0032121.definition_cn: 手部体格检查异常结果，提示尺神经麻痹。该神经支配拇收肌和骨间肌，从而使拇指内收和指间关节伸展。异常表现为患者试图用患侧拇指和食指捏住检查者试图拉走的纸张时，捏握功能减退和肌力减弱。拇长屈肌试图通过屈曲指间关节的拇指尖端来代偿肌力减弱。

HP:0032122.name: Very low visual acuity
HP:0032122.definition: A reduction in visual acuity with best corrected visual acuity between 1.40 (20/500) and 1.89 logMAR (up to roughly 20/1590).
HP:0032122.definition_cn: 最佳矫正视力下降，视力范围在1.40（20/500）至1.89 logMAR（约20/1590）之间。

HP:0032123.name: Ultra-low vision
HP:0032123.definition: Best corrected visual acuity worse than 1.90 logMAR (roughly 20/1590).
HP:0032123.definition_cn: 最佳矫正视力低于1.90 logMAR（约20/1590）。

HP:0032124.name: Abnormal proportion of unswitched memory B cells
HP:0032124.definition: A deviation of the normal proportion of unswitched memory B cells in circulation relative to the total number of B cells.
HP:0032124.name_cn: 未转换记忆B细胞比例异常
HP:0032124.definition_cn: 循环中未转换记忆B细胞相对于B细胞总数的正常比例出现偏离。

HP:0032125.name: Increased proportion of unswitched memory B cells
HP:0032125.definition: An increase above the normal proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells relative to the total number of B cells.
HP:0032125.name_cn: 未转换记忆B细胞比例增加
HP:0032125.definition_cn: 非类别转换记忆B细胞相对于B细胞总数的比例高于正常水平。

HP:0032126.name: Decreased proportion of unswitched memory B cells
HP:0032126.definition: A reduction below the normal proportion of non-class-switched memory B cells relative to the total number of B cells.
HP:0032126.name_cn: 未转换记忆B细胞比例降低
HP:0032126.definition_cn: 非类别转换记忆B细胞相对于B细胞总数的比例低于正常水平。

HP:0032127.name: Abnormal plasmablast proportion
HP:0032127.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of plasmablasts in circulation relative to total number of B cells. Plasmablasts are antibody-secreting cells that originate after infection or vaccination.
HP:0032127.definition_cn: 循环中浆母细胞相对于B细胞总数的比例偏离正常范围。浆母细胞是感染或疫苗接种后产生的抗体分泌细胞。

HP:0032128.name: Increased proportion of plasmablasts
HP:0032128.definition: An elevation above the normal proportion of plasmablasts in circulation relative to total number of B cells.
HP:0032128.definition_cn: 循环中浆母细胞相对于B细胞总数的比例高于正常水平。

HP:0032129.name: Decreased proportion of plasmablasts
HP:0032129.definition: A reduction below the normal proportion of plasmablasts in circulation relative to total number of B cells.
HP:0032129.definition_cn: 循环中浆母细胞相对于B细胞总数的比例低于正常水平。

HP:0032130.name: Mycobacterium abscessus abscessus infection
HP:0032130.definition: Mycobacterium abscessus complex comprises a group of rapidly growing, multidrug-resistant, nontuberculous mycobacteria that are responsible for a wide spectrum of skin and soft tissue diseases, central nervous system infections, bacteremia, and ocular and other infections.
HP:0032130.definition_cn: 脓肿分枝杆菌复合群由一组快速生长、多重耐药的非结核分枝杆菌组成，可导致广泛的皮肤和软组织疾病、中枢神经系统感染、菌血症、眼部感染及其他感染。

HP:0032131.name: Cervical dysplasia
HP:0032131.definition: Cervical dysplasia is the precursor to cervical cancer. It is caused by the persistent infection of the human papillomavirus (HPV) into the cervical tissue. Affected cells develop morphologic features with immature basaloid- type squamous cells and mitotic figures in the upper half of the cervical epithelium.
HP:0032131.definition_cn: 宫颈上皮内瘤变是宫颈癌的前驱病变。其病因是人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）持续感染宫颈组织。受影响的细胞在宫颈上皮的上半部分出现未成熟的基底样鳞状细胞和有丝分裂象的形态学特征。

HP:0032132.name: Decreased circulating total IgG concentration
HP:0032132.definition: A reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood.
HP:0032132.definition_cn: 血液中总免疫球蛋白G（IgG）水平低于正常值。

HP:0032133.name: Transient decreased circulating total IgG
HP:0032133.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood.
HP:0032133.name_cn: 一过性循环总免疫球蛋白G降低
HP:0032133.definition_cn: 血液中总免疫球蛋白G（IgG）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0032134.name: Chronic decreased circulating total IgG
HP:0032134.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood.
HP:0032134.name_cn: 慢性循环总免疫球蛋白G降低
HP:0032134.definition_cn: 血液中总免疫球蛋白G（IgG）水平持续低于正常值。

HP:0032135.name: Decreased circulating IgG subclass concentration
HP:0032135.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of a subclass of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood.
HP:0032135.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G（IgG）亚类浓度低于正常水平。

HP:0032136.name: Decreased circulating IgG1 concentration
HP:0032136.definition: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG1 subclass in the blood circulation.
HP:0032136.definition_cn: 循环血液中IgG1亚类免疫球蛋白水平降低。

HP:0032137.name: Decreased circulating IgG3 concentration
HP:0032137.definition: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG3 subclass in the blood circulation.
HP:0032137.definition_cn: 循环血液中IgG3亚类免疫球蛋白水平降低。

HP:0032138.name: Decreased circulating IgG4 concentration
HP:0032138.definition: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG4 subclass in the blood circulation.
HP:0032138.definition_cn: 循环血液中IgG4亚类免疫球蛋白水平降低。

HP:0032139.name: Reduced isohemagglutinin level
HP:0032139.definition: Level of isohemagglutinin reduced below expected concentration. An isohemagglutinin refers to the naturally occurring antibodies in the ABO blood group system (i.e., anti-A in a group B person, anti-B in a group A person, and anti-A, anti-B, and anti-A,B in a group O person).
HP:0032139.definition_cn: 同种血凝素水平低于预期浓度。同种血凝素是指在ABO血型系统中天然存在的抗体（例如，B型血个体中的抗A抗体，A型血个体中的抗B抗体，以及O型血个体中的抗A、抗B和抗A,B抗体）。

HP:0032140.name: Decreased specific antibody response to vaccination
HP:0032140.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against toxoids and polysaccharides in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0032140.name_cn: 疫苗接种后特异性抗体反应降低
HP:0032140.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后通过抗体滴度测定检测到的针对类毒素和多糖的疫苗后抗体合成能力降低。

HP:0032141.name: Precordial pain
HP:0032141.definition: A type of chest pain that arises in the or under the left breast and often described as throbbing, stabbing, or burning, and lasting hours or longer. The pain may arise with or after effort, and may spread to the left arm or left side of the neck.
HP:0032141.definition_cn: 一种胸痛类型，起源于左乳房或左乳房下方，常被描述为搏动性、刺痛性或烧灼性，持续数小时或更长时间。疼痛可能在用力时或用力后出现，并可向左臂或左侧颈部放射。

HP:0032142.name: Fetor hepaticus
HP:0032142.definition: Fetor hepaticus is the characteristic breath of patients with severe parenchymal liver disease, which has been said to resemble the odor of a mixture of rotten eggs and garlic.
HP:0032142.definition_cn: 肝臭是严重实质性肝病患者的特征性口臭，据称其气味类似于腐烂鸡蛋和大蒜的混合气味。

HP:0032143.name: Burning mouth
HP:0032143.definition: An intense sensation of burning, scalding, or tingling feeling of the tongue or other regions of the oral mucosa.
HP:0032143.definition_cn: 舌或口腔黏膜其他区域的剧烈灼烧感、烫伤感或刺痛感。

HP:0032144.name: Coffee ground vomitus
HP:0032144.definition: Vomit that has the appearance of coffee grounds, which occurs due to the presence of coagulated blood in the vomit.
HP:0032144.definition_cn: 咖啡渣样呕吐物，由于呕吐物中存在凝固血液所致。

HP:0032145.name: Sural nerve atrophy
HP:0032145.definition: Wasting of the sural nerve, a sensory nerve in the calf region of the leg.
HP:0032145.definition_cn: 腓肠神经萎缩，位于小腿区域的感觉神经。

HP:0032146.name: HbC hemoglobin
HP:0032146.definition: Presence of an abnormal type of hemoglobin characterized by the substitution of a glutamic acid residue at position 7 following the initial methionine residue by a lysine (6GAG>6AAG). The presence of HbC can be determined by hemoglobin electrophoresis.
HP:0032146.definition_cn: 存在一种异常类型的血红蛋白，其特征是初始甲硫氨酸残基后的第7位谷氨酸残基被赖氨酸取代（6GAG>6AAG）。HbC的存在可通过血红蛋白电泳检测确定。

HP:0032147.name: Erythromelalgia
HP:0032147.definition: Recurrent episodes of redness, burning pain, and warmth of the extremities following exposure to heat or exercise with symptoms predominantly involving the feet.
HP:0032147.definition_cn: 反复发作的红斑、灼痛及四肢温热感，主要累及足部，常于受热或运动后出现。

HP:0032148.name: Episodic pain
HP:0032148.definition: Intermittent pain, i.e., pain that occurs occasionally and at irregular intervals.
HP:0032148.definition_cn: 间歇性疼痛，即偶尔且不规则间隔发生的疼痛。

HP:0032149.name: Breakthrough pain
HP:0032149.definition: A episode of severe pain that breaks through (i.e., temporarily exacerbates) a period of persistent pain.
HP:0032149.definition_cn: 突破性疼痛发作（即持续性疼痛期间的暂时性加剧）。

HP:0032150.name: Paroxysmal rectal pain
HP:0032150.definition: Excruciating burning pain in the rectal area that may be triggered by defecation.
HP:0032150.definition_cn: 剧烈灼痛感位于直肠区域，可能由排便诱发。

HP:0032151.name: Episodic eosinophilia
HP:0032151.definition: Recurrent episodes of marked eosinophilia that resolve spontaneously.
HP:0032151.name_cn: 发作性嗜酸性粒细胞增多症
HP:0032151.definition_cn: 自发性缓解的显著嗜酸性粒细胞增多反复发作。

HP:0032152.name: Keratosis pilaris
HP:0032152.definition: An anomaly of the hair follicles of the skin that typically presents as small, rough, brown folliculocentric papules distributed over characteristic areas of the skin, particularly the outer-upper arms and thighs.
HP:0032152.definition_cn: 一种皮肤毛囊异常，通常表现为分布于特征性皮肤区域（尤其是上臂外侧和大腿）的小而粗糙、呈褐色的毛囊中心性丘疹。

HP:0032153.name: Joint subluxation
HP:0032153.definition: A partial dislocation of a joint.

HP:0032154.name: Aphthous ulcer
HP:0032154.definition: Oral aphthous ulcers typically present as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border.
HP:0032154.definition_cn: 口腔阿弗他溃疡通常表现为疼痛、边界清晰的纤维蛋白覆盖的黏膜缺损，伴有充血边缘。

HP:0032155.name: Abdominal cramps
HP:0032155.definition: A type of abdominal pain characterized by a feeling of contractions and typically fluctuating in intensity.
HP:0032155.definition_cn: 一种以收缩感为特征的腹痛，通常强度呈波动性变化。

HP:0032156.name: Skin detachment
HP:0032156.definition: Loss of sections of skin either spontaneously or after gentle handling.
HP:0032156.definition_cn: 皮肤自发性或轻微触碰后出现片状脱落。

HP:0032157.name: Recurrent genital herpes
HP:0032157.definition: Recurrent episodes of genital herpes, typically characterized by stages of erythema, papules, short-lived vesicles, painful ulcers, and crusts on the skin of the genitals and surrounding area, and that typically resolve over a period of 2 to 3 weeks.
HP:0032157.definition_cn: 复发性生殖器疱疹，通常表现为生殖器及周围皮肤的红斑、丘疹、短暂性水疱、疼痛性溃疡及结痂等阶段，通常病程持续2至3周后自愈。

HP:0032158.name: Unusual infection by anatomical site
HP:0032158.definition: An unusual infection classified by the affected body part.
HP:0032158.definition_cn: 一种按受累身体部位分类的异常感染。

HP:0032159.name: Fungal meningitis
HP:0032159.definition: An infection of the meninges caused by a fungus. Generally, only individuals with deficiencies of the immune system contract fungal meningitis.
HP:0032159.definition_cn: 真菌性脑膜炎（Fungal Meningitis）是由真菌感染引起的脑膜炎症。通常，仅免疫系统功能缺陷的个体易感染真菌性脑膜炎。

HP:0032160.name: Cryptococcal meningitis
HP:0032160.definition: A type of fungal meningitis caused by an encapsulated yeast that belongs to the genus Cryptococcus. Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus gattii are responsible for the majority of cases of human cryptococcosis.
HP:0032160.definition_cn: 一种由隐球菌属（Cryptococcus）的荚膜酵母菌引起的真菌性脑膜炎。新型隐球菌（Cryptococcus neoformans）和格特隐球菌（Cryptococcus gattii）是导致人类隐球菌病（cryptococcosis）的主要病原体。

HP:0032161.name: Coccidioidal meningitis
HP:0032161.definition: A type of fungal meningitis caused by dissemination of coccidioides to basilar meninges.
HP:0032161.definition_cn: 一种由球孢子菌播散至基底脑膜引起的真菌性脑膜炎。

HP:0032162.name: Unusual skin infection
HP:0032162.definition: A type of infection of the skin that can be regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection.
HP:0032162.definition_cn: 一种皮肤感染类型，可被视为病理性易感性的标志。

HP:0032163.name: Molluscum contagiosum
HP:0032163.definition: Molluscum contagiosum is a cutaneous viral infection that is commonly observed in both healthy and immunocompromised children. The infection is caused by a member of the Poxviridae family, the molluscum contagiosum virus. Molluscum contagiosum presents as single or multiple small white or flesh-colored papules that typically have a central umbilication. The central umbilication may be difficult to observe in young children and, instead, may bear an appearance similar to an acneiform eruption. The lesions vary in size (from 1 mm to 1 cm in diameter) and are painless, although a subset of patients report pruritus in the area of infection. On average, 11-20 papules appear on the body during the course of infection and generally remains a self-limiting disease. However, in immunosuppressed patients, molluscum contagiosum can be a severe infection with hundreds of lesions developing on the body. Extensive eruption is indicative of an advanced immunodeficiency state.
HP:0032163.definition_cn: 传染性软疣是一种皮肤病毒感染，常见于健康儿童和免疫功能低下的儿童。该感染由痘病毒科成员——传染性软疣病毒引起。传染性软疣表现为单个或多个白色或肉色的小丘疹，通常具有中央脐凹。在幼儿中，中央脐凹可能难以观察到，反而可能呈现出类似痤疮样皮疹的外观。病变大小不一（直径从1毫米到1厘米），通常无痛，但部分患者报告感染区域有瘙痒感。在感染过程中，平均有11-20个丘疹出现在身体上，通常为自限性疾病。然而，在免疫功能低下的患者中，传染性软疣可能是一种严重的感染，身体上可能出现数百个病变。广泛的皮疹提示存在严重的免疫缺陷状态。

HP:0032164.name: Increased blood folate concentration
HP:0032164.definition: An elevated circulating concentration of folic acid, which is also known as vitamin B9.
HP:0032164.definition_cn: 循环中升高的叶酸浓度，也称为维生素B9。

HP:0032165.name: Placental mesenchymal dysplasia
HP:0032165.definition: Placental mesenchymal dysplasia is a rare anomaly characterized by placentomegaly, dilatation of chorionic vessels and hydropic stem villi with cistern-like formation. It is often clinically mistaken for a partial hydatidiform mole but there is no trophoblastic proliferation. P57 immunohistochemical expression is discordant, showing a normal positive expression in the cytotrophoblastic cells, and loss of expression in the stromal cells.
HP:0032165.definition_cn: 胎盘间质发育不良是一种罕见的异常，其特征为胎盘肥大、绒毛膜血管扩张以及水肿性干绒毛伴囊泡样形成。临床上常被误诊为部分性葡萄胎，但无滋养细胞增生。P57免疫组织化学表达不一致，表现为细胞滋养层细胞中正常阳性表达，而在间质细胞中表达缺失。

HP:0032167.name: Clostridium difficile enteritis
HP:0032167.definition: An infection of the small intestine (enteritis) by clostridium difficile.
HP:0032167.definition_cn: 由艰难梭菌引起的小肠感染（小肠炎）。

HP:0032168.name: Clostridium difficile colitis
HP:0032168.definition: An infection of the colon (colitis) by clostridium difficile.
HP:0032168.definition_cn: 由艰难梭菌引起的结肠感染（结肠炎）。

HP:0032169.name: Severe infection
HP:0032169.definition: A type of infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection because of unusual severity or intensity of the infection.
HP:0032169.definition_cn: 一种被视为病理性感染易感性标志的感染类型，因其异常严重或强烈的感染程度。

HP:0032170.name: Severe varicella zoster infection
HP:0032170.definition: An unusually severe form of varicella zoster virus (VZV) infection. In the majority of the cases, especially in children, varicella is a very mild infection characterized by skin lesions, low grade fever and malaise. Severe infection is characterized by manifestations including VZV pneumonia, hepatitis, meningitis, and disseminated varicella.
HP:0032170.name_cn: 重症水痘-带状疱疹病毒感染
HP:0032170.definition_cn: 一种异常严重的水痘-带状疱疹病毒（VZV）感染。在大多数病例中，尤其是在儿童中，水痘是一种非常轻微的感染，其特征为皮肤病变、低热和不适。严重感染的特征包括VZV肺炎、肝炎、脑膜炎和播散性水痘等表现。

HP:0032171.name: Bladder pain
HP:0032171.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the urinary bladder. Bladder pain may be more pronounced with a full bladder and relieved upon urination, but this is not always the case.
HP:0032171.definition_cn: 一种以膀胱局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或钝痛）为特征的不适感。膀胱充盈时疼痛可能更为明显，排尿后可能缓解，但并非总是如此。

HP:0032172.name: Air crescent sign
HP:0032172.definition: A crescent of air surrounding a soft-tissue mass in a pulmonary cavity and can be seen in both plain X-ray and CT scan.
HP:0032172.definition_cn: 肺空洞内软组织肿块周围可见新月形气影，在普通X线及CT扫描中均可观察到。

HP:0032173.name: Continuous diaphragm sign
HP:0032173.definition: This sign is seen in pneumomediastinum in which air accumulates between the lower border of the heart and the superior part of the diaphragm, which results in complete visualization of the diaphragm in chest X-ray, hence named continuous diaphragm sign.
HP:0032173.definition_cn: 该征象见于纵隔气肿，其中空气积聚于心脏下缘与膈肌上缘之间，导致胸部X线片中膈肌完全显影，因此称为连续膈肌征。

HP:0032174.name: Tree-in-bud pattern
HP:0032174.definition: The tree-in-bud pattern represents centrilobular branching structures that resemble a budding tree. The pattern reflects a spectrum of endo- and peribronchiolar disorders, including mucoid impaction, inflammation, and/or fibrosis (See Figure 70 of PMID:18195376).
HP:0032174.definition_cn: 树芽征（tree-in-bud pattern）代表类似于发芽树木的细支气管中心性分支结构。该征象反映了一系列细支气管内及细支气管周围病变，包括黏液嵌塞、炎症和/或纤维化（参见PMID:18195376的图70）。

HP:0032175.name: Signet ring sign
HP:0032175.definition: This finding is composed of a ring-shaped opacity representing a dilated bronchus in cross section and a smaller adjacent opacity representing its pulmonary artery, with the combination resembling a signet (or pearl) ring. It is the basic sign of bronchiectasis in pulmonary computed tomography imaging.
HP:0032175.definition_cn: 此发现由环形致密影组成，代表横切面上的扩张支气管，以及邻近较小的致密影，代表其伴行的肺动脉，两者组合形似印章（或珍珠）戒指。这是肺计算机断层扫描成像中支气管扩张的基本征象。

HP:0032176.name: Apical pulmonary opacity
HP:0032176.definition: An apical cap is a caplike lesion at the lung apex, usually caused by intrapulmonary and pleural fibrosis pulling down extrapleural fat or possibly by chronic ischemia resulting in hyaline plaque formation on the visceral pleura. The prevalence increases with age. It can also be seen in hematoma resulting from aortic rupture or in other fluid collection associated with infection or tumor, either outside the parietal pleura or loculated within the pleural space.
HP:0032176.definition_cn: 肺尖帽是一种位于肺尖的帽状病变，通常由肺内和胸膜纤维化牵拉胸膜外脂肪或慢性缺血导致脏层胸膜上透明斑块形成引起。其患病率随年龄增长而增加。此外，它也可出现在主动脉破裂引起的血肿中，或与感染或肿瘤相关的其他液体聚集中，这些液体可位于壁层胸膜外或局限在胸膜腔内。

HP:0032177.name: Parenchymal consolidation
HP:0032177.definition: Consolidation refers to an exudate or other product of disease that replaces alveolar air, rendering the lung solid (as in infective pneumonia).
HP:0032177.definition_cn: 实变是指渗出物或其他病变产物取代肺泡内的空气，使肺组织变得坚实（如感染性肺炎）。

HP:0032178.name: Flaky paint dermatosis
HP:0032178.definition: A dermatosis characterized by generalized shiny, enamel-like, hyperpigmented scales in an irregular pattern. The scales may peel or desquamate, rather like old, sun-baked blistered paint, often with areas of underlying hypopigmentation. This has led to the terms peeling paint or flaky paint dermatosis (See the Figure in PMID:24285001).
HP:0032178.definition_cn: 一种皮肤病，其特征为全身性、光泽如釉质样、不规则分布的过度色素沉着鳞屑。鳞屑可剥脱或脱屑，类似于经日晒起泡的旧油漆，常伴有下方色素减退区域。因此，该病被称为“剥漆样皮肤病”或“片状漆样皮肤病”（参见PMID:24285001中的图例）。

HP:0032179.name: Abnormal circulating globulin concentration
HP:0032179.definition: An abnormal concentration of globulins in the blood. Albumin makes up more than half of the total protein present in serum. The remaining blood proteins except albumin and fibrinogen (which is not in serum) are referred to as globulins. The globulin fraction includes hundreds of serum proteins including carrier proteins, enzymes, complement, and immunoglobulins. Most of these are synthesized in the liver, although the immunoglobulins are synthesized by plasma cells. Globulins are divided into four groups by electrophoresis. The four fractions are alpha1, alpha2, beta and gamma, depending on their migratory pattern between the anode and the cathode.
HP:0032179.definition_cn: 血液中球蛋白的异常浓度。白蛋白占血清中总蛋白质的一半以上。除白蛋白和纤维蛋白原（不在血清中）外的其余血液蛋白质被称为球蛋白。球蛋白部分包括数百种血清蛋白质，包括载体蛋白、酶、补体和免疫球蛋白。其中大多数在肝脏中合成，而免疫球蛋白则由浆细胞合成。通过电泳，球蛋白被分为四组。根据其在阳极和阴极之间的迁移模式，这四组分别为α1、α2、β和γ球蛋白。

HP:0032180.name: Abnormal circulating metabolite concentration
HP:0032180.definition: An abnormal level of an analyte measured in the blood.
HP:0032180.definition_cn: 血液中分析物水平的异常。

HP:0032181.name: Anomalous hepatic venous drainage into the left atrium
HP:0032181.definition: An abnormality of the hepatic veins, which normally drain de-oxygenated blood from the liver into the inferior vena cava, whereby the hepatic veins drain into the left atrium.
HP:0032181.name_cn: 肝静脉异常引流至左心房
HP:0032181.definition_cn: 肝静脉异常，正常情况下肝静脉将去氧血液从肝脏引流至下腔静脉，而此处肝静脉引流至左心房。

HP:0032182.name: Abnormal proportion of memory T cells
HP:0032182.definition: An abnormal proportion of memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. Memory T cells have previously encountered and responded to their cognate antigen and upon a repeated encounter with the antigen can mount a faster and stronger response.
HP:0032182.definition_cn: 血液中记忆T细胞与总T细胞数量的比例异常。记忆T细胞先前已接触并对其同源抗原作出反应，在再次接触该抗原时能够启动更快且更强的免疫应答。

HP:0032183.name: Decreased proportion of memory T cells
HP:0032183.definition: An abnormally reduced proportion of memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood.
HP:0032183.definition_cn: 血液中记忆T细胞相对于总T细胞数量的异常减少。

HP:0032184.name: Increased proportion of memory T cells
HP:0032184.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood.
HP:0032184.definition_cn: 血液中记忆T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常升高。

HP:0032185.name: Disseminated molluscum contagiosum
HP:0032185.definition: The presence of molluscum contagiosum lesions across multiple areas of the body.
HP:0032185.definition_cn: 多发性传染性软疣皮损。

HP:0032186.name: Anal neoplasm
HP:0032186.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the anal canal or anal margin.
HP:0032186.definition_cn: 影响肛管或肛缘的良性或恶性肿瘤。

HP:0032187.name: Anal intraepithelial neoplasia
HP:0032187.definition: Anal intraepithelial neoplasia (AIN) is a premalignant lesion of the anal mucosa that is a precursor to anal cancer.
HP:0032187.definition_cn: 肛门上皮内瘤变（AIN）是肛门黏膜的一种癌前病变，是肛门癌的前期病变。

HP:0032188.name: Cellular hypersensitivity to mitomycin C
HP:0032188.definition: An increased cellular sensitivity to the DNA cross-linking agent, mitomycin C (MMC). In the presence of increased sensitivity, MMC causes increased cell death, chromosome breakage, and accumulation in the G2 phase of the cell cycle.
HP:0032188.name_cn: 细胞对丝裂霉素C的超敏反应
HP:0032188.definition_cn: 细胞对DNA交联剂丝裂霉素C（MMC）的敏感性增加。在敏感性增加的情况下，MMC会导致细胞死亡增加、染色体断裂以及细胞周期G2期的积累。

HP:0032189.name: Cellular hypersensitivity to diepoxybutane
HP:0032189.definition: An increased cellular sensitivity to the DNA cross-linking agent, diepoxybutane (DEB). In the presence of increased sensitivity, DEB causes cell death, chromosome breakage, and accumulation in the G2 phase of the cell cycle.
HP:0032189.name_cn: 细胞对二环氧丁烷的超敏反应
HP:0032189.definition_cn: 细胞对DNA交联剂二环氧丁烷（DEB）的敏感性增加。在敏感性增加的情况下，DEB会导致细胞死亡、染色体断裂以及在细胞周期G2期的积累。

HP:0032190.name: Abnormal meniscus morphology
HP:0032190.definition: Abnormal structure of the meniscus of the knee, two crescent shape fibrocartilaginous pads that disperse the weight of the body and reduce friction of the knee joint during movement.
HP:0032190.definition_cn: 膝关节半月板结构异常，半月板为两个新月形纤维软骨垫，在运动过程中分散身体重量并减少膝关节摩擦。

HP:0032191.name: Torn meniscus
HP:0032191.definition: A tear in the cartilaginous pad (meniscus) of the knee.

HP:0032192.name: Hydatidiform mole
HP:0032192.definition: Hydatidiform mole (HM) is an aberrant human pregnancy with absence of, or abnormal embryonic development, hydropic degeneration of chorionic villi, and excessive proliferation of the trophoblast.
HP:0032192.definition_cn: 葡萄胎（Hydatidiform Mole, HM）是一种异常的人类妊娠，其特征为胚胎发育缺失或异常、绒毛膜绒毛的水样变性以及滋养层细胞的过度增殖。

HP:0032193.name: Decreased low-density lipoprotein particle size
HP:0032193.definition: An abnormal decrease in the average size of low-density lipoprotein particle size in the blood circulation.
HP:0032193.name_cn: 低密度脂蛋白颗粒尺寸减小
HP:0032193.definition_cn: 血液循环中低密度脂蛋白颗粒平均大小的异常减小。

HP:0032195.name: Abnormal S wave
HP:0032195.definition: Any anomaly of the S wave, which is the third component of the QRS wave complex. The S wave signifies the final depolarization of the ventricles at the base of the heart.
HP:0032195.definition_cn: S波异常，即QRS波群第三成分的任何异常。S波代表心室基底部最后的去极化过程。

HP:0032196.name: Prominent S wave in lead I
HP:0032196.definition: Increased amplitude (0.1 mV or more) and/or duration (40 ms or more) of the S wave as measured in lead I of the electrocardiogram.
HP:0032196.definition_cn: 心电图I导联中S波振幅增加（≥0.1 mV）和/或持续时间延长（≥40 ms）。

HP:0032197.name: Deep S wave in lead V5
HP:0032197.definition: Abnormal depth of the S wave in lead V5 of the electrocardiogram.
HP:0032197.definition_cn: 心电图V5导联S波深度异常。

HP:0032198.name: Decreased prothrombin time
HP:0032198.definition: Abnormally short time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the World Health Organization (WHO) using the formula: INR is equal to Patient PT divided by Control PT.
HP:0032198.definition_cn: 凝血酶原时间（Prothrombin Time, PT）检测中凝血时间异常缩短，该检测用于评估外源性凝血途径。凝血酶原时间检测结果通常以国际标准化比值（International Normalized Ratio, INR）表示，INR通过以下公式计算：患者PT除以对照PT，其中对照PT已根据世界卫生组织（WHO）制定的凝血活酶试剂效价进行标准化。

HP:0032199.name: Abnormal prothrombin time
HP:0032199.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the World Health Organization (WHO) using the formula: INR is equal to Patient PT divided by Control PT.
HP:0032199.definition_cn: 凝血酶原时间（Prothrombin Time, PT）检测中，任何与正常凝血时间的偏离，均反映了外源性凝血途径的功能状态。凝血酶原时间检测结果通常以国际标准化比值（International Normalized Ratio, INR）表示，其计算公式为：INR等于患者PT除以对照PT，其中对照PT已根据世界卫生组织（World Health Organization, WHO）制定的凝血活酶试剂效价进行标准化。

HP:0032200.name: Perivascular fibrosis
HP:0032200.definition: The presence of thick collagen bundles around blood vessels, often in an onion-skin type whorling pattern.
HP:0032200.definition_cn: 血管周围存在厚层胶原纤维束，常呈洋葱皮样旋涡状排列。

HP:0032201.name: Rotator cuff tear
HP:0032201.definition: The term rotator cuff describes the tendons connecting the infraspinatus, supraspinatus, teres minor, and subscapularis muscles to the humeral head.Traumatic tears of the rotator cuff tend to occur at the tendon-bone junction of the supraspinatus and greater tuberosity of the humerus whereas degenerative tears tend to be seen posteriorly at the junction of the supraspinatus and infraspinatu A rotator cuff tear is when one or more of these tendons tears or detaches from the humerus.
HP:0032201.definition_cn: 术语“肩袖”描述了将冈下肌、冈上肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌的肌腱连接到肱骨头的结构。创伤性肩袖撕裂通常发生在冈上肌肌腱与肱骨大结节之间的腱骨连接处，而退行性撕裂则多见于冈上肌与冈下肌连接处的后方。肩袖撕裂是指这些肌腱中的一个或多个发生撕裂或从肱骨上脱离的情况。

HP:0032202.name: Vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia
HP:0032202.definition: Vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia (VIN) is widely accepted as the precursor lesion of vulvar squamous cell carcinoma (VSCC). VSCC arises via either a human papilloma virus (HPV)-associated pathway, or more commonly, via a mechanism independent of HPV, often being linked to chronic inflammatory conditions such as lichen sclerosus (LS). Accordingly, two distinct subtypes of VIN are recognized: the HPV-associated high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion/usual VIN (HSIL/uVIN) and the non-HPV-associated differentiated VIN (dVIN). HSIL is clinically identified by its multifocal, warty appearance and on histology by conspicuous cytological and architectural atypia. Differentiated VIN, on the other hand, often produces ill-defined lesions, and on histology, notoriously mimics non-neoplastic epithelial disorders (NNED), particularly LS. As a result, dVIN is rarely identified in advance of a diagnosis of invasive malignancy, despite being the precursor lesion of the majority of VSCC.
HP:0032202.definition_cn: 外阴上皮内瘤变（Vulvar Intraepithelial Neoplasia, VIN）被广泛认为是外阴鳞状细胞癌（Vulvar Squamous Cell Carcinoma, VSCC）的前驱病变。VSCC的发生可通过人乳头瘤病毒（Human Papilloma Virus, HPV）相关途径，或更常见的是通过不依赖HPV的机制，后者通常与慢性炎症性疾病如硬化性苔藓（Lichen Sclerosus, LS）相关。因此，VIN被分为两种不同的亚型：HPV相关的高级别鳞状上皮内病变/普通型VIN（High-Grade Squamous Intraepithelial Lesion/Usual VIN, HSIL/uVIN）和非HPV相关的分化型VIN（Differentiated VIN, dVIN）。HSIL在临床上表现为多灶性、疣状外观，组织学上可见明显的细胞学和组织结构异型性。而分化型VIN通常表现为边界不清的病变，组织学上常与非肿瘤性上皮病变（Non-Neoplastic Epithelial Disorders, NNED）特别是硬化性苔藓相似。因此，尽管dVIN是大多数VSCC的前驱病变，但在侵袭性恶性肿瘤诊断前很少被识别。

HP:0032203.name: Lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
HP:0032203.definition: Lymphoid nodular hyperplasia (LNH) of the terminal ileum and colon has been considered a mucosal response to nonspecific stimuli, most often infections, and consequently has been regarded as a pathophysiologic phenomenon during infancy and childhood. LNH can be ascertained by colonoscopy, whereby a lymphoid nodule is defined as an extruding follicle with a diameter of not more than 2 mm, and LNH is defined as a cluster of not more than 10 of such extruding lymphoid nodules (see Figure 1 of PMID:17368236).
HP:0032203.definition_cn: 末端回肠和结肠的淋巴样结节增生（Lymphoid Nodular Hyperplasia, LNH）被认为是对非特异性刺激（最常见的是感染）的黏膜反应，因此在婴幼儿和儿童期被视为一种病理生理现象。LNH可通过结肠镜检查确诊，其中淋巴样结节被定义为直径不超过2毫米的突出滤泡，而LNH则被定义为不超过10个此类突出淋巴样结节的聚集（参见PMID:17368236的图1）。

HP:0032204.name: Chronic active Epstein-Barr virus infection
HP:0032204.definition: Chronic active Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection is an uncommon outcome of EBV infection and may present as a waxing and waning or fulminant syndrome. Unlike acute infectious mononucleosis, wherein EBV establishes lifelong infection and survives by maintaining a delicate balance with the host as a latent infection, in chronic active EBV infection the host-virus balance is disturbed.
HP:0032204.definition_cn: 慢性活动性爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒（EBV）感染是EBV感染的一种罕见结果，可能表现为波动性或暴发性综合征。与急性传染性单核细胞增多症不同，在急性传染性单核细胞增多症中，EBV通过作为潜伏感染与宿主维持微妙的平衡而建立终身感染并存活，而在慢性活动性EBV感染中，宿主-病毒平衡被破坏。

HP:0032205.name: Increased circulating galectin-3 level
HP:0032205.definition: An increased circulation of galectin-3 in the blood circulation.
HP:0032205.name_cn: 循环中半乳糖凝集素-3水平升高
HP:0032205.definition_cn: 血液中半乳糖凝集素-3（galectin-3）的循环水平升高。

HP:0032207.name: obsolete Abnormal cerebrospinal fluid metabolite concentration
HP:0032207.name_cn: 过时的异常脑脊液代谢物浓度

HP:0032208.name: Increased urinary type 1 collagen N-terminal telopeptide level
HP:0032208.definition: An increased concentration of type 1 collagen N-terminal telopeptide (NTx) level in the urine. Generally the test is performed over a period of time, for instance, 10 cc of morning urine can be collected following 12 hours overnight fasting or for 24 hours.
HP:0032208.name_cn: 尿液中1型胶原N端肽水平升高
HP:0032208.definition_cn: 尿液中1型胶原N端肽（NTx）浓度升高。通常该检测需在一段时间内进行，例如，在12小时过夜禁食后收集10毫升晨尿或进行24小时尿液收集。

HP:0032209.name: Abnormal circulating free T3 concentration
HP:0032209.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of free triiodothyronine (T3) in the blood circulation. A proportion of T3 is bound to plasma proteins in the blood, including mainly thyroxine binding globulin, transthyretin, and albumin. T3 that is not bound to a protein is referred to as free T3.
HP:0032209.name_cn: 异常循环游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸浓度
HP:0032209.definition_cn: 血液循环中游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）浓度偏离正常范围。部分T3与血浆蛋白结合，主要包括甲状腺素结合球蛋白、转甲状腺素蛋白和白蛋白。未与蛋白质结合的T3称为游离T3。

HP:0032210.name: Decreased circulating free T3
HP:0032210.definition: A reduced concentration of free 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine in the blood circulation.
HP:0032210.name_cn: 循环游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸降低
HP:0032210.definition_cn: 血液循环中游离3,3',5-三碘-L-甲状腺素浓度降低。

HP:0032211.name: Increased urinary epithelial cell count
HP:0032211.definition: An increased number of epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis.
HP:0032211.name_cn: 尿路上皮细胞计数增高
HP:0032211.definition_cn: 尿沉渣镜检每高倍视野上皮细胞计数增高。

HP:0032212.name: Increased urinary squamous epithelial cell count
HP:0032212.definition: An increased number of squamous epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis.
HP:0032212.name_cn: 尿液中鳞状上皮细胞计数升高
HP:0032212.definition_cn: 尿沉渣镜检每高倍视野鳞状上皮细胞数量增多。

HP:0032213.name: Increased urinary renal tubular epithelial cell count
HP:0032213.definition: An increased number of renal tubular epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis.
HP:0032213.name_cn: 尿液中肾小管上皮细胞计数升高
HP:0032213.definition_cn: 尿沉渣镜检每高倍视野下肾小管上皮细胞数量增多。

HP:0032214.name: Increased urinary transitional epithelial cell count
HP:0032214.definition: An increased number of transitional epithelial cells per high-power field in urinanalysis.
HP:0032214.name_cn: 尿路上皮细胞计数增加
HP:0032214.definition_cn: 尿沉渣镜检每高倍视野下移行上皮细胞数量增多。

HP:0032215.name: Disseminated cutaneous warts
HP:0032215.definition: Multiple skin warts located in multiple parts of the body, e.g., neck, trunks, and extremities.
HP:0032215.definition_cn: 多发性皮肤疣分布于身体多个部位，例如颈部、躯干及四肢。

HP:0032216.name: Lymphocytic infiltration of the colorectal mucosa
HP:0032216.definition: Abnormally increased intraepithelial lymphocyte count. This finding may be appreciated as large numbers of surface intraepithelial lymphocytes as seen (for instance) with hematoxylin and eosin staining of a colonic biopsy sample taken during colonoscopy.
HP:0032216.name_cn: 结直肠黏膜淋巴细胞浸润
HP:0032216.definition_cn: 上皮内淋巴细胞计数异常增高。此发现可表现为大量表面上皮内淋巴细胞，例如在结肠镜检查中获取的结肠活检样本经苏木精和伊红染色后可见。

HP:0032217.name: Indurated nodule
HP:0032217.definition: A skin nodule that is unusually hard (indurated).
HP:0032217.definition_cn: 一种异常坚硬的皮肤结节（硬化性皮肤结节）。

HP:0032218.name: Decreased proportion of CD4-positive T cells
HP:0032218.definition: A reduction in the proportion of CD4-positive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0032218.definition_cn: CD4阳性T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例降低。

HP:0032219.name: Increased proportion of CD4-positive T cells
HP:0032219.definition: An elevation in the proportion of CD4-positive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0032219.definition_cn: CD4阳性T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例升高。

HP:0032220.name: Interface hepatitis
HP:0032220.definition: Inflammation of the liver characterized by a mononuclear cell infiltrate whereby portal inflammatory cells extend through the limiting plate between the portal tract and liver parenchyma.
HP:0032220.definition_cn: 肝脏炎症，其特征为单核细胞浸润，门脉区炎性细胞通过门脉道与肝实质之间的界板延伸。

HP:0032221.name: Periportal emperipolesis
HP:0032221.definition: The engulfing of lymphocytes by hepatocytes, which typically occurs in the interface hepatitis area.
HP:0032221.definition_cn: 肝细胞对淋巴细胞的吞噬作用，通常发生于界面性肝炎区域。

HP:0032222.name: Serrated intestinal polyps
HP:0032222.definition: The presence of multiple serrated polyps in the intestine. Unlike conventional adenomas, which are uniformly dysplastic, the vast majority of serrated lesions contain no dysplasia. The serrated class includes the hyperplastic polyps, which are not considered precancerous; sessile serrated polyps (also called sessile serrated adenomas); and traditional serrated adenomas. Sessile serrated polyps are larger on average and more often located in the proximal colon. Sessile serrated polyps have a more irregular surface, a pattern to the surface that has been called cloudlike, and indistinct edges compared with hyperplastic polyps. Sessile serrated polyps also have large open pits on the surface (type O pits) when viewed with magnification.
HP:0032222.definition_cn: 肠道内存在多个锯齿状息肉。与传统腺瘤不同，后者普遍存在异型增生，而绝大多数锯齿状病变不包含异型增生。锯齿状类别包括增生性息肉（不被视为癌前病变）、无蒂锯齿状息肉（也称为无蒂锯齿状腺瘤）以及传统锯齿状腺瘤。无蒂锯齿状息肉平均较大，且更常位于近端结肠。与增生性息肉相比，无蒂锯齿状息肉表面更为不规则，表面模式被称为云状，边缘不清晰。在放大观察时，无蒂锯齿状息肉表面还具有较大的开放凹坑（O型凹坑）。

HP:0032223.name: Blood group
HP:0032223.definition: Any of the various types of human blood whose antigen characteristics determine compatibility in transfusion. While the ABO and Rhesus systems are the most well known, there are in total about 300 different blood type antigens distributed across 34 different blood type systems.
HP:0032223.definition_cn: 人类血液中任何一种具有特定抗原特征的类型，这些抗原特征决定了输血相容性。虽然ABO血型系统和Rh血型系统最为人熟知，但总共有约300种不同的血型抗原分布在34个不同的血型系统中。

HP:0032224.name: ABO blood group
HP:0032224.definition: The ABO system consists of A and B antigens and antibodies against these antigens.
HP:0032224.definition_cn: ABO血型系统由A抗原、B抗原及针对这些抗原的抗体组成。

HP:0032225.name: Perifollicular fibroma
HP:0032225.definition: Perifollicular fibroma is a rare cutaneous hamartoma that shows differentiation in the connective tissue sheath of hair follicles. It can occur as a solitary papule or as multiple lesions. Histologically, the lesion consists of a concentric arrangement of cellular fibrous tissue around a normal hair follicle.
HP:0032225.definition_cn: 毛囊周围纤维瘤是一种罕见的皮肤错构瘤，表现为毛囊结缔组织鞘的分化。它可以表现为单发丘疹或多发病变。组织学上，病变由围绕正常毛囊的同心排列的细胞性纤维组织构成。

HP:0032226.name: Abnormal sebaceous gland morphology
HP:0032226.definition: Any structural anomaly of the sebaceous glands.

HP:0032227.name: Sebaceous hyperplasia
HP:0032227.definition: A common, benign skin condition involving hypertrophy of the sebaceous glands characterized by single or multiple lesions that manifest as yellow, soft, small papules with umbilication. The lesions are located commonly on the central face (specifically, the nose, cheeks and forehead) but may also occur elsewhere, including the chest, mouth, scrotum, foreskin, penile shaft, vulva, and areola.
HP:0032227.definition_cn: 一种常见的良性皮肤病变，涉及皮脂腺的肥大，其特征为单发或多发性皮损，表现为黄色、柔软、小的脐凹状丘疹。皮损通常位于面部中央（特别是鼻部、颊部和前额），但也可能出现在其他部位，包括胸部、口腔、阴囊、包皮、阴茎干、外阴和乳晕。

HP:0032228.name: Trichodiscoma
HP:0032228.definition: A small benign fibrovascular tumor of the dermal part of the hair disk. Trichodiscoma is rather simple in appearance and consists of a dome-shaped fibrous tumor with a prominent vascular component that fills the papillary dermis under an atrophic epidermis. As in a normal hair disk, a hair follicle may be present at one edge of the papular lesion.
HP:0032228.definition_cn: 一种位于毛盘真皮部分的良性纤维血管性小肿瘤。毛盘瘤外观较为简单，由圆顶状纤维性肿瘤构成，具有显著的血管成分，填充于萎缩表皮下的乳头真皮层。与正常毛盘类似，丘疹性病变的一侧可能存在毛囊。

HP:0032229.name: Perinuclear antineutrophil antibody positivity
HP:0032229.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against proteins predominantly expressed in perinuclear region of neutrophils.
HP:0032229.name_cn: 核周型抗中性粒细胞抗体阳性
HP:0032229.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体，这些抗体主要针对在中性粒细胞核周区域表达的蛋白质发生反应。

HP:0032230.name: Cytoplasmic antineutrophil antibody positivity
HP:0032230.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against proteins predominantly expressed in cytoplasmic granules of neutrophils.
HP:0032230.name_cn: 胞质型抗中性粒细胞抗体阳性
HP:0032230.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体，这些抗体主要针对在中性粒细胞胞质颗粒中表达的蛋白质发生反应。

HP:0032231.name: Hypochromia
HP:0032231.definition: A qualitative impression that red blood cells have less color than normal when examined under a microscope, usually related to a reduced amount of hemoglobin in the red blood cells.
HP:0032231.definition_cn: 显微镜下观察红细胞时，其颜色较正常红细胞浅淡的定性印象，通常与红细胞内血红蛋白含量减少相关。

HP:0032232.name: Increased circulating creatine kinase MB isoform
HP:0032232.definition: An increased concentration of the MB isoform of creatine kinase in the blood circulation.
HP:0032232.name_cn: 循环肌酸激酶MB同工酶升高
HP:0032232.definition_cn: 血液中肌酸激酶MB同工酶浓度升高。

HP:0032233.name: Increased circulating creatine kinase BB isoform
HP:0032233.definition: An increased concentration of the BB isoform of creatine kinase in the blood circulation.
HP:0032233.name_cn: 循环中肌酸激酶BB同工酶水平升高
HP:0032233.definition_cn: 血液循环中肌酸激酶BB同工酶浓度升高。

HP:0032234.name: Increased circulating creatine kinase MM isoform
HP:0032234.definition: An increased concentration of the MM isoform of creatine kinase in the blood circulation.
HP:0032234.name_cn: 循环中肌酸激酶MM同工酶水平升高
HP:0032234.definition_cn: 血液中肌酸激酶MM同工酶浓度升高。

HP:0032235.name: Anti-La/SS-B antibody positivity
HP:0032235.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against La/SSB autoantigens.
HP:0032235.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对La/SSB自身抗原的自身抗体。

HP:0032236.name: Increased circulating immature neutrophil count
HP:0032236.definition: An abnormally increased number of immature neutrophils in the peripheral blood circulation.
HP:0032236.name_cn: 循环未成熟中性粒细胞计数升高
HP:0032236.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中未成熟中性粒细胞数量异常增多。

HP:0032237.name: Increased circulating myelocyte count
HP:0032237.definition: The number of myelocytes in the peripheral blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Myelocytes are immature neutrophils with a size of 12-18 micrometers, a round or oval nucleus with no nucleoli, bluish-pink staining cytoplasm with primary and secondary granules, and a nucleus:cytoplasm ratio of 2:1.
HP:0032237.name_cn: 循环中髓系细胞计数增加
HP:0032237.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中髓系细胞数量高于正常上限。髓系细胞为未成熟中性粒细胞，直径12-18微米，核呈圆形或椭圆形，无核仁，胞质呈蓝粉色染色，含有初级和次级颗粒，核质比为2:1。

HP:0032238.name: Increased circulating metamyelocyte count
HP:0032238.definition: The number of metamyelocytes in the peripheral blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Metamyelocytes are immature neutrophils with a size of 10-18 micrometers, an indented or kidney-shaped nucleus, pinkish-blue staining cytoplasm with secondary granules, and a nucleus:cytoplasm ratio of 1.5:1.
HP:0032238.name_cn: 循环中晚幼粒细胞计数增加
HP:0032238.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中晚幼粒细胞数量高于正常上限。晚幼粒细胞为未成熟中性粒细胞，直径10-18微米，核呈凹陷或肾形，胞质呈粉蓝色染色并含有次级颗粒，核质比为1.5:1。

HP:0032239.name: Increased circulating band cell count
HP:0032239.definition: The number of band cells in the peripheral blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Band cells are immature neutrophils with a size of 10-18 micrometers, a horseshoe-shaped nucleus with no nucleoli, light-pink staining cytoplasm with many small secondary granules, and a nucleus:cytoplasm ratio of 1:2.
HP:0032239.name_cn: 循环带状细胞计数增加
HP:0032239.definition_cn: 外周血循环中带状细胞数量高于正常上限。带状细胞为未成熟中性粒细胞，大小为10-18微米，核呈马蹄形且无核仁，胞质呈淡粉色染色并含有大量次级颗粒，核质比为1:2。

HP:0032240.name: Elevated circulating E selectin level
HP:0032240.definition: An increased concentration of E selectin in the blood circulation.
HP:0032240.definition_cn: 血液循环中E选择素浓度升高。

HP:0032241.name: Cervical neoplasm
HP:0032241.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the uterine cervix.
HP:0032241.definition_cn: 宫颈肿瘤（宫颈组织异常增生）

HP:0032242.name: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia
HP:0032242.definition: A precancerous condition characterized by dysplasia of the cervical epithelium. Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) 1, 2 and 3 based on its relationship with the prognosis. CIN 1 is mild dysplasia, which is mostly observed because it disappears as part of its natural course. CIN 3 includes severe dysplasia and carcinoma in situ, and management involves treatment because it is highly likely to develop into invasive cancer.
HP:0032242.definition_cn: 一种以宫颈上皮异型增生为特征的癌前病变。根据其与预后的关系，宫颈上皮内瘤变（CIN）分为1级、2级和3级。CIN 1为轻度异型增生，通常采取观察策略，因其在自然病程中可能自行消退。CIN 3包括重度异型增生和原位癌，因其极有可能发展为浸润性癌，需采取治疗措施。

HP:0032243.name: Abnormal tissue metabolite concentration
HP:0032243.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a metabolite in a tissue.
HP:0032243.definition_cn: 组织中代谢物浓度与正常值的任何偏离。

HP:0032244.name: Decreased serum thromboxane B2
HP:0032244.definition: A reduction in the concentration of thromboxane B2 in the blood circulation.
HP:0032244.definition_cn: 血液循环中血栓素B2浓度的降低。

HP:0032245.name: Abnormal metabolism
HP:0032245.definition: An abnormality in the function of the chemical reactions related to processes including conversion of food to enter, synthesis of proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates, or the elimination of waste products.
HP:0032245.definition_cn: 与食物转化为能量、蛋白质、脂类、核酸和碳水化合物的合成，或废物排泄过程相关的化学反应功能异常。

HP:0032247.name: Persistent CMV viremia
HP:0032247.definition: Lasting (uncontrolled) presence of cytomegalovirus in the blood circulation.
HP:0032247.name_cn: 持续性巨细胞病毒血症
HP:0032247.definition_cn: 持续性（未受控）巨细胞病毒血症。

HP:0032248.name: Persistent viremia
HP:0032248.definition: Persistence of virus in the blood circulation longer than would be normal in an immunocompetent host.
HP:0032248.definition_cn: 病毒在血液循环中的持续存在时间超过免疫正常宿主的正常范围。

HP:0032249.name: Coccidioidomycosis
HP:0032249.definition: Infection by a Coccidioides species fungus. These are dimorphic, soil-dwelling, fungi known to cause a broad spectrum of disease, ranging from a mild febrile illness to severe pulmonary manifestations or disseminated disease. The genus Coccidioides is comprised of two genetically distinct species: Coccidioides immitis and C. posadasii.
HP:0032249.definition_cn: 由球孢子菌属真菌引起的感染。这些真菌为双相性、土壤栖息的真菌，已知可引起广泛的疾病谱，从轻微的发热性疾病到严重的肺部表现或播散性疾病。球孢子菌属由两个遗传学上不同的物种组成：粗球孢子菌（Coccidioides immitis）和波萨达斯球孢子菌（Coccidioides posadasii）。

HP:0032250.name: Acinetobacter infection
HP:0032250.definition: An infection by Acinetobacter baumannii, a Gram-negative bacillus that is aerobic, pleomorphic and non-motile. An opportunistic pathogen, A. baumannii has a high incidence among immunocompromised individuals, particularly those who have experienced a prolonged (over 90 d) hospital stay.
HP:0032250.definition_cn: 由鲍曼不动杆菌（Acinetobacter baumannii）引起的感染，该菌为革兰阴性杆菌，需氧、多形性且无运动性。作为一种机会性病原体，鲍曼不动杆菌在免疫功能低下个体中发病率较高，尤其是那些长期住院（超过90天）的患者。

HP:0032252.name: Granuloma
HP:0032252.definition: A compact, organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes, which may be but is not necessarily accompanied by accessory features such as necrosis.
HP:0032252.definition_cn: 一种紧凑、有序的成熟单核吞噬细胞集合，可能但不一定伴随坏死等附属特征。

HP:0032253.name: Eosinophilic granuloma
HP:0032253.definition: A type of granuloma characterized morphologically by the predominance of Langerhans cells with characteristic grooved, folded, indented nuclei in the appropriate milieu that includes variable numbers of eosinophils and histiocytes including multinucleated forms, often appearing similar to osteoclasts or touton like giant cells, neutrophils and small lymphocytes. The concentration of the eosinophilic infiltrate varies from scattered mature cells to sheet-like masses of cells. Occasionally, areas of bone necrosis may interrupt the cellular infiltrate. The foamy cells may also be amassed in clumps, which are of no clinical significance because these clumps represent phagocytosis of lipid debris.
HP:0032253.definition_cn: 一种肉芽肿类型，其形态学特征为在适当的微环境中以朗格汉斯细胞为主，这些细胞具有特征性的沟槽状、折叠状、凹陷状核，同时伴有数量不等的嗜酸性粒细胞和组织细胞，包括多核形式，常类似于破骨细胞或图顿样巨细胞、中性粒细胞和小淋巴细胞。嗜酸性粒细胞浸润的浓度从散在的成熟细胞到片状细胞团块不等。偶尔，骨坏死区域可能中断细胞浸润。泡沫细胞也可能聚集成团，这些团块无临床意义，因为它们代表脂质碎片的吞噬作用。

HP:0032254.name: Increased circulating copper concentration
HP:0032254.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration of copper in the blood circulation. This term refers to the total copper concentration.
HP:0032254.definition_cn: 血液循环中铜浓度异常升高。该术语指总铜浓度。

HP:0032255.name: Opportunistic fungal infection
HP:0032255.definition: An infection that is caused by a fungus that would generally not be able to cause an infection in a host with a normal immune system. Such fungi take advantage of the opportunity, so to speak, that is provided by a weakened immune system.
HP:0032255.definition_cn: 由真菌引起的感染，通常无法在具有正常免疫系统的宿主中引发感染。此类真菌利用免疫系统减弱的机会进行感染。

HP:0032256.name: Histoplasmosis
HP:0032256.definition: Histoplasmosis is caused by the fungus Histoplasma capsulatum and is consider to be an opportunistic infection in immunosuppressed persons.
HP:0032256.definition_cn: 组织胞浆菌病是由荚膜组织胞浆菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）引起的真菌感染，在免疫功能低下个体中被视为一种机会性感染。

HP:0032257.name: Disseminated histoplasmosis
HP:0032257.definition: Histoplasmosis infection involving multiple sites of the body. Disseminated histoplasmosis can involve various organs, including reticuloendothelial organs, gastrointestinal tract, adrenal glands, central nervous system, endovascular structures, kidney, and skin. It typically presents with systemic symptoms like fever, generalized fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and the symptoms related to the specific organ involved. Severe disseminated disease can manifest as septic shock, multi organ failure, and ARDS.
HP:0032257.definition_cn: 多部位组织胞浆菌感染。播散性组织胞浆菌病可累及多个器官，包括网状内皮系统器官、胃肠道、肾上腺、中枢神经系统、血管内结构、肾脏和皮肤。其典型表现为全身性症状，如发热、全身乏力、盗汗、体重减轻，以及受累器官相关的特异性症状。严重的播散性疾病可表现为感染性休克、多器官功能衰竭和急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）。

HP:0032258.name: Pulmonary histoplasmosis
HP:0032258.definition: Infection of the lungs with Histoplasma capsulatum. Symptoms may include fever, headache, weakness, chest pain and dry cough. When imaging is done, chest radiographs may show patchy pneumonia involving one or more lobes with adenopathy of the mediastinum or hilum.
HP:0032258.definition_cn: 肺部荚膜组织胞浆菌感染。症状可能包括发热、头痛、乏力、胸痛和干咳。进行影像学检查时，胸部X线片可能显示累及一个或多个肺叶的斑片状肺炎，并伴有纵隔或肺门淋巴结肿大。

HP:0032259.name: Chronic tinea infection
HP:0032259.definition: The term tinea means fungal infection, whereas dermatophyte refers to the fungal organisms that cause tinea. This term refers to a tinea infection that is chronic or recalcitrant to treatment and may be reflective of an immune defect.
HP:0032259.definition_cn: 术语“tinea”意指真菌感染，而“dermatophyte”则指引起tinea的真菌生物体。该术语指一种慢性或对治疗顽固的tinea感染，可能反映免疫缺陷。

HP:0032260.name: Opportunistic bacterial infection
HP:0032260.definition: An infection that is caused by a bacterium that would generally not be able to cause an infection in a host with a normal immune system. Such bacteria take advantage of the opportunity, so to speak, that is provided by a weakened immune system.
HP:0032260.definition_cn: 由一种在正常免疫系统宿主中通常无法引起感染的细菌所导致的感染。此类细菌利用免疫系统功能减弱的机会进行感染。

HP:0032261.name: Nontuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary infection
HP:0032261.definition: An infection of the lung caused by environmental mycobacteria. Such infections can occur in individuals with predisposing lung disease or immune disease.
HP:0032261.name_cn: 非结核分枝杆菌肺部感染
HP:0032261.definition_cn: 由环境分枝杆菌引起的肺部感染。此类感染可发生于具有易感肺部疾病或免疫疾病的个体中。

HP:0032262.name: Pulmonary tuberculosis
HP:0032262.definition: A lung infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis a slightly curved non-motile, aerobic, non-capsulated and non-spore forming strains of mycobacteria.
HP:0032262.definition_cn: 由结核分枝杆菌引起的肺部感染，该菌为微弯曲、无运动性、需氧、无荚膜且不形成芽孢的分枝杆菌菌株。

HP:0032263.name: Increased blood pressure
HP:0032263.definition: Abnormal increase in blood pressure. An individual measurement of increased blood pressure does not necessarily imply hypertension. In practical terms, multiple measurements are recommended to diagnose the presence of hypertension.
HP:0032263.definition_cn: 血压异常升高。单次血压升高测量并不一定意味着高血压。在实际操作中，建议进行多次测量以诊断是否存在高血压。

HP:0032264.name: Anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity
HP:0032264.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate)-type glutamate receptor.
HP:0032264.name_cn: 抗N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体抗体阳性
HP:0032264.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对NMDA（N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸）型谷氨酸受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0032265.name: CSF autoimmune antibody positivity
HP:0032265.definition: The presence of an antibody in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that is directed against the organism's own cells or tissues.
HP:0032265.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对机体自身细胞或组织的抗体。

HP:0032266.name: CSF anti-NMDA receptor antibody positivity
HP:0032266.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against the NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate)-type glutamate receptor.
HP:0032266.name_cn: 脑脊液抗N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体抗体阳性
HP:0032266.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对NMDA（N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸）型谷氨酸受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0032267.name: Empty delta sign
HP:0032267.definition: This sign is created by a nonenhancing thrombus in the dural sinus surrounded by triangular enhancing dura as seen on cross-section. The sign, seen on contrast-enhanced CT scan images, suggests dural sinovenous thrombosis. It is best seen on wider window settings. It is a reliable sign of sinus thrombosis but is seen only in 25-30% of these cases.
HP:0032267.definition_cn: 该征象由硬脑膜窦内无强化的血栓及周围呈三角形强化的硬脑膜在横断面上形成。在增强CT扫描图像上可见此征象，提示硬脑膜窦静脉血栓形成。在较宽的窗宽设置下显示最佳。该征象是窦血栓形成的可靠征象，但仅见于25-30%的病例中。

HP:0032268.name: Dural tail sign
HP:0032268.definition: This sign represents thickening and enhancement of the dura mater in continuity with a mass, which on MR images, gives the appearance of a tail arising from the mass. The dural tail is thought to represent reactive change; however, it may also be due to tumor invasion. Three criteria need to be met for a positive dural tail sign: the tail should be seen on two successive images through the tumor, it should taper away from the tumor, and it must enhance more than the tumor.
HP:0032268.definition_cn: 该征象表现为硬脑膜增厚和强化，并与肿块相连，在磁共振成像（MRI）上呈现为从肿块延伸出的尾状结构。硬脑膜尾征通常被认为是反应性改变的表现；然而，它也可能由肿瘤浸润引起。阳性硬脑膜尾征需满足以下三个标准：尾状结构应在肿瘤连续的两幅图像中可见，其应从肿瘤处逐渐变细，且其强化程度必须高于肿瘤本身。

HP:0032269.name: Lemon sign
HP:0032269.definition: The lemon sign refers to the shape of the fetal skull at ultrasonography (US) when the frontal bones lose their normal convex contour and appear flattened or inwardly scalloped. This gives the skull a shape that is said to resemble a lemon.. The sign is seen on transverse sonograms of the fetal cranium obtained at the level of the ventricles.
HP:0032269.definition_cn: 柠檬征（Lemon sign）是指在超声检查（US）中，胎儿颅骨额骨失去正常的凸面轮廓，呈现扁平或内凹的扇贝状，使颅骨形状类似于柠檬。该征象在胎儿颅脑横切面超声图像中，于脑室水平可见。

HP:0032270.name: Optic nerve tram-track sign
HP:0032270.definition: A tram-track sign is composed of two enhancing areas of tumor separated from each other by the negative defect of the optic nerve. It is seen on contrast-enhanced CT scan and MRI images, in optic nerve sheath meningioma. The sign helps distinguish between optic nerve sheath meningioma and optic glioma. Optic glioma arises from glial cells within the optic nerve and there is no clear separation between the nerve and the tumor; hence the tram-track sign is not seen in optic gliomas. Calcification may be seen in optic nerve sheath meningiomas in 20-50% of cases and hence the tram-track sign may be seen on nonenhanced CT scan images as a linear calcification around the nerve, but this is less common.
HP:0032270.definition_cn: “电车轨道征”由两个增强的肿瘤区域组成，这两个区域被视神经的负性缺损分隔开。该征象在增强CT扫描和MRI图像中可见于视神经鞘脑膜瘤。此征有助于区分视神经鞘脑膜瘤和视神经胶质瘤。视神经胶质瘤起源于视神经内的胶质细胞，神经与肿瘤之间无明确分隔；因此，视神经胶质瘤中不会出现“电车轨道征”。在20-50%的视神经鞘脑膜瘤病例中可见钙化，因此“电车轨道征”在非增强CT扫描图像中可能表现为神经周围的线性钙化，但这种情况较为少见。

HP:0032271.name: Extrapulmonary tuberculosis
HP:0032271.definition: A type of tubercular infection located outside of the lung, which is the most common location of tuberculosis. There are two types of clinical manifestation of tuberculosis (TB) are pulmonary TB (PTB) and extrapulmonary TB (EPTB). The former is most common. EPTB refers to TB involving organs other than the lungs (e.g., pleura, lymph nodes, abdomen, genitourinary tract, skin, joints and bones, or meninges). A patient with both pulmonary and EPTB is classified as a case of PTB.
HP:0032271.definition_cn: 一种位于肺外的结核感染，而肺部是结核病最常见的发病部位。结核病（TB）的临床表现有两种类型：肺结核（PTB）和肺外结核（EPTB）。前者最为常见。肺外结核（EPTB）指的是累及肺部以外器官的结核病（例如，胸膜、淋巴结、腹部、泌尿生殖道、皮肤、关节和骨骼，或脑膜）。同时患有肺结核和肺外结核的患者被归类为肺结核病例。

HP:0032272.name: obsolete Elevated urinary N-acetylaspartic acid level
HP:0032272.name_cn: 过时的尿N-乙酰天门冬氨酸水平升高

HP:0032273.name: Increased circulating N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
HP:0032273.definition: Concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0032273.name_cn: 循环中N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度升高
HP:0032273.definition_cn: 血液中N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0032274.name: Increased CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
HP:0032274.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0032274.name_cn: 脑脊液N-乙酰天门冬氨酸浓度升高
HP:0032274.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度异常升高。

HP:0032275.name: Recurrent shingles
HP:0032275.definition: Repeated episodes of a localized, painful cutaneous eruption related to reactivation of varicella zoster virus (VZV) and characterized by a characteristic rash in one or two adjacent dermatomes.
HP:0032275.definition_cn: 复发性局部疼痛性皮肤病变，与带状疱疹病毒（VZV）再激活相关，特征为一个或两个相邻皮节出现典型皮疹。

HP:0032276.name: Prominent subcalcaneal fat pad
HP:0032276.definition: Abnormally increased prominence of the fat pad underneath the heal. This feature can be appreciated in figure 1 of PMID:26769062.
HP:0032276.definition_cn: 跟骨下方脂肪垫异常增厚。该特征可在PMID:26769062的图1中观察到。

HP:0032278.name: 2-hydroxyglutarate aciduria
HP:0032278.definition: The concentration of 2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0032278.definition_cn: 尿液中2-羟基戊二酸浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0032281.name: Abnormal base excess
HP:0032281.definition: Deviation from the normal quantity of base excess, defined as the amount of strong acid (in millimoles per liter) that needs to be added in vitro to 1 liter of fully oxygenated whole blood to return a blood sample to standard conditions (pH of 7.40, Pco2 of 40 mm Hg, and temperature of 37 degrees C).
HP:0032281.definition_cn: 碱剩余（Base Excess, BE）偏离正常值，定义为在体外条件下，将1升完全氧合的全血样本恢复到标准状态（pH值为7.40，二氧化碳分压（Pco2）为40毫米汞柱，温度为37摄氏度）所需添加的强酸量（以毫摩尔/升表示）。

HP:0032282.name: Contact dermatitis
HP:0032282.definition: An inflammatory process in skin caused by an exogenous agent that directly or indirectly injure the skin. If the offending agent is identified and removed, the eruption will resolve. An unusual or patterned eruption may be a clue to the presence of a contact dermatitis. Patch testing may be helpful in the differential diagnosis.
HP:0032282.definition_cn: 由外源性物质直接或间接损伤皮肤引起的皮肤炎症过程。若识别并移除致病原，皮疹将消退。异常或特定模式的皮疹可能提示接触性皮炎的存在。斑贴试验有助于鉴别诊断。

HP:0032283.name: Disseminated nontuberculous mycobacterial infection
HP:0032283.definition: An infection with nontuberculous mycobacteria that affects multiple body sites. Such infections can occur in individuals with immune disease.
HP:0032283.name_cn: 播散性非结核分枝杆菌感染
HP:0032283.definition_cn: 非结核分枝杆菌感染累及多部位。此类感染可发生于免疫性疾病患者。

HP:0032284.name: Ultra-low vision with retained motion projection
HP:0032284.definition: Ultra-low vision but with retained ability to identify a moving object (typically hand motion at distance of 30 cm).
HP:0032284.name_cn: 超低视力伴运动投射保留
HP:0032284.definition_cn: 超低视力，但保留识别移动物体的能力（通常为30厘米距离的手部运动）。

HP:0032285.name: Ultra-low vision with retained light projection
HP:0032285.definition: Ultra-low vision but with retained ability to perceive the difference between light and dark. Also when light is projected in each of the four quadrants of the visual field, the individual is able to correctly identify the origin of the light stimulus.
HP:0032285.definition_cn: 极低视力，但保留光感能力。当光线投射到视野的四个象限时，个体能够正确识别光刺激的来源。

HP:0032286.name: Ultra-low vision with retained light perception
HP:0032286.definition: Ultra-low vision but with retained ability to perceive the difference between light and dark.
HP:0032286.definition_cn: 极低视力但保留光感能力。

HP:0032287.name: Ultra-low vision with no light perception
HP:0032287.definition: Ultra-low vision with complete lack of light and form perception.
HP:0032287.definition_cn: 超低视力伴完全性光感和形态觉缺失。

HP:0032288.name: Polyclonal elevation of circulating IgG
HP:0032288.definition: An increase in polyclonal immunoglobulins resulting from many different plasma cells. On serum electrophoresis, a polyclonal gammopathy is characterized by a broad diffuse band with one or more heavy chains and kappa and lambda light chains.
HP:0032288.definition_cn: 多克隆免疫球蛋白的增多源于多种不同的浆细胞。在血清电泳中，多克隆γ球蛋白病的特征表现为一条宽而弥散的条带，包含一种或多种重链以及κ和λ轻链。

HP:0032289.name: Oligoclonal elevation of circulating IgG
HP:0032289.definition: An increase in circulating immunoglobulins characterized by two or more bands in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins.
HP:0032289.definition_cn: 循环免疫球蛋白增加，其特征为血清电泳中出现两条或更多条带，但未出现多克隆性循环免疫球蛋白增加所特有的宽泛弥散带。

HP:0032290.name: Monoclonal elevation of IgG
HP:0032290.definition: An increase in circulating immunoglobulins characterized by a single band in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins.
HP:0032290.definition_cn: 循环免疫球蛋白增加，其特征为血清电泳中出现单一带，而非多克隆性循环免疫球蛋白增加所特有的广泛弥散带。

HP:0032291.name: Monoclonal elevation of intact IgG
HP:0032291.definition: A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has a normal structure with a light and heavy chain.
HP:0032291.definition_cn: 一种单克隆IgG升高的类型，其中涉及的免疫球蛋白具有正常结构，包含轻链和重链。

HP:0032292.name: Monoclonal elevation of IgG light chain
HP:0032292.definition: A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a light chain but not a heavy chain.
HP:0032292.definition_cn: 一种单克隆IgG升高的类型，其中涉及的免疫球蛋白具有异常结构，仅含有轻链而无重链。

HP:0032293.name: Monoclonal elevation of IgG heavy chain
HP:0032293.definition: A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a heavy chain but not a light chain.
HP:0032293.definition_cn: 一种单克隆IgG升高的类型，其中涉及的免疫球蛋白具有异常结构，含有重链但无轻链。

HP:0032294.name: Monoclonal elevation of IgG kappa chain
HP:0032294.definition: A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a kappa light chain but not a heavy chain.
HP:0032294.definition_cn: 一种单克隆IgG升高的类型，其中涉及的免疫球蛋白具有异常结构，包含κ轻链但不含重链。

HP:0032295.name: Monoclonal elevation of IgG lambda chain
HP:0032295.definition: A type of monoclonal elevation of IgG in which the involved immunoglobulin has an abnormal structure with a lambda light chain but not a heavy chain.
HP:0032295.definition_cn: 一种单克隆IgG升高的类型，其中涉及的免疫球蛋白具有异常结构，包含λ轻链但无重链。

HP:0032296.name: Increased circulating IgG subclass
HP:0032296.definition: An elevation of circulating IgG level predominantly related to an elevation of one of the four IgG subclasses.
HP:0032296.definition_cn: 循环IgG水平升高主要与四种IgG亚类之一的升高相关。

HP:0032297.name: Increased circulating IgG3 level
HP:0032297.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of the IgG3 subtype in the blood circulation.
HP:0032297.definition_cn: 血液循环中IgG3亚型浓度异常升高。

HP:0032298.name: Increased circulating IgG1 level
HP:0032298.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of the IgG1 subtype in the blood circulation.
HP:0032298.definition_cn: 循环血液中IgG1亚型浓度异常升高。

HP:0032299.name: Increased circulating IgG2 level
HP:0032299.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of the IgG2 subtype in the blood circulation.
HP:0032299.definition_cn: 血液循环中IgG2亚型浓度异常增高。

HP:0032300.name: Increased circulating IgG4 level
HP:0032300.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of the IgG4 subtype in the blood circulation.
HP:0032300.definition_cn: 血清中IgG4亚型浓度异常升高。

HP:0032301.name: Genital warts
HP:0032301.definition: Warts affecting the skin in the genital area (penile shaft, scrotum, vagina, or labia majora). Warts can be small, beginning as a pinhead-size swelling that may become larger and take on a pedunculated appearance. Warts can spread and coalesce into large masses in the genital or anal area. Their color is variable but tends to be skin colored or darker, and they may occasionally bleed. Warts may cause itching, redness, or discomfort. An outbreak of genital warts may also cause psychological distress.
HP:0032301.definition_cn: 生殖器区域（阴茎干、阴囊、阴道或大阴唇）皮肤受累的疣体。疣体可能较小，初期表现为针头大小的肿胀，随后可能增大并呈现带蒂外观。疣体可扩散并融合成生殖器或肛门区域的大块病变。其颜色多变，但通常为肤色或更深，偶尔可能出血。疣体可能引起瘙痒、发红或不适。生殖器疣的爆发也可能导致心理困扰。

HP:0032302.name: Kappa Bence Jones proteinuria
HP:0032302.definition: The presence of free monoclonal kappa immunoglobulin light chains in the urine.
HP:0032302.definition_cn: 尿液中存在游离单克隆κ免疫球蛋白轻链。

HP:0032303.name: Lambda Bence Jones proteinuria
HP:0032303.definition: The presence of free monoclonal lambda immunoglobulin light chains in the urine.
HP:0032303.definition_cn: 尿液中存在游离单克隆λ免疫球蛋白轻链。

HP:0032304.name: Abnormal circulating mannose-binding protein concentration
HP:0032304.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of mannose-binding protein in the blood circulation.
HP:0032304.name_cn: 异常循环甘露糖结合蛋白浓度
HP:0032304.definition_cn: 血液中甘露糖结合蛋白浓度的任何异常。

HP:0032305.name: Decreased circulating mannose-binding protein concentration
HP:0032305.definition: Concentration of mannose-binding protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0032305.name_cn: 循环甘露糖结合蛋白浓度降低
HP:0032305.definition_cn: 循环血液中甘露糖结合蛋白浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0032306.name: Increased circulating mannose-binding protein concentration
HP:0032306.definition: Concentration of mannose-binding protein in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0032306.name_cn: 循环中甘露糖结合蛋白浓度升高
HP:0032306.definition_cn: 循环血液中甘露糖结合蛋白浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0032308.name: Increased circulating procalcitonin concentration
HP:0032308.definition: An elevated concentration of procalcitonin in the blood circulation.
HP:0032308.name_cn: 循环中降钙素原浓度升高
HP:0032308.definition_cn: 血液中降钙素原浓度升高。

HP:0032309.name: Abnormal granulocyte count
HP:0032309.definition: Any deviation from the normal cell count per volume of granulocytes in the blood circulation.
HP:0032309.definition_cn: 循环血液中每单位体积粒细胞计数的任何异常。

HP:0032310.name: Granulocytosis
HP:0032310.definition: An increased count of granulocytes in the peripheral blood circulation.
HP:0032310.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中粒细胞计数增加。

HP:0032311.name: Increased circulating globulin level
HP:0032311.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration of globulins in the blood.

HP:0032312.name: Decreased circulating globulin level
HP:0032312.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of globulins in the blood.

HP:0032313.name: Frontotemporal hypertrichosis
HP:0032313.definition: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the region of the forehead and temple.

HP:0032314.name: Abnormal areolar morphology
HP:0032314.definition: An abnormal appearance or structure of the ring of pigmented skin that surrounds the nipple.
HP:0032314.definition_cn: 乳晕色素沉着环的异常外观或结构。

HP:0032315.name: Areolar fullness
HP:0032315.definition: The areola (ring of pigmented skin surrounding the nipple) is filled out so as to produce a rounded shape.
HP:0032315.definition_cn: 乳晕（环绕乳头的色素沉着皮肤环）充盈，形成圆形轮廓。

HP:0032316.name: Family history
HP:0032316.definition: Information about close relatives of an individual who is the proband of a study or who is being investigated with the goal of identifying a medical diagnosis. Usually, the family history includes information from three generations of relatives, including children, brothers and sisters, parents, aunts and uncles, nieces and nephews, grandparents, and cousins.
HP:0032316.definition_cn: 关于作为研究先证者或正在接受医学诊断调查的个体的近亲信息。通常，家族史包括三代亲属的信息，涵盖子女、兄弟姐妹、父母、姑姨叔伯、侄子女、祖父母以及堂表兄弟姐妹。

HP:0032317.name: Family history of cancer
HP:0032317.definition: A close blood relative had cancer.
HP:0032317.definition_cn: 一级血亲患有恶性肿瘤。

HP:0032318.name: Family history of heart disease
HP:0032318.definition: A close blood relative had heart disease.

HP:0032319.name: Health status
HP:0032319.definition: Health status of a family member with respect to the disease being investigated in a proband.
HP:0032319.definition_cn: 家族成员相对于先证者所研究疾病的健康状况。

HP:0032320.name: Affected
HP:0032320.definition: This term applies to a family member who is diagnosed with the same condition as the individual who is the primary focus of investigation (the proband).
HP:0032320.definition_cn: 该术语适用于被诊断出与主要研究对象（先证者）相同病症的家庭成员。

HP:0032321.name: Unaffected
HP:0032321.definition: This term applies to a family member in whom the diagnosis that is the primary focus of investigation is excluded.
HP:0032321.definition_cn: 该术语适用于排除作为主要调查重点的诊断的家庭成员。

HP:0032322.name: Healthy
HP:0032322.definition: No history of any serious disease, including the disease being investigated in the proband.
HP:0032322.definition_cn: 无重大疾病史，包括先证者所调查的疾病。

HP:0032323.name: Periodic fever
HP:0032323.definition: Episodic fever that recurs at regular intervals.

HP:0032324.name: Non-periodic recurrent fever
HP:0032324.definition: Episodic fever that recurs at irregular intervals.
HP:0032324.definition_cn: 间歇性发热，呈不规则复发。

HP:0032325.name: Lacunar stroke
HP:0032325.definition: A stroke related to a small infarct (2-20 mm in diameter) in the deep cerebral white matter, basal ganglia, or pons, that is presumed to result from the occlusion of a single small perforating artery supplying the subcortical areas of the brain.
HP:0032325.definition_cn: 与深部脑白质、基底节或脑桥中的小梗死（直径2-20毫米）相关的卒中，推测是由于供应脑皮质下区域的单一小穿支动脉闭塞所致。

HP:0032326.name: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infection
HP:0032326.definition: Infection with staphylococcus aureus resistant to the antibiotic methicillin (MRSA). MRSA can infect any individual but is more common among hospitalized patients, and can also occur as an opportunistic infection.
HP:0032326.name_cn: 甲氧西林耐药金黄色葡萄球菌感染
HP:0032326.definition_cn: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）感染。MRSA可感染任何个体，但在住院患者中更为常见，也可作为机会性感染发生。

HP:0032327.name: Interhemispheric cyst
HP:0032327.definition: Cystic collection (sac-like, fluid containing pocket of membranous tissue) located in the interhemispheric fissure, with or without communication with the ventricular system.
HP:0032327.definition_cn: 位于大脑半球间裂的囊性积液（囊状、含液体的膜性组织腔隙），伴或不伴与脑室系统相通。

HP:0032328.name: Temporomandibular joint adhesion
HP:0032328.definition: Formation of one or more fibrous bands within the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) with resulting limitation of movement of the TMJ. Adhesions may be seen in degenerative processes that involve the TMJ.
HP:0032328.definition_cn: 颞下颌关节（TMJ）内形成一条或多条纤维带，导致颞下颌关节运动受限。粘连可见于涉及颞下颌关节的退行性病变过程中。

HP:0032329.name: Increased urinary 11-deoxycortisol level
HP:0032329.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration of 11-deoxycortisol in the urine.
HP:0032329.name_cn: 尿液中11-脱氧皮质醇水平升高
HP:0032329.definition_cn: 尿液中11-脱氧皮质醇浓度异常升高。

HP:0032330.name: Increased urinary 11-deoxycorticosterone level
HP:0032330.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration or amount of 11-deoxycorticosterone in the urine.
HP:0032330.name_cn: 尿液中11-脱氧皮质酮水平升高
HP:0032330.definition_cn: 尿液中11-脱氧皮质酮浓度或含量异常升高。

HP:0032331.name: Increased urinary 11-deoxytetrahydrocorticosterone level
HP:0032331.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration or amount of 11-deoxytetrahydrocorticosterone the urine.
HP:0032331.name_cn: 尿11-脱氧四氢皮质酮水平升高
HP:0032331.definition_cn: 尿液中11-脱氧四氢皮质酮浓度或含量异常升高。

HP:0032332.name: Oligoclonal elevation of circulating IgM
HP:0032332.definition: An increase in circulating IgM characterized by two or more bands in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase.
HP:0032332.definition_cn: 血清电泳中表现为两条或更多条带而非多克隆性增宽弥漫带的循环IgM水平升高。

HP:0032333.name: Polyclonal elevation of circulating IgA
HP:0032333.definition: A heterogeneous increase in IgA mmunoglobulins characterized by a diffuse band on serum electrophoresis.
HP:0032333.name_cn: 循环免疫球蛋白A（IgA）的多克隆性升高
HP:0032333.definition_cn: 血清电泳中表现为弥漫性带的IgA免疫球蛋白异质性增加。

HP:0032334.name: Oligoclonal elevation of circulating IgA
HP:0032334.definition: An increase in circulating IgA characterized by two or more bands in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins.
HP:0032334.definition_cn: 循环免疫球蛋白A（IgA）增加，其特征为血清电泳中出现两条或更多条带，但未出现多克隆性循环免疫球蛋白增加所特有的广泛弥散带。

HP:0032335.name: Monoclonal elevation of circulating IgA
HP:0032335.definition: An increase in circulating IgA characterized by one predominant band in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins.
HP:0032335.definition_cn: 血清电泳中表现为单一优势带的循环免疫球蛋白A（IgA）水平升高，而非多克隆性免疫球蛋白升高所特有的广泛弥散带。

HP:0032336.name: Increased circulating specific IgE antibody concentration
HP:0032336.name_cn: 循环特异性IgE抗体浓度升高

HP:0032337.name: Monoclonal elevated circulating IgE concentration
HP:0032337.definition: An increase in circulating IgE characterized by one predominant band in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins.
HP:0032337.name_cn: 单克隆性循环IgE浓度升高
HP:0032337.definition_cn: 血清电泳中表现为单一优势带的循环IgE水平升高，而非多克隆性循环免疫球蛋白升高所特有的广泛弥散带。

HP:0032338.name: Oligoclonal elevated circulating IgE concentration
HP:0032338.definition: An increase in circulating IgE characterized by two or more bands in serum electrophoresis but not the broad diffuse band that characterizes a polyclonal increase in circulating immunoglobulins.
HP:0032338.name_cn: 寡克隆性升高的循环IgE浓度
HP:0032338.definition_cn: 循环IgE水平升高，其特征为血清电泳中出现两条或更多条带，但未出现代表循环免疫球蛋白多克隆性增高的广泛弥散带。

HP:0032339.name: Polyclonal elevated circulating IgE concentration
HP:0032339.definition: A heterogeneous increase in IgE mmunoglobulins characterized by a diffuse band on serum electrophoresis.
HP:0032339.name_cn: 多克隆性循环IgE浓度升高
HP:0032339.definition_cn: 血清电泳显示弥漫性条带，提示IgE免疫球蛋白的异质性增高。

HP:0032340.name: obsolete Abnormal spirometry test
HP:0032340.name_cn: 过时的异常肺功能测试

HP:0032341.name: Reduced forced vital capacity
HP:0032341.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of air a person can expel following maximal inspiration.
HP:0032341.definition_cn: 最大吸气后，患者呼出气体量的异常减少。

HP:0032342.name: Reduced forced expiratory volume in one second
