HP:0032342.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second.
HP:0032342.definition_cn: 一秒用力呼气量异常减少。

HP:0032345.name: Elevated cancer Ag 19-9 level
HP:0032345.definition: An abnormal increased in the amount of the carbohydrate antigen 19-9, a recognizable sialo-ganglioside in the blood circulation.
HP:0032345.definition_cn: 血液中碳水化合物抗原19-9（一种可识别的唾液酸神经节苷脂）水平异常升高。

HP:0032346.name: Cutaneous lichen amyloidosis
HP:0032346.definition: Lichen amyloidosis presents with multiple localized or rarely generalized, hyperpigmented grouped papules with a predilection for the shins, calves, ankles, and dorsa of the feet and thighs.
HP:0032346.definition_cn: 淀粉样苔藓表现为多发性局限性或罕见的泛发性、色素沉着的群集性丘疹，好发于胫骨、小腿、踝关节、足背及大腿。

HP:0032347.name: Cutaneous macular amyloidosis
HP:0032347.definition: A type of cutaneous amyloidosis that is characterized by hyperpigmented patches with indefinite margins composed of grayish brown macules, often with a reticulated or rippled appearance.
HP:0032347.name_cn: 皮肤斑块状淀粉样变性
HP:0032347.definition_cn: 一种皮肤淀粉样变性，其特征为边界不清的色素沉着斑块，由灰褐色斑疹组成，常呈网状或波纹状外观。

HP:0032348.name: Cutaneous nodular amyloidosis
HP:0032348.definition: A type of cutaneous amyloidosis that is characterized clinically by waxy, purpuric plaques and nodules and histologically by amyloid deposits in the dermis and subcutaneous tissue.
HP:0032348.name_cn: 皮肤结节性淀粉样变性
HP:0032348.definition_cn: 一种皮肤淀粉样变性，临床特征为蜡样紫癜性斑块和结节，组织学特征为真皮和皮下组织中的淀粉样物质沉积。

HP:0032349.name: Serinuria
HP:0032349.definition: A increased concentration of serine in the urine.
HP:0032349.definition_cn: 尿液中丝氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0032350.name: Sulfocysteinuria
HP:0032350.definition: A increased concentration of sulfocysteine in the urine.
HP:0032350.definition_cn: 尿液中磺基半胱氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0032351.name: Phenylalaninuria
HP:0032351.definition: Increased level of phenylalanine in urine.
HP:0032351.definition_cn: 尿液中苯丙氨酸水平升高。

HP:0032352.name: Methioninuria
HP:0032352.definition: Level of methionine in urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0032352.definition_cn: 尿液中甲硫氨酸水平高于正常值上限。

HP:0032353.name: Leucinuria
HP:0032353.definition: Increased level of leucine in urine.
HP:0032353.definition_cn: 尿液中亮氨酸水平升高。

HP:0032355.name: Decreased peak expiratory flow
HP:0032355.definition: A reduction in the maximum expiratory flow per minute, which can be used to measure how fast a subject can exhale as well as to judge the strength of the expiratory muscles and the condition of the large airways.
HP:0032355.definition_cn: 每分钟最大呼气流量减少，可用于测量受试者的呼气速度，并评估呼气肌的力量以及大气道的状况。

HP:0032356.name: Decreased pre-bronchodilator forced vital capacity
HP:0032356.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of air a person can expel following maximal insipiration, with the test being performed before the administration of a bronchodilating medication.
HP:0032356.name_cn: 支气管扩张剂前用力肺活量降低
HP:0032356.definition_cn: 最大吸气后患者呼出气量异常减少，该测试在支气管扩张药物使用前进行。

HP:0032357.name: Decreased post-bronchodilator forced vital capacity
HP:0032357.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of air a person can expel following maximal insipiration, with the test being performed after the administration of a bronchodilating medication.
HP:0032357.name_cn: 支气管扩张剂后用力肺活量降低
HP:0032357.definition_cn: 在给予支气管扩张药物后进行的测试中，患者最大吸气后能够呼出的空气量出现异常减少。

HP:0032358.name: Decreased post-bronchodilator forced expiratory volume in one second
HP:0032358.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second, with the test being performed after the administration of a bronchodilating medication.
HP:0032358.name_cn: 支气管扩张剂后一秒用力呼气量降低
HP:0032358.definition_cn: 一秒钟用力呼气量异常减少，测试在支气管扩张药物使用后进行。

HP:0032359.name: Decreased forced expiratory flow 25-75%
HP:0032359.definition: A reduction compared to the predicted value of the forced expiratory flow over the middle one-half of the FVC; the average flow from the point at which 25% of the FVC has been exhaled to the point at which 75% of the FVC has been exhaled.
HP:0032359.definition_cn: 与预测值相比，用力肺活量（FVC）中段呼气流量（FEF25-75%）降低；即从呼出25% FVC至呼出75% FVC期间的平均流量。

HP:0032360.name: Decreased pre-bronchodilator forced expiratory flow 25-75%
HP:0032360.definition: A reduction compared to the predicted value of the forced expiratory flow over the middle one-half of the FVC; the average flow from the point at which 25% of the FVC has been exhaled to the point at which 75% of the FVC has been exhaled. Here, the test is performed before the administration of a bronchodilating medication.
HP:0032360.name_cn: 支气管扩张剂使用前呼气流量25-75%降低
HP:0032360.definition_cn: 与预测值相比，用力呼气中段流量（FEF25-75%）降低；即从呼出25%肺活量（FVC）至呼出75%肺活量期间的平均流量。此处测试在给予支气管扩张药物前进行。

HP:0032361.name: Decreased post-bronchodilator forced expiratory flow 25-75%
HP:0032361.definition: A reduction compared to the predicted value of the forced expiratory flow over the middle one-half of the FVC; the average flow from the point at which 25% of the FVC has been exhaled to the point at which 75% of the FVC has been exhaled. Here, the test is performed after the administration of a bronchodilating medication.
HP:0032361.name_cn: 支气管扩张剂后用力呼气流量25-75%降低
HP:0032361.definition_cn: 与预测值相比，用力呼气中段流量（FEF25-75%）降低；即从呼出25%肺活量（FVC）至呼出75%肺活量期间的平均流量。此处测试是在使用支气管扩张药物后进行的。

HP:0032362.name: Increased circulating corticosterone level
HP:0032362.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration of corticosterone in the blood.
HP:0032362.definition_cn: 血液中皮质酮浓度异常升高。

HP:0032363.name: Decreased circulating corticosterone level
HP:0032363.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of corticosterone in the blood.
HP:0032363.definition_cn: 血液中皮质酮浓度异常降低。

HP:0032364.name: obsolete Abnormal CSF amino acid level
HP:0032364.name_cn: 过时的脑脊液氨基酸水平异常

HP:0032365.name: Exacerbated by aspirin exposure
HP:0032365.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by ingestion of aspirin.
HP:0032365.name_cn: 阿司匹林暴露导致的病情加重
HP:0032365.definition_cn: 阿司匹林加重性体征或症状。

HP:0032366.name: Positive direct antiglobulin test
HP:0032366.definition: A positive result of the direct antiglobulin test (DAT), a method of demonstrating the presence of antibody or complement bound to red blood cell (RBC) membranes by the use of anti-human globulin to form a visible agglutination reaction.
HP:0032366.name_cn: 直接抗球蛋白试验阳性
HP:0032366.definition_cn: 直接抗人球蛋白试验（DAT）阳性结果，该方法通过使用抗人球蛋白形成可见的凝集反应，以证明红细胞（RBC）膜上存在抗体或补体。

HP:0032367.name: Abnormal growth hormone level
HP:0032367.definition: Any deviation from the normal level of growth hormone (GH) in the blood circulation. GH or somatotropin is a peptide hormone that stimulates growth, cell reproduction, and cell regeneration. Its secretion from the pituitary is regulated by the neurosecretory nuclei of the hypothalamus, which can release Growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH or somatocrinin) and Growth hormone-inhibiting hormone (GHIH or somatostatin) into the hypophyseal portal venous blood surrounding the pituitary. GH is secreted in a pulsatile manner, which is one of the reasons why an isolated measurement of its blood concentration is not meaningful.
HP:0032367.definition_cn: 血液循环中生长激素（GH）水平与正常值的任何偏离。生长激素（GH）或促生长素是一种肽类激素，可刺激生长、细胞增殖和细胞再生。其由垂体分泌，受下丘脑神经分泌核团的调控，下丘脑可释放生长激素释放激素（GHRH或促生长素）和生长激素抑制激素（GHIH或生长抑素）进入垂体周围的垂体门脉血液中。GH以脉冲式分泌，这也是单独测量其血浓度无意义的原因之一。

HP:0032368.name: Acidemia
HP:0032368.definition: An abnormally low blood pH (usually defined as less than 7.35).
HP:0032368.definition_cn: 异常低下的血液pH值（通常定义为低于7.35）。

HP:0032369.name: Alkalemia
HP:0032369.definition: An abnormally high blood pH (usually defined as 7.41 or above).
HP:0032369.definition_cn: 异常升高的血液pH值（通常定义为7.41或以上）。

HP:0032370.name: Blood group A
HP:0032370.definition: ABO phenotype A, corresponding to the genotype AO or AA.

HP:0032371.name: Isoleucinuria
HP:0032371.definition: An increased concentration of isoleucine in the urine.
HP:0032371.definition_cn: 尿液中异亮氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0032372.name: Increased peripheral blast count
HP:0032372.definition: An increased count in the peripheral blood of cells that are precursors to mature circulating blood cells such as neutrophiles, monocytes, lymphocutes, and erythrocytes. Blasts are not usually found in significant numbers in the peripheral blood circulation, but can be observed in hematopoietic neoplasms such as leukemia, severe infections, and as a result of certain medications.
HP:0032372.name_cn: 外周血原始细胞计数增加
HP:0032372.definition_cn: 外周血中成熟循环血细胞前体细胞（如中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞和红细胞）数量增加。正常情况下，外周血液循环中不应出现大量原始细胞，但在造血系统肿瘤（如白血病）、严重感染以及某些药物治疗后，可观察到原始细胞增多。

HP:0032373.name: Duffy blood group
HP:0032373.definition: The Duffy blood group system is based on the presence of a glycoprotein termed Fy that is on the surface of erythrocytes and some other cells. There are two Duffy antigens named Fya and Fyb, and thus there are four Duffy phenotypes: a+b+, a+b-, a-b+,a-b-.
HP:0032373.definition_cn: 达菲血型系统基于存在于红细胞及其他某些细胞表面的糖蛋白Fy。该系统包含两种达菲抗原，分别命名为Fya和Fyb，因此存在四种达菲表型：a+b+、a+b-、a-b+、a-b-。

HP:0032374.name: Duffy Fya positivity
HP:0032374.definition: Presence of the Duffy Fya antigen.

HP:0032375.name: Duffy Fyb positivity
HP:0032375.definition: Presence of the Duffy Fyb antigen.

HP:0032376.name: Anti-beta 2 glycoprotein I antibody positivity
HP:0032376.definition: Presence of antibodies against beta 2 glycoprotein I in the circulation. Beta-2 glycoprotein I (beta2GPI) is the principal target of autoantibodies in the antiphospholipid syndrome (APS).
HP:0032376.definition_cn: 循环中存在抗β2糖蛋白I抗体。β2糖蛋白I（β2GPI）是抗磷脂综合征（APS）中自身抗体的主要靶标。

HP:0032377.name: Increased urinary orosomucoid
HP:0032377.definition: An increased concentration in the urine of alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (AGP), also known as orosomucoid (ORM). AGP is a 41-43-kDa glycoprotein with a pI of 2.8-3.8. AGP is an acute-phase protein that has many activities including, but not limited to, acting as an acute-phase reactant and disease marker, modulating immunity, binding and carrying drugs, maintaining the barrier function of capillary, and mediating the sphingolipid metabolism.
HP:0032377.definition_cn: 尿液中α-1-酸性糖蛋白（AGP），也称为orosomucoid（ORM）的浓度升高。AGP是一种分子量为41-43 kDa、等电点（pI）为2.8-3.8的糖蛋白。AGP是一种急性期蛋白，具有多种功能，包括但不限于作为急性期反应物和疾病标志物、调节免疫、结合和运输药物、维持毛细血管屏障功能以及介导鞘脂代谢。

HP:0032378.name: Immediate-type hypersensitivity drug reaction
HP:0032378.definition: Hypersensitivity that is observed within 1 hr of exposures. A variety of adverse reactions can occur within minutes to hours of exposure to a drug. Some can be related to the pharmacological action of the drug (WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology type A for augmented) and usually have a low mortality. Others are not readily predictable based on the structure and pharmacological action of the drug and have a relatively high mortality risk (Type B for bizarre). The most serious form of immediate onset drug hypersensitivity reaction, anaphylaxis. Other reactions including itching, dizziness/light-headedness, nausea, chest discomfort but without any objective skin features, physical signs or physiological compromise. Skin only reactions include generalized erythema, urticaria or angioedema without any sentinel features (see below) of other organ involvement.
HP:0032378.name_cn: 速发型超敏反应药物反应
HP:0032378.definition_cn: 在暴露后1小时内观察到的超敏反应。在暴露于药物后的几分钟至几小时内，可能会出现多种不良反应。其中一些可能与药物的药理作用有关（WHO不良反应术语中的A型反应，即增强型），通常死亡率较低。另一些则不易根据药物的结构和药理作用预测，且具有相对较高的死亡风险（B型反应，即奇异型）。最严重的即刻发作药物超敏反应是过敏性休克。其他反应包括瘙痒、头晕/头昏、恶心、胸部不适，但没有任何客观的皮肤特征、体征或生理损害。仅涉及皮肤的反应包括全身性红斑、荨麻疹或血管性水肿，但无其他器官受累的预警特征（见下文）。

HP:0032379.name: Polymorphous light eruption
HP:0032379.definition: The cardinal symptom is severely pruritic skin lesions. Macular, papular, papulovesicular, urticarial, multiforme- and plaque-like variants are differentiated morphologically, hence the name polymorphous. Usually one morphology dominates in a single individual (monomorphous). The skin lesions develop a few hours to several days after sun exposure. Initially, patchy erythema develops, accompanied by pruritus. Distinct lesions then develop. The upper chest, upper arms, backs of the hands, thighs, and the sides of the face are the primary localizations. The skin lesions resolve spontaneously within several days of ceasing sun exposure and do not leave behind any traces.
HP:0032379.definition_cn: 主要症状为严重瘙痒的皮肤病变。根据形态学特征，可分为斑疹、丘疹、丘疱疹、荨麻疹样、多形红斑样及斑块样等多种类型，因此称为多形性日光疹。通常，单个患者以某一种形态为主（单形性）。皮肤病变在日晒后数小时至数天内出现。最初表现为斑片状红斑，伴有瘙痒。随后出现明显的皮损。主要累及部位包括上胸部、上臂、手背、大腿及面部两侧。停止日晒后，皮肤病变在数天内自行消退，且不留任何痕迹。

HP:0032381.name: Hydroa vacciniforme
HP:0032381.definition: In response to the spring sun distinct inflamed reddened skin develops on the ears, nose, cheeks, fingers, backs of the hands, and the lower arms, on which blisters with serous or hemorrhagic content develop. These dry out with the formation of a blackish scab. After shedding of the scab, depressed, varioliform, often hypopigmented scars remain. In addition, hyper- and hypopigmentation are present together, resulting in a polymorphous skin presentation.
HP:0032381.definition_cn: 在春季阳光的照射下，耳部、鼻部、面颊、手指、手背及前臂下侧出现明显的炎症性红斑，继而发展为含有浆液性或出血性内容物的水疱。这些水疱干燥后形成黑色痂皮。痂皮脱落后，遗留凹陷性、痘疮样且常伴有色素减退的瘢痕。此外，色素沉着与色素减退并存，导致皮肤呈现多形性表现。

HP:0032382.name: Uniparental disomy
HP:0032382.definition: Inheritance of both homologues of a chromosome pair from the same parent.
HP:0032382.definition_cn: 同源染色体对的双亲单源遗传。

HP:0032383.name: Uniparental heterodisomy
HP:0032383.definition: A type of uniparental disomy in which the two different chromosomes (or chromosome segments) of the same parent are transmitted.
HP:0032383.definition_cn: 一种单亲二体性，其中来自同一亲本的两条不同染色体（或染色体片段）被传递。

HP:0032384.name: Uniparental isodisomy
HP:0032384.definition: A type of uniparental disomy in which the two identical chromosomes (or chromosome segments) of the same parent are transmitted.
HP:0032384.definition_cn: 一种单亲二体性，其中来自同一亲本的两条相同染色体（或染色体片段）被传递。

HP:0032385.name: Abnormal circulating transferrin concentration
HP:0032385.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of transferrin in the blood circulation.
HP:0032385.name_cn: 异常循环转铁蛋白浓度
HP:0032385.definition_cn: 血清转铁蛋白浓度异常。

HP:0032386.name: Elevated circulating transferrin concentration
HP:0032386.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of transferrin in the blood circulation.
HP:0032386.name_cn: 循环转铁蛋白浓度升高
HP:0032386.definition_cn: 血液中异常增高的转铁蛋白浓度。

HP:0032387.name: Reduced circulating transferrin concentration
HP:0032387.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of transferrin in the blood circulation.
HP:0032387.name_cn: 循环转铁蛋白浓度降低
HP:0032387.definition_cn: 血液中运铁蛋白浓度异常降低。

HP:0032388.name: Periventricular nodular heterotopia
HP:0032388.definition: Nodules of heterotopia along the ventricular walls. There can be a single nodule or a large number of nodules, they can exist on either or both sides of the brain at any point along the higher ventricle margins, they can be small or large, single or multiple.
HP:0032388.definition_cn: 沿脑室壁的异位结节。可为单个结节或大量结节，可存在于脑室上缘的任何一侧或双侧，大小不一，可为单发或多发。

HP:0032389.name: Periventricular laminar heterotopia
HP:0032389.definition: A large mass of heterotopia in a laminar configuration along the ventricular walls. Usually bilateral.
HP:0032389.definition_cn: 沿脑室壁呈层状分布的大片异位组织。通常为双侧性。

HP:0032390.name: Periventricular ribbonlike heterotopia
HP:0032390.definition: Heterotopia that forms a continuous wavy line along the ventricular wall.
HP:0032390.definition_cn: 沿脑室壁形成连续波浪线的异位症。

HP:0032391.name: Subcortical heterotopia
HP:0032391.definition: A form of heterotopia were the mislocalized gray matter is located deep within the white matter.
HP:0032391.definition_cn: 一种异位症形式，即错位的灰质位于白质深处。

HP:0032392.name: Nodular subcortical heterotopia in peritrigonal regions
HP:0032392.definition: Solid nodular heterotopia situated in the region of the peritrigonal optic pathway posterior to the deep gray nuclei.
HP:0032392.name_cn: 脑室三角区周围结节性皮质下异位
HP:0032392.definition_cn: 位于深部灰质核团后方三角区周围视通路区域的实性结节状灰质异位。

HP:0032393.name: Diffuse ribbon-like subcortical heterotopia
HP:0032393.definition: Subcortical heterotopia consisting of a bilateral and symmetric single continuous, undulating ribbon-like layer of gray matter located in the frontal, parietal and occipital lobes. It has no visible connection to the overlying cortex.
HP:0032393.name_cn: 弥漫性带状皮质下异位
HP:0032393.definition_cn: 皮层下异位症，表现为双侧对称的单一连续、波浪状带状灰质层，位于额叶、顶叶和枕叶。未见与上方皮层的明显连接。

HP:0032394.name: Mesial parasagittal subcortical heterotopia
HP:0032394.definition: Subcortical heterotopia extending along the mesial aspect of the lateral ventricles, with direct connection to mesial polymicrogyria-like cortex at the anterior and posterior limits of the heterotopia.
HP:0032394.name_cn: 内侧旁矢状面皮质下异位
HP:0032394.definition_cn: 沿侧脑室内侧延伸的皮质下异位，在异位的前后边界处与内侧多小脑回样皮质直接相连。

HP:0032395.name: Curvilinear subcortical heterotopia
HP:0032395.definition: Large subcortical heterotopia of variable morphology with streaks and swirls. These always connect to the overlying cortex in at least one, but usually in multiple, locations. Spaces with the signal intensity of CSF are usually seen within the heterotopia.
HP:0032395.definition_cn: 形态各异的大型皮质下异位，伴有条纹和漩涡状结构。这些异位组织通常在一个或多个位置与上覆皮质相连。在异位组织内通常可见具有脑脊液信号强度的腔隙。

HP:0032396.name: Transmantle columnar heterotopia
HP:0032396.definition: Linear heterotopia spanning from the cerebral mantle from the pia to the ependyma.
HP:0032396.definition_cn: 从软脑膜至室管膜的线性灰质异位贯穿大脑皮质。

HP:0032397.name: Citrullinuria
HP:0032397.definition: The amount of citrulline in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0032397.definition_cn: 尿液中瓜氨酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:0032398.name: Dysgyria
HP:0032398.definition: An abnormal gyral pattern characterized by abnormalities of sulcal depth or orientation.
HP:0032398.definition_cn: 一种异常的脑回模式，其特征为脑沟深度或方向的异常。

HP:0032399.name: Dysgyria with normal cortical thickness
HP:0032399.definition: An abnormal gyral pattern characterized by abnormalities of sulcal depth or orientation but with a normal thickness of the cortex.
HP:0032399.name_cn: 正常皮质厚度的脑回发育不良
HP:0032399.definition_cn: 一种异常的脑回模式，其特征为脑沟深度或方向异常，但皮质厚度正常。

HP:0032400.name: Dysgyria with thickened cortex
HP:0032400.definition: An abnormal gyral pattern characterized by abnormalities of sulcal depth or orientation and a thickened cortex intermediate between pachygyria and polymicrogyria.
HP:0032400.name_cn: 皮质增厚伴脑回发育不良
HP:0032400.definition_cn: 一种异常的脑回模式，其特征为脑沟深度或方向异常，以及皮质增厚，介于巨脑回畸形和多小脑回畸形之间。

HP:0032401.name: Aspartic aciduria
HP:0032401.definition: A increased concentration of aspartic acid in the urine.
HP:0032401.definition_cn: 尿液中天冬氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0032403.name: Asparaginuria
HP:0032403.definition: An increased concentration of asparagine in the urine.
HP:0032403.definition_cn: 尿液中天冬酰胺浓度升高。

HP:0032404.name: Testicular mass
HP:0032404.definition: An abnormal bulge or lump in a testis. A testicular mass has a long differential diagnosis including testicular torsion, epididymitis, acute orchitis, strangulated hernia and testicular cancer.
HP:0032404.definition_cn: 睾丸异常隆起或肿块。睾丸肿块的鉴别诊断范围广泛，包括睾丸扭转、附睾炎、急性睾丸炎、嵌顿性疝以及睾丸癌。

HP:0032405.name: Increased urinary phosphoserine level
HP:0032405.definition: An increased level of phosphoserine in the urine.
HP:0032405.name_cn: 尿液中磷酸丝氨酸水平升高
HP:0032405.definition_cn: 尿液中磷酸丝氨酸水平升高。

HP:0032406.name: Unilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria
HP:0032406.definition: A type of perisylvian polymicrogyria that largely affects one side of the brain.
HP:0032406.name_cn: 单侧大脑外侧裂周围多小脑回畸形
HP:0032406.definition_cn: 一种主要累及单侧大脑的围外侧裂多小脑回畸形。

HP:0032407.name: Bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria
HP:0032407.definition: A type of perisylvian polymicrogyria that affects both sides of the brain.
HP:0032407.name_cn: 双侧外侧裂周围多小脑回畸形
HP:0032407.definition_cn: 一种双侧大脑受累的围侧裂区多小脑回畸形。

HP:0032408.name: Breast mass
HP:0032408.definition: A breast lump is any discrete mass in a breast noticed by the patient, significant other, or physician.
HP:0032408.definition_cn: 乳房肿块是指患者、其重要他人或医生在乳房中发现的任何离散性肿块。

HP:0032409.name: Subcortical band heterotopia
HP:0032409.definition: A form of subcortical heterotopia with mislocalized gray matter within the white matter.It is defined as longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter. It is part of the lissencephaly spectrum.
HP:0032409.definition_cn: 一种皮质下异位症，表现为灰质在白质内错位。其定义为位于大脑皮质深部、与皮质之间隔有一层外观正常的薄白质的纵向灰质带。该病症属于无脑回畸形谱系的一部分。

HP:0032410.name: Bilateral generalized polymicrogyria
HP:0032410.definition: Symmetric generalized polymicrogyria with no obvious gradient or region of maximal severity; may have abnormal high signal in white matter.
HP:0032410.name_cn: 双侧广泛性多小脑回畸形
HP:0032410.definition_cn: 对称性广泛性多小脑回畸形，无明显梯度或最严重区域；可能伴有白质异常高信号。

HP:0032411.name: Posterior predominant subcortical band heterotopia
HP:0032411.definition: Longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter visible along the occipital cortex.
HP:0032411.name_cn: 后部为主的皮质下带状异位
HP:0032411.definition_cn: 位于大脑皮质深部的灰质纵行带，与大脑皮质之间由一层薄而外观正常的白质分隔，沿枕叶皮质可见。

HP:0032412.name: Anterior predominant subcortical band heterotopia
HP:0032412.definition: Longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter visible in the frontal and temporal lobes.
HP:0032412.name_cn: 前部为主的皮质下带状异位
HP:0032412.definition_cn: 位于大脑皮质深部的灰质纵行带，与大脑皮质之间被一层外观正常的薄层白质分隔，在额叶和颞叶中可见。

HP:0032413.name: Diffuse subcortical band heterotopia
HP:0032413.definition: Longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter visible along the whole brain.
HP:0032413.name_cn: 弥漫性皮质下带状异位
HP:0032413.definition_cn: 位于大脑皮质深部的灰质纵行带，与大脑皮质之间被一层薄层外观正常的白质分隔，沿整个大脑可见。

HP:0032414.name: Hydroxylysinuria
HP:0032414.definition: The presence of an elevated amount of 5-hydroxylysine in the urine. This compound is a hydroxylated derivative of the amino acid lysine that is present in certain collagens.
HP:0032414.definition_cn: 尿液中5-羟基赖氨酸水平升高。该化合物是存在于某些胶原蛋白中的氨基酸赖氨酸的羟基化衍生物。

HP:0032415.name: Parasagittal parieto-occipital polymicrogyria
HP:0032415.definition: Polymicrogyria in parasagittal and mesial aspects of parieto-occipital cortex.
HP:0032415.name_cn: 矢状旁顶枕部多小脑回畸形
HP:0032415.definition_cn: 顶枕叶皮质旁矢状面及内侧面的多小脑回畸形。

HP:0032416.name: Retinal microaneurysm
HP:0032416.definition: A localized dilation of microvasculature formed due to disruption of the internal elastic lamina of a retinal capillary blood vessel. The lesions present as small circular, red dots having distinct margins and are no larger than a blood vessel width at the disk margin. This expansion disturbs the normal flow pattern, changing shear force and pressure along the vessel. Shear force plays a key role in promoting the differentiation and proliferation of endothelial cells.
HP:0032416.definition_cn: 由于视网膜毛细血管内弹性层破坏导致的微血管局部扩张。病变表现为边界清晰的小圆形红点，直径不超过视盘边缘血管宽度。这种扩张扰乱了正常血流模式，改变了沿血管的剪切力和压力。剪切力在促进内皮细胞分化和增殖中起关键作用。

HP:0032417.name: Periglomerular fibrosis
HP:0032417.definition: Circumferential fibrosis in the interstitium surrounding Bowman's capsule
HP:0032417.definition_cn: 鲍曼囊周围间质中的环周纤维化

HP:0032418.name: Abnormal HDL subfraction concentration
HP:0032418.definition: An abnormal concentration of an HDL subfraction, which can be determined by methods such as electrophoresis followed by densitometric determination of the areas under the peaks. Large HDL subfractions are defined as HDL1 (greater than 12 nm), HDL2b (9.7-12 nm), and HDL2a (8.8-9.69 nm). Small HDL subfractions are defined as HDL3a (8.2-8.79 nm), HDL3b (7.8-8.19 nm), and HDL3c (7.20-7.79 nm).
HP:0032418.name_cn: 异常高密度脂蛋白亚组分浓度
HP:0032418.definition_cn: 一种高密度脂蛋白（HDL）亚组分的异常浓度，可通过电泳结合峰面积密度测定法等方法进行测定。大HDL亚组分定义为HDL1（大于12 nm）、HDL2b（9.7-12 nm）和HDL2a（8.8-9.69 nm）。小HDL亚组分定义为HDL3a（8.2-8.79 nm）、HDL3b（7.8-8.19 nm）和HDL3c（7.20-7.79 nm）。

HP:0032419.name: Abnormal HDL2a concentration
HP:0032419.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL2a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.80-9.69 nm.
HP:0032419.name_cn: 异常高密度脂蛋白2a浓度
HP:0032419.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL2a亚组分浓度的任何偏离正常值。HDL2a颗粒定义为尺寸为8.80-9.69纳米的HDL颗粒。

HP:0032420.name: Increased HDL2a concentration
HP:0032420.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL2a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.80-9.69 nm.
HP:0032420.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白2a（HDL2a）浓度升高
HP:0032420.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL2a亚组分浓度高于正常水平。HDL2a颗粒定义为尺寸为8.80-9.69 nm的高密度脂蛋白（HDL）颗粒。

HP:0032421.name: Decreased HDL2a concentration
HP:0032421.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL2a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.80-9.69 nm.
HP:0032421.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白2a浓度降低
HP:0032421.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL2a亚组分浓度低于正常水平。HDL2a颗粒定义为粒径为8.80-9.69 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032422.name: Abnormal HDL2b concentration
HP:0032422.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL2b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 9.7-12 nm.
HP:0032422.name_cn: 异常高密度脂蛋白2b浓度
HP:0032422.definition_cn: 血液中HDL2b亚组分浓度的任何偏离正常值。HDL2b颗粒定义为直径在9.7-12纳米范围内的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032423.name: Decreased HDL2b concentration
HP:0032423.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL2b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 9.7-12 nm.
HP:0032423.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白2b（HDL2b）浓度降低
HP:0032423.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL2b亚组分浓度低于正常水平。HDL2b颗粒定义为粒径为9.7-12纳米的HDL颗粒。

HP:0032424.name: Increased HDL2b concentration
HP:0032424.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL2b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL2b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 9.7-12 nm.
HP:0032424.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白2b（HDL2b）浓度升高
HP:0032424.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL2b亚组分浓度高于正常水平。HDL2b颗粒定义为直径在9.7-12纳米范围内的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032425.name: Abnormal HDL3a concentration
HP:0032425.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL3a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.2-8.79 nm.
HP:0032425.name_cn: 异常高密度脂蛋白3a浓度
HP:0032425.definition_cn: 血液中HDL3a亚组分浓度的任何异常。HDL3a颗粒定义为尺寸为8.2-8.79纳米的HDL颗粒。

HP:0032426.name: Abnormal HDL3b concentration
HP:0032426.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL3b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.8-8.19 nm.
HP:0032426.name_cn: 异常高密度脂蛋白3b浓度
HP:0032426.definition_cn: 血液中HDL3b亚组分浓度的任何异常。HDL3b颗粒定义为尺寸为7.8-8.19 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032427.name: Abnormal HDL3c concentration
HP:0032427.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of the HDL3c subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3c particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.20-7.79 nm.
HP:0032427.name_cn: 异常高密度脂蛋白3c浓度
HP:0032427.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3c亚组分浓度的任何异常。HDL3c颗粒定义为粒径为7.20-7.79 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032428.name: Increased HDL3a concentration
HP:0032428.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL3a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.2-8.79 nm.
HP:0032428.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白3a（HDL3a）浓度升高
HP:0032428.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3a亚组分浓度高于正常水平。HDL3a颗粒定义为大小为8.2-8.79纳米的HDL颗粒。

HP:0032429.name: Decreased HDL3a concentration
HP:0032429.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL3a subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3a particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 8.2-8.79 nm.
HP:0032429.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白3a（HDL3a）浓度降低
HP:0032429.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3a亚组分浓度低于正常水平。HDL3a颗粒定义为粒径为8.2-8.79 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032430.name: Increased HDL3b concentration
HP:0032430.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL3b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.8-8.19 nm.
HP:0032430.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白3b（HDL3b）浓度升高
HP:0032430.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3b亚组分浓度高于正常水平。HDL3b颗粒定义为尺寸为7.8-8.19 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032431.name: Decreased HDL3b concentration
HP:0032431.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL3b subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3b particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.8-8.19 nm.
HP:0032431.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白3b浓度降低
HP:0032431.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3b亚组分浓度低于正常水平。HDL3b颗粒定义为粒径为7.8-8.19 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032432.name: Increased HDL3c concentration
HP:0032432.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of the HDL3c subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3c particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.20-7.79 nm.
HP:0032432.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白3c（HDL3c）浓度升高
HP:0032432.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3c亚组分浓度高于正常水平。HDL3c颗粒定义为粒径为7.20-7.79 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032433.name: Decreased HDL3c concentration
HP:0032433.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of the HDL3c subfraction in the blood circulation. An HDL3c particle is defined as an HDL particle with a size of 7.20-7.79 nm.
HP:0032433.name_cn: 高密度脂蛋白3c浓度降低
HP:0032433.definition_cn: 血液循环中HDL3c亚组分浓度低于正常水平。HDL3c颗粒定义为粒径为7.20-7.79 nm的高密度脂蛋白颗粒。

HP:0032434.name: Delayed umbilical cord separation
HP:0032434.definition: Separation of the umbilical cord occurs at an abnormally late timepoint.

HP:0032435.name: Neonatal omphalitis
HP:0032435.definition: An infection of the umbilicus and/or surrounding tissues occurring in the neonatal period.
HP:0032435.definition_cn: 新生儿期脐部及/或周围组织感染。

HP:0032436.name: Abnormal circulating C-reactive protein concentration
HP:0032436.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of C-reactive protein in the blood circulation.
HP:0032436.name_cn: 异常循环C反应蛋白浓度
HP:0032436.definition_cn: 任何偏离血液循环中C反应蛋白正常浓度的异常。

HP:0032437.name: Reduced circulating C-reactive protein concecntration
HP:0032437.definition: An abnormal decrease of the C-reactive protein level in serum.
HP:0032437.name_cn: 循环C反应蛋白浓度降低
HP:0032437.definition_cn: 血清中C反应蛋白水平的异常降低。

HP:0032438.name: Platelet anisocytosis
HP:0032438.definition: Abnormally increased variability in the size of platelets.
HP:0032438.definition_cn: 血小板大小异常增加变异性。

HP:0032439.name: Airborn particle hypersensitivity
HP:0032439.definition: An abnormally increased sensitivity to airborn particles. This can be diagnosed on the basis of the medical history, taking into account seasonality or a relationship to the concentration of airborn particles in the environment of the affected individual. Aerosol challenge is a gold standard of establishment of the symptom. There exist particle hypersensitivity (diesel exhaust, metals, inorganic material) vs. allergen (including pollen dander, etc) hypersensitivity. The responses are usually different and testing for allergen hypersensitivity is done in concert with serum IgE and or skin testing to the suspected allergen.
HP:0032439.name_cn: 空气传播颗粒物超敏反应
HP:0032439.definition_cn: 对空气中颗粒物的异常敏感性增加。可根据病史进行诊断，需考虑季节性因素或与患者所处环境中空气中颗粒物浓度的关系。气溶胶激发试验是确定该症状的金标准。存在颗粒物超敏反应（柴油尾气、金属、无机材料）与过敏原超敏反应（包括花粉皮屑等）之分。反应通常不同，过敏原超敏反应的检测需结合血清IgE检测和/或对可疑过敏原的皮肤试验。

HP:0032440.name: Blood group B
HP:0032440.definition: ABO phenotype B, corresponding to the genotype BO or BB.

HP:0032441.name: Blood group AB
HP:0032441.definition: ABO phenotype AB, corresponding to the genotype AB.
HP:0032441.definition_cn: ABO血型表型为AB，对应的基因型为AB。

HP:0032442.name: Blood group O
HP:0032442.definition: ABO phenotype O, corresponding to the genotype OO.
HP:0032442.definition_cn: ABO表型为O型，对应的基因型为OO。

HP:0032443.name: Past medical history
HP:0032443.definition: In a medical encounter, the physician generally will interview the patient about his or her current problem, and may perform additional testing. The past medical history (PMH) in contrast records information about the patient's medical, personal and family history that might be relevant to the presenting illness or to provide optimal clinical management. The PMH generally includes (if relevant) other major illnesses, hospitalizations, surgeries, injuries, allergies, gynecologic and obstetric history, family history, personal history including occupational history, alcohol and drug use, etc.
HP:0032443.definition_cn: 在医疗接诊过程中，医生通常会询问患者当前的主诉，并可能进行额外的检查。相比之下，既往病史（Past Medical History, PMH）记录的是与当前疾病相关或有助于优化临床管理的患者医疗、个人及家族史信息。既往病史通常包括（如相关）其他重大疾病、住院史、手术史、外伤史、过敏史、妇科及产科史、家族史、个人史（包括职业史）、酒精及药物使用情况等。

HP:0032444.name: Status post organ transplantation
HP:0032444.definition: The affected individual has received an organ transplant previous to the current medical encounter.
HP:0032444.definition_cn: 该患者在当前就诊前已接受器官移植手术。

HP:0032445.name: Pulmonary cyst
HP:0032445.definition: A round circumscribed space within a lung that is surrounded by an epithelial or fibrous wall of variable thickness. A cyst usually has a thin and regular wall (less than 2 mm) and contains air, although some may contain fluid.
HP:0032445.definition_cn: 肺内圆形界限清晰的空间，周围由厚度不一的上皮或纤维壁包绕。囊肿通常具有薄而规则的壁（小于2毫米），内含气体，但部分囊肿可能含有液体。

HP:0032446.name: Pulmonary bulla
HP:0032446.definition: Pulmonary bullae are rounded focal regions of emphysema with a thin wall which measure more than 1 cm in diameter. They are often subpleural in location and are typically larger in the apices. In some cases, bullae can be very large and result in compression of adjacent lung tissue. A giant bulla is arbitrarily defined as one that occupies at least one third of the volume of a hemithorax. When large, bullae can simulate pneumothorax. The most common cause is paraseptal emphysema but bullae may also be seen in association with centrilobular emphysema.
HP:0032446.definition_cn: 肺大泡是指直径超过1厘米的圆形局灶性肺气肿区域，其壁较薄。通常位于胸膜下，且多见于肺尖部。在某些情况下，大泡可能非常大，导致邻近肺组织受压。巨大肺大泡被定义为占据一侧胸腔至少三分之一体积的大泡。当大泡较大时，可能模拟气胸的表现。最常见的原因是间隔旁型肺气肿，但肺大泡也可能与小叶中心型肺气肿相关。

HP:0032447.name: Pulmonary bleb
HP:0032447.definition: A bleb is a small gas-containing space within the visceral pleura or in the subpleural lung, not larger than 1 cm in diameter. CT findings show a bleb as a thin-walled cystic air space contiguous with the pleura.
HP:0032447.definition_cn: 肺大泡（bleb）是指位于脏层胸膜内或胸膜下肺组织中的直径不超过1厘米的含气小腔。CT影像表现为与胸膜相连的薄壁囊性含气腔隙。

HP:0032448.name: Achlorhydria
HP:0032448.definition: A condition in which production of hydrochloric acid in the stomach is absent.

HP:0032449.name: Abnormal dermoepidermal hemidesmosome morphology
HP:0032449.definition: An abnormal structure or appearance of hemidesmosomes, multiprotein complexes that facilitate the stable adhesion of basal epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane.
HP:0032449.name_cn: 异常真皮-表皮半桥粒形态
HP:0032449.definition_cn: 半桥粒结构或形态异常，即多蛋白复合物异常，导致基底上皮细胞与下方基底膜之间的稳定黏附功能障碍。

HP:0032450.name: Positive blood arsenic test
HP:0032450.definition: Detection of arsenic in the blood circulation.

HP:0032451.name: Oral melanotic macule
HP:0032451.definition: Flat, distinct, discolored area of oral mucosal membrane less than 1 cm wide not associated with a change in the thickness or texture of the affected mucosal membrane. The lesions are small, solitary, well-circumscribed and often uniformly pigmented.
HP:0032451.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜平坦、界限清晰、颜色异常的病变区域，宽度小于1厘米，不伴有受累黏膜厚度或质地的改变。病变通常为小型、孤立、边界清楚且色素分布均匀。

HP:0032452.name: Oral melanoacanthoma
HP:0032452.definition: Oral melanoacanthoma usually presents as an asymptomatic, ill-defined, rapidly enlarging, macular pigmentation. Although most lesions are heavily pigmented, the coloration may or may not be uniform. Any mucosal site may be affected, but buccal mucosal involvement is most common. Although typically solitary, rare patients may present with multifocal lesions.
HP:0032452.definition_cn: 口腔黑色素棘皮瘤通常表现为无症状、边界不清、快速增大的斑片状色素沉着。尽管大多数病变色素沉着明显，但颜色可能均匀或不均匀。任何黏膜部位均可受累，但颊黏膜受累最为常见。虽然通常为单发病变，但罕见患者可能出现多灶性病变。

HP:0032453.name: Abnormal lip pigmentation
HP:0032453.definition: Abnormal coloring of the lip, whereby the lip discolored, blotchy, or darker or lighter than normal.
HP:0032453.definition_cn: 唇部异常色素沉着，表现为唇部色泽异常、斑驳或较正常肤色加深或变浅。

HP:0032454.name: Labial melanotic macule
HP:0032454.definition: Flat, distinct, discolored area on the lip less than 1 cm wide not associated with a change in the thickness or texture.
HP:0032454.definition_cn: 唇部平坦、界限清楚、颜色异常的病灶，宽度小于1厘米，不伴有厚度或质地的改变。

HP:0032455.name: Reduced granulocyte CD18 level
HP:0032455.definition: Reduced level of CD18 on the granulocyte surface. This feature can be assessed by flow cytometry.
HP:0032455.definition_cn: 粒细胞表面CD18水平降低。该特征可通过流式细胞术进行评估。

HP:0032456.name: Unlayered lissencephaly
HP:0032456.definition: A type of lissencephaly whereby upon neuropathological examination the cortical plate is severely disorganized with a festooned-like pattern and with neither lamination nor clear demarcation between white and gray matter.
HP:0032456.definition_cn: 一种无脑回畸形类型，其神经病理学检查显示皮质板严重紊乱，呈花彩样模式，且无分层结构，白质与灰质之间无明显分界。

HP:0032457.name: 2-3-layered lissencephaly
HP:0032457.definition: Pachygyria-agyria spectrum whereby at neuropathological examination the cortical plate consists of a two-three layered organization made up of a molecular layer, a relatively thin wavy layer with a higher cellular density and a third layer with lower cellularity.
HP:0032457.definition_cn: 巨脑回-无脑回谱系，在神经病理学检查中，皮质板由两到三层结构组成，包括分子层、相对较薄且细胞密度较高的波浪状层，以及细胞密度较低的第三层。

HP:0032458.name: Narrowing of medullary canal
HP:0032458.definition: A reduction in diameter and volume of the central cavity of bone where red or yellow bone marrow is located.
HP:0032458.definition_cn: 骨髓腔直径和体积的减少，其中包含红骨髓或黄骨髓。

HP:0032459.name: Abnormal phosphoribosylpyrophosphate synthetase level
HP:0032459.definition: Any deviation from the normal level of the enzyme phosphoribosyl pyrophosphatesynthetase, which catalyzes the synthesis of PP-ribose-P from ATP and ribose-5-phosphate.
HP:0032459.name_cn: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶水平异常
HP:0032459.definition_cn: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶（Phosphoribosyl Pyrophosphate Synthetase）催化从三磷酸腺苷（ATP）和5-磷酸核糖（Ribose-5-Phosphate）合成磷酸核糖焦磷酸（PP-Ribose-P）的过程中，任何偏离正常水平的异常。

HP:0032460.name: Decreased phosphoribosylpyrophosphate synthetase level
HP:0032460.definition: Abnormally reduced level of the enzyme phosphoribosyl pyrophosphatesynthetase, which catalyzes the synthesis of PP-ribose-P from ATP and ribose-5-phosphate.
HP:0032460.name_cn: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶水平降低
HP:0032460.definition_cn: 磷酸核糖焦磷酸合成酶水平异常降低，该酶催化从三磷酸腺苷（ATP）和5-磷酸核糖合成磷酸核糖焦磷酸（PP-ribose-P）的过程。

HP:0032462.name: Increased circulating palmitate level
HP:0032462.definition: An elevation beyond the normal concentration of palmitate (palmitic acid) in the blood circulation.
HP:0032462.name_cn: 循环中棕榈酸水平升高
HP:0032462.definition_cn: 血液循环中棕榈酸酯（棕榈酸）浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0032463.name: Reduced circulating fibronectin level
HP:0032463.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of fibronectin the the blood circulation.
HP:0032463.name_cn: 循环纤维连接蛋白水平降低
HP:0032463.definition_cn: 循环血液中纤维连接蛋白浓度低于正常水平。

HP:0032465.name: Bladder trabeculation
HP:0032465.definition: Muscular projections that protrude into the lumen of the bladder, criss-crossing the walls of the bladder on its inner surface.
HP:0032465.definition_cn: 突入膀胱腔内的肌性突起，在膀胱内表面呈交错排列。

HP:0032466.name: Aplasia of the olfactory bulb
HP:0032466.definition: Lack of formation (congenital absence) of the olfactory bulb.
HP:0032466.definition_cn: 嗅球发育不全（先天性嗅球缺失）。

HP:0032467.name: Past obstetric history
HP:0032467.definition: Information about past pregnancies including gravidity (number of times a woman has been pregnant, regardless of the outcome), parity (total number of births), gestational age of births, and medical conditions related to past pregnancies.
HP:0032467.definition_cn: 既往妊娠史信息，包括孕次（女性怀孕的总次数，无论结局如何）、产次（总分娩次数）、分娩时的孕周，以及与既往妊娠相关的医疗状况。

HP:0032468.name: History of stillbirth
HP:0032468.definition: One or more previous pregnancies resulted in stillbirth, defined as death of a fetus in the later stages of pregnancy (definitions in the literature vary, with cut-offs ranging from 20 to 28 weeks gestation).
HP:0032468.definition_cn: 既往一次或多次妊娠结局为死产，定义为妊娠晚期胎儿死亡（文献中定义不一，妊娠终止时间范围为20至28周）。

HP:0032469.name: Anti-asialoglycoprotein receptor antibody positivity
HP:0032469.definition: Presence of autoantibodies against the asialoglycoprotein receptor (ASGPR) in the blood circulation.
HP:0032469.name_cn: 抗去唾液酸糖蛋白受体抗体阳性
HP:0032469.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在抗去唾液酸糖蛋白受体（ASGPR）自身抗体。

HP:0032470.name: Monilethrix
HP:0032470.definition: The hair shaft has a beaded appearance due to the presence of elliptical nodes that have the diameter of normal hair and are medullated, regularly separated by internodes that are narrow, devoid of medulla and are the site of fracture.
HP:0032470.definition_cn: 毛干呈现串珠状外观，这是由于存在椭圆形结节，这些结节具有正常毛发的直径且含有髓质，它们被无髓质的狭窄节间段规律性地分隔，这些节间段是断裂发生的部位。

HP:0032471.name: Focal polymicrogyria
HP:0032471.definition: Polymicrogyria affecting one or multiple small areas of the cerebral cortex.
HP:0032471.definition_cn: 多小脑回畸形累及大脑皮层的一个或多个小区域。

HP:0032472.name: Abnormal urine urobilinogen level
HP:0032472.definition: An abnormal concentration of urobilinogen in the urine.

HP:0032473.name: Decreased urine urobilinogen
HP:0032473.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of urobilinogen in the urine.

HP:0032476.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin B6 concentration
HP:0032476.definition: An abnormal concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.
HP:0032476.definition_cn: 血液循环中维生素B6的异常浓度。

HP:0032477.name: Elevated circulating vitamin B6 concentration
HP:0032477.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.
HP:0032477.definition_cn: 血液中维生素B6浓度异常升高。

HP:0032478.name: Lateral spinal meningocele
HP:0032478.definition: Protrusion of the arachnoid and dura through spinal foramina.
HP:0032478.definition_cn: 蛛网膜和硬脊膜通过椎间孔突出。

HP:0032479.name: Preimplantation lethality
HP:0032479.definition: It is estimated that about 40-70 percent of human embryos produced in vitro fertilization (IVF) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) are viable embryos, whereas others arrest at different early stages of development. The phenotype of preimplantation lethality is inferred if IVF and ICSI cycles fail because all of an individual's embryos are arrested at early stages of development.
HP:0032479.definition_cn: 据估计，通过体外受精（IVF）和卵胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）产生的人类胚胎中，约有40-70%为可存活胚胎，而其他胚胎则在不同的早期发育阶段停滞。如果IVF和ICSI周期失败，且个体的所有胚胎均在早期发育阶段停滞，则可推断为植入前致死表型。

HP:0032480.name: Beta-aminoisobutyric aciduria
HP:0032480.definition: An increased amount of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine. Beta-aminoisobutyric acid is a non-protein amino acid originating from the catabolism of thymine and valine.
HP:0032480.definition_cn: 尿液中β-氨基异丁酸含量增加。β-氨基异丁酸是一种非蛋白质氨基酸，来源于胸腺嘧啶和缬氨酸的分解代谢。

HP:0032481.name: Abnormal pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
HP:0032481.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081).
HP:0032481.name_cn: 垂体糖蛋白激素α亚单位水平异常
HP:0032481.definition_cn: 糖蛋白激素α多肽循环浓度异常（NCBI Gene 1081）。

HP:0032482.name: Decreased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
HP:0032482.definition: An reduced concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081).
HP:0032482.name_cn: 垂体糖蛋白激素α亚单位水平降低
HP:0032482.definition_cn: 循环糖蛋白激素α多肽浓度降低（NCBI基因1081）。

HP:0032483.name: obsolete Abnormal fecal test result
HP:0032483.name_cn: 过时的异常粪便检测结果

HP:0032484.name: Elevated fecal sodium
HP:0032484.definition: An elevated concentration of sodium in feces.

HP:0032485.name: Abnormal fecal osmolality
HP:0032485.definition: Abnormal concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram.
HP:0032485.definition_cn: 粪便异常浓度通过每千克溶质颗粒总数评估。

HP:0032486.name: Elevated fecal osmolality
HP:0032486.definition: Abnormally high concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram.
HP:0032486.definition_cn: 粪便中溶质颗粒总数每千克异常升高。

HP:0032487.name: Reduced fecal osmolality
HP:0032487.definition: Abnormally low concentration of feces as assessed by the total number of solute particles per kilogram.
HP:0032487.definition_cn: 粪便溶质颗粒浓度异常降低（以每公斤粪便中溶质颗粒总数评估）。

HP:0032488.name: Abnormal fecal pH
HP:0032488.definition: Any deviation from the normal pH of feces. The pH reflects the acidity or alkalinity of a solution on a logarithmic scale on which 7 is neutral, whereby lower values are more acid and higher values more alkaline.
HP:0032488.definition_cn: 粪便pH值异常。pH值反映了溶液的酸碱度，采用对数刻度表示，其中7为中性，低于7的值表示酸性增强，高于7的值表示碱性增强。

HP:0032489.name: Elevated fecal pH
HP:0032489.definition: Abnormally high fecal pH, i.e., abnormal alkalinity of feces.
HP:0032489.definition_cn: 粪便pH值异常升高，即粪便碱度异常。

HP:0032490.name: Decreased fecal pH
HP:0032490.definition: Abnormally low fecal pH, i.e., abnormal acidity of feces.
HP:0032490.definition_cn: 粪便pH值异常降低，即粪便酸度异常。

HP:0032491.name: Increased circulating argininosuccinic acid
HP:0032491.definition: An increased level of the non-proteinogenic amino acid argininosuccinic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0032491.name_cn: 循环中精氨琥珀酸增加
HP:0032491.definition_cn: 血液循环中非蛋白源性氨基酸精氨琥珀酸水平升高。

HP:0032492.name: Anti-myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody positivity
HP:0032492.definition: Presence of antibodies in the serum that react against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein.
HP:0032492.name_cn: 抗髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白抗体阳性
HP:0032492.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白的抗体。

HP:0032493.name: Increased circulating trypsinogen
HP:0032493.definition: An abnormally high concentration of trypsinogen in the blood circulation.
HP:0032493.name_cn: 循环胰蛋白酶原水平升高
HP:0032493.definition_cn: 血液循环中胰蛋白酶原浓度异常升高。

HP:0032495.name: Abnormal terminal:vellus ratio
HP:0032495.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of terminal to vellus hairs.

HP:0032496.name: Elevated terminal:vellus ratio
HP:0032496.definition: An increased proportion of terminal hairs compared to vellus hairs.
HP:0032496.name_cn: 终末毛与毳毛比例升高
HP:0032496.definition_cn: 终毛比例相较于毳毛增加。

HP:0032497.name: Reduced terminal:vellus ratio
HP:0032497.definition: A terminal:vellus ratio under 4:1 is characteristic of androgenetic alopecia.
HP:0032497.name_cn: 末端毛与毳毛比例降低
HP:0032497.definition_cn: 末端毛发与毳毛比例低于4:1是雄激素性脱发的特征性表现。

HP:0032499.name: Giant neutrophil granules
HP:0032499.definition: The presence of abnormally large granules in neutrophils. This finding can be appreciated on a peripheral blood smear. The finding is characteristic of Chediak Higashi syndrome. The giant granules are derived from azurophil granules, whereas peroxidase-negative granules are not involved in their formation.
HP:0032499.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞中出现异常巨大的颗粒。这一发现可通过外周血涂片观察到。该发现是Chediak-Higashi综合征的特征性表现。这些巨大颗粒来源于嗜天青颗粒，而过氧化物酶阴性颗粒不参与其形成。

HP:0032500.name: Exacerbated by tobacco use
HP:0032500.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by smoking tobacco products.
HP:0032500.name_cn: 烟草使用导致的病情加重
HP:0032500.definition_cn: 烟草制品使用相关症状加重。

HP:0032501.name: Exacerbated by contraceptive medication exposure
HP:0032501.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by taking contraceptive medication.
HP:0032501.name_cn: 避孕药物暴露导致的病情加重
HP:0032501.definition_cn: 避孕药物诱发加重的体征或症状。

HP:0032502.name: Exacerbated by barbiturate exposure
HP:0032502.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by taking barbituates.
HP:0032502.name_cn: 巴比妥类药物暴露导致的病情加重
HP:0032502.definition_cn: 巴比妥类药物应用后加重的体征或症状。

HP:0032503.name: Ameliorated by ethanol ingestion
HP:0032503.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by drinking alcohol (ethanol).
HP:0032503.definition_cn: 适用于通过饮用酒精（乙醇）改善或减轻的体征或症状。

HP:0032504.name: Lhermitte's sign
HP:0032504.definition: An electric shock-like sensation that occurs on flexion of the neck. This sensation radiates down the spine, often into the legs, arms, and sometimes to the trunk.
HP:0032504.definition_cn: 颈部屈曲时出现的电击样感觉。该感觉沿脊柱向下放射，常延伸至下肢、上肢，有时可波及躯干。

HP:0032505.name: Hydrophobia
HP:0032505.definition: The word hydrophobia has been used to describe the avoidance of drinking in the presence of hydrophobic spasms that can be observed in human rabies (described as a blockage in the throat with worsening of dyspnea). However, rarely, the same word has been used to describe panic reactions observed in a patient when offered a glass of water. This term does not refer to the latter meaning.
HP:0032505.definition_cn: “恐水症”一词用于描述人类狂犬病中观察到的恐水性痉挛（表现为喉部阻塞伴呼吸困难加重）时的饮水回避现象。然而，该词极少用于描述患者在提供一杯水时出现的恐慌反应。本术语不涉及后者的含义。

HP:0032506.name: Alien limb phenomenon
HP:0032506.definition: Alien limb phenomenon refers to involuntary motor activity of a limb in conjunction with the feeling of estrangement from that limb.
HP:0032506.definition_cn: 异己肢体现象（Alien limb phenomenon）是指肢体出现不自主运动活动，并伴有对该肢体的疏离感。

HP:0032507.name: Labiomental fasciculations
HP:0032507.definition: Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the chin.

HP:0032508.name: Polyembolokoilamania
HP:0032508.definition: Habitual insertion of foreign bodies into bodily orifices.

HP:0032509.name: Onychotillomania
HP:0032509.definition: Onychotillomania is characterized by the compulsive or irresistible urge in patients to pick at, pull off, or harmfully bite or chew their nails.
HP:0032509.definition_cn: 甲癖症（Onychotillomania）的特征为患者出现强迫性或不可抗拒的冲动，表现为反复抠挖、撕扯、咬啮或咀嚼自身指甲，导致甲床损伤。

HP:0032510.name: Tendon pain
HP:0032510.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to a tendon.
HP:0032510.definition_cn: 一种以局部肌腱处物理性不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0032511.name: Superiorly positioned umbilicus
HP:0032511.definition: The position of the umbilicus (belly button) is abnormally high (superior).
HP:0032511.definition_cn: 脐部位置异常偏高（上移）。

HP:0032513.name: Four-vessel umbilical cord
HP:0032513.definition: Four-vessel umbilical cord containing two arteries and two veins.
HP:0032513.definition_cn: 四血管脐带，包含两条动脉和两条静脉。

HP:0032514.name: Supernumerary lacrimal punctum
HP:0032514.definition: A congenital developmental anomaly characterized by the presence of an additional lacrimal punctum in an eyelid.
HP:0032514.definition_cn: 先天性发育异常，表现为眼睑中存在额外的泪点。

HP:0032515.name: Deep dermatophytosis
HP:0032515.definition: A type of invasive dermatophyte infection of the deep dermis characterized by extensive dermal infiltration by fungal elements.
HP:0032515.definition_cn: 一种深部真皮侵袭性皮肤癣菌感染，其特征为真菌成分广泛浸润真皮层。

HP:0032516.name: Invasive dermatophyte infection
HP:0032516.definition: Infection that extends deeply into the dermis by dermatophytes, fungi that typically cause different types of superficial infection (tinea) or skin, hair, or nails.
HP:0032516.definition_cn: 由皮肤癣菌引起的感染，深入真皮层，这些真菌通常引起不同类型的浅表感染（癣）或皮肤、毛发、指甲的感染。

HP:0032517.name: Majocchi's granuloma
HP:0032517.definition: Majocchi's granuloma (MG) is an inflammatory and granulomatous, dermatophytic infection characterized by a granulomatous inflammation around the hair follicle. Histopathologically, MG demonstrates a nodular perifollicular granulomatous infiltrate of lymphoid cells, macrophages, epithelioid cells, multinucleated giant cells, and neutrophils. Unlike superficial dermatophytoses, fungal hyphae and spores can be detected not only on the surface of the epidermis but also within or around the hair follicles.
HP:0032517.definition_cn: 马约基肉芽肿（Majocchi's granuloma, MG）是一种炎症性和肉芽肿性的皮肤癣菌感染，其特征为毛囊周围的肉芽肿性炎症。组织病理学上，MG表现为毛囊周围结节性肉芽肿性浸润，浸润细胞包括淋巴细胞、巨噬细胞、上皮样细胞、多核巨细胞和中性粒细胞。与浅表性皮肤癣菌病不同，真菌菌丝和孢子不仅可在表皮表面检测到，还可在毛囊内或毛囊周围发现。

HP:0032518.name: Disseminated dermatophytosis
HP:0032518.definition: A type of invasive dermatophyte infection characterized by vascular involvement and dissemination to other organs.
HP:0032518.definition_cn: 一种侵袭性皮肤癣菌感染，其特征为血管受累并播散至其他器官。

HP:0032519.name: Increased Burr cell count
HP:0032519.definition: Burr cells, also known as echinocytes, have a speculated border over the entire cell surface. Burr cells are commonly found in both end-stage renal disease and liver disease. Small numbers of Burr cells are commonly found in healthy individuals.
HP:0032519.definition_cn: 棘形红细胞（Burr cells），亦称棘细胞（echinocytes），其整个细胞表面呈现棘状突起。棘形红细胞常见于终末期肾病（end-stage renal disease）和肝脏疾病（liver disease）患者中。少量棘形红细胞在健康个体中也常见。

HP:0032520.name: Masseter muscular weakness
HP:0032520.definition: Reduced strength of the masseter muscle, whose primary function is to elevate the mandible and thereby raise the mandible towards the maxilla, closing the jaw.
HP:0032520.definition_cn: 咬肌力量减弱，其主要功能为上提下颌骨，从而使下颌骨向上颌骨方向移动，闭合下颌。

HP:0032521.name: Self hugging
HP:0032521.definition: Involuntary, tic-like movements consisted of crossing both arms across the chest and tensing the body or clasping the hands and squeezing the arms to the sides. The movements last a few seconds and may occur in series or flurries, generally accompanied by facial grimacing and occasional grunting.
HP:0032521.definition_cn: 不自主的抽动样动作包括双臂交叉于胸前并身体紧绷，或双手紧握并将双臂挤压至身体两侧。这些动作持续数秒，可能连续或阵发性出现，通常伴有面部扭曲和偶尔的呻吟。

HP:0032522.name: Ameliorated by immunosuppresion
HP:0032522.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with immunosuppresive medication.
HP:0032522.name_cn: 免疫抑制治疗后症状缓解
HP:0032522.definition_cn: 适用于通过免疫抑制药物治疗得以改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0032523.name: Tendon thickening
HP:0032523.definition: An abnormal increase in the thickness (diameter) of a tendon.
HP:0032523.definition_cn: 肌腱厚度（直径）异常增厚。

HP:0032524.name: Long thumb
HP:0032524.definition: Length of the thumb is greater than normal.
HP:0032524.definition_cn: 拇指长度超过正常范围。

HP:0032525.name: Exacerbated by acetylcholinesterase inhibitor exposure
HP:0032525.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor such as tensilon (edrophonium) or pyridostigmine (Mestinon).
HP:0032525.name_cn: 乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂暴露导致的病情加重
HP:0032525.definition_cn: 应用于因乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂（如腾喜龙（依酚氯铵）或吡啶斯的明（美斯的明））治疗而加重的体征或症状。

HP:0032526.name: Ameliorated by acetylcholinesterase inhibitor
HP:0032526.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor such as mestinon or tensilon.
HP:0032526.name_cn: 乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂改善
HP:0032526.definition_cn: 适用于通过乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂（如美斯的明或腾喜龙）改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0032527.name: Inferiorly positioned umbilicus
HP:0032527.definition: The position of the umbilicus (belly button) is abnormally low (inferior).
HP:0032527.definition_cn: 脐部位置异常低位（下移）。

HP:0032528.name: Elevated urinary 4-hydroxybutyric acid
HP:0032528.definition: An increased amount of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.
HP:0032528.name_cn: 尿液中4-羟基丁酸水平升高
HP:0032528.definition_cn: 尿液中4-羟基丁酸含量升高。

HP:0032529.name: obsolete Elevated circulating gamma-aminobutyric acid concentration
HP:0032529.name_cn: 过时的 循环中γ-氨基丁酸浓度升高

HP:0032530.name: Decreased tissue succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
HP:0032530.definition: Reduced level of succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase (SSADH).
HP:0032530.name_cn: 组织琥珀酸半醛脱氢酶活性降低
HP:0032530.definition_cn: 琥珀酸半醛脱氢酶（SSADH）水平降低。

HP:0032531.name: Elevated CSF gamma-aminobutyric acid concentration
HP:0032531.name_cn: 脑脊液γ-氨基丁酸浓度升高

HP:0032532.name: Elevated CSF 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP:0032532.definition: Abnormally increased level of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0032532.name_cn: 脑脊液4-羟基丁酸浓度升高
HP:0032532.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中4-羟基丁酸水平异常升高。

HP:0032533.name: Elevated circulating acetone concentration
HP:0032533.definition: An increased level of acetone in the blood circulation. Acetone is one of the predominant ketone bodies.
HP:0032533.definition_cn: 血液循环中丙酮水平升高。丙酮是主要的酮体之一。

HP:0032534.name: Exacerbated by methylxanthine ingestion
HP:0032534.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by ingestion of food containing a methylxanthine compound (for instance, coffee, caffeine, chocolate).
HP:0032534.name_cn: 甲基黄嘌呤摄入导致的病情加重
HP:0032534.definition_cn: 应用于因摄入含有甲基黄嘌呤化合物（例如咖啡、咖啡因、巧克力）的食物而加重的体征或症状。

HP:0032535.name: Cervical (neck)
HP:0032535.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the neck.
HP:0032535.definition_cn: 适用于位于颈部的异常病变。

HP:0032536.name: Increased number of lymph nodes
HP:0032536.definition: An abnormally elevated number of lymph nodes in an anatomical region.
HP:0032536.definition_cn: 某一解剖区域淋巴结数量异常增多。

HP:0032537.name: Delayed fracture healing
HP:0032537.definition: A delay in healing of a fracture past the expected duration.
HP:0032537.definition_cn: 骨折愈合延迟（Delayed Union of Fracture）

HP:0032538.name: Pretibial dimple
HP:0032538.definition: A groove or crease on the shins (pretibial, i.e., over the shin bone). Pretibial creases may be obvious at birth and may range from 3 cm to over 15 cm in length and lengthen as the limb grows. They appear as an elongated dimple because of the attachment of skin to underlying tissue (e.g., to the tibia). The dimple or crease grows in proportion to the growth of the leg.
HP:0032538.definition_cn: 胫骨前沟或皱褶（胫骨前，即位于胫骨上方）。胫骨前皱褶可能在出生时即明显可见，长度范围从3厘米到超过15厘米不等，并随着肢体的生长而延长。由于皮肤与下方组织（如胫骨）的附着，它们表现为一个细长的凹陷。该凹陷或皱褶与腿部的生长成比例增长。

HP:0032539.name: Joint extensor surface localization
HP:0032539.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in extensor surface of the joint. The extensor surface refers to the skin on the opposite side of a joint.
HP:0032539.definition_cn: 适用于位于关节伸侧表面的异常情况。伸侧表面指的是关节对侧的皮肤。

HP:0032540.name: Joint flexor surface localization
HP:0032540.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in flexor surface of the joint. The flexor surface refers to the skin that touches when a joint is bent (flexed).
HP:0032540.definition_cn: 适用于位于关节屈曲面的异常。屈曲面指的是关节弯曲（屈曲）时接触的皮肤表面。

HP:0032541.name: Knuckle pad
HP:0032541.definition: Knuckle pads are benign fibrofatty subcutaneous pads located over the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints that can be mistaken for arthritis. Rarely they affect the dorsal aspect of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints. Clinically they are painless and often affect both hands in an asymmetrical pattern.
HP:0032541.definition_cn: 指节垫是位于近端指间关节（PIP）上的良性纤维脂肪性皮下垫，可能被误认为关节炎。罕见情况下，它们会影响掌指关节（MCP）的背侧。临床上，指节垫无痛，且常以不对称模式影响双手。

HP:0032542.name: Exacerbated by pregnancy
HP:0032542.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by being pregnant.
HP:0032542.definition_cn: 妊娠加重的体征或症状。

HP:0032543.name: Lithoptysis
HP:0032543.definition: Expectoration (coughing up) of a broncholith. Broncholithiasis is defined as the presence of calculi in the tracheobronchial tree. It is a rare disease but can be characterized by clinical and radiological findings of a calcified lymph node eroding bronchial wall and opening into the bronchial lumen.
HP:0032543.definition_cn: 支气管结石咳出。支气管结石症定义为气管支气管树内存在结石。这是一种罕见疾病，但其临床和影像学特征可表现为钙化淋巴结侵蚀支气管壁并开口于支气管腔内。

HP:0032544.name: Predominant small joint localization
HP:0032544.definition: Applies to an abnormality that mainly affects the small joints, including fingers, toes, interphalangeal, metacarpophalangeal, metatarsophalangeal, wrists, ankles, vertebrae, and neck.
HP:0032544.definition_cn: 适用于主要累及小关节的异常，包括手指、足趾、指间关节、掌指关节、跖趾关节、腕关节、踝关节、椎体及颈部。

HP:0032545.name: Abdominal rigidity
HP:0032545.definition: Involuntary tightening of the abdominal musculature that occurs in response to touching the abdomen to avoid pain. Rigidity can occur in the presence of abdominal inflammation and usually involves only the inflamed area.
HP:0032545.definition_cn: 腹壁肌群在触诊时出现的不自主紧张，以避免疼痛。腹壁强直可发生于腹腔炎症时，通常仅累及炎症区域。

HP:0032546.name: Abdominal guarding
HP:0032546.definition: A voluntary contraction of the abdominal wall musculature to avoid pain.
HP:0032546.definition_cn: 腹壁肌肉的自主性收缩以避免疼痛。

HP:0032547.name: Low intraocular pressure
HP:0032547.definition: An abnormal decrease of the pressure within the eye.

HP:0032549.name: Persistent asymmetrical tonic neck reflex
HP:0032549.definition: Persistence beyond the normal age (roughly the first half of the first year of life) of the asymmetric tonic neck reflex (ATNR), which is an easily elicited primitive reflex in the immediate newborn period. The ATNR refers to the phenomenon whereby when the face of an infant is turned to one side, the ipsilateral arm and leg extend and the contralateral arm and leg flex. This posture has been compared to a typical posture of fencers.
HP:0032549.name_cn: 持续性不对称性强直性颈反射
HP:0032549.definition_cn: 非对称性紧张性颈反射（Asymmetric Tonic Neck Reflex, ATNR）在超出正常年龄（大致为出生后前半年）后仍持续存在，该反射在新生儿期极易诱发。ATNR 是指当婴儿头部转向一侧时，同侧上下肢伸展，而对侧上下肢屈曲的现象。这一姿势常被比作击剑运动员的典型姿势。

HP:0032550.name: Howell-Jolly bodies
HP:0032550.definition: Howell-Jolly bodies are small, intra-erythrocytic remnants of erythrocyte nuclei. These inclusions are solitary in each erythrocyte and strongly basophilic. These are often confused with overlying platelets, but can be distinguished by the presence of a halo around overlying platelets.
HP:0032550.definition_cn: Howell-Jolly小体是红细胞内残留的核碎片。这些包涵体在每个红细胞中单独存在，呈强嗜碱性。它们常与重叠的血小板混淆，但可通过观察重叠血小板周围是否存在晕轮来区分。

HP:0032551.name: Hemorrhoids
HP:0032551.definition: Enlarged, bulging blood vessels in and around the anus often associated with rectal bleeding, itching, and pain.
HP:0032551.definition_cn: 肛门及周围区域扩张、突出的血管，常伴有直肠出血、瘙痒和疼痛。

HP:0032552.name: Abnormal pulse
HP:0032552.definition: An anomaly of the rhythmic throbbing of an artery that reflects the widening of the artery as blood flows through it and is caused by successive contractions of the heart.
HP:0032552.definition_cn: 动脉搏动节律异常，反映血液流经时动脉扩张，由心脏连续收缩引起。

HP:0032553.name: Weak pulse
HP:0032553.definition: A diminution in the amplitude (strength) of the pulse such that the examiner has difficulty feeling the pulse.
HP:0032553.definition_cn: 脉搏振幅（强度）减弱，导致检查者难以触及脉搏。

HP:0032554.name: Absent pulse
HP:0032554.definition: The pulsation of an artery where the pulse is taken (e.g. the radial artery at the wrist) cannot be detected on physical examination.
HP:0032554.definition_cn: 在体格检查中无法触及用于测量脉搏的动脉搏动（例如腕部的桡动脉）。

HP:0032556.name: Circumoral cyanosis
HP:0032556.definition: Persistent blue color of the skin that surrounds the mouth.

HP:0032557.name: History of bone marrow transplant
HP:0032557.definition: A past medical history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation involving myeloablative chemoradiotherapy followed by stem cell rescue with autologous or human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched stem cells derived from a donor.
HP:0032557.definition_cn: 既往有造血干细胞移植病史，包括采用清髓性放化疗预处理，随后进行自体或人类白细胞抗原（HLA）匹配的供体来源干细胞移植以进行干细胞拯救。

HP:0032559.name: Short sperm flagella
HP:0032559.definition: Sperm cells with abnormally short flagella.
HP:0032559.definition_cn: 鞭毛异常短的精子细胞。

HP:0032560.name: Coiled sperm flagella
HP:0032560.definition: Sperm cells whose flagella are twisted (coiled).
HP:0032560.definition_cn: 鞭毛扭曲（卷曲）的精子细胞。

HP:0032561.name: Microcephalic sperm head
HP:0032561.definition: Decreased size of the head of sperm.

HP:0032562.name: Tapered sperm head
HP:0032562.definition: Sperm with cigar-shaped heads that gradually dimish in diameter (taper).
HP:0032562.definition_cn: 具有雪茄形头部且直径逐渐减小（锥形）的精子。

HP:0032563.name: Dacryocytosis
HP:0032563.definition: Presence of teardrop-shaped red blood cells.

HP:0032566.name: Oval macrocytosis
HP:0032566.definition_cn: 椭圆形大红细胞症（椭圆形红细胞增多症）。

HP:0032567.name: Lipiduria
HP:0032567.definition: An increased lipid content in the urine.

HP:0032568.name: Urinary mulberry cells
HP:0032568.definition: Distal tubular epithelial cells in which globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) has accumulated. they are the characteristic feature of Fabry disease. Urinary mulberry bodies are a component of mulberry cells that can be distinguished easily from fat particles by their inner lamellar appearance.
HP:0032568.definition_cn: 远端肾小管上皮细胞内积聚了半乳糖三酰基鞘氨醇（Gb3），这是法布里病的特征性表现。尿液中的桑葚体是桑葚细胞的组成部分，其内部层状结构使其易于与脂肪颗粒区分。

HP:0032569.name: Temporal bossing
HP:0032569.definition: Prominence (bulging) in the temple region, which is the part of the skull where the frontal, parietal, temporal, and sphenoid bones join on the side of the head.
HP:0032569.definition_cn: 颞区隆起（膨出），即颅骨侧面额骨、顶骨、颞骨和蝶骨交汇处。

HP:0032570.name: Pontine ischemic lacunes
HP:0032570.definition: Lacunes are infarcts less than 15 mm in diameter in the cortical white matter or in the corona radiata, internal capsule, centrum semiovale, thalamus, basal ganglia, or pons.
HP:0032570.definition_cn: 腔隙性梗死是指直径小于15毫米的梗死灶，位于皮质白质、放射冠、内囊、半卵圆中心、丘脑、基底节或脑桥。

HP:0032571.name: Increased oocyte death
HP:0032571.definition: An increase in death of oocytes, the female germ cell (egg cell), which can be observed clinically in the setting of in vitro fertilization.
HP:0032571.definition_cn: 卵母细胞（雌性生殖细胞）死亡增加，在体外受精的临床环境中可观察到。

HP:0032572.name: Abnormal urinary nucleobase concentration
HP:0032572.definition: A deviation from the normal level of a nucleobase in the urine. Nucleobases are nitrogen-containing biological compounds that form nucleosides: adenine (A), cytosine (C), guanine (G), thymine (T), and uracil (U).
HP:0032572.definition_cn: 尿液中核碱基水平偏离正常值。核碱基是含氮生物化合物，构成核苷：腺嘌呤（A）、胞嘧啶（C）、鸟嘌呤（G）、胸腺嘧啶（T）和尿嘧啶（U）。

HP:0032573.name: Elevated urinary cytidine
HP:0032573.definition: Increased levels of urinary cytidine, a pyrimidine nucleoside in which cytosine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond.
HP:0032573.definition_cn: 尿液中胞苷水平升高，胞苷是一种嘧啶核苷，其中胞嘧啶通过β-N1糖苷键与呋喃核糖相连。

HP:0032574.name: Elevated urinary uridine level
HP:0032574.definition: Increased levels of urinary uridine, a ribonucleoside composed of a molecule of uracil attached to a ribofuranose moiety via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond.
HP:0032574.definition_cn: 尿液中尿苷水平升高，尿苷是一种由尿嘧啶分子通过β-N1糖苷键连接到呋喃核糖部分组成的核糖核苷。

HP:0032575.name: Decreased circulating 12-HETE
HP:0032575.definition: A reduction in the concentration of 12-HETE in the blood circulation, a metabolite of arachidonic acid.
HP:0032575.name_cn: 循环12-羟基二十碳四烯酸（12-HETE）水平降低
HP:0032575.definition_cn: 血液循环中12-羟基二十碳四烯酸（12-HETE）浓度降低，其为花生四烯酸的代谢产物。

HP:0032576.name: Intracellular accumulation of Dol-PP-GlcNAc2Man5
HP:0032576.definition: Intracellular accumulation of the lipid-linked oligosaccharide intermediate Man5GlcNAc2-PP-dolichol.
HP:0032576.definition_cn: 脂质连接的寡糖中间体Man5GlcNAc2-PP-多萜醇的细胞内积聚。

HP:0032577.name: Clonal T cell receptor rearrangement
HP:0032577.definition: Presence of a predominant T cell clone. In PCR-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of one or two prominent bands within a valid size range. In NGS-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of a high number of reads that map to a single T cell receptor clone.
HP:0032577.name_cn: 克隆性T细胞受体基因重排
HP:0032577.definition_cn: 存在一个主要的T细胞克隆。在基于PCR的检测中，这一发现是基于在有效大小范围内出现的一个或两个显著条带推断的。在基于NGS的检测中，这一发现是基于大量测序读段映射到单个T细胞受体克隆推断的。

HP:0032578.name: Third ventricle colloid cyst
HP:0032578.definition: An epithelial lined cyst filled with gelatinous material. The gelatinous material commonly contains mucin, old blood, cholesterol, and ions. Most colloid cysts identified are currently asymptomatic and identified incidentally on imaging. When a colloid cyst does cause issues, it most commonly causes obstructive hydrocephalus.
HP:0032578.definition_cn: 一种内衬上皮的囊肿，充满胶状物质。该胶状物质通常含有粘蛋白、陈旧性血液、胆固醇和离子。目前发现的大多数胶样囊肿无症状，通常是在影像学检查中偶然发现。当胶样囊肿引发症状时，最常见的是导致梗阻性脑积水。

HP:0032579.name: Vascular hamartoma
HP:0032579.definition: A benign focal growth composed of vascular tissue.
HP:0032579.definition_cn: 血管组织构成的良性局灶性增生。

HP:0032580.name: Abnormal bulbus cordis morphology
HP:0032580.definition: Abnormal structure of the bulbus cordis, which is the single outflow tract of the heart during early embryogenesis.
HP:0032580.definition_cn: 心球结构异常，心球是胚胎早期心脏的单一流出道。

HP:0032581.name: Abnormal renal insterstitial morphology
HP:0032581.definition: Any structural anomaly of the interstitium of the kidney. The renal interstitium is defined as the intertubular, extraglomerular, extravascular space of the kidney. It is bounded on all sides by tubular and vascular basement membranes and is filled with cells, extracellular matrix, and interstitial fluid.
HP:0032581.definition_cn: 肾脏间质的任何结构异常。肾间质定义为肾小管间、肾小球外、血管外的空间。其四周由肾小管和血管基底膜所包围，内部充满细胞、细胞外基质和间质液。

HP:0032582.name: Renal interstitial foam cells
HP:0032582.definition: Accumulation of foam cells (FC) in the interstitium of the kidney. Renal FCs display phenotypic characteristics of macrophages and belong to the monocyte/macrophage lineage. Histologically, renal FCs are characterized by round cells with small nuclei and an abundant PAS-positive cytoplasm with lipid-containing vacuoles.
HP:0032582.definition_cn: 肾间质中泡沫细胞（FC）的积聚。肾脏FC表现出巨噬细胞的表型特征，属于单核细胞/巨噬细胞系。组织学上，肾脏FC的特征为圆形细胞，具有小核和丰富的PAS阳性胞质，内含脂质空泡。

HP:0032584.name: Renal interstitial neutrophil infiltration
HP:0032584.definition: Increased numbers of neutrophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.
HP:0032584.name_cn: 肾间质中性粒细胞浸润
HP:0032584.definition_cn: 肾间质组织中中性粒细胞数量增多。

HP:0032585.name: Renal interstitial eosinophil infiltration
HP:0032585.definition: Increased numbers of eosinophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.
HP:0032585.name_cn: 肾间质嗜酸性粒细胞浸润
HP:0032585.definition_cn: 肾间质组织中嗜酸性粒细胞数量增多。

HP:0032586.name: Renal interstitial plasma cell infiltration
HP:0032586.definition: Increased numbers of plasma cells in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.
HP:0032586.definition_cn: 肾间质组织中浆细胞数量增多。

HP:0032587.name: Renal interstitial calcium oxalate
HP:0032587.definition: The presence of birefringent calcium- and oxalate deposits in interstitial cells of the kidney.
HP:0032587.definition_cn: 肾间质细胞内存在双折射性钙和草酸盐沉积物。

HP:0032588.name: Hand apraxia
HP:0032588.definition: Inability to perform purposeful (learned) movements with the hand upon command, even though the command is understood and there is a willingness to perform the movement. Hand apraxia includes the inability to grasp, pick up, and hold large and small objects.
HP:0032588.definition_cn: 无法在指令下执行有目的（习得性）的手部运动，尽管指令被理解且有意愿执行该运动。手部失用症包括无法抓握、拾取和持握大小物体。

HP:0032589.name: Renal lymphocytic tubulitis
HP:0032589.definition: Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by lymphocytes.
HP:0032589.definition_cn: 肾小管上皮淋巴细胞浸润。

HP:0032590.name: Renal neutrophilic tubulitis
HP:0032590.definition: Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by neutrophils.
HP:0032590.name_cn: 肾中性粒细胞性小管炎
HP:0032590.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞浸润肾小管上皮。

HP:0032591.name: Renal interstitial hemosiderin
HP:0032591.definition: Deposition of hemosiderin (a golden-brown, granular pigment derived from ferritin) in interstitial cells of the kidney.
HP:0032591.definition_cn: 肾间质细胞内含铁血黄素（一种由铁蛋白衍生的金棕色颗粒状色素）沉积。

HP:0032592.name: Aplasia of the right hemidiaphragm
HP:0032592.definition: Congenital absence of the right-sided diaphragm.

HP:0032593.name: Myoglobin casts
HP:0032593.definition: A type of acelluar casts with positive myoglobin staining A that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented.
HP:0032593.definition_cn: 一种无细胞管型，伴有肌红蛋白染色阳性，其表面由颗粒组成，颗粒大小不一。这些颗粒可能具有显著的异质性，从细小（细颗粒管型）到粗大（粗颗粒管型），颜色可呈深色、透明或色素沉着。

HP:0032594.name: Renal tubular basement membrane denudation
HP:0032594.definition: Naked basement membranes without tubular epithelium.
HP:0032594.definition_cn: 无肾小管上皮细胞的裸露基底膜。

HP:0032595.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell detachment
HP:0032595.definition: Tubular cross section with a space between the basolateral aspect of tubular epithelium and its basement membrane; classified as global when at least 2/3 circumference of the tubular cross section are involved and segmental when less than 2/3 are involved.
HP:0032595.definition_cn: 肾小管横截面中，肾小管上皮细胞的基底外侧与其基底膜之间存在间隙；当至少涉及肾小管横截面周长的2/3时，分类为全局性；当涉及范围小于2/3时，分类为节段性。

HP:0032596.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell cytoplasmic vacuolization
HP:0032596.definition: Tubular cross section with intracytoplasmic vacuoles in at least one tubular epithelial cell. This feature is classified as isometric when vacuoles are round and similar in size and coarse when vacuoles were not round in shape or varied in size.
HP:0032596.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞胞浆空泡化
HP:0032596.definition_cn: 肾小管横截面显示至少一个肾小管上皮细胞内存在胞质内空泡。当空泡呈圆形且大小相似时，该特征被分类为等径性空泡；当空泡形状不规则或大小不一时，则被分类为粗大性空泡。

HP:0032597.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell sloughing
HP:0032597.definition: At least one free floating cell in the tubular lumen without attachment to adjacent cells or basement membrane in a tubular cross section without detachment. These cells must not aggregate into a tubular shape and completely fill the lumen, if so, it should be classified as a cast.
HP:0032597.definition_cn: 在肾小管横切面中，至少存在一个游离于管腔内的细胞，未附着于邻近细胞或基底膜，且未发生脱离。这些细胞不得聚集成管状并完全填充管腔，若如此，则应归类为管型。

HP:0032598.name: Blebbing of apical cytoplasm of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP:0032598.definition: Tubular cross section with round/irregular cytoplasmic protrusion, shaped like the Greek capital letter Omega (or it may be more vertically elongated Omega), pinched off from apical membrane without apparent closure of the lumen, involving over 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section. The feature can be further classified into proximal or distal tubule.
HP:0032598.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞顶端胞质出泡
HP:0032598.definition_cn: 管状横截面，伴有圆形/不规则的细胞质突起，形似希腊大写字母Omega（或可能为更垂直拉长的Omega），从顶端膜处掐断，未见管腔明显闭合，横截面中涉及超过50%的肾小管细胞。该特征可进一步分类为近端小管或远端小管。

HP:0032599.name: Abnormal renal tubular epithelial morphology
HP:0032599.definition: Any structural anomaly of the renal tubular epithelial cells (RTEC), a layer of cells in the outer layer of the renal tubule. These cells play a role in the absorption of substances such as glucose and amino from the primary urine.
HP:0032599.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞形态异常
HP:0032599.definition_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞（RTEC）的任何结构异常，这些细胞位于肾小管的外层。这些细胞在从原尿中吸收葡萄糖和氨基酸等物质中发挥作用。

HP:0032600.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell hyaline droplets
HP:0032600.definition: Tubular epithelium with round strongly PAS-positive cytoplasmic droplet material in at least one tubular epithelial cell.
HP:0032600.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞透明滴
HP:0032600.definition_cn: 至少在一个肾小管上皮细胞中观察到圆形、强PAS阳性的胞质滴状物质的肾小管上皮细胞。

HP:0032601.name: Multinucleation of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP:0032601.definition: Tubular epithelial cells with greater than 3 nuclei in a single epithelial cell, often overlapping with each other in a single plane of view.
HP:0032601.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞多核化
HP:0032601.definition_cn: 单个上皮细胞内具有超过3个细胞核的肾小管上皮细胞，通常在同一视野内相互重叠。

HP:0032602.name: Prominent nucleoli of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP:0032602.definition: Tubular epithelium with nucleoli clearly visible at 100-fold magnification.
HP:0032602.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞核仁显著
HP:0032602.definition_cn: 100倍放大镜下可见肾小管上皮细胞核仁清晰可见。

HP:0032603.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell simplification
HP:0032603.definition: Tubular cross section with flattened tubular cell cytoplasm (height unequivocally less than width), with complete loss of brush border involving greater than 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section, resulting in an apparent increase in the size of the lumen, without the presence of casts.
HP:0032603.definition_cn: 管状横截面显示管状细胞胞质扁平化（高度明显小于宽度），超过50%的管状细胞横截面完全丧失刷状缘，导致管腔明显增大，未见管型。

HP:0032604.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell mitosis
HP:0032604.definition: Tubular epithelial cells in any mitotic phase, identified by distinctively visible chromosome in either prophase, metaphase, anaphase or telophase configuration.
HP:0032604.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞有丝分裂
HP:0032604.definition_cn: 处于任何有丝分裂期的肾小管上皮细胞，通过前期、中期、后期或末期染色体构型的明显可见特征进行识别。

HP:0032605.name: High renal tubular epithelial cell N/C ratio
HP:0032605.definition: At least one tubular epithelial cell with average sized cytoplasmic area and a nuclear area 3 times greater than average sized nuclei.
HP:0032605.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞核质比增高
HP:0032605.definition_cn: 至少一个肾小管上皮细胞，其胞质面积中等大小，核面积是平均大小细胞核的三倍。

HP:0032606.name: Renal tubular epithelial lipofuscin
HP:0032606.definition: Presence of increased amount of lipofuscin, a yellow, granular cytoplasmic pigment in the renal tubules.
HP:0032606.definition_cn: 肾小管内存在大量脂褐素，一种黄色颗粒状细胞质色素。

HP:0032607.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell swelling
HP:0032607.definition: Tubular cross section lined entirely by tubular epithelium with convex apical cell membrane (i.e., cells are shaped like an upside down U, and lack a distinct smaller protrusion seen in blebbing as defined above) resulting in apparent complete closure of the lumen.
HP:0032607.definition_cn: 管腔横截面完全由管状上皮细胞排列，其顶端细胞膜呈凸起状（即细胞呈倒U形，且缺乏上述定义的泡状突起中可见的明显较小突起），导致管腔明显完全闭合。

HP:0032608.name: Thyroidization-type tubular atrophy
HP:0032608.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by a thyroid-like appearance, with small round tubules with markedly flattened, simplified epithelium and uniform intratubular casts.
HP:0032608.name_cn: 甲状腺化型肾小管萎缩
HP:0032608.definition_cn: 一种以甲状腺样外观为特征的肾小管萎缩类型，表现为小圆形肾小管，伴有显著扁平化、简化的上皮细胞和均匀的管内管型。

HP:0032609.name: Endocrine-type tubular atrophy
HP:0032609.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by endocrine-like appearance of tubules, which are small and have narrow lumina, clear cells, and relatively thin basement membranes.
HP:0032609.definition_cn: 一种以肾小管内分泌样外观为特征的肾小管萎缩类型，表现为小管体积缩小、管腔狭窄、细胞透明以及基底膜相对较薄。

HP:0032610.name: Tubulointerstitial mycobacterial infiltration
HP:0032610.definition: Renal tubulointerstitial infiltration of mycobacteria identified on acid-fast or Fite stains. Can be associated with granulomatous inflammation.
HP:0032610.name_cn: 肾小管间质分枝杆菌浸润
HP:0032610.definition_cn: 在抗酸染色或Fite染色中发现的肾小管间质分枝杆菌浸润。可能与肉芽肿性炎症相关。

HP:0032611.name: Renal tubular epithelial cell hemosiderin
HP:0032611.definition: Tubular epithelial cells containing cytoplasmic hemosiderin, brown-golden granular pigment.
HP:0032611.name_cn: 肾小管上皮细胞含铁血黄素
HP:0032611.definition_cn: 含有细胞质含铁血黄素的肾小管上皮细胞，呈棕金色颗粒状色素。

HP:0032612.name: Triphalangeal hallux
HP:0032612.definition: A hallux (big toe) with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis.
HP:0032612.definition_cn: 具有三个趾骨的单根近远轴的大脚趾（拇趾）。

HP:0032613.name: Renal interstitial amyloid deposits
HP:0032613.definition: Deposition of amyloid in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Amyloid is is made up of 10 nm (on average) fibrils that are most commonly composed of monoclonal light chains (AL), transthyretin (TTR), amd LECT2, or occur in the setting of long standing systemic inflammation.
HP:0032613.definition_cn: 肾间质组织中淀粉样物质的沉积。淀粉样物质由平均直径为10纳米的纤维组成，这些纤维最常见于由单克隆轻链（AL）、转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）和白细胞趋化因子2（LECT2）构成，或发生于长期系统性炎症的情况下。

HP:0032614.name: Renal glomerular amyloid deposition
HP:0032614.definition: Amyloid deposits located in the glomeruli in a focal segmental, diffuse segmental or diffuse global fashion. This abnormality can be accompanied by mesangial involvement and in later stages also involvement of the peripheral capillaries.
HP:0032614.definition_cn: 淀粉样物质以局灶节段性、弥漫节段性或弥漫球性方式沉积于肾小球。该异常可伴有系膜受累，晚期还可累及外周毛细血管。

HP:0032615.name: Abnormal diffusion weighted cerebral MRI morphology
HP:0032615.definition: A diffusion abnormality observed in diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain. Molecular diffusion refers to the notion that any type of molecule in a fluid (eg, water) is randomly displaced as the molecule is agitated by thermal energy. Restricted diffusion of water appears bright on diffusion-weighted images.
HP:0032615.name_cn: 异常弥散加权脑部磁共振成像形态学表现
HP:0032615.definition_cn: 在脑部弥散加权磁共振成像（MRI）中观察到的弥散异常。分子弥散指的是在流体（例如水）中，任何类型的分子由于热能的激发而随机位移的现象。水分子的受限弥散在弥散加权图像上呈现为高信号。

HP:0032616.name: Renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposits
HP:0032616.definition: Accumulation of an immunoglobulin in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. The immunoglobulin may be a monoclonal Ig or the corresponding heavy-chain (HC) or light-chain (LC) subunit. By convention this definition excludes Ig-derived amyloidosis (amyloidosis can be distinguished by its affinity for Congo red staining).
HP:0032616.name_cn: 肾间质免疫球蛋白沉积
HP:0032616.definition_cn: 免疫球蛋白在肾脏间质组织中的积聚。该免疫球蛋白可为单克隆免疫球蛋白或其相应的重链（HC）或轻链（LC）亚单位。根据惯例，此定义不包括免疫球蛋白衍生的淀粉样变性（淀粉样变性可通过其对刚果红染色的亲和性进行区分）。

HP:0032617.name: Renal interstitial hemorrhage
