HP:0032844.name: Focal impaired awareness epileptic spasm
HP:0032844.definition: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032844.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍性癫痫性痉挛
HP:0032844.definition_cn: 一种局灶性起源的癫痫性痉挛，在发作过程中某一时刻意识受损。

HP:0032845.name: Focal aware epileptic spasm
HP:0032845.definition: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is preserved throughout the seizure.
HP:0032845.name_cn: 局灶性意识性癫痫性痉挛
HP:0032845.definition_cn: 一种局灶性癫痫性痉挛，发作期间意识保持完整。

HP:0032846.name: Focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP:0032846.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by a sudden interruption in normal tonic muscle activity lasting 500 ms or less, without evidence of preceding myoclonus as the initial semiological manifestation. The interruption in muscle tone is briefer than seen in a focal atonic seizure.
HP:0032846.name_cn: 局灶性运动性发作伴负性肌阵挛
HP:0032846.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作类型，其特征为正常肌张力活动突然中断，持续时间不超过500毫秒，且无先期肌阵挛作为初始症状学表现。这种肌张力中断较局灶性失张力发作更为短暂。

HP:0032847.name: Focal impaired awareness hemifacial clonic seizure
HP:0032847.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with impairment of awareness in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032847.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损性半侧面部阵挛性发作
HP:0032847.definition_cn: 以累及半侧面部的阵挛性运动为起始的局灶性癫痫发作，伴意识障碍，即发作过程中某一时刻出现意识受损。

HP:0032848.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect
HP:0032848.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032848.name_cn: 局灶性认知性发作伴忽视
HP:0032848.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴忽视，特征为发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032849.name: Aphasic status epilepticus
HP:0032849.definition: Aphasic status epilepticus is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma characterized by a cognitive (rather than motor) language deficit.
HP:0032849.definition_cn: 失语性癫痫持续状态是一种局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态，其特征为认知性（而非运动性）语言功能障碍，且不伴有昏迷。

HP:0032850.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
HP:0032850.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032850.name_cn: 局灶性认知性发作伴表达性失语/失语症
HP:0032850.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴表达性失语/失语症，特征为发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032851.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with visual features
HP:0032851.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colors, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis.
HP:0032851.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒性感觉性癫痫发作伴视觉特征
HP:0032851.definition_cn: 以基本视觉幻觉为特征的癫痫发作，如闪光或闪烁的光/颜色，或其他形状、简单图案、暗点或黑蒙。

HP:0032852.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
HP:0032852.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032852.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴传导性失语/失语症
HP:0032852.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴传导性失语/失语症，特征为发作期间某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032853.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
HP:0032853.definition: A focal sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032853.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损感觉性发作伴冷热感
HP:0032853.definition_cn: 局灶性感觉性癫痫发作伴冷热感，发作期间意识部分或完全受损。

HP:0032854.name: Focal aware hemifacial clonic seizure
HP:0032854.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with retained awareness throughout.
HP:0032854.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性半侧面部阵挛性发作
HP:0032854.definition_cn: 以累及半侧面部的阵挛性运动为起始特征的部分性发作，发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032855.name: Photosensitive myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure
HP:0032855.definition: Generalised myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure provoked by flashing or flickering light.
HP:0032855.name_cn: 光敏性肌阵挛-强直-阵挛性癫痫发作
HP:0032855.definition_cn: 由闪烁或闪光诱发的全身性肌阵挛-强直-阵挛性发作。

HP:0032856.name: Focal aware bilateral motor seizure
HP:0032856.definition: A type of focal bilateral motor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032856.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒双侧运动性癫痫发作
HP:0032856.definition_cn: 一种局灶性双侧运动性癫痫发作，发作期间意识完全保留。

HP:0032857.name: Focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP:0032857.definition: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032857.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性运动性发作伴负性肌阵挛
HP:0032857.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作，伴有负性肌阵挛，特征为发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032858.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP:0032858.definition: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032858.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍运动性发作伴负性肌阵挛
HP:0032858.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作，伴有负性肌阵挛，特征为在发作过程中某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032859.name: Focal impaired awareness motor seizure with paresis/paralysis
HP:0032859.definition: A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032859.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损运动性发作伴轻瘫/瘫痪
HP:0032859.definition_cn: 局灶性运动性发作伴轻瘫/瘫痪，特征为发作期间某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032860.name: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP:0032860.definition: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically generalized. It is a prolonged absence seizure.
HP:0032860.name_cn: 广泛性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态无昏迷
HP:0032860.definition_cn: 广泛性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态无昏迷是一种无明显运动体征的癫痫持续状态，其脑电图表现为广泛性异常。这是一种延长的失神发作。

HP:0032861.name: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
HP:0032861.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness is impaired.
HP:0032861.name_cn: 局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态伴意识障碍
HP:0032861.definition_cn: 局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态伴意识障碍是一种局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态，其特征为意识受损。

HP:0032862.name: Status epilepticus with ictal paresis
HP:0032862.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by prolonged ictal paresis or inhibitory motor seizures.
HP:0032862.name_cn: 癫痫持续状态伴发作性瘫痪
HP:0032862.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫持续状态，其特征为长时间的发作性轻瘫或抑制性运动性癫痫发作。

HP:0032863.name: Typical absence status epilepticus
HP:0032863.definition: Typical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged typical absence seizure.
HP:0032863.definition_cn: 典型失神持续状态是一种广义非惊厥性持续状态，无昏迷，从症状学上表现为延长的典型失神发作。

HP:0032864.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with auditory features
HP:0032864.definition: A type of focal sensory seizure with auditory features during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP:0032864.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒性感觉性癫痫发作伴听觉特征
HP:0032864.definition_cn: 一种具有听觉特征的局灶性感觉性癫痫发作，发作期间意识始终保留。

HP:0032865.name: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus
HP:0032865.definition: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged myoclonic absence seizure. Myoclonic absence status epilepticus consists of proximal, predominantly upper extremity myoclonic jerks corresponding with 3 Hz spike-wave discharges in the EEG.
HP:0032865.name_cn: 肌阵挛失神癫痫持续状态
HP:0032865.definition_cn: 肌阵挛失神持续状态是一种广义非惊厥性持续状态癫痫，不伴有昏迷，从症状学上看是延长的肌阵挛失神发作。肌阵挛失神持续状态表现为近端、主要以上肢肌阵挛性抽动，与脑电图中的3 Hz棘慢波放电相对应。

HP:0032866.name: Oculoclonic status epilepticus
HP:0032866.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repetitive and rapid saccades, in association with epileptic discharges.
HP:0032866.name_cn: 眼阵挛性癫痫持续状态
HP:0032866.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫持续状态，其特征为重复且快速的扫视运动，并伴有癫痫样放电。

HP:0032867.name: Refractory status epilepticus
HP:0032867.definition: Refractory status epilepticus is defined as status epilepticus continuing despite two appropriately selected and dosed antiepileptic drugs, including a benzodiazepine.
HP:0032867.definition_cn: 难治性癫痫持续状态定义为尽管使用了两种适当选择和剂量的抗癫痫药物（包括苯二氮卓类药物），癫痫持续状态仍持续存在。

HP:0032868.name: Super-refractory status epilepticus
HP:0032868.definition: Super-refractory status epilepticus is defined as refractory status epilepticus continuing for 24 h or more following initiation of anesthetic medications, including cases in which seizure control is attained after induction of anesthetic drugs but recurs on weaning the patient off the anesthetic agent.
HP:0032868.name_cn: 超难治性癫痫持续状态
HP:0032868.definition_cn: 超难治性癫痫持续状态定义为在启动麻醉药物治疗后，难治性癫痫持续状态持续24小时或更长时间，包括在诱导麻醉药物后癫痫得到控制但在逐渐减少麻醉药物剂量时癫痫复发的情况。

HP:0032869.name: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
HP:0032869.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness remains intact.
HP:0032869.name_cn: 局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态，无意识障碍
HP:0032869.definition_cn: 局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态无意识障碍是一种局灶性非惊厥性癫痫持续状态，其意识保持完整。

HP:0032870.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia/alexia
HP:0032870.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032870.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴阅读障碍/失读症
HP:0032870.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴阅读障碍/失读症，特征为发作期间出现意识障碍。

HP:0032871.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP:0032871.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032871.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性认知性发作伴幻觉
HP:0032871.definition_cn: 一种局灶性认知性癫痫发作，伴有幻觉，特征为发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032872.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with illusion
HP:0032872.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032872.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴错觉
HP:0032872.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴错觉，特征为发作期间某时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032873.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP:0032873.definition: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache.
HP:0032873.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒感觉性发作伴头部感觉异常
HP:0032873.definition_cn: 以头部感觉异常为特征的癫痫发作，如头晕或头痛。

HP:0032874.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
HP:0032874.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032874.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴听觉失认症
HP:0032874.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴听觉失认，特征为在发作过程中某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032875.name: obsolete Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness
HP:0032875.name_cn: 过时的局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴反应性受损

HP:0032876.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia/aphasia
HP:0032876.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032876.name_cn: 局灶性认知性发作伴传导性失语/失语症
HP:0032876.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴传导性失语/失语症，其特征为发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032877.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations
HP:0032877.definition: A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot and then cold.
HP:0032877.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒感觉性发作伴冷热感
HP:0032877.definition_cn: 以先热后冷感觉为特征的癫痫发作。

HP:0032878.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP:0032878.definition: A focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032878.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损感觉性发作伴头部感觉
HP:0032878.definition_cn: 一种伴有头部感觉的局灶性感觉性癫痫发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损。

HP:0032879.name: Focal impaired awareness seizure with dissociation at onset
HP:0032879.definition: A focal cognitive epileptic seizure with dissociation at the onset of the seizure and with impairment of awareness at at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032879.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损性发作伴起始期解离
HP:0032879.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作，发作初期伴有分离现象，发作过程中某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032880.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with auditory features
HP:0032880.definition: A focal sensory seizure with auditory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032880.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损感觉性发作伴听觉特征
HP:0032880.definition_cn: 伴有听觉特征的局灶性感觉性发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损。

HP:0032881.name: obsolete Focal aware cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness
HP:0032881.name_cn: 过时的术语：局灶性认知性发作伴反应性受损

HP:0032882.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
HP:0032882.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032882.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴似曾相识感/陌生感
HP:0032882.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作，伴有似曾相识感/陌生感，特征为发作期间某时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032883.name: Focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu/jamais vu
HP:0032883.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032883.name_cn: 局灶性意识清楚认知性发作伴似曾相识感/陌生感
HP:0032883.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作，表现为似曾相识感/陌生感，且在整个发作过程中意识保留。

HP:0032884.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory features
HP:0032884.definition: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move. Awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP:0032884.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒性感觉性发作伴躯体感觉特征
HP:0032884.definition_cn: 以感觉现象为特征的癫痫发作，包括刺痛感、麻木感、电击样感觉、疼痛感、运动感或运动欲望。发作期间意识保留。

HP:0032885.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP:0032885.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032885.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴幻觉
HP:0032885.definition_cn: 一种伴有幻觉的局灶性认知性癫痫发作，其特征为在发作过程中某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032886.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia/aphasia
HP:0032886.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032886.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴表达性失语/失语症
HP:0032886.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴表达性失语/失语症，特征为发作期间某一时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032887.name: Generalized atonic seizure
HP:0032887.definition: Generalized atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1-2 s, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.
HP:0032887.definition_cn: 全面性失张力发作是一种全面性运动性发作，其特征为突然发生的肌张力丧失或减弱，无明显先兆性肌阵挛或强直事件，持续时间约1-2秒，累及头部、躯干、下颌或肢体肌肉群。

HP:0032888.name: Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking
HP:0032888.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032888.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损认知性发作伴强迫思维
HP:0032888.definition_cn: 局灶性认知性癫痫发作伴强迫思维，发作期间某时刻出现意识障碍。

HP:0032889.name: Focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory features
HP:0032889.definition: A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes.
HP:0032889.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒性感觉性发作伴味觉特征
HP:0032889.definition_cn: 以味觉现象为特征的癫痫发作，包括酸味、苦味、咸味、甜味或金属味。

HP:0032890.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory features
HP:0032890.definition: A focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032890.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损感觉性发作伴躯体感觉特征
HP:0032890.definition_cn: 局灶性感觉性癫痫发作伴躯体感觉特征，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损。

HP:0032891.name: Focal aware motor seizure with version
HP:0032891.definition: A focal motor seizure with version characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP:0032891.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性运动性发作伴扭转
HP:0032891.definition_cn: 一种局灶性运动性癫痫发作，伴有头眼偏转，特征为在整个发作过程中意识保留。

HP:0032892.name: Infection-related seizure
HP:0032892.definition: Seizure associated with a presumed or proven infection (excluding infection of the central nervous system) or inflammatory state without an alternative precipitant such as metabolic derangement, and regardless of the presence or absence of a fever.
HP:0032892.definition_cn: 与推测或证实的感染（不包括中枢神经系统感染）或炎症状态相关的癫痫发作，且无其他诱因如代谢紊乱，无论是否存在发热。

HP:0032893.name: Gastroenteritis-related afebrile seizure
HP:0032893.definition: Afebrile (less than 38.0 degrees Celcius), brief, and generalized seizures accompanying gastroenteritis without an alternative cause.
HP:0032893.name_cn: 胃肠炎相关性无热惊厥
HP:0032893.definition_cn: 无发热（体温低于38.0摄氏度）、短暂且全身性发作的惊厥，伴随胃肠炎，且无其他明确病因。

HP:0032894.name: Seizure precipitated by febrile infection
HP:0032894.definition: Any form of seizure occurring at the time of a fever (temperature at or above 38.0 degrees Celcius) without infection of the central nervous system, and without an alternative cause such as severe metabolic derangement, occurring at any age.
HP:0032894.name_cn: 发热感染诱发的癫痫发作
HP:0032894.definition_cn: 发热性惊厥（Febrile Seizure）：在发热期间（体温达到或超过38.0摄氏度）发生的任何形式的惊厥，无中枢神经系统感染，且无其他明确病因（如严重代谢紊乱），可发生于任何年龄。

HP:0032895.name: Febrile seizure outside the age of 3 months to 6 years
HP:0032895.definition: Any type of seizure (most often a generalized tonic-clonic seizure) occurring with fever (at least 38.0 degrees Celsius) but in the absence of central nervous system infection, severe metabolic disturbance or other alternative precipitant in people beyond the typical arrange of 3 months-6 years with no prior history of afebrile seizure.
HP:0032895.name_cn: 3个月至6岁年龄范围外的热性惊厥
HP:0032895.definition_cn: 任何类型的癫痫发作（最常见为全身强直-阵挛性发作）伴随发热（至少38.0摄氏度）发生，但在无中枢神经系统感染、严重代谢紊乱或其他诱发因素的情况下，且患者年龄超出典型的3个月至6岁范围，且无既往无热性癫痫发作史。

HP:0032896.name: Music-induced seizure
HP:0032896.definition: Seizure precipitated by listening to music or other complex sounds.
HP:0032896.definition_cn: 音乐或其他复杂声音诱发的癫痫发作。

HP:0032897.name: Focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with gustatory features
HP:0032897.definition: A focal sensory seizure with gustatory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032897.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损感觉性发作伴味觉特征
HP:0032897.definition_cn: 一种具有味觉特征的局灶性感觉性癫痫发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损。

HP:0032898.name: Focal automatism seizure
HP:0032898.definition: A focal seizure characterized at onset by coordinated motor activity. This often resembles a voluntary movement and may consist of an inappropriate continuation of preictal motor activity.
HP:0032898.definition_cn: 一种以协调性运动活动为起始特征的局灶性癫痫发作。这种运动活动通常类似于自主运动，可能表现为发作前运动活动的不适当延续。

HP:0032899.name: Focal orofacial automatism seizure
HP:0032899.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.
HP:0032899.name_cn: 局灶性口面部自动症发作
HP:0032899.definition_cn: 一种以口面部自动症为起始特征的局灶性自动症发作类型。

HP:0032900.name: Focal manual automatism seizure
HP:0032900.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset.
HP:0032900.name_cn: 局灶性手动自动症发作
HP:0032900.definition_cn: 一种以起始期手部自动症为特征的局灶性自动症发作类型。

HP:0032901.name: Focal pedal automatism seizure
HP:0032901.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.
HP:0032901.name_cn: 局灶性足部自动症发作
HP:0032901.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，其特征为起始时出现双侧或单侧足部或腿部的协调性运动。该运动的幅度更类似于正常运动，与涉及腿部的局灶性运动过度性发作相比，其运动较为缓和且不急促。

HP:0032902.name: Focal perseverative automatism seizure
HP:0032902.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.
HP:0032902.name_cn: 局灶性持续性自动症发作
HP:0032902.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作开始时持续进行发作前的运动或行为。

HP:0032903.name: Focal vocal automatism seizure
HP:0032903.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.
HP:0032903.name_cn: 局灶性发声自动症发作
HP:0032903.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，其特征为发作时产生单一或重复的无意义发声，如尖叫或咕哝声。

HP:0032904.name: Focal verbal automatism seizure
HP:0032904.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.
HP:0032904.name_cn: 局灶性言语自动症发作
HP:0032904.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作时出现单个或重复的单词、短语或简短句子。

HP:0032905.name: Focal sexual automatism seizure
HP:0032905.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.
HP:0032905.definition_cn: 一种以发作时出现不自主性行为为特征的局灶性自动症癫痫发作。

HP:0032906.name: Focal head nodding automatism seizure
HP:0032906.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.
HP:0032906.name_cn: 局灶性点头自动症发作
HP:0032906.definition_cn: 一种以发作时头部不自主点头为特征的局灶性自动症癫痫发作。

HP:0032907.name: Focal undressing automatism seizure
HP:0032907.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.
HP:0032907.name_cn: 局灶性脱衣自动症发作
HP:0032907.definition_cn: 一种以发作时出现不自主脱衣为特征的局灶性自动症癫痫发作。

HP:0032908.name: Focal aware undressing automatism seizure
HP:0032908.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032908.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留自动症发作
HP:0032908.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作时出现无意识脱衣行为，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032909.name: Focal impaired awareness automatism seizure
HP:0032909.definition: A focal seizure with automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP:0032909.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍自动症发作
HP:0032909.definition_cn: 部分或完全意识受损的自动症局灶性发作。

HP:0032910.name: Focal aware automatism seizure
HP:0032910.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032910.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留自动症发作
HP:0032910.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，期间意识完全保留。

HP:0032911.name: Focal aware orofacial automatism seizure
HP:0032911.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032911.name_cn: 局灶性意识清醒口面部自动症发作
HP:0032911.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作时出现口面部自动症，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032912.name: Focal aware manual automatism seizure
HP:0032912.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032912.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性手动自动症发作
HP:0032912.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作初期出现手部自动症，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032913.name: Focal aware pedal automatism seizure
HP:0032913.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.
HP:0032913.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性足部自动症发作
HP:0032913.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作时出现协调的双侧或单侧足部或腿部运动，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。该运动的幅度更类似于正常运动，与涉及腿部的局灶性运动过多性发作相比，其运动较为缓和且不急促。

HP:0032914.name: Focal aware perseverative automatism seizure
HP:0032914.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032914.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留持续性自动症发作
HP:0032914.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为在发作起始时及发作期间不恰当地延续发作前的运动或行为，且在整个过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032915.name: Focal aware vocal automatism seizure
HP:0032915.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032915.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性言语自动症发作
HP:0032915.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为在发作起始时及发作过程中产生单一或重复的无意义发声，如尖叫或咕哝声，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032916.name: Focal aware verbal automatism seizure
HP:0032916.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032916.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性语言自动症发作
HP:0032916.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作时出现单个或重复的单词、短语或简短句子，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032917.name: Focal aware sexual automatism seizure
HP:0032917.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032917.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性性自动症发作
HP:0032917.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，其特征为发作时出现不自主性行为，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032918.name: Focal impaired awareness orofacial automatism seizure
HP:0032918.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.
HP:0032918.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损口面部自动症发作
HP:0032918.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，并以发作初期的口面部自动症为特征。

HP:0032919.name: Focal aware head nodding automatism seizure
HP:0032919.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP:0032919.name_cn: 局灶性意识保留性点头自动症发作
HP:0032919.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，其特征为发作时出现不自主的点头动作，且在整个发作过程中意识完全保留。

HP:0032920.name: Focal impaired awareness manual automatism seizure
HP:0032920.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by manual automatisms at onset.
HP:0032920.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍性手动自动症发作
HP:0032920.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，并以起始时的手部自动动作为特征。

HP:0032921.name: Focal impaired awareness pedal automatism seizure
HP:0032921.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.
HP:0032921.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍性足部自动症发作
HP:0032921.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，其特征为发作开始时出现双侧或单侧足部或腿部的协调性运动。与涉及腿部的局灶性运动过度性发作相比，该运动的幅度更类似于正常运动，且较为缓慢或不那么剧烈。

HP:0032922.name: Focal impaired awareness perseverative automatism seizure
HP:0032922.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.
HP:0032922.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损持续性自动症发作
HP:0032922.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，其特征为发作开始时持续进行发作前的运动或行为，且这些行为不适当。

HP:0032923.name: Focal impaired awareness vocal automatism seizure
HP:0032923.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.
HP:0032923.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损性发声自动症发作
HP:0032923.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作类型，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，其特征为发作时产生单一或重复的无意义发声，如尖叫或咕哝。

HP:0032924.name: Focal impaired awareness verbal automatism seizure
HP:0032924.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.
HP:0032924.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍性言语自动症发作
HP:0032924.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，其特征为发作初期出现单个或重复的单词、短语或简短句子。

HP:0032925.name: Focal impaired awareness sexual automatism seizure
HP:0032925.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.
HP:0032925.name_cn: 局灶性意识障碍性性自动症发作
HP:0032925.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症发作，在发作过程中意识部分或完全受损，并以发作时出现不自主性行为为特征。

HP:0032926.name: Focal impaired awareness head nodding automatism seizure
HP:0032926.definition: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.
HP:0032926.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损点头自动症发作
HP:0032926.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症，在发作期间意识部分或完全受损，其特征为发作初期出现不自主的点头动作。

HP:0032927.name: Focal impaired awareness undressing automatism seizure
HP:0032927.definition: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.
HP:0032927.name_cn: 局灶性意识受损性脱衣自动症发作
HP:0032927.definition_cn: 一种局灶性自动症，在发作期间意识部分或完全受损，其特征为发作初期出现不自主脱衣行为。

HP:0032928.name: Elevated CSF neurofilament light chain concentration
HP:0032928.definition: Neurofilament light chain (NfL) is a neuronal cytoplasmic protein highly expressed in large caliber myelinated axons. Its levels increase in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood proportionally to the degree of axonal damage in a variety of neurological disorders, including inflammatory, neurodegenerative, traumatic and cerebrovascular diseases.
HP:0032928.name_cn: 脑脊液神经丝轻链浓度升高
HP:0032928.definition_cn: 神经丝轻链（Neurofilament light chain, NfL）是一种神经元胞质蛋白，主要在大直径有髓轴突中高表达。其水平在脑脊液（cerebrospinal fluid, CSF）和血液中的升高与多种神经系统疾病中的轴突损伤程度呈正相关，这些疾病包括炎症性、神经退行性、创伤性及脑血管性疾病。

HP:0032929.name: Abnormal chondrocyte morphology
HP:0032929.definition: Any abnormal structure of a chondrocyte, which is a polymorphic cell that forms cartilage.
HP:0032929.definition_cn: 软骨细胞（一种形成软骨的多形性细胞）的任何异常结构。

HP:0032930.name: Lacunar halos around chondrocytes
HP:0032930.name_cn: 软骨细胞周围的陷窝晕
HP:0032930.definition_cn: 软骨细胞周围的同心环。

HP:0032931.name: obsolete Focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired attention
HP:0032931.name_cn: 过时的局灶性意识受损性认知性癫痫发作伴注意力障碍

HP:0032932.name: Increased circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
HP:0032932.definition: An increased level of triacylglycerol lipase in the blood circulation (can be measured in serum or plasma).
HP:0032932.name_cn: 循环中胰腺三酰甘油脂肪酶水平升高
HP:0032932.definition_cn: 血液循环中三酰甘油脂肪酶水平升高（可在血清或血浆中测量）。

HP:0032933.name: Airway hyperresponsiveness
HP:0032933.definition: An increased sensitivity of the airways to an inhaled constrictor agonist, a steeper slope of the dose-response curve, and a greater maximal response to the agonist.
HP:0032933.definition_cn: 气道对吸入性收缩激动剂的敏感性增加，剂量-反应曲线斜率更陡，以及对激动剂的最大反应增强。

HP:0032934.name: Spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak
HP:0032934.definition: A spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak (SCSFL) is a spontaneous and unexplained leak of the cerebrospinal fluid from the dura surrounding either the brain (cranial leak) or spine (spinal leak).
HP:0032934.definition_cn: 自发性脑脊液漏（Spontaneous Cerebrospinal Fluid Leak, SCSFL）是指脑脊液自发性且原因不明地从围绕大脑（颅漏）或脊柱（脊髓漏）的硬膜中渗漏。

HP:0032935.name: Posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea
HP:0032935.definition: Grayish, polygonal pattern of opacities with intervening clear zones across the central cornea that resembles crocodile skin.
HP:0032935.definition_cn: 灰白色、多角形混浊图案，中央角膜区域间有透明区，类似鳄鱼皮样外观。

HP:0032936.name: Intrusion symptom
HP:0032936.definition: Unintentional re-experiencing of a traumatic event involves symptoms that typically include sensory impressions and emotional responses stemming from the trauma. These symptoms seem to lack a sense of time perspective and context.
HP:0032936.definition_cn: 创伤事件的无意再体验通常涉及源于创伤的感觉印象和情绪反应等症状。这些症状似乎缺乏时间视角和情境感。

HP:0032937.name: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories
HP:0032937.definition: After experiencing psychological trauma, individuals may repeatedly encounter sensory-perceptual impressions of the event that intrude into their consciousness involuntarily. These intrusive memories often manifest as visual images (such as mental pictures), but can also involve sounds, smells, tastes, and physical sensations. They are accompanied by a variety of negative emotions linked to the most intense moments of the traumatic memory.
HP:0032937.name_cn: 复发性、非自愿性、侵入性痛苦记忆
HP:0032937.definition_cn: 在经历心理创伤后，个体可能会反复遭遇事件的感觉-知觉印象，这些印象会不自主地侵入其意识。这些侵入性记忆通常表现为视觉图像（如心理画面），但也可能涉及声音、气味、味觉和身体感觉。它们伴随着与创伤记忆中最强烈时刻相关的各种负面情绪。

HP:0032938.name: Recurrent trauma-related distressing dreams
HP:0032938.definition: Recurrent distressing dreams occur when the content and/or emotional impact of the dream is connected to a traumatic event or events.
HP:0032938.name_cn: 复发性创伤相关痛苦梦境
HP:0032938.definition_cn: 复发性痛苦梦境的发生与梦境内容及/或情感影响与一个或多个创伤性事件相关联。

HP:0032939.name: Physiological reactivity to cues
HP:0032939.definition: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event(s).
HP:0032939.definition_cn: 对内部或外部线索产生显著的生理反应，这些线索象征或类似于创伤事件的某个方面。

HP:0032940.name: Dissociation
HP:0032940.definition: Disruption or detachment of certain aspects of one's normal psychological functioning typically involves a disconnection or separation from thoughts, feelings, sensations, memories, or one's sense of identity or reality.
HP:0032940.definition_cn: 正常心理功能的某些方面的中断或脱离通常涉及与思想、情感、感觉、记忆或自我认同感或现实感的分离或断开。

HP:0032941.name: Intense psychological distress to cues
HP:0032941.definition: Intense or prolonged psychological distress occurs when individuals are exposed to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event or events.
HP:0032941.name_cn: 对线索的强烈心理困扰
HP:0032941.definition_cn: 当个体暴露于象征或类似于创伤事件某方面的内部或外部线索时，会出现强烈或持续的心理困扰。

HP:0032942.name: Avoidance of stimuli associated with traumatic event
HP:0032942.definition: Avoidance of or efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s). Avoidance of or efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s).
HP:0032942.name_cn: 避免与创伤事件相关的刺激
HP:0032942.definition_cn: 回避或努力回避与创伤事件相关的痛苦记忆、思维或情感。回避或努力回避外部提示物（如人物、地点、对话、活动、物体、情境），这些提示物可能唤起与创伤事件相关的痛苦记忆、思维或情感。

HP:0032943.name: Abnormal urine pH
HP:0032943.definition: A deviation of urine pH from the normal range of 4.5 to 7.8.
HP:0032943.definition_cn: 尿液pH值偏离正常范围（4.5至7.8）。

HP:0032945.name: Renal interstitial inflammation
HP:0032945.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium potentially involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic areas, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.
HP:0032945.definition_cn: 肾间质炎症的组织病理学发现，可能涉及纤维化及非纤维化区域，主要由淋巴细胞、单核细胞和浆细胞组成。

HP:0032946.name: Renal cortical interstitial inflammation
HP:0032946.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic renal cortex, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.
HP:0032946.definition_cn: 肾间质炎症的组织病理学发现，涉及纤维化和非纤维化的肾皮质，由淋巴细胞、单核细胞和浆细胞组成。

HP:0032947.name: Renal medullary interstitial inflammation
HP:0032947.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the interstitium of the renal medulla, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.
HP:0032947.definition_cn: 肾髓质间质炎症的组织病理学发现，由淋巴细胞、单核细胞和浆细胞组成。

HP:0032948.name: Renal interstitial fibrosis
HP:0032948.definition: The accumulation of collagen and related extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules in the interstitium of the kidney. The interstitium is expanded by the presence of collagen that stain blue on trichrome. Tubules are not back to back, but rather separated by fibrosis and can be atrophic.
HP:0032948.definition_cn: 肾间质中胶原蛋白及相关细胞外基质（ECM）分子的积聚。间质因三色染色呈蓝色的胶原蛋白存在而扩张。肾小管并非紧密排列，而是被纤维化分隔，并可能出现萎缩。

HP:0032949.name: Renal interstitial calcium phosphate deposits
HP:0032949.definition: The presence of interstitial aggregates of purple finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate deposits.
HP:0032949.definition_cn: 间质中存在紫色细颗粒状/层状钙和磷酸盐沉积物。

HP:0032950.name: Abnormal renal tubular lumen morphology
HP:0032950.definition: Abnormal structure or form of the lumen (opening) of kidney tubules.
HP:0032950.definition_cn: 肾小管管腔（开口）结构或形态异常。

HP:0032951.name: Renal tubular viral cytopathic changes
HP:0032951.definition: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage. Tubular destruction may be associated with necrotizing interstitial granulomas. Severe granulomatous tubulointerstitial nephritis appears to be characteristic of adenoviral infection and is quite rare in other viral infections. Focal wedge-shaped necrosis may occur in renal parenchyma. Immunostaining for adenovirus shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in infected cells.
HP:0032951.name_cn: 肾小管病毒性细胞病变
HP:0032951.definition_cn: 病毒性细胞病变特征包括模糊的嗜碱性核内包涵体，伴有感染细胞的核增大。远端肾小管比近端肾小管更常受累。伴随急性肾小管损伤，常伴有明显的肾小管坏死和破坏，以及急性间质性肾炎，通常由淋巴细胞、组织细胞、浆细胞和数量不等的中性粒细胞组成的多形性浸润，伴有间质水肿和出血。肾小管破坏可能与坏死性间质性肉芽肿相关。严重的肉芽肿性肾小管间质性肾炎似乎是腺病毒感染的特征，在其他病毒感染中极为罕见。肾实质中可能出现局灶性楔形坏死。腺病毒的免疫染色显示感染细胞的核和胞质呈强阳性染色。

HP:0032952.name: Usual-type tubular atrophy
HP:0032952.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy in which the tubules show thick tubular basement membranes lined by small cuboidal or flat cells. Generally accompanied by fibrosis.
HP:0032952.definition_cn: 一种肾小管萎缩类型，表现为小管基底膜增厚，内衬小立方或扁平细胞。通常伴随纤维化。

HP:0032953.name: Renal tubular cytomegalovirus inclusions
HP:0032953.definition: Characteristic intranuclear glassy-appearing basophilic inclusions with surrounding halo (owl's eye-type inclusion) and marked increase in the size of the cell (cytomegaly), particularly in tubular epithelial cells and in endothelial cells. Often accompanied by cytopathic changes including patchy interstitial pleomorphic infiltrate with lymphocytes, plasma cells, and macrophages.
HP:0032953.name_cn: 肾小管巨细胞病毒包涵体
HP:0032953.definition_cn: 特征性的核内玻璃样嗜碱性包涵体，周围伴有晕圈（猫头鹰眼样包涵体），以及细胞体积显著增大（巨细胞化），尤其见于肾小管上皮细胞和内皮细胞。常伴有细胞病变，包括斑片状间质多形性浸润，浸润细胞包括淋巴细胞、浆细胞和巨噬细胞。

HP:0032954.name: Renal tubular adenovirus inclusions
HP:0032954.definition: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. The inclusions stain positive for adenovirus (e.g., Figure 3 of PMID:29273157). Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. Occasionally glomerular visceral and parietal epithelial cells can be infected. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage.
HP:0032954.definition_cn: 病毒性细胞病变特征包括模糊的嗜碱性核内包涵体，伴有受感染细胞核增大。这些包涵体对腺病毒染色呈阳性（例如，PMID:29273157的图3）。远端肾小管比近端肾小管更常受累。偶尔，肾小球脏层和壁层上皮细胞也可被感染。伴随急性肾小管损伤，常伴有明显的肾小管坏死和破坏，以及急性间质性肾炎，通常由淋巴细胞、组织细胞、浆细胞和数量不等的中性粒细胞组成的多形性浸润，伴有间质水肿和出血。

HP:0032955.name: Renal tubular polyoma virus inclusions
HP:0032955.definition: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions have a ground-glass appearance with irregular central clearing, or a coarse, vesicular appearance. Distal tubules are involved more often than proximal tubules. There may be only medullary involvement in early stages, and parietal epithelial cells may be involved in later stages of the infection. Infected epithelial cell nuclei stain with antibody to the large T antigen of the SV40 virus, which serves as a surrogate marker of human polyomavirus infection.
HP:0032955.name_cn: 肾小管多瘤病毒包涵体
HP:0032955.definition_cn: 肾小管核内包涵体呈现磨玻璃样外观，伴有不规则的中心透亮区，或呈粗糙的泡状外观。远端肾小管受累较近端肾小管更为常见。在感染早期可能仅累及髓质，而在感染后期，壁层上皮细胞也可能受累。受感染的上皮细胞核可通过针对SV40病毒大T抗原的抗体进行染色，该抗体可作为人类多瘤病毒感染的替代标志物。

HP:0032956.name: Renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusions
HP:0032956.definition: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions that stain positive for herpes simplex virus (HSV). HSV is typically associated with multinucleated giant cells with nuclear inclusions and may cause hemorrhagic interstitial nephritis.
HP:0032956.name_cn: 肾小管单纯疱疹病毒包涵体
HP:0032956.definition_cn: 肾小管核内包涵体对单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）染色呈阳性。HSV通常与具有核内包涵体的多核巨细胞相关，并可能引起出血性间质性肾炎。

HP:0032957.name: Dysmorphic hematuria
HP:0032957.definition: The presence of dysmorphic urinary erythrocytes. This feature can be observed by phase-contrastmicroscopy, differential interference microscopy, and bright-field microscopy. The acanthocyte or G1 cell, which is a doughnut-shaped cell with one or more blebs, is reported to constitute a special form of dysmorphic erythro-cyte (D cell) specific for glomerular hematuria.
HP:0032957.definition_cn: 异形尿红细胞的存在。该特征可通过相差显微镜、微分干涉显微镜和明场显微镜观察。棘形红细胞或G1细胞，即具有一个或多个泡状突起的环形细胞，据报道构成了一种特殊形式的异形红细胞（D细胞），特异性见于肾小球性血尿。

HP:0032958.name: Urinary oval fat bodies
HP:0032958.definition: The presence in the urine of desquamated tubular epithelial cells or macrophages filled with lipid droplets.
HP:0032958.definition_cn: 尿液中存在脱落的肾小管上皮细胞或充满脂滴的巨噬细胞。

HP:0032959.name: Intratubular calcium oxalate casts
HP:0032959.definition: Birefringent calcium- and oxalate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.
HP:0032959.definition_cn: 位于肾小管内的双折射性含钙和草酸盐管型。

HP:0032960.name: Intratubular calcium phosphate casts
HP:0032960.definition: Purple and finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.
HP:0032960.definition_cn: 位于肾小管内的紫色、细颗粒状/层状含钙和磷酸盐管型。

HP:0032961.name: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystalluria
HP:0032961.definition: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystals in the urine.

HP:0032962.name: Tubular microcystic change
HP:0032962.definition: Dilated renal tubules (over twice the diameter of a normal proximal tubule) containing eosinophilic amorphous material. This feature is generally accompanied by scalloping of the cast profile. The epithelium lining the microcyst is generally flattened and does not reveal brush border.
HP:0032962.definition_cn: 扩张的肾小管（直径超过正常近端小管的两倍）内含有嗜酸性无定形物质。此特征通常伴有管型轮廓的扇贝样改变。微囊内衬的上皮细胞通常变平，且不显示刷状缘。

HP:0032963.name: Complex renal cyst
HP:0032963.definition: A renal cyst characterized by epithelium lined space (squamous/columnar) with septations.
HP:0032963.definition_cn: 一种以被覆上皮（鳞状/柱状）分隔的空间为特征的肾囊肿。

HP:0032964.name: Uric acid crystalluria
HP:0032964.definition: The presence of uric acid crystals in the urine.
HP:0032964.definition_cn: 尿液中尿酸结晶的存在。

HP:0032965.name: Interstitial emphysema
HP:0032965.definition: Interstitial emphysema is characterized by air dissecting within the interstitium of the lung, typically in the peribronchovascular sheaths, interlobular septa, and visceral pleura. It is most commonly seen in neonates receiving mechanical ventilation. It is rarely recognized radiographically in adults and is infrequently seen on CT scans. It appears as perivascular lucent or low attenuating halos and small cysts.
HP:0032965.definition_cn: 间质性肺气肿的特征是空气在肺间质内分离，通常位于支气管血管周围鞘、小叶间隔和脏层胸膜中。最常见于接受机械通气的新生儿。在成人中很少通过影像学识别，且在CT扫描中不常见。其表现为血管周围透亮或低密度晕环及小囊肿。

HP:0032966.name: Centrilobular emphysema
HP:0032966.definition: A type of emphysema characterized by destroyed centrilobular alveolar walls and enlargement of respiratory bronchioles and associated alveoli. This is the commonest form of emphysema in cigarette smokers. CT findings are centrilobular areas of decreased attenuation, usually without visible walls, of nonuniform distribution and predominantly located in upper lung zones.
HP:0032966.definition_cn: 一种以破坏性小叶中央肺泡壁和呼吸性细支气管及其相关肺泡扩大为特征的肺气肿类型。这是吸烟者中最常见的肺气肿形式。CT表现为小叶中央区域衰减减低，通常无可见壁，分布不均匀，主要位于上肺区。

HP:0032967.name: Panacinar emphysema
HP:0032967.definition: Panacinar emphysema involves all portions of the acinus and secondary pulmonary lobule more or less uniformly. It predominates in the lower lobes and is the form of emphysema associated with1-antitrypsin deficiency. CT scans show a generalized decrease of the lung parenchyma with a decrease in the caliber of blood vessels in the affected lung. Severe panacinar emphysema may coexist and merge with severe centrilobular emphysema. The appearance of feature less decreased attenuation may be indistinguishable from severe constrictive obliterative bronchiolitis.
HP:0032967.definition_cn: 全腺泡型肺气肿（Panacinar emphysema）累及腺泡及次级肺小叶的所有部分，且病变分布较为均匀。该类型肺气肿主要发生于肺下叶，并与α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症（α1-antitrypsin deficiency）相关。CT扫描显示受累肺实质普遍减少，且肺血管管径变细。重度全腺泡型肺气肿可能与重度小叶中心型肺气肿（centrilobular emphysema）并存并融合。其表现为无特征性低密度影，可能与重度缩窄性闭塞性细支气管炎（severe constrictive obliterative bronchiolitis）难以区分。

HP:0032968.name: Expiratory air trapping
HP:0032968.definition: Abnormal retention of gas within a lung or part of a lung, as a result of airway obstruction of abnormalities in lung compliance. In the classic presentation, the lung will appear normal at inspiration, but on exhalation, the diseased portions of the lung which have lost connective tissue recoil will remain lucent while the healthy portions of the lung will become more dense due to atelectasis. This helps distinguish it from mosaic attenuation due to patchy fibrosis, as occurs with nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, and in early usual interstitial pneumonitis (the hallmark imaging diagnosis of interstitial lung disease) in which there is no change with inspiration and expiration.
HP:0032968.definition_cn: 由于气道阻塞或肺顺应性异常导致的肺或部分肺内气体异常滞留。在典型表现中，肺在吸气时表现正常，但在呼气时，由于结缔组织回弹力丧失的病变肺部分仍保持透亮，而健康肺部分由于肺不张变得更加致密。这有助于将其与非特异性间质性肺炎中出现的斑片状纤维化导致的马赛克衰减相区分，以及早期普通型间质性肺炎（间质性肺病的标志性影像诊断）中在吸气和呼气时无变化的情况相区分。

HP:0032969.name: Traction bronchiectasis
HP:0032969.definition: Distortion of the bronchial airways due to mechanical traction on the bronchi resulting from fibrosis of the surrounding lung parenchyma. CT findings represent irregular bronchial dilatation caused by surrounding retractile pulmonary fibrosis. Dilated airways are usually identifiable as such but may be seen as cysts.
HP:0032969.definition_cn: 由于周围肺实质纤维化导致的支气管机械性牵拉引起的支气管气道变形。CT表现为周围收缩性肺纤维化引起的不规则支气管扩张。扩张的气道通常可识别，但可能表现为囊肿。

HP:0032971.name: Computed tomographic halo sign
HP:0032971.definition: CT finding of ground-glass opacity surrounding a nodule or mass. It was first described as a sign of hemorrhage around foci of invasive aspergillosis. The halo sign is nonspecific and may also be caused by hemorrhage associated with other types of nodules or by local pulmonary infiltration by neoplasm.
HP:0032971.definition_cn: CT检查发现结节或肿块周围存在磨玻璃样影。该征象最初被描述为侵袭性曲霉菌病灶周围出血的征象。晕轮征是非特异性的，也可能由其他类型结节相关的出血或肿瘤局部肺浸润引起。

HP:0032972.name: Nodular-centrilobular without tree-in-bud pattern on pulmonary HRCT
HP:0032972.definition: A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography which are anatomically located centrally within secondary pulmonary lobules. Centrilobular nodules may be dense (i.e., solid) and of homogeneous opacity or ground-glass opacity, and may range from a few millimeters to about 1 cm in size. Because of the similar size of secondary lobules, centrilobular nodules often appear to be evenly spaced. Centrilobular nodules are usually separated from the pleural surfaces, fissures, and interlobular septa by a distance of at least several millimeters. They may appear patchy or diffuse in different diseases.
HP:0032972.name_cn: 肺高分辨率CT显示结节性小叶中心型分布，未见树芽征。
HP:0032972.definition_cn: 肺高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）上显示结节样模式，解剖学上位于次级肺小叶的中心位置。小叶中心性结节可能为致密性（即实性）且呈均匀密度或磨玻璃密度，大小可从数毫米至约1厘米不等。由于次级小叶的大小相似，小叶中心性结节通常呈现均匀分布。小叶中心性结节通常与胸膜表面、叶间裂和小叶间隔相隔至少数毫米的距离。在不同疾病中，它们可能呈现斑片状或弥漫性分布。

HP:0032973.name: Abnormal bronchoalveolar lavage fluid morphology
HP:0032973.definition: Abnormal type or counts of nucleated immune cells and acellular components in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid. BAL us performed with a fiberoptic bronchoscope in the wedged position within a selected bronchopulmonary segment. BAL is commonly used to inform the differential diagnosis of interstitial lung disease or to monitor therapeutic interventions.
HP:0032973.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液形态异常
HP:0032973.definition_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液（BAL）中核细胞免疫细胞及无细胞成分的类型或数量异常。支气管肺泡灌洗术（BAL）通过纤维支气管镜在选定的支气管肺段内楔入位置进行。BAL常用于间质性肺疾病的鉴别诊断或治疗干预的监测。

HP:0032974.name: Abnormal cellular composition of bronchoalveolar fluid
HP:0032974.definition: Deviation from the commonly in healthy people observe cellular distribution. Normal ranges are macrophages over 80%, lymphocytes less than 15%, neutrophils less than 3%, eosinophils less than 0.5%, mast cells less than 0.5%.
HP:0032974.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液细胞成分异常
HP:0032974.definition_cn: 与健康人群中常见的细胞分布存在偏差。正常范围为巨噬细胞超过80%，淋巴细胞少于15%，中性粒细胞少于3%，嗜酸性粒细胞少于0.5%，肥大细胞少于0.5%。

HP:0032975.name: Abnormal bronchoalveolar fluid protein level
HP:0032975.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of protein in the bronchoalveolar fluid.
HP:0032975.name_cn: 支气管肺泡液蛋白水平异常
HP:0032975.definition_cn: 支气管肺泡液中蛋白质浓度的任何异常。

HP:0032976.name: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid lymphocyte proportion
HP:0032976.definition: Usually, Lymphoycytes make up less than 15% of all cells found in the bronchoalveloar lavage fluid. This elevated cell proportion can be induced by virus or drugs, or is associated with specific diseases.
HP:0032976.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液淋巴细胞比例升高
HP:0032976.definition_cn: 通常情况下，淋巴细胞占支气管肺泡灌洗液中所有细胞的比例低于15%。这种细胞比例的升高可能由病毒或药物引起，或与特定疾病相关。

HP:0032977.name: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid neutrophil proportion
HP:0032977.definition: Usually, Neutrophils make up less than 3% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. In children, standard value of neutrophils is higher depending on their age (children under the age of 5 show a maximum value of 10%). This elevated cell proportion is a sign for acute and chronic infections (HP:0012387, HP:0006538) and can be associated to specific diseases.
HP:0032977.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液中性粒细胞比例升高
HP:0032977.definition_cn: 通常，中性粒细胞在支气管肺泡灌洗液中的比例低于所有细胞的3%。在儿童中，中性粒细胞的标准值随年龄增长而升高（5岁以下儿童的最大值为10%）。这种细胞比例的升高是急性和慢性感染（HP:0012387，HP:0006538）的标志，并可能与特定疾病相关。

HP:0032978.name: Lipid-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
HP:0032978.definition: Accumulation of lipids in alveolar macrophages with droplet-shaped fat inclusions.
HP:0032978.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液中的脂质沉积巨噬细胞
HP:0032978.definition_cn: 肺泡巨噬细胞内脂质积聚，呈滴状脂肪包涵体。

HP:0032979.name: Hemosiderin-laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
HP:0032979.definition: Hemosiderin-laden macrophages (HLM) in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid were originally known as adiagnostic biomarker of alveolar hemorrhage, but have also been observed in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) with histopathological pattern of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP).
HP:0032979.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液中的含铁血黄素巨噬细胞
HP:0032979.definition_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液（BAL）中的含铁血黄素巨噬细胞（HLM）最初被认为是肺泡出血的诊断性生物标志物，但也在具有寻常型间质性肺炎（UIP）组织病理学模式的特发性肺纤维化（IPF）中被观察到。

HP:0032980.name: Absent bronchoalveolar surfactant-protein C
HP:0032980.definition: Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein C in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid. Comment: Pulmonary surfactant is a highly surface-active mixture of proteins and lipids that is synthesized and secreted onto the alveoli by type II epithelial cells. The protein part of surfactant constitutes of four types of surfactant proteins (SP), SP-A, SP-B, SP-C and SP-D. SP-A and SP-D are hydrophilic proteins that regulate surfactant metabolism and have immunologic functions, whereas SP-B and SP-C are hydrophobic molecules, which play a direct role in the organization of the surfactant structure in the interphase and in the stabilization of the lipid layers during the respiratory cycle. Lack of SP-C may result of surfactant metabolism dysfunction and is also observed in patients with other diffuse parenchymal lung diseases, pathogenetically related to the alveolar surfactant region.
HP:0032980.name_cn: 支气管肺泡表面活性物质蛋白C缺失
HP:0032980.definition_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液中表面活性蛋白C水平显著降低或未能检测到。注释：肺表面活性物质是一种高度表面活性的蛋白质和脂质混合物，由II型上皮细胞合成并分泌到肺泡上。表面活性物质的蛋白质部分由四种表面活性蛋白（SP）组成，即SP-A、SP-B、SP-C和SP-D。SP-A和SP-D是亲水性蛋白，调节表面活性物质的代谢并具有免疫功能，而SP-B和SP-C是疏水性分子，在呼吸周期中直接参与表面活性物质结构的组织以及脂质层的稳定。SP-C的缺乏可能导致表面活性物质代谢功能障碍，并且在其他与肺泡表面活性物质区域病理相关的弥漫性肺实质疾病患者中也可观察到。

HP:0032981.name: Absent bronchoalveolar dimeric surfactant-protein B
HP:0032981.definition: Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein B in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid.
HP:0032981.name_cn: 支气管肺泡二聚体表面活性蛋白B缺失
HP:0032981.definition_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液中表面活性蛋白B水平显著降低或未检测到。

HP:0032983.name: Atoll sign
HP:0032983.definition: CT finding of central ground-glass opacity surrounded by denser consolidation of crescentic shape (forming more than three-fourths of a circle) or complete ring of at least 2 mm in thickness. A rare sign, it was initially reported to be specific for cryptogenic organizing pneumonia, but was subsequently described in patients with paracoccidioidomycosis.
HP:0032983.definition_cn: CT影像表现为中央磨玻璃样影，周围环绕新月形（形成超过四分之三圆周）或完整环状、厚度至少2 mm的实变影。这一罕见征象最初被认为对隐源性机化性肺炎具有特异性，但随后在副球孢子菌病患者中也有描述。

HP:0032984.name: Abnormal alveolar macrophage morphology
HP:0032984.definition: Alveolar macrophages usually make up the majority of cells in the bronchoalveolar space (over 80%). The may contain intracellular material depending on underlying diseases or due to exposition to inhaled particles.
HP:0032984.name_cn: 肺泡巨噬细胞形态异常
HP:0032984.definition_cn: 肺泡巨噬细胞通常构成支气管肺泡腔中大多数细胞（超过80%）。根据潜在疾病或吸入颗粒物的暴露情况，它们可能含有细胞内物质。

HP:0032985.name: Dust particle inclusion in alveolar macrophages
HP:0032985.definition: Accumulation of inhaled, nondigestable particles in macrophages.
HP:0032985.name_cn: 肺泡巨噬细胞内粉尘颗粒包涵体
HP:0032985.definition_cn: 巨噬细胞内吸入性不可消化颗粒的蓄积。

HP:0032986.name: Smoker-inclusions in alveolar macrophages
HP:0032986.definition: In otherwise healthy smokers, characteristic so called smoker-inclusion can be found within the macrophages in the bronchoalveolar fluid. These blue/ black/ round/ oval cytoplasmic inclusions consist of pigmented lipid deposits.
HP:0032986.name_cn: 肺泡巨噬细胞中的吸烟者包涵体
HP:0032986.definition_cn: 在健康吸烟者中，可在支气管肺泡液中的巨噬细胞内发现特征性的所谓吸烟者包涵体。这些蓝/黑/圆/椭圆形的细胞质包涵体由色素性脂质沉积物组成。

HP:0032987.name: Elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid eosinophil proportion
HP:0032987.definition: Usually, eosinophils make up less than 0.5% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. But in eosinophilic lung disease, the eosinophil cell proportion typically represents more than 25%. Comment: An elevated level of eosinophil cells are also a result of infections, or an allergic reaction or can be drug-induced.
HP:0032987.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液嗜酸性粒细胞比例升高
HP:0032987.definition_cn: 通常情况下，嗜酸性粒细胞占支气管肺泡灌洗液中所有细胞的比例低于0.5%。但在嗜酸性肺病中，嗜酸性粒细胞比例通常超过25%。注释：嗜酸性粒细胞水平升高也可能是感染、过敏反应或药物诱导的结果。

HP:0032988.name: Persistent head lag
HP:0032988.definition: The Premie-Neuro and the Dubowitz Neurological Examination score head lag in the same manner. Scoring for both is as follows: 0 = head drops and stays back, 1 = tries to lift head but drops it back, 2 = able to lift head slightly, 3 = lifts head in line with body, and 4 = head in front of body. This term applies if head lag persists beyond an expected age at a level of 0 or 1. Persistent head lag beyond age 4 mo has been linked to poor outcomes.
HP:0032988.definition_cn: Premie-Neuro和Dubowitz神经学检查以相同的方式对头部滞后进行评分。两者的评分标准如下：0 = 头部下垂并保持后仰，1 = 试图抬起头部但随后下垂，2 = 能够轻微抬起头部，3 = 头部与身体保持水平，4 = 头部位于身体前方。如果头部滞后在预期年龄后仍持续存在，且评分为0或1，则适用此术语。头部滞后持续超过4个月与不良预后相关。

HP:0032989.name: Delayed ability to roll over
HP:0032989.definition: Delayed achievement of the ability to roll front to back and back to front.
HP:0032989.definition_cn: 前后翻身能力发育迟缓。

HP:0032990.name: Localized pulmonary hemorrhage
HP:0032990.definition: Circumscribed pulmonary hemorrhage originating from a single bleeding site in the lungs. This can be due to infections, tumorigenesis, foreign bodies, or vascular abnormalities. Patient often feel the site of bleeding, contrast CT scan or angiography may localize the bleeder.
HP:0032990.definition_cn: 局限性肺出血，源自肺部单一出血部位。可能由感染、肿瘤形成、异物或血管异常引起。患者常可感知出血部位，对比增强CT扫描或血管造影可定位出血点。

HP:0032991.name: Abnormal pulmonary fissure morphology
HP:0032991.definition: An abnormal form or number of the pulmonary fissures.
HP:0032991.definition_cn: 肺裂异常形态或数量异常。

HP:0032992.name: Abnormal pulmonary fissure architecture
HP:0032992.definition: An abnormal form or location of a pulmonary fissure.
HP:0032992.definition_cn: 肺裂异常形态或位置异常。

HP:0032993.name: Abnormal pulmonary fissure count
HP:0032993.definition: A deviation from the normal number of pulmonary fissures.

HP:0032994.name: Supernumerary pulmonary fissure
HP:0032994.definition: Presence of a lung fissure that does not exist normally. Supernumerary fissures include the superior accessory fissure, the medial basal fissure, the left horizontal fissure, and the azygos fissure form supernumerary lobes.
HP:0032994.definition_cn: 存在正常情况下不存在的肺裂。副肺裂包括上副裂、内侧基底裂、左水平裂和奇静脉裂，形成副肺叶。

HP:0032995.name: Decreased pulmonary fissure count
HP:0032995.definition: Lack of one or more of the normal pulmonary fissures.
HP:0032995.definition_cn: 肺裂缺失（Lack of one or more of the normal pulmonary fissures）。

HP:0032996.name: Abnormal cystatin C level
HP:0032996.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cystatin C in serum or plasma.
HP:0032996.definition_cn: 血清或血浆中胱抑素C浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0032997.name: Decreased cystatin C level
HP:0032997.definition: A decreased concentration of cystatin C in the blood circulation.
HP:0032997.definition_cn: 血液循环中胱抑素C浓度降低。

HP:0032998.name: Increased cystatin C level
HP:0032998.definition: A elevated concentration of cystatin C in the blood circulation.
HP:0032998.definition_cn: 血液循环中胱抑素C浓度升高。

HP:0032999.name: Increased fecal porphyrin
HP:0032999.definition: Abnormally high concentration of fecal porphyrins in feces.
HP:0032999.definition_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉异常高浓度。

HP:0033000.name: Subglottic laryngitis
HP:0033000.definition: Narrowing of the larynx, commonly occurring during viral respiratory tract infections, in particular in children, leads to symptoms such as hoarseness, a barking cough, stridor, and sometimes dyspnea and respiratory failure.
HP:0033000.definition_cn: 喉部狭窄，常见于病毒性呼吸道感染期间，尤其在儿童中，可导致声音嘶哑、犬吠样咳嗽、喘鸣，有时还会出现呼吸困难和呼吸衰竭等症状。

HP:0033001.name: Laryngeal papilloma
HP:0033001.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the larynx.
HP:0033001.definition_cn: 喉部乳头状瘤（Laryngeal papilloma），即由人乳头瘤病毒（Human Papilloma Virus, HPV）感染引起的良性上皮肿瘤。

HP:0033002.name: Bronchial papilloma
HP:0033002.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on a bronchus.
HP:0033002.definition_cn: 支气管乳头状瘤（Papilloma），即由人乳头瘤病毒感染引起的良性上皮肿瘤，位于支气管。

HP:0033003.name: Tracheal papilloma
HP:0033003.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the trachea.
HP:0033003.definition_cn: 位于气管上的疣状病变（乳头状瘤，即由人乳头瘤病毒感染引起的良性上皮肿瘤）。

HP:0033004.name: Palmar warts
HP:0033004.definition: Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the palm. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).
HP:0033004.definition_cn: 手掌皮肤上出现多发性疣状病变。这些病变呈隆起状，表面增厚且粗糙，可能伴有明显的黑点（血栓形成的毛细血管）。掌疣由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起。

HP:0033005.name: Plantar warts
HP:0033005.definition: Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the sole of the foot. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).
HP:0033005.definition_cn: 足底皮肤多发疣状病变。这些病变呈隆起状，表面增厚且粗糙，可能显示明显的黑点（血栓形成的毛细血管）。掌疣由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起。

HP:0033006.name: Diffuse alveolar damage
HP:0033006.definition: Diffuse alveolar damage (DAD) describes a common histologic injury pattern of the lung. The early stages are characterized by epithelial cell necrosis and sloughing, fibrous exsudate, edema, and hyaline membranes made of surfactant and proteins, filling the alveoli. This results in impaired gas exchange. In later stages, type II cells and myofibroblasts proliferate within the interstitium and airspaces. The corresponding clinical entity is acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). DAD may result from pulmonary drug toxicity, occurs in immunosuppressed, severe viral infections, acute interstial pneumonitis, and crack cocaine inhalation.
HP:0033006.definition_cn: 弥漫性肺泡损伤（Diffuse Alveolar Damage, DAD）描述了一种常见的肺部组织学损伤模式。早期阶段以上皮细胞坏死和脱落、纤维性渗出物、水肿以及由表面活性物质和蛋白质组成的透明膜为特征，这些物质填充肺泡，导致气体交换受损。在后期阶段，II型细胞和肌成纤维细胞在间质和气腔内增殖。相应的临床实体是急性呼吸窘迫综合征（Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome, ARDS）。DAD可能由肺药物毒性引起，发生在免疫抑制患者中，严重病毒感染、急性间质性肺炎以及吸入可卡因也可能导致DAD。

HP:0033007.name: Architectural distortion of the lung
HP:0033007.definition: Architectural distortion is characterized by abnormal displacement of bronchi, vessels, fissures, or septa caused by diffuse or localized lung disease, particularly interstitial fibrosis. This is visible in lung biopsy and CT scans in a distorted appearance and is usually associated with pulmonary fibrosis and accompanied by volume loss.
HP:0033007.definition_cn: 结构扭曲的特征是由弥漫性或局限性肺部疾病，特别是间质性纤维化引起的支气管、血管、叶间裂或间隔的异常移位。在肺活检和CT扫描中可见到扭曲的外观，通常与肺纤维化相关，并伴有肺容积减少。

HP:0033008.name: Increased Z-disc width
HP:0033008.definition: Abnormally increased width of the Z-disk of the sarcomere, resulting from splitting or opening of the Z-disc (c.f., Figure 2 of PMID:28732005).
HP:0033008.definition_cn: 肌节Z盘宽度异常增加，由Z盘分裂或张开所致（参见PMID:28732005图2）。

HP:0033009.name: Increased fecal coproporphyrin 1
HP:0033009.definition: Abnormally high concentration of coproporphyrin 1 in feces.
HP:0033009.name_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉1水平升高
HP:0033009.definition_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉1异常高浓度。

HP:0033010.name: Increased fecal coproporphyrin 3
HP:0033010.definition: Abnormally high concentration of coproporphyrin 3 in feces
HP:0033010.name_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉3水平升高
HP:0033010.definition_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉3异常高浓度

HP:0033011.name: Platystencephaly
HP:0033011.definition: Extreme width of the skull in the occipital region, with anterior narrowing and prognathism.
HP:0033011.definition_cn: 枕骨区域颅骨极度增宽，伴前部狭窄及凸颌畸形。

HP:0033012.name: Abnormal salivary metabolite concentration
HP:0033012.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a metabolite in saliva.

HP:0033013.name: Abnormal salivary cortisol level
HP:0033013.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cortisol in saliva.

HP:0033014.name: Decreased salivary cortisol level
HP:0033014.definition: Abnormally reduced concentration of cortisol in saliva.
HP:0033014.definition_cn: 唾液皮质醇浓度异常降低。

HP:0033015.name: Increased salivary cortisol level
HP:0033015.definition: Abnormally elevated concentration of cortisol in saliva.
HP:0033015.definition_cn: 唾液皮质醇浓度异常升高。

HP:0033016.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgD
HP:0033016.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood.
HP:0033016.definition_cn: 血液中总免疫球蛋白D（IgD）水平持续低于正常值。

HP:0033017.name: Transient decreased circulating IgD
HP:0033017.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood circulation.
HP:0033017.definition_cn: 血液循环中总免疫球蛋白D（IgD）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0033018.name: Chronic absent circulating IgD
HP:0033018.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgD can be measured.
HP:0033018.definition_cn: 持续性免疫球蛋白D（IgD）缺乏症，血液中最多仅能检测到微量IgD。

HP:0033019.name: Male reproductive system neoplasm
HP:0033019.definition: A neoplasm that affects the male reproductive system.
HP:0033019.definition_cn: 影响男性生殖系统的肿瘤。

HP:0033020.name: Female reproductive system neoplasm
HP:0033020.definition: A neoplasm that affects the female reproductive system.
HP:0033020.definition_cn: 影响女性生殖系统的肿瘤。

HP:0033021.name: Transient decreased circulating IgE concentration
HP:0033021.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood.
HP:0033021.definition_cn: 血液中总免疫球蛋白E（IgE）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0033022.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgE concentration
HP:0033022.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood.
HP:0033022.definition_cn: 血液中总免疫球蛋白E（IgE）水平持续低于正常值。

HP:0033023.name: Chronic absent circulating IgE
HP:0033023.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood circulation, whereby at most trace quantities of IgE can be measured.
HP:0033023.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白E（IgE）的持续缺失，最多只能检测到微量IgE。

HP:0033024.name: Transient decreased circulating IgA
HP:0033024.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin A (IgA) in the blood circulation.
HP:0033024.definition_cn: 循环血液中总免疫球蛋白A（IgA）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0033025.name: Chronic absent circulating total IgG
HP:0033025.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG can be measured.
HP:0033025.name_cn: 慢性循环总免疫球蛋白G缺乏症
HP:0033025.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G（IgG）的持续缺失，最多只能检测到微量IgG。

HP:0033026.name: White oral mucosal macule
HP:0033026.definition: A small circumscribed whitish change in the color of the oral mucosa that is neither elevated nor depressed.
HP:0033026.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜局部出现界限清晰的白色病变，既不隆起也不凹陷。

HP:0033027.name: Retinal peau d'orange
HP:0033027.definition: A pebbly orange appearance of the fundus that is said to resemble the skin of an orange.
HP:0033027.definition_cn: 眼底呈现颗粒状橙红色外观，类似于橙皮样改变。

HP:0033028.name: Anti-U1 ribonucleoprotein antibody positivity
HP:0033028.definition: The presence autoantibodies in the serum that react to proteins (70 Kd, A, C) that are associated with U1 RNA and form U1snRNP.
HP:0033028.name_cn: 抗U1核糖核蛋白抗体阳性
HP:0033028.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体，这些抗体与U1 RNA相关蛋白（70 Kd、A、C）发生反应，并形成U1小核核糖核蛋白（U1snRNP）。

HP:0033030.name: Anti-glomerular basement membrane-antibody positivity
HP:0033030.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to the glomerular basement membrane.
HP:0033030.name_cn: 抗肾小球基底膜抗体阳性
HP:0033030.definition_cn: 血清中存在与肾小球基底膜反应的自身抗体。

HP:0033031.name: Hyperpyrexia
HP:0033031.definition: An extreme elevation of core body temperature above normal defined as a rectal temperature of 41.1 degrees Celsius (106 degrees Fahrenheit).
HP:0033031.definition_cn: 核心体温极度升高，超过正常范围，定义为直肠温度达到41.1摄氏度（106华氏度）。

HP:0033032.name: Triggered by an abusive adult
HP:0033032.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is induced by an abusive adult (usually a parent).
HP:0033032.definition_cn: 适用于由虐待性成人（通常为父母）诱发的体征或症状。

HP:0033033.name: Anti-MDA5 antibody positivity
HP:0033033.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to Anti-MDA5 (Anti-melanoma differentiation-associated proteine 5).
HP:0033033.definition_cn: 血清中存在与抗MDA5（抗黑色素瘤分化相关蛋白5）反应的自体抗体。

HP:0033034.name: Anti-citrullinated protein antibody positivity
HP:0033034.definition: The presence autoantibodies in the serum that react do different citrullinated antigens, including filaggrin, fibrinogen, vimentin and collagen.
HP:0033034.name_cn: 抗瓜氨酸化蛋白抗体阳性
HP:0033034.definition_cn: 血清中存在与不同瓜氨酸化抗原（包括丝聚蛋白、纤维蛋白原、波形蛋白和胶原蛋白）反应的自身抗体。

HP:0033035.name: Abnormal Schwann cell morphology
HP:0033035.definition: Abnormality of schwann cells, glial cells that ensheath axons of neurons in the peripheral nervous system and are necessary for their maintenance and function.
HP:0033035.definition_cn: 施万细胞异常，施万细胞是周围神经系统中包裹神经元轴突的胶质细胞，对于神经元的维持和功能至关重要。

HP:0033036.name: Decreased nasal nitric oxide
HP:0033036.definition: Reduced level of nasal nitric oxide (nNO). Current American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society (ATS/ERS) guidelines for nNO measurements recommend air aspiration via a nasal probe while the subject exhales through the mouth against resistance in order to maintain velum closure.
HP:0033036.definition_cn: 鼻腔一氧化氮（nNO）水平降低。目前美国胸科学会/欧洲呼吸学会（ATS/ERS）关于nNO测量的指南建议，在受试者通过口腔对抗阻力呼气以维持软腭闭合的同时，通过鼻腔探头进行空气抽吸。

HP:0033038.name: Anti-RNA-polymerase-III-autoantibody positivity
HP:0033038.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to RNA-polymerase III.
HP:0033038.name_cn: 抗RNA聚合酶III自身抗体阳性
HP:0033038.definition_cn: 血清中存在与RNA聚合酶III反应的自体抗体。

HP:0033039.name: Increased circulating precipitin level
HP:0033039.definition: The presence of high titers of antigen-precipitating IgG in the serum.
HP:0033039.definition_cn: 血清中存在高滴度的抗原沉淀性免疫球蛋白G（IgG）。

HP:0033040.name: Anti-Sm antibody positivity
HP:0033040.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to seven proteins that consist of a core of small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (snRNP) particles.
HP:0033040.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体，这些抗体与由小核核糖核蛋白（snRNP）颗粒核心组成的七种蛋白质发生反应。

HP:0033041.name: Cytokine storm
HP:0033041.definition: Excessive or uncontrolled release of proinflammatory cytokines.
HP:0033041.definition_cn: 过度或失控的促炎性细胞因子释放。

HP:0033042.name: Abnormal chorion morphology
HP:0033042.definition: Any structural anomaly of the fetal part of the placenta, which is known as the chorion.
HP:0033042.definition_cn: 胎盘胎儿部分（即绒毛膜）的任何结构异常。

HP:0033043.name: Edematous chorionic villi
HP:0033043.definition: Swelling of the chorionic villi owing to fluid accumulation.
HP:0033043.definition_cn: 绒毛膜绒毛因液体积聚而肿胀。

HP:0033044.name: Motor regression
HP:0033044.definition: Loss of previously achieved motor skills, as manifested by loss of developmental motor milestones.
HP:0033044.definition_cn: 先前获得的运动技能丧失，表现为发育性运动里程碑的丧失。

HP:0033045.name: Bipedal edema
HP:0033045.definition: A palpable swelling in both feet and ankles caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid).
HP:0033045.definition_cn: 双侧足踝部可触及的肿胀，由间质液体积增加（液体过量）引起。

HP:0033046.name: Michaelis-Gutmann bodies
HP:0033046.definition: Basophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions in macrophages. The inclusions have a small, round laminated appearance. Electron microscopy of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies exhibits partially digested bacteria.
HP:0033046.definition_cn: 巨噬细胞内嗜碱性胞质内包涵体。包涵体呈小而圆的层状外观。Michaelis-Gutmann小体的电子显微镜检查显示部分消化的细菌。

HP:0033047.name: Body ache
HP:0033047.definition: Body ache is a complaint that is often used to denote vague symptoms of mild fatigue, lethargy, or dull aches. We will define it here to mean a dull and poorly localizable pain that is described by the affected individual to affect multiple joints or body parts or even the entire body.
HP:0033047.definition_cn: 全身疼痛是一种常见的主诉，通常用于描述轻度疲劳、嗜睡或钝痛的模糊症状。在此，我们将其定义为一种钝痛且难以定位的疼痛，患者描述其影响多个关节或身体部位，甚至波及全身。

HP:0033048.name: Substantia nigra hypointensity on susceptibility-weighted imaging
HP:0033048.definition: Hypointence (dark) appearance of the substantia nigra inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI).
HP:0033048.name_cn: 黑质在磁敏感加权成像上的低信号
HP:0033048.definition_cn: 使用磁敏感加权成像（SWI）进行磁共振成像时，黑质呈现低信号（暗）表现。

HP:0033049.name: Globus pallidus hypointensity on susceptibility-weighted imaging
HP:0033049.definition: Hypointence (dark) appearance of the globus pallidus inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI).
HP:0033049.name_cn: 磁敏感加权成像上苍白球低信号
HP:0033049.definition_cn: 在磁敏感加权成像（SWI）中，苍白球呈现低信号（暗）表现。

HP:0033050.name: Pharyngalgia
HP:0033050.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the throat.
HP:0033050.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，且感知起源于咽喉部位。

HP:0033051.name: Impaired executive functioning
HP:0033051.definition: A disturbance of executive functioning, which is broadly defined as the set of abilities that allow for the planning, executing, monitoring, and self-correcting of goal-directed behavior while inhibiting task-irrelevant behavior. At least some degree of executive skill is needed to complete most cognitive tasks, and deficits in executive abilities are central to many clinical conditions, including fronto-temporal dementia.
HP:0033051.definition_cn: 执行功能障碍，广义上定义为一系列能力，这些能力允许对目标导向行为进行规划、执行、监控和自我纠正，同时抑制与任务无关的行为。完成大多数认知任务至少需要一定程度的执行技能，而执行能力的缺陷是许多临床病症的核心，包括额颞叶痴呆。

HP:0033052.name: Non-epileptic seizure
HP:0033052.definition: Psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (PNES) are not abnormal perceptions or abnormal beliefs/judgments, nor are they epileptic attacks. They are behaviors that simulate epileptic attacks, not fully consciously.
HP:0033052.definition_cn: 心因性非癫痫性发作（Psychogenic Non-Epileptic Seizures, PNES）并非异常感知或异常信念/判断，亦非癫痫发作。其为模拟癫痫发作的行为，并非完全意识控制。

HP:0033053.name: Pseudoseizure
HP:0033053.definition: Sudden, involuntary seizure-like attacks that, unlike epileptic seizures, are not related to electrographic ictal discharges.
HP:0033053.definition_cn: 突发性、非自主性癫痫样发作，与癫痫发作不同，其与脑电图发作性放电无关。

HP:0033054.name: Myoclonic tremor
HP:0033054.definition: A tremor-like cortical myoclonus. The tremulous movements are in fact small, high-frequency myoclonic jerks, induced by posture or action. They can be mild, but can also be more incapacitating. When present in the lower limbs, these may lead to gait disorders and even drop attacks. These tremor-like movements during action can be mistaken for essential tremor or epileptic seizures.
HP:0033054.definition_cn: 一种震颤样皮质肌阵挛。这种震颤样运动实际上是由姿势或动作诱发的小幅度、高频肌阵挛性抽动。其症状可能轻微，但也可能更为严重，导致功能障碍。当下肢受累时，可能引发步态障碍，甚至跌倒发作。这种动作期间的震颤样运动易被误诊为特发性震颤或癫痫发作。

HP:0033055.name: Impaired ability to plan
HP:0033055.definition: Impaired ability to anticipate future events, implement instructions or goals, and develop appropriate steps ahead of time in order to carry out a task or activity.
HP:0033055.definition_cn: 执行功能障碍（Executive Dysfunction），表现为前瞻性记忆受损（Impaired Prospective Memory）、指令执行障碍（Impaired Instruction Implementation）、目标导向行为缺陷（Goal-Directed Behavior Deficit）以及计划能力下降（Reduced Planning Capacity），导致无法有效完成特定任务或活动。

HP:0033056.name: Impaired ability to organize
HP:0033056.definition: Impaired ability to bring order to information, actions, or materials to achieve a goal or to follow an established organized routine.
HP:0033056.definition_cn: 执行功能障碍，表现为在整理信息、行动或材料以实现目标或遵循既定组织程序方面的能力受损。

HP:0033057.name: Decreased circulating terminal complement component concentration
HP:0033057.definition: Concentration below the lower limit of normal of one or more components of the the terminal membrane attack complex (MAC) portion of complement, which represents the lytic, pore-forming part of the system. The MAC comprises seven components: C5b, C6, C7, C8 (a heterotrimer composed of C8alpha, C8beta and C8gamma) and multiple copies of C9.
HP:0033057.name_cn: 循环末端补体成分浓度降低
HP:0033057.definition_cn: 补体终末膜攻击复合物（MAC）部分的一个或多个组分浓度低于正常下限，该复合物代表系统的溶细胞性、孔形成部分。MAC由七个组分组成：C5b、C6、C7、C8（由C8α、C8β和C8γ组成的异源三聚体）以及多个C9分子。

HP:0033058.name: Decreased circulating complement C7 concentration
HP:0033058.definition: Concentration of the complement component C7 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0033058.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C7浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0033059.name: Decreased circulating complement C6 concentration
HP:0033059.definition: Concentration of the complement component C6 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0033059.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C6浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0033060.name: Decreased circulating complement C5 concentration
HP:0033060.definition: Concentration of the complement component C5 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0033060.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C5浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0033061.name: Increased factor IX activity
HP:0033061.definition: Elevated activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.
HP:0033061.definition_cn: 凝血因子IX活性升高。凝血因子IX本身被因子Xa或因子VIIa激活形成因子IXa，进而激活因子X转化为因子Xa。

HP:0033062.name: Abnormal factor IX activity
HP:0033062.definition: Abnormal activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.
HP:0033062.definition_cn: 凝血因子IX活性异常。凝血因子IX本身被因子Xa或因子VIIa激活形成因子IXa，进而激活因子X转化为因子Xa。

HP:0033063.name: Shortened sleep phase
HP:0033063.definition: A tendency to sleep fewer hours than usual while feeling well-rested.
HP:0033063.definition_cn: 睡眠时间减少倾向伴清醒感

HP:0033064.name: Renal interstitial globotriaosylceramide inclusions
HP:0033064.definition: Accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) in kidney tissues, which can be quantified as the number of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) inclusions/kidney interstitial capillary (KIC).
HP:0033064.name_cn: 肾间质三己糖神经酰胺包涵体
HP:0033064.definition_cn: 肾组织中三己糖酰基鞘氨醇（GL-3）的积聚，可量化为每肾间质毛细血管（KIC）中三己糖酰基鞘氨醇（GL-3）包涵体的数量。

HP:0033065.name: Mild albuminuria
HP:0033065.definition: The presence of mildly increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) less than 30 mg/gm (less than 3.4 mg/mmol).
HP:0033065.definition_cn: 尿液中白蛋白浓度轻度升高，定义为白蛋白-肌酐比值（ACR）小于30 mg/g（小于3.4 mg/mmol）。

HP:0033066.name: Severe albuminuria
HP:0033066.definition: The presence of severely increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio greater than 300 mg/gm (greater than 34 mg/mmol).
HP:0033066.definition_cn: 尿液中白蛋白浓度显著升高，定义为白蛋白-肌酐比值大于300 mg/g（大于34 mg/mmol）。

HP:0033068.name: Medication crystalluria
HP:0033068.definition: A variety of drugs may occasionally cause transient crystalluria, in isolation or in conjunction with other urinary abnormalities. Overdose, dehydration, or hypoalbuminaemia, which increases the unbound drug which is ultrafiltrated by the glomerulus, are the factors usually favoring the precipitation of crystals within the tubular lumina. In some cases, medication-induced crystalluria has a distinct phenotypic appearance. For instance, Sulphadiazine crystals appear as strongly birefringent 'shocks of wheat' or 'shells' with an amber color. Acyclovir crystals are birefringent and needle-shaped, and when present in abundance give to urine a silky and opalescent macroscopic appearance.
HP:0033068.definition_cn: 多种药物偶尔可能引起短暂性结晶尿，单独或与其他尿液异常同时出现。药物过量、脱水或低白蛋白血症（这些因素增加了由肾小球超滤的未结合药物）通常是促进肾小管腔内晶体沉淀的因素。在某些情况下，药物诱导的结晶尿具有独特的表型外观。例如，磺胺嘧啶晶体呈强双折射的“麦穗”或“贝壳”状，呈琥珀色。阿昔洛韦晶体呈双折射针状，当大量存在时，尿液呈现丝状和乳白色宏观外观。

HP:0033069.name: Renal interstitial IgG4+ plasma cell infiltration
HP:0033069.definition: An increased number of IgG4+ plasma cells in the interstitial space of the kidney.
HP:0033069.definition_cn: 肾间质中IgG4+浆细胞数量增多。

HP:0033070.name: Impaired self monitoring
HP:0033070.definition: Impaired ability to track awareness of the effect that one's behavior has on others and how it compares with standards or expectations for behavior.
HP:0033070.definition_cn: 对自身行为对他人影响及与行为标准或期望相比的认知追踪能力受损。

HP:0033071.name: Impaired task monitoring
HP:0033071.definition: Impaired ability to keep track of one's problem-solving success or failure, and to identify and correct mistakes during performance of a goal.
HP:0033071.definition_cn: 执行功能障碍中的自我监控能力受损，表现为在目标执行过程中无法有效追踪问题解决的成功或失败，以及识别和纠正错误。

HP:0033072.name: Abnormal macroscopic urine appearance
HP:0033072.definition: Anomalous physical appearance (color, cloudiness, clarity) or odor of urine.
HP:0033072.definition_cn: 尿液外观异常（颜色、浑浊度、透明度）或气味异常。

HP:0033073.name: Urate tophus
HP:0033073.definition: Intradermal urate crystal deposits appeared as small, superficial, pustule-like, whitish lesions. The lesions may be the focus of inflammatory episodes with increasing pain, swelling, and erythema of the intradermal tophi.
HP:0033073.definition_cn: 皮内尿酸盐结晶沉积表现为浅表性、脓疱样、白色小病灶。这些病灶可能成为炎症发作的中心，伴随皮内痛风石疼痛、肿胀和红斑的加重。

HP:0033074.name: Steroid-responsive anemia
HP:0033074.definition: Amelioration of anemia upon treatment with a steroid medication.
HP:0033074.definition_cn: 使用类固醇药物治疗后贫血症状的改善。

HP:0033075.name: Inappropriately normal thyroid-stimulating hormone level
