HP:0033075.definition: A normal or elevated serum thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level in the face of an elevation in circulating FT4 and/or FT3.
HP:0033075.name_cn: 不适当正常的促甲状腺激素水平
HP:0033075.definition_cn: 在循环游离甲状腺素（FT4）和/或游离三碘甲状腺原氨酸（FT3）升高的情况下，血清促甲状腺激素（TSH）水平正常或升高。

HP:0033076.name: Abnormal circulating free T4 concentration
HP:0033076.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of free thyroxine (T4) in the blood circulation. Circulating T4 is almost entirely bound to specific transport proteins such as thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) but it is the unbound (free) fraction that is able to enter tissues and exert effects.
HP:0033076.name_cn: 异常循环游离甲状腺素浓度
HP:0033076.definition_cn: 血液中游离甲状腺素（T4）浓度偏离正常范围。循环中的T4几乎完全与特定的转运蛋白（如甲状腺素结合球蛋白，TBG）结合，但只有未结合（游离）的部分能够进入组织并发挥生理效应。

HP:0033077.name: Increased circulating free T4 concentration
HP:0033077.definition: An elevated concentration of free thyroxine (fT4) in the blood circulation.
HP:0033077.name_cn: 循环游离甲状腺素（T4）浓度升高
HP:0033077.definition_cn: 血液循环中游离甲状腺素（fT4）浓度升高。

HP:0033078.name: Decreased circulating free T4 concentration
HP:0033078.definition: A reduced concentration of free thyroxine (fT4) in the blood circulation.
HP:0033078.name_cn: 循环游离甲状腺素（T4）浓度降低
HP:0033078.definition_cn: 血液循环中游离甲状腺素（fT4）浓度降低。

HP:0033079.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the thyroid gland
HP:0033079.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the thyroid gland.
HP:0033079.name_cn: 甲状腺发育不全/甲状腺发育不良
HP:0033079.definition_cn: 甲状腺缺如或发育不全。

HP:0033080.name: Abnormal TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0033080.definition: Thyrotrophin-releasing hormone (TRH) is a hypothalamic tripeptide synthesized by, stored within, and released from the hypothalamus. It stimulates the synthesis and release of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) from the anterior pituitary gland. Following administration of exogenous TRH, a transient increase in serum TSH is expected. This term refers to an abnormal response in the TRH stimulation test.
HP:0033080.name_cn: 促甲状腺激素释放激素刺激试验中促甲状腺激素异常反应
HP:0033080.definition_cn: 促甲状腺激素释放激素（TRH）是一种由下丘脑合成、储存并释放的下丘脑三肽。它刺激垂体前叶合成和释放促甲状腺激素（TSH）。在给予外源性TRH后，预期会出现血清TSH的短暂升高。该术语指的是TRH刺激试验中的异常反应。

HP:0033081.name: Absent TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0033081.definition: Failure to increase serum TSH levels in response to a TRH stimulation test.
HP:0033081.name_cn: 促甲状腺激素释放激素刺激试验中促甲状腺激素无反应
HP:0033081.definition_cn: 对促甲状腺激素释放激素（TRH）刺激试验无血清促甲状腺激素（TSH）水平升高反应。

HP:0033082.name: Reduced TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test
HP:0033082.definition: A lower than normal TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test.
HP:0033082.name_cn: 促甲状腺激素释放激素刺激试验中促甲状腺激素反应减弱
HP:0033082.definition_cn: 促甲状腺激素释放激素刺激试验中促甲状腺激素（TSH）反应低于正常水平。

HP:0033083.name: Increased circulating farnesol concentration
HP:0033083.definition: An elevated level of farnesol in the blood circulation.
HP:0033083.definition_cn: 血液循环中法尼醇水平升高。

HP:0033084.name: Abnormal antral follicle count
HP:0033084.definition: Any deviation from a count of antral follicles that is normal for age. Antral follicles appear as small fluid-filled sacs that contain an immature egg. Antral follicle count can be measured (usually on day 2-5 of the menstrual cycle) by transvaginal ultrasound. The number of antral follicles may reflect ovarian reserve.
HP:0033084.definition_cn: 任何与年龄相关的窦卵泡计数正常值的偏离。窦卵泡表现为含有未成熟卵子的小液囊。窦卵泡计数可通过经阴道超声测量（通常在月经周期的第2-5天进行）。窦卵泡的数量可能反映卵巢储备功能。

HP:0033085.name: Reduced antral follicle count
HP:0033085.definition: A count of antral follicles that is lower than normal for age.
HP:0033085.definition_cn: 窦卵泡计数低于年龄正常值。

HP:0033086.name: Increased antral follicle count
HP:0033086.definition: A count of antral follicles that is higher than normal for age.
HP:0033086.definition_cn: 窦卵泡计数高于年龄正常值。

HP:0033087.name: Quotidian fever
HP:0033087.definition: Fever that occurs at daily intervals.

HP:0033088.name: Valinuria
HP:0033088.definition: Urine valine level above the normal range.
HP:0033088.definition_cn: 尿液中缬氨酸水平高于正常范围。

HP:0033089.name: Branched-chain aminoaciduria
HP:0033089.definition: An increased level of a branched chain family amino acid in the urine.
HP:0033089.definition_cn: 尿液中支链氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033090.name: Increased aromatic amino acid level in urine
HP:0033090.definition: An elevated level of an aromatic amino acid in the urine.
HP:0033090.name_cn: 尿液中芳香族氨基酸水平升高
HP:0033090.definition_cn: 尿液中芳香族氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033091.name: Tyrosinuria
HP:0033091.definition: An abnormally increased level of tyrosine in the urine.
HP:0033091.definition_cn: 尿酪氨酸水平异常升高。

HP:0033092.name: Increased urine succinate level
HP:0033092.definition: The concentration of succinate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033092.name_cn: 尿液中琥珀酸水平升高
HP:0033092.definition_cn: 尿液中琥珀酸盐浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0033093.name: Increased glutamine family amino acid level in urine
HP:0033093.definition: An elevated level of an glutamine family amino acid in the urine.
HP:0033093.name_cn: 尿液中谷氨酰胺家族氨基酸水平升高
HP:0033093.definition_cn: 尿液中谷氨酰胺家族氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033094.name: Increased urine glutamate level
HP:0033094.definition: An increased concentration of glutamate in the urine.
HP:0033094.definition_cn: 尿液中谷氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0033095.name: Increased sulfur amino acid level in urine
HP:0033095.definition: An elevated level of a sulfur-containing amino acid in the urine.
HP:0033095.name_cn: 尿液中硫氨基酸水平升高
HP:0033095.definition_cn: 尿液中含硫氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033096.name: Increased aspartate family amino acid level in urine
HP:0033096.definition: An elevated level of an aspartate family amino acid in the urine.
HP:0033096.name_cn: 尿液中天冬氨酸家族氨基酸水平升高
HP:0033096.definition_cn: 尿液中天门冬氨酸家族氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033097.name: Increased urine proteinogenic amino acid derivative level
HP:0033097.definition: An elevated urine level of a compound that is derived from an amino acid.
HP:0033097.name_cn: 尿液中蛋白质源性氨基酸衍生物水平升高
HP:0033097.definition_cn: 尿液中氨基酸衍生物水平升高。

HP:0033098.name: Increased urinary non-proteinogenic amino acid level
HP:0033098.definition: An increased level in the urine of an alpha-amino acid which is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.
HP:0033098.name_cn: 尿液中非蛋白源性氨基酸水平升高
HP:0033098.definition_cn: 尿液中一种非23种蛋白质生成氨基酸的α-氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033099.name: Increased serine family amino acid in urine
HP:0033099.definition: An increased level of a serine family amino acid in the urine.
HP:0033099.name_cn: 尿液中丝氨酸家族氨基酸增加
HP:0033099.definition_cn: 尿液中丝氨酸家族氨基酸水平升高。

HP:0033100.name: Increased proteinogenic amino acid level in urine
HP:0033100.definition: An elevated level of a proteinogenic amino acid in the urine. These are the 23 alpha-amino acids that are precursors to proteins, and are incorporated into proteins during translation. The group includes the 20 amino acids encoded by the nuclear genes of eukaryotes together with selenocysteine, pyrrolysine, and N-formylmethionine.
HP:0033100.name_cn: 尿液中蛋白质生成性氨基酸水平升高
HP:0033100.definition_cn: 尿液中蛋白原性氨基酸水平升高。这些是23种α-氨基酸，它们是蛋白质的前体，并在翻译过程中被整合到蛋白质中。该组包括由真核生物核基因编码的20种氨基酸，以及硒代半胱氨酸、吡咯赖氨酸和N-甲酰甲硫氨酸。

HP:0033101.name: Elevated urine aconitic acid level
HP:0033101.definition: An abnormally increased level of aconitic acid in the urine.
HP:0033101.definition_cn: 尿液中乌头酸水平异常升高。

HP:0033102.name: Monkey wrench femoral neck
HP:0033102.definition: The femoral neck region shows medial metaphyseal beaking and a significant enlargement of the lesser trochanter (with some enlargement also of the greater trochanter), producing a monkey wrench (Swedish key) configuration of the proximal femur. A monkey wrench refers to a type of adjustable wrench with one fixed and one adjustable jaw at right angles to a straight handle.
HP:0033102.definition_cn: 股骨颈区域显示内侧干骺端喙状突起及小转子显著增大（大转子亦有部分增大），导致股骨近端呈现“猴扳手”（瑞典钥匙）形态。“猴扳手”是指一种可调节扳手，其固定钳口与可调节钳口呈直角，连接于直柄上。

HP:0033103.name: Elevated circulating CHI3L1 level
HP:0033103.definition: Increased concentration of chitinase 3-like 1 (CHI3L1) in the blood circulation.
HP:0033103.definition_cn: 血液循环中几丁质酶3样蛋白1（CHI3L1）浓度升高。

HP:0033104.name: Inappropriate absence of fever
HP:0033104.definition: Failure to develop fever in the presence of an infection that normally would be expected to elicit a febrile response.
HP:0033104.definition_cn: 在存在感染的情况下未能出现发热反应，而该感染通常预期会引发发热反应。

HP:0033105.name: Interhypothalamic adhesion
HP:0033105.definition: An abnormal parenchymal band connecting the medial margins of the left and right hypothalami across the third ventricle.
HP:0033105.definition_cn: 一条异常的实质带跨越第三脑室连接左右下丘脑的内侧缘。

HP:0033106.name: Elevated circulating D-dimer concentration
HP:0033106.definition: An increased concentration of D-dimers, a marker of fibrin degradation, in the blood circulation.
HP:0033106.definition_cn: 血液循环中D-二聚体（纤维蛋白降解标志物）浓度升高。

HP:0033107.name: Abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid concentration
HP:0033107.definition: An elevated level of a proteinogenic amino acid in the blood circulation. These are the 23 alpha-amino acids that are precursors to proteins, and are incorporated into proteins during translation. The group includes the 20 amino acids encoded by the nuclear genes of eukaryotes together with selenocysteine, pyrrolysine, and N-formylmethionine.
HP:0033107.name_cn: 异常循环蛋白原性氨基酸浓度
HP:0033107.definition_cn: 血液循环中蛋白质原性氨基酸水平升高。这些是23种α-氨基酸，它们是蛋白质的前体，并在翻译过程中被整合到蛋白质中。该组包括由真核生物核基因编码的20种氨基酸，以及硒代半胱氨酸、吡咯赖氨酸和N-甲酰甲硫氨酸。

HP:0033108.name: Abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid derivative concentration
HP:0033108.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of a compound that is derived from an amino acid.
HP:0033108.name_cn: 异常循环蛋白原性氨基酸衍生物浓度
HP:0033108.definition_cn: 血液循环中源自氨基酸的化合物浓度偏离正常值的任何偏差。

HP:0033109.name: Abnormal circulating non-proteinogenic amino acid concentration
HP:0033109.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an alpha-amino acid which is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.
HP:0033109.name_cn: 异常循环非蛋白源性氨基酸浓度
HP:0033109.definition_cn: 血液循环中非23种蛋白质生成氨基酸的α-氨基酸浓度异常。

HP:0033110.name: Elevated circulating alpha-aminobutyric acid concentration
HP:0033110.definition: An abnormally increased level of alpa-aminobutyric acid in the blood circulation. Alpha-aminobutyric acid alpha-amino acid that is butyric acid bearing a single amino substituent located at position 2.
HP:0033110.name_cn: 循环中α-氨基丁酸浓度升高
HP:0033110.definition_cn: 血液循环中α-氨基丁酸水平异常升高。α-氨基丁酸是一种α-氨基酸，其结构为在2位带有单一氨基取代基的丁酸。

HP:0033111.name: 3-hydroxyisovaleric aciduria
HP:0033111.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyisovaleric acid in the urine above the normal range.
HP:0033111.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基异戊酸浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0033112.name: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein C-III concentration
HP:0033112.definition: An increased concentration in blood of apolipoprotein C-III, a protein component of triglyceride (TG)-rich lipoproteins (TRLs) including very low density lipoproteins (VLDL), high density lipoproteins (HDL) and chylomicrons.
HP:0033112.name_cn: 循环载脂蛋白C-III浓度升高
HP:0033112.definition_cn: 血液中载脂蛋白C-III浓度升高，该蛋白是富含甘油三酯（TG）的脂蛋白（TRLs）的组成部分，包括极低密度脂蛋白（VLDL）、高密度脂蛋白（HDL）和乳糜微粒。

HP:0033113.name: Gallop rhythm
HP:0033113.definition: In the normal heart cycle, two heart sounds can be heard by auscultation per cycle: S1 and S2. A gallop rhythm refers to the presence of three or four heart sounds per cardiac cycle, which is said to resemble the gallop of a horse.
HP:0033113.definition_cn: 在正常心动周期中，每个周期可通过听诊听到两个心音：S1和S2。奔马律是指每个心动周期中出现三个或四个心音，其声音类似于马匹奔跑的节奏。

HP:0033114.name: Quadruple gallop rhythm
HP:0033114.definition: A type of gallop rhythm in which both the third and the fourth sounds are present.
HP:0033114.definition_cn: 一种奔马律类型，其中同时存在第三心音和第四心音。

HP:0033115.name: Elevated circulating tenascin-C level
HP:0033115.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of tenascin-C in the blood circulation.
HP:0033115.name_cn: 循环中腱生蛋白-C水平升高
HP:0033115.definition_cn: 血液循环中腱糖蛋白-C浓度异常升高。

HP:0033116.name: Duodenal gastric metaplasia
HP:0033116.definition: Foci of gastric-type mucus-secreting cells interspersed between duodenal enterocytes. These foci of gastric epithelial cells contain Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive neutral mucin and lack a brush border.
HP:0033116.definition_cn: 胃型黏液分泌细胞灶散布于十二指肠肠上皮细胞之间。这些胃上皮细胞灶含有过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性的中性黏液，且缺乏刷状缘。

HP:0033117.name: Duodenitis
HP:0033117.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the upper small intestine (duodenum).
HP:0033117.definition_cn: 上段小肠（十二指肠）黏膜炎症。

HP:0033118.name: Abnormal right ventricular function
HP:0033118.definition: Anomalous physiology (function) of the right ventricle.

HP:0033119.name: Elevated right ventricular systolic pressure
HP:0033119.definition: Elevation of right ventricular systolic pressure (RVSP) above normal limits. In adults, RVSP is normally 20-30 mmHg.
HP:0033119.definition_cn: 右心室收缩压（RVSP）升高超出正常范围。在成人中，RVSP的正常值为20-30毫米汞柱（mmHg）。

HP:0033120.name: Nummular eczema
HP:0033120.definition: A type of eczema characterized by pruritic coin-shaped patches on the skin. Nummular eczema most commonly occurs on the extremities, particularly the legs, but may occur anywhere on the trunk, hands, or feet
HP:0033120.definition_cn: 一种以皮肤上出现瘙痒性圆形斑块为特征的湿疹类型。盘状湿疹最常见于四肢，尤其是腿部，但也可能出现在躯干、手部或足部的任何部位。

HP:0033121.name: Barking cough
HP:0033121.definition: A cough with a characteristic sound that has been compared to a seal's bark.

HP:0033122.name: Absent P wave
HP:0033122.definition: The P wave that normally precedes each QRS complex by a fixed PR interval of 120 to 200 milliseconds is not present.
HP:0033122.definition_cn: 正常情况下，每个QRS波群前应存在P波，且PR间期固定为120至200毫秒，但此处P波缺失。

HP:0033123.name: Elevated circulating osteopontin level
HP:0033123.definition: Abnormally increased level of osteopontin in the blood circulation
HP:0033123.name_cn: 循环骨桥蛋白水平升高
HP:0033123.definition_cn: 血液循环中骨桥蛋白水平异常升高

HP:0033124.name: Increased serum sorbitol concentration
HP:0033124.definition: An increased level of sorbitol in the blood circulation.
HP:0033124.definition_cn: 循环血液中山梨醇水平升高。

HP:0033125.name: Follicular lymphoma
HP:0033125.definition: An indolent B cell lymphoproliferative disorder of transformed follicular center B cells. Follicular lymphoma is characterized by diffuse lymphadenopathy, bone marrow involvement, splenomegaly and less commonly other extranodal sites of involvement.
HP:0033125.definition_cn: 一种由转化的滤泡中心B细胞引起的惰性B细胞淋巴增殖性疾病。滤泡性淋巴瘤的特征包括弥漫性淋巴结肿大、骨髓受累、脾肿大，以及较少见的其他结外受累部位。

HP:0033126.name: Cutaneous necrosis
HP:0033126.definition: Skin and subcutaneous tissue necrosis (tissue death). Clinically, cutaneous necrosis may present as a painful and extremely tender black eschar (dead tissue found in a full-thickness wound) surrounded by dusky grey-red colored skin.
HP:0033126.definition_cn: 皮肤及皮下组织坏死（组织死亡）。临床上，皮肤坏死可表现为疼痛且极度敏感的黑色焦痂（全层伤口中发现的死亡组织），周围环绕着灰红色的皮肤。

HP:0033127.name: Abnormality of the musculoskeletal system
HP:0033127.definition: An anomaly of the musculoskeletal system, which consists of the bones of the skeleton, muscles, cartilage, tendons, ligaments, joints, and other connective tissue. The musculoskeletal system supports the weight of the body, maintains body position and produces movements of the body or of parts of the body.
HP:0033127.definition_cn: 骨骼肌肉系统异常，该系统由骨骼、肌肉、软骨、肌腱、韧带、关节及其他结缔组织构成。骨骼肌肉系统负责支撑身体重量、维持身体姿势并产生身体或身体部位的运动。

HP:0033128.name: Delayed ability to crawl
HP:0033128.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to crawl at an appropriate developmental stage. Normal infant motor development is marked by a series of postural milestones including learning to crawl on hands and knees between the ages of 6 and 10 months.
HP:0033128.definition_cn: 未能达到适龄发育阶段的爬行能力。正常婴儿运动发育的标志是一系列姿势里程碑，包括在6至10个月大时学会用手和膝盖爬行。

HP:0033129.name: Abnormal shoulder physiology
HP:0033129.definition: Anopmalous function of the shoulder. The shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint that is made up of humerus, scapula and clavicle, which are connected by the sternoclavicular joint (SC), the acromioclavicular joint (AC), the glenohumeral joint (GH), and the scapulothoracic joint (ST). The GH, AC and SC joints link the upper extremity to the axial skeleton at the thorax and enable movement at the shoulder joint: flexion, extension, and rotation of the arm.
HP:0033129.definition_cn: 肩关节功能异常。肩关节为球窝关节，由肱骨、肩胛骨和锁骨组成，这些骨骼通过胸锁关节（SC）、肩锁关节（AC）、盂肱关节（GH）和肩胛胸壁关节（ST）相互连接。盂肱关节、肩锁关节和胸锁关节将上肢与胸廓的中轴骨骼相连，并实现肩关节的运动：手臂的屈曲、伸展和旋转。

HP:0033130.name: Abnormal renal echogenicity
HP:0033130.definition: Anomalous echogenicity of the kidney on ultrasound examination.
HP:0033130.definition_cn: 超声检查显示肾脏回声异常。

HP:0033131.name: Renal medullary hyperechogenicity
HP:0033131.definition: Increased echogenecity of the medullary region of the kidney.

HP:0033132.name: Renal cortical hyperechogenicity
HP:0033132.definition: Increased echogenecity of the kidney cortex.

HP:0033134.name: Abdominal adhesions
HP:0033134.definition: Fibrous bands (i.e., bands of scar-like tissue) that span two or more intra-abdominal organs and/or the inner abdominal wall (i.e. peritoneal membrane).
HP:0033134.definition_cn: 纤维束带（即类似瘢痕组织的带状结构）跨越两个或更多腹腔内器官和/或腹壁内层（即腹膜）。

HP:0033135.name: Hepatic infarction
HP:0033135.definition: Hepatic infarction is defined as areas of coagulative necrosis from hepatocyte cell death caused by local ischemia. Liver infarctions appear as hypoechoic nonvascular regions on conventional and Doppler sonography.
HP:0033135.definition_cn: 肝梗死定义为由局部缺血引起的肝细胞死亡导致的凝固性坏死区域。在常规和多普勒超声检查中，肝梗死表现为低回声无血管区域。

HP:0033136.name: Lymph node abscess
HP:0033136.definition: An inflamed lymph node that is filled with pus.

HP:0033137.name: Abnormal pulmonary alveolar system morphology
HP:0033137.definition: A structural abnormality of the pulmonary acinus, alveolar parenchyma, or alveoli.
HP:0033137.definition_cn: 肺腺泡、肺泡实质或肺泡的结构异常。

HP:0033138.name: Right atrial thrombus
HP:0033138.definition: A thrombus (i.e., a blood clot formed in situ within the vascular system) located in the right atrium of the heart.
HP:0033138.definition_cn: 位于心脏右心房内的血栓（即在血管系统内原位形成的血凝块）。

HP:0033139.name: Elevated circulating uracil concentration
HP:0033139.definition: Concentration of uracil in the blood circulation is above the normal range.
HP:0033139.definition_cn: 血液中尿嘧啶浓度高于正常范围。

HP:0033140.name: Blake's pouch cyst
HP:0033140.definition: The presence of an upwardly displaced normal cerebellar vermis, normal appearance of the fastigium, tentorium and size of the cisterna magna.
HP:0033140.definition_cn: 正常小脑蚓部向上移位，第四脑室顶、小脑幕及大池形态及大小正常。

HP:0033141.name: Severe SARS-CoV-2 infection
HP:0033141.definition: Unusually severe clinical course of SARS-CoV-2 infection, manifested clinically by features such as dyspnea and hypoxia with diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities of the lungs on computed tomographic scan with progressive respiratory insufficiency necessitating oxygen supplementation or mechanical ventilation.
HP:0033141.name_cn: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型感染
HP:0033141.definition_cn: SARS-CoV-2感染的异常严重临床病程，临床表现为呼吸困难、低氧血症，并在计算机断层扫描中显示肺部弥漫性双侧磨玻璃样影，伴随进行性呼吸功能不全，需氧疗或机械通气支持。

HP:0033142.name: Long nasal bridge
HP:0033142.definition: Increased superior-inferior length of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose.
HP:0033142.definition_cn: 鼻梁上下长度增加，鼻梁为鞍形区域，包括鼻根及鼻外侧部。

HP:0033143.name: Jejunitis
HP:0033143.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the middle section of the small intestine.

HP:0033144.name: Abnormal circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
HP:0033144.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood from the normal range.
HP:0033144.name_cn: 异常循环铜蓝蛋白浓度
HP:0033144.definition_cn: 血清铜蓝蛋白浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0033145.name: Increased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
HP:0033145.definition: Elevated concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation.
HP:0033145.name_cn: 循环中铜蓝蛋白浓度升高
HP:0033145.definition_cn: 血清铜蓝蛋白浓度升高。

HP:0033146.name: Elevated circulating methylsuccinic acid concentration
HP:0033146.definition: Increased concentration of methylsuccinic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0033146.name_cn: 循环中甲基琥珀酸浓度升高
HP:0033146.definition_cn: 血液中甲基琥珀酸浓度升高。

HP:0033147.name: Abnormal circulating short-chain fatty-acid concentration
HP:0033147.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a short-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0033147.name_cn: 异常循环短链脂肪酸浓度
HP:0033147.definition_cn: 血液循环中短链脂肪酸正常浓度的任何偏离。

HP:0033148.name: Increased circulating isovaleric acid concentration
HP:0033148.definition: Increased concentration of isovaleric acid, a C5, branched-chain saturated fatty acid, in the blood concentration.
HP:0033148.name_cn: 循环中异戊酸浓度升高
HP:0033148.definition_cn: 血液中异戊酸（一种C5支链饱和脂肪酸）浓度升高。

HP:0033149.name: Intrahepatic bile duct dilatation
HP:0033149.definition: Increased diameter (caliber) of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts).
HP:0033149.definition_cn: 肝内胆管（在赫令管与叶间胆管之间输送胆汁的胆管）直径（管径）增大。

HP:0033150.name: Anorectal abscess
HP:0033150.definition: An abscess located at the junction of the anal canal and the rectum.
HP:0033150.definition_cn: 位于肛管与直肠交界处的脓肿。

HP:0033151.name: Abnormal pharynx morphology
HP:0033151.definition: A structural anomaly of the pharynx.

HP:0033152.name: Abnormal pharynx physiology
HP:0033152.definition: A functional anomaly of the pharynx.

HP:0033153.name: Elevated circulating dodecenoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033153.definition: An abnormally increased circulation of dodecenoylcarnitine, C12:1, in the blood circulation.
HP:0033153.name_cn: 循环十二烯酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033153.definition_cn: 血液中十二碳烯酰肉碱（C12:1）的异常循环增加。

HP:0033154.name: Elevated circulating deoxypyridinoline concentration
HP:0033154.definition: An increased concentration of lysyl-pyridinoline (deoxypyridinoline) cross-links in the blood circulation.
HP:0033154.name_cn: 循环脱氧吡啶啉浓度升高
HP:0033154.definition_cn: 血液循环中赖氨酰吡啶啉（脱氧吡啶啉）交联物浓度升高。

HP:0033155.name: Elevated circulating L-alloisoleucine concentration
HP:0033155.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033155.name_cn: 循环中L-别异亮氨酸浓度升高
HP:0033155.definition_cn: 血液循环中L-别异亮氨酸浓度异常升高。

HP:0033156.name: Elevated urine L-alloisoleucine level
HP:0033156.definition: Abnormally increased level of L-alloisoleucine in the urine.
HP:0033156.name_cn: 尿液中L-别异亮氨酸水平升高
HP:0033156.definition_cn: 尿液中L-别异亮氨酸水平异常升高。

HP:0033157.name: Elevated circulating 3-methylhistidine concentration
HP:0033157.definition: Abnormal increase of the concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033157.name_cn: 循环中3-甲基组氨酸浓度升高
HP:0033157.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-甲基组氨酸浓度异常升高。

HP:0033158.name: Reduced respiratory ciliary beating frequency
HP:0033158.definition: An abnormal reduction in the number of beats per unit time of the respiratory cilia.
HP:0033158.name_cn: 呼吸纤毛摆动频率降低
HP:0033158.definition_cn: 呼吸纤毛单位时间内摆动次数的异常减少。

HP:0033159.name: Reduced urinary inosine level
HP:0033159.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Inosine is a purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.
HP:0033159.definition_cn: 尿液中肌苷含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常下限。肌苷是一种嘌呤核苷，其中次黄嘌呤通过β-N(9)-糖苷键与呋喃核糖相连。

HP:0033160.name: Decreased urinary guanosine level
HP:0033160.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Guanosine is a purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.
HP:0033160.definition_cn: 尿液中鸟苷浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常下限。鸟苷是一种嘌呤核苷，其中鸟嘌呤通过β-N(9)-糖苷键与呋喃核糖相连。

HP:0033161.name: Abnormal urinary purine level
HP:0033161.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a purine compound in the urine. Purines are aromatic heterocyclic compounds containing a purine moiety, which is formed a pyrimidine-ring ring fused to an imidazole ring. Two of the four deoxyribonucleotides (deoxyadenosine and deoxyguanosine) and two of the four ribonucleotides (adenosine, or AMP, and guanosine, or GMP) are purines.
HP:0033161.definition_cn: 尿液中嘌呤化合物含量的任何异常。嘌呤是含有嘌呤基团的芳香杂环化合物，由嘧啶环与咪唑环融合而成。四种脱氧核糖核苷酸中的两种（脱氧腺苷和脱氧鸟苷）以及四种核糖核苷酸中的两种（腺苷，即AMP，和鸟苷，即GMP）属于嘌呤类化合物。

HP:0033162.name: Abnormal urinary pyrimidine level
HP:0033162.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a pyrimidine compound in the urine. Pyrimidines and pyrimidine derivatives are compounds containing a pyrimidne ring, which is a six-member aromatic heterocycle which consists of two nitrogen atoms (at positions 1 and 3) and four carbon atoms. The nucleotides cytosine, thymine and uracil are pyrimidines.
HP:0033162.definition_cn: 尿液中嘧啶化合物正常含量的任何偏离。嘧啶及嘧啶衍生物是含有嘧啶环的化合物，嘧啶环是一种六元芳香杂环，由两个氮原子（位于1位和3位）和四个碳原子组成。核苷酸中的胞嘧啶、胸腺嘧啶和尿嘧啶均属于嘧啶类化合物。

HP:0033163.name: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
HP:0033163.definition: An increased number and/or abnormal type of bacteria in the small bowel. Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth has been defined as the presence of greater than one hundred thousand bacteria (i.e. colony-forming units, CFU) per mL of proximal jejunal aspiration. The normal value is ten thousand or few CFU/ml.
HP:0033163.definition_cn: 小肠细菌数量增加和/或菌群类型异常。小肠细菌过度生长定义为近端空肠抽吸液中每毫升细菌（即菌落形成单位，CFU）数量超过十万。正常值为每毫升一万或更少CFU。

HP:0033164.name: Focal active colitis
HP:0033164.definition: Focal active colitis (FAC) is characterized by focal crypt damage caused by neutrophils. FAC is characterized by an inflammatory infiltrate consisting of intraepithelial neutrophils and/or neutrophils invading the lumen of the criptae, with no other microscopic alteration of the colonic mucosa and, in particular, without the presence of signs of chronic inflammation.
HP:0033164.definition_cn: 局灶性活动性结肠炎（Focal Active Colitis, FAC）的特征是由中性粒细胞引起的局灶性隐窝损伤。FAC的病理表现为由上皮内中性粒细胞和/或侵入隐窝腔的中性粒细胞组成的炎性浸润，且结肠黏膜无其他显微镜下改变，特别是无慢性炎症的迹象。

HP:0033165.name: Necrotizing enterocolitis
HP:0033165.definition: Inflammation of the intestine leading to bacterial invasion causing cellular damage and death which causes necrosis of the colon and intestine.
HP:0033165.definition_cn: 肠道炎症导致细菌侵入，引发细胞损伤和死亡，进而导致结肠和肠道坏死。

HP:0033166.name: Recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections
HP:0033166.definition: An increased susceptibility to viral upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections (otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).
HP:0033166.name_cn: 复发性病毒性上呼吸道感染
HP:0033166.definition_cn: 表现为反复发作的病毒性上呼吸道感染（中耳炎、鼻窦炎、咽炎、扁桃体炎）病史的病毒性上呼吸道感染易感性增加。

HP:0033167.name: Neutrophilic urticarial dermatosis
HP:0033167.definition: A neutrophilic interstitial, perivascular and/or perieccrine infiltrate with leukocytoclasia. Notably, leukocytoclastic vasculitis is not present.
HP:0033167.name_cn: 中性粒细胞性荨麻疹性皮肤病
HP:0033167.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞性间质、血管周围和/或汗腺周围浸润伴白细胞碎裂。值得注意的是，未见白细胞碎裂性血管炎。

HP:0033168.name: Reduced mevalonate kinase activity
HP:0033168.definition: Abnormally reduced activity of mevalonate kinase, which is a key enzyme in the mevalonate biosynthetic pathway that leads to the synthesis of both cholesterol and nonsterol isoprenoids.
HP:0033168.name_cn: 甲羟戊酸激酶活性降低
HP:0033168.definition_cn: 甲羟戊酸激酶活性异常降低，该酶是甲羟戊酸生物合成途径中的关键酶，该途径导致胆固醇和非甾醇类异戊二烯的合成。

HP:0033169.name: Reduced total lung capacity
HP:0033169.definition: Abnormally reduced volume of air in the lungs upon the maximum effort of inspiration.
HP:0033169.definition_cn: 最大吸气努力时肺内空气体积异常减少。

HP:0033170.name: Abnormal skinfold thickness measurement
HP:0033170.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of a skinfold thickness, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.
HP:0033170.definition_cn: 任何偏离皮褶厚度正常范围的情况，皮褶厚度是通过专用卡尺捏起皮肤时对皮下脂肪量进行定量测量的指标。

HP:0033171.name: Abnormal triceps skinfold thickness
HP:0033171.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the thickness of the triceps skinfold, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.
HP:0033171.name_cn: 肱三头肌皮褶厚度异常
HP:0033171.definition_cn: 任何偏离肱三头肌皮褶厚度正常范围的情况，该指标通过专用皮褶卡钳测量皮肤被捏起时的皮下脂肪量来量化。

HP:0033172.name: Increased triceps skinfold thickness
HP:0033172.definition: Increased thickness of the triceps skinfold, which is measured halfway down the back of the upper arm is increased.
HP:0033172.name_cn: 肱三头肌皮褶厚度增加
HP:0033172.definition_cn: 肱三头肌皮褶厚度增加，该测量点位于上臂后侧中点处。

HP:0033173.name: Milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
HP:0033173.definition: Return of lavage fluid with a milky appearance due to the accumulation of a mixture of pulmonary surfactant, which is a lipoprotein complex, in the alveolar space.
HP:0033173.name_cn: 支气管肺泡灌洗液呈乳白色外观
HP:0033173.definition_cn: 由于肺泡腔内积聚的肺表面活性物质（一种脂蛋白复合物）混合物，导致灌洗液呈现乳白色外观。

HP:0033174.name: Bloody bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
HP:0033174.definition: Return of lavage fluid characteristically has a bloody appearance in pulmonary alveolar hemorrhage. This is due to admixture of blood, which typically increases with each consecutive lavage portion. Microscopically erythrocytes can be seen. After 24 to 48 h macrophages contain phagocytosed erythrocytes, indicating previous bleeding.
HP:0033174.name_cn: 血性支气管肺泡灌洗液
HP:0033174.definition_cn: 在肺泡出血中，灌洗液的特征性表现为血性外观。这是由于血液的混合，通常随着每次连续的灌洗部分而增加。显微镜下可见红细胞。24至48小时后，巨噬细胞内含有吞噬的红细胞，提示既往出血。

HP:0033175.name: Elevated circulating 5-oxoproline concentration
HP:0033175.definition: Concentration of L-pyroglutamic acid in the blood is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033175.name_cn: 循环中5-氧代脯氨酸浓度升高
HP:0033175.definition_cn: 血液中L-焦谷氨酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033176.name: Submandibular lymph node enlargement
HP:0033176.definition: Increased size of the lymph nodes that are located beneath the mandible (lower jaw).

HP:0033177.name: Elevated circulating suberic acid concentration
HP:0033177.definition: An increased concentration of suberic acid in the blood circulation. Suberic acid is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,6-dicarboxy derivative of hexane.
HP:0033177.definition_cn: 血液中辛二酸浓度升高。辛二酸是一种α,ω-二羧酸，是己烷的1,6-二羧基衍生物。

HP:0033178.name: Increased circulating interleukin 8 concentration
HP:0033178.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-8 in the circulation.
HP:0033178.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素8浓度升高
HP:0033178.definition_cn: 循环中白细胞介素-8浓度升高。

HP:0033179.name: Elevated circulating aconitic acid concentration
HP:0033179.definition: Concentration of aconitic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033179.name_cn: 循环中乌头酸浓度升高
HP:0033179.definition_cn: 血液循环中乌头酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0033180.name: Torsion of appendix of testis
HP:0033180.definition: The appendix testis or hydatid of Morgagni, is a vestigial remnant of the M眉llerian duct located on the superior pole of the testicle between the testis and epididymis. Although this appendage has no vital function, it is present in 50% of males. Torsion of twisting of this vestigial remnant can be incredibly painful, but usually requires no medical intervention.
HP:0033180.definition_cn: 睾丸附件或莫尔加尼水囊，是位于睾丸与附睾之间睾丸上极的苗勒管遗迹。尽管此附件无重要功能，但存在于50%的男性中。该遗迹的扭转可能引起剧烈疼痛，但通常无需医疗干预。

HP:0033181.name: Spinal epidural abscess
HP:0033181.definition: Spinal epidural abscess (SEA) is caused by a suppurative infection in the epidural space. The mass effect of the abscess can compress and reduce blood flow to the spinal cord, conus medullaris, or cauda equina.
HP:0033181.definition_cn: 脊髓硬膜外脓肿（Spinal Epidural Abscess, SEA）是由硬膜外腔的化脓性感染引起的。脓肿的占位效应可压迫并减少脊髓、脊髓圆锥或马尾神经的血流。

HP:0033182.name: Increased circulating cathepsin D level
HP:0033182.definition: An increase in concentration of cathepsin D in the blood circulation.
HP:0033182.name_cn: 循环组织蛋白酶D水平升高
HP:0033182.definition_cn: 血液循环中组织蛋白酶D浓度升高。

HP:0033183.name: Bilobed right lung
HP:0033183.definition: A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only two lobes of the right lung.
HP:0033183.definition_cn: 右肺发育缺陷，表现为仅存在两叶肺。

HP:0033185.name: Triggered by EBV infection
HP:0033185.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by the Epstein-Barr virus.
HP:0033185.definition_cn: 适用于由爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒（Epstein-Barr virus）感染引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0033186.name: Misalignment of the pulmonary veins
HP:0033186.definition: The term is commonly used to describe a putative abnormal location of pulmonary vein branches adjacent to pulmonary arteries within the same adventitial sheath. However, evidence has been provided that the vessels in question are not pulmonary veins, however represent dilated bronchial veins.
HP:0033186.definition_cn: 该术语通常用于描述肺静脉分支与肺动脉在同一外膜鞘内相邻的假定异常位置。然而，已有证据表明，所涉及的血管并非肺静脉，而是扩张的支气管静脉。

HP:0033187.name: Hyperimidodipeptiduria
HP:0033187.definition: Elevated levels of proline-containing dipeptides in urine.
HP:0033187.definition_cn: 尿液中含脯氨酸二肽水平升高。

HP:0033188.name: Cystic acne
HP:0033188.definition: A severe type of acne characterized by the formation of cysts enclosing a mixture of keratin and sebum.
HP:0033188.definition_cn: 一种严重的痤疮类型，其特征为形成包裹角蛋白和皮脂混合物的囊肿。

HP:0033189.name: Radiculomegaly
HP:0033189.definition: Tooth root length more than 2 SD above mean, or subjectively apparently increased tooth root length.
HP:0033189.definition_cn: 牙根长度超过平均值2个标准差，或主观上明显增加的牙根长度。

HP:0033190.name: Hypertrichotic hyperpigmented patch
HP:0033190.definition: A large nonpalpable spot of the skin over 1 cm in dimension with increased pigmentation and increased hair growth.
HP:0033190.definition_cn: 皮肤上直径超过1厘米的不可触及的大面积色素沉着斑块，伴有毛发增生。

HP:0033191.name: Increased circulating selenium concentration
HP:0033191.definition: An increased concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.
HP:0033191.definition_cn: 血液循环中硒浓度升高。

HP:0033192.name: Decreased circulating selenium concentration
HP:0033192.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.
HP:0033192.definition_cn: 血液中硒浓度异常降低。

HP:0033193.name: Ballooning hepatocyte degeneration
HP:0033193.definition: Swelling of the hepatocyte, rounding of its contour, and alteration of the cytoplasm, which takes on a reticulated, rarefied, or flocculant quality. The cytoplasm of the ballooned hepatocytes often contains clumps of eosinophilic ropey material known as Mallory-Denk bodies (MDBs) or Mallory hyaline, which is composed of hyperphosphorylated misfolded intermediate filaments, ubiquitin, and ubiquitin-binding protein P62.
HP:0033193.definition_cn: 肝细胞肿胀，轮廓变圆，胞质发生改变，呈现网状、稀疏或絮状特征。气球样变的肝细胞胞质中常含有嗜酸性绳索状物质团块，称为Mallory-Denk小体（MDBs）或Mallory透明小体，其由过度磷酸化的错误折叠中间丝、泛素及泛素结合蛋白P62组成。

HP:0033194.name: Perioral erythema
HP:0033194.definition: Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the mouth.
HP:0033194.definition_cn: 口周红斑（由皮肤深层毛细血管充血引起的皮肤发红，局限于口周区域）。

HP:0033195.name: Perianal erythema
HP:0033195.definition: Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the anus.
HP:0033195.definition_cn: 肛周红斑（由于皮肤下层毛细血管充血引起的皮肤发红，局限于肛门周围区域）。

HP:0033196.name: Portal inflammation
HP:0033196.definition: Infiltration of portal fields by inflammatory cells.

HP:0033197.name: Hepatic lobular inflammation
HP:0033197.definition: Infiltration of inflammatory cells in lobules of the liver. A focus of lobular inflammation can be defined as two or more inflammatory cells (neutrophils, lymphocytes and other mononuclear cells, eosinophils and microgranulomas) within the lobule present within the sinusoids or surrounding injured hepatocytes (ballooned or apoptotic hepatocytes).
HP:0033197.definition_cn: 肝小叶内炎性细胞浸润。小叶炎症病灶可定义为肝小叶内窦状隙或受损肝细胞（气球样变或凋亡肝细胞）周围存在两个或更多炎性细胞（中性粒细胞、淋巴细胞及其他单核细胞、嗜酸性粒细胞及微肉芽肿）。

HP:0033198.name: Triggered by viral infection
HP:0033198.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by a virus.
HP:0033198.definition_cn: 适用于由病毒感染引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0033199.name: Increased circulating interleukin 10 concentration
HP:0033199.definition: An elevation of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.
HP:0033199.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素10浓度升高
HP:0033199.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素10浓度升高。

HP:0033200.name: Triceps hyporeflexia
HP:0033200.definition: Reduced intensity of the triceps tendon reflex.

HP:0033201.name: Biceps hyporeflexia
HP:0033201.definition: Reduced intensity of the biceps tendon reflex.
HP:0033201.definition_cn: 肱二头肌肌腱反射减弱。

HP:0033202.name: Brachioradialis hyporeflexia
HP:0033202.definition: Reduced intensity of the brachioradialis tendon reflex.
HP:0033202.definition_cn: 肱桡肌腱反射强度减弱。

HP:0033203.name: Brachioradialis hyperreflexia
HP:0033203.definition: Increased intensity of the brachioradialis reflex.

HP:0033204.name: Triceps hyperreflexia
HP:0033204.definition: Increased intensity of the triceps reflex.

HP:0033205.name: Biceps hyperreflexia
HP:0033205.definition: Increased intensity of the biceps reflex.

HP:0033206.name: Hyperactive Achilles reflex
HP:0033206.definition: Increased intensity of the Achilles reflex.

HP:0033207.name: Increased proportion autoreactive unresponsive CD21-/low B cells
HP:0033207.definition: Increased proportion relative to B-lymphocytes of a subset of B lymphocytes characterized by dim/low levels of CD21, i.e., CD21-/low, in flow cytometry, and additionally enriched in autoreactive clones as determined for instance by clonse showing rheumatoid factor (anti-IgG) reactivity and antibodies recognizing cytoplasmic and to a lesser extent nuclear structures.
HP:0033207.name_cn: 自反应性无应答CD21-/低B细胞比例增加
HP:0033207.definition_cn: 相对于B淋巴细胞，流式细胞术检测中CD21表达水平降低/低下的B淋巴细胞亚群（即CD21-/low）比例增加，并且该亚群在自身反应性克隆中富集，例如表现为类风湿因子（抗IgG）反应性的克隆，以及识别细胞质结构（在较小程度上识别核结构）的抗体。

HP:0033208.name: Alveolar capillary dysplasia
HP:0033208.definition: A developmental defect of the alveolar airspace during cananicular lung development characterized by a decreased number of pulmonary capillaries located away from the alveolar epithelium, thickened alveolar septae, media hypertrophy of small pulmonary arteries and muscularization of distal arterioles, and in some cases lymphangiectasis.
HP:0033208.name_cn: 肺泡毛细血管发育不良
HP:0033208.definition_cn: 肺泡气腔发育缺陷，表现为在肺小管发育阶段，远离肺泡上皮的肺毛细血管数量减少，肺泡间隔增厚，小肺动脉中膜肥厚及远端小动脉肌化，部分病例伴有淋巴管扩张。

HP:0033209.name: Acinar dysplasia
HP:0033209.definition: Arrest of lung development in the pseudoglandular stage (weeks 8 to 16 of human gestation) resulting in small sized lungs, predominantly composed of bronchial and bronchiolar structures embedded in abundant loose mesenchyme that is poorly vascularized. Acinar structures are essentially absent, with no significant formation of saccules and no alveoli.
HP:0033209.definition_cn: 肺发育停滞于假腺期（人类妊娠第8至16周），导致肺体积小，主要由嵌入丰富疏松间充质中的支气管和细支气管结构组成，间充质血管化不良。腺泡结构基本缺失，未见明显囊泡形成，且无肺泡发育。

HP:0033210.name: Congenital alveolar dysplasia
HP:0033210.definition: Arrest of lung development in the cananicular stage (weeks 18 to 26 of human gestation) resulting in simplified acinar spaces, frequently with abundant intervening mesenchyme and no alveoli. In later arrest growth stages early saccular formations may be seen. May resemble the lobular maldevelopment often seen in alveolar capillary dysplasia/misaligment of the pulmonary veins without vein misalignment or marked hypertensive changes of the pulmonary arteries.
HP:0033210.definition_cn: 肺发育停滞于小管期（人类妊娠第18至26周），导致腺泡空间简化，常伴有丰富的间质组织且无肺泡形成。在后期发育停滞阶段，可能观察到早期囊泡结构。此情况可能类似于肺泡毛细血管发育不良/肺静脉错位中常见的肺小叶发育不良，但无静脉错位或肺动脉显著高压性改变。

HP:0033211.name: Decreased total iron binding capacity
HP:0033211.definition: A reduction in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity.
HP:0033211.definition_cn: 总铁结合力（Total-Iron Binding Capacity, TIBC）的降低，该指标用于测量在加入过量放射性铁时血清铁的结合量。潜在（或游离）铁结合力是总铁结合力与实测血清铁之间的差值，对应于未与铁结合的转铁蛋白，即游离铁结合力。

HP:0033212.name: Abnormal total iron binding capacity
HP:0033212.definition: Any deviation from the normal total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added.
HP:0033212.definition_cn: 任何与正常总铁结合力（即当加入过量放射性铁时，血清铁结合量的测定值）的偏离。

HP:0033213.name: Elevated urine suberic acid level
HP:0033213.definition: The concentration of suberic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033213.definition_cn: 尿液中辛二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0033214.name: Recurrent viral pneumonia
HP:0033214.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral pneumonia, as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral pneumonias.
HP:0033214.definition_cn: 病毒性肺炎易感性增加，表现为反复发作的病毒性肺炎。

HP:0033215.name: Obliterative abnormality of the renal glomerulus

HP:0033216.name: Glomerular hyalinosis
HP:0033216.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus. Distribution can include vascular pole, perihilar, tip or neither tip, perihilar or vascular.
HP:0033216.definition_cn: 肾小球内无定形、嗜酸性、玻璃样、过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性、银染色阴性物质的积聚。分布可包括血管极、门周、顶端或既非顶端、门周也非血管极。

HP:0033217.name: Perihilar glomerular hyalinosis
HP:0033217.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the vascular pole/perihilum.
HP:0033217.name_cn: 门周肾小球玻璃样变性
HP:0033217.definition_cn: 在肾小球血管极/肾门处积聚无定形、嗜酸性、玻璃样、过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性、银染色阴性的物质。

HP:0033218.name: Glomerular hyalinosis at the tubular pole
HP:0033218.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the tip/tubular pole.
HP:0033218.name_cn: 肾小管极肾小球玻璃样变性
HP:0033218.definition_cn: 肾小球顶端/管极处无定形、嗜酸性、玻璃样、过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性、银染色阴性物质的积聚。

HP:0033219.name: Glomerular hyalinosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
HP:0033219.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at neither tip nor perihilar/vascular poles. Both the vascular and the tubular pole are present in the glomerular cross section.
HP:0033219.name_cn: 远离血管极和肾小管极的肾小球玻璃样变性
HP:0033219.definition_cn: 肾小球内非尖端、非门周/血管极区域出现无定形、嗜酸性、玻璃样、过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性、银染色阴性物质的沉积。肾小球横切面中可见血管极和管极均存在。

HP:0033220.name: 2-ethylhydracylic aciduria
HP:0033220.definition: An increased concentration of 2-ethylhydracylic acid in the urine.
HP:0033220.definition_cn: 尿液中2-乙基羟基乙酸浓度升高。

HP:0033221.name: Increased CD4:CD8 ratio
HP:0033221.definition: An abnormal elevation of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells.
HP:0033221.definition_cn: CD4+与CD8+ T细胞相对比例的异常升高。

HP:0033222.name: Decreased CD4:CD8 ratio
HP:0033222.definition: An abnormal reduction of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells.
HP:0033222.definition_cn: CD4+与CD8+ T细胞相对比例的异常降低。

HP:0033223.name: Abnormal glomerular parietal epithelial cell morphology
HP:0033223.definition: Any structural abnormality of the parietal epithelial cells that line the inside of Bowman's capsule and form an inconspicuous sheet of flat epithelial cells in continuity with the proximal tubular epithelial cells at the urinary pole and with the podocytes at the vascular pole.
HP:0033223.name_cn: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞形态异常
HP:0033223.definition_cn: 任何衬于鲍曼囊内侧的壁层上皮细胞的结构异常，这些细胞形成一层不明显的扁平上皮细胞层，在尿极与近端小管上皮细胞相连，在血管极与足细胞相连。

HP:0033224.name: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hyperplasia
HP:0033224.definition: Increased number of parietal epithelial cells lining Bowman's capsule. Hyperplasia leads to the cells being present in 2 or more layers, often with crowding and multilayering.
HP:0033224.name_cn: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞增生
HP:0033224.definition_cn: 鲍曼囊壁层上皮细胞数量增加。增生导致细胞呈现2层或更多层排列，常伴有拥挤和多层化现象。

HP:0033225.name: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hypertrophy
HP:0033225.definition: An abnormality of the glomerular parietal epithelial cells characterized by (1) Increased parietal epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets; or (2) enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. Both features can be present
HP:0033225.name_cn: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞肥大
HP:0033225.definition_cn: 肾小球壁层上皮细胞异常，其特征为：(1) 壁层上皮细胞体积增大，伴或不伴胞质内蛋白滴；(2) 核增大伴明显核仁。两种特征可同时存在。

HP:0033226.name: Bowman capsular hyaline drops
HP:0033226.definition: An insudative accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material protruding from Bowman's capsule into the urinary space. Although not always evident by light microscopy, this material is located between Bowman's capsule and the parietal epithelial cells, in some cases associated with newly formed matrix material.
HP:0033226.definition_cn: 一种无定形、嗜酸性、过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性、银染色阴性的渗出性物质，从鲍曼囊突入尿腔。尽管在光学显微镜下并不总是明显，这种物质位于鲍曼囊与壁层上皮细胞之间，在某些情况下与新形成的基质物质相关。

HP:0033227.name: Glomerular synechial adhesion
HP:0033227.definition: An area of basement membrane continuity between the glomerular tuft and Bowman's capsule, without intervening crescent and not adjacent to an area of segmental sclerosis.
HP:0033227.definition_cn: 肾小球丛与鲍曼囊之间的基底膜连续区域，无新月体介入且不邻近节段性硬化区域。

HP:0033228.name: Triceps areflexia
HP:0033228.definition: Inability to elicit triceps tendon reflex.
HP:0033228.definition_cn: 无法引出肱三头肌肌腱反射。

HP:0033229.name: Brachioradialis areflexia
HP:0033229.definition: Inability to elicit brachioradialis tendon reflex.
HP:0033229.definition_cn: 无法引出肱桡肌肌腱反射。

HP:0033230.name: Biceps areflexia
HP:0033230.definition: Inability to elicit biceps tendon reflex.
HP:0033230.definition_cn: 肱二头肌肌腱反射无法引出。

HP:0033231.name: Abnormal glomerular mesangial cellularity
HP:0033231.definition: Abnormal number of its constituent cells of the mesangium of the glomerulus of the kidney.
HP:0033231.name_cn: 肾小球系膜细胞异常增生
HP:0033231.definition_cn: 肾小球系膜组成细胞数量异常。

HP:0033232.name: Abnormal glomerular mesangial matrix morphology
HP:0033232.definition: Any structural anomaly of the glomerular matrix. Mesangial cells generate and embed in their own extracellular matrix. The mesangial matrix is different in composition from the glomerular basement membrane. Its constituents are type IV collagen (but only the alpha1 and alpha2 chains); type V collagen; laminin A, B1, and B2; and considerable amounts of fibronectin, heparan sulfate and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans, entactin, and nidogen. Furthermore, small amounts of the proteoglycans decorin and biglycan are found in the mesangial matrix.
HP:0033232.name_cn: 异常肾小球系膜基质形态
HP:0033232.definition_cn: 肾小球基质任何结构异常。系膜细胞生成并嵌入其自身的细胞外基质。系膜基质的组成与肾小球基底膜不同。其成分包括IV型胶原（但仅包含α1和α2链）、V型胶原、层粘连蛋白A、B1和B2，以及大量的纤维连接蛋白、硫酸乙酰肝素和硫酸软骨素蛋白聚糖、巢蛋白和巢蛋白样蛋白。此外，系膜基质中还含有少量的蛋白聚糖核心蛋白聚糖和双糖链蛋白聚糖。

HP:0033233.name: Paramesangial deposits
HP:0033233.definition: Mesangial immune deposit located adjacent to the paramesangial glomerular basement membrane.
HP:0033233.definition_cn: 系膜免疫沉积物位于副系膜肾小球基底膜附近。

HP:0033234.name: Mesangial hyaline deposition
HP:0033234.definition: Extracellular mesangial accumulation of moderately electron-dense, generally homogenous, amorphous-appearing extracellular material.
HP:0033234.definition_cn: 细胞外系膜区中等电子密度、通常均质、无定形外观的细胞外物质积聚。

HP:0033236.name: Cognitive fatigue
HP:0033236.definition: A failure to sustain attention that requires self-motivation to optimize performance.
HP:0033236.definition_cn: 无法维持需要自我激励以优化表现的注意力。

HP:0033237.name: Visceral epithelial cell detachment
HP:0033237.definition: Detachment of visceral epithelial cells (podocytes) from underlying glomerular basement membrane with intervening new loose basement membrane material (pale on Hematoxylin and eosin, periodic acid-Shiff, trichrome, or silver stain) forming a so-called 'halo'.
HP:0033237.definition_cn: 内脏上皮细胞（足细胞）从下方的肾小球基底膜脱离，其间有新的疏松基底膜物质（在苏木精和伊红、过碘酸-希夫、三色染色或银染色中呈淡色）形成所谓的“晕轮”。

HP:0033238.name: Podocyte microvillous transformation
HP:0033238.definition: Cytoplasmic projections into the urinary space from the luminal side of the podocyte.
HP:0033238.definition_cn: 从足细胞腔面向尿间隙延伸的细胞质突起。

HP:0033239.name: Visceral epithelial cell capping
HP:0033239.definition: Layer of hypertrophied visceral epithelial cells overlying a sclerosed segment of the tuft of the glomerulus.
HP:0033239.definition_cn: 肾小球丛硬化节段上方的肥大性脏层上皮细胞层。

HP:0033240.name: Elevated RV/TLC ratio
HP:0033240.definition: An increase in the ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and (3) body plethysmography. An elevated RV/TLC can be interpreted as a sign of air trapping and hyperinflation.
HP:0033240.name_cn: 右心室/总肺容量比值升高
HP:0033240.definition_cn: 肺功能检测中残气量（Residual Volume, RV）与肺总量（Total Lung Capacity, TLC）比值升高。残气量是指最大呼气后残留在肺内的气体量，肺总量是指最大吸气时肺内所含气体的总量。这些容积无法通过肺量计测定，但可通过惰性气体稀释法、氮气洗出法及体描法进行测量。RV/TLC比值升高可解读为气体潴留和肺过度充气的征象。

HP:0033241.name: Polyalveolar lobe
HP:0033241.definition: An elevation of the total count of alveoli as determined by microscopic point-counting of randomly taken lung sections, not secondary to abnormalities in number, size and structure of the airways. In polyaveolar lobe, the number of alveoli is generally increased three to fivefold.
HP:0033241.definition_cn: 通过随机取样的肺组织切片显微镜下点计数法测定，肺泡总数增加，且不继发于气道数量、大小和结构的异常。在多肺泡肺叶中，肺泡数量通常增加三至五倍。

HP:0033242.name: Horseshoe lung
HP:0033242.definition: A horseshoe lung is an uncommon congenital abnormality caused by the partial fusion of the bases of both lungs behind the pericardial sac.
HP:0033242.definition_cn: 马蹄肺是一种罕见的先天性畸形，由心包囊后方两侧肺基底部分融合所致。

HP:0033243.name: Pulmonary necrosis
HP:0033243.definition: Cellular death affecting one or more parts of the lung. Necrosis is caused by diverse external and internal factors which result in the unregulated digestion of cell components.
HP:0033243.definition_cn: 肺组织局部或广泛性细胞死亡。坏死由多种内外源性因素引起，导致细胞成分的失控性降解。

HP:0033244.name: Glycogen accumulation in pulmonary interstitial cells
HP:0033244.definition: Accumulation of immature interstitial cells containing abundant cytoplasmic glycogen defined by periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) positive cells.
HP:0033244.definition_cn: 含有丰富细胞质糖原的未成熟间质细胞积聚，这些细胞通过过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色呈阳性。

HP:0033245.name: Abnormal alveolar type II pneumocyte morphology
HP:0033245.definition: Any structural abnormality of alveolar type 2 (ATII) cells.
HP:0033245.name_cn: 异常肺泡Ⅱ型上皮细胞形态
HP:0033245.definition_cn: 肺泡Ⅱ型细胞（ATII细胞）的任何结构异常。

HP:0033246.name: Type II pneumocyte hypertrophy
HP:0033246.definition: Increase in size of type II pneumocytes, characterized by qualitative morphologic alterations, including cuboidal shapes, increased nucleocytoplasmic ratio, enlarged nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and various alterations in their nuclear chromatin.
HP:0033246.definition_cn: II型肺泡上皮细胞体积增大，其特征为形态学上的质变，包括立方体形状、核质比增加、核增大、核仁明显以及核染色质的多种改变。

HP:0033247.name: Pulmonary amyloidosis
HP:0033247.definition: Extracellular deposition in lung tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding.
HP:0033247.definition_cn: 肺组织中细胞外沉积的蛋白质样物质，经刚果红染色后在偏振光下呈现苹果绿双折射，经硫酸化阿尔新蓝染色后呈现特定颜色。电子显微镜下观察，淀粉样沉积物由β-片层纤维状物质组成。这些无分支的纤维直径为7.5至10纳米，是蛋白质错误折叠的结果。

HP:0033248.name: Multiple pulmonary interstitial hyalinized nodules
HP:0033248.definition: Fibrosing nodules, consisting of either unilateral or bilateral central whorled deposits of lamellar collagen hyalin.
HP:0033248.name_cn: 多发性肺间质玻璃样结节
HP:0033248.definition_cn: 纤维化结节，由单侧或双侧中心性层状胶原透明样沉积物构成。

HP:0033249.name: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintensity
HP:0033249.definition: Hyperintense lesion in the substantia nigra on magnetic resonance T2 imaging.
HP:0033249.definition_cn: 磁共振T2成像中黑质区高信号病变。

HP:0033250.name: Nailfold capillary tortuosity
HP:0033250.definition: An increased number of turns of the blood vessels of the nailfold with a charactereistic winded or twisted appearance of the blood vessels.
HP:0033250.definition_cn: 甲襞血管迂曲增多，呈现特征性蜿蜒或扭曲的血管形态。

HP:0033251.name: Elevated residual volume
HP:0033251.definition: Increase in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation.
HP:0033251.definition_cn: Increase in residual lung volume post-maximal expiration.

HP:0033252.name: Palmar hyperlinearity
HP:0033252.definition: Exaggerated skin markings (dermatoglyphics) on the palms of the hand.
HP:0033252.definition_cn: 手掌皮肤纹理（皮纹）过度明显。

HP:0033253.name: Reduced circulating interferon gamma concentration
HP:0033253.definition: A reduction in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.
HP:0033253.definition_cn: 循环血液中干扰素γ浓度降低。

HP:0033254.name: Anorectal stricture
HP:0033254.definition: Narrowing of the anorectum associated with inflammation or scar tissue.
HP:0033254.definition_cn: 肛门直肠狭窄伴炎症或瘢痕组织形成。

HP:0033255.name: Congenital lobar overinflation
HP:0033255.definition: A congenital malformation characterized by an overdistended segment of lung, affecting an party of a lobe or the entire one. It results in progressive overinflation of one or more lobes.
HP:0033255.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，其特征为肺段过度扩张，可累及部分肺叶或整个肺叶，导致一个或多个肺叶进行性过度充气。

HP:0033257.name: Delayed ability to walk with support
HP:0033257.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to walk with support (cruise) at an appropriate developmental stage.
HP:0033257.definition_cn: 在适当发育阶段未能获得扶走能力（巡航）。

HP:0033258.name: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
HP:0033258.definition: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) is a sudden, unexpected, witnessed or unwitnessed, non-traumatic and non-drowning death, occurring in benign circumstances, in an individual with epilepsy, with or without evidence for a seizure and excluding documented status epilepticus, in which postmortem examination has not revealed a cause of death.
HP:0033258.definition_cn: 癫痫猝死（SUDEP）是指在良性环境中，癫痫患者突然、意外、目击或非目击、非创伤性及非溺水性的死亡，可能伴有或不伴有癫痫发作的证据，且排除已记录的癫痫持续状态，尸检未发现明确死因。

HP:0033259.name: Non-motor seizure
HP:0033259.definition: A seizure with clinical manifestation but without motor signs (other than possible behavior arrest) as its initial clinical manifestation. The electrographic onset may be generalized, focal, or unknown.
HP:0033259.definition_cn: 以临床表现但无运动体征（除可能的行为停止外）作为初始临床表现的癫痫发作。其电生理学起始可为全面性、局灶性或未知。

HP:0033260.name: Livedo racemosa
HP:0033260.definition: Livedo racemosa describes a reddish-blue mottling of the skin in an irregular, reticular pattern. It differs from the more common livedo reticularis by its shape. Livedo racemosa consists of broken circular segments resulting in a seemingly larger pattern, as opposed to the fine, regular, complete network of livedo reticularis. Livedo racemosa results from permanent impairment of peripheral blood flow and, unlike livedo reticularis, it persists on warming.
HP:0033260.definition_cn: 网状青斑（Livedo racemosa）描述了一种皮肤呈现不规则网状的红蓝色斑驳。其形态与更为常见的网状青斑（Livedo reticularis）不同。网状青斑由断裂的环形片段组成，形成看似更大的图案，而网状青斑则表现为精细、规则且完整的网络。网状青斑是由于外周血流的永久性损害所致，与网状青斑不同，它在温暖环境下仍持续存在。

HP:0033261.name: Renal artery aneurysm
HP:0033261.definition: Increase in diameter of a segment of the renal artery that can be defined as a focal, isolated dilatation of all three layers of the arterial wall over 1.5 times the diameter of the disease-free proximal adjacent arterial segment.
HP:0033261.definition_cn: 肾动脉某节段直径增加，可定义为动脉壁全层局灶性、孤立性扩张，超过邻近无病变近端动脉节段直径的1.5倍。

HP:0033262.name: Transphyseal fracture of the distal humerus
HP:0033262.definition: A fracture through the distal humeral physis that separates the entire distal humeral epiphysis from the metaphysis.
HP:0033262.definition_cn: 肱骨远端骨骺骨折，导致整个肱骨远端骨骺与干骺端分离。

HP:0033263.name: Absent platelet dense granules
HP:0033263.definition: Lack of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelles.
HP:0033263.definition_cn: 血小板致密颗粒缺乏症，一种血小板细胞器缺陷。

HP:0033264.name: Enlarged platelet dense granules
HP:0033264.definition: Increased size of platelet dense granules.

HP:0033265.name: Podocyte myelin figures
HP:0033265.definition: Lamellated intracytoplasmic lipid inclusions within podocytes.
HP:0033265.definition_cn: 足细胞内层状胞质脂质包涵体。

HP:0033266.name: Glomerular pseudocrescent
HP:0033266.definition: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia with resulting cellular crowding of the the urinary space. In contrast with true crescents, these proliferations lack inflammatory cells and fibrin. The cells are typically plump (not spindle-shaped) and often vacuolated, and Bowman's capsule is usually intact.
HP:0033266.definition_cn: 内脏上皮细胞增生导致尿囊腔细胞拥挤。与真正的新月体相比，这些增生缺乏炎性细胞和纤维蛋白。细胞通常饱满（非梭形）且常呈空泡状，鲍曼囊通常完整。

HP:0033267.name: Abnormal glomerular capillary lumen morphology
HP:0033267.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the capillary of the renal glomerulus.
HP:0033267.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管腔形态异常
HP:0033267.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管内腔空间结构异常。

HP:0033268.name: Deflation of the glomerular tuft
HP:0033268.definition: Wrinkling and folding of the capillaries without epithelial cell (podocyte) hyperplasia (formerly called ischemic type of collapse) involving o 80% of the glomerular tuft. The wrinkling is generally made by small regular folds of the glomerular basement membrane.
HP:0033268.definition_cn: 毛细血管皱缩和折叠，无上皮细胞（足细胞）增生（既往称为缺血性塌陷），累及约80%的肾小球簇。皱缩通常由肾小球基底膜的小而规则的折叠引起。

HP:0033269.name: Glomerular capillary collapse
HP:0033269.definition: Collapse is generally accompanied by other descriptors such as hypertrophy and hyperplasia of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, halo, protein droplets in podocytes and glomerular parietal epithelial cells (PECs).
HP:0033269.definition_cn: 塌陷通常伴随其他描述性特征，如覆盖的肾小球上皮细胞的肥大和增生、晕轮、足细胞中的蛋白滴以及肾小球壁层上皮细胞（PECs）中的蛋白滴。

HP:0033270.name: Glomerular capillary congestion
HP:0033270.definition: Global distention of glomerular capillaries with intraluminal intact red blood cells.
HP:0033270.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管的全局性扩张，管腔内可见完整的红细胞。

HP:0033271.name: Glomerular capillary microaneurysm
HP:0033271.definition: Glomerular capillary dilatation due to loosening/detachment of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) from its anchoring points, usually in the context of mesangiolysis or nodular glomerulosclerosis.
HP:0033271.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管微动脉瘤
HP:0033271.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管扩张，由于肾小球基底膜（GBM）从其锚定点松解/脱离，通常发生在系膜溶解或结节性肾小球硬化的背景下。

HP:0033272.name: Abnormal glomerular endothelial cell morphology
HP:0033272.definition: An abnormal structure of the glomerular endothelial cells, which are highly specialized cells with fenestrae and a charged luminal glycocalyx layer that contribute to the filtration barrier.
HP:0033272.name_cn: 肾小球内皮细胞形态异常
HP:0033272.definition_cn: 肾小球内皮细胞结构异常，这些细胞具有高度特化的窗孔结构及带电荷的管腔糖萼层，共同构成滤过屏障。

HP:0033273.name: Loss of glomerular endothelial cell fenestration
HP:0033273.definition: Loss of round to oval discontinuities normally present in the glomerular capillary endothelial cell cytoplasm.
HP:0033273.name_cn: 肾小球内皮细胞窗孔丧失
HP:0033273.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管内皮细胞胞质中正常存在的圆形至椭圆形不连续性的丧失。

HP:0033274.name: Glomerular endotheliosis
HP:0033274.definition: Enlargement of glomerular endothelial cells by cytoplasmic swelling with resulting partial or complete occlusion of the lumen.
HP:0033274.definition_cn: 肾小球内皮细胞因胞质肿胀而增大，导致管腔部分或完全闭塞。

HP:0033275.name: Glomerular endothelial tubuloreticular inclusion
HP:0033275.definition: Inter-anastomosing tubular structures located within cisternae of endoplasmic reticulum, most often within endothelial cells and associated with exposure to interferon.
HP:0033275.name_cn: 肾小球内皮细胞管状网状包涵体
HP:0033275.definition_cn: 位于内质网池内的相互吻合的管状结构，最常见于内皮细胞内，并与干扰素暴露相关。

HP:0033276.name: obsolete Glomerular endocapillary hypercellularity
HP:0033276.name_cn: 陈旧的肾小球毛细血管内细胞增多

HP:0033277.name: Glomerular fibrinoid necrosis
HP:0033277.definition: Fibrin associated with glomerular basement membrane disruption and/or lysis of the mesangial matrix; this lesion does not require the presence of karyorrhexis.
HP:0033277.name_cn: 肾小球纤维蛋白样坏死
HP:0033277.definition_cn: 纤维蛋白与肾小球基底膜破坏和/或系膜基质溶解相关；该病变无需核碎裂的存在。

HP:0033278.name: Reduced CD95-induced lymphocyte apoptosis
HP:0033278.definition: Reduced amount of programmed cell death in peripheral blood lymphocytes following exposure to CD95 (APO-1/Fas), which is a member of the death receptor family, a subfamily of the TNF-R superfamily. Crosslinking of CD95 with its natural ligand CD95L (CD178) or with agonistic antibodies such as anti-APO-1 induces apoptosis in sensitive cells.
HP:0033278.name_cn: CD95诱导的淋巴细胞凋亡减少
HP:0033278.definition_cn: 外周血淋巴细胞在暴露于CD95（APO-1/Fas）后，程序性细胞死亡的数量减少。CD95是死亡受体家族的成员，属于TNF-R超家族的一个亚家族。CD95与其天然配体CD95L（CD178）或激动性抗体（如抗APO-1）的交联可诱导敏感细胞发生凋亡。

HP:0033279.name: Enterocutaneous fistula
HP:0033279.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the intra-abdominal intestinal tract and the skin.
HP:0033279.definition_cn: 腹内肠道与皮肤之间的异常连接（瘘管）。

HP:0033280.name: Paratracheal lymphadenopathy
HP:0033280.definition: Enlargement of lymph nodes surrounding the trachea.

HP:0033281.name: Circulating nucleated red blood cells
HP:0033281.definition: The presence of nucleated red blood cells in the peripheral blood circulation.
HP:0033281.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中存在有核红细胞。

HP:0033282.name: Abnormal glomerular basement membrane morphology
HP:0033282.definition: Any abnormal sttructure of the glomerular basement membrane.
HP:0033282.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜形态异常
HP:0033282.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜的任何异常结构。

HP:0033283.name: Segmentally thickened glomerular basement membrane
HP:0033283.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a segmental and increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.
HP:0033283.name_cn: 节段性增厚的肾小球基底膜
HP:0033283.definition_cn: 显著的肾小球基底膜（GBM）显示节段性增厚（主观估计），电子显微镜下未见电子致密物沉积。增厚从内皮细胞到脏层上皮细胞质膜进行测量，主要归因于致密层厚度的增加，通常总体厚度超过健康年龄和性别匹配个体正常平均GBM厚度的2个标准差以上。

HP:0033284.name: Diffusely thickened glomerular basement membrane
HP:0033284.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.
HP:0033284.name_cn: 弥漫性增厚的肾小球基底膜
HP:0033284.definition_cn: 显著的肾小球基底膜（GBM）表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的增厚（主观估计），电子显微镜下未见电子致密物沉积。增厚从内皮细胞到脏层上皮细胞质膜进行测量，主要归因于致密层厚度的增加，通常总体厚度超过健康年龄和性别匹配个体正常平均GBM厚度的2个标准差以上。

HP:0033285.name: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with no electron dense deposits
HP:0033285.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by electron microscopy.
HP:0033285.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜增厚，未见电子致密物沉积
HP:0033285.definition_cn: 显著的肾小球基底膜（GBM）增厚（主观估计），电子显微镜下未见电子致密物沉积。

HP:0033286.name: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with electron dense deposits
HP:0033286.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜增厚伴电子致密物沉积

HP:0033287.name: Glomerular basement membrane lucencies
HP:0033287.definition: Lucent zones within the glomerular basement membranes. May reflect remote/resolved deposits.
HP:0033287.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜内的透亮区。可能反映既往/已消退的沉积物。

HP:0033289.name: Glomerular basement membrane wrinkling
HP:0033289.definition: Irregular folding of the glomerular basement membrane with an intact lamina densa.
HP:0033289.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜不规则折叠伴致密层完整。

HP:0033290.name: Glomerular subendothelial widening
HP:0033290.definition: Expansion of the space between the glomerular endothelium and lamina densa by electron-lucent material.
HP:0033290.definition_cn: 肾小球内皮与致密层之间间隙因电子透明物质而扩张。

HP:0033291.name: Glomerular karyhorrhectic debris
HP:0033291.definition: Apoptotic, pyknotic, and fragmented nuclei within the glomerulus.
HP:0033291.definition_cn: 肾小球内凋亡、固缩及碎裂的细胞核。

HP:0033292.name: Glomerular fibrin thrombus
HP:0033292.definition: An aggregate of coagulated blood containing fibrin, with or without entrapped cellular elements, within a glomerular capillary lumen.
HP:0033292.definition_cn: 肾小球毛细血管腔内含有纤维蛋白的凝固血液聚集体，可伴有或不伴有被捕获的细胞成分。

HP:0033293.name: Glomerular hyaline pseudothrombus
HP:0033293.definition: Intracapillary amorphous, eosinophilic material consisting of immune deposits.
HP:0033293.definition_cn: 毛细血管内无定形嗜酸性物质，由免疫沉积物组成。

HP:0033294.name: Glomerular lipoprotein thrombus
HP:0033294.definition: Intracapillary silver-positive material that is finely vacuolated and laminated, and stains with oil red O on frozen sections.
HP:0033294.definition_cn: 毛细血管内银染色阳性物质，呈细小的空泡状和层状结构，在冰冻切片上可被油红O染色。

HP:0033295.name: Mesangial Immune complex deposition
HP:0033295.definition: Extracellular meangial accumulation of finely granular material corresponding to immunoglobulin and/or complement by immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry; most typically electron-dense although this may decrease with resorption of the deposit.
HP:0033295.definition_cn: 免疫荧光/免疫组织化学显示细胞外系膜区细颗粒状物质沉积，对应免疫球蛋白和/或补体；电镜下通常表现为电子致密物，但随着沉积物的吸收，其致密性可能降低。

HP:0033296.name: Binucleated visceral epithelial cells
HP:0033296.definition: Visceral epithelial cells with 2 nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.
HP:0033296.definition_cn: 双核内脏上皮细胞。可通过光学显微镜或超微结构显微镜观察。

HP:0033297.name: Multinucleated visceral epithelial cells
HP:0033297.definition: Visceral epithelial cells with more than two nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.
HP:0033297.definition_cn: 多核内脏上皮细胞。可通过光学显微镜或超微结构显微镜观察。

HP:0033298.name: Abnormal circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration
HP:0033298.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration in blood of factor H-related protein 1 (FHR-1)
HP:0033298.name_cn: 异常循环补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度
HP:0033298.definition_cn: 血液中因子H相关蛋白1（FHR-1）浓度偏离正常值

HP:0033299.name: Reduced circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration
HP:0033299.definition: Decreased level of circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration in the blood circulation.
HP:0033299.name_cn: 循环补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度降低
HP:0033299.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度水平降低。

HP:0033300.name: Increased circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration
HP:0033300.definition: Elevated level of circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration in the blood circulation.
HP:0033300.name_cn: 循环补体因子H相关蛋白1浓度升高
HP:0033300.definition_cn: 循环补体因子H相关蛋白1（Complement Factor H-Related Protein 1, CFHR1）浓度在血液循环中升高。

HP:0033301.name: Elevated circulating 1-methylhistidine concentration
HP:0033301.definition: An abnormally increased level of 1-methylhistidine in the blood circulation. 1-methylhistidine is a derivative of L-histidine.
HP:0033301.name_cn: 循环中1-甲基组氨酸浓度升高
HP:0033301.definition_cn: 血液循环中1-甲基组氨酸水平异常升高。1-甲基组氨酸是L-组氨酸的衍生物。

HP:0033302.name: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid concentration
HP:0033302.definition: The concentration of 4-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033302.name_cn: 循环中4-羟基苯乙酸浓度升高
HP:0033302.definition_cn: 血液循环中4-羟基苯乙酸的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0033303.name: Elevated urinary monocarboxylic acid level
HP:0033303.definition: Abnormally increased amount of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine. Monocarboxylic acids are molecules with one COOH functional group.
HP:0033303.definition_cn: 尿液中单羧酸异常增多。单羧酸是含有一个羧基（COOH）官能团的分子。

HP:0033304.name: obsolete Elevated urine 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid level
HP:0033304.name_cn: 过时的尿4-羟基苯乙酸水平升高

HP:0033305.name: Abnormal circulating fetuin A concentration
HP:0033305.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of fetuin A in the blood circulation.
HP:0033305.name_cn: 异常循环胎球蛋白A浓度
HP:0033305.definition_cn: 血液中胎球蛋白A（Fetuin A）浓度与正常值的任何偏离。

HP:0033306.name: Decreased circulating fetuin A concentration
HP:0033306.definition: A reduction below normal of fetuin A in the blood circulation.
HP:0033306.name_cn: 循环胎球蛋白A浓度降低
HP:0033306.definition_cn: 循环血液中胎球蛋白A水平低于正常值。

HP:0033307.name: Increased circulating fetuin A concentration
HP:0033307.definition: An elevation above normal of fetuin A in the blood circulation.
HP:0033307.name_cn: 循环中胎球蛋白A浓度升高
HP:0033307.definition_cn: 循环血液中胎球蛋白A水平升高。

HP:0033309.name: Ileoileal intussusception
HP:0033309.definition: A type of intussusception of the small intestine in which one part of the ileum invaginates (telescopes) into another part of the ileum.
HP:0033309.definition_cn: 一种小肠套叠类型，其中回肠的一部分内陷（套叠）进入回肠的另一部分。

HP:0033310.name: Osmotic diarrhea
HP:0033310.definition: Osmotic diarrhea results from the presence of osmotically active, poorly absorbed solutes in the bowel lumen that inhibit normal water and electrolyte absorption.
HP:0033310.definition_cn: 渗透性腹泻是由于肠腔内存在具有渗透活性的、难以吸收的溶质，抑制了正常的水分和电解质吸收所致。

HP:0033311.name: Abdominal aortic dissection
HP:0033311.definition: A tear in the intimal layer of the abdominal aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers.
HP:0033311.definition_cn: 腹主动脉内膜层撕裂导致内膜与中膜层分离。

HP:0033312.name: Abnormal Bowman space morphology
HP:0033312.definition: Structural anomaly located in Bowman's space, which represents the beginning of the urinary space and is contiguous with the proximal convoluted tubule of the nephron.
HP:0033312.definition_cn: 鲍曼囊腔内存在结构异常，该腔隙为尿路空间的起始部分，并与肾单位的近曲小管相连续。

HP:0033313.name: Urinary space collagenization
HP:0033313.definition: Acellular collagenous matrix within Bowman's space, not associated with extracapillary hypercellularity or necrosis, associated with sclerosis or deflation of the tuft.
HP:0033313.definition_cn: 鲍曼囊腔内无细胞胶原基质，未见毛细血管外细胞增生或坏死，伴有肾小球丛硬化或塌陷。

HP:0033314.name: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia
HP:0033314.definition: Increased number of visceral epithelial cells (2 or more layers), often with crowding and multilayering, but without continuity with the parietal epithelium.
HP:0033314.definition_cn: 内脏上皮细胞数量增多（2层或以上），常伴有拥挤和多层化，但与壁层上皮无连续性。

HP:0033315.name: Visceral epithelial hyaline droplets
HP:0033315.definition: Round to ovoid, Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, fuchsinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions within visceral epithelial cells.
HP:0033315.definition_cn: 圆形至卵圆形，过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性，嗜品红胞质包涵体位于内脏上皮细胞内。

HP:0033316.name: Glomerular crescent formation
HP:0033316.definition: Glomerular crescent refers hyperplastic lesions involving 10% or more of the circumference of Bowman's capsule. Crescents can be composed of a variable mixture of epithelial/leukocyte hypercellularity, fibrous matrix, and fibrin.
HP:0033316.definition_cn: 肾小球新月体是指涉及鲍曼囊周径10%或以上的增生性病变。新月体可由上皮细胞/白细胞增生、纤维基质和纤维蛋白的不同比例混合组成。

HP:0033317.name: Cellular crescent
HP:0033317.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of greater than two cell layers and involving more than 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of greater than 75% cells with or without fibrin, and less than 25% fibrous matrix.
HP:0033317.definition_cn: 一种肾小球新月体类型，其特征为超过两层细胞的毛细血管外细胞增生，累及超过10%的肾小囊周径，由超过75%的细胞组成，伴或不伴纤维蛋白，且纤维基质少于25%。

HP:0033318.name: Fibrocellular crescent
HP:0033318.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of more than 2 cell layers and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of 25% to 75% cells with or without fibrin, and the remainder fibrous matrix.
HP:0033318.definition_cn: 一种肾小球新月体类型，其特征为超过2层细胞的毛细血管外细胞增生，累及超过10%的囊周，由25%至75%的细胞组成，伴或不伴纤维蛋白，其余为纤维基质。

HP:0033319.name: Fibrous crescent
HP:0033319.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary fibrosis composed of greater than 75% matrix and of less than 25% cells with or without fibrin, usually associated with disruption of Bowman's capsule and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference.
HP:0033319.definition_cn: 一种肾小球新月体类型，其特征为超过75%的基质和少于25%的细胞组成的毛细血管外纤维化，伴或不伴纤维蛋白，通常与鲍曼囊破裂相关，并累及超过10%的囊周。

HP:0033320.name: Mesangial cell loss
HP:0033320.definition: Loss of mesangial cells segmentally or globally.
HP:0033320.definition_cn: 节段性或全局性系膜细胞丧失。

HP:0033321.name: Glomerular obsolescence
HP:0033321.definition: Globally sclerotic glomeruli are that are small and without hyalinosis and may appear with collapse of the tuft with collagenization of the urinary space. Bowman's capsule is completely or partially absent and there is no periglomerular fibrosis and glomerular size is decreased by more than 50% compared to all other glomeruli in the same biopsy. Obsolescent glomeruli may appear to be receding into the interstitium.
HP:0033321.definition_cn: 全球硬化性肾小球表现为体积缩小且无透明变性，可能伴有肾小球丛塌陷及尿囊腔胶原化。鲍曼囊完全或部分缺失，且无肾小球周围纤维化，肾小球体积较同一活检标本中其他肾小球缩小超过50%。废弃肾小球可能表现为向间质退缩。

HP:0033322.name: Glomerular capillary wall duplication without cellular interposition
HP:0033322.definition: Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix, with or without endocapillary hypercellularity and no evidence of interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.
HP:0033322.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管壁复层化，无细胞插入
HP:0033322.definition_cn: 原始肾小球基底膜（GBM）的双轮廓/覆盖的基底膜基质的附加层，伴或不伴毛细血管内细胞增多，且在原始GBM和新形成的GBM层之间无插入的迁移细胞（系膜细胞、内皮细胞、单核细胞）证据。

HP:0033323.name: Glomerular capillary wall duplication with cellular interposition
HP:0033323.definition: Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix with interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.
HP:0033323.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管壁增厚伴细胞插入
HP:0033323.definition_cn: 原始肾小球基底膜（GBM）的双层轮廓/覆盖的基底膜基质附加层，在原始GBM和新形成的GBM层之间插入迁移的细胞（系膜细胞、内皮细胞、单核细胞）。

HP:0033324.name: Elevated circulating homovanillic acid concentration
HP:0033324.definition: The concentration of homovanillic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033324.name_cn: 循环中高香草酸浓度升高
HP:0033324.definition_cn: 血液循环中高香草酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033325.name: Elevated circulating sebacic acid concentration
HP:0033325.definition: Increased concentration of sebacic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0033325.name_cn: 循环中癸二酸浓度升高
HP:0033325.definition_cn: 血液循环中癸二酸浓度升高。

HP:0033326.name: Elevated circulating hydroxyphenlyllactic acid concentration
HP:0033326.definition: An increased concentration of 4-hydroxyphenlyllactic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0033326.name_cn: 循环中羟基苯基乳酸浓度升高
HP:0033326.definition_cn: 血液循环中4-羟基苯乳酸浓度升高。

HP:0033327.name: Nail psoriasis
HP:0033327.definition: Psoriatic nail abnormality characterized by the presence of neutrophils in the nail bed epithelium, hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, presence of exudates on the corneal epithelium, focal hypogranulosis and psoriasiform hyperplasia of the nail bed.
HP:0033327.definition_cn: 银屑病甲异常，其特征为甲床上皮中存在中性粒细胞，角化过度伴角化不全，角膜上皮上存在渗出物，局灶性颗粒层减少以及甲床的银屑病样增生。

HP:0033328.name: Type II pneumocyte hyperplasia
HP:0033328.definition: Increase in the number of type II pneumocytes.
HP:0033328.definition_cn: II型肺泡上皮细胞数量增加。

HP:0033329.name: Abnormal postural reflex
HP:0033329.definition: Anomaly of the physiological response to maintain the body's posture when movement and position is altered.
HP:0033329.definition_cn: 运动与体位改变时维持身体姿势的生理反应异常。

HP:0033330.name: Impaired neck-righting reflex
HP:0033330.definition: Abnormal neck-righting response, which is said to be a physiological response when a child is placed flat on his or her back and the head is turned 90 degrees to the right or the left. With a normal neck-righting response, there follows a reflected torsion of the vertebral column in the same direction as the induced rotation of the neck. That is, the whole body follows the direction in which the head was turned. The response is present from birth to the age of five years.
HP:0033330.definition_cn: 颈部矫正反应异常，这是一种生理反应，当儿童仰卧平躺时，将其头部向右或向左旋转90度。在正常的颈部矫正反应中，脊柱会随之发生与颈部诱导旋转方向相同的反射性扭转。即，整个身体会跟随头部转动的方向。该反应从出生至五岁期间存在。

HP:0033331.name: Acute phase response
HP:0033331.definition: Presence of one or more manifestations of the acute phase response. Acute phase proteins (APP) are blood proteins primarily synthesized by hepatocytes as part of the acute phase response (APR). The APR is part of the early-defense or innate immune system, which is triggered by different stimuli including trauma, infection, stress, neoplasia, and inflammation. The APR results in a complex systemic reaction with the goal of reestablishing homeostasis and promoting healing.
HP:0033331.definition_cn: 存在一种或多种急性期反应表现。急性期蛋白（Acute Phase Proteins, APP）是由肝细胞主要合成的血液蛋白，作为急性期反应（Acute Phase Response, APR）的一部分。急性期反应是早期防御或先天免疫系统的一部分，由多种刺激因素触发，包括创伤、感染、应激、肿瘤形成和炎症。急性期反应导致复杂的全身性反应，旨在重建内环境稳态并促进愈合。

HP:0033332.name: Elevated circulating amyloid A concentration
HP:0033332.definition: The concentration of serum amyloid A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033332.name_cn: 循环淀粉样蛋白A浓度升高
HP:0033332.definition_cn: 血清淀粉样蛋白A在血液循环中的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0033333.name: Jaw contracture
HP:0033333.definition: Limitation of motion of the jaw due to structural changes in a muscle such as the massseter responsible for jaw movement.
HP:0033333.definition_cn: 由于负责下颌运动的肌肉（如咬肌）发生结构性改变而导致的下颌运动受限。

HP:0033334.name: Abnormal embryonic development
HP:0033334.definition: An anomaly in the development of the embryo, that is, of the early developmental stage of development that follows the fertilization of an egg by sperm.
HP:0033334.definition_cn: 胚胎发育异常，即受精卵形成后早期发育阶段的发育异常。

HP:0033335.name: Abnormal preimplantation embryonic development
HP:0033335.definition: An anomaly in the development of the embryo in a stage prior to implantation.
HP:0033335.definition_cn: 植入前阶段胚胎发育异常。

HP:0033336.name: Zygotic cleavage failure
HP:0033336.definition: Failure of a fertilized oocyte to undergo the first round of cell division.
HP:0033336.definition_cn: 受精卵未能进行第一次细胞分裂。

HP:0033337.name: Abnormal gametogenesis
HP:0033337.definition: An anomaly in the process by a a haploid cell is formed from a diploid cells through meiosis. In males, diploid spermatogonia produce two haploid cells (secondary spermatocytes) in meiosis I and four haploid spermatids in meiosis II. In females, primordial germ cells under meiosis II before birth to form primary oocytes. Once puberty cell begins, these cells form secondary oocytes through meiosis II.
HP:0033337.definition_cn: 在二倍体细胞通过减数分裂形成单倍体细胞的过程中出现异常。在男性中，二倍体的精原细胞在减数分裂I中产生两个单倍体细胞（次级精母细胞），在减数分裂II中产生四个单倍体的精子细胞。在女性中，原始生殖细胞在出生前进行减数分裂II形成初级卵母细胞。一旦青春期开始，这些细胞通过减数分裂II形成次级卵母细胞。

HP:0033338.name: Abnormal female meiosis
HP:0033338.definition_cn: 异常卵母细胞减数分裂

HP:0033339.name: Increased circulating inosine concentration
HP:0033339.definition: An increased concentration of inosine in the blood circulation.

HP:0033340.name: Increased circulating guanosine concentration
HP:0033340.definition: Increased concentration of guanosine in the blood circulation.

HP:0033341.name: Elevated circulating sitosterol concentration
HP:0033341.definition: An increased concentration of beta-sitosterol in the blood circulation.
HP:0033341.definition_cn: 血液循环中β-谷甾醇浓度升高。

HP:0033342.name: Anti-aquaporin 4 antibody positivity
HP:0033342.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against aquaporin-4.
HP:0033342.name_cn: 抗水通道蛋白4抗体阳性
HP:0033342.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对水通道蛋白-4（aquaporin-4）的自身体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。
