HP:0033343.name: Mucoid diarrhea
HP:0033343.definition: Passage of an increased number of stools containing mucus, a thick fluid substance secreted by mucous membranes.
HP:0033343.definition_cn: 排便次数增加，粪便中含有黏液，即由黏膜分泌的黏稠液体物质。

HP:0033344.name: Pleural cobblestoning
HP:0033344.definition: A pleural cobblestone appearance characterized by irregular bumps surrounded by depressed lines in open lung biopsy. Caused by underlying scarring causing retraction of the interlobular septa where they insert on the pleura.
HP:0033344.definition_cn: 胸膜鹅卵石样外观，表现为开胸肺活检中不规则隆起被凹陷线环绕。其原因为基础瘢痕形成导致小叶间隔在胸膜附着处回缩。

HP:0033345.name: Neuralgia
HP:0033345.definition: Pain (An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience) along the course of a nerve.
HP:0033345.definition_cn: 神经痛（沿神经走行的不愉快感觉和情绪体验）

HP:0033346.name: Psychic epileptic aura
HP:0033346.definition: Aura with affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual phenomena including illusory or composite hallucinatory events.
HP:0033346.definition_cn: 伴有情感性、记忆性或复合性感知现象的先兆，包括错觉性或复合性幻觉事件。

HP:0033347.name: Cognitive epileptic aura
HP:0033347.definition: A purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to altered cognition.
HP:0033347.definition_cn: 癫痫发作的纯粹主观表现，涉及认知改变。

HP:0033348.name: Epileptic aura
HP:0033348.definition: An epileptic aura is a purely subjective clinical manifestation of an epileptic seizure. If an epileptic aura is not followed by loss of awareness or propagation to a bilateral tonic-clonic seizure then it is a type of focal aware non-motor seizure.
HP:0033348.definition_cn: 癫痫先兆是癫痫发作的一种纯粹主观的临床表现。如果癫痫先兆未伴随意识丧失或未进展为双侧强直-阵挛性发作，则其属于局灶性意识清醒非运动性发作的一种类型。

HP:0033349.name: Seizure cluster
HP:0033349.definition: A fourfold or greater increase of usual seizure frequency within a 3-day period, where the patient demonstrates full recovery between seizure events within the cluster. The seizure cluster should be recognizable by the primary clinician, carer or patient.
HP:0033349.definition_cn: 在3天期间内，癫痫发作频率增加至通常的四倍或以上，且患者在发作群集期间各次发作事件之间表现出完全恢复。该癫痫发作群集应由主治医师、护理人员或患者本人识别。

HP:0033350.name: Elevated forced expiratory volume in one second
HP:0033350.definition: An increase in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second, compared to some standard or previous measure of same subject.
HP:0033350.definition_cn: 一秒用力呼气量（FEV1）的增加，相较于同一受试者的标准值或先前测量值。

HP:0033351.name: Candida esophagitis
HP:0033351.definition: Candida infections of the esophagus are considered opportunistic infections and are seen most commonly in immunosuppressed patients, the most common symptoms being dysphagia, odynophagia, and retrosternal pain.
HP:0033351.definition_cn: 食管念珠菌感染被视为机会性感染，最常见于免疫抑制患者，其主要症状包括吞咽困难、吞咽痛以及胸骨后疼痛。

HP:0033352.name: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis
HP:0033352.definition: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis involves sudden and potentially lethal increases in PAP and PVR that cause acute rise in right atrial and right ventricular end-diastolic pressure accompanied by low cardiac output.
HP:0033352.definition_cn: 肺动脉高压危象涉及肺动脉压（PAP）和肺血管阻力（PVR）的突然且可能致命的升高，导致右心房和右心室舒张末期压力急剧上升，并伴有低心输出量。

HP:0033353.name: Abnormal blood vessel morphology
HP:0033353.definition: Any structural anomaly of a blood vessel (artery, arteriole, capillary, venule, or vein).
HP:0033353.definition_cn: 血管（动脉、小动脉、毛细血管、小静脉或静脉）的任何结构异常。

HP:0033354.name: Abnormal urine metabolite level
HP:0033354.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a metabolite in urine.
HP:0033354.definition_cn: 尿液中代谢物含量的任何异常。

HP:0033355.name: Increased urine deoxypyridinoline level
HP:0033355.definition: An increased level of deoxypyridinoline in the urine. Deoxypyridinoline is a crosslink product of collagen molecules found in bone and excreted in urine during bone degradation, has been described as a marker of bone turnover.
HP:0033355.name_cn: 尿脱氧吡啶啉水平升高
HP:0033355.definition_cn: 尿液中脱氧吡啶啉水平升高。脱氧吡啶啉是骨胶原分子交联产物，在骨降解过程中随尿液排出，已被描述为骨转换的标志物。

HP:0033356.name: Elevated circulating o-phosphoserine concentration
HP:0033356.definition: An abnormally increased level of o-phosphoserine in the blood circulation. o-phosphoserine is a derivative of serine.
HP:0033356.name_cn: 循环中O-磷酸丝氨酸浓度升高
HP:0033356.definition_cn: 血液循环中O-磷酸丝氨酸水平异常升高。O-磷酸丝氨酸是丝氨酸的衍生物。

HP:0033357.name: Limited head rotation
HP:0033357.definition: Reduced range of motion turning the head side to side.
HP:0033357.definition_cn: 头部侧向旋转活动度受限。

HP:0033358.name: Abnormal urine osmolality
HP:0033358.definition: A deviation from the normal range of concentration of particles in urine.
HP:0033358.definition_cn: 尿液颗粒浓度偏离正常范围。

HP:0033359.name: Hyperosthenuria
HP:0033359.definition: An abnormally high urinary specific gravity, i.e., increased concentration of solutes in the urine.
HP:0033359.definition_cn: 尿比重异常增高，即尿液溶质浓度升高。

HP:0033360.name: Impaired ability to shift attention
HP:0033360.definition: A behavioral abnormality whereby a person is unable to move freely from one situation, activity or aspect of aa problem to another as circumstances demand. Key aspects of shifting include the ability to make transitions, problem solve flexibly, switch or alternate attention, and change focus from one mind-set or topic to another. Mild deficits in the ability to shift compromise the efficiency of problem solving, whereas more severe difficulties are reflected in perseverative behaviors. Sometimes this is described as being rigid or inflexible.
HP:0033360.definition_cn: 一种行为异常，表现为个体无法根据情境需求自由地从一种情境、活动或问题的某一方面转换到另一方面。转换能力的关键方面包括进行过渡的能力、灵活解决问题的能力、切换或交替注意力的能力，以及从一种思维模式或话题转换到另一种的能力。转换能力的轻度损害会降低问题解决的效率，而更严重的困难则表现为持续行为。有时这被描述为僵化或不灵活。

HP:0033361.name: Nasal ulcer
HP:0033361.definition: An open sore of the nasal mucosa.

HP:0033362.name: Recurrent coughing spasms
HP:0033362.definition: Repeated occurrence of episodes of coughing, with each episode consisting of at least five minutes of continuous coughing.
HP:0033362.definition_cn: 反复发作的咳嗽发作，每次发作至少持续五分钟的连续性咳嗽。

HP:0033363.name: Hyaline membranes
HP:0033363.definition: Hyaline membranes are homogeneous eosinophilic material composed of cellular debris, plasma proteins, and surfactant plastered against alveolar ducts and alveolar walls. The hyaline membranes are deposited along the walls of the alveoli, where gas exchange typically occurs, thereby making gas exchange difficult.
HP:0033363.definition_cn: 透明膜是由细胞碎片、血浆蛋白和表面活性物质组成的均匀嗜酸性物质，附着于肺泡管和肺泡壁上。透明膜沉积在通常进行气体交换的肺泡壁上，从而导致气体交换困难。

HP:0033364.name: Lipoid pneumonia
HP:0033364.definition: A specific form of lung inflammation that results from accumulation of lipids in the alveoli. Lipoid pneumonia can be either exogenous or endogenous in cause based on the source of the lipid.
HP:0033364.definition_cn: 一种特定类型的肺部炎症，由肺泡内脂质积聚引起。根据脂质来源的不同，脂质性肺炎可分为外源性和内源性两种类型。

HP:0033365.name: Endogenous lipoid pneumonia
HP:0033365.definition: A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is the body itself. When an airway is obstructed, it is often the case that distal to the obstruction, lipid-laden macrophages and giant cells fill the lumen of the disconnected airspace.
HP:0033365.definition_cn: 一种脂质性肺炎，其脂质来源为机体自身。当气道发生阻塞时，阻塞远端常可见充满脂质的巨噬细胞和巨细胞填充于孤立的气腔腔内。

HP:0033366.name: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia
HP:0033366.definition: A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is external to the body.
HP:0033366.definition_cn: 一种脂质性肺炎，其脂质来源为外源性。

HP:0033367.name: Orthodeoxia
HP:0033367.definition: Low level of blood oxygen induced by changing from a recumbent to an upright position.
HP:0033367.definition_cn: 从卧位转变为直立位引起的低氧血症。

HP:0033368.name: Platypnea
HP:0033368.definition: A type of dyspnea that occurs when the affected person changes from a recumbent to an upright position.
HP:0033368.definition_cn: 一种在患者从卧位转变为直立位时发生的呼吸困难类型。

HP:0033369.name: Cavitating leukodystrophy
HP:0033369.definition: A type of leukodystrophy characterized by multiple small cavitations typically in the periventricular and deep cerebral white matter. The cavitations are visible as a central cavity with cerebrospinal fluid-like signal intensity.
HP:0033369.name_cn: 空泡性脑白质营养不良
HP:0033369.definition_cn: 一种以多发性小空洞为特征的脑白质营养不良，通常位于脑室周围和深部脑白质。这些空洞在影像学上表现为具有脑脊液样信号强度的中央腔隙。

HP:0033370.name: Bronchial telangiectasia
HP:0033370.definition: Telangiectasias (small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes) located in the trachoebronchial system.
HP:0033370.name_cn: 支气管毛细血管扩张症
HP:0033370.definition_cn: 气管支气管系统内的毛细血管扩张症（位于皮肤或黏膜表面附近的微小扩张血管）。

HP:0033371.name: Bronchocentric granulomatosis
HP:0033371.definition: Granulomatous inflammation that surrounds the bronchi and bronchioles, replacing bronchial walls and mucosa. In bronchocentric granulomatosis, the lumen of the airway contains necrotic debris, and palisaded histiocytes surround the lumen.
HP:0033371.name_cn: 支气管中心性肉芽肿病
HP:0033371.definition_cn: 支气管和细支气管周围出现肉芽肿性炎症，取代支气管壁和黏膜。在支气管中心性肉芽肿病中，气道管腔内含有坏死碎片，且管腔周围可见栅栏状排列的组织细胞。

HP:0033372.name: Abnormal KCO
HP:0033372.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of KCO. The KCO is a measurement of the rate constant for alveolar uptake of CO during breath-holding in the single breath measurement of DLCO at full inflation. The DLCO is derived as the product of the KCO and the single breath alveolar volume (VA) divided by PB-PH2O.
HP:0033372.name_cn: 异常的一氧化碳弥散系数（KCO）
HP:0033372.definition_cn: 任何偏离KCO正常范围的情况。KCO是在单次呼吸法测定DLCO（一氧化碳弥散量）时，在充分吸气后屏气期间肺泡对CO摄取速率常数的测量值。DLCO由KCO与单次呼吸肺泡容积（VA）的乘积除以大气压减去水蒸气分压（PB-PH2O）得出。

HP:0033373.name: Increased KCO
HP:0033373.definition: Increased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).
HP:0033373.definition_cn: 肺一氧化碳弥散量（DLCO）速率常数（效率指数）增加。

HP:0033374.name: Decreased KCO
HP:0033374.definition: Decreased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).
HP:0033374.definition_cn: 肺一氧化碳弥散量（DLCO）速率常数（效率指数）降低。

HP:0033375.name: Anthracosis
HP:0033375.definition: Anthracosis is the deposition of black carbon pigment. It is commonly seen in perihilar lymph nodes as well as within lung parenchyma. There can be prominent storiforming (i.e., spiral patterning) of histiocytes, to such an extent as to mimic a neoplastic lesion histologically. Anthracosis is a common finding in smokers and polluted city dwellers.
HP:0033375.definition_cn: 炭末沉着症是指黑色碳素色素的沉积。常见于肺门周围淋巴结以及肺实质内。组织细胞可出现显著的席纹状（即螺旋状）排列，其程度在组织学上可类似肿瘤性病变。炭末沉着症常见于吸烟者和污染城市居民。

HP:0033376.name: Alveolar septal thickening
HP:0033376.definition: Increased width of the alveolar septum, which is the structure that separates neighboring alveoli. This finding can be appreciated on histology.
HP:0033376.definition_cn: 肺泡间隔增宽，即分隔相邻肺泡的结构增厚。此现象可在组织学检查中观察到。

HP:0033377.name: Increased airway neuroendocrine cells
HP:0033377.definition: Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cells (NECs) within distal airways. There are no formal criteria for an increase (which is also dependent on the sensitivity of the staining method), findings of neuroendocrine cells in at least 70% of bronchioles by lung biopsy and at least 10% NECs in an individual airway are consistent with the diagnosis of Neuroendocrine cell hyperplasia of infancy in the appropriate clinical setting. Increases are also seen in other clinical settings. Neuroendocrine neoplasms of the lung encompass NE tumors (NETs), which split into typical and atypical carcinoids, and NE carcinomas (NECs).
HP:0033377.name_cn: 气道神经内分泌细胞增多
HP:0033377.definition_cn: 远端气道内存在数量增加的蛙皮素免疫阳性神经内分泌细胞（NECs）。目前尚无明确的增加标准（这也取决于染色方法的敏感性），在适当的临床背景下，通过肺活检发现至少70%的细支气管中存在神经内分泌细胞，且单个气道中至少10%的NECs，符合婴儿期神经内分泌细胞增生的诊断。在其他临床情况下也可见到NECs的增加。肺神经内分泌肿瘤包括神经内分泌肿瘤（NETs），分为典型和非典型类癌，以及神经内分泌癌（NECs）。

HP:0033378.name: Increased airway neuroepithelial bodies
HP:0033378.definition: Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cell cluster (neuroepithelial bodies) in the alveolar ducts.
HP:0033378.name_cn: 气道神经上皮小体增多
HP:0033378.definition_cn: 肺泡导管中存在大量蛙皮素免疫阳性神经内分泌细胞簇（神经上皮小体）。

HP:0033379.name: Bilateral superior vena cava
HP:0033379.definition: The presence of a left and a right superior vena cava.

HP:0033380.name: Nasal chondritis
HP:0033380.definition: Inflammation of the cartilage of the nose.

HP:0033381.name: Elevated circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033381.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of O-stearoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033381.name_cn: 循环硬脂酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033381.definition_cn: 血液循环中O-硬脂酰肉碱浓度异常升高。

HP:0033382.name: Elevated circulating palmitoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033382.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of palmitoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033382.name_cn: 循环棕榈酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033382.definition_cn: 血液中棕榈酰肉碱浓度异常升高。

HP:0033383.name: Decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude
HP:0033383.definition: Reduced level of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP), which is recorded following electrical stimulation of a nerve from surface electrodes overlying a muscle supplied by that nerve.
HP:0033383.name_cn: 复合肌肉动作电位幅度降低
HP:0033383.definition_cn: 复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）水平降低，该电位是通过对支配某肌肉的神经进行电刺激，并在该肌肉表面的电极上记录得到的。

HP:0033384.name: Elevated urinary collagen degradation products
HP:0033384.definition: Increased level in the urine of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.
HP:0033384.name_cn: 尿液中胶原降解产物升高
HP:0033384.definition_cn: 尿液中胶原降解代谢产物水平升高，例如由胶原酶或丝氨酸蛋白酶产生的胶原片段。

HP:0033385.name: Elevated urine pyridinoline level
HP:0033385.definition: An increased amount of pyridinoline in the urine.
HP:0033385.definition_cn: 尿液中吡啶诺林含量升高。

HP:0033386.name: Abnormal circulating collagen degradation product concentration
HP:0033386.definition: Abnormal concentration in the blood circulation of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.
HP:0033386.name_cn: 异常循环胶原降解产物浓度
HP:0033386.definition_cn: 血液循环中由胶原降解产生的代谢物浓度异常，例如由胶原酶或丝氨酸蛋白酶产生的胶原片段。

HP:0033387.name: Elevated circulating pyridinoline concentration
HP:0033387.definition: An increased concentration of hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (pyridinoline) in the blood circulation.
HP:0033387.name_cn: 循环中吡啶诺林浓度升高
HP:0033387.definition_cn: 血液循环中羟赖氨酰吡啶啉（吡啶啉）浓度升高。

HP:0033388.name: Abnormal bronchial artery morphology
HP:0033388.definition: Any structural abnormality of a bronchial artery.

HP:0033389.name: Bronchopulmonary anastomosis
HP:0033389.definition: Abnormal arterial anastomosis (connection) between bronchial and pulmonary arteries.
HP:0033389.definition_cn: 支气管动脉与肺动脉之间的异常动脉吻合（连接）。

HP:0033390.name: Bronchial artery dilatation
HP:0033390.definition: Increased caliber of a bronchial artery, which can be defined as a bronchial artery diameter that exceeds 2 mm.
HP:0033390.definition_cn: 支气管动脉管径增宽，可定义为支气管动脉直径超过2毫米。

HP:0033391.name: Bronchial artery hypertrophy
HP:0033391.definition: Increase in the volume of bronchial artery wall due to the enlargement of its component cells.
HP:0033391.definition_cn: 支气管动脉壁体积增加，由于其组成细胞增大所致。

HP:0033392.name: Perivascular pre-capillary pulmonary artery inflammation
HP:0033392.definition: Inflammatory cell infiltration surrounding precapillary pulmonary arteries (arterioles; 20-70 micrometer).
HP:0033392.name_cn: 血管周围前毛细血管肺动脉炎症
HP:0033392.definition_cn: 毛细血管前肺动脉（小动脉；20-70微米）周围炎性细胞浸润。

HP:0033393.name: Irregularly shaped sperm tail
HP:0033393.definition: Irregular or changing caliber (diameter) along the tail of the sperm.
HP:0033393.definition_cn: 精子尾部不规则或变化的管径（直径）。

HP:0033394.name: Anti-carbonic anhydrase II antibody positivity
HP:0033394.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against carbonic anhydrase II.
HP:0033394.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对碳酸酐酶II的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033395.name: Antilactoferrin antibody positivity
HP:0033395.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against lactoferrin.
HP:0033395.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对乳铁蛋白的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033396.name: Glomerular extracapillary fibrin
HP:0033396.definition: Presence of ropey, eosinophilic material (brght red on Trichrome staining) consistent with extracapillary fibrin outside of capillary lumina.
HP:0033396.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管外纤维蛋白
HP:0033396.definition_cn: 存在绳索状嗜酸性物质（三色染色呈亮红色），符合毛细血管腔外纤维蛋白沉积。

HP:0033397.name: Bowman-space proteinaceous debris
HP:0033397.definition: The presence of eosinophilic Periodic Acid Schiff (PAS)-positive cell free, protein-derived material occupying Bowman's space.
HP:0033397.definition_cn: 鲍曼腔内存在嗜酸性过碘酸希夫（PAS）染色阳性的无细胞蛋白源性物质。

HP:0033398.name: Pleural plaque
HP:0033398.definition: Deposits of hyalinized collagen fibers in the parietal pleura (preferentially pleura adjacent to ribs, particularly the sixth through ninth ribs).
HP:0033398.definition_cn: 壁层胸膜（尤其邻近肋骨，特别是第六至第九肋骨的胸膜）中透明化胶原纤维的沉积。

HP:0033399.name: Persistent fever
HP:0033399.definition: Fever that persists longer than expected for an acute infectious disease. No precise threshold exists, and the clinical interpretation of fever is context-dependent, but as a rule of thumb, this term refers to fever that persists longer than 2-3 weeks.
HP:0033399.definition_cn: 持续时间超过急性感染性疾病预期病程的发热。目前尚无明确的阈值，且发热的临床解释需结合具体情境，但通常而言，该术语指持续超过2-3周的发热。

HP:0033400.name: Acute abdomen
HP:0033400.definition: A sudden onset of abdominal pain with associated nausea or vomiting. The acute abdomen may be caused by an infection, inflammation, vascular occlusion, or obstruction.
HP:0033400.definition_cn: 突发性腹痛伴恶心或呕吐。急腹症可能由感染、炎症、血管闭塞或梗阻引起。

HP:0033401.name: Tissue ischemia
HP:0033401.definition: Ischemia is defined as a restriction of arterial blood supply to a tissue associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolis requirements of the tissue. Depending on the involved tissues, clinical manifestations may include pain, pallor, lack of pulse, coldness, paresthesia, and paralysis. Additional associated manifestations include hemodynamic parameters (reduced blood pressure distal to the site of restricted arterial supply) and angiographic evidence of arterial occclusion.
HP:0033401.definition_cn: 缺血被定义为动脉血液供应至组织的限制，伴随氧合不足，无法满足组织的代谢需求。根据受累组织的不同，临床表现可能包括疼痛、苍白、无脉、发冷、感觉异常和麻痹。其他相关表现包括血流动力学参数（动脉供应受限部位远端的血压降低）以及动脉闭塞的血管造影证据。

HP:0033402.name: Digital ischemia
HP:0033402.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to a digit (finger or toe) associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the digit. Clinical manifestations may include pain, pallor, lack of pulse, coldness, paresthesia, and paralysis.
HP:0033402.definition_cn: 指（趾）动脉供血受限，导致氧合不足，无法满足指（趾）代谢需求。临床表现可能包括疼痛、苍白、无脉、发冷、感觉异常和麻痹。

HP:0033403.name: Testicular ischemia
HP:0033403.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to a testis associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue. Clinical manifestations may include pain and swelling of the affected testis.
HP:0033403.definition_cn: 睾丸动脉血供受限，导致组织氧合不足，无法满足其代谢需求。临床表现可能包括患侧睾丸疼痛和肿胀。

HP:0033404.name: Intestinal ischemia
HP:0033404.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to the intestine associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue. Acute intestinal ischemia can involve the small or large intestine, and usually presents with sudden severe non-specific abdominal pain.
HP:0033404.definition_cn: 肠系膜动脉供血不足导致的肠道组织氧合不足，无法满足其代谢需求。急性肠缺血可累及小肠或大肠，通常表现为突发的剧烈非特异性腹痛。

HP:0033405.name: Abnormal circulating organic amino compound concentration
HP:0033405.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of an organic amino compound, defined as a compound formally derived from ammonia by replacing one, two or three hydrogen atoms by organyl groups.
HP:0033405.name_cn: 异常循环有机氨基酸化合物浓度
HP:0033405.definition_cn: 任何有机氨基化合物（定义为通过用一个、两个或三个有机基团取代氨分子中的一个、两个或三个氢原子而正式衍生的化合物）的正常浓度偏离。

HP:0033406.name: Elevated circulating phosphoethanolamine concentration
HP:0033406.definition: An increased concentration of o-phosphoethanolamine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033406.name_cn: 循环磷酸乙醇胺浓度升高
HP:0033406.definition_cn: 血液循环中O-磷酸乙醇胺浓度升高。

HP:0033407.name: Elevated urine acetoacetic acid level
HP:0033407.definition: Elevated amount of acetoacetic acid in the urine.
HP:0033407.definition_cn: 尿液中乙酰乙酸含量升高。

HP:0033408.name: Elevated circulating acetoacetic acid concentration
HP:0033408.definition: An increased level of acetoacetic acid in the blood circulation. Acetoacetic acid is one of the predominant ketone bodies.
HP:0033408.name_cn: 循环乙酰乙酸浓度升高
HP:0033408.definition_cn: 血液中乙酰乙酸水平升高。乙酰乙酸是主要的酮体之一。

HP:0033409.name: Elevated urinary 2-hydroxybutyric acid
HP:0033409.definition: An increased amount of 2-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.
HP:0033409.name_cn: 尿中2-羟基丁酸水平升高
HP:0033409.definition_cn: 尿液中2-羟基丁酸含量升高。

HP:0033410.name: Elevated circulating cartilage oligomeric matrix protein concentration
HP:0033410.definition: An increased blood concentration of cartilage oligomeric matrix protein (COMP).
HP:0033410.name_cn: 循环软骨寡聚基质蛋白浓度升高
HP:0033410.definition_cn: 软骨寡聚基质蛋白（COMP）血液浓度升高。

HP:0033411.name: Lower extremity akinesia
HP:0033411.definition: Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily in the lower extremities.
HP:0033411.definition_cn: 下肢活动或运动启动障碍，以及无法迅速且轻松地执行普通随意运动。

HP:0033412.name: Upper extremity akinesia
HP:0033412.definition: Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily in the upper extremities.
HP:0033412.definition_cn: 上肢活动或运动启动障碍，无法迅速且轻松地执行普通随意运动。

HP:0033413.name: Upper extremity hypokinesia
HP:0033413.definition: Abnormally diminished movement of the upper extremities. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency.
HP:0033413.definition_cn: 上肢运动异常减退。与瘫痪不同，运动减退并不以运动力量缺乏为特征，而是表现为运动贫乏。典型的习惯性动作（例如，交叉双臂、交叉双腿）的频率减少。

HP:0033414.name: Lower extremity hypokinesia
HP:0033414.definition: Abnormally diminished movement of the lower extremities. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency.
HP:0033414.definition_cn: 下肢运动异常减退。与瘫痪不同，运动减退并非以运动力量缺乏为特征，而是表现为运动贫乏。典型的习惯性动作（例如，交叉双臂、交叉双腿）频率减少。

HP:0033415.name: Cardiac tamponade
HP:0033415.definition: The accumulation of pericardial fluid with subsequent compression of all cardiac chambers which prevents cardiac filling.
HP:0033415.definition_cn: 心包积液积聚导致所有心腔受压，进而阻碍心脏充盈。

HP:0033416.name: Hip adductor weakness
HP:0033416.definition: Reduced ability to bring the leg toward the midline of the body.

HP:0033417.name: Elevated circulating hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP:0033417.definition: An increased concentration in the blood circulation of a hydroxybutyric acid, that is, of a compound comprising a butyric acid core carrying at least one hydroxy substituent.
HP:0033417.name_cn: 循环中羟基丁酸浓度升高
HP:0033417.definition_cn: 血液循环中羟基丁酸浓度升高，即含有至少一个羟基取代基的丁酸核心化合物浓度增加。

HP:0033418.name: Elevated circulating 2-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP:0033418.definition: Elevation of the 2-hydroxybutyric acid concentration in the blood above the normal range.
HP:0033418.name_cn: 循环中2-羟基丁酸浓度升高
HP:0033418.definition_cn: 血液中2-羟基丁酸浓度升高超出正常范围。

HP:0033419.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP:0033419.definition: Elevation of the 3-hydroxybutyric acid concentration in the blood above the normal range.
HP:0033419.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基丁酸浓度升高
HP:0033419.definition_cn: 血液中3-羟基丁酸浓度升高超出正常范围。

HP:0033420.name: Pulmonary arterial plexiform lesion
HP:0033420.definition: Focal proliferation of pulmonary artery endothelial cells, leading to the formation of complex capillary-like channels.
HP:0033420.definition_cn: 肺动脉内皮细胞局灶性增生，导致形成复杂的毛细血管样通道。

HP:0033421.name: Pulmonary artery intimal thickening
HP:0033421.definition: Increased thickness of the intimal layer of the pulmonary artery. Throughout the pulmonary arterial tree, the thin intima consists of a non-fenestrated monolayer of endothelial cells lining the vessel lumen, as well as a sub-endothelial interstitium that extends to the internal elastic lamina. Intimal thickness in human lung ranges from 1-16% of total wall thickness. Pulmonary artery intimal thickening can be defined as a relative intima thickness to the thickness of the vessel wall of over 10%.
HP:0033421.definition_cn: 肺动脉内膜层增厚。在整个肺动脉树中，薄的内膜由一层无孔的内皮细胞组成，这些细胞排列在血管腔内，以及延伸到内弹性膜的内皮下间质。人类肺中内膜厚度占血管壁总厚度的1-16%。肺动脉内膜增厚可定义为内膜厚度相对于血管壁厚度超过10%。

HP:0033422.name: Pulmonary artery adventitial fibrosis
HP:0033422.definition: Increased amount of collagen, proteoglycans, and other extracellular matrix proteins resulting in scarring and thickening in the adventia of the pulmonary arterial tree.
HP:0033422.definition_cn: 胶原蛋白、蛋白聚糖及其他细胞外基质蛋白含量增加，导致肺动脉树外膜瘢痕形成及增厚。

HP:0033423.name: Pulmonary arterial hypertension with positive acute response to NO challenge
HP:0033423.definition: A form of pulmonary arterial hypertension in which there is a reduction of mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP) at least 10 mmHg to reach an absolute value of mPAP not more than 40 mmHg with an increased or unchanged cardiac output (CO) in response to inhaled nitric oxide at 10-20 ppm.
HP:0033423.name_cn: 一氧化氮激发试验呈急性阳性反应的肺动脉高压
HP:0033423.definition_cn: 一种肺动脉高压类型，其特征为在吸入10-20 ppm一氧化氮后，平均肺动脉压（mPAP）至少降低10 mmHg，达到mPAP绝对值不超过40 mmHg，同时心输出量（CO）增加或保持不变。

HP:0033424.name: Pulmonary arterial hypertension with lack of acute response to NO challenge
HP:0033424.definition: A form of pulmonary arterial hypertension with lack of adequate hemodynamic response to NO challenge (adequate response is defined as a reduction of mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP) of at least 10 mmHg to reach an absolute value of mPAP 40 mmHg or less with an increased or unchanged cardiac output (CO) in response to inhaled nitric oxide at 10-20 ppm).
HP:0033424.name_cn: 肺动脉高压伴一氧化氮激发试验无急性反应
HP:0033424.definition_cn: 一种肺动脉高压类型，表现为对一氧化氮（NO）激发试验缺乏足够的血流动力学反应（足够的反应定义为在吸入10-20 ppm一氧化氮后，平均肺动脉压（mPAP）至少降低10 mmHg，达到mPAP绝对值40 mmHg或以下，且心输出量（CO）增加或保持不变）。

HP:0033425.name: Periungual erythema
HP:0033425.definition: Erythema (redness of the skin caused by hyperemia in superficial capillaries) in the region surrounding a fingernail or toe nail.
HP:0033425.definition_cn: 甲周红斑（由浅表毛细血管充血引起的皮肤发红）。

HP:0033426.name: Pulmonary air embolism
HP:0033426.definition: Venous air embolism is a consequence of air being introduced into the venous circulation, and subsequently to the right heart, and pulmonary circulation. When small amounts of air reach pulmonary circulation they can be removed by gas diffusion across the arteriolar wall into the alveoli, amounts of gas exceeding 50 ml can cause pulmonary outflow tract obstruction with or without concomitant arterial embolisation.
HP:0033426.definition_cn: 静脉空气栓塞是由于空气进入静脉循环，随后进入右心和肺循环所导致的后果。当少量空气到达肺循环时，它们可以通过气体扩散穿过小动脉壁进入肺泡而被清除；超过50毫升的气体量可能导致肺流出道阻塞，伴或不伴动脉栓塞。

HP:0033427.name: Pulmonary capillary angioectasia
HP:0033427.definition: Focal accumulation of dilated pulmonary capillaries.
HP:0033427.name_cn: 肺毛细血管血管扩张症
HP:0033427.definition_cn: 肺毛细血管扩张的局灶性积聚。

HP:0033428.name: Systemic autoinflammation
HP:0033428.definition: Dysregulation of the innate immune system characterized by systemic pathobiology, i.e., with symptoms that can affect the entire body.
HP:0033428.definition_cn: 以系统性病理生物学为特征的先天免疫系统失调，即具有可影响全身的症状。

HP:0033429.name: Neuroinflammation
HP:0033429.definition: Activation of the brain's innate immune system in response to an inflammatory challenge and is characterized by a host of cellular and molecular changes within the brain.
HP:0033429.definition_cn: 大脑固有免疫系统在应对炎症刺激时的激活，其特征为大脑内一系列细胞和分子变化。

HP:0033430.name: Non-infectious meningitis
HP:0033430.definition: Inflammation of the layers of tissue that cover the brain and spinal cord (meninges) and of the fluid-filled space between the meninges (subarachnoid space) when it is caused by disorders that are not infections or by drugs or vaccines.
HP:0033430.definition_cn: 非感染性疾病、药物或疫苗引起的脑膜（覆盖大脑和脊髓的组织层）及蛛网膜下腔（脑膜之间的液体填充空间）的炎症。

HP:0033431.name: Cytomegalovirus colitis
HP:0033431.definition: A form of cytomegalovirus infection characterized by infection and inflammation of the colon.
HP:0033431.definition_cn: 一种巨细胞病毒感染形式，其特征为结肠感染和炎症。

HP:0033433.name: Ileocecal ulcer
HP:0033433.definition: An erosion of the mucous membrane in the region connecting the ileum and cecum.

HP:0033434.name: Nasal septum perforation
HP:0033434.definition: A full-thickness defect of the nasal septum.

HP:0033435.name: Abnormal circulating keto acid concentration
HP:0033435.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a keto acid in the blood circulation. Keto acids or ketoacids are organic compounds that contain a carboxylic acid group and a ketone group.
HP:0033435.definition_cn: 血液中酮酸浓度偏离正常值。酮酸（Keto acids或Ketoacids）是一类含有羧酸基团和酮基团的有机化合物。

HP:0033436.name: Elevated circulating 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid concentration
HP:0033436.definition: The concentration of 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acidin the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033436.name_cn: 循环中3-甲基-2-氧代戊酸浓度升高
HP:0033436.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-甲基-2-氧代戊酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0033437.name: Elevated circulating 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid concentration
HP:0033437.definition: The concentration of 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033437.name_cn: 循环中4-甲基-2-氧代戊酸浓度升高
HP:0033437.definition_cn: 血液循环中4-甲基-2-氧代戊酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0033438.name: Elevated circulating myoglobin concentration
HP:0033438.definition: An increased blood concentration of myoglobin.
HP:0033438.name_cn: 循环肌红蛋白浓度升高

HP:0033439.name: Elevated circulating decenoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033439.definition: Concentration of decenoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033439.name_cn: 循环中癸烯酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033439.definition_cn: 血液中癸烯酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033440.name: Elevated circulating octenoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033440.definition: Concentration of octenoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033440.name_cn: 循环辛酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033440.definition_cn: 血液中辛酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033441.name: Elevated circulating hexanoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033441.definition: Concentration of hexanoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033441.name_cn: 循环中己酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033441.definition_cn: 血液中己酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033442.name: Elevated circulating glutarylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033442.definition: Concentration of glutarylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033442.name_cn: 循环中戊二酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033442.definition_cn: 血液中戊二酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033443.name: Elevated circulating propionylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033443.definition: Increased concentration of propionylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033443.name_cn: 循环中丙酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033443.definition_cn: 血液中丙酰肉碱浓度升高。

HP:0033444.name: Elevated circulating dodecanoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033444.definition: Concentration of dodecanoylcarnitine (C12:0) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033444.name_cn: 循环十二酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033444.definition_cn: 血液中十二烷酰肉碱（C12:0）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033445.name: Reduced circulating acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033445.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration in the blood circulation of acylcarnitine, which is produced by reversible esterification of the 3-hydroxyl group of carnitine.
HP:0033445.name_cn: 循环酰基肉碱浓度降低
HP:0033445.definition_cn: 血液循环中酰基肉碱浓度异常降低，酰基肉碱是由肉碱的3-羟基基团可逆酯化反应生成的。

HP:0033446.name: Elevated circulating butyrylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033446.definition: Concentration of O-butyrylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033446.name_cn: 循环中丁酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033446.definition_cn: 血液中O-丁酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033447.name: Elevated circulating isovalerylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033447.definition: Concentration of O-isovalerylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033447.name_cn: 循环异戊酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033447.definition_cn: 血液中O-异戊酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0033448.name: Increased mid-arm muscle circumference
HP:0033448.definition: Elevation of the midupper arm circumference midway between the acromion and olecranon processes of the ulna with the use of a steel or fiberglass tape. This measure is a proxy for the muscle mass of the upper arm and can be used as a part of the assessment of nutritional status in children.
HP:0033448.definition_cn: 使用钢制或玻璃纤维卷尺测量肩峰与尺骨鹰嘴突之间中点的上臂围。该测量值可作为上臂肌肉质量的替代指标，并可用于儿童营养状况评估的一部分。

HP:0033449.name: Decreased mid-arm muscle circumference
HP:0033449.definition: Reduction of the midupper arm circumference midway between the acromion and olecranon processes of the ulna with the use of a steel or fiberglass tape. This measure is a proxy for the muscle mass of the upper arm and can be used as a part of the assessment of nutritional status in children.
HP:0033449.definition_cn: 使用钢制或玻璃纤维卷尺测量肩峰与尺骨鹰嘴突之间中点的上臂围。该测量值可作为上臂肌肉质量的替代指标，并可用于儿童营养状况评估的一部分。

HP:0033450.name: Abnormal circulating prealbumin concentration
HP:0033450.definition: Any deviation from normal concentration of albumin in the blood circulation.
HP:0033450.name_cn: 异常循环前白蛋白浓度
HP:0033450.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常血液循环中白蛋白浓度的异常情况。

HP:0033451.name: Increased circulating prealbumin concentration
HP:0033451.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of prealbumin in the blood circulation.
HP:0033451.name_cn: 循环前白蛋白浓度升高
HP:0033451.definition_cn: 血清前白蛋白浓度高于正常范围。

HP:0033452.name: obsolete Decreased circulating prealbumin concentration
HP:0033452.name_cn: 过时的 循环前白蛋白浓度降低

HP:0033453.name: Limited neck extension
HP:0033453.definition: Reduced ability to move the head back towards the ceiling so that one is looking upwards.

HP:0033454.name: Tube feeding
HP:0033454.definition: Feeding problem necessitating food and nutrient delivery via a tube.
HP:0033454.definition_cn: 需要通过管饲进行食物和营养素输送的喂养问题。

HP:0033455.name: obsolete Elevated urinary dicarboxylic acid level
HP:0033455.name_cn: 过时的尿中二羧酸水平升高

HP:0033456.name: Elevated urine keto acid level
HP:0033456.definition: Increased amount of a keta acid in the urine.

HP:0033457.name: Elevated urine 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid level
HP:0033457.definition: Increased amount of 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid in the urine.
HP:0033457.name_cn: 尿液中3-甲基-2-氧代戊酸水平升高
HP:0033457.definition_cn: 尿液中3-甲基-2-氧代戊酸含量升高。

HP:0033458.name: Elevated urine 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid level
HP:0033458.definition: Increased amount of 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid in the urine.
HP:0033458.name_cn: 尿液中4-甲基-2-氧代戊酸水平升高
HP:0033458.definition_cn: 尿液中4-甲基-2-氧代戊酸含量升高。

HP:0033459.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein concentration
HP:0033459.definition: Reduced concentration in the blood circulation of a lipid-transport protein (apoliprotein).
HP:0033459.name_cn: 循环载脂蛋白浓度降低
HP:0033459.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂质转运蛋白（载脂蛋白）浓度降低。

HP:0033460.name: Increased circulating apolipoprotein circulation
HP:0033460.definition: Elevated concentration in the blood circulation of a lipid-transport protein (apoliprotein).
HP:0033460.name_cn: 循环中载脂蛋白水平升高
HP:0033460.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂质转运蛋白（载脂蛋白）浓度升高。

HP:0033461.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxylinoleylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033461.definition: Increased concentration of 3-hydroxylinoleylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033461.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基亚油酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033461.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基亚油酰肉碱浓度升高。

HP:0033462.name: Elevated circulating oleylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033462.definition: Increased concentration of oleylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033462.name_cn: 循环油酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033462.definition_cn: 血液循环中油酰肉碱浓度升高。

HP:0033463.name: obsolete Elevated circulating palmitoleylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033463.name_cn: 过时的 循环中棕榈酰肉碱浓度升高

HP:0033464.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxypalmitoleylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033464.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxypalmitoleylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033464.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基棕榈酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033464.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基棕榈酰肉碱浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0033465.name: Elevated circulating tetradecanoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033465.name_cn: 循环十四酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033465.definition_cn: 循环十四烷酰浓度升高。

HP:0033466.name: Weak grip
HP:0033466.definition: Reduced grip strength. Gripping is the motion by which the hand tightly grasps an object or other hand.
HP:0033466.definition_cn: 握力减退。握持是指手部紧握物体或另一只手的动作。

HP:0033467.name: Low 10-minute APGAR score
HP:0033467.definition: A normal APGAR score can be coded as 'not Low 10-minute APGAR score'.
HP:0033467.definition_cn: 正常APGAR评分可编码为“非低10分钟APGAR评分”。

HP:0033475.name: Limited shoulder abduction
HP:0033475.definition: Decreased ability to move the arm away from the midline of the body.
HP:0033475.definition_cn: Reduced abduction capacity of the upper extremity.

HP:0033476.name: Extractable nuclear antigen positivity
HP:0033476.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against extractable nuclear components that are referred to as extractable because they can be extracted from cell nuclei with saline solution.
HP:0033476.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体，这些抗体与可提取核成分发生反应，之所以称为可提取，是因为它们可以用生理盐水从细胞核中提取出来。

HP:0033477.name: Abnormal circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
HP:0033477.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of lipoprotein lipase in the blood circulation.
HP:0033477.name_cn: 异常循环脂蛋白脂肪酶浓度
HP:0033477.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂蛋白脂酶浓度异常。

HP:0033478.name: Increased circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
HP:0033478.definition: Increased concentration of lipoprotein lipase in the blood circulation.
HP:0033478.name_cn: 循环脂蛋白脂肪酶浓度升高
HP:0033478.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂蛋白脂肪酶浓度升高。

HP:0033480.name: Hypobilirubinemia
HP:0033480.definition: Concentration of bilirubin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0033480.definition_cn: 血清胆红素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0033481.name: Limited lateral neck flexion
HP:0033481.definition: Reduced range of motion resulting in decreased ability to move the ear toward the top of the shoulder.
HP:0033481.definition_cn: 活动范围受限导致耳部向肩部顶端移动能力下降。

HP:0033482.name: Limited shoulder flexion
HP:0033482.definition: A reduced ability to flex the shoulder. Shoulder flexion is the motion that moves the arms from a resting position by the side of the body to a position above the head.
HP:0033482.definition_cn: 肩关节屈曲功能减退。肩关节屈曲是指将手臂从身体侧方的静止位置移动至头部上方的动作。

HP:0033483.name: Podocyte infolding
HP:0033483.definition: Folding of cytoplasmic processes of podocytes into the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) with thickening of the lamina densa and microspheres and/or microtubular structures within the GBM.
HP:0033483.definition_cn: 足细胞胞质突起折叠进入肾小球基底膜（GBM），伴随致密层增厚以及GBM内微球体和/或微管结构形成。

HP:0033484.name: Elevated circulating linoleylcarnitine concentration
HP:0033484.definition: Increased concentration of linoleylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP:0033484.name_cn: 循环中十八碳烯酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0033484.definition_cn: 血液循环中亚油酰肉碱浓度升高。

HP:0033485.name: Glomerular basement membrane disruption
HP:0033485.definition: A point of rupture in the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) where the discontinuous portions of GBM are still identifiable with a basement membrane stain such as Periodic acid Schiff (PAS) or silver.
HP:0033485.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜（GBM）破裂点，其中GBM的不连续部分仍可通过基底膜染色（如过碘酸希夫染色（PAS）或银染）识别。

HP:0033486.name: Abnormal glomerular basement membrane texture
HP:0033486.definition: Anomalous appearance or structure of the surface of the glomerular basement membrane.
HP:0033486.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜纹理异常
HP:0033486.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜表面形态或结构异常。

HP:0033487.name: Glomerular basement membranes powdery deposit
HP:0033487.definition: Punctate electron-dense material typically in a band-like distribution along the lamina rara interna and within tubular basement membranes within the subendothelial aspect of the glomerular basement membrane.
HP:0033487.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜粉末状沉积物
HP:0033487.definition_cn: 点状电子致密物质通常呈带状分布，位于肾小球基底膜内皮下侧的透明层内层及小管基底膜内。

HP:0033488.name: Glomerular endocapillary leukocyte hypercellularity
HP:0033488.definition: Increased number of leukocytes internal to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), but not limited to within glomerular capillaries.
HP:0033488.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管内白细胞增多症
HP:0033488.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜（GBM）内白细胞数量增加，但不局限于肾小球毛细血管内。

HP:0033489.name: Glomerular endocapillary neutrophil hypercellularity
HP:0033489.definition: Increased number of neutrophils internal to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), but not limited to within glomerular capillaries.
HP:0033489.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管内中性粒细胞增多症
HP:0033489.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜（GBM）内中性粒细胞数量增加，但不局限于肾小球毛细血管内。

HP:0033490.name: Glomerular endocapillary foam-cell hypercellularity
HP:0033490.definition: Presence of lipid-filled cells, often a macrophage, with a vacuolated appearance in the glomerulus often occupying the endocapillary space.
HP:0033490.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管内泡沫细胞增生
HP:0033490.definition_cn: 肾小球内存在脂质填充的细胞，通常为巨噬细胞，呈空泡状外观，常占据毛细血管内腔。

HP:0033491.name: Global mesangial sclerosis
HP:0033491.definition: A generalized global (over 80%) increase of mesangial matrix that is present throughout the mesangial stalk (with or without associated mesangial hypercellularity).
HP:0033491.definition_cn: 弥漫性全球性（超过80%）系膜基质增加，存在于整个系膜蒂（伴或不伴相关系膜细胞增生）。

HP:0033492.name: Podocyte cytoskeletal condensation
HP:0033492.definition: Reorganization of podocyte cytoskeletal proteins at the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) aspect of the cell, with associated cytoplasmic electron density at the GBM aspect of the podocyte.
HP:0033492.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜（GBM）侧足细胞骨架蛋白的重组，伴随足细胞GBM侧胞质电子密度的增加。

HP:0033493.name: Mesangial matrix expansion
HP:0033493.definition: Increased mesangial extracellular material with interspace width of over 2 mesangial cell nuclei, in one or more peripheral mesangial areas.
HP:0033493.definition_cn: 一个或多个外周系膜区域中系膜细胞外基质增加，且系膜间隙宽度超过2个系膜细胞核直径。

HP:0033494.name: Glomerular basement membrane amyloid spicule
HP:0033494.definition: Amyloid spicules are projections of typically silver-positive material from the outer aspect of the glomerular capillary wall, perpendicular to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), most often caused by amyloidosis with the latter confirmed by additional stains.
HP:0033494.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜淀粉样棘突
HP:0033494.definition_cn: 淀粉样棘突是从肾小球毛细血管壁外侧垂直向肾小球基底膜（GBM）突出的典型银染色阳性物质，通常由淀粉样变性引起，后者需通过附加染色进一步确认。

HP:0033495.name: Segmental glomerulosclerosis
HP:0033495.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration and can include hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, podocyte depletion, halo and adhesion of the tuft to the Bowman capsule.
HP:0033495.definition_cn: 肾小球丛的节段性硬化，由细胞外基质增加引起，导致肾小球毛细血管闭塞，并可包括玻璃样变性、泡沫细胞、覆盖的肾小球上皮细胞肥大、足细胞耗竭、晕轮以及肾小球丛与鲍曼囊的粘连。

HP:0033496.name: Perihilar segmental glomerulosclerosis
HP:0033496.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration is present at the vascular pole, involving less than 50% of the tuft. It can be accompanied by other descriptors such as hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, podocyte depletion, halo and adhesion of the tuft to the Bowman's capsule.
HP:0033496.name_cn: 门周节段性肾小球硬化症
HP:0033496.definition_cn: 肾小球丛的节段性硬化表现为细胞外基质增多，导致肾小球毛细血管闭塞，病变位于血管极，累及肾小球丛的不足50%。可伴随其他描述性病变，如玻璃样变性、泡沫细胞、覆盖的肾小球上皮细胞肥大、足细胞减少、晕轮以及肾小球丛与鲍曼囊的粘连。

HP:0033497.name: Tip variant segmental glomerulosclerosis
HP:0033497.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft characterized by an adhesion at the tip of the glomerular tuft abutting the proximal tubular taek-off can be accompanied by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration at the glomerular tip. Features including hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells can also be observed.
HP:0033497.name_cn: 局灶节段性肾小球硬化症（FSGS）
HP:0033497.definition_cn: 肾小球丛节段性硬化，其特征为肾小球丛顶端与近端肾小管起始部粘连，可伴随细胞外基质增多，导致肾小球顶端毛细血管闭塞。此外，还可观察到玻璃样变性、泡沫细胞及覆盖的肾小球上皮细胞肥大等特征。

HP:0033498.name: Segmental glomerulosclerosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
HP:0033498.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft characterized by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration at neither the tubular or vascular poles. Features including hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells can also be observed.
HP:0033498.name_cn: 远离血管极和肾小管极的节段性肾小球硬化
HP:0033498.definition_cn: 肾小球簇节段性硬化，其特征为细胞外基质增多，导致肾小球毛细血管闭塞，但未累及肾小管极或血管极。还可观察到透明变性、泡沫细胞及覆盖的肾小球上皮细胞肥大等特征。

HP:0033499.name: Glomerular basement membrane electron dense deposits
HP:0033499.definition: Electron-dense deposits in the lamina densa with a ribbon or a sausage structure.
HP:0033499.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜电子致密沉积物
HP:0033499.definition_cn: 致密层内电子致密沉积物呈带状或香肠状结构。

HP:0033500.name: Subendothelial glomerular basement membrane electron dense deposits
HP:0033500.definition: Electron dense deposits in the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) subendothelial space associated with a prominent GBM reflecting an increase in thickness. This feature can be associated with GBM remodeling along the endothelial aspect.
HP:0033500.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜下电子致密沉积物
HP:0033500.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜（GBM）内皮下间隙中的电子致密沉积物，伴随显著的GBM增厚。这一特征可能与GBM沿内皮侧的重塑相关。

HP:0033501.name: Subepithelial glomerular basement membrane electron dense deposits
HP:0033501.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with exogenous material deposited between the outer (epithelial) aspect of the GBM and the visceral epithelial cell, with varying degrees of incorporation into the GBM.
HP:0033501.name_cn: 上皮下肾小球基底膜电子致密沉积物
HP:0033501.definition_cn: 显著的肾小球基底膜（GBM）表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观估计），外源性物质沉积于GBM的外侧（上皮侧）与脏层上皮细胞之间，并不同程度地融入GBM。

HP:0033502.name: Abnormal esterified to free carnitine ratio
HP:0033502.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of acylcarnitine (i.e., esterified carnitine) to free carnitine.
HP:0033502.name_cn: 酯化与游离肉碱比例异常
HP:0033502.definition_cn: 酰基肉碱（即酯化肉碱）与游离肉碱的正常比例的任何偏离。

HP:0033503.name: Elevated CSF fumarate concentration
HP:0033503.definition: An increased concentration of fumarate, an intermediate in the citric acid cycle, in the cebrebrospinal fluid.
HP:0033503.name_cn: 脑脊液富马酸盐浓度升高
HP:0033503.definition_cn: 脑脊液中柠檬酸循环中间产物富马酸盐浓度升高。

HP:0033504.name: Elevated circulating fumarate concentration
HP:0033504.definition: An increased concentration of fumarate, an intermediate in the citric acid cycle, in the blood circulation.
HP:0033504.name_cn: 循环中富马酸盐浓度升高
HP:0033504.definition_cn: 血液循环中富马酸（柠檬酸循环中间产物）浓度升高。

HP:0033505.name: Livedo reticularis
HP:0033505.definition: Livedo reticularis is characterized by the presence of a bluish purple, mottled or netlike pattern in unbroken circles on the skin. Exposure to cold environments usually intensifies the vascular pattern. Presumably, the condition results from slow or stagnant blood flow, vessel-wall pathology, and decreased oxygen tension.
HP:0033505.definition_cn: 网状青斑的特征是皮肤上出现未闭合的环状蓝紫色斑驳或网状图案。暴露于寒冷环境通常会加剧血管图案。推测该病症是由于血流缓慢或停滞、血管壁病理改变以及氧张力降低所致。

HP:0033506.name: Increased esterified to free carnitine ratio
HP:0033506.definition: An elevated ratio of acylcarnitine (i.e., esterified carnitine) to free carnitine.
HP:0033506.name_cn: 酯化肉碱与游离肉碱比值升高
HP:0033506.definition_cn: 酰基肉碱（即酯化肉碱）与游离肉碱比值升高。

HP:0033507.name: Decreased esterified to free carnitine ratio
HP:0033507.definition: A reduced ratio of acylcarnitine (i.e., esterified carnitine) to free carnitine.
HP:0033507.name_cn: 酯化肉碱与游离肉碱比值降低
HP:0033507.definition_cn: 酰基肉碱（即酯化肉碱）与游离肉碱的比率降低。

HP:0033508.name: EBV meningitis
HP:0033508.definition: Inflammation of the meninges related to infection by Epstein-Barr virus.
HP:0033508.definition_cn: 与爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒感染相关的脑膜炎症。

HP:0033509.name: EBV encephalitis
HP:0033509.definition: Inflammation of the brain related to infection by Epstein-Barr virus.
HP:0033509.definition_cn: 与爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒感染相关的脑炎。

HP:0033510.name: Cutaneous horn
HP:0033510.definition: A cutaneous horn is a keratinized non-malignant protrusion on the surface of the skin. Diagnosis is established by biopsy of the horn and biopsy of the horn and the underlying skin.
HP:0033510.definition_cn: 皮肤角是一种角化的非恶性皮肤表面突起。诊断需通过皮肤角及其下方皮肤的活检来确定。

HP:0033511.name: Addictive substance use
HP:0033511.definition: Chronic compulsive drug seeking and continued use despite harmful consequences.
HP:0033511.definition_cn: 慢性强迫性药物寻求及持续使用，尽管存在有害后果。

HP:0033512.name: Addictive stimulant use
HP:0033512.definition: Addiction to a stimulant drug is defined as a drug that typically increases alertness, attention, and energy while also elevating blood pressure, heart rate, and breathing.
HP:0033512.definition_cn: 对兴奋剂药物的成瘾被定义为一种通常能提高警觉性、注意力和能量，同时也会升高血压、心率和呼吸频率的药物依赖状态。

HP:0033514.name: Addictive amphetamine use
HP:0033514.definition: Addiction to amphetamine or dextroamphetamine is a serious concern.
HP:0033514.definition_cn: 苯丙胺或右旋苯丙胺成瘾是一个严重的问题。

HP:0033515.name: Addictive opioid use
HP:0033515.name_cn: 成瘾性阿片类药物使用

HP:0033516.name: Addictive benzodiazepine use
HP:0033516.name_cn: 成瘾性苯二氮卓类药物使用

HP:0033519.name: Addictive methamphetamine use
HP:0033519.name_cn: 成瘾性甲基苯丙胺使用

HP:0033520.name: Paradoxical embolism
HP:0033520.definition: Paradoxical embolism describes the passage of a venous or right-sided cardiac thrombus into the arterial or systemic circulation.
HP:0033520.definition_cn: 反常性栓塞描述的是静脉或右心系统血栓进入动脉或体循环的过程。

HP:0033521.name: Nasal dryness
HP:0033521.definition: A lack of humidification of the nasal mucosa.

HP:0033522.name: Cerebral cavernous malformation
HP:0033522.definition: A cerebral cavernous malformation (also known as cavernoma, cavernous angioma, cavernous hemangioma) is a collection of structurally abnormal slow-flow capillaries predominantly in the central nervous system. These are multiple mulberry-like distended caverns of dilated thin-walled capillaries without the normal intervening brain parenchymal architecture. Often, individual cavernomas are surrounded by hemosiderin representing remote oozing due to the abnormal capillaries.
HP:0033522.definition_cn: 脑内海绵状血管畸形（也称为海绵状血管瘤、海绵状血管瘤、海绵状血管瘤）是一种主要位于中枢神经系统内的结构异常的慢血流毛细血管集合。这些血管畸形由多个桑葚样扩张的薄壁毛细血管腔组成，缺乏正常的脑实质结构。通常，单个海绵状血管瘤周围可见含铁血黄素沉积，表明由于异常毛细血管导致的远期渗血。

HP:0033523.name: Abnormal sperm principal piece morphology
HP:0033523.definition: A structural anomaly of the part of the sperm flagellum that is distal to the sperm midpiece and mitochondrial sheath and which leads into the end piece.
HP:0033523.definition_cn: 精子尾部结构异常，位于精子中段和线粒体鞘远端，延伸至末段。

HP:0033524.name: Abnormal sperm axoneme morphology
HP:0033524.definition: Abnormal structure of the sperm axonemal structure which consists of a ring of nine microtubular doublets and a central pair of microtubules, giving the classical 9+2 microtubular arrangement. The axoneme contains a central pair of microtubules (C1 and C2) that are connected by a bridge-like structure forming the central pair complex (CPC). Each of the nine outer doublets is composed of type A and B microtubules and connected by radial spokes to the CPC.
HP:0033524.definition_cn: 精子轴丝结构异常，该结构由九个微管双联体环和一个中央微管对组成，形成经典的9+2微管排列。轴丝包含一对中央微管（C1和C2），它们通过桥状结构连接形成中央对复合体（CPC）。每个外周二联体由A型和B型微管组成，并通过放射辐条与CPC相连。

HP:0033525.name: Absent sperm axoneme central pair complex
HP:0033525.definition: Absence of the central pair of microtubules in the sperm axoneme, thereby forming a 9+0 pattern instead of the normal 9+2 pattern.
HP:0033525.name_cn: 精子轴丝中央对复合体缺失
HP:0033525.definition_cn: 精子轴丝中央微管对缺失，从而形成9+0模式而非正常的9+2模式。

HP:0033526.name: Limited ankle dorsiflexion
HP:0033526.definition: Reduced ability to move the foot up toward the shin.

HP:0033527.name: Decreased gonadotropin-stimulated testosterone-to-androstenedione ratio
HP:0033527.definition: A reduced amount of testosterone relative in androstenedione in the blood circulation following administration of hCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin).
HP:0033527.name_cn: 促性腺激素刺激的睾酮与雄烯二酮比值降低
HP:0033527.definition_cn: 在注射人绒毛膜促性腺激素（hCG）后，血液循环中睾酮相对于雄烯二酮的浓度降低。

HP:0033528.name: Abnormal cardiac output
HP:0033528.definition: A deviation from normal Cardiac output, which is defined as the amount of blood pumped by the heart minute and is the mechanism whereby blood flows around the body, especially providing blood flow to the brain and other vital organs.
HP:0033528.definition_cn: 心输出量异常，即心脏每分钟泵出的血液量偏离正常值，这是血液在体内循环的机制，尤其为大脑和其他重要器官提供血流。

HP:0033529.name: Abnormal cardiac index
HP:0033529.definition: Any deviation from the normal value of the cardiac index, defined as cardiac output divided by body surface area.
HP:0033529.definition_cn: 任何偏离心脏指数正常值的情况，心脏指数定义为心输出量除以体表面积。

HP:0033530.name: Increased cardiac index
HP:0033530.definition: An elevated cardiac index, defined as cardiac output divided by body surface area.
HP:0033530.definition_cn: 心脏指数升高，定义为心输出量除以体表面积。

HP:0033531.name: Decreased cardiac index
HP:0033531.definition: A reduced cardiac index, defined as cardiac output divided by body surface area.
HP:0033531.definition_cn: 心脏指数降低，定义为心输出量除以体表面积。

HP:0033532.name: Decreased cardiac output
HP:0033532.definition: A decreased volume of blood pumped by the left and right ventricle, per unit time. Cardiac output (CO) is the product of the heart rate (HR), i.e. the number of heartbeats per minute (bpm), and the stroke volume (SV), which is the volume of blood pumped from the ventricle per beat.
HP:0033532.definition_cn: 单位时间内左心室和右心室泵出的血液量减少。心输出量（Cardiac Output, CO）是心率（Heart Rate, HR，即每分钟心跳次数，bpm）与每搏输出量（Stroke Volume, SV，即每次心跳心室泵出的血液量）的乘积。

HP:0033533.name: Increased cardiac output
HP:0033533.definition: An increased volume of blood pumped by the left and right ventricle, per unit time. Cardiac output (CO) is the product of the heart rate (HR), i.e. the number of heartbeats per minute (bpm), and the stroke volume (SV), which is the volume of blood pumped from the ventricle per beat.
HP:0033533.definition_cn: 单位时间内由左心室和右心室泵出的血液量增加。心输出量（Cardiac Output, CO）是心率（Heart Rate, HR，即每分钟心跳次数，bpm）与每搏输出量（Stroke Volume, SV，即每次心跳心室泵出的血液量）的乘积。

HP:0033534.name: Increased circulating brain natriuretic peptide concentration
HP:0033534.definition: An increased concentration of brain natriuretic peptide in the blood circulation.
HP:0033534.definition_cn: 循环血液中脑钠肽浓度升高。

HP:0033535.name: Reduced platelet dense granules
HP:0033535.definition: Decreased number of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelle.
HP:0033535.definition_cn: 血小板致密颗粒数量减少，一种血小板细胞器。

HP:0033536.name: Reduced platelet alpha granules
HP:0033536.definition: A reduced number of platelet alpha granules.

HP:0033537.name: Mosaic pulmonary attenuation pattern
HP:0033537.definition: Mosaic attenuation refers to heterogeneous areas of differing pulmonary attenuation on CT imaging.
HP:0033537.definition_cn: 马赛克衰减（Mosaic Attenuation）是指在CT影像上肺部出现不同衰减程度的异质性区域。

HP:0033538.name: Aortic annulus calcification
HP:0033538.definition: Pathological deposition of calcium salts in the aortic annulus, a fibrous ring-like structure found at the insertion point of the basal attachments of the aortic valve leaflets within the left ventricular outflow tract.
HP:0033538.definition_cn: 主动脉瓣环钙盐病理性沉积，主动脉瓣环为位于左心室流出道内主动脉瓣叶基底附着点处的纤维环状结构。

HP:0033539.name: Bilateral apical pulmonary fibrosis
HP:0033539.definition: A reticular pattern of linear or lineonodular densities in apical portions of both the right and left lungs seen initially on high-resolution computed tomography and in case of progression also on standard chest x-ray.
HP:0033539.definition_cn: 在初始高分辨率计算机断层扫描（HRCT）中观察到双侧肺尖部呈线状或线结节状密度影的网状模式，若病情进展，标准胸部X线片（CXR）中亦可见此表现。

HP:0033540.name: Reversible airflow obstruction
HP:0033540.definition: Airflow obstruction with a significant response to a bronchodilator defined as an increase in FEV1 and/or FVC by 12 percent or more and by at least 200 mL.
HP:0033540.definition_cn: 气流阻塞对支气管扩张剂有显著反应，定义为FEV1和/或FVC增加12%或以上，且至少增加200 mL。

HP:0033541.name: Irreversible airflow obstruction
HP:0033541.definition: Airflow obstruction without significant response to a bronchodilator defined as an increase in FEV1 and/or FVC by 12 percent or more and by at least 200 mL.
HP:0033541.definition_cn: 气流受限且对支气管扩张剂无明显反应，定义为FEV1和/或FVC增加不足12%且增加量少于200 mL。

HP:0033542.name: Bronchial wall thickening
HP:0033542.definition: Radiological appearance of increased density around the walls of a bronchus or large bronchiole. This feature is thought to be related to edema involving the bronchial wall as well as the peribronchial interstitial space. If the cross section of a bronchus is captured in a radiograph or computed tomography image, it is said to have the appearance of a donut because of the central lucency representing the airway of the bronchus surrounded by a circular region of increased density.
HP:0033542.definition_cn: 支气管或大支气管壁周围密度增高的影像学表现。此特征被认为与累及支气管壁及支气管周围间质的水肿相关。若在X线片或计算机断层扫描图像中捕获支气管的横截面，由于其中心透亮区代表支气管的气道，周围环绕着密度增高的环形区域，故呈现“甜甜圈”样外观。

HP:0033543.name: Addictive nicotine use
HP:0033543.definition: Nicotine addiction can be defined as a chronic, compulsive craving for nicotine and continued usage despite harmful consequences.
HP:0033543.definition_cn: 尼古丁成瘾可定义为一种慢性、强迫性的对尼古丁的渴求，并在明知有害后果的情况下仍持续使用。

HP:0033544.name: Mesangial fibril deposition
HP:0033544.definition: Extracellular mesangial accumulation of slender proteinaceous fibers.
HP:0033544.definition_cn: 肾小球系膜区细胞外细长蛋白纤维沉积。

HP:0033545.name: Mesangial fibrillary deposits
HP:0033545.definition: Extracellular mesangial aggregates composed of randomly arranged, straight, non-branching fibrils that are thicker than amyloid fibrils (average diameter about 20 nm) and are often admixed with smudgy, electron-dense material.
HP:0033545.definition_cn: 由随机排列、直行、无分支的纤维组成的细胞外系膜聚集物，这些纤维比淀粉样纤维更粗（平均直径约20纳米），并常与模糊的电子致密物质混合。

HP:0033546.name: Mesangial microfibril deposition
HP:0033546.definition: Unbranched noncollagenous microfibrils within the mesangial matrix, composed of proteins not present within the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), most notably fibrillin-1, that attach to mesangial cells and GBM structural proteins.
HP:0033546.definition_cn: 肾小球系膜基质内未分支的非胶原性微纤维，由不包含于肾小球基底膜（GBM）内的蛋白质组成，尤其是原纤维蛋白-1（fibrillin-1），其附着于系膜细胞和GBM结构蛋白上。

HP:0033547.name: Mesangial immunotactoid deposits
HP:0033547.definition: Extracellular mesangial aggregates composed of non-branching fibrils, focally parallel over 30 nM in diameter. The term immunotactoid refers to highly organized immune depositions appearing as rod-like microtubular structures in ultrastructural examination.
HP:0033547.name_cn: 系膜免疫触须样沉积物
HP:0033547.definition_cn: 由非分支纤维组成的细胞外系膜聚集物，局部平行排列，直径超过30纳米。术语“免疫触须样”指的是在超微结构检查中呈现为棒状微管结构的高度有序的免疫沉积物。

HP:0033548.name: Mesangial amyloid deposition
HP:0033548.definition: Extracellular mesangial aggregates composed of fine, randomly oriented, non-branching fibrils 8-12 nm in diameter, often forming a cottony mass.
HP:0033548.definition_cn: 由直径8-12纳米的细长、随机排列、无分支的纤维组成的细胞外系膜聚集物，常形成棉絮状团块。

HP:0033549.name: Nodular mesangiosclerosis
HP:0033549.definition: Lobular, round to oval mesangial lesions with an acellular hyaline/matrix core surrounded by compressed mesangial nuclei.
HP:0033549.definition_cn: 小叶状、圆形至椭圆形系膜病变，具有无细胞透明/基质核心，周围环绕受压的系膜细胞核。

HP:0033550.name: Necrotizing pulmonary granulomatosis
HP:0033550.definition: A granuloma that is associated with necrotic changes. Caseation necrosis is defined as a region in granulomas with eosinophilic, granular and cheese-like cellular debris with necrosis. The word caseous itself means pertaining or related to cheese, and comes from the Latin word caseus, meaning cheese.
HP:0033550.definition_cn: 与坏死性改变相关的肉芽肿。干酪样坏死定义为肉芽肿内出现嗜酸性、颗粒状及奶酪样细胞碎片的坏死区域。术语“干酪样”本身意指与奶酪相关，源自拉丁语“caseus”，意为奶酪。

HP:0033551.name: Non-necrotizing pulmonary granulomatosis
HP:0033551.definition: A granuloma located in the lung that is not associated with necrotic changes.

HP:0033552.name: Chronic villitis
HP:0033552.definition: Villitis of unknown etiology (synonymous with villitis of unknown etiology) is a histologic diagnosis and, although it may have a variable distribution, evidence indicates that 3 parenchymal blocks will identify 62% of villitis, reaching an asymptote of 6 and 7 blocks identifying 85% of villitis. Villitis of unknown etiology by definition excludes those cases where an etiology is identified, such as viral or acute infections, and thus is preferred to the term nonspecific chronic villitis. It is usually lymphohistiocytic: although the presence of rare plasma cells does not exclude the diagnosis, thorough evaluation for an infectious etiology, such as cytomegalovirus, is required in a predominantly plasma cell villitis.
HP:0033552.definition_cn: 病因不明的绒毛炎（与病因不明的绒毛炎同义）是一种组织学诊断，尽管其分布可能有所不同，但证据表明，3个实质组织块可识别62%的绒毛炎，而6至7个组织块可识别85%的绒毛炎，达到渐近线。根据定义，病因不明的绒毛炎排除了那些已确定病因的病例，如病毒或急性感染，因此相较于非特异性慢性绒毛炎这一术语更为优选。它通常为淋巴细胞-组织细胞性：尽管罕见浆细胞的存在并不排除该诊断，但在以浆细胞为主的绒毛炎中，需要对感染性病因（如巨细胞病毒）进行彻底评估。

HP:0033553.name: Septic embolism
HP:0033553.definition: Embolization of intravascular thrombus containing microorganisms into the distant tissues via arterial system.
HP:0033553.definition_cn: 含有微生物的血管内血栓通过动脉系统栓塞至远端组织。

HP:0033554.name: Anti-Mi2 antibody positivity
HP:0033554.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against the Mi-2 antigen.
HP:0033554.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Mi-2抗原的自身抗体。

HP:0033555.name: Anti-Ro/SS-A antibody positivity
HP:0033555.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against Ro/SSA autoantigens.
HP:0033555.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Ro/SSA自身抗原的自身抗体。

HP:0033556.name: Anti-nucleoporin 62 antibody positivity
HP:0033556.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against nucleoporin 62.
HP:0033556.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对核孔蛋白62（nucleoporin 62）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033557.name: Anti-proteinase 3 antibody positivity
HP:0033557.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against proteinase 3. Proteinase 3 (PR3) antigen is a 29-kD serine protease that exists as a protein triplet in human neutrophils
HP:0033557.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对蛋白酶3的自身抗体。蛋白酶3（PR3）抗原是一种29千道尔顿的丝氨酸蛋白酶，以蛋白质三联体的形式存在于人类中性粒细胞中。

HP:0033558.name: Anti-histone antibody positivity
HP:0033558.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone antigens.
HP:0033558.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对组蛋白抗原的自身抗体。

HP:0033559.name: Anti-myeloperoxidase antibody positivity
HP:0033559.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against myeloperoxidase.
HP:0033559.name_cn: 抗髓过氧化物酶抗体阳性
HP:0033559.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对髓过氧化物酶的自体抗体。

HP:0033560.name: Anti-PM-Scl antibody positivity
HP:0033560.definition: Anti-PM-Scl antibodies target components of RNA-processing exosome complex in the nucleolus. There are ten proteins in this complex and antibodies to eight of them are found at varying frequencies; PM/Scl-100, PM/Scl-75, hRrp4, hRrp42, hRrp46, hCs14, hRrp41, and hRrp40.
HP:0033560.definition_cn: 抗PM-Scl抗体靶向核仁中RNA加工外泌体复合物的组分。该复合物包含十种蛋白质，其中八种蛋白质的抗体在不同频率下被发现；这些蛋白质包括PM/Scl-100、PM/Scl-75、hRrp4、hRrp42、hRrp46、hCs14、hRrp41和hRrp40。

HP:0033561.name: Anti-bactericidal/permeability-increasing protein antibody positivity
HP:0033561.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against bactericidal/permeability-increasing protein (BPI). BPI is an endotoxin-binding host protein with important antibacterial effects against Gram-negative bacteria, such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa. BPI is a 55 kDalton protein that is most abundant in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils. BPI also acts as a target antigen for antineutrophil cytoplasmic autoantibodies.
HP:0033561.name_cn: 抗杀菌/通透性增加蛋白抗体阳性
HP:0033561.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对杀菌/通透性增加蛋白（BPI）的自身抗体。BPI是一种内毒素结合宿主蛋白，对革兰氏阴性菌（如铜绿假单胞菌）具有重要的抗菌作用。BPI是一种55千道尔顿的蛋白质，在中性粒细胞的嗜天青颗粒中含量最为丰富。BPI也是抗中性粒细胞胞浆自身抗体的靶抗原。

HP:0033562.name: Anti-glycoprotein-210 antibody positivity
HP:0033562.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against glycoprotein-210.
HP:0033562.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对糖蛋白-210的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033563.name: Anti-tissue transglutaminase antibody positivity
HP:0033563.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against tissue transglutaminase.
HP:0033563.name_cn: 抗组织转谷氨酰胺酶抗体阳性
HP:0033563.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对组织转谷氨酰胺酶的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033564.name: Stasis dermatitis
HP:0033564.definition: Stasis dermatitis commonly occurs in older age. It is caused by venous hypertension resulting from retrograde flow due to incompetent venous valves, valve destruction, or obstruction of the venous system. Further tissue changes arise from an inflammatory process mediated by metalloproteinases, which are up-regulated by ferric ion from extravasated red blood cells. Stasis dermatitis presents initially as poorly demarcated erythematous plaques of the lower legs bilaterally, classically involving the medial malleolus.
HP:0033564.definition_cn: 淤积性皮炎常见于老年人群。其病因是由于静脉瓣膜功能不全、瓣膜破坏或静脉系统阻塞导致的静脉高压引起的逆向血流。进一步的病理改变由金属蛋白酶介导的炎症过程引起，而金属蛋白酶的上调则是由外渗红细胞中的三价铁离子所引发。淤积性皮炎的初期表现为双侧小腿边界不清的红斑性斑块，典型部位为内踝。

HP:0033565.name: Anti-epidermal transglutaminase antibody positivity
HP:0033565.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against epidermal transglutaminase.
HP:0033565.name_cn: 抗表皮转谷氨酰胺酶抗体阳性
HP:0033565.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对表皮转谷氨酰胺酶的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033566.name: Abnormal ventricular axis
HP:0033566.definition: Any deviation from the normal direction of the ventricular axis. The left ventricle makes up most of the heart muscle under normal circumstances and therefore generates the most electrical force visible on the EKG. The normal ventricular axis is directed downward and slightly towards the left. The ventricular axis can be determined by analyzing the QRS complex, which represents ventricular depolarization.
HP:0033566.definition_cn: 心室轴方向的任何偏离。在正常情况下，左心室构成心肌的大部分，因此在心电图上产生最大的电活动。正常的心室轴方向向下并略微向左。心室轴可通过分析代表心室去极化的QRS波群来确定。

HP:0033567.name: Right axis deviation
HP:0033567.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS axis falls between +90 degrees and 180 degrees, or beyond +100 degrees if the adult range is used.
HP:0033567.definition_cn: 一种心电图中的异常心室电轴，其中QRS电轴介于+90度至180度之间，或若采用成人标准则超过+100度。

HP:0033568.name: Left axis deviation
HP:0033568.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS axis falls between -30 degrees and -90 degrees.
HP:0033568.definition_cn: 一种心电图中的异常心室轴，其中QRS轴位于-30度至-90度之间。

HP:0033569.name: Extreme axis deviation
HP:0033569.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS axis fall sbetween -90 degrees and 180 degrees. In this case, the ventricular vector is directed upward and to the right.
HP:0033569.definition_cn: 一种心电图中的异常心室电轴，其中QRS轴位于-90度至180度之间。在此情况下，心室向量方向朝上且向右。

HP:0033570.name: Indeterminate ventricular axis
HP:0033570.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS complex is isoelectric or equiphasic in all leads with no dominant QRS deflection.
HP:0033570.definition_cn: 一种心电图中的异常心室电轴，表现为所有导联中QRS波群呈等电位或等相性，无主导QRS波偏转。

HP:0033571.name: Peripheral lung neovascularity
HP:0033571.definition: The presence of small, tortuous, micronodular, serpiginous intrapulmonary vessels often in the subpleural lung or in proximity to centrilobular arterioles, coursing in directions inconsistent with known arteriolar anatomy.
HP:0033571.definition_cn: 存在细小、迂曲、微结节状、蜿蜒的肺内血管，通常位于胸膜下肺组织或靠近小叶中央细动脉，其走行方向与已知的细动脉解剖结构不一致。

HP:0033572.name: Anti-H1 antibody positivity
HP:0033572.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H1.
HP:0033572.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对组蛋白H1的自身抗体。

HP:0033573.name: Anti-H4 antibody positivity
HP:0033573.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H4.
HP:0033573.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对组蛋白H4的自身抗体。

HP:0033574.name: Anti-H3 antibody positivity
HP:0033574.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H3.
HP:0033574.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对组蛋白H3的自身抗体。

HP:0033575.name: Anti-H2A antibody positivity
HP:0033575.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H2A.
HP:0033575.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对组蛋白H2A的自身抗体。

HP:0033576.name: Anti-H2B antibody positivity
HP:0033576.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H2B.
HP:0033576.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对组蛋白H2B的自身抗体。

HP:0033577.name: In situ pulmonary artery thrombosis
HP:0033577.definition: Localized thrombosis in pulmonary arteries frequently found in patients with idiopathic and hereditary pulmonary arterial hypertension and pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease.
HP:0033577.definition_cn: 特发性肺动脉高压、遗传性肺动脉高压以及先天性心脏病相关性肺动脉高压患者中常见肺动脉局部血栓形成。

HP:0033578.name: Pre-capillary pulmonary hypertension
HP:0033578.definition: Pre-capillary pulmonary hypertension is a haemodynamic condition characterized by elevated mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP over 20 mmHg) and pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR 3 Wood units or more) accompanied by normal pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP not more than 15 mmHg).
HP:0033578.name_cn: 毛细血管前性肺动脉高压
HP:0033578.definition_cn: 毛细血管前性肺动脉高压是一种血流动力学状态，其特征为平均肺动脉压（mPAP超过20 mmHg）和肺血管阻力（PVR≥3 Wood单位）升高，同时伴有正常的肺动脉楔压（PAWP≤15 mmHg）。

HP:0033579.name: Decreased growth hormone responses to growth hormone-releasing hormone challenge
HP:0033579.definition: Insufficient growth hormone secretion following administration of growth hormone-releasing hormone.
HP:0033579.name_cn: 生长激素对生长激素释放激素刺激的反应降低
HP:0033579.definition_cn: 生长激素释放激素给药后生长激素分泌不足。

HP:0033580.name: Compound motor action potential abnormality
HP:0033580.definition: An abnormal finding in a compound motor action potential measurement in EMG. Nerve conduction studies involve the application of a depolarising square wave electrical pulses to the skin over a peripheral nerve producing: (1) a propagated nerve action potential (NAP) recorded at a distant point over the same nerve: and (2) a compound muscle action potential (CMAP) arising from the activation of muscle fibers in a target muscle supplied by the nerve. In both cases these may be recorded with surface or needle electrodes. The CMAP is a summated voltage response from the individual muscle fiber action potentials. The shortest latency of the CMAP is the time from stimulus artifact to onset of the response and is a biphasic response with an initial upward deflection followed by a smaller downward deflection. The CMAP amplitude is measured from baseline to negative peak (the neurophysiological convention is that negative voltage is demonstrated by an upward deflection) and measured in millivolts (mV).
HP:0033580.name_cn: 复合运动动作电位异常
HP:0033580.definition_cn: 肌电图（EMG）中复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）测量的异常发现。神经传导研究涉及在外周神经上方的皮肤施加去极化方波电脉冲，产生：（1）在同一神经远端记录到的传播性神经动作电位（NAP）；以及（2）由该神经支配的目标肌肉中肌纤维激活产生的复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）。这两种情况均可通过表面电极或针电极记录。CMAP是单个肌纤维动作电位的电压总和。CMAP的最短潜伏期是从刺激伪迹到反应起始的时间，表现为双相反应，初始为向上的偏转，随后为较小的向下偏转。CMAP的振幅从基线到负峰值测量（神经生理学惯例是负电压表现为向上的偏转），并以毫伏（mV）为单位进行测量。

HP:0033581.name: Absent peripheral lymph nodes in presence of infection
HP:0033581.definition: The absence of any palpable lymph nodes in the presence of symptoms suggesting infection in that drainage area should raise suspicion for immunodeficiency diseases.
HP:0033581.name_cn: 感染状态下外周淋巴结缺如
HP:0033581.definition_cn: 在存在提示引流区域感染症状的情况下，未触及任何可触及的淋巴结应引起对免疫缺陷疾病的怀疑。

HP:0033582.name: Pulmonary interstitial lymphocyte infiltration
HP:0033582.definition: Abnormal accumulation of lymphocytes in the interstitium of the lung.
HP:0033582.definition_cn: 肺间质淋巴细胞异常积聚。

HP:0033583.name: Follicular bronchiolitis
HP:0033583.definition: Follicular bronchiolitis is a polyclonal hyperplasia of bronchiolar associated lymphoid tissue characterized by the is characterized by the development of lymphoid follicles with germinal centers in walls of the small airways.
HP:0033583.definition_cn: 滤泡性细支气管炎是一种细支气管相关淋巴组织的多克隆增生，其特征为在小气道壁内形成具有生发中心的淋巴滤泡。

HP:0033584.name: Nonspecific interstitial pneumonia
HP:0033584.definition: Temporally uniform (all lesions are in the same stage of evolution) pattern of diffuse inflammatory interstitial process, mostly symmetric over the entire lung, involving mainly the alveolar septa.
HP:0033584.definition_cn: 时间上均匀（所有病变处于相同的演变阶段）的弥漫性炎症性间质过程模式，主要在整个肺部对称分布，主要累及肺泡间隔。

HP:0033585.name: Fibrotic non-specific interstitial pneumonia
HP:0033585.definition: A type of non-specific interstitial pneumonia in which interstitial thickening is due to uniform dense or loose fibrosis and mild chronic inflammation.
HP:0033585.name_cn: 纤维化性非特异性间质性肺炎
HP:0033585.definition_cn: 一种非特异性间质性肺炎，其间质增厚由均匀致密或疏松的纤维化及轻度慢性炎症引起。

HP:0033586.name: Cellular non-specific interstitial pneumonia
HP:0033586.definition: A type of non-specific interstitial pneumonia in which interstitial thickening is mainly due to infiltration of inflammatory cells and type II pneumocyte hyperplasia.
HP:0033586.name_cn: 细胞性非特异性间质性肺炎
HP:0033586.definition_cn: 一种非特异性间质性肺炎，其中间质增厚主要由炎性细胞浸润和II型肺泡上皮细胞增生引起。

HP:0033587.name: Vulvar abscess
HP:0033587.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the vulvar region.
HP:0033587.definition_cn: 外阴区域局限性脓液或坏死组织积聚。

HP:0033588.name: Labial adhesion
HP:0033588.definition: Synechia vulvae (adhesions of the labia minora) are characterized by a complete or partial fusion of the labia minora in the midline.
HP:0033588.definition_cn: 小阴唇粘连（Synechia vulvae）的特征是小阴唇在中线处发生完全或部分融合。

HP:0033589.name: Flatulence
HP:0033589.definition: Passage of excessive amounts of gas and the feeling of abdominal fullness and bloating.
HP:0033589.definition_cn: 过度排气及腹部饱胀感和胀气感。

HP:0033590.name: Inguinal abscess
HP:0033590.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the groin (inguinal region).
HP:0033590.definition_cn: 腹股沟区（腹股沟区域）局限性脓液或坏死组织积聚。

HP:0033591.name: Staghorn calculus
HP:0033591.definition: Large branching stones that fill part of all of the renal pelvis and renal calyces and they can be complete or partial depending on the level of occupancy of the collecting system.
HP:0033591.definition_cn: 占据部分或全部肾盂及肾盏的大型分支状结石，根据其占据集合系统的程度，可分为完全性结石或部分性结石。

HP:0033592.name: Anti-H3-H4 antibody positivity
HP:0033592.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against the H3-H4 histone dimer.
HP:0033592.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对H3-H4组蛋白二聚体的自身抗体。

HP:0033593.name: Anti-H2A-H2B antibody positivity
HP:0033593.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against the H2A-H2B histone dimer.
HP:0033593.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对H2A-H2B组蛋白二聚体的自身抗体。

HP:0033594.name: Elevated urinary 7-biopterin level
HP:0033594.definition: An abnormally increased amount of 7-biopterin in the urine.
HP:0033594.name_cn: 尿液中7-生物蝶呤水平升高
HP:0033594.definition_cn: 尿液中7-生物蝶呤异常增高。

HP:0033595.name: Elevated circulating globotriaosylceramide concentration
HP:0033595.definition: Increased concentration of globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) in the blood circulation. Globotriaosylceramide, also named ceramidetrihexoside, is the primary lipid storage in Fabry disease.
HP:0033595.name_cn: 循环中升高的三己糖神经酰胺浓度
HP:0033595.definition_cn: 血液循环中三己糖酰基鞘氨醇（Globotriaosylceramide, Gb3）浓度升高。三己糖酰基鞘氨醇，亦称神经酰胺三己糖苷（Ceramidetrihexoside），是法布里病（Fabry Disease）中主要的脂质储存物质。

HP:0033596.name: Elevated urinary 3-methylcrotonylglycine level
HP:0033596.definition: An abnormally increased amount of 3-methylcrotonylglycine in the urine.
HP:0033596.name_cn: 尿液中3-甲基巴豆酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:0033596.definition_cn: 尿液中3-甲基巴豆酰甘氨酸异常升高。

HP:0033597.name: Decreased mucosal sucrase-isomaltase activity
HP:0033597.definition: Reduced activity of the linked disaccharidase, sucrase-isomaltase, which is a glycoprotein localized to the brush border membrane of small intestinal villi.
HP:0033597.name_cn: 黏膜蔗糖酶-异麦芽糖酶活性降低
HP:0033597.definition_cn: 与刷状缘膜相关的双糖酶活性降低，即蔗糖酶-异麦芽糖酶，这是一种定位于小肠绒毛刷状缘膜的糖蛋白。

HP:0033598.name: Fibrillar glomerular subepithelial deposits
HP:0033598.definition: Fibrillar deposits located between the outer (epithelial) aspect of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) and the visceral epithelial cell, with varying degrees of incorporation into the GBM. This feature is associated with a prominent GBM reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate).
HP:0033598.name_cn: 纤维样肾小球上皮下沉积物
HP:0033598.definition_cn: 位于肾小球基底膜（GBM）外侧（上皮侧）与脏层上皮细胞之间的纤维样沉积物，不同程度地融入GBM中。此特征与GBM显著增厚相关，表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观评估）。

HP:0033599.name: Glomerular amyloid subepithelial deposits
HP:0033599.definition: A type of fibrillar glomerular subepithelial deposit characterized by extracellular aggregates composed of fine, randomly oriented, non-branching fibrils 8-12 nm in diameter, often forming a cottony mass. This feature is associated with a prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate).
HP:0033599.name_cn: 肾小球淀粉样物质上皮下沉积
HP:0033599.definition_cn: 一种纤维样肾小球上皮下沉积物，其特征为由直径8-12纳米的细、随机排列、无分支的纤维组成的细胞外聚集物，常形成棉絮状团块。此特征与显著的肾小球基底膜（GBM）相关，表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观估计）。

HP:0033600.name: Fibrillary glomerular subepithelial deposits
HP:0033600.definition: A type of fibrillar glomerular subepithelial deposit characterized by extracellular aggregates of randomly arranged, straight, non-branching fibrils that are thicker than amyloid fibrils (average diameter about 20 nm) and are often admixed with smudgy, electron-dense material. This feature is associated with a prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate).
HP:0033600.name_cn: 纤维性肾小球上皮下沉积物
HP:0033600.definition_cn: 一种纤维状肾小球上皮下沉积物，其特征为细胞外随机排列的直纤维聚集，这些纤维不分支且比淀粉样纤维更粗（平均直径约20纳米），常与模糊的电子致密物质混合。此特征与显著的肾小球基底膜（GBM）相关，表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观估计）。

HP:0033601.name: Glomerular subepithelial immune-complex deposits
HP:0033601.definition: A type of glomerular subepithelial deposit characterized by finely granular material deposited between the outer (epithelial) aspect of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) and the visceral epithelial cell, with varying degrees of incorporation into the GBM and corresponding to immunoglobulin and/or complement by immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry. This feature is associated with a prominent GBM reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate).
HP:0033601.name_cn: 肾小球上皮下免疫复合物沉积
HP:0033601.definition_cn: 一种肾小球上皮下沉积类型，其特征为细颗粒状物质沉积于肾小球基底膜（GBM）外（上皮）侧与脏层上皮细胞之间，伴有不同程度地融入GBM，并通过免疫荧光/免疫组织化学检测与免疫球蛋白和/或补体相对应。此特征与显著的GBM增厚相关，表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观评估）。

HP:0033602.name: Glomerular hyaline subepithelial deposits
HP:0033602.definition: A type of glomerular subepithelial deposit characterized by a moderately electron-dense, generally homogenous, amorphous-appearing extracellular material located between the outer (epithelial) aspect of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) and the visceral epithelial cell, with varying degrees of incorporation into the GBM. This feature is associated with a prominent GBM reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate).
HP:0033602.name_cn: 肾小球透明上皮下沉积物
HP:0033602.definition_cn: 一种肾小球上皮下沉积类型，其特征为中等电子密度、通常均质、无定形外观的细胞外物质，位于肾小球基底膜（GBM）的外侧（上皮侧）与脏层上皮细胞之间，并不同程度地融入GBM。此特征与显著的GBM增厚相关，表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观评估）。

HP:0033603.name: Glomerular subepithelial deposits
