HP:0033603.definition: Deposits located between the outer (epithelial) aspect of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) and the visceral epithelial cell, with varying degrees of incorporation into the GBM. This feature may be associated with a prominent GBM reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate).
HP:0033603.definition_cn: 沉积物位于肾小球基底膜（GBM）的外侧（上皮）面与脏层上皮细胞之间，并不同程度地融入GBM中。这一特征可能与显著的GBM增厚相关，表现为弥漫性且相对均匀的厚度增加（主观评估）。

HP:0033604.name: Glomerular capillary wire loop deposits
HP:0033604.definition: Glomerulus showing markedly and irregularly thickened capillary walls with massive fuchsinophilic subendothelial deposits, resulting in narrowing of capillary lumina. This feature is said to resemble a wire loop.
HP:0033604.name_cn: 肾小球毛细血管袢样沉积物
HP:0033604.definition_cn: 肾小球显示毛细血管壁显著且不规则增厚，伴有大量嗜品红性内皮下沉积物，导致毛细血管腔狭窄。此特征被称为“铁丝圈样改变”。

HP:0033605.name: Pustular rash
HP:0033605.definition: A rash composed of pustular lesions. A pustule is defined as a vesicle or bulla containing purulent material. It varies in size and may occur at different levels within the epidermis: subcorneal, intraepidermal, or basement membrane zones. The pustules may or may not be sterile and are normally filled with neutrophils.
HP:0033605.definition_cn: 由脓疱性病变组成的皮疹。脓疱定义为含有脓性物质的囊泡或大疱。其大小不一，可发生在表皮内的不同层次：角质层下、表皮内或基底膜区。脓疱可能无菌或非无菌，通常充满中性粒细胞。

HP:0033606.name: Bone marrow maturation arrest
HP:0033606.definition: Interruption of the procecss of diffferentiation of hematopoietic cells in the bone marrow, manifested by an increased proportion of immature cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0033606.definition_cn: 骨髓中造血细胞分化过程中断，表现为骨髓中未成熟细胞比例增加。

HP:0033607.name: Bone marrow arrest at the promyelocytic stage
HP:0033607.definition: A type of bone marrow maturation arrest characterized by accumulation of neutrophil precursor cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0033607.name_cn: 骨髓停滞于早幼粒细胞阶段
HP:0033607.definition_cn: 一种以骨髓中中性粒细胞前体细胞积聚为特征的骨髓成熟障碍类型。

HP:0033608.name: Pulmonary nodule
HP:0033608.definition: Focal rounded or ovoid opacity, not more than 3 cm in diameter. Pulmonary nodules are typically observed by chest radiography or computer tomography imaging.
HP:0033608.definition_cn: 局灶性圆形或卵圆形密度影，直径不超过3厘米。肺结节通常通过胸部X线摄影或计算机断层扫描成像进行观察。

HP:0033609.name: Solid pulmonary nodule
HP:0033609.definition: A type of pulmonary nodule whose density obscures the underlying parenchyma and thus has a \
HP:0033609.definition_cn: 一种肺部结节类型，其密度遮蔽了下方实质组织，因此具有\

HP:0033610.name: Subsolid pulmonary nodule
HP:0033610.definition: Pulmonary subsolid nodules (SSNs) refer to pulmonary nodules with pure ground-glass nodules and part-solid ground-glass nodules. A ground-glass nodule (GGN) is the morphologic description of a pulmonary nodule category on thin-section chest computed tomography (CT). During the past decade, the natural history, management strategy and long-term prognosis in the case of GGNs have attracted attention.
HP:0033610.definition_cn: 肺亚实性结节（SSNs）指的是包含纯磨玻璃结节和部分实性磨玻璃结节的肺结节。磨玻璃结节（GGN）是薄层胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）上对一类肺结节的形态学描述。在过去十年中，磨玻璃结节的自然病程、管理策略及长期预后引起了广泛关注。

HP:0033611.name: Part-solid pulmonary nodule
HP:0033611.definition: Part-solid pulmonary nodules are nodules that present with both ground-glass and solid components in which the underlying lung architecture cannot be visualized.
HP:0033611.definition_cn: 部分实性肺结节是指同时呈现磨玻璃影和实性成分的结节，其中无法观察到下方的肺组织结构。

HP:0033612.name: Pure ground-glass pulmonary nodule
HP:0033612.definition: Pure ground-glass pulmonary nodules (GGNs) are defined as focal nodular areas of increased lung attenuation through which lung parenchymal structures, such as the pulmonary vessels or bronchial structures, can be observed.
HP:0033612.definition_cn: 纯磨玻璃样肺结节（Pure Ground-Glass Nodules, GGNs）被定义为局灶性结节样区域，其肺组织密度增高，但仍可透过其观察到肺实质结构，如肺血管或支气管结构。

HP:0033613.name: Perifissural pulmonary nodule
HP:0033613.definition: Solid, homogenous nodules characterized by a smooth margin and oval, rounded, lentiform or triangular shape. They are typically located within 15 mm from the issue or the pleura. Perifissural nodules may be further differentiated into typical (have contact with interlobar septum) and atypical (do not have contact with interlobar septum). They likely represent intrapulmonary lymphnodes.
HP:0033613.definition_cn: 实性、均质性结节，边缘光滑，呈椭圆形、圆形、透镜形或三角形。通常位于距胸膜或肺实质15毫米以内。肺裂旁结节可进一步分为典型（与叶间隔接触）和非典型（不与叶间隔接触）。这些结节可能代表肺内淋巴结。

HP:0033614.name: Tracheal bronchus
HP:0033614.definition: Aberrant or accessory bronchus supplying the upper lobe originating from the lateral wall of the trachea. The tracheal bronchus is more commonly right-sided, has a variable length and may be blind-ended. Two common types of tracheal bronchus are: supernumerary and displaced.
HP:0033614.definition_cn: 起源于气管侧壁的异常或副支气管供应上叶。气管支气管更常见于右侧，长度不一，可能为盲端。气管支气管的两种常见类型为：额外型和移位型。

HP:0033615.name: Displaced tracheal bronchus
HP:0033615.definition: Accessory bronchus originating from trachea replacing one of the segmental branches of the anatomically normal upper lobe bronchus.
HP:0033615.definition_cn: 起源于气管的副支气管取代了解剖学上正常的上叶支气管的一个段支。

HP:0033616.name: Accessory cardiac bronchus
HP:0033616.definition: Accessory bronchus originating from the medial wall of the right or left ban bronchus or bronchus intermedius. A cardiac bronchus is usually blind-ended.
HP:0033616.definition_cn: 起源于右或左主支气管或中间支气管内侧壁的副支气管。心脏支气管通常为盲端。

HP:0033617.name: Supernumerary tracheal bronchus
HP:0033617.definition: Accessory bronchus which exits the trachea in addition to an anatomically normal branching upper lobe bronchus.
HP:0033617.definition_cn: 副支气管，其在解剖学上正常的上叶支气管分支之外从气管分出。

HP:0033618.name: Displaced lobar tracheal bronchus
HP:0033618.definition: Accessory entire right upper lobe bronchial system originating from the trachea with absent anatomically normal upper lobe bronchus.
HP:0033618.name_cn: 移位性肺叶气管支气管
HP:0033618.definition_cn: 起源于气管的右上叶副支气管系统，伴解剖学上正常的右上叶支气管缺如。

HP:0033619.name: Typical perifissural nodule
HP:0033619.definition: A perifissural nodule that has contact with the interlobar septum (and is therefore considered typical).
HP:0033619.definition_cn: 与叶间隔接触的裂隙周围结节（因此被认为是典型的）。

HP:0033620.name: Atypical perifissural nodule
HP:0033620.definition: A perifissural nodule that does not have contact with the interlobar septum (and is therefore considered atypical).
HP:0033620.definition_cn: 不与叶间隔接触的裂隙旁结节（因此被视为非典型）。

HP:0033621.name: Bronchial diverticula
HP:0033621.definition: Bronchial diverticula are blind-ended outpouchings arising from the bronchial tree. They are commonly pulsion diverticula acquired related to chronic cough. Subcarinal air cyst is thought to represent a small main bronchial diverticulum.
HP:0033621.definition_cn: 支气管憩室是起源于支气管树的盲端外突囊袋。它们通常是与慢性咳嗽相关的获得性压力性憩室。隆突下气囊被认为是一种小型主支气管憩室。

HP:0033622.name: Migratory erythematous plaque
HP:0033622.definition: A migratory, centrifugal, erythematous, tender, non-purpuric, and well-demarcated plaque. This feature may be observed in TNF receptor-associated periodic syndrome, in which it often occurs together with migratory myalgia in muscles located underneath the affected areas of skin.
HP:0033622.definition_cn: 一种游走性、离心性、红斑性、触痛性、非紫癜性且边界清晰的斑块。此特征可见于肿瘤坏死因子受体相关周期性综合征（TNF receptor-associated periodic syndrome），常与受累皮肤区域下方肌肉的游走性肌痛同时发生。

HP:0033623.name: Birth history
HP:0033623.definition: Information about the delivery and health status at birth typically elicited as a part of the past medical history.
HP:0033623.definition_cn: 关于分娩和出生时健康状况的信息通常作为既往病史的一部分进行采集。

HP:0033624.name: History of congenital CMV infection
HP:0033624.definition: A congenital cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection of the newborn can follow either a primary or recurrent maternal infection. Jaundice, petechiae, and hepatosplenomegaly are the most frequently noted clinical triad in symptomatic infants. Affected infants may develop permanent disabilities such as hearing loss, vision loss, motor and cognitive deficits.
HP:0033624.name_cn: 先天性巨细胞病毒感染史
HP:0033624.definition_cn: 新生儿先天性巨细胞病毒（CMV）感染可由母体原发性或复发性感染引起。黄疸、瘀点和肝脾肿大是有症状婴儿中最常见的临床三联征。受影响的婴儿可能会出现永久性残疾，如听力损失、视力丧失、运动和认知缺陷。

HP:0033625.name: Emotional insecurity
HP:0033625.definition: A feeling of general unease or nervousness that may be triggered by a sense of vulnerability or instability, which is perceived as threatening.
HP:0033625.definition_cn: 一种普遍的不适或紧张感，可能由脆弱感或不稳定感引发，这些感觉被感知为具有威胁性。

HP:0033626.name: Increased non-HDL cholesterol concentration
HP:0033626.definition: Increase above normal levels of non-HDL cholesterol in the blood. Non-HDL cholesterol is total cholesterol minus high-density lipoprotein HDL-cholesterol (high-density lipoprotein-cholesterol).
HP:0033626.name_cn: 非高密度脂蛋白胆固醇浓度升高
HP:0033626.definition_cn: 血液中非高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（non-HDL cholesterol）水平升高至超出正常范围。非高密度脂蛋白胆固醇为总胆固醇（total cholesterol）减去高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, HDL-C）后的数值。

HP:0033627.name: Increased urine harderoporphyrin level
HP:0033627.definition: Concentration of harderoporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0033627.definition_cn: 尿液中硬卟啉浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:0033628.name: Bowel irritability
HP:0033628.definition: Intermittent abdominal pain with diarrhea and/or constipation.
HP:0033628.definition_cn: 间歇性腹痛伴腹泻和/或便秘。

HP:0033629.name: IgG4 autoimmune antibody positivity
HP:0033629.definition: The presence of an antibody of subclass IgG4 in the blood circulation that is directed against the organism's own cells or tissues.
HP:0033629.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对机体自身细胞或组织的IgG4亚类抗体。

HP:0033630.name: Brain fog
HP:0033630.definition: Brain fog is a type of transient cognitive dysfunction that comprises a constellation of symptoms that impair intellectual functioning to a level that interferes with daily activities, commonly including forgetfulness, mental slowness, difficulty thinking or focusing, a perceived slowing of mental processing speed, inability to find the right words, a sensation that the mind went blank or is \
HP:0033630.definition_cn: 脑雾是一种短暂的认知功能障碍，包含一系列症状，这些症状损害智力功能至影响日常活动的水平，通常包括健忘、思维迟缓、思考或集中注意力困难、感知到的思维处理速度减慢、无法找到合适的词语、感觉大脑一片空白或“卡住”。

HP:0033631.name: Spondylitis
HP:0033631.definition: Inflammation of the vertebrae (vertebral bodies) or spine.
HP:0033631.definition_cn: 椎体或脊柱的炎症（脊椎炎）。

HP:0033632.name: Abnormal alveolar volume
HP:0033632.definition: Alveolar volume (VA) is a volume accessible during 10-second breath-hold, measured during a single breath maneuver. VA is calculated by knowing the fractional concentration of the tracer gas (eg helium) and the volume of the gas inhaled. VA = Vi*(Fi tracer/Fa tracer). In this equation, Vi = inspired volume of tracer gas, Fi tracer= inspired fraction of tracer gas, Fa tracer = alveolar (exhaled) fraction of tracer gas.
HP:0033632.definition_cn: 肺泡容积（VA）是指在单次呼吸操作中，通过10秒屏气期间可测量的容积。VA的计算基于示踪气体（如氦气）的分数浓度以及吸入气体的体积。VA = Vi*(Fi示踪/Fa示踪)。在此公式中，Vi = 吸入示踪气体的体积，Fi示踪 = 吸入示踪气体的分数浓度，Fa示踪 = 肺泡（呼出）示踪气体的分数浓度。

HP:0033633.name: Decreased alveolar volume
HP:0033633.definition: An abnormal reduction in alveolar volume.

HP:0033634.name: Increased alveolar volume
HP:0033634.definition: An abnormal elevation in alveolar volume.

HP:0033635.name: Post-capillary pulmonary hypertension
HP:0033635.definition: Post-capillary pulmonary hypertension is a hemodynamic condition characterized by elevated mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP greater than 20 mmHg) and pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP greater than 15 mmHg) and pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR less than 3 Wood units).
HP:0033635.name_cn: 毛细血管后性肺动脉高压
HP:0033635.definition_cn: 毛细血管后肺动脉高压是一种血流动力学状态，其特征为平均肺动脉压升高（mPAP大于20 mmHg）、肺动脉楔压升高（PAWP大于15 mmHg）以及肺血管阻力降低（PVR小于3 Wood单位）。

HP:0033636.name: Combined pre- and post-capillary pulmonary hypertension
HP:0033636.definition: Combined pre- and post-capillary pulmonary hypertension is a haemodynamic condition characterized by elevated mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP over 20 mmHg) and pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP over 15 mmHg) and pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR at least 3 Wodd units).
HP:0033636.name_cn: 混合性毛细血管前和毛细血管后肺动脉高压
HP:0033636.definition_cn: 混合性毛细血管前后性肺动脉高压是一种血流动力学状态，其特征为平均肺动脉压（mPAP超过20 mmHg）、肺动脉楔压（PAWP超过15 mmHg）和肺血管阻力（PVR至少3 Wood单位）的升高。

HP:0033637.name: Anti-endomysial antibody positivity
HP:0033637.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against endomysial tissue transglutaminase 2 (tTG2).
HP:0033637.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对肌内膜组织转谷氨酰胺酶2（tTG2）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033638.name: Intralobular septal thickening
HP:0033638.definition: Intralobular septal thickening is a computed tomography finding of increased width of the walls (septa) within a pulmonary lobule. Secondary pulmonary lobules represent a cluster of up to 30 acini 9 supplied by a common distal pulmonary artery and bronchiole. These clustered acini are bounded by interstitial fibrous septa (interlobular septa) which outline an irregular polyhedron of varying size between 1 and 2.5 cm. Interlobular septal thickening is seen on chest radiographs as thin linear opacities at right angles to and in contact with the lateral pleural surfaces near the lung bases. In contrast, intralobular septal thickening are visible as fine linear opacities in a lobule when the intralobular interstitial tissue is abnormally thickened. When numerous, they may appear as a fine reticular pattern.
HP:0033638.definition_cn: 小叶间隔增厚是一种计算机断层扫描（CT）表现，指肺小叶内间隔壁的宽度增加。次级肺小叶由多达30个腺泡组成，这些腺泡由共同的远端肺动脉和细支气管供血。这些聚集的腺泡被间质纤维间隔（小叶间隔）所包围，形成大小在1至2.5厘米之间的不规则多面体。在胸部X线片上，小叶间隔增厚表现为与肺基底附近侧胸膜表面垂直并接触的细线状阴影。相比之下，当小叶内间质组织异常增厚时，小叶间隔增厚在小叶内表现为细线状阴影。当数量较多时，可能呈现为细网状模式。

HP:0033639.name: Septic pulmonary embolism
HP:0033639.definition: Embolization of intravascular thrombus containing microorganisms into the pulmonary parenchyma via arterial system. Septic pulmonary embolism (PE) can be associated with multiple additional clinical manifestations such as fever, tachypnea, and hemoptysis. This HPO term refers to the finding of the septic embolus in the lung, which can be inferred from radiological findings. Typical radiographic features of septic PE include patchy air space lesions simulating non-specific bronchopneumonia; multiple ill defined round or wedge shaped densities of varying sizes from approximately 0.5 to 3.5 cm located peripherally; lesions abutting the pleura and located at the end of vessels (feeding vessel sign) seen on chest CT scans. Other pulmonary features suggesting septic PE include bilateral, occasional unilateral, rapid progression of cavities or abscess formations.
HP:0033639.definition_cn: 含有微生物的血管内血栓通过动脉系统栓塞至肺实质。脓毒性肺栓塞（Septic Pulmonary Embolism, PE）可伴随多种临床表现，如发热、呼吸急促和咯血。该人类表型本体（Human Phenotype Ontology, HPO）术语指在肺部发现的脓毒性栓子，可通过影像学检查推断。脓毒性肺栓塞的典型影像学特征包括：类似非特异性支气管肺炎的斑片状气腔病变；外周分布的多发边界不清的圆形或楔形密度影，大小从约0.5至3.5厘米不等；胸部CT扫描中可见病变紧邻胸膜并位于血管末端（供血血管征）。提示脓毒性肺栓塞的其他肺部特征包括双侧或偶尔单侧的空洞或脓肿形成的快速进展。

HP:0033640.name: Acetabular erosions
HP:0033640.definition: Erosion (loss of substance) of the acetabular subchondral cortical bone. The acetabulum is the concave surface that meets with the head of the femur, forming the hip joint.
HP:0033640.definition_cn: 髋臼软骨下皮质骨侵蚀（物质丢失）。髋臼是与股骨头相接的凹面，共同构成髋关节。

HP:0033641.name: Aortic valve leaflet calcification
HP:0033641.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the leaflets (cusps) of the aortic valve.
HP:0033641.definition_cn: 主动脉瓣瓣叶钙盐沉积。

HP:0033642.name: Mitral valve leaflet calcification
HP:0033642.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in the leaflets (cusps) of the mitral valve.
HP:0033642.definition_cn: 二尖瓣瓣叶（瓣尖）钙盐沉积。

HP:0033643.name: Increased circulating very long-chain fatty acid concentration
HP:0033643.definition: Increased concentration of very long-chain fatty acids in the blood circulation. Very long-chain fatty acids are fatty acids (FAs) with a chain-length of 22 or more carbons.
HP:0033643.name_cn: 循环中极长链脂肪酸浓度升高
HP:0033643.definition_cn: 血液循环中极长链脂肪酸浓度升高。极长链脂肪酸是指碳链长度在22个或以上的脂肪酸。

HP:0033644.name: Elevated circulating erythropoietin concentration
HP:0033644.definition: Increased concentration of erythropoietin in the blood circulation. Erythropoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the peritubular cells of the kidney that stimulates red blood cell production.
HP:0033644.name_cn: 循环促红细胞生成素浓度升高
HP:0033644.definition_cn: 血液循环中促红细胞生成素浓度升高。促红细胞生成素是一种由肾小管周围细胞产生的糖蛋白激素，可刺激红细胞生成。

HP:0033645.name: Midline brainstem cleft
HP:0033645.definition: A developmental defect characterized by an abnormal cleft (V-shaped indentation of the stalklike part of the brain consisting of the medulla oblongata, the midbrain, and the pons.
HP:0033645.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为异常裂隙（V形凹陷），位于脑干（由延髓、中脑和脑桥组成的茎状部分）。

HP:0033646.name: Absent hippocampal commissure
HP:0033646.definition: Absence of the fibers that connect the contralateral hippocampi via the crura of the fornix and run beneath the posterior portion of the corpus callosum.
HP:0033646.definition_cn: 通过穹窿脚连接对侧海马并在胼胝体后部下方走行的纤维缺失。

HP:0033647.name: Silhouette sign
HP:0033647.definition: The silhouette sign is the absence of depiction of an anatomic soft-tissue border. It is caused by consolidation and/or atelectasis of the adjacent lung, by a large mass, or by contiguous pleural fluid. The silhouette sign results from the juxtaposition of structures of similar radiographic attenuation. The sign actually refers to the absence of a silhouette.
HP:0033647.definition_cn: 轮廓征是指解剖软组织边界无法显现的现象。其成因包括邻近肺部的实变和/或肺不张、巨大肿块或邻近的胸腔积液。轮廓征是由于具有相似放射线衰减特性的结构并列所致。该征象实际上指的是轮廓的缺失。

HP:0033648.name: Pulmonary pseudocavity
HP:0033648.definition: A pseudocavity appears as an oval or round area of low attenuation in lung nodules, masses, or areas of consolidation that represent spared parenchyma, normal or ectatic bronchi, or focal emphysema rather than cavitation. These pseudocavities usually measure less than 1 cm in diameter. They have been described in patients with adenocarcinoma, bronchioloalveolar carcinoma, and benign conditions such as infectious pneumonia.
HP:0033648.definition_cn: 假性空洞表现为肺结节、肿块或实变区域内的椭圆形或圆形低密度区，代表残留的肺实质、正常或扩张的支气管，或局灶性肺气肿，而非真正的空洞形成。这些假性空洞的直径通常小于1厘米。它们已在腺癌、细支气管肺泡癌以及感染性肺炎等良性病变的患者中被描述。

HP:0033649.name: Paraseptal emphysema
HP:0033649.definition: Paraseptal emphysema is characterized by predominant involvement of the distal alveoli and their ducts and sacs. It is characteristically bounded by any pleural surface and the interlobular septa. This emphysema is characterized by subpleural and peribronchovascular regions of low attenuation separated by intact interlobular septa, sometimes associated with bullae.
HP:0033649.definition_cn: 间隔旁型肺气肿的特征是主要累及远端肺泡及其导管和囊泡。其典型表现为由任何胸膜表面和小叶间隔所界定。该型肺气肿的特征是胸膜下和支气管血管周围区域出现低密度影，由完整的小叶间隔分隔，有时伴有肺大泡。

HP:0033650.name: Pulmonary parenchymal band
HP:0033650.definition: A parenchymal band is a linear opacity, usually 1-3 mm thick and up to 5 cm long that usually extends to the visceral pleura (which is often thickened and may be retracted at the site of contact). It reflects pleuroparenchymal fibrosis and is usually associated with distortion of the lung architecture. Parenchymal bands are most frequently encountered in individuals who have been exposed to asbestos.
HP:0033650.definition_cn: 肺实质带是一种线性致密影，通常厚度为1-3毫米，长度可达5厘米，通常延伸至脏层胸膜（该处胸膜常增厚并可能在接触部位回缩）。它反映了胸膜肺实质纤维化，通常与肺结构扭曲相关。肺实质带最常见于曾接触石棉的个体。

HP:0033651.name: Pulmonary mycetoma
HP:0033651.definition: A mycetoma is a discrete mass of intertwined hyphae, usually of an Aspergillus species, matted together by mucus, fibrin, and cellular debris colonizing a cavity, usually from prior fibrocavitary disease (eg, tuberculosis or sarcoidosis). A mycetoma may move to a dependent location when the patient changes position and may show an air crescent sign. CT scans may show a spongelike pattern and foci of calcification in the mycetoma.
HP:0033651.definition_cn: 真菌球是由交织的菌丝组成的离散团块，通常为曲霉菌属，由黏液、纤维蛋白和细胞碎片粘合在一起，定植于空洞内，通常继发于先前的纤维空洞性疾病（如结核病或结节病）。当患者改变体位时，真菌球可能会移动到依赖位置，并可能显示空气新月征。CT扫描可能显示真菌球内的海绵样模式和钙化灶。

HP:0033652.name: Broncholith
HP:0033652.definition: A broncholith, a calcified peribronchial lymph node that erodes into an adjacent bronchus, is most often the consequence of Histoplasma or tuberculous infection. The imaging appearance is of a small calcific focus in or immediately adjacent to an airway, most frequently the right middle lobe bronchus. Broncholiths are readily identified on CT scans. Distal obstructive changes may include atelectasis, mucoid impaction, and bronchiectasis
HP:0033652.definition_cn: 支气管结石（broncholith）是一种钙化的支气管周围淋巴结，侵蚀至邻近的支气管，通常由组织胞浆菌（Histoplasma）或结核感染引起。影像学表现为气道内或紧邻气道的小钙化灶，最常见于右中叶支气管。支气管结石在CT扫描中易于识别。远端阻塞性改变可能包括肺不张（atelectasis）、黏液嵌塞（mucoid impaction）和支气管扩张（bronchiectasis）。

HP:0033653.name: Bronchocele
HP:0033653.definition: A bronchocele is bronchial dilatation due to retained secretions (mucoid impaction) usually caused by proximal obstruction, either congenital (eg, bronchial atresia) or acquired (eg, obstructing cancer). A bronchocele is a tubular or branching Y-or V-shaped structure that may resemble a gloved finger. The CT attenuation of the mucus is generally that of soft tissue but may be modified by its composition (eg, high-attenuation material in allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis). In the case of bronchial atresia, the surrounding lung may be of decreased attenuation because of reduced ventilation and, thus, perfusion.
HP:0033653.definition_cn: 支气管囊肿是由于近端阻塞（如先天性支气管闭锁或获得性阻塞性肿瘤）导致的支气管扩张，通常由分泌物滞留（黏液嵌塞）引起。支气管囊肿呈管状或分支状的Y形或V形结构，可能类似于戴手套的手指。黏液在CT上的衰减值通常与软组织相似，但其成分可能影响其表现（例如，过敏性支气管肺曲霉病中的高衰减物质）。在支气管闭锁的情况下，由于通气减少，周围肺组织的衰减值可能降低，从而导致灌注减少。

HP:0033654.name: Beaded septum sign
HP:0033654.definition: Irregular and nodular thickening of interlobular septa reminiscent of a row of beads.
HP:0033654.definition_cn: 小叶间隔不规则结节样增厚，呈串珠样改变。

HP:0033655.name: Pulmonary cavity
HP:0033655.definition: A gas-filled space, seen as lucency or low-attenuation area, within a nodule, mass or area of parenchymal consolidations. It has a clearly defined wall over 4 mm thick.
HP:0033655.definition_cn: 结节、肿块或实质实变区域内出现的气体填充空间，表现为透亮区或低密度区，其壁清晰且厚度超过4毫米。

HP:0033656.name: Juxtaphrenic peak
HP:0033656.definition: A juxtaphrenic peak is a small triangular opacity based at the apex of the dome of a hemidiaphragm, associated with upper lobe volume loss of any cause (eg, postirradiation fibrosis or upper lobectomy). It is most readily appreciated on a frontal chest radiograph. The peak is caused by upward retraction of the inferior accessory fissure or an intrapulmonary septum associated with the pulmonary ligament.
HP:0033656.definition_cn: 膈旁峰是指位于一侧膈顶顶点的小三角形致密影，与任何原因引起的上叶体积缩小相关（例如，放射性纤维化或上叶切除术）。在胸部正位X线片上最易观察到。该峰是由于下副裂或与肺韧带相关的肺内间隔向上牵拉所致。

HP:0033657.name: Linear atelectasis
HP:0033657.definition: Linear atelectasis is a focal area of subsegmental atelectasis with a linear configuration, almost always extending to the pleura. It is commonly horizontal but sometimes oblique or vertical. The thickness of the atelectasis may range from a few millimeters to more than 1 cm.
HP:0033657.definition_cn: 线性肺不张是一种局灶性亚段肺不张，呈线性形态，几乎总是延伸至胸膜。它通常呈水平方向，但有时也可呈斜向或垂直方向。肺不张的厚度可从几毫米到超过1厘米不等。

HP:0033658.name: Rounded atelectasis
HP:0033658.definition: Rounded atelectasis is rounded collapsed lung associated with invaginated fibrotic pleura and thickened and fibrotic interlobular septa. Most frequently, it is the consequence of an asbestos-induced exudative pleural effusion with resultant pleural scarring, but it may occur with any cause of pleural fibrosis. On chest radiographs, rounded atelectasis appears as a mass abutting a pleural surface, usually in the posterior part of a lower lobe. Distorted vessels have a curvilinear disposition as they converge on the mass (the comet tail sign). The degree of lobar retraction depends on the volume of atelectatic lung. It is almost invariably associated with other signs of pleural fibrosis (eg, blunting of costophrenic angle). CT is more sensitive for the detection and display of the characteristic features of rounded atelectasis. An additional sign is homogeneous uptake of contrast medium in the atelectatic lung.
HP:0033658.definition_cn: 圆形肺不张是指与内陷的纤维化胸膜及增厚且纤维化的叶间隔相关的圆形肺塌陷。最常见的原因是石棉引起的渗出性胸腔积液导致的胸膜瘢痕形成，但也可能由任何导致胸膜纤维化的病因引起。在胸部X线片上，圆形肺不张表现为紧贴胸膜表面的肿块，通常位于下叶的后部。扭曲的血管呈曲线状向肿块汇聚（彗星尾征）。肺叶回缩的程度取决于肺不张的范围。几乎总是伴有其他胸膜纤维化的征象（例如，肋膈角变钝）。CT在检测和显示圆形肺不张的特征性表现方面更为敏感。另一个征象是不张肺组织对造影剂的均匀摄取。

HP:0033660.name: Hand paresthesia
HP:0033660.definition: Tingling (often referred to as a pins and needles feeling) and numbness in the hand.
HP:0033660.definition_cn: 手部感觉异常（常描述为针刺感）及麻木。

HP:0033661.name: Air crescent
HP:0033661.definition: An air crescent is a collection of air in a crescentic shape that separates the wall of a cavity from an inner mass. The air crescent sign is often considered characteristic of either Aspergillus colonization of preexisting cavities or retraction of infarcted lung in angioinvasive aspergillosis. However, the air crescent sign has also been reported in other conditions, including tuberculosis, Wegener granulomatosis, intracavitary hemorrhage, and lung cancer.
HP:0033661.definition_cn: 空气新月征是指呈新月形聚集的空气，将空洞壁与内部肿块分隔开。空气新月征通常被认为是预先存在的空洞内曲霉菌定植或侵袭性曲霉菌病中梗死肺组织回缩的特征性表现。然而，空气新月征也可见于其他疾病，包括结核病、韦格纳肉芽肿病、腔内出血和肺癌。

HP:0033662.name: Air bronchogram
HP:0033662.definition: An air bronchogram is a pattern of air-filled (low-attenuation) bronchi on a background of opaque (high-attenuation) airless lung. The sign implies (a) patency of proximal airways and (b) evacuation of alveolar air by means of absorption (atelectasis) or replacement (eg, pneumonia) or a combination of these processes. In rare cases, the displacement of air is the result of marked interstitial expansion (eg, lymphoma).
HP:0033662.definition_cn: 支气管充气征是指在无气肺（高密度）背景下出现的气体填充（低密度）支气管的影像学表现。该征象提示：（a）近端气道通畅；（b）肺泡气体通过吸收（肺不张）或替代（如肺炎）或这些过程的组合被清除。在罕见情况下，气体移位是显著的间质扩张（如淋巴瘤）的结果。

HP:0033663.name: Air trapping
HP:0033663.definition: Air trapping is retention of air in the lung distal to an obstruction (usually partial). Air trapping is seen on end-expiration CT scans as parenchymal areas with less than normal increase in attenuation and lack of volume reduction. Comparison between inspiratory and expiratory CT scans can be helpful when air trapping is subtle or diffuse.
HP:0033663.definition_cn: 空气滞留是指空气在远端气道（通常为部分性）阻塞后滞留在肺内。在呼气末CT扫描中，空气滞留表现为肺实质区域衰减增加低于正常且缺乏体积缩小。当空气滞留表现轻微或弥漫时，吸气相和呼气相CT扫描的对比有助于诊断。

HP:0033664.name: Ganglioglioma
HP:0033664.definition: Gangliogliomas are rare tumors of the central nervous system. The are WHO grade I and considered low grade. They are well differentiated neuroepithelial tumors consisting of both dysplastic neuronal and neoplastic glial cells.
HP:0033664.definition_cn: 神经节胶质瘤是中枢神经系统的罕见肿瘤。它们属于WHO I级，被认为是低级别肿瘤。它们是分化良好的神经上皮性肿瘤，由发育不良的神经元和肿瘤性胶质细胞组成。

HP:0033665.name: Diminished health-related quality of life
HP:0033665.definition: A reduction in an individual's subjective assessment of his or her sense of well-being and ability to perform social roles.
HP:0033665.name_cn: 健康相关生活质量下降
HP:0033665.definition_cn: 个体对其幸福感及履行社会角色能力的主观评估下降。

HP:0033666.name: Diminished physical functioning
HP:0033666.definition: A reduction in the ability to perform activities of daily living as compared to previous abilities because of functional deficits due to illness. The 36-item Short Form (SF-36) health survey questionnaire is one of many methods used to measure patients' perceptions of diminished physical functioning.
HP:0033666.definition_cn: 由于疾病导致的功能缺陷，与先前能力相比，日常生活活动能力下降。36项简短健康调查问卷（SF-36）是用于测量患者对躯体功能减退感知的多种方法之一。

HP:0033667.name: Diminished mental health
HP:0033667.definition: A reduction in the subjective feeling of mental well being.
HP:0033667.definition_cn: 心理健康主观感受的降低。

HP:0033668.name: Abnormal amygdala morphology
HP:0033668.definition: A structural anomaly of the amygdala.

HP:0033669.name: Enlarged amygdala
HP:0033669.definition: A increase in the volume (size) of the amygdyla.

HP:0033670.name: Organizing pneumonia
HP:0033670.definition: Organizing pneumonia manifests as a histologic pattern characterized by loose plugs of connective tissue in the airspaces and distal airways. Interstitial inflammation and fibrosis are minimal or absent. Cryptogenic organizing pneumonia, or COP, is a distinctive clinical disorder among the idiopathic interstitial pneumonias, but the histologic pattern of organizing pneumonia is encountered in many different situations, including pulmonary infection, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, and collagen vascular diseases. Airspace consolidation is the cardinal feature of organizing pneumonia on chest radiographs and CT scans. In COP, the distribution is typically subpleural and basal and sometimes bronchocentric. Other manifestations of organizing pneumonia include groundglass opacity, tree-in-bud pattern, and nodular opacities.
HP:0033670.definition_cn: 机化性肺炎表现为一种组织学模式，其特征为肺泡腔和远端气道内疏松的结缔组织栓子。间质炎症和纤维化极少或不存在。隐源性机化性肺炎（COP）是特发性间质性肺炎中的一种独特临床疾病，但机化性肺炎的组织学模式见于多种不同情况，包括肺部感染、过敏性肺炎和胶原血管疾病。肺泡实变是机化性肺炎在胸部X线和CT扫描中的主要特征。在COP中，分布通常为胸膜下和基底段，有时为支气管中心性。机化性肺炎的其他表现包括磨玻璃影、树芽征和结节影。

HP:0033671.name: Pulmonary oligemia
HP:0033671.definition: Oligemia is a reduction in pulmonary blood volume. Most frequently, this reduction is regional, but occasionally it is generalized. Regional oligemia is usually associated with reduced blood flow in the oligemic area. Oligemia appears as a regional or widespread decrease in the size and number of identifiable pulmonary vessels, which is indicative of less than normal blood flow.
HP:0033671.definition_cn: 肺血容量减少（Oligemia）是指肺血容量的减少。最常见的是局部性减少，但偶尔也可为广泛性减少。区域性肺血容量减少通常与减少区域的血流减少相关。肺血容量减少表现为可识别的肺血管大小和数量的区域性或广泛性减少，这提示血流低于正常水平。

HP:0033672.name: Positive carpal Tinel sign
HP:0033672.definition: The Tinel test is performed by lightly tapping (percussing) over the median nerve. It is positive (abnormal) if the patient experiences pain and paresthesias (tingling, numbness) along the distribution of the median nerve.
HP:0033672.definition_cn: 蒂内尔试验通过轻叩（叩诊）正中神经进行。如果患者沿正中神经分布区域出现疼痛和感觉异常（刺痛、麻木），则结果为阳性（异常）。

HP:0033673.name: Positive Phalen test
HP:0033673.definition: The Phalen maneuver is performed by having the patient hold both wrists in complete and forced flexion (pushing the dorsal surfaces of both hands together) for 30-60 seconds. This can increase the pressure in the carpal tunnel. The test is positive (abnormal) if the patient experiences characteristic symptoms of carpal tunnel syndrome (pain and paresthesias along the distribution of the median nerve, i.e., thumb, index finger, and middle finger).
HP:0033673.definition_cn: Phalen试验通过让患者保持双侧腕关节完全且强制屈曲（将双手背侧表面相互挤压）30至60秒进行。此操作可增加腕管内的压力。若患者出现腕管综合征的典型症状（沿正中神经分布区域，即拇指、食指和中指的疼痛和感觉异常），则试验结果为阳性（异常）。

HP:0033674.name: Pulmonary blood flow redistribution
HP:0033674.definition: Pulmonary blood flow redistribution refers to any departure from the normal distribution of blood flow in the lungs that is caused by an increase in pulmonary vascular resistance elsewhere in the pulmonary vascular bed. Pulmonary blood flow redistribution is indicated by a decrease in the size and/or number of visible pulmonary vessels in one or more lung regions, with a corresponding increase in number and/or size of pulmonary vessels in other parts of the lung.
HP:0033674.definition_cn: 肺血流重新分布是指由于肺血管床其他部位肺血管阻力增加导致的肺部血流正常分布的任何偏离。肺血流重新分布表现为一个或多个肺区域可见肺血管的大小和/或数量减少，同时肺部其他部位的肺血管数量和/或大小相应增加。

HP:0033675.name: Frailty
HP:0033675.definition: A clinically recognizable state of increased vulnerability resulting from a decline in reserve and function across multiple physiologic systems such that the ability to cope with everyday or acute stressors is compromised.
HP:0033675.definition_cn: 一种临床上可识别的脆弱性增加状态，源于多个生理系统储备和功能的下降，导致应对日常或急性应激源的能力受损。

HP:0033676.name: Posttraumatic stress symptom
HP:0033676.definition: A behavioral or psychological symptom that typically occurs following exposure to one or more traumatic events is posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Symptoms of PTSD include intrusive recollections, such as re-experiencing the trauma through flashbacks, memories, or nightmares. Additionally, individuals may experience avoidant and numbing symptoms, which can include diminished emotions and avoidance of situations that serve as reminders of the traumatic event. Hyperarousal is another symptom, characterized by increased irritability, exaggerated startle reactions, and difficulties with sleeping or concentrating.
HP:0033676.definition_cn: 创伤后应激障碍（Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, PTSD）是一种在暴露于一个或多个创伤性事件后通常出现的行为或心理症状。PTSD的症状包括侵入性回忆，例如通过闪回、记忆或噩梦重新体验创伤。此外，个体可能出现回避和麻木症状，表现为情感减退和回避可能引发创伤事件回忆的情境。过度警觉是另一常见症状，其特征为易激惹、惊跳反应增强以及睡眠或注意力集中困难。

HP:0033677.name: Acute respiratory distress syndrome
HP:0033677.definition: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is defined as an acute disorder that starts within seven days of the inciting event and is characterized by bilateral lung infiltrates and severe progressive hypoxemia in the absence of any evidence of cardiogenic pulmonary edema. ARDS is defined by the patient's oxygen in arterial blood (PaO2) to the fraction of the oxygen in the inspired air (FiO2). These patients have a PaO2/FiO2 ratio of less than 300.
HP:0033677.definition_cn: 急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）定义为一种急性疾病，通常在诱发事件发生后七天内发病，其特征为双侧肺部浸润性病变和严重进行性低氧血症，且无任何心源性肺水肿的证据。ARDS的诊断依据为患者动脉血氧分压（PaO2）与吸入氧浓度（FiO2）的比值。这些患者的PaO2/FiO2比值小于300。

HP:0033678.name: Acute coronary syndrome
HP:0033678.definition: The term acute coronary syndrome (ACS) refers to any group of clinical symptoms compatible with acute myocardial ischemia and includes unstable angina (UA), non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI), and ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI).
HP:0033678.definition_cn: 急性冠状动脉综合征（Acute Coronary Syndrome, ACS）是指与急性心肌缺血相符的一组临床症状，包括不稳定型心绞痛（Unstable Angina, UA）、非ST段抬高型心肌梗死（Non-ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction, NSTEMI）和ST段抬高型心肌梗死（ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction, STEMI）。

HP:0033679.name: Abnormal red nucleus morphology
HP:0033679.definition: Any structural anomaly of the red nucleus, a part of the midbrain involved in control of movement.
HP:0033679.definition_cn: 红核结构异常，红核为中脑的一部分，参与运动控制。

HP:0033680.name: Pilocytic astrocytoma
HP:0033680.definition: The most common form of astrocytoma (WHO Grade I) in childhood. These typically have MAPK signaling pathway abnormalities.
HP:0033680.definition_cn: 儿童期最常见的星形细胞瘤类型（WHO I级）。这些肿瘤通常具有MAPK信号通路异常。

HP:0033681.name: Oligodendroglioma
HP:0033681.definition: Oligodendroglioma is a type of diffusely infiltrating glioma and constitutes approximately 5% of primary intracranial tumors. They often involve the cortical gray matter and are most commonly seen in the frontal lobes. OGs are generally low grade WHO grade II neoplasms that are slow-growing tumors and have a favorable treatment response when compared to other gliomas. Grade III anaplastic OG is a more malignant form of the tumor which portends a less favorable prognosis and may occur de novo or as degeneration from the lower grade OG.
HP:0033681.definition_cn: 少突胶质细胞瘤是一种弥漫性浸润性胶质瘤，约占原发性颅内肿瘤的5%。它们常累及皮质灰质，最常见于额叶。少突胶质细胞瘤通常为WHO II级肿瘤，生长缓慢，与其他胶质瘤相比，治疗反应较好。III级间变性少突胶质细胞瘤是一种恶性程度更高的肿瘤，预后较差，可能为原发或由低级别少突胶质细胞瘤恶变而来。

HP:0033682.name: Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
HP:0033682.definition: Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytomas (PXA) are rare low-grade astrocytomas (WHO Grade II) typically found in the temporal lobe and classically presenting with epilepsy. PXA is an astrocytic neoplasm that most often presents in children or young adults but can also occur in adults. The diagnosis of anaplastic PXA is made based upon tumor histopathologic characteristics and requires increased proliferative activity (mitotic index at least 5 mitoses/10 HPF), which is associated with worse overall survival. In general, anaplastic PXAs acquire features of a more aggressive astrocytic neoplasm that can include increased proliferation, necrosis, microvascular proliferation, loss of pericellular reticulin, and increased infiltrative growth.
HP:0033682.name_cn: 多形性黄色星形细胞瘤
HP:0033682.definition_cn: 多形性黄色星形细胞瘤（Pleomorphic Xanthoastrocytomas, PXA）是一种罕见的低级别星形细胞瘤（WHO II级），通常位于颞叶，典型表现为癫痫发作。PXA是一种星形细胞肿瘤，最常见于儿童或年轻成人，但也可能发生于成人。间变性PXA的诊断基于肿瘤的组织病理学特征，需要显示增殖活性增加（有丝分裂指数至少为5个有丝分裂/10个高倍视野），这与较差的总体生存率相关。一般而言，间变性PXA具有更具侵袭性的星形细胞肿瘤特征，包括增殖增加、坏死、微血管增生、细胞周围网状纤维缺失以及浸润性生长增加。

HP:0033683.name: Jaw hyperreflexia
HP:0033683.definition: Increased intensity of muscle tendon reflexes in jaw.

HP:0033684.name: Abnormal muscle fiber-type distribution
HP:0033684.definition: Ay deviation from the normal distribution of fiber types in skeletal muscle. The skeletal muscle groups of the mammalian body are made up of bundles of muscle fibers. These fibers can be assigned to different Types, with characteristic movement rates, response to neural inputs, and metabolic styles. Skeletal muscle fibers are broadly classified as slow-twitch (type 1) and fast-twitch (type 2). Multiple fiber types are generally intermingled within a single muscle group, and different muscle groups have varying proportions of fiber types
HP:0033684.definition_cn: 骨骼肌纤维类型分布异常。哺乳动物体内的骨骼肌群由肌纤维束组成。这些纤维可被划分为不同类型，具有特征性的收缩速度、对神经输入的反应以及代谢方式。骨骼肌纤维大致分为慢缩型（I型）和快缩型（II型）。多种纤维类型通常混合存在于单一肌群中，不同肌群的纤维类型比例各异。

HP:0033685.name: Fiber type grouping
HP:0033685.definition: An abnormal distribution of muscle fiber types in muscle tissue. Human skeletal muscle contains at least two fiber types recognizable by histochemical techniques. In transverse sections of normal skeletal muscle, type 1 and type 2 fibers are distributed in a random fashion. Grouping of fibers of the same type can be seen in certain peripheral neuropathies, thought to be due to reinnervation of denervated muscle fibers by sprouting axons. With grouping, motor units enlarge. The fibers of a motor unit, which are normally scattered, come to lie adjacent to one another. Histochemical examination shows groups of muscle fibers of the same histochemical type.
HP:0033685.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中肌纤维类型的异常分布。人类骨骼肌至少包含两种可通过组织化学技术识别的纤维类型。在正常骨骼肌的横切面中，1型和2型纤维呈随机分布。在某些周围神经病变中，可见同类型纤维的聚集，这被认为是由于轴突发芽对去神经支配的肌纤维进行再神经支配所致。随着聚集的发生，运动单位扩大。正常情况下分散的运动单位纤维会彼此相邻。组织化学检查显示同一组织化学类型的肌纤维群。

HP:0033686.name: Mitochondrial hypertrophy
HP:0033686.definition: Enlargement of mitochondria. Mitochondrial hypertrophy is not discernible by light microscopy. By electron microscopy (EM), hypertrophic mitochondria have normal cristae and normal matrix density. In contrast, swollen mitochondria display swollen cristae and irregular matrix densities in EM.
HP:0033686.definition_cn: 线粒体增大。线粒体肥大在光学显微镜下不可见。通过电子显微镜（EM）观察，肥大的线粒体具有正常的嵴和正常的基质密度。相比之下，肿胀的线粒体在电子显微镜下显示出肿胀的嵴和不规则的基质密度。

HP:0033687.name: Short term memory impairment
HP:0033687.definition: A deficit in the retention of pieces of information (memory chunks) for a relatively short time (usually up to 30 seconds).
HP:0033687.definition_cn: 短期记忆信息片段（记忆块）保留缺陷，持续时间相对较短（通常不超过30秒）。

HP:0033688.name: Long term memory impairment
HP:0033688.definition: A deficit in the ability to retrieve information from long-term memory, which can be defined as a seemingly unlimited capacity to store memories can last years and relate to the performance of actions or skills (i.e., procedural memories, knowing how) and memories of facts, rules, concepts, and events (i.e., declarative memories, knowing that).
HP:0033688.definition_cn: 从长期记忆中提取信息的能力缺陷，长期记忆可定义为一种看似无限的存储记忆的能力，可持续数年，涉及动作或技能的执行（即程序性记忆，知道如何做）以及事实、规则、概念和事件的记忆（即陈述性记忆，知道是什么）。

HP:0033689.name: Anterograde memory impairment
HP:0033689.definition: The impaired ability to establish new long-term memories.
HP:0033689.definition_cn: 新长期记忆形成能力受损。

HP:0033690.name: Retrograde memory impairment
HP:0033690.definition: Inability to retrieve information from the long-term memory that was acquired before the onset of amnesia.
HP:0033690.definition_cn: 无法从长期记忆中检索出在失忆症发作前获得的信息。

HP:0033691.name: Procedural memory loss
HP:0033691.definition: A reduction in the ability to retrieve information about how to perform activities, such as how to ride a bike or drive a car, how to perform activities of daily living, or how to play a musical instrument.
HP:0033691.definition_cn: 执行功能记忆减退（Impairment of Procedural Memory）

HP:0033692.name: Declarative memory loss
HP:0033692.definition: Impaired ability to remember facts and events.

HP:0033693.name: Phantosmia
HP:0033693.definition: Perception of an odor in the absence of any stimuli in the surrounding environment that could emit the odor.
HP:0033693.definition_cn: 在没有周围环境中任何可能散发气味的刺激物的情况下，对气味的感知。

HP:0033694.name: Tactile hallucination
HP:0033694.definition: Perception of touch without a tactile stimulus.
HP:0033694.definition_cn: 无触觉刺激的触觉感知（Tactile Perception Without Tactile Stimulus）。

HP:0033695.name: Occupational disability
HP:0033695.definition: This is a general term that denotes a reduced ability to perform the work that one performed prior to an illness, and may be related to pain, cognitive dysfunction, fatigue or other physical disabilities.
HP:0033695.definition_cn: 这是一个通用术语，表示个体在患病后执行先前工作能力下降，可能与疼痛、认知功能障碍、疲劳或其他身体残疾相关。

HP:0033696.name: Pseudo-chilblain
HP:0033696.definition: Acral areas of erythema with vesicles or pustules. The lesions resemble chilblains and have purpuric areas, affecting hands and feet.
HP:0033696.definition_cn: 肢端红斑伴水疱或脓疱。皮损类似冻疮，并伴有紫癜区域，累及手足。

HP:0033697.name: Vesicular eruption
HP:0033697.definition: A type of acute-onset skin rash characterized by multiple vesicles, which are circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevation generally considered less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point. The fluid contained in a vesicle may be clear, serous, or hemorrhagic.
HP:0033697.definition_cn: 一种急性发作的皮疹类型，其特征为多发性水疱，这些水疱为局限性、含液体的表皮隆起，通常认为其最宽处直径小于10毫米。水疱内所含液体可为透明、浆液性或血性。

HP:0033698.name: Monomorphic vesicular eruption
HP:0033698.definition: A type of vesicular eruption in which the vesicles are at same stages.
HP:0033698.definition_cn: 一种水疱性皮疹，其中水疱处于相同阶段。

HP:0033699.name: Polymorphic vesicular eruption
HP:0033699.definition: A type of vesicular eruption in which the vesicles are at different stages.
HP:0033699.definition_cn: 一种水疱性皮疹，其特征为水疱处于不同发展阶段。

HP:0033700.name: Papulovesicular eruption
HP:0033700.definition: An acute onset rash characterized by by multiple vesicles, which are circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevations with a diameter less than 10mm at the widest point, and by multiple papules, which are circumscribed, solid epidermal elevations with no visible fluid with a diameter less than 10mm at the widest point.
HP:0033700.definition_cn: 急性发作性皮疹，其特征为多发性水疱（水疱为局限性、含液体的表皮隆起，最宽处直径小于10毫米）和多发性丘疹（丘疹为局限性、实性表皮隆起，无可见液体，最宽处直径小于10毫米）。

HP:0033701.name: Cortical sclerosis of the iliac wing
HP:0033701.definition: Increased density related to increased bone mass in the outermost layer (edge) of the iliac wing.
HP:0033701.definition_cn: 髂骨翼最外层（边缘）密度增加与骨量增加相关。

HP:0033702.name: Subpleural curvilinear line
HP:0033702.definition: This finding is a thin curvilinear opacity, 1-3 mm in thickness, lying less than 1 cm from and parallel to the pleural surface. It corresponds to atelectasis of normal lung if seen in the dependent posteroinferior portion of lung of a patient in the supine position and is subsequently shown to disappear on CT sections acquired with the patient prone. It may also be encountered in patients with pulmonary edema or fibrosis (other signs are usually present).
HP:0033702.definition_cn: 该影像表现为一条细薄的曲线状致密影，厚度为1-3毫米，位于胸膜表面下方不足1厘米处且与之平行。若在仰卧位患者肺部的后下依赖区域观察到，则提示正常肺组织的肺不张，且在患者俯卧位时进行的CT扫描中该影消失。此外，该征象亦可见于肺水肿或肺纤维化患者（通常伴有其他体征）。

HP:0033703.name: Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor
HP:0033703.definition: Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor (DNT) is a benign glioneuronal neoplasm that most commonly occurs in children and young adults and may present with medically intractable, chronic seizures. Lesions vary in size from 10 to 25 mm, although occasionally larger tumors of up to 70 mm have been reported. Grossly, tumors appear as well-defined, solitary nodular masses or poorly demarcated lesions. On the cut section, most tumors are cortically located and may extend into the underlying subcortical white matter in larger tumors. Multi-nodular appearance or cystic changes are commonly found
HP:0033703.name_cn: 胚胎发育不良性神经上皮肿瘤
HP:0033703.definition_cn: 胚胎发育不良性神经上皮肿瘤（Dysembryoplastic Neuroepithelial Tumor, DNT）是一种良性的胶质神经元性肿瘤，最常见于儿童和年轻成人，可能表现为药物难治性慢性癫痫发作。病变大小通常在10至25毫米之间，但偶尔也有报道称肿瘤可达70毫米。大体上，肿瘤表现为边界清晰的孤立结节性肿块或边界不清的病变。在切面上，大多数肿瘤位于皮质，较大的肿瘤可能延伸至下方的皮质下白质。多结节外观或囊性变常见。

HP:0033704.name: Elevated urinary homogentisic acid
HP:0033704.definition: An increased amount of homogentisic acid in the urine.
HP:0033704.definition_cn: 尿液中高浓度的尿黑酸。

HP:0033705.name: Tearfulness
HP:0033705.definition: A feeling of sadness characterized by episodes of crying that can occur suddenly and are not easily controlled in social situations.
HP:0033705.definition_cn: 一种以突发性哭泣为特征的悲伤情绪，在社交场合中难以控制。

HP:0033706.name: Progressive massive fibrosis
HP:0033706.definition: This condition is caused by slow-growing conglomeration of dust particles and collagen deposition in individuals (mostly coal workers) heavily exposed to inorganic dust. Progressive massive fibrosis manifests as masslike lesions, usually bilateral and in the upper lobes. Background nodular opacities reflect accompanying pneumoconiosis, with or without emphysematous destruction adjacent to the massive fibrosis. Lesions similar to progressive massive fibrosis sometimes occur in other conditions, such as sarcoidosis and talcosis.
HP:0033706.definition_cn: 该病症由缓慢生长的粉尘颗粒聚集和胶原沉积引起，主要见于长期暴露于无机粉尘的个体（多为煤矿工人）。进行性大块纤维化表现为肿块样病变，通常为双侧性且位于上叶。背景中的结节状阴影反映了伴随的尘肺病，大块纤维化邻近区域可能伴有或不伴有肺气肿性破坏。与进行性大块纤维化相似的病变有时也见于其他疾病，如结节病和滑石粉沉着病。

HP:0033707.name: Perioral hyperkeratosis
HP:0033707.definition: Increased thickness of the stratum corneum (the outer layer of the skin) in the skin surrounding the mouth.

HP:0033708.name: Anti-3-hydroxy- 3-methylglutaryl-coA reductase antibody positivity
HP:0033708.name_cn: 抗3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶抗体阳性

HP:0033709.name: Increased sputum production
HP:0033709.definition: An increase in the amount of airway mucus. This feature may be characterized by frequent or excessive throat clearing (exhalation through tightly constricted laryngopharyngeal tissues accompanied by vibration of the palatoglossal arch and the vocal folds serving to clear mucus from the airway).
HP:0033709.definition_cn: 气道黏液分泌增多。该特征可能表现为频繁或过度的清喉动作（通过高度收缩的喉咽组织进行呼气，伴随腭舌弓和声带的振动，以清除气道中的黏液）。

HP:0033710.name: Rest dyspnea
HP:0033710.definition: A perception of shortness of breath that occurs independently of exertion.
HP:0033710.definition_cn: 静息性呼吸困难（Dyspnea at rest）

HP:0033711.name: Pulmonary interstitial thickening
HP:0033711.definition: Pathological thickening of the pulmonary interstitium visualized radiographically and divided into interlobular and intralobular septal thickening.
HP:0033711.definition_cn: 放射学上可见的肺间质病理性增厚，分为小叶间隔增厚和小叶内间隔增厚。

HP:0033712.name: Repeated implantation failure
HP:0033712.definition: Repeated implantation failure refers to a situation in which embryos of good quality fail to implant following several in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment cycles.
HP:0033712.definition_cn: 反复种植失败（Repeated Implantation Failure, RIF）是指在多次体外受精（In Vitro Fertilization, IVF）治疗周期中，优质胚胎未能成功着床的情况。

HP:0033713.name: Anti-signal recognition particle antibody positivity
HP:0033713.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against anti-signal recognition particle.
HP:0033713.name_cn: 抗信号识别颗粒抗体阳性
HP:0033713.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对抗信号识别颗粒的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0033714.name: Multiple meningiomas
HP:0033714.definition: The occurrence of multiple distinct meningiomas in the same individual.
HP:0033714.definition_cn: 同一患者体内发生多个不同脑膜瘤。

HP:0033715.name: Hippocampal sclerosis
HP:0033715.definition: Hippocampal sclerosis is a neuropathologic finding characterized by neuronal loss and gliosis in the CA-1 and subiculum of the hippocampus.
HP:0033715.definition_cn: 海马硬化是一种神经病理学表现，其特征为海马CA-1区和下托的神经元丢失和胶质增生。

HP:0033716.name: EEG with frontal epileptiform discharges
HP:0033716.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the frontal region.
HP:0033716.name_cn: 脑电图显示额叶癫痫样放电
HP:0033716.definition_cn: 额叶区记录到局灶性癫痫样脑电图放电。

HP:0033717.name: EEG with temporal epileptiform discharges
HP:0033717.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the temporal region.
HP:0033717.name_cn: 脑电图显示颞叶癫痫样放电
HP:0033717.definition_cn: 颞区记录到局灶性癫痫样脑电图放电。

HP:0033718.name: EEG with central epileptiform discharges
HP:0033718.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the central region.
HP:0033718.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央区癫痫样放电
HP:0033718.definition_cn: 中央区记录到局灶性癫痫样脑电图放电。

HP:0033719.name: EEG with parietal epileptiform discharges
HP:0033719.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the parietal region.
HP:0033719.name_cn: 脑电图显示顶叶癫痫样放电
HP:0033719.definition_cn: 顶叶区记录到局灶性癫痫样脑电图放电。

HP:0033720.name: EEG with occipital epileptiform discharges
HP:0033720.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the occipital region.
HP:0033720.name_cn: 枕叶癫痫样放电的脑电图
HP:0033720.definition_cn: 枕叶区记录到的局灶性癫痫样脑电图放电。

HP:0033721.name: EEG with centrotemporal epileptiform discharges
HP:0033721.definition: Focal epileptiform EEG discharges recorded in the centrotemporal region.
HP:0033721.name_cn: 脑电图显示中央颞区癫痫样放电
HP:0033721.definition_cn: 记录到中央颞区局灶性癫痫样脑电图放电。

HP:0033722.name: Autonomic epileptic aura
HP:0033722.definition: An autonomic epileptic aura is a purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to autonomic nervous system function. Autonomic auras include cardiorespiratory (e.g., palpitations and shortness of breath), gastrointestinal, genitourinary (genital sensations, urinary urge), and cutaneous (feeling of warmth or cold) sensations. Abdominal auras constitute the most common type of autonomic aura. These include sensations of nausea, pain, or indescribable discomfort in the abdominal or periumbilical area that can be static, rise to the chest and throat, or descend into the lower abdominal region.
HP:0033722.definition_cn: 自主神经性癫痫先兆是一种纯粹主观的癫痫发作表现，涉及自主神经系统功能。自主神经性先兆包括心肺（如心悸和呼吸急促）、胃肠道、泌尿生殖（生殖器感觉、尿急）和皮肤（温热或寒冷感）感觉。腹部先兆是最常见的自主神经性先兆类型。这些包括腹部或脐周区域的恶心、疼痛或难以描述的不适感，这些感觉可以是静止的，上升至胸部和喉咙，或下降至下腹部区域。

HP:0033723.name: Abnormal cerebral venous sinus morphology
HP:0033723.definition: Abnormal structure of the venous sinuses that drain blood from the cerebral veins and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the arachnoid granulations to the internal jugular veins.
HP:0033723.definition_cn: 引流脑静脉血液及蛛网膜颗粒脑脊液（CSF）至颈内静脉的静脉窦结构异常。

HP:0033724.name: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
HP:0033724.definition: An intracranial thrombosis of the venous sinuses. These typically present with headache, seizures or venous stroke secondary to raised cerebral venous pressure. Cerebral venous sinus thromboses usually affect larger areas of brain parenchyma than those affected by cerebral vein thromboses.
HP:0033724.definition_cn: 颅内静脉窦血栓形成。此类病症通常表现为头痛、癫痫发作或继发于脑静脉压升高的静脉性卒中。与脑静脉血栓相比，脑静脉窦血栓通常累及更大范围的脑实质区域。

HP:0033725.name: Thin corpus callosum
HP:0033725.definition: An abnormally thin corpus callous, due to atrophy, hypoplasia or agenesis. This term is intended to be used in situations where it is not known if thinning of the corpus callosum (for instance, as visualized by magnetic resonance tomography) is due to abnormal development (e.g. a leukodystrophy) or atrophy following normal development (e.g. neurodegeneration).
HP:0033725.definition_cn: 胼胝体异常变薄，由于萎缩、发育不全或发育不全。该术语旨在用于在无法确定胼胝体变薄（例如，通过磁共振断层扫描观察到的）是由于异常发育（例如，脑白质营养不良）还是正常发育后的萎缩（例如，神经退行性变）的情况下使用。

HP:0033726.name: Lupus nephritis
HP:0033726.definition: Lupus nephritis is a type of glomerulonephritis that constitutes one of the most severe organ manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus. Lupus nephritis is subclassified in six distinct classes, that represent different manifestations and severities of renal involvement and guide the therapeutic management.
HP:0033726.definition_cn: 狼疮性肾炎是一种肾小球肾炎，是系统性红斑狼疮最严重的器官表现之一。狼疮性肾炎被细分为六个不同的类别，这些类别代表了肾脏受累的不同表现和严重程度，并指导治疗管理。

HP:0033727.name: Diffuse lupus nephritis
HP:0033727.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with active or inactive diffuse, segmental or global endocapillary or extracapillary glomerulonephritis involving at least 50% of all glomeruli, typically with diffuse subendothelial immune deposits, with or without mesangial alterations.
HP:0033727.definition_cn: 一种狼疮性肾炎的亚型，表现为活动性或非活动性弥漫性、节段性或全球性毛细血管内或毛细血管外肾小球肾炎，累及至少50%的肾小球，通常伴有弥漫性内皮下免疫沉积物，伴或不伴有系膜改变。

HP:0033728.name: Mesangial proliferative lupus nephritis
HP:0033728.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with purely mesangial hypercellularity of any degree or mesangial matrix expansion by lightmicroscopy, with mesangial immune deposits. A few isolated subepithelial or subendothelial deposits may be visible by immunoflourescence or electron microscopy, but not by light microscopy.
HP:0033728.name_cn: 系膜增生性狼疮性肾炎
HP:0033728.definition_cn: 一种狼疮性肾炎亚型，表现为光镜下任何程度的单纯系膜细胞增生或系膜基质扩张，并伴有系膜免疫沉积物。免疫荧光或电子显微镜下可能可见少量孤立的皮下或内皮下沉积物，但光镜下不可见。

HP:0033729.name: Minimal mesangial lupus nephritis
HP:0033729.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with normal glomeruli by light microscopy, but mesangial immune deposits by immunofluorescence.
HP:0033729.name_cn: 微小系膜性狼疮性肾炎
HP:0033729.definition_cn: 光镜下肾小球正常，但免疫荧光显示系膜区免疫沉积物的一类狼疮性肾炎亚型。

HP:0033730.name: Membranous lupus nephritis
HP:0033730.definition: A lupus nephritis subclass with global or segmental subepithelial immune deposits or their morphological sequelae by light microscopy and by immunofluorescence or electron microscopy, with or without mesangial alterations. May occur in combination with class III or IV, in which case both classes are diagnosed. May show advanced sclerosis
HP:0033730.definition_cn: 一种狼疮性肾炎亚型，表现为光镜、免疫荧光或电镜下可见的全局性或节段性上皮下免疫沉积物或其形态学后遗症，伴或不伴系膜改变。可能与III型或IV型狼疮性肾炎同时发生，此时应同时诊断两种类型。可能表现为晚期硬化。

HP:0033731.name: Focal lupus nephritis
HP:0033731.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with active or inactive focal, segmental or global endocapillary or extracapillary glomerulonephritis involving less than 50% of all glomeruli, typically with focal subendothelial immune deposits, with or without mesangial alterations
HP:0033731.definition_cn: 狼疮性肾炎的一个亚类，表现为活动性或非活动性局灶性、节段性或全球性毛细血管内或毛细血管外肾小球肾炎，累及少于50%的肾小球，通常伴有局灶性内皮下免疫沉积，伴或不伴系膜改变。

HP:0033732.name: Advanced sclerotic lupus nephritis
HP:0033732.definition: A subclass of lupus nephritis with at least 90% of glomeruli globally sclerosed without residual activity.
HP:0033732.name_cn: 晚期硬化性狼疮性肾炎
HP:0033732.definition_cn: 一种狼疮性肾炎亚型，其特征为至少90%的肾小球呈现全球性硬化，且无残余活动性病变。

HP:0033733.name: Low-grade vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033733.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux without dilation of the renal calyces (Grade I-II).
HP:0033733.definition_cn: 无肾盏扩张的膀胱输尿管反流（I-II级）。

HP:0033734.name: High-grade vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033734.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with dilation of the renal calyces (Grade III - V).
HP:0033734.name_cn: 高级别膀胱输尿管反流
HP:0033734.definition_cn: 膀胱输尿管反流伴肾盏扩张（III级 - V级）。

HP:0033735.name: Grade I vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033735.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux into the ureter only.
HP:0033735.definition_cn: 仅输尿管内的膀胱输尿管反流。

HP:0033736.name: Grade II vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033736.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux into a non-dilated pyelocalyceal system.
HP:0033736.definition_cn: 膀胱输尿管反流进入非扩张的肾盂肾盏系统。

HP:0033737.name: Grade III vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033737.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with dilatation of the collecting system.
HP:0033737.definition_cn: 膀胱输尿管反流伴集合系统扩张。

HP:0033738.name: Primary vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033738.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux due to abnormalities in ureterovesical junction, e.g. ectopic insertion of the ureter or short intravesical tunnel at the ureterovesical junction.
HP:0033738.name_cn: 原发性膀胱输尿管反流
HP:0033738.definition_cn: 由于输尿管膀胱连接处异常导致的膀胱输尿管反流，例如输尿管异位插入或输尿管膀胱连接处膀胱内隧道过短。

HP:0033739.name: Secondary vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033739.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux induced by increased bladder pressures in patients with voiding dysfunction e.g. in case of congenital posterior urethral valves or neurogenic bladder dysfunction.
HP:0033739.name_cn: 继发性膀胱输尿管反流
HP:0033739.definition_cn: 排尿功能障碍（如先天性后尿道瓣膜或神经源性膀胱功能障碍）患者因膀胱压力升高导致的膀胱输尿管反流。

HP:0033740.name: Grade V vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033740.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with massive dilation of the collecting system and severe tortuosity of the ureter.
HP:0033740.definition_cn: 膀胱输尿管反流伴集合系统显著扩张及输尿管严重迂曲。

HP:0033741.name: Grade IV vesicoureteral reflux
HP:0033741.definition: Vesicoureteral reflux with more-extensive dilation with blunting of the calyces and tortuosity of the ureter.
HP:0033741.definition_cn: 膀胱输尿管反流伴更广泛的扩张，肾盏变钝及输尿管迂曲。

HP:0033742.name: Intrarenal reflux
HP:0033742.definition: Severe vesicoureteral reflux reaching the kidney parenchyma.
HP:0033742.definition_cn: 重度膀胱输尿管反流累及肾实质。

HP:0033743.name: Macular agenesis
HP:0033743.definition: A congenital defect characterized by lack of development of the macula.
HP:0033743.definition_cn: 黄斑发育不全的先天性缺陷。

HP:0033744.name: Global cerebellar dysplasia
HP:0033744.definition: A type of cerebellar dysplasia that affects the entire cerebellum.
HP:0033744.definition_cn: 一种累及全小脑的小脑发育不良类型。

HP:0033745.name: Dysplasia of the superior cerebellar vermis
HP:0033745.definition: A type of cerebellar dysplasia that affects the upper part of the cerebellar vermis.
HP:0033745.definition_cn: 一种影响小脑蚓部上部的小脑发育不良。

HP:0033746.name: Intrascapular pain
HP:0033746.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the area between the shoulder blades.
HP:0033746.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于肩胛骨之间的区域。

HP:0033747.name: Abnormal exteroceptive sensation
HP:0033747.definition: A type of somatic sensory dysfunction characterized by abnormality of superficial sensation that is mediated by receptors in skin and mucous membranes.
HP:0033747.definition_cn: 一种躯体感觉功能障碍，其特征为由皮肤和黏膜中的感受器介导的浅感觉异常。

HP:0033749.name: Abnormal functional residual capacity
HP:0033749.definition: A deviation from normal values for the functional residual capacity, which is defined as the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation.
HP:0033749.definition_cn: 功能性残气量（Functional Residual Capacity, FRC）偏离正常值，功能性残气量定义为正常被动呼气后残留在肺内的气体容积。

HP:0033750.name: Reduced functional residual capacity
HP:0033750.definition: An abnormal reduction in the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation.
HP:0033750.definition_cn: 功能性残气量异常减少。

HP:0033751.name: Elevated functional residual capacity
HP:0033751.definition: An abnormal increase in the volume remaining in the lungs after a normal, passive exhalation.
HP:0033751.definition_cn: 肺内残余气量异常增加。

HP:0033752.name: Abnormal residual volume
HP:0033752.definition: Any deviation from normal values of the residual volume, which is defined as the volume of air left in the lungs at the end of maximal expiration (ie. the volume of air which you cannot voluntarily exhale from your lungs).
HP:0033752.definition_cn: 任何与残气量正常值的偏离，残气量定义为在最大呼气结束时残留在肺内的空气体积（即无法自主从肺部呼出的空气体积）。

HP:0033753.name: Reduced residual volume
HP:0033753.definition: Abnormal decrease in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation.
HP:0033753.definition_cn: 功能性残气量异常减少。

HP:0033754.name: Abnormal left ventricular end-diastolic volume
HP:0033754.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of end-diastolic volume of the left ventricle, which is the volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole).
HP:0033754.name_cn: 左心室舒张末期容积异常
HP:0033754.definition_cn: 左心室舒张末期容量的任何偏离正常范围，即舒张末期（收缩期前）左心室内的血液容量。

HP:0033755.name: Increased left ventricular end-diastolic volume
HP:0033755.definition: Abnormally high volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole).
HP:0033755.name_cn: 左心室舒张末期容积增加
HP:0033755.definition_cn: 舒张末期（收缩期前）左心室血容量异常增高。

HP:0033756.name: Decreased left ventricular end-diastolic volume
HP:0033756.definition: Abnormally low volume of blood in the left ventricle at the end of diastole (just before systole).
HP:0033756.name_cn: 左心室舒张末期容积降低
HP:0033756.definition_cn: 舒张末期（收缩期前）左心室血容量异常降低。

HP:0033758.name: Labial abscess
HP:0033758.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the labia.
HP:0033758.definition_cn: 外阴脓肿或坏死组织局限区域。

HP:0033759.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium
HP:0033759.definition: Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of magnesium.
HP:0033759.name_cn: 肾小管镁重吸收功能障碍

HP:0033760.name: Decreased maximal oxygen uptake
HP:0033760.definition: Maximum oxygen uptake (VO2max) is defined as the highest rate of oxygen uptake and utilization by the body during intense, maximal exercise, whereby further increases in work rate do not bring on additional rises in VO2 (i.e. plateau). VO2Max is typically measured with a treadmill and ergometer and the participant exercises with increasing levels of intensity. VO2Max is the point at which oxygen uptake no longer increases despite an increase in workload.
HP:0033760.definition_cn: 最大摄氧量（VO2max）定义为在剧烈、最大强度运动期间，机体摄取和利用氧气的最高速率，此时进一步增加运动强度不会引起摄氧量的额外上升（即达到平台期）。最大摄氧量通常通过跑步机和功率计进行测量，受试者在逐渐增加的运动强度下进行锻炼。最大摄氧量是指尽管运动负荷增加，但摄氧量不再上升的临界点。

HP:0033761.name: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis
HP:0033761.definition: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis is a granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate composed of neutrophils, lymphocytes, plasma cells, xanthomatous histiocytes, and multinucleated giant cells.
HP:0033761.name_cn: 黄色肉芽肿性肾盂肾炎
HP:0033761.definition_cn: 黄色肉芽肿性肾盂肾炎是一种由中性粒细胞、淋巴细胞、浆细胞、黄色瘤样组织细胞和多核巨细胞组成的肉芽肿性炎症浸润。

HP:0033762.name: Middle cerebral artery stroke
HP:0033762.definition: Acute onset neurological deficits such as weakness, dizziness, numbness, issues with speech, or visual changes related to sudden impairment of blood flow to a part of the brain due to occlusion or rupture of the middle cerebral artery to the brain.
HP:0033762.definition_cn: 急性起病的神经功能缺损，如无力、眩晕、麻木、言语障碍或视觉改变，与大脑中动脉闭塞或破裂导致的脑部血流突然中断相关。

HP:0033763.name: Death in adulthood
HP:0033763.definition: Cessation of life at the age of 16 years or later.

HP:0033764.name: Death in middle age
HP:0033764.definition: Death between the age of 40 and 60 years.

HP:0033765.name: Death in late adulthood
HP:0033765.definition: Death at an age of at least 60 years.

HP:0033766.name: Polymelia
HP:0033766.definition: Polymelia is a congenital anomaly, which is defined as the presence of accessory limbs attached to various body regions and could be classified as cephalomelia (extra-limb attached to the head), notomelia (extra-limb attached to the back bone), thoracomelia (extra-limb attached to the thorax), and pyromelia (extra-limb attached to the pelvis).
HP:0033766.definition_cn: 多肢畸形是一种先天性异常，其特征为在身体不同区域附着有额外肢体，可分类为头肢畸形（额外肢体附着于头部）、背肢畸形（额外肢体附着于脊柱）、胸肢畸形（额外肢体附着于胸部）和盆肢畸形（额外肢体附着于骨盆）。

HP:0033767.name: Abnormal single motor unit action potential
HP:0033767.definition: Abnormally high or low single motor unit action potential reading (-Pk Amps).
HP:0033767.name_cn: 异常单运动单位动作电位
HP:0033767.definition_cn: 单运动单位动作电位振幅异常增高或降低（-峰值振幅）。

HP:0033768.name: Penile thrush
HP:0033768.definition: Overgrowth of candida albicans in the penis.
HP:0033768.definition_cn: 阴茎白色念珠菌过度生长。

HP:0033769.name: Fundic gland polyposis
HP:0033769.definition: Multiple polyps in the acid-secreting mucosa of the gastric body and fundus. Fundic gland polyps (FGP) are usually 1 to 5 mm in size, though larger polyps have been found. FGPs are typically sessile, shiny, translucent, pale to pinkish in color (resembling the surrounding mucosa), and often exhibit tiny surface blood vessels. These polyps have characteristically been observed to chunk off or detach entirely at the base when removed with cold forceps, in contrast to other types of gastric polyps.
HP:0033769.definition_cn: 胃体和胃底酸分泌黏膜多发息肉。胃底腺息肉（FGP）通常大小为1至5毫米，但也发现过较大的息肉。FGP通常为无蒂、有光泽、半透明、颜色苍白至粉红色（与周围黏膜相似），且常表现为表面微小血管。与其他类型的胃息肉不同，这些息肉在冷钳移除时具有特征性地从基底部整块脱落或完全分离的特点。

HP:0033770.name: Gastric adenocarcinoma
HP:0033770.definition: An adenocarcinoma arising from the stomach glandular epithelium. Gastric carcinoma often produces no specific symptoms when it is superficial and potentially surgically curable, although up to 50% of patients may have nonspecific gastrointestinal complaints such as dyspepsia.
HP:0033770.definition_cn: 起源于胃腺上皮的腺癌。胃癌在表浅且可能通过手术治愈时通常不产生特异性症状，尽管多达50%的患者可能出现非特异性胃肠道不适，如消化不良。

HP:0033771.name: Pleuritic chest pain
HP:0033771.definition: Pleuritic chest pain is characterized by sudden and intense sharp, stabbing, or burning pain in the chest when inhaling and exhaling.
HP:0033771.definition_cn: 胸膜炎性胸痛的特征是呼吸时突然出现的剧烈、尖锐、刺痛或烧灼样胸痛。

HP:0033772.name: Abnormal RV/TLC ratio
HP:0033772.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and body plethysmography.
HP:0033772.name_cn: 异常的残气量/肺总量比值
HP:0033772.definition_cn: 肺功能检查中残气量（RV）与肺总量（TLC）比值偏离正常范围。残气量（RV）是指最大呼气后残留在肺内的气体量，肺总量（TLC）是指最大吸气时肺内所含气体的总量。这些容积无法通过肺量计测定，但可通过惰性气体稀释法、氮气洗出法和体描法进行测量。

HP:0033773.name: Decreased RV/TLC ratio
HP:0033773.definition: An abnormally low ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining after maximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in the lungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and body plethysmography.
HP:0033773.name_cn: 右心室/总肺容量比值降低
HP:0033773.definition_cn: 肺功能测试中残气量（RV）与肺总量（TLC）比值异常降低。残气量（RV）是指最大呼气后残留在肺内的气体量，而肺总量（TLC）是指最大吸气时肺内气体的总量。这些容积无法通过肺量计测定，但可通过惰性气体稀释法、氮气洗出法和体描法进行测量。

HP:0033774.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid
HP:0033774.definition: Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of uric acid.
HP:0033774.name_cn: 尿酸肾小管重吸收功能障碍
HP:0033774.definition_cn: 肾小管对尿酸的重吸收减少。

HP:0033775.name: Pulmonary imaging sign
HP:0033775.definition: An abnormal pulmonary imaging finding defined by eponym or reference to signs, symbols, or naturalistic images.
HP:0033775.definition_cn: 一种异常的肺部影像学表现，通过人名、体征、符号或自然图像进行定义。

HP:0033776.name: Enamel pearls
HP:0033776.definition: Small nodules of enamel on the root of a tooth.

HP:0033777.name: Supernumerary cusp
HP:0033777.definition: Additional cusps of a dental crown.

HP:0033778.name: Leung cusp
HP:0033778.definition: An additional cusp located in the middle of the occlusal surface.
HP:0033778.definition_cn: 位于咬合面中央的额外牙尖。

HP:0033779.name: Barrel-shaped tooth
HP:0033779.definition: A tooth crown with convex mesial and distal surfaces.
HP:0033779.definition_cn: 具有凸起的近中面和远中面的牙冠。

HP:0033780.name: Bulbous tooth
HP:0033780.definition: A tooth crown with a marked cervical area constriction.
HP:0033780.definition_cn: 具有明显颈区收缩的牙冠。

HP:0033781.name: Tapered tooth
HP:0033781.definition: A tooth with a crown that narrows from proximal toward the incisal edge. Tapering of teeth typically involves incisors.
HP:0033781.definition_cn: 一颗牙冠从近中向切缘逐渐变窄的牙齿。牙齿的锥形化通常涉及切牙。

HP:0033782.name: Semilunar tooth
HP:0033782.definition: An incisor with a half-moon shape incisal edge.
HP:0033782.definition_cn: 具有半月形切缘的切牙。

HP:0033783.name: Molar incisor malformation
HP:0033783.definition: Molar incisor malfomation (MIM) is composed of normal crown with marked cervical constriction, thin, narrow short roots which is a combination of signs that occurs in deciduous and permanent molars.
HP:0033783.definition_cn: 磨牙切牙畸形（Molar Incisor Malformation, MIM）表现为冠部形态正常但伴有显著的颈部缩窄，以及细、窄、短的牙根，这种组合性体征可见于乳磨牙和恒磨牙。

HP:0033784.name: Dentin dysplasia
HP:0033784.definition: This is a bundled term as dentin dysplasia is composed of short roots with pointed ends and taurodontism and intrapulpal calcifications.
HP:0033784.definition_cn: 这是一个组合术语，因为牙本质发育不良由短根伴尖端变细、牛牙症和髓腔内钙化组成。

HP:0033785.name: Enamel agenesis
HP:0033785.definition: Complete or almost complete absence of enamel.
HP:0033785.definition_cn: 釉质完全或几乎完全缺失。

HP:0033786.name: Hypomature enamel
HP:0033786.definition: Enamel with a white or brown discoloration without hypoplasia.
HP:0033786.definition_cn: 釉质呈现白色或棕色变色，无发育不全。

HP:0033787.name: Cementum hypoplasia
HP:0033787.definition: The decrease or absence of cementum. The cementum anchors the periodontal ligament attachment fiber between the tooth root and the alveolar bone. Its absence leads to early loss of teeth.
HP:0033787.definition_cn: 牙骨质减少或缺失。牙骨质将牙周韧带附着纤维锚定于牙根与牙槽骨之间。其缺失会导致牙齿早期脱落。

HP:0033788.name: Cementum overgrowth
HP:0033788.definition: Excess of cementum on the tooth root surface.

HP:0033789.name: Triggered by cheese ingestion
HP:0033789.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating cheese.
HP:0033789.definition_cn: 适用于由食用奶酪引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0033790.name: Thistle tube shaped pulp
HP:0033790.definition: A thistle tube shape of the pulp chamber, meaning an enlarged coronal pulp chamber with narrow pulp canals giving a radiographic appearance of the shape of a thistle tube or a flame. It may occur isolated or associated with other dental anomalies and rare diseases such as dentinogenesis imperfecta, which should be assessed and coded separately. The diagnosis thistle tube shape pulp requires clinical and radiographic examinations.
HP:0033790.definition_cn: 牙髓腔呈蓟管状，即冠部牙髓腔扩大伴狭窄的根管，在影像学上呈现蓟管或火焰状外观。该病变可单独发生或与其他牙科异常及罕见疾病（如牙本质发育不全）相关，应分别进行评估和编码。诊断蓟管状牙髓腔需进行临床和影像学检查。

HP:0033791.name: Tooth ankylosis
HP:0033791.definition: Fusion of a tooth with alveolar bone.

HP:0033792.name: Cross bite
HP:0033792.definition: Lingual occlusion of buccal cusps and/or incisal edge of maxillary teeth to the buccal cusps and/or incisal edge of mandibular teeth.
HP:0033792.definition_cn: 上颌牙齿的颊尖和/或切缘与下颌牙齿的颊尖和/或切缘的舌侧咬合。

HP:0033793.name: Triggered by food ingestion
HP:0033793.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating a certain food.
HP:0033793.definition_cn: 适用于由摄入特定食物引发或诱发的体征或症状。

HP:0033794.name: Acral overgrowth
HP:0033794.definition: Excessive growth of hands and feet (predominantly due to soft tissue swelling). Typical manifestations include shoe size increase, foot enlargement, glove tightness, and hand enlargement.
HP:0033794.definition_cn: 肢端肥大症（主要由于软组织肿胀）。典型表现包括鞋码增大、足部增大、手套紧绷和手部增大。

HP:0033796.name: Abnormal leukocyte physiology
HP:0033796.definition: A functional abnormality of a white blood cell.

HP:0033797.name: Leukocyte migration defect
HP:0033797.definition: Any abnormality of leukocyte motility in response to chemokines, which is required for the inflammatory response to infections, and for organ development, tissues homeostasis, and vascularization.
HP:0033797.definition_cn: 任何白细胞对趋化因子反应的运动性异常，这种运动性对于感染引发的炎症反应以及器官发育、组织稳态和血管生成是必需的。

HP:0033798.name: Impaired leukocyte adhesion
HP:0033798.definition: During states of inflammation, white blood cells (leukocytes) play a key role in maintaining tissue homeostasis through elimination of pathogens and removal of damaged tissue. Leukocytes migrate to the site of inflammation by crawling over and through the blood vessel wall, into the tissue. This term refers to a defect in the attachment of leukocytes to the blood vessel wall, which is a key step required before they can pass through gaps of the endothelial cells of the blood vessel wall to migrate to the site of inflammation.
HP:0033798.definition_cn: 在炎症状态下，白细胞（leukocytes）通过清除病原体和移除受损组织在维持组织稳态中发挥关键作用。白细胞通过爬行穿过血管壁进入组织，迁移至炎症部位。该术语指的是白细胞与血管壁附着缺陷，这是其穿过血管壁内皮细胞间隙迁移至炎症部位之前所需的关键步骤。

HP:0033799.name: Abnormal circulating sex hormone concentration
HP:0033799.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a sex hormone in the blood circulation
HP:0033799.definition_cn: 任何血液循环中性激素正常浓度的偏离

HP:0033800.name: Blistering by anatomical location
HP:0033800.definition: Blistering (presence of multiple fluid filled blisters) categorized according to the body site where they occur.
HP:0033800.name_cn: 按解剖部位分类的水疱
HP:0033800.definition_cn: 水疱形成（存在多个充满液体的水疱）根据其发生的身体部位进行分类。

HP:0033801.name: Blistering by histological location
HP:0033801.definition: Blistering (presence of multiple fluid filled blisters) categorized according to the layer of the skin in which the blister originates. The skin is divided into three layers. The epidermis (outermost layer, which mainly consists of keratinocytes), the dermis, and a subcutaneous layer. The epidermis is divided into five layers: the basal lamina (innermost layer), the basal cell layer, the stratum spinosum, the stratum granulosum, and the stratum corneum (outermost layer). Cleavage in epidermolysis bullosa (EB) simplex occurs within the basal keratinocytes; in junctional EB, within the lamina lucida; and in dystrophic EB occurs in the sublamina densa, in the upper portion of the dermis (papillary dermis). In Kindler's EB, cleavage can occur in the basal keratinocytes, in the lamina lucida, or below the lamina densa.
HP:0033801.name_cn: 按组织学部位分类的水疱
HP:0033801.definition_cn: 水疱形成（存在多个充满液体的水疱）根据水疱起源的皮肤层次进行分类。皮肤分为三层：表皮（最外层，主要由角质形成细胞组成）、真皮和皮下层。表皮又分为五层：基底层（最内层）、基底细胞层、棘层、颗粒层和角质层（最外层）。在单纯型大疱性表皮松解症（EB）中，裂隙发生在基底角质形成细胞内；在交界型EB中，裂隙发生在透明层内；在营养不良型EB中，裂隙发生在致密层下方的真皮上部（乳头层）。在Kindler型EB中，裂隙可发生在基底角质形成细胞内、透明层内或致密层下方。

HP:0033802.name: Intra-epidermal blistering
HP:0033802.definition: A type of blistering in which the lesions are located within the epidermis with loss of cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes. In simplex EB, cleavage occurs in the basal layer, which is the innermost layer of the epidermis and consists of a single layer of basal germinative cells (mostly epidermal Keratinocytes) that proliferate and thereby produce new cells for other epidermal layers. As the cells move towards the upper layers of the epidermis they mature and eventually form cornified cells. The suprabasal cell layer lies directly above the basal layer and is composed of five to ten layers of cells.
HP:0033802.definition_cn: 一种水疱性疾病，其病变位于表皮内，伴有角质形成细胞间黏附丧失。在单纯型大疱性表皮松解症（EB）中，裂隙发生在基底层，即表皮的最内层，由单层基底生发细胞（主要为表皮角质形成细胞）组成，这些细胞通过增殖为其他表皮层产生新细胞。随着细胞向表皮上层移动，它们逐渐成熟并最终形成角化细胞。基底上层直接位于基底层之上，由五至十层细胞组成。

HP:0033803.name: Sub-lamina densa cleavage
HP:0033803.definition: A type of blistering in which the cleavage plane of blisters is located below the lamina densa.
HP:0033803.definition_cn: 一种水疱类型，其水疱的分离平面位于致密板下方。

HP:0033804.name: Subepidermal blistering
HP:0033804.definition: A type of blistering in which the lesions are located beneath the epidermis.
HP:0033804.definition_cn: 一种水疱类型，其病变位于表皮下方。

HP:0033805.name: Non-necrotizing granuloma
HP:0033805.definition: A granuloma which is not associated with necrotic changes.

HP:0033806.name: Abnormal epidermis stratum granulosum morphology
HP:0033806.definition: An abnormal structure of the stratum granulosum, which is is a thin layer of cells in the epidermis lying above the stratum spinosum and below the stratum corneum.
HP:0033806.definition_cn: 颗粒层结构异常，该层为位于棘层之上、角质层之下的表皮薄层细胞。

HP:0033807.name: Absent keratohyalin granules
HP:0033807.definition: Lack of keratohyalin granules, which are normally present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin.
HP:0033807.definition_cn: 角质透明颗粒缺乏，该颗粒通常存在于皮肤表皮层颗粒层中。

HP:0033808.name: Spermatocele
HP:0033808.definition: A cystic structure arising from the epididymis, rete testis or efferent ductuli. These structures are filled with spermatozoa containing fluid that may be milky. These cysts are usually outside the tunica vaginalis and, as with hydrocele, transluminate easily.
HP:0033808.definition_cn: 一种源自附睾、睾丸网或输出小管的囊性结构。这些结构内充满含有精子的液体，可能呈乳白色。这些囊肿通常位于鞘膜外，与鞘膜积液类似，易于透光。

HP:0033809.name: Increased circulating 17 hydroxypregnenolone concentration
HP:0033809.definition: Increased concentration of 17alpha-hydroxypregnenolone in the blood circulation. 17alpha-hydroxypregnenolone is a 21-carbon steroid that is converted from pregnenolone by steroid 17-alpha-hydroxylase, as an intermediate in the biosynthesis of gonadal steroid hormones and adrenal corticosteroids.
HP:0033809.name_cn: 循环中17-羟基孕烯醇酮浓度升高
HP:0033809.definition_cn: 血液中17α-羟基孕烯醇酮浓度升高。17α-羟基孕烯醇酮是一种21碳类固醇，由孕烯醇酮通过类固醇17α-羟化酶转化而来，作为性腺类固醇激素和肾上腺皮质激素生物合成的中间产物。

HP:0033810.name: Decreased circulating dihydrotestosterone concentration
HP:0033810.definition: A reduced concentration of dihydrotestosterone in the blood circulation.
HP:0033810.name_cn: 循环二氢睾酮浓度降低
HP:0033810.definition_cn: 血液循环中二氢睾酮浓度降低。

HP:0033811.name: Abnormal circulating androstenedione concentration
HP:0033811.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation.
HP:0033811.name_cn: 异常循环雄烯二酮浓度
HP:0033811.definition_cn: 血液中雄烯二酮浓度异常。

HP:0033812.name: Decreased circulating androstenedione concentration
HP:0033812.definition: Reduced concentration of androstenedione in the blood circulation.
HP:0033812.name_cn: 循环雄烯二酮浓度降低
HP:0033812.definition_cn: 血液循环中雄烯二酮浓度降低。

HP:0033813.name: Perilobular
HP:0033813.definition: Situated or occurring around a lobe of an organ.

HP:0033814.name: Paraseptal
HP:0033814.definition: Characterized by predominant involvement of the distal alveoli and their ducts and sacs. It is characteristically bounded by any pleural surface and the interlobular septa.
HP:0033814.definition_cn: 以远端肺泡及其导管和囊泡为主要受累部位为特征。其典型边界为任何胸膜表面和肺小叶间隔。

HP:0033815.name: Bronchocentric
HP:0033815.definition_cn: 位于支气管或细支气管中心。

HP:0033816.name: Centrilobular
HP:0033816.definition: Located in the center of the secondary pulmonary lobules, which are the functional units of the lungs.
HP:0033816.definition_cn: 位于次级肺小叶的中心，次级肺小叶是肺的功能单位。

HP:0033817.name: Miliary
HP:0033817.definition: Characterized by numerous small lesions said to resemble millet seed.
HP:0033817.definition_cn: 以多发粟粒样小病灶为特征。

HP:0033818.name: Reticular
HP:0033818.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles a net or network-like structure.
HP:0033818.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常，其分布和外观类似于网状或网络状结构。

HP:0033819.name: Perilymphatic
HP:0033819.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near lymphatic structures (node or vessel).
HP:0033819.definition_cn: 适用于分布和外观位于或邻近淋巴结构（淋巴结或淋巴管）的异常。

HP:0033820.name: Apical
HP:0033820.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at the apex of an organ. For instance, apical refers to the superior portion of the lung.
HP:0033820.definition_cn: 适用于描述异常分布和外观位于器官顶端的病变。例如，肺尖（apical）指肺的上部。

HP:0033821.name: Pulmonary mass
HP:0033821.definition: A mass in the lung seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics).
HP:0033821.definition_cn: 胸部影像学检查中观察到的肺部肿块定义为直径大于3厘米的密度增高影（不考虑其轮廓、边界或密度特征）。

HP:0033822.name: Mass on thoracic imaging
HP:0033822.definition: A mass is any pulmonary, pleural, or mediastinal lesion seen on chest radiographs as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics). Mass usually implies a solid or partly solid opacity. CT allows more exact evaluation of size, location, attenuation, and other features.
HP:0033822.definition_cn: 肿块是指在胸部X线片上可见的直径大于3厘米的肺、胸膜或纵隔病变，表现为不透明影（不论其轮廓、边缘或密度特征）。肿块通常意味着实性或部分实性的不透明影。CT能够更精确地评估其大小、位置、衰减值及其他特征。

HP:0033823.name: Mediastinal mass
HP:0033823.definition: A mass in the mediastinum seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics).
HP:0033823.definition_cn: 胸部影像学检查中发现的纵隔肿块定义为直径大于3厘米的密度影（不考虑轮廓、边界或密度特征）。

HP:0033824.name: Pleural mass
HP:0033824.definition: A mass in the pleura seen on chest imaging is defined as an opacity greater than 3 cm in diameter (without regard to contour, border, or density characteristics).
HP:0033824.definition_cn: 胸膜肿块在胸部影像学上定义为直径大于3厘米的密度增高影（不考虑其轮廓、边界或密度特征）。

HP:0033825.name: Superior mediastinal mass
