HP:0034086.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against PM-Scl75.
HP:0034086.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对PM-Scl75的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034087.name: Anti-U11/U12 RNP antibody positivity
HP:0034087.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against U11/U12 RNP.
HP:0034087.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对U11/U12核糖核蛋白（RNP）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034088.name: Anti-Ku antibody positivity
HP:0034088.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ku.
HP:0034088.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Ku抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034089.name: Anti-B23 antibody positivity
HP:0034089.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against B23.
HP:0034089.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对B23的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034090.name: Anti-RuvBL1/2 antibody positivity
HP:0034090.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against RuvBL1/2.
HP:0034090.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对RuvBL1/2的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034091.name: Anti-platelet derived growth factor receptor
HP:0034091.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against platelet derived growth factor receptor.
HP:0034091.name_cn: 抗血小板衍生生长因子受体
HP:0034091.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对血小板衍生生长因子受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034092.name: Anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody positivity
HP:0034092.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against cyclic citrullinated peptide.
HP:0034092.name_cn: 抗环瓜氨酸肽抗体阳性
HP:0034092.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对环瓜氨酸肽（cyclic citrullinated peptide, CCP）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034093.name: Anti-Ro52/TRIM21 antibody positivity
HP:0034093.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ro52/TRIM21.
HP:0034093.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Ro52/TRIM21的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034094.name: Anti-angiotensin receptor type-1 antibody positivity
HP:0034094.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against angiotensin receptor type-1.
HP:0034094.name_cn: 抗血管紧张素受体1型抗体阳性
HP:0034094.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对1型血管紧张素受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034095.name: Anti-endothelin-1 type A receptor antibody positivity
HP:0034095.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against endothelin-1 type A receptor.
HP:0034095.name_cn: 抗内皮素-1 A型受体抗体阳性
HP:0034095.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对内皮素-1 A型受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

Usually IA-2A are measured using the intracellular portion of IA-2 (IA-2ic) made up of the protein tyrosine phosphatase (PTP) and juxtamembrane (JM) regions.
HP:0034158.name_cn: 胰岛抗原-2抗体酪氨酸磷酸酶区域阳性
HP:0034158.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对胰岛抗原2A（IA-2）酪氨酸磷酸酶区域的自身体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。通常使用由蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶（PTP）和近膜区（JM）组成的IA-2细胞内部分（IA-2ic）来检测IA-2A。

HP:0034159.name: Paget disease of bone
HP:0034159.definition: A localized disorder of bone remodeling. Increased numbers of larger than normal osteoclasts initiate the process at affected skeletal sites, and the increase in bone resorption is followed by an increase in new bone formation, altering bone architecture.
HP:0034159.definition_cn: 一种局部性骨重塑障碍。在受累骨骼部位，数量增多的异常增大的破骨细胞启动该过程，骨吸收增加随后伴随新骨形成增加，从而改变骨结构。

HP:0034160.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 9 concentration
HP:0034160.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 9 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034160.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素9浓度
HP:0034160.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素-9浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0034161.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 9 concentration
HP:0034161.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of interleukin 9 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034161.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素9浓度降低
HP:0034161.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素9浓度异常降低。

HP:0034162.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 10 concentration
HP:0034162.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034162.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素10浓度
HP:0034162.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素10浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0034163.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素10浓度异常降低。

HP:0034164.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素21浓度

HP:0034165.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素21浓度降低
HP:0034165.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素21浓度异常降低。

HP:0034166.name: Increased circulating interleukin 21 concentration
HP:0034166.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 21 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034166.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素21浓度升高
HP:0034166.definition_cn: 循环血液中白细胞介素21浓度异常升高。

HP:0034167.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 22 concentration
HP:0034167.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034167.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素22浓度
HP:0034167.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素22浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0034168.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素22浓度降低
HP:0034168.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素22浓度异常降低。

HP:0034169.name: Increased circulating interleukin 22 concentration
HP:0034169.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 22 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034169.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素22浓度升高
HP:0034169.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素22浓度异常升高。

HP:0034170.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 23 concentration
HP:0034170.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034170.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素23浓度
HP:0034170.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素23浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0034171.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 23 concentration

HP:0034171.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素23浓度降低
HP:0034171.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素23浓度异常降低。

HP:0034172.name: Increased circulating interleukin 23 concentration
HP:0034172.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 23 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034172.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素23浓度升高
HP:0034172.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素23浓度异常升高。

HP:0034173.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 27 concentration
HP:0034173.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034173.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素27浓度
HP:0034173.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素27浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0034174.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素27浓度降低
HP:0034174.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素27浓度异常降低。

HP:0034175.name: Increased circulating interleukin 27 concentration
HP:0034175.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of interleukin 27 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034175.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素27浓度升高
HP:0034175.definition_cn: 循环血液中白细胞介素27浓度异常升高。

HP:0034176.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 17A concentration
HP:0034176.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 17A in the blood circulation.
HP:0034176.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素17A浓度
HP:0034176.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素17A浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:0034177.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 17A concentration

HP:0034177.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素17A浓度异常降低。

HP:0034178.name: Increased circulating interleukin 17A concentration

HP:0034178.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素17A浓度升高
HP:0034178.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素17A浓度异常升高。

HP:0034179.name: Vertebral artery aneurysm
HP:0034179.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the vertebral artery .
HP:0034179.definition_cn: 椎动脉壁异常囊状扩张或动脉瘤样膨出。

HP:0034180.name: Fusion of the caudate and putamen
HP:0034180.definition: Abnormal joined appearance of the caudate and putamen with an absence of the anterior limb of the internal capsule.
HP:0034180.definition_cn: 尾状核与壳核异常连接，伴内囊前肢缺失。

HP:0034181.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the liver
HP:0034181.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the liver.
HP:0034181.name_cn: 肝脏发育不全/肝脏发育不良

HP:0034182.name: Segmental hypoplasia of liver
HP:0034182.definition: Anatomically the liver is divided into right and left lobes based on the attachment of its peritoneal ligaments. This term refers to a developmental anomaly characterzied by the underdevelopment of one of the lobes of the liver. This is a rare and usually asymptomatic anomaly that can be detected incidentally on cross sectional imaging with computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:0034182.definition_cn: 解剖学上，肝脏根据其腹膜韧带的附着分为右叶和左叶。该术语指一种发育异常，其特征为肝脏某一叶的发育不全。这是一种罕见且通常无症状的异常，可通过计算机断层扫描或磁共振成像的横断面影像偶然发现。

HP:0034183.name: Spastic triplegia
HP:0034183.definition: Spastic weakness found in both lower extremities and one upper extremity.
HP:0034183.definition_cn: 双侧下肢及一侧上肢出现痉挛性无力。

HP:0034184.name: Increased insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
HP:0034184.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration of insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit level in the blood circulation.
HP:0034184.name_cn: 胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基浓度升高
HP:0034184.definition_cn: 血液循环中胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基水平异常升高。

HP:0034185.name: Median pseudocleft lip
HP:0034185.definition: A type of mild median cleft lip in which the central tubercle of the upper lip is replaced by a mucosal cleft in the midline.
HP:0034185.definition_cn: 一种轻度正中唇裂，其中上唇中央结节被中线处的黏膜裂隙所取代。

HP:0034186.name: Patella alta
HP:0034186.definition: Patella alta is a patella that rides abnormally high in relation to the femur, the femoral trochlea, or the tibia, with decreased bony stability requiring increased knee flexion angles to engage the trochlea.
HP:0034186.definition_cn: 高位髌骨是指髌骨相对于股骨、股骨滑车或胫骨异常高位，骨性稳定性降低，需要增加膝关节屈曲角度以使髌骨与滑车接触。

HP:0034187.name: Clavicular pseudarthrosis
HP:0034187.definition: A developmental defect in a the clavicule leading to bending and pathologic fracture, with inability to form a normal bony callus with subsequent fibrous nonunion, leading to the pseudarthrosis (or false joint).
HP:0034187.definition_cn: 锁骨发育缺陷导致弯曲和病理性骨折，无法形成正常骨痂，随后发生纤维性不愈合，导致假关节形成（或假性关节）。

HP:0034188.name: Midline liver
HP:0034188.definition: Position of the liver across the middle of the body instead of being in its normal position to the right of the stomach.
HP:0034188.definition_cn: 肝脏位于身体中线位置，而非其正常解剖位置即胃的右侧。

HP:0034189.name: Anti-thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor antibody positivity
HP:0034189.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against thyroid-stimulating hormone.
HP:0034189.name_cn: 抗甲状腺刺激激素受体抗体阳性
HP:0034189.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对促甲状腺激素的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034190.name: Abnormal fetal cardiovascular physiology
HP:0034190.definition: Abnormal functionality of the fetal cardiovascular system.
HP:0034190.definition_cn: 胎儿心血管系统功能异常。

HP:0034191.name: Elevated fetal middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity
HP:0034191.definition: Increased peak systolic velocity of the fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) as evaluated by Doppler ultrasound.
HP:0034191.name_cn: 胎儿大脑中动脉收缩期峰值流速升高
HP:0034191.definition_cn: 经多普勒超声评估，胎儿大脑中动脉（MCA）收缩期峰值流速增加。

HP:0034192.name: Pulmonary thromboembolism
HP:0034192.definition: Pulmonary embolism is caused by emboli, which have originated from venous thrombi, traveling to and occluding the arteries of the lung.
HP:0034192.definition_cn: 肺栓塞是由源自静脉血栓的栓子迁移并阻塞肺动脉所引起。

HP:0034193.name: Stratum basale cleavage
HP:0034193.definition: Cleavage within the epidermal keratinocytes, which is the innermost layer of the epidermis and consists of proliferating cells that give rise to the outer layers of the epidermis.
HP:0034193.definition_cn: 表皮角质形成细胞内的裂解，即表皮的最内层，由增殖细胞组成，这些细胞生成表皮的外层。

HP:0034194.name: Suprabasal cleavage
HP:0034194.definition: Cleavage within the suprabasal cell layer of the epidermis, which lies directly above the basal layer and is composed of five to ten layers of cells.
HP:0034194.definition_cn: 表皮棘层内的裂隙，该层直接位于基底层上方，由五至十层细胞组成。

HP:0034195.name: Triggered by muscle relaxant
HP:0034195.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a muscle relaxant such as suxamethonium and mivacurium.
HP:0034195.definition_cn: 适用于因暴露于肌肉松弛剂（如琥珀胆碱和米库氯铵）而诱发或引发的体征或症状。

HP:0034196.name: Ductus venosus agenesis
HP:0034196.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of formation of the ductus venosus (a shunt that allows oxygenated blood in the umbilical vein to bypass the liver in the fetal circulation).
HP:0034196.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为静脉导管（一种在胎儿循环中使脐静脉中的含氧血液绕过肝脏的分流结构）未形成。

HP:0034197.name: Third trimester onset
HP:0034197.definition: This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth during the third trimester, which is defined as 28 weeks and zero days (28+0) of gestation and beyond.
HP:0034197.definition_cn: 该术语指在妊娠晚期（定义为妊娠28周零天（28+0）及以后）首次观察到的表型特征。

HP:0034198.name: Second trimester onset
HP:0034198.definition: This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth during the second trimester, which comprises the range of gestational ages from 14 0/7 weeks to 27 6/7 (inclusive).
HP:0034198.definition_cn: 该术语指在妊娠中期（即孕周范围为14周0天至27周6天，包括首尾）首次观察到的表型特征。

HP:0034199.name: Late first trimester onset
HP:0034199.definition: This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth in the first trimester during the early fetal period, which is defined as 11 0/7 to 13 6/7 weeks of gestation (inclusive).
HP:0034199.definition_cn: 该术语指在妊娠早期（定义为妊娠11周0天至13周6天，包括首尾两天）首次观察到的表型特征。

HP:0034200.name: Abnormal CSF homovanillic acid concentration
HP:0034200.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of homovanillic acid (HVA) in the cerebrospinal fluid. HVA is a metabolite of dopamine.
HP:0034200.name_cn: 脑脊液高香草酸浓度异常
HP:0034200.definition_cn: 脑脊液中高香草酸（HVA）浓度偏离正常范围。高香草酸是多巴胺的代谢产物。

HP:0034201.name: Increased CSF homovanillic acid concentration
HP:0034201.definition: Elevated concentration of homovanillic acid (HVA) in the cerebrospinal fluid. HVA is a metabolite of dopamine.
HP:0034201.name_cn: 脑脊液高香草酸浓度升高
HP:0034201.definition_cn: 脑脊液中高香草酸（HVA）浓度升高。HVA是多巴胺的代谢产物。

HP:0034202.name: Abnormal iduronate sulfatase concentration
HP:0034202.name_cn: 异常艾杜糖醛酸硫酸酯酶浓度

HP:0034203.name: Decreased iduronate sulfatase level
HP:0034203.definition: An decreased level of iduronate-2-sulfatase activity in the blood circulation.
HP:0034203.name_cn: 艾杜糖醛酸硫酸酯酶水平降低
HP:0034203.definition_cn: 血液循环中艾杜糖醛酸-2-硫酸酯酶活性水平降低。

HP:0034204.name: Decreased circulating C1-esterase inhibitor concentration
HP:0034204.definition: Decreased concentration of C1-esterase inhibitor (C1INH) in the blood circulation.
HP:0034204.name_cn: 循环中C1酯酶抑制剂浓度降低
HP:0034204.definition_cn: 血液循环中C1酯酶抑制剂（C1INH）浓度降低。

HP:0034205.name: Iniencephaly
HP:0034205.definition: Iniencephaly is a rare neural tube defect involving dysmorphic spine and abnormal fusion of the portion of the occipital skull with the back. It results in extreme fixed head retroflexion.
HP:0034205.definition_cn: 枕骨裂脑露畸形是一种罕见的神经管缺陷，涉及脊柱畸形及枕骨部分与背部异常融合，导致头部极度后仰固定。

HP:0034206.name: Abnormal fetal central nervous system morphology
HP:0034206.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal central nervous system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0034206.name_cn: 胎儿中枢神经系统形态异常
HP:0034206.definition_cn: 胎儿中枢神经系统异常结构发现。此亚层次中的术语仅限于可在产前期间观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0034207.name: Abnormal fetal gastrointestinal system morphology
HP:0034207.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal gastrointestinal system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0034207.name_cn: 胎儿胃肠道系统形态异常
HP:0034207.definition_cn: 胎儿消化系统结构异常发现。此子层次中的术语仅限于可在产前期间观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0034208.name: Fetal intracranial hemorrhage
HP:0034208.definition: Abnormal bleeding inside the skull (cranium) of a fetus.
HP:0034208.definition_cn: 胎儿颅内异常出血（颅骨内）。

HP:0034209.name: Fetal subependymal hemorrhage
HP:0034209.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage located in the subependymal germinal matrix below the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles in the caudothalamic notch.
HP:0034209.definition_cn: 一种位于侧脑室额角下方尾状核丘脑沟内室管膜下生发基质中的胎儿颅内出血类型。

HP:0034210.name: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage
HP:0034210.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding into the ventricular system of the brain.
HP:0034210.definition_cn: 一种胎儿颅内出血类型，伴有脑室系统内出血。

HP:0034211.name: Fetal cerebral parenchymal hemorrhage
HP:0034211.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding into the parenchyma (tissue) of the brain.
HP:0034211.definition_cn: 一种胎儿颅内出血类型，出血进入脑实质（组织）。

HP:0034212.name: Fetal extra-axial hemorrhage
HP:0034212.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding that occurs within the skull but outside of the brain tissue itself (into the epidural, subdural, or arachnoid space).
HP:0034212.definition_cn: 一种胎儿颅内出血类型，出血发生在颅骨内但位于脑组织外部（进入硬膜外、硬膜下或蛛网膜下腔）。

HP:0034213.name: Fetal posterior fossa hemorrhage
HP:0034213.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the posterior cranial fossa, which is the part of the cranial cavity that is located between the foramen magnum and tentorium cerebelli and contains the brainstem and cerebellum.
HP:0034213.definition_cn: 一种发生于后颅窝的胎儿颅内出血，后颅窝是位于枕骨大孔与小脑幕之间的颅腔部分，内含脑干和小脑。

HP:0034214.name: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage without ventriculomegaly
HP:0034214.definition: A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage characterized by clear hemorrhage spillover to the ventricles filling less than 50% of the lateral ventricle and without ventriculomegaly of greater than 15 mm in the transverse diameter of the lateral ventricular atrium.
HP:0034214.name_cn: 胎儿脑室内出血不伴脑室扩大
HP:0034214.definition_cn: 一种胎儿脑室内出血类型，其特征为出血明显溢出至脑室，但填充侧脑室不足50%，且侧脑室房横径不超过15毫米，无脑室扩大。

HP:0034215.name: Fetal cerebellar hemisphere hemorrhage
HP:0034215.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the hemisphere of the cerebellum.
HP:0034215.definition_cn: 一种发生在小脑半球的胎儿颅内出血类型。

HP:0034216.name: Fetal cerebellar vermis hemorrhage
HP:0034216.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the vermis of the cerebellum.
HP:0034216.definition_cn: 一种发生于小脑蚓部的胎儿颅内出血类型。

HP:0034217.name: Sonographic non-visualized fetal bladder
HP:0034217.definition: Inability to visualize the fetal bladder on targeted prenatal sonography examination. The fetal bladder can be visualized with sonography as a midline, fluid-filled structure in the pelvis as early as 10-12 weeks of gestation. The normal fetus voids at least once an hour but never completely empties the urinary bladder. The fetal bladdder should be consistently imaged after 13 weeks of gestation.
HP:0034217.name_cn: 超声检查未见胎儿膀胱
HP:0034217.definition_cn: 在针对性产前超声检查中无法观察到胎儿膀胱。胎儿膀胱在妊娠10-12周时即可通过超声检查显示为位于骨盆中线处的液性结构。正常胎儿每小时至少排尿一次，但膀胱从未完全排空。妊娠13周后应持续观察到胎儿膀胱的影像。

HP:0034218.name: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with ventriculomegaly
HP:0034218.definition: A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) characterized by spillover to ventricles with flooding of 50% or more of one or both lateral ventricles accrued accompanying ventriculomegaly, but with no apparent brain parenchymal injury. This type of IVH may be defined as a diameter exceeding 15 mm in the transverse diameter of the lateral ventricular atrium as visualiuzed by prenatal sonography.
HP:0034218.name_cn: 胎儿脑室内出血伴脑室扩大
HP:0034218.definition_cn: 一种胎儿脑室内出血（IVH）类型，其特征为出血溢入脑室，导致一侧或双侧侧脑室50%或以上被血液充盈，并伴有脑室扩大，但无明显脑实质损伤。该类型IVH可通过产前超声检查定义为侧脑室房部横径超过15毫米。

HP:0034219.name: Fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with periventricular hemorrhage
HP:0034219.definition: A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage that additionally includes hemorrhage in a large part of the periventricular parenchyma.
HP:0034219.name_cn: 胎儿脑室内出血伴脑室周围出血
HP:0034219.definition_cn: 一种胎儿脑室内出血类型，其还包括大部分脑室周围实质的出血。

HP:0034220.name: Temporal lobe megalencephaly
HP:0034220.definition: Expansion of the temporal lobes of the brain along all axes, including rostrocaudal, superoinferior, and mediolateral, resulting in a globular appearance of the brain.
HP:0034220.definition_cn: 颞叶沿所有轴（包括头尾轴、上下轴和内外轴）的扩张，导致大脑呈现球形外观。

HP:0034221.name: Abnormal temporal lobe morphology
HP:0034221.definition: An abnormal structural of the zone (lobe) of the cerebral cortex that is located inferior to the lateral fissure on other cerebral hemispheres.
HP:0034221.definition_cn: 位于大脑半球外侧裂下方的大脑皮质区域（叶）的异常结构。

HP:0034222.name: Temporal lobe dysplasia
HP:0034222.definition: A developmental defect of the temporal lobe of the cerebral cortex that is characterized by prominent sulcations and radially directed gyrations.
HP:0034222.definition_cn: 大脑皮层颞叶发育缺陷，其特征为显著的脑沟和放射状脑回。

HP:0034223.name: Elevated umbilical artery pulsatility
HP:0034223.definition: Human umbilical artery (UA) blood flow pulsatility measured by Doppler ultrasound is a widely used biomarker for the detection of elevated placental vascular resistance. Elevated UA pulsatility, which in the most extreme cases manifests as absent or even reversed end-diastolic velocity, is associated with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) and still-birth.
HP:0034223.definition_cn: 通过多普勒超声测量的人脐动脉（UA）血流搏动指数是广泛用于检测胎盘血管阻力升高的生物标志物。UA搏动指数升高，在极端情况下表现为舒张末期血流缺失甚至反向，与宫内生长受限（IUGR）和死产相关。

HP:0034224.name: Absent end-diastolic umbilical artery flow
HP:0034224.definition: An anomaly that is visualized by umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry. Flow in the umbilical artery should be in the forward direction in normal circumstances. This anomaly is characterized by an absence of flow in the umbilical artery at the end of diastole.
HP:0034224.name_cn: 舒张末期脐动脉血流缺失
HP:0034224.definition_cn: 通过脐动脉多普勒血流速度描记法观察到的异常。在正常情况下，脐动脉血流应为正向流动。该异常的特征是舒张末期脐动脉血流缺失。

HP:0034225.name: Reversed end-diastolic umbilical artery flow
HP:0034225.definition: An anomaly that is visualized by umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry. Flow in the umbilical artery should be in the forward direction in normal circumstances. This anomaly is characterized by an reversal of flow in the umbilical artery at the end of diastole (i.e., backwards flow).
HP:0034225.name_cn: 反向脐动脉舒张末期血流
HP:0034225.definition_cn: 脐动脉多普勒血流速度成像所见的异常。正常情况下，脐动脉血流应为正向流动。该异常的特征是舒张末期脐动脉血流反向（即逆向流动）。

HP:0034226.name: Champagne cork sign
HP:0034226.definition: Characteristic appearance of the chest and abdomen in the sagittal view on prenatal ultrasound when the chest is small and the abdomen protruding.
HP:0034226.definition_cn: 产前超声矢状面显示胸腔狭小、腹部突出的特征性胸腹外观。

HP:0034227.name: Aortic isthmus hypoplasia
HP:0034227.definition: A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the isthmus (arch between the left subclavian and insertion of the patent ductus arteriosus/ligamentum arteriosum) has a diameter of less than 40% of the diameter of the ascending aorta.
HP:0034227.definition_cn: 一种主动脉弓发育不全的类型，其中峡部（位于左锁骨下动脉与动脉导管未闭/动脉韧带插入点之间的弓部）直径小于升主动脉直径的40%。

HP:0034228.name: Proximal aortic arch hypoplasia
HP:0034228.definition: A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the proximal aortic arch (arch proximal to the origin of the left subclavian artery) has a diameter of less than 60% of the diameter of the ascending aorta.
HP:0034228.name_cn: 近端主动脉弓发育不全
HP:0034228.definition_cn: 一种主动脉弓发育不全类型，其中近端主动脉弓（位于左锁骨下动脉起始处近端）的直径小于升主动脉直径的60%。

HP:0034229.name: Distal aortic arch hypoplasia
HP:0034229.definition: A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the distal aortic arch (arch distal to the ductus arteriosus) has a diameter of less than 60% of the diameter of the ascending aorta.
HP:0034229.name_cn: 远端主动脉弓发育不全
HP:0034229.definition_cn: 一种主动脉弓发育不全的类型，其中远端主动脉弓（动脉导管远端的弓部）直径小于升主动脉直径的60%。

HP:0034230.name: Inferior crossed fused renal ectopia
HP:0034230.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia characterized by fusion between the upper pole of the cross-fused ectopic kidney (located more inferiorly relative to the other kidney) and the lower pole of the other orthotopic kidney (located in a more superior position).
HP:0034230.definition_cn: 一种交叉融合型肾异位，其特征为交叉融合异位肾（相对于另一肾脏位置更靠下）的上极与另一原位肾（位置更靠上）的下极发生融合。

HP:0034231.name: Sigmoid kidney
HP:0034231.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia where the normal side kidney is present superiorly and the direction of pelvic is medial, the kidney which crosses positioned inferiorly with direction of pelvic toward the lateral side. As kidneys fuse after complete rotation on the vertical axis, both renal pelves lie in correct orientation.
HP:0034231.definition_cn: 一种交叉融合性肾异位类型，其中正常侧肾脏位于上方，肾盂方向朝向内侧，而交叉的肾脏位于下方，肾盂方向朝向侧方。由于肾脏在垂直轴上完全旋转后融合，两个肾盂均处于正确的方位。

HP:0034232.name: Unilateral lump kidney
HP:0034232.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia where fusion occurs over a wide margin, both renal pelves anteriorly directed and placed more inferiorly.
HP:0034232.definition_cn: 一种交叉融合性肾异位类型，其中融合范围广泛，双侧肾盂向前方指向且位置更为靠下。

HP:0034233.name: Disc kidney
HP:0034233.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which kidneys fuse along their medial borders.
HP:0034233.definition_cn: 一种交叉融合性肾异位，其中肾脏沿其内侧缘融合。

HP:0034234.name: L-shaped kidney
HP:0034234.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which the crossed kidney lies inferiorly and transversely, fused with the lower pole of the normal kidney.
HP:0034234.definition_cn: 一种交叉融合型肾异位，其中交叉肾位于下方并横向，与正常肾的下极融合。

HP:0034235.name: Superior crossed-fused renal ectopia
HP:0034235.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which the ectopic kidney lies superiorly and its lower pole fuses with the upper pole of the normal kidney. The renal pelvis of both kidneys lies anteriorly.
HP:0034235.definition_cn: 一种交叉融合肾异位类型，其中异位肾位于上方，其下极与正常肾的上极融合。两肾的肾盂均位于前方。

HP:0034236.name: Apnea of prematurity
HP:0034236.definition: Recurrent episodes of apnea occurring in infants born less than 37 weeks of gestation, defined specifically as a pause of breathing for more than 15-20 s, or accompanied by oxygen desaturation (SpO2 not more than 80% for at least 4 s) and bradycardia (heart rate less than 2/3 of baseline for at least 4 s), in infants born less than 37 weeks of gestation.
HP:0034236.definition_cn: 妊娠不足37周出生的婴儿中反复发生的呼吸暂停发作，具体定义为呼吸暂停超过15-20秒，或伴有氧饱和度下降（SpO2不超过80%至少持续4秒）和心动过缓（心率低于基线值的2/3至少持续4秒）。

HP:0034237.name: Open neural tube defect
HP:0034237.definition: A type of neural tube defect that is not covered by skin.
HP:0034237.definition_cn: 一种未被皮肤覆盖的神经管缺陷。

HP:0034238.name: Closed neural tube defect
HP:0034238.definition: A type of neural tube defect that is covered by skin.
HP:0034238.definition_cn: 一种被皮肤覆盖的神经管缺陷。

HP:0034239.name: Renal vein thrombosis
HP:0034239.definition: The presence of a thrombus (blood clot) in the major renal veins or its tributaries, generally leading to passive congestion that develops causes the affected kidney to swell and become engorged, leading to degeneration of nephrons and causing symptoms of flank pain, hematuria, and decreased urine output.
HP:0034239.definition_cn: 肾静脉主干或其属支内存在血栓（血凝块），通常导致被动性充血，进而引起受累肾脏肿胀和充血，导致肾单位退化，并引发侧腹疼痛、血尿和尿量减少等症状。

HP:0034240.name: Fetal neck mass
HP:0034240.definition: An abnormal growth (lump) of tissue in the neck region of a fetus. Masses may be simple cystic,, cystic with a few simple septations (fewer than three septations and less than 3-mm thick), cystic with multiple or thick septations (greater than three septations or septations 3-mm-thick or more), a mass that is than is less than 50% solid, and a mass that is 50% solid or more.
HP:0034240.definition_cn: 胎儿颈部区域组织异常增生（肿块）。肿块可为单纯囊性、囊性伴少量简单分隔（少于三个分隔且厚度小于3毫米）、囊性伴多发或厚分隔（多于三个分隔或分隔厚度≥3毫米）、实性成分少于50%的肿块，以及实性成分≥50%的肿块。

HP:0034241.name: Prenatal death
HP:0034241.definition: Death of a fetus in the uterus.

HP:0034242.name: Abnormal fetal genitourinary system morphology
HP:0034242.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal genitourinary system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0034242.name_cn: 胎儿泌尿生殖系统形态异常
HP:0034242.definition_cn: 胎儿泌尿生殖系统异常结构发现。此子层次中的术语仅限于可在产前期间观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0034243.name: Abnormal fetal pulmonary morphology
HP:0034243.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal lungs. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP:0034243.definition_cn: 胎儿肺部异常结构发现。此亚层次中的术语仅限于在产前期间可观察到的发现。其他HPO术语也可用于描述胎儿表型。

HP:0034244.name: Gastric pseudomass
HP:0034244.definition: At US examination from the second trimester onward, the fetal stomach appears as a uniformly anechoic, sharply circumscribed round structure in the left upper quadrant. However, debris is commonly visualized in the stomach, forming a pseudomass.
HP:0034244.definition_cn: 在妊娠中期及以后的超声检查中，胎儿胃部表现为左上腹区一个均匀无回声、边界清晰的圆形结构。然而，胃内常可见到碎屑，形成假性肿块。

HP:0034246.name: Fetal scalp mass
HP:0034246.definition: An abnormal growth (lump) of tissue that projects from the fetal scalp.
HP:0034246.definition_cn: 胎儿头皮组织异常增生（肿块）突起。

HP:0034247.name: Fetal lower urinary tract obstruction
HP:0034247.definition: An obstruction in the ureter leading to bladder outlet obstruction. Special criteria are used for lower urinary tract obstruction (LUTO) in the fetus. Prenatal LUTO has classically been suspected on the basis of three ultrasonographic findings: megacystis, dilated posterior urethra (known as the keyhole sign) and hydronephrosis.
HP:0034247.definition_cn: 输尿管梗阻导致膀胱出口梗阻。胎儿下尿路梗阻（LUTO）采用特殊标准进行诊断。产前LUTO通常基于以下三种超声检查结果进行怀疑：巨膀胱、后尿道扩张（称为“钥匙孔征”）以及肾积水。

HP:0034248.name: Increased fetal lens echogenicity
HP:0034248.definition: Increased echogenicity (increased brightness in the gray-scale sonography image) of the lens of a fetus.
HP:0034248.definition_cn: 胎儿晶状体回声增强（灰度超声图像中亮度增加）。

HP:0034249.name: Severe influenza infection
HP:0034249.definition: An unusually severe infection by an influenza virus.
HP:0034249.definition_cn: 由流感病毒引起的异常严重感染。

HP:0034250.name: Fetal nuchal edema
HP:0034250.definition: Nuchal edema is considered present in a fetus at gestational week 14 or more if in the midsagittal plane of the neck, there is subcutaneous edema that produces a characteristic tremor on ballotment of the fetal head. This constitutes the severe end of the spectrum of increased nuchal fold thickness, which is defined as soft-tissue thickening of 6 mm or more, seen in the suboccipitobregmatic view of the fetal head. Nuchal edema may be confined to the neck or it may be generalized, as part of hydrops fetalis.
HP:0034250.definition_cn: 在妊娠14周或以上的胎儿中，如果在颈部的中矢状面上存在皮下水肿，且在胎儿头部触诊时产生特征性震颤，则认为存在颈项水肿。这是颈项皱褶厚度增加的严重表现，定义为在胎儿头部的枕下前囟视图中可见软组织增厚达6毫米或以上。颈项水肿可能局限于颈部，也可能作为胎儿水肿的一部分而广泛存在。

HP:0034251.name: Abnormal corneal reflex
HP:0034251.definition: An anomaly of the corneal reflex that normally induces involuntary blinking of the eyelids following contact of the cornea.
HP:0034251.definition_cn: 角膜反射异常，通常指角膜接触后未能诱发眼睑的不自主眨眼反应。

HP:0034252.name: Absent corneal reflex
HP:0034252.definition: Absence of the corneal blinking reflex, which normally induces involuntary blinking of the eyelids following contact of the cornea. The corneal blink reflex is caused by a loop between the trigeminal sensory nerves and the facial motor (VII) nerve innervation of the orbicularis oculi muscles.
HP:0034252.definition_cn: 角膜瞬目反射缺失，该反射通常在角膜接触后引发眼睑的不自主瞬目。角膜瞬目反射由三叉神经感觉神经与面神经（VII）运动神经支配的眼轮匝肌之间的环路所引起。

HP:0034253.name: Eosinophil nuclear hypersegmentation
HP:0034253.definition: An excessive division of the lobes of the nucleus of eosinophils. Eosinophils with more than two nuclear lobes are commonly regarded as hypersegmented, because seventy to ninety percent of peripheral blood eosinophils have two nuclear lobes.
HP:0034253.name_cn: 嗜酸性粒细胞核过度分叶
HP:0034253.definition_cn: 嗜酸性粒细胞核叶过度分裂。具有超过两个核叶的嗜酸性粒细胞通常被视为过度分叶，因为外周血中70%至90%的嗜酸性粒细胞具有两个核叶。

HP:0034254.name: Face of the giant panda sign
HP:0034254.definition: The face of the giant panda sign on T2-weighted MRI is characterized by preservation of normal signal intensity in the red nuclei and lateral portion of the pars reticulata of the substantia nigra, high signal in the tegmentum, and hypointensity of the superior colliculus. The findings are said to resemble the face of a giant panda.
HP:0034254.definition_cn: T2加权磁共振成像上的“大熊猫脸征”表现为红核和黑质网状部外侧部分信号强度正常，被盖区高信号，上丘低信号。这些表现被认为类似于大熊猫的面部特征。

HP:0034255.name: Colovesical fistula
HP:0034255.definition: An aberrant, pathological communication between the colon and the bladder.

HP:0034256.name: Absent dermoepidermal hemidesmosomes
HP:0034256.definition: Lack of demonstrable hemidesmosomes at the dermoepidermal junction. Hemidesmosomes are the specialized junctional complexes, that contribute to the attachment of epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane in stratified and other complex epithelia, such as the skin.
HP:0034256.definition_cn: 真皮-表皮连接处缺乏可证实的半桥粒。半桥粒是特化的连接复合体，有助于复层上皮和其他复杂上皮（如皮肤）中的上皮细胞附着于基底膜。

HP:0034257.name: C4 nephritic factor positivity
HP:0034257.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that recognize C4b2a, the C3 convertase of the classical pathway of complement.
HP:0034257.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在识别C4b2a（经典补体途径的C3转化酶）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0034258.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the midbrain
HP:0034258.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the midbrain (mesencephalon).
HP:0034258.name_cn: 中脑发育不全/中脑发育不良

HP:0034259.name: Hypoplasia of the midbrain
HP:0034259.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the mesencephalon.

HP:0034260.name: Aplastic zygomatic arch
HP:0034260.definition: Developmental defect characterized by the absence of the zygomatic arch.
HP:0034260.definition_cn: 以颧弓缺失为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0034261.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of facial bones
HP:0034261.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence or underdevelopment of one or more facial bone.
HP:0034261.name_cn: 面骨发育不全/面骨发育不良
HP:0034261.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为一个或多个面部骨骼的缺失或发育不全。

HP:0034262.name: Absent lanugo
HP:0034262.definition: Lack of development of lanugo, the fine, soft, unpigmented hair on the body of a fetus or newborn baby.
HP:0034262.definition_cn: 胎毛发育不全，即胎儿或新生儿体表细软、无色的毛发未充分发育。

HP:0034263.name: Abnormal vaginal bleeding
HP:0034263.definition: Abnormal vaginal bleeding occurs between menstrual periods, after sex, or after menopause. Menstrual periods that are heavier or last longer than usual or last more than seven days also are considered abnormal.
HP:0034263.definition_cn: 异常阴道出血发生在月经周期之间、性交后或绝经后。月经量比平常多或持续时间比平常长，或持续超过七天也被视为异常。

HP:0034264.name: Postcoital vaginal bleeding
HP:0034264.definition: Postcoital bleeding (PCB) consists of spotting or bleeding after sexual intercourse that is not related to a person's menstrual cycle.
HP:0034264.definition_cn: 性交后出血（Postcoital Bleeding, PCB）是指在性交后出现的与月经周期无关的点滴出血或出血现象。

HP:0034267.name: Pelvic pain
HP:0034267.definition: Pain perceived in the area of the pelvis, the lower part of the abdomen located between the hip bones.
HP:0034267.definition_cn: 骨盆区域感知的疼痛，位于髋骨之间的下腹部部分。

HP:0034269.name: Abnormal vaginal discharge
HP:0034269.definition: Anomalous amount, odor, or consistency of the fluid or mucus that comes from the vagina
HP:0034269.definition_cn: 阴道分泌物或粘液在量、气味或质地方面的异常。

HP:0034270.name: Serrated incisors
HP:0034270.definition: Incisor teeth with irregular edges said to resemble a saw.
HP:0034270.definition_cn: 边缘呈锯齿状的不规则切牙。

HP:0034271.name: Copper beaten skull
HP:0034271.definition: Diffuse prominent gyral impressions on the inner table of skull vault said to resemble beaten copper.
HP:0034271.definition_cn: 颅穹窿内板可见弥漫性显著的脑回压迹，形似锤击铜片样改变。

HP:0034272.name: Perifoveal hypoautofluorescence
HP:0034272.definition: Decreased amount of autofluorescence (emission of fluorescent light from ocular structures in the absence of sodium fluorescein) in the retina in the region surrounding the fovea.
HP:0034272.name_cn: 中心凹周围低自发荧光
HP:0034272.definition_cn: 黄斑周围区域视网膜自发荧光（在无荧光素钠存在下，眼内结构发出的荧光）量减少。

HP:0034273.name: Premature sagging cheeks
HP:0034273.definition: Drooping or sinking of tissues of the cheeks more than would be expected at a given age. Sagging can occur due to a relative excess of skin and/or lack of elastic recoil as well as fat accumulation.
HP:0034273.definition_cn: 面颊组织下垂或下沉程度超过特定年龄段的预期水平。下垂可能由于皮肤相对过多和/或弹性回缩力不足以及脂肪堆积所致。

HP:0034274.name: Gastrointestinal ulcer
HP:0034274.definition: A deep defect in the esophageal, gastric, duodenal or intestinal wall involving the entire mucosal thickness and penetrating through the muscularis mucosae.
HP:0034274.definition_cn: 食管、胃、十二指肠或肠壁深层缺损，累及全层黏膜并穿透黏膜肌层。

HP:0034275.name: Verrucous epidermal nevus
HP:0034275.definition: A type of epidermal nevus (which represent Blaschkoid hamartomas of the skin that result from mosaic post-zygotic mutations) that appears as skin-colored-to-brown, sharply demarcated, papillomatous papules that coalesce into plaques. The majority of these nevi are either present at birth or occur within the first year of life.
HP:0034275.definition_cn: 一种表皮痣（代表由合子后镶嵌突变引起的皮肤Blaschko线样错构瘤），表现为肤色至棕色的、边界清晰的乳头状丘疹，融合成斑块。大多数此类痣在出生时即存在或在出生后第一年内出现。

HP:0034276.name: Elevated circulating thymidine concentration
HP:0034276.definition: Concentration of thymidine in the blood circulation above the normal range.
HP:0034276.name_cn: 循环胸腺嘧啶浓度升高
HP:0034276.definition_cn: 血液循环中胸苷浓度高于正常范围。

HP:0034277.name: Elevated circulating deoxyuridine concentration
HP:0034277.definition: Concentration of 2-deoxyuridine in the blood circulation is above the normal range.
HP:0034277.name_cn: 循环脱氧尿苷浓度升高
HP:0034277.definition_cn: 血液循环中2-脱氧尿苷浓度高于正常范围。

HP:0034278.name: Multinucleated erythroblast
HP:0034278.definition: Erythroblasts with multiple nuclei. Erythroblasts are nucleated precrusor cells of erythrocytes that are localized to the bone marrow. Normally, erythroblasts have a single nucleus. The abnormal finding of erythrocytes with two or more nuclei may be related to defects in cytokinesis.
HP:0034278.definition_cn: 多核幼红细胞。幼红细胞是位于骨髓中的有核红细胞前体细胞。正常情况下，幼红细胞具有单个细胞核。出现两个或更多细胞核的异常幼红细胞可能与胞质分裂缺陷有关。

HP:0034279.name: 2,8-dihydroxyadenine crystalluria
HP:0034279.definition: The presence of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine crystals in the urine. The crystals appear as round, yellow-brown crystals.
HP:0034279.definition_cn: 尿液中存在2,8-二羟基腺嘌呤结晶。结晶呈圆形，黄棕色。

HP:0034280.name: Target cells
HP:0034280.definition: Target cells (codocytes) have a centrally located disk of hemoglobin surrounded by an area of pallor with an outer rim of hemoglobin adjacent to the cell membrane giving the cell the appearance of a target.
HP:0034280.definition_cn: 靶形红细胞（codocytes）具有位于中央的血红蛋白盘，周围环绕着苍白区域，靠近细胞膜的外缘有血红蛋白环，使细胞呈现靶形外观。

HP:0034281.name: Phalangeal cone-shaped epiphyses
HP:0034281.definition: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the phalanges of the hands or feet. Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery.
HP:0034281.definition_cn: 手足指（趾）骨锥形骨骺。锥形骨骺（亦称圆锥形骨骺）是指骨骺向杯状干骺端内陷。即骨骺远端呈锥形延伸，这是由于骨骺中央部分相对于其周边部分生长加速所致。

HP:0034282.name: Subcutaneous ossification
HP:0034282.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the soft tissue beneath the skin. Subcutaneous ossifications may be observed by radiography or by palpation.
HP:0034282.definition_cn: 皮下软组织异位骨化。可通过放射影像学检查或触诊观察到皮下骨化。

HP:0034283.name: Increased fecal protoporphyrin concentration
HP:0034283.definition: Abnormally high concentration of protoporphyrin (derivative of porphyrin with propionic acid groups) in feces.
HP:0034283.name_cn: 粪便中原卟啉浓度升高
HP:0034283.definition_cn: 粪便中原卟啉（具有丙酸基团的卟啉衍生物）浓度异常升高。

HP:0034284.name: Recurrent gingivitis
HP:0034284.definition: Repeated occurrences of inflammatory condition of the gums (gingival tissue), most commonly caused by bacterial infection.
HP:0034284.definition_cn: 复发性牙龈炎（Recurrent Gingivitis），最常见由细菌感染引起。

HP:0034285.name: Enteroviral encephalitis
HP:0034285.definition: Inflammation of the brain related to infection by an enterovirus.
HP:0034285.definition_cn: 肠道病毒感染相关性脑炎。

HP:0034286.name: Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia
HP:0034286.definition: Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia is an opportunistic infection that occurs in immunosuppressed populations.
HP:0034286.definition_cn: 卡氏肺孢子虫肺炎是一种发生于免疫抑制人群的机会性感染。

HP:0034287.name: Afibrinogenemia
HP:0034287.definition: Lack of detectable fibrinogen in the blood circulation.
HP:0034287.definition_cn: 循环血液中无法检测到纤维蛋白原。

HP:0034288.name: Elevated circulating reverse T3 concentration
HP:0034288.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation.
HP:0034288.name_cn: 循环反三碘甲状腺原氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034288.definition_cn: 血液中反三碘甲状腺原氨酸（3,3',5'-三碘甲状腺原氨酸或rT3）浓度异常升高。

HP:0034289.name: Elevated circulating rT3/T3 ratio
HP:0034289.definition: An abnormally increased ratio of the concentrations of reverse T3 to T3 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034289.name_cn: 循环中反三碘甲状腺原氨酸/三碘甲状腺原氨酸比值升高
HP:0034289.definition_cn: 血液循环中反三碘甲状腺原氨酸（reverse T3）与三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）浓度比值异常升高。

HP:0034290.name: Elevated circulating tiglylglycine concentration
HP:0034290.definition: Concentration of tiglylglycine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034290.name_cn: 循环中甲基丙二酰甘氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034290.definition_cn: 血液中甲基丙二酰甘氨酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0034291.name: Elevated circulating creatine concentration
HP:0034291.definition: An elevation above the normal range of creatine in the blood circulation.
HP:0034291.definition_cn: 血循环中肌酐水平高于正常范围。

HP:0034292.name: Reduced circulating creatine concentration
HP:0034292.definition: An reduction below the normal range of creatine in the blood circulation.

HP:0034293.name: Temporal lobe calcification
HP:0034293.definition: The presence of calcium deposition within the temporal lobe of the brain.

HP:0034294.name: Ductal bile plugs
HP:0034294.definition: Bile thrombi that form an obstruction (plug) in a dilated bile duct.
HP:0034294.definition_cn: 扩张胆管内形成梗阻（栓子）的胆汁栓。

HP:0034295.name: Reduced cerebral white matter volume
HP:0034295.definition: An abnormally low volume of the white matter of the brain.

HP:0034296.name: Elevated urine 3,5,6-trichloro-2-pyridinol level
HP:0034296.name_cn: 尿液中3,5,6-三氯-2-吡啶醇水平升高
HP:0034296.definition_cn: 尿液中3,5,6-三氯-2-吡啶酚的检测。

HP:0034297.name: Elevated circulating tetracosanoic acid concentration
HP:0034297.definition: Elevated concentration of tetracosanoic acid (a C24 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation.
HP:0034297.name_cn: 循环中二十四烷酸浓度升高
HP:0034297.definition_cn: 血液循环中二十四烷酸（一种C24直链饱和脂肪酸）浓度升高。

HP:0034298.name: Elevated circulating hexacosanoic acid concentration
HP:0034298.definition: Elevated concentration of hexacosanoic acid (a C26 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation.
HP:0034298.name_cn: 循环中二十六烷酸浓度升高
HP:0034298.definition_cn: 血液循环中二十六烷酸（一种C26直链饱和脂肪酸）浓度升高。

HP:0034299.name: Sertoli cell-only phenotype
HP:0034299.definition: A histological phenotype observed on testicular biopsy in which only Sertoli cells line the seminiferous tubules of the testis.
HP:0034299.definition_cn: 睾丸活检中观察到的组织学表型，其中仅支持细胞（Sertoli细胞）排列于睾丸生精小管内。

HP:0034300.name: Decreased acid sphingomyelinase activity
HP:0034300.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme acid sphingomyelinase activity in the blood circulation.
HP:0034300.name_cn: 酸性鞘磷脂酶活性降低
HP:0034300.definition_cn: 血液循环中酸性鞘磷脂酶活性降低。

HP:0034301.name: Congenital pouch colon
HP:0034301.definition: A malformation of the colon in which a pouch-like dilatation of a varying degree of shortened colon is associated with an anorectal malformation. The pouch usually terminates in a fistulous communication with the genitourinary tract.
HP:0034301.definition_cn: 结肠畸形，表现为不同程度的缩短结肠呈袋状扩张，并伴有肛门直肠畸形。该袋状结构通常终止于与泌尿生殖道的瘘管连接。

HP:0034302.name: Megalopapilla
HP:0034302.definition: A congenitally anomalous enlarged optic disc (surface area greater than 2.50 square millimeters). It is considered to be a normal variant without physiological defects.
HP:0034302.definition_cn: 先天性异常增大的视盘（表面积大于2.50平方毫米）。此情况被视为无生理缺陷的正常变异。

HP:0034303.name: Notched T wave
HP:0034303.definition: A bifid T-wave with a notch duration between the 2 peaks at least 0.04 sec and an amplitude at least 0.05 mV.
HP:0034303.definition_cn: 双峰T波，其两峰间切迹持续时间至少为0.04秒，振幅至少为0.05毫伏。

HP:0034304.name: Epsilon wave
HP:0034304.definition: An electric signal of depolarization observed between the end of the QRS complex and the beginning of the T wave.
HP:0034304.definition_cn: 在QRS波群结束与T波开始之间观察到的去极化电信号。

HP:0034305.name: 2:1 atrioventricular block
HP:0034305.definition: A type of second-degree atrioventricular block in which every other P wave is not conducted through the AV node such that only every other P wave is followed by a QRS complex.
HP:0034305.definition_cn: 一种二度房室传导阻滞，其中每隔一个P波未能通过房室结传导，导致仅每隔一个P波后跟随一个QRS波群。

HP:0034306.name: Ventricular bigeminy
HP:0034306.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of a normal QRS followed by a premature ventricular contraction; a rhythmic pairing of normal and atypical beats originating in the ventricles in a 1-1 ratio such that an ectopic ventricular beat follows each regular heartbeat.
HP:0034306.definition_cn: 心电图表现为正常QRS波群后跟随一个室性早搏；心室起源的正常与异位搏动以1:1比例成对出现，即每个正常心搏后跟随一个异位心室搏动。

HP:0034307.name: Elevated left ventricular end-diastolic diameter
HP:0034307.definition: The LV end-diastolic internal diameter was measured from two-dimensional (2D) images in the parasternal long-axis view, timed with mitral valve closure at the level of the mitral valve chordae.
HP:0034307.name_cn: 左心室舒张末期内径增大
HP:0034307.definition_cn: 左心室舒张末期内径通过二维（2D）图像在胸骨旁长轴切面进行测量，时间点定位于二尖瓣关闭时，测量位置在二尖瓣腱索水平。

HP:0034308.name: Prolonged P wave
HP:0034308.definition: Abnormal increased in the duration of the P wave, which is a marker of delayed inter-atrial conduction.
HP:0034308.definition_cn: P波时限异常延长，提示心房内传导延迟。

HP:0034309.name: Multiflagellar spermatozoa
HP:0034309.definition: Spermatozoa with multiple flagella attached to the sperm head.
HP:0034309.definition_cn: 多鞭毛精子症（Spermatozoa with multiple flagella attached to the sperm head）。

HP:0034310.name: Post-vaccination yellow fever
HP:0034310.definition: Infection with the yellow fever virus of the live-attenuated vaccine.
HP:0034310.definition_cn: 黄热病减毒活疫苗病毒感染。

HP:0034311.name: Hypoplastic optic chiasm
HP:0034311.definition: Developmental defect characterized by undergrowth of the optic chiasm.
HP:0034311.definition_cn: 以视交叉发育不全为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0034312.name: Nocturnal hypoxemia
HP:0034312.definition: Abnormally reduced oxyhemoglobin saturation during sleep (nocturnal). Different thresholds are used in the literature, including more than 10 percent of total sleep time below a SpO2 of 90 percent.
HP:0034312.definition_cn: 睡眠期间异常降低的氧合血红蛋白饱和度（夜间）。文献中使用了不同的阈值，包括总睡眠时间中超过10%的时间SpO2低于90%。

HP:0034313.name: Hyperdynamic left ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0034313.definition: An abnormally increased ejection fraction of the left ventricle, usually defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction greater than 70 percent.
HP:0034313.name_cn: 左心室射血分数高动力状态
HP:0034313.definition_cn: 左心室射血分数异常增高，通常定义为左心室射血分数大于70%。

HP:0034314.name: Abnormal left ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0034314.definition: Any abnormality of the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), which is the fraction of chamber volume ejected in systole (stroke volume) in relation to the volume of the blood in the ventricle at the end of diastole (end-diastolic volume). Stroke volume (SV) is calculated as the difference between end-diastolic volume (EDV) and end-systolic volume (ESV). LVEF is calculated as [SV/EDV] in percent.
HP:0034314.definition_cn: 左心室射血分数（LVEF）的任何异常，即收缩期射出的心室容积（每搏输出量）与舒张末期心室血液容积（舒张末期容积）的比值。每搏输出量（SV）计算为舒张末期容积（EDV）与收缩末期容积（ESV）之差。左心室射血分数（LVEF）以百分比计算，公式为[SV/EDV]×100%。

HP:0034315.name: Chronic cough
HP:0034315.definition: A persistent cough, defined as a cough lasting longer than eight weeks in adults or longer than four weeks in children.
HP:0034315.definition_cn: 慢性咳嗽，定义为成人持续超过八周或儿童持续超过四周的咳嗽。

HP:0034316.name: Thinning of the substantia nigra pars compacta
HP:0034316.definition: Reduced volume of pars compacta of the substantia nigra.

HP:0034318.name: Unusual virus reactivation
HP:0034318.definition: Reactivation is the mechanism whereby a latent virus that has infected a host cell switches to a lytic stage, undergoing productive viral replication and allowing the virus to spread. This term refers to reactivation regarded as unusual because of frequency, intensity, location, or nature of the virus, in the sense that the reactivation would not be observed in an immunocompetent host.
HP:0034318.definition_cn: 再激活是指潜伏于宿主细胞内的病毒转变为裂解期，进行病毒复制并传播的机制。该术语特指因频率、强度、部位或病毒性质异常而发生的再激活，即在免疫功能正常的宿主中不会观察到的再激活现象。

HP:0034319.name: CNS vasculitis with reactivation of varicella-zoster virus
HP:0034319.definition: A vasculopathy in the central nervous system (CNS) following reactivation of varicella-zoster virus due to a productive viral infection of both large and small cerebral arteries.
HP:0034319.name_cn: 中枢神经系统血管炎伴水痘-带状疱疹病毒再激活
HP:0034319.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统（CNS）血管病变，继发于水痘-带状疱疹病毒再激活，导致大、小脑动脉的增殖性病毒感染。

HP:0034320.name: Muscle fiber intracytoplasmic reducing inclusion bodies
HP:0034320.definition: Intracytoplasmic inclusions in myofibers that reduce nitro-blue tetrazolium (NBT) and thus stain strongly with the menadione-NBT stain.
HP:0034320.name_cn: 肌纤维胞浆内还原性包涵体
HP:0034320.definition_cn: 肌纤维内胞质内包涵体能够还原硝基蓝四氮唑（NBT），因此在使用甲萘醌-NBT染色时呈现强染色。

HP:0034321.name: Elevated circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration
HP:0034321.definition: Concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034321.name_cn: 循环中胍基乙酸浓度升高
HP:0034321.definition_cn: 血液循环中胍基乙酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034322.name: Reduced tissue galactocerebrosidase activity
HP:0034322.definition: Concentration or activity of galactocerebrosidase (EC 3.2.1.46) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:0034322.name_cn: 组织半乳糖脑苷脂酶活性降低
HP:0034322.definition_cn: 半乳糖脑苷脂酶（EC 3.2.1.46）的浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:0034323.name: Reduced circulating growth hormone concentration
HP:0034323.definition: Concentration of growth hormone in the blood circulation below normal limits.
HP:0034323.name_cn: 循环生长激素浓度降低
HP:0034323.definition_cn: 循环血液中生长激素浓度低于正常范围。

HP:0034324.name: Brachiocephalic artery aneurysm
HP:0034324.definition: An abnormal widening (dilatation) of the brachiocephalic artery
HP:0034324.definition_cn: 头臂动脉异常扩张（扩张）

HP:0034325.name: Common carotid artery aneurysm
HP:0034325.definition: An abnormal widening (dilatation) of the common carotid artery.
HP:0034325.definition_cn: 颈总动脉异常扩张（颈总动脉扩张症）。

HP:0034326.name: Adenomyosis
HP:0034326.definition: Inappropriate (ectopic) endometrial tissue proliferation within the uterine myometrium, often presenting clinically with painful menses and heavy menstrual bleeding.
HP:0034326.definition_cn: 子宫肌层内不适当（异位）子宫内膜组织增生，临床上常表现为痛经和月经过多。

HP:0034327.name: Posterior corneal stroma punctiform multicolored opacities
HP:0034327.definition: Thin, punctiform elements of various colors in the posterior stroma of the cornea, immediately anterior to Descemet membrane. The elements are visible to direct and indirect illumination.
HP:0034327.name_cn: 后角膜基质点状多色混浊
HP:0034327.definition_cn: 角膜后基质层中，紧邻Descemet膜前方，可见多种颜色的细小点状结构。这些结构在直接和间接照明下均可见。

HP:0034328.name: Fibro-obliterative bile-duct lesion
HP:0034328.definition: A condition in which the lumen of a bile duct has been filled by fibrous scar material, in effect replacing the bile duct with a fibrous scar.
HP:0034328.definition_cn: 胆管纤维化闭塞症，即胆管管腔被纤维瘢痕组织填充，实质上导致胆管被纤维瘢痕组织取代。

HP:0034329.name: Dysplastic megalencephaly
HP:0034329.definition: A congenital brain malformation characterized by marked overgrowth and dysplasia affecting one or both cerebral hemispheres, and, in some cases, subcortical brain regions as well. The presence of dysplasia in dysplastic megalencephaly distinguishes it from other forms of generalized megalencephaly.
HP:0034329.definition_cn: 一种先天性脑发育畸形，其特征为显著过度生长和发育不良，累及一侧或双侧大脑半球，在某些病例中还可累及皮层下脑区。发育不良性巨脑症中发育不良的存在使其与其他类型的广泛性巨脑症相区别。

HP:0034330.name: Regional right ventricular hypokinesis
HP:0034330.definition: Decreased range of right ventricular motion in a portion of the right ventricle of the heart.
HP:0034330.name_cn: 区域性右心室运动功能减退
HP:0034330.definition_cn: 右心室部分区域运动范围减小。

HP:0034331.name: McConnell sign
HP:0034331.definition: Severe hypokinesia of the mid-free wall of the right ventricle of the heart with a normal contraction of the apical segment of the right ventricle.
HP:0034331.definition_cn: 右心室中游离壁严重运动减退，右心室心尖段收缩正常。

HP:0034332.name: Cognitive regression
HP:0034332.definition: Loss of cognitive developmental skills, as manifested by loss of developmental cognitive milestones.
HP:0034332.definition_cn: 认知发育技能丧失，表现为发育认知里程碑的丧失。

HP:0034333.name: Increased circulating hypoxanthine concentration
HP:0034333.definition: Elevated concentration of hypoxanthine in the blood circulation.
HP:0034333.name_cn: 循环中次黄嘌呤浓度升高
HP:0034333.definition_cn: 血液中次黄嘌呤浓度升高。

HP:0034335.name: Inheritance qualifier
HP:0034335.definition: The terms in this hierarchy can be used to specify the context in which inheritance of a disease is typically observed.
HP:0034335.definition_cn: 该层级中的术语可用于指定疾病遗传通常观察到的背景。

HP:0034336.name: Splenic infarction
HP:0034336.definition: Ischemia and necrosis of part or all of the spleen resulting from compromise of blood supply resulting from arterial or venous occlusion.
HP:0034336.definition_cn: 脾脏部分或全部缺血及坏死，由动脉或静脉闭塞导致的血液供应受损引起。

HP:0034337.name: Claw hand deformity
HP:0034337.definition: An abnormality of the hand characterized by metacarpophalangeal (MCP) hyperextension and proximal interphalangeal (PIP) and distal interphalangeal (DIP) flexion. The position of the affected hand is said to resemble a claw.
HP:0034337.definition_cn: 一种手部异常，其特征为掌指关节（MCP）过伸以及近端指间关节（PIP）和远端指间关节（DIP）屈曲。受累手的位置被称为类似爪形。

HP:0034338.name: Imprinted
HP:0034338.definition: Requires that the abnormal allele be paternal or maternal in origin, depending on the disease-gene relationship. Imprinting refers to a normal developmental process in which either the paternal or maternal allele is inactivated, depending on the specific locus, thus leading to expression from only one copy of the gene. Disease typically manifests when a deleterious variant is inherited from a parent whose copy of the gene would normally be expressed, but not when a deleterious variant is inherited from a parent whose copy of the gene would normally be inactivated.
HP:0034338.definition_cn: 要求异常等位基因源自父系或母系，具体取决于疾病与基因的关系。印记作用是指一种正常的发育过程，在此过程中，根据特定基因座的不同，父系或母系等位基因会被失活，从而导致仅从基因的一个拷贝进行表达。当从通常表达该基因拷贝的父母遗传到有害变异时，疾病通常会显现；而当从通常失活该基因拷贝的父母遗传到有害变异时，疾病则不会显现。

HP:0034339.name: Pseudoautosomal inheritance
HP:0034339.definition: A pattern of inheritance observed for alleles in the X-Y identical regions is referred to as pseudoautosomal inheritance, because it resembles the pattern seen for alleles located on autosomes.
HP:0034339.definition_cn: 在X-Y同源区域中观察到的等位基因遗传模式被称为假常染色体遗传，因为它类似于位于常染色体上的等位基因的遗传模式。

HP:0034340.name: Pseudoautosomal dominant inheritance
HP:0034340.definition: A type of pseudoautosomal inheritance that is dominant and in which heterozygous males and females both manifest a disease phenotype.
HP:0034340.definition_cn: 一种显性假常染色体遗传，其中杂合子男性和女性均表现出疾病表型。

HP:0034341.name: Pseudoautosomal recessive inheritance
HP:0034341.definition: A type of pseudoautosomal inheritance that is recessive and in which biallelic males and females both manifest a disease phenotype.
HP:0034341.definition_cn: 一种隐性假常染色体遗传，其中双等位基因的男性和女性均表现出疾病表型。

HP:0034342.name: Trapezius muscle aplasia
HP:0034342.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of formation of the trapezius muscle, which is broad superficial muscle that extends from the posterior neck to the posterior part of the trunk (thorax).
HP:0034342.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为斜方肌未形成。斜方肌是一块宽阔的浅层肌肉，从颈部后侧延伸至躯干（胸部）后侧。

HP:0034343.name: Requires heterozygosity
HP:0034343.definition: A rarely encountered phenomenon in which condition is most severe in the heterozygous state. Such disorders are rare and currently all are X-linked. Most X-linked recessive conditions manifest if hemizygous in males, or biallelic in females, though may have a mild phenotype in the heterozygous state in females.
HP:0034343.definition_cn: 一种罕见现象，其中病情在杂合状态下最为严重。此类疾病较为罕见，目前均为X连锁遗传。大多数X连锁隐性遗传病在男性半合子或女性双等位基因状态下表现明显，尽管在女性杂合状态下可能表现为轻度表型。

HP:0034344.name: Female-limited expression
HP:0034344.definition: Used to refer to a monogenic trait linked to an autosomal locus in which the phenotypic effects of allelic differences are expressed only in the female sex.
HP:0034344.definition_cn: 用于指代与常染色体位点相关的单基因性状，其中等位基因差异的表型效应仅在女性中表达。

HP:0034345.name: Mendelian inheritance
HP:0034345.definition: A mode of inheritance of diseases whose pathophysiology can be traced back to deleterious variants in a single gene. The inheritance patterns of these single-gene (monogenic) diseases are often referred to as Mendelian in honor of Gregor Mendel.
HP:0034345.definition_cn: 一种疾病遗传模式，其病理生理学可追溯至单个基因的有害变异。这些单基因（单基因性）疾病的遗传模式通常被称为孟德尔遗传，以纪念格雷戈尔·孟德尔。

HP:0034346.name: Nesidioblastosis
HP:0034346.definition: An abnormality of pancreatic beta cells characterized by a proliferation of abnormal beta cells throughout the entire pancreas, with enlarged islet size and number (hypertrophic islets), increased periductular islets, enlarged beta-cell nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm. Occasionally beta cells with pleomorphic nuclei, ductuloinsular complexes, and neoformation of islets from ducts are observed.
HP:0034346.definition_cn: 胰腺β细胞异常，其特征为异常β细胞在整个胰腺内增殖，胰岛体积和数量增大（肥大性胰岛），导管周围胰岛增多，β细胞核增大且胞质丰富透明。偶见核多形性β细胞、导管-胰岛复合体以及导管新生胰岛。

HP:0034347.name: Greater auricular nerve thickening
HP:0034347.definition: Increase in thickness of the great auricular nerve, a cutaneous nerve of the head. It originates from the cervical plexus, with branches of spinal nerves C2 and C3. Thickening may lead to the nerve being palpable or even visible in this region.
HP:0034347.definition_cn: 耳大神经增厚，该神经为头部皮神经，起源于颈丛，由脊神经C2和C3的分支组成。增厚可能导致该神经在此区域可触及甚至可见。

HP:0034348.name: Subpulmonary stenosis
HP:0034348.definition: A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing of the outflow tract of the right ventricle immediately below the pulmonary valve.
HP:0034348.definition_cn: 一种心血管畸形，表现为肺动脉瓣下方右心室流出道狭窄。

HP:0034349.name: Supravalvar pulmonary stenosis
HP:0034349.definition: A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing at the level of the pulmonary sinotubular junction above the pulmonic valve.
HP:0034349.definition_cn: 一种心血管畸形，表现为肺动脉瓣上方肺动脉窦管交界处狭窄。

HP:0034350.name: Valvular pulmonary stenosis
HP:0034350.definition: A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing of the outflow tract of the right ventricle immediately at the level of the pulmonary valve.
HP:0034350.definition_cn: 一种心血管畸形，与右心室流出道在肺动脉瓣水平处的狭窄相关。

HP:0034351.name: Neuromyotonia
HP:0034351.definition: Peripheral nerve hyperexcitability manifesting as spontaneous discharges originating from motor axons or their terminals, lead to overactivity of muscles, typically manifesting as twitches, cramps and stiffness.
HP:0034351.definition_cn: 周围神经兴奋性增高表现为源自运动轴突或其末梢的自发放电，导致肌肉过度活动，通常表现为肌束颤动、肌痉挛和肌强直。

HP:0034352.name: Bile duct polyp
HP:0034352.definition: An elevated growth from the the mucosa of the bile duct.
HP:0034352.definition_cn: 胆管黏膜上的隆起性病变。

HP:0034353.name: Appendicular spasticity
HP:0034353.definition: A type of spasticity that affects one or more limbs (arms or legs).
HP:0034353.definition_cn: 一种影响一个或多个肢体（上肢或下肢）的痉挛性瘫痪。

HP:0034354.name: Trichoschisis
HP:0034354.definition: Transverse fractures through the hair shafts (trichoschisis). Trichoschisis is characterized by a sharp transverse fracture of the hair shaft.
HP:0034354.definition_cn: 毛干横断性骨折（毛干断裂症）。毛干断裂症的特征是毛干出现锐利的横断性骨折。

HP:0034355.name: White cerebellum sign
HP:0034355.definition: On computed tomography of the brain,the white (or dense) cerebellum sign is seen when the cerebellum appears dense with respect to the cerebral parenchyma. The increase in attenuation of cerebellum is in fact a relative hyperdensity caused by decreased attenutation of the brain. It represents anoxic-ischemic cerebral injury, and has a very poor prognosis.
HP:0034355.definition_cn: 在脑部计算机断层扫描中，当小脑相对于大脑实质呈现高密度时，可见到白小脑征（或致密小脑征）。小脑衰减值的增加实际上是由于大脑衰减值降低导致的相对高密度。该征象提示缺氧缺血性脑损伤，预后极差。

HP:0034356.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of low molecular weight protein
HP:0034356.definition: Increased loss of low-molecular weight proteins by the kidneys, measured in terms of the fractional excretion (FE). The FE of low-molecular-weight proteins such as beta2-microglobulin can be measured in terms of plasma and urine concentrations, since urinary low-molecular-weight protein concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.
HP:0034356.name_cn: 低分子量蛋白质肾小管重吸收功能障碍
HP:0034356.definition_cn: 肾脏对低分子量蛋白质的排泄增加，以排泄分数（FE）衡量。低分子量蛋白质（如β2-微球蛋白）的排泄分数可通过血浆和尿液浓度进行测量，因为尿液中的低分子量蛋白质浓度会随水的重吸收而变化。

HP:0034357.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of glucose
HP:0034357.definition: Increased fractional excretion (FE) of glucose in the urine. The FE of glucose is the percentage of the glucose filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine glucose, rather than by the interpretation of urinary glucose concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.
HP:0034357.name_cn: 肾小管葡萄糖重吸收功能障碍
HP:0034357.definition_cn: 尿液中葡萄糖的排泄分数（Fractional Excretion, FE）增加。葡萄糖的排泄分数是指肾脏滤过的葡萄糖中排泄到尿液中的百分比。它是通过血浆和尿液中的葡萄糖浓度来测量的，而不是仅通过尿液葡萄糖浓度的解释，因为尿液葡萄糖浓度会随着水的重吸收而变化。

HP:0034358.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of sodium
HP:0034358.definition: Increased fractional excretion (FE) of sodium in the urine. The FE of sodium is the percentage of the sodium filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine sodium, rather than by the interpretation of urinary glucose concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.
HP:0034358.name_cn: 肾小管钠重吸收功能障碍
HP:0034358.definition_cn: 尿钠排泄分数（FE）增加。尿钠排泄分数是指肾脏滤过的钠中通过尿液排出的百分比。其测量基于血浆和尿液中的钠浓度，而非仅通过尿液葡萄糖浓度进行解释，因为尿液葡萄糖浓度会随着水的重吸收而变化。

HP:0034359.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of phosphate
HP:0034359.definition: Increased fractional excretion (FE) of glucose in the phosphate. The FE of glucose is the percentage of the phosphate filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine phosphate, rather than by the interpretation of urinary phosphate concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.
HP:0034359.name_cn: 肾小管磷酸盐重吸收障碍
HP:0034359.definition_cn: 磷酸盐中葡萄糖的排泄分数（FE）增加。葡萄糖的排泄分数是指肾脏滤过的磷酸盐中通过尿液排出的百分比。它是通过血浆和尿液中的磷酸盐来测量的，而不是仅通过尿液磷酸盐浓度的解释，因为尿液葡萄糖浓度会随着水的重吸收而变化。

HP:0034360.name: Action myoclonus
HP:0034360.definition: A type of myoclonus (arrhythmic muscular jerking) that is induced by voluntary movement. It is made worse by attempts at precise or coordinated movement (intention myoclonus) and may also be provoked by certain sensory stimuli.
HP:0034360.definition_cn: 一种由自主运动诱发的肌阵挛（非节律性肌肉抽搐）。在尝试进行精确或协调运动时症状加重（意向性肌阵挛），并可能由某些感觉刺激引发。

HP:0034361.name: Redundant umbilical skin
HP:0034361.definition: Greater than normal amount of skin surrounding the umbilicus (belly button) with protrusion of the umbilicus above the plane of the abdomen.
HP:0034361.definition_cn: 脐周皮肤组织量增多，伴脐部突出于腹平面以上。

HP:0034362.name: Dull foveal reflex
HP:0034362.definition: Reduced brightness of the foveal reflex, which normally is a bright pinpoint of light that is observed to move sideways or up and down in response to movement of the opthalmoscope.
HP:0034362.definition_cn: 黄斑中心凹反射亮度降低，正常情况下表现为一个明亮的光点，在检眼镜移动时可观察到其横向或上下移动。

HP:0034363.name: Corneal pterygium
HP:0034363.definition: Corneal pterygium is an ocular surface disease characterized mainly by a wing-shaped growth of limbal and conjunctival tissue over the adjacent cornea.
HP:0034363.definition_cn: 角膜翼状胬肉是一种以角膜缘及结膜组织向邻近角膜呈翼状增生为主要特征的眼表疾病。

HP:0034364.name: Fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium
HP:0034364.definition: Replacement of the myocardium of the right ventricular free wall by fat and fibrous tissue.
HP:0034364.name_cn: 右心室心肌纤维脂肪替代
HP:0034364.definition_cn: 右心室游离壁心肌被脂肪和纤维组织替代。

HP:0034365.name: Elevated circulating alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde concentration
HP:0034365.definition: Increased concentration of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde in the blood circulation.
HP:0034365.name_cn: 循环中α-氨基己二酸半醛浓度升高
HP:0034365.definition_cn: 血液中α-氨基己二酸半醛浓度升高。

HP:0034366.name: Fracture blister
HP:0034366.definition: Fracture blister is a type of blister that forms following acute bone fractures, typically near the ankle, wrist elbow or foot, where skin adheres tightly to bone with little subcutaneous fat cushioning. The blister that results resembles that of a second degree burn.
HP:0034366.definition_cn: 骨折性水疱是一种在急性骨折后形成的水疱，通常出现在踝关节、腕关节、肘部或足部等皮肤紧贴骨骼且皮下脂肪较少的区域。形成的水疱类似于二度烧伤的水疱。

HP:0034367.name: Decreased circulating beta-mannosidase activity
HP:0034367.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase below the lower limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.
HP:0034367.name_cn: 循环β-甘露糖苷酶活性降低
HP:0034367.definition_cn: β-甘露糖苷酶活性低于正常下限。β-甘露糖苷酶是一种溶酶体酶，负责分解寡糖。

HP:0034368.name: Urolithiasis
HP:0034368.definition: Renal stones are formed within the kidneys, and this is called nephrolithiasis. Urolithiasis is a condition that occurs when these stones exit the renal pelvis and move into the remainder of the urinary collecting system, which includes the ureters, bladder, and urethra.
HP:0034368.definition_cn: 肾结石在肾脏内形成，这一过程称为肾结石病。尿路结石病是指这些结石从肾盂排出并进入尿路收集系统其余部分（包括输尿管、膀胱和尿道）时所发生的病症。

HP:0034369.name: Decreased level of coenzyme Q10 in skeletal muscle
HP:0034369.definition: Reduced amount of coenzyme Q10,a naturally occurring quinone, in skeletal muscle tissue.
HP:0034369.name_cn: 骨骼肌中辅酶Q10水平降低
HP:0034369.definition_cn: 骨骼肌组织中辅酶Q10（一种天然存在的醌类化合物）含量降低。

HP:0034370.name: Abnormal muscle tissue metabolite concentration
HP:0034370.name_cn: 异常肌肉组织代谢物浓度

HP:0034371.name: Reduced circulating prekallikrein concentration
HP:0034371.definition: Reduced concentration of prekallikrein (PK; also known as Fletcher factor) in the blood circulation. PK is the precursor of plasma kallikrein, a serine protease that activates kinins. PK is cleaved to produce kallikrein by activated Factor XII.
HP:0034371.name_cn: 循环前激肽释放酶浓度降低
HP:0034371.definition_cn: 血液循环中前激肽释放酶（PK；亦称弗莱彻因子）浓度降低。前激肽释放酶是血浆激肽释放酶的前体，后者是一种丝氨酸蛋白酶，可激活激肽。前激肽释放酶被活化的XII因子裂解生成激肽释放酶。

HP:0034373.name: External tibial torsion
HP:0034373.definition: External twisting of the tibia resulting in the toes of each foot pointing outward (outtoeing) .
HP:0034373.definition_cn: 胫骨外旋导致双足脚趾向外偏转（外八字步态）。

HP:0034374.name: Trident acetabulum
HP:0034374.definition: Abnormal appearance of the acetabulum characterized by spurs at the medial and lateral acetabular margin and in the center of the acetabulum, giving rise to shape resembling a three-pronged spear sadi to resemble a trident.
HP:0034374.definition_cn: 髋臼形态异常，表现为髋臼内侧缘、外侧缘及中心处骨赘形成，导致髋臼形态呈三叉戟样改变。

HP:0034375.name: Spherophakia
HP:0034375.definition: Spherophakia is a rare congenital condition that presents with weak zonules around a more spherical crystalline lens with an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens, and highly myopic eye. The lens zonules are developmentally hypoplastic and abnormally weak and due to non-attachment of the posterior zonules to the equatorial zone of the lens, the lens changes its normal shape to spherical.
HP:0034375.definition_cn: 球形晶状体是一种罕见的先天性病症，表现为晶状体周围悬韧带薄弱，晶状体呈更球形且前后径增厚，并伴有高度近视。晶状体悬韧带在发育过程中发育不全且异常薄弱，由于后悬韧带未附着于晶状体赤道区，导致晶状体形态改变为球形。

HP:0034376.name: Atrioventricular valve regurgitation
HP:0034376.definition: Regurgitation of a heart valve that controls blood flow from a an atrium to a ventricle, including mitral, tricuspid, or, rarely, single atrioventicular valve.
HP:0034376.definition_cn: 控制血液从心房流向心室的心脏瓣膜反流，包括二尖瓣、三尖瓣或罕见的单一房室瓣反流。

HP:0034377.name: Single atrioventricular valve regurgitation
HP:0034377.definition: Regurgitation of the single atrioventricular valve regurgitation (AVVR) in the context of a congenital heart defect with a single ventricle. Roughly three quarters of patients following Fontan procedure display AVVR.
HP:0034377.definition_cn: 单心室先天性心脏病背景下的单一房室瓣反流（AVVR）。大约四分之三的Fontan术后患者表现出房室瓣反流。

HP:0034378.name: Urethrovesical occlusion
HP:0034378.definition: Blockage of the flow of urine from the bladder into the urethra.

HP:0034379.name: obsolete Vascular granular osmiophilic material deposition
HP:0034379.definition: Accumulation of granular osmiophilic material in blood vessel walls. Osmiophilic material becomes black upon staining with osmium tetroxide.
HP:0034379.name_cn: 过时的血管颗粒状嗜锇物质沉积
HP:0034379.definition_cn: 血管壁内颗粒状嗜锇物质沉积。嗜锇物质经四氧化锇染色后呈黑色。

HP:0034380.name: Juvenile type testicular granulosa cell tumor
HP:0034380.definition: Juvenile granulosa cell tumor of the testis of neonates and infants is an uncommon lesion frequently associated with abnormal sex chromosome and ambiguous genitalia.
HP:0034380.name_cn: 青少年型睾丸颗粒细胞瘤
HP:0034380.definition_cn: 新生儿和婴儿睾丸幼年型颗粒细胞瘤是一种罕见的病变，常与性染色体异常和生殖器模糊相关。

HP:0034381.name: Central nervous system axonal spheroid
HP:0034381.definition: Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons. During neurodegeneration, bubble-like swellings form along the length of the axon, a primary and early effect of dynamic axonal deformation. These varicosities, spheroids, or swellings have been described as beads on a string and branches bearing fruit, and they frequently appear on degenerating axons. The focal swellings on degenerating axons, axonal spheroids, are often filled with cellular debris such as organelles, pathological proteins, and disorganized cytoskeletal elements.
HP:0034381.name_cn: 中枢神经系统轴突球状体
HP:0034381.definition_cn: 轴突球状体是形成于大多数退行性轴突上的泡状生物结构。在神经退行性变过程中，泡状肿胀沿轴突长度形成，这是动态轴突变形的首要和早期效应。这些膨大、球状体或肿胀被描述为串珠状或结果的分支，它们经常出现在退行性轴突上。退行性轴突上的局灶性肿胀，即轴突球状体，通常充满细胞碎片，如细胞器、病理性蛋白质和紊乱的细胞骨架成分。

HP:0034382.name: Disease remission
HP:0034382.definition: A decrease in or disappearance of signs and symptoms typically associated with a disease course.
HP:0034382.definition_cn: 症状和体征的减轻或消失，通常与疾病病程相关。

HP:0034383.name: Elevated circulating biliverdin concentration
HP:0034383.definition: Increased concentration of biliverdin, a green tetrapyrrolic bile pigment, in the blood circulation.
HP:0034383.definition_cn: 血液循环中胆绿素（一种绿色四吡咯胆汁色素）浓度升高。

HP:0034384.name: Elevated circulating insulin:C-peptide ratio
HP:0034384.definition: Increased ratio of insulin to C-peptide in the blood circulation.
HP:0034384.name_cn: 循环胰岛素:C肽比值升高
HP:0034384.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰岛素与C肽比值升高。

HP:0034385.name: Abnormal left ventricular endsystolic diameter
HP:0034385.definition: A deviation from the normal range of the left ventricular endsystolic diameter.
HP:0034385.name_cn: 左心室收缩末期直径异常
HP:0034385.definition_cn: 左心室收缩末期直径偏离正常范围。

HP:0034386.name: Reduced left ventricular endsystolic diameter
HP:0034386.definition: A lower than normal left ventricular endsystolic diameter.
HP:0034386.name_cn: 左心室收缩末期直径减小
HP:0034386.definition_cn: 左心室收缩末期直径低于正常值。

HP:0034388.name: Hilar lymph node enlargement
HP:0034388.definition: Hilar lymphadenopathy is swelling or enlargement of lymph nodes localized in hila, wedge-shaped anatomical structures containing pulmonary vessels, major bronchi, nerves and lymph nodes. Hilar lymph nodes are not visible on chest X-ray if they are not enlarged. Hilar lymph node enlargement can be caused by benign and malignant conditions and can be symmetrical (bilateral) or asymmetrical (unilateral).
HP:0034388.definition_cn: 肺门淋巴结肿大是指位于肺门区域的淋巴结发生肿胀或增大，肺门为楔形解剖结构，包含肺血管、主支气管、神经和淋巴结。若肺门淋巴结未发生肿大，胸部X线检查中不可见。肺门淋巴结肿大可由良性和恶性病变引起，可为对称性（双侧）或非对称性（单侧）。

HP:0034389.name: Pulmonary vein varix
HP:0034389.definition: Pulmonary vein varix (PVV), refers to a localized dilatation of a pulmonary vein. PVV is a rare condition and can be congenital or acquired. PVV typically occur at the confluence of the veins adjacent to the left atrium. PVVs are sometimes classified into three morphological types: saccular, tortuous and confluent.
HP:0034389.definition_cn: 肺静脉曲张（Pulmonary Vein Varix, PVV）是指肺静脉的局部扩张。PVV是一种罕见病症，可为先天性或后天性。PVV通常发生于邻近左心房的静脉汇合处。PVV有时根据形态学特征分为三种类型：囊状型、迂曲型和汇合型。

HP:0034390.name: Decreased CSF glycine concentration
HP:0034390.definition: Abnormally decreased levels of glycine in cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0034390.name_cn: 脑脊液甘氨酸浓度降低
HP:0034390.definition_cn: 脑脊液中甘氨酸水平异常降低。

HP:0034391.name: Elbow contracture
HP:0034391.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of the elbow resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin.
HP:0034391.definition_cn: 肘关节被动活动范围受限，由于非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊或皮肤）的结构性改变导致关节周围组织弹性丧失所致。

HP:0034392.name: Joint contracture
HP:0034392.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin. A contracture prevents movement of the associated body part.
HP:0034392.definition_cn: 关节被动活动范围受限，由于非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊或皮肤）的结构性改变导致关节周围组织弹性丧失所致。挛缩阻碍了相关身体部位的运动。

HP:0034393.name: Elbow extension contracture
HP:0034393.definition: An elbow contracture that limits the ability of the elbow joint to flex (flexion of the the elbow joint refers to bending the elbow joint to bring the hand closer to the shoulder), meaning that the elbow is fixed in an extended (straight) position.
HP:0034393.definition_cn: 肘关节挛缩限制了肘关节的屈曲功能（肘关节屈曲是指弯曲肘关节使手部靠近肩部），意味着肘关节固定在伸直位。

HP:0034394.name: Forearm supination contracture
HP:0034394.definition: A contracture that limits the ability of the forearm to stabilize the hand in pronation (pronation refers to a rotation of the forearm that causes the palm and forearm to face downwards), meaning that the palm is fixed in a upward orientation. Restriction of supination/pronation can occur at the elbow (radial-humeral joint), at the wrist (radial-ulnar joint), and anywhere in between.
HP:0034394.definition_cn: 一种挛缩限制了前臂在旋前时稳定手部的能力（旋前是指前臂旋转导致手掌和前臂朝下的动作），意味着手掌固定在上方朝向。旋后/旋前受限可能发生在肘部（桡肱关节）、腕部（桡尺关节）以及两者之间的任何部位。

HP:0034395.name: Forearm pronation contracture
HP:0034395.definition: A contracture that limits the ability of the forearm to stabilize the hand in supiation (supination refers to a rotation of the forearm that causes the palm and forearm to face upwards), meaning that the palm is fixed in a downward orientation. Restriction of supination/pronation can occur at the elbow (radial-humeral joint), at the wrist (radial-ulnar joint), and anywhere in between.
HP:0034395.definition_cn: 挛缩限制了前臂在旋后位（旋后是指前臂旋转使手掌和前臂朝上）稳定手部的能力，意味着手掌固定于向下的方向。旋后/旋前受限可发生于肘部（桡肱关节）、腕部（桡尺关节）以及两者之间的任何部位。

HP:0034396.name: Hippocampal malrotation
HP:0034396.definition: Hippocampal malrotation, also termed incomplete inversion of the hippocampus or hippocampal malformation, is an increasingly recognized neuroimaging finding of undetermined clinical significance. It is characterized by features including (i) Round or pyramidal shape instead of ovoid shape; (ii) Medial position of the hippocampus on the hippocampal sulcus; (iii) The collateral sulcus is excessively deep or verticalized; (iv) Fimbria located medial to the hippocampus; (v) Small or displaced fornix; (vi) Enlarged temporal horn and empty choroid fissure; (vii) Thickened subiculum; (viii) Reduced upper horizontal portion of the parahippocampal gyrus.
HP:0034396.definition_cn: 海马旋转不良，也称为海马不完全内旋或海马畸形，是一种逐渐被认识的神经影像学表现，其临床意义尚未明确。其特征包括：（i）海马呈圆形或锥形而非卵圆形；（ii）海马位于海马沟的内侧；（iii）侧副沟过深或垂直化；（iv）海马伞位于海马内侧；（v）穹窿较小或移位；（vi）颞角扩大且脉络裂空虚；（vii）下托增厚；（viii）海马旁回上部水平部分减少。

HP:0034397.name: Claw toe deformity
HP:0034397.definition: Claw toes are characterized by hyperextension at the metatarsal-phalangeal joints and flexion of the interphalangeal joints.
HP:0034397.definition_cn: 爪形趾的特征是跖趾关节过伸和趾间关节屈曲。

HP:0034398.name: Toe deformity
HP:0034398.definition: Abnormal positioning of toe phalanges. Deformities of the lesser toes often occur gradually, though they can be brought on by trauma. The main adult sagittal plane deformities consist of claw toes, hammer toes and mallet toes. Axial plane deformities include crossover toes.
HP:0034398.definition_cn: 趾骨异常定位。小趾畸形通常逐渐发生，但也可能由创伤引起。主要的成人矢状面畸形包括爪形趾、锤状趾和槌状趾。轴向面畸形包括交叉趾。

HP:0034399.name: Prolonged central motor conduction time
HP:0034399.definition: Increased duration of the central motor conduction time (CMCT). The CMCT estimates the conduction time of corticospinal fibers between motor cortex and spinal (or bulbar) motoneurons. It includes the times for excitation of cortical cells, conduction via the corticobulbar-corticospinal tract and excitation of the motoneuron sufficient to reach its firing threshold. CMCT is calculated by subtracting the peripheral conduction time from the MEP latency recorded after cortical stimulation.
HP:0034399.name_cn: 中枢运动传导时间延长
HP:0034399.definition_cn: 中枢运动传导时间（Central Motor Conduction Time, CMCT）延长。CMCT用于评估运动皮层与脊髓（或延髓）运动神经元之间皮质脊髓束纤维的传导时间。它包括皮层细胞的兴奋时间、通过皮质延髓-皮质脊髓束的传导时间以及运动神经元达到其放电阈值所需的兴奋时间。CMCT的计算方法是从皮层刺激后记录的MEP（运动诱发电位）潜伏期中减去外周传导时间。

HP:0034400.name: Circumferential skin creases on extremities
HP:0034400.definition: Ringed creases of the skin of the extremities related to folding of excess skin.
HP:0034400.definition_cn: 四肢皮肤环形皱褶与皮肤冗余折叠相关。

HP:0034401.name: Atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor
HP:0034401.definition: An aggressive malignant embryonal neoplasm arising from the central nervous system. It is composed of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm. Mutations of the SMARCB1 gene or very rarely SMARCA4 (BRG1) gene are present. The vast majority of cases occur in childhood. Symptoms include lethargy, vomiting, cranial nerve palsy, headache, and hemiplegia.
HP:0034401.name_cn: 非典型畸胎瘤样/横纹肌样瘤
HP:0034401.definition_cn: 一种起源于中枢神经系统的侵袭性恶性胚胎性肿瘤。其由具有大偏心核、明显核仁和丰富细胞质的细胞组成。存在SMARCB1基因或极少数情况下SMARCA4（BRG1）基因的突变。绝大多数病例发生在儿童期。症状包括嗜睡、呕吐、颅神经麻痹、头痛和偏瘫。

HP:0034402.name: Rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
HP:0034402.definition: A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the kidney that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers, and pathologic diagnosis requires familiarity with these microscopic features plus awareness that adult onset is possible. It can be associated with abnormalities of chromosome 22. It is characterized by the presence of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm.
HP:0034402.definition_cn: 一种高度侵袭性、极为罕见的肾脏肿瘤，通常见于儿童。术语“横纹肌样”用于描述该肿瘤，因为肿瘤细胞类似于横纹肌母细胞，但缺乏肌源性标志物，病理诊断需要熟悉这些显微镜下特征，并意识到成人发病的可能性。该肿瘤可能与22号染色体异常相关。其特征为存在具有大偏心核、明显核仁和丰富细胞质的细胞。

HP:0034403.name: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
HP:0034403.definition: A form of T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma in which cytotoxic CD8+ T cells infiltrate adipose tissue forming subcutaneous nodules.
HP:0034403.name_cn: 皮下脂膜炎样T细胞淋巴瘤
HP:0034403.definition_cn: 一种T细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤，其特征为细胞毒性CD8+ T细胞浸润脂肪组织，形成皮下结节。

HP:0034404.name: Fungal hyphae in sputum
HP:0034404.definition: Presence of hyphae (long, branching, filamentous structures produced by fungi) in sputum.
HP:0034404.definition_cn: 痰液中存在菌丝（由真菌产生的长而分枝的丝状结构）。

HP:0034405.name: Enlarged tectum
HP:0034405.definition: Increasaed size of the tectum, which is the region of the midbrain posterior to the cerebral aqueduct of Sylvius. The midbrain is the most superior portion of the brainstem.
HP:0034405.definition_cn: 中脑顶盖增大，即位于中脑导水管（Sylvius导水管）后方的中脑区域。中脑是脑干的最上部分。

HP:0034406.name: Elevated CSF angiotensin-converting enzyme concentration
HP:0034406.name_cn: 脑脊液血管紧张素转换酶浓度升高

HP:0034407.name: Reduced circulating 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase concentration
