HP:0034407.definition: Decreased concentration of 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase in th blood circulation.
HP:0034407.name_cn: 循环中3-酮酰基辅酶A硫解酶浓度降低
HP:0034407.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-酮酰基辅酶A硫解酶浓度降低。

HP:0034408.name: Solitary angiokeratoma
HP:0034408.definition: A dark, keratotic papule about 2-10 mm in diameter, usually occurring on the lower extremeities. Usually the lesions begin as bright, soft, and nonkeratotic paules which grow larger and change to a firm, blue to black and keratotic stage.
HP:0034408.definition_cn: 一种直径约2-10毫米的深色角化性丘疹，通常发生于下肢。病变初期表现为明亮、柔软且非角化性的丘疹，随后逐渐增大并转变为坚实、呈蓝黑色且角化性的阶段。

HP:0034409.name: Fordyce angiokeratoma
HP:0034409.definition: A type of angiokeratoma that most commonly occurs on the scrotum of patients who are 40 years old or older. The typical single lesion is a dark red to blue dome-shaped papule 2-4 mm in diameter with a very discrete keratotic surface. Typically, they are multiple and arranged in a line parallel to the raphe mediana of the scrotum. They also occur on the vulva and less commnly on the penis.
HP:0034409.definition_cn: 一种血管角化瘤，最常见于40岁或以上患者的阴囊。典型的单一病变为直径2-4毫米的暗红色至蓝色圆顶状丘疹，表面有明显的角化。通常为多发，并沿阴囊中缝平行排列。也可发生于外阴，较少见于阴茎。

HP:0034410.name: Angiokeratoma circumscriptum naeviforme
HP:0034410.definition: A type of angiokeratoma that typically presents in childhood as a large, mostly linear and unilateral hyperkeratotic plaque which is composed of confluent keratotic papules. The size ranges from a few centimeters up to a major part of the body surface. Initially the lesions present as multiple reddish macules, clinically similar to a nevus flammeus. Within several years they develop into acanthokeratotic papules that agrregate into plaques which may have a hyperkeratotic surface.
HP:0034410.name_cn: 局限性痣样血管角化瘤
HP:0034410.definition_cn: 一种血管角化瘤，通常在儿童期表现为大面积、多为线性和单侧分布的过度角化斑块，由融合的角化性丘疹组成。其大小范围从几厘米到占据体表大部分区域不等。最初病变表现为多发性红色斑疹，临床上类似于鲜红斑痣。在数年内，这些病变发展为棘层角化性丘疹，并聚集成斑块，表面可能呈现过度角化。

HP:0034411.name: Angiokeratoma of Mibelli
HP:0034411.definition: A type of angiokeratoma that typically presents in women on the dorsa of fingers and toes and multiple dark red papules with a slightly verrucous surface, each measuring about 3-5 mm in diameter.
HP:0034411.definition_cn: 一种血管角化瘤，通常见于女性手指和足背，表现为多个暗红色丘疹，表面略呈疣状，直径约3-5毫米。

HP:0034412.name: Laryngeal mass
HP:0034412.definition: A lump in the region of the larynx. A mass is any lump in the body that can be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes or an immune reaction. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup. Laryngeal masses can be visualized by multiple methods include computed tomography.
HP:0034412.definition_cn: 喉部区域的肿块。肿块是指体内任何可能由细胞异常增生、囊肿、激素变化或免疫反应引起的团块。通常，肿块是初步发现，将引导进一步的检查。喉部肿块可通过多种方法进行可视化检查，包括计算机断层扫描（CT）。

HP:0034413.name: Palate mass
HP:0034413.definition: A lump in the region of the palate. A mass is any lump in the body that can be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes or an immune reaction. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup.
HP:0034413.definition_cn: 腭部肿块。肿块是指体内任何可能由细胞异常增生、囊肿、激素变化或免疫反应引起的局部隆起。通常，肿块是初步发现，需进一步检查以明确诊断。

HP:0034414.name: Thick oral frenulum
HP:0034414.definition: Increased thickness of an oral frenulum, flaps of mucous membrane that extend from the midline gingiva to the upper or lower lip.
HP:0034414.definition_cn: 口腔系带增厚，即从中线牙龈延伸至上唇或下唇的黏膜皱襞增厚。

HP:0034415.name: Tooth avulsion
HP:0034415.definition: A type of dental trauma characterized by total dislocation of the tooth from its socket.
HP:0034415.definition_cn: 一种牙科创伤类型，其特征为牙齿从其牙槽窝完全脱位。

HP:0034416.name: Torn oral frenulum
HP:0034416.definition: Laceration or tear of an oral frenulum, flaps of mucous membrane that extend from the midline gingiva to the upper or lower lip.
HP:0034416.definition_cn: 口腔系带撕裂或断裂，即从中线牙龈延伸至上唇或下唇的粘膜瓣。

HP:0034417.name: Intraoral laceration
HP:0034417.definition: A wound of the mucosa within the oral cavity covering lips, tongue, palate, gingiva, pharynx, or retropharynx.
HP:0034417.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜损伤，累及唇、舌、腭、牙龈、咽或咽后壁。

HP:0034418.name: Erythematous oral mucosa
HP:0034418.definition: An erythematous lesion of the oral mucosa may result from a variety of tissue alterations, including inflammation, erythrocyte extravasation, and atrophy or reduced keratinization of the surface epithelium.
HP:0034418.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜红斑性病变可能由多种组织改变引起，包括炎症、红细胞外渗以及表层上皮萎缩或角化减少。

HP:0034419.name: Mitral chordae tendinae rupture
HP:0034419.definition: Breakage of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve. This can lead to loss of tension of one of the mitral valve leaflets and mitral regurgitation.
HP:0034419.definition_cn: 二尖瓣腱索断裂。这可能导致二尖瓣瓣叶张力丧失，进而引发二尖瓣反流。

HP:0034420.name: History of cardiovascular procedure
HP:0034420.definition: Indicates that a cardiovascular procedure such as stenting, bypass, catherization was performed on a patient.
HP:0034420.definition_cn: 表明患者已接受心血管介入治疗，如支架植入术、冠状动脉旁路移植术或导管插入术。

HP:0034421.name: Ejection click
HP:0034421.definition: A high-pitched sound that occurs at the moment of maximal opening of the aortic or pulmonary valves. They are heard just after the first heart sound. The sounds occur in the presence of a dilated aorta or pulmonary artery or in the presence of a bicuspid or flexible stenotic aortic or pulmonary valve. Ejection clicks may also be called ejection sounds.
HP:0034421.definition_cn: 在主动脉瓣或肺动脉瓣最大开放时刻出现的高频音。这些声音紧接在第一心音之后听到。此类声音见于主动脉或肺动脉扩张，或存在二叶式或柔韧性狭窄的主动脉瓣或肺动脉瓣时。喷射性喀喇音亦可称为喷射音。

HP:0034422.name: Cryofibrinogenemia
HP:0034422.definition: Cryofibrinogen is an abnormal protein that forms precipitate only in plasma. consisting of fibrinogen, fibronectin, alpha1-antitrypsin and alpha2-macroglobulin.
HP:0034422.definition_cn: 冷纤维蛋白原是一种仅在血浆中形成沉淀的异常蛋白质，由纤维蛋白原、纤维连接蛋白、α1-抗胰蛋白酶和α2-巨球蛋白组成。

HP:0034423.name: triggered by allergens
HP:0034423.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to allergens.
HP:0034423.definition_cn: 适用于由接触过敏原引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0034424.name: Clicking tinnitus
HP:0034424.definition: A type of tinnitus that presents as clicks, resembling the noise made by the snapping together of 2 fingers.
HP:0034424.definition_cn: 一种表现为咔嗒声的耳鸣类型，类似于两指相扣发出的声音。

HP:0034425.name: Reduced hair sulfur content
HP:0034425.definition: Abnormally low amount of sulfur in hair.

HP:0034427.name: Purulent eye discharge
HP:0034427.definition: Secretion of pus-like (purulent) material from the eye, which may caused the eyelids to be matted together.
HP:0034427.definition_cn: 眼部分泌脓性物质（脓性分泌物），可能导致眼睑粘连。

HP:0034429.name: Bacteria in cerebrospinal fluid
HP:0034429.definition: Presence of bacteria in the cerebrospinal fluid, as manifested by visual inspection or bacterial culture results.
HP:0034429.definition_cn: 脑脊液中存在细菌，通过肉眼观察或细菌培养结果证实。

HP:0034431.name: Joint crepitus
HP:0034431.definition: A popping, clicking or crackling sound that accompaniees movement of a joint.
HP:0034431.definition_cn: 关节活动时伴随的弹响、咔嗒声或碎裂音。

HP:0034432.name: Intertriginous distribution
HP:0034432.definition: Applies to the localization of a skin lesion involving any area of the body where two opposing skin surfaces can touch and rub or chaff.
HP:0034432.definition_cn: 适用于涉及身体任何部位皮肤病变的定位，其中两个相对的皮肤表面可能接触并摩擦或擦伤。

HP:0034433.name: Distributed along skin tension lines
HP:0034433.definition: Applies to the localization of a skin lesion that correspond to skin tension lines, which are linear clefts in the skin that indicate the direction of orientation of the underlying collagen fibers. Skin tension lines are also known as Langer's lines or lines of cleavage.
HP:0034433.definition_cn: 适用于皮肤病变的定位，其对应于皮肤张力线，即皮肤中的线性裂隙，指示下方胶原纤维的定向方向。皮肤张力线也称为朗格线或分裂线。

HP:0034434.name: Abnormal communication
HP:0034434.definition: Presence of any form of communication (e.g., verbal or non-verbal) that does not align with cultural expectations or developmental level.
HP:0034434.definition_cn: 存在任何形式的交流（例如，言语或非言语）与文化期望或发育水平不一致。

HP:0034435.name: Abnormal eye contact
HP:0034435.definition: Any abnormality of eye contact behavior. We define eye contact as a form of nonverbal communication between two individuals who are facing each other in which an individual directs the eyes towards the eyes or face of the other individual. Eye contact occurs frequently and voluntarily during face-to-face verbal communication. The duration and frequency of eye contact that is interpreted to be appropriate may follow social and situational norms.
HP:0034435.definition_cn: 眼接触行为异常。我们将眼接触定义为两个面对面个体之间的一种非语言交流形式，其中一个个体将视线指向另一个个体的眼睛或面部。在面对面言语交流过程中，眼接触频繁且自愿发生。被解读为适当的眼接触持续时间和频率可能遵循社会和情境规范。

HP:0034436.name: Gaze avoidance
HP:0034436.definition: A deliberate avoidance of eye contact.

HP:0034437.name: Excessive eye contact
HP:0034437.definition: Tendency to maintain sustained eye contact for an inappropriately long period of time.
HP:0034437.definition_cn: 持续性不适当长时间眼神接触倾向。

HP:0034439.name: Instep location
HP:0034439.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the arched middle portion of the foot in front of the ankle joint (i.e., instep).
HP:0034439.definition_cn: 适用于位于踝关节前方足弓中部（即足背）的异常情况。

HP:0034440.name: Ameliorated by ultraviolet light exposure
HP:0034440.definition: Applies to a skin lesion that is improved or made more bearable by exposure to ultraviolet light (sunshine or phototherapy).
HP:0034440.definition_cn: 适用于通过暴露于紫外线（阳光或光疗）而改善或更易耐受的皮肤病变。

HP:0034441.name: Decreased circulating aspartic acid concentration
HP:0034441.definition: An reduced concentration of aspartic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0034441.name_cn: 循环天冬氨酸浓度降低
HP:0034441.definition_cn: 血液中天冬氨酸浓度降低。

HP:0034442.name: Abnormal circulating erythropoietin concentration
HP:0034442.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of erythropoietin in the blood circulation. Erythropoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the peritubular cells of the kidney that stimulates red blood cell production.
HP:0034442.name_cn: 异常循环促红细胞生成素浓度
HP:0034442.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常血液循环中促红细胞生成素浓度的异常。促红细胞生成素是一种由肾小管周围细胞产生的糖蛋白激素，可刺激红细胞生成。

HP:0034443.name: Reduced circulating erythropoietin concentration
HP:0034443.definition: Decreased concentration of erythropoietin in the blood circulation. Erythropoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the peritubular cells of the kidney that stimulates red blood cell production.
HP:0034443.name_cn: 循环促红细胞生成素浓度降低
HP:0034443.definition_cn: 血液循环中促红细胞生成素浓度降低。促红细胞生成素是一种由肾小管周围细胞产生的糖蛋白激素，可刺激红细胞生成。

HP:0034444.name: Abnormal gamma-glutamyltransferase level
HP:0034444.definition: Any deviation from the normal level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues.
HP:0034444.name_cn: γ-谷氨酰转移酶水平异常
HP:0034444.definition_cn: 任何偏离γ-谷氨酰转移酶（GGT）正常水平的情况。GGT主要存在于肾脏、肝脏和胰腺细胞中，但在其他组织中也有少量存在。

HP:0034445.name: Reduced gamma-glutamyltransferase level
HP:0034445.definition: Decreased level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues.
HP:0034445.name_cn: γ-谷氨酰转移酶水平降低
HP:0034445.definition_cn: γ-谷氨酰转移酶（GGT）水平降低。GGT主要存在于肾脏、肝脏和胰腺细胞中，但在其他组织中也有少量存在。

HP:0034446.name: Elevated circulating histamine concentration
HP:0034446.definition: Increased concentration of histamine in the blood circulation.

HP:0034447.name: Increased circulating interleukin 18 concentration
HP:0034447.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-18 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034447.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素18浓度升高
HP:0034447.definition_cn: 循环血液中白细胞介素-18浓度升高。

HP:0034448.name: Abnormal phytanic acid:pristanic acid ratio
HP:0034448.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of blood phytanic acid concentration to pristanic acid concentration.
HP:0034448.name_cn: 异常植烷酸：降植烷酸比值
HP:0034448.definition_cn: 血液植烷酸浓度与降植烷酸浓度正常比值的任何偏离。

HP:0034449.name: Increased phytanic acid:pristanic acid ratio
HP:0034449.definition: An elevation above the normal ratio of blood phytanic acid concentration to pristanic acid concentration.
HP:0034449.name_cn: 植物酸：降植烷酸比值升高
HP:0034449.definition_cn: 血液植烷酸浓度与降植烷酸浓度比值高于正常水平。

HP:0034450.name: Decreased phytanic acid:pristanic acid ratio
HP:0034450.definition: A reduction below the normal ratio of blood phytanic acid concentration to pristanic acid concentration.
HP:0034450.name_cn: 植物酸与降植烷酸比值降低
HP:0034450.definition_cn: 血液植烷酸浓度与降植烷酸浓度比值低于正常水平。

HP:0034451.name: Rectovesical fistula
HP:0034451.definition: An aberrant, pathological communication between the rectum and the bladder.

HP:0034452.name: Rectoureteral fistula
HP:0034452.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the ureter.
HP:0034452.definition_cn: 直肠与输尿管之间的异常连接（瘘管）。

HP:0034454.name: Arachnoid granulation
HP:0034454.definition: Arachnoid granulations (AGs) are tufts of arachnoid membrane invaginated into the dural sinuses through which cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) enters the venous system. The lesions are primarily located in the parasagittal region along the superior sagittal sinus, which is occasionally seen at the transverse sinus. Normally dural venous sinus AGs typically range from 2 to 8 mm in size, but may grow enough to expand the dural sinuses, and even the inner table, diploic space and outer table of the skull.
HP:0034454.definition_cn: 蛛网膜颗粒（Arachnoid Granulations, AGs）是蛛网膜组织向硬脑膜窦内突入的簇状结构，通过其脑脊液（Cerebrospinal Fluid, CSF）进入静脉系统。病变主要位于上矢状窦旁的矢状旁区，偶尔可见于横窦。正常情况下，硬脑膜静脉窦内的蛛网膜颗粒大小通常为2至8毫米，但可能增大至足以扩张硬脑膜窦，甚至累及颅骨的内板、板障间隙及外板。

HP:0034455.name: Increased CSF taurine concentration
HP:0034455.definition: Increased concentration of taurine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0034455.name_cn: 脑脊液牛磺酸浓度升高
HP:0034455.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中牛磺酸浓度升高。

HP:0034456.name: Elevated circulating glutathione concentration
HP:0034456.definition: An abnormally increased level of glutathione in the blood circulation.
HP:0034456.name_cn: 循环谷胱甘肽浓度升高
HP:0034456.definition_cn: 血液循环中谷胱甘肽水平异常升高。

HP:0034457.name: Hawkinsinuria
HP:0034457.definition: The concentration of hawkinsin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034457.definition_cn: 尿液中霍金斯素浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0034458.name: Elevated urinary phenylpyruvic acid level
HP:0034458.definition: An abnormally increased amount of phenylpyruvic acid in the urine.
HP:0034458.name_cn: 尿中苯丙酮酸水平升高
HP:0034458.definition_cn: 尿中苯丙酮酸异常增多。

HP:0034459.name: Ameliorated by lumbar puncture
HP:0034459.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by lumbar puncture.
HP:0034459.definition_cn: 适用于通过腰椎穿刺改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034460.name: Increased CSF uracil concentration
HP:0034460.definition: An increased level of uracil in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0034460.name_cn: 脑脊液尿嘧啶浓度升高
HP:0034460.definition_cn: 脑脊液中尿嘧啶水平升高。

HP:0034461.name: Elevated urine kynurenine level
HP:0034461.definition: An abnormally increased amount of kynurenine in the urine.
HP:0034461.name_cn: 尿液中犬尿氨酸水平升高
HP:0034461.definition_cn: 尿液中犬尿氨酸水平异常升高。

HP:0034462.name: Increased CSF L-alloisoleucine concentration
HP:0034462.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0034462.name_cn: 脑脊液L-别异亮氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034462.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中L-别异亮氨酸浓度异常升高。

HP:0034463.name: Hydroxylysinemia
HP:0034463.definition: An increased concentration of hydroxylysine in the blood circulation. Hydroxylysine arises from a post-translational hydroxy modification of lysine and is unique to collagen and proteins containing collagen-like sequences. Elevated concentrations of hydroxylysine may indicate increased bone turnover.
HP:0034463.definition_cn: 血液循环中羟赖氨酸浓度升高。羟赖氨酸由赖氨酸的翻译后羟基化修饰产生，且仅存在于胶原蛋白及含有胶原样序列的蛋白质中。羟赖氨酸浓度升高可能提示骨转换增加。

HP:0034464.name: Homocitrullinuria
HP:0034464.definition: An increased amount of L-homocitrulline in the urine. L-homocitrulline is an L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine having a carbamoyl group at the N(6)-position. It is found in individuals with urea cycle disorders.
HP:0034464.definition_cn: 尿液中L-高瓜氨酸水平升高。L-高瓜氨酸是L-赖氨酸的衍生物，即在N(6)位具有氨甲酰基的L-赖氨酸。该物质常见于尿素循环障碍患者。

HP:0034465.name: 2-hydroxyadipic aciduria
HP:0034465.definition: The concentration of 2-hydroxyadipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034465.definition_cn: 尿液中2-羟基己二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0034466.name: Homoargininuria
HP:0034466.definition: An increased amount of homoarginine in the urine. Homoarginine is a nonproteinogenic alpha amino acid.
HP:0034466.definition_cn: 尿液中高精氨酸水平升高。高精氨酸是一种非蛋白源性α-氨基酸。

HP:0034467.name: Increased urinary cysteine level
HP:0034467.definition: An increased concentration of cysteine in the urine.
HP:0034467.definition_cn: 尿液中半胱氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0034468.name: Gastric xanthoma
HP:0034468.definition: Gastric xanthomas (also known as xanthelasmas) are are plaque-like red lesions defined by the presence of histiocytic containing lipids.
HP:0034468.definition_cn: 胃黄色瘤（亦称黄斑瘤）是由含脂质的组织细胞构成的斑块状红色病变。

HP:0034469.name: Decreased stool elastase level
HP:0034469.definition: Reduced amount of pancreatic elastase in the stool. This feature may be observed with pancreatic insufficiency.
HP:0034469.name_cn: 粪便弹性蛋白酶水平降低
HP:0034469.definition_cn: 粪便中胰弹性蛋白酶含量降低。此特征可能见于胰腺功能不全。

HP:0034470.name: Elevated stool chloride content
HP:0034470.definition: Elevated amount of chloride in the stool.
HP:0034470.definition_cn: 粪便中氯化物含量升高。

HP:0034471.name: Increased fecal coproporphyrin III:coproporphyrin I ratio
HP:0034471.definition: Abnormal relative increase in the amount of fecal coproporphyrin III as compared to coproporphyrin I in the feces.
HP:0034471.name_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉III与粪卟啉I比值升高
HP:0034471.definition_cn: 粪便中粪卟啉III相对于粪卟啉I的异常相对增加。

HP:0034472.name: Increased fecal harderoporphyrin
HP:0034472.definition: Abnormally high concentration of harderoporphyrin in feces.
HP:0034472.definition_cn: 粪便中硬卟啉异常高浓度。

HP:0034473.name: Increased fecal heptacarboxylporphyrin
HP:0034473.definition: Abnormally high concentration of heptacarboxylporphyrin in feces.
HP:0034473.name_cn: 粪便中七羧基卟啉增加
HP:0034473.definition_cn: 粪便中七羧基卟啉异常增高。

HP:0034474.name: Increased fecal pentacarboxylporphyrin
HP:0034474.definition: Abnormally high concentration of pentacarboxylporphyrin in feces.
HP:0034474.definition_cn: 粪便中五羧基卟啉浓度异常升高。

HP:0034475.name: Increased fecal isocoproporphyrin
HP:0034475.definition: Abnormally high concentration of isocoproporphyrin in feces.
HP:0034475.definition_cn: 粪便中异粪卟啉异常高浓度。

HP:0034476.name: Positive fecal Clostridium botulinum test
HP:0034476.definition: Identification of Clostridium botulinum toxin in the feces.
HP:0034476.name_cn: 粪便肉毒梭菌检测阳性
HP:0034476.definition_cn: 粪便中肉毒梭菌毒素的鉴定。

HP:0034477.name: Perihepatic adhesions
HP:0034477.definition: Abnormal union of the membranous surfaces of the liver capsule and the parietal peritoneum due to inflammation or injury. Adhesions may be visualized by laparoscopy and may have a violin string appearance.
HP:0034477.definition_cn: 由于炎症或损伤导致的肝被膜与壁层腹膜膜性表面异常粘连。可通过腹腔镜检查观察到粘连，并可能呈现琴弦样外观。

HP:0034478.name: Dilated vas deferens
HP:0034478.definition: Abnormal increase in diameter (expansion) of the vas deferens.
HP:0034478.definition_cn: 输精管直径异常增大（扩张）。

HP:0034479.name: Enlarged epididymis
HP:0034479.definition: Abnormal increase in the size of the epididymis.

HP:0034481.name: Atypical gestures
HP:0034481.definition: Spontaneous production of communicative gestures that are perceived as odd or mechanical, or are poorly integrated with other means of communication. This may include inaccurate mimicry of typical gestures.
HP:0034481.definition_cn: 自发性产生被感知为怪异或机械化的交流性手势，或这些手势与其他交流方式整合不良。这可能包括对典型手势的不准确模仿。

HP:0034483.name: Bone marrow vacuolated lymphocytes
HP:0034483.definition: The presence of lymphocytes with multilple vacuoles (a membrane-bound cell organelle) in the bone marrow.
HP:0034483.definition_cn: 骨髓中存在具有多个空泡（膜结合细胞器）的淋巴细胞。

HP:0034484.name: Spinal cord calcifications
HP:0034484.definition: The presence of calcium deposition in the spinal cord.

HP:0034485.name: Neuroepithelial cyst
HP:0034485.definition: A benign epithelial-lined cystic lesion that can occur anywhere in the neuraxis. Neuroepithelial cysts are ependymal or epithelial lined fluid collections of unknown etiology within the central nervous system parenchyma with no obvious ventricular or subarachnoid connection. Most cysts are asymptomatic, however, some present with seizures, mass effect, or rarely with movement disorders. On imaging, they present as CSF-like parenchymal cysts with smooth, rounded borders and minimal or no surrounding signal intensity abnormality.
HP:0034485.definition_cn: 一种良性上皮衬里囊性病变，可发生于神经轴任何部位。神经上皮囊肿是中枢神经系统实质内由室管膜或上皮衬里的液体积聚，病因不明，与脑室或蛛网膜下腔无明显联系。大多数囊肿无症状，但部分可表现为癫痫发作、占位效应，或罕见情况下出现运动障碍。影像学上表现为类似脑脊液的实质内囊肿，边界光滑、圆形，周围信号强度异常轻微或无异常。

HP:0034486.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 7 concentration
HP:0034486.definition: A diminished concentration of interleukin-7 in the circulation.
HP:0034486.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素7浓度降低
HP:0034486.definition_cn: 循环中白细胞介素-7浓度降低。

HP:0034487.name: Increased circulating interleukin 12 concentration
HP:0034487.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-12 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034487.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素12浓度升高
HP:0034487.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素-12浓度升高。

HP:0034488.name: Increased circulating interleukin 13 concentration
HP:0034488.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-13 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034488.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素13浓度升高
HP:0034488.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素-13浓度升高。

HP:0034489.name: Increased circulating interleukin 2 concentration
HP:0034489.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-2 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034489.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素2浓度升高
HP:0034489.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素-2浓度升高。

HP:0034490.name: Increased circulating interleukin 4 concentration
HP:0034490.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-4 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034490.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素4浓度升高
HP:0034490.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素-4浓度升高。

HP:0034491.name: Increased circulating interleukin 5 concentration
HP:0034491.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-5 in the blood circulation.
HP:0034491.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素5浓度升高
HP:0034491.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素-5浓度升高。

HP:0034492.name: Salpingitis
HP:0034492.definition: An inflammation of the fallopian tube.

HP:0034493.name: Tubo-ovarian abscess
HP:0034493.definition: A tubo-ovarian abscess (TOA) is a complex infectious mass of the adnexa that forms as a sequela of pelvic inflammatory disease.
HP:0034493.definition_cn: 输卵管卵巢脓肿（TOA）是一种复杂的附件感染性肿块，作为盆腔炎性疾病的后遗症形成。

HP:0034494.name: Opacified paranasal sinuses
HP:0034494.definition: White appearance (radio-opaqueness) of a paranasal sinus on radiography.
HP:0034494.definition_cn: 鼻窦X线检查中的白色影像（放射不透性）。

HP:0034495.name: Elevated brain glutamine level by MRS
HP:0034495.definition: An increased in the level of glutamine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0034495.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内谷氨酰胺水平升高
HP:0034495.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内谷氨酰胺（Glutamine）水平升高。

HP:0034496.name: Abnormal brain glutamine level by MRS
HP:0034496.definition: A deviation from normal in the level of glutamine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0034496.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内谷氨酰胺水平异常
HP:0034496.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内谷氨酰胺水平异常。

HP:0034497.name: Increased urinary hexanoic acid level
HP:0034497.definition: The concentration of hexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034497.definition_cn: 尿液中己酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0034498.name: Hepatic focal nodular hyperplasia
HP:0034498.definition: Hepatic focal nodular hyperplasia (FNH) is a benign hepatic tumor. FNH develops within hepatic parenchymal tissue that is otherwise histologically normal. Macroscopically, the tumor is characterized by the presence of depressed, grayish-white scar, which is generally (but not always) located at the center of the lesion, with fibrous septa radiating outward, toward the periphery of the tumor. This stellate scar is found in only 50% of all FNH nodules, but its presence is regarded as pathognomonic. The lesion itself is usually lighter in color than the tissue that surrounds it, and it sometimes has a yellowish hue. FNH nodules are generally not capsulated; their margins are well defined, and they are sometimes lobulated.
HP:0034498.definition_cn: 肝局灶性结节性增生（Focal Nodular Hyperplasia, FNH）是一种良性肝脏肿瘤。FNH发生于组织学上正常的肝实质组织内。大体上，肿瘤特征为存在凹陷的灰白色瘢痕，通常（但并非总是）位于病变中心，纤维间隔向外放射状延伸至肿瘤周边。这种星状瘢痕仅见于50%的FNH结节中，但其存在被视为病理特征性表现。病变本身通常比周围组织颜色较浅，有时呈淡黄色。FNH结节通常无包膜；其边界清晰，有时呈分叶状。

HP:0034499.name: Increased bone marrow iron
HP:0034499.definition: An increased amount of iron in the bone marrow.

HP:0034500.name: Glenoid fracture
HP:0034500.definition: A fracture of the glenoid fossa, a relatively shallow dish is located on the lateral scapula and is the socket portion of the shoulder joint that meets to articulate the humeral head.
HP:0034500.definition_cn: 肩胛盂窝骨折，肩胛盂窝位于肩胛骨外侧，是一个相对较浅的凹槽，构成肩关节的关节窝部分，与肱骨头相连接形成关节。

HP:0034501.name: Widened mediastinum
HP:0034501.definition: Abnormal increase in the width of the mediastinum, often defined as being greater than 6 to 8 cm.
HP:0034501.definition_cn: 纵隔宽度异常增大，通常定义为超过6至8厘米。

HP:0034502.name: Narrow mediastinum
HP:0034502.definition: Abnormal decrease in the width of the mediastinum.

HP:0034503.name: Ovarian torsion
HP:0034503.definition: Ovarian torsion is a twisting of the ligaments that support the adnexa, cutting off the blood flow to the ovary.
HP:0034503.definition_cn: 卵巢扭转是指支撑附件的韧带发生扭转，导致卵巢血流中断。

HP:0034504.name: Septate gallbladder
HP:0034504.definition: Septate gallbladder is characterized by the presence of a septum that divides the gallbladder in two chambers. When the septum dividing the gallbladder lies longitudinally it is called bilobed gallbladder and when there is a transverse septum separating the fundus from the rest of the gallbladder it is called an hour-glass gallbladder.
HP:0034504.definition_cn: 分隔胆囊的特征是存在一个将胆囊分为两个腔室的隔膜。当分隔胆囊的隔膜呈纵向分布时，称为双叶胆囊；当存在一个横向隔膜将胆囊底部与其余部分分隔时，称为沙漏型胆囊。

HP:0034505.name: Gallbladder wall thickening
HP:0034505.definition: Abnormal increased in the thickness of the wall of the gallbladder.

HP:0034506.name: Gallbladder enlargement
HP:0034506.definition: Abnormal increased in the thickness of the size of the gallbladder.

HP:0034507.name: Gallbladder mass
HP:0034507.definition: An abnormal lesion or swelling seen on gallbladder imaging.
HP:0034507.definition_cn: 胆囊影像学检查中发现的异常病变或肿胀。

HP:0034508.name: Fingerprint bodies
HP:0034508.definition: Fingerprint bodies are inclusion bodies located at the periphery of the muscle fibers underneath the sarcolemma (subsarcolemmal), consisting of non-membrane-bound packed lamellae arranged in concentric patterns resembling fingerprints.
HP:0034508.definition_cn: 指纹体是位于肌纤维膜下（肌膜下）的包涵体，由非膜结合的层状结构组成，呈同心圆排列，形似指纹。

HP:0034509.name: Spheroid bodies
HP:0034509.definition: An accumulation of myofilamentous material within individual muscle fibers, forming usually round but occasionally elongated bodies ranging from 2 to 15 pm in size. The so-called spheroid bodies stain green with the modified trichrome preparation and are mainly present in the periphery of type 1 muscle fibers, where they may occupy large sectors sharply demarcated from the remainder of the cross-sectioned muscle fiber.
HP:0034509.definition_cn: 肌纤维内肌丝物质积聚，形成通常为圆形但偶尔为椭圆形的结构，大小范围为2至15微米。这些所谓的球状体在改良的三色染色法中呈绿色，主要存在于1型肌纤维的周边区域，可能占据横切面肌纤维的较大区域，与其余部分形成明显的界限。

HP:0034510.name: Abnormal muscle tissue enzyme activity or level
HP:0034510.definition: Any deviation from the normal activity or histological staining of an enzyme in muscle tissue, usually measured in a muscle biopsy specimen.
HP:0034510.name_cn: 肌肉组织酶活性或水平异常
HP:0034510.definition_cn: 任何偏离肌肉组织中酶的正常活性或组织学染色的情况，通常通过肌肉活检标本进行检测。

HP:0034511.name: Reduced muscle aconitase activity
HP:0034511.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyne aconitase in muscle tissue.
HP:0034511.name_cn: 肌肉乌头酸酶活性降低
HP:0034511.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中乌头酸酶活性降低。

HP:0034512.name: Transitional-cell carcinoma of the ureter
HP:0034512.definition: A cancer of the ureter that most often arises in the distal third of the ureter and is often diagnosed during the sixth and seventh decades of life. The most common presentation is gross hematuria or flank pain.
HP:0034512.definition_cn: 输尿管癌，最常见于输尿管远端三分之一处，通常在患者六十至七十岁之间被诊断。最常见的临床表现是肉眼血尿或侧腹疼痛。

HP:0034513.name: Increased circulating Interferon-alpha concentration
HP:0034513.definition: An elevation in the concentration of interferon alpha measured in the blood circulation.
HP:0034513.definition_cn: 循环血液中干扰素α浓度升高。

HP:0034514.name: Liver hamartoma
HP:0034514.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the liver.
HP:0034514.definition_cn: 一种良性（非癌性）肿瘤样畸形，由起源于肝脏的异常混合细胞和组织构成。

HP:0034515.name: Ameloblastoma
HP:0034515.definition: Ameloblastoma is a benign odontogenic tumor generally present in the jaw bone. The tumor originates from the residual epithelium of the tooth germ, epithelium of odontogenic cysts stratified squamous epithelium and epithelium of the enamel organ.
HP:0034515.definition_cn: 成釉细胞瘤是一种常见的良性牙源性肿瘤，通常发生于颌骨内。该肿瘤起源于牙胚的残余上皮、牙源性囊肿的复层鳞状上皮以及釉质器的上皮组织。

HP:0034516.name: Ameliorated by ketogenic diet
HP:0034516.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by following a ketogenic diet.
HP:0034516.definition_cn: 适用于通过遵循生酮饮食而改善或减轻的体征或症状。

HP:0034517.name: Pretibial hyperpigmentation
HP:0034517.definition: Darkening of the area of skin that overlies the shin.

HP:0034519.name: Muscle fiber fuchsinophilic inclusion bodies
HP:0034519.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that react positively with acid fuchsin.
HP:0034519.definition_cn: 肌细胞胞质内存在与酸性品红呈阳性反应的包涵体。

HP:0034520.name: Esophageal myenteric plexus degeneration
HP:0034520.definition: Deterioration of the cells of the myenteric plexus (also known as the Auerbach plexus) located between the layers of the muscular propria of the esophagus.
HP:0034520.definition_cn: 位于食管固有肌层之间的肌间神经丛（也称为奥尔巴赫神经丛）细胞退化。

HP:0034521.name: Periorificial hyperkeratosis
HP:0034521.definition: Scaling and overgrowth of horny tissue of the skin surrounding body orifices (including peri-auricular, peri-oral, peri-anal areas.
HP:0034521.definition_cn: 体孔周围皮肤角化组织增生及过度生长（包括耳周、口周、肛周区域）。

HP:0034522.name: Eosinophilic lymph node infiltration
HP:0034522.definition: Presence of an elevated number of eosinophils in a lymph node (usually as demonstrated by lymph node biopsy).
HP:0034522.name_cn: 嗜酸性粒细胞性淋巴结浸润
HP:0034522.definition_cn: 淋巴结中嗜酸性粒细胞数量增多（通常通过淋巴结活检证实）。

HP:0034523.name: Blood parasite
HP:0034523.definition: Detection of a parasitic organism in the blood stream. Blood parasites include malaria plasmodia, microfilaria species, trypanosomes (the causative agents of African sleeping sickness and South American Changas disease) and the causative agents of schistosomiasis of the bladder and the intestine.
HP:0034523.definition_cn: 血液中检测到寄生虫。血液寄生虫包括疟原虫、微丝蚴、锥虫（引起非洲昏睡病和南美恰加斯病的病原体）以及引起膀胱和肠道血吸虫病的病原体。

HP:0034524.name: Bloodstream trypomastigotes
HP:0034524.definition: Presence of trypomastigote parasites in the blood stream. This finding can be demonstrated by the identification of trypomastigote parasites on peripheral blood smear.
HP:0034524.definition_cn: 血液中存在锥鞭毛体寄生虫。此发现可通过在外周血涂片中识别锥鞭毛体寄生虫来证实。

HP:0034525.name: Adamantinoma
HP:0034525.definition: A primary low-grade, malignant bone tumor that is predominantly located in the mid-portion of the tibia. Histologically, classic adamantinoma is a biphasic tumor characterized by epithelial and osteofibrous components that may be intermingled with each other in various proportions and differentiating patterns.
HP:0034525.definition_cn: 一种原发的低度恶性骨肿瘤，主要位于胫骨中段。组织学上，经典型釉质瘤是一种双相性肿瘤，其特征为上皮成分和骨纤维成分以不同比例和分化模式相互混合。

HP:0034526.name: Abnormal enzyme activity in muscle tissue
HP:0034526.definition: Deviation from the normal activity of an enzyme in muscle tissue.
HP:0034526.name_cn: 肌肉组织中酶活性异常
HP:0034526.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中酶活性异常。

HP:0034527.name: Reduced muscle phosphoglycerate kinase activity
HP:0034527.definition: Reduced activity of phosphoglycerate kinase (PGK) in muscle tissue. PGK is a glycolytic enzyme that catalyzes one of the two ATP-producing reactions in the glycolytic pathway, through the conversion of 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate to 3-phosphoglycerate.
HP:0034527.name_cn: 肌肉磷酸甘油酸激酶活性降低
HP:0034527.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中磷酸甘油酸激酶（PGK）活性降低。PGK是一种糖酵解酶，通过将1,3-二磷酸甘油酸转化为3-磷酸甘油酸，催化糖酵解途径中两个ATP生成反应之一。

HP:0034528.name: Reduced fibroblast type III procollagen synthesis
HP:0034528.definition: Diminished production of type III procollagen by cultured skin fibroblasts.
HP:0034528.name_cn: 成纤维细胞III型前胶原合成减少
HP:0034528.definition_cn: 培养的皮肤成纤维细胞中III型前胶原的生成减少。

HP:0034529.name: Reduced muscle myoadenylate deaminase activity
HP:0034529.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme myoadenylate deaminase. Myoadenylate deaminase is the muscle isoform of adenosine monophosphate (AMP) deaminase and catalyzes the deamination of AMP to inosine monophosphate and ammonia.
HP:0034529.name_cn: 肌肉肌苷酸脱氨酶活性降低
HP:0034529.definition_cn: 肌腺苷酸脱氨酶活性降低。肌腺苷酸脱氨酶是腺苷一磷酸（AMP）脱氨酶的肌肉同工酶，催化AMP脱氨生成肌苷一磷酸和氨。

HP:0034530.name: Bent long bone
HP:0034530.definition: A developmental defect of a long bone, such as the femur or the humerus, characterized by a sharply curve deviation located in the diaphysis (shaft) of the bone.
HP:0034530.definition_cn: 长骨发育缺陷，如股骨或肱骨，其特征为位于骨干（骨体）的显著弯曲偏离。

HP:0034531.name: Tracheal rupture
HP:0034531.definition: A break or tear in the trachea.

HP:0034532.name: Increased myocardial glycogen content
HP:0034532.definition: Elevated amount of glycogen in the myocardium.

HP:0034533.name: Triggered by monoamine oxidase inhibitor
HP:0034533.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a monoamine oxidase inhibitor.
HP:0034533.name_cn: 由单胺氧化酶抑制剂引发
HP:0034533.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于单胺氧化酶抑制剂引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0034534.name: Triggered by serotonin reuptake inhibitor
HP:0034534.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
HP:0034534.name_cn: 由血清素再摄取抑制剂引发
HP:0034534.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于血清素再摄取抑制剂引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0034535.name: Ameliorated by acetazolamide
HP:0034535.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with acetazolamide.
HP:0034535.definition_cn: 适用于通过乙酰唑胺治疗得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034536.name: Ameliorated by exposure to medication
HP:0034536.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a medication. Terms in this subhierarchy are intended to be used for cases in which the fact that a manifestation of a disease responds to a specific treatment can be used in the differential diagnosis.
HP:0034536.definition_cn: 适用于通过药物治疗改善或缓解的体征或症状。该子层次结构中的术语旨在用于在鉴别诊断中可以利用疾病表现对特定治疗有反应的情况。

HP:0034537.name: Ameliorated by vitamin B12
HP:0034537.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with vitamin B12.
HP:0034537.definition_cn: 适用于通过维生素B12治疗得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034538.name: Ameliorated by thiamine
HP:0034538.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with thiamine.
HP:0034538.definition_cn: 适用于通过硫胺素治疗得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034539.name: Ameliorated by dantrolene
HP:0034539.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with dantrolene.
HP:0034539.definition_cn: 适用于通过丹曲林治疗得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034540.name: Ameliorated by biotin
HP:0034540.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with biotin.
HP:0034540.definition_cn: 适用于通过生物素治疗得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034541.name: Reduced bone-marrow megakaryocyte size
HP:0034541.definition: Decreased in average size (diameter) of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow. Megakaryocyte diameter can be assessed as using automated cellular imaging systems.
HP:0034541.name_cn: 骨髓巨核细胞体积减小
HP:0034541.definition_cn: 骨髓中巨核细胞平均大小（直径）减小。巨核细胞直径可通过自动化细胞成像系统进行评估。

HP:0034542.name: Hairshafts with longitudinal grooves
HP:0034542.definition: Long narrow depressions running lengthwise in hairshafts. This feature can be appreciated by scanning electron microsopy.
HP:0034542.definition_cn: 沿毛干纵向延伸的细长凹陷。此特征可通过扫描电子显微镜观察。

HP:0034543.name: Mycobacterium bacteremia
HP:0034543.definition: Presence of viable mycobacteria in the blood.
HP:0034543.definition_cn: 血液中存在活的分枝杆菌。

HP:0034544.name: Decreased delta-aminolevulinate dehydratase activity
HP:0034544.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme delta-aminolevulinate dehydratase. The enzyme is active in erythrocytes.
HP:0034544.name_cn: δ-氨基乙酰丙酸脱水酶活性降低
HP:0034544.definition_cn: δ-氨基乙酰丙酸脱水酶活性降低。该酶在红细胞中具有活性。

HP:0034545.name: Elevated circulating pancreatic secretory trypsin inhibitor activity
HP:0034545.definition: Increased activity of the enzyme pancreatic secretory trypsin inhibitor in the blood circulation.
HP:0034545.name_cn: 循环中胰腺分泌性胰蛋白酶抑制剂活性升高
HP:0034545.definition_cn: 血液循环中胰腺分泌型胰蛋白酶抑制剂酶活性增加。

HP:0034546.name: Presence of uterus in 46,XY individual
HP:0034546.definition: A developmental anomaly in which an individual with an X chromosome and a Y chromosome (usually 46,XY) has a uterus. The uterus and Fallopian tubes are derived from the M眉llerian duct and thus this phenotype is generally also associated with the presence of Fallopian tubes.
HP:0034546.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其中具有X染色体和Y染色体的个体（通常为46,XY）拥有子宫。子宫和输卵管源自苗勒管，因此这种表型通常也与输卵管的存在相关。

HP:0034547.name: Intraluminal meconium calcification
HP:0034547.definition: Deposition of calcium in meconium present in the internal cavity of the fetal bowel. This manifestation may be the result of any distal intestinal obstruction.
HP:0034547.definition_cn: 胎粪内钙质沉积于胎儿肠腔内。此表现可能为远端肠梗阻所致。

HP:0034548.name: Portal vein hypoplasia
HP:0034548.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the portal vein.
HP:0034548.definition_cn: 门静脉发育不全（Portal Vein Hypoplasia）

HP:0034549.name: Adrenal leiomyoma
HP:0034549.definition: Adrenal leiomyoma is a rare, benign solid tumor that develops from the smooth muscle of the adrenal vein and its tributaries
HP:0034549.definition_cn: 肾上腺平滑肌瘤是一种罕见的良性实体肿瘤，起源于肾上腺静脉及其属支的平滑肌。

HP:0034550.name: Small intestinal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate
HP:0034550.definition: Infiltration of the wall of the small intestine by lymphocytes and mature plasma cells.
HP:0034550.definition_cn: 小肠壁淋巴细胞及成熟浆细胞浸润。

HP:0034551.name: Triggered by neuroleptic medication
HP:0034551.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to neuroleptic (also known as antipsychotic) medication.
HP:0034551.name_cn: 由神经阻滞剂药物引发
HP:0034551.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于神经阻滞剂（也称为抗精神病药物）所引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0034552.name: Abnormal peroxisomal morphology
HP:0034552.definition: Structural anomaly of peroxisomes, which are small, membrane-enclosed metabolic organelles with roles in the metabolism of complex lipids and reactive ionic species.
HP:0034552.name_cn: 过氧化物酶体形态异常
HP:0034552.definition_cn: 过氧化物酶体结构异常，过氧化物酶体是一种由膜包裹的小型代谢细胞器，在复杂脂质和反应性离子物质的代谢中发挥作用。

HP:0034553.name: Absence of peroxisomes
HP:0034553.definition: Lack of observable peroxisomes. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.
HP:0034553.definition_cn: 过氧化物酶体缺失。此特征可通过培养细胞（如成纤维细胞）的免疫组织化学染色或电子显微镜观察。

HP:0034554.name: Paucity of peroxisomes
HP:0034554.definition: Reduced number of observable peroxisomes per cell. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.
HP:0034554.definition_cn: 每个细胞中可观察到的过氧化物酶体数量减少。该特征可通过培养细胞（如成纤维细胞）的免疫组织化学染色或电子显微镜观察。

HP:0034555.name: Reduced sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase activity
HP:0034555.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase, which typically is measured in a biopsy specimen from liver or muscle.
HP:0034555.name_cn: 硫化物:醌氧化还原酶活性降低
HP:0034555.definition_cn: 硫化物:醌氧化还原酶活性降低，通常通过肝脏或肌肉活检标本进行检测。

HP:0034556.name: Deficit at segmental level
HP:0034556.definition: Refers to distribution of neurological deficits that corresponds to a deficit of a specific spinal segment and all segments below it.
HP:0034556.definition_cn: 指神经功能缺损的分布，对应于特定脊髓节段及其以下所有节段的缺损。

HP:0034557.name: Rhabdoid tumor
HP:0034557.definition: Rhabdoid tumors are rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis. The most common anatomic localizations are the central nervous system, the kidneys, and other soft tissues.
HP:0034557.definition_cn: 横纹肌样瘤是一种罕见且侵袭性强的恶性肿瘤，主要发生于婴幼儿，预后较差。最常见的解剖部位包括中枢神经系统、肾脏及其他软组织。

HP:0034558.name: Rhabdoid tumor of the ovary
HP:0034558.definition: A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the ovary that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers.
HP:0034558.definition_cn: 一种高度侵袭性、极为罕见的卵巢肿瘤，通常见于儿童。之所以使用“横纹肌样”这一术语，是因为肿瘤细胞类似于横纹肌母细胞，但缺乏肌源性标志物。

HP:0034559.name: Cardiac rhabdoid tumor
HP:0034559.definition: A rare and aggressive neoplasms developing mainly in the kidney but also in cerebral and extra-cerebral tissues and rarely in the heart. Histologically, rhabdoid renal and extrarenal tumors share common characteristics. The cells are polygonal, with eccentric, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions. The tumors have an infiltrative growth pattern, necrosis, and high proliferative index. The immunohistochemistry tools of investigation facilitate differential diagnosis by showing loss of INI-1 expression, usually accompanied by germline mutations of the SMARCB1 gene. When INI-1 is still expressed in the affected tissues, a rhabdoid tumor with SMARCA4 mutations should be considered.
HP:0034559.definition_cn: 一种罕见且侵袭性强的肿瘤，主要发生于肾脏，但也可见于脑组织和脑外组织，极少发生于心脏。组织学上，肾内和肾外横纹肌样肿瘤具有共同特征。细胞呈多边形，核偏心、泡状，核仁明显，胞质内可见嗜酸性包涵体。肿瘤呈浸润性生长模式，伴有坏死和高增殖指数。免疫组织化学检查工具有助于鉴别诊断，通常显示INI-1表达缺失，常伴有SMARCB1基因的种系突变。当受累组织中仍表达INI-1时，应考虑存在SMARCA4突变的横纹肌样肿瘤。

HP:0034560.name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of the bladder
HP:0034560.definition: A rhabdoid tumor (a rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis) originating in the urinary bladder.
HP:0034560.definition_cn: 膀胱起源的横纹肌样瘤（一种罕见且侵袭性强的恶性肿瘤，常见于婴幼儿，预后不良）。

HP:0034561.name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of liver
HP:0034561.definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in the liver. MRT are best characterized by the presence of round or polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, typical eosinophilic perinuclear inclusions, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Immunohistochemical expression of vimentin and epithelial markers and lack of staining for S-100, myoglobin and desmin are commonly found, but are non-specific.
HP:0034561.definition_cn: 一种起源于肝脏的恶性横纹肌样瘤（Malignant Rhabdoid Tumor, MRT）。MRT最显著的特征是存在圆形或多角形细胞，这些细胞具有丰富的嗜酸性细胞质、典型的嗜酸性核周包涵体、泡状核和显著的核仁。免疫组织化学检测通常显示波形蛋白（vimentin）和上皮标志物的表达，而S-100、肌红蛋白（myoglobin）和结蛋白（desmin）染色阴性，但这些特征并不具有特异性。

HP:0034562.name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of muscle
HP:0034562.definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in muscle tissue.
HP:0034562.definition_cn: 起源于肌肉组织的恶性横纹肌样瘤（Malignant Rhabdoid Tumor, MRT）。

HP:0034563.name: Neck teratoma
HP:0034563.definition: A teratoma located in the neck.

HP:0034564.name: Kidney teratoma
HP:0034564.definition: A teratoma located in a kidney.

HP:0034565.name: Elevated urinary 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide-riboside level
HP:0034565.definition: Increased amount of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide(AICA)-riboside in the urine. AICA-riboside is the dephosphorylated counterpart of AICAR, an intermediate of de novo purine biosynthesis.
HP:0034565.name_cn: 尿中5-氨基-4-咪唑甲酰胺核苷水平升高
HP:0034565.definition_cn: 尿液中5-氨基-4-咪唑甲酰胺（AICA）-核糖苷含量增加。AICA-核糖苷是AICAR（嘌呤从头合成途径的中间产物）的去磷酸化形式。

HP:0034566.name: Aplasia of posterior communicating artery
HP:0034566.definition: A developmental anomnaly characterized by the lack of development of the posterior communicating artery.
HP:0034566.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为后交通动脉发育不全。

HP:0034567.name: Optic pit
HP:0034567.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by congenital excavation of the optic nerve head.
HP:0034567.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为先天性视神经盘凹陷。

HP:0034568.name: Ameliorated by naloxone
HP:0034568.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with naloxone, an opioid antagonist.
HP:0034568.definition_cn: 适用于通过使用阿片受体拮抗剂纳洛酮治疗后得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034569.name: Ameliorated by pyridoxal phosphate
HP:0034569.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of pyridoxal phosphate (activated vitamin B6).
HP:0034569.definition_cn: 适用于通过摄入磷酸吡哆醛（活化维生素B6）而改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034570.name: Thickened intrahepatic portal venules
HP:0034570.definition: Increased width of the vascular wall of portal venules within the liver.
HP:0034570.definition_cn: 肝内门静脉小血管壁增厚。

HP:0034571.name: Ovarian fibrosis
HP:0034571.definition: Excessive proliferation of fibroblasts and deposition of extracellular matrix within the ovary.
HP:0034571.definition_cn: 卵巢内成纤维细胞过度增殖及细胞外基质沉积。

HP:0034572.name: Pigment incontinence
HP:0034572.definition: A process in which melanosomes (melanin granules) are deposited in the dermis. The dermal melanosomes are observed to be mainly in macrophages. This phenomenon of pigmentary incontinence usually follows an inflammatory process with the basic feature of basal cell damage, such as in lichen planus, lupus erythematosus, Riehl's melanosis, incontinentia pigmenti (Bloch-Sulzberger), and fixed drug eruption. Incontinence of pigment, or dropping off of epidermal melanin into the dermis, frequently produces a clinically recognizable and characteristic slate-gray pigmentation.
HP:0034572.definition_cn: 一种过程，其中黑素体（黑色素颗粒）沉积于真皮层。观察到真皮层中的黑素体主要存在于巨噬细胞内。这种色素失禁现象通常继发于以基底细胞损伤为基本特征的炎症过程，如扁平苔藓、红斑狼疮、Riehl黑变病、色素失禁症（Bloch-Sulzberger综合征）以及固定性药疹。色素失禁，即表皮黑色素脱落至真皮层，常导致临床上可识别且特征性的石板灰色色素沉着。

HP:0034574.name: Reduced epidermal keratin 10 protein expression
HP:0034574.definition: Amount of keratin 10 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.
HP:0034574.name_cn: 表皮角蛋白10蛋白表达降低
HP:0034574.definition_cn: 表皮中角蛋白10的含量低于正常下限。该发现通常通过免疫荧光显微镜检查确认。

HP:0034575.name: Reduced epidermal collagen IV protein expression
HP:0034575.name_cn: 表皮胶原IV蛋白表达降低

HP:0034576.name: Reduced epidermal bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 protein expression
HP:0034576.definition: Lower than normal amount of bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 (BP230) in the epidermis.
HP:0034576.name_cn: 表皮大疱性类天疱疮抗原1蛋白表达降低
HP:0034576.definition_cn: 表皮中低于正常水平的大疱性类天疱疮抗原1（BP230）。

HP:0034577.name: Reduced epidermal collagen VII protein expression
HP:0034577.name_cn: 表皮胶原蛋白VII表达降低

HP:0034578.name: Reduced epidermal collagen XVII protein expression
HP:0034578.name_cn: 表皮胶原XVII蛋白表达降低

HP:0034579.name: Reduced epidermal integrin alpha6beta4 protein expression
HP:0034579.name_cn: 表皮整合素α6β4蛋白表达降低

HP:0034581.name: Bloodstream Trypanosoma cruzi
HP:0034581.definition: Presence of Trypanosoma cruzi in the blood stream. Trypanosoma cruzii is the etiological agent of Chagas disease.
HP:0034581.definition_cn: 血液中存在克氏锥虫（Trypanosoma cruzi）。克氏锥虫是恰加斯病（Chagas disease）的病原体。

HP:0034582.name: Abnormal lymph node cell composition
HP:0034582.definition: A deviation from the normal distribution of cell types or their relative proportions in a lymph node.
HP:0034582.definition_cn: 淋巴结中细胞类型或其相对比例偏离正常分布。

HP:0034583.name: Lipid-laden lymph node macrophages
HP:0034583.definition: Lymph node with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids.
HP:0034583.name_cn: 脂质负载淋巴结巨噬细胞
HP:0034583.definition_cn: 淋巴结内巨噬细胞数量增多，且巨噬细胞内富含脂质。

HP:0034585.name: Cochlear nerve hypoplasia
HP:0034585.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the cochlear nerve.
HP:0034585.definition_cn: 一种以耳蜗神经发育不全为特征的发育缺陷。

HP:0034586.name: Glutathionuria
HP:0034586.definition: Level of glutathione in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034586.definition_cn: 尿液中谷胱甘肽水平高于正常上限。

HP:0034587.name: Nevus psiloliparus
HP:0034587.definition: Nevus psiloliparus is a rare fatty tissue nevus that is a marker for encephalocraniocutaneous lipomatosis, a neurocutaneous syndrome with ocular and central nervous system anomalies. Clinically, nevus psiloliparus is often described as a congenital alopecia and appears as an irregularly shaped, circumscribed area of alopecia on the scalp. Histopathology demonstrates a near-complete absence of mature hair follicles with preservation of arrector pili muscles and mature adipocytes within the dermis.
HP:0034587.definition_cn: 无毛脂肪痣是一种罕见的脂肪组织痣，是脑颅皮肤脂肪瘤病的标志，后者是一种伴有眼部和中枢神经系统异常的神经皮肤综合征。临床上，无毛脂肪痣常被描述为先天性脱发，表现为头皮上不规则形状、界限分明的脱发区域。组织病理学显示，真皮层内成熟毛囊几乎完全缺失，但立毛肌和成熟脂肪细胞得以保留。

HP:0034588.name: Crypt hyperplasia
HP:0034588.definition: Crypt hyperplasia denotes elongation of the length of the crypts of Lieberkuhn, a process that initially precedes villous atrophy. Elongation may be caused by expansion of the lamina propria as a result of the proliferation of stromal cells, an influx of inflammatory cells and tissue remodeling.
HP:0034588.definition_cn: 隐窝增生（Crypt hyperplasia）指的是Lieberkühn隐窝长度的延长，这一过程通常先于绒毛萎缩（villous atrophy）发生。隐窝延长可能由基质细胞（stromal cells）增殖、炎症细胞浸润以及组织重塑（tissue remodeling）导致的固有层（lamina propria）扩张所引起。

HP:0034589.name: Increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate concentration
HP:0034589.definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034589.name_cn: 循环中脱氢表雄酮硫酸盐浓度升高
HP:0034589.definition_cn: 循环血液中硫酸脱氢表雄酮浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034590.name: Abnormal circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
HP:0034590.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood circulation.
HP:0034590.name_cn: 异常循环甲状腺素结合球蛋白浓度
HP:0034590.definition_cn: 血液循环中甲状腺素结合球蛋白（Thyroxine-Binding Globulin, TBG）浓度的任何异常偏离。

HP:0034591.name: Decreased circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
HP:0034591.definition: A reduction from the normal concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood circulation.
HP:0034591.name_cn: 循环甲状腺素结合球蛋白浓度降低
HP:0034591.definition_cn: 血液循环中甲状腺素结合球蛋白（TBG）浓度低于正常水平。

HP:0034592.name: Elevated circulating beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
HP:0034592.definition: An increased concentration of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0034592.name_cn: 循环中β-氨基异丁酸浓度升高
HP:0034592.definition_cn: 血液循环中β-氨基异丁酸浓度升高。

HP:0034593.name: Elevated circulating dihydrouracil concentration
HP:0034593.definition: An increased concentration of dihydrouracil in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of uracil that is also known as 5,6-dihydrouracil.
HP:0034593.name_cn: 循环中二氢尿嘧啶浓度升高
HP:0034593.definition_cn: 血液循环中二氢尿嘧啶浓度升高。二氢尿嘧啶是尿嘧啶分解代谢过程中的中间产物，也称为5,6-二氢尿嘧啶。

HP:0034594.name: Elevated circulating dihydrothymine concentration
HP:0034594.definition: An increased concentration of dihydrothymine in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of thymine.
HP:0034594.name_cn: 循环中二氢胸腺嘧啶浓度升高
HP:0034594.definition_cn: 血液循环中二氢胸腺嘧啶浓度升高。二氢尿嘧啶是胸腺嘧啶分解代谢的中间产物。

HP:0034595.name: Elevated circulating N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine concentration
HP:0034595.definition: An increased concentrationof N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine in the blood circulation.
HP:0034595.name_cn: 循环中N-氨基甲酰基-β-丙氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034595.definition_cn: 血液循环中N-氨甲酰基-β-丙氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0034596.name: Elevated ciculating 5-hydroxymethyluracil concentration
HP:0034596.definition: An increased concentration of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the blood circulation.
HP:0034596.name_cn: 循环中5-羟甲基尿嘧啶浓度升高
HP:0034596.definition_cn: 血液循环中5-羟甲基尿嘧啶浓度升高。

HP:0034597.name: Decreased CSF creatinine concentration
HP:0034597.definition: Concentration of creatinine in the cerebrrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034597.definition_cn: 脑脊液肌酐浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034598.name: Elevated urinary creatine level
HP:0034598.definition: An increased amount of creatine in the urine.

HP:0034599.name: Decreased circulating biotin concentration
HP:0034599.definition: Concentration of biotin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034599.definition_cn: 血液中生物素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034600.name: Elevated circulating thrombopoietin concentration
HP:0034600.definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.
HP:0034600.name_cn: 循环中血小板生成素浓度升高
HP:0034600.definition_cn: 循环血液中血小板生成素浓度高于正常上限。血小板生成素是一种由肝脏和肾脏产生的糖蛋白激素，可刺激巨核细胞的生成和分化。

HP:0034601.name: Decreased circulating C1q concentration
HP:0034601.definition: Concentration or activity of the C1q protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. C1q is the first component of the classical pathway and is composed of the C1qA chain, C1qB chain, and C1qC chain, which are encoded by C1qA, C1qB, and C1qC genes.
HP:0034601.definition_cn: 血液循环中C1q蛋白浓度或活性低于正常值下限。C1q是经典途径的第一个组分，由C1qA链、C1qB链和C1qC链组成，分别由C1qA、C1qB和C1qC基因编码。

HP:0034602.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein A-II concentration
HP:0034602.definition: Concentration of apolipoprotein A-II below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034602.name_cn: 循环载脂蛋白A-II浓度降低
HP:0034602.definition_cn: 载脂蛋白A-II浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034603.name: Elevated circulating CA19-9 concentration
HP:0034603.definition: Concentration of CA19-9 above the upper limit of normal.

HP:0034604.name: Elevated circulating DOPA concentration
HP:0034604.definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034604.definition_cn: 血液中多巴（3,4-二羟基苯丙氨酸）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034605.name: Elevated CSF DOPA concentration
HP:0034605.definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the cerebrospinal fluid above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034605.definition_cn: 脑脊液中多巴（3,4-二羟基苯丙氨酸）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034606.name: Elevated circulating porphyrin concentration
HP:0034606.definition: Concentration of porphyrins or of a specific porphryin above the upper limit of normal. The most commonly tested circulating porphyrins are coproporphyrin, protoporphyrin, and uroporphyrin. Normally protoporphyrin is present in the highest concentration.
HP:0034606.definition_cn: 卟啉或特定卟啉浓度高于正常上限。最常检测的循环卟啉包括粪卟啉、原卟啉和尿卟啉。正常情况下，原卟啉浓度最高。

HP:0034607.name: Decreased circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
HP:0034607.definition: Concentration of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034607.definition_cn: 血液循环中17-羟孕酮浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034608.name: Decreased circulating transcobalamin II concentration
HP:0034608.definition: Concentration of transcobalamin II in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034608.name_cn: 循环中钴胺传递蛋白II浓度降低
HP:0034608.definition_cn: 循环血液中钴胺传递蛋白II浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034609.name: Polychromasia
HP:0034609.definition: Increased variation in the color of the erythrocytes (red blood cells), including pale red, normal or dark colors, indicating a highly variable hemoglobin concentration. Typically this indicates the release of immature erythrocytes in states of anemia.
HP:0034609.definition_cn: 红细胞（erythrocytes）颜色变异度增加，包括淡红色、正常或深色，提示血红蛋白浓度（hemoglobin concentration）存在显著变异。通常这表明在贫血（anemia）状态下释放了未成熟红细胞（immature erythrocytes）。

HP:0034610.name: Decreased circulating myo-inositol concentration
HP:0034610.definition: Concentration of myo-inositol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034610.definition_cn: 血液循环中肌醇浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034611.name: Elevated circulating arabinitol concentration
HP:0034611.definition: Concentration of arabinitol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034611.name_cn: 循环阿拉伯糖醇浓度升高
HP:0034611.definition_cn: 血液中阿拉伯糖醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0034612.name: Elevated urine arabitol level
HP:0034612.definition: Amount of arabitol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034612.name_cn: 尿阿拉伯糖醇水平升高
HP:0034612.definition_cn: 尿液中阿拉伯糖醇含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034613.name: Elevated urine erythritol level
HP:0034613.definition: Amount of erythritol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034613.name_cn: 尿液中赤藓糖醇水平升高
HP:0034613.definition_cn: 尿液中赤藓糖醇含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034614.name: Elevated circulating erythritol concentration
HP:0034614.definition: Concentration of erythritol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034614.name_cn: 循环赤藓糖醇浓度升高
HP:0034614.definition_cn: 循环血液中赤藓糖醇浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034615.name: Reduced circulating matrix metalloproteinase 2 concentration
HP:0034615.definition: Concentration of matrix metalloproteinase 2 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034615.name_cn: 循环基质金属蛋白酶2浓度降低
HP:0034615.definition_cn: 循环血液中基质金属蛋白酶2浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034616.name: Abnormal circulating coenzyme concentration
HP:0034616.definition: Concentration of a coenzyme (an organic molecule that binds to the active sites of an enzyme to promote the catalysis of a reaction) is above or below the limits of normal.
HP:0034616.definition_cn: 辅酶（一种与酶活性位点结合的有机分子，用于促进反应的催化）浓度高于或低于正常范围。

HP:0034617.name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl methionine concentration
HP:0034617.definition: Concentration of S-adenosyl methionine (SAM) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. SAM is a cosubstrate involved in methyl group transfers, transsulfuration, and aminopropylation.
HP:0034617.name_cn: 循环中S-腺苷甲硫氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034617.definition_cn: 循环血液中S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）浓度高于正常上限。SAM是一种参与甲基转移、转硫作用和氨基丙基化反应的共底物。

HP:0034618.name: Abnormal circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
HP:0034618.definition: Concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal. Membrane cofactor protein (MCP, CD46) is a cell surface complement regulatory protein which acts as a cofactor for the factor I-mediated cleavage of the activated complement components C3b/C4b.
HP:0034618.name_cn: 异常循环膜辅因子蛋白浓度
HP:0034618.definition_cn: 循环血液中膜辅因子蛋白浓度超出正常范围。膜辅因子蛋白（MCP，CD46）是一种细胞表面补体调节蛋白，作为因子I介导的活化补体成分C3b/C4b裂解的辅因子发挥作用。

HP:0034619.name: Decreased circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
HP:0034619.definition: Concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034619.name_cn: 循环膜辅因子蛋白浓度降低
HP:0034619.definition_cn: 循环血液中膜辅因子蛋白浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034620.name: Elevated circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
HP:0034620.definition: Concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034620.name_cn: 循环膜辅因子蛋白浓度升高
HP:0034620.definition_cn: 循环血液中膜辅因子蛋白浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034621.name: Hepatic xanthomatosis
HP:0034621.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the liver. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034621.definition_cn: 肝脏内局部脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但通常是系统性疾病的显著可见体征，如家族性高胆固醇血症。

HP:0034622.name: Adrenal xanthomatosis
HP:0034622.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the adrenal gland. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034622.definition_cn: 肾上腺内局灶性脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但常为家族性高胆固醇血症等全身性疾病的重要可见体征。

HP:0034623.name: Splenic xanthomatosis
HP:0034623.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spleen. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034623.definition_cn: 脾脏内局部脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但常为系统性疾病的显著体征，如家族性高胆固醇血症。

HP:0034624.name: Spinal cord xanthomatosis
HP:0034624.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spinal cord. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034624.definition_cn: 脊髓内局灶性脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但常为系统性疾病的显著可见体征，如家族性高胆固醇血症。

HP:0034625.name: Brain xanthomatosis
HP:0034625.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the brain. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034625.definition_cn: 脑内局部脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但常为系统性疾病的显著体征，如家族性高胆固醇血症。

HP:0034626.name: Pulmonary xanthomatosis
HP:0034626.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the lung. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034626.definition_cn: 肺内局部脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但通常是系统性疾病的显著可见体征，如家族性高胆固醇血症。

HP:0034627.name: Bone marrow xanthomatosis
HP:0034627.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the bone marrow. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034627.definition_cn: 骨髓内局部脂质沉积。黄色瘤为良性病变，但常为家族性高胆固醇血症等系统性疾病的显著体征。

HP:0034628.name: Lymph node xanthomatosis
HP:0034628.definition: Lipid deposits localized within one or more lymph nodes. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.
HP:0034628.definition_cn: 脂质沉积局限于一个或多个淋巴结。黄色瘤为良性病变，但通常是系统性疾病的显著可见体征，如家族性高胆固醇血症。

HP:0034629.name: Xanthoma of bone
HP:0034629.definition: Xanthoma of bone is an exceedingly rare benign primary bone tumor histologically characterized by mononuclear macrophage-like cells, abundant foam cells, and multinucleated giant cells.
HP:0034629.definition_cn: 骨黄色瘤是一种极为罕见的良性原发性骨肿瘤，其组织学特征为单核巨噬细胞样细胞、大量泡沫细胞和多核巨细胞。

HP:0034630.name: Ameliorated by folinic acid
HP:0034630.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with folinic acid.
HP:0034630.definition_cn: 适用于通过亚叶酸治疗改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034631.name: Triggered by succinylcholine anesthetic
HP:0034631.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a succinylcholine anesthetic such as suxamethonium.
HP:0034631.name_cn: 由琥珀酰胆碱麻醉引发
HP:0034631.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于琥珀酰胆碱类麻醉剂（如琥珀胆碱）所引发或诱发的体征或症状。

HP:0034632.name: Exogenous androgen exposure
HP:0034632.definition: History of having been treated with an exogenous androgen medication.
HP:0034632.definition_cn: 外源性雄激素药物治疗史。

HP:0034633.name: Reduced muscle enolase activity
HP:0034633.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme enolase in muscle tissue. The enzyme enolase catalyzes the interconversion of 2-phosphoglycerate and phosphoenolpyruvate. In adult human muscle, over 90% of enolase activity is accounted for by the beta-enolase subunit, the protein product of the ENO3 gene.
HP:0034633.name_cn: 肌肉烯醇化酶活性降低
HP:0034633.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中烯醇化酶活性降低。烯醇化酶催化2-磷酸甘油酸与磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸之间的相互转化。在成人肌肉中，超过90%的烯醇化酶活性由β-烯醇化酶亚基（ENO3基因的蛋白质产物）所贡献。

HP:0034634.name: Dopamine antagonist exposure
HP:0034634.definition: History of having been treated with a dopamine antagonist including metaclopramide, phenothiazine; haloperidol, chlorpromazine, promethazine, prochlorperazine, ziprasidone, and quetiapine.
HP:0034634.definition_cn: 既往接受过多巴胺拮抗剂治疗史，包括甲氧氯普胺、吩噻嗪类；氟哌啶醇、氯丙嗪、异丙嗪、丙氯拉嗪、齐拉西酮和喹硫平。

HP:0034635.name: Muscle fiber granulofilamentous inclusion bodies
HP:0034635.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that contain a mxiture of granules and filaments.
HP:0034635.name_cn: 肌纤维颗粒丝状包涵体
HP:0034635.definition_cn: 肌细胞胞质内存在包含颗粒和细丝混合物的包涵体。

HP:0034636.name: Bone marrow myeloid vacuolization
HP:0034636.definition: Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of myeloid precursors in the bone marrow.
HP:0034636.definition_cn: 骨髓中髓系前体细胞胞质内空泡形成（细胞质内出现无细胞质的空间，由膜包裹并充满液体）。

HP:0034637.name: Pulmonary cylindroma
HP:0034637.definition: A cylindroma located in the lung. Cylindromas are well-circumscribed, smooth, pale pink nodular tumors, often with arborizing vessels visible. The tumors are slow growing and vary in size from a few millimeters to over 5 mm.
HP:0034637.definition_cn: 位于肺部的圆柱瘤。圆柱瘤为界限清楚、表面光滑、呈淡粉色的结节性肿瘤，常可见分支状血管。肿瘤生长缓慢，大小从数毫米至超过5毫米不等。

HP:0034638.name: Colonic fibrinopurulent exudate
HP:0034638.definition: Fluid visible on the colonic surface containing fibrin, inflammatory cells, and cellular debris.
HP:0034638.name_cn: 结肠纤维蛋白脓性渗出物
HP:0034638.definition_cn: 结肠表面可见含有纤维蛋白、炎性细胞及细胞碎屑的液体。

HP:0034639.name: Bloodstream microfilaria
HP:0034639.definition: Presence of filaria in the blood stream. Filariasis is a common cause of elephantiasis in Coastal Districts of India. The initial manifestations are repeated episodes of fever with chills and rigor, lymphadenopathy which gradually progress to elephantiasis. In India filarial infestation is commonly caused by W. bancrofti and Brugia malayi, the former responsible for almost 98 percent of all cases.
HP:0034639.definition_cn: 血液中存在丝虫。丝虫病是印度沿海地区象皮病的常见病因。初始表现为反复发作的发热伴寒战和僵直，淋巴结肿大，逐渐进展为象皮病。在印度，丝虫感染通常由班氏吴策线虫（Wuchereria bancrofti）和马来布鲁格线虫（Brugia malayi）引起，前者几乎占所有病例的98%。

HP:0034640.name: Skin infectious agent
HP:0034640.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the skin.
HP:0034640.definition_cn: 皮肤中存在感染性病原体。

HP:0034641.name: Dermal microfilaria
HP:0034641.definition: Presence of filariae in the skin.

HP:0034642.name: Dermal papillary IgA deposition
HP:0034642.definition: Accumulation of immunoglobulin A (IgA) surrounding dermal papillae, which are specialized cells that support the hair follicle.
HP:0034642.definition_cn: 真皮乳头周围免疫球蛋白A（IgA）的积聚，真皮乳头是支持毛囊的特化细胞。

HP:0034643.name: Dermal immune complex deposition
HP:0034643.definition: Accumulation of antigen-bound antibody in the skin.
HP:0034643.definition_cn: 皮肤中抗原结合抗体的积聚。

HP:0034644.name: Abnormal liver metabolite concentration
HP:0034644.definition: The concentration of a metabolite in the liver is above or below the limits of normal.
HP:0034644.definition_cn: 肝脏中代谢物浓度超出或低于正常范围。

HP:0034645.name: Hepatic polyglucosan accumulation
HP:0034645.definition: Intracellular accumulation of polyglucosan bodies-containing amylopectinlike polysaccharide-in the liver.
HP:0034645.definition_cn: 肝细胞内含有多葡聚糖体的支链淀粉样多糖的积聚。

HP:0034646.name: Urinary bladder neurofibroma
HP:0034646.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) located in the urinary bladder.
HP:0034646.definition_cn: 位于膀胱的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘瘤）。

HP:0034647.name: Synovial granuloma
HP:0034647.definition: An aggregation of macrophages (forming in response to chronic inflammation) localized in the lining of a joint (synovium).
HP:0034647.definition_cn: 慢性炎症反应中巨噬细胞聚集于关节滑膜内。

HP:0034648.name: Elevated urine fumaric acid level
HP:0034648.definition: The concentration of fumaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034648.definition_cn: 尿液中富马酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0034649.name: Elevated urine N-acetylaspartic acid level
HP:0034649.definition: The amount of N-acetylaspartate in the urine, when corrected for urine concentration, is above upper limit of normal. This feature can be measured using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.
HP:0034649.name_cn: 尿N-乙酰天门冬氨酸水平升高
HP:0034649.definition_cn: 尿液中N-乙酰天冬氨酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限。此指标可通过气相色谱-质谱联用技术进行测定。

HP:0034650.name: Elevated urine suberylglycine level
HP:0034650.definition: Level of suberylglycine in urine above upper limit of normal.
HP:0034650.name_cn: 尿中辛二酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:0034650.definition_cn: 尿液中琥珀酰甘氨酸水平高于正常上限。

HP:0034651.name: Elevated urine phenylpropionylglycine level
HP:0034651.definition: Level of phenylpropionylglycine in urine above upper limit of normal.
HP:0034651.name_cn: 尿苯丙酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:0034651.definition_cn: 尿中苯丙酰甘氨酸水平高于正常上限。

HP:0034652.name: Elevated urine octenedioic acid level
HP:0034652.definition: The concentration of octenedioic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034652.definition_cn: 尿液中辛烯二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:0034653.name: Monocarboxylic aciduria
HP:0034653.definition: Level of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal. A monocarboxylic acid is an oxoacid containing one carboxy group.
HP:0034653.definition_cn: 尿液中单羧酸水平高于正常上限。单羧酸是一种含有一个羧基的含氧酸。

HP:0034654.name: Elevated urine octanoic acid level
HP:0034654.definition: Amount of octanoic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034654.definition_cn: 尿液中辛酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034655.name: Elevated urine glutaconic acid level
HP:0034655.definition: The concentration of glutaconic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034655.name_cn: 尿液中戊二酸水平升高
HP:0034655.definition_cn: 尿液中戊二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0034656.name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxyglutaric level
HP:0034656.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034656.name_cn: 尿液中3-羟基戊二酸水平升高
HP:0034656.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基戊二酸浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:0034657.name: Elevated urine malonic acid level
HP:0034657.definition: The concentration of malonic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034657.definition_cn: 尿液中丙二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0034658.name: Elevated urine propionylglycine level
HP:0034658.definition: Amount of propionylglycine in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034658.name_cn: 尿丙酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:0034658.definition_cn: 尿中丙酰甘氨酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034659.name: Elevated urine tiglylglycine level
HP:0034659.definition: Amount of tiglylglycine in the urine above upper limit of normal.
HP:0034659.name_cn: 尿中甲基巴豆酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:0034659.definition_cn: 尿液中甲基丙二酰甘氨酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034660.name: Elevated urine 2-methylacetoacetic acid level
HP:0034660.definition: Amount of 2-methylacetoacetic acid in the urine above upper limit of normal.
HP:0034660.name_cn: 尿液中2-甲基乙酰乙酸水平升高
HP:0034660.definition_cn: 尿液中2-甲基乙酰乙酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034661.name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxypropionic acid level
HP:0034661.definition: Amount of 3-hydroxypropionic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034661.name_cn: 尿液中3-羟基丙酸水平升高
HP:0034661.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基丙酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034662.name: Elevated urine 2-methylcitric acid level
HP:0034662.definition: Amount of 2-methylcitric acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034662.name_cn: 尿液中2-甲基柠檬酸水平升高
HP:0034662.definition_cn: 尿液中2-甲基柠檬酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034663.name: Elevated urine 4-hydroxyisovaleric acid level
HP:0034663.definition: Amount of 4-hydroxyisovaleric acid in urine above upper limit of normal.
HP:0034663.name_cn: 尿4-羟基异戊酸水平升高
HP:0034663.definition_cn: 尿液中4-羟基异戊酸含量高于正常上限。

HP:0034664.name: Elevated urine 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid level
HP:0034664.definition: Amount of 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal. 2-Hydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid or 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid (HMVA) is an organic acid generated by L-isoleucine metabolism.
HP:0034664.name_cn: 尿液中2-羟基-3-甲基戊酸水平升高
HP:0034664.definition_cn: 尿液中2-羟基-3-甲基戊酸含量高于正常上限。2-羟基-3-甲基戊酸（HMVA）是由L-异亮氨酸代谢生成的有机酸。

HP:0034665.name: Shoulder contracture
HP:0034665.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the shoulder joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.
HP:0034665.definition_cn: 肩关节非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊和/或皮肤）结构改变导致的被动活动范围受限（屈曲、伸展或其他运动受限）。

HP:0034666.name: Shoulder extension contracture
HP:0034666.definition: Lack of the full expected passive range of flexion of the shoulder joint (Shoulder flexion puts the arms from a resting position at one's sides to straight above the head; thus, with shoulder extension contracture it is not possible to raise the arms above the head fully).
HP:0034666.definition_cn: 肩关节屈曲被动活动范围受限（肩关节屈曲是指将手臂从身体两侧的静止位置抬至头顶上方；因此，在肩关节伸展挛缩的情况下，无法将手臂完全抬至头顶上方）。

HP:0034667.name: Thumb extension contracture
HP:0034667.definition: Movement in the sagittal plane that increases the angle of the thumb joint (straightens the joint); motion involving posterior bending of the vertebral column or returning to the upright position from a flexed position.
HP:0034667.definition_cn: 矢状面上增加拇指关节角度的运动（使关节伸直）；涉及脊柱后屈或从屈曲位返回直立位的运动。

HP:0034668.name: Tongue myxoma
HP:0034668.definition: A myxoma (benign soft tissue neoplasm characterized by the presence of spindle and stellate cells, lobulated growth pattern, and myxoid stroma formation) localized in the tongue.
HP:0034668.definition_cn: 舌部黏液瘤（一种良性软组织肿瘤，其特征为存在梭形细胞和星形细胞、分叶状生长模式以及黏液样基质形成）。

HP:0034669.name: Abnormal knee morphology
HP:0034669.definition: A structural abnormality of the knee joint or surrounding structures.
HP:0034669.definition_cn: 膝关节或周围结构的结构异常。

HP:0034670.name: Abnormal knee physiology
HP:0034670.definition: A functional anomaly of the knee joint.

HP:0034671.name: Knee contracture
HP:0034671.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the knee joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.
HP:0034671.definition_cn: 膝关节非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊和/或皮肤）结构改变导致的被动活动范围受限（屈曲、伸展或其他运动受限）。

HP:0034672.name: Knee extension contracture
HP:0034672.definition: A type of knee joint contracture in which the knee lacks full expected flexion, such that the upper and lower leg cannot be brought together.
HP:0034672.definition_cn: 一种膝关节挛缩类型，表现为膝关节无法达到预期的完全屈曲，导致大腿和小腿无法完全靠拢。

HP:0034673.name: Abnormal ankle morphology
HP:0034673.definition: A structural anomaly of the ankle.

HP:0034674.name: Abnormal ankle physiology
HP:0034674.definition: A functional anomaly of the ankle.

HP:0034675.name: Toe joint contracture
HP:0034675.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of a toe joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.
HP:0034675.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊和/或皮肤）的结构性改变导致的趾关节被动活动范围受限（屈曲、伸展或其他运动受限）。

HP:0034676.name: Extension contracture of toe
HP:0034676.definition: A type of toe joint contracture in which the joint lacks full expected flexion, so that the two bony segments on either side of their connecting joint cannot be brought together.
HP:0034676.definition_cn: 一种足趾关节挛缩类型，表现为关节无法达到预期的完全屈曲，导致连接关节两侧的两块骨段无法相互靠拢。

HP:0034681.name: Finger joint contracture
HP:0034681.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of a finger joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.
HP:0034681.definition_cn: 由于非骨性组织（如肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节囊和/或皮肤）的结构性改变导致的指关节被动活动范围受限（屈曲、伸展或其他运动受限）。

HP:0034682.name: Extension contracture of finger
HP:0034682.definition: A type of finger joint contracture in which the joint lacks full expected flexion, so that the two bony segments on either side of their connecting joint cannot be brought together.
HP:0034682.definition_cn: 一种手指关节挛缩类型，表现为关节无法达到预期的完全屈曲，导致连接关节两侧的两块骨段无法相互靠拢。

HP:0034683.name: Reduced muscle telethonin level
HP:0034683.definition: Amount of telethonin protein expression in muscle tissue below lower limit of normal. Telethonin is a 19-kDa sarcomeric protein, localized to the Z-disc of skeletal and cardiac muscles.
HP:0034683.name_cn: 肌肉肌联蛋白水平降低
HP:0034683.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中telethonin蛋白表达量低于正常下限。Telethonin是一种19 kDa的肌节蛋白，定位于骨骼肌和心肌的Z盘。

HP:0034684.name: Abnormal enzyme concentration or activity
HP:0034684.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal.
HP:0034684.definition_cn: 酶浓度或活性高于或低于正常范围。

HP:0034685.name: Abnormal liver enzyme activity or concentration
HP:0034685.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in liver tissue.
HP:0034685.definition_cn: 肝组织中酶的浓度或活性高于或低于正常范围。

HP:0034686.name: Reduced hepatic urocanase activity
HP:0034686.definition: Activity of urocanase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034686.definition_cn: 肝脏中尿刊酸酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034687.name: Impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis
HP:0034687.definition: Reduced hydrolysis (splitting of a bond and the addition of the hydrogen anion of water) of the sulfuric ester linkage in the molecule of cerebroside sulfate, possibly leading to accumuation of cerebroside sulfate.
HP:0034687.name_cn: 脑苷脂硫酸酯水解障碍
HP:0034687.definition_cn: 硫酸酯键在脑苷脂硫酸酯分子中的水解（键的断裂和水的氢阴离子的添加）减少，可能导致脑苷脂硫酸酯的积累。

HP:0034688.name: Reduced peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase activity
HP:0034688.definition: Diminished enzyme activity of peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase, an enzyme that metabolizes glutaryl-CoA (a metabolite of L-lysine, L-hydroxy-lysine and L-tryptophan) by dehydrogenation to glutaconyl-CoA directly followed by decarboxylation of this to crotonyl-CoA.
HP:0034688.name_cn: 过氧化物酶体戊二酰辅酶A氧化酶活性降低
HP:0034688.definition_cn: 过氧化物酶体戊二酰辅酶A氧化酶活性降低，该酶通过脱氢作用将戊二酰辅酶A（L-赖氨酸、L-羟基赖氨酸和L-色氨酸的代谢产物）代谢为戊烯二酰辅酶A，随后直接脱羧生成巴豆酰辅酶A。

HP:0034689.name: Reduced sterol 27-hydroxylase activity
HP:0034689.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme sterol 27-hydroxylase, which participates in the degradation of cholesterol to bile acid. Sterol 27-hydroxylase catalyzes the first step in the normal oxidation of the steroid side chain, converting cholesterol, as well as different 7a-hydroxylated cholesterol metabolites, to 27-oxygenated steroids.
HP:0034689.definition_cn: 固醇27-羟化酶活性降低，该酶参与胆固醇降解为胆汁酸的过程。固醇27-羟化酶催化类固醇侧链正常氧化的第一步，将胆固醇以及不同的7α-羟基化胆固醇代谢物转化为27-氧化类固醇。

HP:0034690.name: Reduced short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
HP:0034690.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme Short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (SCAD), a key enzyme of fatty acid beta-oxidation that catalyzes the first step in mitochondrial beta-oxidation of fatty acids.
HP:0034690.name_cn: 短链酰基辅酶A脱氢酶活性降低
HP:0034690.definition_cn: 短链酰基辅酶A脱氢酶（Short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, SCAD）活性降低，该酶是脂肪酸β-氧化的关键酶，催化线粒体内脂肪酸β氧化的第一步反应。

HP:0034691.name: Reduced 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
HP:0034691.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PGDH), which catalyzes the first step in the pathway by converting D-3-phosphoglycerate (PGA), an intermediate in glycolysis, to phosphohydroxypyruvate concomitant with the reduction of NAD+.
HP:0034691.name_cn: 3-磷酸甘油酸脱氢酶活性降低
HP:0034691.definition_cn: 3-磷酸甘油酸脱氢酶（PGDH）活性降低，该酶催化糖酵解中间产物D-3-磷酸甘油酸（PGA）转化为磷酸羟基丙酮酸，同时伴随NAD+的还原。

HP:0034693.name: Reduced hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase activity
HP:0034693.definition: Activity of methionine adenosyltransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal. Note that there are multiple methionine adenosyltransferase isoezymes.
HP:0034693.name_cn: 肝甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶活性降低
HP:0034693.definition_cn: 肝脏中甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶活性低于正常下限。需注意存在多种甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶同工酶。

HP:0034694.name: Substantia nigra dopaminergic neuron loss
HP:0034694.definition: Degeneration and loss of neurons in the substantia nigra of the brain.
HP:0034694.name_cn: 黑质多巴胺能神经元丧失
HP:0034694.definition_cn: 黑质神经元变性和丧失。

HP:0034696.name: Intramuscular lipoma
HP:0034696.definition: A lipoma that is located within a muscle.

HP:0034697.name: Cutaneous telangiectasia
HP:0034697.definition: Dilated blood vessels on the skin.

HP:0034698.name: Abnormal aromatase activity
HP:0034698.definition: Aromatase activity outside of the normal range.
HP:0034698.definition_cn: 芳香化酶活性超出正常范围。

HP:0034699.name: Elevated aromatase activity
HP:0034699.definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034699.definition_cn: 芳香化酶酶活性高于正常值上限。

HP:0034700.name: Reduced aromatase activity
