HP:0034700.definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034700.definition_cn: 芳香化酶酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034701.name: Corneal amyloidosis
HP:0034701.definition: A form of amyloidosis that is located in the cornea.

HP:0034702.name: Abnormal keratinocyte morphology
HP:0034702.definition: Any structural anomaly of the keratinocyte. The keratinocyte is the major cell type of the epidermis and is responsible for generating the protective barrier.
HP:0034702.definition_cn: 角化细胞的结构异常。角化细胞是表皮的主要细胞类型，负责生成保护性屏障。

HP:0034703.name: Keratinocyte vacuolization
HP:0034703.definition: Increased number of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in keratinocytes.
HP:0034703.definition_cn: 角质形成细胞中空泡（由膜包被的细胞器，内部无细胞质，由膜衬里，并充满液体）数量增加。

HP:0034704.name: Parotid gland adenocarcinoma
HP:0034704.definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the parotid gland.

HP:0034705.name: Pulmonary vasculitis
HP:0034705.definition: Cellular inflammation, vessel destruction, and tissue necrosis of the blood vessels of the lung.
HP:0034705.definition_cn: 肺血管的细胞炎症、血管破坏及组织坏死。

HP:0034706.name: Reduced hepatic D-glycerate kinase activity
HP:0034706.definition: Activity of D-glycerate kinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034706.name_cn: 肝D-甘油酸激酶活性降低
HP:0034706.definition_cn: 肝脏中D-甘油酸激酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034707.name: Lymph-node hemophagocytosis
HP:0034707.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages in a lymph node.
HP:0034707.definition_cn: 淋巴结中组织细胞或巨噬细胞对红细胞、淋巴细胞或其他造血前体细胞的吞噬作用。

HP:0034708.name: Superior pubic ramus hypoplasia
HP:0034708.definition: Underdevelopment of the upper branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).
HP:0034708.definition_cn: 耻骨上支发育不全（耻骨下支）。

HP:0034709.name: Uterine adenofibroma
HP:0034709.definition: A rare benign mullerian mixed tumor of the uterus composed of benign epithelial and mesenchymal components.
HP:0034709.definition_cn: 一种罕见的子宫良性苗勒管混合性肿瘤，由良性上皮成分和间叶成分构成。

HP:0034710.name: Pulmonary hamartoma
HP:0034710.definition: A benign malformation of the lung that includes an abnormal mixture of tissue components such as cartilage, epithelium, fat, or muscle which are common to the lung but without preservation of the organ architecture.
HP:0034710.definition_cn: 肺良性畸形，包含异常混合的组织成分，如软骨、上皮、脂肪或肌肉，这些成分常见于肺部，但未保留器官结构。

HP:0034711.name: Peripheral axonal distension
HP:0034711.definition: An abnormal histological finding characterized by an increase in the cross-section area of peripheral nerve axons (up to 20-25 micrometers in diameter).
HP:0034711.definition_cn: 一种异常的组织学发现，其特征为周围神经轴突横截面积增加（直径可达20-25微米）。

HP:0034712.name: Decreased circulating alpha-mannosidase activity
HP:0034712.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:0034712.name_cn: 循环α-甘露糖苷酶活性降低
HP:0034712.definition_cn: 血液循环中α-甘露糖苷酶浓度或活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034713.name: Abnormal hepatocyte morphology
HP:0034713.definition: A structural anomaly of the hepatocyte, which is the main cell type that makes up the liver perncyhma. Hepatocytes are usually binucleated and appear as sheets in the liver tissue.
HP:0034713.definition_cn: 肝细胞结构异常，肝细胞是构成肝脏实质的主要细胞类型。肝细胞通常为双核，并在肝组织中呈片状分布。

HP:0034714.name: Hepatic melanin-like lysosomal pigmentation
HP:0034714.definition: Accumulation of dark, coarsely granular pigment localized in lysosomes of centrilobular hepatocytes.
HP:0034714.name_cn: 肝黑色素样溶酶体色素沉着
HP:0034714.definition_cn: 中央小叶肝细胞溶酶体内局灶性积聚的深色粗颗粒色素。

HP:0034715.name: Reduced uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
HP:0034715.definition: Activity of the enzyme uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase (UROD; EC 4.1.1.37) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034715.name_cn: 尿卟啉原脱羧酶活性降低
HP:0034715.definition_cn: 尿卟啉原脱羧酶（UROD；EC 4.1.1.37）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034716.name: Reduced heme oxygenase activity
HP:0034716.definition: Activity of the enzyme heme oxygenase below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034716.name_cn: 血红素加氧酶活性降低
HP:0034716.definition_cn: 血红素加氧酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034717.name: Swollen achromatic neurons in the cerebral cortex
HP:0034717.definition: The presence of enlarged and swollen neurons that lack Nissl bodies (the rough endoplasmic reticulum-achromasia refers to neurons that lack Nissl bodies) in the cortex of the brain.
HP:0034717.name_cn: 大脑皮质中的肿胀无色神经元
HP:0034717.definition_cn: 大脑皮质中存在神经元肿大且缺乏尼氏体（粗面内质网-染色质溶解是指缺乏尼氏体的神经元）。

HP:0034718.name: Vacuolated hepatocytes
HP:0034718.definition: Presence of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in hepatocytes, which normally rarely contain vacuoles.
HP:0034718.definition_cn: 肝细胞中出现空泡（由膜包裹的细胞器，内部无细胞质，由膜衬里，充满液体），而正常情况下肝细胞中极少含有空泡。

HP:0034719.name: Lack of oocyte pronucleus formation
HP:0034719.definition: An abnormality of oocyte maturation characterized by the inability of oocytes to form pronuclei after in vitro fertilization procedures. Oocytes normally show two pronuclei 17 to 20 hours after in vitro insemination.
HP:0034719.name_cn: 卵母细胞原核形成缺失
HP:0034719.definition_cn: 卵母细胞成熟异常，其特征为体外受精程序后卵母细胞无法形成原核。正常情况下，卵母细胞在体外受精后17至20小时会显示两个原核。

HP:0034720.name: Self-healing squamous epithelioma
HP:0034720.definition: A type of skin tumor that initially presents as a reddish macule and subsequently becomes papular, enlarged, ulcerated and ultimately heals leaving pitted scars.
HP:0034720.definition_cn: 一种皮肤肿瘤，最初表现为红斑，随后发展为丘疹、增大、溃疡，最终愈合后留下凹陷性瘢痕。

HP:0034721.name: Elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration
HP:0034721.definition: Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034721.name_cn: 循环中植烷酸浓度升高
HP:0034721.definition_cn: 血液循环中降植烷酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034722.name: Sarcoplasmic bodies
HP:0034722.definition: Rounded or oval structures that appeared brown on hematoxylin and eosin and red on the modified Gomori trichrome stain.
HP:0034722.definition_cn: 在苏木精和伊红染色中呈棕色的圆形或椭圆形结构，在改良的Gomori三色染色中呈红色。

HP:0034723.name: Elevated CSF hydroxyproline concentration
HP:0034723.name_cn: 脑脊液羟脯氨酸浓度升高

HP:0034724.name: Reduced CSF cystine concentration
HP:0034724.definition: Concentration of cystine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal. Cystine is sulfur-containing amino acid obtained by the oxidation of two cysteine molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.
HP:0034724.name_cn: 脑脊液胱氨酸浓度降低
HP:0034724.definition_cn: 脑脊液中胱氨酸浓度低于正常值下限。胱氨酸是一种含硫氨基酸，由两个半胱氨酸分子氧化后通过二硫键连接而成。

HP:0034725.name: Abnormal circulating beta-mannosidase activity
HP:0034725.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase outside normal limits. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.
HP:0034725.name_cn: 异常循环β-甘露糖苷酶活性
HP:0034725.definition_cn: β-甘露糖苷酶活性超出正常范围。β-甘露糖苷酶是一种溶酶体酶，负责分解寡糖。

HP:0034726.name: Elevated circulating beta-mannosidase activity
HP:0034726.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase above the upper limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.
HP:0034726.name_cn: 循环β-甘露糖苷酶活性升高
HP:0034726.definition_cn: β-甘露糖苷酶活性高于正常上限。β-甘露糖苷酶是一种溶酶体酶，负责分解寡糖。

HP:0034727.name: Reduced circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
HP:0034727.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034727.name_cn: 循环中α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性降低
HP:0034727.definition_cn: α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034728.name: Abnormal circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
HP:0034728.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.
HP:0034728.name_cn: 异常循环α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性
HP:0034728.definition_cn: 外周血液循环中α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性超出正常范围。

HP:0034729.name: Elevated circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
HP:0034729.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034729.name_cn: 循环中α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性升高
HP:0034729.definition_cn: α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性高于正常值上限。

HP:0034730.name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine concentration
HP:0034730.definition: Increased concentration of S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the blood circulation.
HP:0034730.name_cn: 循环中S-腺苷-L-同型半胱氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034730.definition_cn: 血液循环中S-腺苷-L-同型半胱氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0034731.name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl-L-methionine concentration
HP:0034731.definition: Concentration S-adenosyl-L-methionine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034731.name_cn: 循环中S-腺苷-L-甲硫氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034731.definition_cn: 循环血液中S-腺苷-L-蛋氨酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034732.name: Exercise-triggered malignant hyperthermia
HP:0034732.definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by exercise-induced life-threatening hyperthermia with a body temperature over 40 degrees C and signs of encephalopathy ranging from confusion to convulsions or coma. Incidence increases with rising ambient temperature and relative humidity. Manifestations may include rhabdomyolysis (presenting with myalgia, muscle weakness, and myoglobinuria), tachycardia, and in severe cases multiorgan failure.
HP:0034732.definition_cn: 恶性高热（Malignant Hyperthermia）以运动诱发的危及生命的高热为特征，体温超过40摄氏度，并伴有脑病症状，从意识模糊到惊厥或昏迷不等。其发病率随环境温度和相对湿度的升高而增加。临床表现可能包括横纹肌溶解症（表现为肌痛、肌无力和肌红蛋白尿）、心动过速，严重时可出现多器官功能衰竭。

HP:0034733.name: Anesthesic-triggered malignant hyperthermia
HP:0034733.definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature to 39-42 degrees C in response to inhalational anesthetics such as halothane or to muscle relaxants such as succinylcholine.
HP:0034733.definition_cn: 恶性高热，其特征为在接触吸入性麻醉剂（如氟烷）或肌肉松弛剂（如琥珀胆碱）后，体温迅速升高至39-42摄氏度。

HP:0034734.name: Elevated CSF argininosuccinic acid concentration
HP:0034734.definition: Concentration of argininosuccinic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034734.name_cn: 脑脊液精氨琥珀酸浓度升高
HP:0034734.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中精氨琥珀酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034735.name: Elevated CSF aspartylglucosamine concentration
HP:0034735.definition: Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034735.name_cn: 脑脊液天冬氨酰葡萄糖胺浓度升高
HP:0034735.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中天冬氨酰葡萄糖胺浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034736.name: Elevated circulating alpha-oxoadipic acid concentration
HP:0034736.definition: Concentration of alpha-oxoadipic acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034736.name_cn: 循环中α-酮己二酸浓度升高
HP:0034736.definition_cn: 血液中α-酮己二酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034737.name: Abnormal erythrocyte metabolite concentration
HP:0034737.definition: A deviation from the normal range of a metabolite in red blood cells.
HP:0034737.name_cn: 异常红细胞代谢物浓度
HP:0034737.definition_cn: 红细胞内代谢物浓度偏离正常范围。

HP:0034738.name: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione concentration
HP:0034738.definition: Concentration of glutathione in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Glutathione (GSH) is an important redox active biomolecule critical in the maintenance and regulation of cellular and organismal health.
HP:0034738.name_cn: 红细胞谷胱甘肽浓度降低
HP:0034738.definition_cn: 红细胞内谷胱甘肽浓度低于正常值下限。谷胱甘肽（GSH）是一种重要的氧化还原活性生物分子，对维持和调节细胞及机体健康至关重要。

HP:0034739.name: Elevated CSF sarcosine concentration
HP:0034739.definition: Concentration of sarcosine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034739.name_cn: 脑脊液肌氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034739.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中肌氨酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034740.name: Reduced CSF methionine concentration
HP:0034740.definition: Concentration of methionine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034740.name_cn: 脑脊液甲硫氨酸浓度降低
HP:0034740.definition_cn: 脑脊液中甲硫氨酸浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034741.name: Elevated circulating homoarginine concentration
HP:0034741.definition: Concentration of homoarginine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034741.name_cn: 循环同型精氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034741.definition_cn: 循环血液中同型精氨酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034742.name: Elevated urinary formiminoglutamic acid level
HP:0034742.definition: The concentration of formiminoglutamic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034742.name_cn: 尿中甲酰亚胺谷氨酸水平升高
HP:0034742.definition_cn: 尿液中亚胺甲基谷氨酸浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0034743.name: Elevated CSF proline concentration
HP:0034743.definition: Concentration of proline in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034743.name_cn: 脑脊液脯氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034743.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中脯氨酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034744.name: Elevated urinary S-sulfocysteine level
HP:0034744.definition: Level of S-sulfocysteine high in urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034744.name_cn: 尿液中S-磺基半胱氨酸水平升高
HP:0034744.definition_cn: 尿液中S-磺基半胱氨酸水平高于正常值上限。

HP:0034745.name: Elevated circulating S-sulfocysteine concentration
HP:0034745.definition: Concentration of S-sulfocysteine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034745.name_cn: 循环中S-磺基半胱氨酸浓度升高
HP:0034745.definition_cn: 血液循环中S-磺基半胱氨酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034746.name: Sertoli cell hyperplasia
HP:0034746.definition: Abnormal increase in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis.
HP:0034746.definition_cn: 睾丸中支持细胞数量异常增多。

HP:0034747.name: CSF infectious agent
HP:0034747.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0034747.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在感染性病原体。

HP:0034748.name: CSF mycobacteria
HP:0034748.definition: Mycobacterium present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). This feature can be ascertained by CSF microscopy.
HP:0034748.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在分枝杆菌。此特征可通过脑脊液显微镜检查确认。

HP:0034749.name: Fungal bloodstream infection
HP:0034749.definition: Detection of a fungal organism (such as candida or coccidioides) in the blood stream.
HP:0034749.definition_cn: 血液中真菌生物体（如念珠菌或球孢子菌）的检测。

HP:0034750.name: Supraclavicular lymphadenopathy
HP:0034750.definition: Enlarged lymph node located just above the clavicle (collarbone).

HP:0034751.name: Inguinal lymphadenopathy
HP:0034751.definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the inguinal region (groin).
HP:0034751.definition_cn: 位于腹股沟区的淋巴结肿大。

HP:0034752.name: Axillary lymphadenopathy
HP:0034752.definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the axillary region (armpit).
HP:0034752.definition_cn: 腋窝区（腋下）淋巴结肿大。

HP:0034753.name: Positive Murphy sign
HP:0034753.definition: Murphy's sign is elicited in patients with acute cholecystitis by asking the patient to take in and hold a deep breath while palpating the subcostal region. In practice, Murphy's sign is performed by palpating the subcostal region during inspiration. If pain is elicited and the patient suddenly stops their inspiratory effort, a positive Murphy's sign has been elicited.
HP:0034753.definition_cn: 墨菲征（Murphy's sign）在急性胆囊炎患者中通过让患者深吸气并屏住呼吸，同时触诊肋下区域来引出。实际操作中，墨菲征是在患者吸气时触诊肋下区域进行的。如果引发疼痛且患者突然停止吸气动作，则提示墨菲征阳性。

HP:0034754.name: Bilious emesis
HP:0034754.definition: Vomiting whereby the vomit has the color of bile, yellowish-green.
HP:0034754.definition_cn: 胆汁性呕吐，呕吐物呈黄绿色胆汁样。

HP:0034755.name: Ameliorated by NSAID
HP:0034755.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).
HP:0034755.definition_cn: 适用于通过非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）治疗而改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034756.name: Fetal exposure history
HP:0034756.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to a medication or other substance.
HP:0034756.definition_cn: 妊娠期母体暴露于药物或其他物质的历史。

HP:0034757.name: Fetal barbiturate exposure
HP:0034757.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to barbiturate medications such as phenobarbital. Barbiturates are used medically as anxiolytics, hypnotics, and anticonvulsants.
HP:0034757.name_cn: 胎儿巴比妥类药物暴露
HP:0034757.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲曾暴露于巴比妥类药物（如苯巴比妥）的病史。巴比妥类药物在医学上用作抗焦虑药、催眠药和抗惊厥药。

HP:0034758.name: Fetal narcotic exposure
HP:0034758.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to narcotic medications such as morphine or codeine. Narcotics are used medically to treat moderate or severe pain.
HP:0034758.definition_cn: 妊娠期母体暴露于麻醉药物（如吗啡或可待因）的病史。麻醉药物在医学上用于治疗中度或重度疼痛。

HP:0034759.name: Ameliorated by ethosuximide
HP:0034759.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of ethosuximide. Ethosuximide is most often used to treat absence seizures.
HP:0034759.definition_cn: 适用于通过给予乙琥胺而改善或减轻的体征或症状。乙琥胺最常用于治疗失神发作。

HP:0034760.name: Reduced epidermal extracellular matrix protein 1 protein expression
HP:0034760.definition: Lower than normal amount of extracellular matrix protein 1 (ECM1) in the epidermis.
HP:0034760.name_cn: 表皮细胞外基质蛋白1蛋白表达降低
HP:0034760.definition_cn: 表皮中细胞外基质蛋白1（ECM1）含量低于正常水平。

HP:0034761.name: Neurofibroma by anatomical location
HP:0034761.definition: Neurofibroma categorized according to the anatomical site of origin.
HP:0034761.name_cn: 按解剖部位分类的神经纤维瘤
HP:0034761.definition_cn: 神经纤维瘤根据解剖起源部位进行分类。

HP:0034762.name: Tongue neurofibroma
HP:0034762.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the tongue.
HP:0034762.definition_cn: 位于舌部的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘瘤）。

HP:0034763.name: Cardiac neurofibroma
HP:0034763.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the heart.
HP:0034763.definition_cn: 位于心脏的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘肿瘤）。

HP:0034764.name: Gastric neurofibroma
HP:0034764.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the stomach.
HP:0034764.definition_cn: 位于胃部的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘瘤）。

HP:0034765.name: Renal neurofibroma
HP:0034765.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the kidney.
HP:0034765.definition_cn: 位于肾脏的神经纤维瘤（良性周围神经鞘肿瘤）。

HP:0034766.name: Muscle fiber polyglucosan inclusion bodies
HP:0034766.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in muscle fibers.
HP:0034766.name_cn: 肌纤维多葡聚糖包涵体
HP:0034766.definition_cn: 肌纤维中积聚了分支不良且球形度差的支链淀粉样糖原（多聚葡萄糖）。

HP:0034767.name: Abnormal rete ridge morphology
HP:0034767.definition: Abnormal structure of the rete ridges (also known as rete pegs), which are downward projections of epithelium surrounding the connective tissue papillae in between the dermal papillae.
HP:0034767.definition_cn: 网状嵴（也称为网状钉突）结构异常，其为围绕真皮乳头间结缔组织乳头的上皮向下突起。

HP:0034768.name: Rete ridge elongation
HP:0034768.definition: Increased length of the rete rdiges of the epidermis.

HP:0034769.name: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis
HP:0034769.definition: Accumulation of monoclonal CD1a-positive Langerhans cells in the bronchioles and alveolar interstitium that can cause damage to the lungs.
HP:0034769.name_cn: 肺朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症
HP:0034769.definition_cn: 单克隆CD1a阳性朗格汉斯细胞在细支气管和肺泡间质中的积聚，可导致肺组织损伤。

HP:0034770.name: Lumbar hypolordosis
HP:0034770.definition: Flattening of a curve in the spine in the lumbar (lower back) region.
HP:0034770.definition_cn: 腰椎区域脊柱曲度变平。

HP:0034771.name: Battle sign
HP:0034771.definition: Battle sign is bruising over the mastoid process that is typically the result of head trauma. It is retroauricular or mastoid ecchymosis that is typically the result of head trauma. Battle sign typically requires significant head trauma and may indicate significant internal injury to the brain and not just the posterior cranial vault or mastoid.
HP:0034771.definition_cn: Battle征是乳突区瘀斑，通常由头部创伤引起。它是耳后或乳突区瘀斑，通常由头部创伤引起。Battle征通常需要显著的头部创伤，可能提示大脑内部存在严重损伤，而不仅仅是后颅窝或乳突区的损伤。

HP:0034772.name: Decreased skull base length
HP:0034772.definition: Reduced anterioposterior dimension of the skull base.

HP:0034773.name: Oscillopsia
HP:0034773.definition: A visual disturbance in which objects in the visual field appear to oscillate (jump, jiggle, vibrate).
HP:0034773.definition_cn: 一种视觉障碍，表现为视野中的物体出现振荡（跳动、抖动、振动）。

HP:0034774.name: Decreased blink rate
HP:0034774.definition: The frequency with which the eye is blinked is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034774.definition_cn: 眨眼频率低于正常下限。

HP:0034775.name: Abnormal blink rate
HP:0034775.definition: A deviation from the normal frequency of blinking the eye.

HP:0034776.name: Elevated blink rate
HP:0034776.definition: The frequecy with which the eye is blinked is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034776.definition_cn: 眨眼频率超过正常上限。

HP:0034778.name: Maternal hyperthyroidism
HP:0034778.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of hyperthyroidism during the corresponding pregnancy.
HP:0034778.name_cn: 母体甲状腺功能亢进症
HP:0034778.definition_cn: 胎儿或先证者的母亲在相应妊娠期间有甲状腺功能亢进病史。

HP:0034779.name: Perineal
HP:0034779.definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the perineum (the region of skin between the genitals and the anus).
HP:0034779.definition_cn: 适用于影响会阴部（生殖器与肛门之间的皮肤区域）的异常情况。

HP:0034780.name: Gadolinium exposure
HP:0034780.definition: History of exposure to gadolinium, a contrast medium often used for magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:0034780.definition_cn: 钆暴露史，钆是一种常用于磁共振成像的造影剂。

HP:0034781.name: Purulent parotid gland drainage
HP:0034781.definition: Excretion of pus (purulent discharge) from the opening of the parotid duct.
HP:0034781.definition_cn: 腮腺导管开口处脓性分泌物排出。

HP:0034782.name: Obstipation
HP:0034782.definition: Obstipation is the inability to pass either stool or flatus (gas).
HP:0034782.definition_cn: 便秘是指无法排出粪便或排气（气体）。

HP:0034784.name: Vasculitis by anatomical site
HP:0034784.definition: Vasculitis categorized according to the anatomical site where the finding is localized.
HP:0034784.name_cn: 按解剖部位分类的血管炎
HP:0034784.definition_cn: 根据病变解剖部位分类的血管炎。

HP:0034785.name: Vasculitis by histology
HP:0034785.definition: Vasculitis categorized according to type of histological abnormality.
HP:0034785.definition_cn: 根据组织学异常类型分类的血管炎。

HP:0034786.name: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
HP:0034786.definition: A type of vasculitis characterized by the presence of debris of neutrophils within the blood vessel walls.
HP:0034786.definition_cn: 一种以血管壁内存在中性粒细胞碎片为特征的血管炎。

HP:0034787.name: Accumulation of lipid droplets in small-bowel enterocytes
HP:0034787.name_cn: 小肠肠上皮细胞内脂滴积聚

HP:0034788.name: Pericardial friction rub
HP:0034788.definition: A pericardial friction rub is a grating, to-and-fro sound that occurs in phase with the heart sounds.
HP:0034788.definition_cn: 心包摩擦音是一种与心音同步的、来回的摩擦音。

HP:0034790.name: Abnormal muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
HP:0034790.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue.
HP:0034790.name_cn: 异常肌肉琥珀酸脱氢酶染色
HP:0034790.definition_cn: 骨骼肌组织中琥珀酸脱氢酶染色量的任何异常。

HP:0034791.name: Increased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
HP:0034791.name_cn: 肌肉琥珀酸脱氢酶染色增强

HP:0034792.name: Decreased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
HP:0034792.name_cn: 肌肉琥珀酸脱氢酶染色减少

HP:0034793.name: Small intestinal hamartoma
HP:0034793.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the small intestine.
HP:0034793.definition_cn: 一种良性（非癌性）肿瘤样畸形，由起源于小肠的异常混合细胞和组织构成。

HP:0034794.name: Pyriform sperm head
HP:0034794.definition: Pyriform spermatozoa consist of a normally shaped acrosomal structure which can be normal in size or enlarged, while the post-acrosomal region shows severe elongation and an acute narrowing to the posterior end, ending in about the same thickness as the connecting mid-piece.
HP:0034794.definition_cn: 梨形精子具有形态正常的顶体结构，其大小可为正常或增大，而顶体后区则呈现严重伸长并急剧向后端变窄，最终厚度与连接的中段大致相同。

HP:0034795.name: Excess residual spermatozoal cytoplasm
HP:0034795.definition: Excess residual cytoplasm is associated with abnormal spermatozoa produced from a defective spermiation process. This abnormal excess cytoplasm should not be confused with more physiological cytoplasmic residues that can be observed in direct microscopy of the ejaculate but not in dried, fixed and stained morphology smears.
HP:0034795.definition_cn: 过量的残余细胞质与由缺陷的精子释放过程产生的异常精子相关。这种异常的过量细胞质不应与在精液直接显微镜检查中观察到的更生理性的细胞质残留物混淆，后者在干燥、固定和染色的形态学涂片中不可见。

HP:0034796.name: Cardiomyocyte hyaline bodies
HP:0034796.definition: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions within the cytoplasm of cardiomyocytes.
HP:0034796.definition_cn: 心肌细胞胞质内肌膜下嗜酸性玻璃样区域。

HP:0034797.name: Hepatic hemophagocytosis
HP:0034797.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the liver.
HP:0034797.definition_cn: 在肝脏中观察到组织细胞或巨噬细胞对红细胞、淋巴细胞或其他造血前体细胞的吞噬作用。

HP:0034798.name: CSF hemophagocytosis
HP:0034798.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0034798.definition_cn: 在脑脊液（CSF）中观察到组织细胞或巨噬细胞对红细胞、淋巴细胞或其他造血前体细胞的吞噬作用。

HP:0034799.name: Splenic hemophagocytosis
HP:0034799.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the spleen.
HP:0034799.definition_cn: 脾脏中组织细胞或巨噬细胞对红细胞、淋巴细胞或其他造血前体细胞的吞噬现象。

HP:0034800.name: Urinary bladder granulomatosis
HP:0034800.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the urinary bladder as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.
HP:0034800.definition_cn: 根据病理学检查，膀胱内存在多个肉芽肿。肉芽肿是由称为上皮样细胞的修饰巨噬细胞组成的0.5至2毫米的小集合体，通常被淋巴细胞包围。

HP:0034801.name: Epidermal necrosis
HP:0034801.definition: Death of keratinocytes in the epidermis layer of the skin, which generally manifests as extensive exfoliation (separation of the epidermis from the underlying dermis).
HP:0034801.definition_cn: 表皮层角质形成细胞死亡，通常表现为广泛性表皮剥脱（表皮与真皮分离）。

HP:0034802.name: Exacerbated by flexion
HP:0034802.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) bending of a limb or joint.
HP:0034802.definition_cn: 应用于因肢体或关节弯曲而加重（或加剧疼痛）的体征或症状。

HP:0034803.name: Hemolacria
HP:0034803.definition: The presence of blood in tears.

HP:0034804.name: Corneal foreign body sensation
HP:0034804.definition: A perception that an object is in contact with the eye.

HP:0034805.name: Buttock pain
HP:0034805.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the buttock (round fleshy area at the lower rear area of a human trunk).
HP:0034805.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于臀部（人体躯干后下方圆形肉质区域）。

HP:0034806.name: Vaginal foreign body sensation
HP:0034806.definition: A perception that an object located in the vagina.

HP:0034807.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
HP:0034807.definition: Attacks of breathlessness that occur at night and may awaken the sleeping patient.
HP:0034807.definition_cn: 夜间阵发性呼吸困难，可能导致患者从睡眠中惊醒。

HP:0034808.name: Eyelid pain
HP:0034808.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eyelid.
HP:0034808.definition_cn: 一种以眼睑局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0034809.name: Abnormal sperm physiology
HP:0034809.definition: Abnormality of a sperm function including protection of paternal DNA, traversing the female reproductive tract, oocyte localisation, penetration of the zona pellucida, oocyte activation and centriole deposition.
HP:0034809.definition_cn: 精子功能异常，包括父源DNA保护、穿越女性生殖道、卵母细胞定位、透明带穿透、卵母细胞激活及中心粒沉积。

HP:0034810.name: Small acrosomal area
HP:0034810.definition: Reduction in size of the acrosome below the lower limit of normal. The acrosome is a unique membranous organelle located over the anterior part of the sperm nucleus. According to the World Health Organization criteria, the acrosome must be clearly visible, comprising approximately 40-70 percent of the sperm head.
HP:0034810.definition_cn: 顶体大小低于正常下限。顶体是一种独特的膜性细胞器，位于精子核的前部。根据世界卫生组织的标准，顶体必须清晰可见，约占精子头部的40-70%。

HP:0034811.name: Bent sperm flagella
HP:0034811.definition: The proportion of sperm cells whose flagella is sharply curved or has a sharp angle is above normal limits.
HP:0034811.definition_cn: 鞭毛呈锐角弯曲或存在锐角的精子细胞比例超出正常范围。

HP:0034812.name: Spermiation failure
HP:0034812.definition: Spermiation failure is indicated by apparently normal spermiogenesis, but the presence of retained Sd2 spermatids in stages III-V of human spermatogenesis, whereas maturation arrest is indicated by a lack of late Sd1 and Sd2 spermatids in the epithelium.
HP:0034812.definition_cn: 精子释放障碍表现为精子发生过程看似正常，但在人类精子发生的III-V阶段存在滞留的Sd2期精子细胞，而成熟阻滞则表现为上皮组织中缺乏晚期Sd1和Sd2期精子细胞。

HP:0034813.name: Hypospermatogenesis
HP:0034813.definition: A morphological abnormality visible upon biopsy of the germinal epithelium of the testis in which the cellularity of the germinal epithelium is reduced in general, so that all stages of germ cells (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, and spermatids) are present but reduced in number. This term applies to biopsies with some tubules showing diminished amounts of qualitatively complete spermatogenesis in combination with a vast majority of tubules that lack germ cells.
HP:0034813.definition_cn: 睾丸生精上皮活检中可见的形态学异常，表现为生精上皮细胞普遍减少，所有阶段的生殖细胞（精原细胞、精母细胞和精子细胞）均存在但数量减少。该术语适用于活检中部分曲细精管显示质量完整的精子发生减少，同时绝大多数曲细精管缺乏生殖细胞的情况。

HP:0034814.name: Conjunctival membrane
HP:0034814.definition: Formation of a sheet of tissue by coagulum of exudate over the conjunctiva of the eye that if removed leaves behind a denuded bleeding surface.
HP:0034814.definition_cn: 在眼结膜上，由渗出物凝固形成一层组织膜，若将其移除，会留下裸露的出血面。

HP:0034815.name: Extreme oligozoospermia
HP:0034815.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than zero but less than 2 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than zero but less than one million sperm per milliliter.
HP:0034815.definition_cn: 一种少精子症类型，其特征为射精液中精子总数大于零但少于200万，或每毫升精子浓度大于零但少于100万。

HP:0034816.name: Mild oligozoospermia
HP:0034816.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 30 but less than 39 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 10 but less than 15 million sperm per milliliter.
HP:0034816.definition_cn: 一种少精子症类型，其特征为射精液中精子总数超过3000万但少于3900万，或每毫升精子浓度超过1000万但少于1500万。

HP:0034817.name: Moderate oligozoospermia
HP:0034817.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 10 but less than 29 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 5 but less than 10 million sperm per milliliter.
HP:0034817.definition_cn: 一种少精症类型，其特征为射精液中精子总数大于1000万但少于2900万，或每毫升精子浓度大于500万但少于1000万。

HP:0034818.name: Severe oligozoospermia
HP:0034818.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 2 but less than 10 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 1 but less than 5 million sperm per milliliter.
HP:0034818.definition_cn: 一种少精子症类型，其特征为射精液中精子总数大于200万但少于1000万，或每毫升精子浓度大于100万但少于500万。

HP:0034819.name: Iris nodule
HP:0034819.definition: The presence of a nodule (small rounded lump of tissue) in the iris.
HP:0034819.definition_cn: 虹膜结节（虹膜内的小圆形组织肿块）的存在。

HP:0034820.name: Koeppe nodules
HP:0034820.definition: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie at the pupillary margin.
HP:0034820.definition_cn: 一种虹膜结节类型，由位于瞳孔边缘的炎性细胞沉淀物组成。

HP:0034821.name: Bussaca nodules
HP:0034821.definition: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie on the iris surface.
HP:0034821.definition_cn: 一种虹膜结节类型，由位于虹膜表面的炎性细胞沉淀物组成。

HP:0034823.name: Decreased CSF copper concentration
HP:0034823.definition: Concentration of copper in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034823.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中铜浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034824.name: Diffuse pulmonary lymphoid hyperplasia
HP:0034824.definition: Diffuse lymphoid hyperplasia (DLH) describes the pathological entity that lies between follicular bronchiolitis and lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia (LIP). It is pathologically characterized by a diffuse peribronchiolar proliferation of hyperplastic lymphoid follicles (BALT), extended along the lymphatics to involve the interlobular septa and pleura. Unlike LIP, DHL does not show uniform involvement of the alveolar septa.
HP:0034824.name_cn: 弥漫性肺淋巴组织增生
HP:0034824.definition_cn: 弥漫性淋巴组织增生（Diffuse lymphoid hyperplasia, DLH）是一种介于滤泡性细支气管炎（follicular bronchiolitis）和淋巴细胞性间质性肺炎（lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia, LIP）之间的病理实体。其病理特征表现为沿细支气管周围弥漫性增生的淋巴滤泡（支气管相关淋巴组织，BALT），并沿淋巴管延伸至小叶间隔和胸膜。与LIP不同，DLH不表现为肺泡间隔的均匀受累。

HP:0034825.name: Ameliorated by steroid medication
HP:0034825.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a steroid medication such as prednisone.
HP:0034825.name_cn: 糖皮质激素药物治疗后症状缓解
HP:0034825.definition_cn: 适用于通过使用类固醇药物（如泼尼松）治疗而得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:0034826.name: Triggered by medication exposure
HP:0034826.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of a medication.
HP:0034826.definition_cn: 适用于由药物给药引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0034827.name: Triggered by levothyroxin exposure
HP:0034827.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of levothyroxin (thyroid hormone).
HP:0034827.name_cn: 由左旋甲状腺素暴露引发
HP:0034827.definition_cn: 适用于由左旋甲状腺素（甲状腺激素）给药引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0034828.name: Reduced muscle laminin alpha-2 chain staining
HP:0034828.definition: A decreased amount of laminin alpha-2 chain in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.
HP:0034828.name_cn: 肌肉层粘连蛋白α2链染色减少
HP:0034828.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中层粘连蛋白α-2链含量减少。该特征可通过肌肉组织的免疫组织化学或蛋白质印迹法检测显示。

HP:0034829.name: Adrenal cortical sclerosis
HP:0034829.definition: Abnormal thickening of of the outer layer (cortex) of the adrenal gland due to fibrosis.
HP:0034829.definition_cn: 肾上腺皮质纤维化导致的异常增厚。

HP:0034830.name: Reduced hepatic fructose-1,6-phosphate aldolase activity
HP:0034830.definition: Concentration or activity of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034830.name_cn: 肝果糖-1,6-二磷酸醛缩酶活性降低
HP:0034830.definition_cn: 肝组织中1,6-二磷酸果糖醛缩酶浓度或活性低于正常下限。

HP:0034831.name: Pancreatic hamartoma
HP:0034831.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the pancreas.
HP:0034831.definition_cn: 胰腺良性（非癌性）肿瘤样畸形，由异常混合的细胞和组织构成，起源于胰腺。

HP:0034832.name: Liver angiomyolipoma
HP:0034832.definition: A benign liver neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.
HP:0034832.definition_cn: 一种由脂肪、血管和平滑肌成分组成的良性肝脏肿瘤。

HP:0034833.name: Cardiac lipoma
HP:0034833.definition: A lipoma that is located within a the heart.

HP:0034834.name: Peripheral nerve polyglucosan inclusion bodies
HP:0034834.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in peripheral nerve fibers.
HP:0034834.name_cn: 周围神经多葡聚糖包涵体
HP:0034834.definition_cn: 周围神经纤维中积聚了分支不良且球形度差的支链淀粉样糖原（多聚葡萄糖）。

HP:0034835.name: Cardiac polyglucosan accumulation
HP:0034835.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in myocardial tissue.
HP:0034835.definition_cn: 心肌组织中积聚了分支不良且球形度差的支链淀粉样糖原（多聚葡萄糖）。

HP:0034836.name: Cystic nephroma
HP:0034836.definition: A benign cystic neoplasm of the kidney.

HP:0034837.name: Absent dermal elastic fibers
HP:0034837.definition: Elastic fibers not demonstrable in skin biopsy.
HP:0034837.definition_cn: 皮肤活检中未显示弹性纤维。

HP:0034838.name: Cleavage at junction of stratum corneum and stratum granulosum
HP:0034838.definition: Splitting of the skin (cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes) localized to the interface between the stratum corneum and stratum granulosum layers of the epidermis.
HP:0034838.name_cn: 角质层与颗粒层交界处的裂解
HP:0034838.definition_cn: 皮肤裂隙（角质形成细胞的细胞间黏附）局限于表皮角质层与颗粒层交界处。

HP:0034839.name: Lymphoid hyperplasia
HP:0034839.definition: An abnormal bone marrow finding characterized by many poorly circumscribed and occasionally confluent lymphoid nodules. The nodules contain small and uniform lymphocytes with rounded nuclei, clumped chromatin, and without prominent nucleoli.
HP:0034839.definition_cn: 一种异常的骨髓发现，其特征为多个边界不清且偶有融合的淋巴结节。这些结节包含小而均匀的淋巴细胞，细胞核呈圆形，染色质呈团块状，且无明显核仁。

HP:0034840.name: Absence of epidermal lamellar bodies
HP:0034840.definition: Lack of lamellar bodies (LBs) inthe epidermis. LBs are specialized organelles that contain pro-barrier lipids imparting a fully lamellar internal structure, but also other cargoes such as enzymes (lipid metabolizing and proteolytic), enzyme inhibitors, and antimicrobial peptides.
HP:0034840.definition_cn: 表皮中缺乏板层小体（LBs）。板层小体是一种特殊的细胞器，内含促进屏障功能的脂质，赋予其完全板层化的内部结构，同时还包含其他成分，如酶类（脂质代谢酶和蛋白水解酶）、酶抑制剂以及抗菌肽。

HP:0034841.name: Gastrointestinal granulomatosis
HP:0034841.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the gastrointestinal tract (Pylorus, esophagus, jejunum, ileum, cecum, rectum, perirectal area, esophagus) as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.
HP:0034841.definition_cn: 根据病理学检查结果，胃肠道（幽门、食管、空肠、回肠、盲肠、直肠、直肠周围区域、食管）存在多发性肉芽肿。肉芽肿是由称为上皮样细胞的修饰巨噬细胞组成的0.5至2毫米的小集合体，通常被淋巴细胞包围。

HP:0034842.name: Enlarged sperm head vacuole
HP:0034842.definition: Increased size of sperm vacuoles, which are surface concavities typically located at the the tip or middle area of sperm heads. According to the WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen, sperm head vacuoles are considered abnormal when exceeding 20% of the cross-sectional area of the head. Vacuoles are found in almost all samples with normal sperm morphology; this term applies if the proportion of sperm with abnormally large vacuoles is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034842.definition_cn: 精子头部空泡增大，这些空泡通常位于精子头部的顶端或中部区域。根据《世界卫生组织人类精液检查与处理实验室手册》，当精子头部空泡超过头部横截面积的20%时，被视为异常。几乎所有具有正常精子形态的样本中均可发现空泡；若具有异常大空泡的精子比例超过正常上限，则适用此术语。

HP:0034843.name: Ureteral hamartoma
HP:0034843.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the ureter.
HP:0034843.definition_cn: 一种良性（非癌性）肿瘤样畸形，由起源于输尿管的异常混合细胞和组织构成。

HP:0034844.name: Fetal methimazole exposure
HP:0034844.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to methimazole.
HP:0034844.definition_cn: 妊娠期间母体接触甲巯咪唑的胎儿或儿童病史。

HP:0034845.name: Fetal procarbazine exposure
HP:0034845.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to procarbazine.
HP:0034845.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有接触丙卡巴肼的暴露史。

HP:0034846.name: Fetal fluorouracil exposure
HP:0034846.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to fluorouracil.
HP:0034846.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有氟尿嘧啶暴露史。

HP:0034847.name: Fetal cytarabine exposure
HP:0034847.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cytarabine.
HP:0034847.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有阿糖胞苷暴露史。

HP:0034848.name: Fetal tetracycline exposure
HP:0034848.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to tetracycline.
HP:0034848.definition_cn: 胎儿或儿童母亲在妊娠期间有接触四环素史。

HP:0034849.name: Fetal quinine exposure
HP:0034849.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to quinine.
HP:0034849.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有奎宁暴露史。

HP:0034850.name: Fetal cyclophosphamide exposure
HP:0034850.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cyclophosphamide.
HP:0034850.definition_cn: 妊娠期间母体接触环磷酰胺的胎儿或儿童暴露史。

HP:0034851.name: Fetal metronidazole exposure
HP:0034851.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to metronidazole.
HP:0034851.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有甲硝唑暴露史。

HP:0034852.name: Fetal phenobarbital exposure
HP:0034852.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenobarbital.
HP:0034852.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有苯巴比妥暴露史。

HP:0034853.name: Fetal phenytoin exposure
HP:0034853.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenytoin.
HP:0034853.definition_cn: 妊娠期间胎儿或儿童的母亲有苯妥英暴露史。

HP:0034854.name: Periumbilical
HP:0034854.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near the umbilicus (belly button).
HP:0034854.definition_cn: 适用于分布和外观位于或接近脐部（脐部）的异常。

HP:0034855.name: Maternal obesity during pregnancy
HP:0034855.definition: A history of obesity, which can be defined as a body mass index of 30 or greater, in the mother of a fetus or index patient.
HP:0034855.definition_cn: 母体肥胖史，定义为胎儿或索引患者的母亲体重指数（BMI）≥30。

HP:0034856.name: Maternal amniocentesis
HP:0034856.definition: A history of amniocentesis having been performed in the mother of a fetus or index patient.
HP:0034856.definition_cn: 胎儿或先证者母亲曾行羊膜穿刺术史。

HP:0034857.name: Typified by highly variable age of onset
HP:0034857.definition: Description of conditions in which age of onset is highly variable even in family members who share the same disease-associated variant or variants.
HP:0034857.name_cn: 以发病年龄高度变异为特征
HP:0034857.definition_cn: 描述在家族成员中即使共享相同疾病相关变异或变异组合，发病年龄仍存在高度变异性的情况。

HP:0034858.name: Abnormal leukocyte enzyme concentration or activity
HP:0034858.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme as measured in leukocytes is above or below the limits of normal.
HP:0034858.name_cn: 白细胞酶浓度或活性异常
HP:0034858.definition_cn: 白细胞中测定的酶浓度或活性高于或低于正常范围。

HP:0034859.name: Reduced tissue beta-glucuronidase activity
HP:0034859.definition: Concentration or activity of beta-glucuronidase (EC 3.2.1.31) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.
HP:0034859.name_cn: 组织β-葡萄糖醛酸酶活性降低
HP:0034859.definition_cn: β-葡萄糖醛酸苷酶（EC 3.2.1.31）浓度或活性低于正常下限。FECH酶可在多种组织中检测，包括培养的成纤维细胞和白细胞。

HP:0034860.name: Reduced leukocyte alpha-L-fucosidase activity
HP:0034860.definition: Concentration or activity of an alpha-L-fucosidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
HP:0034860.name_cn: 白细胞α-L-岩藻糖苷酶活性降低
HP:0034860.definition_cn: 白细胞中测得的α-L-岩藻糖苷酶浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。

HP:0034861.name: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase B activity
HP:0034861.definition: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase B as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
HP:0034861.name_cn: 白细胞芳基硫酸酯酶B活性降低
HP:0034861.definition_cn: 白细胞中测得的芳基硫酸酯酶B浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。

HP:0034862.name: Reduced leukocyte steroid sulfatase activity
HP:0034862.definition: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase C as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
HP:0034862.name_cn: 白细胞类固醇硫酸酯酶活性降低
HP:0034862.definition_cn: 白细胞中测得的芳基硫酸酯酶C浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。

HP:0034863.name: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase A activity
HP:0034863.definition: Concentration or activity of the lysosomal enzyme arylsulfatase A (EC 3.1.6.8) as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
HP:0034863.name_cn: 白细胞芳基硫酸酯酶A活性降低
HP:0034863.definition_cn: 白细胞中测得的溶酶体酶芳基硫酸酯酶A（EC 3.1.6.8）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。

HP:0034864.name: Decreased alpha-galactosidase A activity
HP:0034864.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-galactosidase outsidebelow the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034864.definition_cn: 酶α-半乳糖苷酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034865.name: Positive fecal parasite test
HP:0034865.definition: Demonstration of parasite in stool specimen, e.g., Parasites present on wet mount of stool.e
HP:0034865.definition_cn: 粪便样本中寄生虫的检测，例如：粪便湿涂片中寄生虫的存在。

HP:0034866.name: Positive stool infectious agent test
HP:0034866.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in stool positive.
HP:0034866.definition_cn: 粪便中任何类型病原体检测呈阳性。

HP:0034867.name: Positive stool giardia antigen
HP:0034867.definition: Test for giardia antigen in stool such as immune assay or DFA positive.
HP:0034867.definition_cn: 粪便中贾第虫抗原检测，如免疫测定或直接荧光抗体（DFA）阳性。

HP:0034868.name: Entamoeba histolytica antibody positive in stool
HP:0034868.definition: Demonstration of antibody directed against Entamoeba histolytica in stool.
HP:0034868.name_cn: 粪便中溶组织内阿米巴抗体阳性
HP:0034868.definition_cn: 粪便中抗溶组织内阿米巴抗体的检测。

HP:0034869.name: Reduced erythrocyte free porphyrin concentration
HP:0034869.definition: Concentration of porphyrin in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034869.name_cn: 红细胞游离卟啉浓度降低
HP:0034869.definition_cn: 红细胞内卟啉浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034870.name: Reduced circulating urocanic acid concentration
HP:0034870.definition: The concentration of urocanic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034870.definition_cn: 血液循环中尿刊酸浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034871.name: Decreased urinary epinephrine level
HP:0034871.definition: The concentration of epinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034871.definition_cn: 尿液中肾上腺素浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:0034872.name: Decreased CSF epinephrine concentration
HP:0034872.definition: Concentration of epinephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034872.name_cn: 脑脊液肾上腺素浓度降低
HP:0034872.definition_cn: 脑脊液中肾上腺素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034873.name: Decreased circulating epinephrine concentration
HP:0034873.definition: Concentration of epinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034873.name_cn: 循环肾上腺素浓度降低
HP:0034873.definition_cn: 循环血液中肾上腺素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034874.name: Decreased circulating norepinephrine concentration
HP:0034874.definition: Concentration of norepinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034874.name_cn: 循环去甲肾上腺素浓度降低
HP:0034874.definition_cn: 循环血液中去甲肾上腺素浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0034875.name: Decreased urinary norepinephrine level
HP:0034875.definition: The concentration of norepinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034875.name_cn: 尿去甲肾上腺素水平降低
HP:0034875.definition_cn: 尿中去甲肾上腺素浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，低于正常值下限。

HP:0034876.name: Decreased urinary metaepinephrine level
HP:0034876.definition: The concentration of metanephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034876.name_cn: 尿中变肾上腺素水平降低
HP:0034876.definition_cn: 尿液中甲氧基肾上腺素浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:0034877.name: Decreased CSF metanephrine concentration
HP:0034877.definition: Concentration of metanephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034877.name_cn: 脑脊液间甲肾上腺素浓度降低
HP:0034877.definition_cn: 脑脊液中甲氧基肾上腺素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034878.name: Decreased circulating metanephrine concentration
HP:0034878.definition: Concentration of metanephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034878.name_cn: 循环中甲氧基肾上腺素浓度降低
HP:0034878.definition_cn: 循环血液中甲氧基肾上腺素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034879.name: Ovarian mass
HP:0034879.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the ovary. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034879.definition_cn: 卵巢局部肿胀或增大。在诊断过程的早期阶段，在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质之前，通常使用“肿块”一词来描述。

HP:0034880.name: Adrenal mass
HP:0034880.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the adrenal gland. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034880.definition_cn: 肾上腺局部肿胀或增大。在诊断过程的早期阶段，在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质之前，通常使用“肿块”一词来描述。

HP:0034881.name: Uterine mass
HP:0034881.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034881.definition_cn: 子宫局部肿胀或增大。在诊断初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0034882.name: Prostatic calculus
HP:0034882.definition: Calcium deposits in the prostate gland.

HP:0034883.name: Decreased portal vein velocity
HP:0034883.definition: A reduction in the velocity of portal venous flow, generally measured by Doppler ultrasound. Portal venous flow is normally towards the liver with peak systolic velocities in the range of 20-40 cm/s.
HP:0034883.definition_cn: 门静脉血流速度降低，通常通过多普勒超声测量。门静脉血流通常朝向肝脏，收缩期峰值流速范围为20-40厘米/秒。

HP:0034884.name: Uterine cervix mass
HP:0034884.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the cervis of the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034884.definition_cn: 子宫颈局部肿胀或增大。在诊断工作初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0034885.name: Abnormal urinary uromodulin level
HP:0034885.definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for usine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0034885.name_cn: 尿液中尿调节蛋白水平异常
HP:0034885.definition_cn: 尿液中尿调节素（又称Tamm Horsfall蛋白）的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，超出正常范围。

HP:0034886.name: Decreased urinary uromodulin level
HP:0034886.definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034886.name_cn: 尿液中尿调节蛋白水平降低
HP:0034886.definition_cn: 尿液中尿调节素（亦称Tamm-Horsfall蛋白）的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，低于正常值下限。

HP:0034887.name: Increased urine phenylacetylglutamine level
HP:0034887.definition: The concentration of phenylacetylglutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034887.name_cn: 尿中苯乙酰谷氨酰胺水平升高
HP:0034887.definition_cn: 尿液中苯乙酰谷氨酰胺的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0034888.name: Decreased urine guanidinoacetic acid level
HP:0034888.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034888.name_cn: 尿中胍基乙酸水平降低
HP:0034888.definition_cn: 尿液中肌基乙酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:0034889.name: Positive urine infectious agent nucleic acid test
HP:0034889.definition: Detection of DNA and RNA originating from an infectious agent (bacteria, viruses, parasites and fungi) in the urine.
HP:0034889.name_cn: 尿液病原体核酸检测阳性
HP:0034889.definition_cn: 尿液中病原体（细菌、病毒、寄生虫和真菌）来源的DNA和RNA检测。

HP:0034890.name: Positive CMV urine nucleic acid test
HP:0034890.definition: Detection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:0034890.name_cn: 巨细胞病毒（CMV）尿液核酸检测阳性
HP:0034890.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测尿液中巨细胞病毒（Cytomegalovirus, CMV）核酸。

HP:0034891.name: Positive Neisseria gonorrhoeae urine nucleic acid test
HP:0034891.definition: Detection of Neisseria gonorrhoeae nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:0034891.name_cn: 淋病奈瑟菌尿液核酸检测阳性
HP:0034891.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测尿液中淋病奈瑟菌（Neisseria gonorrhoeae）的核酸。

HP:0034892.name: Positive enterovirus urine nucleic acid test
HP:0034892.definition: Detection of enterovirus nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:0034892.name_cn: 肠道病毒尿核酸阳性检测
HP:0034892.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应等方法检测尿液中的肠道病毒核酸。

HP:0034893.name: Elevated brain glycine level by MRS
HP:0034893.definition: An increase in the level of glycine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0034893.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内甘氨酸水平升高
HP:0034893.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内甘氨酸（Glycine）水平升高。

HP:0034894.name: Elevated brain polyol compounds by MRS
HP:0034894.definition: An increase in the level of polyol compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0034894.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）检测显示脑内多元醇化合物水平升高
HP:0034894.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内多元醇化合物水平升高。

HP:0034895.name: Elevated brain gamma-aminobutyric acid by MRS
HP:0034895.definition: An increase in the level of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0034895.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）水平升高
HP:0034895.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到大脑中γ-氨基丁酸（Gamma-Aminobutyric Acid, GABA）水平升高。

HP:0034896.name: History of recent anticoagulant ingestion
HP:0034896.definition: Medical history of ingestion of anticoagulants prior to presentation.
HP:0034896.definition_cn: 就诊前有抗凝药物服用史。

HP:0034897.name: Decreased circulating antidiuretic hormone concentration
HP:0034897.definition: Concentration of antidiuretic hormone, also known as vasopressin, is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:0034897.name_cn: 循环抗利尿激素浓度降低
HP:0034897.definition_cn: 抗利尿激素（也称为血管加压素）在血液循环中的浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034898.name: Elevated circulating growth hormone-releasing hormone concentration
HP:0034898.definition: Concentration of growth hormone-releasing hormone above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:0034898.name_cn: 循环中生长激素释放激素浓度升高
HP:0034898.definition_cn: 循环血液中生长激素释放激素浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034899.name: Abnormal amniotic fluid protein concentration
HP:0034899.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of a protein in the amniotic fluid from normal limits
HP:0034899.definition_cn: 羊水蛋白质浓度偏离正常范围

HP:0034900.name: Decreased amniotic fluid alpha-fetoprotein concentration
HP:0034900.definition: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the amniotic fluid below lower limit of normal.
HP:0034900.name_cn: 羊水甲胎蛋白浓度降低
HP:0034900.definition_cn: 羊水中甲胎蛋白浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034901.name: Increased circulating vitamin E concentration
HP:0034901.definition: Concentration of vitamin E in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034901.definition_cn: 血清维生素E浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0034902.name: Abnormal circulating calcitonin concentration
HP:0034902.definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.
HP:0034902.definition_cn: 降钙素浓度异常，降钙素是一种由32个氨基酸组成的多肽激素，主要由甲状腺滤泡旁细胞产生，其在血液循环中的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0034903.name: Decreased circulating calcitonin concentration
HP:0034903.definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034903.definition_cn: 血液中降钙素浓度低于正常值下限。降钙素是一种由32个氨基酸组成的多肽激素，主要由甲状腺滤泡旁细胞产生。

HP:0034904.name: Decreased circulating thyrotropin releasing hormone concentration
HP:0034904.definition: Concentration of thyrotropin releasing hormone below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:0034904.name_cn: 循环促甲状腺激素释放激素浓度降低
HP:0034904.definition_cn: 血液循环中促甲状腺激素释放激素浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0034905.name: Elevated circulating uroporphyrin concentration
HP:0034905.definition: Concentration of uroporphyrin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034905.definition_cn: 循环血液中尿卟啉浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0034906.name: Increased urine pentacarboxylporphyrin level
HP:0034906.definition: Concentration of pentacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034906.name_cn: 尿中五羧基卟啉水平升高
HP:0034906.definition_cn: 尿液中五羧基卟啉浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:0034907.name: Increased urine hexacarboxylporphyrin level
HP:0034907.definition: Concentration of hexacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034907.name_cn: 尿中六羧基卟啉水平升高
HP:0034907.definition_cn: 尿液中六羧基卟啉浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0034908.name: Increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
HP:0034908.definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034908.name_cn: 循环中脱氢表雄酮浓度升高
HP:0034908.definition_cn: 循环血液中脱氢表雄酮浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034909.name: Increased erythrocyte coproporphyrin concentration
HP:0034909.definition: Concentration of coproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034909.name_cn: 红细胞粪卟啉浓度升高
HP:0034909.definition_cn: 红细胞中粪卟啉浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034910.name: Increased erythrocyte uroproporphyrin concentration
HP:0034910.definition: Concentration of uroproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034910.name_cn: 红细胞尿卟啉浓度升高
HP:0034910.definition_cn: 红细胞中尿卟啉浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034911.name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein E concentration
HP:0034911.definition: Concentration of apolipoprotein E below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034911.name_cn: 循环载脂蛋白E浓度降低
HP:0034911.definition_cn: 载脂蛋白E浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034912.name: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein E concentration
HP:0034912.definition: Concentration of apolipoprotein E above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034912.name_cn: 循环载脂蛋白E浓度升高
HP:0034912.definition_cn: 载脂蛋白E浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034913.name: Acrosomal hypoplasia
HP:0034913.definition: Reduction in the size of the acrosome of the head of spermatozoa.
HP:0034913.definition_cn: 精子头部顶体体积缩小。

HP:0034914.name: Oocyte maturation arrest
HP:0034914.definition: Oocyte maturation arrest (OMA) can manifest as failed in vitro fetilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) attempts using affected oocytes.
HP:0034914.definition_cn: 卵母细胞成熟阻滞（Oocyte Maturation Arrest, OMA）可表现为使用受影响的卵母细胞进行体外受精/卵胞浆内单精子注射（In Vitro Fertilization/Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection, IVF/ICSI）尝试失败。

HP:0034915.name: Abnormal anus morphology
HP:0034915.definition: A structural anomaly of the anus.

HP:0034916.name: Abnormal anus physiology
HP:0034916.definition: A functional anomaly of the anus.

HP:0034917.name: Weak anal sphincter tone
HP:0034917.definition: Reduced muscle tone of the sphincter of the anus.

HP:0034918.name: Reduced muscle 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase activity
HP:0034918.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in muscle tissue.
HP:0034918.name_cn: 肌肉2,4-二烯酰辅酶A还原酶活性降低
HP:0034918.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中2,4-二烯酰辅酶A还原酶活性降低。

HP:0034919.name: Reduced liver 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase activity
HP:0034919.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in liver tissue.
HP:0034919.name_cn: 肝脏2,4-二烯酰辅酶A还原酶活性降低
HP:0034919.definition_cn: 肝组织中2,4-二烯酰辅酶A还原酶活性降低。

HP:0034920.name: Nasal mucosa vasculitis
HP:0034920.definition: Inflammation of blood vessels in the mucosa of the nasal cavity.

HP:0034921.name: Pituitary blastoma
HP:0034921.definition: Pituitary blastoma is a distinctive anterior hypophyseal tumor of infants
HP:0034921.definition_cn: 垂体母细胞瘤是一种独特的婴儿前垂体肿瘤。

HP:0034922.name: Peripheral axon spheroid formation
HP:0034922.definition: Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons.
HP:0034922.definition_cn: 轴突球状体是大多数退行性轴突上形成的泡状生物学特征。

HP:0034923.name: Reduced liver carboxylesterase 1 activity
HP:0034923.definition: Activity of the enzyme carboxylesterase 1 in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034923.name_cn: 肝脏羧酸酯酶1活性降低
HP:0034923.definition_cn: 肝脏组织中羧酸酯酶1活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034924.name: Abnormal dermis morphology
HP:0034924.definition: A structural anomaly of the dermis, the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer.
HP:0034924.definition_cn: 真皮结构异常，即位于表皮下方和皮下层上方的皮肤层。

HP:0034925.name: Perivascular dermis hyaline deposition
HP:0034925.definition: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the dermis layer of the skin.
HP:0034925.name_cn: 血管周围真皮玻璃样沉积
HP:0034925.definition_cn: 真皮层血管周围大量无定形透明（透明且均质）物质的沉积。

HP:0034926.name: Perivascular small intestinal hyaline deposition
HP:0034926.definition: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the wall of the small intestine.
HP:0034926.name_cn: 血管周围小肠玻璃样沉积
HP:0034926.definition_cn: 小肠壁血管周围大量无定形透明（透明且均质）物质的沉积。

HP:0034927.name: Large keratohyaline granules
HP:0034927.definition: Abnormally large keratohyalin granules (KHG). KHG are typically present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin (and epithelium of the mucosae). KHG are protein structures found in the keratinocytes of the stratum granulosum.
HP:0034927.definition_cn: 异常增大的透明角质颗粒（Keratohyalin Granules, KHG）。透明角质颗粒通常存在于皮肤表皮层（以及黏膜上皮）的颗粒层中。透明角质颗粒是颗粒层角质形成细胞中的蛋白质结构。

HP:0034928.name: Decreased muscle lipoic acid content
HP:0034928.definition: Reduced amount of lipoic acid in muscle tissue.
HP:0034928.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中硫辛酸含量降低。

HP:0034929.name: Reduced hepatic cystathionine gamma-lyase activity
HP:0034929.definition: Activity of cystathionine gamma-lyase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034929.name_cn: 肝胱硫醚γ-裂解酶活性降低
HP:0034929.definition_cn: 肝脏中胱硫醚γ-裂解酶活性低于正常下限。

HP:0034930.name: Digestive system neoplasm
HP:0034930.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the digestive system.
HP:0034930.definition_cn: 消化系统肿瘤（组织异常增生）。

HP:0034931.name: Lumbar spondylosis
HP:0034931.definition: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the lumbar vertebral column.
HP:0034931.definition_cn: 腰椎关节病，即退行性关节疾病，累及腰椎。

HP:0034932.name: Decreased circulating acid maltase activity
HP:0034932.definition: Activity of the enzyme acid maltase (also known as alpha-1,4-glucosidase) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034932.name_cn: 循环酸性麦芽糖酶活性降低
HP:0034932.definition_cn: 酸性麦芽糖酶（也称为α-1,4-葡萄糖苷酶）活性低于正常下限。

HP:0034933.name: obsolete Increased circulating ribitol concentration
HP:0034933.name_cn: 过时的 循环核糖醇浓度升高

HP:0034934.name: Abnormal circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
HP:0034934.definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.
HP:0034934.name_cn: 异常循环7-脱氢胆固醇浓度
HP:0034934.definition_cn: 血液循环中7-脱氢胆固醇浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0034935.name: Decreased circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
HP:0034935.definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034935.name_cn: 循环中7-脱氢胆固醇浓度降低
HP:0034935.definition_cn: 血液循环中7-脱氢胆固醇浓度低于正常下限。

HP:0034936.name: Elevated circulating lathosterol concentration
HP:0034936.definition: Concentration of lathosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034936.name_cn: 循环中羊毛甾醇浓度升高
HP:0034936.definition_cn: 血液中羊毛甾醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0034937.name: Elevated circulating desmosterol concentration
HP:0034937.definition: Concentration of desmosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034937.name_cn: 循环脱氢胆固醇浓度升高
HP:0034937.definition_cn: 循环血液中脱氢胆固醇浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0034938.name: Decreased circulating sialic acid concentration
HP:0034938.definition: Concentration of sialic acid in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034938.definition_cn: 血液循环中唾液酸浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0034939.name: Purulent synovial fluid
HP:0034939.definition: The synovial fluid (also known as synovia, i.e., the fluid found in the cavities of synovial joints) contains increased quantities of white blood cells.
HP:0034939.definition_cn: 滑液（亦称关节液，即存在于滑膜关节腔内的液体）中白细胞数量增加。

HP:0034940.name: Muscle fiber calsequestrin 1-containing inclusion bodies
HP:0034940.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that demonstrate immunoreactivity for calsequestrin 1.
HP:0034940.name_cn: 肌纤维钙结合蛋白1包涵体
HP:0034940.definition_cn: 肌细胞胞质内存在对钙螯合蛋白1（calsequestrin 1）具有免疫反应性的包涵体。

HP:0034941.name: Palatine myxoma
HP:0034941.definition: A myxoma (A benign tumor composed of myxomatous tissue composed of loosely-arranged spindle, polygonal, and stellate cells) localized to the palate. Clinically, such tumors may present as a sessile nodule on the hard palate.
HP:0034941.definition_cn: 腭部黏液瘤（一种由黏液样组织构成的良性肿瘤，组织由松散排列的梭形、多边形和星形细胞组成）。临床上，此类肿瘤可表现为硬腭上的无蒂结节。

HP:0034942.name: Vaginal myxoma
HP:0034942.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized in the vagina.
HP:0034942.definition_cn: 阴道黏液瘤（原始结缔组织肿瘤）。

HP:0034943.name: Decreased dermal collagen
HP:0034943.definition: Abnormally reduced amount of collagen fibers in the dermis.
HP:0034943.definition_cn: 真皮层胶原纤维异常减少。

HP:0034944.name: Irregularly shaped keratohyaline granules
HP:0034944.definition: Abnormal shape of keratohyaline granules in dermal keratinocytes.
HP:0034944.name_cn: 不规则形状的透明角质颗粒
HP:0034944.definition_cn: 皮肤角质形成细胞中透明角质颗粒形态异常。

HP:0034945.name: Tubular shadows
HP:0034945.definition: Tubular shadows are characterized by a complete absence of cells in the testicular tubules, meaning that germ cells as well as somatic Sertoli cells are absent. The cells have been replaced by hyalinization.
HP:0034945.definition_cn: 管状阴影的特征是睾丸小管中完全缺乏细胞，这意味着生殖细胞以及体细胞支持细胞均不存在。这些细胞已被透明样变所取代。

HP:0034946.name: Multiple eyelid margin cysts
HP:0034946.definition: Presence of many apocrine hidrocystoma (cysts) on the margins of the eyelids.
HP:0034946.definition_cn: 眼睑边缘存在多个大汗腺囊腺瘤（囊肿）。

HP:0034947.name: Altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath
HP:0034947.definition: The fibrous sheath is a structure in the midpiece of the sperm flagellum surrounding the outer dense fibers. It comprises two longitudinal columns and transverse ribs. In case of altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath the symmetrical structure is lost, most commonly with the columns not being opposite to each other, which can be visualized by electron microscopy.
HP:0034947.name_cn: 纤维鞘内纵柱位置改变
HP:0034947.definition_cn: 纤维鞘是精子鞭毛中段围绕外周致密纤维的结构。它由两条纵向柱和横向肋组成。当纤维鞘中纵向柱的位置发生改变时，对称结构会丧失，最常见的情况是两条纵向柱不再相对，这可以通过电子显微镜观察到。

HP:0034948.name: Uterine myxoma
HP:0034948.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the uterus.
HP:0034948.definition_cn: 子宫黏液瘤（原始结缔组织肿瘤）。

HP:0034949.name: Uterine cervix myxoma
HP:0034949.definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the the cervix of the uterus.
HP:0034949.definition_cn: 子宫颈粘液瘤（原始结缔组织肿瘤）。

HP:0034950.name: Typified by complete penetrance
HP:0034950.definition: Penetrance describes the proportion of genotype positive individuals that develop disease given a lifespan of 80 years. For example, penetrance of Neurofibromatosis type 1 is close to 100%.
HP:0034950.definition_cn: 外显率（Penetrance）描述了在80年寿命内，基因型阳性个体发展为疾病的比例。例如，1型神经纤维瘤病（Neurofibromatosis type 1）的外显率接近100%。

HP:0034951.name: Osteochondromyxoma
HP:0034951.definition: A rare benign chondroid and osteoid matrix-producing neoplasm of bone characterized by extensive myxoid changes. OMX originate from bony cortices and have been observed in the nasal region, as well as the tibia and radius.
HP:0034951.definition_cn: 一种罕见的良性软骨样和骨样基质生成性骨肿瘤，其特征为广泛的黏液样改变。骨黏液样瘤（OMX）起源于骨皮质，并已在鼻部、胫骨和桡骨区域观察到。

HP:0034952.name: Gangliocytoma
HP:0034952.definition: A low-grade central nervous system tumor composed of dysplastic ganglion cells, usually presenting in children or young adults and located in the cerebral hemispheres.
HP:0034952.definition_cn: 一种低级别中枢神经系统肿瘤，由发育不良的神经节细胞构成，通常见于儿童或年轻成人，位于大脑半球。

HP:0034953.name: Duodenal gastrinoma
HP:0034953.definition: A gastrinoma, a neuroendocrine tumors characterized by the secretion of gastrin with resultant excessive gastric acid production, that is localized to the duodenum.
HP:0034953.definition_cn: 胃泌素瘤，一种神经内分泌肿瘤，其特征为分泌胃泌素，导致胃酸分泌过多，且定位于十二指肠。

HP:0034954.name: Thymic carcinoid tumor
HP:0034954.definition_cn: 原发性胸腺神经内分泌肿瘤。

HP:0034955.name: Bone marrow eosinophilia
HP:0034955.definition: Count of eosinophils in the bone marrow above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034955.name_cn: 骨髓嗜酸性粒细胞增多症
HP:0034955.definition_cn: 骨髓中嗜酸性粒细胞计数高于正常上限。

HP:0034956.name: Exacerbated by lithium exposure
HP:0034956.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with lithium.
HP:0034956.name_cn: 锂暴露导致的病情加重
HP:0034956.definition_cn: 锂治疗加重的体征或症状。

HP:0034957.name: Reduced hepatic glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
HP:0034957.definition: Activity of glycogen debrancher enzyme (also known as amylo-1,6-glucosydase, 4-alpha-glucantransferase) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034957.name_cn: 肝糖原脱支酶活性降低
HP:0034957.definition_cn: 肝组织中糖原脱支酶（亦称淀粉-1,6-葡萄糖苷酶，4-α-葡聚糖转移酶）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034958.name: Asymmetrical insertion of the midpiece into the head
HP:0034958.definition: Insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon on an axis that diverges from the midline axis of the spermatozoon head. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034958.name_cn: 中段与头部的非对称性插入
HP:0034958.definition_cn: 精子头部中轴线偏离的颈部和中段插入。若具有此缺陷的精子比例超出正常上限，则适用此术语。

HP:0034959.name: Bent sperm neck
HP:0034959.definition: Sharply angled insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this feature is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034959.definition_cn: 精子头部与颈部及中段呈锐角插入。若具有此特征的精子比例超过正常上限，则适用此术语。

HP:0034960.name: Elevated urine 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid level
HP:0034960.definition: The concentration of 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0034960.name_cn: 尿液中3,6-环氧二羧酸水平升高
HP:0034960.definition_cn: 尿液中3,6-环氧二羧酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0034961.name: Gallbladder biliary sludging
HP:0034961.definition: Presence of biliary sludge (a mixture of particulate solids that have precipitated from bile) in the gallbladder. Such sediment consists of cholesterol crystals, calcium bilirubinate pigment, and other calcium salts. Sludge is usually detected on transabdominal ultrasonography.
HP:0034961.definition_cn: 胆囊内存在胆泥（由胆汁中沉淀的颗粒状固体混合物）。此类沉积物由胆固醇结晶、胆红素钙色素及其他钙盐组成。胆泥通常通过经腹超声检查发现。

HP:0034962.name: Exacerbated by amiodarone exposure
HP:0034962.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with amiodarone.
HP:0034962.name_cn: 胺碘酮暴露导致的病情加重
HP:0034962.definition_cn: 应用于因胺碘酮治疗而加重的体征或症状。

HP:0034963.name: Ureteral mass
HP:0034963.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the ureter. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034963.definition_cn: 输尿管局部肿胀或增大。在诊断检查的早期阶段，在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质之前，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0034964.name: Wide cavum septum pellucidum
HP:0034964.definition: Width of the cavum septum pellucidum above the upper limit of normal, which is defined as a separation of greater than one cm of the leaves of the cavum septum pellucidum.
HP:0034964.definition_cn: 透明隔腔宽度超过正常上限，定义为透明隔腔叶间距大于1厘米。

HP:0034965.name: Hypoplastic trochlear nerve
HP:0034965.definition: Underdevelopment of the trochlear nerve, which is the fourth cranial nerve and one of the ocular motor nerves that controls eye movement.
HP:0034965.definition_cn: 滑车神经发育不全，滑车神经为第四对脑神经，是控制眼球运动的动眼神经之一。

HP:0034966.name: Thymic cyst
HP:0034966.definition: A closed sac of tissue (cyst) located in the thymus. Thymic cysts are a rare, benign anomaly, are usually asymptomatic, and mostly occur in the anterior mediastinum .
HP:0034966.definition_cn: 位于胸腺内的封闭性组织囊（囊肿）。胸腺囊肿是一种罕见的良性异常，通常无症状，且多发生于前纵隔。

HP:0034967.name: Uterine cyst
HP:0034967.definition: A closed sack of tissue (cyst) located in the uterus.

HP:0034968.name: Urinary bladder mass
HP:0034968.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the urinary bladder. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034968.definition_cn: 膀胱局部肿胀或增大。在诊断工作初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0034969.name: Endosteal scalloping
HP:0034969.definition: A series of indentations or erosions on a normally smooth margin of the inner layer of the cortex (i.e. the endosteum) of bones.
HP:0034969.definition_cn: 骨皮质内层（即骨内膜）正常光滑边缘上的一系列凹陷或侵蚀。

HP:0034970.name: Urinary bladder hamartoma
HP:0034970.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the urinary bladder.
HP:0034970.definition_cn: 一种良性（非癌性）肿瘤样畸形，由起源于膀胱的异常混合细胞和组织构成。

HP:0034971.name: Peritoneal mass
HP:0034971.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the peritoneal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034971.definition_cn: 局限于腹膜腔的肿胀或增大。在诊断过程的早期阶段，通常在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质之前，使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0034972.name: Fallopian tube mass
HP:0034972.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the Fallopian tube. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:0034972.definition_cn: 输卵管局部肿胀或增大。在诊断工作初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:0034973.name: Aplasia of the pyramids of the medulla oblongata
HP:0034973.definition: Congenital absence of the pyramids, that is, of the paired structures located at the medial aspect of the ventral medulla that flank the anterior median fissure.
HP:0034973.definition_cn: 先天性锥体缺失，即位于腹侧延髓内侧、前正中裂两侧的成对结构缺失。

HP:0034974.name: Bathrocephaly
HP:0034974.definition: A deformity of the posterior skull with bulging of the midportion of the occipital bone that is often associated with a benign variant of the mendosal suture.
HP:0034974.definition_cn: 后颅骨畸形，伴枕骨中部膨出，常与门多萨缝的良性变异相关。

HP:0034975.name: Occipital horn
HP:0034975.definition: Downward pointing exostoses of the occipital bone situated in the tendinous insertions of the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles.
HP:0034975.definition_cn: 位于胸锁乳突肌和斜方肌肌腱附着处的枕骨向下突出的外生骨疣。

HP:0034976.name: Absent pituitary stalk
HP:0034976.definition: A developmental defect characterized by failure to develop of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.
HP:0034976.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为垂体柄未能发育。垂体柄，也称为漏斗或漏斗柄，是下丘脑与垂体之间的连接结构。

HP:0034977.name: Abnormal pituitary stalk morphology
HP:0034977.definition: A structural anomaly of the pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.
HP:0034977.definition_cn: 垂体柄结构异常，也称为漏斗部或漏斗柄，是下丘脑与垂体之间的连接部分。

HP:0034978.name: Interrupted pituitary stalk
HP:0034978.definition: A developmental defect characterized by a discontinuity of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.
HP:0034978.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为垂体柄的连续性中断。垂体柄，也称为漏斗或漏斗柄，是下丘脑与垂体之间的连接结构。

HP:0034979.name: Facial synkinesis
HP:0034979.definition: Unintentional movement in one area of the face produced during intentional movement of another area of the face.
HP:0034979.definition_cn: 面部某一区域在有意运动时引发的另一区域的无意识运动。

HP:0034980.name: Synkinesis
HP:0034980.definition: Unintentional movement in one area of the body produced during intentional movement of another area of the body.
HP:0034980.definition_cn: 一个身体区域在另一个身体区域进行有意识运动时产生的无意识运动。

HP:0034982.name: Perianal anethesia
HP:0034982.definition: Loss of sensation to the area of buttocks, perianal space and thighs.
HP:0034982.definition_cn: 臀部、肛周区域及大腿感觉丧失。

HP:0034983.name: Failure of phenylephrine to induce blanching of eye redness
HP:0034983.definition: Instillation of 2.5% phenylephrine drops into the eye does not induce blanching of eye redness. Failure to blanch suggests redness caused by scleral vessel engorgement (e.g., scleritis) or extravascular cause (e.g., hemorrhage), not episcleritis or conjunctivitis.
HP:0034983.name_cn: 去氧肾上腺素未能诱导眼部充血消退
HP:0034983.definition_cn: 将2.5%去氧肾上腺素滴眼液滴入眼内未能引起眼红消退。未能消退提示眼红由巩膜血管充血（如巩膜炎）或血管外原因（如出血）引起，而非表层巩膜炎或结膜炎。

HP:0034984.name: Fetal alcohol exposure
HP:0034984.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to ethanol (alcohol).
HP:0034984.definition_cn: 妊娠期母体暴露于乙醇（酒精）的胎儿或儿童病史。

HP:0034985.name: Reduced cellular cobalamin uptake
HP:0034985.definition: Diminished ability of cells to transport cobalamine from the extracellular space to the cytoplasm.
HP:0034985.definition_cn: 细胞将钴胺素从细胞外空间转运至细胞质的能力减弱。

HP:0034986.name: Focal necrotic brainstem lesion
HP:0034986.definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the brainstem.
HP:0034986.name_cn: 局灶性脑干坏死性病变
HP:0034986.definition_cn: 脑干局部细胞坏死，常伴有炎性细胞浸润。

HP:0034987.name: Focal necrotic optic nerve lesion
HP:0034987.definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the optic nerve.
HP:0034987.name_cn: 局灶性坏死性视神经病变
HP:0034987.definition_cn: 视神经局部细胞坏死，常伴有炎性细胞浸润。

HP:0034988.name: Focal necrotic thalamus lesion
HP:0034988.definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the thalamus.
HP:0034988.name_cn: 局灶性丘脑坏死性病变
HP:0034988.definition_cn: 丘脑局部细胞坏死，常伴有炎性细胞浸润。

HP:0034989.name: Interstitial dermal edema
HP:0034989.definition: Accumulation of fluid in the interstitial spaces of the skin. This finding can be appreciated my microscopic examination of a skin biopsy.
HP:0034989.definition_cn: 皮肤间质间隙内液体积聚。此现象可通过皮肤活检的显微镜检查得以确认。

HP:0034991.name: Shoulder external rotation contracture
HP:0034991.definition: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by decreased internal rotation of shoulder, that is, by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability to internally rotate the humerus at the shoulder joint (if the arm is flexed at the elbow, Internal rotation of the shoulder rotates the forearm towards the center of the body).
HP:0034991.definition_cn: 一种肩关节挛缩类型，其特征为肩关节内旋功能减退，即肱骨在肩关节处的主动和被动内旋能力长期降低（若肘关节屈曲，肩关节内旋使前臂向身体中线旋转）。

HP:0034992.name: Thumb adduction contracture
HP:0034992.definition: A type of thumb contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability of the metacarpal-phalangeal and/or interphalangeal joints of the thumb to bring from medial side to neutral position, where the neutral position for the thumb is when the distal and proximal segments of the thumb joint are in linear alignment.
HP:0034992.definition_cn: 一种拇指挛缩类型，其特征为拇指掌指关节和/或指间关节主动和被动活动能力慢性减退，无法从内侧位置恢复到中立位，其中拇指的中立位是指拇指关节的远端和近端节段呈线性对齐状态。

HP:0034994.name: obsolete Elevated circulating saccharopine concentration
HP:0034994.name_cn: 过时的 循环中升高的萨卡洛平浓度

HP:0034995.name: Reduced tissue fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase activity
HP:0034995.definition: Activity of fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase (EC 3.1.3.11) below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver and leukocytes.
HP:0034995.name_cn: 组织果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶活性降低
HP:0034995.definition_cn: 果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶（EC 3.1.3.11）活性低于正常下限。该酶活性可在多种组织中测定，包括肝脏和白细胞。

HP:0034996.name: Reduced hepatic carbamoylphosphate synthetase 1 activity
HP:0034996.definition: Activity of carbamoylphosphate synthetase 1 in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0034996.name_cn: 肝内氨甲酰磷酸合成酶1活性降低
HP:0034996.definition_cn: 肝脏中氨基甲酰磷酸合成酶1活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0034997.name: Reduced intraepidermal small nerve fiber density
HP:0034997.definition: Reduced number of small nerve fibers in the skin.
HP:0034997.name_cn: 表皮内小神经纤维密度降低
HP:0034997.definition_cn: 皮肤小神经纤维数量减少。

HP:0034998.name: Femoral artery duplication
HP:0034998.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the presence of a supernumerary femoral artery.
HP:0034998.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征为存在一条额外的股动脉。

HP:0034999.name: Intracellular accumulation of collagen VII
HP:0034999.definition: Collagen VII is the major molecular constituent of anchoring fibrils in the skin. Collagen VII is synthesized as three identical pro-alpha1(VII) polypeptide chains, which are hydroxylated and glycosylated in a coordinated manner and then fold into triple-helical procollagen VII in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). Mature collagen VII undergoes a multistep fibril polymerization process to form the anchoring fibrils. Mutant pro-alpha1(VII) polypeptide chains or procollagen VII molecules do not pass the ER quality control and are retained in the ER or designated for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation resulting in reduced amounts of collagen VII in the skin.
HP:0034999.name_cn: 细胞内胶原蛋白VII的积聚
HP:0034999.definition_cn: VII型胶原是皮肤中锚定纤维的主要分子成分。VII型胶原以三条相同的pro-α1(VII)多肽链形式合成，这些多肽链在内质网（ER）中经过协调的羟基化和糖基化后，折叠成三螺旋结构的VII型前胶原。成熟的VII型胶原经历多步骤的纤维聚合过程，形成锚定纤维。突变的pro-α1(VII)多肽链或VII型前胶原分子无法通过内质网的质量控制，被保留在内质网中或被标记为泛素-蛋白酶体降解，导致皮肤中VII型胶原的含量减少。

HP:0035000.name: Reduced reticular lamina anchoring fibril density
