HP:0035000.definition: Diminished amount of the anchoring fibrils in the basement membrane zone that normally attach the epithelium to the basement membrane.
HP:0035000.name_cn: 网状层锚定纤维密度降低
HP:0035000.definition_cn: 基底膜区锚定纤维数量减少，这些纤维通常将上皮细胞固定于基底膜。

HP:0035001.name: Reduced lamina lucida anchoring filament density
HP:0035001.definition: Diminished amount of the anchoring filaments that normally bridge the lamina lucida and insert into the lamina densa in the cutaneous basement membrane zone.
HP:0035001.name_cn: 基板透明层锚定纤维密度降低
HP:0035001.definition_cn: 皮肤基底膜区中，通常连接透明层并插入致密层的锚定纤维数量减少。

HP:0035002.name: Reduced epidermal keratin 5 protein expression
HP:0035002.definition: Amount of keratin 5 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.
HP:0035002.name_cn: 表皮角蛋白5蛋白表达降低
HP:0035002.definition_cn: 表皮中角蛋白5的含量低于正常下限。该发现通常通过免疫荧光显微镜检查确认。

HP:0035003.name: Reduced epidermal keratin 14 protein expression
HP:0035003.definition: Amount of keratin 14 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.
HP:0035003.name_cn: 表皮角蛋白14蛋白表达降低
HP:0035003.definition_cn: 表皮中角蛋白14的含量低于正常下限。该结果通常通过免疫荧光显微镜检查确定。

HP:0035004.name: Reduced epidermal keratin protein expression
HP:0035004.definition: Amount of one or more keratins in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.
HP:0035004.definition_cn: 表皮中一种或多种角蛋白含量低于正常下限。该发现通常通过免疫荧光显微镜检查确定。

HP:0035005.name: Reduced hepatic alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase activity
HP:0035005.definition: Activity of alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0035005.name_cn: 肝丙氨酸-乙醛酸氨基转移酶活性降低
HP:0035005.definition_cn: 肝脏中丙氨酸-乙醛酸氨基转移酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:0035006.name: Hepatic sinusoidal dilatation
HP:0035006.definition: Presence of an increased amount of blood in the hepatic capillaries.
HP:0035006.definition_cn: 肝毛细血管内血液量增多。

HP:0035007.name: Thin spermatozoon midpiece
HP:0035007.definition: The cross-sectional size (diameter) of the midpiece of the spermatozoon is below the lower limit of normal. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035007.definition_cn: 精子中段横截面尺寸（直径）低于正常下限。若具有此缺陷的精子比例超过正常上限，则适用此术语。

HP:0035008.name: Thick spermatozoon midpiece insertion
HP:0035008.definition: Increased width of the midpiece of the spermatozoon. The midpiece is the structure that is located between the head and the flagella (tail) of the spermatozoon. This term applies if the width of the midpiece increases progressively from the flagella to the head and if the proportion of individual spermatozoa with this anomaly is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035008.definition_cn: 精子中段宽度增加。中段是位于精子头部与鞭毛（尾部）之间的结构。若中段宽度从鞭毛向头部逐渐增加，且具有此异常的精子比例超过正常上限，则适用此术语。

HP:0035009.name: Shoulder adduction contracture
HP:0035009.definition: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in the active and passive ability to abduct the shoulder. This results in the shoulders being closer to midline. The affected individual is not able to position the shoulders away from the body.
HP:0035009.definition_cn: 一种肩关节挛缩类型，其特征为肩关节主动及被动外展能力慢性减退。这导致双肩更靠近中线。受累个体无法将肩部远离身体定位。

HP:0035010.name: Occupational exposure history
HP:0035010.definition: Exposure to a substance that results from the performance of an employee's duties.

HP:0035011.name: Occupational silver exposure
HP:0035011.definition: A history of exposure to silver that has occurred in relation to performance of job duties.

HP:0035012.name: Abnormal femoral artery morphology
HP:0035012.definition: Any structural abnormality of the femoral artey, a large blood vessel that provides oxygenated blood to lower extremity structures and in part to the lower anterior abdominal wall.
HP:0035012.definition_cn: 股动脉结构异常，股动脉是一条主要血管，负责向下肢结构及部分下腹前壁输送含氧血液。

HP:0035014.name: Extrahepatic bile duct fibrosis
HP:0035014.definition: Accumulation of fibrous connective tissue (collagen) in the extrahepatic bile ducts.
HP:0035014.definition_cn: 肝外胆管纤维结缔组织（胶原）积聚。

HP:0035015.name: Elevated circulating short-chain acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035015.definition: Concentration of short-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Short chain acylcarnitines have between two and five carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C2-C5),
HP:0035015.name_cn: 循环短链酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035015.definition_cn: 血液中短链酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。酰基肉碱根据酰基链中碳原子数分类。短链酰基肉碱的酰基链中含有二至五个碳原子（C2-C5）。

HP:0035016.name: Elevated circulating C4 acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035016.definition: Concentration of C4 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C4 acylcarnitines have a four-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035016.name_cn: 循环中C4酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035016.definition_cn: 血液中C4酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。C4酰基肉碱具有四碳酰基链。

HP:0035017.name: Elevated circulating medium-chain acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035017.definition: Concentration of medium-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Medium-chain acylcarnitines have between six and twelve carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C6-C12),
HP:0035017.name_cn: 循环中链酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035017.definition_cn: 血液循环中中链酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。酰基肉碱根据酰基链中的碳原子数进行分类。中链酰基肉碱的酰基链中含有六至十二个碳原子（C6-C12）。

HP:0035018.name: Elevated circulating long-chain acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035018.definition: Concentration of long-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Long-chain acylcarnitines have between thirteen and twenty carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C13-C20),
HP:0035018.name_cn: 循环长链酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035018.definition_cn: 血液循环中长链酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。酰基肉碱根据酰基链中碳原子数分类。长链酰基肉碱的酰基链中含有十三至二十个碳原子（C13-C20）。

HP:0035019.name: Elevated circulating C5 acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035019.definition: Concentration of C5 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C5 acylcarnitines have a five-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035019.name_cn: 循环中C5酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035019.definition_cn: 血液中C5酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。C5酰基肉碱具有五碳酰基链。

HP:0035020.name: Elevated circulating C18 acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035020.definition: Concentration of C18 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C18 acylcarnitines have a eighteen-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035020.name_cn: 循环中C18酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035020.definition_cn: 血液循环中C18酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。C18酰基肉碱具有十八碳酰基链。

HP:0035021.name: Elevated circulating C16 acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035021.definition: Concentration of C16 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C16 acylcarnitines have a sixteen-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035021.name_cn: 循环中C16酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035021.definition_cn: 血液循环中C16酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。C16酰基肉碱具有十六碳酰基链。

HP:0035022.name: Elevated circulating very long-chain acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035022.definition: Concentration of very long-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Very long-chain acylcarnitines have twentyone or more carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C21 and higher),
HP:0035022.name_cn: 循环中极长链酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035022.definition_cn: 血液循环中极长链酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。酰基肉碱根据酰基链中碳原子数量进行分类。极长链酰基肉碱在酰基链中具有二十一个或更多碳原子（C21及以上）。

HP:0035023.name: Elevated circulating acetylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035023.definition: Concentration of acetylcarnitine (C2 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acetylcarnitine has a two-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035023.name_cn: 循环乙酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035023.definition_cn: 血液循环中乙酰肉碱（C2酰基肉碱）浓度高于正常上限。乙酰肉碱具有二碳酰基链。

HP:0035024.name: Elevated circulating methylmalonylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035024.definition: Concentration of methylmalonylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035024.name_cn: 循环中甲基丙二酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035024.definition_cn: 血液中甲基丙二酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0035025.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyhexadecanoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035025.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyhexadecanoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035025.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基十六酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035025.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基十六烷酰肉碱浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0035026.name: Elevated circulating C6 acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035026.definition: Concentration of C6 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C6 acylcarnitines have a six-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035026.name_cn: 循环中C6酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035026.definition_cn: 血液循环中C6酰基肉碱浓度高于正常上限。C6酰基肉碱具有六碳酰基链。

HP:0035027.name: Elevated circulating methylglutarylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035027.definition: Concentration of methylglutarylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035027.name_cn: 循环中甲基戊二酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035027.definition_cn: 血液中甲基戊二酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0035028.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyisovalerylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035028.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyisovalerylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035028.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基异戊酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035028.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基异戊酰肉碱浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0035029.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyhexanoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035029.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyhexanoylcarnitine (C6-OH) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035029.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基己酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035029.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基己酰肉碱（C6-OH）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0035030.name: Elevated circulating carnitine concentration
HP:0035030.definition: Concentration of carnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035030.definition_cn: 血液中肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0035031.name: Elevated circulating tiglylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035031.definition: Concentration of tiglylcarnitine (C5:1) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0035031.name_cn: 循环中戊二酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:0035031.definition_cn: 血液中戊烯酰肉碱（C5:1）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0035032.name: Reduced circulating acetylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035032.definition: Concentration of acetylcarnitine (C2 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Acetylcarnitine has a two-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0035032.name_cn: 循环乙酰肉碱浓度降低
HP:0035032.definition_cn: 血液循环中乙酰肉碱（C2酰基肉碱）浓度低于正常值下限。乙酰肉碱具有二碳酰基链。

HP:0035033.name: Reduced circulating octadecenoylcarnitine concentration
HP:0035033.definition: Concentration of octadecenoylcarnitine (C18:1 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0035033.name_cn: 循环十八烯酰肉碱浓度降低
HP:0035033.definition_cn: 血液循环中十八碳烯酰肉碱（C18:1酰基肉碱）浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0040007.name: Absent pigmentation of chest
HP:0040007.definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the chest.
HP:0040007.definition_cn: 胸部皮肤色素沉着缺失。

HP:0040009.name: Hyperparakeratosis
HP:0040009.definition: Abnormal keratinization of the epidermal stratum coreum (horny layer) with increased keratin formation, preservation of the nuclei in the superficial cells, and absence of the stratum granulosum.
HP:0040009.definition_cn: 表皮角质层（角化层）异常角化，伴有角蛋白形成增加，表层细胞核保留，以及颗粒层缺失。

HP:0040012.name: Chromosome breakage
HP:0040012.definition: Elevated rate of chromosomal breakage or interchanges occurring either spontaneously or following exposure to various DNA-damaging agents. This feature may be assayed by treatment of cultured lymphocytes with agents such as chemical mutagens, irradiation, and alkylating agents.
HP:0040012.definition_cn: 染色体断裂或互换率升高，无论是自发发生还是暴露于各种DNA损伤剂后发生。该特征可通过使用化学诱变剂、辐射和烷化剂等处理培养的淋巴细胞进行检测。

HP:0040015.name: Increased activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
HP:0040015.name_cn: 线粒体呼吸链活性增强

HP:0040021.name: obsolete Radial deviation of the thumb

HP:0040030.name: Chorioretinal hypopigmentation
HP:0040030.name_cn: 脉络膜视网膜色素减退

HP:0040031.name: Chorioretinal hyperpigmentation
HP:0040031.name_cn: 脉络膜视网膜色素沉着过度

HP:0040033.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone
HP:0040033.name_cn: 第五跖骨发育不全/发育不良

HP:0040034.name: Abnormality of the second metatarsal bone

HP:0040035.name: Abnormality of the fourth metatarsal bone

HP:0040037.name: obsolete Thin fingernail (obsolete)
HP:0040037.name_cn: 废弃术语：薄指甲（已废弃）

HP:0040040.name: Toenail onycholysis
HP:0040040.definition: Painless and spontaneous separation of a toenail from the nail bed.
HP:0040040.definition_cn: 无痛性自发性趾甲与甲床分离。

HP:0040042.name: Aplasia of the eccrine sweat glands

HP:0040043.name: Hypoplasia of the eccrine sweat glands

HP:0040048.name: obsolete Aplasia of the left hemidiaphragm

HP:0040049.name: Macular edema
HP:0040049.definition: Thickening of the retina that takes place due to accumulation of fluid in the macula as a nonspecific response to blood-retinal barrier breakdown. Macular edema is a common pathological response to a wide variety of ocular insults, most commonly after intraocular (e.g. cataract) surgery or in association with retinal vascular (e.g. diabetic eye disease, retinal vein occlusion) or inflammatory (e.g. uveitis) disease.
HP:0040049.definition_cn: 由于黄斑区液体积聚作为对血-视网膜屏障破坏的非特异性反应而发生的视网膜增厚。黄斑水肿是对多种眼部损伤的常见病理反应，最常见于眼内（如白内障）手术后或与视网膜血管（如糖尿病眼病、视网膜静脉阻塞）或炎症（如葡萄膜炎）疾病相关。

HP:0040065.name: obsolete Abnormal morphology of bones of the upper limbs

HP:0040066.name: obsolete Abnormal morphology of bones of the lower limbs
HP:0040066.name_cn: 下肢骨骼异常形态学改变

HP:0040071.name: Abnormal morphology of ulna
HP:0040071.definition: Any structural anomaly of the ulna, a bone of the forearm the extends from the elbow to the little finger.
HP:0040071.definition_cn: 尺骨结构异常，尺骨为前臂骨骼，从肘部延伸至小指。

HP:0040073.name: obsolete Abnormal forearm bone morphology
HP:0040073.name_cn: 陈旧性前臂骨形态异常

HP:0040077.name: obsolete Abnormal concentration of calcium in blood

HP:0040081.name: Abnormal circulating creatine kinase concentration
HP:0040081.definition: Any deviation from the normal circulating creatine kinase concentration.
HP:0040081.name_cn: 异常循环肌酸激酶浓度
HP:0040081.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常循环肌酸激酶浓度的异常。

HP:0040082.name: Happy demeanor
HP:0040082.definition: A conspicuously happy disposition, characterized by frequent smiling and laughing, which may be contextually inappropriate or unrelated to the situation.
HP:0040082.definition_cn: 显著欣快的情绪状态，表现为频繁的微笑和发笑，可能与情境不符或无关。

HP:0040083.name: obsolete Toe walking
HP:0040083.definition: Toe walking is a pattern of walking in which a person walks on balls of his or her feet, with no contact between the heels and ground. Toe-walking is common in children who are learning to walk, but most children outgrow it around the age of two years. This term refers to the persistence of toe-walking beyond the usual age.
HP:0040083.definition_cn: 踮足行走是一种步态模式，表现为个体仅以足前部（跖骨区域）着地行走，而足跟与地面无接触。踮足行走在学步期儿童中较为常见，但大多数儿童在约两岁左右会自然消失。该术语特指超过正常年龄后仍持续存在的踮足行走现象。

HP:0040084.name: Abnormal circulating renin concentration
HP:0040084.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of renin in the blood, a central hormone in the control of blood pressure and various other physiological functions.
HP:0040084.definition_cn: 血液中肾素浓度偏离正常值，肾素是调控血压及多种其他生理功能的核心激素。

HP:0040087.name: Abnormal blood folate concentration
HP:0040087.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of folate in the blood circulation.
HP:0040087.definition_cn: 血液中叶酸浓度的任何异常。

HP:0040088.name: Abnormal lymphocyte count
HP:0040088.definition: Any abnormality in the total number of lymphocytes in the blood.
HP:0040088.definition_cn: 血液中淋巴细胞总数的任何异常。

HP:0040089.name: Abnormal natural killer cell count
HP:0040089.definition: Any deviation from the normal overall count of natural killer (NK) cells in the circulation or a deviation from the normal distribution of NK cell subtypes.
HP:0040089.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞计数异常
HP:0040089.definition_cn: 循环中自然杀伤（NK）细胞总数或NK细胞亚型分布的任何偏离正常值的情况。

HP:0040090.name: Abnormal tympanic membrane morphology
HP:0040090.definition: Any structural abnormality of the tympanic membrane

HP:0040091.name: Asymmetry of the size of ears

HP:0040092.name: Asymmetry of the shape of the ears

HP:0040093.name: Asymmetry of the position of the ears

HP:0040095.name: Neoplasm of the outer ear
HP:0040095.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the outer ear.
HP:0040095.definition_cn: 外耳肿瘤（组织异常增生）

HP:0040096.name: Neoplasm of the inner ear
HP:0040096.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the inner ear.
HP:0040096.definition_cn: 内耳肿瘤（内耳组织异常增生）

HP:0040097.name: Neoplasm of the ceruminal gland
HP:0040097.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ceruminal gland.
HP:0040097.definition_cn: 耵聍腺肿瘤（耵聍腺组织异常增生）。

HP:0040101.name: Cutaneous atresia of the external auditory canal

HP:0040102.name: Osseous atresia of the external auditory canal

HP:0040103.name: Cutaneous stenosis of the external auditory canal

HP:0040104.name: Osseous stenosis of the external auditory canal

HP:0040113.name: Old-aged sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0040113.name_cn: 老年性感音神经性听力损失

HP:0040114.name: Absence of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle

HP:0040115.name: Abnormal Eustachian tube morphology
HP:0040115.definition: A structural anomaly of the Eustachian tube (ET). The ET is a biomechanical valve between the nasopharynx and the middle ear. Physiologically, it controls the passive adaptation of the middle ear air pressure to the ambient air pressure primarily via direct muscular actions of the soft palate. In the closed state it protects the middle ear. Inadequate function of the ET causes middle ear ventilation disorders.
HP:0040115.definition_cn: 咽鼓管（Eustachian Tube, ET）结构异常。咽鼓管是连接鼻咽部与中耳的生物力学阀门。在生理状态下，它主要通过软腭的肌肉活动控制中耳气压与外界气压的被动适应。在关闭状态下，它保护中耳免受外界影响。咽鼓管功能不全可导致中耳通气功能障碍。

HP:0040120.name: Abnormality of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle

HP:0040121.name: Abnormality of the acoustic reflex
HP:0040121.definition: An abnormality in the reflexive contraction of the middle-ear muscles in response to sound stimulation.
HP:0040121.definition_cn: 声刺激引起的中耳肌反射性收缩异常。

HP:0040122.name: Impairment of the the acoustic reflex

HP:0040123.name: Impairment of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
HP:0040123.name_cn: 鼓膜张肌反射功能障碍

HP:0040126.name: Abnormal circulating vitamin B12 concentration
HP:0040126.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of cobalamin (vitamin B12) in the blood. Vitamin B12 is one of the eight B vitamins.
HP:0040126.definition_cn: 血液中钴胺素（维生素B12）浓度偏离正常范围。维生素B12是八种B族维生素之一。

HP:0040127.name: Abnormal sweat homeostasis
HP:0040127.definition: An abnormality of the composition of sweat or the levels of its components.
HP:0040127.definition_cn: 汗液成分或其组分水平的异常。

HP:0040130.name: Abnormal circulating iron concentration
HP:0040130.definition: The concentration of iron in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0040130.definition_cn: 血液循环中的铁浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0040131.name: Abnormal motor nerve conduction velocity
HP:0040131.name_cn: 运动神经传导速度异常

HP:0040132.name: Abnormal sensory nerve conduction velocity
HP:0040132.name_cn: 感觉神经传导速度异常

HP:0040133.name: Abnormal circulating ferritin concentration
HP:0040133.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of ferritin. Ferritin concentration can be measured in serum or plasma.
HP:0040133.definition_cn: 血清或血浆中铁蛋白浓度的异常偏离正常循环水平。铁蛋白浓度可通过血清或血浆进行测定。

HP:0040135.name: Abnormal transferrin saturation
HP:0040135.definition: Any abnormality in the serum transferrin saturation, which is calculated by dividing the serum iron level by total iron-binding capacity.
HP:0040135.definition_cn: 血清转铁蛋白饱和度异常，其计算方式为血清铁水平除以总铁结合能力。

HP:0040137.name: Comedonal acne
HP:0040137.definition: A type of acne in which open and closed comedones comprise the majority of the lesions, with substantially fewer papules and pustules.
HP:0040137.definition_cn: 一种以开放性粉刺和闭合性粉刺为主要皮损的痤疮类型，丘疹和脓疱显著较少。

HP:0040138.name: Mucinous histiocytosis
HP:0040138.definition: Multiple subcutaneous non-fragile and skin-coloured papules characterized by interstitial infiltrate of spindle and epithelioid histiocytes, and mucin. There are well circumscribed aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes and mucin in the upper and middle dermis,with the histiocytes arranged between collagen bundles and separated from the epidermis by a Grenz zone.
HP:0040138.name_cn: 黏液性组织细胞增生症
HP:0040138.definition_cn: 多发性皮下非脆弱性肤色丘疹，其特征为梭形和上皮样组织细胞及黏蛋白的间质浸润。在真皮上部和中部可见界限清楚的上皮样组织细胞和黏蛋白聚集，组织细胞排列于胶原束之间，并通过格伦茨区与表皮分隔。

HP:0040139.name: Lipogranulomatosis
HP:0040139.definition: Yellow nodules of lipoid material are deposited in the skin and mucosae. This gives rise to granulomatous reactions.
HP:0040139.definition_cn: 脂质物质的黄色结节沉积于皮肤和黏膜，引发肉芽肿性反应。

HP:0040142.name: Reduced circulating 5-oxoprolinase activity
HP:0040142.definition: Activity or concentration of 5-oxoprolinase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme catalyzes the reaction 5-oxo-L-proline + ATP + 2 H(2)O = L-glutamate + ADP + 2 H(+) + phosphate.
HP:0040142.name_cn: 循环中5-氧代脯氨酸酶活性降低
HP:0040142.definition_cn: 血液循环中5-氧代脯氨酸酶活性或浓度低于正常下限。该酶催化反应：5-氧代-L-脯氨酸 + ATP + 2 H₂O = L-谷氨酸 + ADP + 2 H⁺ + 磷酸盐。

HP:0040143.name: Dystopic os odontoideum
HP:0040143.definition: Os odontoideum is classified into two anatomic types (orthotopic and dystopic). Os odontoideum is defined as an ossicle that consists of smooth and separate caudal portions of the odontoid process. With orthotopic os odontoideum, the ossicle moves with the anterior arch of the atlas, while the dystopic type consists of an ossicle near the basion, or one that is fused with the clivus
HP:0040143.definition_cn: 齿状突小骨（Os odontoideum）被分为两种解剖类型（原位型和异位型）。齿状突小骨被定义为由齿状突的平滑且分离的尾端部分组成的骨片。在原位型齿状突小骨中，骨片与寰椎前弓一起移动，而异位型则包括位于颅底点附近的骨片或与斜坡融合的骨片。

HP:0040144.name: L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria
HP:0040144.definition: An increase in the level of L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine.
HP:0040144.definition_cn: 尿液中L-2-羟基戊二酸水平升高。

HP:0040148.name: Cortical myoclonus
HP:0040148.definition: Cortical myoclonus mainly affects the distal upper limbs and face, which reflects the largest cortical representations of these body areas. It is often focal, but may be multifocal, bilateral or generalized, as a consequence of intracortical and transcallosal spreading of abnormal activity. It typically occurs on voluntary action and may affect speech and gait. Cortical myoclonic jerks are stimulus sensitive, typically to touch, but sensitivity to visual stimuli is also described. Most patients with cortical myoclonus have both positive myoclonus and NM, occurring either independently or together as a complex of the two kinds of myoclonus. If cortical myoclonus is prolonged and lasts for hours, days or weeks, it is called epilepsia partials continua and is considered to be a rare form of focal epileptic status. Focal cortical myoclonus almost always points to an underlining lesion of the sensori-motor cortex, which produces hyperexcitability (e.g. vascular, inflammatory or neoplastic).
HP:0040148.definition_cn: 皮质肌阵挛主要影响上肢远端和面部，这反映了这些身体区域在皮质中的最大代表区。它通常是局灶性的，但也可能是多灶性、双侧性或全身性的，这是由于异常活动在皮质内和经胼胝体扩散的结果。它通常在自主运动时发生，并可能影响言语和步态。皮质肌阵挛性抽搐对刺激敏感，通常是对触觉刺激敏感，但也有对视觉刺激敏感的报道。大多数皮质肌阵挛患者同时存在阳性肌阵挛和阴性肌阵挛，这两种肌阵挛可能独立发生，也可能同时发生，形成复杂的肌阵挛表现。如果皮质肌阵挛持续时间较长，持续数小时、数天或数周，则称为持续性部分性癫痫，被认为是一种罕见的局灶性癫痫持续状态。局灶性皮质肌阵挛几乎总是提示感觉运动皮质的潜在病变，这些病变导致过度兴奋（如血管性、炎症性或肿瘤性病变）。

HP:0040149.name: Woolly scalp hair
HP:0040149.definition: The presence of wooly hair on the scalp. The term wooly hair refers to an abnormal variant of hair that is fine, with tightly coiled curls, and often hypopigmented. Optical microscopy may reveal the presence of tight spirals and a clear diameter reduction as compared with normal hair. Electron microscopy may show flat, oval hair shafts with reduced transversal diameter.
HP:0040149.definition_cn: 头皮上存在羊毛状毛发。术语“羊毛状毛发”指的是一种异常的毛发变异，其特征为毛发纤细、紧密卷曲，且常伴有色素减退。光学显微镜下可观察到紧密的螺旋结构，与正常毛发相比直径明显减小。电子显微镜下可显示扁平、椭圆形的毛干，且横径减小。

HP:0040154.name: Acne inversa
HP:0040154.definition: A chronic skin condition involving the inflammation of the apocrine sweat glands, forming pimple-like bumps known as abscesses.
HP:0040154.definition_cn: 一种慢性皮肤病，涉及顶泌汗腺的炎症，形成称为脓肿的丘疹样肿块。

HP:0040155.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxybutyric acid
HP:0040155.definition: An increased amount of 3-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.
HP:0040155.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基丁酸含量升高。

HP:0040156.name: Elevated urinary carboxylic acid
HP:0040156.definition: An increased amount of carboxylic acid in the urine.

HP:0040162.name: Orthokeratosis
HP:0040162.definition: Formation of an anuclear keratin layer

HP:0040168.name: obsolete Focal seizures, afebril
HP:0040168.name_cn: 过时的术语：局灶性发作，无热性

HP:0040174.name: Abnormality of extrinsic muscle of tongue

HP:0040175.name: Platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase deficiency
HP:0040175.definition: Reduced level of platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase.
HP:0040175.name_cn: 血小板活化因子乙酰水解酶缺乏症
HP:0040175.definition_cn: 血小板活化因子乙酰水解酶水平降低。

HP:0040176.name: Abnormal circulating phospholipid concentration
HP:0040176.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a phospholipid in the blood circulation.

HP:0040177.name: Abnormal level of platelet-activating factor
HP:0040177.name_cn: 血小板活化因子水平异常

HP:0040178.name: Increased level of platelet-activating factor
HP:0040178.name_cn: 血小板活化因子水平升高

HP:0040179.name: Decreased level of platelet-activating factor
HP:0040179.name_cn: 血小板活化因子水平降低

HP:0040181.name: Chapped lip
HP:0040181.definition: Cracking, fissuring, and peeling of the skin of the lips.
HP:0040181.definition_cn: 唇部皮肤皲裂、裂隙及脱屑。

HP:0040182.name: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia
HP:0040182.definition: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia is a nonparoxysmal tachyarrhythmia characterized by an increased resting heart rate (HR) and/or an exaggerated HR response to minimal exertion or a change in body posture. HR is constantly above the physiological range with no appropriate relation to metabolic or physiological demands.
HP:0040182.definition_cn: 不适当窦性心动过速是一种非阵发性快速性心律失常，其特征为静息心率（HR）增快和/或对轻微体力活动或体位改变时心率反应过度。心率持续高于生理范围，且与代谢或生理需求无适当关联。

HP:0040186.name: Maculopapular exanthema
HP:0040186.definition: A skin rash that is characterized by diffuse cutaneous erythema with areas of skin elevation. It may evolve to vesicles or papules as part of a more severe clinical entity. Different degrees of angioedema with involvement of subcutaneous tissue may also appear.
HP:0040186.definition_cn: 一种以弥漫性皮肤红斑伴局部皮肤隆起为特征的皮疹。作为更严重临床实体的一部分，可能发展为水疱或丘疹。也可能出现不同程度的血管性水肿，并累及皮下组织。

HP:0040187.name: Neonatal sepsis
HP:0040187.definition: Systemic inflammatory response to infection in newborn babies.
HP:0040187.definition_cn: 新生儿感染引发的全身性炎症反应综合征（Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome, SIRS）。

HP:0040188.name: Osteochondrosis
HP:0040188.definition: Abnormal growth ossification centers in children. Initially a degeneration/ necrosis followed by regeneration or recalcification.
HP:0040188.definition_cn: 儿童骨化中心异常生长。初期表现为退行性变/坏死，随后出现再生或再钙化。

HP:0040189.name: Scaling skin
HP:0040189.definition: Refers to the loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes.
HP:0040189.definition_cn: 指表皮外层以大片鳞屑状脱落。

HP:0040192.name: APUdoma
HP:0040192.definition: An endocrine tumor arising from an APUD cell.
HP:0040192.name_cn: APUD细胞（胺前体摄取与脱羧细胞）
HP:0040192.definition_cn: 源自APUD细胞的内分泌肿瘤。

HP:0040193.name: obsolete Pinealoblastoma
HP:0040193.name_cn: 过时的松果体母细胞瘤

HP:0040194.name: Increased head circumference
HP:0040194.definition: An abnormally increased head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart.
HP:0040194.definition_cn: 儿童生长发育过程中出现的头围异常增大。头围测量使用非弹性卷尺，测量范围包括眉弓上方、耳部上方及枕骨后方的周径。测量所得头围数值需绘制于相应的生长曲线图上进行评估。

HP:0040195.name: Decreased head circumference
HP:0040195.definition: An abnormally reduced head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart. Microcephaly is defined as a head circumference (HC) that is great than two standard deviations below the mean of age- and gender-matched population based samples. Severe microcephaly is defined with an HC that is three standard deviations below the mean.
HP:0040195.definition_cn: 在生长发育中的儿童中，头围异常减小。头围使用非弹性卷尺测量，测量范围包括眉毛和耳朵上方至头后部的距离。所测得的头围随后绘制在相应的生长曲线图上。小头畸形定义为头围（HC）低于同年龄和性别匹配人群样本平均值两个标准差以上。严重小头畸形则定义为头围低于平均值三个标准差以上。

HP:0040196.name: Mild microcephaly
HP:0040196.definition: Decreased occipito-frontal (head) circumference (OFC). For the microcephaly OFC must be between -3 SD and -2 SD compared to appropriate, age matched, normal standards (i.e. -3 SD <= OFC < -2 SD).
HP:0040196.definition_cn: 枕额（头）围（OFC）减小。对于小头畸形，OFC必须与相应年龄匹配的正常标准相比在-3标准差（SD）至-2标准差之间（即-3 SD <= OFC < -2 SD）。

HP:0040197.name: Encephalomalacia
HP:0040197.definition: Encephalomalacia is the softening or loss of brain tissue after cerebral infarction, cerebral ischemia, infection, craniocerebral trauma, or other injury.
HP:0040197.definition_cn: 脑软化症是指脑梗死、脑缺血、感染、颅脑创伤或其他损伤后脑组织的软化或丧失。

HP:0040200.name: Motor impersistence
HP:0040200.definition: The inability to maintain postures or positions (such as keeping eyes closed, protruding the tongue, maintaining conjugate gaze steadily in a fixed direction, or making a prolonged 'ah' sound) without repeated prompts.
HP:0040200.definition_cn: 无法在没有反复提示的情况下维持姿势或位置（如保持闭眼、伸舌、稳定地保持固定方向的共轭凝视或发出持续的“啊”音）。

HP:0040201.name: Simultanapraxia
HP:0040201.definition: A subset of motor impersistence, defined as the inability to perform more than two of the simple voluntary acts simultaneously, such as closing the eyes and protruding the tongue.
HP:0040201.definition_cn: 运动持续不能的一个亚型，定义为无法同时执行两个以上的简单自主动作，例如闭眼和伸舌。

HP:0040202.name: Abnormal consumption behavior
HP:0040202.definition: Recurrent abnormal consumption of food, liquids, or objects that could have negative consequences for the individual.
HP:0040202.definition_cn: 反复异常摄入食物、液体或物体，可能对个体产生负面影响。

HP:0040203.name: Abnormal CSF neopterin concentration
HP:0040203.definition: Abnormal concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0040203.name_cn: 脑脊液新蝶呤浓度异常
HP:0040203.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中新蝶呤浓度异常。

HP:0040204.name: Elevated CSF neopterin level
HP:0040204.definition: Increased concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0040204.name_cn: 脑脊液新蝶呤水平升高
HP:0040204.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中新蝶呤浓度升高。

HP:0040205.name: Decreased CSF neopterin level
HP:0040205.definition: Decreased concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0040205.name_cn: 脑脊液新蝶呤水平降低
HP:0040205.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中新蝶呤浓度降低。

HP:0040206.name: Abnormal circulating neopterin concentration
HP:0040206.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of neopterin in the blood circulation.
HP:0040206.definition_cn: 血液循环中新蝶呤浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0040207.name: Abnormal CSF pterin concentration
HP:0040207.definition: Abnormal concentration of a pterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0040207.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中蝶呤浓度异常。

HP:0040208.name: Elevated CSF biopterin level
HP:0040208.definition: Concentration of biopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0040208.name_cn: 脑脊液生物蝶呤水平升高
HP:0040208.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中生物蝶呤浓度高于正常上限。

HP:0040209.name: Decreased CSF biopterin level
HP:0040209.definition: Concentration of biopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0040209.name_cn: 脑脊液生物蝶呤水平降低
HP:0040209.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中生物蝶呤浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0040210.name: Abnormal circulating biopterin concentration
HP:0040210.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of biopterin in the blood circulation.
HP:0040210.name_cn: 异常循环生物蝶呤浓度
HP:0040210.definition_cn: 血液循环中生物蝶呤浓度异常。

HP:0040211.name: Abnormal skin morphology of the palm
HP:0040211.definition: An abnormality of the skin of the palm, that is, the skin of the front of the hand.
HP:0040211.definition_cn: 手掌皮肤异常，即手前部皮肤的异常。

HP:0040212.name: Risus sardonicus
HP:0040212.definition: Fixed sarcastic grimace and anxious expression. Caused by spasms of the masseter and other facial muscles.
HP:0040212.definition_cn: 固定的讽刺性苦笑和焦虑表情。由咬肌及其他面部肌肉痉挛引起。

HP:0040213.name: Hypopnea
HP:0040213.definition: Hypopnea is referring to breathing that is abnormally shallow.
HP:0040213.definition_cn: 低通气是指呼吸异常浅表。

HP:0040214.name: Abnormal circulating insulin concentration
HP:0040214.definition: An abnormal concentration of insulin in the body.

HP:0040215.name: obsolete Abnormal circulating insulin level
HP:0040215.name_cn: 过时的异常循环胰岛素水平

HP:0040216.name: Hypoinsulinemia
HP:0040216.definition: A decreased concentration of insulin in the blood.

HP:0040217.name: Elevated hemoglobin A1c
HP:0040217.definition: An increased concentration of hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), which is the product of nonenzymatic attachment of a hexose molecule to the N-terminal amino acid of the hemoglobin molecule. This reaction is dependent on blood glucose concentration, and therefore reflects the mean glucose concentration over the previous 8 to 12 weeks. The HbA1c level provides a better indication of long-term glycemic control than one-time blood or urinary glucose measurements.
HP:0040217.definition_cn: 血红蛋白A1c（HbA1c）浓度升高，这是六碳糖分子与血红蛋白分子N端氨基酸非酶促结合的产物。该反应依赖于血糖浓度，因此反映了过去8至12周的平均血糖水平。HbA1c水平比一次性血液或尿液葡萄糖测量更能反映长期血糖控制情况。

HP:0040218.name: Reduced natural killer cell count
HP:0040218.definition: Less than normal number of natural killer cells, a type of lymphocyte in the innate immune system with an ability to mediate cytotoxicity and produce cytokines after the ligation of a germline-encoded activation receptor.
HP:0040218.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞计数减少
HP:0040218.definition_cn: 自然杀伤细胞数量低于正常水平，自然杀伤细胞是先天免疫系统中的一种淋巴细胞，具有在种系编码的激活受体连接后介导细胞毒性和产生细胞因子的能力。

HP:0040219.name: Absent natural killer cells
HP:0040219.definition: Lack of natural killer cells, a type of lymphocyte in the innate immune system that contains cytoplasmic granzymes, i.e., small granules with perforin and proteases that allow natural killer cells to form pores in the cell membrane of the target cell through which the granzymes and associated molecules can enter, inducing apoptosis.
HP:0040219.definition_cn: 自然杀伤细胞缺乏，自然杀伤细胞是先天免疫系统中的一种淋巴细胞，其胞质内含有颗粒酶，即含有穿孔素和蛋白酶的小颗粒，这些颗粒使自然杀伤细胞能够在靶细胞的细胞膜上形成孔洞，从而使颗粒酶及相关分子进入，诱导细胞凋亡。

HP:0040220.name: Abnormal size of the dental root

HP:0040222.name: Maternal thrombophilia
HP:0040222.definition: An increased tendency towards thrombosis in the mother during a pregnancy.
HP:0040222.definition_cn: 妊娠期母体血栓形成倾向增加。

HP:0040223.name: Pulmonary hemorrhage
HP:0040223.definition: Pulmonary hemorrhage is a bleeding within the lungs. Older children and adults may spit blood or bloody sputum. Neonates, infants and young children usually do not spit up blood. Anemia, pulmonary infiltrates, increasingling bloody return on BAL and the presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in broncho-alveolar lavage (BAL) fluid or lung biopsy can diagnose lung bleeding. Alveolar macrophages contain phagocytosed red blood cells and stain positive for hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, after about 48-72 hours following pulmonary hemorraghe. Previous or recurrent bleeding can thus be distinguished from fresh events. A differentiation into local or diffuse is of importance. Also differentiate if pulmonary hemorrhage is due to a primary lung disorder or a manifestation of a systemic disease.
HP:0040223.definition_cn: 肺出血是指肺部内的出血。年长儿童和成人可能出现咯血或血性痰。新生儿、婴儿和幼儿通常不会咯血。贫血、肺部浸润、支气管肺泡灌洗（BAL）中逐渐增多的血性回流以及支气管肺泡灌洗液或肺活检中存在含铁血黄素巨噬细胞可诊断肺出血。肺泡巨噬细胞含有吞噬的红细胞，并在肺出血后约48-72小时对血红蛋白降解产物铁血黄素呈阳性染色。因此，可以区分既往或复发性出血与新鲜出血事件。区分局部或弥漫性出血具有重要意义。此外，还需区分肺出血是由原发性肺部疾病引起还是系统性疾病的临床表现。

HP:0040224.name: Abnormality of fibrinolysis
HP:0040224.definition: Clinical phenotype characterized by delayed bleeding accelerated break down of blood clot (fibrinolysis)
HP:0040224.definition_cn: 以延迟性出血和加速血凝块分解（纤溶）为特征的临床表型。

HP:0040225.name: Decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor Multimers
HP:0040225.definition: A decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor multimers.
HP:0040225.name_cn: 高分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体减少
HP:0040225.definition_cn: 高分子量血管性血友病因子多聚体减少。

HP:0040226.name: Decreased level of heparin co-factor II
HP:0040226.definition: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of heparin co-factor II
HP:0040226.definition_cn: 与肝素辅因子II浓度降低相关的凝血异常

HP:0040227.name: Decreased level of histidine-rich glycoprotein
HP:0040227.definition: Decrease of these levels result in increased inhibition of fibrinolysis and reduced inhibition of coagulation
HP:0040227.name_cn: 富含组氨酸糖蛋白水平降低
HP:0040227.definition_cn: 这些水平的降低导致纤维蛋白溶解抑制增强和凝血抑制减弱。

HP:0040229.name: Decreased level of thrombomodulin
HP:0040229.definition: Thrombomodulin is a cofactor in the thrombin induced activation of Protein C. In the case of deficiency there will be less Protein C and tendency to clot
HP:0040229.name_cn: 血栓调节蛋白水平降低
HP:0040229.definition_cn: 血栓调节蛋白是凝血酶诱导的蛋白C激活过程中的一个辅助因子。在缺乏的情况下，蛋白C水平会降低，从而增加血栓形成的倾向。

HP:0040230.name: Decreased level of tissue plasminogen activator
HP:0040230.definition: The tPA protein catalyzes the conversion of plasiminogen to plasmin, and thus break down of clots. When there is a deficiency there will be an increase of thrombosis
HP:0040230.name_cn: 组织纤溶酶原激活物水平降低
HP:0040230.definition_cn: tPA蛋白催化纤溶酶原转化为纤溶酶，从而促进血栓的分解。当tPA缺乏时，血栓形成的风险将增加。

HP:0040232.name: Delayed onset bleeding
HP:0040232.definition: Abnormal bleeding related to a procedure or trauma which does not start at the time of the initial insult, but after delay by at least 24 hours.
HP:0040232.definition_cn: 与手术或创伤相关的异常出血，并非在初始损伤时立即发生，而是延迟至少24小时后出现。

HP:0040233.name: Factor XIII subunit A deficiency
HP:0040233.definition: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit A, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.
HP:0040233.definition_cn: 因子XIII亚基A缺乏，导致因子XIII活性降低。活化的因子XIII交联纤维蛋白聚合物，使血凝块固化。

HP:0040234.name: Factor XIII subunit B deficiency
HP:0040234.definition: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit B, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.
HP:0040234.definition_cn: 因子XIII亚基B缺乏，导致因子XIII活性降低。活化的因子XIII交联纤维蛋白聚合物，使血凝块固化。

HP:0040235.name: Leukocyte inclusion bodies
HP:0040235.definition: The presence of intraceullar inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in leukocytes.
HP:0040235.definition_cn: 白细胞内包涵体（可染色物质，通常为蛋白质的聚集体）的存在。

HP:0040236.name: Hyperfibrinolysis
HP:0040236.definition: Increased degradation of fibrin, associated with clot instability and bleeding
HP:0040236.definition_cn: 纤维蛋白降解增加，与血栓不稳定和出血相关

HP:0040237.name: Impaired binding of factor VIII to VWF
HP:0040237.definition: Impaired binding of factor VIII to von Willebrand Factor. This is determined using a modified ELISA assay.
HP:0040237.name_cn: 因子VIII与血管性血友病因子（VWF）结合受损
HP:0040237.definition_cn: 因子VIII与血管性血友病因子结合受损。此结果通过改良的酶联免疫吸附测定法（ELISA）确定。

HP:0040238.name: Impaired neutrophil chemotaxis
HP:0040238.definition: An impairment of the migration of neutrophils towards chemoattractants as part of the innate immune response
HP:0040238.name_cn: 中性粒细胞趋化功能受损
HP:0040238.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞向趋化因子迁移的损伤，作为先天免疫反应的一部分。

HP:0040239.name: Increased plasma vitamin K epoxide after vitamin K supplementation
HP:0040239.definition: Increased plasma vitamin K epoxide after vitamin K supplementation is present in VKCFD (vitamin K-dependent clotting factor deficiency) type 2, but not in VKCFD type 1.
HP:0040239.name_cn: 补充维生素K后血浆维生素K环氧化物增加
HP:0040239.definition_cn: 维生素K补充后血浆维生素K环氧化物增加见于2型维生素K依赖性凝血因子缺乏症（VKCFD），但在1型维生素K依赖性凝血因子缺乏症（VKCFD）中未见此现象。

HP:0040240.name: Increased ratio of VWF propeptide to VWF antigen
HP:0040240.definition: An increased VWF propeptide to VWF antigen indicates that deficiency of VWF is not due to impaired synthesis but due to rapid clearance. The VWF propeptide is measured by ELISA.
HP:0040240.name_cn: 血管性血友病因子前肽与血管性血友病因子抗原比值升高
HP:0040240.definition_cn: VWF前肽与VWF抗原比值升高表明VWF缺乏并非由于合成障碍，而是由于快速清除所致。VWF前肽通过酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）进行测定。

HP:0040241.name: Increased RIPA
HP:0040241.definition: Increased platelet agglutination in response to low-dose ristocetin
HP:0040241.name_cn: 增强的瑞斯托霉素诱导的血小板聚集（Increased Ristocetin-Induced Platelet Aggregation, RIPA）
HP:0040241.definition_cn: 低剂量瑞斯托霉素诱导的血小板凝集增强

HP:0040243.name: Prolonged euglobulin clot lysis time
HP:0040243.definition: Abnormally increased length of time required for an in vitro clot to dissolve in the absence of the normal plasmin inhibitors. This test is a clinical assay used to measure fibrinolysis. The euglobulin fraction of plasma is precipitated and used to form clot by addition of thrombin; after clot forms the rate of clot breakdown (fibrinolysis) can be monitored.
HP:0040243.name_cn: 延长的优球蛋白溶解时间
HP:0040243.definition_cn: 在缺乏正常纤溶酶抑制剂的情况下，体外血凝块溶解所需时间异常延长。该检测是一种用于测量纤维蛋白溶解的临床测定方法。通过沉淀血浆中的优球蛋白组分，并加入凝血酶形成血凝块；血凝块形成后，可监测其分解速率（纤维蛋白溶解）。

HP:0040244.name: Prolonged Russell's viper venom time
HP:0040244.definition: Increased time to coagulation in the Russell's viper venom assay
HP:0040244.name_cn: 延长罗素氏蝰蛇毒时间
HP:0040244.definition_cn: 拉塞尔蝰蛇毒液试验中凝血时间延长

HP:0040245.name: Reduced alpha-2-antiplasmin activity
HP:0040245.definition: Reduced activity of alpha-2-antiplasmin. This protein inactivates the protease plasmin that drives fibrinolysis.
HP:0040245.definition_cn: α-2-抗纤溶酶活性降低。该蛋白可灭活驱动纤溶过程的蛋白酶纤溶酶。

HP:0040246.name: Reduced antithrombin antigen
HP:0040246.definition: Reduced antithrombin antigen. A reduced level of antithrombin may lead to an increased risk of thrombus formation.
HP:0040246.definition_cn: 抗凝血酶抗原水平降低。抗凝血酶水平降低可能导致血栓形成风险增加。

HP:0040247.name: Reduced euglobulin clot lysis time
HP:0040247.definition: Abnormally decreased length of time required for an in vitro clot to dissolve in the absence of the normal plasmin inhibitors. This test is a clinical assay used to measure fibrinolysis. The euglobulin fraction of plasma is precipitated and used to form clot by addition of thrombin; after clot forms the rate of clot breakdown (fibrinolysis) can be monitored.
HP:0040247.name_cn: 优球蛋白凝块溶解时间缩短
HP:0040247.definition_cn: 在缺乏正常纤溶酶抑制剂的情况下，体外血凝块溶解所需时间异常缩短。该检测是一种用于测量纤维蛋白溶解的临床测定方法。通过沉淀血浆中的优球蛋白组分并加入凝血酶形成血凝块；血凝块形成后，可监测其分解速率（纤维蛋白溶解）。

HP:0040248.name: Reduced plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
HP:0040248.definition: Reduced activity of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1. This protein down-regulates fibrinolysis in the circulation by inhibiting the two major plasminogen activators: tissue-plasminogen activator and urokinase-plasminogen activator.
HP:0040248.name_cn: 纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1活性降低
HP:0040248.definition_cn: 纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1活性降低。该蛋白通过抑制两种主要的纤溶酶原激活物——组织型纤溶酶原激活物和尿激酶型纤溶酶原激活物，下调循环中的纤溶作用。

HP:0040249.name: Reduced plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 antigen
HP:0040249.definition: Reduced level of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 antigen.
HP:0040249.name_cn: 纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1抗原水平降低
HP:0040249.definition_cn: 纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1抗原水平降低。

HP:0040250.name: Reduced prothrombin antigen
HP:0040250.definition: Reduced prothrombin antigen as measured by ELISA assay. Prothrombin is a vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor that is proteolytically cleaved to form thrombin.
HP:0040250.definition_cn: 通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）检测到的凝血酶原抗原水平降低。凝血酶原是一种维生素K依赖性凝血因子，经蛋白水解裂解后形成凝血酶。

HP:0040251.name: Hand dimple
HP:0040251.definition: A cutaneous indentation resulting from tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) of the hand.
HP:0040251.definition_cn: 由于皮肤与手部深层结构（骨骼）的牵拉导致的皮肤凹陷。

HP:0040255.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the clitoris
HP:0040255.name_cn: 阴蒂发育不全/阴蒂发育不良

HP:0040256.name: Aplastic/Hypoplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
HP:0040256.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasopharyngeal adenoids.
HP:0040256.name_cn: 再生障碍性/发育不全性鼻咽腺样体
HP:0040256.definition_cn: 鼻咽腺样体缺失或发育不全。

HP:0040257.name: Abnormal size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
HP:0040257.definition: A deviation in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.
HP:0040257.name_cn: 鼻咽部腺样体异常增大
HP:0040257.definition_cn: 鼻咽部腺样体大小异常。

HP:0040258.name: Hypoplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
HP:0040258.name_cn: 鼻咽部腺样体发育不全
HP:0040258.definition_cn: 鼻咽部腺样体发育不全。

HP:0040259.name: Aplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
HP:0040259.definition: Absence of the nasopharyngeal adenoids as a developmental defect.
HP:0040259.name_cn: 再生障碍性鼻咽腺样体
HP:0040259.definition_cn: 鼻咽部腺样体缺失作为一种发育缺陷。

HP:0040260.name: Decreased size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
HP:0040260.definition: An abnormal decrease in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.
HP:0040260.definition_cn: 鼻咽腺样体体积异常缩小。

HP:0040261.name: Increased size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
HP:0040261.definition: An abnormal increase in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

HP:0040262.name: Glue ear
HP:0040262.definition: Middle ear is filled with glue-like fluid instead of air.
HP:0040262.definition_cn: 中耳内充满胶样液体而非空气。

HP:0040264.name: Jaw pain
HP:0040264.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the jaw.
HP:0040264.name_cn: 颞下颌关节疼痛（Temporomandibular Joint Pain）
HP:0040264.definition_cn: 一种以颌部局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0040265.name: Upper limb muscle hypertrophy
HP:0040265.definition: Abnormal increase in muscle size and mass of one or both arms not due to training.
HP:0040265.definition_cn: 单侧或双侧上肢肌肉体积和质量的异常增大，非由训练所致。

HP:0040268.name: obsolete Recurrent infections of the middle ear

HP:0040270.name: Impaired glucose tolerance
HP:0040270.definition: An abnormal resistance to glucose, i.e., a reduction in the ability to maintain glucose levels in the blood stream within normal limits following oral or intravenous administration of glucose.
HP:0040270.definition_cn: 糖耐量异常，即口服或静脉注射葡萄糖后，维持血糖水平在正常范围内的能力降低。

HP:0040272.name: Hyperintensity of MRI T2 signal of the spinal cord
HP:0040272.definition: A region of high intensity (brightness) observed upon magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of the spinal cord.
HP:0040272.definition_cn: 脊髓磁共振成像（MRI）扫描中观察到的高信号强度（高亮度）区域。

HP:0040273.name: Adenocarcinoma of the intestines
HP:0040273.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the intestines.
HP:0040273.definition_cn: 一种起源于肠道的具有腺体结构的恶性上皮肿瘤。

HP:0040274.name: Adenocarcinoma of the small intestine
HP:0040274.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the small intestine.
HP:0040274.definition_cn: 一种起源于小肠的具有腺体结构的恶性上皮肿瘤。

HP:0040275.name: Adenocarcinoma of the large intestine
HP:0040275.definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the large intestine.
HP:0040275.definition_cn: 一种具有腺体结构的恶性上皮性肿瘤，起源于大肠。

HP:0040279.name: Frequency
HP:0040279.definition: Class to represent frequency of phenotypic abnormalities within a patient cohort.
HP:0040279.definition_cn: 用于表示患者队列中表型异常频率的类别。

HP:0040280.name: Obligate
HP:0040280.definition: Always present, i.e. in 100% of the cases.
HP:0040280.definition_cn: 始终存在，即100%的病例中均出现。

HP:0040281.name: Very frequent
HP:0040281.definition: Present in 80% to 99% of the cases.

HP:0040282.name: Frequent
HP:0040282.definition: Present in 30% to 79% of the cases.

HP:0040283.name: Occasional
HP:0040283.definition: Present in 5% to 29% of the cases.

HP:0040284.name: Very rare
HP:0040284.definition: Present in 1% to 4% of the cases.

HP:0040286.name: Abnormal axial muscle morphology
HP:0040286.definition: A structural anomaly of the muscles of the trunk and head.
HP:0040286.definition_cn: 躯干和头部肌肉的结构异常。

HP:0040288.name: Nasogastric tube feeding
HP:0040288.definition: The condition of inability to eat normally treated by placement of a thin tube through the nose into the stomach that is then used to carry food.
HP:0040288.definition_cn: 经鼻胃管置入术治疗进食功能障碍。

HP:0040289.name: Cyclic neutropenia
HP:0040289.definition: Recurrent episodes of abnormally low levels of neutrophils in the body (neutropenia).
HP:0040289.name_cn: 周期性中性粒细胞减少症
HP:0040289.definition_cn: 复发性中性粒细胞减少症（Recurrent Neutropenia）。

HP:0040296.name: Abnormal location of the eyebrow
HP:0040296.definition: Anomalous anatomical placement of the eyebrow.

HP:0040297.name: Preauricular cyst
HP:0040297.definition: Preauricular sinus is an occasional finding and most frequently appears as a small pit close to the anterior margin of the ascending portion of the helix. The opening has also been reported along the postero superior margin of the helix, the tragus or the lobule. Preauricular sinus may lead to the formation of a subcutaneous cyst that is intimately related to the tragal cartilage and the anterior crus of the helix.
HP:0040297.definition_cn: 耳前窦是一种偶发发现，最常见于耳轮升支前缘附近的小凹陷。也有报道称其开口位于耳轮后上缘、耳屏或耳垂。耳前窦可能导致与耳屏软骨及耳轮前脚密切相关的皮下囊肿形成。

HP:0040299.name: Decreased circulating free fatty acid level
HP:0040299.name_cn: 循环游离脂肪酸水平降低

HP:0040300.name: Abnormal circulating free fatty acid concentration
HP:0040300.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a free fatty acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0040300.name_cn: 异常循环游离脂肪酸浓度
HP:0040300.definition_cn: 血液中游离脂肪酸浓度偏离正常值的任何异常。

HP:0040301.name: Increased urinary glycerol
HP:0040301.definition: An increased concentration of glycerol in the urine.

HP:0040302.name: Hyperglycerolemia
HP:0040302.definition: Increased concentration of glycerol in the blood.

HP:0040303.name: Decreased circulating iron concentration
HP:0040303.definition: The concentration of iron in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0040303.definition_cn: 循环血液中铁浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0040305.name: Increased male libido
HP:0040305.definition: Increased desire for sexual activity on the part of a male.

HP:0040306.name: Decreased male libido
HP:0040306.definition: Reduced desire for sexual activity on the part of a male.
HP:0040306.definition_cn: 男性性欲减退 (Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder in Males)

HP:0040307.name: Male sexual dysfunction
HP:0040307.definition: A problem occurring during any phase of the male sexual response cycle that prevents the individual from experiencing satisfaction from the sexual activity
HP:0040307.definition_cn: 男性性反应周期中任何阶段出现的问题，导致个体无法从性活动中获得满足感。

HP:0040308.name: Male anorgasmia
HP:0040308.definition: Inability of a male to reach orgasm.
HP:0040308.definition_cn: 男性性高潮障碍（Male Orgasmic Disorder）

HP:0040310.name: Sterile arthritis
HP:0040310.definition: An inflammatory arthritis characterized by purulent synovial fluid with neutrophil accumulation, but with negative cultures.
HP:0040310.definition_cn: 一种炎症性关节炎，其特征为脓性滑液伴中性粒细胞积聚，但培养结果为阴性。

HP:0040311.name: Symmetric polyarthritis
HP:0040311.definition: Polyarthritis refers to a joint disease that involves at least five joints. One or more signs of inflammation, including pain, movement restriction, swelling, warmth, and redness, are seen in the joints involved. Polyarthritis is defined as symmetric if at least half of the joints involved are affected in a symmetric (i.e., both right and the left) fashion.
HP:0040311.definition_cn: 多关节炎是指累及至少五个关节的关节疾病。受累关节出现一种或多种炎症体征，包括疼痛、活动受限、肿胀、发热和发红。如果至少一半的受累关节呈对称性（即左右两侧）受累，则定义为对称性多关节炎。

HP:0040313.name: Oligoarthritis
HP:0040313.definition: A type of arthritis that affects up to four joints in the first six months of disease.
HP:0040313.definition_cn: 一种在疾病最初六个月内累及最多四个关节的关节炎类型。

HP:0040314.name: Blind vagina
HP:0040314.definition: The vagina ends in a blind pouch or sac rather than being connected to the internal genitalia.
HP:0040314.definition_cn: 阴道末端呈盲囊状，未与内生殖器相连。

HP:0040315.name: Tongue edema
HP:0040315.definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tongue.

HP:0040317.name: Blue urine
HP:0040317.definition: An abnormal blue color of the urine.

HP:0040318.name: Red urine
HP:0040318.definition: An abnormal red color of the urine.

HP:0040319.name: Dark urine
HP:0040319.definition: An abnormal dark color of the urine.
HP:0040319.definition_cn: 尿液异常深色（尿色异常加深）

HP:0040320.name: Red-brown urine
HP:0040320.definition: An abnormal red-brown color of the urine.
HP:0040320.definition_cn: 尿液呈现异常的红棕色。

HP:0040321.name: Dark yellow urine
HP:0040321.definition: An abnormal dark-yellow color of the urine.

HP:0040322.name: Purple urine
HP:0040322.definition: An abnormal purple color of the urine.

HP:0040323.name: Eyelid erythema
HP:0040323.definition: Redness of the skin of the eyelids, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.
HP:0040323.definition_cn: 眼睑皮肤红斑，由皮肤深层毛细血管充血引起。

HP:0040324.name: Heliotrope rash
HP:0040324.definition: In a heliotrope rash, the color of the skin turns to violet, which is the color of the heliotrope flower.
HP:0040324.definition_cn: 在天芥菜疹中，皮肤颜色转变为紫罗兰色，即天芥菜花的颜色。

HP:0040325.name: Bull's eye rash
HP:0040325.definition: A cutaneous eruption that consists of multiple (at least two) concentric erythematous rings.
HP:0040325.definition_cn: 一种皮肤病变，表现为多个（至少两个）同心性红斑环。

HP:0040327.name: Abnormal morphology of the olfactory bulb
HP:0040327.definition: An abnormal morphology of the olfactory bulb (bulbus olfactorius), which is involved in olfaction, i.e. the sense of smell.
HP:0040327.definition_cn: 嗅球（bulbus olfactorius）形态异常，该结构参与嗅觉功能，即嗅觉感知。

HP:0040328.name: Focal hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
HP:0040328.definition: An abnormal area of increased brightness (hyperintensity) that is limited to one particular area.
HP:0040328.name_cn: 磁共振成像显示脑白质局灶性高信号
HP:0040328.definition_cn: 局限于特定区域的异常高信号（高信号强度）区域。

HP:0040329.name: Multifocal hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
HP:0040329.definition: An abnormal area of increased brightness (hyperintensity) that occurs in several distinct areas.
HP:0040329.name_cn: 磁共振成像显示脑白质多灶性高信号
HP:0040329.definition_cn: 多发性异常高信号区域（Hyperintensity）。

HP:0040330.name: Confluent hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
HP:0040330.definition: Areas of brighter than expected MRI signal in the white matter of the brain whereby individual patches run together.
HP:0040330.name_cn: 磁共振成像显示脑白质融合性高信号
HP:0040330.definition_cn: 脑白质中MRI信号异常增高的区域，其中单个斑片相互融合。

HP:0040331.name: Focal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI

HP:0040332.name: Multifocal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI

HP:0040333.name: Confluent hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
HP:0040333.name_cn: 磁共振成像显示脑白质融合性低信号

HP:0040334.name: Purulent rhinitis
HP:0040334.definition: Chronic rhinitis accompanied by pus formation.

HP:0040402.name: Nipple localization
HP:0040402.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is distributed around the nipples or located in the nipples.
HP:0040402.definition_cn: 适用于分布于乳头周围或位于乳头的体征或症状。

HP:0040403.name: Breast microcalcification
HP:0040403.definition: The term breast microcalcification is used to define calcium deposits in the breast with a diameter of less than 1 mm.
HP:0040403.definition_cn: 乳腺微钙化这一术语用于定义直径小于1毫米的乳腺钙质沉积。

HP:0040404.name: Architectural distortion of breast
HP:0040404.definition: Architectural distortion is defined as an architectural disruption of the normal breast that does not have obvious mass opacities, which may be early signs of breast carcinoma.
HP:0040404.definition_cn: 结构扭曲被定义为乳腺正常结构的破坏，不伴有明显的肿块影，可能是乳腺癌的早期征象。

HP:0040405.name: Asymmetric thickening of the nipple-areolar complex
HP:0040405.definition: Thickening of the skin around the nipple with a distribution that is not equal on all sides.
HP:0040405.name_cn: 乳头-乳晕复合体不对称增厚
HP:0040405.definition_cn: 乳头周围皮肤增厚，且分布不均。

HP:0040406.name: Perimenopausal
HP:0040406.definition: Perimenopause, or the menopausal transition, encompasses that period of time during which physiologic changes mark progression toward a woman's final menstrual period. This phase begins with the onset of menstrual irregularities and continues until a woman reaches menopause, or one year after amenorrhea has occurred. Perimenopause can last for a variable amount of time, the median of which is four years.
HP:0040406.definition_cn: 围绝经期，或称绝经过渡期，是指女性生理变化标志着向最终月经周期过渡的时期。此阶段始于月经不规律的出现，并持续至女性达到绝经期，即闭经发生后一年。围绝经期的持续时间各异，其中位数为四年。

HP:0040407.name: Mastitis
HP:0040407.definition: Mastitis is defined as an inflammation of the breast and may or may not be accompanied by infection.
HP:0040407.definition_cn: 乳腺炎被定义为乳房的炎症，可能伴随感染，也可能不伴随感染。

HP:0040408.name: Ameliorated by menopause
HP:0040408.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by menopause.
HP:0040408.definition_cn: 适用于因绝经而改善或减轻的体征或症状。

HP:0040409.name: Fluctuance on palpation
HP:0040409.definition: Yielding to alternate pressure by palpating fingers so as to suggest that the area being felt contains fluid.
HP:0040409.definition_cn: 触诊时手指交替施压，提示被触诊区域存在液体。

HP:0040410.name: History of vasectomy
HP:0040410.definition: A medical history of having undergone a vasectomy prior to the current presentation.
HP:0040410.definition_cn: 既往有输精管结扎术病史。

HP:0040411.name: Pain in penis
HP:0040411.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the penis.
HP:0040411.definition_cn: 阴茎局部不适感（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感觉。

HP:0040412.name: Left ventricular thrombus
HP:0040412.definition: A blood clot (thrombus) localized in the left ventricle. Left ventricular thrombus is a serious complication of acute myocardial infarction and also of non-ischemic cardiomyopathies.
HP:0040412.definition_cn: 位于左心室的血栓（血栓形成）。左心室血栓是急性心肌梗死以及非缺血性心肌病的严重并发症。

HP:0040414.name: Gelatinous ascites
HP:0040414.definition: A type of ascites characterized by copious amounts of mucinous ascites and mucinous peritoneal implants, leading to progressive obliteration of the peritoneal cavity and intestinal obstruction.
HP:0040414.definition_cn: 一种以大量黏液性腹水和黏液性腹膜种植为特征的腹水类型，导致腹膜腔进行性闭塞和肠梗阻。

HP:0040415.name: Diffuse breast nodularity
HP:0040415.definition: Breast tissue with a lumpy or ropelike texture.
HP:0040415.name_cn: 弥漫性乳腺结节性病变
HP:0040415.definition_cn: 乳腺组织呈结节状或绳索样质地。

HP:0040416.name: Abnormal urinary nitrogen compound level
HP:0040416.definition: The amount of a nitrogen compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside of normal limits.
HP:0040416.definition_cn: 尿液中氮化合物的含量，经尿液浓度标准化后，超出正常范围。

HP:0040417.name: Decreased urinary biopterin level
HP:0040417.definition: The amount of biopterin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0040417.definition_cn: 尿液中生物蝶呤含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:0040418.name: Abnormal urine guanidinoacetic acid level
HP:0040418.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside normal limits.
HP:0040418.name_cn: 尿液胍基乙酸水平异常
HP:0040418.definition_cn: 尿液中肌基乙酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后超出正常范围。

HP:0040419.name: Elevated urine guanidinoacetic acid level
HP:0040419.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0040419.name_cn: 尿中胍基乙酸水平升高
HP:0040419.definition_cn: 尿液中肌基乙酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0040420.name: Decreased urinary neopterin level
HP:0040420.definition: The amount of neopterin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0040420.definition_cn: 尿液中新蝶呤含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:0040421.name: Abnormal urinary inosine level
HP:0040421.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0040421.definition_cn: 尿液中肌苷含量经尿液浓度标准化后超出正常范围。

HP:0040422.name: Elevated urinary inosine level
HP:0040422.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0040422.definition_cn: 尿液中肌苷含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:0040423.name: Abnormal urinary guanosine level
HP:0040423.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0040423.definition_cn: 尿液中鸟苷含量经尿液浓度标准化后超出正常范围。

HP:0040424.name: Elevated urinary guanosine level
HP:0040424.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0040424.definition_cn: 尿液中鸟苷浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:0040425.name: Abnormal urinary hypoxanthine level
HP:0040425.definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside of normal limits.
HP:0040425.definition_cn: 尿液中次黄嘌呤浓度经尿液浓度标准化后超出正常范围。

HP:0040426.name: Decreased urinary hypoxanthine level
HP:0040426.definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0040426.name_cn: 尿液中次黄嘌呤水平降低
HP:0040426.definition_cn: 尿液中次黄嘌呤浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，低于正常值下限。

HP:0041042.name: Absent neutrophil lactoferrin
HP:0041042.definition: The absence of lactoferrin in neutrophil granules, which could be caused by either an isolated failure of synthesis of this protein (or the production of an antigenically unrecognizable form of lactoferrin) or a complete deficiency of specific granule production.
HP:0041042.name_cn: 中性粒细胞乳铁蛋白缺失
HP:0041042.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞颗粒中乳铁蛋白的缺失，可能是由于该蛋白质的孤立合成失败（或产生抗原性不可识别的乳铁蛋白形式）或特定颗粒产生的完全缺陷所致。

HP:0041043.name: Neutrophil nuclear clefts
HP:0041043.definition: An abnormality of the nucleus of neutrophils, which presents as either a type I nuclear cleft, where the nuclear cleft may show a transition into a round/oval shape. The second type nuclear cleft, which runs perpendicular to the nuclear surface, and this type of cleft might be related to nuclear lobe formation.
HP:0041043.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞核异常，表现为I型核裂隙，其中核裂隙可能过渡为圆形/椭圆形。第二种类型为垂直于核表面的核裂隙，此类裂隙可能与核叶形成相关。

HP:0041044.name: Low neutrophil alkaline phosphatase
HP:0041044.definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase in neutrophils, which could be due to absence of enzyme or the production of defective enzyme.
HP:0041044.name_cn: 中性粒细胞碱性磷酸酶降低
HP:0041044.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞碱性磷酸酶水平异常降低，可能由于酶缺失或缺陷酶生成所致。

HP:0041045.name: Increased neutrophil mitochondria
HP:0041045.definition: An increased number of mitochondria detected in neutrophils.
HP:0041045.name_cn: 中性粒细胞线粒体增多
HP:0041045.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞中检测到线粒体数量增加。

HP:0041046.name: Increased neutrophil ribosomes
HP:0041046.definition: An increased number of ribosomes detected in neutrophils.
HP:0041046.name_cn: 中性粒细胞核糖体增多
HP:0041046.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞中核糖体数量增多。

HP:0041047.name: Bladder outlet obstruction
HP:0041047.definition: A compression or resistance upon the bladder outflow channel at any location from the bladder neck to urethral meatus, which usually causes lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS).
HP:0041047.definition_cn: 从膀胱颈至尿道外口任何部位对膀胱流出道产生的压迫或阻力，通常导致下尿路症状（LUTS）。

HP:0041048.name: Decreased expression of GPI-anchored proteins on the cell surface
HP:0041048.definition: A decrease in the protein expression of GPI-anchor proteins, such as CD55 and CD59, at the cell surface, which suggests a defect in GPI-anchor biosynthesis.
HP:0041048.name_cn: 细胞表面糖基磷脂酰肌醇锚定蛋白表达降低
HP:0041048.definition_cn: 细胞表面GPI锚定蛋白（如CD55和CD59）的蛋白表达降低，提示GPI锚定生物合成缺陷。

HP:0041050.name: Renal tubular cyst
HP:0041050.definition: Tubular lumnal dilatation/prominence lined by simple layer of cuboidal-to-flat tublar epihelial cells.
HP:0041050.definition_cn: 管腔扩张/突出，内衬单层立方至扁平管状上皮细胞。

HP:0041051.name: Ageusia
HP:0041051.definition: A rare condition that is characterized by a complete loss of taste function of the tongue.
HP:0041051.definition_cn: 一种罕见的病症，其特征为舌部味觉功能的完全丧失。

HP:0041052.name: Agenesis of putamen
HP:0041052.definition: A developmental defect characterized by the absence of the putamen owing to its failure to develop.
HP:0041052.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷，其特征是由于壳核未能发育而导致其缺失。

HP:0041054.name: obsolete Fractured thoracic segment of trunk

HP:0041055.name: Fractured humerus
HP:0041055.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the humerus.

HP:0041056.name: Hot cross bun sign
HP:0041056.definition: A cruciform-shaped hyperintensity within the pons found on T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
HP:0041056.definition_cn: 在T2加权磁共振成像（MRI）中发现桥脑内呈十字形高信号。

HP:0041057.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG4
HP:0041057.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood circulation.
HP:0041057.definition_cn: 循环血液中总免疫球蛋白G4（IgG4）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0041058.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG4
HP:0041058.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood.
HP:0041058.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G4（IgG4）的持续性降低。

HP:0041059.name: Chronic (near) absent circulating IgG4
HP:0041059.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG4 can be measured.
HP:0041059.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G4（IgG4）的持续缺失，最多只能检测到微量IgG4。

HP:0041060.name: Chronic partially decreased circulating IgG4
HP:0041060.definition: A lasting limited decrease of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood.
HP:0041060.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G4（IgG4）持续性的有限降低。

HP:0041061.name: Fractured calcaneus
HP:0041061.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the calcaneus.

HP:0041062.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG2
HP:0041062.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood circulation.
HP:0041062.definition_cn: 血液循环中总免疫球蛋白G2（IgG2）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0041063.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG2
HP:0041063.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood.
HP:0041063.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G2（IgG2）的持续性降低。

HP:0041065.name: Chronic (near) absent circulating IgG2
HP:0041065.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG2 can be measured.
HP:0041065.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G2（IgG2）的持续缺失，最多只能检测到微量IgG2。

HP:0041066.name: Chronic partially decreased circulating IgG2
HP:0041066.definition: A lasting limited decrease of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood.
HP:0041066.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G2（IgG2）的持续性有限降低。

HP:0041067.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG1
HP:0041067.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood circulation.
HP:0041067.definition_cn: 血液循环中总免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0041068.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG1
HP:0041068.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood.
HP:0041068.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）的持续降低。

HP:0041069.name: Chronic (near) absent circulating IgG1
HP:0041069.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG1 can be measured.
HP:0041069.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）的持续缺失，最多只能检测到微量IgG1。

HP:0041070.name: Chronic partially decreased circulating IgG1
HP:0041070.definition: A lasting limited decrease of immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood.
HP:0041070.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G1（IgG1）的持续有限性降低。

HP:0041071.name: Transient decreased circulating IgG3
HP:0041071.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood circulation.
HP:0041071.definition_cn: 血液循环中总免疫球蛋白G3（IgG3）水平暂时性低于正常值。

HP:0041072.name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG3
HP:0041072.definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood.
HP:0041072.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G3（IgG3）的持续性降低。

HP:0041073.name: Fractured thoracic vertebra
HP:0041073.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the thoracic vertebra.

HP:0041074.name: Chronic (near) absent circulating IgG3
HP:0041074.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG3 can be measured.
HP:0041074.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G3（IgG3）的持续缺失，最多只能检测到微量IgG3。

HP:0041075.name: Chronic partially decreased circulating IgG3
HP:0041075.definition: A lasting limited decrease of immunoglobulin G3 (IgG3) in the blood.
HP:0041075.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白G3（IgG3）的持续性有限降低。

HP:0041076.name: Abnormal immunoglobulin level in body fluid
HP:0041076.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in body fluids, such as mucous.
HP:0041076.name_cn: 体液免疫球蛋白水平异常
HP:0041076.definition_cn: 体液（如黏液）中免疫球蛋白水平异常偏离正常值。

HP:0041077.name: Increased immunoglobulin level in body fluid
HP:0041077.definition: An elevation from normal levels of immunoglobulins in body fluids, such as mucous.
HP:0041077.name_cn: 体液免疫球蛋白水平升高
HP:0041077.definition_cn: 体液（如黏液）中免疫球蛋白水平升高。

HP:0041078.name: Decreased immunoglobulin level in body fluid
HP:0041078.definition: An reduction from normal levels of immunoglobulins in body fluids, such as mucous.
HP:0041078.name_cn: 体液免疫球蛋白水平降低
HP:0041078.definition_cn: 体液（如黏液）中免疫球蛋白水平低于正常值。

HP:0041079.name: Decreased body fat percentage
HP:0041079.definition: The percentage of fat as a part of total body weight below the norm, usually defined as less than 14% for females and less than 8% for males.
HP:0041079.definition_cn: 体脂百分比低于正常值，通常定义为女性低于14%，男性低于8%。

HP:0041080.name: Abnormal proportion of exhausted T cells
HP:0041080.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of exhausted T cell relative to T cell in the blood.
HP:0041080.definition_cn: 血液中耗竭T细胞相对于T细胞的正常比例出现偏差。

HP:0041081.name: Fractured lower leg
HP:0041081.definition: Bone fracture anywhere in the tibia, fibula, or ankle.
HP:0041081.definition_cn: 胫骨、腓骨或踝关节任何部位的骨折。

HP:0041082.name: Fractured skull
HP:0041082.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the skull.

HP:0041083.name: Fractured phalanx
HP:0041083.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the phalanx.

HP:0041084.name: Compression-fractured thoracic vertebra
HP:0041084.definition: A fracture of the thoracic vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.
HP:0041084.definition_cn: 由年龄相关性骨量减少（骨质疏松症）导致的胸椎骨折。

HP:0041085.name: Compression-fractured vertebra
HP:0041085.definition: A fracture of the vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.
HP:0041085.definition_cn: 由骨量减少（骨质疏松症）引起的椎体骨折，该骨量减少是作为衰老过程的一部分而发生的。

HP:0041086.name: Compression-fractured cervical vertebra
HP:0041086.definition: A fracture of the cervical vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.
HP:0041086.definition_cn: 由骨量减少（骨质疏松症）引起的颈椎骨折，该骨量减少是作为衰老过程的一部分而发生的。

HP:0041087.name: Compression-fractured lumbar vertebra
HP:0041087.definition: A fracture of the lumbar vertebra that is caused by a loss of bone mass (osteoporosis) that occurs as part of aging.
HP:0041087.definition_cn: 由年龄相关性骨量减少（骨质疏松症）引起的腰椎骨折。

HP:0041088.name: Avulsion fractured humerus
HP:0041088.definition: A fractured in which a fragment of the humerus tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

HP:0041089.name: Avulsion fractured tibia
HP:0041089.definition: A fractured in which a fragment of the tibia tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.
HP:0041089.definition_cn: 胫骨撕脱性骨折，即由于物理创伤导致胫骨碎片从主骨体上撕裂分离。

HP:0041090.name: Pelvic avulsion fracture
HP:0041090.definition: An avulsion fracture (i.e., a type of fracture in which a piece of bone tears away from the site where the muscle attaches to the bone) of a bone of the pelvis.
HP:0041090.definition_cn: 骨盆撕脱性骨折（即一种骨折类型，其中一块骨片从肌肉附着于骨的部位撕裂）。

HP:0041091.name: Avulsion fractured epiphysis of femur
HP:0041091.definition: A fractured in which the fragment of the epiphysis of femur bone tears away from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.

HP:0041092.name: Emotional hypersensitivity
HP:0041092.definition: Heightened emotional reactivity to environmental stimuli, including the emotions of others.
HP:0041092.definition_cn: 对环境刺激（包括他人情绪）的情绪反应性增强。

HP:0041093.name: Beau's lines
HP:0041093.definition: A nail dystrophy that is preseents as grooved lines that run from side to side on the fingernail or the toenail that may look like indentations or ridges on the nail plate. They are caused by temporary disruption in the growth of proximal nail matrix. Trauma is usually the initiating factor such as infections, severe medical illnesses, major surgery/anesthesia, medication side effects, and autoimmune disease.
HP:0041093.definition_cn: 一种表现为指甲或趾甲上横向沟纹的甲营养不良，可能呈现为甲板上的凹陷或隆起。这些沟纹是由于近端甲母质生长暂时性中断所致。创伤通常是诱发因素，如感染、严重内科疾病、重大手术/麻醉、药物副作用以及自身免疫性疾病。

HP:0041094.name: Complete tracheal ring
HP:0041094.definition: Continuous or nearly continuous configuration of the cartilaginous tracheal ring.
HP:0041094.definition_cn: 气管软骨环的连续或近乎连续构型。

HP:0041095.name: Decreased middle cerebral artery pulsatility index
HP:0041095.definition: Abnormally reduced blood flow pulsatility in in the middle cerebral artery (MCA). The pulsatility index (PI) is calculated using the following equation PI = (peak systolic velocity-end-diastolic velocity)/mean velocity.
HP:0041095.name_cn: 大脑中动脉搏动指数降低
HP:0041095.definition_cn: 大脑中动脉（MCA）血流搏动性异常降低。搏动指数（PI）通过以下公式计算：PI =（收缩期峰值流速 - 舒张末期流速）/ 平均流速。

HP:0041114.name: Fractured metaphysis of femur
HP:0041114.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the metaphysis of femur.
HP:0041114.definition_cn: 股骨干骺端部分或完全骨折。
