HP:0041221.definition_cn: 股骨头部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041222.name: Fractured fibula
HP:0041222.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the fibula.

HP:0041223.name: Fractured metatarsal bone of digit 5
HP:0041223.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the metatarsal bone of digit 5.
HP:0041223.definition_cn: 第五趾跖骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041224.name: Fractured manual digit bone
HP:0041224.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the manual digit bone.
HP:0041224.definition_cn: 手指骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041225.name: Fractured 1st metacarpal
HP:0041225.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the metacarpal bone of digit 1.
HP:0041225.definition_cn: 第一掌骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041226.name: Fractured distal tarsal bone
HP:0041226.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the distal tarsal bone.
HP:0041226.definition_cn: 远端跗骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041227.name: Fractured distal tarsal bone 2
HP:0041227.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the distal tarsal bone 2.
HP:0041227.definition_cn: 远端跗骨2部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041228.name: Fractured distal tarsal bone 3
HP:0041228.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the distal tarsal bone 3.
HP:0041228.definition_cn: 远端跗骨3的部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041230.name: Fractured metatarsal bone of digit 4
HP:0041230.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the metatarsal bone of digit 4.
HP:0041230.definition_cn: 第四趾跖骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041231.name: Fractured metatarsal bone of digit 1
HP:0041231.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the metatarsal bone of digit 1.
HP:0041231.definition_cn: 第一跖骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041232.name: obsolete Fractured skeleton of manual acropodium
HP:0041232.name_cn: 陈旧性手部肢端骨折骨架

HP:0041233.name: Fractured ilium
HP:0041233.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the ilium.

HP:0041234.name: Fractured bone of jaw
HP:0041234.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the bone of jaw.
HP:0041234.definition_cn: 下颌骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041235.name: Fractured hindlimb bone
HP:0041235.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the hindlimb bone.
HP:0041235.definition_cn: 后肢骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041236.name: Fractured middle finger phalanx
HP:0041236.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the middle phalanx of a finger.
HP:0041236.definition_cn: 手指中节指骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041237.name: Fractured patella
HP:0041237.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the patella.

HP:0041239.name: Fractured thumb phalanx
HP:0041239.definition: A partial or complete breakage of a phalanx of the thumb.
HP:0041239.definition_cn: 拇指指骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041240.name: Fractured phalanx of pes
HP:0041240.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the phalanx of pes.
HP:0041240.definition_cn: 足趾指骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041241.name: Fractured finger phalanx
HP:0041241.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the phalanx of a finger.

HP:0041243.name: Fractured proximal finger phalanx
HP:0041243.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the proximal phalanx of manus.
HP:0041243.definition_cn: 手部近节指骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041244.name: Fractured scapula
HP:0041244.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the scapula.
HP:0041244.definition_cn: 肩胛骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041245.name: Fractured shoulder bone
HP:0041245.definition: A partial or complete breakage of a shoulder bone.
HP:0041245.definition_cn: 肩胛骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:0041246.name: Fractured sternum
HP:0041246.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the sternum.

HP:0041247.name: Fractured tarsal bone
HP:0041247.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the tarsal bone.

HP:0041248.name: Fractured carpal bone
HP:0041248.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the carpal bone.

HP:0041249.name: Fractured nose
HP:0041249.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the nose.

HP:0045004.name: Abnormal ossification of the trapezoid bone

HP:0045005.name: Neural tube defect
HP:0045005.definition: A neural tube defect arises when the neural tube, the embryonic precursor of the brain and spinal cord, fails to close during neurulation. The cranial region (anencephaly) or the low spine (open spina bifida; myelomeningocele) are most commonly affected although, in the severe NTD craniorachischisis, almost the entire neural tube remains open, from midbrain to low spine.
HP:0045005.definition_cn: 神经管缺陷（Neural Tube Defect, NTD）是指在神经胚形成过程中，作为大脑和脊髓胚胎前体的神经管未能正常闭合。最常见的受累部位包括颅部区域（无脑畸形，Anencephaly）或脊柱下部（开放性脊柱裂，Open Spina Bifida；脊髓脊膜膨出，Myelomeningocele）。在严重的神经管缺陷类型——颅脊柱裂（Craniorachischisis）中，几乎整个神经管从中脑至脊柱下部均保持开放状态。

HP:0045006.name: Aplasia of lymphatic vessels
HP:0045006.definition_cn: 淋巴管发育不全（淋巴管缺失）。

HP:0045007.name: Abnormal substantia nigra morphology
HP:0045007.definition: A structural anomaly of the substantia nigra, which is a midbrain dopaminergic nucleus which has a critical role in modulating motor movement and reward functions as part of the basal ganglia circuitry.
HP:0045007.definition_cn: 黑质结构异常，黑质为中脑多巴胺能核团，作为基底神经节环路的重要组成部分，在调节运动功能和奖赏功能中起关键作用。

HP:0045009.name: obsolete Abnormal morphology of the radius

HP:0045010.name: Abnormal peripheral nerve morphology by anatomical site
HP:0045010.definition: Abnormal morphology of a specific peripheral nerve
HP:0045010.name_cn: 解剖部位周围神经形态异常
HP:0045010.definition_cn: 特定周围神经的形态学异常

HP:0045011.name: Decreased urine bicarbonate concentration
HP:0045011.definition: Abnormally decreased concentration of hydrogencarbonate in the urine.
HP:0045011.name_cn: 尿液碳酸氢盐浓度降低
HP:0045011.definition_cn: 尿液碳酸氢盐浓度异常降低。

HP:0045012.name: Decreased urinary catecholamine concentration
HP:0045012.name_cn: 尿液中儿茶酚胺浓度降低

HP:0045016.name: obsolete Elevated serum long-chain fatty acids
HP:0045016.name_cn: 过时的血清长链脂肪酸升高

HP:0045017.name: Congenital malformation of the left heart
HP:0045017.definition: Defect or defects of the morphogenesis of the left heart identifiable at birth.
HP:0045017.definition_cn: 出生时可识别的左心形态发生缺陷。

HP:0045025.name: Narrow palpebral fissure
HP:0045025.definition: Reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids.
HP:0045025.definition_cn: 上睑与下睑之间垂直距离的缩短。

HP:0045026.name: Abnormal mediastinum morphology
HP:0045026.definition: Any structural anomaly of the central compartment of the thoracic cavity.
HP:0045026.definition_cn: 胸腔中央隔室的结构异常。

HP:0045028.name: Microlissencephaly
HP:0045028.definition: Severe microcephaly and lissencephaly with granular surfaces with immature cortical plate, reduced in thickness, with focal polymicrogyria and immature small neurons with rare processes, intermingled with a considerable number of glial elements.
HP:0045028.definition_cn: 严重的小头畸形和光滑脑畸形，表面呈颗粒状，皮质板未成熟且厚度减少，伴有局灶性多小脑回畸形和未成熟的小神经元，其突起稀少，混杂有大量胶质细胞成分。

HP:0045029.name: Eosinophilic fasciitis
HP:0045029.definition: Inflammation and thickening (localized fibrosis) of the fascia, the tissue under the skin and over the muscle, typically associated with a build up of eosinophils in the muscles and tissues.
HP:0045029.definition_cn: 筋膜炎和筋膜增厚（局部纤维化），即位于皮下和肌肉上方的筋膜组织发生炎症和增厚，通常与肌肉和组织中嗜酸性粒细胞的积聚相关。

HP:0045034.name: Elevated urinary 3-aminoisobutyric acid
HP:0045034.definition: An increased amount of 3-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine.
HP:0045034.definition_cn: 尿液中3-氨基异丁酸水平升高。

HP:0045038.name: Gastric lymphoma
HP:0045038.definition: Lymphoma that originates in the stomach itself.
HP:0045038.definition_cn: 原发性胃淋巴瘤（Primary Gastric Lymphoma）

HP:0045039.name: Osteolysis involving bones of the upper limbs

HP:0045040.name: Abnormal circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
HP:0045040.definition: A deviation from the normal serum concentration/activity of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), which catalyzes the reduction of pyruvate to form lactate.
HP:0045040.name_cn: 异常循环乳酸脱氢酶浓度
HP:0045040.definition_cn: 乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）血清浓度/活性异常，该酶催化丙酮酸还原生成乳酸。

HP:0045041.name: Reduced circulating lactate dehydrogenase concentration
HP:0045041.definition: Concentration of lactate dehydrogenase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0045041.name_cn: 循环乳酸脱氢酶浓度降低
HP:0045041.definition_cn: 循环血液中乳酸脱氢酶浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0045042.name: Decreased circulating complement C4 concentration
HP:0045042.definition: Concentration of the complement component C4 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0045042.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C4浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0045043.name: Decreased circulating complement C4a concentration
HP:0045043.definition: Concentration of the complement component C4a in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0045043.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C4a浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0045044.name: Decreased circulating complement C4b concentration
HP:0045044.definition: Concentration of the complement component C4b in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0045044.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分C4b浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0045045.name: Elevated circulating acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0045045.definition: Concentration of acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0045045.name_cn: 循环酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0045045.definition_cn: 血液中酰基肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0045046.name: Reduced insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
HP:0045046.definition: An abnormally decreased concentration of insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit level in the blood circulation.
HP:0045046.name_cn: 胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基浓度降低
HP:0045046.definition_cn: 血液循环中胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白酸不稳定亚基水平异常降低。

HP:0045047.name: HbS hemoglobin
HP:0045047.definition: Presence of an abnormal type of hemoglobin characterized by the substitution of a glutamic acid residue at position 7 following the initial methionine residue by a valine (the mutation causative of sickle cell disease). The mutation promotes the polymerization of the HbS under conditions of low oxygen concentration. HbS can be identified by multiple methodologies including hemoglobin electrophoresis and high-performance liquid chromatography.
HP:0045047.definition_cn: 存在一种异常类型的血红蛋白，其特征是在起始甲硫氨酸残基后的第7位谷氨酸残基被缬氨酸取代（该突变导致镰状细胞病）。该突变在低氧浓度条件下促进HbS的聚合。HbS可通过多种方法进行鉴定，包括血红蛋白电泳和高效液相色谱法。

HP:0045048.name: Increased HbA2 hemoglobin
HP:0045048.definition: An elevated concentration in the blood of hemoglobin A2 (HbA2), which is a normal variant of hemoglobin A that consists of two alpha and two delta chains and is normally present at low levels in adults but may be increased in beta thalassemia.
HP:0045048.definition_cn: 血液中血红蛋白A2（HbA2）浓度升高，HbA2是血红蛋白A的一种正常变异体，由两条α链和两条δ链组成，在成人中通常以低水平存在，但在β地中海贫血中可能升高。

HP:0045049.name: Abnormal DLCO
HP:0045049.definition: An abnormal amount of oxygen passes into the blood from the lungs and/or an abnormal amount of carbon dioxide passes from the blood into the lungs.
HP:0045049.name_cn: 异常的一氧化碳弥散量（DLCO）
HP:0045049.definition_cn: 异常量的氧气从肺部进入血液和/或异常量的二氧化碳从血液进入肺部。

HP:0045050.name: Increased DLCO
HP:0045050.definition: Increased ability of the lungs to transfer gas from inspired air to the bloodstream as measured by the diffusing capacity of the lungs for carbon monoxide (DLCO) test.
HP:0045050.definition_cn: 通过一氧化碳弥散量（DLCO）测试测量的肺部将吸入空气中的气体转移至血液的能力增强。

HP:0045051.name: Decreased DLCO
HP:0045051.definition: Reduced ability of the lungs to transfer gas from inspired air to the bloodstream as measured by the diffusing capacity of the lungs for carbon monoxide (DLCO) test.
HP:0045051.definition_cn: 肺一氧化碳弥散量（DLCO）测试显示，肺部将吸入空气中的气体转移至血液的能力降低。

HP:0045052.name: Abnormality of the brachial nerve plexus
HP:0045052.definition: Any abnormality of the brachial nerve plexus.

HP:0045053.name: Abnormality of the lumbosacral nerve plexus
HP:0045053.definition: Any abnormality of the lumbosacral nerve plexus.

HP:0045055.name: Tiger tail banding
HP:0045055.definition: An abnormal appearance of hair under polarizing microscopy (using crossed polarizers), whereby hair shafts show striking alternating bright and dark bands, often referred to as tiger tail banding.
HP:0045055.definition_cn: 在偏振光显微镜下（使用交叉偏振器）观察到的毛发异常外观，表现为毛干呈现出显著的明暗交替带，通常称为虎尾带。

HP:0045056.name: Abnormal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
HP:0045056.definition: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the blood circulation outside normal limits.
HP:0045056.name_cn: 异常循环甲胎蛋白浓度
HP:0045056.definition_cn: 血清甲胎蛋白浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0045057.name: Decreased circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
HP:0045057.definition: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0045057.name_cn: 循环甲胎蛋白浓度降低
HP:0045057.definition_cn: 血清甲胎蛋白浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0045058.name: Abnormality of the testis size
HP:0045058.definition: An anomaly of the size of the testicle (the male gonad).
HP:0045058.definition_cn: 睾丸（男性性腺）大小异常。

HP:0045059.name: Hyperkeratotic papule
HP:0045059.definition: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point that is composed of localized hyperkeratosis (the latter may be demonstrated histopathologically).
HP:0045059.definition_cn: 局限性、实性皮肤隆起，无可见液体，直径从针尖大小至最宽处小于10毫米不等，由局部角化过度构成（后者可通过组织病理学证实）。

HP:0045060.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia involving bones of the extremities
HP:0045060.name_cn: 四肢骨骼发育不全/发育不良

HP:0045063.name: Increased PIVKA-II
HP:0045063.definition: Des-gamma carboxyprothrombin (DCP) or pro-thrombin induced by vitamin K absence-II (PIVKA-II) is an abnormal prothrombin protein that is increased in the serum of patients with HCC. Generation of DCP is thought to be a result of an acquired defect in the post- translational carboxylation of the prothrombin precursor in malignant cells.
HP:0045063.definition_cn: 脱-γ-羧基凝血酶原（Des-gamma carboxyprothrombin, DCP）或维生素K缺乏诱导的凝血酶原-II（Prothrombin Induced by Vitamin K Absence-II, PIVKA-II）是一种异常的凝血酶原蛋白，在肝细胞癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma, HCC）患者的血清中水平升高。DCP的产生被认为是恶性细胞中凝血酶原前体在翻译后羧化过程中获得性缺陷的结果。

HP:0045075.name: Sparse eyebrow
HP:0045075.definition_cn: 眉毛毛发密度/数量减少。

HP:0045079.name: Distal femoral metaphyseal irregularity
HP:0045079.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of the distal metaphysis of the femur.
HP:0045079.name_cn: 股骨远端干骺端不规则
HP:0045079.definition_cn: 股骨远端干骺端正常光滑表面不规则。

HP:0045080.name: Decreased proportion of CD3-positive T cells
HP:0045080.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of CD3-positive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0045080.definition_cn: CD3阳性T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0045081.name: Abnormality of body mass index
HP:0045081.definition: Anomaly in the weight-to-height squared ratio, calculated by dividing the individual's weight in kilograms by the square of the individual's height in meters and used as an indicator of obesity and underweight compared to averages.
HP:0045081.definition_cn: 体重指数异常，通过将个体体重（千克）除以身高（米）的平方计算得出，用于作为肥胖和体重不足的指标，并与平均值进行比较。

HP:0045082.name: Decreased body mass index
HP:0045082.definition: Abnormally decreased weight-to-height squared ratio, calculated by dividing the individual's weight in kilograms by the square of the individual's height in meters and used as an indicator of underweight compared to averages.
HP:0045082.definition_cn: 体重指数（BMI）异常降低，通过将个体体重（千克）除以身高（米）的平方计算得出，作为与平均值相比体重过低的指标。

HP:0045083.name: obsolete Increased body mass index
HP:0045083.name_cn: 过时的 体重指数增加

HP:0045086.name: Knee joint hypermobility
HP:0045086.definition: The ability of the knee to move past its normal range of motion, (knee hyperextension is greater than 10 degrees).
HP:0045086.definition_cn: 膝关节活动度超过其正常范围（膝关节过伸超过10度）。

HP:0045088.name: Clinical relevance
HP:0045088.definition: Subontology for annotating phenotypic features as distinctive or minor findings in patients. The subontology is intended to be used to annotate subjective clinical impressions of whether a certain finding is important for the differential diagnosis.
HP:0045088.definition_cn: 用于注释表型特征为患者中显著或次要发现的子本体论。该子本体论旨在用于注释关于某一发现是否对鉴别诊断具有重要性的主观临床印象。

HP:0045089.name: Distinctive finding
HP:0045089.definition: In clinical parlance, findings are occasionally interpreted as being distinctive or minor, reflecting a subjective clinical impression of the importance of a feature for the differential diagnosis. A minor finding is taken to be one that is likely to have high utility in distinguishing the correct diagnosis from other candidates in the differential.
HP:0045089.definition_cn: 在临床术语中，偶尔会将发现解释为具有独特性或次要性，这反映了对某一特征在鉴别诊断中重要性的主观临床印象。次要发现被认为是在鉴别诊断中具有较高效用，能够将正确诊断与其他候选诊断区分开来的特征。

HP:0045090.name: Minor finding
HP:0045090.definition: In clinical parlance, findings are occasionally interpreted as being distinctive or minor, reflecting a subjective clinical impression of the importance of a feature for the differential diagnosis. A minor finding is taken to be one that is unlikely to help distinguish the correct diagnosis from other candidates in the differential.
HP:0045090.definition_cn: 在临床术语中，偶尔会将检查结果解释为具有特异性或次要性，这反映了临床医生对某一特征在鉴别诊断中的重要性的主观印象。次要性发现通常被认为不太可能有助于在鉴别诊断中区分出正确的诊断。

HP:0046502.name: Anorgasmia
HP:0046502.definition: Inability of individual to reach orgasm.

HP:0046504.name: Decreased libido
HP:0046504.definition_cn: 性欲减退 (Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder, HSDD)

HP:0046505.name: Hand pain
HP:0046505.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort localized to the hand.
HP:0046505.definition_cn: 一种以手部局部身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:0046506.name: Pain in head and neck region

HP:0046507.name: Bradypnea
HP:0046507.definition: Bradypnea is referring to breathing that is abnormally slow.
HP:0046507.definition_cn: 呼吸过缓是指呼吸频率异常缓慢。

HP:0046508.name: Abnormal cervical spine morphology
HP:0046508.definition: Any morphological abnormality of the cervical vertebral column.

HP:0100000.name: Early onset of sexual maturation
HP:0100000.definition: An early onset of puberty, in this case early does not refer to precocious.
HP:0100000.definition_cn: 青春期早期，此处“早期”并非指性早熟。

HP:0100001.name: Malignant mesothelioma
HP:0100001.definition: Malignant mesothelioma is a form of cancer that originates from the cells of the mesothelium, a thin tissue layer surrounding the body's internal organs. Malignant mesothelioma is almost exclusively caused by asbestos exposure, pleural mesothelioma being the most common form, affecting the lining of the lungs called the pleura. Other forms such as perioneal-, percardial- or testicular- mesothelioma are much rarer.
HP:0100001.definition_cn: 恶性间皮瘤是一种起源于间皮细胞的癌症，间皮是覆盖在人体内部器官表面的薄层组织。恶性间皮瘤几乎完全由石棉暴露引起，其中胸膜间皮瘤是最常见的类型，影响称为胸膜的肺脏内衬。其他类型如腹膜间皮瘤、心包间皮瘤或睾丸间皮瘤则较为罕见。

HP:0100002.name: Pleural mesothelioma
HP:0100002.definition: A malignant mesothelioma originating from cells of the pleura (the thin layer of mesothelium lining the lungs). Pleural mesothelioma is the most common form of mesothelioma.
HP:0100002.definition_cn: 一种源自胸膜（覆盖肺部的薄层间皮）细胞的恶性间皮瘤。胸膜间皮瘤是间皮瘤最常见的类型。

HP:0100003.name: Peritoneal mesothelioma
HP:0100003.definition: A Malignant mesothelioma originating from cells of the peritoneum (the thin layer of mesothelium lining the abdomen). Peritoneal mesothelioma is the second most common form of mesothelioma after pleural mesothelioma.
HP:0100003.definition_cn: 恶性间皮瘤起源于腹膜细胞（覆盖腹部的薄层间皮）。腹膜间皮瘤是继胸膜间皮瘤之后第二常见的间皮瘤类型。

HP:0100004.name: Pericardial mesothelioma
HP:0100004.definition: A Malignant mesothelioma originating from cells of the pericardium (the thin layer of mesothelium lining the heart).
HP:0100004.definition_cn: 恶性间皮瘤，起源于心包（覆盖心脏的薄层间皮组织）。

HP:0100005.name: Testicular mesothelioma
HP:0100005.definition: A Malignant mesothelioma of the testis.

HP:0100006.name: Neoplasm of the central nervous system
HP:0100006.definition: A neoplasm of the central nervous system.

HP:0100007.name: Neoplasm of the peripheral nervous system
HP:0100007.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm (tumor) of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0100007.definition_cn: 周围神经系统良性或恶性肿瘤（肿瘤）。

HP:0100008.name: Schwannoma
HP:0100008.definition: A benign nerve sheath tumor composed of Schwann cells.
HP:0100008.definition_cn: 由施万细胞组成的良性神经鞘瘤。

HP:0100012.name: Neoplasm of the eye
HP:0100012.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the eye.
HP:0100012.definition_cn: 眼肿瘤（眼部组织的异常增生）

HP:0100013.name: Neoplasm of the breast
HP:0100013.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the breast.
HP:0100013.definition_cn: 乳腺肿瘤（乳腺组织异常增生）

HP:0100014.name: Epiretinal membrane
HP:0100014.definition: An epiretinal membrane is a thin sheet of fibrous tissue that can develop on the surface of the macular area of the retina and cause a disturbance in vision. An epiretinal membrane area can develop on the thin macular area of the retin. An epiretinal membrane is also sometimes called a macular pucker, premacular fibrosis, surface wrinkling retinopathy or cellophane maculopathy.
HP:0100014.definition_cn: 视网膜前膜是一种纤维组织薄膜，可形成于视网膜黄斑区表面，导致视力障碍。视网膜前膜可形成于视网膜薄弱的黄斑区。视网膜前膜有时也被称为黄斑皱褶、黄斑前纤维化、表面皱褶性视网膜病变或玻璃纸样黄斑病变。

HP:0100015.name: Stahl ear
HP:0100015.definition: The presence of a supernumerary, i.e. third, crus of the helix in the helix, arising at or above the normal bifurcation of the antihelix.
HP:0100015.definition_cn: 耳轮内存在额外（即第三）耳轮脚，起源于对耳轮正常分叉处或其上方。

HP:0100016.name: Abnormal mesentery morphology
HP:0100016.definition: Folds of membranous tissue (peritoneum, mesothelium) attached to the wall of the abdomen and enclosing viscera. Examples include the mesentery for the small intestine; the transverse mesocolon, which attaches the transverse portion of the colon to the back wall of the abdomen; and the mesosigmoid, which enfolds the sigmoid portion of the colon. Cells of the same embryologic origin also surround the other organs of the body such as the lungs (pleura) or the heart (pericardium).
HP:0100016.definition_cn: 附着于腹壁并包裹内脏的膜性组织（腹膜、间皮）皱襞。例如，小肠的肠系膜；横结肠系膜，将结肠的横部附着于腹后壁；以及乙状结肠系膜，包裹结肠的乙状部。具有相同胚胎起源的细胞也围绕身体的其他器官，如肺（胸膜）或心脏（心包）。

HP:0100017.name: Capsular cataract
HP:0100017.definition: A cataract that affects the capsule of the lens.
HP:0100017.definition_cn: 影响晶状体囊的白内障。

HP:0100018.name: Nuclear cataract
HP:0100018.definition: A nuclear cataract is an opacity or clouding that develops in the lens nucleus. That is, a nuclear cataract is one that is located in the center of the lens. The nucleus tends to darken changing from clear to yellow and sometimes brown.
HP:0100018.definition_cn: 核性白内障是指晶状体核内发生的混浊或云雾状改变。即核性白内障位于晶状体的中心部位。晶状体核往往会发生颜色变化，从透明变为黄色，有时甚至变为棕色。

HP:0100019.name: Cortical cataract
HP:0100019.definition: A cataract which affects the layer of the lens surrounding the nucleus, i.e., the lens cortex. It is identified by its unique wedge or spoke appearance.
HP:0100019.definition_cn: 影响晶状体核周围层（即晶状体皮质）的白内障。其特征为独特的楔形或轮辐状外观。

HP:0100020.name: Posterior capsular cataract
HP:0100020.definition: A cataract which is found in the back outer layer of the lens. This type often develops more rapidly.
HP:0100020.definition_cn: 后囊下白内障（Posterior Subcapsular Cataract, PSC），位于晶状体后囊外层，通常进展较快。

HP:0100021.name: Cerebral palsy
HP:0100021.definition: Cerebral palsy describes a group of permanent disorders of the development of movement and posture, causing activity limitation, that are attributed to nonprogressive disturbances that occurred in the developing fetal or infant brain. The motor disorders of cerebral palsy are often accompanied by disturbances of sensation, perception, cognition, communication, and behavior, by epilepsy, and by secondary musculoskeletal problems.
HP:0100021.definition_cn: 脑性瘫痪（Cerebral Palsy）是指一组由于发育中的胎儿或婴儿大脑发生非进行性损伤所导致的运动和姿势发育障碍的永久性疾病，这些障碍导致活动受限。脑性瘫痪的运动障碍常伴有感觉、知觉、认知、交流和行为障碍，以及癫痫和继发性肌肉骨骼问题。

HP:0100022.name: Abnormality of movement
HP:0100022.definition: An abnormality of movement with a neurological basis characterized by changes in coordination and speed of voluntary movements.
HP:0100022.definition_cn: 一种以神经系统为基础的异常运动，其特征为自主运动的协调性和速度发生改变。

HP:0100023.name: Recurrent hand flapping
HP:0100023.definition: A type of repetitive behavior in which the affected individual repeatedly waves the hands and/or arms rhythmically.
HP:0100023.definition_cn: 一种刻板重复性行为，患者表现为双手和/或双臂有节律性地反复挥动。

HP:0100024.name: Conspicuously happy disposition
HP:0100024.definition: An unusually happy demeanor over time, which can also be observed during inappropriate situations that should, for example, cause distress, fear, or anger.
HP:0100024.definition_cn: 长期表现出异常愉悦的情绪状态，即使在应引发痛苦、恐惧或愤怒等负面情绪的不适当情境下亦可观察到。

HP:0100025.name: Overfriendliness
HP:0100025.definition: A form of hypersociability that presents as mostly inappropriate friendliness towards others.
HP:0100025.definition_cn: 一种表现为对他人过度不适当友好的社交过度活跃形式。

HP:0100026.name: Arteriovenous malformation
HP:0100026.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries.

HP:0100029.name: Lingual thyroid
HP:0100029.definition: An aberrant thyroid gland or Ectopic thyroid located at the base of the tongue, just posterior to the foramen cecum as a result of a failure of the thyroid to descend.
HP:0100029.definition_cn: 异位甲状腺或舌根异位甲状腺，位于舌根处，恰在盲孔后方，由于甲状腺未能下降所致。

HP:0100030.name: Accessory ectopic thyroid tissue
HP:0100030.definition: Accessory ectopic thyroid tissue arising from remnants of the thyroglossal duct anywhere along the path of the thyroglossal duct tract.
HP:0100030.definition_cn: 源自甲状舌管路径上任何部位的甲状舌管残余组织产生的副异位甲状腺组织。

HP:0100031.name: Neoplasm of the thyroid gland
HP:0100031.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the thyroid gland.
HP:0100031.definition_cn: 甲状腺肿瘤（甲状腺组织异常增生）

HP:0100033.name: Tics
HP:0100033.definition: Repeated, individually recognizable, intermittent movements or movement fragments that are almost always briefly suppressible and are usually associated with awareness of an urge to perform the movement.
HP:0100033.definition_cn: 反复出现的、个体可识别的、间歇性的运动或运动片段，几乎总是可以短暂抑制，通常与执行运动的冲动意识相关。

HP:0100034.name: Motor tics
HP:0100034.definition: Movement-based tics affecting discrete muscle groups.
HP:0100034.definition_cn: 影响离散肌群的运动性抽动。

HP:0100035.name: Phonic tics
HP:0100035.definition: Tics are defined as movements or sounds that resemble physiological motor behaviors, but are typically inopportune to social context and appear sudden, repetitive, and often exaggerated. Tic vocalizations commonly termed vocal or phonic tics may include any possible sound (eg, sniffing, coughing, throat clearing, whistling, or grunting), word, or sentence and are most commonly encountered within the spectrum of primary tic disorders, as Tourette syndrome.
HP:0100035.definition_cn: 抽动症被定义为类似于生理性运动行为的动作或声音，但通常在社交场合中不合时宜，表现为突然、重复且常常夸张。发声性抽动通常称为声音或语音性抽动，可能包括任何可能的声音（例如，吸气、咳嗽、清嗓、吹口哨或咕噜声）、词语或句子，最常见于原发性抽动障碍谱系中，如抽动秽语综合征（Tourette综合征）。

HP:0100036.name: Pseudo-fractures
HP:0100036.definition: A band of bone material of decreased density forming alongside the surface of the cortical bone with thickening of the periosteum. Callus formation in the affected area is common and gives the appearance of a false fracture.
HP:0100036.definition_cn: 沿皮质骨表面形成的低密度骨材料带，伴随骨膜增厚。受累区域常见骨痂形成，呈现假性骨折的外观。

HP:0100037.name: Abnormality of the scalp hair
HP:0100037.definition: An abnormality of the hair of head.

HP:0100038.name: Slow-growing scalp hair
HP:0100038.definition: Scalp hair whose growth is slower than normal.
HP:0100038.definition_cn: 头皮毛发生长速度低于正常水平。

HP:0100039.name: Thickened cortex of bones
HP:0100039.definition: An Abnormality of cortical bone leading to an abnormal thickness of the cortex of affected bones.
HP:0100039.definition_cn: 一种皮质骨异常，导致受累骨骼的皮质厚度异常增厚。

HP:0100040.definition: A broad appearance of the second toe.

HP:0100041.name: Broad 3rd toe
HP:0100041.definition: A broad appearance of the third toe.

HP:0100042.name: Broad 4th toe
HP:0100042.definition: A broad appearance of the fourth toe.

HP:0100043.name: Broad 5th toe
HP:0100043.definition: A broad appearance of the fifth toe.

HP:0100050.name: Ivory epiphyses of the 2nd toe
HP:0100050.definition: Epiphyses of the 2nd toe are hard and dense like ivory. Such an epiphysis has a uniformly dense appearance on radiographs.
HP:0100050.definition_cn: 第二趾骨骺硬化且致密如象牙。此类骨骺在X线片上呈现均匀致密的外观。

HP:0100238.name: Synostosis involving bones of the upper limbs
HP:0100238.definition: An abnormal union between bones or parts of bones of the upper limbs.
HP:0100238.definition_cn: 上肢骨或骨部分之间的异常连接。

HP:0100240.name: Synostosis of joints
HP:0100240.definition: The abnormal fusion of neighboring bones across a joint.

HP:0100241.name: Ectopic respiratory mucosa
HP:0100241.definition: Ectopic respiratory epithelium presenting as a superficial lesion in the skin usually localized unilateral in the skin of the forearm and associated with ipsilateral hand malformations.
HP:0100241.definition_cn: 异位呼吸上皮表现为皮肤浅表病变，通常单侧局限于前臂皮肤，并伴有同侧手部畸形。

HP:0100242.name: Sarcoma
HP:0100242.definition: A connective tissue neoplasm formed by proliferation of mesodermal cells. Bone and soft tissue sarcomas are the main types of sarcoma. Sarcoma is usually highly malignant.
HP:0100242.definition_cn: 一种由中胚层细胞增殖形成的结缔组织肿瘤。骨肉瘤和软组织肉瘤是肉瘤的主要类型。肉瘤通常具有高度恶性。

HP:0100243.name: Leiomyosarcoma
HP:0100243.definition: A smooth muscle connective tissue tumor, which is rare type of cancer that is a malignant neoplasm of smooth muscle. When such a neoplasm is benign, it is called a leiomyoma.
HP:0100243.definition_cn: 平滑肌结缔组织肿瘤，这是一种罕见的恶性肿瘤，属于平滑肌的恶性新生物。当此类新生物为良性时，称为平滑肌瘤。

HP:0100244.name: Fibrosarcoma
HP:0100244.definition: A fibroblastic sarcoma is a malignant tumor derived from fibrous connective tissue and characterized by immature proliferating fibroblasts or undifferentiated anaplastic spindle cells.
HP:0100244.definition_cn: 纤维肉瘤是一种源自纤维结缔组织的恶性肿瘤，其特征为未成熟增殖的成纤维细胞或未分化的间变性梭形细胞。

HP:0100245.name: Gastrointestinal desmoid tumor
HP:0100245.definition: Benign, slow-growing tumors without any metastatic potential. Despite their benign nature, they can damage nearby structures causing organ dysfunction. Histologically they resemble low-grade fibrosarcomas, but they are very locally aggressive and tend to recur even after complete resection. There is a tendency for recurrence in the setting of prior surgery and the most common localisation of these tumors is intraabdominal from smooth muscle cells of the instestine.
HP:0100245.definition_cn: 良性、缓慢生长的肿瘤，无任何转移潜能。尽管其性质为良性，但可能损害邻近结构，导致器官功能障碍。组织学上，它们类似于低级别纤维肉瘤，但具有极强的局部侵袭性，即使在完全切除后也容易复发。在既往手术史的情况下，存在复发倾向，这些肿瘤最常见的定位是源自肠道平滑肌细胞的腹腔内。

HP:0100246.name: Osteoma
HP:0100246.definition: Osteomas are bony growths found most commonly on the skull and mandible; however, they may occur in any bone of the body. Osteomas do not usually cause clinical problems and do not become malignant.
HP:0100246.definition_cn: 骨瘤是最常见于颅骨和下颌骨的骨性增生；然而，它们可发生于身体的任何骨骼。骨瘤通常不会引起临床问题，也不会恶变。

HP:0100247.name: Recurrent singultus
HP:0100247.definition: A contraction of the diaphragm that repeats several times per minute. In humans, the abrupt rush of air into the lungs causes the epiglottis to close, creating a hic sound. Also known as synchronous diaphragmatic flutter (SDF), or singultus, from the Latin singult, the act of catching one's breath while sobbing. The hiccup is an involuntary action involving a reflex arc.
HP:0100247.definition_cn: 膈肌痉挛，每分钟重复数次。在人类中，空气突然涌入肺部导致会厌关闭，产生“呃逆”声。也称为同步性膈肌颤动（Synchronous Diaphragmatic Flutter, SDF）或呃逆（Singultus），源自拉丁语“singult”，指在抽泣时屏住呼吸的动作。呃逆是一种涉及反射弧的非自主性动作。

HP:0100248.name: Hemiballismus
HP:0100248.definition: Hemiballismus is a rare movement disorder that is caused primarily by damage to various areas in the basal ganglia. Hemiballismus is usually characterized by involuntary flinging motions of the extremities. The movements are often violent and have wide amplitudes of motion. They are continuous and random and can involve proximal and/or distal muscles on one side of the body, while some cases even include the facial muscles. The more a patient is active, the more the movements increase. With relaxation comes a decrease in movements.
HP:0100248.definition_cn: 偏侧投掷症是一种罕见的运动障碍，主要由基底节区不同区域的损伤引起。偏侧投掷症通常表现为肢体的不自主投掷样运动。这些运动通常剧烈且幅度较大，呈连续性和随机性，可累及身体一侧的近端和/或远端肌肉，部分病例甚至涉及面部肌肉。患者活动越多，运动症状越明显；放松时，运动症状则有所减轻。

HP:0100249.name: Calcification of muscles
HP:0100249.definition: Deposition of calcium salts in muscle tissue.

HP:0100251.name: Multiple central nervous system lipomas
HP:0100251.definition: The presence of multiple lipomas located in the central nervous system.
HP:0100251.name_cn: 多发性中枢神经系统脂肪瘤
HP:0100251.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统内多发性脂肪瘤的存在。

HP:0100253.name: Abnormality of the medullary cavity of the long bones
HP:0100253.definition: An abnormality of the medullary cavity (medulla, innermost part), which is the central cavity of bone shafts where red bone marrow and/or yellow bone marrow (adipose tissue) is stored.
HP:0100253.definition_cn: 髓腔异常（髓质，最内层部分），即骨干部位的中央腔室，其中储存有红骨髓和/或黄骨髓（脂肪组织）。

HP:0100254.name: Stenosis of the medullary cavity of the long bones

HP:0100255.name: Metaphyseal dysplasia
HP:0100255.definition: The presence of dysplastic regions in metaphyseal regions.
HP:0100255.definition_cn: 干骺端区域存在发育不良区域。

HP:0100256.name: Senile plaques
HP:0100256.definition: Senile plaques are extracellular deposits of amyloid in the gray matter of the brain.
HP:0100256.definition_cn: 老年斑是大脑灰质中淀粉样蛋白的细胞外沉积物。

HP:0100257.name: Ectrodactyly
HP:0100257.definition: A condition in which middle parts of the hands and/or feet (digits and meta-carpals and -tarsals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic 3rd toe/fingers over absent 2nd or 3rd toes/fingers as far as oligo- or monodactyl hands and/or feet.
HP:0100257.definition_cn: 一种表现为手和/或足中部（指骨、掌骨和跖骨）缺失，形成裂隙样外观的病症。其严重程度差异很大，从第三趾/指轻度发育不良，到第二或第三趾/指缺失，甚至出现少指/单指手和/或足。

HP:0100258.name: Preaxial polydactyly
HP:0100258.definition: A form of polydactyly in which the extra digit or digits are localized on the side of the thumb or great toe.
HP:0100258.definition_cn: 一种多指（趾）畸形，其中多余的手指或脚趾位于拇指或大脚趾的侧面。

HP:0100259.name: Postaxial polydactyly
HP:0100259.definition: A form of polydactyly in which the extra digit or digits are localized on the side of the fifth finger or fifth toe.
HP:0100259.definition_cn: 一种多指畸形类型，其中多余的手指或脚趾位于第五指或第五趾的侧面。

HP:0100260.name: Mesoaxial polydactyly
HP:0100260.definition: The presence of a supernumerary finger or toe (not a thumb or hallux) involving the third or fourth metacarpal/tarsal with associated osseous syndactyly.
HP:0100260.definition_cn: 第三或第四掌骨/跖骨多指/趾（非拇指或拇趾）伴骨性并指/趾畸形。

HP:0100261.name: Abnormal tendon morphology
HP:0100261.definition: An abnormality of the structure or form of the tendons, also often called sinews.
HP:0100261.definition_cn: 肌腱结构或形态异常，亦常称为筋腱异常。

HP:0100266.name: Synostosis of carpals/tarsals
HP:0100266.definition: The carpus consists of the scaphoid, lunate, triquetal, pisiform, captitate, hamate, trapezoid, and trapezium bones. The tarsus consists of the talus, calcaneus, cuboid, cuneiform, and navicular bones. This term applies if there is any fusion among the bones of the carpus or tarsus.
HP:0100266.definition_cn: 腕骨由舟骨、月骨、三角骨、豌豆骨、头状骨、钩骨、小多角骨和大多角骨组成。跗骨由距骨、跟骨、骰骨、楔骨和舟骨组成。此术语适用于腕骨或跗骨之间存在任何融合的情况。

HP:0100267.name: Lip pit
HP:0100267.definition: A depression located on a lip.

HP:0100268.name: Upper lip pit
HP:0100268.definition: Depression located on the vermilion of the upper lip, usually paramedian.
HP:0100268.definition_cn: 位于上唇唇红部的凹陷，通常为旁正中位。

HP:0100269.name: Paramedian lip pit
HP:0100269.definition: Depression located paramedially on the vermilion of a lip.
HP:0100269.definition_cn: 位于唇红缘旁正中的凹陷。

HP:0100270.name: Abnormality of dorsoventral patterning of the limbs
HP:0100270.definition: An abnormality resulting from a defect or disruption of dorsoventral patterning that normally happens during early development of the limbs. A disruption of the normal development of the dorsoventral axis may lead to a variable spectrum of different phenotypic abnormalities that may affect the nails and or palmar and dorsal side of the hands and/or feet, ultimately changing the normal dorsoventral appearance of the affected limbs.
HP:0100270.definition_cn: 一种由背腹模式缺陷或中断导致的异常，通常发生在肢体早期发育过程中。背腹轴正常发育的中断可能导致一系列不同的表型异常，可能影响指甲和/或手掌及手背和/或足背，最终改变受累肢体的正常背腹外观。

HP:0100271.name: Hyponasal speech
HP:0100271.definition: Hyponasal speech is when there is an abnormally reduced nasal airflow during speech often in a setting of nasal obstruction or congestion.
HP:0100271.definition_cn: 低鼻音语音是指在鼻阻塞或鼻充血的情况下，说话时鼻腔气流异常减少的现象。

HP:0100272.name: Branchial sinus
HP:0100272.definition: A congenital branchial sinus is a remnant of the embryonic branchial arches and their intervening clefts and pouches that has failed to regress completely. Sinuses typically have their external orifice inferior to the ramus of the mandible. They may traverse the parotid gland, and run in close vicinity to the facial nerve in the external auditory canal.
HP:0100272.definition_cn: 先天性鳃窦是胚胎期鳃弓及其间沟和囊的残留物，未能完全退化。窦道通常位于下颌支下方，可能穿过腮腺，并在外耳道中与面神经紧密相邻。

HP:0100274.name: Gustatory lacrimation
HP:0100274.definition: Gustatory lacrimation results from an aberrant innervation of fibers from the seventh cranial nerve to the pterygopalatine ganglion which are destined originally for the submandibular ganglion. This aberrant innervation leads to uncontrollable tearing while eating or in anticipation of a meal.
HP:0100274.definition_cn: 味觉性流泪是由于第七对脑神经纤维异常支配翼腭神经节所致，这些纤维原本应支配下颌下神经节。这种异常神经支配导致在进食或预期进食时出现无法控制的流泪现象。

HP:0100275.name: Diffuse cerebellar atrophy
HP:0100275.definition: Diffuse unlocalised atrophy affecting the cerebellum.
HP:0100275.definition_cn: 小脑弥漫性非局限性萎缩。

HP:0100276.name: Skin pit
HP:0100276.definition: A small, skin-lined tract that leads from the surface to deep within the tissues.

HP:0100277.name: Periauricular skin pits
HP:0100277.definition: Benign congenital lesions of the periauricular soft tissue consisting of a blind-ending narrow tube or pit.
HP:0100277.definition_cn: 良性先天性耳周软组织病变，由盲端狭窄管或凹陷组成。

HP:0100279.name: Ulcerative colitis
HP:0100279.definition: A chronic inflammatory bowel disease that includes characteristic ulcers, or open sores, in the colon. The main symptom of active disease is usually constant diarrhea mixed with blood, of gradual onset and intermittent periods of exacerbated symptoms contrasting with periods that are relatively symptom-free. In contrast to Crohn's disease this special form of colitis begins in the distal parts of the rectum, spreads continually upwards and affects only mucose and submucose tissue of the colon.
HP:0100279.definition_cn: 一种慢性炎症性肠病，其特征为结肠内出现溃疡或开放性疮口。活动期疾病的主要症状通常为逐渐发作的持续性血性腹泻，症状加重期与相对无症状期交替出现。与克罗恩病不同，这种特殊类型的结肠炎始于直肠远端，持续向上蔓延，且仅累及结肠的黏膜和黏膜下层组织。

HP:0100280.name: Crohn's disease
HP:0100280.definition: A chronic granulomatous inflammatory disease of the intestines that may affect any part of the gastrointestinal tract from mouth to anus, causing a wide variety of symptoms. It primarily causes abdominal pain, diarrhea which may be bloody, vomiting, or weight loss, but may also cause complications outside of the gastrointestinal tract such as skin rashes, arthritis, inflammation of the eye, tiredness, and lack of concentration. Crohn's disease is thought to be an autoimmune disease, in which the body's immune system attacks the gastrointestinal tract, causing inflammation.
HP:0100280.definition_cn: 一种慢性肉芽肿性肠道炎症性疾病，可累及从口腔至肛门的任何胃肠道部位，引发多种症状。主要表现为腹痛、可能带血的腹泻、呕吐或体重减轻，但也可能引起胃肠道以外的并发症，如皮疹、关节炎、眼部炎症、疲劳和注意力不集中。克罗恩病被认为是一种自身免疫性疾病，其中机体的免疫系统攻击胃肠道，导致炎症反应。

HP:0100281.name: Chronic colitis
HP:0100281.definition: A chronic inflammatory disease of the large intestine (colon, cecum and rectum).
HP:0100281.definition_cn: 慢性炎症性大肠疾病（结肠、盲肠和直肠）。

HP:0100282.name: Acute colitis
HP:0100282.definition: An acute and self-limited inflammatory disease of the large intestine (colon, cecum and rectum).
HP:0100282.definition_cn: 急性自限性大肠炎（结肠、盲肠及直肠）。

HP:0100283.name: EMG
HP:0100283.definition: Continuous electromyographic activity of motor units at rest, i.e., without voluntary movement of the muscles.
HP:0100283.definition_cn: 静息状态下运动单位的持续性肌电活动，即无肌肉自主运动时的肌电活动。

HP:0100284.name: EMG
HP:0100284.definition: High frequency discharges in electromyography (EMG) that vary in amplitude and frequency, waxing and waning continuously with firing frequencies ranging from 150/second down to 20/second and producing a sound that has been referred to as a dive bomber sound.
HP:0100284.definition_cn: 肌电图（EMG）中观察到的高频放电，其振幅和频率不断变化，呈波动性增强和减弱，放电频率范围从150次/秒降至20次/秒，产生的声音被称为“俯冲轰炸机声”。

HP:0100285.name: EMG
HP:0100285.definition: An electromyographic finding associated with erratic or absent neuromuscular transmission with erratic, moment-to-moment changes in the shape of the motor unit potential (MUP).
HP:0100285.definition_cn: 与神经肌肉传递异常或缺失相关的肌电图表现，伴随运动单位电位（MUP）形态的随机、瞬时变化。

HP:0100287.name: EMG
HP:0100287.definition: The presence of reduced conduction velocity of motor nerves on electromyography.
HP:0100287.definition_cn: 肌电图显示运动神经传导速度降低。

HP:0100288.name: EMG
HP:0100288.definition: The presence of spontaneous bursts of rapidly firing potentials that recur at regular intervals of 2-10 per second and are unaffected by voluntary effort. This is an electromyographic (EMG) finding.
HP:0100288.definition_cn: 存在自发性快速放电电位爆发，以每秒2-10次的规律性间隔重复出现，且不受自主努力影响。此为肌电图（EMG）检查结果。

HP:0100289.name: Abnormality of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
HP:0100289.name_cn: 模式反转视觉诱发电位异常

HP:0100290.name: Abnormality of peripheral somatosensory evoked potentials
HP:0100290.name_cn: 周围体感诱发电位异常

HP:0100291.name: Delayed somatosensory central conduction time
HP:0100291.definition: An abnormal increase (delay) in the somatosensory central conduction time (CCT), which can be measured from the peak of N13 to the peak of N20 (peak CCT) or from the onset of N11 to the onset of N20 (onset CCT).
HP:0100291.name_cn: 延迟的躯体感觉中枢传导时间
HP:0100291.definition_cn: 躯体感觉中枢传导时间（CCT）的异常延长（延迟），可通过N13波峰至N20波峰（峰值CCT）或N11波起始至N20波起始（起始CCT）进行测量。

HP:0100292.name: Amyloidosis of peripheral nerves
HP:0100292.definition: The presence of amyloid deposition in the nerves of the peripheral nervous system.
HP:0100292.definition_cn: 周围神经系统神经纤维中淀粉样蛋白沉积的存在。

HP:0100293.name: Hypertrophied muscle fibers
HP:0100293.definition: The presence of an increased amount of muscle fibers with an increased diameter. This feature can be ascertained by microscopic examination of a muscle biopsy sample. Together with fiber size variation and atrophied muscle fibers, and hypertrophied muscle fibers are commonly found in myopathies.
HP:0100293.definition_cn: 肌纤维直径增大的数量增加。此特征可通过肌肉活检样本的显微镜检查确定。与纤维大小变异、萎缩肌纤维和肥大肌纤维一起，这些特征常见于肌病中。

HP:0100297.name: Increased endomysial connective tissue
HP:0100297.definition: An increased volume of the endomysium, which is a connective tissue sheath that surrounds each muscule fiber. Together, bundles of muscle fibers form a fasciculus, surrounded by another layer of connective tissue called the perimysium.
HP:0100297.definition_cn: 肌内膜体积增加，肌内膜是围绕每根肌纤维的结缔组织鞘。肌纤维束共同形成肌束，肌束由另一层称为肌束膜的结缔组织包围。

HP:0100301.name: Muscle fiber tubular inclusions
HP:0100301.definition: Unusual regions of densely packed membranous tubules known as tubular aggregates which present as membranous inclusions, derived from membranes of sarcoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria, containing miscellaneous proteins with a variety of enzymatic activities.
HP:0100301.definition_cn: 异常区域中密集排列的膜性小管，称为管状聚集物，表现为膜性包涵体，源自肌浆网和线粒体的膜，含有多种具有不同酶活性的蛋白质。

HP:0100302.name: Muscle fiber tubuloreticular inclusions
HP:0100302.name_cn: 肌纤维小管网状包涵体

HP:0100303.name: Muscle fiber cytoplasmatic inclusion bodies
HP:0100303.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells. Inclusion bodies are aggregates (deposits) or stainable material, usually misfolded proteins.
HP:0100303.definition_cn: 肌细胞胞质内包涵体的存在。包涵体是聚集物（沉积物）或可染色物质，通常为错误折叠的蛋白质。

HP:0100304.name: Muscle fiber intranuclear inclusion bodies
HP:0100304.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the nucleus of muscle cells. Inclusion bodies are aggregates (deposits) or stainable material, usually misfolded proteins.
HP:0100304.definition_cn: 肌细胞核内包涵体的存在。包涵体是聚集物（沉积物）或可染色物质，通常为错误折叠的蛋白质。

HP:0100305.name: Ring fibers
HP:0100305.definition: Ring fibers are formed by a bundle of peripheral myofibrils which are circumferentially oriented such that they encircle the internal portion of the sarcoplasm which is normal in structure and orientation.
HP:0100305.definition_cn: 环状纤维由一束外周肌原纤维形成，这些肌原纤维呈环状排列，环绕着结构及方向正常的肌浆内部。

HP:0100306.name: Muscle fiber hyaline bodies
HP:0100306.definition: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions in the cytoplasm of muscle fibers. Hyaline bodies show significant reactivity to myofibrillar ATPase after acid pre-incubation and with immunohistochemistry, show intense reactivity with only slow myosin heavy chain. Electron microscopy of the affected areas show a lack of myofibrils and a uniform, finely granular matrix, sometimes suggesting a filamentous nature, containing few scattered nuclei and mitochondria.
HP:0100306.definition_cn: 肌纤维胞质中的肌膜下嗜酸性玻璃样区域。透明小体在酸性预孵育后对肌原纤维ATP酶显示出显著反应性，在免疫组织化学中仅与慢肌球蛋白重链显示出强烈反应性。受影响区域的电子显微镜检查显示肌原纤维缺失，存在均匀的细颗粒基质，有时提示为丝状结构，其中含有少量散在的细胞核和线粒体。

HP:0100308.name: Cerebral cortical hemiatrophy
HP:0100308.definition: Atrophy of one side of the brain, characterized by findings including thinning of the cerebral cortex, reduced volume of the cerebral white matter with abnormal myelination, and enlargement of the ispilateral fourth ventricle.
HP:0100308.definition_cn: 单侧大脑萎缩，其特征包括大脑皮质变薄、脑白质体积减少伴髓鞘形成异常，以及同侧第四脑室扩大。

HP:0100309.name: Subdural hemorrhage
HP:0100309.definition: Hemorrhage occurring between the dura mater and the arachnoid mater.

HP:0100310.name: Epidural hemorrhage
HP:0100310.definition: Hemorrhage occurring between the dura mater and the skull.

HP:0100311.name: Cerebral ventricular adhesions
HP:0100311.definition: Bands of scar-like tissue that have formed within a cerebral ventricle.
HP:0100311.definition_cn: 脑室内形成的瘢痕样组织带。

HP:0100312.name: Cerebral germinoma
HP:0100312.definition: The presence of a germ cell tumor of the cerebrum.
HP:0100312.definition_cn: 大脑生殖细胞肿瘤的存在。

HP:0100313.name: Cerebral granulomatosis
HP:0100313.definition: Cerebral inflammation involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.
HP:0100313.definition_cn: 涉及肉芽肿反应的脑部炎症，即一种非特异性炎症反应，涉及肉芽肿，定义为由成熟单核吞噬细胞（包括上皮样细胞和多核巨细胞）组成的紧密有序的集合。

HP:0100314.name: Cerebral inclusion bodies
HP:0100314.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within cells of the brain.
HP:0100314.definition_cn: 脑细胞内可染色物质的核内或胞质内聚集物。

HP:0100316.name: Hirano bodies
HP:0100316.definition: Intracellular aggregates of actin and actin-associated proteins within nerve cells.
HP:0100316.definition_cn: 神经细胞内肌动蛋白及肌动蛋白相关蛋白的细胞内聚集物。

HP:0100317.name: Argyrophilic inclusion bodies
HP:0100317.definition: Presence of abundant argyrophilic grains and coiled bodies on microscopic examination of brain tissue.
HP:0100317.definition_cn: 脑组织显微镜检查显示大量嗜银颗粒和卷曲小体。

HP:0100318.name: Lafora bodies
HP:0100318.definition: An intraneuronal inclusion body composed of acid mucopolysaccharides.
HP:0100318.definition_cn: 由酸性黏多糖组成的神经元内包涵体。

HP:0100319.name: Cerebral hyaline bodies
HP:0100319.definition: Cerebral eosinophilic, discrete, intracytoplasmatic inclusions of unknown significance.
HP:0100319.definition_cn: 脑嗜酸性、离散性、胞质内包涵体，意义不明。

HP:0100320.name: Rosenthal fibers
HP:0100320.definition: Thick, elongated, worm-like or corkscrew eosinophilic bundle that are found on H&E staining of the brain in the presence of long standing gliosis, occasional tumors, and some metabolic disorders.
HP:0100320.definition_cn: 在长期存在的胶质增生、偶发肿瘤及某些代谢性疾病中，通过H&E染色在脑组织中观察到的增厚、延长、蠕虫状或螺旋状的嗜酸性束状结构。

HP:0100321.name: Abnormal dentate nucleus morphology
HP:0100321.definition: An abnormality of the dentate nucleus.

HP:0100323.name: Juvenile aseptic necrosis
HP:0100323.definition: Juvenile aseptic necrosis comprises a group of orthopedic diseases characterized by interruption of the blood supply of a bone, followed by localized bony necrosis most often of the epiphyses of bones of children or teenagers.
HP:0100323.definition_cn: 青少年无菌性坏死是一组骨科疾病，其特征为骨血供中断，随后发生局部骨坏死，最常见于儿童或青少年骨骺。

HP:0100324.name: Scleroderma
HP:0100324.definition: A chronic autoimmune phenomenon characterized by fibrosis (or hardening) and vascular alterations of the skin.
HP:0100324.definition_cn: 一种慢性自身免疫现象，其特征为皮肤纤维化（或硬化）及血管改变。

HP:0100326.name: Immunologic hypersensitivity
HP:0100326.definition: Immunological states where the immune system produces harmful responses upon reexposure to sensitizing antigens.
HP:0100326.definition_cn: 过敏反应（Allergic Reactions）是指免疫系统在再次接触致敏抗原时产生有害反应的免疫状态。

HP:0100327.name: Cow milk allergy
HP:0100327.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against cow milk protein.
HP:0100327.definition_cn: 对牛乳蛋白产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0100328.name: Carpometacarpal synostosis
HP:0100328.definition: Fusion involving carpal and metacarpal bones.

HP:0100333.name: Unilateral cleft lip
HP:0100333.definition: A non-midline cleft of the upper lip on one side only.

HP:0100335.name: Non-midline cleft of the upper lip

HP:0100335.definition_cn: 上唇外侧裂（裂隙或沟槽），累及上唇的侧部而非中线/正中区域。

HP:0100336.name: Bilateral cleft lip
HP:0100336.definition: A non-midline cleft of the upper lip on the left and right sides.
HP:0100336.definition_cn: 上唇左侧及右侧非中线裂。

HP:0100337.name: Bilateral cleft palate
HP:0100337.definition: Nonmidline cleft palate on the left and right sides.
