HP:0100950.name: Decreased 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase level
HP:0100950.name_cn: 3-羟基酰基辅酶A脱氢酶水平降低

HP:0100952.name: Enlarged sylvian cistern
HP:0100952.definition: An increase in size of the subarachnoid space associated with the lateral cerebral sulcus (Sylvian fissure).
HP:0100952.definition_cn: 外侧脑沟（Sylvian裂）相关的蛛网膜下腔空间增大。

HP:0100957.name: Abnormal renal medulla morphology
HP:0100957.definition: Any structural abnormality of the medulla of the kidney.
HP:0100957.definition_cn: 肾髓质的任何结构异常。

HP:0100958.name: Narrow foramen obturatorium
HP:0100958.definition: Decreased width of the foramen obturatorium. The foramen obturatorium (also known as the obturator foramen) is a hole located between the ischium and pubis bones of the pelvis.
HP:0100958.definition_cn: 闭孔宽度减小。闭孔（也称为闭孔孔）是位于骨盆坐骨和耻骨之间的孔洞。

HP:0100959.name: Dense metaphyseal bands
HP:0100959.definition: Dense radiopaque bands of bone which are thicker than the adjacent diaphyseal cortex and may form at the metaphysis of growing bones. They appear on radiographs as bone that is more radiopaque that the adjacent diaphyseal cortex.
HP:0100959.definition_cn: 在生长中的骨骼干骺端形成的比邻近骨干皮质更厚的致密放射不透光骨带。在X线片上表现为比邻近骨干皮质更不透光的骨组织。

HP:0100960.name: Lateral ventricular asymmetry
HP:0100960.definition: Abnormal difference in size between the left and right lateral cerebral ventricles.
HP:0100960.definition_cn: 左右侧脑室大小异常差异。

HP:0100961.name: Enlarged hippocampus
HP:0100961.definition: Increase in size of the hippocampus.

HP:0100962.name: Excessive shyness
HP:0100962.definition: Atypically high degree of awkwardness or apprehension experienced when approaching or being approached by others.
HP:0100962.definition_cn: 社交焦虑障碍（Social Anxiety Disorder）或社交恐惧症（Social Phobia）

HP:0100963.name: Hyperesthesia
HP:0100963.definition: Increased sensitivity to stimulation, excluding the special senses, which may refer to various modes of cutaneous sensibility including touch and thermal sensation without pain, as well as to pain.
HP:0100963.definition_cn: 对刺激的敏感性增加，不包括特殊感觉，可能涉及多种皮肤感觉模式，包括无痛的触觉和温度觉，以及痛觉。

HP:0200000.name: Dysharmonic skeletal maturation
HP:0200000.definition: Different levels of maturation of different bones.
HP:0200000.definition_cn: 不同骨骼的成熟度差异。

HP:0200001.name: Dysharmonic accelerated bone age
HP:0200001.definition: A type of dysharmonic skeletal maturation in which there is an acceleration in skeletal maturation whose degree differs markedly in different bones.
HP:0200001.definition_cn: 一种骨骼成熟不协调的类型，表现为骨骼成熟加速，且不同骨骼的加速程度显著不同。

HP:0200005.name: Abnormal shape of the palpebral fissure
HP:0200005.definition: The presence of an abnormal shape of the palpebral fissure.

HP:0200007.name: Abnormal size of the palpebral fissures
HP:0200007.definition: An abnormal size of the palpebral fissures for example unusually long or short palpebral fissures.
HP:0200007.definition_cn: 睑裂大小异常，例如睑裂过长或过短。

HP:0200008.name: Intestinal polyposis
HP:0200008.definition: The presence of multiple polyps in the intestine.
HP:0200008.definition_cn: 肠道内多发性息肉的存在。

HP:0200013.name: Neoplasm of fatty tissue
HP:0200013.definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of adipose tissue.
HP:0200013.definition_cn: 脂肪组织肿瘤（脂肪组织的异常增生）。

HP:0200016.name: Acrokeratosis
HP:0200016.definition: Overgrowth of the stratum corneum characterized by flesh-coloured or slightly pigmented smooth or warty papules on the upper surface of hands and feet.
HP:0200016.definition_cn: 手足背侧皮肤角质层过度增生，表现为肤色或轻度色素沉着的平滑或疣状丘疹。

HP:0200017.name: Cerebral white matter agenesis
HP:0200017.definition: Congenital defect with failure of the development of the cerebral white matter.
HP:0200017.definition_cn: 先天性脑白质发育不全缺陷。

HP:0200018.name: Protanomaly
HP:0200018.definition: A type of anomalous trichromacy associated with defective long-wavelength-sensitive (L) cones, causing the sensitivity spectrum to be shifted toward medium wavelengths. This leads to difficulties especially in distinguishing red and green.
HP:0200018.definition_cn: 一种与长波长敏感（L）视锥细胞缺陷相关的异常三色视觉，导致敏感光谱向中波长偏移。这尤其导致在区分红色和绿色时出现困难。

HP:0200020.name: Corneal erosion
HP:0200020.definition: An erosion or abrasion of the cornea's outermost layer of epithelial cells.
HP:0200020.definition_cn: 角膜上皮细胞最外层的侵蚀或磨损。

HP:0200022.name: Choroid plexus papilloma
HP:0200022.definition: Choroid plexus papilloma is a histologically benign neoplasm located in the ventricular system of the choroid plexus.
HP:0200022.definition_cn: 脉络丛乳头状瘤是一种组织学上良性的肿瘤，位于脉络丛的脑室系统内。

HP:0200023.name: Priapism
HP:0200023.definition: A painful and harmful medical condition in which the erect penis doesn't return to its flaccid state, despite the absence of both physical and psychological stimulation, within four hours.
HP:0200023.definition_cn: 一种疼痛且有害的医学病症，表现为阴茎在勃起状态下，尽管缺乏生理和心理刺激，仍无法在四小时内恢复至松弛状态。

HP:0200024.name: Premature chromatid separation
HP:0200024.definition: The presence of premature sister chromatid segregation.
HP:0200024.definition_cn: 姐妹染色单体早熟分离。

HP:0200025.name: Mandibular pain
HP:0200025.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the mandible.
HP:0200025.definition_cn: 一种以物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，局限于下颌骨区域。

HP:0200026.name: Ocular pain
HP:0200026.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eye.
HP:0200026.definition_cn: 一种以眼部局部物理不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感。

HP:0200028.name: Pretibial myxedema
HP:0200028.definition: A diffuse, non-pitting edema and thickening of the skin usually on the anterior aspect of the lower legs spreading to the dorsum of the feet.
HP:0200028.definition_cn: 一种弥漫性、非凹陷性水肿及皮肤增厚，通常发生于小腿前侧，并蔓延至足背。

HP:0200029.name: Vasculitis in the skin
HP:0200029.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects skeletal muscle tissue.
HP:0200029.definition_cn: 一种影响骨骼肌组织的血管炎（血管壁炎症）。

HP:0200032.name: Kayser-Fleischer ring
HP:0200032.definition: Grey-green or brownish-pigmented ring in the deep epithelial layers at the outer border of the cornea.
HP:0200032.definition_cn: 角膜外缘深层上皮层中的灰绿色或棕褐色色素环。

HP:0200034.name: Papule
HP:0200034.definition: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point.
HP:0200034.definition_cn: 局限性、实性皮肤隆起，无可见液体，直径从针尖大小至最宽处小于10毫米不等。

HP:0200035.name: Skin plaque
HP:0200035.definition: A plaque is a solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter.
HP:0200035.definition_cn: 斑块是一种直径大于1厘米的实性、隆起、平台样（平顶）的皮损。

HP:0200036.name: Skin nodule
HP:0200036.definition: Morphologically similar to a papule, but greater than either 10mm in both width and depth, and most frequently centered in the dermis or subcutaneous fat.
HP:0200036.definition_cn: 形态学上类似于丘疹，但宽度和深度均大于10毫米，最常见于真皮层或皮下脂肪组织中心。

HP:0200037.name: Skin vesicle
HP:0200037.definition: A circumscribed, fluid-containing, epidermal elevation generally considered less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point.
HP:0200037.definition_cn: 局限性、含液体的表皮隆起，通常最宽处直径小于10毫米。

HP:0200039.name: Pustule
HP:0200039.definition: A small elevation of the skin containing cloudy or purulent material usually consisting of necrotic inflammatory cells.
HP:0200039.definition_cn: 皮肤上含有浑浊或脓性物质的小隆起，通常由坏死性炎症细胞组成。

HP:0200040.name: Epidermoid cyst
HP:0200040.definition: Nontender, round and firm, but slightly compressible, intradermal or subcutaneous cyst measuring 0.5-5 cm in diameter. Epidermal cysts are intradermal or subcutaneous tumors, grow slowly and occur on the face, neck, back and scrotum. They usually appear at or around puberty, and as a rule an affected individual has one solitary or a few cysts.
HP:0200040.definition_cn: 无痛、圆形且坚实但略有压缩性的皮内或皮下囊肿，直径0.5-5厘米。表皮囊肿为皮内或皮下肿瘤，生长缓慢，常见于面部、颈部、背部和阴囊。通常出现在青春期或青春期前后，且患者通常为单个或少数几个囊肿。

HP:0200041.name: Skin erosion
HP:0200041.definition: A discontinuity of the skin exhibiting incomplete loss of the epidermis, a lesion that is moist, circumscribed, and usually depressed.
HP:0200041.definition_cn: 皮肤不连续性表现为表皮不完全缺失，病灶湿润、界限清楚且通常凹陷。

HP:0200042.name: Skin ulcer
HP:0200042.definition: A discontinuity of the skin exhibiting complete loss of the epidermis and often portions of the dermis and even subcutaneous fat.
HP:0200042.definition_cn: 皮肤完整性中断，表现为表皮完全缺失，常伴有部分真皮甚至皮下脂肪的丧失。

HP:0200043.name: Verrucae
HP:0200043.definition: Warts, benign growths on the skin or mucous membranes that cause cosmetic problems as well as pain and discomfort. Warts most often occur on the hands, feet, and genital areas.
HP:0200043.definition_cn: 疣，皮肤或黏膜上的良性增生，导致美观问题以及疼痛和不适。疣最常见于手部、足部和生殖器区域。

HP:0200044.name: Porokeratosis
HP:0200044.definition: A clonal disorder of keratinization with one or multiple atrophic patches surrounded by a clinically and histologically distinctive hyperkeratotic ridgelike border called the cornoid lamella.
HP:0200044.definition_cn: 一种角化克隆性疾病，表现为一个或多个萎缩性斑块，周围环绕着临床和组织学上独特的角化过度脊状边界，称为角化不全层。

HP:0200046.name: Cat cry
HP:0200046.definition: The presence of a characteristic high-pitched cry that sounds similar to the meowing of a kitten.
HP:0200046.definition_cn: 存在一种特征性的高音调哭声，类似于小猫的喵喵声。

HP:0200047.name: Chondritis of pinna
HP:0200047.definition: Inflammation of the cartilage of the external ear.

HP:0200049.name: Upper limb hypertonia
HP:0200049.definition: Increased muscle tone observed in the arms of the affected person.

HP:0200053.name: Hemihypotrophy of lower limb
HP:0200053.definition: Shortening of a leg affecting only one side.

HP:0200057.name: Marcus Gunn pupil
HP:0200057.definition: An aberrant pupillary response characterized by (i) Constriction of pupils of both eyes when the light stimulus is applied to the normal eye, and (ii) Dilatation of pupils of both eyes when the light stimulus is rapidly transferred from the normal eye (after brief light exposure to the normal eye) to the affected eye.
HP:0200057.definition_cn: 异常瞳孔反应，其特征为：（i）当光刺激作用于正常眼时，双眼瞳孔均出现收缩；（ii）当光刺激从正常眼（短暂光暴露后）迅速转移至患眼时，双眼瞳孔均出现扩张。

HP:0200063.name: Colorectal polyposis
HP:0200063.definition: Multiple abnormal growths that arise from the lining of the large intestine (colon or rectum) and protrude into the intestinal lumen.
HP:0200063.definition_cn: 多发性异常增生，起源于大肠（结肠或直肠）黏膜层，并向肠腔内突出。

HP:0200064.name: Asymmetry of iris pigmentation
HP:0200064.definition: Asymmetry between the two irides or asymmetry between different parts of one iris.
HP:0200064.definition_cn: 双侧虹膜不对称或单侧虹膜不同部位不对称。

HP:0200067.name: Recurrent spontaneous abortion
HP:0200067.definition: Repeated episodes of abortion (Expulsion of the product of fertilization before completing the term of gestation) without deliberate interference.
HP:0200067.definition_cn: 复发性流产（在妊娠期未完成前，受精产物自然排出，无故意干预）。

HP:0200071.name: Peripheral vitreoretinal degeneration
HP:0200071.definition: A type of vitreoretinal degeneration with manifestations that are concentrated at the periphery of the retina.
HP:0200071.name_cn: 周边部玻璃体视网膜变性
HP:0200071.definition_cn: 一种玻璃体视网膜变性，其临床表现集中于视网膜周边部。

HP:0200072.name: Episodic quadriplegia
HP:0200072.definition: Intermittent episodes of paralysis of all four limbs.

HP:0200073.name: Respiratory insufficiency due to defective ciliary clearance
HP:0200073.name_cn: 由于纤毛清除功能缺陷导致的呼吸功能不全

HP:0200084.name: Giant cell hepatitis
HP:0200084.definition: Chronic hepatitis characterized by parenchymal inflammation with formation of large multinucleated hepatocytes in response to a variety of insults to the liver.
HP:0200084.definition_cn: 慢性肝炎的特征为实质炎症，并在肝脏受到多种损伤后形成多核巨肝细胞。

HP:0200096.name: Triangular-shaped open mouth
HP:0200096.definition: A facial appearance characterized by a permanently or nearly permanently opened mouth, in which the upper lip is tented in a way that the opened mouth has the appearance of a triangle.
HP:0200096.definition_cn: 面部特征表现为持续性或近乎持续性张口状态，上唇呈帐篷样隆起，使张口时呈现三角形外观。

HP:0200099.name: obsolete Peripheral retinal pigmentation abnormalities
HP:0200099.name_cn: 陈旧性周边视网膜色素异常

HP:0200104.name: Absent fifth fingernail
HP:0200104.definition: Absence of nail of little finger.

HP:0200109.name: Absent/shortened outer dynein arms
HP:0200109.name_cn: 外动力蛋白臂缺失/缩短

HP:0200114.name: Metabolic alkalosis
HP:0200114.definition: Metabolic alkalosis is defined as a disease state where the pH is elevated to greater than 7.45 secondary to some metabolic process.
HP:0200114.definition_cn: 代谢性碱中毒被定义为一种疾病状态，其中由于某些代谢过程导致pH值升高至大于7.45。

HP:0200117.name: Recurrent upper and lower respiratory tract infections
HP:0200117.definition: Increased susceptibility to upper and lower respiratory tract infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of upper and lower respiratory tract infections.
HP:0200117.name_cn: 复发性上呼吸道和下呼吸道感染
HP:0200117.definition_cn: 对上呼吸道和下呼吸道感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的上呼吸道和下呼吸道感染。

HP:0200119.name: Acute hepatitis
HP:0200119.definition: Acute hepatic injury resulting from inflammation typically accompanied by increased serum alanine transaminase activity. Etiologies include viral hepatitis, drugs, toxins, and autoimmune disorders.
HP:0200119.definition_cn: 急性肝损伤通常由炎症引起，伴随血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶活性升高。病因包括病毒性肝炎、药物、毒素和自身免疫性疾病。

HP:0200120.name: Chronic active hepatitis
HP:0200120.definition: Chronic hepatitis associated with recurrent clinical exacerbations, extrahepatic manifestations, and progression to cirrhosis.
HP:0200120.definition_cn: 慢性肝炎伴有反复临床加重、肝外表现及进展为肝硬化。

HP:0200122.name: Atypical or prolonged hepatitis
HP:0200122.name_cn: 非典型性或迁延性肝炎

HP:0200123.name: Chronic hepatitis
HP:0200123.definition: Hepatitis that lasts for more than six months.

HP:0200124.name: Chronic hepatitis due to cryptosporidium infection
HP:0200124.definition: Chronic hepatitis associated with infection by cryptosporidia, as demonstrated (for example) by immunohistochemistry of liver tissue.
HP:0200124.name_cn: 隐孢子虫感染引起的慢性肝炎
HP:0200124.definition_cn: 慢性肝炎与隐孢子虫感染相关，如通过肝组织免疫组织化学检测所证实。

HP:0200127.name: Atrial cardiomyopathy
HP:0200127.definition: Any complex of structural, architectural, contractile or electrophysiological changes affecting the atria with the potential to produce clinically relevant manifestations.
HP:0200127.definition_cn: 任何影响心房的结构、构造、收缩或电生理学改变的复合体，具有产生临床相关表现的潜在性。

HP:0200128.name: Biventricular hypertrophy
HP:0200128.definition: Thickening of the heart walls in both ventricles.

HP:0200129.name: obsolete Calcific mitral stenosis
HP:0200129.name_cn: 陈旧性钙化性二尖瓣狭窄

HP:0200134.name: Epileptic encephalopathy
HP:0200134.definition: A condition in which epileptiform abnormalities are believed to contribute to the progressive disturbance in cerebral function. Epileptic encephalaopathy is characterized by (1) electrographic EEG paroxysmal activity that is often aggressive, (2) seizures that are usually multiform and intractable, (3) cognitive, behavioral and neurological deficits that may be relentless, and (4) sometimes early death.
HP:0200134.definition_cn: 一种被认为由癫痫样异常导致脑功能进行性障碍的疾病。癫痫性脑病的特征包括：(1) 脑电图（EEG）上常表现为侵袭性的阵发性电活动，(2) 癫痫发作通常为多形性且难治性，(3) 认知、行为和神经功能缺陷可能持续进展，(4) 有时可能导致早期死亡。

HP:0200135.name: obsolete Macrocephaly due to hydrocephalus
HP:0200135.name_cn: 过时的术语：由于脑积水引起的巨头畸形

HP:0200146.name: Mucoid extracellular matrix accumulation
HP:0200146.definition: An increase of medial mucoid extracellular matrix creating translamellar and/or intralamellar expansions including extracellular pools as noted on an H&E stain and/or a stain to highlight extracellular matrix material (Movat's pentachrome, Alcian blue, etc.).
HP:0200146.name_cn: 黏液样细胞外基质积聚
HP:0200146.definition_cn: 内侧黏液样细胞外基质增加，形成跨板层和/或板层内扩张，包括细胞外池，如H&E染色和/或用于突出细胞外基质材料的染色（Movat五色染色、阿尔新蓝染色等）所示。

HP:0200147.name: Neuronal loss in basal ganglia
HP:0200147.definition: A reduction in the number of nerve cells in the basal ganglia.
HP:0200147.name_cn: 基底神经节神经元丧失
HP:0200147.definition_cn: 基底神经节神经元数量减少。

HP:0200148.name: Abnormal liver function tests during pregnancy
HP:0200148.name_cn: 妊娠期肝功能异常检测

HP:0200149.name: CSF lymphocytic pleiocytosis
HP:0200149.definition: An increased lymphocyte count in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0200149.name_cn: 脑脊液淋巴细胞增多症
HP:0200149.definition_cn: 脑脊液中淋巴细胞计数增高。

HP:0200150.name: Increased serum bile acid concentration during pregnancy
HP:0200150.name_cn: 妊娠期血清胆汁酸浓度升高

HP:0200151.name: Cutaneous mastocytosis
HP:0200151.definition: Multifocal dense infiltrates of mast cells in cutaneous tissue.
HP:0200151.definition_cn: 皮肤组织中多灶性密集的肥大细胞浸润。

HP:0200158.name: Agenesis of permanent mandibular lateral incisor

HP:0200159.name: Agenesis of primary mandibular lateral incisor

HP:0400000.name: Tall chin
HP:0400000.definition: Increased vertical distance from the vermillion border of the lower lip to the inferior-most point of the chin.
HP:0400000.definition_cn: 下唇朱红缘至颏部最下点的垂直距离增加。

HP:0400001.name: Chin with vertical crease
HP:0400001.definition: Vertical crease fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin with the face at rest.
HP:0400001.definition_cn: 位于下唇朱红缘下方、面部静止时颏部脂肪垫上方的垂直皱褶。

HP:0400002.name: Extra concha fold
HP:0400002.definition: Folds or ridges within the concha that are distinct from the crus helix.
HP:0400002.definition_cn: 耳甲腔内与耳轮脚明显不同的皱襞或隆起。

HP:0400003.name: Focal absence of the external ear
HP:0400003.definition: Absence of a localized portion of the ear that cannot be described by a more precise term (e.g., absent ear lobe).
HP:0400003.definition_cn: 耳部局部缺失，无法用更精确的术语描述（例如，耳垂缺失）。

HP:0400004.name: Long ear
HP:0400004.definition: Median longitudinal ear length greater than two SD above the mean determined by the maximal distance from the superior aspect to the inferior aspect of the external ear.
HP:0400004.definition_cn: 耳廓纵向中位长度超过平均值两个标准差，该长度由外耳上缘至下缘的最大距离确定。

HP:0400005.name: Short ear
HP:0400005.definition: Median longitudinal ear length less than two SD above the mean determined by the maximal distance from the superior aspect to the inferior aspect of the external ear.
HP:0400005.definition_cn: 耳廓中位纵向长度小于均值以上两个标准差，该长度由外耳上缘至下缘的最大距离确定。

HP:0400007.name: Polymenorrhea
HP:0400007.definition: Frequent menses; menstrual cycles lasting less than 21 days.
HP:0400007.definition_cn: 月经频发；月经周期少于21天。

HP:0400008.name: Menometrorrhagia
HP:0400008.definition: Prolonged/excessive menses and bleeding at irregular intervals.
HP:0400008.definition_cn: 月经延长/过多及不规则出血。

HP:0410006.name: Abnormality of ophthalmic artery
HP:0410006.definition: Abnormality of the first branch of the internal carotid artery.
HP:0410006.definition_cn: 颈内动脉第一分支异常。

HP:0410008.name: Abnormality of the peripheral nervous system
HP:0410008.definition: Any abnormality of the part of the nervous system that consists of the nerves and ganglia outside of the brain and spinal cord.
HP:0410008.definition_cn: 周围神经系统异常（Peripheral Nervous System Abnormality）

HP:0410009.name: Abnormality of the somatic nervous system
HP:0410009.definition: Any abnormality of the part of the peripheral nervous system associated with sensation and skeletal muscle voluntary control of body movements.
HP:0410009.definition_cn: 周围神经系统感觉和骨骼肌随意控制身体运动部分的任何异常。

HP:0410010.name: Abnormality of somatic nerve plexus
HP:0410010.definition: Any abnormality of the somatic nerve plexus.

HP:0410011.name: Abnormality of masticatory muscle
HP:0410011.definition: Any abnormality of the masticatory muscle.

HP:0410012.name: Abnormal mouth floor morphology
HP:0410012.definition: Any abnormality of the mouth floor.

HP:0410013.name: Abnormality of the submandibular region
HP:0410013.definition: Any abnormality of the submandibular region, the region between the mandible and the hyoid bone contains the submandibular and sublingual glands, suprahyoid muscles, submandibular ganglion, and lingual artery.
HP:0410013.definition_cn: 下颌下区异常，即位于下颌骨与舌骨之间的区域，包含下颌下腺、舌下腺、舌骨上肌群、下颌下神经节及舌动脉。

HP:0410014.name: Abnormal ganglion morphology
HP:0410014.definition: An abnormality of nerve cell cluster or a group of nerve cell bodies located in the autonomic nervous system.
HP:0410014.definition_cn: 自主神经系统内神经细胞簇或神经细胞群异常。

HP:0410015.name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system ganglion morphology
HP:0410015.definition: An abnormality of nerve cell cluster or a group of nerve cell bodies located in the peripheral autonomic nervous system.
HP:0410015.name_cn: 周围神经系统神经节形态异常
HP:0410015.definition_cn: 位于外周自主神经系统中的神经细胞簇或神经细胞群异常。

HP:0410016.name: Abnormal cranial ganglion morphology
HP:0410016.definition: An abnormality of nerve cell cluster or a group of nerve cell bodies located in the autonomic nervous system of the cranium.
HP:0410016.definition_cn: 颅部自主神经系统内神经细胞簇或神经细胞群异常。

HP:0410017.name: Otitis externa
HP:0410017.definition: Inflammation or infection of the external auditory canal (EAC), the auricle, or both.
HP:0410017.definition_cn: 外耳道（EAC）、耳廓或两者同时发生的炎症或感染。

HP:0410018.name: Recurrent ear infections
HP:0410018.definition: Increased susceptibility to ear infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of ear infections.
HP:0410018.definition_cn: 耳部感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作的耳部感染。

HP:0410019.name: Epigastric pain
HP:0410019.definition: Pain that is localized to the region of the upper abdomen immediately below the ribs.
HP:0410019.definition_cn: 上腹部肋骨下区域局限性疼痛。

HP:0410020.name: Fish odor
HP:0410020.definition: Body odor characterized by an offensive body odor and the smell of rotting fish due to the excessive excretion of trimethylamine (TMA) in the urine, sweat, and breath of affected individuals.
HP:0410020.definition_cn: 体臭特征为恶臭体味及腐烂鱼腥味，这是由于患者尿液、汗液和呼吸中三甲胺（TMA）过度排泄所致。

HP:0410022.name: Vaginal fish odor
HP:0410022.definition: A fish odor in the vaginal area, that is characteristic of bacterial vaginosis (BV), and is due to trimethylamine (TMA).
HP:0410022.definition_cn: 阴道区域出现鱼腥味，这是细菌性阴道病（Bacterial Vaginosis, BV）的特征性表现，其原因是三甲胺（Trimethylamine, TMA）的存在。

HP:0410023.name: Abnormal distribution of cell junction proteins in buccal mucosal cells
HP:0410023.definition: An anomalous amount or location of cell junction proteins such as plakoglobin or Cx43.
HP:0410023.name_cn: 颊黏膜细胞中细胞连接蛋白的异常分布
HP:0410023.definition_cn: 细胞连接蛋白（如斑珠蛋白或连接蛋白43）的数量或位置异常。

HP:0410027.name: Alveolar bone loss around teeth
HP:0410027.definition: A decrease in the amount of alveolar bone around the root of a tooth.
HP:0410027.definition_cn: 牙根周围牙槽骨量减少。

HP:0410028.name: Recurrent oral herpes
HP:0410028.definition: Recurrent episodes of oral herpes, typically characterized by blisters or ulcers on the gums, lips and/or tongue caused by herpes virus.
HP:0410028.definition_cn: 复发性口腔疱疹，通常表现为由疱疹病毒引起的牙龈、唇部和/或舌部的水疱或溃疡。

HP:0410030.name: Cleft lip
HP:0410030.definition: A gap in the lip or lips.

HP:0410031.name: Submucous cleft of soft and hard palate
HP:0410031.definition: Soft and hard-palate submucous clefts are characterized by bony defects in the midline of the soft and hard palate that are covered by the lining (ie mucous membrane) of the roof of the mouth.
HP:0410031.definition_cn: 软硬腭黏膜下裂的特征是软腭和硬腭中线处的骨性缺损，这些缺损被口腔顶部的衬里（即黏膜）所覆盖。

HP:0410033.name: Unilateral alveolar cleft of maxilla
HP:0410033.definition: One sided alveolar cleft of the maxilla.

HP:0410034.name: Bilateral alveolar cleft of maxilla
HP:0410034.definition: Nonmidline alveolar cleft of the maxilla.
HP:0410034.definition_cn: 上颌骨非中线牙槽突裂。

HP:0410035.name: Abnormal T cell activation
HP:0410035.definition: Any abnormality in the activation of T cells, i.e. the change in morphology and behavior of a mature or immature T cell resulting from exposure to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific.
HP:0410035.definition_cn: T细胞活化过程中的任何异常，即成熟或未成熟T细胞在暴露于有丝分裂原、细胞因子、趋化因子、细胞配体或特异性抗原后发生的形态和行为变化。

HP:0410042.name: Abnormal liver morphology
HP:0410042.definition: Any structural anomaly of the bile-secreting organ that is important for detoxification, for fat, carbohydrate, and protein metabolism, and for glycogen storage.
HP:0410042.definition_cn: 任何与胆汁分泌器官相关的结构异常，该器官在解毒、脂肪、碳水化合物和蛋白质代谢以及糖原储存中具有重要作用。

HP:0410043.name: Abnormal neural tube morphology
HP:0410043.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hollow epithelial tube found on the dorsal side of the vertebrate embryo that develops into the central nervous system (i.e. brain and spinal cord).
HP:0410043.definition_cn: 脊椎动物胚胎背侧中空上皮管（将发育为中枢神经系统，即脑和脊髓）的任何结构异常。

HP:0410050.name: Decreased level of 1,5 anhydroglucitol in serum
HP:0410050.definition: A decrease in the level of 1,5 anhydroglucitol in the serum. 1,5-Anhydrosorbitol is a validated marker of short-term glycemic control. This substance is derived mainly from food, is well absorbed in the intestine, and is distributed to all organs and tissues.
HP:0410050.name_cn: 血清中1,5-脱水葡萄糖醇水平降低
HP:0410050.definition_cn: 血清中1,5-脱水葡萄糖醇水平降低。1,5-脱水山梨醇是短期血糖控制的有效标志物。该物质主要来源于食物，在肠道内被良好吸收，并分布至所有器官和组织。

HP:0410051.name: Increased level of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid in urine
HP:0410051.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0410051.name_cn: 尿液中3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酸水平升高
HP:0410051.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0410052.name: Increased level of allantoin in serum
HP:0410052.definition: An increase in the level of allantoin in the serum.
HP:0410052.name_cn: 血清中尿囊素水平升高
HP:0410052.definition_cn: 血清中尿囊素水平升高。

HP:0410053.name: Elevated circulating gamma-aminobutyric acid concentration
HP:0410053.definition: An increase in the level of Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the blood circulation.
HP:0410053.name_cn: 循环中γ-氨基丁酸浓度升高
HP:0410053.definition_cn: 血液循环中γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）水平升高。

HP:0410054.name: Decreased circulating GABA concentration
HP:0410054.definition: A decrease in the level of GABA in the serum.
HP:0410054.name_cn: 循环中γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）浓度降低
HP:0410054.definition_cn: 血清中γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）水平降低。

HP:0410055.name: Decreased level of erythritol in urine
HP:0410055.definition: A decrease in the level of erythritol in the urine.
HP:0410055.name_cn: 尿液中赤藓糖醇水平降低
HP:0410055.definition_cn: 尿液中赤藓糖醇水平降低。

HP:0410056.name: Decreased CSF erythritol concentration
HP:0410056.definition: Concentration of erythritol in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0410056.name_cn: 脑脊液赤藓糖醇浓度降低
HP:0410056.definition_cn: 脑脊液中赤藓糖醇浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0410057.name: Increased level of D-threitol in plasma
HP:0410057.definition: An increase in the level of D-threitol in the plasma.
HP:0410057.name_cn: 血浆中D-苏糖醇水平升高
HP:0410057.definition_cn: 血浆中D-苏糖醇水平升高。

HP:0410058.name: Increased CSF D-threitol concentration
HP:0410058.definition: The concentration of D-threitol in the cerebrospinal fluid is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0410058.name_cn: 脑脊液D-苏糖醇浓度升高
HP:0410058.definition_cn: 脑脊液中D-苏糖醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0410059.name: Increased level of D-threitol in urine
HP:0410059.definition: An increase in the level of D-threitol in the urine.
HP:0410059.name_cn: 尿液中D-苏糖醇水平升高
HP:0410059.definition_cn: 尿液中D-苏糖醇水平升高。

HP:0410060.name: Decreased level of D-mannose in urine
HP:0410060.definition: A decrease in the level of D-mannose in the urine.
HP:0410060.name_cn: 尿液中D-甘露糖水平降低
HP:0410060.definition_cn: 尿液中D-甘露糖水平降低。

HP:0410061.name: Increased level of galactitol in plasma
HP:0410061.definition: An increase in the level of galactitol in the plasma.
HP:0410061.name_cn: 血浆中半乳糖醇水平升高
HP:0410061.definition_cn: 血浆中半乳糖醇水平升高。

HP:0410062.name: Increased level of galactitol in urine
HP:0410062.definition: An increase in the level of galactitol in the urine.
HP:0410062.name_cn: 尿液中半乳糖醇水平升高
HP:0410062.definition_cn: 尿液中半乳糖醇水平升高。

HP:0410063.name: Increased level of galactonate in red blood cells
HP:0410063.definition: An increase in the level of galactonate in the red blood cells.
HP:0410063.name_cn: 红细胞中半乳糖酸水平升高
HP:0410063.definition_cn: 红细胞中半乳糖酸水平升高。

HP:0410064.name: Increased level of galactitol in red blood cells
HP:0410064.definition: An increase in the level of galactitol in the red blood cells.
HP:0410064.name_cn: 红细胞中半乳糖醇水平升高
HP:0410064.definition_cn: 红细胞内半乳糖醇水平升高。

HP:0410065.name: Increased level of hippuric acid in blood
HP:0410065.definition: An increase in the level of hippuric acid in the blood.
HP:0410065.name_cn: 血液中马尿酸水平升高
HP:0410065.definition_cn: 血液中马尿酸水平升高。

HP:0410066.name: Increased level of hippuric acid in urine

HP:0410070.definition: An increase in the level of ribitol in the urine. Ribotol is a crystalline pentose alcohol (C5H12O5) and is a metabolic end product formed by the reduction of ribose.

HP:0410132.definition_cn: 尿液中L-焦谷氨酸水平升高。

HP:0410133.name: Chronic idiopathic urticaria
HP:0410133.definition: Urticaria characterized by spontaneously recurring hives for 6 weeks or longer.
HP:0410133.definition_cn: 慢性荨麻疹，其特征为自发性反复发作的风疹，持续6周或更长时间。

HP:0410134.name: Physical urticaria
HP:0410134.definition: Urticaria caused by physical agents, such as heat, cold, light, friction.
HP:0410134.definition_cn: 物理性因素（如热、冷、光、摩擦）诱发的荨麻疹。

HP:0410135.name: Cold urticaria
HP:0410135.definition: Urticaria may be caused by cold temperatures.
HP:0410135.definition_cn: 寒冷性荨麻疹可能由低温诱发。

HP:0410136.name: Aquagenic urticaria
HP:0410136.definition: A form of physical urticaria, in which contact with water, regardless of its temperature and source, evokes pruritic follicular wheals on the skin.
HP:0410136.definition_cn: 一种物理性荨麻疹，其中接触水，无论其温度和来源如何，都会在皮肤上引发瘙痒性毛囊性风团。

HP:0410137.name: Solar urticaria
HP:0410137.definition: Urticaria in response to exposure to ultraviolet-A (UVA), ultraviolet-B (UVB), visible and rarely infrared light.
HP:0410137.definition_cn: 紫外线A（UVA）、紫外线B（UVB）、可见光及罕见红外线照射后引发的荨麻疹。

HP:0410138.name: Vibratory urticaria
HP:0410138.definition: Urticaria in response to dermal vibration, with coincident degranulation of mast cells and increased histamine levels in serum.
HP:0410138.definition_cn: 皮肤振动性荨麻疹，伴随肥大细胞脱颗粒及血清组胺水平升高。

HP:0410144.name: Abnormal circulating biotinidase concentration
HP:0410144.definition: An abnormality in the biotinidase level, an enzyme that releases biotin from biocytin, the product of biotin-dependent carboxylases degradation.
HP:0410144.name_cn: 异常循环生物素酶浓度
HP:0410144.definition_cn: 生物素酶水平异常，该酶负责从生物素依赖性羧化酶降解产物生物胞素中释放生物素。

HP:0410145.name: Decreased circulating biotinidase concentration
HP:0410145.definition: Concentration of biotinidase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Biotidinase is an enzyme that releases biotin from biocytin, the product of biotin-dependent carboxylases degradation.
HP:0410145.name_cn: 循环生物素酶浓度降低
HP:0410145.definition_cn: 血液循环中生物素酶浓度低于正常下限。生物素酶是一种从生物胞素（生物素依赖性羧化酶降解产物）中释放生物素的酶。

HP:0410146.name: Elevated circulating biotinidase concentration
HP:0410146.definition: Concentration of biotinidase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Biotidinase is an enzyme that releases biotin from biocytin, the product of biotin-dependent carboxylases degradation.
HP:0410146.name_cn: 循环生物素酶浓度升高
HP:0410146.definition_cn: 血液循环中生物素酶浓度高于正常值上限。生物素酶是一种从生物胞素中释放生物素的酶，生物胞素是生物素依赖性羧化酶降解的产物。

HP:0410147.name: Eosinophilic infiltration in the stomach mucosa
HP:0410147.definition: Infiltration of eosinophils in the stomach mucosa, that is diagnosed by an upper endoscopy and microscopy that shows more than 20 eosinophils per high-power field in association with peripheral eosinophilia and the absence of secondary cause of eosinophilia.
HP:0410147.name_cn: 胃黏膜嗜酸性粒细胞浸润
HP:0410147.definition_cn: 胃黏膜嗜酸性粒细胞浸润，通过上消化道内镜和显微镜检查诊断，显示每高倍视野下超过20个嗜酸性粒细胞，并伴有外周血嗜酸性粒细胞增多，且排除继发性嗜酸性粒细胞增多的原因。

HP:0410148.name: Idiopathic anaphylaxis
HP:0410148.definition: A rare form of anaphylaxis for which triggers cannot be identified despite a detailed history and careful diagnostic assessment.
HP:0410148.definition_cn: 一种罕见的过敏性休克类型，尽管进行了详细的病史采集和谨慎的诊断评估，仍无法确定其触发因素。

HP:0410149.name: Drug-induced anaphylaxis
HP:0410149.definition: A form of anaphylaxis that is triggered by intake of drugs or medications.
HP:0410149.definition_cn: 药物诱发性过敏反应（Drug-Induced Anaphylaxis）

HP:0410151.name: Eosinophilic infiltration of the esophagus
HP:0410151.definition: Infiltration of numerous eosinophils (usually greater than 15 per high power field) into the squamous epithelium of the esophagus, and layering of eosinophils on the surface layer of the esophagus.
HP:0410151.name_cn: 食管嗜酸性粒细胞浸润
HP:0410151.definition_cn: 食管鳞状上皮内大量嗜酸性粒细胞浸润（通常每高倍视野超过15个），以及食管表层嗜酸性粒细胞层状分布。

HP:0410152.name: Eosinophilic microabscess formation in the esophagus
HP:0410152.definition: The formation of small localized collection of eosinophiles (an eosinophilic microabscess) in the esophagus. Usually clusters of greater than or equal to 4 eosinophils are seen, that appear as exudates or white spots or white plaques.
HP:0410152.name_cn: 食管嗜酸性微脓肿形成
HP:0410152.definition_cn: 食管内局部嗜酸性粒细胞聚集形成（嗜酸性微脓肿）。通常可见大于或等于4个嗜酸性粒细胞簇，表现为渗出物、白斑或白色斑块。

HP:0410153.name: Increased level of methylsuccinic acid in urine
HP:0410153.definition: The concentration of methylsuccinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0410153.name_cn: 尿液中甲基琥珀酸水平升高
HP:0410153.definition_cn: 尿液中甲基琥珀酸浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:0410154.name: Increased level of myristic acid in serum
HP:0410154.definition: An increase in the level of myristic acid in the serum.
HP:0410154.name_cn: 血清中肉豆蔻酸水平升高
HP:0410154.definition_cn: 血清中肉豆蔻酸水平升高。

HP:0410157.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中N-乙酰神经氨酸水平升高。

HP:0410158.name_cn: 过时的 尿液中O-磷酸乙醇胺水平升高

HP:0410166.name: Defective interstrand cross-link repair
HP:0410166.definition: A defect in the of the process of interstrand cross-link repair: removal of a DNA interstrand crosslink (a covalent attachment of DNA bases on opposite strands of the DNA) and restoration of the DNA. DNA interstrand crosslinks occur when both strands of duplex DNA are covalently tethered together (e.g. by an exogenous or endogenous agent), thus preventing the strand unwinding necessary for essential DNA functions such as transcription and replication.
HP:0410166.definition_cn: 链间交联修复过程中的缺陷：DNA链间交联的移除（DNA双链上相对碱基之间的共价连接）及DNA的修复。DNA链间交联发生在双链DNA的两条链被共价连接在一起时（例如通过外源性或内源性物质），从而阻碍了DNA进行转录和复制等基本功能所需的链解旋。

HP:0410167.name: Abnormal morphology of the chest musculature
HP:0410167.definition: Any abnormality of the chest muscles.
HP:0410167.name_cn: 胸部肌肉组织形态异常

HP:0410168.name: Abnormality of the back musculature
HP:0410168.definition: Any abnormality of the back muscles.

HP:0410169.name: Abnormal morphology of the shoulder musculature

HP:0410169.name_cn: 肩部肌肉组织形态异常

HP:0410170.name: Hippocampal atrophy
HP:0410170.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of hippocampus tissue that was once present.
HP:0410170.definition_cn: 部分或完全的海马体组织萎缩（丧失），该组织先前存在。

HP:0410171.name: Increased cotinine level
HP:0410171.definition: Increased concentration of cotinine in urine.
HP:0410171.definition_cn: 尿液中可替宁浓度升高。

HP:0410172.name: Blood xenobiotic
HP:0410172.definition: The presence of a xenobiotic in blood.
HP:0410172.definition_cn: 血液中外源性物质的存在。

HP:0410173.name: Increased circulating troponin I concentration
HP:0410173.definition: An increased concentration of tropnin I in the blood, which is a cardiac regulatory protein that controls the calcium mediated interaction between actin and myosin. Raised cardiac troponin concentrations are now accepted as the standard biochemical marker for the diagnosis of myocardial infarction.
HP:0410173.name_cn: 循环肌钙蛋白I浓度升高
HP:0410173.definition_cn: 血液中肌钙蛋白I浓度升高，肌钙蛋白I是一种心脏调节蛋白，控制钙介导的肌动蛋白和肌球蛋白之间的相互作用。目前，升高的心脏肌钙蛋白浓度已被公认为诊断心肌梗死的标准生化标志物。

HP:0410174.name: Increased circulating troponin T concentration
HP:0410174.definition: An increased concentration of tropnin T in the blood, which is a cardiac regulatory protein that controls the calcium mediated interaction between actin and myosin. Raised cardiac troponin concentrations are now accepted as the standard biochemical marker for the diagnosis of myocardial infarction.
HP:0410174.name_cn: 循环肌钙蛋白T浓度升高

HP:0410175.definition_cn: 血液中酮体（乙酰乙酸、β-羟基丁酸和丙酮）水平升高。

HP:0410193.name: Abnormal circulating UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
HP:0410193.definition: An abnormality in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in plasma. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.
HP:0410193.name_cn: 异常循环尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶浓度
HP:0410193.definition_cn: 血浆中尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶水平异常。尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶催化反应：UDP-葡萄糖 = UDP-半乳糖。

HP:0410196.name: Abnormal erythrocyte UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
HP:0410196.definition: An abnormality in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.
HP:0410196.name_cn: 异常红细胞尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶浓度
HP:0410196.definition_cn: 红细胞中尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶水平异常。尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶催化反应：UDP-葡萄糖 = UDP-半乳糖。

HP:0410197.name: Increased erythrocyte UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
HP:0410197.definition: An increase in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.
HP:0410197.name_cn: 红细胞尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶浓度升高
HP:0410197.definition_cn: 红细胞中尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶水平升高。尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶催化反应：UDP-葡萄糖 = UDP-半乳糖。

HP:0410198.name: Decreased erythrocyte UDP glucose-4-epimerase concentration
HP:0410198.definition: A decrease in uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase level in red blood cells. Uridine diphosphate glucose-4-epimerase catalyzes the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.
HP:0410198.name_cn: 红细胞尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶浓度降低
HP:0410198.definition_cn: 红细胞中尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶水平降低。尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖-4-差向异构酶催化反应：UDP-葡萄糖 = UDP-半乳糖。

HP:0410199.name: Increased CSF urate concentration
HP:0410199.definition: Increased concentration of urate in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0410199.definition_cn: 脑脊液中尿酸浓度升高。

HP:0410200.name: Positive meconium barbiturate test
HP:0410200.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in meconium.
HP:0410200.name_cn: 胎粪巴比妥酸盐检测阳性
HP:0410200.definition_cn: 检测胎粪中苯巴比妥等巴比妥酸盐代谢物。

HP:0410201.name: Positive hair barbiturate test
HP:0410201.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in the hair.
HP:0410201.name_cn: 毛发巴比妥酸盐检测阳性
HP:0410201.definition_cn: 检测毛发中的巴比妥酸盐代谢物，如苯巴比妥。

HP:0410202.name: Positive stool barbiturate test
HP:0410202.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in the stool.
HP:0410202.name_cn: 粪便巴比妥酸盐检测阳性
HP:0410202.definition_cn: 粪便中巴比妥酸盐代谢物（如苯巴比妥）的检测。

HP:0410203.name: Positive gastric fluid barbiturate test
HP:0410203.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as phenobarbital in the gastric fluid.
HP:0410203.name_cn: 胃液巴比妥酸盐检测阳性
HP:0410203.definition_cn: 胃液中苯巴比妥等巴比妥酸盐代谢物的检测。

HP:0410204.name: Increased intestinal transit time
HP:0410204.definition: An increase in the length of time required for food to pass through the intestines.

HP:0410205.name: Abnormal circulating nicotinurate concentration
HP:0410205.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of nicotinurate in the blood.
HP:0410205.definition_cn: 血液中烟尿酸浓度的任何异常。

HP:0410206.name: Increased circulating nicotinurate level
HP:0410206.definition: An increased amount of nicotinurate in the blood.
HP:0410206.definition_cn: 血液中烟尿酸水平升高。

HP:0410207.name: Positive methadone plasma/serum test
HP:0410207.definition: Detection of methadone or its metabolite 2-ethylidene-1,5-dimethyl-3,3- diphenylpyrrolidine (EDDP) in plasma or serum.
HP:0410207.name_cn: 美沙酮血浆/血清检测阳性
HP:0410207.definition_cn: 血浆或血清中美沙酮或其代谢物2-亚乙基-1,5-二甲基-3,3-二苯基吡咯烷（EDDP）的检测。

HP:0410208.name: Positive plasma/serum cotinine test
HP:0410208.definition: Detection of cotinine, an alkaloid found in tobacco and the predominant metabolite of nicotine, in plasma or serum.
HP:0410208.name_cn: 血浆/血清可替宁检测阳性
HP:0410208.definition_cn: 血浆或血清中可替宁（一种存在于烟草中的生物碱，也是尼古丁的主要代谢产物）的检测。

HP:0410209.name: Folate deficiency in CSF
HP:0410209.definition: A reduced concentration of folic acid, which is also known as vitamin B9 in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0410209.definition_cn: 脑脊液中叶酸（维生素B9）浓度降低。

HP:0410210.name: Abnormal cord blood measurement
HP:0410210.definition: An abnormality in any umbilical cord measurement performed after birth, such as the blood gas level.
HP:0410210.definition_cn: 出生后进行的任何脐带测量异常，例如血气水平异常。

HP:0410211.name: Abnormal blood gas level in cord blood

HP:0410212.name: Hyperoxemia in cord blood
HP:0410212.definition: An abnormally high level of blood oxygen in the cord blood.
HP:0410212.definition_cn: 脐带血中氧分压异常升高。

HP:0410213.name: Hypoxemia in cord blood
HP:0410213.definition: An abnormally low level of blood oxygen in the cord blood.
HP:0410213.definition_cn: 脐带血氧分压异常降低。

HP:0410214.name: Hypercapnia in cord blood
HP:0410214.definition: Abnormally elevated blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level in the cord blood.
HP:0410214.definition_cn: 脐带血中二氧化碳（CO2）水平异常升高。

HP:0410215.name: Hypocapnia in cord blood
HP:0410215.definition: Abnormally decreased blood carbon dioxide (CO2) level in the cord blood.
HP:0410215.definition_cn: 脐带血中二氧化碳（CO2）水平异常降低。

HP:0410216.name: Abnormal blood 5-methyltetrahydrofolate level
HP:0410216.definition: An abnormal concentration of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate in the blood.
HP:0410216.name_cn: 血液5-甲基四氢叶酸水平异常
HP:0410216.definition_cn: 血液中5-甲基四氢叶酸浓度异常。

HP:0410217.name: Reduced blood 5-methyltetrahydrofolate level
HP:0410217.definition: A decreased concentration of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate in the blood.
HP:0410217.name_cn: 血液中5-甲基四氢叶酸水平降低
HP:0410217.definition_cn: 血液中5-甲基四氢叶酸浓度降低。

HP:0410218.name: Hypoplasia of maxilla relative to mandible
HP:0410218.definition: Abnormally small dimension of the maxilla (upper jaw) relative to the mandible (lower jaw).
HP:0410218.name_cn: 上颌骨相对于下颌骨的发育不全
HP:0410218.definition_cn: 上颌骨相对于下颌骨尺寸异常缩小。

HP:0410219.name: Hypoplasia of mandible relative to maxilla
HP:0410219.definition: Abnormally small dimension of the mandible (lower jaw) relative to the maxilla (upper jaw).
HP:0410219.name_cn: 下颌骨相对于上颌骨发育不全
HP:0410219.definition_cn: 下颌骨（下颚）相对于上颌骨（上颚）的异常小尺寸。

HP:0410220.name: Increased anti-dairy protein IgE antibody level
HP:0410220.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against dairy proteins, including casein, alpha-lactalbumin, beta-lactoglobulin or bovine serum albumin contained in cow, sheep or goat milk and milk products.
HP:0410220.name_cn: 抗乳蛋白IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410220.definition_cn: 针对乳制品蛋白（包括酪蛋白、α-乳白蛋白、β-乳球蛋白或牛血清白蛋白）的IgE抗体水平升高，这些蛋白存在于牛、羊或山羊奶及其制品中。

HP:0410221.name: Increased anti-animal protein IgE antibody level
HP:0410221.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against animal proteins, such as albumins that are present in animal hair, dander, shed skin, saliva and urine.
HP:0410221.name_cn: 抗动物蛋白IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410221.definition_cn: 针对动物蛋白的IgE抗体水平升高，例如存在于动物毛发、皮屑、脱落皮肤、唾液和尿液中的白蛋白。

HP:0410222.name: Increased anti-seafood IgE antibody level
HP:0410222.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against seafood, including fish, shrimp, lobster, crab, squid and abalone.
HP:0410222.definition_cn: 针对海鲜（包括鱼类、虾类、龙虾、螃蟹、鱿鱼和鲍鱼）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410223.name: Increased anti-dust mite IgE antibody level
HP:0410223.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against dust mites, such as house dust mites.
HP:0410223.definition_cn: 针对尘螨（如屋尘螨）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410224.name: Increased anti-bacteria IgE antibody level
HP:0410224.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against bacteria.
HP:0410224.definition_cn: 针对细菌的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410225.name: Increased anti-drug IgE antibody level
HP:0410225.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against a drug or class of drugs, such as antibiotics.
HP:0410225.definition_cn: 针对某种药物或某类药物（如抗生素）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410226.name: Increased anti-feather IgE antibody level
HP:0410226.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against feathers, which could be indicative of an allergy against feathers themselves, or mite allergens present in feathers.
HP:0410226.definition_cn: 针对羽毛的IgE抗体水平升高，可能提示对羽毛本身或羽毛中存在的螨虫过敏原的过敏反应。

HP:0410227.name: Increased anti-food allergen IgE antibody level
HP:0410227.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against proteins found in foods, such as milk, egg, soy, wheat, peanut, treenut, fish, and shellfish.
HP:0410227.name_cn: 抗食物过敏原IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410227.definition_cn: 针对食物中蛋白质（如牛奶、鸡蛋、大豆、小麦、花生、坚果、鱼类和贝类）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410228.name: Increased anti-plant based food allergen IgE antibody level
HP:0410228.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against a plant based food allergen, including vegetables and fruits.
HP:0410228.name_cn: 抗植物性食物过敏原IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410228.definition_cn: 针对植物性食物过敏原（包括蔬菜和水果）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410229.name: Increased anti-gluten IgE antibody level
HP:0410229.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye.
HP:0410229.name_cn: 抗麦胶蛋白IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410229.definition_cn: 针对麸质的IgE抗体水平升高，麸质是一种存在于小麦、大麦和黑麦中的蛋白质。

HP:0410230.name: Increased anti-nut food product IgE antibody level
HP:0410230.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against nut food products such as peanuts or tree nuts, such as hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, and almonds.
HP:0410230.name_cn: 抗坚果食物特异性IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410230.definition_cn: 针对坚果类食品（如花生或树坚果，包括榛子、核桃、腰果和杏仁）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410231.name: Increased anti-egg IgE antibody level
HP:0410231.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against eggs, including egg whites, egg yolks, and egg proteins such as ovoalbumin and ovomucoid.
HP:0410231.name_cn: 抗卵清蛋白IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410231.definition_cn: 针对鸡蛋的IgE抗体水平升高，包括蛋清、蛋黄以及卵白蛋白和卵粘蛋白等鸡蛋蛋白。

HP:0410232.name: Increased anti-fungi IgE antibody level
HP:0410232.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against fungus, such as molds like zygomycota, ascomycota and deuteromycota.
HP:0410232.definition_cn: 针对真菌（如接合菌门、子囊菌门和半知菌门等霉菌）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410233.name: Increased anti-meat allergen IgE antibody level
HP:0410233.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against meat, such as mammalian meat, including beef or pork, or poultry, like duck or chicken.
HP:0410233.name_cn: 抗肉类过敏原IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410233.definition_cn: 针对肉类（如哺乳动物肉类，包括牛肉或猪肉）或禽类（如鸭肉或鸡肉）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410234.name: Increased anti-parasite IgE antibody level
HP:0410234.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against parasites, such as helminths (parasitic worms, such as Ascaris lumbricoides, Trichuris trichiura, Ancylostoma duodenalis, Necator americanus, Strongyloides stercoralis) or parasites such as Toxoplasma gondii.
HP:0410234.name_cn: 抗寄生虫IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410234.definition_cn: 针对寄生虫（如蠕虫类寄生虫，包括蛔虫Ascaris lumbricoides、鞭虫Trichuris trichiura、十二指肠钩虫Ancylostoma duodenalis、美洲钩虫Necator americanus、粪类圆线虫Strongyloides stercoralis）或寄生虫（如弓形虫Toxoplasma gondii）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410235.name: Increased anti-insect IgE antibody level
HP:0410235.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against antigens from insects such as moths, mosquitos, or cockroaches.
HP:0410235.definition_cn: 针对昆虫（如蛾类、蚊子或蟑螂）抗原的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410236.name: Increased anti-venom IgE antibody level
HP:0410236.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against venom from insects such as bees, wasps, hornets, yellowjackets.
HP:0410236.definition_cn: 针对蜜蜂、黄蜂、大黄蜂、胡蜂等昆虫毒液的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410238.name: Increased anti-plant product IgE antibody level
HP:0410238.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against antigens from plants and products derived from plants, such as wood or pollen.
HP:0410238.name_cn: 抗植物产物IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410238.definition_cn: 针对植物及其衍生产物（如木材或花粉）抗原的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410239.name: Positive urine norcotinine test
HP:0410239.definition: Detection of norcotinine, a metabolite of nicotine, in urine.
HP:0410239.name_cn: 尿液中正去甲烟碱检测阳性
HP:0410239.definition_cn: 尿液中尼古丁代谢物去甲烟碱的检测。

HP:0410240.name: Abnormal circulating IgA concentration
HP:0410240.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgA immunoglobulin in blood.
HP:0410240.name_cn: 异常循环免疫球蛋白A浓度
HP:0410240.definition_cn: 血清免疫球蛋白A（IgA）水平异常偏离正常范围。

HP:0410241.name: Abnormal circulating IgE concentration
HP:0410241.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgE immunoglobulin in blood.
HP:0410241.definition_cn: 血液中IgE免疫球蛋白水平异常偏离正常值。

HP:0410242.name: Abnormal circulating IgG concentration
HP:0410242.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgG immunoglobulin in blood.
HP:0410242.name_cn: 异常循环免疫球蛋白G浓度
HP:0410242.definition_cn: 血液中IgG免疫球蛋白水平异常偏离正常值。

HP:0410243.name: Abnormal circulating IgM concentration
HP:0410243.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgM immunoglobulin in blood.
HP:0410243.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白IgM水平异常偏离正常值。

HP:0410244.name: Abnormal circulating IgD concentration
HP:0410244.definition: An abnormal deviation from normal levels of IgD immunoglobulin in blood.
HP:0410244.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白D（IgD）水平异常偏离正常值。

HP:0410245.name: Decreased circulating IgD concentration
HP:0410245.definition: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin D (IgD) in blood.
HP:0410245.definition_cn: 血液中免疫球蛋白D（IgD）水平异常降低。

HP:0410246.name: Increased circulating IgD concentration
HP:0410246.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin D in blood.
HP:0410246.definition_cn: 血清免疫球蛋白D水平异常升高。

HP:0410247.name: Increased anti-animal dander IgE antibody level
HP:0410247.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against animal dander, tiny scales shed from animal skin or hair, such as from pet dogs or cats.
HP:0410247.name_cn: 抗动物皮屑IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410247.definition_cn: 针对动物皮屑（如宠物狗或猫的皮肤或毛发脱落的微小鳞屑）的IgE抗体水平升高。

HP:0410248.name: Increased anti-house dust mite IgE antibody level
HP:0410248.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against house dust mites, a common allergen.
HP:0410248.name_cn: 抗屋尘螨IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410248.definition_cn: 针对屋尘螨的IgE抗体水平升高，屋尘螨为常见过敏原。

HP:0410249.name: Increased anti-alpha-gal IgE antibody level
HP:0410249.definition: Increased level of IgE antibody against galactose-alpha-1, 3 galactose (alpha-gal), a carbohydrate found in mammalian meat.
HP:0410249.name_cn: 抗α-半乳糖IgE抗体水平升高
HP:0410249.definition_cn: 针对半乳糖-α-1,3-半乳糖（α-gal）的IgE抗体水平升高，α-gal是一种存在于哺乳动物肉类中的碳水化合物。

HP:0410251.name: Abnormal L-selectin shedding
HP:0410251.definition: An abnormality in the cleavage of L-selectin during the process of guiding neutrophils to the site of infection. Proteolytic cleavage of L-selectin results in rapid shedding from the cell surface, which has a role in neutrophil rolling and accumulation at the site of infection.
HP:0410251.definition_cn: 在引导中性粒细胞向感染部位迁移过程中，L-选择素（L-selectin）的裂解异常。L-选择素的蛋白水解裂解导致其从细胞表面快速脱落，这一过程在中性粒细胞的滚动及在感染部位的积聚中起重要作用。

HP:0410252.name: Chronic neutropenia
HP:0410252.definition: Neutropenia with an absolute neutrophil count (ANC) less than 1,500,000,000/L lasting for more than 3 months.
HP:0410252.name_cn: 慢性中性粒细胞减少症
HP:0410252.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞减少症，绝对中性粒细胞计数（ANC）低于1,500,000,000/L，持续超过3个月。

HP:0410253.name: Myeloid maturation arrest
HP:0410253.definition: Chornic neutropenia arising from an impaired proliferation and maturation of myeloid progenitor cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0410253.definition_cn: 慢性中性粒细胞减少症，源于骨髓中髓系祖细胞增殖和成熟受损。

HP:0410254.name: Cyclic neutropenia in myeloid maturation arrest in bone marrow
HP:0410254.definition: Cyclic neutropenia arising from an impaired proliferation and maturation of myeloid progenitor cells in the bone marrow.
HP:0410254.name_cn: 骨髓中粒细胞成熟停滞导致的周期性中性粒细胞减少症
HP:0410254.definition_cn: 由骨髓中髓系祖细胞增殖和成熟障碍引起的周期性中性粒细胞减少症。

HP:0410255.name: Transient neutropenia
HP:0410255.definition: A transient reduction in the number of neutrophils in the peripheral blood. Transient neutropenia is most commonly associated with viral infections, but other causes include drugs and autoimmunity.
HP:0410255.name_cn: 短暂性中性粒细胞减少症
HP:0410255.definition_cn: 外周血中性粒细胞数量的一过性减少。一过性中性粒细胞减少症最常见于病毒感染，但其他原因包括药物和自身免疫性疾病。

HP:0410256.name: Infection associated neutropenia
HP:0410256.definition: Transient neutropenia caused by an infection, such as with a virus, bacteria or protozoan.
HP:0410256.name_cn: 感染相关性中性粒细胞减少症
HP:0410256.definition_cn: 由感染（如病毒、细菌或原虫）引起的短暂性中性粒细胞减少症。

HP:0410257.name: Neutrophilia in presence of infection
HP:0410257.definition: An increased number of neutrophils circulating in the blood during an infection, such as with a bacteria, virus or fungus.
HP:0410257.name_cn: 感染状态下的中性粒细胞增多症
HP:0410257.definition_cn: 感染期间（如细菌、病毒或真菌感染）循环血液中中性粒细胞数量增加。

HP:0410258.name: Neutrophilia in absence of infection
HP:0410258.definition: An increased number of neutrophils circulating in the blood in the absence of an infection. Factors contributing to neutrophilia could include inflammation or congenital disorders.
HP:0410258.name_cn: 无感染性中性粒细胞增多症
HP:0410258.definition_cn: 在没有感染的情况下，血液中循环的中性粒细胞数量增加。导致中性粒细胞增多的因素可能包括炎症或先天性异常。

HP:0410259.name: Hepatopulmonary fusion
HP:0410259.definition: Fusion of the liver with the lung.

HP:0410260.name: Asymmetrical gluteal crease
HP:0410260.definition: The presence of an asymmetrical gluteal crease, the horizontal crease formed by the inferior aspect of the buttocks and the posterior upper leg.
HP:0410260.definition_cn: 存在不对称臀沟，即由臀部下方与大腿后侧上部形成的水平皱褶。

HP:0410261.name: Wide space between 4th and 5th toe
HP:0410261.definition: A widely spaced gap between the fourth toe and the fifth (pinky) toe.
HP:0410261.name_cn: 第四和第五趾间间隙增宽
HP:0410261.definition_cn: 第四趾与第五趾（小趾）之间的间隙显著增宽。

HP:0410262.name: Lower cranial nerve dysfunction
HP:0410262.definition: A functional abnormality affecting the lower cranial nerves, which include the paired 9th (glossopharyngeal), 10th (vagal), 11th (accessory) and 12th (hypoglossal) cranial nerves.
HP:0410262.definition_cn: 影响下组颅神经的功能异常，包括成对的第9对（舌咽神经）、第10对（迷走神经）、第11对（副神经）和第12对（舌下神经）颅神经。

HP:0410263.name: Brain imaging abnormality
HP:0410263.definition: An anomaly of metabolism or structure of the brain identified by imaging.
HP:0410263.definition_cn: 通过影像学检查发现的大脑代谢或结构异常。

HP:0410264.name: Subglottic hemangioma
HP:0410264.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the airway, typically below the vocal chords, that can cause severe obstruction of the airway.
HP:0410264.definition_cn: 血管瘤，一种位于气道内的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤，通常位于声带下方，可能导致气道严重阻塞。

HP:0410265.name: Supraglottic hemangioma
HP:0410265.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the upper part of the larynx (voice box) including the epiglottis; the area above the vocal cords.
HP:0410265.definition_cn: 喉部血管瘤，一种位于喉部（声带）上部的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤，包括会厌；声带上方区域。

HP:0410266.name: Visceral hemangioma
HP:0410266.definition: A hemangioma arising from within visceral structures, the internal organs of the body.

HP:0410267.name: Intestinal hemangioma
HP:0410267.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the intestines, which includes the bowel.
HP:0410267.definition_cn: 血管瘤，一种位于肠道（包括肠管）内的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤。

HP:0410268.name: Spleen hemangioma
HP:0410268.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the spleen.
HP:0410268.definition_cn: 脾脏血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤，即脾脏血管瘤。

HP:0410269.name: Labial hemangioma
HP:0410269.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the upper lip.
HP:0410269.definition_cn: 位于上唇的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤——血管瘤。

HP:0410270.name: Esophageal hemangioma
HP:0410270.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the esophagus.
HP:0410270.definition_cn: 食管血管瘤，一种位于食管的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤。

HP:0410271.name: Laryngeal hemangioma
HP:0410271.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the glottic or supraglottic regions.
HP:0410271.definition_cn: 血管瘤，一种位于声门或声门上区域的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤。

HP:0410272.name: Vulvar hemangioma
HP:0410272.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the vulva.
HP:0410272.definition_cn: 外阴血管瘤，一种位于外阴的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤。

HP:0410273.name: Retropharyngeal hemangioma
HP:0410273.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the retropharyngeal space, the portion of the peripharyngeal space that is located posterior to the pharynx.
HP:0410273.definition_cn: 咽后间隙血管瘤，一种位于咽后间隙的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤，咽后间隙是咽周间隙中位于咽部后方的部分。

HP:0410274.name: Paraspinal hemangioma
HP:0410274.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the paraspinal muscular region, the muscles next to the spine.
HP:0410274.definition_cn: 血管瘤，一种位于脊柱旁肌区（即脊柱旁肌肉区域）的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤。

HP:0410275.name: Lumbosacral hemangioma
HP:0410275.definition: A spinal cord hemangioma located in the lumbosacral spine region.
HP:0410275.definition_cn: 位于腰骶椎区域的脊髓血管瘤。

HP:0410276.name: Supraumbilical raphe
HP:0410276.definition: An abnormality of the sternum that presents at birth as a ventral sternal non-union defect, due to an abnormality of the fusion of the layers of the skin. It presents as a scar-like line that extends upward from the umbilicus (belly button).
HP:0410276.definition_cn: 一种胸骨异常，表现为出生时存在的腹侧胸骨未融合缺陷，由于皮肤层融合异常所致。表现为一条从脐部（肚脐）向上延伸的瘢痕样线。

HP:0410277.name: Sternal pit
HP:0410277.definition: A sternal pit is a small indentation or dimple in the skin overlying the sternum of the chest. In some cases, the skin defect can be linear, extending several inches over the sternum.
HP:0410277.definition_cn: 胸骨凹陷是指位于胸骨上方皮肤处的小型凹陷或酒窝样结构。在某些情况下，皮肤缺损可呈线性，沿胸骨延伸数英寸。

HP:0410278.name: Pituitary gland cyst
HP:0410278.definition: A fluid-filled sacs that develop on or near the pituitary gland.

HP:0410279.name: Atrophic pituitary gland
HP:0410279.definition: Partial or complete wasting (loss) of the pituitary gland.
HP:0410279.definition_cn: 垂体部分或完全萎缩（丧失）。

HP:0410280.name: Pediatric onset
HP:0410280.definition: Onset of disease manifestations before adulthood, defined here as before the age of 16 years, but excluding neonatal or congenital onset.
HP:0410280.definition_cn: 疾病表现在成年期之前发作，此处定义为16岁之前，但排除新生儿期或先天性发作。

HP:0410281.name: Dyspepsia
HP:0410281.definition: A heterogeneous group of symptoms that are localized in the epigastric region. Typical dyspeptic symptoms include postprandial fullness, early satiation, epigastric pain and epigastric burning, but other upper gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, belching or abdominal bloating often occur.
HP:0410281.definition_cn: 位于上腹部的异质性症状群。典型的消化不良症状包括餐后饱胀、早饱、上腹痛和上腹烧灼感，但其他上消化道症状如恶心、嗳气或腹胀也常发生。

HP:0410282.name: Abnormal circulating amylase concentration
HP:0410282.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of amylase in the blood, an enzyme which helps digest glycogen and starch. It is produced mainly in the pancreas and salivary glands.
HP:0410282.definition_cn: 血液中淀粉酶浓度异常，该酶主要参与糖原和淀粉的消化过程，主要由胰腺和唾液腺分泌。

HP:0410283.name: Positive blood acetaminophen test
HP:0410283.definition: Detection of acetaminophen in the blood.
HP:0410283.name_cn: 血液中对乙酰氨基酚检测阳性
HP:0410283.definition_cn: 血液中对乙酰氨基酚检测。

HP:0410284.name: Positive norpropoxyphene blood test
HP:0410284.definition: Detection of norpropoxyphene in the blood, a major metabolite of the opioid analgesic drug dextropropoxyphene.
HP:0410284.name_cn: 阳性去甲丙氧芬血液检测
HP:0410284.definition_cn: 血液中检测到去甲丙氧芬，其为阿片类镇痛药右丙氧芬的主要代谢产物。

HP:0410285.name: Positive meconium methadone test
HP:0410285.definition: Detection of methadone or its metabolite 2-ethylidene-1,5-dimethyl-3,3- diphenylpyrrolidine (EDDP) in meconium.
HP:0410285.definition_cn: 胎粪中美沙酮或其代谢物2-亚乙基-1,5-二甲基-3,3-二苯基吡咯烷（EDDP）的检测。

HP:0410286.name: Positive blood molindone test
HP:0410286.definition: Detection of molindone in the blood, an antipyschotic used for treatment of schizophrenia.
HP:0410286.name_cn: 血液中莫林酮检测阳性
HP:0410286.definition_cn: 血液中检测到莫林酮，一种用于治疗精神分裂症的抗精神病药物。

HP:0410287.name: Intrathoracic hemangioma
HP:0410287.definition: A hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, that is located in the intrathoracic or chest region.
HP:0410287.definition_cn: 胸腔内或胸部区域的血管内皮细胞良性肿瘤，即血管瘤。

HP:0410288.name: Hyperamylasemia
HP:0410288.definition: Increased level of amylase in the blood, an enzyme which helps digest glycogen and starch. It is produced mainly in the pancreas and salivary glands.
HP:0410288.definition_cn: 血清淀粉酶水平升高，该酶有助于消化糖原和淀粉，主要由胰腺和唾液腺分泌。

HP:0410289.name: Hypoamylasemia
HP:0410289.definition: Decreased level of amylase in the blood, an enzyme which helps digest glycogen and starch. It is produced mainly in the pancreas and salivary glands.
HP:0410289.definition_cn: 血清淀粉酶水平降低。淀粉酶是一种主要由胰腺和唾液腺分泌的酶，其功能是催化糖原和淀粉的消化分解。

HP:0410290.name: Positive urine norpropoxyphene test
HP:0410290.name_cn: 尿液中诺丙氧芬检测阳性
HP:0410290.definition_cn: 尿液中诺丙氧芬的检测。

HP:0410291.name: Negativism
HP:0410291.definition: Opposing or not responding to instructions or external stimuli.
HP:0410291.definition_cn: 违拗或对外界指令及刺激无反应。

HP:0410292.name: Abnormal isohemagglutinin level
HP:0410292.definition: An abnormal level of isohemagglutinin in the blood. An isohemagglutinin refers to the naturally occurring antibodies in the ABO blood group system (i.e., anti-A in a group B person, anti-B in a group A person, and anti-A, anti-B, and anti-A,B in a group O person).
HP:0410292.name_cn: 异常同种血细胞凝集素水平
HP:0410292.definition_cn: 血液中同种血凝素水平异常。同种血凝素是指在ABO血型系统中天然存在的抗体（例如，B型血个体中的抗A抗体，A型血个体中的抗B抗体，以及O型血个体中的抗A、抗B和抗A,B抗体）。

HP:0410293.name: Absent isohemagglutinin level
HP:0410293.definition: Absent or undetectable level of isohemagglutinin. An isohemagglutinin refers to the naturally occurring antibodies in the ABO blood group system (i.e., anti-A in a group B person, anti-B in a group A person, and anti-A, anti-B, and anti-A,B in a group O person).
HP:0410293.definition_cn: 同种血细胞凝集素缺失或无法检测水平。同种血细胞凝集素是指在ABO血型系统中天然存在的抗体（例如，B型血个体中的抗A抗体，A型血个体中的抗B抗体，以及O型血个体中的抗A、抗B和抗A,B抗体）。

HP:0410294.name: Decreased specific antibody response to protein vaccine
HP:0410294.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against proteins in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410294.name_cn: 蛋白质疫苗特异性抗体反应降低
HP:0410294.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后抗体合成能力降低，表现为通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定所检测到的针对疫苗中蛋白质的抗体生成减少。

HP:0410295.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to tetanus vaccine
HP:0410295.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a tetanus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410295.name_cn: 完全或接近完全缺乏对破伤风疫苗的特异性抗体反应
HP:0410295.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后无法合成针对破伤风抗原的抗体，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410296.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to hepatitis B vaccine
HP:0410296.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a hepatisis B antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410296.name_cn: 对乙型肝炎疫苗的特定抗体反应完全或几乎完全缺失
HP:0410296.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后无法合成针对乙型肝炎抗原的抗体，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410297.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to tetanus vaccine
HP:0410297.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a tetanus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410297.name_cn: 破伤风疫苗特异性抗体反应部分缺失
HP:0410297.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后针对破伤风抗原合成抗体的能力降低，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410298.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to hepatitis B vaccine
HP:0410298.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a hepatitis B antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410298.name_cn: 乙型肝炎疫苗特异性抗体反应部分缺失
HP:0410298.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后针对乙型肝炎抗原的抗体合成能力降低，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410299.name: Decreased specific antibody response to polysaccharide vaccine
HP:0410299.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against polysaccharides in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410299.name_cn: 多糖疫苗特异性抗体反应降低
HP:0410299.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后通过抗体滴度测定评估的针对疫苗中多糖的抗体合成能力降低。

HP:0410300.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to unconjugated pneumococcus vaccine
HP:0410300.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a pneumococcus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410300.name_cn: 完全或接近完全缺乏对非结合型肺炎球菌疫苗的特异性抗体反应
HP:0410300.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后无法合成针对肺炎球菌抗原的抗体，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410301.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to unconjugated pneumococcus vaccine
HP:0410301.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a pneumococcus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410301.name_cn: 对非结合型肺炎球菌疫苗的特定抗体反应部分缺失
HP:0410301.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后针对肺炎球菌抗原的抗体合成能力降低，通过疫苗接种后的抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410302.name: Decreased specific antibody response to protein-conjugated polysaccharide vaccine
HP:0410302.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against protein-conjugated polysaccharides in vaccines, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410302.name_cn: 对蛋白质结合多糖疫苗的特异性抗体反应降低
HP:0410302.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后通过抗体滴度测定评估的针对疫苗中蛋白结合多糖的抗体合成能力降低。

HP:0410303.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) vaccine
HP:0410303.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410303.name_cn: 对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）疫苗的特定抗体反应完全或几乎完全缺失
HP:0410303.definition_cn: 无法合成针对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Haemophilus influenzae type b, Hib）抗原的疫苗接种后抗体，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410304.name: Complete or near-complete absence of specific antibody response to meningococcus vaccine
HP:0410304.definition: The inability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a meningococcus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410304.name_cn: 特定抗体对脑膜炎球菌疫苗的完全或接近完全缺失反应
HP:0410304.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后无法合成针对脑膜炎球菌抗原的抗体，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410305.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) vaccine
HP:0410305.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410305.name_cn: 对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）疫苗的特定抗体反应部分缺失
HP:0410305.definition_cn: 接种后针对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）抗原的抗体合成能力降低，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410306.name: Partial absence of specific antibody response to meningococcus vaccine
HP:0410306.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize postvaccination antibodies against a meningococcus antigen, as measured by antibody titer determination following vaccination.
HP:0410306.name_cn: 脑膜炎球菌疫苗特异性抗体反应部分缺失
HP:0410306.definition_cn: 疫苗接种后针对脑膜炎球菌抗原的抗体合成能力降低，通过疫苗接种后抗体滴度测定进行评估。

HP:0410307.name: Positive stool methadone test
HP:0410307.definition: Detection of methadone and its metabolites in the stool.
HP:0410307.definition_cn: 粪便中美沙酮及其代谢物的检测。

HP:0410308.name: Decreased specific antibody response to infection
HP:0410308.definition: A reduced ability to synthesize antibodies against antigens from an infectious agent or pathogen (such as bacteria, viruses, parasites, etc.), as measured by antibody titer determination following infection.
HP:0410308.name_cn: 感染特异性抗体反应降低
HP:0410308.definition_cn: 感染后通过抗体滴度测定评估的针对感染源或病原体（如细菌、病毒、寄生虫等）抗原的抗体合成能力降低。

HP:0410309.name: Alpha-aminoadipic aciduria
HP:0410309.definition: The concentration of alpha-aminoadipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0410309.definition_cn: 尿液中α-氨基己二酸浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限。

HP:0410310.name: Abnormality of neutrophil morphology in CSF
HP:0410310.definition: An abnormal form or size of neutrophils in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0410310.name_cn: 脑脊液中中性粒细胞形态异常
HP:0410310.definition_cn: 脑脊液中中性粒细胞形态或大小异常。

HP:0410311.name: Hyposegmentation of neutrophil nuclei in CSF
HP:0410311.definition: Hyposegmented (hypolobulated) or bilobed neutrophil nuclei in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0410311.name_cn: 脑脊液中中性粒细胞核分叶减少
HP:0410311.definition_cn: 脑脊液中低分叶（低分叶化）或双叶中性粒细胞核。

HP:0410312.name: Hypersegmentation of neutrophil nuclei in CSF
HP:0410312.definition: An excessive division of the lobes of the nucleus of a neutrophil in the cerebrospinal fluid.
HP:0410312.name_cn: 脑脊液中中性粒细胞核过度分叶
HP:0410312.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞核分叶过多在脑脊液中的表现。

HP:0410313.name: Abnormal urinary 1-methylhistidine concentration
HP:0410313.definition: Abnormal concentration of 1-methylhistidine in the urine.
HP:0410313.name_cn: 尿中1-甲基组氨酸浓度异常
HP:0410313.definition_cn: 尿液中1-甲基组氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0410314.name: Decreased urinary 1-methylhistidine
HP:0410314.definition: Decreased concentration of 1-methylhistidine in the urine.
HP:0410314.name_cn: 尿中1-甲基组氨酸水平降低
HP:0410314.definition_cn: 尿液中1-甲基组氨酸浓度降低。

HP:0410315.name: Increased urinary 1-methylhistidine
HP:0410315.definition: Increased concentration of 1-methylhistidine in the urine.
HP:0410315.name_cn: 尿中1-甲基组氨酸水平升高
HP:0410315.definition_cn: 尿液中1-甲基组氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0410316.name: Abnormal urinary 3-methylhistidine level
HP:0410316.definition: Abnormal amount of 3-methylhistidine in the urine.
HP:0410316.name_cn: 尿中3-甲基组氨酸水平异常
HP:0410316.definition_cn: 尿液中3-甲基组氨酸含量异常。

HP:0410317.name: Increased urinary 3-methylhistidine
HP:0410317.definition: Increased concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the urine.
HP:0410317.name_cn: 尿中3-甲基组氨酸水平升高
HP:0410317.definition_cn: 尿液中3-甲基组氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0410318.name: Decreased urinary 3-methylhistidine
HP:0410318.definition: Decreased concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the urine.
HP:0410318.name_cn: 尿3-甲基组氨酸水平降低
HP:0410318.definition_cn: 尿液中3-甲基组氨酸浓度降低。

HP:0410319.name: Alpha-gal allergy
HP:0410319.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against alpha-gal.
HP:0410319.definition_cn: 对α-半乳糖（alpha-gal）的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410320.name: Animal protein allergy
HP:0410320.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against animal proteins.
HP:0410320.definition_cn: 对动物蛋白产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410321.name: Animal dander allergy
HP:0410321.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against animal dander.
HP:0410321.definition_cn: 对动物皮屑产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410322.name: Bacteria allergy
HP:0410322.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against bacteria.
HP:0410322.definition_cn: 对细菌产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410323.name: Drug allergy
HP:0410323.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against drugs.
HP:0410323.definition_cn: 药物不良反应中的免疫性超敏反应。

HP:0410324.name: Dust mite allergy
HP:0410324.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against dust mites.
HP:0410324.definition_cn: 对尘螨的免疫反应表现为超敏反应。

HP:0410326.name: Feather allergy
HP:0410326.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against feathers.
HP:0410326.definition_cn: 对羽毛产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410327.name: Dairy allergy

HP:0410327.definition_cn: 对乳制品产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410328.name: Egg allergy
HP:0410328.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against eggs.
HP:0410328.definition_cn: 对鸡蛋产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410329.name: Gluten allergy

HP:0410330.name: Meat allergen allergy
HP:0410330.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against allergens contained in meat products.
HP:0410330.definition_cn: 对肉制品中所含过敏原产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410331.name: Nut food product allergy
HP:0410331.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against nut food products.
HP:0410331.definition_cn: 对坚果类食品产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410332.name: Plant based food allergy
HP:0410332.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against plant based food allergens.
HP:0410332.definition_cn: 对植物性食物过敏原产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410333.name: Seafood allergy

HP:0410334.name: Fungi allergy
HP:0410334.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against fungus.
HP:0410334.definition_cn: 对真菌的免疫反应表现为超敏反应。

HP:0410335.name: Insect allergy
HP:0410335.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against insects.
HP:0410335.definition_cn: 昆虫引起的超敏反应表现为不良免疫反应。

HP:0410336.name: Venom allergy
HP:0410336.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against insect venom.
HP:0410336.definition_cn: 昆虫毒液引起的超敏反应表现为不良免疫反应。

HP:0410337.name: Parasite allergy
HP:0410337.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against parasites.
HP:0410337.definition_cn: 针对寄生虫的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410338.name: Plant product allergy
HP:0410338.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against plant products.
HP:0410338.definition_cn: 对植物产品产生的不良免疫反应形式的超敏反应。

HP:0410339.name: Insect bite allergy
HP:0410339.definition: Hypersensitivity in form of an adverse immune reaction against insect bites.
HP:0410339.definition_cn: 昆虫叮咬引起的超敏反应表现为不良免疫反应。

HP:0410340.name: Focal epithelial hyperplasia of oral mucosa
HP:0410340.definition: The occurrence of multiple or unique whitish or normal in color small papules or nodules in oral cavity, especially on labial and buccal mucosa, lower lip and tongue, and less often on the upper lip, gingiva and palate.
HP:0410340.name_cn: 口腔黏膜局灶性上皮增生
HP:0410340.definition_cn: 口腔内出现多发性或单一性、颜色呈白色或正常的小丘疹或结节，尤其多见于唇黏膜、颊黏膜、下唇和舌部，较少见于上唇、牙龈和腭部。

HP:0410341.name: Abnormal circulating heparan sulfate level
HP:0410341.definition: An abnormal level of heparan sulfate in the blood.
HP:0410341.name_cn: 异常循环硫酸乙酰肝素水平
HP:0410341.definition_cn: 血液中硫酸乙酰肝素水平异常。

HP:0410342.name: Increased circulating heparan sulfate level
HP:0410342.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of heparan sulfate in the blood.
HP:0410342.name_cn: 循环硫酸乙酰肝素水平升高
HP:0410342.definition_cn: 血液中硫酸乙酰肝素浓度异常升高。

HP:0410343.name: Decreased circulating heparan sulfate level
HP:0410343.definition: An abnormal decrease in the concentration of heparan sulfate in the blood.
HP:0410343.name_cn: 循环硫酸乙酰肝素水平降低
HP:0410343.definition_cn: 血液中硫酸乙酰肝素浓度异常降低。

HP:0410344.name: Shortened O-fucosylated glycan on properdin
HP:0410344.definition: Decreased length of O-fucosylated glycans present on properdin.
HP:0410344.name_cn: 缩短的O-岩藻糖基化糖链在备解素上
HP:0410344.definition_cn: 补体因子P上存在的O-岩藻糖基化聚糖长度减少。

HP:0410345.name: Increased urinary polyhexose
HP:0410345.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of polyhexose in the urine.
HP:0410345.definition_cn: 尿液中多聚己糖浓度异常升高。

HP:0410346.name: Increased urinary galactosylated oligosaccharide
HP:0410346.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of galactosylated oligosaccharides in urine.
HP:0410346.name_cn: 尿中半乳糖基化寡糖增加
HP:0410346.definition_cn: 尿液中半乳糖基化寡糖浓度异常升高。

HP:0410347.name: Increased urinary high-mannose-type oligosaccharide
HP:0410347.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of high-mannose-type oligosaccharides in the urine.
HP:0410347.name_cn: 尿液中高甘露糖型寡糖增加
HP:0410347.definition_cn: 尿液中高甘露糖型寡糖浓度异常升高。

HP:0410348.name: Increased urinary multiantennary sialylated oligosaccharide
HP:0410348.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of multiantennary sialylated oligosaccharides in the urine.
HP:0410348.name_cn: 尿液中多分支唾液酸化寡糖增加
HP:0410348.definition_cn: 尿液中多天线唾液酸化寡糖浓度异常升高。

HP:0410349.definition: An abnormal decrease in glycosyltransferase O-fucosylpeptide 3-beta-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase enzymatic level.

HP:0410350.name: Increased urinary fucosylated oligosaccharide
HP:0410350.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of small fucosylated oligosaccharides in the urine.
HP:0410350.name_cn: 尿中岩藻糖基化寡糖增加
HP:0410350.definition_cn: 尿液中岩藻糖基化寡糖浓度异常升高。

HP:0410351.name: Abnormal complex N-glycan level
