HP:0410351.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上复杂N-聚糖的异常浓度。

HP:0410352.name: Increased complex N-glycan level
HP:0410352.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of complex N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410352.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上复合N-聚糖浓度的异常增加。

HP:0410353.name: Decreased complex N-glycan level
HP:0410353.definition: An abnormal decrease in the concentration of complex N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410353.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上复合N-聚糖浓度异常降低。

HP:0410354.name: Increased sialylated N-glycan level
HP:0410354.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of sialylated N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410354.name_cn: 唾液酸化N-聚糖水平升高
HP:0410354.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上唾液酸化N-聚糖浓度的异常增加。

HP:0410355.name: Decreased sialylated N-glycan level
HP:0410355.definition: An abnormal decrease in the concentration of sialylated N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410355.name_cn: 唾液酸化N-聚糖水平降低
HP:0410355.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上唾液酸化N-聚糖浓度的异常降低。

HP:0410356.name: Abnormal high-mannose N-glycan level
HP:0410356.definition: An abnormal concentration of high-mannose N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410356.name_cn: 异常高甘露糖N-聚糖水平
HP:0410356.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上高甘露糖型N-聚糖的异常浓度。

HP:0410357.name: Increased high-mannose N-glycan level
HP:0410357.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of high-mannose N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410357.name_cn: 高甘露糖型N-聚糖水平升高
HP:0410357.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上高甘露糖型N-聚糖浓度的异常升高。

HP:0410358.name: Decreased high-mannose N-glycan level
HP:0410358.definition: An abnormal decrease in the concentration of high-mannose N-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410358.name_cn: 高甘露糖型N-聚糖水平降低
HP:0410358.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上高甘露糖型N-聚糖浓度异常降低。

HP:0410359.name: Abnormal core 1 O-glycan level
HP:0410359.definition: An abnormal in the concentration of core 1 O-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410359.name_cn: 异常核心1 O-聚糖水平
HP:0410359.definition_cn: 糖蛋白核心1 O-聚糖浓度异常。

HP:0410360.name: Increased core 1 O-glycan level
HP:0410360.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of core 1 O-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410360.name_cn: 核心1 O-聚糖水平升高
HP:0410360.definition_cn: 糖蛋白核心1 O-聚糖浓度异常升高。

HP:0410361.name: Decreased core 1 O-glycan level
HP:0410361.definition: An abnormal decrease in the concentration of core 1 O-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410361.name_cn: 核心1 O-聚糖水平降低
HP:0410361.definition_cn: 糖蛋白核心1 O-聚糖浓度异常降低。

HP:0410362.name: Decreased O-mannosyl glycans on alpha-dystroglycan
HP:0410362.definition: Hypoglycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan with O-mannosyl glycans. Alpha-dystroglycan is a functional target of O-mannosyl glycosylation and functional glycosylation of alpha-DG is essential in its interaction with the extracellular matrix.
HP:0410362.name_cn: α-肌营养不良蛋白聚糖上的O-甘露糖基聚糖减少
HP:0410362.definition_cn: α-肌营养不良聚糖的O-甘露糖基聚糖低糖基化。α-肌营养不良聚糖是O-甘露糖基糖基化的功能靶点，α-DG的功能性糖基化在其与细胞外基质的相互作用中至关重要。

HP:0410363.name: Increased monosialylated core 1 O-glycan level
HP:0410363.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of monosialylated core 1 O-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410363.name_cn: 单唾液酸化核心1 O-聚糖水平升高
HP:0410363.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上单唾液酸化核心1 O-聚糖浓度的异常增加。

HP:0410364.name: Decreased monosialylated core 1 O-glycan level
HP:0410364.definition: An abnormal decrease in the concentration of monosialylated core 1 O-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410364.name_cn: 单唾液酸化核心1 O-聚糖水平降低
HP:0410364.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上单唾液酸化核心1 O-聚糖浓度异常降低。

HP:0410365.name: Increased disialylated core 1 O-glycan level
HP:0410365.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of disialylated core 1 O-glycans on glycoproteins.
HP:0410365.name_cn: 二唾液酸化核心1 O-聚糖水平升高
HP:0410365.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上二唾液酸化核心1 O-聚糖浓度的异常增加。

HP:0410366.name: Increased globoside Gb4 level
HP:0410366.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of globoside Gb4.

HP:0410367.name: Increased hepatitis A virus antibody level
HP:0410367.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin against hepatitis A virus in the blood.
HP:0410367.name_cn: 甲型肝炎病毒抗体水平升高
HP:0410367.definition_cn: 血液中抗甲型肝炎病毒免疫球蛋白水平异常升高。

HP:0410368.name: Increased globoside Gb3 level
HP:0410368.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of glycolipid globoside Gb3.
HP:0410368.definition_cn: 糖脂球苷Gb3浓度异常升高。

HP:0410369.name: Increased hepatitis B virus antibody level
HP:0410369.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin against hepatitis B virus in the blood.
HP:0410369.name_cn: 乙型肝炎病毒抗体水平升高
HP:0410369.definition_cn: 血液中抗乙型肝炎病毒免疫球蛋白水平异常升高。

HP:0410371.name: Increased hepatitis C virus antibody level
HP:0410371.definition: An abnormally increased level of immunoglobulin against hepatitis C virus in the blood.
HP:0410371.name_cn: 丙型肝炎病毒抗体水平升高
HP:0410371.definition_cn: 血液中抗丙型肝炎病毒免疫球蛋白水平异常升高。

HP:0410372.name: Increased Tn-antigen level
HP:0410372.definition: An abnormal increase in the concentration of Tn antigen on glycoproteins.
HP:0410372.definition_cn: 糖蛋白上Tn抗原浓度异常升高。

HP:0410373.name: Abnormal proportion of naive CD4 T cells
HP:0410373.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of naive CD4 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0410373.name_cn: 初始CD4 T细胞比例异常
HP:0410373.definition_cn: 初始CD4 T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0410374.name: Abnormal proportion of naive CD8 T cells
HP:0410374.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of naive CD8 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0410374.name_cn: 初始CD8 T细胞比例异常
HP:0410374.definition_cn: 初始CD8 T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0410375.name: Increased proportion of naive CD4 T cells
HP:0410375.name_cn: 初始CD4 T细胞比例增加

HP:0410376.name: Increased proportion of naive CD8 T cells
HP:0410376.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of naive CD8 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0410376.name_cn: 初始CD8 T细胞比例增加
HP:0410376.definition_cn: 相对于总T细胞数量，初始CD8 T细胞比例异常增高。

HP:0410377.name: Decreased proportion of naive CD8 T cells
HP:0410377.definition: An abnormally reduced proportion of naive CD8 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0410377.name_cn: 初始CD8 T细胞比例降低
HP:0410377.definition_cn: 初始CD8 T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常降低。

HP:0410378.name: Decreased proportion of naive CD4 T cells
HP:0410378.definition: An abnormally reduced proportion of naive CD4 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0410378.name_cn: 初始CD4 T细胞比例降低
HP:0410378.definition_cn: 初始CD4 T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常降低。

HP:0410379.name: Abnormal proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells
HP:0410379.definition: An abnormal proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
HP:0410379.name_cn: CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例异常
HP:0410379.definition_cn: 血液中CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞与总T细胞数量相比存在异常比例。这些细胞具有CD45RO阳性和CD127阳性的表型。该细胞类型还被描述为CD25阴性、CD44高表达和CD122高表达。

HP:0410380.name: Abnormal proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells
HP:0410380.definition: An abnormal proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with memory phenotype is CD45RO and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
HP:0410380.name_cn: CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例异常
HP:0410380.definition_cn: 血液中CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞与总T细胞数量相比比例异常。具有记忆表型的CD8阳性αβ T细胞为CD45RO和CD127阳性。该细胞类型也被描述为CD25阴性、CD44高表达和CD122高表达。

HP:0410381.name: Abnormal proportion of central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410381.definition: An abnormal proportion of central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410381.name_cn: 中央记忆型CD4阳性αβ T细胞比例异常
HP:0410381.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，中央记忆性CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例异常。这些细胞具有CCR7阳性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性及CD25阴性的表型特征。

HP:0410382.name: obsolete Abnormal proportion of effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410382.name_cn: 过时的效应记忆CD4阳性αβ T细胞比例异常

HP:0410383.name: Abnormal proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410383.definition: An abnormal proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410383.name_cn: 效应记忆CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例异常
HP:0410383.definition_cn: 血液中效应记忆CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞与总T细胞数量相比存在异常比例。这些细胞具有CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型。

HP:0410384.name: Abnormal proportion of central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410384.definition: An abnormal proportion of central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410384.name_cn: 中央记忆型CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例异常
HP:0410384.definition_cn: 血液中中央记忆性CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞与总T细胞数量相比存在异常比例。这些细胞具有CCR7阳性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性及CD25阴性的表型特征。

HP:0410385.name: Decreased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells
HP:0410385.definition: Decreased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with memory phenotype is CD45RO and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
HP:0410385.name_cn: CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例降低
HP:0410385.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例降低。具有记忆表型的CD8阳性αβ T细胞为CD45RO和CD127阳性。该细胞类型也被描述为CD25阴性、CD44高表达和CD122高表达。

HP:0410386.name: Decreased proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells
HP:0410386.definition: Decresaed proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
HP:0410386.name_cn: CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例降低
HP:0410386.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例降低。这些细胞具有CD45RO阳性和CD127阳性的表型。该细胞类型也被描述为CD25阴性、CD44高表达和CD122高表达。

HP:0410388.name: Decreased proportion of central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410388.definition: A reduced proportion of central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410388.name_cn: 中央记忆型CD4阳性αβ T细胞比例降低
HP:0410388.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，中央记忆型CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例降低。这些细胞具有CCR7阳性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型特征。
