HP:0410389.definition: A reduced proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta central memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410389.name_cn: 中央记忆型CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例降低
HP:0410389.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性、αβ中央记忆T细胞比例降低。这些细胞表型为CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性及CD25阴性。

HP:0410390.name: Decreased proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410390.definition: A reduced proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta effector memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410390.name_cn: 效应记忆CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例降低
HP:0410390.definition_cn: 与外周血中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性αβ效应记忆T细胞比例降低。这些细胞表型为CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性及CD25阴性。

HP:0410391.name: Increased proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells
HP:0410391.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
HP:0410391.name_cn: CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例增加
HP:0410391.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD4阳性、αβ记忆T细胞比例异常升高。这些细胞具有CD45RO阳性和CD127阳性的表型。该细胞类型也被描述为CD25阴性、CD44高表达和CD122高表达。

HP:0410392.name: Increased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells
HP:0410392.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CD45RO and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
HP:0410392.name_cn: CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例增加
HP:0410392.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例异常升高。这些细胞具有CD45RO和CD127阳性表型。该细胞类型也被描述为CD25阴性、CD44高表达和CD122高表达。

HP:0410393.name: Increased proportion of central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410393.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410393.name_cn: 中央记忆型CD4阳性αβ T细胞比例增加
HP:0410393.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，中央记忆型CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞比例异常升高。这些细胞具有CCR7阳性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型特征。

HP:0410394.name: Increased proportion of effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410394.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410394.name_cn: 效应记忆CD4阳性αβ T细胞比例增加
HP:0410394.definition_cn: 血液中效应记忆CD4阳性αβ记忆T细胞与总T细胞比例异常升高。这些细胞具有CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型。

HP:0410395.name: Increased proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410395.definition: An increased proportion of effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410395.name_cn: 效应记忆CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例增加
HP:0410395.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，效应记忆CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例增加。这些细胞具有CCR7阴性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型。

HP:0410396.name: Increased proportion of central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells
HP:0410396.definition: An increased proportion of central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
HP:0410396.name_cn: 中央记忆型CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例增加
HP:0410396.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，中央记忆型CD8阳性αβ T细胞比例增加。这些细胞具有CCR7阳性、CD127阳性、CD45RA阴性、CD45RO阳性和CD25阴性的表型特征。

HP:0410397.name: Bronchiolectasis
HP:0410397.definition: Saccular dilatation of the terminal bronchioles.
HP:0410397.definition_cn: 终末细支气管囊状扩张。

HP:0410399.name: Positive blood lead test
HP:0410399.definition: Detection of lead in the blood.

HP:0410400.name: Absent sebaceous glands
HP:0410400.definition: Absence of the sebaceous gland, the holocrine gland that secretes sebum into the hair follicles, or in hairless areas into ducts.
HP:0410400.definition_cn: 皮脂腺缺失，即全浆分泌腺无法将皮脂分泌至毛囊，或在无毛区域分泌至导管。

HP:0410401.name: Worse in evening
HP:0410401.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is exacerbated in the evening as compared to the day.
HP:0410401.definition_cn: 适用于相较于白天在傍晚加重的体征或症状。

HP:0430000.name: Abnormal frontal bone morphology
HP:0430000.definition: An abnormality of the frontal bone.

HP:0430002.name: Abnormal lacrimal bone morphology
HP:0430002.definition: An abnormality of the lacrimal bone.

HP:0430003.name: Abnormal palatine bone morphology
HP:0430003.definition: An abnormality of the palatine bone.

HP:0430005.name: Abnormal ethmoid bone morphology
HP:0430005.definition: An abnormality of the ethmoid bone

HP:0430006.name: Ectopic cilia of eyelid
HP:0430006.definition: An eyelash that emerges from the underside (conjunctiva) of the upper or lower eyelid.

HP:0430007.name: Symblepharon
HP:0430007.definition: A partial or complete adhesion of the palpebral conjunctiva of the eyelid to the bulbar conjunctiva of the eyeball.
HP:0430007.definition_cn: 眼睑睑结膜与眼球球结膜部分或完全粘连。

HP:0430008.name: Accessory eyelid
HP:0430008.definition: The presence of more than the normal number of eyelids.

HP:0430010.name: Microblepharia
HP:0430010.definition: Abnormal shortness of the vertical dimensions of the eyelids.
HP:0430010.definition_cn: 眼睑垂直维度异常缩短。

HP:0430011.name: Defect of palpebral conjunctiva
HP:0430011.definition: An abnormality of the palpebral conjunctiva.

HP:0430012.name: Incomplete ossification of palatine bone
HP:0430012.definition: Failure to complete ossification (maturation and calcification) of the palatine bone.
HP:0430012.definition_cn: 腭骨骨化不全（成熟与钙化障碍）。

HP:0430013.name: Absent palatine bone ossification
HP:0430013.definition: Lack of formation of the palatine bone.

HP:0430014.name: Abnormality of musculature of soft palate
HP:0430014.definition: An abnormality of one or more of the five muscles of the soft palate.
HP:0430014.definition_cn: 软腭五块肌肉中一块或多块肌肉的异常。

HP:0430015.name: Abnormal morphology of musculature of pharynx
HP:0430015.definition: An abnormality of any of the muscles of the pharynx.
HP:0430015.name_cn: 咽部肌肉组织形态异常

HP:0430016.name: Abnormality of tensor veli palatini muscle
HP:0430016.definition: An abnormality of the tensor veli palatini muscle

HP:0430017.name: Abnormality of uvular muscle
HP:0430017.definition: An abnormality of the uvular muscle

HP:0430018.name: Abnormality of nasal musculature
HP:0430018.definition: An abnormality of the muscles of the structure of the nose.

HP:0430019.name: Abnormality of muscle of facial expression
HP:0430019.definition: An abnormality of any of the muscles of facial expression, which are innervated by the seventh (VII) cranial nerve and control facial expression.
HP:0430019.definition_cn: 面部表情肌异常，这些肌肉由第七（VII）对颅神经支配，负责控制面部表情。

HP:0430020.name: Abnormality of levator labii superioris alaeque nasi muscle
HP:0430020.definition: An abnormality of the levator labii superioris alaeque nasi muscle.
HP:0430020.name_cn: 上唇提肌及鼻翼肌异常

HP:0430021.name: Abnormal common carotid artery morphology
HP:0430021.definition: An abnormality of the common carotid arteries, which provide the arterial supply to the head and neck and give rise to the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery.
HP:0430021.definition_cn: 颈总动脉异常，其为头颈部提供动脉血供，并分出颈内动脉和颈外动脉。

HP:0430022.name: Abnormality of the sphenoid sinus
HP:0430022.definition: An abnormality of the sphenoid sinus, one of the mucosa-lined, normally air-filled paranasal sinuses of the bones of the skull. The sphenoid sinus is located within the sphenoid bone.
HP:0430022.definition_cn: 蝶窦异常，蝶窦为颅骨内衬黏膜、正常情况下充满空气的副鼻窦之一，位于蝶骨内。

HP:0430023.name: Abnormality of the maxillary sinus
HP:0430023.definition: An abnormality of the maxillary sinus, one of the mucosa-lined, normally air-filled paranasal sinuses of the bones of the skull. The maxillary sinus is located within the skeleton of the midface, lateral to the nasal cavity.
HP:0430023.definition_cn: 上颌窦异常，上颌窦为颅骨中黏膜衬里、正常情况下充满空气的鼻旁窦之一。上颌窦位于中面部骨骼内，鼻腔外侧。

HP:0430024.name: Abnormality of external jugular vein
HP:0430024.definition: An abnormality of an external jugular vein of the neck.

HP:0430025.name: Bilateral facial palsy
HP:0430025.definition: Two-sided or bilateral weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure.
HP:0430025.definition_cn: 双侧或双侧面部表情肌及眼轮匝肌无力。

HP:0430026.name: obsolete Abnormality of the shape of the midface

HP:0430028.name: Hyperplasia of the maxilla
HP:0430028.definition: Abnormally increased dimension of the maxilla, especially relative to the mandible, resulting in a malocclusion or malalignment between the upper and lower teeth or in anterior positioning of the nasal base, increased convexity of the face, increased nasolabial angle, or increased width (transverse dimension of the maxilla.
HP:0430028.definition_cn: 上颌骨异常增大，特别是相对于下颌骨而言，导致上下牙齿之间的错颌或错位，或鼻基底前移、面部凸度增加、鼻唇角增大，或上颌骨宽度（横向尺寸）增加。

HP:0430029.name: Hyperplasia of the premaxilla
HP:0430029.definition: An abnormality of the premaxilla (the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla) causing it to appear relatively large in size compared to the other parts of the maxilla or other facial structures.
HP:0430029.definition_cn: 前颌骨（形成上颌骨前部的胚胎结构）异常，导致其相对于上颌骨其他部分或其他面部结构显得相对较大。

HP:0430030.name: Positive infectious agent test
HP:0430030.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in a specimen positive.
HP:0430030.definition_cn: 任何针对样本中传染性病原体的检测结果呈阳性。

HP:0430031.name: Aqueous humor viral DNA positivity
HP:0430031.definition: The presence of viral DNA (e.g., cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex virus, or varicella zoster virus) in the aqueous humor of the eye.
HP:0430031.definition_cn: 眼房水中存在病毒DNA（例如巨细胞病毒、单纯疱疹病毒或水痘-带状疱疹病毒）。

HP:0430032.name: Electronic cigarette exposure history
HP:0430032.definition: History of use of electronic cigarettes (vaping).
HP:0430032.definition_cn: 电子烟使用史（雾化吸入）。

HP:0430033.name: Gottron sign
HP:0430033.definition: Erythematous macules or patches over extensor surfaces of elbows, knuckles, knees, and ankles.
HP:0430033.definition_cn: 肘部、指节、膝部和踝部伸侧出现红斑性斑疹或斑片。

HP:0430034.name: Hypertension resistant to conventional therapy
HP:0430034.definition: Resistant hypertension is defined as above-goal elevated blood pressure in a patient despite the concurrent use of 3 antihypertensive drug classes, commonly including a long-acting calcium channel blocker, a blocker of the renin-angiotensin system (angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker), and a diuretic.
HP:0430034.definition_cn: 难治性高血压定义为在患者同时使用3种抗高血压药物（通常包括长效钙通道阻滞剂、肾素-血管紧张素系统阻滞剂（血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂或血管紧张素受体阻滞剂）以及利尿剂）的情况下，血压仍高于目标值。

HP:0430035.name: Tibiofibular interosseous membrane calcification
HP:0430035.definition: Deposition of excess calcium in the interosseous membrane of the leg, which extends between the interosseous crests of the tibia and fibula and separates the anterior and posterior muscles of the lower leg.
HP:0430035.definition_cn: 下肢骨间膜中过量钙的沉积，该骨间膜延伸于胫骨和腓骨的骨间嵴之间，并将小腿前肌群和后肌群分隔开。

HP:0430036.name: Supracondylar elbow fracture
HP:0430036.definition: A type of elbow fracture that involves the distal humerus just above the elbow.
HP:0430036.definition_cn: 一种涉及肘关节上方远端肱骨的肘部骨折类型。

HP:0430043.name: Thoracic lordosis
HP:0430043.definition: Thoracic lordosis refers to an abnormal curvature of the thoracic spine in which the thoracic spine displays lordosis (inward curve) instead of the normal kyphosis (outward curve).
HP:0430043.definition_cn: 胸椎前凸是指胸椎异常弯曲，表现为胸椎呈现前凸（向内弯曲）而非正常的后凸（向外弯曲）。

HP:0430044.name: Radiation into left arm
HP:0430044.definition: Refers to pain or discomfort that is perceived to travel from the chest into the left arm.
HP:0430044.definition_cn: 指从胸部放射至左臂的疼痛或不适感。

HP:0430045.name: Radiation into right arm
HP:0430045.definition: Refers to pain or discomfort that is perceived to travel from the chest into the right arm.
HP:0430045.definition_cn: 指从胸部放射至右臂的疼痛或不适感。

HP:0430046.name: Small joint hypermobilty
HP:0430046.definition: The capability that a small joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes. Small joints include metacarpophalangeal joints, proximal interphalangeal joints, \nsecond to fifth metatarsophalangeal joints, and wrists.
HP:0430046.definition_cn: 小关节（或一组关节）在生理轴上被动和/或主动地超出正常范围活动的能力。小关节包括掌指关节、近端指间关节、第二至第五跖趾关节以及腕关节。

HP:0430047.name: Large joint hypermobilty
HP:0430047.definition: The capability that a large joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes. Large joints include shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, and ankles.
HP:0430047.definition_cn: 大关节（或一组关节）在生理轴上被动和/或主动地超越正常范围的运动能力。大关节包括肩关节、肘关节、髋关节、膝关节和踝关节。

HP:0430048.name: Intracranial calcification
HP:0430048.definition: Intracranial calcifications refer to calcifications within the brain parenchyma or vasculature. The five major components of the brain comprise the cerebrum, cerebellum, brain stem, pituitary gland, and hypothalamus.
HP:0430048.definition_cn: 颅内钙化是指脑实质或脑血管系统内的钙化。大脑的五个主要组成部分包括大脑、小脑、脑干、垂体和下丘脑。

HP:0430050.name: Anti-thyroid antibody positivity
HP:0430050.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against one or more components on the thyroid.
HP:0430050.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对甲状腺一个或多个成分的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:0430051.name: Bloodstream pathogen-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430051.definition: Positive serology for a exposure to an infectious agent (i.e., examining serum for the presence of pathogen-specific antibodies).
HP:0430051.name_cn: 血流病原体特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430051.definition_cn: 针对感染性病原体暴露的血清学检测阳性（即检测血清中是否存在病原体特异性抗体）。

HP:0430052.name: Anti-SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus antibody positivity
HP:0430052.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus type 2 (SARS-CoV-2).
HP:0430052.name_cn: 抗严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）抗体阳性
HP:0430052.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型（SARS-CoV-2）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430053.name: Anti-West Nile virus antibody positivity
HP:0430053.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the West Nile virus.
HP:0430053.name_cn: 抗西尼罗病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430053.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对西尼罗病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430054.name: Anti-microfilaria antibody positivity
HP:0430054.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a microfilaria (parasite).
HP:0430054.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对微丝蚴（寄生虫）成分的抗体。

HP:0430055.name: Anti-trypanosoma cruzi antibody positivity
HP:0430055.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of trypanosoma cruzi.
HP:0430055.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对克氏锥虫（Trypanosoma cruzi）组分的抗体。

HP:0430056.name: Anti-chikungunya virus antibody positivity
HP:0430056.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of chikungunya virus.
HP:0430056.name_cn: 抗基孔肯雅病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430056.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对基孔肯雅病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430057.name: Anti-chlamydia psittaci antibody positivity
HP:0430057.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of chlamydia psittaci.
HP:0430057.name_cn: 抗鹦鹉热衣原体抗体阳性
HP:0430057.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对鹦鹉热衣原体（Chlamydia psittaci）某一组分的抗体。

HP:0430058.name: Anti-herpes simplex antibody positivity
HP:0430058.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of herpes simplex.
HP:0430058.name_cn: 抗单纯疱疹病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430058.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对单纯疱疹病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430059.name: Bloodstream virus-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430059.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a virus.
HP:0430059.name_cn: 血流病毒特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430059.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对病毒的抗体。

HP:0430060.name: Bloodstream parasite-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430060.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a parasite.
HP:0430060.name_cn: 血流寄生虫特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430060.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对寄生虫的抗体反应。

HP:0430061.name: Bloodstream antibacterial antibody positivity
HP:0430061.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a bacterium.
HP:0430061.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对细菌的抗体反应。

HP:0430062.name: Anti-Japanese encephalitis virus-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430062.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the Japanese encephalitis virus.
HP:0430062.name_cn: 抗日本脑炎病毒特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430062.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对日本脑炎病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430063.name: Anti-chlamydia trachomatis-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430063.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of chlamydia trachomatis.
HP:0430063.name_cn: 抗沙眼衣原体特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430063.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对沙眼衣原体成分的抗体。

HP:0430064.name: Anti-Epstein-Barr virus-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430064.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the Epstein Barr virus (EBV).
HP:0430064.name_cn: 抗爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430064.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒（EBV）某一组分的抗体。

HP:0430065.name: Anti-babesia-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430065.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a parasite of the genus Babesia (parasite).
HP:0430065.name_cn: 抗巴贝虫特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430065.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对巴贝斯虫属寄生虫（Babesia）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430066.name: Anti-Zikavirus-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430066.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the Zika virus.
HP:0430066.name_cn: 抗寨卡病毒特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430066.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对寨卡病毒（Zika virus）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430067.name: Positive bloodstream nucleic acid pathogen test
HP:0430067.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of a test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen.
HP:0430067.name_cn: 血流核酸病原体检测阳性
HP:0430067.definition_cn: 针对病原体特异性核酸序列的聚合酶链反应（PCR）检测呈阳性（异常）结果。

HP:0430068.name: Positive microfilaria PCR test in the blood circulation
HP:0430068.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of a microfilarial parasite in the blood circulation.
HP:0430068.name_cn: 血液循环中微丝蚴PCR检测阳性
HP:0430068.definition_cn: 检测血液循环中微丝蚴寄生虫的核酸。

HP:0430069.name: Positive JC-virus PCR test in the blood circulation
HP:0430069.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of the JC-virus (JC-Polyomavirus, John Cunningham virus) in the blood circulation.
HP:0430069.definition_cn: 检测血液循环中JC病毒（JC多瘤病毒，约翰·坎宁安病毒）的核酸。

HP:0430070.name: Placenta previa
HP:0430070.definition: Implantation of the placenta over or near the internal os of the cervix.
HP:0430070.definition_cn: 胎盘植入于宫颈内口上方或附近。

HP:0430071.name: Abnormal circulating organic compound concentration
HP:0430071.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of an orrganic compound from the normal range. An organic compound is defined as any compound that contains a carbon atom.
HP:0430071.name_cn: 异常循环有机化合物浓度
HP:0430071.definition_cn: 任何有机化合物浓度偏离正常范围的情况。有机化合物定义为含有碳原子的任何化合物。

HP:0430072.name: Abnormal circulating beta-carotene concentration
HP:0430072.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of beta-carotene in the blood circulation from the normal range.
HP:0430072.name_cn: 异常循环β-胡萝卜素浓度
HP:0430072.definition_cn: 血液循环中β-胡萝卜素浓度偏离正常范围的任何偏差。

HP:0430073.name: Decreased circulating beta-carotene concentration
HP:0430073.definition: The concentration of beta-carotene in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0430073.name_cn: 循环β-胡萝卜素浓度降低
HP:0430073.definition_cn: 血液循环中β-胡萝卜素浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0430074.name: Increased circulating beta-carotene concentration
HP:0430074.definition: The concentration of beta-carotene in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0430074.name_cn: 循环β-胡萝卜素浓度升高
HP:0430074.definition_cn: 血液循环中β-胡萝卜素浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0430075.name: Mammary blocked duct
HP:0430075.definition: Blocked mammary ducts represent an area of localized milk stasis, typically associated with breast engorgement and resulting in a localized tender breast lump or area of blushed color; the breast may feel hot; and there may be a white, painful bleb on the end of the nipple.
HP:0430075.definition_cn: 乳腺导管阻塞表现为局部乳汁淤积，通常与乳房充血相关，导致局部乳房压痛性肿块或发红区域；乳房可能感觉发热；乳头末端可能出现白色、疼痛性水疱。

HP:0430076.name: Bloodstream antifungal antibody positivity
HP:0430076.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a fungus.
HP:0430076.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对真菌的抗体。

HP:0430077.name: Anti-coccidioidal antibody positivity
HP:0430077.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a fungus of the Coccidioides genus.
HP:0430077.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对球孢子菌属真菌成分的抗体。

HP:0430078.name: Anti-cryptococcal antibody positivity
HP:0430078.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a fungus of the Cryptoccous genus.
HP:0430078.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对隐球菌属真菌成分的抗体。

HP:0430079.name: Anti-mycoplasma antibody positivity
HP:0430079.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a mycoplasmal component.
HP:0430079.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对支原体成分的抗体。

HP:0430080.name: Anti-rickettsial antibody positivity
HP:0430080.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a rickettsial bacterium. Rickettsiae are gram-negative bacteria with an obligate intracellular life cycle circulating between mammalian hosts and hematophagous arthropod vectors
HP:0430080.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对立克次体细菌成分的抗体。立克次体为革兰氏阴性菌，具有专性细胞内生命周期，在哺乳动物宿主和吸血节肢动物媒介之间循环传播。

HP:0430081.name: Anti-Bartonella henselae antibody positivity
HP:0430081.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Bartonella.
HP:0430081.name_cn: 抗汉赛巴尔通体抗体阳性
HP:0430081.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对巴尔通体（Bartonella）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430082.name: Anti-Dengue virus antibody positivity
HP:0430082.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Dengue virus.
HP:0430082.name_cn: 抗登革热病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430082.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对登革病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430083.name: Anti-arbovirus antibody positivity
HP:0430083.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of an Arbovirus.
HP:0430083.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对虫媒病毒（Arbovirus）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430084.name: Anti-lymphocytic choriomeningitis antibody positivity
HP:0430084.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV).
HP:0430084.name_cn: 抗淋巴细胞性脉络丛脑膜炎病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430084.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对淋巴细胞性脉络丛脑膜炎病毒（LCMV）成分的抗体。

HP:0430085.name: Anti-varicella-zoster antibody positivity
HP:0430085.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Varicella-zoster virus.
HP:0430085.name_cn: 抗水痘-带状疱疹病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430085.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对水痘-带状疱疹病毒（Varicella-zoster virus）成分的抗体。

HP:0430086.name: Anti-rubella antibody positivity
HP:0430086.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of rubella virus.
HP:0430086.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对风疹病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430087.name: Anti-cytomegalovirus antibody positivity
HP:0430087.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of cytomegalovirus (CMV).
HP:0430087.name_cn: 抗巨细胞病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430087.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对巨细胞病毒（CMV）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430088.name: Anti-measles antibody positivity
HP:0430088.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of measles virus.
HP:0430088.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对麻疹病毒成分的抗体。

HP:0430089.name: Anti-schistosoma antibody positivity
HP:0430089.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a parasite of the genus Schistosomiasis is a parasitic disease historically known as bilharzia caused by the trematode of the genus Schistosoma. Schistosomiasis is a parasitic disease historically known as bilharzia caused by the trematode of the genus Schistosoma.
HP:0430089.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对血吸虫属寄生虫成分的抗体，血吸虫病是一种由血吸虫属吸虫引起的寄生虫病，历史上称为血吸虫病。

HP:0430090.name: Anti-Powassan virus antibody positivity
HP:0430090.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of a Powassan virus (POW), which is an arbovirus within the family of Flaviviruses primarily found in the Northeastern United States, Canada, and Russia. It is a zoonotic infection transmitted to humans by several tick species and is the only member of the tick-borne flaviviruses endemic to North America.
HP:0430090.name_cn: 抗波瓦桑病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430090.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对波瓦桑病毒（Powassan virus, POW）成分的抗体，该病毒属于黄病毒科（Flaviviridae）的虫媒病毒，主要分布于美国东北部、加拿大和俄罗斯。这是一种人畜共患感染，通过多种蜱类传播给人类，并且是北美特有的蜱传黄病毒属（tick-borne flaviviruses）的唯一成员。

HP:0430091.name: Marker expression
HP:0430091.definition: Detection of an marker such as a protein by immunohistochemistry or related investigation techniques. The presence or absence of such markers can be used to identify cell types on the basis of a profile of expressed markers. These terms do not imply abnormality and can be used for any cell type or organ.
HP:0430091.definition_cn: 通过免疫组织化学或相关检测技术检测某种标志物（如蛋白质）。此类标志物的存在与否可用于基于表达标志物谱的细胞类型鉴定。这些术语并不暗示异常，可用于任何细胞类型或器官。

HP:0430092.name: BCL2 expression
HP:0430092.definition: Detection of the presence of BCL2 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-BCL2 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430092.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光团（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗BCL2抗体检测目标细胞中BCL2的存在。

HP:0430093.name: BCL6 expression
HP:0430093.definition: Detection of the presence of BCL6 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-BCL6 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430093.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光团（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗BCL6抗体检测目标细胞中BCL6的存在。

HP:0430094.name: CD5 expression
HP:0430094.definition: Detection of the presence of CD5 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD5 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430094.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD5抗体检测目标细胞上CD5的存在。

HP:0430095.name: CD10 expression
HP:0430095.definition: Detection of the presence of CD10 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD10 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430095.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光团（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD10抗体检测目标细胞上CD10的存在。

HP:0430096.name: CD23 expression
HP:0430096.definition: Detection of the presence of CD23 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD23 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430096.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD23抗体检测目标细胞上CD23的存在。

HP:0430097.name: CD38 expression
HP:0430097.definition: Detection of the presence of CD38 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD38 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430097.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD38抗体检测目标细胞上CD38的存在。

HP:0430098.name: CD45 expression
HP:0430098.definition: Detection of the presence of CD45 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD45 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430098.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD45抗体检测目标细胞上CD45的存在。

HP:0430099.name: Cyclin D1 expression
HP:0430099.definition: Detection of the presence of cyclin D1 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-cyclin D1 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430099.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光团（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗细胞周期蛋白D1抗体检测目标细胞中细胞周期蛋白D1的存在。

HP:0430100.name: FMC7 expression
HP:0430100.definition: Detection of the presence of FMC7 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-FMC7 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430100.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光团（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗FMC7抗体检测目标细胞上FMC7的存在。

HP:0430101.name: CD19 expression
HP:0430101.definition: Detection of the presence of CD19 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD19 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430101.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光素（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD19抗体检测目标细胞上CD19的存在。

HP:0430102.name: CD20 expression
HP:0430102.definition: Detection of the presence of CD20 on the cell(s) of interest with the use of anti-CD20 antibodies conjugated to a chromogen (for immunohistochemistry) or fluorophore (for flow cytometry).
HP:0430102.definition_cn: 使用与色原（用于免疫组织化学）或荧光团（用于流式细胞术）结合的抗CD20抗体检测目标细胞上CD20的存在。

HP:0430103.name: Past surgical history
HP:0430103.definition: information about the patient's previous surgical treatments that might be relevant to the presenting illness or to provide optimal clinical management.
HP:0430103.definition_cn: 与当前疾病相关或有助于提供最佳临床管理的患者既往手术治疗信息。

HP:0430104.name: Abnormal superficial temporal artery morphology
HP:0430104.definition: Any structural abnormality of a superficial temporal artery, originating from the external carotid artery and passing over the zygomatic process. The superficial temporal artery is located on the superficial parts of the forehead and sides of the head and face.
HP:0430104.definition_cn: 颞浅动脉（Superficial Temporal Artery）起源于颈外动脉（External Carotid Artery），经过颧弓（Zygomatic Process）的任何结构异常。颞浅动脉位于额部及头面部两侧的浅表部位。

HP:0430105.name: Skip lesions on temporal artery biopsy
HP:0430105.definition: Patchy inflammation of the superficial temporal artery, forming isolated foci of arteritis.
HP:0430105.name_cn: 颞动脉活检中的跳跃性病变
HP:0430105.definition_cn: 颞浅动脉斑片状炎症，形成孤立性动脉炎病灶。

HP:0430106.name: Abnormal brain-evoked potentials
HP:0430106.definition: Any anomaly of brain-evoked potentials, defined as potentials generated by exteroceptive stimuli reflect synchronized activity by neuronal and axonal groups in the central nervous system (CNS) resulting from the arrival of nerve impulses after stimulation of a peripheral nerve or its receptors. Depending on the type of stimulus, evoked potentials are categorized as visual (VEP), auditory (AEP), or somatosensory (SSEP). Motor evoked potentials (MEP) occur when the brain's motor area is stimulated. They result from the activation of a sufficient number of motor units.
HP:0430106.definition_cn: 任何脑诱发电位的异常，定义为由外感受性刺激产生的电位，反映了中枢神经系统（CNS）中神经元和轴突群的同步活动，这种活动是由于外周神经或其受体受到刺激后神经冲动的到达所引起的。根据刺激类型的不同，诱发电位可分为视觉诱发电位（VEP）、听觉诱发电位（AEP）或体感诱发电位（SSEP）。当大脑运动区受到刺激时，会产生运动诱发电位（MEP），这是由于足够数量的运动单位被激活所致。

HP:0430107.name: Sputum infectious agent
HP:0430107.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the sputum, as characterized by sputum culture or other investigation.
HP:0430107.definition_cn: 痰液中存在病原体，通过痰培养或其他检查进行特征描述。

HP:0430108.name: Positive Mycobacterium avium sputum culture
HP:0430108.definition: Growth of mycobacterium avium in a sputum culture.
HP:0430108.name_cn: 阳性鸟分枝杆菌痰培养
HP:0430108.definition_cn: 痰培养中鸟分枝杆菌的生长。

HP:0430109.name: Positive bloodstream infectious agent antigen test
HP:0430109.definition: A test result demonstrating the presence of an antigen (marker such as a protein against which an antibody reacts) specific to an infectious agent.
HP:0430109.name_cn: 血流感染病原体抗原检测阳性
HP:0430109.definition_cn: 检测结果显示存在特定于感染性病原体的抗原（标记物，如抗体反应的蛋白质）。

HP:0430110.name: Positive bloodstream Cysticercosis antigen test
HP:0430110.definition: Demonstration of an antigen specific to Cysticercosis in the bloodstream.
HP:0430110.name_cn: 血液囊虫病抗原检测阳性
HP:0430110.definition_cn: 在血液中检测到囊尾蚴病特异性抗原。

HP:0430111.name: Klazomania
HP:0430111.definition: Involuntary attacks of compulsive paroxysmal shouting. The shouting behaviors may be extremely loud and not related to the ongoing mental state of the affected individual. Shouting episodes may occur in bouts and last for several hours.
HP:0430111.definition_cn: 不自主的强迫性阵发性喊叫发作。喊叫行为可能极为响亮，且与患者当前的精神状态无关。喊叫发作可能呈阵发性，持续数小时。

HP:0430112.name: Coprolalia
HP:0430112.definition: Coprolalia denotes the involuntary utterance of obscenities. Intent is an important classifier in coprolalic behaviors, and unfortunately it remains unclear how to objectively distinguish coprolalia from common swearing.
HP:0430112.definition_cn: 秽语症（Coprolalia）是指不由自主地发出污言秽语。在秽语行为中，意图是一个重要的分类标准，然而遗憾的是，目前尚不清楚如何客观地区分秽语症与普通的咒骂行为。

HP:0430113.name: Continuous involuntary vocalizations
HP:0430113.definition: Continuous groaning, moaning, grunting, and shrieking.
HP:0430113.definition_cn: 持续性呻吟、呜咽、咕哝及尖叫。

HP:0430114.name: Aplasia/hypoplasia of the uterine cervix
HP:0430114.definition: Congenital absence or underdevelopment of the uterine cervix.
HP:0430114.name_cn: 子宫颈发育不全/子宫颈发育不良
HP:0430114.definition_cn: 先天性宫颈缺失或发育不全。

HP:0430116.name: Primary peritoneal serous papillary adenocarcinoma
HP:0430116.definition: A serous papillary adenocarcinoma that arises from the lining of the peritoneum
HP:0430116.name_cn: 原发性腹膜浆液性乳头状腺癌
HP:0430116.definition_cn: 源自腹膜内衬的浆液性乳头状腺癌

HP:0430117.name: Positive skin infectious agent test
HP:0430117.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in skin positive.
HP:0430117.definition_cn: 皮肤样本中任何类型的感染性病原体检测呈阳性。

HP:0430118.name: Positive skin fungus test
HP:0430118.definition: A test for fungus, e.g., fungal hyphae, in a skin specimen (usually a skin scraping), demonstrates the presence of fungi. Most commonly, a skin scraping is obtained using a small scalpel blade, the specimen is placed on a clean glass slide, a drop of potassium hydroxide (KOH) is added, and the specimen is examined microscopically for fungal structures such as hyphae or yeast.
HP:0430118.definition_cn: 皮肤标本（通常为皮肤刮取物）的真菌检测，例如真菌菌丝，可证实真菌的存在。最常见的操作方法是使用小型手术刀片获取皮肤刮取物，将标本置于洁净的载玻片上，滴加一滴氢氧化钾（KOH）溶液，然后在显微镜下观察是否存在菌丝或酵母等真菌结构。

HP:0430119.name: Nasal secretion eosinophilia
HP:0430119.definition: Count of eosinophils in nasal secretions (for instance, nasal discharge) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0430119.name_cn: 鼻分泌物嗜酸性粒细胞增多症
HP:0430119.definition_cn: 鼻分泌物（例如，鼻腔分泌物）中嗜酸性粒细胞计数高于正常上限。

HP:0430120.name: Nasal secretion neutrophilia
HP:0430120.definition: Count of neutrophils in nasal secretions (for instance, nasal discharge) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0430120.name_cn: 鼻腔分泌物中性粒细胞增多症
HP:0430120.definition_cn: 鼻腔分泌物（例如，鼻分泌物）中中性粒细胞计数高于正常上限。

HP:0430121.name: Seminal vesicle agenesis
HP:0430121.definition: A developmental defect characterized by congenital absence of the seminal vesicle.

HP:0430122.name: Head impulse test has corrective saccade
HP:0430122.definition: In a patient with nystagmus, The examiner briskly rotates the head of the patient while having the patient fixate on a target. A corrective saccade indicates the patient's eye will move in one direction and quickly return back to neutral position.
HP:0430122.name_cn: 头脉冲试验出现纠正性扫视
HP:0430122.definition_cn: 在眼球震颤患者中，检查者迅速旋转患者头部，同时让患者注视一个目标。矫正性扫视表明患者的眼睛会向一个方向移动，并迅速返回中立位置。

HP:0430123.name: Positive CSF infectious agent test
HP:0430123.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) positive.
HP:0430123.name_cn: 脑脊液病原体检测阳性
HP:0430123.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中任何病原体的检测结果呈阳性。

HP:0430124.name: Positive CSF toxoplasma gondii nucleic acid test
HP:0430124.definition: Detection of Toxoplasma gondii nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:0430124.name_cn: 脑脊液弓形虫核酸检测阳性
HP:0430124.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的弓形虫（Toxoplasma gondii）核酸。

HP:0430125.name: Elevated circulating plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
HP:0430125.definition: The activity or concentration of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0430125.name_cn: 循环纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1活性升高
HP:0430125.definition_cn: 循环血液中纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂-1的活性或浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0430126.name: Abnormal circulating plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
HP:0430126.definition: The activity or concentration of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of the normal range.
HP:0430126.name_cn: 异常循环纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂1活性
HP:0430126.definition_cn: 循环血液中纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂-1的活性或浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0430127.name: Brain localization
HP:0430127.definition: The pattern by which a phenotype is localized to or predominant in a part of the brain.
HP:0430127.definition_cn: 表型在大脑某一部分的定位或优势分布模式。

HP:0430128.name: Frontal cortical localization
HP:0430128.definition: Localization to or predominance in the frontal cortex of the brain.
HP:0430128.definition_cn: 定位于或主要位于大脑额叶皮层。

HP:0430129.name: Posterior fossa localization
HP:0430129.definition: Localization to or predominance in the parts of the brain within the posterior fossa.
HP:0430129.definition_cn: 后颅窝内脑部结构的定位或优势分布。

HP:0430130.name: Subcortical localization
HP:0430130.definition: Localization to or predominance in the subcortical region of the brain.
HP:0430130.definition_cn: 定位于或主要位于大脑皮质下区域。

HP:0430131.name: Parietal cortex localization
HP:0430131.definition: Localization to or predominance in the parietal cortex of the brain.
HP:0430131.definition_cn: 定位于或主要位于大脑顶叶皮层。

HP:0430132.name: Occipital cortex localization
HP:0430132.definition: Localization to or predominance in the occipital cortex of the brain.
HP:0430132.definition_cn: 定位于或主要位于大脑枕叶皮层。

HP:0430133.name: Tobacco use history
HP:0430133.definition: History of use of tobacco products such as cigarettes.
HP:0430133.definition_cn: 有吸烟史，使用烟草制品如香烟。

HP:0430134.name: Bartholin cyst
HP:0430134.definition: A fluid-filled sac near the vaginal opening. A Bartholin cyst is usually unilateral, asymptomatic blockage of the Bartholin gland, which may lead to a painless swelling.
HP:0430134.definition_cn: 阴道口附近的液性囊性病变。巴氏腺囊肿通常为单侧、无症状的巴氏腺导管阻塞，可能导致无痛性肿胀。

HP:0430135.name: Abnormal circulating hepatic transaminase concentration
HP:0430135.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of alanine aminotransferase or aspartate aminotransferase.
HP:0430135.name_cn: 异常循环肝转氨酶浓度
HP:0430135.definition_cn: 血液循环中丙氨酸氨基转移酶或天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0430136.name: Reduced circulating aspartate aminotransferase concentration
HP:0430136.definition: The concentration of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0430136.name_cn: 循环中天冬氨酸氨基转移酶浓度降低
HP:0430136.definition_cn: 循环血液中天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0430137.name: Elevated urine succinic acid level
HP:0430137.definition: The concentration of succinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0430137.definition_cn: 尿液中琥珀酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:0430138.name: Positive CSF varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test
HP:0430138.definition: Detection of Varicella zoster virus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:0430138.name_cn: 脑脊液水痘-带状疱疹病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:0430138.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的水痘-带状疱疹病毒（Varicella zoster virus, VZV）核酸。

HP:0430139.name: CSF pathogen-specific antibody positivity
HP:0430139.definition: Positive serology in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) for a exposure to an infectious agent (i.e., examining CSF for the presence of pathogen-specific antibodies).
HP:0430139.name_cn: 脑脊液病原体特异性抗体阳性
HP:0430139.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中针对感染性病原体的血清学检测呈阳性（即检测脑脊液中是否存在病原体特异性抗体）。

HP:0430140.name: Positive CSF nucleic acid pathogen test
HP:0430140.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen.
HP:0430140.name_cn: 脑脊液病原体核酸检测阳性
HP:0430140.definition_cn: 针对病原体特异性核酸序列的脑脊液（CSF）检测（如聚合酶链反应）呈阳性（异常）结果。

HP:0430141.name: CSF varicella zoster antibody positivity
HP:0430141.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of varicella zoster virus.
HP:0430141.name_cn: 脑脊液水痘-带状疱疹病毒抗体阳性
HP:0430141.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对水痘-带状疱疹病毒（Varicella Zoster Virus, VZV）某一成分的抗体。

HP:0430142.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 6 concentration
HP:0430142.definition: The concentration of interleukin-6 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:0430142.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素6浓度降低
HP:0430142.definition_cn: 循环血液中白细胞介素-6浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:0430143.name: Elevated circulating C12 acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0430143.definition: Concentration of C12 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C12 acylcarnitines have a twelve-carbon acyl chain.
HP:0430143.name_cn: 循环中C12酰基肉碱浓度升高
HP:0430143.definition_cn: 血液中C12酰基肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。C12酰基肉碱具有十二碳酰基链。

HP:0430144.name: Frontalis muscle overactivity
HP:0430144.definition: Increased activity of the frontalis muscle, causing a characteristic staring and astonished facial expression.
HP:0430144.definition_cn: 额肌活动增强，导致特征性的凝视和惊讶面部表情。

HP:0430145.name: Nasal dermoid cyst
HP:0430145.definition: An ectodermal inclusion cyst containing skin and skin appendages; sebaceous glands, hair follicles, and occasionally sweat glands.
HP:0430145.definition_cn: 一种包含皮肤及其附属器的外胚层包涵囊肿；皮脂腺、毛囊，偶尔还有汗腺。

HP:0430146.name: Elevated circulating complement C3 concentration
HP:0430146.definition: Concentration of the complement component C3 in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0430146.definition_cn: 血清补体成分C3浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0430147.name: Abnormal circulating inhibin B concentration
HP:0430147.definition: The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0430147.definition_cn: 循环血液中抑制素B浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0430148.name: Abnormal circulating lipoprotein(a) concentration
HP:0430148.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein(a) in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.
HP:0430148.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂蛋白(a)的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0430150.name: Positive blood infectious agent test
HP:0430150.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the blood circulation positive.
HP:0430150.definition_cn: 任何针对血液循环中病原体的检测呈阳性。

HP:0430151.name: Positive respiratory tract infectious agent test
HP:0430151.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the respiratory tract positive.
HP:0430151.name_cn: 呼吸道感染病原体检测阳性
HP:0430151.definition_cn: 呼吸道病原体检测呈阳性。

HP:0500001.name: Body odor
HP:0500001.definition: A perceived unpleasant smell given off by the body.

HP:0500005.name: Anal pain
HP:0500005.definition: Pain in and around the anus or rectum (perianal region).
HP:0500005.definition_cn: 肛门及直肠周围区域（肛周区域）疼痛。

HP:0500007.name: Iris flocculi
HP:0500007.definition: Multiple cysts along the pupillary margin that appear as spherical or tear-drop-shaped pigmented lesions or wrinkled masses emerging from the pupillary border of the iris.
HP:0500007.definition_cn: 沿瞳孔缘分布的多个囊肿，表现为球形或泪滴状色素性病变或从虹膜瞳孔缘突出的皱褶状肿块。

HP:0500008.name: Cornea verticillata
HP:0500008.definition: Golden brown or gray deposits with a clockwise, whorl-like distribution in the inferior interpalpebal portion of the cornea.
HP:0500008.definition_cn: 角膜下方睑裂区呈现金黄色或灰色沉积物，呈顺时针涡状分布。

HP:0500009.name: Dysplastic gangliocytoma of the cerebellum
HP:0500009.definition: It is a rare, slowly growing tumor of the cerebellum, a gangliocytoma sometimes considered to be a hamartoma, characterized by diffuse hypertrophy of the granular layer of the cerebellum.
HP:0500009.name_cn: 小脑发育不良性神经节细胞瘤
HP:0500009.definition_cn: 这是一种罕见的小脑缓慢生长的肿瘤，即神经节细胞瘤，有时被认为是错构瘤，其特征为小脑颗粒层弥漫性肥大。

HP:0500011.name: Moon facies
HP:0500011.definition: A rounded, puffy face with fat deposits in the temporal fossa and cheeks, a double chin.
HP:0500011.definition_cn: 圆形、浮肿的面容，伴有颞窝及颊部脂肪沉积，双下巴。

HP:0500012.name: Abnormal gonadotropin-releasing hormone concentration
HP:0500012.definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of the normal gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH). Intermittent GnRH secretion from the hypothalamus acts upon its receptor in the anterior pituitary to regulate the production and release of the gonadotropins, follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH).
HP:0500012.name_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素浓度异常
HP:0500012.definition_cn: 正常循环浓度的促性腺激素释放激素（GnRH）的偏离。下丘脑间歇性分泌的GnRH作用于其在前垂体的受体，以调节促性腺激素、卵泡刺激素（FSH）和黄体生成素（LH）的产生和释放。

HP:0500013.name: Lack of gonadotropin-releasing hormone pulsatility
HP:0500013.definition: Secretion of gonadotropin-releasing hormone that does not occur in a pulsatile fashion.
HP:0500013.name_cn: 促性腺激素释放激素脉冲分泌缺乏
HP:0500013.definition_cn: 非脉冲式促性腺激素释放激素分泌异常。

HP:0500015.name: Abnormal cardiac test
HP:0500015.definition: Abnormal test result of cardiovascular physiology.
HP:0500015.definition_cn: 心血管生理学检测结果异常。

HP:0500016.name: Abnormal cardiac MRI
HP:0500016.definition: Abnormal results of a MRI for the heart.
HP:0500016.definition_cn: 心脏磁共振成像（MRI）异常结果。

HP:0500017.name: Abnormal cardiac catheterization
HP:0500017.definition: Abnormal results from the diagnostic tests resulting from cardiac catheterization.
HP:0500017.definition_cn: 心导管检查诊断测试结果异常。

HP:0500018.name: Abnormal cardiac exercise stress test
HP:0500018.definition: Abnormal results of exercise on heart function.
HP:0500018.name_cn: 异常心脏运动负荷试验
HP:0500018.definition_cn: 心脏功能运动试验异常结果。

HP:0500019.name: Abnormal resting energy expenditure from metabolic cart test
HP:0500019.definition: Resting energy expenditure (REE) can be measured with indirect calorimetry using a metabolic cart, which is used to measure the oxygen consumption (VO2) and carbon dioxide production (VCO2).
HP:0500019.name_cn: 代谢车测试显示静息能量消耗异常
HP:0500019.definition_cn: 静息能量消耗（Resting Energy Expenditure, REE）可通过间接测热法使用代谢车进行测量，代谢车用于测量氧耗量（VO2）和二氧化碳产生量（VCO2）。

HP:0500020.name: Abnormal cardiac biomarker test
HP:0500020.definition: Abnormal blood test results measuring creatine kinase (CK), CK-MB, troponin (TROPI), myoglobin, and/or cardiac enzymes.
HP:0500020.name_cn: 心脏生物标志物检测异常
HP:0500020.definition_cn: 检测肌酸激酶（CK）、肌酸激酶同工酶MB（CK-MB）、肌钙蛋白（TROPI）、肌红蛋白和/或心肌酶谱的血液检查结果异常。

HP:0500021.name: Reduced brain gamma-aminobutyric acid level by MRS
HP:0500021.definition: An decreased level of gamma-aminobutyric acid in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:0500021.name_cn: 磁共振波谱显示脑内γ-氨基丁酸水平降低
HP:0500021.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（MRS）检测到脑内γ-氨基丁酸水平降低。

HP:0500022.name: Abnormal circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
HP:0500022.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone in the circulation.
HP:0500022.name_cn: 异常循环脱氢表雄酮浓度
HP:0500022.definition_cn: 循环中脱氢表雄酮浓度偏离正常值。

HP:0500024.name: Aplasia of the musculature of the pelvis
HP:0500024.definition: Absence of the musculature of the pelvis.
HP:0500024.name_cn: 骨盆肌肉组织发育不全

HP:0500026.name: Hypoplasia of the musculature of the pelvis
HP:0500026.definition: Underdevelopment of the musculature of the pelvis.

HP:0500028.name: Cotton wool plaques
HP:0500028.definition: Deposition of large, diffuse cotton wool amyloid plaques (CWPs) lacking a dense core and associated neuritic changes.
HP:0500028.definition_cn: 大量弥散性棉絮样淀粉样斑块（CWPs）沉积，缺乏致密核心，并伴有神经突改变。

HP:0500030.name: Abnormal hepatic glycogen storage
HP:0500030.definition: Change in normal glycogen storage content.
HP:0500030.definition_cn: 正常糖原储存含量的改变。

HP:0500031.name: Sclerosis of the carpal bones
HP:0500031.definition: An elevation in bone density in one or more carpal bones of the hand.
HP:0500031.definition_cn: 手部一个或多个腕骨骨密度增高。

HP:0500032.name: Abnormal neuron branching
HP:0500032.definition: Abnormality of the structure and branching of the dendrites of a neuron.
HP:0500032.definition_cn: 神经元树突结构和分支异常。

HP:0500033.name: Abnormal natural killer subset distribution
HP:0500033.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion natural killer subsets relative to the total number of natural killer cells.
HP:0500033.name_cn: 异常自然杀伤细胞亚群分布
HP:0500033.definition_cn: 自然杀伤细胞亚群相对于自然杀伤细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0500035.name: Nasolacrimal sac granuloma
HP:0500035.definition: A mass of granulation tissue in response to chronic dacryocystitis as polypoid formations or they follow accidental injury, from probing and as a reaction to retained foreign bodies in the sac.
HP:0500035.definition_cn: 慢性泪囊炎引起的肉芽组织增生可形成息肉样病变，或继发于意外损伤、探通术以及泪囊内异物滞留后的反应。

HP:0500036.name: Nasolacrimal sac papilloma
HP:0500036.definition: Benign tumor of the nasolacrimal sac.

HP:0500037.name: Nasolacrimal sac epithelial papillary carcinoma
HP:0500037.definition: The malignant epithelial neoplasm with papillary growths in the nasolacrimal sac.
HP:0500037.definition_cn: 鼻泪囊内恶性上皮性肿瘤伴乳头状生长。

HP:0500039.name: Conjunctival cicatrization
HP:0500039.definition: An abnormality of the conjuctiva and ocular surface caused by conjunctival inflammation and associated with scarring.
HP:0500039.definition_cn: 由结膜炎症引起的结膜和眼表异常，并伴有瘢痕形成。

HP:0500040.name: Dermolipoma of the conjunctiva
HP:0500040.definition: A benign tumor composed of adipose tissue and dense connective tissue usually located near the temporal fornix.
HP:0500040.definition_cn: 一种由脂肪组织和致密结缔组织组成的良性肿瘤，通常位于颞穹窿附近。

HP:0500041.name: Myopic astigmatism
HP:0500041.definition: A condition where one or both of the two principal meridians focus in the front of the retina when the eye is at rest.
HP:0500041.definition_cn: 一种眼屈光不正状态，当眼睛处于静止状态时，两个主要子午线中的一个或两个聚焦在视网膜前方。

HP:0500042.name: Latent hypermetropia
HP:0500042.definition: A term to describe when farsightedness is masked when the accommodative muscles are used to increase the focusing power of the eye.

HP:0500043.name: Eyelid retraction
HP:0500043.definition: With the eyes in primary position, the sclera is visible above the superior corneal limbus.
HP:0500043.definition_cn: 在眼球处于原在位时，巩膜在上方角膜缘上方可见。

HP:0500044.name: Upper eyelid retraction
HP:0500044.definition: An elevation of the eyelid above the normal level in the primary position.

HP:0500045.name: Collier's sign
HP:0500045.definition: A unilateral or bilateral eyelid retraction due to midbrain lesions.
HP:0500045.definition_cn: 中脑病变导致的单侧或双侧眼睑退缩。

HP:0500046.name: Seborrhoeic blepharitis
HP:0500046.definition: Inflammation of the eyelid due to overactivity of the sebaceous gland.
HP:0500046.definition_cn: 睑板腺功能亢进引起的睑缘炎。

HP:0500047.name: Nasolacrimal sac lymphoma
HP:0500047.definition: A type of lymphoma that involves the nasolacrimal sac.
HP:0500047.definition_cn: 一种累及鼻泪囊的淋巴瘤。

HP:0500048.name: Delayed canalization of nasolacrimal duct
HP:0500048.definition: A very common condition in which the extreme end of the nasolacrimal duct underneath the inferior turbinate fails to complete its canalization in the newborn period.
HP:0500048.definition_cn: 一种非常常见的疾病，即新生儿期下鼻甲下方的鼻泪管末端未能完成其管道化。

HP:0500049.name: Retinopathy of prematurity
HP:0500049.definition: An avascular or abnormally vascularized retina that occurs in premature infants and can lead to blindness.
HP:0500049.definition_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变（Retinopathy of Prematurity, ROP）是一种发生在早产儿中的视网膜血管发育异常或血管化不足的疾病，可能导致失明。

HP:0500050.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 1
HP:0500050.definition: The retinal vessels stop and then a linear flat white line is present that usually runs the circumference of the vascular retina.
HP:0500050.definition_cn: 视网膜血管终止，随后出现一条通常沿血管化视网膜周缘延伸的线性平坦白线。

HP:0500051.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 2
HP:0500051.definition: The accumulating neovascularization thickens and manifests as a linear bump. The neovascularization remains along the surface of the retina and does not extend off the retina into the cortical vitreous.
HP:0500051.definition_cn: 新生血管的积聚导致增厚，并表现为线性隆起。新生血管仍沿视网膜表面分布，并未延伸至视网膜外的玻璃体皮质。

HP:0500052.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 3
HP:0500052.definition: The neovascularization accumulates at the edge of the vascularized retina and extends into the vitreous (also called extra retinal fibrosis proliferation). In cases of Zone 2 and Zone 3, this may be sausage shaped. In more posterior Zone 1 disease, the stage 3 can appear as a direct extension of the normal retinal vessels but extending tangentially over the avascular retina.
HP:0500052.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变第三期
HP:0500052.definition_cn: 新生血管在血管化视网膜边缘积聚并向玻璃体内延伸（也称为视网膜外纤维化增殖）。在2区和3区病例中，新生血管可能呈香肠状。在更靠后的1区病变中，第3期可表现为正常视网膜血管的直接延伸，但呈切线方向延伸至无血管视网膜上方。

HP:0500053.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4
HP:0500053.definition: Scar tissue that forms a continuous sheet coming up from the edge of the vascularized retina. This scar tissue can grow toward the vitreous base/posterior lens capsule resulting in traction, distortion, and even detachment.
HP:0500053.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变第四期
HP:0500053.definition_cn: 从血管化视网膜边缘形成的连续性瘢痕组织。该瘢痕组织可向玻璃体基底部/后囊膜方向生长，导致牵引、变形甚至脱离。

HP:0500054.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4a
HP:0500054.definition: A detachment that involves the peripheral retina that does not extend into the macula.
HP:0500054.definition_cn: 一种涉及周边视网膜的脱离，未延伸至黄斑区。

HP:0500055.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4b
HP:0500055.definition: A detachment that involves the peripheral retina that involves the macula itself. The detachment usually starts in the temporal periphery although can also involve the nasal retina as well.
HP:0500055.definition_cn: 涉及周边视网膜的脱离，累及黄斑本身。脱离通常始于颞侧周边，但也可能累及鼻侧视网膜。

HP:0500056.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5
HP:0500056.definition: Funnel detachment from the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.
HP:0500056.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变第五期
HP:0500056.definition_cn: 视网膜漏斗状脱离，伴四个象限普遍牵拉。

HP:0500057.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5a
HP:0500057.definition: An open funnel detachment of the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.
HP:0500057.definition_cn: 视网膜开放性漏斗状脱离，通常伴有四个象限的牵拉。

HP:0500058.name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5b
HP:0500058.definition: A closed funnel detachment of the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.
HP:0500058.definition_cn: 视网膜闭合漏斗状脱离，伴四个象限普遍牵拉。

HP:0500059.name: Retinopathy of prematurity zone I
HP:0500059.definition: Retinopathy which extends from the center of the optic disc to twice the distance from the center of the optic disc to the center of the macula.
HP:0500059.definition_cn: 从视盘中心延伸至视盘中心至黄斑中心距离两倍范围的视网膜病变。

HP:0500060.name: Retinopathy of prematurity zone II
HP:0500060.definition: Retinopathy which extends centrifugally from the edge of zone I to the nasal ora serrata.
HP:0500060.definition_cn: 从Ⅰ区边缘向鼻侧锯齿缘离心性扩展的视网膜病变。

HP:0500061.name: Retinopathy of prematurity zone III
HP:0500061.definition: Retinopathy which is a residual crescent of retina anterior to zone II.
HP:0500061.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变第三区
HP:0500061.definition_cn: 视网膜病变，表现为视网膜前残留的新月形病变，位于II区前方。

HP:0500062.name: Retinopathy of prematurity plus
HP:0500062.definition: Venous dilatation and arteriolar tortuosity of the posterior retinal vessels and may later increase in severity to include iris vascular engorgement, poor pupillary dilatation (rigid pupil), and vitreous haze. This definition has been further refined in the later clinical trials in which the diagnosis of plus disease could be made if sufficient vascular dilatation and tortuosity are present in at least 2 quadrants of the eye.
HP:0500062.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变附加症
HP:0500062.definition_cn: 视网膜后部血管的静脉扩张和小动脉迂曲，后期可能加重，包括虹膜血管充血、瞳孔扩张不良（瞳孔僵硬）和玻璃体混浊。在后期的临床试验中，该定义进一步细化，若至少2个象限的血管扩张和迂曲达到足够程度，即可诊断为附加病变（plus disease）。

HP:0500063.name: Retinopathy of prematurity pre-plus
HP:0500063.definition: As vascular abnormalities of the posterior pole that are insufficient for the diagnosis of plus disease but that demonstrate more arterial tortuosity and more venous dilatation than normal.
HP:0500063.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变前加期
HP:0500063.definition_cn: 后极部血管异常，不足以诊断为附加病变，但表现出较正常更多的动脉迂曲和静脉扩张。

HP:0500064.name: Retinopathy of prematurity threshold
HP:0500064.definition: A retinopathy with a 50% likelihood of progressing to retinal detachment. Threshold disease is considered to be present when stage 3 retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) is present in either zone I or zone II, with at least 5 continuous or 8 total clock hours of disease, and the presence of plus disease.
HP:0500064.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变阈值期
HP:0500064.definition_cn: 一种具有50%进展为视网膜脱离风险的视网膜病变。当早产儿视网膜病变（ROP）处于第3期，且病变位于I区或II区，至少连续5个或总计8个钟点范围，并伴有附加病变时，可认为存在阈值病变。

HP:0500065.name: Retinopathy of prematurity prethreshold
HP:0500065.definition: High risk patients who were in Zone 1 (no Plus or stage 3) or Zone 2 with Plus or stage 3 but not both.
HP:0500065.name_cn: 早产儿视网膜病变阈值前期
HP:0500065.definition_cn: 处于区域1（无Plus或3期）或区域2（有Plus或3期但不同时具备）的高危患者。

HP:0500066.name: Latent myopia
HP:0500066.definition: The difference between total and manifest myopia.
HP:0500066.definition_cn: 总近视与显性近视的区别。

HP:0500069.name: Paralytic ectropion
HP:0500069.definition: A type of ectropion associated with orbicularis muscle weakness caused by cranial nerve VII palsy.
HP:0500069.definition_cn: 一种与由颅神经VII麻痹引起的眼轮匝肌无力相关的睑外翻。

HP:0500070.name: Conjunctival dermolipoma
HP:0500070.definition: A conjuctival lesion composed of adipose tissue and dense connective tissue. Such choristomas of dermal elements are normally found at the outer canthus, and have a gelatinous appearance. Classically, there is an indistinct posterior border (with the lesion frequently extending into the orbit) and a well-demarcated anterior border several millimeters posterior to the limbus.
HP:0500070.definition_cn: 由脂肪组织和致密结缔组织构成的结膜病变。此类皮肤成分的迷芽瘤通常位于外眦，呈胶状外观。典型表现为后缘模糊（病变常延伸至眼眶内），前缘清晰，位于角膜缘后数毫米处。

HP:0500072.name: Absolute eccentric fixation
HP:0500072.definition: Eccentric fixation in which the angle of eccentricity equals the objective angle of deviation.
HP:0500072.definition_cn: 偏心注视，其中偏心角等于客观偏斜角。

HP:0500073.name: Abnormal ocular alignment
HP:0500073.definition: Any deviation from the normal ocular alignment.
HP:0500073.definition_cn: 任何偏离正常眼位的情况。

HP:0500074.name: Dissociated vertical deviation
HP:0500074.definition: An incomitant tendency for an occluded eye to elevate and extort which resolves on uncovering.
HP:0500074.definition_cn: 遮盖时被遮盖眼出现上斜和外旋倾向，去遮盖后消失。

HP:0500075.name: Dissociated horizontal deviation
HP:0500075.definition: A change in horizontal ocular alignment, unrelated to accommodation, that is brought about solely by a change in the balance of visual input from the two eyes.
HP:0500075.definition_cn: 非调节性水平眼位改变，仅由双眼视觉输入平衡变化引起。

HP:0500076.name: Alternating hypertropia
HP:0500076.definition: A type of vertical tropia in which, when one eye is fixing, the other eye is deviated upwards.
HP:0500076.definition_cn: 一种垂直性斜视，当一只眼注视时，另一只眼向上偏斜。

HP:0500077.name: Alternating hyperphoria
HP:0500077.definition: A type of vertical phoria in which, in dissociation, the occluded eye deviates upwards.
HP:0500077.definition_cn: 一种垂直性隐斜视，在分离状态下，被遮盖的眼球向上偏斜。

HP:0500078.name: Alternating hypotropia
HP:0500078.definition: A type of vertical tropia in which, when one eye is fixing, the other eye is deviated downwards.
HP:0500078.definition_cn: 一种垂直性斜视，当一只眼注视时，另一只眼向下偏斜。

HP:0500079.name: Alternating hypophoria
HP:0500079.definition: A type of vertical phoria in which, in dissociation, the occluded eye deviates downwards.
HP:0500079.definition_cn: 一种垂直性隐斜视，在分离状态下，被遮盖眼向下偏斜。

HP:0500081.name: Pseudophakia
HP:0500081.definition: The term pseudophakia refers to having an artificial lens implanted after the natural eye lens has been removed. During cataract surgery the natural cloudy lens is replaced by an pseudophakia intraocular lens (IOL).
HP:0500081.definition_cn: 假晶状体（Pseudophakia）是指在自然晶状体被摘除后植入人工晶状体的状态。在白内障手术中，混浊的自然晶状体被替换为假晶状体人工晶状体（Intraocular Lens, IOL）。

HP:0500086.name: Optic nerve gray crescent
HP:0500086.definition: Having a characteristic appearance of a slate gray area of pigmentation within the disk margins that commonly appears along the inferotemporal or temporal neuroretinal rim areas.
HP:0500086.definition_cn: 具有特征性的外观，表现为视盘边缘内的石板灰色色素沉着区域，通常出现在颞下或颞侧神经视网膜边缘区域。

HP:0500087.name: Peripapillary atrophy
HP:0500087.definition: Thinning in the layers of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium around the optic nerve.
HP:0500087.definition_cn: 视神经周围视网膜层及视网膜色素上皮层变薄。

HP:0500088.name: Foveal depigmentation
HP:0500088.definition: Loss of pigment in the fovea centralis.

HP:0500089.name: Optic nerve sheath meningioma
HP:0500089.definition: A benign tumor of meningothelial cells of the meninges that usually occurs in middle age. It is typically unilateral and there is an association with neurofibromatosis type 2.
HP:0500089.definition_cn: 一种发生于脑膜脑膜上皮细胞的良性肿瘤，通常见于中年人群。该肿瘤通常为单侧发生，并与2型神经纤维瘤病相关。

HP:0500090.name: Periocular capillary hemangioma
HP:0500090.definition: A capillary hemangioma surrounding the eyeball but within the orbit.
HP:0500090.definition_cn: 眼球周围但位于眼眶内的毛细血管瘤。

HP:0500091.name: Lymphangioma of the orbit
HP:0500091.definition: A hamartoma of lymph vessels that usually presents in childhood. It tends to increase in size with head-down posture and with the Valsalva maneuver. Superficial lesions are visible as transilluminable cystic spaces of the lid or conjunctiva that may also contain blood. Deep lesions may cause gradual proptosis or present acutely with orbital pain and reduced vision due to hemorrhage.
HP:0500091.definition_cn: 淋巴管错构瘤，通常于儿童期发病。头低位及Valsalva动作时，其体积易增大。浅表病变表现为眼睑或结膜透光性囊性间隙，其中可能含有血液。深部病变可导致渐进性眼球突出，或因出血而急性出现眼眶疼痛及视力下降。

HP:0500092.name: Orbital rhabdomyosarcoma
HP:0500092.definition: A mesenchymal tumor that is considered to be the commonest primary orbital malignancy in children. Histologically, it may be differentiated into embryonal, alveolar, and pleomorphic types. It is usually intraconal or within the superior orbit.
HP:0500092.definition_cn: 一种间叶性肿瘤，被认为是儿童中最常见的原发性眼眶恶性肿瘤。组织学上，可将其分为胚胎型、腺泡型和多形型。通常位于眶内或上眼眶内。

HP:0500093.name: Food allergy
HP:0500093.definition: Primary food allergies primarily occur as a result (most likely) of gastrointestinal sensitization to predominantly stable food allergens (glycoproteins). A secondary food allergy develops after primary sensitization to airborne allergens (e. g., pollen allergens) with subsequent reactions (due to cross-reactivity) to structurally related often labile allergens in (plant) foods.
HP:0500093.definition_cn: 原发性食物过敏主要（最可能）是由于胃肠道对主要稳定的食物过敏原（糖蛋白）的致敏作用而发生。继发性食物过敏则是在对空气传播的过敏原（例如，花粉过敏原）发生原发性致敏后，随后对（植物性）食物中结构相关且通常不稳定的过敏原（由于交叉反应性）产生反应而发展。

HP:0500094.name: Latex allergy
HP:0500094.definition: Latex allergy is an IgE-mediated immediate hypersensitivity response to natural rubber latex (NRL) protein with a variety of clinical signs ranging from contact urticaria, angioedema, asthma, and anaphylaxis.
HP:0500094.definition_cn: 乳胶过敏是一种由IgE介导的对天然橡胶乳胶（NRL）蛋白的速发型超敏反应，其临床表现多样，包括接触性荨麻疹、血管性水肿、哮喘和过敏性休克。

HP:0500095.name: Food-induced anaphylaxis
HP:0500095.definition: Food-induced anaphylaxis is a severe, potentially fatal, systemic allergic reaction that occurs suddenly after contact with an allergy-causing food.
HP:0500095.name_cn: 食物诱发的过敏性休克
HP:0500095.definition_cn: 食物诱发的过敏性休克是一种严重的、可能致命的全身性过敏反应，在接触致敏食物后突然发生。

HP:0500096.name: Venom-induced anaphylaxis
HP:0500096.definition: A form of anaphylaxis that is triggered by exposure to venom.
HP:0500096.name_cn: 毒液诱发的过敏性休克
HP:0500096.definition_cn: 一种由接触毒液引发的过敏性休克形式。

HP:0500097.name: Stool xenobiotic
HP:0500097.definition_cn: 粪便中外源性物质的存在。

HP:0500098.name: Meconium xenobiotic
HP:0500098.definition: Presence of a xenobiotic in meconium.
HP:0500098.definition_cn: 胎粪中外源性物质的存在。

HP:0500099.name: Hair xenobiotic
HP:0500099.definition_cn: 毛发中外源性物质的存在。

HP:0500100.name: Plasma/serum xenobiotic
HP:0500100.definition: Presence of a xenobiotic in plasma and/or serum.
HP:0500100.definition_cn: 血浆和/或血清中外源性物质的存在。

HP:0500101.name: Gastric fluid xenobiotic
HP:0500101.definition: Presence of a xenobiotic in gastric fluid.
HP:0500101.definition_cn: 胃液中存在外源性物质。

HP:0500104.name: Decreased diastolic blood pressure
HP:0500104.definition: Abnormal decrease in diastolic blood pressure.

HP:0500105.name: Decreased systolic blood pressure
HP:0500105.definition: Abnormal decrease in systolic blood pressure.

HP:0500106.name: Isolated systolic hypertension
HP:0500106.definition: Elevated systolic blood pressure without an elevated blood pressure.
HP:0500106.definition_cn: 单纯收缩期高血压（Isolated Systolic Hypertension）。

HP:0500107.name: Isolated diastolic hypotension
HP:0500107.definition: A decrease in diastolic blood pressure (<60 mmHg) without a decrease in systolic blood pressure (> or = to 100 mmHg).
HP:0500107.definition_cn: 舒张压降低（<60 mmHg）而收缩压未降低（≥100 mmHg）。

HP:0500108.name: Positive urine cocaine test
HP:0500108.definition: Detection of cocaine or its major metabolite, benzoylecgonine, in urine.
HP:0500108.definition_cn: 尿液中可卡因或其主要代谢物苯甲酰爱康宁的检测。

HP:0500109.name: Positive urine barbiturate test
HP:0500109.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as Phenobarbital in urine.
HP:0500109.name_cn: 尿巴比妥酸盐检测阳性
HP:0500109.definition_cn: 尿液中苯巴比妥等巴比妥酸盐代谢物的检测。

HP:0500110.name: Positive urine cannabinoid test
HP:0500110.definition: Detection of delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) or other cannabinoid metabolites in urine.
HP:0500110.definition_cn: 尿液中δ-9-四氢大麻酚（THC）或其他大麻素代谢物的检测。

HP:0500111.name: Positive urine benzodiazepines test
HP:0500111.definition: Detection of benzodiazepine metabolites, primarily nordiazepam, oxazepam, and temazepam, in urine.
HP:0500111.name_cn: 尿苯二氮卓类药物检测阳性
HP:0500111.definition_cn: 尿液中苯二氮卓类代谢物的检测，主要为去甲西泮、奥沙西泮和替马西泮。

HP:0500112.name: Positive urine amphetamine test
HP:0500112.definition: Detection of amphetamine or its metabolites in urine.
HP:0500112.name_cn: 尿液中苯丙胺检测呈阳性
HP:0500112.definition_cn: 尿液中苯丙胺或其代谢物的检测。

HP:0500113.name: Positive urine opioid test
HP:0500113.definition: Detection of opioids or opioid metabolites in urine.
HP:0500113.name_cn: 尿阿片类药物检测阳性
HP:0500113.definition_cn: 尿液中阿片类药物或阿片类代谢物的检测。

HP:0500114.name: Abnormal stool urobilinogen concentration
HP:0500114.definition: Abnormal concentration of urobilinogen present in the stool.
HP:0500114.definition_cn: 粪便中尿胆原浓度异常。

HP:0500115.name: Increased stool urobilinogen concentration
HP:0500115.definition: An increased amount of urobilinogen present in the stool.
HP:0500115.definition_cn: 粪便中尿胆原含量增加。

HP:0500116.name: Positive blood barbiturate test
HP:0500116.definition: Detection of barbiturate metabolites such as Phenobarbital in blood.
HP:0500116.name_cn: 血液巴比妥酸盐检测阳性
HP:0500116.definition_cn: 血液中巴比妥酸盐代谢物（如苯巴比妥）的检测。

HP:0500117.name: Abnormal CSF urate concentration
HP:0500117.definition: Abnormal concentration of urate in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:0500117.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中尿酸盐浓度异常。

HP:0500132.name: Hypovalinemia
HP:0500132.definition: A decreased amount of valine in the blood.
HP:0500132.definition_cn: 血液中缬氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500133.name: Hypotyrosinemia
HP:0500133.definition: An decreased concentration of tyrosine in the blood.
HP:0500133.definition_cn: 血液中酪氨酸浓度降低。

HP:0500134.name: Hypertryptophanemia
HP:0500134.definition: An increased amount of tryptophan in the blood.
HP:0500134.definition_cn: 血液中色氨酸水平升高。

HP:0500135.name: Hypotryptophanemia
HP:0500135.definition: A decreased amount of tryptophan in the blood.
HP:0500135.definition_cn: 血液中色氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500136.name: Hypothreoninemia
HP:0500136.definition: A decreased amount of threonine in the blood.
HP:0500136.definition_cn: 血液中苏氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500138.name: Hyperserinemia
HP:0500138.definition: An increased amount of serine in the blood.
HP:0500138.definition_cn: 血液中丝氨酸水平升高。

HP:0500139.name: Hypoprolinemia
HP:0500139.definition: A decreased amount of proline in the blood.
HP:0500139.definition_cn: 血液中脯氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500140.name: Decreased circulating hydroxyproline concentration
HP:0500140.definition: A decreased amount of hydroxyproline in the blood.
HP:0500140.name_cn: 循环羟脯氨酸浓度降低
HP:0500140.definition_cn: 血液中羟脯氨酸含量降低。

HP:0500141.name: Hypophenylalaninemia
HP:0500141.definition: A decreased amount of phenylalanine in the blood.
HP:0500141.definition_cn: 血液中苯丙氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500142.name: Hypolysinemia
HP:0500142.definition: A decreased amount of lysine in the blood.
HP:0500142.definition_cn: 血液中赖氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500143.name: Hypoleucinemia
HP:0500143.definition: Decreased amount of leucine in the blood.
HP:0500143.definition_cn: 血液中亮氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500144.name: Hypoisoleucinemia
HP:0500144.definition: A decreased amount of isoleucine in the blood.
HP:0500144.definition_cn: 血液中异亮氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500145.name: Hypohistidinemia
HP:0500145.definition: A decreased amount of histidine in the blood.
HP:0500145.definition_cn: 血液中组氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500147.name: Hypoglutaminemia
HP:0500147.definition: Decreased amount of glutamine in the blood.

HP:0500148.name: Abnormal circulating glutamate concentration
HP:0500148.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of glutamate in the blood circulation.
HP:0500148.definition_cn: 血液中谷氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0500149.name: Hyperglutamatemia
HP:0500149.definition: Concentration of glutamate in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:0500149.definition_cn: 血液中谷氨酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:0500150.name: Hypoglutamatemia
HP:0500150.definition: A decreased amount of glutamate in the blood.
HP:0500150.definition_cn: 血液中谷氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500151.name: Hypercystinemia
HP:0500151.definition: An increased amount of cystine in the blood.
HP:0500151.definition_cn: 血液中胱氨酸水平升高。

HP:0500152.name: Hypocystinemia
HP:0500152.definition: A decreased amount of cystine in the blood.
HP:0500152.definition_cn: 血液中胱氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500153.name: Hyperargininemia
HP:0500153.definition: An increased amount of arginine levels in the blood.
HP:0500153.definition_cn: 血液中精氨酸水平升高。

HP:0500154.name: Hypoalaninemia
HP:0500154.definition: A decreased amount of alanine in the blood.
HP:0500154.definition_cn: 血液中丙氨酸水平降低。

HP:0500155.name: Abnormal circulating asparagine concentration
HP:0500155.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of asparagine in the blood circulation.
HP:0500155.name_cn: 异常循环天冬酰胺浓度
HP:0500155.definition_cn: 血液中天冬酰胺浓度的任何异常。

HP:0500156.name: Hyperasparaginemia
HP:0500156.definition: An increased amount of asparagine in the blood.
HP:0500156.definition_cn: 血液中天冬酰胺水平升高。

HP:0500157.name: Hypoasparaginemia
HP:0500157.definition: A decreased amount of asparagine in the blood.
HP:0500157.definition_cn: 血液中天冬酰胺水平降低。

HP:0500158.name: Abnormal circulating aspartic acid concentration
HP:0500158.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of aspartate in the blood circulation.
HP:0500158.name_cn: 异常循环天冬氨酸浓度
HP:0500158.definition_cn: 血液中天冬氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0500159.name: Increased circulating aspartic acid concentration
HP:0500159.definition: An increased concentration of aspartic acid in the blood circulation.
HP:0500159.name_cn: 循环中天门冬氨酸浓度升高
HP:0500159.definition_cn: 血液中天冬氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0500160.name: Abnormal circulating carnosine concentration
HP:0500160.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of carnosine in the blood circulation.
HP:0500160.definition_cn: 血液循环中肌肽浓度的任何异常偏离。

HP:0500161.name: Increased circulating carnosine concentration
HP:0500161.definition: Concentration of carnosine in the blood circulation above normal limits.
HP:0500161.definition_cn: 血液中肌肽浓度超出正常范围。

HP:0500162.name: Decreased circulating carnosine concentration
HP:0500162.definition: A decreased amount of carnosine in blood.

HP:0500163.name: Hypoornithinemia
HP:0500163.definition: An abnormal decrease in ornithine in the blood.
HP:0500163.definition_cn: 血液中鸟氨酸水平异常降低。

HP:0500164.name: Abnormal blood carbon dioxide level
HP:0500164.definition: An abnormality of carbon dioxide (CO2) in the arterial blood.
HP:0500164.definition_cn: 动脉血中二氧化碳（CO2）异常。

HP:0500165.name: Abnormal blood oxygen level
HP:0500165.definition: An abnormality of the partial pressure of oxygen in the arterial blood.

HP:0500166.name: Abnormal circulating gastrin concentration
HP:0500166.definition: An abnormal concentration of gastrin in the blood.

HP:0500167.name: Hypergastrinemia
HP:0500167.definition: An elevated amount of gastrin in the blood.

HP:0500170.name: Abnormal concentration of acylcarnitine in the urine

HP:0500256.name_cn: 尿液异丁酰甘氨酸浓度异常
HP:0500256.definition_cn: 尿液中异丁酰甘氨酸浓度异常。

HP:0500257.name: Increased urine isobutyrylglycine concentration
HP:0500257.definition: Elevated concentration of isobutyrylglycine in the urine.
HP:0500257.name_cn: 尿异丁酰甘氨酸浓度升高
HP:0500257.definition_cn: 尿液中异丁酰甘氨酸浓度升高。

HP:0500258.name: Abnormal carbon dioxide level in cord blood
HP:0500258.definition: Abnormal amount of carbon dioxide in umbilical cord blood
HP:0500258.name_cn: 脐带血中二氧化碳水平异常
HP:0500258.definition_cn: 脐带血中二氧化碳含量异常

HP:0500259.name: Abnormal oxygen level in cord blood
HP:0500259.definition: An abnormal level of blood oxygen in the cord blood.
HP:0500259.definition_cn: 脐带血中血氧水平异常。

HP:0500260.name: Triggered by head trauma
HP:0500260.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a head trauma.
HP:0500260.definition_cn: 适用于由头部创伤暴露引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:0500261.name: Triggered by anesthetics
HP:0500261.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to anesthetics.
HP:0500261.definition_cn: 适用于由麻醉剂暴露引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:0500262.name: Atrichia
HP:0500262.definition: The most dramatic and severe form of hair loss characterized by an absence of hair follicles.
HP:0500262.definition_cn: 最显著且严重的脱发形式，其特征为毛囊缺失。

HP:0500263.name: Abnormal helper T cell proportion
HP:0500263.definition: Abnormal proportion of helper T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500263.definition_cn: 辅助性T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0500264.name: Increased helper T cell proportion
HP:0500264.definition: Increased proportion of helper T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500264.definition_cn: 辅助性T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例增加。

HP:0500265.name: Increased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta TEMRA T cells
HP:0500265.definition: An increased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta effector memory RA TEMRA T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.
HP:0500265.name_cn: CD8阳性、αβ型TEMRA T细胞比例增加
HP:0500265.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性、αβ效应记忆RA TEMRA T细胞比例增加。这些细胞具有CD45RA阳性、CD45RO阴性和CCR7阴性的表型。

HP:0500266.name: Decreased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta TEMRA T cells
HP:0500266.definition: An decreased proportion of CD8-positive, alpha-beta effector memory RA TEMRA T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.
HP:0500266.name_cn: CD8阳性αβ TEMRA T细胞比例降低
HP:0500266.definition_cn: 与血液中T细胞总数相比，CD8阳性、αβ效应记忆RA TEMRA T细胞比例降低。这些细胞具有CD45RA阳性、CD45RO阴性和CCR7阴性的表型。

HP:0500267.name: Abnormal proportion of CD4-positive helper T cells
HP:0500267.definition: An abnormal proportion of circulating CD4-positive helper T cells relative to total T cell count.
HP:0500267.name_cn: CD4阳性辅助T细胞比例异常
HP:0500267.definition_cn: 循环中CD4阳性辅助性T细胞相对于总T细胞计数的异常比例。

HP:0500269.name: Abnormal proportion of gamma-delta T cells
HP:0500269.definition: Abnormal proportion of gamma-delta T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500269.definition_cn: γ-δ T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0500270.name: Increased proportion of gamma-delta T cells
HP:0500270.definition: Increased proportion of gamma-delta T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500270.definition_cn: γ-δ T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例增加。

HP:0500271.name: Decreased proportion of gamma-delta T cells
HP:0500271.definition: Decreased proportion of gamma-delta T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500271.definition_cn: γ-δ T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例降低。

HP:0500272.name: Abnormal proportion of immature gamma-delta T cells
HP:0500272.definition: Abnormal proportion of immature gamma-delta T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500272.name_cn: 未成熟γ-δ T细胞比例异常
HP:0500272.definition_cn: 未成熟γ-δ T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例异常。

HP:0500273.name: Increased proportion of immature gamma-delta T cells
HP:0500273.definition: Increased proportion of immature gamma-delta T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500273.name_cn: 未成熟γ-δ T细胞比例增加
HP:0500273.definition_cn: 未成熟γ-δ T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例增加。

HP:0500274.name: Decreased proportion of immature gamma-delta T cells
HP:0500274.definition: Decreased proportion of immature gamma-delta T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP:0500274.name_cn: 未成熟γ-δ T细胞比例降低
HP:0500274.definition_cn: 未成熟γ-δ T细胞相对于T细胞总数的比例降低。

HP:0550003.name: Proximal scleroderma
HP:0550003.definition: Symmetrical thickening, tightening and induration of the skin of the fingers and the skin proximal to the metacarpophalangeal or metatarsophalangeal joints. These changes can involve the entire limb, face, neck and trunk.
HP:0550003.definition_cn: 对称性增厚、紧绷和硬化，累及手指皮肤以及掌指关节或跖趾关节近端皮肤。这些改变可波及整个肢体、面部、颈部和躯干。

HP:0550004.name: Verruca plana
HP:0550004.definition: Slightly raised wart 2-5 mm in diameter often associated with viral infections, commonly persistent in immunodeficient individuals.
HP:0550004.definition_cn: 直径2-5毫米的轻微隆起疣体，通常与病毒感染相关，常见于免疫缺陷个体中且具有持续性。

HP:0550005.name: Bilateral basilar pulmonary fibrosis
HP:0550005.definition: It is a bilateral reticular pattern of linear or lineonodular densities that are most pronounced in basilar portions of the lungs on standard chest x-ray. It is the third minor criterion for scleroderma diagnosis.
HP:0550005.definition_cn: 在标准胸部X光片上，表现为双侧网状线性或线状结节样密度影，主要位于肺基底部分。这是硬皮病诊断的第三项次要标准。

HP:3000002.name: Abnormal inner ear epithelium morphology
HP:3000002.definition: Any structural anomaly of an inner ear epithelium.

HP:3000003.name: Abnormal mandibular ramus morphology
HP:3000003.definition: An abnormality of a mandibular ramus.

HP:3000004.name: Abnormal frontalis muscle physiology
HP:3000004.definition: Abnormal function of the frontalis muscle, which covers parts of the forehead and is responsible for raising the eyebrows.
HP:3000004.definition_cn: 额肌功能障碍，该肌肉覆盖部分前额，主要负责提升眉毛。

HP:3000020.definition: An abnormality of a zygomaticus minor muscle.
