HP:3000021.definition: An abnormality of a buccal fat pad.

HP:3000022.name: Abnormal external ear cartilage morphology
HP:3000022.definition: An abnormality of a cartilage of external ear.

HP:3000023.name: Abnormality of angular artery
HP:3000023.definition: An abnormality of the angular artery, the terminal branch of the facial artery.
HP:3000023.definition_cn: 角动脉异常，面动脉的终末分支。

HP:3000024.name: Abnormal facial artery morphology
HP:3000024.definition: Any structural abnormality of a facial artery, one of the branches of the external carotid artery.
HP:3000024.definition_cn: 面动脉结构异常，其为颈外动脉分支之一。

HP:3000025.name: Abnormality of ciliary ganglion
HP:3000025.definition: An abnormality of a ciliary ganglion.

HP:3000026.name: obsolete Abnormality of common carotid artery plus branches
HP:3000026.name_cn: 陈旧性颈总动脉及其分支异常

HP:3000027.name: Abnormality of buccinator muscle
HP:3000027.definition: An abnormality of a buccinator muscle.

HP:3000028.name: Abnormality of depressor anguli oris muscle
HP:3000028.definition: An abnormality of a depressor anguli oris muscle.

HP:3000029.name: Abnormality of depressor labii inferioris
HP:3000029.definition: An abnormality of a depressor labii inferioris.

HP:3000030.name: Abnormal morphology of bony orbit of skull
HP:3000030.definition: An abnormality of an orbit of skull.

HP:3000031.name: Abnormality of anterior ethmoidal artery
HP:3000031.definition: An abnormality of an anterior ethmoidal artery.

HP:3000032.name: Abnormality of central retinal artery
HP:3000032.definition: An abnormality of a central retinal artery.

HP:3000033.name: Abnormal nasopharyngeal adenoid morphology
HP:3000033.name_cn: 鼻咽部腺样体形态异常

HP:3000034.name: Abnormality nasal septum cartilage morphology
HP:3000034.definition: An abnormality of a cartilage of nasal septum.

HP:3000035.name: Abnormality of cervical plexus
HP:3000035.definition: Abnormality of the plexus of the ventral rami of the first four cervical spinal nerves which are located from C1 to C4 cervical segment in the neck.
HP:3000035.definition_cn: 位于颈部C1至C4节段的前四对颈神经腹侧支丛异常。

HP:3000036.name: Abnormal head blood vessel morphology
HP:3000036.definition: An abnormality of a blood vessel of the head, including branches of the arterial and venous systems of the head.
HP:3000036.definition_cn: 头部血管异常，包括头部动脉和静脉系统的分支。

HP:3000037.name: Abnormal neck blood vessel morphology
HP:3000037.definition: An abnormality of a blood vessel of the neck, including branches of the arterial and venous systems of the neck.
HP:3000037.definition_cn: 颈部血管异常，包括颈部动脉和静脉系统的分支。

HP:3000038.name: Abnormal cricoid cartilage morphology
HP:3000038.definition: Any structural abnormality of a cricoid cartilage, that is, of the ring-shaped cartilage of the larynx.
HP:3000038.definition_cn: 环状软骨结构异常，即喉部环状软骨的任何结构异常。

HP:3000039.name: Abnormality of dorsal nasal artery
HP:3000039.definition: An abnormality of a dorsal nasal artery.

HP:3000040.definition: An abnormality of an ethmoid sinus.

HP:3000041.name: Abnormality of external carotid artery
HP:3000041.definition: An abnormality of an external carotid artery.

HP:3000042.definition: Any structural abnormality of a jugular vein.

HP:3000043.name: Abnormal facial vein morphology
HP:3000043.definition: An abnormality of a facial vein.

HP:3000044.name: Abnormality of frontal process of maxilla
HP:3000044.definition: An abnormality of a frontal process of the maxilla bone.

HP:3000045.name: Abnormality of genioglossus muscle
HP:3000045.definition: An abnormality of a genioglossus muscle.

HP:3000046.name: Abnormal geniohyoid muscle morphology
HP:3000046.definition: An abnormality of a geniohyoid muscle.

HP:3000047.name: Abnormal glossopharyngeal nerve morphology
HP:3000047.definition: Any structural anomaly of the glossopharyngeal nerve, the ninth paired cranial nerve (CN IX).
HP:3000047.definition_cn: 舌咽神经（第九对颅神经，CN IX）的任何结构异常。

HP:3000048.name: Abnormal great auricular nerve morphology
HP:3000048.definition: Any structural anomaly of a great auricular nerve.
HP:3000048.definition_cn: 耳大神经的任何结构异常。

HP:3000049.name: Abnormal greater palatine artery morphology
HP:3000049.definition: An abnormality of a greater palatine artery.

HP:3000050.name: Abnormal odontoid tissue morphology
HP:3000050.definition: An abnormality of an odontoid tissue.

HP:3000051.name: Abnormal hyoglossus muscle morphology
HP:3000051.definition: An abnormality of a hyoglossus muscle.

HP:3000052.name: Abnormal hyoid bone morphology
HP:3000052.definition: Any structural abnormality of the hyoid bone (hyoid), a small U-shaped (horseshoe-shaped) solitary bone, situated in the midline of the neck anteriorly at the base of the mandible and posteriorly at the fourth cervical vertebra.
HP:3000052.definition_cn: 舌骨（hyoid bone）的任何结构异常，舌骨为一块小型U形（马蹄形）独立骨，位于颈部中线，前部位于下颌骨基底，后部位于第四颈椎。

HP:3000053.name: Abnormal hypopharynx morphology
HP:3000053.definition: A structural anomaly of the hypopharyx, which is the most inferior portion of the pharynx. The hypopharynx continues from the oropharynx at the pharyngoepiglottic fold superiorly and extends inferiorly to the level of the inferior aspect of the cricoid cartilage, which marks the beginning of the cervical esophagus.
HP:3000053.definition_cn: 下咽部结构异常，下咽部是咽部最下方的部分。下咽部自上方咽会厌皱襞处与口咽部相延续，向下延伸至环状软骨下缘水平，此处标志着颈段食管的起始。

HP:3000054.name: Abnormal inferior alveolar artery morphology
HP:3000054.definition: An abnormality of an inferior alveolar artery.

HP:3000055.name: Abnormality of inferior alveolar nerve
HP:3000055.definition: An abnormality of an inferior alveolar nerve.

HP:3000056.name: Abnormality of artery of lower lip
HP:3000056.definition: An abnormality of an artery of lower lip.

HP:3000057.name: Abnormality of inferior oblique extraocular muscle
HP:3000057.definition: An abnormality of an inferior oblique extraocular muscle.

HP:3000058.name: Abnormality of inferior rectus extraocular muscle
HP:3000058.definition: An abnormality of an inferior rectus extraocular muscle.

HP:3000059.name: Abnormal inferior thyroid vein morphology
HP:3000059.definition: An abnormality of an inferior thyroid vein.
HP:3000059.name_cn: 甲状腺下静脉形态异常

HP:3000060.name: Abnormal infraorbital artery morphology
HP:3000060.definition: An abnormality of an infraorbital artery.

HP:3000061.name: Abnormality of infra-orbital nerve
HP:3000061.definition: A structural abnormality of an infra-orbital nerve. The infraorbital nerve arises from the maxillary branch of the trigeminal nerve and normally traverses the orbital floor in the infraorbital canal.
HP:3000061.definition_cn: 眶下神经结构异常。眶下神经起源于三叉神经的上颌支，通常穿过眶底的眶下管。

HP:3000062.name: Abnormal internal carotid artery morphology
HP:3000062.definition: An abnormality of an internal carotid artery.

HP:3000063.name: Abnormality of internal jugular vein
HP:3000063.definition: An abnormality of an internal jugular vein.

HP:3000064.name: Abnormality of intrinsic muscle of tongue
HP:3000064.definition: An abnormality of an intrinsic muscle of tongue.

HP:3000065.name: Abnormal lacrimal artery morphology
HP:3000065.definition: An abnormality of a lacrimal artery.

HP:3000066.name: Abnormal lacrimal sac morphology
HP:3000066.definition: An abnormality of a lacrimal sac.

HP:3000067.name: Abnormal lateral cricoarytenoid muscle morphology
HP:3000067.definition: Any structural abnormality of a lateral crico-arytenoid muscle, which extends from the lateral cricoid cartilage to the muscular process of the arytenoid cartilage, and can adduct the vocal cords, which closes the rima glottidis and thereby protects the airway.
HP:3000067.definition_cn: 环杓侧肌的结构异常，该肌肉从环状软骨外侧延伸至杓状软骨的肌突，能够内收声带，从而关闭声门裂，保护气道。

HP:3000068.name: Abnormality of lateral pterygoid muscle
HP:3000068.definition: An abnormality of a lateral pterygoid muscle.

HP:3000069.name: Abnormality of lateral rectus extra-ocular muscle
HP:3000069.definition: An abnormality of a lateral rectus extra-ocular muscle.

HP:3000070.name: Abnormality of levator anguli oris
HP:3000070.definition: An abnormality of a levator anguli oris.

HP:3000071.name: Abnormality of levator labii superioris
HP:3000071.definition: An abnormality of a levator labii superioris.

HP:3000072.name: Abnormal levator palpebrae superioris morphology
HP:3000072.definition: An abnormality of a levator palpebrae superioris.

HP:3000073.name: Abnormality of levator veli palatini muscle
HP:3000073.definition: An abnormality of a levator veli palatini.

HP:3000074.name: Abnormal lingual artery morphology
HP:3000074.definition: Any structural abnormality of a lingual artery.

HP:3000075.name: Abnormal lingual nerve morphology
HP:3000075.definition: Any structural anomaly of a lingual nerve.

HP:3000076.name: Abnormality of lingual tonsil
HP:3000076.definition: An abnormality of a lingual tonsil.

HP:3000077.name: Abnormal mandible condylar process morphology
HP:3000077.definition: An abnormality of a mandible condylar process.

HP:3000078.name: Abnormal mandible coronoid process morphology
HP:3000078.definition: An abnormality of a mandible coronoid process.

HP:3000079.name: Abnormal mandibular symphysis morphology
HP:3000079.definition: A structural abnormality of a mandibular symphysis.

HP:4000001.name: Abnormal cardiac magnetic resonance imaging finding
HP:4000001.definition: Abnormal finding by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), which uses non-ionizing radiation via a strong magnetic field and radio frequency energy to generate three dimensional images. This term comprises findings that are specific to MRI. Findings such as ventricular spetum defect that can be detected by multiple modalities should be coded separately.
HP:4000001.name_cn: 异常心脏磁共振成像发现
HP:4000001.definition_cn: 磁共振成像（MRI）异常发现，该技术利用非电离辐射通过强磁场和射频能量生成三维图像。此术语包括MRI特有的发现。如室间隔缺损等可通过多种检测方式发现的异常应单独编码。

HP:4000003.name: Elevated myocardial native T2
HP:4000003.definition: Increased duration of myocardial T2 time without gadolinium contrast. Elevated T2, which can detect myocardial edema.
HP:4000003.definition_cn: 非钆对比剂下心肌T2时间延长。T2值升高，可检测心肌水肿。

HP:4000004.name: Myocardial late gadolinium enhancement
HP:4000004.definition: Areas of high signal intensity in magnetic resonance imaging of the heart appearing 10 to 15 minutes after injection of the intercellular contrast agent gadolinium.
HP:4000004.definition_cn: 心脏磁共振成像中，在注射细胞间对比剂钆后10至15分钟出现的高信号强度区域。

HP:4000005.name: Pericardial late gadolinium enhancement
HP:4000005.definition: Areas of high signal intensity in magnetic resonance imaging of the pericardium appearing around 10 minutes after injection of the intercellular contrast agent gadolinium.
HP:4000005.definition_cn: 心包磁共振成像中，在注射细胞间对比剂钆后约10分钟出现的高信号强度区域。

HP:4000006.name: Elevated myocardial native T1
HP:4000006.definition: Increased duration of myocardial T1 time without gadolinium contrast. T1 mapping consists of quantifying the T1 relaxation time of a tissue by using analytical expressions of image-based signal intensities. A fundamental principle of MR imaging is that the signal intensity of pixels is based on the relaxation of hydrogen nuclei protons in a static magnetic field. The T1 relaxation times between two tissues vary substantially. Edema, fat infiltration, and fibrosis also cause differences in T1 relaxivity.
HP:4000006.definition_cn: 无钆对比剂下心肌T1时间延长。T1 mapping通过基于图像信号强度的解析表达式来量化组织的T1弛豫时间。磁共振成像的一个基本原理是像素的信号强度基于静磁场中氢核质子的弛豫。两种组织之间的T1弛豫时间存在显著差异。水肿、脂肪浸润和纤维化也会导致T1弛豫率的差异。

HP:4000007.name: Bronchoconstriction
HP:4000007.definition: Tightening of smooth muscle surrounding the bronchi and bronchioles with consequent wheezing and shortness of breath.
HP:4000007.definition_cn: 支气管和细支气管周围平滑肌收缩，导致喘鸣和呼吸困难。

HP:4000008.name: Formation of multiple pronuclei during fertilization
HP:4000008.definition: Pronuclei formation is a critical process during fertilization. Normally, there are two pronuclei (2PN), including the paternal pronucleus and the maternal pronucleus, in the zygote after fertilization. It is generally accepted that multiple pronuclei (MPN) formation is due to the abnormal extrusion of the second polar body or to abnormal fertilization with multiple sperm. The MPN therefore can cause infertility and recurrent failure of IVF/ICSI.
HP:4000008.name_cn: 受精过程中多原核形成
HP:4000008.definition_cn: 原核形成是受精过程中的关键步骤。正常情况下，受精后的合子中存在两个原核（2PN），包括父源原核和母源原核。普遍认为，多原核（MPN）的形成是由于第二极体异常排出或多精子受精所致。因此，MPN可能导致不孕症及体外受精/卵胞浆内单精子注射（IVF/ICSI）的反复失败。

HP:4000009.name: Kinesiophobia
HP:4000009.definition: An excessive, irrational, and debilitating fear of carrying out a physical movement due to a feeling of vulnerability to painful injury or reinjury.
HP:4000009.definition_cn: 对因感觉易受疼痛性损伤或再次损伤而进行身体运动产生的过度、非理性且致残性恐惧。

HP:4000010.name: Impaired renal tubular reabsorption of bicarbonate
HP:4000010.definition: Decreased renal tubular reabsorption of bicarbonate.
HP:4000010.name_cn: 肾小管重吸收碳酸氢盐功能障碍
HP:4000010.definition_cn: 肾小管对碳酸氢盐的重吸收减少。

HP:4000011.name: History of congenital HPV infection
HP:4000011.definition: A congenital human papillomavirus (HPV) infection of the newborn. Congential HPV infection can manifest as condyloma cuminata in the newborn.
HP:4000011.definition_cn: 新生儿先天性人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染。先天性HPV感染可表现为新生儿尖锐湿疣。

HP:4000013.name: Anti-desmoglein-1 antibody positivity
HP:4000013.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoglein-1, a dermal cell adhesion molecule.
HP:4000013.name_cn: 抗桥粒芯蛋白1抗体阳性
HP:4000013.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对桥粒芯蛋白-1（一种皮肤细胞黏附分子）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000014.name: Anti-desmoglein-3 antibody positivity
HP:4000014.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoglein-3, a dermal cell adhesion molecule.
HP:4000014.name_cn: 抗桥粒芯蛋白3抗体阳性
HP:4000014.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对桥粒芯蛋白-3（一种皮肤细胞黏附分子）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000015.name: Anti-envoplakin antibody positivity
HP:4000015.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against envoplakin, a cytoskeletal linker protein that links intermediate filaments to cellular junctions.
HP:4000015.name_cn: 抗包膜斑蛋白抗体阳性
HP:4000015.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体（免疫球蛋白），这些抗体与envoplakin（一种将中间丝连接到细胞连接的细胞骨架连接蛋白）发生反应。

HP:4000016.name: Anti-periplakin antibody positivity
HP:4000016.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against periplakin.
HP:4000016.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对周斑蛋白（periplakin）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000017.name: Anti-desmoplakin I antibody positivity
HP:4000017.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoplakin-1.
HP:4000017.name_cn: 抗桥粒斑蛋白I抗体阳性
HP:4000017.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对桥粒斑蛋白-1（desmoplakin-1）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000018.name: Anti-desmoplakin II antibody positivity
HP:4000018.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmoplakin-II.
HP:4000018.name_cn: 抗桥粒斑蛋白II抗体阳性
HP:4000018.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对桥粒斑蛋白-II（desmoplakin-II）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000019.name: Anti-BP230 antibody positivity
HP:4000019.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against BP230.
HP:4000019.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对BP230的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000020.name: Anti-BP180 antibody positivity
HP:4000020.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against BP180.
HP:4000020.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对BP180的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000021.name: Anti-laminin 332 antibody positivity
HP:4000021.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against laminin-332.
HP:4000021.name_cn: 抗层粘连蛋白332抗体阳性
HP:4000021.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对层粘连蛋白-332（laminin-332）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000022.name: Anti-laminin 6 antibody positivity
HP:4000022.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against laminin-6.
HP:4000022.name_cn: 抗层粘连蛋白6抗体阳性
HP:4000022.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对层粘连蛋白-6的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000023.name: Anti-laminin gamma1 antibody positivity
HP:4000023.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against laminin gamma-1.
HP:4000023.name_cn: 抗层粘连蛋白γ1抗体阳性
HP:4000023.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对层粘连蛋白γ-1的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000024.name: Anti-laminin antibody positivity
HP:4000024.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a laminin. Laminins are major components of the basement membrane.
HP:4000024.name_cn: 抗层粘连蛋白抗体阳性
HP:4000024.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对层粘连蛋白的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。层粘连蛋白是基底膜的主要成分。

HP:4000025.name: Anti-integrin antibody positivity
HP:4000025.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against an integrin. Integrins are a family of cell adhesion molecules with 24 known integrin heterodimers. Integrins transduce mechanical and biochemical signals from fibrotic extracellular matrix into the cell, activate latent TGFbeta, and subsequently modulate fibroblast adhesion, migration, and growth.
HP:4000025.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对整合素的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。整合素是一类细胞黏附分子家族，已知有24种整合素异二聚体。整合素将来自纤维化细胞外基质的机械和生化信号转导至细胞内，激活潜在的转化生长因子β（TGF-β），并随后调节成纤维细胞的黏附、迁移和生长。

HP:4000026.name: Anti-transglutaminase 6 antibody
HP:4000026.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against transglutaminase 6.
HP:4000026.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对转谷氨酰胺酶6的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000027.name: Anti-LAD-1 antibody positivity
HP:4000027.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against LAD-1, which is the soluble 120 kDa ectodomain of BP180.
HP:4000027.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对LAD-1（即BP180的可溶性120 kDa胞外域）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000028.name: Anti-LABD97 antibody positivity
HP:4000028.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against LABD97, which is structurally identical to a portion of the extracellular domain of BPAg2. BPAg2, a 180 kDa bullous pemphigoid antigen, is a transmembrane protein important for basement membrane cohesion.
HP:4000028.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对LABD97的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白），LABD97在结构上与BPAg2的胞外域部分相同。BPAg2是一种180 kDa的大疱性类天疱疮抗原，是一种对基底膜粘附至关重要的跨膜蛋白。

HP:4000029.name: Antigliadin antibody positivity
HP:4000029.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against gliadin.
HP:4000029.definition_cn: 血清中存在与麦胶蛋白（gliadin）反应的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000030.name: Anti-reticulin antibody positivity
HP:4000030.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against reticulin.
HP:4000030.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对网状纤维的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000031.name: Anti-type VII collagen antibody
HP:4000031.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against collagen type VII.
HP:4000031.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对VII型胶原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000032.name: False perception of self-motion
HP:4000032.definition: A perception that one's body is moving or swaying despite lack of motion of the body.
HP:4000032.definition_cn: 主观性运动感（Subjective sensation of movement or swaying despite absence of actual body motion）

HP:4000033.name: Non-spinning vertigo
HP:4000033.definition: A perception of unsteadiness of dizziness that is not characterized bythe spinning sensation of classic vertigo, but rather by an oscillatory perception (rocking, bobbing, or swaying despite the fact that the subject is not moving).
HP:4000033.definition_cn: 一种不稳定性或头晕的感知，其特征并非经典眩晕的旋转感，而是一种振荡性感知（尽管受试者并未移动，但仍感到摇摆、晃动或摇晃）。

HP:4000034.name: Infection-associated lymphopenia
HP:4000034.name_cn: 感染相关性淋巴细胞减少症
HP:4000034.definition_cn: 感染期间淋巴细胞计数减少。

HP:4000035.name: Primary obstructive megaureter
HP:4000035.definition: Megaurater associated with obstruction or an adynamic ureteral segment in the ureterovesical junction.
HP:4000035.name_cn: 原发性梗阻性巨输尿管症
HP:4000035.definition_cn: 巨输尿管伴梗阻或输尿管膀胱连接处无动力性输尿管段。

HP:4000036.name: Encysted hydrocele of the cord
HP:4000036.definition: A type of hydrocele testis in which both the proximal and distal portions of processus vaginalis get obliterated while the central portion remains patent and fluid accumulates within it.
HP:4000036.definition_cn: 一种睾丸鞘膜积液类型，其中鞘状突的近端和远端部分均发生闭塞，而中央部分保持开放，液体在其中积聚。

HP:4000037.name: Congenital hydrocele
HP:4000037.definition: Congenital hydrocele occurs when processus vaginalis is patent and communicates with the peritoneal cavity. This communication allows the movement of peritoneal fluid but is too small to allow the intra-abdominal contents to herniate through.
HP:4000037.definition_cn: 先天性鞘膜积液发生于鞘状突未闭并与腹膜腔相通。这种通道允许腹膜液流动，但过于狭小以致腹腔内容物无法通过形成疝。

HP:4000038.name: Infantile hydrocele
HP:4000038.definition: Infantile Hydrocele is a type pf hydrocele in which the processus vaginalis gets obliterated at the level of the deep inguinal ring. However, the portion distal to it remains patent and allows fluid accumulation.
HP:4000038.definition_cn: 婴儿鞘膜积液是一种鞘膜积液类型，其中鞘状突在腹股沟深环水平处闭锁，但其远端部分仍保持开放，导致液体积聚。

HP:4000039.name: Reduced proportion of mucosal-associated invariant T cells
HP:4000039.definition: A decreased proportion of circulating mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells relative to total T cell count.
HP:4000039.name_cn: 黏膜相关恒定T细胞比例降低
HP:4000039.definition_cn: 循环黏膜相关恒定T细胞（MAIT细胞）相对于总T细胞计数的比例降低。

HP:4000040.name: Puerpural onset
HP:4000040.definition: Onset of a phenotypic abnormality or a disease during childbirth or in the period immediately following.
HP:4000040.definition_cn: 围产期表型异常或疾病发作。

HP:4000041.name: AA amyloidosis
HP:4000041.definition: Extracellular tissue deposition of fibrils that are composed of fragments of and/or intact serum amyloid A protein, a hepatic acute phase reactant.
HP:4000041.definition_cn: 由血清淀粉样蛋白A（一种肝脏急性期反应物）的片段和/或完整蛋白组成的纤维在细胞外组织中的沉积。

HP:4000042.name: Fracture type
HP:4000042.definition: Category of fracture. Terms from this subontology can be used together with terms in the subontology that descends from Bone fracture (HP:0020110).
HP:4000042.definition_cn: 骨折分类。该子本体论中的术语可与源自骨折（HP:0020110）的子本体论中的术语联合使用。

HP:4000043.name: Greenstick fracture
HP:4000043.definition: A type of fracture in which the broken bone is not completely separated.

HP:4000044.name: Transverse fracture
HP:4000044.definition: A type of fracture in which the break is in a straight line across the bone.

HP:4000045.name: Spiral fracture
HP:4000045.definition: A type of fracture in which the break spirals around the bone.

HP:4000046.name: Oblique fracture
HP:4000046.definition: A type of fracture in which there is a diagonal break across the bone.

HP:4000047.name: Compression fracture
HP:4000047.definition: A type of fracture in which the bone is crushed, causing the broken bone to be wider or flatter in appearance.
HP:4000047.definition_cn: 一种骨折类型，其中骨骼被压碎，导致骨折部位在外观上变宽或变平。

HP:4000048.name: Comminuted fracture
HP:4000048.definition: A type of fracture in which the break is in three or more pieces and fragments are present at the fracture site.

HP:4000049.name: Segmental fracture
HP:4000049.definition: A type of fracture in which the same bone is fractured in two places, so there is a floating segment of bone.
HP:4000049.definition_cn: 一种骨折类型，即同一骨在两处发生骨折，导致出现游离骨段。

HP:4000050.name: Open fracture
HP:4000050.definition: A type of fracture in which there is an open wound or break in the skin near the site of the broken bone.

HP:4000051.name: Closed fracture
HP:4000051.definition: A type of fracture in which the broken bone that does not penetrate the skin.

HP:4000052.name: Avulsion fracture
HP:4000052.definition: A type of fracture that is localied near to a a tendon or ligament and a small fragment of bone is separated from the main mass of bone as a result of physical trauma.
HP:4000052.definition_cn: 一种靠近肌腱或韧带的骨折类型，由于物理创伤导致一小块骨片从主骨块中分离。

HP:4000053.name: Displaced fracture
HP:4000053.definition: A type of fracture in which the ends of the fractured bone are no longer aligned.
HP:4000053.definition_cn: 一种骨折类型，其中骨折断端不再对齐。

HP:4000055.name: Intestinal inflammation
HP:4000055.definition: A reaction characterizeds by capillary dilatation, leukocytic infiltration, redness, heat, pain, swelling localized to the in the intestinal tract.
HP:4000055.definition_cn: 一种以毛细血管扩张、白细胞浸润、发红、发热、疼痛和局限于肠道的肿胀为特征的反应。

HP:4000056.name: Abnormal apoptosis
HP:4000056.definition: Any abnormality of programmed cell death (apoptosis), which is defined as the orchestrated collapse of a cell characterized by membrane blebbing, cell shrinkage, condensation of chromatin, and fragmentation of DNA followed by rapid engulfment of the corpse by neighboring cells. Apoptosis is distinguished from death by necrosis by the absence of an associated inflammatory response.
HP:4000056.definition_cn: 程序性细胞死亡（凋亡）的任何异常，其定义为细胞的有序崩溃，特征为膜起泡、细胞皱缩、染色质凝聚和DNA片段化，随后由邻近细胞迅速吞噬尸体。凋亡与坏死性死亡的区别在于不伴随炎症反应。

HP:4000057.name: Decreased FasL-mediated apoptosis
HP:4000057.definition: A reduced amount of programmed cell death upon stimulation of the FAS receptor, which normally induces caspase-8 dependent apoptosis.
HP:4000057.name_cn: Fas配体介导的细胞凋亡减少
HP:4000057.definition_cn: 在FAS受体刺激下，程序性细胞死亡数量减少，而FAS受体通常诱导依赖caspase-8的细胞凋亡。

HP:4000058.name: Glomerular proteinuria
HP:4000058.definition: A type of proteinuria characterized by increased permeability of the glomerular capillary wall to macromolecules (particularly albumin), whereby protein excretion can reach 20 g/24 h and consists mainly of albumin.
HP:4000058.definition_cn: 一种以肾小球毛细血管壁对大分子物质（特别是白蛋白）通透性增加为特征的蛋白尿，其蛋白排泄量可达20克/24小时，且主要由白蛋白组成。

HP:4000059.name: Abnormal lung development
HP:4000059.definition: A structural defect associated with abnormal development of the lung.
HP:4000059.definition_cn: 肺发育异常相关的结构缺陷

HP:4000061.name: Pancreatic alpha-cell hyperplasia
HP:4000061.definition: A diffuse and specific increase in the number of alpha-cells.
HP:4000061.definition_cn: α细胞数量呈弥漫性和特异性增加。

HP:4000062.name: 3-4 metacarpal synostosis
HP:4000062.definition: A congenital hand malformation characterized by the coalescence of the coalescence of third and fourth metacarpals (i.e., those corresponding to the middle and ring fingers).
HP:4000062.name_cn: 第三至第四掌骨骨性连接
HP:4000062.definition_cn: 一种先天性手部畸形，其特征为第三和第四掌骨（即对应中指和无名指的掌骨）融合。

HP:4000063.name: Sleep related hallucination
HP:4000063.definition: Hallucination during onset/falling asleep in any sensory modality, usually auditory, visual, or tactile.
HP:4000063.definition_cn: 入睡/觉醒期幻觉（任何感觉形式，通常为听觉、视觉或触觉）

HP:4000064.name: Poor sleep
HP:4000064.definition: Subjectively or observationally reported sleep that is insufficiently restorative, disrupted, or of inadequate quality, regardless of duration. Poor sleep may involve difficulty maintaining sleep continuity, frequent awakenings, a sense of light or shallow sleep, or waking up feeling unrefreshed. It is typically identified through self-report or clinical interview and not by objective measurements.
HP:4000064.definition_cn: 主观或观察报告显示睡眠恢复不足、睡眠中断或睡眠质量不佳，无论持续时间长短。不良睡眠可能表现为难以维持睡眠连续性、频繁觉醒、感觉睡眠浅或轻浅，以及醒来后感觉未恢复精力。通常通过自我报告或临床访谈识别，而非客观测量。

HP:4000066.name: Abnormal iliac artery morphology
HP:4000066.definition: Any structural anomaly of the iliac artery.

HP:4000067.name: Iliac artery aneurysm
HP:4000067.definition: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the iliac artery.
HP:4000067.definition_cn: 髂动脉异常囊状扩张或动脉瘤。

HP:4000068.name: Abnormal interest
HP:4000068.definition: Any deviation from normal intensity or subject of a person's interests, which can be defined as a state of giving selective attention to something.
HP:4000068.definition_cn: 个体兴趣强度或主题的任何偏离正常状态，可定义为对某事物选择性注意的状态。

HP:4000069.name: Persistent preoccupation with parts of objects
HP:4000069.definition: A type of abnormal interest characterized by a persistent and intense focus on parts of a toy/object. For example, affected individuals may spin the wheels on a toy car rather than drive the toy car.
HP:4000069.name_cn: 对物体部分的持续关注
HP:4000069.definition_cn: 一种异常兴趣类型，其特征为对玩具/物体某一部分的持续且强烈的关注。例如，受影响的个体可能会旋转玩具车的轮子，而不是驾驶玩具车。

HP:4000070.name: Fixated interests
HP:4000070.definition: Highly restricted, fixated interests that are abnormal in intensity or focus (e.g., strong attachment to or preoccupation with unusual objects, excessively circumscribed or perseverative interests).
HP:4000070.definition_cn: 在强度或焦点上异常的高度受限、固着的兴趣（例如，对不寻常物体的强烈依恋或专注，过度局限或持续重复的兴趣）。

HP:4000072.name: Abnormal language feature
HP:4000072.definition: The presence of any atypical form of expressive language.
HP:4000072.definition_cn: 表达性语言中任何非典型形式的出现。

HP:4000073.name: Pronoun reversal
HP:4000073.definition: Atypical language features characterized by first vs. second or third person pronoun errors such as using 'you' or 'he/she' in place of 'I'.
HP:4000073.definition_cn: 以第一人称与第二或第三人称代词错误为特征的非典型语言特征，例如使用“你”或“他/她”代替“我”。

HP:4000074.name: Involuntary vocalization
HP:4000074.definition: Production of sound done without will or conscious control. Involuntary vocalizations include tics, stereotypies vocalizations as part of dystonia or chorea, continuous vocalizing behaviors such as groaning or grunting, pathological laughter and crying, and others. These vocalizations are not recognized as socially or culturally appropriate.
HP:4000074.definition_cn: 无意识或非自主性发声。非自主性发声包括抽动症、作为肌张力障碍或舞蹈病一部分的刻板性发声、持续性发声行为（如呻吟或咕哝）、病理性哭笑等。这些发声行为在社会或文化上不被视为适当。

HP:4000075.name: Reduced frequency of facial expressions
HP:4000075.definition: The number of times facial expressions are produced in a given period is lower than expected given the social and cultural context.
HP:4000075.definition_cn: 在特定时间段内，面部表情产生的频率低于基于社会文化背景的预期值。

HP:4000076.name: Use of another person's body to communicate
HP:4000076.definition: Moving another person's hand, body part, or body to communicate a desire, e.g. pushing or pulling someone toward a desired object or placing someone's hand on something.
HP:4000076.definition_cn: 通过移动他人的手、身体部位或整个身体来传达需求，例如推动或拉动某人朝向所需物体，或将某人的手放置在特定物体上。

HP:4000077.name: Fixated interest with abnormal focus
HP:4000077.definition: A fixated interest in a specific topic that is atypical for the social context of the individual, such as topics of a non-social nature like fossils or vacuum cleaners.
HP:4000077.definition_cn: 对某一特定主题的固着兴趣，该兴趣在个体的社会背景中非典型，例如非社交性质的主题，如化石或真空吸尘器。

HP:4000078.name: Fixated interest with abnormal intensity
HP:4000078.definition: An abnormally intense interest in a topic or object that is not atypical for the social context of the affected person.
HP:4000078.definition_cn: 对某一主题或物体表现出异常强烈的兴趣，且该兴趣在受影响个体的社会背景下并不典型。

HP:4000079.name: Sensory seeking
HP:4000079.definition: Unusual interest in sensory aspects of the environment.
HP:4000079.definition_cn: 对环境感官方面的异常兴趣。

HP:4000081.name: Reduced production of gestures
HP:4000081.definition: Diminished use of typical non-verbal conversational gestures such as shaking the head to indicate no or nodding the head to indicate yes.
HP:4000081.definition_cn: 典型非语言交流手势使用减少，例如摇头表示否定或点头表示肯定。

HP:4000082.name: Reduced cooperative play
HP:4000082.definition: Impairment in a child's ability to be able to play in a way that involves peer collaboration. Collaborative play involves things such as verbal and non-verbal communication (e.g., self-initiated interactions), turn-taking, sharing, reciprocity, and collaborative problem-solving. It is often contrasted to parallel play, which involves a form of social play in which two children do similar activities near each other and often mimic each other. Typically developing children develop collaborative play between the ages of 4 and 5.
HP:4000082.definition_cn: 儿童在参与同伴协作游戏方面的能力受损。协作游戏涉及言语和非言语交流（例如，自发性互动）、轮流、分享、互惠以及协作解决问题。它通常与平行游戏相对比，平行游戏是一种社交游戏形式，其中两个儿童在彼此附近进行类似的活动，并经常相互模仿。典型发育的儿童在4至5岁之间发展出协作游戏能力。

HP:4000083.name: Lack of interest in peers
HP:4000083.definition: Lack of interest in peers of comparable age and social groups is evident when an individual, such as a child, shows more interest in socializing with adults rather than children their own age.
HP:4000083.definition_cn: 对同龄人及相应社会群体缺乏兴趣的表现，在个体（如儿童）中尤为明显，其更倾向于与成年人而非同龄儿童进行社交互动。

HP:4000084.name: Reduced sharing of interests
HP:4000084.definition: An absence or abnormally low frequency of engaging with others to share personal interests or topics. Interest sharing includes offers of information about oneself as a form of social interaction.
HP:4000084.definition_cn: 社交兴趣分享缺失或频率异常低下。兴趣分享包括以社交互动形式提供关于自身的信息。

HP:4000085.name: Reduced object sharing
HP:4000085.definition: An absence or reduction in object sharing. Object sharing is an early emerging social skill in which a child will share objects such as toys, balls, or books with parents or peers during object play.
HP:4000085.definition_cn: 物体共享缺失或减少。物体共享是一种早期发展的社交技能，指儿童在物体游戏过程中与父母或同伴分享玩具、球类或书籍等物品。

HP:4000087.name: Abnormal communicative facial expressions
HP:4000087.definition: Abnormal expressions (movements or position of muscles of the face that convey the emotional state of an individual to observers during social interactions) comprising abnormalities of quantity, range, context-appropriateness, and quality.
HP:4000087.definition_cn: 面部表情异常（在社交互动中，面部肌肉的运动或位置向观察者传达个体情感状态）包括数量异常、范围异常、情境适宜性异常及质量异常。

HP:4000088.name: Facial expressions that do not match the context
HP:4000088.definition: Production of facial expressions that are misaligned with the social context.
HP:4000088.definition_cn: 面部表情的产生与社会情境不符。

HP:4000089.name: Abnormal quality of facial expression
HP:4000089.definition: Spontaneous production of communicative facial expressions that have poor quality or are exaggerated or muted.
HP:4000089.definition_cn: 自发性产生质量较差、夸张或减弱的交流性面部表情。

HP:4000090.name: Abnormal gesture use
HP:4000090.definition: Abnormality in the use of gestures defined as hand, shoulder, and head movements that convey a shared meaning within a culture that replace or supplement verbal communication.
HP:4000090.definition_cn: 手势使用异常，定义为在特定文化中具有共同意义的手部、肩部和头部运动，用以替代或补充言语交流。

HP:4000092.name: Poor conversational reciprocity
HP:4000092.definition: Reduced use of reciprocal (back and forth) conversation, as compared to what would be expected for language level.
HP:4000092.definition_cn: 与预期语言水平相比，互惠性（双向）对话的使用减少。

HP:4000093.name: Ectopic tooth eruption
HP:4000093.definition: A condition in which the permanent teeth, because of deficiency of growth in the jaw or segment of jaw, assume a path of eruption that intercepts a primary tooth, causes its premature loss and produces a consequent malposition of the permanent tooth.
HP:4000093.definition_cn: 由于颌骨或颌骨节段生长不足，导致恒牙萌出路径受阻，进而引发乳牙过早脱落，并导致恒牙错位的一种病症。

HP:4000094.name: Corpus cavernosum hypoplasia
HP:4000094.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by undergrowth of the corpus cavernosum.
HP:4000094.definition_cn: 一种以海绵体发育不全为特征的发育异常。

HP:4000095.name: Elevated circulating thymine concentration
HP:4000095.definition: Concentration of the nucleobase thymine in the blood circulation above the normal range.
HP:4000095.name_cn: 循环胸腺嘧啶浓度升高
HP:4000095.definition_cn: 血液中胸腺嘧啶浓度超出正常范围。

HP:4000100.name: Positive lactose hydrogen breath test
HP:4000100.definition: Elevated hydrogen gas level in exhaled breath following oral administration of lactose. In individuals with lactose intolerance, undigested lactose in the colon will be metabolized by colonic bacteria, releasing hydrogen gas.
HP:4000100.definition_cn: 口服乳糖后呼气中氢气水平升高。在乳糖不耐受个体中，未消化的乳糖在结肠内被结肠细菌代谢，释放出氢气。

HP:4000101.name: Triggered by exposure to medication
HP:4000101.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a medication.
HP:4000101.definition_cn: 适用于由药物暴露引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:4000102.name: Triggered by allopurinol
HP:4000102.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to allopurinol.
HP:4000102.definition_cn: 适用于由别嘌呤醇暴露引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:4000103.name: Ameliorated by oral zinc supplementation
HP:4000103.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by oral zinc supplementation.
HP:4000103.definition_cn: 适用于通过口服锌补充剂改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:4000104.name: Curved dental root
HP:4000104.definition: A root of a tooth that is more rounded than normal.
HP:4000104.definition_cn: 牙根形态异常（牙根圆钝）

HP:4000105.name: Abnormal four chamber view of the fetal heart
HP:4000105.definition: The four-chamber (4Ch) view of the fetal heart is the most widely used screening examination for the detection of structural cardiac abnormalities during routine fetal ultrasonography. In the healthy normal fetus, the apical 4Ch view demonstrates four well-developed chambers, a concordant atrioventricular (AV) connection, unobstructed AV valves (mitral and tricuspid valves), the foramen ovale flap opening into left atrium (LA), and an intact interventricular septum. Additionally, the pulmonary venous opening can be visualized at the LA wall. Any structural deviations from normal anatomy may lead to congenital heart disease that can be determined by the 4Ch view of the fetal heart's ultrasound imaging.
HP:4000105.name_cn: 胎儿心脏四腔心切面异常
HP:4000105.definition_cn: 胎儿心脏四腔心切面（4Ch）是常规胎儿超声检查中最广泛用于筛查结构性心脏异常的检查方法。在健康正常的胎儿中，心尖四腔心切面显示四个发育良好的心腔、一致的房室连接、无梗阻的房室瓣（二尖瓣和三尖瓣）、卵圆孔瓣向左心房（LA）开放以及完整的室间隔。此外，肺静脉开口可在左心房壁上观察到。任何与正常解剖结构的偏离都可能导致先天性心脏病，这些异常可通过胎儿心脏超声成像的四腔心切面来确定。

HP:4000106.name: Spleen hamartoma
HP:4000106.definition: A hamartomatous lesion (benign focal lesions composed of disorganized tissue elements) localized in the spleen.
HP:4000106.definition_cn: 脾脏局灶性错构瘤（由紊乱组织成分构成的良性局灶性病变）。

HP:4000107.name: Positive lupus band test
HP:4000107.definition: Deposits of immunoglobulins and complement components along the dermoepidermal junction.
HP:4000107.definition_cn: 免疫球蛋白和补体成分沿真皮-表皮交界处沉积。

HP:4000108.name: Bone marrow erythroid vacuolization
HP:4000108.definition: Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of erythroid precursors in the bone marrow.
HP:4000108.definition_cn: 骨髓中红系前体细胞胞质内空泡形成（细胞质内出现无细胞质、由膜包绕并充满液体的空间）。

HP:4000109.name: Triggered by electromagnetic field
HP:4000109.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to an electromagnetic field.
HP:4000109.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于电磁场引发或导致的体征或症状。

HP:4000110.name: Exposure history
HP:4000110.definition: Information about current and past exposure to metals, dust, fibers, fumes, chemicals, biologic hazards, radiation, noise, and/or vibration at work or home.
HP:4000110.definition_cn: 关于当前及既往在工作或家庭环境中接触金属、粉尘、纤维、烟雾、化学品、生物危害、辐射、噪音和/或振动的信息。

HP:4000111.name: Asbestos exposure
HP:4000111.definition: History of exposure to asbestos, a fibrous mineral with physical and chemical properties that make it resistant to heat and degradation.
HP:4000111.definition_cn: 石棉暴露史，石棉是一种纤维状矿物，其物理和化学特性使其具有耐热性和抗降解性。

HP:4000112.name: Medication history
HP:4000112.definition: Information about current or past medications taken by an individual.
HP:4000112.definition_cn: 个体当前或既往用药史信息。

HP:4000113.name: Aminoglycoside exposure
HP:4000113.definition: History of having taken aminoglycoside antibiotics.
HP:4000113.definition_cn: 既往使用氨基糖苷类抗生素史。

HP:4000114.name: Statin exposure
HP:4000114.definition: History of having taken statins, also known as HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors.
HP:4000114.definition_cn: 既往服用他汀类药物史，亦称3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A（HMG-CoA）还原酶抑制剂。

HP:4000115.name: Potassium-sparing diuretic exposure
HP:4000115.definition: History of having taken a potassium-sparing diuretic exposure such as amiloride, eplerenone, spironolactone, and triamterene.
HP:4000115.definition_cn: 既往使用保钾利尿剂暴露史，如阿米洛利、依普利酮、螺内酯和氨苯蝶啶。

HP:4000117.name: Valproate exposure
HP:4000117.definition: History of having taken valproate (valproic acid).
HP:4000117.definition_cn: 既往服用丙戊酸盐（丙戊酸）史。

HP:4000119.name: Calcium channel blocker exposure
HP:4000119.definition: History of having taken a calcium channel blocker such as amlodipine, nicardipine, nifedipine, verapamil, or diltiazem.
HP:4000119.definition_cn: 既往服用钙通道阻滞剂（如氨氯地平、尼卡地平、硝苯地平、维拉帕米或地尔硫卓）的病史。

HP:4000121.name: Triggered by poison ivy, poson oak, or sumac
HP:4000121.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure (cutaneous contact) to poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac. These three plants each contain urushiol. Contact with these plants is the most common causes of clinically diagnosed allergic contact dermatitis.
HP:4000121.name_cn: 由毒葛、毒橡树或漆树引发的接触性皮炎
HP:4000121.definition_cn: 适用于因接触（皮肤接触）毒葛、毒橡树和毒漆树而引发或导致的体征或症状。这三种植物均含有漆酚。接触这些植物是临床诊断的过敏性接触性皮炎的最常见原因。

HP:4000122.name: History of exclusive breast feeding
HP:4000122.definition: A past medical history of having been fed exclusively by breast feeding.

HP:4000123.name: Nutrition history
HP:4000123.definition: A part of the past medical history consisting of information about the typical food intake of an individual.
HP:4000123.definition_cn: 既往病史中关于个体典型食物摄入情况的部分。

HP:4000124.name: High dietary oxalate intake
HP:4000124.definition: A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing high levels of oxalate, such as green-leaf vegetables, tea, nuts, chocolate and rhubarb.
HP:4000124.definition_cn: 既往摄入大量富含草酸盐的食物史，如绿叶蔬菜、茶叶、坚果、巧克力和大黄。

HP:4000125.name: Recent honey ingestion
HP:4000125.definition: A history of ingestion of honey in recent weeks.

HP:4000126.name: Raw egg-white ingestion
HP:4000126.definition: A history of eating raw egg whites.

HP:4000127.name: Exacerbated by sodium channel blocking agent exposure
HP:4000127.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by administration of sodium channel blocking agents such as phenytoin, carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, lamotrigine, topiramate, and zonisamide.
HP:4000127.name_cn: 钠通道阻滞剂暴露导致的病情加重
HP:4000127.definition_cn: 应用于因使用钠通道阻滞剂（如苯妥英、卡马西平、奥卡西平、拉莫三嗪、托吡酯和唑尼沙胺）而加重的体征或症状。

HP:4000128.name: Addictive nitrous oxide use
HP:4000128.definition: Addiction to inhaled nitrous oxide gas (N2O) is a growing concern.
HP:4000128.name_cn: 成瘾性一氧化二氮使用
HP:4000128.definition_cn: 吸入性一氧化二氮（N2O）成瘾问题日益引起关注。

HP:4000129.name: Recent blood transfusion
HP:4000129.definition: A past medical history of a recent blood transfusion.

HP:4000130.name: Ameliorated by colchicine
HP:4000130.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of colchizine.
HP:4000130.definition_cn: 适用于通过秋水仙碱给药后改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:4000131.name: Ameliorated by vitamin D
HP:4000131.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of vitamin D.
HP:4000131.definition_cn: 适用于通过维生素D给药改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:4000132.name: Exacerbated by phenytoin exposure
HP:4000132.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by administration of phenytoin.
HP:4000132.name_cn: 苯妥英暴露导致的病情加重
HP:4000132.definition_cn: 应用于因苯妥英给药而加重的体征或症状。

HP:4000133.name: Triggered by angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor
HP:4000133.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to anngiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor such as benazepril, captopril, enalapril, fosinopril, and lisinopril.
HP:4000133.name_cn: 由血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂引发
HP:4000133.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂（如贝那普利、卡托普利、依那普利、福辛普利和赖诺普利）所引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:4000134.name: Prostaglandin E1 exposure
HP:4000134.definition: History of having been treateed with prostaglandin E1.
HP:4000134.definition_cn: 既往接受过前列腺素E1治疗史。

HP:4000135.name: 5-fluorouracil exposure
HP:4000135.definition: History of having been treated with 5-fluorouracil.
HP:4000135.definition_cn: 既往接受过5-氟尿嘧啶治疗史。

HP:4000136.name: 6-mercaptopurine exposure
HP:4000136.definition: History of having been treateed with 6-mercaptopurine.
HP:4000136.definition_cn: 曾接受6-巯基嘌呤治疗史。

HP:4000137.name: Isoniazid exposure
HP:4000137.definition: History of having been treateed with isoniazid.
HP:4000137.definition_cn: 既往接受异烟肼治疗史。

HP:4000138.name: Absent cavum septum pellucidum
HP:4000138.definition: The cavum septum pellucidum (CSP) is an important fetal midline forebrain landmark that is normally visible by prenatal sonography. This term refers to the lack of visibility of the CSP on prenatal sonography. The CSP normally can be visualized between 18 and 37 weeks of gestation. Lack of visualization of the CSP in this time period generally requires follow up and may indicate the presence of underlying malformations such as malformations of the corpus callosum. The lack of CSP before 18 weeks or after 37 weeks of gestation (or postnatally) is considered a normal finding.
HP:4000138.definition_cn: 透明隔腔（Cavum Septum Pellucidum, CSP）是胎儿中线前脑的重要标志，通常在产前超声检查中可见。该术语指的是在产前超声检查中未能观察到透明隔腔。透明隔腔通常在妊娠18至37周之间可见。在此时间段内未能观察到透明隔腔通常需要进一步随访，并可能提示存在潜在的畸形，如胼胝体畸形。在妊娠18周之前或37周之后（或出生后）未能观察到透明隔腔被认为是正常现象。

HP:4000139.name: Fetal abdominal cyst
HP:4000139.definition: Fetal abdominal cysts are usually detected during the second trimester anomaly scan or discovered incidentally at later gestations. However, a definitive diagnosis is often not made until postnatal life. The most common etiologies of fetal abdominal cysts are: ovarian, gastrointestinal cystic duplication, liver and choledochal, meconium pseudocysts, mesenteric and adrenal. Following identification of a cyst, careful morphological assessment allows the prediction of their natural history and importantly, the likelihood of surgical intervention being required postnatally.
HP:4000139.definition_cn: 胎儿腹腔囊肿通常在妊娠中期异常扫描时被检测到，或在妊娠后期偶然发现。然而，明确的诊断通常需在出生后才能确定。胎儿腹腔囊肿最常见的病因包括：卵巢囊肿、胃肠道重复囊肿、肝脏及胆总管囊肿、胎粪假性囊肿、肠系膜囊肿和肾上腺囊肿。在发现囊肿后，通过仔细的形态学评估可以预测其自然病程，尤其是判断出生后是否需要手术干预的可能性。

HP:4000140.name: Fetal bowel dilatation
HP:4000140.definition: Fetal bowel dilatation is characterized by fluid-filled intestinal loops which measure at least fifteen millimeters long or seven millimeters in diameter. Ultrasonographic image of dilated fetal bowel is a sign of intestinal mechanical or functional obstruction and its prevalence will depend on the underlying condition: bowel atresia or stenosis, malrotation with volvulus, meconium ileus, total colonic aganglionosis, and meconium plug syndrome. The etiology of fetal bowel dilatation is a difficult prenatal diagnosis since ultrasound has limited accuracy for bowel evaluation.
HP:4000140.definition_cn: 胎儿肠管扩张的特征是充满液体的肠袢，其长度至少为十五毫米或直径为七毫米。扩张胎儿肠管的超声图像是肠道机械性或功能性梗阻的征象，其发生率取决于基础疾病：肠闭锁或狭窄、肠旋转不良伴肠扭转、胎粪性肠梗阻、全结肠无神经节细胞症以及胎粪塞综合征。胎儿肠管扩张的病因学在产前诊断中较为困难，因为超声在肠道评估方面的准确性有限。

HP:4000141.name: Left ventricular dilatation
HP:4000141.definition: Enlargement of the chamber of the left heart ventricle.

HP:4000142.name: Fetal trigonocephaly
HP:4000142.definition: A fetal ultrasound finding defined by flattening of the occiput with pointing of the frontal bones and brachycephaly with an increased cephalic index. It is characterized by keel shaped deformity of forehead with midline ridge, bilateral fronto temporal constriction with compensatory biparietal expansion, supra orbital and lateral orbital retrusion and hypotelorism. This finding is said to resemble a strawberry.
HP:4000142.definition_cn: 胎儿超声检查发现，定义为枕骨扁平伴额骨尖突及短头畸形，头指数增加。其特征为前额呈龙骨状畸形伴中线嵴，双侧额颞部缩窄伴代偿性双顶骨扩张，眶上及眶外侧后缩，以及眼距过窄。此发现被描述为类似草莓形状。

HP:4000143.name: Abnormal fetal heart outflow tract
HP:4000143.definition: A prenatal anomaly of the outflow tract. Fetal ultrasound may not always be able to easily and accurately describe the outflow anomaly, but can detect abnormal anatomy. Often, follow up with a fetal echo is recommended, but fetal ultrasound is limited.
HP:4000143.definition_cn: 流出道产前异常。胎儿超声检查可能无法总是轻松且准确地描述流出道异常，但能够检测到解剖结构异常。通常建议进行胎儿超声心动图随访，但胎儿超声检查存在局限性。

HP:4000144.name: Recent past medical history
HP:4000144.definition: History of events that precede the current presenting condition and are thought to be of potential relevance, having occurred in the hours, days, or weeks before the current condition.
HP:4000144.definition_cn: 既往病史中与当前主诉相关的潜在相关事件，包括在当前病情发生前数小时、数天或数周内发生的事件。

HP:4000145.name: History of recent viral illness
HP:4000145.definition: Medical history of a viral illness in recent weeks.
HP:4000145.definition_cn: 近期病毒性疾病的既往病史。

HP:4000146.name: History of recent dental procedure
HP:4000146.definition: Medical history of a dental procedure in recent weeks.

HP:4000147.name: Abnormal hepatic artery morphology
HP:4000147.definition: Any structural anomaly of the hepatic artery or its branches.
HP:4000147.definition_cn: 肝动脉或其分支的任何结构异常。

HP:4000148.name: Hepatic artery hyperplasia
HP:4000148.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the hepatic arteries.

HP:4000149.name: Lymph node necrosis
HP:4000149.definition: Areas of necrotic tissue within a lymph node.
HP:4000149.definition_cn: 淋巴结内坏死组织区域。

HP:4000150.name: Multinucleated neuron
HP:4000150.definition: Neurons that contain more than one nucleus.

HP:4000151.name: History of recent contralateral injury
HP:4000151.definition: A history of an injury that occurred several hours, days, or weeks before the current presenting complaint and is located on the other side of the body relative to the current presenting complaint.
HP:4000151.definition_cn: 既往损伤史，发生于当前主诉前数小时、数天或数周，且位于当前主诉对侧身体部位。

HP:4000152.name: Alternating laterality
HP:4000152.definition: Occurring on the left and right in succession. This term can refer to alternating sides of the body (e.g., Alternating hemiplegia) or alternative sides of the visual field (e.g., some migraine auras).
HP:4000152.definition_cn: 左右交替发生。该术语可指身体两侧的交替（例如，交替性偏瘫）或视野两侧的交替（例如，某些偏头痛先兆）。

HP:4000153.name: Cervical squamous cell papilloma
HP:4000153.definition: A benign tumor arising from the epithelial surface of the cervix and usually caused by Human Papillomavirus infection.
HP:4000153.name_cn: 宫颈鳞状细胞乳头状瘤
HP:4000153.definition_cn: 宫颈上皮良性肿瘤，通常由人乳头瘤病毒感染引起。

HP:4000154.name: Liver leiomyoma
HP:4000154.definition: A benign smooth muscle neoplasm that arises in the liver.

HP:4000158.name: Typified by high penetrance
HP:4000158.definition: Description of conditions in which only an incomplete but relatively high proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for incomplete, but high penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least 80 percent but less than 100 percent of individuals with the given genotype would manifest the disease with a full lifespan.
HP:4000158.definition_cn: 描述在假设完整寿命为80岁的情况下，无论年龄如何，仅有部分但相对较高比例的携带特定基因型的个体会表现出疾病的情况。对于不完全但高外显率，目前尚无普遍接受的定义，但我们建议，如果至少80%但不足100%的携带该基因型的个体在完整寿命内会表现出疾病，则应用此术语。

HP:4000159.name: Typified by moderate penetrance
HP:4000159.definition: Description of conditions in which only a moderate proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for moderate penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least 20 percent but less than 80 percent of individuals with the given genotype would manifest the disease with a full lifespan.
HP:4000159.definition_cn: 描述在假设完整寿命为80岁的情况下，无论年龄如何，仅有中等比例的携带特定基因型的个体表现出疾病的情况。目前尚无普遍接受的中等外显率定义，但我们建议，如果携带特定基因型的个体在完整寿命内至少有20%但低于80%的比例表现出疾病，则适用该术语。

HP:4000160.name: Typified by low penetrance
HP:4000160.definition: Description of conditions in which only a low proportion of individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease regardless of age assuming a full lifespan of 80 years. There is no commonly accepted definition for low penetrance, but we suggest that this term be applied if at least some but less than 20 percent of carriers would manifest the disease with a full lifespan.
HP:4000160.definition_cn: 描述在假设完整寿命为80年的情况下，无论年龄如何，仅有低比例携带特定基因型的个体表现出疾病的情况。目前对于低外显率尚无普遍接受的定义，但我们建议若在完整寿命内至少有一部分但少于20%的携带者会表现出疾病，则可采用该术语。

HP:4000162.name: Decreased Succinyl-CoA 3-ketoacid CoA transferase activity
HP:4000162.definition: Decreased activity of the enzyme succinyl-CoA 3-ketoacid CoA transferase.
HP:4000162.name_cn: 琥珀酰辅酶A 3-酮酸辅酶A转移酶活性降低
HP:4000162.definition_cn: 琥珀酰辅酶A 3-酮酸辅酶A转移酶活性降低。

HP:4000163.name: Reduced phytanic acid oxidase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000163.definition: Activity of the enzyme phytanoyl-CoA hydroxylase (PhyH; EC 1.14.11.18) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. PhyH plays a role in the catabolism of phytanic acid, a branched-chain fatty acid that is a normal constituent of the human diet.
HP:4000163.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中植烷酸氧化酶活性降低
HP:4000163.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中植烷酰辅酶A羟化酶（PhyH；EC 1.14.11.18）活性低于正常下限。PhyH在植烷酸的分解代谢中起重要作用，植烷酸是一种支链脂肪酸，是人类饮食中的正常成分。

HP:4000164.name: Reduced bifunctional protein activity
HP:4000164.definition: Diminished activity of hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 4 (HSD17B4), also known as D-bifunctional protein (DBP), a peroxisomal enzyme that catalyzes multiple steps of beta-oxidation of very long chain fatty acids.
HP:4000164.definition_cn: 17-β羟类固醇脱氢酶4（HSD17B4）活性降低，该酶也被称为D-双功能蛋白（DBP），是一种过氧化物酶体酶，催化极长链脂肪酸β-氧化的多个步骤。

HP:4000165.name: Decreased circulating plasmalogen concentration
HP:4000165.definition: Reduced plasmalogen concentration in the blood circulation.
HP:4000165.name_cn: 循环血浆缩醛磷脂浓度降低
HP:4000165.definition_cn: 血液循环中缩醛磷脂浓度降低。

HP:4000166.name: Post-vaccination varicella zoster virus infection
HP:4000166.definition: Infection with live, attenuated varicella-zoster virus following vaccination. This is an extremely rare event that may indicate immunocompromise.
HP:4000166.name_cn: 疫苗接种后水痘带状疱疹病毒感染
HP:4000166.definition_cn: 接种减毒活水痘-带状疱疹病毒疫苗后感染。此事件极为罕见，可能提示免疫功能低下。

HP:4000167.name: Recent steroid exposure
HP:4000167.definition: History of having been treated with corticosteroid medications in recent weeks.
HP:4000167.definition_cn: 近期有糖皮质激素类药物治疗史。

HP:4000168.name: Shark teeth
HP:4000168.definition: Eruption of permanent teeth behind deciduous (baby) teeth before they have fallen out, resulting in a double row of teeth. This phenomen is typically observed between the ages of 5 to 7 years.
HP:4000168.definition_cn: 乳牙未脱落时恒牙在其后方萌出，导致双排牙现象。此现象通常见于5至7岁儿童。

HP:4000169.name: Pontine T2 hypointensity
HP:4000169.definition: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the pons.
HP:4000169.definition_cn: 脑桥磁共振成像（MRI）中T2信号较预期更暗。

HP:4000170.name: Anti-platelet antigen antibody positivity
HP:4000170.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against antigens present on the surface of thrombocytes such as the glycoproteins GPIIb/IIIa, GPIb/IX, and GPIa/IIa.
HP:4000170.name_cn: 抗血小板抗原抗体阳性
HP:4000170.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体（免疫球蛋白），这些抗体与血小板表面抗原如糖蛋白GPIIb/IIIa、GPIb/IX和GPIa/IIa发生反应。

HP:4000171.name: Anti-voltage-gated potassium channel antibody positivity
HP:4000171.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a voltage-gated potassium channel.
HP:4000171.name_cn: 抗电压门控钾通道抗体阳性
HP:4000171.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对电压门控钾通道的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:4000172.name: Vegan diet
HP:4000172.definition: A history of following a vegan diet characterized by avoidance of food sourced from animals including meet, fish, and dairy products.
HP:4000172.definition_cn: 既往遵循纯素饮食史，其特征为避免摄入来源于动物的食物，包括肉类、鱼类及乳制品。

HP:4000173.name: History of previous pregnancy with hydrops fetalis
HP:4000173.definition: One or more previous pregnancies in which the fetus developed hydrops fetalis.
HP:4000173.name_cn: 既往妊娠史伴胎儿水肿
HP:4000173.definition_cn: 既往一次或多次妊娠中胎儿出现胎儿水肿。

HP:4000174.name: Ameliorated by potassium supplements
HP:4000174.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingesting a potassium supplement.
HP:4000174.definition_cn: 适用于通过摄入钾补充剂而改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:4000175.name: Ameliorated by niacin
HP:4000175.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingesting niacin (vitamin B3).
HP:4000175.definition_cn: 适用于通过摄入烟酸（维生素B3）改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:4000176.name: Aggravated by exposure to medication
HP:4000176.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with a medication.

HP:4000177.name: Bleeding ameliorated by vitamin K
HP:4000177.definition: Applies to bleeding that is significantly reduced by treatment with vitamin K.
HP:4000177.definition_cn: 适用于经维生素K治疗后显著减少的出血。

HP:4000178.name: Anti-retroviral therapy exposure
HP:4000178.definition: History of having been treated with an antiretroviral agent.
HP:4000178.name_cn: 抗逆转录病毒治疗暴露
HP:4000178.definition_cn: 既往接受抗逆转录病毒药物治疗史。

HP:4000179.name: Potassium-wasting diuretic exposure
HP:4000179.definition: History of having been treated with a potassium-wasting diuretic such as thiazide (chlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, hydrochlorothiazide, indapamide, metolazone) and loop (bumetanide, ethacrynic acid, furosemide, torsemide) diuretics.
HP:4000179.definition_cn: 既往曾使用排钾利尿剂治疗史，如噻嗪类（氯噻嗪、氯噻酮、氢氯噻嗪、吲达帕胺、美托拉宗）和袢利尿剂（布美他尼、依他尼酸、呋塞米、托拉塞米）。

HP:4000180.name: Tricyclic antidepressant exposure
HP:4000180.definition: History of having been treated with a tricyclic antidepressant medication.
HP:4000180.definition_cn: 既往接受三环类抗抑郁药物治疗史。

HP:4000181.name: Excessive dental attrition
HP:4000181.definition: A higher than expected amount of attrition of teeth, as menifested by loss of tooth characteristics including rounding or sharpening of incisal edges, loss of cusps, and fracturing of teeth, to an extent that is deemed more than would be expected at a given age.
HP:4000181.definition_cn: 牙齿磨损程度高于预期，表现为牙齿特征的丧失，包括切缘的圆钝或锐化、牙尖的丧失以及牙齿的断裂，其程度被认为超过特定年龄段的预期范围。

HP:4000182.name: Positionally dependent pain
HP:4000182.definition: Pain improves or worsens with changes in body position.
HP:4000182.definition_cn: 疼痛随体位改变而缓解或加重。

HP:4000183.name: Abnormal erythrocyte adenosine triphosphate concentration
HP:4000183.definition: Concentration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in red blood cells (erythrocytes) outside of the normal range.
HP:4000183.name_cn: 异常红细胞三磷酸腺苷浓度
HP:4000183.definition_cn: 红细胞（红细胞）中三磷酸腺苷（ATP）浓度超出正常范围。

HP:4000184.name: Reduced erythrocyte adenosine triphosphate concentration
HP:4000184.definition: Concentration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in red blood cells (erythrocytes) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:4000184.name_cn: 红细胞三磷酸腺苷浓度降低
HP:4000184.definition_cn: 红细胞（红细胞）内三磷酸腺苷（ATP）浓度低于正常下限。

HP:4000186.name: Elevated erythrocyte adenosine triphosphate concentration
HP:4000186.definition: Concentration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in red blood cells (erythrocytes) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:4000186.name_cn: 红细胞三磷酸腺苷浓度升高
HP:4000186.definition_cn: 红细胞（红细胞）内三磷酸腺苷（ATP）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:4000187.name: Spermatogonial maturation arrest
HP:4000187.definition: A type of spermatogenesis maturation arrest in which the block of developmental occurs in the spermatogonial stage. Testicular histology shows seminiferous tubules with Sertoli cells and spermatogonial cells but no further differentiated cells like spermatocytes or round spermatids.
HP:4000187.definition_cn: 一种精子发生成熟阻滞类型，其发育阻滞发生在精原细胞阶段。睾丸组织学显示生精小管中存在支持细胞和精原细胞，但无进一步分化的细胞如精母细胞或圆形精子细胞。

HP:4000189.name: Elevated circulating neuron-specific enolase concentration
HP:4000189.definition: Concentration of neuron-specific enolase above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:4000189.name_cn: 循环神经元特异性烯醇化酶浓度升高
HP:4000189.definition_cn: 循环血液中神经元特异性烯醇化酶浓度高于正常上限。

HP:4000190.name: Reduced leukocyte alpha-mannosidase activity
HP:4000190.definition: Concentration or activity of an alpha-mannosidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
HP:4000190.name_cn: 白细胞α-甘露糖苷酶活性降低
HP:4000190.definition_cn: 白细胞中测得的α-甘露糖苷酶浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。

HP:4000191.name: Increased circulating alpha-mannosidase activity
HP:4000191.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:4000191.name_cn: 循环中α-甘露糖苷酶活性增加
HP:4000191.definition_cn: 血液循环中α-甘露糖苷酶浓度或活性高于正常上限。

HP:4000192.name: Reduced leukocyte cathepsin D activity
HP:4000192.definition: Concentration or activity of cathepsin D as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal. The reduction in cathepsin D activity can also be measured in fibroblasts.
HP:4000192.name_cn: 白细胞组织蛋白酶D活性降低
HP:4000192.definition_cn: 白细胞中测定的组织蛋白酶D浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。成纤维细胞中亦可检测到组织蛋白酶D活性降低。

HP:4000193.name: Reduced leukocyte N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase activity
HP:4000193.definition: Concentration or activity of N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
HP:4000193.name_cn: 白细胞N-磺基葡萄糖胺磺基水解酶活性降低
HP:4000193.definition_cn: 白细胞中测得的N-磺基葡萄糖胺磺基水解酶浓度或活性低于正常范围。

HP:4000194.name: Pseudohyperkalemia
HP:4000194.definition: Pseudohyperkalemia describes a falsely elevated potassium level upon measurement of the serum electrolyte concentration due to disruption of cells during the collection or processing of the sample.
HP:4000194.definition_cn: 假性高钾血症是指在血清电解质浓度测量过程中，由于样本采集或处理过程中细胞破坏导致的钾水平假性升高。

HP:4000195.name: Abnormal enzyme activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000195.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in cultured fibroblasts. Fibroblasts are easy to grow in culture and are the main cell type involved in producing extracellular matrix. They are used as a convenient model system for measuring enzyme activity for enzymes that are not expressed in blood cells. Usually, the test is done in fibroblasts for convenience rather than for the investigation of a pathophysiology specific to fibroblasts.
HP:4000195.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中酶活性异常
HP:4000195.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中酶的浓度或活性高于或低于正常范围。成纤维细胞易于在培养中生长，并且是参与产生细胞外基质的主要细胞类型。它们被用作测量不在血细胞中表达的酶活性的便捷模型系统。通常，出于方便而非针对成纤维细胞特定病理生理学的研究，该检测在成纤维细胞中进行。

HP:4000196.name: Reduced heparan-alpha-glucosaminide N-acetyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000196.definition: Concentration or activity of N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.
HP:4000196.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中肝素-α-葡萄糖苷酶N-乙酰转移酶活性降低
HP:4000196.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的N-磺基葡萄糖胺磺基水解酶浓度或活性低于正常范围。

HP:4000197.name: Reduced N-acetylgalactosamine-6-sulfate sulfatase in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000197.definition: Concentration or activity of N-acetylgalactosamine-6-sulfate sulfatase as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.
HP:4000197.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中N-乙酰半乳糖胺-6-硫酸酯酶活性降低
HP:4000197.definition_cn: 在培养的成纤维细胞中测得的N-乙酰半乳糖胺-6-硫酸酯酶浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。

HP:4000198.name: Reduced acetylglucosamine-6-sulfate sulfatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000198.definition: Concentration or activity of N-acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase (EC 3.1.6.14) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. N-acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase hydrolyzes heparan sulfate and keratan sulfate.
HP:4000198.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中乙酰氨基葡萄糖-6-硫酸酯酶活性降低
HP:4000198.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖-6-硫酸酯酶（EC 3.1.6.14）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖-6-硫酸酯酶可水解硫酸乙酰肝素和硫酸角质素。

HP:4000199.name: Reduced erythrocyte porphobilinogen deaminase activity
HP:4000199.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of porphobilinogen deaminase (EC 4.3.1.8) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:4000199.name_cn: 红细胞卟胆原脱氨酶活性降低
HP:4000199.definition_cn: 红细胞中卟胆原脱氨酶（EC 4.3.1.8）活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:4000200.name: Reduced holocarboxylase synthetase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000200.definition: Concentration or activity of holocarboxylase synthetase (EC 6.3.4.10) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.
HP:4000200.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中全羧化酶合成酶活性降低
HP:4000200.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中全羧化酶合成酶（EC 6.3.4.10）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。

HP:4000201.name: Abnormal circulating alpha mannosidase activity
HP:4000201.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase outside of the limits of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:4000201.name_cn: 异常循环α-甘露糖苷酶活性
HP:4000201.definition_cn: 血液循环中α-甘露糖苷酶浓度或活性超出正常范围。

HP:4000202.name: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase activity
HP:4000202.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.49) is below the limits of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts.
HP:4000202.name_cn: 组织α-N-乙酰半乳糖胺酶活性降低
HP:4000202.definition_cn: α-N-乙酰半乳糖胺酶（EC 3.2.1.49）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。该活性可在多种组织中测定，包括培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:4000203.name: Reduced erythrocyte arginase activity
HP:4000203.definition: Activity or concentration of arginase (EC 3.5.3.1) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Arginase catalyzes the last step of the urea cycle.
HP:4000203.name_cn: 红细胞精氨酸酶活性降低
HP:4000203.definition_cn: 红细胞中精氨酸酶（EC 3.5.3.1）活性或浓度低于正常下限。精氨酸酶催化尿素循环的最后一步。

HP:4000204.name: Reduced mitochondrial acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000204.definition: Concentration or activity of mitochondrial acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.9) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.
HP:4000204.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中线粒体乙酰辅酶A乙酰转移酶活性降低
HP:4000204.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的线粒体乙酰辅酶A乙酰转移酶（EC 2.3.1.9）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。

HP:4000205.name: Reduced tissue beta-mannosidase activity
HP:4000205.definition: Concentration or activity of beta-mannosidase (EC 3.2.1.25) below the lower limit of normal. Beta-mannosidas enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:4000205.name_cn: 组织β-甘露糖苷酶活性降低
HP:4000205.definition_cn: β-甘露糖苷酶（EC 3.2.1.25）浓度或活性低于正常下限。β-甘露糖苷酶可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:4000206.name: Reduced 3-methylcrotonyl CoA carboxylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000206.definition: Activity of 3-methylcrotonyl-CoA carboxylase (EC 6.4.1.4) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:4000206.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中3-甲基巴豆酰辅酶A羧化酶活性降低
HP:4000206.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中3-甲基巴豆酰辅酶A羧化酶（EC 6.4.1.4）活性低于正常下限。

HP:4000207.name: Reduced branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000207.definition: Activity of branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase complex (EC 1.2.4.4) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:4000207.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中支链α-酮酸脱氢酶活性降低
HP:4000207.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中支链α-酮酸脱氢酶复合体（EC 1.2.4.4）活性低于正常下限。

HP:4000208.name: Reduced erythrocyte galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase activity
HP:4000208.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase (GALT; EC 2.7.7.12) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:4000208.name_cn: 红细胞半乳糖-1-磷酸尿苷酰转移酶活性降低
HP:4000208.definition_cn: 红细胞中半乳糖-1-磷酸尿苷酰转移酶（GALT；EC 2.7.7.12）活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:4000209.name: Abnormal erythrocyte adenosine deaminase activity
HP:4000209.definition: Activity of adenosine deaminase in red blood cells outside the limits of normal.
HP:4000209.name_cn: 异常红细胞腺苷脱氨酶活性
HP:4000209.definition_cn: 红细胞内腺苷脱氨酶活性超出正常范围。

HP:4000210.name: Reduced isovaleryl CoA dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000210.definition: Activity of isovaleryl-CoA dehydrogenase (EC 1.3.99.10) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:4000210.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中异戊酰辅酶A脱氢酶活性降低
HP:4000210.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中异戊酰辅酶A脱氢酶（EC 1.3.99.10）活性低于正常下限。

HP:4000211.name: Reduced glycerol kinase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:4000211.definition: Activity of glycerol kinase (EC 2.7.1.30) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:4000211.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中甘油激酶活性降低
HP:4000211.definition_cn: 成纤维细胞培养中甘油激酶（EC 2.7.1.30）活性低于正常下限。

HP:4000212.name: Increased circulating vitamin A concentration
HP:4000212.definition: Concentration of vitamin A above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:4000212.definition_cn: 血液循环中维生素A浓度高于正常上限。

HP:4000213.name: Elevated circulating hyaluronic acid concentration
HP:4000213.definition: Concentration of hyaluronic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:4000213.name_cn: 循环透明质酸浓度升高
HP:4000213.definition_cn: 血清透明质酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:4000214.name: Diminished breath sounds
HP:4000214.definition: A reduction in the intensity of the breath sound as ascertained by auscultation of the lung.
HP:4000214.definition_cn: 肺部听诊时呼吸音强度减弱。

HP:5000000.name: Anti-AK5 antibody positivity
HP:5000000.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against anti-adenylate kinase 5 (AK5).
HP:5000000.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对抗腺苷酸激酶5（AK5）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000001.name: Anti-AMPAR antibody positivity
HP:5000001.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against anti-alpha-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid receptor (AMPAR).
HP:5000001.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对抗α-氨基-3-羟基-5-甲基-4-异恶唑丙酸受体（AMPAR）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000002.name: Anti-Amphiphysin antibody
HP:5000002.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Amphiphysin.
HP:5000002.definition_cn: 循环血液中存在针对Amphiphysin的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000003.name: Anti-ARHGAP26 antibody
HP:5000003.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Rho GTPase-activating protein 26 (ARHGAP26).
HP:5000003.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Rho GTP酶激活蛋白26（ARHGAP26）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000004.name: Anti-CARP VIII antibody
HP:5000004.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Carbonic anhydrase-related protein VIII (CARPVIII).
HP:5000004.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对碳酸酐酶相关蛋白VIII（Carbonic Anhydrase-Related Protein VIII, CARPVIII）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000005.name: Anti-CASPR2
HP:5000005.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against contactin-associated protein-like 2 (CASPR2).
HP:5000005.name_cn: 抗接触蛋白相关蛋白2抗体
HP:5000005.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对接触蛋白相关蛋白样2（CASPR2）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000006.name: Anti-CV2/CRMP5 antibody positivity
HP:5000006.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against CV2/CRMP5. Anti-CV2/CRMP5 autoantibody is the most commonly detected anti-neuronal autoantibody. Patients with typical paraneoplastic chorea show fully developed chorea in the course of weeks to months with acute inflammation in the striatum.
HP:5000006.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对CV2/CRMP5的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。抗CV2/CRMP5自身抗体是最常检测到的抗神经元自身抗体。典型副肿瘤性舞蹈症患者在数周至数月内表现出完全发展的舞蹈症，并伴有纹状体的急性炎症。

HP:5000007.name: Anti-DPPX antibody
HP:5000007.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against dipeptidyl-peptidase-like protein 6 (DPPX).
HP:5000007.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对二肽基肽酶样蛋白6（DPPX）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000008.name: Anti-FGFR3 antibody positivity
HP:5000008.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against FGFR3.
HP:5000008.name_cn: 抗成纤维细胞生长因子受体3抗体阳性
HP:5000008.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对成纤维细胞生长因子受体3（FGFR3）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000009.name: Anti-GABA(A)R antibody
HP:5000009.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against gamma-aminobutyric acid A receptor, i.e., GABA(A)R.
HP:5000009.name_cn: 抗γ-氨基丁酸A型受体抗体
HP:5000009.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对γ-氨基丁酸A受体（即GABA(A)R）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000010.name: Anti-GABA(B)R antibody
HP:5000010.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against gamma-aminobutyric acid B receptor, i.e., GABA(B)R.
HP:5000010.name_cn: 抗γ-氨基丁酸B型受体抗体
HP:5000010.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对γ-氨基丁酸B受体（即GABA(B)R）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000011.name: Anti-GAD65 antibody
HP:5000011.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against glutamic acid decarboxylase 65 (GAD65).
HP:5000011.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对谷氨酸脱羧酶65（GAD65）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000012.name: Anti-Gephyrin antibody
HP:5000012.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Gephyrin.
HP:5000012.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Gephyrin的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000013.name: Anti-GFAP antibody
HP:5000013.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP).
HP:5000013.name_cn: 抗胶质纤维酸性蛋白抗体
HP:5000013.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000014.name: Anti-GlyR antibody
HP:5000014.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Glycine receptor (GlyR).
HP:5000014.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对甘氨酸受体（Glycine receptor, GlyR）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000015.name: Anti-Homer-3 antibody
HP:5000015.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Homer-3.
HP:5000015.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Homer-3的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000016.name: Anti-Hu antibody positivity
HP:5000016.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Hu.
HP:5000016.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Hu抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000017.name: Anti-Iglon5 antibody
HP:5000017.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against immunoglobulin-like cell adhesion molecule 5 (IgLON5).
HP:5000017.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对免疫球蛋白样细胞黏附分子5（IgLON5）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000018.name: Anti-ITPR1 antibody
HP:5000018.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor 1 (ITPR1).
HP:5000018.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对1,4,5-三磷酸肌醇受体1（ITPR1）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000019.name: Anti-Kelch like protein 11 antibody positivity
HP:5000019.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against kelch-like protein 11 (KLHL11).
HP:5000019.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对kelch样蛋白11（KLHL11）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000020.name: Anti-LGI1 antibody
HP:5000020.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against leucine-rich glioma-inactivated 1 (LGI1).
HP:5000020.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对富含亮氨酸的胶质瘤失活蛋白1（LGI1）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000021.name: Anti-Ma antibody positivity
HP:5000021.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ma.
HP:5000021.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Ma抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000022.name: Anti-Ma2 antibody positivity
HP:5000022.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ma2.
HP:5000022.definition_cn: 循环血液中存在针对Ma2抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000023.name: Anti-Ma1 antibody positivity
HP:5000023.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ma1.
HP:5000023.definition_cn: 循环血液中存在针对Ma1抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000024.name: Anti-mGluR1 antibody
HP:5000024.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against metabotropic glutamate receptor 1 (mGluR1).
HP:5000024.name_cn: 抗代谢型谷氨酸受体1抗体
HP:5000024.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对代谢型谷氨酸受体1（mGluR1）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000025.name: Anti-mGluR5 antibody
HP:5000025.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against metabotropic glutamate receptor 5 (mGluR5).
HP:5000025.name_cn: 抗代谢型谷氨酸受体5抗体
HP:5000025.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对代谢型谷氨酸受体5（mGluR5）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000026.name: Anti-neurexin-3alpha antibody positivity
HP:5000026.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against neurexin-3alpha.
HP:5000026.name_cn: 抗神经连接蛋白-3α抗体阳性
HP:5000026.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对neurexin-3α的自身体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000027.name: Anti-P/Q-type VGCC antibody positivity
HP:5000027.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against P/Q-type voltage-gated calcium channels (VGCCs).
HP:5000027.name_cn: 抗P/Q型电压门控钙通道抗体阳性
HP:5000027.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对P/Q型电压门控钙通道（VGCCs）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000028.name: Anti-MAP1B antibody
HP:5000028.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against microtubule-associated protein 1B (MAP1B).
HP:5000028.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对微管相关蛋白1B（MAP1B）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000029.name: Anti-PKCgamma antibody
HP:5000029.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against protein kinase Cgamma.
HP:5000029.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对蛋白激酶Cγ的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000030.name: Anti-Ri antibody
HP:5000030.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Ri, an antineuronal antibody.
HP:5000030.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Ri（一种抗神经元抗体）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000031.name: Anti-Septin-5 antibody
HP:5000031.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Septin-5.
HP:5000031.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Septin-5的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000032.name: Anti-SEZ6L2 antibody
HP:5000032.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against seizure-related 6 homolog like 2 (SEZ6L2).
HP:5000032.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对癫痫相关6同源物样2（SEZ6L2）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000033.name: Anti-SOX1 antibody
HP:5000033.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against SOX1. Anti-SOX1 antibodies, also known as antiglial nuclear antibody (AGNA), are specifically found in paraneoplastic neurological disorders. Since SOX1 is expressed in neuronal precursor cells in the developing central nervous system, it has been used as an early marker of neural stem cells.
HP:5000033.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对SOX1的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。抗SOX1抗体，也称为抗胶质核抗体（AGNA），特异性地存在于副肿瘤性神经系统疾病中。由于SOX1在发育中的中枢神经系统的神经元前体细胞中表达，因此它已被用作神经干细胞的早期标志物。

HP:5000034.name: Anti-Tr/DNER antibody
HP:5000034.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Tr/DNER. Anti-Tr antibodies are directed against cerebellar Purkinje cells (termed anti-Tr or PCA-Tr). Anti-Tr autoantibodies are frequently associated with Hodgkin lymphoma (HL). Anti-Tr antibodies are defined by a specific staining pattern in cerebellar tissue that is characterized by punctate immunoreactivity in both the dendritic tree and soma of Purkinje cells but not in their axons. This characteristic pattern is indicative of the presence of anti-Tr antibodies. The Delta/Notch-like epidermal growth factor-related receptor (DNER) was identified as the target antigen of anti-Tr.
HP:5000034.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Tr/DNER的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。抗Tr抗体针对小脑浦肯野细胞（称为抗Tr或PCA-Tr）。抗Tr自身抗体常与霍奇金淋巴瘤（HL）相关。抗Tr抗体通过小脑组织中的特定染色模式定义，其特征为浦肯野细胞的树突和胞体中的点状免疫反应性，但轴突中无此反应。这一特征性模式表明抗Tr抗体的存在。Delta/Notch样表皮生长因子相关受体（DNER）被鉴定为抗Tr的靶抗原。

HP:5000035.name: Anti-TRIM46 antibody
HP:5000035.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the axon initial segment protein tripartite motif 46 (TRIM46).
HP:5000035.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对轴突起始段蛋白三重基序46（TRIM46）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000036.name: Anti-TRIM9/TRIM67 antibody
HP:5000036.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against TRIM9/TRIM67.
HP:5000036.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对TRIM9/TRIM67的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000037.name: Anti-Yo antibody positivity
HP:5000037.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Yo.
HP:5000037.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Yo抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000038.name: Anti-titin antibody positivity
HP:5000038.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against titin.
HP:5000038.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对肌联蛋白（titin）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000039.name: Anti-Zic4 antibody positivity
HP:5000039.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against Zic family member 4 (ZIC4).
HP:5000039.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对Zic家族成员4（ZIC4）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:5000040.name: Distal radioulnar joint space widening
HP:5000040.definition: Increased space between the distal radius and distal ulna at sigmoid notch (radioulnar distance more than 6 mm at the sigmoid notch).
HP:5000040.name_cn: 远端桡尺关节间隙增宽
HP:5000040.definition_cn: 远端桡骨与远端尺骨在乙状切迹处间距增大（乙状切迹处桡尺距离超过6毫米）。

HP:5000042.name: Anti-Sj/ITPR1 antibody
