HP:5210044.definition: Increased susceptibility to Enterobacter infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Enterobacter.
HP:5210044.definition_cn: 对肠杆菌属感染的易感性增加，表现为严重或侵袭性肠杆菌属感染。

HP:5210045.name: Recurrent Enterobacter infection
HP:5210045.definition: Increased susceptibility to Enterobacter infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Enterobacter infection.
HP:5210045.definition_cn: 对肠杆菌感染易感性增加，表现为肠杆菌感染反复发作。

HP:5210046.name: Unusual Serratia infection
HP:5210046.definition: Increased susceptibility to Serratia infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Serratia, or by Serratia infection occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210046.definition_cn: 对沙雷菌感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作或严重/侵袭性沙雷菌感染，或沙雷菌感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210109.name_cn: 隐球菌引起的慢性肝炎
HP:5210109.definition_cn: 免疫缺陷背景下由隐球菌感染引起的慢性肝炎。

HP:5210110.name: Unusual mycobacterial infection
HP:5210110.definition: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/disseminated infection with mycobacterial organisms, including Mycobacterium tuberculosis, non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTM), or BCG.
HP:5210110.definition_cn: 对分枝杆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为反复或严重/播散性分枝杆菌感染，包括结核分枝杆菌、非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）或卡介苗感染。

HP:5210111.name: Tuberculosis infection
HP:5210111.definition: Increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium tuberculosis infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis, or by Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210111.definition_cn: 对结核分枝杆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为反复或严重/侵袭性结核分枝杆菌感染，或结核分枝杆菌感染发生于罕见解剖部位。

HP:5210112.name: Disseminated tuberculosis infection
HP:5210112.definition: Disseminated infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis, involving multiple organ systems. Organ-specific manifestations of disseminated tuberculosis include renal tuberculosis (tuberculous pyelonephritis, presenting with sterile pyuria and hematuria), hepatic tuberculosis, adrenal tuberculosis, and tuberculous osteomyelitis.
HP:5210112.definition_cn: 播散性结核分枝杆菌感染，累及多个器官系统。播散性结核的器官特异性表现包括：肾结核（结核性肾盂肾炎，表现为无菌性脓尿和血尿）、肝结核、肾上腺结核以及结核性骨髓炎。

HP:5210113.name: Recurrent tuberculosis infection
HP:5210113.definition: Increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium tuberculosis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection.
HP:5210113.definition_cn: 对结核分枝杆菌感染的易感性增高，表现为反复发作的结核分枝杆菌感染。

HP:5210114.name: Tuberculous osteomyelitis
HP:5210114.definition: Osteomyelitis caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210114.definition_cn: 由结核分枝杆菌感染引起的骨髓炎，发生于对感染异常易感的背景下。

HP:5210115.name: Non-tuberculous mycobacterial infection
HP:5210115.definition: Increased susceptibility to non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with NTM, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210115.definition_cn: 对非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性NTM感染，或感染发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210116.name: Unusual VZV infection
HP:5210116.definition: Increased susceptibility to varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with VZV, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210116.name_cn: 不典型水痘-带状疱疹病毒感染
HP:5210116.definition_cn: 对水痘-带状疱疹病毒（VZV）感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性VZV感染，或感染发生于特殊解剖部位。

HP:5210117.name: Recurrent non-tuberculous mycobacterial infection
HP:5210117.definition: Increased susceptibility to non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) infection.
HP:5210117.name_cn: 复发性非结核分枝杆菌感染
HP:5210117.definition_cn: 对非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的非结核分枝杆菌（NTM）感染。

HP:5210118.name: Opportunistic mycobacterial infection
HP:5210118.definition: Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections that rarely cause disease in immunocompetent individuals.
HP:5210118.definition_cn: 对免疫功能正常者罕见发病的分枝杆菌感染易感性增加。

HP:5210119.name: Unusual Cryptosporidium infection
HP:5210119.definition: Increased susceptibility to Cryptosporidium infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Cryptosporidium, or by Cryptosporidium infection occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210119.definition_cn: 隐孢子虫感染易感性增加，表现为反复或严重/侵袭性隐孢子虫感染，或隐孢子虫感染发生在异常解剖部位。

HP:5210120.name: Recurrent Cryptosporidium infection
HP:5210120.definition: Increased susceptibility to Cryptosporidium infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Cryptosporidium infection.
HP:5210120.definition_cn: 对隐孢子虫感染易感性增高，表现为反复发作的隐孢子虫感染。

HP:5210121.name: Unusual upper respiratory tract infection
HP:5210121.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the upper respiratory tract, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the nose, sinuses, pharynx, larynx, or middle ear, or by infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210121.definition_cn: 上呼吸道感染易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的鼻腔、鼻窦、咽部、喉部或中耳感染，或由非典型病原体或机会性病原体引起的感染。

HP:5210122.name: Sclerosing cholangitis due to Cryptosporidium infection
HP:5210122.definition: Sclerosing cholangitis caused by Cryptosporidium infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210122.name_cn: 隐孢子虫感染所致硬化性胆管炎
HP:5210122.definition_cn: 隐孢子虫感染导致的硬化性胆管炎，在异常感染易感性的背景下发生。

HP:5210123.name: Unusual lower respiratory tract infection
HP:5210123.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the lower respiratory tract, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, or lung parenchyma, or by infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210123.name_cn: 不常见的下呼吸道感染
HP:5210123.definition_cn: 下呼吸道感染易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的气管、支气管、细支气管或肺实质感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的感染。

HP:5210124.name: Unusual Giardia lamblia infection
HP:5210124.definition: Increased susceptibility to Giardia lamblia infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Giardia lamblia, or by Giardia lamblia infection occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210124.name_cn: 非典型蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染
HP:5210124.definition_cn: 对贾第鞭毛虫感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作或严重/侵袭性的贾第鞭毛虫感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210125.name: Persistent Giardia lamblia infection
HP:5210125.definition: Increased susceptibility to Giardia lamblia infections as manifested by a chronic or persistent Giardia lamblia infection.
HP:5210125.name_cn: 慢性蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染
HP:5210125.definition_cn: 对蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染的易感性增加，表现为慢性或持续性蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染。

HP:5210126.name: Recurrent Giardia lamblia infection
HP:5210126.definition: Increased susceptibility to Giardia lamblia infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Giardia lamblia infection.
HP:5210126.name_cn: 复发性蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染
HP:5210126.definition_cn: 对蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染的易感性增加，表现为蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫感染的反复发作。

HP:5210127.name: Unusual Toxoplasma infection
HP:5210127.definition: Increased susceptibility to Toxoplasma gondii infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Toxoplasma gondii, or by Toxoplasma gondii infection occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210127.definition_cn: 对弓形虫（Toxoplasma gondii）感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性弓形虫感染，或弓形虫感染发生在异常的解剖部位。

HP:5210128.name: Unusual cardiovascular system infection
HP:5210128.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection involving the heart or major vessels, as manifested by recurrent or severe endocarditis, myocarditis, pericarditis, or infectious vasculitis, or by cardiovascular infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210128.definition_cn: 涉及心脏或大血管的感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作或严重的心内膜炎、心肌炎、心包炎或感染性血管炎，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的心血管系统感染。

HP:5210129.name: Toxoplasma infection of the central nervous system (CNS)
HP:5210129.definition: Infection of the central nervous system with Toxoplasma gondii, typically presenting as cerebral toxoplasmosis.
HP:5210129.name_cn: 弓形虫中枢神经系统感染
HP:5210129.definition_cn: 中枢神经系统感染刚地弓形虫，通常表现为脑弓形虫病。

HP:5210130.name: Unusual Leishmania infection
HP:5210130.definition: Increased susceptibility to Leishmania infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Leishmania, or by Leishmania infection occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210130.name_cn: 不常见的利什曼原虫感染
HP:5210130.definition_cn: 对利什曼原虫感染的易感性增高，表现为复发或严重/侵袭性利什曼原虫感染，或在非典型解剖位置发生利什曼原虫感染。

HP:5210131.name: Severe Leishmania infection
HP:5210131.definition: Increased susceptibility to Leishmania infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Leishmania.
HP:5210131.definition_cn: 对利什曼原虫感染的易感性增加，表现为严重或侵袭性利什曼原虫感染。

HP:5210132.name: Recurrent Leishmania infection
HP:5210132.definition: Increased susceptibility to Leishmania infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Leishmania infection.
HP:5210132.name_cn: 复发性利什曼原虫感染
HP:5210132.definition_cn: 对利什曼原虫感染易感性增高，表现为反复发作的利什曼原虫感染。

HP:5210133.name: Opportunistic parasitic infection
HP:5210133.definition: Increased susceptibility to parasitic infections that rarely cause disease in immunocompetent individuals.
HP:5210133.definition_cn: 对免疫功能正常个体中极少致病的寄生虫感染易感性增加。

HP:5210134.name: Unusual cholangitis
HP:5210134.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious cholangitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the biliary tract, or by cholangitis occurring in an unusual clinical context such as absence of cholelithiasis or biliary obstruction. Causative agents include bacteria (Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Enterococcus species) and fungi (Candida species).
HP:5210134.definition_cn: 对感染性胆管炎的易感性增加，其表现为胆道的反复或严重感染，或在非典型临床背景下发生的胆管炎（如无胆石症或胆道梗阻）。致病菌包括细菌（大肠杆菌、肺炎克雷伯菌、肠球菌属）和真菌（念珠菌属）。

HP:5210135.name: Unusual genitourinary infection
HP:5210135.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the genitourinary tract, as manifested by recurrent or severe cystitis, pyelonephritis, kidney abscess, or vaginal infection, or by genitourinary infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210135.name_cn: 不寻常泌尿生殖系统感染
HP:5210135.definition_cn: 泌尿生殖道感染易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的膀胱炎、肾盂肾炎、肾脓肿或阴道感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的泌尿生殖道感染。

HP:5210137.name: Unusual eye infection
HP:5210137.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the eye or its adnexa, as manifested by recurrent or severe conjunctivitis, keratitis, retinitis, or other ocular infection, or by ocular infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210137.definition_cn: 眼部或其附属器感染易感性增加，表现为复发性或重型结膜炎、角膜炎、视网膜炎或其他眼部感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的眼部感染。

HP:5210138.name: Unusual liver infection
HP:5210138.definition: An atypical or infrequent infectious process affecting the liver parenchyma that deviates from common viral or bacterial patterns. This may include infections caused by rare pathogens (e.g., specific fungi, parasites, or rare bacteria) or infections presenting with atypical clinical or pathological features.
HP:5210138.definition_cn: 影响肝实质的非典型或罕见感染过程，区别于常见的病毒或细菌感染模式。此类感染可能由罕见病原体（例如特定真菌、寄生虫或稀有细菌）引起，或表现为不典型临床或病理特征。

HP:5210139.name: Infectious hepatitis
HP:5210139.definition: Inflammation of the liver tissue caused by an infectious agent, most commonly viruses (e.g., Hepatitis A, B, C), but also potentially by bacteria, parasites, or fungi. It is characterized by diffuse involvement of the liver parenchyma.
HP:5210139.definition_cn: 由感染性病原体引起的肝组织炎症，最常见为病毒（如甲型、乙型、丙型肝炎），但也可能由细菌、寄生虫或真菌引起。其特征为肝实质弥漫性受累。

HP:5210140.name: Bacterial sepsis
HP:5210140.definition: Sepsis caused by bacterial infection, characterized by a dysregulated host response to a bacterial pathogen with systemic inflammation, organ dysfunction, and potential progression to septic shock.
HP:5210140.definition_cn: 细菌感染引起的败血症，以机体对细菌病原体出现失调的宿主反应为特征，表现为全身炎症反应、器官功能障碍，并可能进展至感染性休克。

HP:5210141.name: Fungal sepsis
HP:5210141.definition: Sepsis caused by fungal infection, characterized by a dysregulated host response to a fungal pathogen with systemic inflammation, organ dysfunction, and potential progression to septic shock.
HP:5210141.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的脓毒症，其特征为宿主对真菌病原体的反应失调，伴有全身炎症反应、器官功能障碍，并可能进展为感染性休克。

HP:5210142.name: Viral sepsis
HP:5210142.definition: Sepsis or sepsis-like syndrome caused by viral infection, characterized by a dysregulated host response to a viral pathogen with systemic inflammation, multi-organ involvement, and potential progression to circulatory and respiratory failure.
HP:5210142.definition_cn: 由病毒感染引发的脓毒症或类脓毒症综合征，其特征为宿主对病毒病原体反应失调，表现为全身炎症反应、多器官受累，并可能进展为循环衰竭和呼吸衰竭。

HP:5210143.name: Mycobacterial sepsis
HP:5210143.definition: Sepsis or sepsis-like systemic illness caused by mycobacterial infection, characterized by a dysregulated host response with systemic inflammation, multi-organ involvement, and disseminated mycobacterial disease.
HP:5210143.definition_cn: 分枝杆菌感染引起的脓毒症或脓毒症样全身性疾病，其特征为宿主反应失调伴全身炎症反应、多器官受累及播散性分枝杆菌病。

HP:5210144.name: Pneumonia with consolidation
HP:5210144.definition: Pneumonia characterized by lobar or segmental consolidation on radiographic imaging, reflecting alveolar filling with inflammatory exudate that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210144.definition_cn: 肺炎在影像学上表现为肺叶或肺段实变，其病理基础为异常易感状态下发生的肺泡炎性渗出物填充。

HP:5210146.name: Unusual cytomegalovirus infection
HP:5210146.definition: Increased susceptibility to cytomegalovirus (CMV) infections as manifested by severe, invasive, persistent, or disseminated CMV infection.
HP:5210146.name_cn: 非典型巨细胞病毒感染
HP:5210146.definition_cn: 对巨细胞病毒(CMV)感染的易感性增加，表现为严重、侵袭性、持续性或播散性CMV感染。

HP:5210147.name: Unusual pleural empyema
HP:5210147.definition: Increased susceptibility to pleural empyema, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the pleural space, or by empyema occurring in an unusual clinical context such as an atypical causative organism or failure to resolve with standard therapy.
HP:5210147.definition_cn: 对脓胸易感性增强，表现为胸膜腔反复或严重感染，或在非典型临床情况下发生脓胸，例如由非典型病原体引起或对标准治疗无反应。

HP:5210148.name: Severe pleural empyema
HP:5210148.definition: Increased susceptibility to pleural empyema, as manifested by a severe or life-threatening infection of the pleural space requiring surgical drainage, decortication, or intensive care.
HP:5210148.definition_cn: 对胸腔积脓的易感性增加，表现为严重的或危及生命的胸腔间隙感染，需进行外科引流、胸膜剥脱术或重症监护治疗。

HP:5210149.name: Recurrent pleural empyema
HP:5210149.definition: Increased susceptibility to pleural empyema, as manifested by recurrent episodes of pleural space infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210149.definition_cn: 对脓胸的易感性增高，表现为胸腔感染反复发作，且发作频率在同年龄健康个体中异常。

HP:5210150.name: Unusual endocarditis
HP:5210150.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious endocarditis, as manifested by recurrent or severe endocardial infection, or by endocarditis caused by an unusual organism.
HP:5210150.definition_cn: 对感染性心内膜炎的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重的心内膜感染，或由罕见病原体引起的心内膜炎。

HP:5210151.name: Severe endocarditis
HP:5210151.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious endocarditis, as manifested by severe or complicated endocarditis with valvular destruction, systemic emboli, or heart failure requiring surgical intervention.
HP:5210151.definition_cn: 对感染性心内膜炎的易感性增加，表现为严重或复杂的心内膜炎伴瓣膜破坏、全身性栓塞，或需要手术干预的心力衰竭。

HP:5210152.name: Recurrent endocarditis
HP:5210152.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious endocarditis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of endocardial infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210152.definition_cn: 感染性心内膜炎易感性增加，表现为反复发作的心内膜感染，其发生频率超出同年龄段健康个体的正常范围。

HP:5210153.name: Unusual myocarditis
HP:5210153.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious myocarditis, as manifested by recurrent or severe inflammation of the myocardium caused by infection, or by myocarditis caused by an unusual organism.
HP:5210153.definition_cn: 对感染性心肌炎的易感性增高，表现为由感染引起的反复发作或严重的心肌炎症，或由非典型病原体引起的心肌炎。

HP:5210154.name: Severe myocarditis
HP:5210154.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious myocarditis, as manifested by severe myocardial inflammation with haemodynamic compromise, arrhythmia, or fulminant heart failure.
HP:5210154.definition_cn: 感染性心肌炎易感性增高，表现为严重心肌炎症伴血流动力学障碍、心律失常或暴发性心力衰竭。

HP:5210155.name: Recurrent myocarditis
HP:5210155.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious myocarditis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of myocardial inflammation caused by infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210155.definition_cn: 对传染性心肌炎易感性增高，表现为因感染引发的心肌炎症反复发作，其发作频率对于同龄健康个体而言属异常增高。

HP:5210156.name: Unusual pericarditis
HP:5210156.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious pericarditis, as manifested by recurrent or severe inflammation of the pericardium caused by infection, or by pericarditis caused by an unusual organism.
HP:5210156.definition_cn: 对感染性心包炎的易感性增加，表现为由感染引起的心包复发性或严重炎症，或由罕见病原体引起的心包炎。

HP:5210157.name: Severe pericarditis
HP:5210157.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious pericarditis, as manifested by severe inflammation of the pericardium with pericardial effusion, tamponade, or constrictive pericarditis.
HP:5210157.definition_cn: 感染性心包炎易感性增高，表现为心包严重炎症伴心包积液、心脏压塞或缩窄性心包炎。

HP:5210158.name: Recurrent pericarditis
HP:5210158.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious pericarditis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of pericardial inflammation caused by infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210158.definition_cn: 对感染性心包炎的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的感染性心包炎症性病变，且发作频率对于同龄健康个体而言异常增高。

HP:5210159.name: Unusual infectious vasculitis
HP:5210159.definition: Increased susceptibility to vasculitis caused by infection, as manifested by recurrent or severe vascular inflammation of infectious aetiology, or by infectious vasculitis caused by an unusual organism.
HP:5210159.definition_cn: 感染所致血管炎易感性增高，表现为感染性病因引发的反复发作或严重血管炎症，或由罕见病原体引起的感染性血管炎。

HP:5210160.name: Severe infectious vasculitis
HP:5210160.definition: Increased susceptibility to vasculitis caused by infection, as manifested by severe vascular inflammation with ischaemia, infarction, or end-organ damage.
HP:5210160.definition_cn: 感染所致血管炎易感性增高，表现为严重血管炎症伴缺血、梗死或终末器官损害。

HP:5210161.name: Recurrent infectious vasculitis
HP:5210161.definition: Increased susceptibility to vasculitis caused by infection, as manifested by recurrent episodes of vascular inflammation of infectious etiology that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210161.definition_cn: 感染导致血管炎易感性增高，表现为反复发作的感染性血管炎症，其发作频率超出同龄健康个体常见范围。

HP:5210163.name: Bacterial liver abscess
HP:5210163.definition: Abscess of the liver caused by bacterial infection. Principal causative agents include Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Bacteroides species, and Staphylococcus aureus.
HP:5210163.definition_cn: 细菌感染引起的肝脓肿。主要致病菌包括大肠埃希菌、肺炎克雷伯菌、拟杆菌属和金黄色葡萄球菌。

HP:5210164.name: Staphylococcal liver abscess
HP:5210164.definition: A liver abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus infection that may arise from hematogenous spread, biliary infection, or contiguous spread.
HP:5210164.definition_cn: 由金黄色葡萄球菌感染引起的肝脓肿可能源于血源性播散、胆道感染或邻近蔓延。

HP:5210165.name: Klebsiella liver abscess
HP:5210165.definition: Abscess of the liver caused by Klebsiella species infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210165.definition_cn: 克雷伯菌属感染所致的肝脓肿，发生于特殊易感状态下。

HP:5210166.name: Fungal liver abscess
HP:5210166.definition: A liver abscess caused by fungal infection, with common causative organisms including Candida species (often as part of hepatosplenic candidiasis) and Aspergillus species.
HP:5210166.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的肝脓肿，常见致病菌包括念珠菌属（常为肝脾念珠菌病的组成部分）和曲霉菌属。

HP:5210167.name: Hepatic candidiasis
HP:5210167.definition: Infection of the liver caused by Candida species that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210167.definition_cn: 念珠菌属引起的肝感染，发生于异常感染易感性的背景下。

HP:5210168.name: Parasitic liver abscess
HP:5210168.definition: A liver abscess or cystic hepatic lesion caused by parasitic infection, with principal causative organisms being Entamoeba histolytica (amoebic liver abscess) and Echinococcus species (hepatic hydatid disease).
HP:5210168.definition_cn: 由寄生虫感染引起的肝脏脓肿或囊性肝病变，主要致病微生物为溶组织内阿米巴（阿米巴性肝脏脓肿）和棘球蚴属（肝包虫病）。

HP:5210169.name: Amoebic liver abscess
HP:5210169.definition: Abscess of the liver caused by Entamoeba histolytica infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210169.definition_cn: 溶组织内阿米巴感染引起的肝脓肿，发生于感染异常易感性背景下。

HP:5210170.name: Echinococcal liver cyst
HP:5210170.definition: Cystic or alveolar lesion of the liver caused by Echinococcus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210170.definition_cn: 由棘球蚴感染引起的肝脏囊性或泡状病变，发生在异常感染易感性的背景下。

HP:5210171.name: Hepatic schistosomiasis
HP:5210171.definition: Infection of the liver caused by Schistosoma species, occurring in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection, typically presenting with periportal fibrosis or hepatosplenomegaly.
HP:5210171.definition_cn: 由血吸虫属引起的肝脏感染，发生于感染异常易感性的背景下，通常表现为门静脉周围纤维化或肝脾肿大。

HP:5210172.name: Bacterial splenic abscess
HP:5210172.definition: A splenic abscess caused by bacterial infection, typically with organisms such as Staphylococcus aureus, Salmonella species, and gram-negative enteric bacteria. It may arise from hematogenous seeding, contiguous spread, or trauma.
HP:5210172.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的脾脓肿，常见致病菌包括金黄色葡萄球菌、沙门氏菌属及革兰氏阴性肠道细菌。其发病机制可能源于血行播散、邻近组织蔓延或创伤。

HP:5210173.name: Fungal splenic abscess
HP:5210173.definition: A splenic abscess caused by fungal infection, often as part of hepatosplenic candidiasis.
HP:5210173.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的脾脓肿，常作为肝脾念珠菌病的一部分。

HP:5210174.name: Parasitic splenic abscess
HP:5210174.definition: A splenic abscess or cystic splenic lesion caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Echinococcus species (splenic hydatid disease) and Entamoeba histolytica.
HP:5210174.definition_cn: 寄生虫感染所致的脾脓肿或囊性脾脏病变，病原体包括棘球蚴属（脾包虫病）和溶组织内阿米巴。

HP:5210175.name: Unusual infectious gastroenteritis
HP:5210175.definition: An increased susceptibility to gastroenteritis of infectious etiology, as manifested by a recurrent or severe gastroenteritis, a prolonged diarrhoeal illness, or a gastroenteritis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210175.name_cn: 不常见的感染性胃肠炎
HP:5210175.definition_cn: 对传染性病因的胃肠炎易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的胃肠炎、迁延性腹泻性疾病，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的胃肠炎。

HP:5210176.name: Unusual bacterial gastroenteritis
HP:5210176.definition: A gastroenteritis caused by bacterial infection, with common causative organisms including Salmonella species, Shigella species, Campylobacter, and pathogenic Escherichia coli.
HP:5210176.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的胃肠炎，常见病原体包括沙门氏菌属、志贺氏菌属、弯曲杆菌及致病性大肠杆菌。

HP:5210177.name: Unusual viral gastroenteritis
HP:5210177.definition: A gastroenteritis caused by viral infection, with common causative organisms including rotavirus, norovirus, adenovirus, astrovirus, and enterovirus.
HP:5210177.definition_cn: 由病毒感染引起的胃肠炎，常见病原体包括轮状病毒、诺如病毒、腺病毒、星状病毒和肠道病毒。

HP:5210178.name: Unusual fungal gastroenteritis
HP:5210178.definition: A gastroenteritis caused by fungal infection, most often by Candida species. A fungal gastroenteritis can occur in any host with severely disrupted mucosal immunity or following prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotic exposure, and can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210178.name_cn: 不常见的真菌性胃肠炎
HP:5210178.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的胃肠炎，最常见的是念珠菌属。真菌性胃肠炎可发生于黏膜免疫严重受损或经历长期广谱抗生素暴露的宿主，可能是异常感染易感性的表现。

HP:5210179.name: Unusual parasitic gastroenteritis
HP:5210179.definition: A gastroenteritis caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Giardia lamblia, Cryptosporidium species, and Microsporidia.
HP:5210179.name_cn: 非典型性寄生虫性胃肠炎
HP:5210179.definition_cn: 由寄生虫感染引起的胃肠炎，其病原体包括蓝氏贾第鞭毛虫、隐孢子虫属物种和微孢子虫。

HP:5210180.name: Unusual infectious colitis
HP:5210180.definition: An increased susceptibility to colitis of infectious etiology, as manifested by a recurrent or severe colonic infection, or by an infectious colitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210180.definition_cn: 易感性增加导致的感染性结肠炎，表现为复发性或严重结肠感染，或由非典型或机会性致病菌引起的感染性结肠炎。

HP:5210181.name: Unusual bacterial colitis
HP:5210181.definition: A colitis caused by bacterial infection, with common causative organisms including Salmonella, Shigella, Campylobacter, enteroinvasive Escherichia coli, and Clostridioides difficile.
HP:5210181.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的结肠炎，常见致病菌包括沙门氏菌、志贺氏菌、弯曲杆菌、肠侵袭性大肠杆菌以及艰难梭菌。

HP:5210182.name: Unusual viral colitis
HP:5210182.definition: A colitis caused by viral infection, with causative organisms including cytomegalovirus, adenovirus, norovirus, and enterovirus.
HP:5210182.definition_cn: 由病毒感染引起的结肠炎，病原体包括巨细胞病毒、腺病毒、诺如病毒和肠道病毒。

HP:5210183.name: Unusual fungal colitis
HP:5210183.definition: A colitis caused by fungal infection, most commonly by Candida species.
HP:5210183.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的结肠炎，最常见病原体为念珠菌属。

HP:5210184.name: Unusual parasitic colitis
HP:5210184.definition: A colitis caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Entamoeba histolytica, Cryptosporidium species, and Strongyloides stercoralis.
HP:5210184.name_cn: 不寻常的寄生虫性结肠炎
HP:5210184.definition_cn: 由寄生虫感染引起的结肠炎，致病原包括溶组织内阿米巴、隐孢子虫属及粪类圆线虫。

HP:5210185.name: Unusual infectious pancreatitis
HP:5210185.definition: An increased susceptibility to pancreatitis of infectious etiology, as manifested by a recurrent or severe infectious pancreatitis, or by a pancreatitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210185.definition_cn: 对感染性病因的胰腺炎易感性增加，具体表现为复发性或重症感染性胰腺炎，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的胰腺炎。

HP:5210186.name: Unusual bacterial pancreatitis
HP:5210186.definition: A pancreatitis caused by bacterial infection, which may occur as a complication of bacteraemia, ascending biliary infection, or invasive abdominal infection.
HP:5210186.name_cn: 非典型性细菌性胰腺炎
HP:5210186.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的胰腺炎，可能作为菌血症、上行性胆道感染或侵袭性腹腔感染的并发症发生。

HP:5210187.name: Unusual viral pancreatitis
HP:5210187.definition: A pancreatitis caused by viral infection, with causative organisms including mumps virus, cytomegalovirus, coxsackievirus, and other enteroviruses.
HP:5210187.definition_cn: 由病毒感染引起的胰腺炎，致病微生物包括流行性腮腺炎病毒、巨细胞病毒、考萨奇病毒及其他肠道病毒。

HP:5210188.name: Unusual fungal pancreatitis
HP:5210188.definition: A pancreatitis caused by fungal infection. Such cases are rare and typically occur as a manifestation of disseminated invasive fungal disease (with Candida or Aspergillus species) in severely immunocompromised hosts.
HP:5210188.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引发的胰腺炎。此类病例罕见，通常作为播散性侵袭性真菌病（由念珠菌或曲霉菌属引起）在免疫功能严重低下患者中的一种表现形式出现。

HP:5210189.name: Unusual parasitic pancreatitis
HP:5210189.definition: A pancreatitis caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Cryptosporidium species, Ascaris lumbricoides, and Echinococcus species.
HP:5210189.definition_cn: 由寄生虫感染引起的胰腺炎，致病微生物包括隐孢子虫属、蛔虫和棘球绦虫属。

HP:5210190.name: Unusual bacterial cholangitis
HP:5210190.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial cholangitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the biliary tract, or by cholangitis occurring in an unusual clinical context such as absence of cholelithiasis or biliary obstruction. Principal causative agents include Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Enterococcus species.
HP:5210190.definition_cn: 对细菌性胆管炎的易感性增加，表现为胆道系统的反复或严重感染，或在非典型临床情境中发生的胆管炎（例如无胆石症或胆道梗阻情况下）。主要致病菌包括大肠杆菌、肺炎克雷伯菌和肠球菌属。

HP:5210191.name: Unusual cystitis
HP:5210191.definition: Increased susceptibility to cystitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the urinary bladder, or by cystitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210191.definition_cn: 对膀胱炎易感性增加，表现为反复发作或严重的膀胱感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的膀胱炎。

HP:5210192.name: Unusual hemorrhagic cystitis
HP:5210192.definition: Increased susceptibility to haemorrhagic cystitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe bladder infection with frank haematuria caused by viral or other atypical organisms. Its occurrence is inherently unusual and can indicate significant immune deficiency.
HP:5210192.definition_cn: 对出血性膀胱炎易感性增加，表现为反复发作或严重的膀胱感染伴肉眼血尿，由病毒或其他非典型病原体引起。本病的发生本身即不寻常，可能提示存在显著免疫缺陷。

HP:5210193.name: Unusual fungal cystitis
HP:5210193.definition: Increased susceptibility to fungal cystitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the urinary bladder caused by fungal organisms.
HP:5210193.definition_cn: 真菌性膀胱炎易感性增加，表现为由真菌引起的反复发作或重度膀胱感染。

HP:5210194.name: Unusual bacterial cystitis
HP:5210194.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial cystitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the urinary bladder caused by bacteria, or by bacterial cystitis caused by an atypical organism.
HP:5210194.definition_cn: 细菌性膀胱炎易感性增加，表现为由细菌引起的膀胱反复或严重感染，或由非典型病原体导致的细菌性膀胱炎。

HP:5210195.name: Unusual pyelonephritis
HP:5210195.definition: An inflammation of the kidney involving the renal parenchyma, pelvis, and calices, occurring in a manner unusual for a healthy individual of the same age, as manifested by recurrent or severe episodes of pyelonephritis, or by pyelonephritis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism
HP:5210195.definition_cn: 累及肾实质、肾盂和肾盏的肾脏炎症，其发病方式与同龄健康个体不符，表现为复发性或重症肾盂肾炎，或由非典型病原体或机会性病原体引起的肾盂肾炎。

HP:5210196.name: Unusual kidney abscess
HP:5210196.definition: Abscess of the kidney occurring in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection, as manifested by renal abscess caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism, or by renal abscess occurring in the absence of the usual predisposing factors such as urinary tract obstruction or urolithiasis.
HP:5210196.definition_cn: 肾脓肿发生于异常感染易感性的背景下，表现为由非典型或机会性病原体引起的肾脓肿，或在缺乏尿路梗阻或尿石症等常见诱发因素情况下发生的肾脓肿。

HP:5210197.name: Bacterial kidney abscess
HP:5210197.definition: Abscess of the kidney caused by bacterial infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210197.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的肾脓肿，发生在感染易感性增高的背景下。

HP:5210198.name: Fungal kidney abscess
HP:5210198.definition: Abscess of the kidney caused by fungal infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210198.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的肾脏脓肿，发生于异常感染易感性的背景下。

HP:5210199.name: Parasitic kidney abscess
HP:5210199.definition: Abscess of the kidney caused by parasitic infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210199.definition_cn: 寄生虫感染导致的肾脏脓肿，发生于异常易感的感染背景下。

HP:5210200.name: Unusual vaginal infection
HP:5210200.definition: Increased susceptibility to vaginal infection, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the vagina or vulvovaginal area caused by bacterial, viral, fungal, or parasitic organisms, or by vaginal infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210200.definition_cn: 阴道感染易感性增加，表现为由细菌、病毒、真菌或寄生虫引起的阴道或外阴阴道区域反复或严重感染，或由非典型或条件致病微生物引起的阴道感染。

HP:5210201.name: Unusual bacterial vaginal infection
HP:5210201.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial vaginal infection, as manifested by recurrent or severe bacterial vaginosis or vaginal bacterial infection that is unusual in frequency or severity for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210201.name_cn: 非典型细菌性阴道感染
HP:5210201.definition_cn: 对细菌性阴道感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或重度细菌性阴道病，或相较于同年龄段健康个体而言发生频率或严重程度异常的阴道细菌感染。

HP:5210202.name: Unusual viral vaginal infection
HP:5210202.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral vaginal infection, as manifested by recurrent or severe herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection of the vaginal or vulvovaginal area that can occur in the context of immune deficiency.
HP:5210202.definition_cn: 病毒性阴道感染易感性增加，表现为免疫缺陷背景下可能出现的反复或严重的阴道或外阴阴道区域单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）感染。

HP:5210203.name: Unusual fungal vaginal infection
HP:5210203.definition: Increased susceptibility to vulvovaginal candidiasis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the vagina or vulvovaginal area caused by Candida species. Predominantly caused by Candida albicans, with Candida glabrata in azole-resistant cases.
HP:5210203.definition_cn: 外阴阴道念珠菌病易感性增加，表现为由念珠菌属引发的阴道或外阴阴道区域反复或严重感染。主要由白色念珠菌引起，唑类耐药病例中以光滑念珠菌为主。

HP:5210204.name: Unusual parasitic vaginal infection
HP:5210204.definition: Increased susceptibility to parasitic vaginal infection, as manifested by recurrent or severe trichomoniasis or other parasitic vaginal infection. A common causative agent is Trichomonas vaginalis, which has been documented in immunocompromised hosts.
HP:5210204.name_cn: 非典型寄生虫性阴道炎
HP:5210204.definition_cn: 易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的滴虫病及其他寄生虫性阴道感染。常见的致病原为阴道毛滴虫，该病原体在免疫功能受损宿主中已有明确记录。

HP:5210205.name: Unusual bacterial osteomyelitis
HP:5210205.definition: An osteomyelitis caused by bacterial infection, with common causative organisms including Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus species, and gram-negative bacilli such as Salmonella and Serratia marcescens.
HP:5210205.name_cn: 非典型性细菌性骨髓炎
HP:5210205.definition_cn: 细菌感染引起的骨髓炎，常见病原体包括金黄色葡萄球菌、链球菌属，以及沙门氏菌和粘质沙雷菌等革兰阴性杆菌。

HP:5210206.name: Unusual fungal osteomyelitis
HP:5210206.definition: An osteomyelitis caused by fungal infection, with causative organisms including Candida species, Aspergillus species, and the dimorphic fungi.
HP:5210206.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的骨髓炎，致病菌包括念珠菌属、曲霉菌属以及双相真菌。

HP:5210207.name: Unusual infectious arthritis
HP:5210207.definition: An increased susceptibility to arthritis of infectious etiology, as manifested by a recurrent or severe septic arthritis, or by an infectious arthritis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210207.definition_cn: 对感染性病因关节炎的易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的化脓性关节炎，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的感染性关节炎。

HP:5210208.name: Unusual bacterial arthritis
HP:5210208.definition: An arthritis caused by bacterial infection, with common causative organisms including Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus species, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, and Haemophilus influenzae.
HP:5210208.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的关节炎，常见致病微生物包括金黄色葡萄球菌、链球菌属、淋病奈瑟菌和流感嗜血杆菌。

HP:5210209.name: Unusual fungal arthritis
HP:5210209.definition: An arthritis caused by fungal infection, with causative organisms including Candida species, Aspergillus species, and Cryptococcus.
HP:5210209.definition_cn: 一种由真菌感染引起的关节炎，其致病菌包括念珠菌属、曲霉菌属和隐球菌属。

HP:5210210.name: Unusual mycobacterial arthritis
HP:5210210.definition: An arthritis caused by mycobacterial infection, with causative organisms including Mycobacterium tuberculosis (tuberculous arthritis) and non-tuberculous mycobacteria.
HP:5210210.name_cn: 非典型分枝杆菌关节炎
HP:5210210.definition_cn: 由分枝杆菌感染引起的关节炎，其致病微生物包括结核分枝杆菌（结核性关节炎）和非结核分枝杆菌。

HP:5210211.name: Unusual infectious myositis
HP:5210211.definition: An increased susceptibility to myositis of infectious aetiology, as manifested by a recurrent or severe inflammation of skeletal muscle caused by infection, or by an infectious myositis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism. Common causative organisms include Staphylococcus aureus (pyomyositis), Streptococcus pyogenes, and Clostridium species (gas gangrene), as well as viral, fungal, and parasitic agents.
HP:5210211.definition_cn: 对感染性病因的肌炎易感性增高，表现为由感染引起的复发性或严重性骨骼肌炎症，或由非典型/条件致病微生物所致的感染性肌炎。常见病原体包括金黄色葡萄球菌（化脓性肌炎）、化脓性链球菌、梭菌属（气性坏疽），以及病毒、真菌和寄生虫等病原体。

HP:5210212.name: Unusual bacterial myositis
HP:5210212.definition: A myositis caused by bacterial infection, with common causative organisms including Staphylococcus aureus (pyomyositis) and Streptococcus species.
HP:5210212.definition_cn: 由细菌感染引起的肌炎，常见致病菌包括金黄色葡萄球菌（化脓性肌炎）和链球菌属。

HP:5210213.name: Unusual fungal myositis
HP:5210213.definition: A myositis caused by fungal infection, with causative organisms including Candida species, Aspergillus species, and the Mucorales. A fungal myositis is rare and typically a manifestation of severe immunocompromise.
HP:5210213.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的肌炎，致病微生物包括念珠菌属、曲霉菌属及毛霉目。真菌性肌炎罕见，通常表现为免疫功能严重低下的病理状态。

HP:5210214.name: Unusual mycobacterial myositis
HP:5210214.definition: A myositis caused by mycobacterial infection, with causative organisms including Mycobacterium tuberculosis and non-tuberculous mycobacteria.
HP:5210214.definition_cn: 由分枝杆菌感染引起的肌炎，致病微生物包括结核分枝杆菌和非结核分枝杆菌。

HP:5210215.name: Unusual viral myositis
HP:5210215.definition: A myositis caused by viral infection, with causative organisms including enterovirus, influenza virus, coxsackievirus, and HIV.
HP:5210215.definition_cn: 由病毒感染引起的肌炎，病原体包括肠道病毒、流感病毒、柯萨奇病毒和人类免疫缺陷病毒。

HP:5210216.name: Viral meningitis
HP:5210216.definition: A meningitis caused by viral infection, with common causative organisms including herpes simplex virus, varicella-zoster virus, enterovirus, and CMV. A recurrent or chronic viral meningitis (particularly chronic enteroviral meningoencephalitis) can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210216.definition_cn: 由病毒感染引起的脑膜炎，常见病原体包括单纯疱疹病毒、水痘-带状疱疹病毒、肠道病毒及巨细胞病毒。复发性或慢性病毒性脑膜炎（特别是慢性肠道病毒性脑膜脑炎）可能提示存在异常的感染易感性。

HP:5210217.name: Bacterial meningitis
HP:5210217.definition: A meningitis caused by bacterial infection, with common causative organisms including Streptococcus pneumoniae, Neisseria meningitidis, and Haemophilus influenzae type b. A recurrent or invasive bacterial meningitis with encapsulated organisms can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in antibody deficiencies, complement deficiencies, and asplenia.
HP:5210217.definition_cn: 细菌性脑膜炎是由细菌感染引起的脑膜炎症，常见致病微生物包括肺炎链球菌、脑膜炎奈瑟菌以及b型流感嗜血杆菌。当患者发生复发性或侵袭性细菌性脑膜炎且病原体为有荚膜微生物时，可能提示存在异常感染易感性，这种情况尤其常见于抗体缺陷、补体缺陷及无脾症患者。

HP:5210218.name: Parasitic meningitis
HP:5210218.definition: A meningitis caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Toxoplasma gondii, Acanthamoeba, and Naegleria fowleri. A parasitic meningitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210218.definition_cn: 寄生虫感染引起的脑膜炎，其致病微生物包括刚地弓形虫、棘阿米巴及福氏耐格里阿米巴。此类寄生虫性脑膜炎可作为异常感染易感性的临床表现。

HP:5210219.name: Mycobacterial meningitis
HP:5210219.definition: A meningitis caused by mycobacterial infection, with the principal causative organism being Mycobacterium tuberculosis (tuberculous meningitis). A non-tuberculous mycobacterial meningitis is rare and can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease.
HP:5210219.definition_cn: 由分枝杆菌感染引起的脑膜炎，其主要致病菌为结核分枝杆菌（结核性脑膜炎）。非结核分枝杆菌性脑膜炎较为罕见，可能表现为对感染的异常易感性，尤其是孟德尔遗传性分枝杆菌易感性疾病患者。

HP:5210220.name: Fungal encephalitis
HP:5210220.definition: An encephalitis caused by fungal infection, with causative organisms including Cryptococcus neoformans, Aspergillus species, Candida species, and the Mucorales. A fungal encephalitis is most often a manifestation of disseminated invasive fungal disease in severely immunocompromised hosts.
HP:5210220.definition_cn: 由真菌感染引起的脑炎，其病原体包括新型隐球菌、曲霉菌属、念珠菌属及毛霉目真菌。真菌性脑炎通常表现为严重免疫功能受损宿主体内的播散性侵袭性真菌感染。

HP:5210221.name: Parasitic encephalitis
HP:5210221.definition: An encephalitis caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Toxoplasma gondii (toxoplasmic encephalitis), Acanthamoeba, and Naegleria fowleri. A parasitic encephalitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210221.definition_cn: 寄生虫感染引起的脑炎，病原体包括刚地弓形虫（弓形虫性脑炎）、棘阿米巴和福氏耐格里阿米巴。寄生虫性脑炎可表现为对感染的异常易感性。

HP:5210222.name: Mycobacterial encephalitis
HP:5210222.definition: An encephalitis caused by mycobacterial infection, with the principal causative organism being Mycobacterium tuberculosis (tuberculous encephalitis, often as part of CNS tuberculosis). A mycobacterial encephalitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease.
HP:5210222.definition_cn: 由分枝杆菌感染引起的脑炎，主要致病微生物为结核分枝杆菌（结核性脑炎，常作为中枢神经系统结核的一部分）。分枝杆菌性脑炎可能是异常感染易感性的表现，尤其见于孟德尔分枝杆菌病易感性患者。

HP:5210223.name: Bacterial brain abscess
HP:5210223.definition: A brain abscess caused by bacterial infection, with causative organisms including Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus species, anaerobes, and gram-negative bacilli. It may arise from contiguous spread (sinusitis, otitis) or hematogenous seeding, and a bacterial brain abscess can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in phagocyte defects.
HP:5210223.definition_cn: 细菌感染引起的脑脓肿，其致病菌包括金黄色葡萄球菌、链球菌属、厌氧菌和革兰阴性杆菌。该病症可通过邻近组织扩散（如鼻窦炎、中耳炎）或血行播散引发，细菌性脑脓肿可能是感染易感性异常的表现，尤其在吞噬细胞缺陷患者中更为常见。

HP:5210224.name: Fungal brain abscess
HP:5210224.definition: A brain abscess caused by fungal infection, with causative organisms including Aspergillus species, Cryptococcus, Candida, and the Mucorales. A fungal brain abscess is most often a manifestation of disseminated invasive fungal disease in severely immunocompromised hosts.
HP:5210224.definition_cn: 真菌感染引起的脑脓肿，其致病菌包括曲霉菌属、隐球菌、念珠菌及毛霉目。真菌性脑脓肿多为严重免疫功能受损宿主发生播散性侵袭性真菌病的临床表现。

HP:5210225.name: Parasitic brain abscess
HP:5210225.definition: A brain abscess caused by parasitic infection, with causative organisms including Toxoplasma gondii, Entamoeba histolytica, and Echinococcus species. A parasitic brain abscess can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210225.definition_cn: 寄生虫感染引起的脑脓肿，致病微生物包括刚地弓形虫、溶组织内阿米巴和棘球绦虫属。寄生虫性脑脓肿可作为异常感染易感性的表现。

HP:5210226.name: Mycobacterial brain abscess
HP:5210226.definition: A brain abscess caused by mycobacterial infection, with the classic manifestation being a tuberculoma caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. A mycobacterial brain abscess can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease.
HP:5210226.definition_cn: 由分枝杆菌感染引起的脑脓肿，其典型表现为结核分枝杆菌所致的结核瘤。分枝杆菌性脑脓肿可表现为感染的异常易感性，尤其见于孟德尔遗传性分枝杆菌易感性疾病患者。

HP:5210227.name: Unusual spinal cord infection
HP:5210227.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the spinal cord, as manifested by infectious myelitis, spinal epidural or intradural abscess, or spinal cord compression due to infectious spondylodiscitis occuring in an unusual clinical context such as an atypical causative organism, absence of the usual predisposing factors, or by occurrence in the context of immune deficiency. Principal causative agents include bacteria (Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, Mycobacterium tuberculosis), fungi (Aspergillus species, Candida species), and viruses (enteroviruses, VZV, CMV).
HP:5210227.definition_cn: 脊髓感染易感性增加，表现为感染性脊髓炎、脊柱硬膜外或硬膜下脓肿，或因感染性脊椎间盘炎导致的脊髓受压。此类情况可见于非典型临床背景，如非典型病原体、缺乏常规诱因，或发生于免疫缺陷状态下。主要病原体包括细菌（金黄色葡萄球菌、大肠埃希菌、结核分枝杆菌）、真菌（曲霉菌属、念珠菌属）及病毒（肠道病毒、水痘-带状疱疹病毒、巨细胞病毒）。

HP:5210228.name: Unusual bacterial skin infection
HP:5210228.definition: An increased susceptibility to bacterial infection of the skin, as manifested by a recurrent or severe cutaneous bacterial infection, or by a skin infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism. Common causative organisms include Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus species. A recurrent bacterial skin infection can be a manifestation of phagocyte defects, hyper-IgE syndrome, and atopic dermatitis-related immune defects.
HP:5210228.name_cn: 非典型细菌性皮肤感染
HP:5210228.definition_cn: 对皮肤细菌感染易感性的增加，表现为反复或严重的皮肤细菌感染，或由非典型或条件致病菌引起的皮肤感染。常见致病菌包括金黄色葡萄球菌和链球菌属。反复发生的细菌性皮肤感染可能是吞噬细胞缺陷、高IgE综合征以及特应性皮炎相关的免疫缺陷的表现。

HP:5210229.name: Unusual bacterial skin abscess
HP:5210229.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial skin abscesses, as manifested by recurrent, multifocal, or unusually severe collections of pus within the dermis or deeper skin layers. While common causative organisms include Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus species, this term also encompasses abscesses caused by opportunistic or atypical bacteria, or those that are refractory to standard antibiotic therapy.
HP:5210229.name_cn: 特殊性细菌性皮肤脓肿
HP:5210229.definition_cn: 对细菌性皮肤脓肿的易感性增加，表现为真皮或更深层皮肤内复发性、多灶性或异常严重的脓液聚集。虽然常见致病菌包括金黄色葡萄球菌和链球菌属，但该术语亦涵盖由条件致病菌或非典型细菌引起的脓肿，或对标准抗生素治疗无效的病例。

HP:5210230.name: Recurrent boils
HP:5210230.definition: A recurrent infection of hair follicles producing furuncles (boils), with common causative organisms being Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus species. A recurrent boil can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in chronic granulomatous disease, hyper-IgE syndrome (STAT3 deficiency), leukocyte adhesion deficiency, and atopic dermatitis-related immune defects.
HP:5210230.definition_cn: 复发性毛囊感染形成的疖肿，常见病原体为金黄色葡萄球菌及链球菌属。复发性疖肿可能是机体对感染异常易感的表现，尤其见于慢性肉芽肿病、高IgE综合征（STAT3缺陷）、白细胞黏附缺陷症以及特应性皮炎相关的免疫缺陷患者。

HP:5210231.name: Bacterial cellulitis
HP:5210231.definition: A cellulitis caused by bacterial infection of the dermis and subcutaneous tissue, with common causative organisms including Streptococcus pyogenes and Staphylococcus aureus.
HP:5210231.definition_cn: 蜂窝织炎系由细菌感染真皮层和皮下组织引起的炎症，其常见病原体包括但不限于化脓性链球菌和金黄色葡萄球菌。

HP:5210232.name: Unusual viral skin infection
HP:5210232.definition: An increased susceptibility to viral infection of the skin, as manifested by a recurrent or severe cutaneous viral infection, or by a skin infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism. Common causative organisms include herpes simplex virus, varicella-zoster virus, human papillomavirus, and Molluscum contagiosum.
HP:5210232.definition_cn: 皮肤病毒感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重的皮肤病毒感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的皮肤感染。常见致病病原体包括单纯疱疹病毒、水痘-带状疱疹病毒、人乳头瘤病毒及传染性软疣病毒。

HP:5210233.name: Unusual HSV skin infection
HP:5210233.definition: A herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection of the skin, which may present as localised vesicular lesions in any host. A severe, persistent, or disseminated cutaneous HSV infection (including eczema herpeticum and chronic ulcerative herpes) can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210233.name_cn: 非典型单纯疱疹病毒皮肤感染
HP:5210233.definition_cn: 单纯疱疹病毒(HSV)皮肤感染，可表现为任何宿主出现局限性水疱性病变。严重、持续或播散性皮肤HSV感染（包括疱疹性湿疹及慢性溃疡性疱疹）可能是易感性异常的表现。

HP:5210234.name: Unusual parasitic skin infection
HP:5210234.definition: An increased susceptibility to parasitic infection of the skin or subcutaneous tissue, as manifested by a recurrent, severe, or atypically distributed parasitic skin lesion, or by a cutaneous parasitic infection occurring in an unusual clinical context. Causative organisms include Leishmania species, Onchocerca volvulus, and Ancylostoma species. An atypical or disseminated cutaneous leishmaniasis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210234.definition_cn: 对皮肤或皮下组织寄生虫感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性、严重或非典型分布的寄生虫性皮肤病变，或出现在特殊临床背景下的皮肤寄生虫感染。病原体包括利什曼原虫属、旋盘尾丝虫和钩虫属。非典型或播散性皮肤利什曼病可成为感染易感性异常的表现。

HP:5210235.name: Unusual VZV skin infection
HP:5210235.definition: Varicella-zoster virus (VZV) skin infection including chickenpox or herpes zoster that is unusually severe or persistent.
HP:5210235.name_cn: 罕见水痘-带状疱疹病毒皮肤感染
HP:5210235.definition_cn: 水痘-带状疱疹病毒（VZV）所致的皮肤感染，包括异常严重或持续存在的水痘或带状疱疹。

HP:5210236.name: Unusual fungal skin infection
HP:5210236.definition: An increased susceptibility to fungal infection of the skin or subcutaneous tissue, as manifested by a recurrent, severe, or atypically distributed fungal lesion, or by an infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism. Common manifestations include chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis or subcutaneous mycoses (such as sporotrichosis caused by Sporothrix species.
HP:5210236.definition_cn: 皮肤或皮下组织真菌感染易感性增高，表现为反复发作、严重或非典型分布的真菌性病灶，或由非典型/条件致病性微生物引起的感染。常见表现包括慢性黏膜皮肤念珠菌病或皮下真菌病（如由孢子丝菌属引起的孢子丝菌病）。

HP:5210237.name: Recurrent diaper rash
HP:5210237.definition: Recurrent nappy (diaper) rash of infectious aetiology, typically caused by Candida.
HP:5210237.definition_cn: 复发性尿布疹（感染性病因），通常由白色念珠菌引起。

HP:5210238.name: Unusual nail infection
HP:5210238.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the nail apparatus, including the nail plate, nail bed, nail matrix, and proximal nail fold, as manifested by recurrent or severe nail infection, or by nail infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210238.definition_cn: 指甲装置（包括甲板、甲床、甲母质和近端甲皱襞）对感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重指甲感染，或由非典型或条件致病菌引起的指甲感染。

HP:5210239.name: Unusual bacterial nail bed infection
HP:5210239.definition: Increased susceptibility to bacterial infection of the nail bed and proximal nail fold (paronychia), as manifested by recurrent or severe episodes that are unusual in frequency or severity for a healthy individual of the same age. Principal causative agents include Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus species.
HP:5210239.name_cn: 罕见的细菌性甲床感染
HP:5210239.definition_cn: 甲床及近端甲褶（甲沟炎）对细菌感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重发作，其频率或严重程度在同龄健康个体中属异常。主要致病菌包括金黄色葡萄球菌和链球菌属。

HP:5210240.name: Unusual HSV infection
HP:5210240.definition: Increased susceptibility to herpes simplex virus (HSV) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HSV, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210240.name_cn: 非典型单纯疱疹病毒感染
HP:5210240.definition_cn: 对单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性HSV感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210241.name: Recurrent onychomycosis
HP:5210241.definition: Increased susceptibility to recurrent fungal nail infection (onychomycosis), as manifested by recurrent or persistent infection of the nail plate, nail bed, or nail matrix caused by dermatophytes (Trichophyton species) or Candida species.
HP:5210241.definition_cn: 对复发性甲真菌病的易感性增加，表现为甲板、甲床或甲母质出现由皮肤癣菌（毛癣菌属）或念珠菌属引起的复发性或持续性感染。

HP:5210242.name: Unusual mycobacterial skin infection
HP:5210242.definition: An increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infection of the skin, as manifested by persistent, disseminated, or multifocal cutaneous lesions occurring in an unusual clinical context. This includes skin involvement in tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) or infections caused by atypical mycobacteria (nontuberculous mycobacteria), such as M. marinum, M. avium complex, or M. chelonae.
HP:5210242.name_cn: 非典型分枝杆菌皮肤感染
HP:5210242.definition_cn: 皮肤分枝杆菌感染易感性增高，表现为在特殊临床背景下出现持续性、播散性或多灶性皮肤病变。这包括结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis）所致的皮肤受累，或由非典型分枝杆菌（非结核分枝杆菌）引起的感染，例如海分枝杆菌、鸟分枝杆菌复合群或龟分枝杆菌感染。

HP:5210243.name: Unusual fascia infection
HP:5210243.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of the fascia and surrounding soft tissue, as manifested by necrotizing fasciitis or other invasive fascial infection occurring in an unusual clinical context. Necrotizing fasciitis is a rapidly progressive, life-threatening infection of the superficial fascia and subcutaneous tissue.
HP:5210243.definition_cn: 筋膜及周围软组织感染易感性增加，表现为在异常临床情境下发生的坏死性筋膜炎或其他侵袭性筋膜感染。坏死性筋膜炎是一种快速进展、危及生命的浅筋膜与皮下组织感染性疾病。

HP:5210244.name: Unusual cutaneous larva migrans
HP:5210244.definition: Infestation of the skin by migrating hookworm larvae (principally Ancylostoma braziliense and Ancylostoma caninum), causing serpiginous, pruritic, erythematous cutaneous tracks. Although typically self-limited in immunocompetent hosts, cutaneous larva migrans may follow a prolonged or atypical course in the context of immune deficiency, including HIV/AIDS and other T-cell defects.
HP:5210244.name_cn: 不典型皮肤幼虫移行症
HP:5210244.definition_cn: 皮肤由移行钩虫幼虫（主要为巴西钩口线虫和犬钩口线虫）侵染引起，导致蜿蜒形、瘙痒性、红斑性皮肤幼虫移行通道。虽然免疫功能正常者通常具有自限性，但在免疫缺陷（包括艾滋病病毒感染者/艾滋病患者及其他T细胞缺陷疾病）背景下，皮肤幼虫移行症可能呈现病程迁延或非典型发展。

HP:5210245.name: Unusual cutaneous leishmaniasis
HP:5210245.definition: Infection of the skin and subcutaneous tissue by Leishmania species, as manifested by cutaneous or mucocutaneous leishmaniasis occurring in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection. Cutaneous leishmaniasis presents with chronic, non-healing ulcerative skin lesions.
HP:5210245.definition_cn: 由利什曼原虫引起的皮肤及皮下组织感染，表现为在异常易感背景下发生的皮肤或皮肤黏膜利什曼病。皮肤利什曼病的特征为慢性、非愈合性溃疡性皮肤病变。

HP:5210246.name: Severe gingivitis
HP:5210246.definition: Increased susceptibility to gingivitis, as manifested by severe or necrotising gingival infection, including necrotising ulcerative gingivitis, associated with significant tissue destruction.
HP:5210246.definition_cn: 牙龈炎易感性增加，表现为严重或坏死性牙龈感染，包括伴有显著组织破坏的坏死性溃疡性牙龈炎。

HP:5210247.name: Recurrent periodontitis
HP:5210247.definition: Increased susceptibility to periodontitis, as manifested by recurrent or chronic periodontal infection that is unusual in frequency or severity for a healthy individual of the same age
HP:5210247.definition_cn: 牙周炎易感性增高，表现为同龄健康个体中罕见或严重程度超常的复发性或慢性牙周感染。

HP:5210248.name: Severe dental abscess
HP:5210248.definition: Increased susceptibility to dental abscess, as manifested by a severe or invasive dental abscess with systemic spread or requiring hospitalisation.
HP:5210248.definition_cn: 对牙脓肿易感性增高，表现为重症或侵袭性牙脓肿伴全身播散，或需住院治疗。

HP:5210249.name: Recurrent dental abscesses
HP:5210249.definition: Increased susceptibility to dental abscess, as manifested by recurrent episodes of dental abscesses that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210249.definition_cn: 对牙脓肿的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的牙脓肿，其频率对于同龄健康个体而言异常。

HP:5210250.name: Severe stomatitis
HP:5210250.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious stomatitis, as manifested by severe or invasive oral mucosal infection causing necrosis or aphthous ulceration of tissue, or requiring systemic antiviral or antimicrobial therapy.
HP:5210250.definition_cn: 对感染性口炎易感性增加，表现为导致组织坏死或口疮性溃疡的严重或侵袭性口腔黏膜感染，或需全身性抗病毒或抗菌治疗。

HP:5210251.name: Recurrent stomatitis
HP:5210251.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious stomatitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of oral mucosal infection that are unusual in frequency or severity for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210251.definition_cn: 对感染性口炎的易感性增高，表现为反复发作的口腔黏膜感染，其发作频率或严重程度超出同龄健康个体的常见范围。

HP:5210252.name: Unusual oral thrush
HP:5210252.definition: Increased susceptibility to oral candidiasis caused by Candida albicans, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the oral mucosa, or by oral thrush occurring beyond the neonatal period without an identifiable predisposing cause.
HP:5210252.definition_cn: 白色念珠菌引起的口腔念珠菌病易感性增加，表现为口腔黏膜复发性或严重感染，或超出新生儿期且无明显诱因的鹅口疮。

HP:5210253.name: Severe oral thrush
HP:5210253.definition: Increased susceptibility to oral candidiasis, as manifested by severe or invasive oropharyngeal infection with Candida albicans, including extension to the oesophagus or systemic spread.
HP:5210253.definition_cn: 口腔念珠菌病易感性增加，表现为严重的或侵袭性的白色念珠菌口咽部感染，包括累及食道或全身播散。

HP:5210254.name: Severe pharyngitis
HP:5210254.definition: Increased susceptibility to pharyngitis, as manifested by a severe episode of pharyngeal infection requiring hospitalisation or intravenous antimicrobial therapy, or complicated by peritonsillar abscess, retropharyngeal abscess, or invasive spread.
HP:5210254.definition_cn: 咽炎易感性增加，具体表现为严重咽部感染发作需住院治疗或静脉注射抗菌药物治疗，或并发扁桃体周脓肿、咽后脓肿或侵袭性扩散。

HP:5210255.name: Severe otitis media
HP:5210255.definition: Increased susceptibility to otitis media, as manifested by a severe episode of middle ear infection requiring hospitalisation, intravenous antibiotics, or surgical intervention, or complicated by mastoiditis, meningitis, or other invasive spread.
HP:5210255.definition_cn: 对中耳炎易感性增加，表现为严重中耳感染发作，需要住院治疗、静脉抗生素或手术干预，或并发乳突炎、脑膜炎或其他侵袭性扩散。

HP:5210256.name: Severe otitis externa
HP:5210256.definition: Increased susceptibility to otitis externa, as manifested by a severe or invasive infection of the external ear canal, including necrotising (malignant) otitis externa with involvement of surrounding bone or soft tissue.
HP:5210256.definition_cn: 对外耳道炎易感性增加，表现为外耳道严重或侵袭性感染，包括累及周围骨或软组织的坏死性（恶性）外耳道炎。

HP:5210257.name: Recurrent otitis externa
HP:5210257.definition: Increased susceptibility to otitis externa, as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection of the external ear canal that are unusual in frequency or severity for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210257.definition_cn: 对特定外耳道炎的易感性增高，表现为反复发作的外耳道感染，其发作频率或严重程度对相同年龄的健康个体而言均属异常。

HP:5210258.name: Unusual conjunctivitis
HP:5210258.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious conjunctivitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the conjunctiva, or by conjunctivitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210258.definition_cn: 对感染性结膜炎的易感性增加，表现为结膜复发性或严重感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的结膜炎。

HP:5210259.name: Severe conjunctivitis
HP:5210259.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious conjunctivitis, as manifested by a severe episode with corneal involvement (keratoconjunctivitis), subepithelial infiltrates, or requiring systemic antiviral or antimicrobial therapy.
HP:5210259.definition_cn: 感染性结膜炎易感性增高，表现为伴有角膜受累（角结膜炎）、上皮下浸润或需全身抗病毒/抗微生物治疗的严重发作。

HP:5210260.name: Recurrent conjunctivitis
HP:5210260.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious conjunctivitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of conjunctival infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210260.definition_cn: 传染性结膜炎易感性增加，表现为反复发作的结膜感染，其发作频率对于同龄健康个体而言属异常增高。

HP:5210261.name: Unusual keratitis
HP:5210261.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious keratitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the cornea, or by keratitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210261.definition_cn: 感染性角膜炎易感性增高，表现为角膜反复发作或严重感染，或由非典型微生物或机会致病性微生物引起的角膜炎。

HP:5210262.name: Severe keratitis
HP:5210262.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious keratitis, as manifested by a severe episode of corneal infection with stromal involvement, corneal ulceration, perforation, or significant visual impairment.
HP:5210262.definition_cn: 对感染性角膜炎的易感性增加，表现为伴有基质受累的严重角膜感染发作、角膜溃疡、穿孔或显著视力损害。

HP:5210263.name: Recurrent keratitis
HP:5210263.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious keratitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of corneal infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210263.definition_cn: 对感染性角膜炎易感性增加，表现为反复发作的角膜感染，其发作频率超出同龄健康个体的正常范围。

HP:5210264.name: Unusual retinitis
HP:5210264.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious retinitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the retina, or by retinitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210264.definition_cn: 对感染性视网膜炎易感性增加，表现为视网膜反复或严重感染，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的视网膜炎。

HP:5210265.name: Severe retinitis
HP:5210265.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious retinitis, as manifested by severe or extensive retinal infection with rapid progression, retinal detachment, or significant visual loss.
HP:5210265.definition_cn: 对感染性视网膜炎的易感性增加，表现为重度或广泛性视网膜感染伴快速进展、视网膜脱离或显著视力丧失。

HP:5210266.name: Recurrent retinitis
HP:5210266.definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious retinitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of retinal infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
HP:5210266.definition_cn: 感染性视网膜炎易感性增高，表现为反复发作的视网膜感染，其发作频率在同龄健康个体中属异常。

HP:5210267.name: Family history of unusual infection
HP:5210267.definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of unusually severe, recurrent, or opportunistic infection.
HP:5210267.definition_cn: 一级或二级亲属中有异常严重、反复发作或机会性感染的家族史。

HP:5210268.name: Family history of immune deficiency
HP:5210268.definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of an immune deficiency.
HP:5210268.definition_cn: 免疫缺陷家族史（一级或二级亲属）。

HP:5210269.name: Family history of autoimmunity
HP:5210269.definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of an autoimmune disease.
HP:5210269.definition_cn: 一级或二级亲属的自身免疫性疾病家族史。

HP:5210270.name: Family history of death due to infection
HP:5210270.definition: A family history of death of a first- or second-degree relative caused by infection.
HP:5210270.name_cn: 家族史中有因感染导致的死亡病例
HP:5210270.definition_cn: 一级或二级亲属因感染所致死亡的家族史。

HP:5210271.name: Family history of lymphoma
HP:5210271.definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of a lymphoma.
HP:5210271.definition_cn: 一级或二级亲属中有淋巴瘤的家族史。

HP:5210272.name: Family history of leukaemia
HP:5210272.definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of a leukaemia.
HP:5210272.definition_cn: 一级或二级亲属中有白血病家族史。

HP:5210273.name: Maternal history of recurrent miscarriage
HP:5210273.definition: A maternal history of recurrent miscarriage, defined as two or more pregnancy losses.
HP:5210273.definition_cn: 复发性流产的母体病史，定义为两次或两次以上的妊娠丢失。

HP:5210274.name: Unexplained sibling death
HP:5210274.definition: Death of a sibling that remains unexplained despite investigation, which may indicate an undiagnosed disease in the family.
HP:5210274.name_cn: 不明原因同胞猝死（SUDC，Sudden Unexplained Death in Childhood）
HP:5210274.definition_cn: 兄弟姐妹不明原因死亡（经排查后仍无法解释），可能提示家族存在隐匿性疾病。

HP:5210275.name: Consanguinity
HP:5210275.definition: A reproductive relationship between two individuals who are related by blood as second cousins or closer. In a medical and genetic context, consanguinity increases the coefficient of inbreeding, raising the probability that an offspring will inherit identical alleles from a common ancestor (homozygosity by descent). This significantly increases the risk for autosomal recessive disorders, such as inborn errors of immunity, metabolic diseases, and rare neurodevelopmental syndromes. A history of consanguinity serves as a vital clinical marker for directing diagnostic investigations toward recessive genetic etiologies, especially in the presence of rare phenotypes or unexplained family medical history.
HP:5210275.definition_cn: 具有血缘关系的二级表亲或更近亲属之间的生殖关系。在医学和遗传学领域，近亲繁殖会提高近交系数，增加子代从共同祖先继承相同等位基因（同源纯合性）的概率。这将显著增加常染色体隐性遗传病的风险，包括免疫系统先天缺陷、代谢性疾病及罕见的神经发育综合征。近亲繁殖史是重要的临床标志，尤其在存在罕见表型或不明原因家族病史时，可引导诊断方向聚焦于隐性遗传病因学研究。

HP:5210276.name: Unusual mycobacterial osteomyelitis
HP:5210276.definition: An osteomyelitis caused by mycobacterial infection, with causative organisms including Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mycobacterium bovis BCG (typically as a complication of BCG vaccination), and non-tuberculous mycobacteria.
HP:5210276.name_cn: 非典型分枝杆菌骨髓炎
HP:5210276.definition_cn: 由分枝杆菌感染引起的骨髓炎，病原体包括结核分枝杆菌、牛分枝杆菌卡介苗（通常作为卡介苗接种后的并发症），以及非结核分枝杆菌。

HP:5210277.name: Unusual musculoskeletal infection
HP:5210277.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of bones, joints, or muscles, as manifested by recurrent or severe osteomyelitis, septic arthritis, or infectious myositis, or by musculoskeletal infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210277.definition_cn: 骨骼、关节或肌肉感染易感性增加，表现为反复发作或严重的骨髓炎、化脓性关节炎、感染性肌炎，或由非典型/机会性病原体引起的肌肉骨骼感染。

HP:5210278.name: Unusual infectious osteomyelitis
HP:5210278.definition: Increased susceptibility to osteomyelitis of infectious aetiology, as manifested by recurrent or severe bone infection, multifocal osteomyelitis, or osteomyelitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210278.definition_cn: 对感染性病因导致的骨髓炎易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重骨骼感染、多灶性骨髓炎，或由非典型或机会性病原体引发的骨髓炎。

HP:5210279.name: Unusual lymphatic system infection
HP:5210279.definition: Increased susceptibility to infection involving lymph nodes or lymphatic vessels, as manifested by recurrent or severe lymphadenitis or lymph node abscess, or by lymphatic infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
HP:5210279.definition_cn: 对感染涉及淋巴结或淋巴管的易感性增加，其临床表现包括复发性或严重淋巴结炎、淋巴结脓肿，或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的淋巴系统感染。

HP:5210280.name: Unusual oral cavity infection
HP:5210280.definition: Infection of the oral cavity including the gingiva, periodontium, teeth, tongue, or oral mucosa that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210280.definition_cn: 在异常易感背景下发生的口腔感染，包括牙龈、牙周组织、牙齿、舌部或口腔黏膜的感染。

HP:5210281.name: Post-vaccination mumps
HP:5210281.definition: Infection with attenuated mumps vaccine virus following mumps vaccination, occurring in the context of unusual susceptibility to live viral vaccines.
HP:5210281.definition_cn: 接种减毒腮腺炎疫苗后发生的疫苗病毒感染，发生在对活病毒疫苗异常易感的背景下。

HP:5210282.name: Cytomegalovirus retinitis
HP:5210282.definition: Retinitis caused by cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210282.name_cn: 巨细胞病毒性视网膜炎
HP:5210282.definition_cn: 发生于异常感染易感性背景下的巨细胞病毒（CMV）感染所致视网膜炎。

HP:5210283.name: Cytomegalovirus pneumonitis
HP:5210283.definition: Pneumonitis caused by cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210283.definition_cn: 特殊易感背景下巨细胞病毒（CMV）感染所致肺炎。

HP:5210284.name: Cytomegalovirus encephalitis
HP:5210284.definition: Encephalitis caused by cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210284.definition_cn: 发生在异常易感背景下的巨细胞病毒（CMV）感染所致脑炎。

HP:5210286.name: Unusual EBV infection
HP:5210286.definition: Increased susceptibility to Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infections as manifested by severe or disseminated disease or impaired control of EBV infection.
HP:5210286.definition_cn: 对EB病毒（EBV）感染的易感性增加，表现为严重感染、播散性感染或EBV感染控制能力受损。

HP:5210288.name: EBV-driven HLH
HP:5210288.definition: Haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) triggered by Epstein-Barr virus infection.
HP:5210288.name_cn: EBV相关性噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症
HP:5210288.definition_cn: 由EB病毒触发的噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症。

HP:5210290.name: Disseminated herpes simplex virus infection
HP:5210290.definition: Disseminated infection with herpes simplex virus (HSV), involving multiple organ systems.
HP:5210290.name_cn: 播散性单纯疱疹病毒感染
HP:5210290.definition_cn: 单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）播散性感染，累及多器官系统。

HP:5210291.name: Recurrent herpes simplex virus infection
HP:5210291.definition: Increased susceptibility to herpes simplex virus (HSV) infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of HSV infection.
HP:5210291.name_cn: 复发性单纯疱疹病毒感染
HP:5210291.definition_cn: 单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）感染易感性增高，表现为HSV感染反复发作。

HP:5210293.name: Persistent adenovirus viremia
HP:5210293.definition: Persistent or recurrent detection of adenovirus in the blood that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210293.definition_cn: 在异常感染易感性背景下，血中腺病毒持续或反复检出。

HP:5210294.name: Adenovirus colitis
HP:5210294.definition: Colitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210294.definition_cn: 腺病毒感染所致结肠炎发生于异常易感状态背景下。

HP:5210295.name: Adenovirus hepatitis
HP:5210295.definition: Hepatitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210295.definition_cn: 发生于感染易感性异常背景下的腺病毒感染所致肝炎

HP:5210296.name: Adenovirus encephalitis
HP:5210296.definition: Encephalitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210296.definition_cn: 由腺病毒感染引起的脑炎，发生于感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210297.name: Adenovirus pneumonitis
HP:5210297.definition: Pneumonitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210297.definition_cn: 腺病毒感染引发的肺炎，发生在感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210298.name: Recurrent chickenpox infection
HP:5210298.definition: Increased susceptibility to varicella (chickenpox) infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of chickenpox infection.
HP:5210298.definition_cn: 对水痘（chickenpox）感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的水痘感染。

HP:5210299.name: Severe chickenpox infection
HP:5210299.definition: Increased susceptibility to varicella (chickenpox) infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with varicella (chickenpox).
HP:5210299.definition_cn: 对水痘（chickenpox）感染的易感性增加，表现为水痘（chickenpox）的严重或侵袭性感染。

HP:5210301.name: VZV encephalitis
HP:5210301.definition: Encephalitis caused by varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210301.name_cn: 水痘-带状疱疹病毒脑炎
HP:5210301.definition_cn: 水痘-带状疱疹病毒（VZV）感染引起的脑炎，发生于感染异常易感性背景下。

HP:5210302.name: VZV pneumonitis
HP:5210302.definition: Pneumonitis caused by varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210302.name_cn: 水痘-带状疱疹病毒性肺炎
HP:5210302.definition_cn: 由水痘-带状疱疹病毒（VZV）感染引起的肺炎，发生于感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210303.name: Unusual warts
HP:5210303.definition: Increased susceptibility to human papillomavirus (HPV) causing warts infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HPV causing warts, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210303.definition_cn: 对引起疣的人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）易感性增加，表现为引起疣的HPV的复发性或严重/侵袭性感染，或发生在异常的解剖位置。

HP:5210304.name: Disseminated warts
HP:5210304.definition: Increased susceptibility to human papillomavirus (HPV) manifested by unusually severe, extensive, or invasive warts.
HP:5210304.definition_cn: 对人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的易感性增高，表现为异常严重、广泛或具有侵袭性生长模式的疣状病变。

HP:5210305.name: Recurrent warts
HP:5210305.definition: Increased susceptibility to human papillomavirus (HPV), manifested by recurrent episodes of warts.
HP:5210305.definition_cn: 人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）易感性增加，表现为疣状病变反复发作。

HP:5210306.name: Chronic warts
HP:5210306.definition: Increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection causing warts that fail to clear over an extended period or recur after treatment that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210306.definition_cn: 在异常感染易感性背景下，人类乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染风险增加，导致疣体持续存在（长期不消退）或治疗后复发。

HP:5210309.name: Persistent molluscum infection
HP:5210309.definition: Increased susceptibility to Molluscum contagiosum infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Molluscum contagiosum infection.
HP:5210309.name_cn: 持续性传染性软疣感染
HP:5210309.definition_cn: 传染性软疣感染易感性增高，表现为反复发作的传染性软疣感染。

HP:5210310.name: Unusual norovirus infection
HP:5210310.definition: Increased susceptibility to norovirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with norovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210310.definition_cn: 对诺如病毒易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性诺如病毒感染，或感染发生于异常解剖位置。

HP:5210312.name: Chronic norovirus infection
HP:5210312.definition: Increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent norovirus infection, as manifested by prolonged viral shedding and recurrent or unremitting gastrointestinal symptoms beyond the typical course of acute infection.
HP:5210312.definition_cn: 对慢性或持续性诺如病毒感染的易感性增高，表现为病毒脱落期延长，以及超出急性感染典型病程的复发性或持续性胃肠道症状。

HP:5210313.name: Unusual Aichi virus hepatitis
HP:5210313.definition: Hepatitis caused by Aichi virus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210313.definition_cn: 爱知病毒感染所致肝炎发生于感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210314.name: Unusual enterovirus infection
HP:5210314.definition: Increased susceptibility to enterovirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with enterovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210314.definition_cn: 对肠道病毒感染的易感性增高，表现为反复或严重/侵袭性肠道病毒感染，或发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210315.name: Enteroviral central nervous system infection
HP:5210315.definition: Infection of the central nervous system by enterovirus that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210315.name_cn: 肠道病毒中枢神经系统感染
HP:5210315.definition_cn: 肠道病毒在异常易感状态下感染中枢神经系统。

HP:5210316.name: Enteroviral sepsis
HP:5210316.definition: Sepsis or sepsis-like syndrome caused by enterovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210316.definition_cn: 肠道病毒感染引起的脓毒症或脓毒症样综合征，发生在感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210317.name: Unusual astrovirus infection
HP:5210317.definition: Increased susceptibility to astrovirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with astrovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210317.definition_cn: 对星状病毒感染的易感性增加，表现为反复或严重/侵袭性星状病毒感染，或发生于不常见解剖部位。

HP:5210318.name: Disseminated astrovirus infection
HP:5210318.definition: Disseminated infection with astrovirus involving organs beyond the gastrointestinal tract that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210318.definition_cn: 星状病毒播散性感染累及胃肠道以外器官，发生于特殊易感背景下。

HP:5210319.name: Astrovirus central nervous system infection
HP:5210319.definition: Infection of the central nervous system by astrovirus that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210319.name_cn: 星状病毒中枢神经系统感染
HP:5210319.definition_cn: 星状病毒引起的中枢神经系统感染发生于异常感染易感性的背景下。

HP:5210320.name: Unusual influenza infection
HP:5210320.definition: Increased susceptibility to influenza virus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with influenza virus.
HP:5210320.definition_cn: 对流感病毒的易感性增加，表现为反复或重症/侵袭性流感病毒感染。

HP:5210321.name: Persitent influenza virema
HP:5210321.definition: Persistent or recurrent detection of influenza virus in the blood or prolonged shedding in respiratory secretions that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210321.definition_cn: 在异常易感性背景下，流感病毒在血液中持续性或复发性检测阳性，或在呼吸道分泌物中持续排出。

HP:5210323.name: Unusual parainfluenza infection
HP:5210323.definition: Increased susceptibility to parainfluenza virus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with parainfluenza virus.
HP:5210323.definition_cn: 对副流感病毒感染的易感性增加，表现为复发或严重/侵袭性副流感病毒感染。

HP:5210325.name: Recurrent parainfluenza virus infection
HP:5210325.definition: Increased susceptibility to parainfluenza virus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of parainfluenza virus infection.
HP:5210325.name_cn: 复发性副流感病毒感染
HP:5210325.definition_cn: 对副流感病毒的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的副流感病毒感染。

HP:5210326.name: Chronic SARS-CoV-2 infection
HP:5210326.definition: A persistent SARS-CoV-2 infection with prolonged active viral replication and continuous detection of virus beyond the typical duration of acute COVID-19, typically lasting several weeks or longer, often with culturable virus and intra-host viral evolution. A chronic COVID-19 infection is distinct from post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (long COVID), which represents a post-infectious syndrome after viral clearance, and from recurrent COVID-19 reinfections, which are common in the general population.
HP:5210326.name_cn: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型慢性感染
HP:5210326.definition_cn: 一种伴有延长的活跃病毒复制且病毒持续检测超出急性COVID-19典型病程的持续性严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型感染，通常持续数周或更长时间，常可培养出病毒并存在宿主内病毒演化。慢性COVID-19感染区别于严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2型感染的急性期后遗症（长新冠），后者为病毒清除后的感染后综合征；亦区别于在普通人群中常见的复发性COVID-19再感染。

HP:5210328.name: Severe seasonal coronavirus infection
HP:5210328.definition: A severe infection caused by a seasonal coronavirus (HCoV-229E, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-NL63, or HCoV-HKU1), characterized by lower respiratory tract involvement, hypoxia, or systemic illness beyond that typically seen with these viruses in immunocompetent hosts.
HP:5210328.name_cn: 重度季节性冠状病毒感染
HP:5210328.definition_cn: 由季节性冠状病毒（HCoV-229E、HCoV-OC43、HCoV-NL63或HCoV-HKU1）引起的重症感染，以下呼吸道受累、低氧血症或超出非免疫抑制宿主通常表现的全身性病症为特征。

HP:5210329.name: Chronic seasonal coronavirus infection
HP:5210329.definition: A persistent infection with a seasonal coronavirus (HCoV-229E, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-NL63, or HCoV-HKU1) with prolonged active viral replication beyond the typical duration of acute infection.
HP:5210329.name_cn: 慢性季节性冠状病毒感染
HP:5210329.definition_cn: 指人季节性冠状病毒（HCoV-229E、HCoV-OC43、HCoV-NL63或HCoV-HKU1）的持续感染，其活跃病毒复制期超过急性感染的典型病程。

HP:5210330.name: Unusual HHV6 infection
HP:5210330.definition: Increased susceptibility to human herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HHV-6, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location, such as the brain.
HP:5210330.definition_cn: 对人类疱疹病毒6型（HHV-6）感染的易感性增加，表现为HHV-6感染的复发或严重/侵袭性感染，或发生在异常解剖部位（如脑部）。

HP:5210331.name: Unusual HHV8 infection
HP:5210331.definition: Increased susceptibility to human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HHV-8, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210331.definition_cn: 人类疱疹病毒8型（HHV-8）感染易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性HHV-8感染，或感染发生于罕见解剖部位。

HP:5210332.name: BK virus nephropathy
HP:5210332.definition: Nephropathy caused by BK polyomavirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210332.definition_cn: 在异常易感状态下，BK多瘤病毒感染导致的肾病。

HP:5210333.name: BK virus encephalitis
HP:5210333.definition: Encephalitis caused by BK polyomavirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210333.definition_cn: BK多瘤病毒感染所致脑炎，发生于感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210334.name: Unusual JC virus infection
HP:5210334.definition: Increased susceptibility to JC polyomavirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with JC polyomavirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210334.definition_cn: JC多瘤病毒感染的易感性增高，表现为JC多瘤病毒的复发性或严重/侵袭性感染，或发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210335.name: JC nephropathy
HP:5210335.definition: Nephropathy caused by JC polyomavirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
HP:5210335.definition_cn: JC多瘤病毒感染引起的肾病发生于感染易感性异常的背景下。

HP:5210336.name: JC encephalitis
HP:5210336.definition: Encephalitis caused by JC polyomavirus infection, typically presenting as progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML).
HP:5210336.definition_cn: JC多瘤病毒感染引起的脑炎，通常表现为进行性多灶性白质脑病(PML)。

HP:5210337.name: Infectious granulomatosis
HP:5210337.definition: Granulomatous inflammation with multiple granuloma formation attributable to a causative infectious agent, including bacteria, mycobacteria, fungi, or parasites.
HP:5210337.definition_cn: 由致病性感染因子（包括细菌、分枝杆菌、真菌或寄生虫）引起的肉芽肿性炎症，伴有多发性肉芽肿形成。

HP:5210338.name: Non-infectious granulomatosis
HP:5210338.definition: Granulomatous inflammation involving the formation of multiple granulomas not attributable to a causative infectious agent, arising in the context of immune dysregulation, foreign-body reactions or idiopathic.
HP:5210338.definition_cn: 肉芽肿性炎症表现为与感染性病原体无关的多发性肉芽肿形成，其发病机制涉及免疫失调、异物反应或特发性因素。

HP:5210339.name: Caseating granulomatosis
HP:5210339.definition: Granulomatous inflammation characterized by the formation of multiple granulomas exhibiting caseation necrosis, in which the necrotic tissue acquires an amorphous, cheese-like appearance.
HP:5210339.definition_cn: 以形成呈现干酪样坏死的多发性肉芽肿为特征的肉芽肿性炎症，其坏死组织呈现无定形的、奶酪样的外观。

HP:5210340.name: Non-caseating granulomatosis
HP:5210340.definition: Granulomatous inflammation characterized by the formation of multiple granulomas without central caseation necrosis.
HP:5210340.definition_cn: 肉芽肿性炎症，以多发性肉芽肿形成为特征，无中央干酪样坏死。

HP:5210341.name: Granulomatous lymphocytic interstitial lung disease
HP:5210341.definition: An interstitial lung disease, characterized by lymphocytic infiltration and/or granulomatous inflammation of the lung after exclusion of infection and alternative causes, often associated with multisystem inflammatory or granulomatous disease in patients with common variable immunodeficiency (CVID).
HP:5210341.name_cn: 肉芽肿性淋巴细胞性间质性肺疾病
HP:5210341.definition_cn: 一种间质性肺病，其特征为在排除感染及其他病因后，出现肺部淋巴细胞浸润和/或肉芽肿性炎症，常见于普通变异型免疫缺陷病（CVID）患者，常伴有多系统炎症性或肉芽肿性疾病。

HP:5210342.name: Granulomatous lymphadenopathy
HP:5210342.definition: Lymph node enlargement resulting from granulomatous inflammation, characterized by compact aggregates of epithelioid macrophages and giant cells within the lymph node parenchyma.
HP:5210342.definition_cn: 淋巴结肿大源于肉芽肿性炎症，其特征为淋巴结实质内致密聚集的上皮样巨噬细胞和巨细胞。

HP:5210343.name: Granuloma annulare
HP:5210343.definition: A non-infectious inflammatory granulomatous dermatosis characterized by annular or disseminated erythematous plaques resulting from palisading granulomas with central mucin deposition in the dermis.
HP:5210343.definition_cn: 非感染性炎性肉芽肿性皮肤病，其特征为环状或播散性红斑性斑块，真皮内可见伴中心黏蛋白沉积的栅栏状肉芽肿。

HP:5210344.name: Granulomatous synovitis
HP:5210344.definition: Inflammation of the synovial membrane characterized by granuloma formation within synovial tissue, consisting of aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with or without multinucleated giant cells.
HP:5210344.definition_cn: 滑膜炎症，特征为滑膜组织内形成肉芽肿，表现为上皮样组织细胞聚集，伴或不伴多核巨细胞。

HP:5210345.name: Granulomatous uveitis
HP:5210345.definition: Uveitis characterized by granulomatous inflammatory pattern of the uveal tract, with clinical findings that may include large keratic precipitates, iris nodules, or other signs of intraocular granulomatous inflammation.
HP:5210345.definition_cn: 以肉芽肿性炎症为特征的葡萄膜炎，其临床表现可包括大角膜后沉着物、虹膜结节或其他眼内肉芽肿性炎症表现。

HP:5210346.name: Granulomatous gingivitis
HP:5210346.definition: Inflammation of the gingiva characterized by granulomatous tissue reaction, with compact aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleate giant cells within the gingival lamina propria.
HP:5210346.definition_cn: 以肉芽肿性组织反应为特征的牙龈炎症，牙龈固有层内可见致密聚集的上皮样组织细胞和多核巨细胞。

HP:5210347.name: Granulomatous iritis
HP:5210347.definition: Inflammation of the iris characterized by granulomatous tissue reaction, with compact aggregates of mononuclear phagocytes within the iris stroma.
HP:5210347.definition_cn: 以肉芽肿性组织反应为特征的虹膜炎症，其虹膜基质内可见单核吞噬细胞的致密聚集。

HP:5210348.name: Unusual Burkholderia pseudomallei infection
