HP:5210348.definition: An increased susceptibility to Burkholderia pseudomallei infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Burkholderia pseudomallei, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210348.name_cn: 不典型假鼻疽伯克霍尔德菌感染
HP:5210348.definition_cn: 对伯克霍尔德菌（*Burkholderia pseudomallei*）感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性伯克霍尔德菌感染，或发生于罕见解剖部位的感染。

HP:5210349.name: Unusual coagulase-negative Staphylococcus infection
HP:5210349.definition: An increased susceptibility to coagulase-negative staphylococci infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with coagulase-negative staphylococci, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210349.name_cn: 罕见凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染
HP:5210349.definition_cn: 凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染，或发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210350.name: Recurrent coagulase-negative Staphylococcus infection
HP:5210350.definition: An increased susceptibility to coagulase-negative staphylococci infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of coagulase-negative staphylococci infection.
HP:5210350.name_cn: 复发性凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染
HP:5210350.definition_cn: 对凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌的易感性增高，表现为反复发作的凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染。

HP:5210351.name: Severe coagulase-negative Staphylococcus infection
HP:5210351.definition: An increased susceptibility to coagulase-negative staphylococci infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with coagulase-negative staphylococci.
HP:5210351.name_cn: 严重凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染
HP:5210351.definition_cn: 对凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌易感性增加，表现为发生严重或侵袭性的凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌感染。

HP:5210352.name: Unusual Enterococcus faecalis infection
HP:5210352.definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecalis infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Enterococcus faecalis, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210352.definition_cn: 对粪肠球菌的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性粪肠球菌感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖位置。

HP:5210353.name: Recurrent Enterococcus faecalis infection
HP:5210353.definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecalis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210353.definition_cn: 对粪肠球菌感染的易感性增加，表现为该病原体引起的反复感染发作。

HP:5210354.name: Severe Enterococcus faecalis infection
HP:5210354.definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecalis infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Enterococcus faecalis.
HP:5210354.definition_cn: 粪肠球菌感染易感性增加——表现为粪肠球菌引起的严重或侵袭性感染。

HP:5210355.name: Unusual Enterococcus faecium infection
HP:5210355.definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecium infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Enterococcus faecium, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210355.definition_cn: 对粪肠球菌感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性粪肠球菌感染，或感染发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210356.name: Recurrent Enterococcus faecium infection
HP:5210356.definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecium infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210356.definition_cn: 对粪肠球菌感染易感性增加，表现为反复发生该病原体的感染发作。

HP:5210357.name: Severe Enterococcus faecium infection
HP:5210357.definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecium infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Enterococcus faecium.
HP:5210357.definition_cn: 屎肠球菌易感性增高，表现为屎肠球菌引起的严重或侵袭性感染。

HP:5210358.name: Unusual Viridans Streptococci infection
HP:5210358.definition: An increased susceptibility to viridans group streptococci infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with viridans group streptococci, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210358.name_cn: 不寻常的草绿色链球菌感染
HP:5210358.definition_cn: 对草绿色链球菌群感染的易感性增高，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性草绿色链球菌群感染，或感染发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210359.name: Endocarditis caused by Streptococcus viridans infection
HP:5210359.definition: An endocarditis caused by infection with viridans group streptococci, which are a characteristic causative agent of subacute bacterial endocarditis.
HP:5210359.name_cn: 草绿色链球菌感染引起的心内膜炎
HP:5210359.definition_cn: 由草绿色链球菌感染引起的心内膜炎——此类病原体是亚急性细菌性心内膜炎的典型致病菌。

HP:5210360.name: Liver abscess due to Streptococcus viridans
HP:5210360.definition: A liver abscess caused by infection with viridans group streptococci, which may arise from hematogenous spread, biliary infection, or contiguous spread.
HP:5210360.name_cn: 草绿色链球菌性肝脓肿
HP:5210360.definition_cn: 由草绿色链球菌群感染引起的肝脓肿，可经血源性播散、胆道感染或邻近组织蔓延等途径发生。

HP:5210361.name: Unusual Mycobacterium abscessus infection
HP:5210361.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium abscessus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycobacterium abscessus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210361.name_cn: 非典型脓肿分枝杆菌感染
HP:5210361.definition_cn: 对脓肿分枝杆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为脓肿分枝杆菌的复发性或严重/侵袭性感染，或感染发生于不寻常的解剖位置。

HP:5210362.name: Recurrent Mycobacterium abscessus infection
HP:5210362.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium abscessus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210362.name_cn: 复发性脓肿分枝杆菌感染
HP:5210362.definition_cn: 对脓肿分枝杆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的该病原体感染。

HP:5210363.name: Severe Mycobacterium abscessus infection
HP:5210363.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium abscessus infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Mycobacterium abscessus.
HP:5210363.name_cn: 严重脓肿分枝杆菌感染
HP:5210363.definition_cn: 对脓肿分枝杆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为严重的或侵袭性的脓肿分枝杆菌感染。

HP:5210364.name: Unusual Mycobacterium avium complex infection
HP:5210364.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycobacterium avium complex, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210364.name_cn: 非典型鸟分枝杆菌复合群感染
HP:5210364.definition_cn: 对鸟分枝杆菌复合群感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或重度/侵袭性鸟分枝杆菌复合群感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210365.name: Recurrent Mycobacterium avium complex infection
HP:5210365.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210365.name_cn: 复发性鸟分枝杆菌复合群感染
HP:5210365.definition_cn: 对鸟分枝杆菌复合体感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的该病原体感染。

HP:5210366.name: Severe Mycobacterium avium complex infection
HP:5210366.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Mycobacterium avium complex.
HP:5210366.name_cn: 严重鸟分枝杆菌复合群感染
HP:5210366.definition_cn: 对鸟分枝杆菌复合体易感性增高，表现为严重的鸟分枝杆菌复合体感染或侵袭性鸟分枝杆菌复合体感染。

HP:5210367.name: Unusual Mycoplasma infection
HP:5210367.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycoplasma infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycoplasma, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210367.definition_cn: 对支原体感染的易感性增高，表现为反复或严重/侵袭性支原体感染，或发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210368.name: Recurrent Mycoplasma infection
HP:5210368.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycoplasma infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210368.definition_cn: 对支原体感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的此类病原体感染。

HP:5210369.name: Severe Mycoplasma infection
HP:5210369.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycoplasma infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Mycoplasma.
HP:5210369.definition_cn: 对支原体感染易感性增加，表现为严重的或侵袭性支原体感染。

HP:5210370.name: Unusual Ureaplasma infection
HP:5210370.definition: An increased susceptibility to Ureaplasma infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Ureaplasma, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210370.definition_cn: 对Ureaplasma感染的易感性增高，表现为反复发作或严重/侵袭性的Ureaplasma感染，或感染发生在异常的解剖部位。

HP:5210371.name: Pulmonary cryptococcosis
HP:5210371.definition: An infection of the lungs caused by Cryptococcus species, which is the most common entry portal for cryptococcal disease and may present as nodules, consolidation, or interstitial infiltrates.
HP:5210371.definition_cn: 由隐球菌属引起的肺部感染，这是隐球菌病最常见的侵入门户，临床可表现为结节、实变或间质性浸润。

HP:5210372.name: Cryptococcoma
HP:5210372.definition: A granulomatous mass-like lesion caused by Cryptococcus infection, which may occur in the lung, brain, skin, or other organs.
HP:5210372.definition_cn: 由隐球菌感染引起的肉芽肿性肿块样病变，可发生于肺部、脑部、皮肤或其他器官。

HP:5210373.name: Unusual mucormycosis
HP:5210373.definition: An increased susceptibility to Mucorales infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mucorales, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210373.definition_cn: 毛霉目感染易感性增高，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性毛霉目感染，或发生于异常解剖部位的感染。

HP:5210374.name: Unusual Talaromyces marneffei infection
HP:5210374.definition: An increased susceptibility to Talaromyces marneffei infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Talaromyces marneffei, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210374.name_cn: 罕见马尔尼菲篮状菌感染
HP:5210374.definition_cn: 对马尔尼菲篮状菌感染易感性增加，表现为复发性或重症/侵袭性马尔尼菲篮状菌感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210375.name: Unusual dermatophyte infection
HP:5210375.definition: An increased susceptibility to dermatophytes infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with dermatophytes, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210375.definition_cn: 对皮肤癣菌的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性皮肤癣菌感染，或发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210376.name: Recurrent dermatophyte infection
HP:5210376.definition: An increased susceptibility to dermatophytes infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210376.definition_cn: 对皮肤癣菌的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的感染。

HP:5210378.name: Unusual mold infection
HP:5210378.definition: An increased susceptibility to mould infection, as manifested by a recurrent or severe invasive infection with filamentous fungi other than Aspergillus, or by a mould infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism. Common causative organisms include Fusarium species, Scedosporium species, and Lomentospora prolificans.
HP:5210378.definition_cn: 对霉菌感染易感性增加，表现为反复或严重的侵袭性丝状真菌感染（除曲霉外），或由非典型或机会性病原体引起的霉菌感染。常见致病菌包括镰刀菌属、赛多孢子菌属和繁茂波氏霉菌。

HP:5210379.name: Unusual Blastomyces dermatitidis infection
HP:5210379.definition: An increased susceptibility to Blastomyces dermatitidis infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Blastomyces dermatitidis, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210379.name_cn: 不典型皮炎芽生菌感染
HP:5210379.definition_cn: 对皮炎芽生菌感染易感性增加，表现为皮炎芽生菌引起的复发性或严重/侵袭性感染，或发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210380.name: Recurrent Blastomyces dermatitidis infection
HP:5210380.definition: An increased susceptibility to Blastomyces dermatitidis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210380.definition_cn: 对皮炎芽生菌（Blastomyces dermatitidis）的易感性增加，其特征为反复发作的该病原体感染。

HP:5210381.name: Severe Blastomyces dermatitidis infection
HP:5210381.definition: An increased susceptibility to Blastomyces dermatitidis infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Blastomyces dermatitidis.
HP:5210381.name_cn: 严重的皮炎芽生菌感染
HP:5210381.definition_cn: 对皮炎芽生菌的易感性增加，表现为严重的或侵袭性的皮炎芽生菌感染。

HP:5210382.name: Unusual Coccidioides infection
HP:5210382.definition: An increased susceptibility to Coccidioides infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Coccidioides, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210382.definition_cn: 球孢子菌感染易感性增高，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性球孢子菌感染，或感染发生在异常解剖部位。

HP:5210383.name: Recurrent Coccidioides infection
HP:5210383.definition: An increased susceptibility to Coccidioides infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210383.definition_cn: 对球孢子菌属感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的该病原体感染。

HP:5210384.name: Severe Coccidioides infection
HP:5210384.definition: An increased susceptibility to Coccidioides infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Coccidioides.
HP:5210384.definition_cn: 球孢子菌感染易感性增高，表现为球孢子菌所致严重感染或侵袭性感染。

HP:5210385.name: Unusual Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infection
HP:5210385.definition: An increased susceptibility to Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Paracoccidioides brasiliensis, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210385.name_cn: 罕见巴西副球孢子菌感染
HP:5210385.definition_cn: 对巴西副球孢子菌感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或重症/侵袭性巴西副球孢子菌感染，或发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210386.name: Recurrent Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infection
HP:5210386.definition: An increased susceptibility to Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210386.name_cn: 复发性巴西副球孢子菌感染
HP:5210386.definition_cn: 对巴西副球孢子菌的易感性增加，表现为该病原体引起的感染反复发作。

HP:5210387.name: Severe Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infection
HP:5210387.definition: An increased susceptibility to Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Paracoccidioides brasiliensis.
HP:5210387.name_cn: 重症巴西副球孢子菌感染
HP:5210387.definition_cn: 巴西副球孢子菌感染的易感性增高，表现为严重的或侵袭性的巴西副球孢子菌感染。

HP:5210389.name: Recurrent Histoplasma capsulatum infection
HP:5210389.definition: An increased susceptibility to Histoplasma capsulatum infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.
HP:5210389.name_cn: 复发性荚膜组织胞浆菌感染
HP:5210389.definition_cn: 对荚膜组织胞浆菌感染的易感性增加，表现为反复发作的该病原体感染。

HP:5210391.name: Unusual Candida auris infection
HP:5210391.definition: An increased susceptibility to Candida auris infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Candida auris, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210391.definition_cn: 对耳念珠菌感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性耳念珠菌感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210392.name: Chronic Candida auris infection
HP:5210392.definition: An increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent Candida auris infection, as manifested by prolonged infection with this multi-drug-resistant emerging Candida species.
HP:5210392.definition_cn: 对慢性或持续性耳念珠菌感染的易感性增加，表现为由该多药耐药新兴念珠菌属引起的迁延性感染。

HP:5210393.name: Severe Candida auris infection
HP:5210393.definition: An increased susceptibility to Candida auris infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Candida auris.
HP:5210393.definition_cn: 对耳念珠菌感染的易感性增加，表现为由耳念珠菌引起的严重或侵袭性感染。

HP:5210394.name: HSV hepatitis
HP:5210394.definition: A hepatitis caused by herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection, which may present as a severe or fulminant hepatitis with elevated transaminases, coagulopathy, and hepatic failure.
HP:5210394.definition_cn: 由单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）感染引起的肝炎，可能表现为重症或暴发性肝炎，伴有转氨酶升高、凝血功能障碍和肝功能衰竭。

HP:5210395.name: VZV meningitis
HP:5210395.definition: A meningitis caused by varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infection, which may occur as part of primary varicella, herpes zoster, or zoster sine herpete (without rash).
HP:5210395.name_cn: 水痘-带状疱疹病毒性脑膜炎
HP:5210395.definition_cn: 水痘-带状疱疹病毒（VZV）感染引起的脑膜炎，可发生于原发性水痘、带状疱疹或无疹性带状疱疹过程中。

HP:5210396.name: Giant molluscum
HP:5210396.definition: A molluscum contagiosum lesion exceeding one centimetre in diameter, which may present as an unusually large, persistent, or atypical lesion.
HP:5210396.definition_cn: 直径超过一厘米的传染性软疣病变，可表现为异常大、持续存在或不典型的病变。

HP:5210397.name: Unusual HHV7 infection
HP:5210397.definition: An increased susceptibility to human herpesvirus 7 (HHV-7) infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HHV-7, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210397.definition_cn: 对人类疱疹病毒7型（HHV-7）感染的易感性增加，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性HHV-7感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210398.name: BK virus cystitis
HP:5210398.definition: A cystitis caused by BK polyomavirus infection, typically presenting as haemorrhagic cystitis with macroscopic haematuria.
HP:5210398.definition_cn: 由BK多瘤病毒感染引起的膀胱炎，典型表现为伴有肉眼血尿的出血性膀胱炎。

HP:5210399.name: Unusual poliovirus infection
HP:5210399.definition: An increased susceptibility to poliovirus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with poliovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210399.name_cn: 非典型脊髓灰质炎病毒感染
HP:5210399.definition_cn: 脊髓灰质炎病毒感染易感性增高，表现为反复发作或严重/侵袭性脊髓灰质炎病毒感染，或发生于非典型解剖部位。该易感性增高可通过以下方式证实：（1）培养或分子检测分离出脊髓灰质炎病毒，（2）通过检测针对病毒抗原的特异性抗体证实感染。

HP:5210400.name: Chronic poliovirus excretion
HP:5210400.definition: A chronic shedding of poliovirus in stool over an extended period, typically following vaccination with live attenuated oral poliovirus vaccine, with viral excretion persisting for months or years. A chronic poliovirus excretion is characteristic of antibody deficiencies including X-linked agammaglobulinaemia and common variable immunodeficiency, in which patients may shed vaccine-derived poliovirus indefinitely.
HP:5210400.name_cn: 慢性脊髓灰质炎病毒排出
HP:5210400.definition_cn: 脊髓灰质炎病毒在粪便中的长期慢性排出，通常见于接种口服脊髓灰质炎减毒活疫苗后，病毒排泄可持续数月或数年。慢性脊髓灰质炎病毒排出是抗体缺陷疾病的特征，包括X连锁无丙种球蛋白血症和常见变异型免疫缺陷病，这些患者可能无限期排出疫苗衍生脊髓灰质炎病毒。

HP:5210401.name: Severe rotavirus infection
HP:5210401.definition: An increased susceptibility to rotavirus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with rotavirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210401.definition_cn: 对轮状病毒感染的易感性增高，表现为反复发生或严重/侵袭性轮状病毒感染，或感染发生于非典型解剖位置。

HP:5210402.name: Unusual respiratory syncytial virus infection
HP:5210402.definition: An increased susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with RSV, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210402.name_cn: 非典型呼吸道合胞病毒感染
HP:5210402.definition_cn: 对呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）感染的易感性增高，表现为反复或严重/侵袭性RSV感染，或发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210403.name: Severe respiratory syncytial virus infection
HP:5210403.definition: An increased susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
HP:5210403.name_cn: 重症呼吸道合胞病毒感染
HP:5210403.definition_cn: 对呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）感染的易感性增加，表现为严重或侵袭性呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）感染。

HP:5210404.name: Chronic respiratory syncytial virus infection
HP:5210404.definition: An increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, as manifested by prolonged viral shedding and persistent or recurrent respiratory symptoms beyond the typical course of acute infection.
HP:5210404.name_cn: 慢性呼吸道合胞病毒感染
HP:5210404.definition_cn: 对慢性或持续性呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）感染的易感性增加，表现为病毒持续排出时间延长，并在急性感染典型病程后仍存在持续或反复发作的呼吸道症状。

HP:5210405.name: Chronic rhinovirus infection
HP:5210405.definition: An increased susceptibility to rhinovirus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with rhinovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210405.definition_cn: 鼻病毒感染易感性增高，表现为复发性或严重/侵袭性鼻病毒感染，或发生于非典型解剖部位。

HP:5210406.name: Unusual human metapneumovirus infection
HP:5210406.definition: An increased susceptibility to human metapneumovirus (hMPV) infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with hMPV, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
HP:5210406.name_cn: 非典型人偏肺病毒感染
HP:5210406.definition_cn: 人类偏肺病毒（hMPV）感染的易感性增高，表现为复发性或重症/侵袭性hMPV感染，或感染发生于异常解剖部位。

HP:5210407.name: Toxoplasma eye infection
HP:5210407.definition: An ocular infection caused by Toxoplasma gondii, typically presenting as chorioretinitis with characteristic retinal lesions and potential progression to vision loss.
HP:5210407.definition_cn: 由刚地弓形虫引起的眼部感染，常表现为脉络膜视网膜炎，特征性视网膜病变并可能进展至视力丧失。

HP:5210408.name: BCG-associated disease
HP:5210408.definition: An adverse disease following vaccination with the Bacillus Calmette-Gu茅rin (BCG) live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis vaccine, ranging from local BCGitis (regional lymphadenitis or injection-site abscess) to disseminated BCGosis. BCG associated disease can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in severe combined immunodeficiency, Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease (MSMD), and chronic granulomatous disease.
HP:5210408.definition_cn: 接种卡介苗（Bacillus Calmette-Guérin，减毒牛分枝杆菌活疫苗）后可能出现的不良疾病，其表现范围从局部卡介苗病（区域性淋巴结炎或注射部位脓肿）到播散性卡介苗病。卡介苗相关疾病可能是感染易感性异常的表现，尤其见于重症联合免疫缺陷病、孟德尔遗传性分枝杆菌易感性疾病（MSMD）以及慢性肉芽肿病患者。

HP:6000000.name: Left-right disorientation
HP:6000000.definition: A tendency to mix up left and right in one's own body space, typically elicited by asking a person to perform a two-stage command involving specified lateralized anatomy.
HP:6000000.definition_cn: 自身身体空间内左右混淆的倾向，通常通过要求个体执行涉及特定侧向解剖结构的两阶段指令来诱发。

HP:6000001.name: Elevated circulating DNAJB9 protein concentration
HP:6000001.definition: Concentration of DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 (DNAJB9) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000001.definition_cn: 血液循环中DnaJ同源亚家族B成员9（DNAJB9）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000002.name: Olecranon fracture
HP:6000002.definition: A partial or complete break in the olecranon,which is the proximal articular portion of the ulna and makes up part of the elbow.
HP:6000002.definition_cn: 尺骨鹰嘴部分或完全骨折，尺骨鹰嘴是尺骨的近端关节部分，构成肘关节的一部分。

HP:6000003.name: History of mastectomy
HP:6000003.definition: Past medical history of surgical breast removal.
HP:6000003.definition_cn: 既往手术史：乳房切除术。

HP:6000004.name: Lymphangiosarcoma
HP:6000004.definition: A malignant neoplasm arising from the endothelial cells of the lymphatic vessels.
HP:6000004.definition_cn: 淋巴管内皮细胞来源的恶性肿瘤。

HP:6000005.name: Exposure to inhaled lipids
HP:6000005.definition: Aspiration or inhalation of lipid-containing products.
HP:6000005.definition_cn: 脂质类物质吸入或误吸。

HP:6000006.name: Holster sign
HP:6000006.definition: Symmetric poikiloderma of hips and lateral thighs below the greater trochanter.
HP:6000006.definition_cn: 大转子下方臀部及大腿外侧对称性皮肤异色症。

HP:6000007.name: Salivary basal cell adenoma
HP:6000007.definition: A rare neoplasm consisting of a monomorphic population of basaloid epithelial cells, and it accounts for approximately 1-2% of all salivary gland tumors.
HP:6000007.definition_cn: 一种罕见的肿瘤，由单形性基底样上皮细胞组成，约占所有唾液腺肿瘤的1-2%。

HP:6000008.name: Hemidiaphragm elevation
HP:6000008.definition: Elevated Hemidiaphragm is a condition where one portion of the diaphragm is higher than the other. Elevated hemidiaphragm occurs when one side of the diaphragm becomes weak from muscular disease or loss of innervation due to phrenic nerve injury.
HP:6000008.definition_cn: 膈肌抬高（Elevated Hemidiaphragm）是指膈肌的一部分高于另一部分的病理状态。膈肌抬高通常是由于膈肌因肌肉疾病或膈神经损伤导致的神经支配丧失而出现一侧膈肌无力所致。

HP:6000009.name: Cerebriform connective tissue nevus
HP:6000009.definition: The cerebriform connective tissue nevus (CCTN) is one of the most characteristic skin findings. It commonly occurs on the soles of the feet, and frequently causes problems because of pain, pruritus, infection, bleeding,exudation, odor, and walking impairment.
HP:6000009.definition_cn: 脑回状结缔组织痣（Cerebriform Connective Tissue Nevus, CCTN）是最具特征性的皮肤表现之一。其常见于足底，常因疼痛、瘙痒、感染、出血、渗出、异味及行走障碍等问题引发临床症状。

HP:6000010.name: Linear Hyperpigmentation along Blaschko's lines
HP:6000010.definition: Linear streaks and swirls of macular hyperpigmentation along the lines of Blaschko.
HP:6000010.definition_cn: 沿Blaschko线分布的斑片状色素沉着呈线性条纹和漩涡状。

HP:6000011.name: Excessive guilt
HP:6000011.definition: Excessive guilt is an internal feeling that is intense and considered clinically to be beyond normal range, out of proportion for the act or offense; excessive guilt is typically based on an incorrect judgment of responsibility for an unfavorable outcome. Excessive guilt is typically pervasive and enduring, i.e. it is not fleeting or a temporary thought associated with a specific action.
HP:6000011.definition_cn: 过度内疚是一种强烈的内在情感，在临床上被认为超出正常范围，与行为或过错不成比例；过度内疚通常基于对不利结果责任的不正确判断。过度内疚通常是普遍且持久的，即它不是短暂的或与特定行为相关的暂时性想法。

HP:6000012.name: Mediastinal shift
HP:6000012.definition: A deviation of the mediastinum from its normal position in the midline of the thoracic cavity. The mediastinum is a compartment of the thoracic cavity that contains the heart and its blood vessels, the esophagus, trachea, thymus, as well as nerves and lymph nodes.
HP:6000012.definition_cn: 纵隔偏离其在胸腔中线正常位置。纵隔是胸腔的一个隔室，包含心脏及其血管、食管、气管、胸腺以及神经和淋巴结。

HP:6000013.name: Bendopnea
HP:6000013.definition: Dyspnea as a result of bending forward while not holding one's breath; dyspnea or shortness of breath onset within 30 seconds of bending forward.
HP:6000013.definition_cn: 前屈位不屏气时出现的呼吸困难；前屈位30秒内出现的呼吸困难或气短。

HP:6000014.name: Pain worse when lying flat
HP:6000014.definition: Refers to pain that is worse when the affected individual lies down (flat).
HP:6000014.definition_cn: 指患者在平卧位时疼痛加重的症状。

HP:6000015.name: Tympanic membrane hypermobility
HP:6000015.definition: Abnormally increased ability to move of the tympanic membrane.

HP:6000016.name: Elevated circulating vitamin B12 concentration
HP:6000016.definition: Concentration of vitamin B12 in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000016.definition_cn: 血清维生素B12浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000017.name: Elevated circulating soluble FASL concentration
HP:6000017.definition: The concentration of soluble FASL in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. The first apoptosis signal receptor (FAS) pathway regulates apoptosis and is critical for proper development and functioning of the immune system. FAS ligand (FASL) can bind to FAS receptors.
HP:6000017.name_cn: 循环可溶性FAS配体浓度升高
HP:6000017.definition_cn: 循环血液中可溶性FAS配体（soluble FASL）浓度高于正常上限。第一凋亡信号受体（FAS）通路调控细胞凋亡，对免疫系统的正常发育和功能至关重要。FAS配体（FASL）可与FAS受体结合。

HP:6000018.name: Internal anal sphincter achalasia
HP:6000018.definition: A disorder of the internal anal sphincter (IAS) in which the IAS fails to relax that manifests clinically as intractable constipation.
HP:6000018.name_cn: 肛门内括约肌失弛缓症
HP:6000018.definition_cn: 内括约肌功能障碍（Internal Anal Sphincter Dysfunction, IASD），表现为内括约肌无法松弛，临床表现为顽固性便秘（Intractable Constipation）。

HP:6000019.name: Anthracycline exposure
HP:6000019.definition: History of treatment with an anthracycline chemotherapy agent.
HP:6000019.definition_cn: 既往使用蒽环类化疗药物治疗史。

HP:6000020.name: Binge drinking
HP:6000020.definition: A pattern of episodic heavy alcohol use characterized by the consumption of a high number of drinks per occasion.
HP:6000020.definition_cn: 一种间歇性大量饮酒的模式，其特征为每次饮酒时摄入大量酒精饮料。

HP:6000021.name: Decreased circulating thrombopoietin concentration
HP:6000021.definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.
HP:6000021.name_cn: 循环中血小板生成素浓度降低
HP:6000021.definition_cn: 循环血液中血小板生成素浓度低于正常值下限。血小板生成素是一种由肝脏和肾脏产生的糖蛋白激素，可刺激巨核细胞的生成和分化。

HP:6000022.name: Collagenoma
HP:6000022.definition: A rare hamartomatous malformation characterized by the predominant proliferation of normal collagen fibers and normal, decreased, or increased elastic fibers. Collagenomas may be solitary or multiple, sporadic, acquired or inherited.
HP:6000022.definition_cn: 一种罕见的错构瘤性畸形，其特征为正常胶原纤维的显著增生，以及正常、减少或增加的弹性纤维。胶原瘤可为单发或多发，散发性、获得性或遗传性。

HP:6000023.name: Lack of sufficient daily physical activity
HP:6000023.definition: Physical activity levels less than those required for optimal health and prevention of premature death.
HP:6000023.definition_cn: 体力活动水平低于维持最佳健康状态和预防过早死亡所需的标准。

HP:6000024.name: Synesthesia
HP:6000024.definition: A phenomenon whereby stimulation of one sensory or cognitive pathway leads to automatic, involuntary experiences in a second sensory or cognitive pathway. For instance, people with synaesthesia may experience unusual colors, tastes, and other sensations when engaged in everyday activities like reading or listening to music.
HP:6000024.definition_cn: 一种现象，即刺激一个感觉或认知通路会导致在第二个感觉或认知通路中产生自动、非自主的体验。例如，联觉患者在从事日常活动（如阅读或听音乐）时，可能会体验到异常的颜色、味觉及其他感觉。

HP:6000025.name: Dark cerumen
HP:6000025.definition: Abnormally dark color of cerumen (earwax), which is a waxy substance secreted in the ear canal that normally has a brown, orange, red, yellowish or gray.
HP:6000025.definition_cn: 耵聍（耳垢）颜色异常深暗，其为外耳道分泌的蜡状物质，通常呈棕色、橙色、红色、淡黄色或灰色。

HP:6000026.name: History of spicy food intake
HP:6000026.definition: A history of high intake of spciy foods with ingrediaents such as capsaicin, pepper, chili, ginger, garlic, onion, fenugreek, and turmeric.
HP:6000026.definition_cn: 长期高摄入含有辣椒素、胡椒、辣椒、姜、大蒜、洋葱、葫芦巴和姜黄等成分的辛辣食物史。

HP:6000027.name: Oil-drop brown pigmentation of the corneal limbus
HP:6000027.definition: Brown pigment spots in the limbus (border between the cornea and the sclera).
HP:6000027.name_cn: 角膜缘油滴状棕色色素沉着
HP:6000027.definition_cn: 角膜缘（角膜与巩膜交界处）棕色色素斑。

HP:6000028.name: Hazardous alcohol use
HP:6000028.definition: Hazardous drinking is defined as a quantity or pattern of alcohol consumption that places individuals at risk for adverse health events. This could include alcohol use despite potentially hazardous or risky consequences, such as operating heavy machinery or drunk driving.
HP:6000028.definition_cn: 危险饮酒被定义为一种酒精摄入量或饮酒模式，使个体面临不良健康事件的风险。这可能包括在潜在危险或风险后果的情况下仍饮酒，例如操作重型机械或酒后驾驶。

HP:6000029.name: Social anxiety
HP:6000029.definition: Excessive fear of embarrassment, humiliation, or rejection when exposed to possible negative evaluation by others when engaged in a public performance or social interaction.
HP:6000029.name_cn: 社交焦虑障碍 (Social Anxiety Disorder, SAD)
HP:6000029.definition_cn: 在公众表演或社交互动中，当面临可能的负面评价时，对尴尬、羞辱或拒绝的过度恐惧。

HP:6000030.name: Placidity
HP:6000030.definition: Flat affect and reduced response to emotional stimuli. Fear and anger responses that are normally present are blunted.
HP:6000030.definition_cn: 情感平淡和对情绪刺激的反应减弱。通常存在的恐惧和愤怒反应被钝化。

HP:6000031.name: Phaeohyphomycosis
HP:6000031.definition: Phaeohyphomycosis refers to infections due to a large group of heterogenous organisms called dematiaceous or melanized fungi. These fungi are distinguished by the predominance of melanin in their cell walls, which likely acts as a virulence factor. Virtually, everyone is exposed to dematiaceous fungi through inhalation, as they are ubiquitous in the environment, although the development of infection is extremely uncommon.
HP:6000031.definition_cn: 暗色丝孢霉病（Phaeohyphomycosis）是指由一大类异质性生物体——暗色真菌（dematiaceous fungi）或黑色素化真菌（melanized fungi）引起的感染。这些真菌的特征是其细胞壁中富含黑色素（melanin），黑色素可能作为一种毒力因子（virulence factor）发挥作用。实际上，几乎每个人都通过吸入暴露于暗色真菌，因为它们广泛存在于环境中，但感染的发生极为罕见。

HP:6000032.name: Autophony
HP:6000032.definition: Hearing one's own voice resonating loudly in the ear.

HP:6000033.name: High altitude exposure
HP:6000033.definition: A history of being at high altitude in situations such hiking, mountain climbing, travel to mountains, or air travel.
HP:6000033.definition_cn: 既往有高海拔暴露史，如徒步、登山、山区旅行或航空旅行。

HP:6000034.name: History of recent hospitalization
HP:6000034.definition: A past medical history of recently being hospitalized.

HP:6000035.name: Palpitations terminated by Valsava maneuver
HP:6000035.definition: Cessation of palpitations can be induced by Valsava maneuver.
HP:6000035.name_cn: 心悸通过瓦尔萨尔瓦动作终止
HP:6000035.definition_cn: 通过瓦尔萨尔瓦动作可诱发心悸终止。

HP:6000036.name: Long telomere length
HP:6000036.definition: Abnormally long telomeres in somatic cells.
HP:6000036.definition_cn: 体细胞中端粒异常延长。

HP:6000037.name: Reduced circulating aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase activity
HP:6000037.definition: The activity of aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (also known as DOPA decarboxylase, tryptophan decarboxylase, and 5-hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000037.name_cn: 循环芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶活性降低
HP:6000037.definition_cn: 血液循环中芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶（亦称多巴脱羧酶、色氨酸脱羧酶及5-羟色氨酸脱羧酶）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000038.name: Subclavian artery stenosis
HP:6000038.definition: Abnormal narrowing of the subclavian artery.

HP:6000040.name: Neuropathic pain
HP:6000040.definition: Neuropathic pain is triggered by lesions to the somatosensory nervous system that alter its structure and function so that pain occurs spontaneously and responses to noxious and innocuous stimuli are pathologically amplified.
HP:6000040.definition_cn: 神经病理性疼痛是由躯体感觉神经系统的损伤引发的，这些损伤改变了其结构和功能，导致疼痛自发产生，并且对有害和无害刺激的反应在病理上被放大。

HP:6000041.name: Repeated cold water exposure
HP:6000041.definition: A history of repeated exposure to cold water, as may result, for instance, from surfing, diving, kayaking, or swimming.
HP:6000041.definition_cn: 反复暴露于冷水环境史，例如可能由冲浪、潜水、皮划艇或游泳等活动引起。

HP:6000042.name: Tinnitus exacerbated by swallowing
HP:6000042.definition: Tinnitus (sound heard by a subjhect when no corresponding external sound is present) that is made worse by swallowing.
HP:6000042.definition_cn: 吞咽加重的耳鸣（患者在没有相应外部声音存在时听到的声音）。

HP:6000043.name: Rhythmic movements of the tympanic membrane
HP:6000043.definition: Regularly occurring motion of the tympanic membrane (eardrum), which is located between the inner and middle ear. This can be a manifestation of tensor tympani myoclonus, which can also be ascertained as sawtooth patterns on long-term tympanometry.
HP:6000043.definition_cn: 位于内耳与中耳之间的鼓膜（耳膜）的规律性运动。这可能是鼓膜张肌肌阵挛的表现，长期鼓室导抗图检查中也可观察到锯齿状波形。

HP:6000044.name: Elongated temporal styloid process
HP:6000044.definition: The length of the temporal styloid process is above the upper limit of normal. The styloid process is a cylindrical, slender, needle-like projection of varying lengths averaging 2 to 3 cm. The styloid process projects from the inferior part of the petrous temporal bone and offers attachment to the stylohyoid ligament and the stylohyoid, stylopharyngeus, and styloglossus muscles.
HP:6000044.definition_cn: 颞骨茎突长度超出正常上限。茎突为圆柱形、细长、针状突起，长度不一，平均为2至3厘米。茎突自颞骨岩部下方向前下方突出，为茎突舌骨韧带及茎突舌骨肌、茎突咽肌和茎突舌肌提供附着点。

HP:6000045.name: Ameliorated by nitroglycerin
HP:6000045.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with nitroglycerin.
HP:6000045.definition_cn: 适用于通过硝酸甘油治疗得到改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:6000046.name: Pulsus paradoxus
HP:6000046.definition: Pulsus paradoxus refers to a systolic pressure drop greater than 10mmHg during inspiration.
HP:6000046.definition_cn: 奇脉（Pulsus paradoxus）是指在吸气期间收缩压下降超过10毫米汞柱（mmHg）的现象。

HP:6000047.name: Chest pain triggered by palpitation
HP:6000047.definition: Chest pain can be induced by palpation of the chest, which may be an indication of costochondritis.
HP:6000047.definition_cn: 胸痛可由胸部触诊诱发，这可能是肋软骨炎的指征。

HP:6000048.name: Chest pain described as pressure
HP:6000048.definition: Discomfort in the chest described as pressure, heaviness, or tightness.
HP:6000048.definition_cn: 胸部不适，表现为压迫感、沉重感或紧缩感。

HP:6000049.name: Chest pain described as ripping or tearing
HP:6000049.definition: Chest pain described as a tearing or ripping sensation.
HP:6000049.name_cn: 胸痛描述为撕裂样或撕扯样
HP:6000049.definition_cn: 胸痛描述为撕裂或撕扯感。

HP:6000050.name: Ameliorated by flexion
HP:6000050.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by bending (flexing) a joint.
HP:6000050.definition_cn: 适用于通过弯曲（屈曲）关节而改善或减轻的体征或症状。

HP:6000051.name: Located on the chest
HP:6000051.definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring around the thorax (chest).
HP:6000051.definition_cn: 适用于位于或发生在胸部周围的发现。

HP:6000052.name: Localized to the penis
HP:6000052.definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring in or on the penis.
HP:6000052.definition_cn: 适用于位于或发生在阴茎上的发现。

HP:6000053.name: Snowstorm pattern of uterus on ultrasound
HP:6000053.definition: A sonographic snowstorm pattern of the uterusresults from the presence of a complex vesicular intrauterine mass containing many grape-like cysts.
HP:6000053.name_cn: 超声检查中的子宫暴风雪样改变
HP:6000053.definition_cn: 子宫超声检查中的“暴风雪”样模式是由于子宫内存在复杂的囊性肿块，其中包含多个葡萄状囊肿所致。

HP:6000055.name: Exposure to aquatic animals
HP:6000055.definition: History of exposure to aquatic animals.

HP:6000056.name: Superficial blush-like subcutaneous fatty lesions
HP:6000056.definition: Multiple, oblong, fatty lesions in the superficial subcutaneous fatty tissue. They are mostly under 2 cm in long axis diameter. They demonstrate nodular (blush-like) increased fluid signal at unenhanced MRI and are markedly hyperechoic at ultrasound.
HP:6000056.name_cn: 浅表性红斑样皮下脂肪病变
HP:6000056.definition_cn: 浅表皮下脂肪组织内多发、椭圆形脂肪性病变。大多数病变长轴直径小于2厘米。在未增强的磁共振成像（MRI）中，这些病变呈现结节状（花斑样）液体信号增强，在超声检查中表现为显著的高回声。

HP:6000057.name: Dermal multinucleated giant cells
HP:6000057.definition: Presence of giant cells in the dermis. Giant cells are formed by fusion of various cells such as macrophage, epithelioid cells, monocytes, etc., These are multi-nucleated, large in size, and generally present at the site of chronic inflammation and other granulomatous conditions.
HP:6000057.definition_cn: 真皮层内存在巨细胞。巨细胞由巨噬细胞、上皮样细胞、单核细胞等多种细胞融合形成，具有多核、体积大的特征，通常出现在慢性炎症及其他肉芽肿性病变的部位。

HP:6000058.name: Exacerbation of eyelid lesion by crying
HP:6000058.definition: Applies to an eyelid lesion such as hemangiomas or varices that swells upon crying.
HP:6000058.name_cn: 哭泣导致眼睑病变加重
HP:6000058.definition_cn: 适用于眼睑病变，如血管瘤或静脉曲张，在哭泣时出现肿胀。

HP:6000059.name: Localized to upper eyelid
HP:6000059.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the upper eyelid.
HP:6000059.definition_cn: 适用于位于上眼睑的异常病变。

HP:6000060.name: Aerophagia
HP:6000060.definition: Repetitive air swallowing and belching and that may result in abdominal distention.
HP:6000060.definition_cn: 反复性空气吞咽和嗳气，可能导致腹部膨胀。

HP:6000061.name: Vaginal passage of hydatidiform mole tissue
HP:6000061.definition: Passage from the vagina of hyatidiform tissue, appearing as clusters of vesicles (similar to small grapes) developed from the transformation of chorionic villi. This is a manifestation of a molar pregnancy (hyatidiform mole).
HP:6000061.name_cn: 葡萄胎组织经阴道排出
HP:6000061.definition_cn: 阴道排出葡萄胎组织，表现为由绒毛膜绒毛转化形成的簇状囊泡（类似小葡萄）。这是葡萄胎妊娠（葡萄胎）的表现。

HP:6000062.name: Abnormal nipple discharge
HP:6000062.definition: Abnormal fluid that seeps out of the nipple of the breast. Nipple discharge is categozied as lactational, physiologic, or pathologic.
HP:6000062.definition_cn: 乳头异常渗出的液体。乳头溢液可分为哺乳性、生理性或病理性。

HP:6000063.name: Hepatolithiasis
HP:6000063.definition: The presence of gallstones within the intrahepatic bile ducts proximal to the right and left hepatic ducts.
HP:6000063.definition_cn: 肝内胆管近端左右肝管处存在胆结石。

HP:6000064.name: Excessive eructation
HP:6000064.definition: Abnormally frequent belching (expelling gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth).
HP:6000064.definition_cn: 病理性频繁嗳气（通过口腔从胃部排出气体并伴有噪音）。

HP:6000065.name: Esophageal fibrosis
HP:6000065.definition: Fibrosis located in the subepithelial portion of the esophagus. Fibrosisis is defined by the overgrowth, hardening, and/or scarring of various tissues and is attributed to excess deposition of extracellular matrix components including collagen.
HP:6000065.definition_cn: 位于食管上皮下层的纤维化。纤维化定义为各种组织的过度生长、硬化和/或瘢痕形成，归因于细胞外基质成分（包括胶原蛋白）的过度沉积。

HP:6000066.name: Triggered by extension of leg
HP:6000066.definition: This term refers to pain that is triggered by extending (straightening) the leg.
HP:6000066.definition_cn: 该术语指由腿部伸展（伸直）引发的疼痛。

HP:6000067.name: Increased myocardial pyrophosphate uptake
HP:6000067.definition: Amount of pyrophosphate uptake by the myocardium as demonstrated by by technetium pyrophosphate (99mTc-PYP) scintigraphy above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000067.name_cn: 心肌焦磷酸盐摄取增加
HP:6000067.definition_cn: 心肌对焦磷酸盐的摄取量，通过锝焦磷酸盐（99mTc-PYP）闪烁扫描显示，高于正常上限。

HP:6000068.name: Ameliorated by nerve block
HP:6000068.definition: Refers to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by anesthetic block of a nerve.
HP:6000068.definition_cn: 指通过神经麻醉阻滞改善或缓解的体征或症状。

HP:6000069.name: Brief tear break-up time
HP:6000069.definition: Tear film break up time (number of seconds that elapse between the last blink and the appearance of the first dry spot in the tear film) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000069.definition_cn: 泪膜破裂时间（从最后一次眨眼到泪膜中出现第一个干燥点所经过的秒数）低于正常下限。

HP:6000070.name: Cutaneous granuloma
HP:6000070.definition: A granuloma localized to the skin, that is, a chronic inflammatory manifestation with localized aggregation of histiocytes with or without other inflammatory cells (such as plasma cells, eosinophils, or neutrophils), with or without necrosis, with or without vasculitis, with or without calcification, and with or without foreign bodies. Granulomas may be due to infection or chronic inflammatory disease or reactions to foreign material.
HP:6000070.definition_cn: 皮肤局限性肉芽肿，即一种慢性炎症表现，其特征为组织细胞局部聚集，伴或不伴其他炎症细胞（如浆细胞、嗜酸性粒细胞或中性粒细胞），伴或不伴坏死，伴或不伴血管炎，伴或不伴钙化，以及伴或不伴异物。肉芽肿可能由感染、慢性炎症性疾病或对外来物质的反应引起。

HP:6000071.name: Heterotopic dermal ossification
HP:6000071.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the dermis (i.e., the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer).
HP:6000071.definition_cn: 真皮层（即位于表皮层下方和皮下层上方的皮肤层）内异常、异位骨组织的形成。

HP:6000072.name: Thinning of outer muscular layer of small bowel
HP:6000072.definition: The depth of the outer muscular layer of the small bowel is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000072.definition_cn: 小肠外肌层厚度低于正常下限。

HP:6000073.name: Renal lymphangiectasia
HP:6000073.definition: A developmental anomaly of renal lymphatics that results from a failure of the lymphatics to make communication with the rest of the lymph trunks. The abnormal lymphatics thus dilate and form cystic spaces at the renal sinus and in the perinephric space.
HP:6000073.definition_cn: 肾淋巴管发育异常，由于淋巴管未能与其他淋巴干建立交通所致。异常淋巴管因此扩张，并在肾窦及肾周间隙形成囊性腔隙。

HP:6000074.name: Pharyngeal myxoma
HP:6000074.definition: A myxoma (benign, locally infiltrative neoplasms arising from mesenchymal origin) localized to the pharynx.
HP:6000074.definition_cn: 咽部黏液瘤（源自间叶组织的良性、局部浸润性肿瘤）。

HP:6000075.name: Subcutaneous arteriolar thrombosis
HP:6000075.definition_cn: 皮下小动脉内纤维蛋白血栓。

HP:6000076.name: Renal vasculitis
HP:6000076.definition: Vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) in the kidney. Renal vasculitis can be observed with numerous disorders and presents clinically as rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis (RPGN) which is characterized by acute kidney injury (AKI), haematuria and proteinuria. Histological examination of the kidney reveals severe inflammation in the form of crescent formation, glomerular necrosis and vasculitis of small and medium sized vessels within the kidney.
HP:6000076.definition_cn: 肾脏血管炎（肾血管炎症）。肾血管炎可见于多种疾病，临床表现为快速进展性肾小球肾炎（Rapidly Progressive Glomerulonephritis, RPGN），其特征包括急性肾损伤（Acute Kidney Injury, AKI）、血尿（Haematuria）和蛋白尿（Proteinuria）。肾脏组织学检查显示严重炎症，表现为新月体形成（Crescent Formation）、肾小球坏死（Glomerular Necrosis）以及肾脏内中小血管的血管炎（Vasculitis of Small and Medium-Sized Vessels）。

HP:6000077.name: Pancreatic islet beta cell iron deposition
HP:6000077.definition: Accumulation of abnormally high amounts of iron in beta cells of the pancreas.
HP:6000077.definition_cn: 胰腺β细胞中铁异常高水平的蓄积。

HP:6000078.name: Nasal hamartoma
HP:6000078.definition: A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the nose.
HP:6000078.definition_cn: 鼻部错构瘤（由构成成分异常混合形成的组织畸形）。

HP:6000079.name: Metachromatic intraneuronal lipid deposits
HP:6000079.definition: A type of metachromasia localized to a peripheral nerve. Metachromasia may be defined as the staining of tissue or tissue components such that the color of the tissue-bound dye complex differs significantly from the color of the original dye complex to give a marked contrast in color. For instance in metachromatic leukodystrophy, bloated Schwann cells, containing granularmetachromatic storage material May display a characteristic yellow green dichroism under crossed polarised light.
HP:6000079.name_cn: 异染性神经元内脂质沉积
HP:6000079.definition_cn: 一种局限于周围神经的异染性现象。异染性可定义为组织或组织成分的染色，使得与染料结合的组织复合物的颜色与原始染料复合物的颜色显著不同，从而产生明显的颜色对比。例如，在异染性脑白质营养不良中，含有颗粒状异染性储存物质的肿胀雪旺细胞在交叉偏振光下可能显示出特征性的黄绿色二色性。

HP:6000080.name: Reduced phosphoserine phosphatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000080.definition: Activity of phosphoserine phosphatase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000080.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中磷酸丝氨酸磷酸酶活性降低
HP:6000080.definition_cn: 成纤维细胞培养中磷酸丝氨酸磷酸酶活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000081.name: Reduced alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000081.definition: Activity of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000081.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中α-氨基己二酸半醛合酶活性降低
HP:6000081.definition_cn: 成纤维细胞培养中α-氨基己二酸半醛合酶活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000082.name: Reduced hepatic beta-ureidopropionase activity
HP:6000082.definition: Activity of beta-ureidopropionase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000082.name_cn: 肝β-脲基丙酸酶活性降低
HP:6000082.definition_cn: 肝脏中β-脲基丙酸酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000083.name: Reduced hepatic dihydropyrimidinase activity
HP:6000083.definition: Activity of dihydropyrimidinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000083.name_cn: 肝二氢嘧啶酶活性降低
HP:6000083.definition_cn: 肝脏中二氢嘧啶酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000084.name: Sunken fontanelle
HP:6000084.definition: Fontanelle that is more deeply set than normal. Fontanelles are normally relatively firm and curve only slightly inward. A sunken fontanelle can be a sign of dehydration or marasmus.
HP:6000084.definition_cn: 凹陷的囟门。囟门通常相对坚实且仅轻微内凹。囟门凹陷可能是脱水或消瘦症的体征。

HP:6000085.name: Angulation of penis
HP:6000085.definition: Abnormally increased curvature of the penis.

HP:6000086.name: History of urethral procedure or catheterization
HP:6000086.definition: A past medical history of a procedure or catheterization involving the urethra.
HP:6000086.definition_cn: 既往有涉及尿道的操作或导尿史。

HP:6000087.name: Penile swelling
HP:6000087.definition: Abormal enlargement of the penis owing to accumulation of fluid.
HP:6000087.definition_cn: 阴茎异常增大由于液体潴留。

HP:6000088.name: Reduced muscle alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
HP:6000088.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000088.name_cn: 肌肉α-1,4-葡萄糖苷酶活性降低
HP:6000088.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中α-1,4-葡萄糖苷酶活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000089.name: Brown tumor
HP:6000089.definition: A brown tumor is a bone lesion that results from bony resorption by excess osteoclastic activity, and replacement by fibrous tissue and giant cells. Brown tumor is an uncommon pathognomonic sign of hyperparathyroidism.
HP:6000089.definition_cn: 棕色瘤是一种由过度破骨细胞活性导致的骨吸收病变，并由纤维组织和巨细胞替代。棕色瘤是甲状旁腺功能亢进症的一种罕见特征性体征。

HP:6000090.name: Dermal flame figures
HP:6000090.definition: Flame-figures are composed of a central part consisting of collagen fibers and eosinophilic granules, surrounded by a histiocytic and eosinophilic infiltrate. Subsequently, eosinophils tend to disappear and are replaced by phagocytic granulomas, consisting of histiocytes and sometimes giant cells, around the flame figures.
HP:6000090.definition_cn: 火焰状结构由中央部分的胶原纤维和嗜酸性颗粒组成，周围环绕着组织细胞和嗜酸性粒细胞浸润。随后，嗜酸性粒细胞倾向于消失，并被由组织细胞和有时巨细胞组成的吞噬性肉芽肿所取代，这些肉芽肿围绕在火焰状结构周围。

HP:6000091.name: Postpartum exacerbation
HP:6000091.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is present during pregnancy and becomes worse following birth.
HP:6000091.definition_cn: 妊娠期出现并在产后加重的体征或症状。

HP:6000092.name: Retinoid exposure
HP:6000092.definition_cn: 既往使用维甲酸类药物史。

HP:6000093.name: Propylthiouracil exposure
HP:6000093.definition: History of having been treated with propylthiouracil.
HP:6000093.definition_cn: 既往曾接受丙硫氧嘧啶治疗史。

HP:6000094.name: History of outdoor activities
HP:6000094.definition: History of spending a substantial amount of time outdoors with occupation or hobbies related to the outdoors, including hunting, gardening, farming, agriculture, horticulture, miners, working in wet fields.
HP:6000094.definition_cn: 有长期户外活动史，职业或爱好与户外相关，包括狩猎、园艺、农业、农艺、园艺、采矿、湿地作业。

HP:6000095.name: Draining sinus tract in skin
HP:6000095.definition: A sinus tract is an abnormal channel that originates from the skin or a mucous surface to a deep-seated focus of suppuration.
HP:6000095.definition_cn: 窦道是一种异常通道，起源于皮肤或黏膜表面，通向深部化脓性病灶。

HP:6000096.name: Corneal transplant history
HP:6000096.definition: Past medical history of surgical replacement of the cornea with corneal tissue from a donor.
HP:6000096.definition_cn: 既往史：曾接受供体角膜组织移植手术。

HP:6000097.name: Spontaneous lens capsule rupture
HP:6000097.definition: Breakage of the capsule of the lens. This is most often observed as a complication of lens surgery, but this term refers to lens capsule rupture not related to surgery or major trauma.
HP:6000097.name_cn: 自发性晶状体囊膜破裂
HP:6000097.definition_cn: 晶状体囊膜破裂。这最常见于晶状体手术的并发症，但该术语特指与手术或重大创伤无关的晶状体囊膜破裂。

HP:6000098.name: Contact lens wearer
HP:6000098.definition: A past medical history of wearing contact lenses.
HP:6000098.definition_cn: 既往佩戴隐形眼镜病史。

HP:6000099.name: Airway mucosal thickening
HP:6000099.definition: Increase in thickness of the mucosa of the airways above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000099.definition_cn: 气道黏膜厚度增加超过正常上限。

HP:6000100.name: Hyperpolarized transepithelial nasal potential difference
HP:6000100.definition: Increased (more negative) voltage across the nasal epithelium.
HP:6000100.name_cn: 超极化跨上皮鼻电位差
HP:6000100.definition_cn: 鼻上皮跨膜电位增加（负值增大）。

HP:6000101.name: Corneopalpebral synechiae
HP:6000101.definition: An adhesion between the conjunctiva of the eyelid and the cornea.
HP:6000101.definition_cn: 眼睑结膜与角膜之间的粘连。

HP:6000102.name: Breast intraductal papilloma
HP:6000102.definition: Intraductal papilloma is a benign tumor found within breast ducts. The abnormal proliferation of ductal epithelial cells causes growth. A solitary intraductal papilloma is usually found centrally posterior to the nipple affecting the central duct. Multiple intraductal papillomas are located peripherally, found in any breast quadrant affecting the peripheral ducts.
HP:6000102.definition_cn: 导管内乳头状瘤是一种位于乳腺导管内的良性肿瘤。导管上皮细胞的异常增殖导致其生长。单发性导管内乳头状瘤通常位于乳头后方中央，影响中央导管。多发性导管内乳头状瘤则位于外周，可出现在乳腺的任何象限，影响外周导管。

HP:6000103.name: Precipitous labor
HP:6000103.definition: Precipitous labor is extremely rapid labor and delivery, usually defined as expulsion of the fetus within less than 3 hours of commencement of regular contractions.
HP:6000103.definition_cn: 急产是指分娩过程极为迅速，通常定义为从规律宫缩开始至胎儿娩出在3小时以内。

HP:6000104.name: Twin pregnancy
HP:6000104.definition: Maternal history of a pregnancy with two fetuses in the uterus.

HP:6000105.name: Vaginal mass
HP:6000105.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the vagina. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6000105.definition_cn: 阴道局部肿胀或增大。在诊断检查的早期阶段，在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质之前，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:6000106.name: Costovertebral angle tenderness
HP:6000106.definition: Pain that is elicited by palpation of the region inside of the costovertebral angle, which is formed by the 12th rib and the spine.
HP:6000106.definition_cn: 肋脊角区域触诊引发的疼痛，该区域由第12肋骨和脊柱构成。

HP:6000107.name: Cervical motion tenderness
HP:6000107.definition: Pain that is elicited by moving the uterine cervix. This finding can be ascertained by pelvic exam. Cervical motion tenderness is a gynecological exam finding that could be indicative of peritoneal infection.
HP:6000107.definition_cn: 宫颈活动痛。此体征可通过盆腔检查确认。宫颈举痛是妇科检查中的一项发现，可能提示腹膜感染。

HP:6000108.name: Abnormal penile discharge
HP:6000108.definition: Fluid that originates from the urethra that is not urine, pre-ejaculate or semen.
HP:6000108.definition_cn: 尿道分泌物（非尿液、预射精液或精液）。

HP:6000109.name: Supernumerary finger flexion crease
HP:6000109.definition: The presence of an extra digital crease in and individual with normal joint anatomy.
HP:6000109.definition_cn: 在关节解剖结构正常的个体中出现额外的指间皱褶。

HP:6000110.name: Large joint predominance
HP:6000110.definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that mainly affect large joints.
HP:6000110.definition_cn: 主要累及大关节的表型异常。

HP:6000111.name: Monoarticular
HP:6000111.definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that affects a single joint.

HP:6000112.name: Hockey-stick palmar crease
HP:6000112.definition: An abnormality of the upper palmar crease whereby the crease widens and ends between the second and third fingers and is said to resemble a hockey stick.
HP:6000112.definition_cn: 掌上横纹异常，表现为横纹增宽并终止于第二和第三指之间，形似曲棍球杆。

HP:6000113.name: Elevated urinary succinyladenosine level
HP:6000113.definition: The amount of succinyladenosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000113.name_cn: 尿液中琥珀酰腺苷水平升高
HP:6000113.definition_cn: 尿液中琥珀酰腺苷浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000114.name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxymethyluracil level
HP:6000114.definition: The amount of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000114.name_cn: 尿液中5-羟甲基尿嘧啶水平升高
HP:6000114.definition_cn: 尿液中5-羟甲基尿嘧啶的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000115.name: Decreased urine creatinine level
HP:6000115.definition: The amount of creatinine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000115.definition_cn: 尿肌酐浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:6000116.name: Elevated urinary deoxyuridine level
HP:6000116.definition: The amount of deoxyuridine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000116.name_cn: 尿中脱氧尿苷水平升高
HP:6000116.definition_cn: 尿液中脱氧尿苷的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000117.name: obsolete Elevated urinary AICA-riboside level
HP:6000117.name_cn: 过时的尿中AICA-核苷水平升高

HP:6000118.name: Elevated urinary dihydrouracil level
HP:6000118.definition: The amount of dihydrouracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000118.name_cn: 尿中二氢尿嘧啶水平升高
HP:6000118.definition_cn: 尿液中二氢尿嘧啶含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000119.name: Elevated urinary dihydrothymine level
HP:6000119.definition: The amount of dihydrothymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000119.name_cn: 尿中二氢胸腺嘧啶水平升高
HP:6000119.definition_cn: 尿液中二氢胸腺嘧啶含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限值。

HP:6000120.name: Elevated urinary sulfatide level
HP:6000120.definition: The amount of sulfatides in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Sulfatides are derived from GalCer via esterification of a sulfate group to 3-hydroxyl of the galactose moiety.
HP:6000120.definition_cn: 尿液中硫酸酯的含量，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限。硫酸酯是由半乳糖脑苷脂（GalCer）通过硫酸基团与半乳糖部分的3-羟基酯化反应生成的。

HP:6000121.name: Elevated urinary xanthurenic acid level
HP:6000121.definition: The amount of xanthurenic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000121.definition_cn: 尿液中黄尿酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000122.name: Increased urinary N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharide level
HP:6000122.definition: Presence of N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharides in the urine.
HP:6000122.name_cn: 尿液中富含N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖的寡糖水平升高
HP:6000122.definition_cn: 尿液中存在富含N-乙酰葡萄糖胺的寡糖。

HP:6000123.name: Elevated urinary 2'-deoxyadenosine level
HP:6000123.definition: The amount of 2'-deoxyadenosine (dAdo) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000123.name_cn: 尿液中2'-脱氧腺苷水平升高
HP:6000123.definition_cn: 尿液中2'-脱氧腺苷（dAdo）浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限值。

HP:6000124.name: Positive 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test
HP:6000124.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of the 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test, which indicates the presence of alpha-ketoacids in the urine.
HP:6000124.definition_cn: 2,4-二硝基苯肼尿液试验阳性（异常）结果，提示尿液中存在α-酮酸。

HP:6000125.name: Elevated urinary dolichol level
HP:6000125.definition: The amount of dolichol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000125.definition_cn: 尿液中多萜醇含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000126.name: Decreased urinary bile acid level
HP:6000126.definition: The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000126.definition_cn: 尿液中胆汁酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:6000127.name: Elevated urinary creatine/creatinine ratio
HP:6000127.definition: The ratio of creatine to creatinine concentration in the urine is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000127.definition_cn: 尿液中肌酸与肌酐浓度比值高于正常上限。

HP:6000128.name: Elevated urinary thymidine level
HP:6000128.definition: The amount of thymidine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000128.definition_cn: 尿液中胸苷含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:6000129.name: Elevated urinary glutarylglycine level
HP:6000129.definition: The amount of glutarylglycine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000129.name_cn: 尿液中戊二酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:6000129.definition_cn: 尿液中戊二酰甘氨酸含量，经尿液浓度校正后，低于正常值下限。

HP:6000130.name: Elevated urinary indican level
HP:6000130.definition: Detection of indican in the urine. Urinary indican concentration may be elevated in small bowel bacterial overgrowth. Indican is produced by bacterial deconjugation of dietary tryptophan to indole which is absorbed at all levels of the intestine, but principally from the small bowel.
HP:6000130.definition_cn: 尿液中吲哚酚的检测。在小肠细菌过度生长的情况下，尿液中吲哚酚浓度可能升高。吲哚酚是由饮食中的色氨酸经细菌脱结合作用生成吲哚，吲哚在肠道的各个部位被吸收，但主要来自小肠。

HP:6000131.name: Dacrolith
HP:6000131.definition: Dacryolith is a concretion (accumulation of sediment) within the nasolacrimal system.
HP:6000131.definition_cn: 泪石是鼻泪系统内的凝结物（沉积物积聚）。

HP:6000132.name: Reduced erythrocyte gamma-glutamyl cysteine synthetase activity
HP:6000132.definition: Activity of gamma-glutamylcysteine synthetase (EC 6.3.2.2) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000132.name_cn: 红细胞γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸合成酶活性降低
HP:6000132.definition_cn: 红细胞中γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸合成酶（EC 6.3.2.2）活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000133.name: Decreased erythrocyte nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide-cytochrome b5 reductase activity
HP:6000133.definition: The activity of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH)-cytochrome b5 reductase in erythrocytes (red blood cells) is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000133.name_cn: 红细胞烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸-细胞色素b5还原酶活性降低
HP:6000133.definition_cn: 红细胞（红细胞）中烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NADH）-细胞色素b5还原酶的活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000134.name: Reduced alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000134.definition: Activity of alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase (AMACR; EC 5.1.99.4) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000134.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中α-甲基酰基辅酶A消旋酶活性降低
HP:6000134.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中α-甲基酰基辅酶A消旋酶（AMACR；EC 5.1.99.4）活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000135.name: Low semen volume
HP:6000135.definition: Volume of semen in ejaculate below the lower limit of normal. This finding can be ascertained by semen analysis. Comment: Sperm are produced within the testis, in the process of spermatogenesis, then travel through the male reproductive tract (the seminiferous tubules, epididymis, vas deferens, prostate and urethra). As the sperm travel, seminal fluid is added from the seminal vesicles, prostate, testis and epididymis and periurethral glands. The function of the ejaculate is to transport sperm into the female genital tract and to provide a suitable environment for sperm survival during this transit.
HP:6000135.definition_cn: 精液量低于正常下限。此发现可通过精液分析确认。注释：精子在睾丸内通过精子发生过程产生，随后通过男性生殖道（曲细精管、附睾、输精管、前列腺和尿道）运输。在精子运输过程中，精囊、前列腺、睾丸、附睾及尿道周围腺体分泌的精浆被加入。射精的功能是将精子输送至女性生殖道，并在此过程中为精子存活提供适宜环境。

HP:6000136.name: Elbow localization
HP:6000136.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the elbow.
HP:6000136.definition_cn: 适用于位于（或主要位于）肘部的异常情况。

HP:6000137.name: Enlarged lunula
HP:6000137.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the visible portion of the distal nail matrix that extends beyond the proximal nail fold, which is referred to as the lunula.
HP:6000137.definition_cn: 远端甲母质可见部分的异常增大，延伸超过近端甲皱襞，即甲半月。

HP:6000138.name: Heel localization
HP:6000138.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the heel.
HP:6000138.definition_cn: 适用于位于（或主要位于）足跟的异常情况。

HP:6000139.name: Splinter hemorrhages
HP:6000139.definition: Thin, red to reddish-brown lines of blood (hemorrhages) under the nails. Splinter hemorrhages run vertically under the nails.
HP:6000139.definition_cn: 甲下细长、红色至红褐色的出血线（出血）。甲下线状出血呈垂直分布。

HP:6000140.name: Lateral thrust
HP:6000140.definition: Lateral thrust (LT) refers to an abnormal knee joint motion in the early stance phase where the knee joint center moves laterally. Also known as varus thrust, LR is defined as the dynamic worsening or abrupt onset of varus (bow-leg) alignment as the limb accepts weight (stance phase), with a return to less varus and more neutral alignment during lift-off and the non-weight-bearing (swing) phase of gait, varus thrust is a potent mechanical risk factor for medial knee osteoarthritis progression.
HP:6000140.definition_cn: 侧向推力（Lateral Thrust, LT）是指在步态早期支撑相中，膝关节中心向外侧移动的异常膝关节运动。也称为内翻推力（Varus Thrust），内翻推力被定义为在肢体承重（支撑相）时，内翻（弓形腿）对线动态恶化或突然出现，而在抬离和非承重（摆动相）阶段恢复到较少内翻和更中立的对线。内翻推力是内侧膝骨关节炎进展的一个强有力的机械风险因素。

HP:6000141.name: Cerebral contusion
HP:6000141.definition: A contusion is a region of injured tissue in which blood capillaries have been ruptured without laceration (bruise). Brain contusions are bruises of the cortical surface that damage the surface from the outside inward, producing disruption of tissue and vessels. The term cerebral contusion describes the pathology of focal necrosis and hemorrhage, typically observed in older children, involving particularly cerebral cortex and subcortical white matter. Such lesions are usually found in coup and contrecoup, as well as inferior orbital, frontal, and temporal locations. Cerebral contusions cause permanent damage to tissues of the cerebrum. The etiology of cerebral contusion is trauma to the head.
HP:6000141.definition_cn: 挫伤是指毛细血管破裂但无撕裂的受损组织区域（瘀伤）。脑挫伤是皮质表面的损伤，由外向内破坏组织及血管，导致组织及血管的断裂。脑挫伤这一术语描述了局灶性坏死和出血的病理改变，常见于年长儿童，尤其涉及大脑皮质及皮质下白质。此类病变通常见于冲击点、对冲点以及眶下、额叶和颞叶部位。脑挫伤会导致大脑组织的永久性损伤。脑挫伤的病因是头部创伤。

HP:6000142.name: Fecolith
HP:6000142.definition: A mass of accumulated hardened fecal matter.

HP:6000143.name: Appendicitis
HP:6000143.definition: Appendicitis is inflammation of the vermiform appendix. Appendix a hollow organ located at the tip of the cecum, usually in the right lower quadrant of the abdomen.
HP:6000143.definition_cn: 阑尾炎是阑尾的炎症。阑尾是位于盲肠末端的中空器官，通常位于腹部的右下象限。

HP:6000144.name: Left ventricular aneurysm
HP:6000144.definition: A severely scarred portion of infarcted ventricular myocardium that does not contract normally but instead bulges outward while the rest of the ventricle contracts during systole.
HP:6000144.definition_cn: 在收缩期，心室其余部分正常收缩时，梗死的心室心肌中严重瘢痕化的部分无法正常收缩，反而向外膨出。

HP:6000145.name: Boot-shaped cardiac silhouette
HP:6000145.definition: An abnormal form of the heart seen upon chest radiography in which the heart displays an upturned apex and slight concave pulmonary artery segment. This configuration is said to resemble a boot.
HP:6000145.definition_cn: 胸部X线检查中观察到的一种心脏异常形态，表现为心尖上翘及肺动脉段轻度凹陷。此形态被称为靴形心。

HP:6000146.name: Hydrosalpinx
HP:6000146.definition: Hydrosalpinx is a distension or dilatation of the fallopian tube in the presence of a distal tubal occlusion.
HP:6000146.definition_cn: 输卵管积水是指在输卵管远端阻塞的情况下，输卵管发生扩张或膨胀。

HP:6000147.name: Elevated methylhex-dienedioic level by MRS
HP:6000147.definition: An increase in the level of 3-methylhex-2,4-dienedioic acid or 3-methylhex-3,4-dienedioic acid in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:6000147.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）检测显示甲基己二烯二酸（methylhex-dienedioic acid）水平升高
HP:6000147.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到大脑中3-甲基己-2,4-二烯二酸（3-methylhex-2,4-dienedioic acid）或3-甲基己-3,4-二烯二酸（3-methylhex-3,4-dienedioic acid）水平升高。

HP:6000148.name: Perihepatic enhancement
HP:6000148.definition: Increased signal (contrast enhancement) surrounding the liver observed on computer tomography or magnetic resonance imaging following administration of contrast agents.
HP:6000148.definition_cn: 在计算机断层扫描或磁共振成像中，注射造影剂后观察到肝脏周围信号增强（对比增强）。

HP:6000149.name: Reduced in vitro contracture test threshold
HP:6000149.definition: The in vitro contracture test determines the sensitivity of freshly obtained skeletal muscle specimens to caffeine or halothane applied to a bathing solution. Muscles from persons susceptible to malignant hyperthermia have lower contracture thresholds for these agents than do normal muscle.
HP:6000149.name_cn: 体外收缩试验阈值降低
HP:6000149.definition_cn: 体外收缩试验用于测定新鲜获取的骨骼肌标本在浸泡液中暴露于咖啡因或氟烷时的敏感性。恶性高热易感者的肌肉对这些药物的收缩阈值低于正常肌肉。

HP:6000150.name: Reduced F-wave amplitude
HP:6000150.definition: Reduced strength (amplitude) of the F-wave, which is an electrophysiological artifact produced by antidromic activation of motoneurons following distal electrical stimulation of motor nerve fibers.
HP:6000150.definition_cn: F波幅度降低，F波是一种电生理伪迹，由运动神经纤维远端电刺激后运动神经元的逆向激活产生。

HP:6000151.name: Enlarged peroxisomes
HP:6000151.definition: Abnormal increase in size of peroxisomes.
HP:6000151.definition_cn: 过氧化物酶体体积异常增大。

HP:6000152.name: Adrenocortical hyperplasia
HP:6000152.definition: A non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands, specifically the cortex, although the cortex cannot be definitively identified by conventional imaging. Adrenal cortical hyperplasia is defined radiologically as a non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands.
HP:6000152.definition_cn: 肾上腺皮质增生（Adrenal Cortical Hyperplasia）是指肾上腺，特别是皮质部分的非恶性生长或增大，尽管通过常规影像学检查无法明确识别皮质部分。放射学上将肾上腺皮质增生定义为肾上腺的非恶性生长或增大。

HP:6000153.name: Lymphocytic infiltration of the parotid gland
HP:6000153.definition: Accumulation of lymphocytes in the parotid gland. This feature is generally defined as a count of lymphocytes per area that is above normal limits on histopathological examination.
HP:6000153.definition_cn: 腮腺淋巴细胞浸润。此特征通常定义为组织病理学检查中单位面积内淋巴细胞计数超出正常范围。

HP:6000154.name: Bone marrow granuloma
HP:6000154.definition: A granuloma (a focal aggregate of immune cells that forms in response to a persistent inflammatory stimulus) localiyed to the bone marrow. A granuloma characteristically demonstrates the compact organization of mature macrophages, which may or may not be associated with other inflammatory cell types.
HP:6000154.definition_cn: 骨髓局限性肉芽肿（一种由免疫细胞在持续性炎症刺激下形成的局灶性聚集）。肉芽肿特征性地表现为成熟巨噬细胞的紧密组织，可能伴有或不伴有其他炎症细胞类型。

HP:6000155.name: Neuronal intranuclear inclusion bodies
HP:6000155.definition: The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neurons.
HP:6000155.definition_cn: 神经元内包涵体（可染色物质，通常为蛋白质的聚集体）的存在。

HP:6000157.name: Decreased pancreatic acinar cell density
HP:6000157.definition: Number (count) of pancreatic acinar cells reduced below normal. This feature can be ascertained by pancreas biopsy.
HP:6000157.name_cn: 胰腺腺泡细胞密度降低
HP:6000157.definition_cn: 胰腺腺泡细胞数量（计数）低于正常水平。此特征可通过胰腺活检确认。

HP:6000158.name: Unesterified cholesterol accumulation in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000158.definition: An abnormal result of the the filipin test. In this test is based on the reaction of unesterified cholesterol with fluorescent antibiotic filipin giving a strongly fluorescent, stable cholesterol-filipin complex suitable for in situ detection. An abnormal test result is present if there is a perinuclear accumulation of staining in lysosomal storage organelles (LSOs).
HP:6000158.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中未酯化胆固醇的积聚
HP:6000158.definition_cn: 菲律宾菌素试验结果异常。该试验基于未酯化胆固醇与荧光抗生素菲律宾菌素的反应，形成一种强荧光、稳定的胆固醇-菲律宾菌素复合物，适用于原位检测。若在溶酶体储存细胞器（LSOs）中出现核周染色积聚，则表明试验结果异常。

HP:6000159.name: Hepatic lipid-laden macrophage infiltration
HP:6000159.definition: Accumulation of foamy cells (lipid-laden macrophages) in the parenchyma of the liver.
HP:6000159.name_cn: 肝脂质负荷巨噬细胞浸润
HP:6000159.definition_cn: 肝实质内泡沫细胞（脂质负载巨噬细胞）的积聚。

HP:6000160.name: Splenic lipid-laden macrophage infiltration
HP:6000160.definition: Accumulation of foamy cells (lipid-laden macrophages) in the parenchyma of the spleen.
HP:6000160.name_cn: 脾脏脂质负荷巨噬细胞浸润
HP:6000160.definition_cn: 脾实质内泡沫细胞（脂质负载巨噬细胞）的积聚。

HP:6000161.name: Reduced hepatic N-acetylglutamate synthase activity
HP:6000161.definition: Concentration or activity of N-acetylglutamate synthase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000161.name_cn: 肝内N-乙酰谷氨酸合酶活性降低
HP:6000161.definition_cn: 肝组织中N-乙酰谷氨酸合酶浓度或活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000162.name: Excessive licorice consumption
HP:6000162.definition: Ingestion of large amounts of licorice.

HP:6000163.name: Shoulder localization
HP:6000163.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the shoulder.
HP:6000163.definition_cn: 适用于位于（或主要位于）肩部的异常情况。

HP:6000164.name: Pregnancy conceived despite intrauterine device
HP:6000164.definition: Intrauterine devices (IUDs) are used for contraception. Rarely pregnancy occurs despite the presence of an IUD. Such pregnancies are associated with an increased risk of spontaneous abortion and preterm delivery due to infection, and a higher risk of maternal septic complications.
HP:6000164.name_cn: 宫内节育器避孕失败妊娠
HP:6000164.definition_cn: 宫内节育器（IUD）用于避孕。尽管存在IUD，偶尔仍会发生妊娠。此类妊娠与因感染导致的自发性流产和早产风险增加相关，且母体脓毒症并发症的风险更高。

HP:6000165.name: Maternal folate deficiency
HP:6000165.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of folate deficiency during the corresponding pregnancy.
HP:6000165.definition_cn: 胎儿或先证者的母亲在相应妊娠期间有叶酸缺乏病史。

HP:6000166.name: Maternal zinc deficiency
HP:6000166.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of abnormally low zinc levels during the corresponding pregnancy.
HP:6000166.definition_cn: 胎儿或先证者的母亲在相应妊娠期间有锌水平异常低下的病史。

HP:6000167.name: Use of intrauterine device
HP:6000167.definition: Intrauterine devices (IUD) are commonly used for contraception. IUD complications are rare, but include perforation, pelvic infection, expulsion, missing strings, and difficult IUD removal.
HP:6000167.definition_cn: 宫内节育器（IUD）常用于避孕。IUD并发症较为罕见，但包括穿孔、盆腔感染、脱落、尾丝缺失及IUD取出困难。

HP:6000168.name: History of recent central venous catheter
HP:6000168.definition: A past medical history of a recent central venous catheter (CVC). A CVC is an indwelling device inserted into a large, central vein (most commonly the internal jugular, subclavian, or femoral) and advanced until the terminal lumen resides within the inferior vena cava, superior vena cava, or right atrium. CVCs can be a necessary producre for critically ill patients with indications such as total parenteral nutrition administration, dialysis, plasmapheresis, medication administration, and hemodynamic monitoring, and to facilitate further complex interventions such as transvenous pacemaker placement. Complications include arrhythmia, central vein stenosis, and sepsis.
HP:6000168.definition_cn: 既往病史：近期中心静脉导管（Central Venous Catheter, CVC）置入史。中心静脉导管是一种留置装置，通常插入大静脉（最常见的是颈内静脉、锁骨下静脉或股静脉），并推进至导管末端位于下腔静脉、上腔静脉或右心房内。CVC对于危重患者可能是必要的操作，适应症包括全肠外营养输注、透析、血浆置换、药物输注和血流动力学监测，以及促进进一步复杂干预措施如经静脉起搏器植入。并发症包括心律失常、中心静脉狭窄和脓毒症。

HP:6000169.name: History of total parenteral nutrition dependence
HP:6000169.definition: A past medical history of a recent depence on total parenteral nutrition (TPN), which refers to intravenously administered nutrition being the only source of nutrition the patient is receiving.
HP:6000169.definition_cn: 既往病史显示近期依赖全肠外营养（Total Parenteral Nutrition, TPN），即患者仅通过静脉途径接受营养支持。

HP:6000170.name: Pain alleviated by testicle elevation
HP:6000170.definition: This refers to testicular pain that is lessened or made more bearable by elevation of the testicle.
HP:6000170.name_cn: 疼痛通过睾丸抬高缓解
HP:6000170.definition_cn: 此症状指通过抬高睾丸可减轻或缓解的睾丸疼痛。

HP:6000171.name: Abdominal wall mass
HP:6000171.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the abdominal wall (the skin, fascia, and muscle encases the abdominal cavity and viscera). The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6000171.definition_cn: 腹壁（包括皮肤、筋膜和肌肉，包裹腹腔和内脏）局部异常增大或肿胀。在诊断检查的早期阶段，在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质之前，通常使用“肿块”一词来描述。

HP:6000172.name: Tympanic membrane bulging
HP:6000172.definition: The tympanic membrane protrudes (swells outwards). This feature may be observed with otoscopy.
HP:6000172.definition_cn: 鼓膜膨出（向外肿胀）。此特征可通过耳镜检查观察到。

HP:6000173.name: Ear pain exacerbated by manipulating tragus or pinna
HP:6000173.definition: Applies to pain of the ear that is worsened, aggravated, or exacerbated by touching or moving the tragus or pinna.
HP:6000173.name_cn: 耳屏或耳廓操作加重的耳痛
HP:6000173.definition_cn: 适用于因触碰或移动耳屏或耳廓而加重、加剧或恶化的耳部疼痛。

HP:6000174.name: Lateral neck mass
HP:6000174.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the side of the neck. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6000174.definition_cn: 颈部侧面的异常增大或肿胀。在诊断过程的早期阶段，通常在尚未确定肿胀的确切性质时，使用“肿块”一词。

HP:6000175.name: Occipital location
HP:6000175.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the occiput (back part of the head).
HP:6000175.definition_cn: 适用于位于枕骨（头部后部）的异常。

HP:6000176.name: Anterior neck swelling
HP:6000176.definition: Abormal enlargement of the front part of the neck owing to accumulation of fluid.
HP:6000176.definition_cn: 颈部前部异常肿大，由于液体潴留所致。

HP:6000177.name: Uvular swelling
HP:6000177.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the uvula related to an abnormal accumulation of fluid.
HP:6000177.definition_cn: 悬雍垂异常增大与液体异常积聚相关。

HP:6000178.name: Purulent drainage from Stensen duct
HP:6000178.definition: Flow of pus (purulence) from the Stensen duct. The Stensen duct is also known as the parotid duct and is the route that saliva takes from the major salivary gland (parotid gland) to the mouth.
HP:6000178.definition_cn: 腮腺导管（Stensen导管）脓性分泌物。腮腺导管，亦称Stensen导管，是唾液从主要唾液腺（腮腺）流向口腔的通道。

HP:6000179.name: History of gastric bypass surgery
HP:6000179.definition: History of having received gastric bypass surgery. This is a procedure that reduces the functional volume of the stomach and is used to treat morbid obesity.
HP:6000179.definition_cn: 既往接受过胃旁路手术史。该手术旨在减少胃的功能性容量，用于治疗病态肥胖症。

HP:6000180.name: Triggered by volatile organic compounds
HP:6000180.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to volatile organic compounds (VOCs), which comprise various organic chemicals which are released as gases from different liquids or solids.
HP:6000180.name_cn: 由挥发性有机化合物引发
HP:6000180.definition_cn: 适用于由暴露于挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）引发或导致的体征或症状，这些化合物包括从不同液体或固体中以气体形式释放的各种有机化学物质。

HP:6000181.name: History of radiation therapy
HP:6000181.definition: A medical history of having undergone radiation therapy, which is a treatment that uses ionizing radiation for purposes such as the control the growth of malignant cells in cancer treatment.
HP:6000181.definition_cn: 既往接受过放射治疗史，放射治疗是一种利用电离辐射以控制恶性肿瘤细胞生长的治疗方法，常用于癌症治疗。

HP:6000182.name: Absent otoacoustic emissions
HP:6000182.definition: Failure to record otoacoustic emissions (OAE), i.e., sounds generated from the cochlea in response to an acoustic stimulus and transmitted across the middle ear to the external ear canal.
HP:6000182.definition_cn: 未能记录到耳声发射（OAE），即由耳蜗在声刺激下产生并通过中耳传递至外耳道的声音。

HP:6000183.name: Thickened tympanic membrane
HP:6000183.definition: The tympanic membrane (eardrum, myringa) is a thin, semitransparent, oval membrane, approximately 1 cm in diameter, that separates the external acoustic meatus from the tympanic cavity. Thickening refers to an increase of the dimension across the membrane.
HP:6000183.definition_cn: 鼓膜（tympanic membrane，又称eardrum或myringa）为一层薄而半透明的椭圆形膜，直径约1厘米，将外耳道（external acoustic meatus）与鼓室（tympanic cavity）分隔开。鼓膜增厚（thickening）是指鼓膜厚度增加。

HP:6000184.name: Filum terminale lipoma
HP:6000184.definition: Filum terminale lipomas (FTLs) are a type of lumbosacral lipoma in which the fat is entirely within the filum terminale and separate from the conus medullaris.
HP:6000184.definition_cn: 终丝脂肪瘤（Filum Terminale Lipomas, FTLs）是一种腰骶部脂肪瘤，其脂肪组织完全位于终丝内，并与脊髓圆锥分离。

HP:6000185.name: Low tetrahydrocortisol (THF) plus 5-alpha-THF/tetrahydrocortisone (THE) ratio
HP:6000185.definition: The relative concentration of tetrahydrocortisol plus 5-alpha-tetrahydrocortisol relative to that of tetrahydrocortisone is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000185.name_cn: 低四氢皮质醇（THF）加5α-四氢皮质醇（5α-THF）/四氢可的松（THE）比值
HP:6000185.definition_cn: 四氢皮质醇加5α-四氢皮质醇相对于四氢可的松的相对浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000186.name: Anti-soluble liver antigen/liver pancreas antibody positivity
HP:6000186.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against soluble liver antigen.
HP:6000186.name_cn: 抗可溶性肝抗原/肝胰抗体阳性
HP:6000186.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对可溶性肝抗原的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000187.name: Anti-thrombospondin type I domain-containing 7A antibody positivity
HP:6000187.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against thrombospondin type I domain-containing 7A.
HP:6000187.name_cn: 抗凝血酶反应蛋白1型结构域7A抗体阳性
HP:6000187.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对含有血小板反应蛋白1型结构域的7A蛋白的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000188.name: Antisperm antibody positivity
HP:6000188.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against sperm antigens.
HP:6000188.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对精子抗原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000189.name: Decreased circulating ficolin 3 concentration
HP:6000189.definition: Concentration of ficolin 3 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000189.name_cn: 循环纤维胶凝蛋白3浓度降低
HP:6000189.definition_cn: 循环血液中纤维胶凝蛋白3浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000190.name: Abnormal seminal vesicle morphology
HP:6000190.definition: A structural abnormality of the seminal vesicle. The seminal vesicles are a pair of glands that also include the prostate gland and the bulbourethral glands and are located in the pelvis superior to the rectum, inferior to the fundus of the bladder and posterior to the prostate. The seminal vesicles contribute around 70% of the fluid that will eventually become semen.
HP:6000190.definition_cn: 精囊结构异常。精囊是一对腺体，与前列腺和尿道球腺共同构成男性附属腺体，位于盆腔内，直肠上方，膀胱底下方，前列腺后方。精囊分泌的液体约占最终形成精液的70%。

HP:6000191.name: Seminal vesicle cyst
HP:6000191.definition: A cyst (sac-like mass that may contain serous liquid or semisolid material) caused by distention of the seminal vesicle due to atresia of the ejaculatory duct.
HP:6000191.definition_cn: 由于射精管闭锁导致精囊扩张引起的囊肿（囊状肿块，可能含有浆液性液体或半固体物质）。

HP:6000192.name: Silica dust exposure
HP:6000192.definition: History of exposure to respirable crystalline silica (SiO2).
HP:6000192.definition_cn: 接触可吸入结晶二氧化硅（SiO2）史。

HP:6000193.name: Anti-osteoprotegerin antibody positivity
HP:6000193.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against osteoprotegerin.
HP:6000193.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对骨保护素（osteoprotegerin）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000194.name: History of adrenalectomy
HP:6000194.definition: A past medical history of having had a surgical procedure to remove the adrenal glands.
HP:6000194.definition_cn: 既往有肾上腺切除术病史。

HP:6000195.name: Elevated mitochondrial citrate synthase synthase activity
HP:6000195.definition: Activity of the enzyme mitochondrial citrate synthase (EC:2.3.3.1) in muscle tissue is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000195.name_cn: 线粒体柠檬酸合酶活性升高
HP:6000195.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中线粒体柠檬酸合酶（EC:2.3.3.1）的活性高于正常上限。

HP:6000196.name: Reduced muscle lactate dehydrogenase activity
HP:6000196.definition: Activity of the enzyme lactate dehdrogenase (LHD; 1.1.1.27) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. LDH catalyzes the conversion of pyruvate to lactate and back, as it converts NAD+ to NADH and back.
HP:6000196.name_cn: 肌肉乳酸脱氢酶活性降低
HP:6000196.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中乳酸脱氢酶（LDH；EC 1.1.1.27）的活性低于正常下限。LDH催化丙酮酸转化为乳酸及其逆反应，同时将NAD+转化为NADH及其逆反应。

HP:6000197.name: Reduced muscle phosphoglycerate mutase activity
HP:6000197.definition: Activity of the enzyme Phosphoglycerate mutase (PGM) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. PGM is an enzyme that catalyzes step 8 of glycolysis (EC 5.4.2.11).
HP:6000197.name_cn: 肌肉磷酸甘油酸变位酶活性降低
HP:6000197.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中磷酸甘油酸变位酶（Phosphoglycerate Mutase, PGM）的活性低于正常下限。磷酸甘油酸变位酶是一种催化糖酵解第8步反应的酶（EC 5.4.2.11）。

HP:6000198.name: Reduced muscle phosphorylase kinase activity
HP:6000198.definition: Activity of the enzyme muscle phosphorylase kinase (PhK) in muscle tissue below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000198.name_cn: 肌肉磷酸化酶激酶活性降低
HP:6000198.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中肌磷酸化酶激酶（PhK）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000199.name: Reduced 3-beta-hydroxysteroid-delta-5-desaturase activity in cultured fibroblasts
