HP:6000438.definition: The amount of iodine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000438.definition_cn: 尿碘浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000439.name: Increased circulating interleukin 15 concentration
HP:6000439.definition: The concentration of interleukin 15 (IL-15) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000439.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素15浓度升高
HP:6000439.definition_cn: 循环血液中白细胞介素15（IL-15）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000440.name: Reduced circulating squalene concentration
HP:6000440.definition: The concentration of squalene in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000440.definition_cn: 血液循环中角鲨烯浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000441.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 6 concentration
HP:6000441.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 6 (IL-6) in the blood circulation.
HP:6000441.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素6浓度
HP:6000441.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素6（IL-6）浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:6000442.name: Abnormal circulating interleukin 12 concentration
HP:6000442.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the concentration of interleukin 12 in the blood circulation.
HP:6000442.name_cn: 异常循环白细胞介素12浓度
HP:6000442.definition_cn: 血液中白细胞介素12浓度偏离正常范围的任何异常。

HP:6000443.name: Elevated blood mercury concentration
HP:6000443.definition: The concentration of mercury in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.
HP:6000443.definition_cn: 血液中汞浓度高于总血汞浓度指导值的上限，提示可能存在有害影响。

HP:6000444.name: Elevated blood cadmiun concentration
HP:6000444.definition: The concentration of cadmium in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.
HP:6000444.definition_cn: 血液中镉浓度超过全血汞浓度指导值的上限，提示可能存在有害效应。

HP:6000445.name: Elevated thallium concentration
HP:6000445.definition: The concentration of thallium in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood mercury concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.
HP:6000445.definition_cn: 血液中铊的浓度超过了全血汞浓度指导值的上限，提示可能存在有害效应。

HP:6000446.name: Abnormal circulating CC chemokine concentration
HP:6000446.definition: The concentration in the blood circulation of a member of the CC chemokine family is outside of normal limits.
HP:6000446.name_cn: 异常循环CC趋化因子浓度
HP:6000446.definition_cn: 循环血液中CC趋化因子家族成员的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:6000447.name: Decreased CSF asialotransferrin to transferrin ratio
HP:6000447.definition: The concentration of asialotransferrin relative to that of transferrin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000447.name_cn: 脑脊液去唾液酸转铁蛋白与转铁蛋白比值降低
HP:6000447.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中无唾液酸转铁蛋白相对于转铁蛋白的浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000448.name: Anti-desmocollin antibody positivity
HP:6000448.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against desmocollin.
HP:6000448.name_cn: 抗桥粒芯蛋白抗体阳性
HP:6000448.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对桥粒芯糖蛋白的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000449.name: Occupational exposure to raw nonsynthetic textiles
HP:6000449.definition: A history of exposure by inhalation of airborne particles generated during the processing of raw, nonsynthetic textiles, particularly cotton. Classically, exposure to cotton dust during the spinning and manufacturing process causes byssinosis. However, exposure to jute, flax, and hemp fibers has also been implicated in its development.
HP:6000449.name_cn: 职业性接触原生态非合成纺织品
HP:6000449.definition_cn: 吸入性暴露史，涉及在加工未经合成的纺织品（特别是棉花）过程中产生的空气悬浮颗粒。典型情况下，在纺纱和制造过程中暴露于棉尘会导致棉尘病（byssinosis）。然而，暴露于黄麻、亚麻和大麻纤维也被认为与该病的发生有关。

HP:6000450.name: Rokitansky-Aschoff gallbladder sinuses
HP:6000450.definition: Localized or diffuse epithelial proliferation with hypertrophy of the muscularis layer and invagination of the mucosa through the muscularis, forming intramural diverticula (i.e., small, bulging pouches in the wall of the gallbladder).
HP:6000450.name_cn: 罗基坦斯基-阿肖夫胆囊窦
HP:6000450.definition_cn: 局部或弥漫性上皮增生伴肌层肥大及黏膜通过肌层内陷，形成壁内憩室（即胆囊壁内的小而突出的囊袋）。

HP:6000451.name: Porcelain gallbladder
HP:6000451.definition: Porcelain gallbladder refers to the condition in which the inner gallbladder wall is encrusted with calcium. The wall becomes brittle, hard, and often takes on a bluish hue. It is usually found incidentally on plain abdominal x-rays or other imaging because most patients are asymptomatic.
HP:6000451.definition_cn: 瓷胆囊（Porcelain gallbladder）是指胆囊内壁被钙质沉积所覆盖的病理状态。胆囊壁因此变得脆弱、硬化，并常呈现蓝灰色。该病症通常是在腹部平片或其他影像学检查中偶然发现的，因为大多数患者并无明显症状。

HP:6000452.name: Gallbladder adhesions
HP:6000452.definition: Strands of scar tissue bands of scar tissue that form an abnormal connection between the gallbladder and another abdominal structure. Adhesions can form followiing gallbladder inflammation (cholecystitis).
HP:6000452.definition_cn: 胆囊与另一腹部结构之间形成的异常连接的瘢痕组织束。粘连可在胆囊炎症（胆囊炎）后形成。

HP:6000453.name: Bilioduodenal fistula
HP:6000453.definition: An abnormal connection between the gallbladder and the duodenum.
HP:6000453.definition_cn: 胆囊与十二指肠之间的异常连接。

HP:6000454.name: Pneumobilia
HP:6000454.definition: Accumulation of gas in the biliary tree.

HP:6000455.name: Ectopic gallstone
HP:6000455.definition: A gallstone located outside of the gallbladder.

HP:6000456.name: Sleep drunkeness
HP:6000456.definition: Sleep drunkenness refers to the prolonged and pronounced difficulty with awakening from nocturnal sleep and daytime naps. This symptom should be distinguished from the milder and physiologic state of sleep inertia seen even in healthy controls .
HP:6000456.definition_cn: 睡眠醉酒状态（Sleep drunkenness）是指从夜间睡眠和日间小睡中觉醒时出现的持续且显著的困难。该症状应与即使在健康对照者中也能观察到的较轻且生理性的睡眠惯性（Sleep inertia）相鉴别。

HP:6000457.name: Mallory bodies
HP:6000457.definition: Cytoplasmic hyaline inclusions of hepatocytes that are predominantly filamentous ranging from a diameter of 3 to 24 nm vs. 10 nm of classical IF. Mallory-Denk bodies can be classified as type I (parallels filaments), II (randomly orient filaments), or III (granular and amorphous). Type II occurs in the periphery while type III occurs around the center. MDB occur in ballooned hepatocytes.
HP:6000457.definition_cn: 肝细胞胞质内透明包涵体，主要为丝状结构，直径范围为3至24纳米，而经典中间丝（IF）直径为10纳米。Mallory-Denk小体可分为I型（平行排列的丝状结构）、II型（随机排列的丝状结构）或III型（颗粒状和无定形结构）。II型主要出现在外周区域，而III型则出现在中心区域。Mallory-Denk小体见于气球样变的肝细胞中。

HP:6000458.name: Sulfur-containing abscess
HP:6000458.definition: An abscess containing tiny yellow clumps (sulfur granules), formed by infection with Actinomyces and generally associated with a granulomatous and suppurative infection.
HP:6000458.definition_cn: 含有微小黄色团块（硫磺颗粒）的脓肿，由放线菌感染形成，通常与肉芽肿性和化脓性感染相关。

HP:6000459.name: Retracted tympanic membrane
HP:6000459.definition: A condition in which part of the tympanic membrane is pull backed into the middle ear cavity (also called retraction pocket).
HP:6000459.definition_cn: 一种情况，其中部分鼓膜被拉回至中耳腔（也称为回缩袋）。

HP:6000460.name: Ectopic testis
HP:6000460.definition: Localization of the testis in an anatomic location other than the scrotum.
HP:6000460.definition_cn: 睾丸异位于阴囊以外的解剖位置。

HP:6000461.name: Cerebral subcortical cyst
HP:6000461.definition: A fluid-filled sac (cyst) in the region below the cortex of the cerebrum. In magnetic resonance imaging, the fluid within the cyst has the same appearance as cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000461.definition_cn: 大脑皮层下方区域内的液性囊性病变（囊肿）。在磁共振成像中，囊肿内的液体与脑脊液（CSF）呈现相同的影像学特征。

HP:6000462.name: Anti-ADAMTS13 antibody positivity
HP:6000462.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against A Disintegrin and Metalloprotease with ThromboSpondin type 1 repeats, member 13 (ADAMTS13).
HP:6000462.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对具有血小板反应蛋白1型重复序列的解整合素样金属蛋白酶13（ADAMTS13）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000463.name: Habitual mouth breathing
HP:6000463.definition: A tendency to breathe through the mouth. Defined as over 25-30 percent of the air passing through the mouth instead of the nose, mouth breathing often occurs due to upper airway obstruction which reduces the nasal airflow and forces the air to enter completely or partially through oral cavity.
HP:6000463.definition_cn: 口呼吸倾向。定义为超过25-30%的气流通过口腔而非鼻腔，口呼吸通常由于上呼吸道阻塞导致鼻腔气流减少，迫使气流完全或部分通过口腔进入。

HP:6000464.name: Squared off shoulders
HP:6000464.definition: An appearance of the shoulders whereby the neck-trapezius angle (angle between the neck and the shoulder) and the angle formed by the shoulder and the arms hanging at the side of the body are both close to 90 degrees. This gives the should the appearance of the corner of a square.
HP:6000464.definition_cn: 肩部外观表现为颈斜方肌角（颈部与肩部之间的角度）以及肩部与自然下垂于身体两侧的上臂所形成的角度均接近90度。这种形态使肩部呈现出类似直角的外观。

HP:6000465.name: Elevated urine mesaconic acid level
HP:6000465.definition: The amount of mesaconic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000465.definition_cn: 尿液中经尿浓度校正后的中康酸水平高于正常上限。

HP:6000466.name: Elevated urine 3-methyladipic acid level
HP:6000466.definition: The amount of 3-methyladipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000466.name_cn: 尿液中3-甲基己二酸水平升高
HP:6000466.definition_cn: 尿液中3-甲基己二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000467.name: Elevated urine D-lactate level
HP:6000467.definition: The amount of D-lactate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. L-lactate is a familiar molecule to the human body and is also produced in large amounts in human tissues, depending on metabolic conditions. In contrast, D-lactate is produced only in minute quantities in human tissues, and is therefore not detectable in the bloodstream under normal physiological conditions.
HP:6000467.definition_cn: 尿液中D-乳酸浓度经尿液浓度标准化后高于正常上限。L-乳酸是人体熟悉的分子，在人体组织中根据代谢条件大量产生。相比之下，D-乳酸在人体组织中仅微量产生，因此在正常生理条件下在血液中无法检测到。

HP:6000468.name: Elevated CSF alpha-ketoglutarate concentration
HP:6000468.definition: The concentration of alpha-ketoglutarate in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000468.name_cn: 脑脊液α-酮戊二酸浓度升高
HP:6000468.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中α-酮戊二酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000469.name: Elevated urine 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methylbutanoic acid level
HP:6000469.definition: The amount of 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methylbutanoic acidin the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000469.name_cn: 尿液中2,3-二羟基-2-甲基丁酸水平升高
HP:6000469.definition_cn: 尿液中2,3-二羟基-2-甲基丁酸的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限。

HP:6000470.name: Fetal oral mass
HP:6000470.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the oral cavity of a fetus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined. This finding is generally first observed by prenatal sonography or magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:6000470.definition_cn: 胎儿口腔局部肿胀或增大。在诊断初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。这一发现通常首先通过产前超声检查或磁共振成像观察到。

HP:6000471.name: Dilated ejaculatory duct
HP:6000471.definition: Increase in diameter of the ejeculatory duct. The ejaculatory duct delivers sperm into the urethra, adding secretions from the prostate and is formed by the union of the vas deferens with the duct of the seminal vesicle.
HP:6000471.definition_cn: 射精管直径增大。射精管将精子输送至尿道，并加入前列腺分泌物，由输精管与精囊腺导管汇合而成。

HP:6000472.name: Decreased Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein concentration in hematopoietic cells
HP:6000472.definition: The concentration of Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome protein in hematopoietic cells is below the lower limit of normal. This feature is measured by flow cytometry or Western blotting.
HP:6000472.name_cn: 造血细胞中Wiskott-Aldrich综合征蛋白浓度降低
HP:6000472.definition_cn: 造血细胞中Wiskott-Aldrich综合征蛋白的浓度低于正常下限。该特征通过流式细胞术或蛋白质印迹法进行检测。

HP:6000473.name: Decreased FOXP3-expressing T cell count
HP:6000473.definition: The number of T cells in peripheral blood that express FOXP3-expressing is below the lower limit of normal. This finding is determined by flow cytometry.
HP:6000473.definition_cn: 外周血中表达FOXP3的T细胞数量低于正常下限。该结果通过流式细胞术测定。

HP:6000474.name: Elevated circulating complement component concentration
HP:6000474.definition: Concentration of a complement component in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000474.name_cn: 循环补体成分浓度升高
HP:6000474.definition_cn: 血液循环中补体成分浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000475.name: Anti-beta fodrin antibody positivity
HP:6000475.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a component of beta-fodrin.
HP:6000475.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对β-血影蛋白（beta-fodrin）成分的自身体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000476.name: Elevated circulating tetradecenoylcarnitine concentration
HP:6000476.definition: The concentration of tetradecenoylcarnitine (C14:1) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000476.name_cn: 循环十四烯酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:6000476.definition_cn: 血液循环中十四烯酰肉碱（C14:1）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000477.name: Elevated urine 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine level
HP:6000477.definition: The amount of 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000477.name_cn: 尿液中2-反式,4-顺式-癸二烯酰肉碱水平升高
HP:6000477.definition_cn: 尿液中2-反式,4-顺式-癸二烯酰肉碱的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限。

HP:6000478.name: Elevated circulating 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine concentration
HP:6000478.definition: The concentration of 2-trans,4-cis-decadienoylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000478.name_cn: 循环中2-反式,4-顺式-十碳二烯酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:6000478.definition_cn: 血液循环中2-反式,4-顺式-癸二烯酰肉碱的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000479.name: Elevated urine N-acetyltyrosine level
HP:6000479.definition: The amount of N-acetyltyrosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000479.name_cn: 尿N-乙酰酪氨酸水平升高
HP:6000479.definition_cn: 尿液中N-乙酰酪氨酸的含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000480.name: Elevated urine manganese level
HP:6000480.definition: The amount of manganese in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000480.definition_cn: 尿液中锰含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000481.name: Reduced urinary manganese level
HP:6000481.definition: The amount of manganese in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000481.definition_cn: 尿液中锰含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:6000482.name: Decreased circulating catecholamine concentration
HP:6000482.definition: Concentration of a catecholamine in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000482.name_cn: 循环儿茶酚胺浓度降低
HP:6000482.definition_cn: 循环血液中儿茶酚胺浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000483.name: Empty sella turcica
HP:6000483.definition: Empty sella or arachnoidocele has been defined as the herniation of the subarachnoid space within the sella turcica, associated with elongated pituitary stalk and flattening of the pituitary gland.
HP:6000483.definition_cn: 空蝶鞍或蛛网膜囊肿被定义为蛛网膜下腔在蝶鞍内的疝出，伴随垂体柄的延长和垂体腺的扁平化。

HP:6000484.name: Elevated brain guanidinoacetate level by MRS
HP:6000484.definition: An increase in the level of guanidinoacetate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
HP:6000484.name_cn: 磁共振波谱（MRS）显示脑内胍基乙酸水平升高
HP:6000484.definition_cn: 通过磁共振波谱分析（Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, MRS）检测到脑内胍基乙酸（Guanidinoacetate）水平升高。

HP:6000485.name: Elevated circulating beta chorionic gonadotropin concentration
HP:6000485.definition: The concentration of beta chorionic gonadotropin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000485.name_cn: 循环β人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度升高
HP:6000485.definition_cn: 血清中β-人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度高于正常参考值上限。

HP:6000486.name: Elevated circulating CXCL10 concentration
HP:6000486.definition: The concentration of C-X-C motif chemokine 10 (CXCL10) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000486.definition_cn: 血液循环中C-X-C基序趋化因子10（CXCL10）的浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000487.name: Reduced circulating interleukin 12 concentration
HP:6000487.definition: The concentration of interleukin 12 (IL-12) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000487.name_cn: 循环白细胞介素12浓度降低
HP:6000487.definition_cn: 循环血液中白细胞介素12（IL-12）浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000488.name: Reduced circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
HP:6000488.definition: The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000488.name_cn: 循环成纤维细胞生长因子23浓度降低
HP:6000488.definition_cn: 循环血液中成纤维细胞生长因子23的浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000489.name: Abnormal circulating fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
HP:6000489.definition: The concentration of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of normal.
HP:6000489.name_cn: 异常循环成纤维细胞生长因子23浓度
HP:6000489.definition_cn: 血液循环中成纤维细胞生长因子23的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:6000490.name: Impaired heel-walking ability
HP:6000490.definition: Difficulty or reduced ability to walk on heels. Heel-walking can be tested as a part of the neurological examination. Foot dorsal extension weakness leads to difficulties in walking on heels.
HP:6000490.definition_cn: 足跟行走困难或能力减退。足跟行走测试可作为神经系统检查的一部分。足背伸肌无力导致足跟行走困难。

HP:6000491.name: Anti-prothrombin antibody positivity
HP:6000491.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against prothrombin.
HP:6000491.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对凝血酶原的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000492.name: Anti-factor V antibody positivity
HP:6000492.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against factor V.
HP:6000492.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对因子V的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000493.name: Anti-factor VII antibody positivity
HP:6000493.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor VII.
HP:6000493.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对因子VII的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000494.name: Anti-factor VIII antibody positivity
HP:6000494.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor VIII.
HP:6000494.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对因子VIII的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000495.name: Anti-factor IX antibody positivity
HP:6000495.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against factor IX.
HP:6000495.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对因子IX的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000496.name: Anti-factor X antibody positivity
HP:6000496.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor X.
HP:6000496.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对因子X的抗体。

HP:6000497.name: Anti-factor XI antibody positivity
HP:6000497.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor XI.
HP:6000497.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对因子XI的抗体。

HP:6000498.name: Anti-factor XIII antibody positivity
HP:6000498.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor XIII.
HP:6000498.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对因子XIII的抗体。

HP:6000499.name: Anti-factor H antibody positivity
HP:6000499.definition: The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against factor H.
HP:6000499.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对H因子的抗体。

HP:6000500.name: Extremities cold to touch
HP:6000500.definition: Cool or cold arms or legs related to peripheral vasoconstriction, the narrowing of blood vessels resulting from the contraction of muscular walls in large arteries and the small arterioles of skin and most internal organs. Following exposure to low ambient temperatures, vasoconstriction decreases heat dissipation from skin surfaces, thus preventing life-threatening hypothermia.
HP:6000500.definition_cn: 与周围血管收缩相关的四肢发凉或冰冷，这是由于大动脉和皮肤及大多数内脏器官的小动脉的肌壁收缩导致的血管狭窄。在暴露于低温环境后，血管收缩减少了皮肤表面的热量散失，从而防止危及生命的低体温症。

HP:6000501.name: Ruffled acrosome
HP:6000501.definition: An irregular wavy appearance of sperm acrosomes.
HP:6000501.definition_cn: 精子顶体呈现不规则波浪状外观。

HP:6000502.name: Elevated circulating calprotectin concentration
HP:6000502.definition: The concentration of calprotectin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000502.name_cn: 循环钙卫蛋白浓度升高
HP:6000502.definition_cn: 血液循环中钙卫蛋白浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000503.name: 4-5 toe cutaneous syndactyly
HP:6000503.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 4 and 5.
HP:6000503.name_cn: 第四至第五趾皮肤性并趾畸形
HP:6000503.definition_cn: 第四和第五趾之间在前后轴上存在软组织连续性。

HP:6000504.name: Poly-hill sign
HP:6000504.definition: A typical physical examination in patients with muscular dystrophies and selective weakness and atrophy of the trapezius muscle and proximal deltoid muscle. The contour of the back shows unique hills and drops.
HP:6000504.definition_cn: 肌营养不良症患者典型体格检查显示斜方肌和近端三角肌选择性无力和萎缩。背部轮廓呈现独特的“山丘与低谷”样改变。

HP:6000505.name: 3-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:6000505.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the third to the fifth fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.
HP:6000505.definition_cn: 第三至第五指在前后轴上存在软组织连续性，向远端延伸至少至近端指间关节水平。

HP:6000506.name: Radioulnar subluxation
HP:6000506.definition: Partial dislocation of the radioulnar joint.

HP:6000507.name: Non-pitting edema
HP:6000507.definition: Non-pitting edema occurs when excess fluid builds up in the body causing swelling that does not indent when pressure is applied. It usually occurs in the limbs, and often results from underlying medical conditions affecting lymphatic system function.
HP:6000507.definition_cn: 非凹陷性水肿是指体内液体过多积聚导致肿胀，且在施加压力时不会出现凹陷。通常发生于四肢，常由影响淋巴系统功能的潜在医学状况引起。

HP:6000508.name: Anti-human ferritin peptide antibody positivity
HP:6000508.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the human ferritin peptide.
HP:6000508.name_cn: 抗人铁蛋白肽抗体阳性
HP:6000508.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对人铁蛋白肽的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000509.name: Elevated CSF L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid concentration
HP:6000509.definition: The concentration of L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000509.name_cn: 脑脊液L-2-羟基戊二酸浓度升高
HP:6000509.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中L-2-羟基戊二酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000510.name: Elevated erythrocyte inosine triphosphate concentration
HP:6000510.definition: Concentration of inosine triphosphate in red blood cells is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000510.name_cn: 红细胞三磷酸肌苷浓度升高
HP:6000510.definition_cn: 红细胞内三磷酸肌苷浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000511.name: Reduced erythrocyte inosine triphosphatase activity
HP:6000511.definition: Activity or concentration of inosine triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase (EC 3.6.1.19) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000511.name_cn: 红细胞次黄苷三磷酸酶活性降低
HP:6000511.definition_cn: 红细胞中三磷酸肌苷焦磷酸水解酶（EC 3.6.1.19）活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000512.name: Reduced circulating alpha-1,3-fucosyltransferase activity
HP:6000512.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-1,3-fucosyltransferase is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.
HP:6000512.name_cn: 循环中α-1,3-岩藻糖基转移酶活性降低
HP:6000512.definition_cn: 血液循环中α-1,3-岩藻糖基转移酶的浓度或活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000513.name: Diminished neutrophil myeloperoxidase activity
HP:6000513.definition: Activity of the enzyme myeloperoxidase (EC 1.11.1.7) in neutrophils below the lower limit of normal. This feature can be measured by peroxidase cytochemistry or biochemical assays. Myeloperoxidase is a lysosomal hemoprotein located in the azurophilic granules of polymorphonuclear leukocytes and monocytes.
HP:6000513.name_cn: 中性粒细胞髓过氧化物酶活性降低
HP:6000513.definition_cn: 中性粒细胞中髓过氧化物酶（EC 1.11.1.7）活性低于正常下限。该特征可通过过氧化物酶细胞化学染色或生化检测进行测定。髓过氧化物酶是一种位于多形核白细胞和单核细胞嗜天青颗粒中的溶酶体血红素蛋白。

HP:6000514.name: Reduced erythrocyte uroporphyrinogen III cosynthase activity
HP:6000514.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of uroporphyrinogen III (EC 4.2.1.75) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000514.name_cn: 红细胞尿卟啉原III共合成酶活性降低
HP:6000514.definition_cn: 红细胞中尿卟啉原III（EC 4.2.1.75）水平或活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000515.name: Elevated 18-hydroxycorticosterone to aldosterone ratio
HP:6000515.definition: The relative concentration in the blood circulation of 18-hydroxycorticosterone compared to that of aldosterone is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000515.name_cn: 18-羟基皮质酮与醛固酮比值升高
HP:6000515.definition_cn: 18-羟基皮质酮在血液循环中的相对浓度与醛固酮相比，高于正常范围上限。

HP:6000516.name: Elevated circulating 21-deoxycortisol concentration
HP:6000516.definition: The concentration of 21-deoxycortisol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000516.name_cn: 循环中21-脱氧皮质醇浓度升高
HP:6000516.definition_cn: 血液循环中21-脱氧皮质醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000517.name: Elevated monolysocardiolipin/cardiolipin ratio
HP:6000517.definition: The concentration of monolysocardiolipin related to that of cardiolipin is above the upper limit of normal. This is a functional assay that can be performed from a blood spot to diagnose Barth syndrome (OMIM:302060).
HP:6000517.name_cn: 单溶血心磷脂/心磷脂比值升高
HP:6000517.definition_cn: 单溶血心磷脂与心磷脂的浓度比值高于正常上限。这是一种功能性检测，可通过血斑样本进行，用于诊断巴特综合征（OMIM:302060）。

HP:6000518.name: Low maternal vitamin B12 concentration
HP:6000518.definition: The concentration of vitamin B12 in the mother's blood during pregnancy is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000518.definition_cn: 妊娠期母体血液中维生素B12浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000519.name: Elevated circulating inhibin A concentration
HP:6000519.definition: The concentration of inibin A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000519.definition_cn: 循环血液中抑制素A的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000520.name: Increased circulating inhibin B concentration
HP:6000520.definition: The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000520.definition_cn: 血液循环中抑制素B的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000521.name: Elevated circulating lipoprotein(a) concentration
HP:6000521.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein(a) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Lipoprotein(a), also known as apolipoprotein(A), is encoded by LPA (HGNC:6667).
HP:6000521.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂蛋白(a)浓度高于正常上限。脂蛋白(a)，亦称载脂蛋白(A)，由LPA基因（HGNC:6667）编码。

HP:6000522.name: Reduced circulating lipoprotein(a) concentration
HP:6000522.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein(a) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal. Lipoprotein(a), also known as apolipoprotein(A), is encoded by LPA (HGNC:6667).
HP:6000522.definition_cn: 血液循环中的脂蛋白(a)浓度低于正常下限。脂蛋白(a)，也称为载脂蛋白(A)，由LPA基因（HGNC:6667）编码。

HP:6000523.name: Increased urinary bile acid level
HP:6000523.definition: The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000523.definition_cn: 尿液中胆汁酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000524.name: Abnormal urinary bile acid level
HP:6000524.definition: The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.
HP:6000524.definition_cn: 尿液中胆汁酸浓度经尿液浓度标准化后超出正常范围。

HP:6000525.name: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione reductase activity
HP:6000525.definition: Activity of glutathione reductase (EC 1.6.4.2) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000525.name_cn: 红细胞谷胱甘肽还原酶活性降低
HP:6000525.definition_cn: 红细胞中谷胱甘肽还原酶（EC 1.6.4.2）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000526.name: Failure to elevate lactate upon ischemic exercise test
HP:6000526.definition: Failure to elevate lactate in blood washed out from ischemically exercised muscles as assayed by the forearm ischemic exercise test.
HP:6000526.name_cn: 缺血性运动试验中乳酸未能升高
HP:6000526.definition_cn: 前臂缺血运动试验检测显示，缺血运动肌肉中洗出的血液未能升高乳酸水平。

HP:6000527.name: Elevated circulating cholestanol concentration
HP:6000527.definition: The concentration of cholestanol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Cholestanol is the 5-alpha-dihydro derivative of cholesterol.
HP:6000527.name_cn: 循环胆甾烷醇浓度升高
HP:6000527.definition_cn: 血液循环中胆甾烷醇浓度高于正常上限。胆甾烷醇是胆固醇的5-α-二氢衍生物。

HP:6000528.name: Livestock exposure
HP:6000528.definition: A medical history of having been exposed to livestock (animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm ).
HP:6000528.definition_cn: 既往有牲畜接触史（指在农场饲养的牛、羊等动物）。

HP:6000529.name: Synchronous skin lesions
HP:6000529.definition: Applies to an abnormality of the skin in which multiple lesions occur at the same time.
HP:6000529.definition_cn: 适用于皮肤异常，表现为同时出现多发性皮损。

HP:6000530.name: Serpentine skin location
HP:6000530.definition: Refers to a skin lseion that has a snake-like (serpentine) shape.
HP:6000530.definition_cn: 指具有蛇形（蜿蜒状）形态的皮肤病变。

HP:6000531.name: Abnormal urinary organic compound level
HP:6000531.definition: The amount of an organic compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal. An organic compound is defined here as a chemical compound that contains a carbon-hydrogen or carbon-carbon bond, although some other definitions exist. Examples of organic compounds includes alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatic compounds, alcohols, ketones, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, and esters.
HP:6000531.name_cn: 尿有机化合物水平异常
HP:6000531.definition_cn: 尿液中某种有机化合物的含量，经尿液浓度标准化后，超出正常范围。此处定义的有机化合物为含有碳氢键或碳碳键的化合物，尽管存在其他定义。有机化合物的实例包括烷烃、烯烃、炔烃、芳香族化合物、醇类、酮类、醛类、羧酸类和酯类。

HP:6000532.name: Elevated urinary histamine level
HP:6000532.definition: The amount of histamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000532.definition_cn: 尿液中组胺含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000533.name: Elevated urinary N-methylhistamine level
HP:6000533.definition: The amount of N-methylhistamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000533.definition_cn: 尿液中N-甲基组胺的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000534.name: Elevated urinary ureidopropionic acid level
HP:6000534.definition: The amount of ureidopropionic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000534.name_cn: 尿中脲基丙酸水平升高
HP:6000534.definition_cn: 尿液中脲基丙酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000535.name: Elevated urinary porphyrin level
HP:6000535.definition: The amount of a porphyrin compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Porphrins are natural pigments containing a fundamental skeleton of four pyrrole nuclei united through the alpha-positions by four methine groups to form a macrocyclic structure. Porpyrins giove rise to heme and combalamine.
HP:6000535.definition_cn: 尿液中卟啉化合物的含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限。卟啉是一类天然色素，其基本骨架由四个吡咯核通过四个亚甲基基团在α位连接形成大环结构。卟啉是血红素和钴胺素的前体物质。

HP:6000536.name: Elevated urinary coproporphyrin level
HP:6000536.definition: The amount of a coproporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000536.definition_cn: 尿液中粪卟啉的含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000537.name: Ecrrine sweat gland predominance
HP:6000537.definition: Applies to an abnormality of the skin that is located in or surrounding eccrine sweat glands.
HP:6000537.definition_cn: 适用于位于或围绕外泌汗腺的皮肤异常。

HP:6000538.name: Poorly demarcated skin lesion
HP:6000538.definition: Applies to an abnormality of the skin whose boundary to the surrounding normal skin is not clearly defined.
HP:6000538.definition_cn: 适用于皮肤异常，其与周围正常皮肤的边界不明确。

HP:6000539.name: History of recent cat bite
HP:6000539.definition: Medical history of a recent bite or scratch injury due to a cat.
HP:6000539.definition_cn: 近期因猫咬伤或抓伤导致的医疗史。

HP:6000540.name: History of recent stay in area with inadequate sewage sanitation
HP:6000540.definition: A history of having been in an area with inadequate sewage sanitation in the recent past.
HP:6000540.name_cn: 近期居住于污水卫生设施不足地区史
HP:6000540.definition_cn: 近期曾到访污水卫生条件不足区域的历史。

HP:6000541.name: Positive cutaneous herpes simplex virus nucleic acid test
HP:6000541.definition: Detection of cutaneous herpes simplex virus nucleic acid in the skin by a method such as polymerase chain reaction. The sample is usually obtained by cutaneous swabs from skin lesions.
HP:6000541.name_cn: 皮肤单纯疱疹病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000541.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测皮肤中单纯疱疹病毒（Herpes Simplex Virus, HSV）的核酸。样本通常通过皮肤病变部位的皮肤拭子采集获得。

HP:6000542.name: Positive CSF mycobacterium tuberculosis nucleic acid test
HP:6000542.definition: Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000542.name_cn: 脑脊液结核分枝杆菌核酸检测阳性
HP:6000542.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的结核分枝杆菌核酸。

HP:6000543.name: Positive mycobacterium CSF culture
HP:6000543.definition: Growth of mycobacterium in a culture derived from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000543.name_cn: 脑脊液分枝杆菌培养阳性
HP:6000543.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）培养中分枝杆菌的生长。

HP:6000544.name: Positive mycobacterium CSF microscopy
HP:6000544.definition: The demonstration of mycobacterium by microscopy of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000544.name_cn: 脑脊液抗酸杆菌涂片阳性
HP:6000544.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）显微镜检查显示分枝杆菌。

HP:6000545.name: Positive treponema pallidum PCR test in the blood circulation
HP:6000545.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of treponema pallidum in the blood circulation by a method such a polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000545.name_cn: 血液中梅毒螺旋体聚合酶链反应（PCR）检测阳性
HP:6000545.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测血液循环中的梅毒螺旋体（Treponema pallidum）核酸。

HP:6000546.name: Positive human Immunodeficiency virus nucleic acid test in the blood circulation
HP:6000546.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of human immunodeficiency vrus (HIV) in the blood circulation by a methiod such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000546.name_cn: 血液循环中人类免疫缺陷病毒核酸阳性检测
HP:6000546.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）的核酸。

HP:6000547.name: Positive CSF enterovirus nucleic acid test
HP:6000547.definition: Detection of enteroviral nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000547.name_cn: 脑脊液肠道病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000547.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的肠道病毒核酸。

HP:6000548.name: Positive CSF Borrelia burgdorferi nucleic acid test
HP:6000548.definition: Detection of Borrelia burgdorferi nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000548.name_cn: 脑脊液伯氏疏螺旋体核酸检测阳性
HP:6000548.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的伯氏疏螺旋体（Borrelia burgdorferi）核酸。

HP:6000549.name: Positive CSF arbovirus nucleic acid test
HP:6000549.definition: Detection of arbovus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR..
HP:6000549.name_cn: 脑脊液虫媒病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000549.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的虫媒病毒核酸。

HP:6000550.name: Positive Bartonella henselae nucleic acid test in the blood circulation
HP:6000550.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Bartonella henselae in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000550.name_cn: 血液循环中巴尔通体汉塞拉核酸阳性检测
HP:6000550.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测循环血液中的汉赛巴尔通体核酸。

HP:6000551.name: Positive Dengue virus PCR test in the blood circulation
HP:6000551.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of the Dengue virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000551.name_cn: 血液中登革病毒PCR检测阳性
HP:6000551.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测血液循环中登革病毒的核酸。

HP:6000552.name: Positive CSF JC-virus nucleic acid test
HP:6000552.definition: Detection of JC-virus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000552.name_cn: 脑脊液JC病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000552.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的JC病毒核酸。

HP:6000553.name: Bloodstream Malaria parasite
HP:6000553.definition: Presence of malaria parasites in the peripheral blood.

HP:6000554.name: Positive bloodstream plasmodium falciparum nucleic acid pathogen test
HP:6000554.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Plasmodium falciparum (a type of Malaria parasite) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000554.name_cn: 血液中恶性疟原虫核酸病原体检测阳性
HP:6000554.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链式反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中的恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）核酸。

HP:6000555.name: Decreased erythrocyte fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase activity
HP:6000555.definition: Activity or concentration of fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase (EC 4.1.2.13) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000555.name_cn: 红细胞果糖-1,6-二磷酸醛缩酶活性降低
HP:6000555.definition_cn: 红细胞中果糖-1,6-二磷酸醛缩酶（EC 4.1.2.13）活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000556.name: Reduced circulating dopamine beta-hydroxylase activity
HP:6000556.definition: Concentration of Dopamine beta-hydroxylase (DBH; EC 1.14.17.1) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. DBH catalyzes the oxidative hydroxylation of dopamine to norepinephrine.
HP:6000556.name_cn: 循环多巴胺β-羟化酶活性降低
HP:6000556.definition_cn: 循环血液中多巴胺β-羟化酶（Dopamine beta-hydroxylase, DBH; EC 1.14.17.1）浓度低于正常值下限。DBH催化多巴胺氧化羟化为去甲肾上腺素。

HP:6000557.name: Reduced erythrocyte bisphosphoglycerate mutase activity
HP:6000557.definition: Activity or concentration of bisphosphoglycerate mutase (BPGM; EC 5.4.2.4;) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. BPGM is a multifunctional enzyme specifically found in red blood cells that synthesizes 2,3-diphosphoglycerate through its synthase activity and degrades it through its phosphatase activity.
HP:6000557.name_cn: 红细胞二磷酸甘油酸变位酶活性降低
HP:6000557.definition_cn: 红细胞中二磷酸甘油酸变位酶（BPGM；EC 5.4.2.4）活性或浓度低于正常下限。BPGM是一种多功能酶，特异性地存在于红细胞中，通过其合酶活性合成2,3-二磷酸甘油酸，并通过其磷酸酶活性降解2,3-二磷酸甘油酸。

HP:6000558.name: Reduced erythrocyte adenylate kinase activity
HP:6000558.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of adenylate kinase (EC 2.7.4.3) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal. Adenylate kinase is a ubiquitous monomeric enzyme that catalyzes the reversible conversion of MgATP plus AMP to MgADP plus ADP and contributes to homeostasis of the adenine nucleotide composition in the cell.
HP:6000558.name_cn: 红细胞腺苷酸激酶活性降低
HP:6000558.definition_cn: 红细胞中腺苷酸激酶（EC 2.7.4.3）活性或浓度低于正常下限。腺苷酸激酶是一种普遍存在的单体酶，催化MgATP与AMP可逆转化为MgADP与ADP，并参与维持细胞内腺苷酸核苷的稳态。

HP:6000559.name: Reduced erythrocyte hexokinase activity
HP:6000559.definition: Activity or concentration of hexokinase (EC 2.7.1.1) in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Arginase catalyzes the last step of the urea cycle.
HP:6000559.name_cn: 红细胞己糖激酶活性降低
HP:6000559.definition_cn: 红细胞中己糖激酶（EC 2.7.1.1）活性或浓度低于正常下限。精氨酸酶催化尿素循环的最后一步。

HP:6000560.name: Decreased circulating carboxypeptidase N activity
HP:6000560.definition: Activity of the enzyme Carboxypeptidase N (arginine carboxypeptidase, EC 3.4.17.3) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000560.definition_cn: 血液循环中羧肽酶N（精氨酸羧肽酶，EC 3.4.17.3）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000561.name: Elevated red cell pyruvate kinase activity
HP:6000561.definition: Activity or concentration of pyruvate kinase (EC 2.7.1.40) in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal. Pyruvate kinase (EC 2.7.1.40) is a glycolytic enzyme that catalyzes the transphosphorylation from phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) to ADP, yielding pyruvate and ATP.
HP:6000561.name_cn: 红细胞丙酮酸激酶活性升高
HP:6000561.definition_cn: 红细胞中丙酮酸激酶（EC 2.7.1.40）活性或浓度高于正常上限。丙酮酸激酶（EC 2.7.1.40）是一种糖酵解酶，催化磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸（PEP）向ADP的转磷酸化反应，生成丙酮酸和ATP。

HP:6000562.name: Reduced circulating adenosine deaminase-2 activity
HP:6000562.definition: Concentration of adenosine deaminase 2 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000562.name_cn: 循环腺苷脱氨酶-2活性降低
HP:6000562.definition_cn: 循环血液中腺苷脱氨酶2浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000563.name: Reduced sepiapterin reductase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000563.definition: Activity of sepiapterin reductase (7,8-dihydrobiopterin:NADP+ oxidoreductase; EC 1.1.1.153) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000563.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中墨蝶呤还原酶活性降低
HP:6000563.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中，七蝶呤还原酶（7,8-二氢生物蝶呤：NADP+氧化还原酶；EC 1.1.1.153）活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000564.name: Elevated circulating vasoactive intestinal peptide concentration
HP:6000564.definition: The concentration of vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000564.name_cn: 循环血管活性肠肽浓度升高
HP:6000564.definition_cn: 血液循环中血管活性肠肽（VIP）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000565.name: Elevated circulating cholesterol sulfate concentration
HP:6000565.definition: The concentration of cholesterol sulfate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000565.name_cn: 循环胆固醇硫酸盐浓度升高
HP:6000565.definition_cn: 血液循环中硫酸胆固醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000566.name: Elevated circulating lipoprotein X concentration
HP:6000566.definition: The concentration of lipoprotein X in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000566.definition_cn: 血液循环中脂蛋白X的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000567.name: Elevated circulating oxalate concentration
HP:6000567.definition: The concentration of oxalate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000567.definition_cn: 血液循环中草酸盐浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000568.name: Elevated blood ethylene glycol concentration
HP:6000568.definition: The concentration of ethylene glycol in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.
HP:6000568.definition_cn: 血液中乙二醇浓度高于总浓度指导值的上限，提示可能存在有害效应。

HP:6000569.name: Midline notching of lower lip
HP:6000569.definition: Exaggerated indentation at the very middle (midline) of the lower lip.
HP:6000569.definition_cn: 下唇正中线处过度凹陷。

HP:6000570.name: Reduced tissue thymidine phosphorylase activity
HP:6000570.definition: Activity of thymidine phosphorylase (EC 2.4.2.4) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes.
HP:6000570.name_cn: 组织胸苷磷酸化酶活性降低
HP:6000570.definition_cn: 胸苷磷酸化酶（EC 2.4.2.4）在以下组织中的活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括白细胞。

HP:6000571.name: Reduced tissue tripeptidyl peptidase 1 activity
HP:6000571.definition: Activity of tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1;EC 3.4.14.9) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. TTP1 activity can be measured in tissues including fibroblasts and leukocytes muscle.
HP:6000571.name_cn: 组织三肽基肽酶1活性降低
HP:6000571.definition_cn: 三肽基肽酶1（TPP1；EC 3.4.14.9）在组织中的活性低于正常下限。TPP1活性可在包括成纤维细胞、白细胞和肌肉在内的组织中测定。

HP:6000572.name: Reduced tissue arginine:glycine amidinotransferase activity
HP:6000572.definition: Activity of L-arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (GATM; EC 2.1.4.1) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. GATM activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000572.name_cn: 组织精氨酸:甘氨酸脒基转移酶活性降低
HP:6000572.definition_cn: L-精氨酸:甘氨酸脒基转移酶（GATM；EC 2.1.4.1）在以下组织中的活性低于正常下限。GATM活性可在多种组织中测量，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000573.name: Reduced tissue aspartylglucosaminidase activity
HP:6000573.definition: Activity of aspartylglucosaminidase (AGA; EC 3.5.1.26) in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. AGA activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000573.name_cn: 组织天冬氨酰葡萄糖胺酶活性降低
HP:6000573.definition_cn: 天冬氨酰葡萄糖胺酶（Aspartylglucosaminidase, AGA; EC 3.5.1.26）在组织中的活性低于正常下限。AGA活性可在多种组织中测定，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000574.name: Reduced tissue carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase activity
HP:6000574.definition: Activity of carnitine-acylcarnitine translocase (CACT) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. CACT activity can be measured in multiple tissues.
HP:6000574.name_cn: 组织肉碱-酰基肉碱转位酶活性降低
HP:6000574.definition_cn: 组织中肉碱-酰基肉碱转位酶（Carnitine-Acylcarnitine Translocase, CACT）活性低于正常下限。CACT活性可在多种组织中测定。

HP:6000575.name: Reduced circulating 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase activity
HP:6000575.definition: The activity of 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000575.name_cn: 循环中6-丙酮酰四氢蝶呤合酶活性降低
HP:6000575.definition_cn: 血液循环中6-丙酮酰四氢蝶呤合成酶的活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000576.name: Reduced tissue mannosyl-oligosaccharide glucosidase activity
HP:6000576.definition: Activity of mannosyl-oligosaccharide glucosidase (MOGS) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. MOGS activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000576.name_cn: 组织甘露糖基寡糖葡萄糖苷酶活性降低
HP:6000576.definition_cn: 组织中的甘露糖基寡糖葡萄糖苷酶（Mannosyl-oligosaccharide Glucosidase, MOGS）活性低于正常下限。MOGS活性可在多种组织中测定，包括肝脏和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000577.name: Reduced tissue 3-methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
HP:6000577.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme 3-methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase (EC 4.2.1.18) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts.
HP:6000577.name_cn: 组织3-甲基戊烯二酰辅酶A水合酶活性降低
HP:6000577.definition_cn: 线粒体酶3-甲基戊烯二酰辅酶A水合酶（EC 4.2.1.18）在组织中的活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000578.name: Reduced tissue gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
HP:6000578.definition: Activity of gamma-glutamyltransferase in the tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000578.name_cn: 组织γ-谷氨酰转移酶活性降低
HP:6000578.definition_cn: γ-谷氨酰转移酶在组织中的活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000579.name: Positive oropharangeal infectious agent test
HP:6000579.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the oropharynx positive. The oropharynx is defined as the middle part of the throat and includes the soft palate, the side and back walls of the throat, the tonsils, and the posterior one-third of the tongue.
HP:6000579.name_cn: 口咽部病原体检测阳性
HP:6000579.definition_cn: 口咽部任何类型的病原体检测呈阳性。口咽部定义为咽喉的中部，包括软腭、咽喉的侧壁和后壁、扁桃体以及舌的后三分之一。

HP:6000580.name: Positive oropharynx poliovirus nucleic acid test
HP:6000580.definition: Detection of poliovirus nucleic acid in the oropharynx by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000580.name_cn: 口咽部脊髓灰质炎病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000580.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测口咽部脊髓灰质炎病毒核酸。

HP:6000581.name: Positive synonvial fluid infectious agent test
HP:6000581.definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the synovial fluid (i.e., in a joint) positive.
HP:6000581.name_cn: 滑膜液病原体检测阳性
HP:6000581.definition_cn: 任何类型的滑液（即关节内）感染性病原体检测呈阳性。

HP:6000582.name: Positive synonvial fluid culture
HP:6000582.definition: Growth of an infectious agent in a culture derived from synovial fluid.
HP:6000582.definition_cn: 源自滑液的培养物中病原体的生长。

HP:6000583.name: Positive synovial fluid gram stain
HP:6000583.definition: Demonstration of the presence of bacteria by gram staining of joint (synovial) fluid. The sample is generally obtained by arthrocentesis.
HP:6000583.definition_cn: 通过关节（滑膜）液的革兰氏染色法证实细菌的存在。样本通常通过关节穿刺术获取。

HP:6000584.name: Anti Parvovirus antibody positivity
HP:6000584.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of parvovirus.
HP:6000584.definition_cn: 血液中存在针对细小病毒组分的抗体。

HP:6000585.name: Brain parenchymal tuberculoma
HP:6000585.definition: Tuberculoma results from hematogenous spread of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M. tb) from an extracranial source. Diagnosis is based on computed tomography (CT) scan and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies with a similar ring-enhancing lesion.
HP:6000585.definition_cn: 结核瘤是由颅外来源的结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis, M. tb）经血行播散所致。诊断主要依据计算机断层扫描（CT）和磁共振成像（MRI）检查，显示为类似的环形强化病灶。

HP:6000586.name: Muscle arteriovenous malformation
HP:6000586.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in muscle tissue.
HP:6000586.definition_cn: 一种异常的血管构型，使动脉血直接分流至静脉，而不经过毛细血管，且位于肌肉组织中。

HP:6000587.name: Bone arteriovenous malformation
HP:6000587.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in a bone.
HP:6000587.definition_cn: 一种异常的血管构型，使动脉血直接分流至静脉而不经过毛细血管，且位于骨内。

HP:6000588.name: Periosteal elevation
HP:6000588.definition: Lifting or separation of the periosteum from the outer surface of a bone. Periosteal elevation is usually seen in benign process, frequently in cranioencephalic traumas. There is an elevation of the periosteum after blood, like in cephalohematomas.
HP:6000588.definition_cn: 骨膜从骨外表面的抬起或分离。骨膜抬高通常见于良性病变，常见于颅脑外伤。在血液积聚后，如头血肿，会出现骨膜抬高。

HP:6000589.name: Esophageal dilation
HP:6000589.definition: Widening (relatively uniform increase in diameter) of a segment of the esophagus.
HP:6000589.definition_cn: 食管节段性扩张（相对均匀的直径增加）。

HP:6000590.name: Spinal lipoma
HP:6000590.definition: A lipoma that is localized to the spine.

HP:6000591.name: Loose body in joint
HP:6000591.definition: Small fragments of articular cartilage that break off in a joint as a result of a injury, degeneration, or other processes.
HP:6000591.definition_cn: 关节软骨碎片因损伤、退行性变或其他病理过程而脱落在关节内。

HP:6000592.name: Paraspinal arteriovenous malformation
HP:6000592.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in adjacent to the spine, i.e., in a location that is normally occupied by muscles, ligaments, nerves, and other tissues that run alongside the spinal column.
HP:6000592.definition_cn: 一种异常的血管构型，其将动脉血直接分流至静脉，而不经过毛细血管，且位于脊柱邻近区域，即通常由肌肉、韧带、神经及其他沿脊柱走行的组织所占据的位置。

HP:6000593.name: Supernumerary tarsal bone
HP:6000593.definition: The presence of an additional tarsal bone that is not one of the canonical tarsal bones (cuboid, medial, intermediate, and lateral cuneiform, navicular, talus, calcaneus).
HP:6000593.definition_cn: 存在一个额外的跗骨，该跗骨不属于典型的跗骨（骰骨、内侧楔骨、中间楔骨、外侧楔骨、舟骨、距骨、跟骨）。

HP:6000594.name: Maxillary cyst
HP:6000594.definition: A closed sac that has developed in the upper jaw bone (maxilla) and contains fluid or semi-solid material. Cystic lesions of the maxilla are benign entities with both odontogenic and non-odontogenic origins.
HP:6000594.definition_cn: 上颌骨（maxilla）内形成的封闭囊性结构，内含液体或半固体物质。上颌骨囊性病变（Cystic lesions of the maxilla）为良性病变，其起源可分为牙源性（odontogenic）和非牙源性（non-odontogenic）。

HP:6000595.name: Mandibular cyst
HP:6000595.definition: A closed sac that has developed in the lower jaw bone (mandibula) and contains fluid or semi-solid material.
HP:6000595.definition_cn: 下颌骨（mandible）内形成的封闭囊性结构，内含液体或半固体物质。

HP:6000596.name: Sixth cranial nerve hypoplasia
HP:6000596.definition: Underdevelopment of the six cranial nerve (abducens nerve).
HP:6000596.definition_cn: 第六对脑神经（外展神经）发育不全。

HP:6000597.name: Third cranial nerve hypoplasia
HP:6000597.definition: Underdevelopment of the third cranial nerve (oculomotor nerve).
HP:6000597.definition_cn: 第三脑神经（动眼神经）发育不全。

HP:6000598.name: Elevated urinary succinylacetone level
HP:6000598.definition: Presence in the urine of succinylacetone, which is one of the toic block metabolites formed in tyrosinaemia type 1 because of a defect in the final enzyme of the pathway of the degradation of tyrosine, namely fumarylacetoacetase (FAH, EC 3.7.1.2).
HP:6000598.name_cn: 尿液中琥珀酰丙酮水平升高
HP:6000598.definition_cn: 尿液中存在琥珀酰丙酮，这是由于酪氨酸降解途径的最终酶——延胡索酰乙酰乙酸酶（FAH，EC 3.7.1.2）缺陷，导致1型酪氨酸血症中形成的毒性代谢产物之一。

HP:6000599.name: Elevated urinary 2-oxoisocaproic level
HP:6000599.definition: The amount of 2-oxoisocaproic in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000599.name_cn: 尿中2-氧代异己酸水平升高
HP:6000599.definition_cn: 尿液中2-氧代异己酸的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000600.name: Elevated urinary 2-oxovaleric acid level
HP:6000600.definition: The amount of 2-oxovaleric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000600.name_cn: 尿中2-氧代戊酸水平升高
HP:6000600.definition_cn: 尿液中2-氧代戊酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限值。

HP:6000601.name: Elevated urinary 2-hydroxyisocaproic acid level
HP:6000601.definition: The amount of 2-hydroxyisocaproic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000601.name_cn: 尿中2-羟基异己酸水平升高
HP:6000601.definition_cn: 尿液中2-羟基异己酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000602.name: Elevated urinary isovalerylglycine level
HP:6000602.definition: The amount of isovalerylglycine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000602.name_cn: 尿异戊酰甘氨酸水平升高
HP:6000602.definition_cn: 尿液中异戊酰甘氨酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000603.name: Elevated urinary 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyric acid level
HP:6000603.definition: The amount of 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000603.name_cn: 尿液中2-甲基-3-羟基丁酸水平升高
HP:6000603.definition_cn: 尿液中2-甲基-3-羟基丁酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000604.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxypentanoic acid level
HP:6000604.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxypentanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000604.name_cn: 尿中3-羟基戊酸水平升高
HP:6000604.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基戊酸的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000605.name: Elevated urinary 7-hydroxyoctanoic acid level
HP:6000605.definition: The amount of 7-hydroxyoctanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000605.name_cn: 尿中7-羟基辛酸水平升高
HP:6000605.definition_cn: 尿液中7-羟基辛酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000606.name: Elevated urinary D-glyceric acid level
HP:6000606.definition: The amount of D-glyceric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000606.name_cn: 尿液中D-甘油酸水平升高
HP:6000606.definition_cn: 尿液中D-甘油酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000607.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxyisobutyric acid level
HP:6000607.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxyisobutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000607.name_cn: 尿中3-羟基异丁酸水平升高
HP:6000607.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基异丁酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000608.name: Elevated urinary 3,4-Dihydroxybutyric acid level
HP:6000608.definition: The amount of 3,4-Dihydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000608.name_cn: 尿中3,4-二羟基丁酸水平升高
HP:6000608.definition_cn: 尿液中3,4-二羟基丁酸（3,4-Dihydroxybutyric acid）的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000609.name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxyadipic acid level
HP:6000609.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxyadipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000609.name_cn: 尿中3-羟基己二酸水平升高
HP:6000609.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基己二酸浓度经尿浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000610.name: Elevated erythrocyte galactose-1-phosphate concentration
HP:6000610.definition: Concentration of galactose-1-phosphate in red blood cells (erythrocytes) above the upper level of normal.
HP:6000610.name_cn: 红细胞半乳糖-1-磷酸浓度升高
HP:6000610.definition_cn: 红细胞（红细胞）中半乳糖-1-磷酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000611.name: Elevated circulating chitotriosidase activity
HP:6000611.definition: Increased activity or concentration of the enzyme chitotriosidase. Serum chitotriosidase is a biomarker that has shown high specificity and sensitivity in patients with sarcoidosis.
HP:6000611.name_cn: 循环中壳三糖苷酶活性升高
HP:6000611.definition_cn: 壳三糖苷酶活性或浓度增加。血清壳三糖苷酶是一种生物标志物，在结节病患者中显示出高特异性和敏感性。

HP:6000612.name: Squamosal suture synostosis
HP:6000612.definition: Premature closure of the squamosal suture, which is one of the lateral minor skull sutures, separating the parietal and squamous temporal bones.
HP:6000612.definition_cn: 鳞状缝早闭，鳞状缝为颅骨外侧次要骨缝之一，分隔顶骨与颞骨鳞部。

HP:6000613.name: Enlarged fetal lungs
HP:6000613.definition: The size (volume) of the lungs of a fetus above the upper limit of normal for the gestational age.
HP:6000613.definition_cn: 胎儿肺体积超过该孕周正常范围上限。

HP:6000614.name: Orbital inflammation
HP:6000614.definition: An inflammatory condition localized to the orbit, presenting capillary dilatation, leukocytic infiltration, redness, heat, and pain. CT or MIR Imaging demonstrates enlargement of the muscle belly of one (or more) extraocular muscles typically with the involvement of tendinous insertions. Inflammation can also be observed in surrounding tissues, including the orbital fat, lacrimal gland, and optic nerve sheath.
HP:6000614.definition_cn: 一种局限于眼眶的炎症性疾病，表现为毛细血管扩张、白细胞浸润、红肿、发热和疼痛。CT或MRI影像显示一条（或多条）眼外肌肌腹增大，通常伴有肌腱附着点受累。炎症也可在周围组织中观察到，包括眶脂肪、泪腺和视神经鞘。

HP:6000615.name: Reduced Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000615.definition: Concentration or activity of inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase OCRL-1 as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme has phosphoinositide 5-phosphatase (EC 3.1.3.36) activity.
HP:6000615.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中肌醇多磷酸5-磷酸酶OCRL-1活性降低
HP:6000615.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的肌醇多磷酸5-磷酸酶OCRL-1的浓度或活性低于正常范围。该酶具有磷酸肌醇5-磷酸酶（EC 3.1.3.36）活性。

HP:6000616.name: Reduced muscle glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
HP:6000616.definition: Activity of the gycogen debrancher enzyme (GDE) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. GDE is a large monomeric protein with two catalytic activities: amylo-1,6-glucosidase (EC 3.2.1.33) and 4-alpha-glucanotransferase (EC 2.4.1.25).
HP:6000616.name_cn: 肌肉糖原脱支酶活性降低
HP:6000616.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中糖原脱支酶（GDE）活性低于正常下限。GDE是一种具有两种催化活性的大型单体蛋白：淀粉-1,6-葡萄糖苷酶（EC 3.2.1.33）和4-α-葡聚糖转移酶（EC 2.4.1.25）。

HP:6000617.name: Reduced tissue UDP-glucuronyl-transferase activity
HP:6000617.definition: Concentration or activity of uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase below the lower limit of normal. The activity of this enzyme can be measured in liver and rarely in other tissues.
HP:6000617.name_cn: 组织UDP-葡萄糖醛酸转移酶活性降低
HP:6000617.definition_cn: 尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖醛酸转移酶浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶活性可在肝脏中检测，偶见于其他组织。

HP:6000618.name: Temporal artery giant cells
HP:6000618.definition: The presence of giant cells in the temporal artery. This is a feature of giant cell arteritis. Giant cells are multinucleated cells formed by fusion of multiple macrophages and are typically located in the intima of the arterial wall. This feature is typically demonstrated by temporal artery biopsy but other arteries may also be affected.
HP:6000618.definition_cn: 颞动脉中存在巨细胞。这是巨细胞性动脉炎的一个特征。巨细胞是由多个巨噬细胞融合形成的多核细胞，通常位于动脉壁的内膜层。这一特征通常通过颞动脉活检来证实，但其他动脉也可能受累。

HP:6000619.name: Reduced phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000619.definition: Activity of phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (EC 4.1.1.32) is below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000619.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸羧激酶活性降低
HP:6000619.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸羧激酶（EC 4.1.1.32）活性低于正常下限。

HP:6000620.name: Elevated urinary pyrroline hydroxycarboxylic acid level
HP:6000620.definition: The amount of pyrroline hydroxycarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000620.name_cn: 尿中吡咯啉羟羧酸水平升高
HP:6000620.definition_cn: 尿液中吡咯啉羟羧酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000621.name: Elevated urinary N-tau-ribosylhistidine level
HP:6000621.definition: Presence of N tau-ribosylhistidine (His-R) in the urine. His-R is a histidine derivative found in the urine of histidinemic patients.
HP:6000621.name_cn: 尿N-τ-核糖基组氨酸水平升高
HP:6000621.definition_cn: 尿液中存在N-τ-核糖基组氨酸（His-R）。His-R是一种组氨酸衍生物，常见于组氨酸血症患者的尿液中。

HP:6000622.name: Elevated urinary ureidoisobutyric acid level
HP:6000622.definition: The amount of ureidoisobutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Ureidoisobutyric acid is increased in the urine of patients with beta-ureidopropionase (EC 3.5.1.6) deficiency.
HP:6000622.name_cn: 尿中脲基异丁酸水平升高
HP:6000622.definition_cn: 尿液中脲基异丁酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。β-脲基丙酸酶（EC 3.5.1.6）缺乏症患者尿液中脲基异丁酸水平升高。

HP:6000623.name: Elevated urinary N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid level
HP:6000623.definition: The amount of N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000623.name_cn: 尿中N-氨基甲酰-β-氨基异丁酸水平升高
HP:6000623.definition_cn: 尿液中N-氨甲酰基-β-氨基异丁酸含量，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000624.name: Nipple epidermal Paget cells
HP:6000624.definition: Malignant, intraepithelial adenocarcinoma cells of variable sizes usually large in size, present singly or in the form of small groups within the epidermis of the nipple. Cells may be ovoid, round, or signet-ring forms, usually mucin positive, and the cytoplasm may contain periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, diastase-resistant granules, indicating the presence of neutral mucopolysaccharides. The cells possess microscopic features of glandular cells with pale to clear vacuolated cytoplasm, and nuclei are usually high-grade with prominent nucleoli.
HP:6000624.definition_cn: 恶性、上皮内腺癌细胞大小不一，通常较大，单个或小群存在于乳头表皮内。细胞可呈卵圆形、圆形或印戒状，通常黏液染色阳性，胞质内可含有过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性、淀粉酶抵抗的颗粒，提示存在中性黏多糖。细胞具有腺细胞的显微特征，胞质苍白至透明且呈空泡状，核通常为高级别，核仁明显。

HP:6000625.name: Penile corporal blood gas ischemia
HP:6000625.definition: Partial pressure of oxygen (pO2) in cavernous blood of the penis is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000625.definition_cn: 阴茎海绵体血氧分压（pO2）低于正常下限。

HP:6000626.name: Recent temporal region trauma
HP:6000626.definition: A history of an injury to the temporal region of the skull that occurred recently (several hours, days, or weeks before the current presenting complaint).
HP:6000626.definition_cn: 近期颞骨区域外伤史（发生于当前主诉前数小时、数天或数周内）。

HP:6000627.name: Rest limb pain
HP:6000627.definition: Rest pain is a continuous unrelenting pain due to ischemia of the lower leg, beginning with or being aggravated by elevation and being relieved by sitting with legs in a dependent position or by standing.
HP:6000627.definition_cn: 静息痛是由于下肢缺血引起的持续性剧烈疼痛，通常在抬高下肢时开始或加重，而在下肢下垂坐位或站立时缓解。

HP:6000628.name: Scalloped appearance of liver surface
HP:6000628.definition: A lesion associated with pseudomyxoma peritonei whosetypical CT appearance is scalloping of the surface of the liver and spleen caused by loculated accumulations of mucin, which distinguishes mucin from fluid ascites. The mucinous material is similar in density to water. There are also islands of higher attenuation due to scattered solid elements and calcification within mucinous material.
HP:6000628.definition_cn: 与腹膜假性黏液瘤相关的病变，其典型的CT表现为由局限性黏液积聚引起的肝脏和脾脏表面扇贝样改变，这可将黏液与腹水区分开来。黏液物质的密度与水相似。由于黏液物质中散布的固体成分和钙化，还存在高密度区域。

HP:6000629.name: Nipple thickening
HP:6000629.definition: Thickening of the skin around the nipple.

HP:6000630.name: Hypoechoic breast mass
HP:6000630.definition: A breast mass visualized by sonography that displays a lower than normal echo signal (and this that appears dark gray in the typical ultrasound image).
HP:6000630.definition_cn: 超声检查中显示的乳腺肿块，其回声信号低于正常水平（在典型的超声图像中呈现深灰色）。

HP:6000631.name: Unilocular ovarian cyst
HP:6000631.definition: An ovarian cyst without septa and a solid component.
HP:6000631.definition_cn: 无分隔及实性成分的卵巢囊肿。

HP:6000632.name: Mesenteric torsion
HP:6000632.definition: Mesenteric torsion is a pathological rotation of the intestinal tract around the axis of the mesenteric root, resulting in rapid occlusion of the cranial mesenteric artery.
HP:6000632.definition_cn: 肠系膜扭转是一种病理性的肠道围绕肠系膜根部轴线的旋转，导致颅侧肠系膜动脉迅速闭塞。

HP:6000633.name: High-pitched bowel sounds
HP:6000633.definition: Abnormal bowel sounds of an unually high frequency.

HP:6000634.name: Exacerbated by opiate medication
HP:6000634.definition: Applied to a sign orr symptom that is worsed by administration of opiate medications.
HP:6000634.definition_cn: 阿片类药物应用后加重的体征或症状。

HP:6000635.name: Breast granuloma
HP:6000635.definition: Formation of a non-necrotizing granuloma in breat tissue typically in combination with a localized infiltrate of multi-nucleated giant cells, epithelioid histiocytes, lymphocytes, and plasma cells.
HP:6000635.definition_cn: 乳腺组织中非坏死性肉芽肿的形成，通常伴随多核巨细胞、上皮样组织细胞、淋巴细胞和浆细胞的局部浸润。

HP:6000636.name: Exposure to cosmetic fragrances
HP:6000636.definition: A history of exposure to fragrances found in cosmetic products.
HP:6000636.definition_cn: 化妆品中香料成分接触史。

HP:6000637.name: Sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication
HP:6000637.definition: Sweating and flushing in the preauricular area in response to mastication or a salivary stimulus. Facial warmth, flushing, and sweating in the territory of the auriculotemporal nerve overlying the parotid gland, which may include the preauricular skin, the temporal skin, the scalp, and the temporomandibular joint region. Symptoms occur during meals, especially with spicy and sour foods. This feature is inferred to be a consequence of injury to the auriculotemporal nerve, a branch if the trigeminal nerve.
HP:6000637.name_cn: 咀嚼时耳前区出现出汗和潮红
HP:6000637.definition_cn: 咀嚼或唾液刺激引起的耳前区出汗和潮红。位于腮腺上方的耳颞神经支配区域出现面部温热、潮红和出汗，可能包括耳前皮肤、颞部皮肤、头皮和颞下颌关节区域。症状在进餐时出现，尤其是食用辛辣和酸性食物时。该特征被推断为三叉神经分支耳颞神经损伤的后果。

HP:6000638.name: Reduced hepatic glyoxylate reductase activity
HP:6000638.definition: Activity of glyoxylate reductase/hydroxypyruvate reductase (GRHPR; EC 1.1.1.79) in liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000638.name_cn: 肝乙醛酸还原酶活性降低
HP:6000638.definition_cn: 肝脏中乙醛酸还原酶/羟基丙酮酸还原酶（GRHPR；EC 1.1.1.79）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000639.name: PAS-positive lymphocyte vacuolization
HP:6000639.definition: Presence of lymphocytes with positive staining for periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) cytoplasmic vacuoles.
HP:6000639.definition_cn: 存在周期性酸-希夫（PAS）染色阳性的淋巴细胞胞质空泡。

HP:6000640.name: Lipid-laden bone-marrow macrophages
HP:6000640.definition: Bone marrow with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids.
HP:6000640.name_cn: 脂质负载骨髓巨噬细胞
HP:6000640.definition_cn: 骨髓中巨噬细胞数量增多，且巨噬细胞内大量脂质沉积。

HP:6000641.name: Bone marrow monocytosis
HP:6000641.definition: Increased count of monocytes in the bone marrow.
HP:6000641.definition_cn: 骨髓中单核细胞计数增加。

HP:6000642.name: Sunflower cataract
HP:6000642.definition: Sunflower cataract (SC) is a type of anterior subcapsular cataract almost only seen in Wilson disease, an autosomal-recessive condition with a defect in the metabolism of copper leading to accumulation of copper in the liver and basal ganglia. SC consists of a thin, centralized opacification that is located directly under the anterior capsule and encompasses between one-third and one-half of the anterior lens pole surface area. In all cases, the central opacification is surrounded by additional, secondary opacifications arranged in ray-like structures around it. This pattern is said to resemble a sunflower, with a large central disk surrounded by petals.
HP:6000642.definition_cn: 向日葵样白内障（Sunflower Cataract, SC）是一种几乎仅见于威尔逊病（Wilson Disease）的前囊下白内障类型。威尔逊病是一种常染色体隐性遗传病，由于铜代谢缺陷导致铜在肝脏和基底节中积累。SC表现为位于前囊正下方的薄层中央混浊，覆盖晶状体前极表面积的三分之一至二分之一。在所有病例中，中央混浊周围还伴有呈放射状排列的继发性混浊。这种模式被认为类似于向日葵，即中央大圆盘被花瓣状结构环绕。

HP:6000643.name: Anti-lamin A antibody positivity
HP:6000643.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against lamin A.
HP:6000643.name_cn: 抗核纤层蛋白A抗体阳性
HP:6000643.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对层粘连蛋白A（lamin A）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000644.name: Anti-lamin C antibody positivity
HP:6000644.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against human lamin C.
HP:6000644.name_cn: 抗层粘连蛋白C抗体阳性
HP:6000644.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对人类层粘连蛋白C（Lamin C）的自身抗体。

HP:6000645.name: Anti-vinculin antibody positivity
HP:6000645.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against vinculin.
HP:6000645.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对纽蛋白（vinculin）的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000646.name: Anti-annexin A5 antibody positivity
HP:6000646.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against annexin A5.
HP:6000646.definition_cn: 循环血液中存在针对膜联蛋白A5（Annexin A5）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000647.name: Bulging fontanelle
HP:6000647.definition: An outward curving of a fontanelle, which occurs when fluid builds up in the brain or the brain swells, causing increased pressure inside the skull.
HP:6000647.definition_cn: 囟门膨出，指由于脑内液体积聚或脑组织肿胀导致颅内压增高，进而引起囟门向外凸出的现象。

HP:6000648.name: 3-4 toe cutaneous syndactyly
HP:6000648.definition: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 3 and 4.
HP:6000648.definition_cn: 第三和第四趾之间在前后轴上存在软组织连续性。

HP:6000649.name: Triangular nail
HP:6000649.definition: Nail so wide as long with a distal part presenting an acute angle.
HP:6000649.definition_cn: 指甲宽度与长度相近，远端部分呈现锐角。

HP:6000650.name: Distal tibiofibular synostosis
HP:6000650.definition: Fusion of the distal (i.e.., located away from the trunk) part of the tibia and fibula.
HP:6000650.definition_cn: 胫骨和腓骨远端部分的融合。

HP:6000651.name: Abnormal metacarpal ossification
HP:6000651.definition: Any abnormal process of ossification of the metacarpal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metacarpal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metacarpal I). At the eighth to ninth week of fetal life, ossification commences in the middle of the body. At the third year the distal extremities of the metacarpals of the fingers and the base of the metacarpal of the thumb begin to ossify; they unite with the bodies at about the twentieth year.
HP:6000651.definition_cn: 掌骨骨化的任何异常过程，通常每块掌骨由两个骨化中心进行骨化：一个位于骨干，另一个位于头部（第二、第三、第四和第五掌骨）或基底部（第一掌骨）。在胎儿发育的第八至第九周，骨化过程在骨干中部开始。在第三年时，手指掌骨的远端和拇指掌骨的基底部开始骨化；这些部分大约在第二十年时与骨干融合。

HP:6000652.name: Rib spur
HP:6000652.definition: A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from a rib.
HP:6000652.definition_cn: 源自肋骨的骨性突起（骨刺，骨赘）。

HP:6000653.name: Crescent-shaped iliac bone
HP:6000653.definition: Deficient mineralization of the iliac wings, giving a paraglider/crescent shape to the iliac bone.
HP:6000653.definition_cn: 髂骨翼矿化不足，导致髂骨呈现滑翔翼/新月形形态。

HP:6000654.name: Abnormal ischium ossification
HP:6000654.definition: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of ischial bones.

HP:6000655.name: Femoral neck fracture
HP:6000655.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the neck of femur.
HP:6000655.definition_cn: 股骨颈部分或完全骨折。

HP:6000656.name: Papillary dermis eosinophilic hyaline material
HP:6000656.definition: Accumulation of eosinophilic hyaline material observed around the papillary dermis and the blood vessels located in it. The papillary dermis is the uppermost layer of the dermis. It intertwines with the rete ridges of the epidermis and is composed of fine and loosely arranged collagen fibers.
HP:6000656.name_cn: 乳头状真皮层嗜酸性透明物质
HP:6000656.definition_cn: 在乳头层真皮及其周围血管中观察到嗜酸性透明物质沉积。乳头层真皮是真皮的最上层，与表皮的网状嵴交织，由细而疏松排列的胶原纤维组成。

HP:6000657.name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
HP:6000657.definition: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) is an exocrine neoplasm of the pancreas consisting of epithelial cells growing within the pancreatic ducts (main pancreatic duct or its major branches) and producing mucin. IPMN is a mucin-producing pancreatic cystic tumor. IPMN contains epithelial cells that can create papillary projections.
HP:6000657.name_cn: 胰腺导管内乳头状黏液性肿瘤
HP:6000657.definition_cn: 导管内乳头状黏液性肿瘤（Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm, IPMN）是一种胰腺外分泌性肿瘤，由生长在胰管（主胰管或其主要分支）内的上皮细胞组成，并产生黏液。IPMN是一种产生黏液的胰腺囊性肿瘤。IPMN包含可形成乳头状突起的上皮细胞。

HP:6000658.name: Medium vessel vasculitis
HP:6000658.definition: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects medium-sized blood vessels. By common usage, vasculitis predominantly refers to arterial disease. Medium-sized vasculitis is observed in diseases including polyarteritis nodosa, Kawasaki disease, and cutaneous polyarteritis nodosa.
HP:6000658.definition_cn: 一种影响中等大小血管的血管炎（血管壁炎症）。根据普遍用法，血管炎主要指动脉疾病。中等大小血管炎可见于结节性多动脉炎、川崎病和皮肤结节性多动脉炎等疾病。

HP:6000659.name: Elevated muscle fiber laminin alpha 5 expression
HP:6000659.definition: A decreased amount of laminin alpha-5 in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue. Laminin subunit alpha-5 is a protein encoded by the LAMA5 gene.
HP:6000659.name_cn: 肌纤维层粘连蛋白α5表达升高
HP:6000659.definition_cn: 肌肉组织中层粘连蛋白α-5含量减少。该特征可通过肌肉组织的免疫组织化学或蛋白质印迹法显示。层粘连蛋白α-5亚基是由LAMA5基因编码的蛋白质。

HP:6000660.name: Paravertebral mass
HP:6000660.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized next to the vertebral column. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6000660.definition_cn: 脊柱旁局部肿胀或增大。在诊断工作初期，当肿胀的确切性质尚未确定时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:6000661.name: Phlebolith
HP:6000661.definition: A calcified structure that forms within a vein. The pathogenesis of phleboliths is thought to involve an organized thrombus produced when the peripheral blood flow slows. The thrombus calcifies, form- ing the core of the phlebolith. Then, the fibrinous com- ponent undergoes secondary calcification and becomes attached. Repetition of this process causes enlargement of the phlebolith.
HP:6000661.definition_cn: 静脉内形成的钙化结构。静脉石的形成机制被认为与周围血流减慢时产生的机化血栓有关。血栓钙化后形成静脉石的核心。随后，纤维蛋白成分发生继发性钙化并附着。此过程的重复导致静脉石增大。

HP:6000662.name: Bladder rupture
HP:6000662.definition: A perforation in the wall of the urinary bladder. Bladder rupture, a relatively rare condition, is most commonly due to abdominal or pelvic trauma but may be spontaneous or iatrogenic in association with surgical or endoscopic procedures. In most cases, patients with bladder rupture have gross hematuria. Other symptoms of bladder rupture include pelvic pain, lower abdominal pain, and difficulty voiding.
HP:6000662.definition_cn: 膀胱壁穿孔。膀胱破裂是一种相对罕见的病症，最常见于腹部或骨盆创伤，但也可能自发发生或与外科手术或内窥镜操作相关的医源性损伤。在大多数情况下，膀胱破裂患者会出现肉眼血尿。膀胱破裂的其他症状包括骨盆疼痛、下腹部疼痛和排尿困难。

HP:6000663.name: Elevated myocardial iron load
HP:6000663.definition: Increased amount of iron in myocardial tissue.

HP:6000664.name: Right ventricular regional wall motion abnormality
HP:6000664.definition: The occurrence of abnormal or absent contractility of a region of the heart muscle of the right ventricule. Conventional assessment of RWMA is based on visual interpretation of endocardial excursion and myocardial thickening from the echocardiogram videos.
HP:6000664.name_cn: 右心室区域性室壁运动异常
HP:6000664.definition_cn: 右心室心肌区域收缩异常或缺失的发生。常规的右心室壁运动异常（RWMA）评估基于对超声心动图视频中心内膜偏移和心肌增厚的视觉解读。

HP:6000665.name: Right ventricular regional akinesia
HP:6000665.definition: A region of the right ventricle exhibits absent contraction (akinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle.
HP:6000665.name_cn: 右心室区域性运动不能
HP:6000665.definition_cn: 右心室某一区域与心室其余部分相比，出现收缩缺失（无运动）。

HP:6000666.name: Right ventricular regional dyskinesia
HP:6000666.definition: A region of the right ventricle exhibits abnormal contraction (dyskinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle, leading to outward bulging or ballooning during contraction or inadequate inward movement.
HP:6000666.name_cn: 右心室区域性运动障碍
HP:6000666.definition_cn: 右心室某一区域与心室其他部分相比出现异常收缩（运动障碍），导致在收缩期间向外膨出或呈球囊样扩张，或向内运动不足。

HP:6000667.name: Right ventricular aneurysm
HP:6000667.definition: A localized, abnormal dilation or bulging of a portion of the right ventricular wall.
HP:6000667.definition_cn: 右心室壁局部异常扩张或膨出。

HP:6000668.name: Glomerular immune-complex deposition
HP:6000668.definition: Accumulation of immune deposits, containing immunoglobulins, complement, and other proteins, at various intraglomerular locations. This can lead to glomerulonephritis, with the type of injury that results being dependent on four factors: the mechanism of the deposit formation, the site of deposit formation, the composition of the deposits and the amount of the deposits.
HP:6000668.name_cn: 肾小球免疫复合物沉积
HP:6000668.definition_cn: 免疫沉积物（包含免疫球蛋白、补体及其他蛋白质）在肾小球内不同部位的积聚。此现象可导致肾小球肾炎，其损伤类型取决于四个因素：沉积物形成的机制、沉积物形成的部位、沉积物的组成成分以及沉积物的数量。

HP:6000669.name: Glomerular PLA2R immune-complex deposition
HP:6000669.definition: Accumulation of immune deposits, containing auto-antibodies against the podocyte antigen M-type phospholipase A2 receptor (PLA2R) in intraglomerular locations.
HP:6000669.name_cn: 肾小球PLA2R免疫复合物沉积
HP:6000669.definition_cn: 肾小球内免疫沉积物积聚，包含针对足细胞抗原M型磷脂酶A2受体（PLA2R）的自身抗体。

HP:6000670.name: Elevated urinary L-glycerate level
HP:6000670.definition: The amount of L-glycerate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000670.name_cn: 尿液中L-甘油酸水平升高
HP:6000670.definition_cn: 尿液中L-甘油酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000671.name: Breast myxoma
HP:6000671.definition: A rare, benign mesenchymal tumor of the breast characterized histologically by stellate, round, and spindle-shaped cells with vesicular nuclei and scant cytoplasm that are scattered in the myxoid stroma.
HP:6000671.definition_cn: 一种罕见的乳腺良性间叶性肿瘤，其组织学特征为星形、圆形和梭形细胞，具有泡状核和稀少的细胞质，这些细胞散布在黏液样基质中。

HP:6000672.name: Ovarian cystadenoma
HP:6000672.definition: A common, benign ovarian tumor that carries a good prognosis. The two most frequent types of cystadenomas are serous and mucinous cystadenomas whereas endometrioid and clear cell cystadenomas are rare.
HP:6000672.definition_cn: 一种常见的良性卵巢肿瘤，预后良好。最常见的两种类型是浆液性囊腺瘤和黏液性囊腺瘤，而子宫内膜样囊腺瘤和透明细胞囊腺瘤则较为罕见。

HP:6000673.name: Abnormal CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
HP:6000673.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000673.name_cn: 脑脊液N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度异常
HP:6000673.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度的任何异常。

HP:6000674.name: Decreased CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration
HP:6000674.definition: Concentration of N-acetylaspartic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000674.name_cn: 脑脊液N-乙酰天门冬氨酸浓度降低
HP:6000674.definition_cn: 脑脊液中N-乙酰天冬氨酸浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000675.name: Elevated urinary mevalonate lactone level
HP:6000675.definition: The amount of mevalonate lactone in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000675.name_cn: 尿中甲羟戊酸内酯水平升高
HP:6000675.definition_cn: 尿液中甲羟戊酸内酯含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000676.name: Anti-von Willebrand factor antibody positivity
HP:6000676.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to von Willebrand factor (VWF).
HP:6000676.name_cn: 抗血管性血友病因子抗体阳性
HP:6000676.definition_cn: 血清中存在与血管性血友病因子（VWF）反应的自体抗体。

HP:6000677.name: Elevated natural killer cell count
HP:6000677.definition: The count of natural killer cells per volume of blood is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000677.name_cn: 自然杀伤细胞计数升高
HP:6000677.definition_cn: 外周血自然杀伤细胞计数高于正常值上限。

HP:6000678.name: Myositis-specific autoantibody positivity
HP:6000678.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that display a high degree of specificity for idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (myositis-specific autoantibodies (MSAs)). MSAs are clinically useful biomarkers to help the diagnosis of polymyositis/dermatomyositis (PM/DM). Many of these are also associated with a unique clinical subset of PM/DM, making them useful in predicting and monitoring certain clinical manifestations.
HP:6000678.name_cn: 肌炎特异性自身抗体阳性
HP:6000678.definition_cn: 血清中存在对特发性炎性肌病（肌炎特异性自身抗体（MSAs））具有高度特异性的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。MSAs是临床上用于辅助诊断多发性肌炎/皮肌炎（PM/DM）的生物标志物。其中许多抗体还与PM/DM的特定临床亚型相关，使其在预测和监测某些临床表现方面具有实用价值。

HP:6000679.name: Abnormal serum osmolality
HP:6000679.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the serum osmolality, defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea.
HP:6000679.definition_cn: 任何偏离血清渗透压正常范围的情况，定义为血液中所有溶解颗粒（如钠及其相关阴离子、钾、葡萄糖和尿素）的渗透压总和。

HP:6000680.name: Low serum osmolality
HP:6000680.definition: Serum osmolality, which is defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000680.definition_cn: 血清渗透压，即血液中所有溶解颗粒（如钠及其伴随阴离子、钾、葡萄糖和尿素）的渗透压总和，低于正常值下限。

HP:6000681.name: High serum osmolality
HP:6000681.definition: Serum osmolality, which is defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000681.definition_cn: 血清渗透压，即血液中所有溶解颗粒（如钠及其伴随阴离子、钾、葡萄糖和尿素）的渗透压总和，已超过正常上限。

HP:6000682.name: History of compressive dressings
HP:6000682.definition: A past medical history of having been treated with tight bandages, compression sleeve, tight casts or splints, immobilizers, or similar items such as overly tight clothes, watch bands, or handcuffs.
HP:6000682.definition_cn: 既往有使用过紧绷带、压力袖套、过紧石膏或夹板、固定器，或类似物品如过紧衣物、手表带或手铐的治疗史。

HP:6000683.name: Triggered by overhead motions
