HP:6000683.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is induced by repeatedly performing overhead motions, such as painting a ceiling or working on objects located above the head, or some types of athletics.
HP:6000683.definition_cn: 适用于由反复进行过头顶动作（如粉刷天花板或处理位于头顶上方的物体）或某些类型的体育活动所引发的体征或症状。

HP:6000684.name: Radiating pain
HP:6000684.definition: Pain that is perceived to extend or spread out from one area of the body to another.

HP:6000685.name: Mitral opening snap
HP:6000685.definition: Opening snap is an additional sound heard in the diastole that is related to the opening of a stenotic but mobile mitral valve. It is described as an early diastolic, high-pitched sound, which is associated with opening of the mitral and/or tricuspid valve.
HP:6000685.definition_cn: 开瓣音是一种在舒张期听到的额外心音，与狭窄但活动的二尖瓣的开放有关。它被描述为一种早期舒张期的高频音，与二尖瓣和/或三尖瓣的开放相关。

HP:6000686.name: Mucus in stool
HP:6000686.definition: Abnormally increased amount of mucus in the feces. Mucus is a slippery aqueous secretion produced by mucous membranes including those of the intestines.
HP:6000686.definition_cn: 粪便中黏液异常增多。黏液是由黏膜（包括肠道黏膜）分泌的一种滑润的水样分泌物。

HP:6000687.name: Elevated circulating CCL3 concentration
HP:6000687.definition: The concentration of C-C Motif Ligand 3 (CCL3) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000687.definition_cn: 循环血液中C-C基序配体3（CCL3）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000688.name: Elevated circulating CCL4 concentration
HP:6000688.definition: The concentration of C-C Motif Ligand 4 (CCL4) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000688.definition_cn: 血液循环中C-C基序配体4（CCL4）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000689.name: Elevated CSF 14-3-3 protein concentration
HP:6000689.definition: The concentration of 14-3-3 protein in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000689.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中14-3-3蛋白浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000690.name: Elevated CSF dihydrobiopterin concentration
HP:6000690.definition: Concentration of dihydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000690.name_cn: 脑脊液二氢生物蝶呤浓度升高
HP:6000690.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中二氢生物蝶呤浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000691.name: Left atrial fibrosis
HP:6000691.definition: Atrial fibrosis is an hallmark of atrial structural remodelling, characterized by the aberrant activation, proliferation and differentiation of fibroblasts, and subsequent excessive synthesis and irregular deposition of extracellular matrix proteins.
HP:6000691.definition_cn: 心房纤维化是心房结构重塑的标志，其特征为成纤维细胞的异常激活、增殖和分化，以及随后细胞外基质蛋白的过度合成和不规则沉积。

HP:6000692.name: Abnormal circulating atrial natriuretic peptide pro-hormone concentration
HP:6000692.definition: The concentration in the blood circulation of atrial natriuretic peptide pro-hormone or one of its processed fragments is outside of the range of normal.
HP:6000692.name_cn: 异常循环心房利钠肽前激素浓度
HP:6000692.definition_cn: 循环血液中房钠肽前体激素或其某一加工片段的浓度超出正常范围。

HP:6000693.name: Reduced circulating NT-proANP concentration
HP:6000693.definition: The concentration of NT-proANP in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000693.definition_cn: 循环血液中NT-proANP浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000694.name: Elevated circulating 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid concentration
HP:6000694.definition: The concentration of delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000694.name_cn: 循环中1-吡咯啉-5-羧酸浓度升高
HP:6000694.definition_cn: 血液循环中δ-1-吡咯啉-5-羧酸盐的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000695.name: Reduced tissue delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
HP:6000695.definition: Concentration or activity of delta-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate dehydrogenase (P5CDH; EC 1.5.1.12) below the lower limit of normal. P5CDH can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. P5CDH is a mitochondrial matrix NAD(+)-dependent dehydrogenase which catalyzes the second step of the proline degradation pathway, converting pyrroline-5-carboxylate to glutamate.
HP:6000695.name_cn: 组织δ-1-吡咯啉-5-羧酸脱氢酶活性降低
HP:6000695.definition_cn: δ-1-吡咯啉-5-羧酸脱氢酶（P5CDH；EC 1.5.1.12）的浓度或活性低于正常下限。P5CDH可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。P5CDH是一种线粒体基质NAD(+)依赖性脱氢酶，催化脯氨酸降解途径的第二步，将吡咯啉-5-羧酸转化为谷氨酸。

HP:6000696.name: Elevated circulating N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
HP:6000696.definition: The concentration of N-carbamyl-beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000696.name_cn: 循环中N-氨基甲酰-β-氨基异丁酸浓度升高
HP:6000696.definition_cn: 血液循环中N-氨甲酰-β-氨基异丁酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000697.name: Low tissue ferrochelatase activity
HP:6000697.definition: Concentration or activity of Ferrochelatase (FECH; EC 4.99.1.1) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. FECH is the terminal enzyme of the heme biosynthetic pathway, and catalyzes the insertion of iron into protoporphyrin to form heme.
HP:6000697.name_cn: 低组织亚铁螯合酶活性
HP:6000697.definition_cn: 铁螯合酶（Ferrochelatase，FECH；EC 4.99.1.1）浓度或活性低于正常下限。FECH酶可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。FECH是血红素生物合成途径的终末酶，催化铁插入原卟啉以形成血红素。

HP:6000698.name: Elevated circulating heptacarboxylporphyrin concentration
HP:6000698.definition: The concentration of heptacarboxylporphyrin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000698.name_cn: 循环中七羧基卟啉浓度升高
HP:6000698.definition_cn: 血液循环中七羧基卟啉浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000699.name: Aggravated by menstruation
HP:6000699.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe during mensutruation.
HP:6000699.definition_cn: 经期加重的体征或症状。

HP:6000700.name: Reduced breast milk zinc concentration
HP:6000700.definition: The concentration of zinc in breast milk is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000700.definition_cn: 母乳中锌浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000701.name: Elevated urinary bile acid level
HP:6000701.definition: The amount of bile acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000701.definition_cn: 尿液中胆汁酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000702.name: Elevated urinary glyoxylic acid level
HP:6000702.definition: The amount of glyoxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. The conjugate base of glyoxylic acid is known as glyoxylate.
HP:6000702.definition_cn: 尿液中乙醛酸的含量，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限。乙醛酸的共轭碱称为乙醛酸盐。

HP:6000703.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid concentration
HP:6000703.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000703.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基邻氨基苯甲酸浓度升高
HP:6000703.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基邻氨基苯甲酸的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000704.name: Elevated circulating CXCL9 concentration
HP:6000704.definition: The concentration of chemokine (C-X-C motif) ligand 9 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000704.definition_cn: 血液循环中趋化因子（C-X-C基序）配体9的浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000705.name: Thickened fibular cortex
HP:6000705.definition: Abnormal increase in the thickness (distance between the inner and outer boundaries) of the outer layer (cortex) of the fibula.
HP:6000705.definition_cn: 腓骨外层（皮质）厚度（内外边界之间的距离）异常增加。

HP:6000706.name: New medication added in recent weeks
HP:6000706.definition: Medical history of starting a new medication recently.

HP:6000708.name: Femoral osteosclerosis
HP:6000708.definition: An abnormal increase of bone mineral density of the femur. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.
HP:6000708.definition_cn: 股骨骨矿物质密度异常增高。硬化通常在放射线照片上表现为不透明度增加的区域。

HP:6000709.name: Absent Bell phenomenon
HP:6000709.definition: The Bell phenomenon is the reflex upward movement of the front of the eyeball when the eyelids close (or blink). It protects the eye by helping to keep the cornea moist. This term refers to a lack of this phenomenon, which can be observed with certain conditions such as congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles.
HP:6000709.definition_cn: 贝尔现象是指眼睑闭合（或眨眼）时眼球前部的反射性上移运动。它通过帮助保持角膜湿润来保护眼睛。该术语指的是这种现象的缺失，可在某些情况下观察到，如先天性眼外肌纤维化。

HP:6000710.name: Dalen Fuchs nodules
HP:6000710.definition: Nodules (yellow-white subretinal pigment epithelium lesions) that form between Bruch's membrane and the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP:6000710.definition_cn: 结节（黄白色视网膜色素上皮下病变）形成于布鲁赫膜与视网膜色素上皮之间。

HP:6000711.name: Triggering by ocular trauma
HP:6000711.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by trauma to the eye.
HP:6000711.definition_cn: 适用于由眼部创伤引发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:6000712.name: Gelatinous drop-like dystrophic cornea
HP:6000712.definition: Deposition of amyloid material in the subepithelial space of the cornea.
HP:6000712.name_cn: 胶样滴状角膜营养不良
HP:6000712.definition_cn: 角膜上皮下间隙淀粉样物质沉积。

HP:6000713.name: Hepatic reticuloendothelial system cell iron deposition
HP:6000713.definition: Abnormal accumulation of iron in reticuloendothelial cells of the liver. This feature can be appreciated on liver biopsy by Perls iron stain for granular iron deposition, based on agreement that only discernible hemosiderin granules represent significant iron deposition.
HP:6000713.name_cn: 肝网状内皮系统细胞铁沉积
HP:6000713.definition_cn: 肝脏网状内皮细胞内铁的异常积聚。通过肝脏活检中的Perls铁染色可观察到颗粒状铁沉积，基于共识认为仅可辨别的含铁血黄素颗粒代表显著的铁沉积。

HP:6000714.name: Reduced epidermal kindlin-1 expression
HP:6000714.definition: Lower than normal amount of kindlin-1 in the epidermis.
HP:6000714.definition_cn: 表皮中kindlin-1含量低于正常水平。

HP:6000715.name: Central giant cell lesion of the jaw
HP:6000715.definition: A benign proliferative and asymptomatic intraosseous lesion of the jaw formed by fibrous tissue that contains multiple focus of hemorrhage and an aggregation of multinucleated giant cells.
HP:6000715.name_cn: 颌骨中心性巨细胞病变
HP:6000715.definition_cn: 一种良性的、无症状的颌骨内增生性病变，由纤维组织构成，内含多个出血灶和多核巨细胞聚集。

HP:6000716.name: Terminal hepatic lobular vascular occlusion
HP:6000716.definition: A type of Hepatic venous outflow obstruction characterized by fibrous concentric narrowing of zone 3 terminal hepatic venules, centrilobular hepatocyte necrosis, and sinusoidal congestion, accomapnied by necrosis of pericentral hepatocytes, and narrowing and eventual fibrosis of central veins.
HP:6000716.definition_cn: 一种肝静脉流出道梗阻类型，其特征为第三区终末肝小静脉的纤维性同心性狭窄、小叶中央肝细胞坏死及肝窦充血，伴随中央静脉周围肝细胞坏死，以及中央静脉的狭窄和最终纤维化。

HP:6000717.name: Axonal spheroids
HP:6000717.definition: During neurodegeneration, bubble-like swellings form along the length of the axon, a primary and early effect of dynamic axonal deformation. These varicosities, spheroids, or swellings have been described as beads on a string and branches bearing fruit, and they frequently appear on degenerating axons.
HP:6000717.definition_cn: 在神经退行性变过程中，轴突沿其长度形成泡状肿胀，这是动态轴突变形的主要和早期效应。这些膨大、球状体或肿胀被描述为串珠状或结果的分支，它们经常出现在退化的轴突上。

HP:6000718.name: Decreased liver bile salt export pump expression
HP:6000718.definition: Amount of bile salt export pump (BSEP, coded by the ABCB11 gene) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000718.name_cn: 肝胆汁酸盐输出泵表达降低
HP:6000718.definition_cn: 肝组织中胆汁盐输出泵（BSEP，由ABCB11基因编码）含量低于正常值下限。

HP:6000719.name: Reduced tissue type II iodothyronine deiodinase activity
HP:6000719.definition: Concentration or activity of type II iodothyronine deiodinase below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in tissues such as cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000719.name_cn: 组织型II碘甲状腺原氨酸脱碘酶活性降低
HP:6000719.definition_cn: II型碘化甲状腺氨酸脱碘酶浓度或活性低于正常下限。该活性可在培养的成纤维细胞等组织中测定。

HP:6000720.name: Reduced tissue fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase activity
HP:6000720.definition: Activity of fatty aldehyde dehydrogenase (EC 1.2.1.3) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes.
HP:6000720.name_cn: 组织脂肪醛脱氢酶活性降低
HP:6000720.definition_cn: 组织中脂肪醛脱氢酶（EC 1.2.1.3）活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测定，包括培养的成纤维细胞和白细胞。

HP:6000721.name: Decreased circulating pancreatic isoamylase activity
HP:6000721.definition: The activity of alpha-Amylase (1,4-alpha-D-glucan-4-glucanohydrolase E. C. 3.2.1.1, pancreatic isoamylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000721.name_cn: 循环胰腺异淀粉酶活性降低
HP:6000721.definition_cn: 血液循环中α-淀粉酶（1,4-α-D-葡聚糖-4-葡聚糖水解酶 E.C. 3.2.1.1，胰腺同工酶）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6000722.name: Reduced tissue guanidinoacetate methyltransferase activity
HP:6000722.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme guanidinoacetate methyltransferase in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts.
HP:6000722.name_cn: 组织胍基乙酸甲基转移酶活性降低
HP:6000722.definition_cn: 线粒体酶胍基乙酸甲基转移酶在组织中的活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000723.name: Reduced erythrocyte galactokinase activity
HP:6000723.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of galactokinase (EC 2.7.1.6) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000723.name_cn: 红细胞半乳糖激酶活性降低
HP:6000723.definition_cn: 红细胞中半乳糖激酶（EC 2.7.1.6）活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000724.name: Auspitz sign
HP:6000724.definition: The appearance of small bleeding points after successive layers of scale have been removed from the surface of psoriatic papules or plaques.
HP:6000724.definition_cn: 银屑病丘疹或斑块表面连续鳞屑层剥除后出现的小出血点。

HP:6000725.name: Salty tasting skin
HP:6000725.definition: Skin tastes marked salty without an obvious explanation such as heat or exercise. This finding can be observed in infants with cystic fibrosis.
HP:6000725.definition_cn: 皮肤呈现明显咸味，且无明显诱因如发热或运动。此现象可见于囊性纤维化患儿。

HP:6000726.name: Scalp nodule
HP:6000726.definition: A small firm lump located in the skin of the scalp that is greater than one cm in diameter.
HP:6000726.definition_cn: 位于头皮皮肤内直径大于一厘米的小型硬质肿块。

HP:6000727.name: History of undercooked pork ingestion
HP:6000727.definition: A history of ingestion of undercooked pork. This is particularly relevant in areas with a high prevalence of cysticercosis.
HP:6000727.definition_cn: 食用未煮熟猪肉史。这在囊尾蚴病高发地区尤为重要。

HP:6000728.name: History of recent rodent exposure
HP:6000728.definition: A history of exposed to rodents (mice, rats, prarie dogs) within several weeks of the current presenting complaint.
HP:6000728.definition_cn: 当前主诉前数周内有啮齿动物（小鼠、大鼠、草原犬鼠）接触史。

HP:6000729.name: Positive CSF fungus test
HP:6000729.definition: Any kind of test for a fungal infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) positive.
HP:6000729.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中真菌感染病原体的任何检测结果呈阳性。

HP:6000730.name: Positive CSF human T-lymphotropic virus type I antibody positivity
HP:6000730.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of human T-lymphotropic virus type I.
HP:6000730.name_cn: 脑脊液人类T淋巴细胞病毒I型抗体阳性
HP:6000730.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对人类T淋巴细胞病毒I型（HTLV-I）某一成分的抗体。

HP:6000731.name: Positive chlamydia trachomatis urine nucleic acid test
HP:6000731.definition: Detection of Chlamydia trachomatis nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000731.name_cn: 沙眼衣原体尿液核酸检测阳性
HP:6000731.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测尿液中的沙眼衣原体（Chlamydia trachomatis）核酸。

HP:6000732.name: Anti-streptococcus deoxyribonuclease-B antibody positivity
HP:6000732.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against streptococcal deoxyribonuclease-B (ADN-B). Almost all group A streptococci have this antigen and a strong elevation of the antibody is observed in patients with acute rheumatic fever, acute glomerulonephritis and other streptococcal infections.
HP:6000732.name_cn: 抗链球菌脱氧核糖核酸酶-B抗体阳性
HP:6000732.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对链球菌脱氧核糖核酸酶-B（ADN-B）的抗体。几乎所有A组链球菌都具有该抗原，并且在急性风湿热、急性肾小球肾炎及其他链球菌感染患者中观察到该抗体的显著升高。

HP:6000733.name: Positive streptococcus A rapid antigen detection test
HP:6000733.definition: Positive detection of a group A streptococcal antigen in a test perforned on a throat swab.
HP:6000733.name_cn: A组链球菌快速抗原检测试验阳性
HP:6000733.definition_cn: 咽拭子检测中A组链球菌抗原阳性。

HP:6000734.name: Positive synovial mycobacterial culture
HP:6000734.definition: Growth of a mycobacteria in a culture derived from synovial fluid.
HP:6000734.name_cn: 滑膜分枝杆菌培养阳性
HP:6000734.definition_cn: 从滑液中培养出的分枝杆菌生长。

HP:6000735.name: Positive mycobacterial synovial nucleic acid test
HP:6000735.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of mycobacteria in the synovial fluid by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000735.name_cn: 分枝杆菌滑膜核酸阳性检测
HP:6000735.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测滑液中分枝杆菌的核酸。

HP:6000736.name: Positive bloodstream babesia nucleic acid pathogen test
HP:6000736.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of genus Babesia (parasite) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000736.name_cn: 血液巴贝虫核酸病原体检测阳性
HP:6000736.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链式反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中巴贝斯虫属（寄生虫）的核酸。

HP:6000737.name: Positive bloodstream influenza nucleic test
HP:6000737.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of an influenza virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000737.name_cn: 血流流感核酸阳性检测
HP:6000737.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中流感病毒的核酸。

HP:6000738.name: Positive bloodstream parainfluenza virus nucleic acid test
HP:6000738.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of parainfluenza virus in the blood circulation by a methiod such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000738.name_cn: 血液中副流感病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000738.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链式反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中副流感病毒的核酸。

HP:6000739.name: Positive bloodstream adenovirus nucleic acid test
HP:6000739.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of an adenovirus in the blood circulation by a methiod such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000739.name_cn: 血液腺病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000739.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中的腺病毒核酸。

HP:6000740.name: Anti-Francisella tularensis antibody positivity
HP:6000740.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Francisella tularensis.
HP:6000740.name_cn: 抗土拉弗朗西斯菌抗体阳性
HP:6000740.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对土拉弗朗西斯菌（Francisella tularensis）某一成分的抗体。

HP:6000741.name: Positive bloodstream MERS coronavirus nucleic acid test
HP:6000741.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Middle East Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000741.name_cn: 血液中MERS冠状病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000741.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链式反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中的中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒（MERS-CoV）核酸。

HP:6000742.name: Positive nasopharyngeal corynebacterium diphtheriae nucleic acid test
HP:6000742.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Corynebacterium diphtheriae in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000742.name_cn: 鼻咽部白喉棒状杆菌核酸检测阳性
HP:6000742.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测鼻咽分泌物中的白喉棒状杆菌核酸。

HP:6000743.name: Pediculosis capitis
HP:6000743.definition: Visualization of at least one louse on visual inspection of the head hair. Use of a bright light, magnifying lens, or fine-toothed comb (lice comb) can aid in diagnosis.
HP:6000743.definition_cn: 通过肉眼检查头皮毛发，观察到至少一只虱子。使用强光源、放大镜或细齿梳（虱子梳）可辅助诊断。

HP:6000744.name: Premature glabellar skin wrinkling
HP:6000744.definition: The presence in the skin of the glabellar region of an increased degree of wrinkling (irregular folds and indentations) of the skin as compared with age-related norms.
HP:6000744.name_cn: 前额皮肤过早皱纹形成
HP:6000744.definition_cn: 与年龄相关标准相比，眉间区域皮肤出现皱纹（不规则褶皱和凹陷）程度增加。

HP:6000745.name: Flexural reticulate hyperpigmentation
HP:6000745.definition: Hyperpigmented macules with a reticulate (net-like) pattern involving the neck, axillae, groins, and other flexures like the inframammary folds in females. Histopathology shows orthokeratosis or hyperkeratosis, thinning of the suprapapillary epithelium, elongation of the rete ridges, hyperpigmentation of the basal layer, and follicular cysts. A perivascular lymphohistiocytic infiltrate can be observed in the papillary dermis.
HP:6000745.definition_cn: 颈部、腋窝、腹股沟及女性乳房下皱襞等屈曲部位出现网状（网纹状）色素沉着斑。组织病理学显示角化过度或角化不全，乳头层上皮变薄，网状嵴延长，基底层色素沉着，以及毛囊囊肿。在乳头层真皮中可见血管周围淋巴细胞和组织细胞浸润。

HP:6000746.name: Elevated fractional excretion of urate
HP:6000746.definition: Abnormally increased proportion of filtered urate that is excreted in the urine as calculated using the concentrations of urate and creatinine in both blood and urine. Clinically this manifests as uric acid wasting.
HP:6000746.definition_cn: 通过血液和尿液中尿酸和肌酐浓度计算得出的滤过尿酸在尿液中排泄比例异常增高。临床上表现为尿酸排泄增多。

HP:6000747.name: Abnormal urinary creatine level
HP:6000747.definition: The amount of creatine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.
HP:6000747.definition_cn: 尿液中肌酐含量经尿液浓度标准化后超出正常范围。

HP:6000748.name: Decreased urinary creatine level
HP:6000748.definition: The amount of creatine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000748.definition_cn: 尿液中肌酐含量经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:6000749.name: Elevated circulating type I procollagen aminoterminal propeptide concentration
HP:6000749.definition: The concentration of type I procollagen aminoterminal propeptide in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. The aminoterminal propeptide of type I procollagen (PINP) in serum is a sensitive indicator of the synthesis of type I collagen.
HP:6000749.name_cn: 循环中I型前胶原氨基端前肽浓度升高
HP:6000749.definition_cn: 血液循环中I型前胶原氨基端前肽浓度高于正常值上限。血清中的I型前胶原氨基端前肽（PINP）是I型胶原合成的敏感指标。

HP:6000750.name: Decreased tissue S-adenosylhomocysteine hydrolase activity
HP:6000750.definition: Concentration or activity of S-adenosylhomocysteine hydrolase (EC 3.3.1.1) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including erythrocytes and liver.
HP:6000750.name_cn: 组织S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸水解酶活性降低
HP:6000750.definition_cn: S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸水解酶（EC 3.3.1.1）浓度或活性低于正常下限。FECH酶可在多种组织中检测，包括红细胞和肝脏。

HP:6000751.name: Decreased urinary dopamine level
HP:6000751.definition: The concentration of dopamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000751.definition_cn: 尿液中多巴胺浓度经尿液浓度校正后低于正常值下限。

HP:6000752.name: Elevated erythrocyte AICA-ribotide concentration
HP:6000752.definition: Concentration of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide (AICA-riboside) in red blood cells is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000752.name_cn: 红细胞AICA-核糖苷浓度升高
HP:6000752.definition_cn: 红细胞中5-氨基-4-咪唑甲酰胺（AICA-核糖苷）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000753.name: Elevated circulating monomethyl sterol concentration
HP:6000753.definition: Concentration of monomethylsterols (such as 4alpha-monomethylsterol) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000753.name_cn: 循环单甲基甾醇浓度升高
HP:6000753.definition_cn: 血液循环中单甲基甾醇（如4α-单甲基甾醇）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000754.name: Elevated circulating dimethyl sterol concentration
HP:6000754.definition: The concentration of dimethylsterols in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000754.name_cn: 循环二甲基甾醇浓度升高
HP:6000754.definition_cn: 血液循环中二甲基甾醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000755.name: Elevated circulating C-terminal fibroblast growth factor 23 concentration
HP:6000755.definition: The concentration of the C-terminal portion of fibroblast growth factor 23 in the blood circulation is outside of the limits of normal.
HP:6000755.name_cn: 循环中C端成纤维细胞生长因子23浓度升高
HP:6000755.definition_cn: 血液循环中成纤维细胞生长因子23的C端片段浓度超出正常范围。

HP:6000756.name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid level
HP:6000756.definition: The amount of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid (5-HIAA) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000756.name_cn: 尿5-羟基吲哚乙酸水平升高
HP:6000756.definition_cn: 尿液中5-羟基吲哚乙酸（5-HIAA）的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000757.name: Elevated circulating thiosulfate concentration
HP:6000757.definition: The concentration of thiosulfate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000757.name_cn: 循环硫代硫酸盐浓度升高
HP:6000757.definition_cn: 血液循环中硫代硫酸盐浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000758.name: Elevated circulating interleukin 1 receptor antagonist concentration
HP:6000758.definition: The concentration of interleukin 1 receptor antagonist (IL-1RA) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000758.name_cn: 循环中白细胞介素1受体拮抗剂浓度升高
HP:6000758.definition_cn: 血液循环中白细胞介素1受体拮抗剂（IL-1RA）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000759.name: Positive CSF West Nile virus nucleic acid test
HP:6000759.definition: Detection of West Nile virus nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000759.name_cn: 脑脊液西尼罗病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000759.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的西尼罗病毒核酸。

HP:6000760.name: Positive CSF herpes simplex virus nucleic acid test
HP:6000760.definition: Detection of herpes simplex virus (HSV) nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000760.name_cn: 脑脊液单纯疱疹病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000760.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链式反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的单纯疱疹病毒（HSV）核酸。

HP:6000761.name: Positive CSF cryptococcal antigen test
HP:6000761.definition: A test result demonstrating the presence of a cryptococal antigen in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000761.name_cn: 脑脊液隐球菌抗原检测阳性
HP:6000761.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中隐球菌抗原检测结果呈阳性。

HP:6000762.name: Positive rubella CSF culture
HP:6000762.definition: Growth of rubella virus in a culture derived from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000762.name_cn: 风疹病毒脑脊液培养阳性
HP:6000762.definition_cn: 从脑脊液（CSF）培养物中分离的风疹病毒生长。

HP:6000763.name: Positive CSF treponema pallidum nucleic acid test
HP:6000763.definition: Detection of Treponema pallidum (syphillis) nucleic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000763.name_cn: 脑脊液梅毒螺旋体核酸检测阳性
HP:6000763.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测脑脊液（CSF）中的梅毒螺旋体（梅毒）核酸。

HP:6000764.name: Decreased CSF tetrahydrobiopterin level
HP:6000764.definition: Concentration of tetrahydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000764.name_cn: 脑脊液四氢生物蝶呤水平降低
HP:6000764.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中四氢生物蝶呤浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000765.name: Decreased CSF N-acetyl-aspartyl-glutamate concentration
HP:6000765.definition: The concentration of N-acetyl-aspartyl-glutamate (NAAG) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000765.name_cn: 脑脊液N-乙酰天冬氨酰谷氨酸浓度降低
HP:6000765.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中N-乙酰天冬氨酰谷氨酸（NAAG）浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000766.name: Positive CSF Tropheryma whipplei bacteria microscopy
HP:6000766.definition: Demonstration of Tropheryma whipplei bacteria in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) my microscopic analysis.
HP:6000766.name_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）显微镜检查发现惠普尔养障体（Tropheryma whipplei）细菌阳性
HP:6000766.definition_cn: 通过显微镜分析在脑脊液（CSF）中证实了惠普尔养障体（Tropheryma whipplei）细菌的存在。

HP:6000767.name: CSF treponemal antibody positivity
HP:6000767.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of treponema pallidum (syphilis).
HP:6000767.name_cn: 脑脊液梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性
HP:6000767.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对梅毒螺旋体（Treponema pallidum）成分的抗体。

HP:6000768.name: Echophenomenon
HP:6000768.definition: A stimulus triggered repetition of an action (echopraxia) or sound (echolalia) performed without the explicit awareness of an individual.
HP:6000768.definition_cn: 一种由刺激引发的动作重复（模仿动作，echopraxia）或声音重复（模仿言语，echolalia），个体在无明确意识的情况下执行。

HP:6000769.name: Paracentral hyper-autofluorecence
HP:6000769.definition: Increased autofluorescence in areas adjacent to the central macula (but not including the very center).
HP:6000769.definition_cn: 黄斑中心旁区域（但不包括中心凹）的自发荧光增强。

HP:6000770.name: Fixed fetal extremities
HP:6000770.definition: A condition in which the limbs of a fetus are immobile or held in a rigid position. The limbs are consistently immobile and rigid. Fixed extremities can be observed during prenatal imaging (e.g., ultrasound).
HP:6000770.definition_cn: 胎儿肢体固定或僵硬状态。肢体持续不动且僵硬。产前影像学检查（如超声）可观察到固定肢体。

HP:6000771.name: Abnormal peripapillary microvascular network
HP:6000771.definition: The density of the deep peripapillary microvascular network (i.e., the number of blood vessels) is below the lower limit of normal. This finding is observable by optical coherence tomography angiography.
HP:6000771.name_cn: 异常视盘周围微血管网络
HP:6000771.definition_cn: 视乳头周围深层微血管网络密度（即血管数量）低于正常下限。此发现可通过光学相干断层扫描血管成像观察到。

HP:6000772.name: Auriculitis
HP:6000772.definition: Inflammation of the skin and soft tissues of the outer ear.
HP:6000772.definition_cn: 外耳皮肤及软组织炎症。

HP:6000773.name: Recent history of moisture in external ear canal
HP:6000773.definition: A recent history of being exposed to moisture in the external ear canal.
HP:6000773.definition_cn: 近期外耳道潮湿暴露史。

HP:6000774.name: History of recent trauma to external ear canal
HP:6000774.definition: Medical history of trauma to the external ear canal, including cotton-swab use, in recent weeks.
HP:6000774.definition_cn: 近期外耳道创伤史，包括棉签使用情况。

HP:6000775.name: Elevated urinary 4-tyramine level
HP:6000775.definition: The amount of 4-tyramine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000775.definition_cn: 尿液中4-酪胺含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000776.name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxykynurenine concentration
HP:6000776.definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxykynurenine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000776.name_cn: 循环中3-羟基犬尿氨酸浓度升高
HP:6000776.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-羟基犬尿氨酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000778.name: Cone-shaped distal tibial epiphysis
HP:6000778.definition: The distal epiphysis (rounded portion of bone at the far end of the tibia distal to the growth plate) has an abnormal cone-shaped appearance, that is, the epiphysis has a globular form at the bottom, tapering to a point at the top.
HP:6000778.definition_cn: 远端骨骺（位于胫骨远端生长板远端的圆形骨端）呈现异常的锥形外观，即骨骺底部呈球形，向顶部逐渐变细至一点。

HP:6000779.name: Osteoporotic femoral neck
HP:6000779.definition: Low bone mass localized in the neck of the femur. Osteoporosis is defined based on a T-score of -2.5 or lower (bone mineral density of 2.5 or more standard deviations below that of a normal young adult).
HP:6000779.name_cn: 骨质疏松性股骨颈骨折
HP:6000779.definition_cn: 股骨颈局部骨量减少。骨质疏松症的定义基于T值≤-2.5（骨密度低于正常年轻成人平均值2.5个标准差或以上）。

HP:6000781.name: Reduced tissue phosphomannomutase activity
HP:6000781.definition: Activity of the enzyme phosphomannomutase (EC 5.4.2.8) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes, fibroblasts, and liver.
HP:6000781.name_cn: 组织磷酸甘露糖变位酶活性降低
HP:6000781.definition_cn: 组织中磷酸甘露糖变位酶（EC 5.4.2.8）活性低于正常下限。该酶活性可在多种组织中测定，包括白细胞、成纤维细胞和肝脏。

HP:6000782.name: Reduced tissue phosphomannose isomerase activity
HP:6000782.definition: Activity of the mitochondrial enzyme phosphomannose isomerase (PMI; EC 5.3.1.8) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes, fibroblasts, and liver.
HP:6000782.name_cn: 组织磷酸甘露糖异构酶活性降低
HP:6000782.definition_cn: 线粒体酶磷酸甘露糖异构酶（PMI；EC 5.3.1.8）在组织中的活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括白细胞、成纤维细胞和肝脏。

HP:6000783.name: Reduced tissue palmitoyl-protein thioesterase activity
HP:6000783.definition: Activity of the enzyme palmitoyl-protein thioesterase (PPT; EC 3.1.2.22) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes.
HP:6000783.name_cn: 组织棕榈酰蛋白硫酯酶活性降低
HP:6000783.definition_cn: 组织中棕榈酰蛋白硫酯酶（PPT；EC 3.1.2.22）活性低于正常下限。该酶活性可在多种组织中测定，包括培养的成纤维细胞和白细胞。

HP:6000784.name: Maternal household cat exposure
HP:6000784.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of regular exposure to one or more cats, e.g., in the household.
HP:6000784.definition_cn: 胎儿或指示病例的母亲有定期接触一只或多只猫的历史，例如在家庭环境中。

HP:6000785.name: Protein craving
HP:6000785.definition: Unusually strong preference for protein-rich foods.
HP:6000785.definition_cn: 对富含蛋白质食物的异常强烈偏好。

HP:6000786.name: Absent superficial temporal artery pulse
HP:6000786.definition: The pulsation of the superficial temporal artery cannot be detected on physical examination.
HP:6000786.definition_cn: 颞浅动脉搏动在体格检查中无法触及。

HP:6000787.name: Basilar artery fenestration
HP:6000787.definition: A fenestration affecting the basilar artery. Basilar fenestration typically occurs at the lower end of the basilar artery just as the vertebral arteries join Fenestrations of intracranial arteries are segmental duplications of the lumen into two distinct endothelium-lined channels, which may or may not share their adventitial layer. They can range from a small focus of divided tissue to long-segment duplication. Fenestrations are the result of partial failure of fusion of paired primitive embryologic vessels or incomplete obliteration of different anastomosis in a primitive vascular network. The association of fenestrations with aneurysms has been suggested in many small case series, though the exact relationship is not well defined.
HP:6000787.definition_cn: 基底动脉窗式畸形。基底动脉窗式畸形通常发生在基底动脉下端，即椎动脉汇合处。颅内动脉窗式畸形是指管腔节段性重复形成两个独立的内皮衬里通道，这些通道可能共享或不共享其外膜层。其范围可从小的分隔组织到长节段重复。窗式畸形是由于成对的原始胚胎血管部分融合失败或原始血管网络中不同吻合的不完全闭塞所致。尽管确切关系尚未明确，但许多小型病例系列研究提示窗式畸形与动脉瘤之间存在关联。

HP:6000788.name: Displacement of the extensor tendon in metacarpophalangeal joint
HP:6000788.definition: Dislocation of the extensor tendons from their central position on the metacarpal heads can be traumatic, congenital, spontaneous, or degenerative.
HP:6000788.definition_cn: 伸肌腱从其掌骨头中央位置脱位可能是创伤性、先天性、自发性或退行性的。

HP:6000789.name: Heloma
HP:6000789.definition: A corn, also known as a clavus, heloma, or focal intractable plantar hyperkeratosis, is a type of callosity. Corns are uncomfortable, thickened skin lesions that result from repeated mechanical trauma due to friction or pressure forces.
HP:6000789.definition_cn: 鸡眼，亦称clavus、heloma或局灶性顽固性跖部角化过度，属于胼胝的一种类型。鸡眼是由于反复的机械性创伤，如摩擦或压力作用，导致皮肤增厚形成的不适性病变。

HP:6000790.name: Exacerbated by pronation
HP:6000790.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) pronation. Pronation of the hand involves the rotation of the forearm and wrist so that the palm of the hand faces downwards or towards the back (posteriorly).
HP:6000790.definition_cn: 应用于因旋前而加重（或加剧疼痛）的体征或症状。手的旋前涉及前臂和手腕的旋转，使手掌朝下或朝后（后方）。

HP:6000791.name: Distortion of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure
HP:6000791.definition: Change in the normal shape (displacement, asymmetry) of the anterior part of the interhemispheric fissure. This finding can be identified prenatally by sonography or magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:6000791.name_cn: 大脑半球间裂前部变形
HP:6000791.definition_cn: 大脑半球间裂前部正常形态改变（移位、不对称）。该发现可通过产前超声检查或磁共振成像识别。

HP:6000792.name: Positive lacrimal tract actinomyces culture
HP:6000792.definition: Growth of Actinomyces israelii (anaerobic filamentous gram positive) culture of lacrimal discharge or concretions.
HP:6000792.definition_cn: 泪液分泌物或结石中以色列放线菌（厌氧丝状革兰氏阳性菌）的培养生长。

HP:6000793.name: Eschar
HP:6000793.definition: A type of wound characterized by dry, black, hard necrotic tissue.
HP:6000793.definition_cn: 一种以干燥、黑色、坚硬的坏死组织为特征的伤口类型。

HP:6000794.name: History of wearing tightly fitted clothing
HP:6000794.definition: History of wearing tight clothing such as compression shorts, sports bras, bike shorts, wet suits, spandex, veils, and tight hats.
HP:6000794.definition_cn: 穿着紧身衣物史，包括压缩短裤、运动文胸、自行车短裤、潜水服、氨纶衣物、面纱及紧身帽。

HP:6000795.name: Anti-folate receptor antibody positivity
HP:6000795.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the folate receptor in the blood circulation.
HP:6000795.definition_cn: 血清中存在自身抗体（免疫球蛋白），这些抗体与血液循环中的叶酸受体发生反应。

HP:6000796.name: Positive bloodstream VDRL test
HP:6000796.definition: An abnormal (positive) result of the Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) test performed in peripheral blood, suggesting past or present syphilis.
HP:6000796.definition_cn: 外周血梅毒螺旋体血清学试验（Venereal Disease Research Laboratory, VDRL）结果异常（阳性），提示既往或现症梅毒感染。

HP:6000797.name: Positive bloodstream rapid plasma reagin test
HP:6000797.definition: Positive result of the the rapid plasma reagin test (RPR test. This is a rapid diagnostic test that looks for non-specific antibodies in the blood of the patient that may indicate an infection by syphilis or related non-venereal treponematoses.
HP:6000797.name_cn: 阳性血液快速血浆反应素试验
HP:6000797.definition_cn: 快速血浆反应素试验（RPR试验）阳性结果。该试验是一种快速诊断检测，旨在检测患者血液中可能提示梅毒或相关非性病性密螺旋体感染的非特异性抗体。

HP:6000798.name: Positive bloodstream HIV p24 antigen test
HP:6000798.definition: Demonstration of the p24 antigen of human immunodeficiency virus in the bloodstream.
HP:6000798.name_cn: HIV p24抗原血液检测阳性
HP:6000798.definition_cn: 人免疫缺陷病毒p24抗原在血液中的检测。

HP:6000799.name: Positive Quantiferon tuberculosis test
HP:6000799.definition: A positive Quantiferon test result indicating Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The Quantiferon assay is designed to stimulate IFN-gamma release from CD4+ T cells in a single tuberculosis antigen tube using long peptides from three M. tuberculosis antigens.
HP:6000799.name_cn: 结核分枝杆菌特异性γ-干扰素释放试验阳性
HP:6000799.definition_cn: Quantiferon试验阳性结果提示结核分枝杆菌感染。Quantiferon检测法旨在通过使用来自三种结核分枝杆菌抗原的长肽，在单一结核抗原管中刺激CD4+ T细胞释放干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）。

HP:6000800.name: Tzanck smear with multinucleated giant cells
HP:6000800.definition: Tzanck smear demonstrates multinucleated giant cells, a sign that is suggestive for herpetic infections. Such smears are taken from skin lesions and display multinucleated cells with ground glass nuclei, nuclear moulding, and margination of nuclear chromatin typical of herpes simplex and varicella infection.
HP:6000800.definition_cn: Tzanck涂片显示多核巨细胞，这一征象提示疱疹病毒感染。此类涂片取自皮肤病变部位，并显示出具有毛玻璃样核、核塑形及核染色质边集的多核细胞，这些特征为单纯疱疹病毒和水痘病毒感染所典型表现。

HP:6000801.name: Positive Mazzotti test
HP:6000801.definition: Locally applied 1.6 percent diethylcarbamazine citrate in Nivea lotion can be used as a diagnostic test for onchocerciasis. Papular reactions are considered as positive test results.
HP:6000801.definition_cn: 局部应用1.6%枸橼酸乙胺嗪于妮维雅乳液中可作为盘尾丝虫病的诊断试验。丘疹反应被视为阳性测试结果。

HP:6000802.name: Positive bloodstream Tropheryma whippelii nucleic acid test
HP:6000802.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Tropheryma whippelii in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000802.name_cn: 血液中Tropheryma whippelii核酸阳性检测
HP:6000802.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测血液循环中的惠普尔养障体（Tropheryma whippelii）核酸。

HP:6000803.name: Elevated urinary 2,8-dihydroxyadenine level
HP:6000803.definition: The amount of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000803.name_cn: 尿液中2,8-二羟基腺嘌呤水平升高
HP:6000803.definition_cn: 尿液中2,8-二羟基腺嘌呤的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000804.name: Elevated urine fructose level
HP:6000804.definition: Amount of fructose in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000804.definition_cn: 尿液中果糖含量高于正常上限。

HP:6000805.name: Elevated urinary uroporphyrin level
HP:6000805.definition: The amount of uroporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000805.definition_cn: 尿液中尿卟啉含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6000806.name: Elevated urinary phosphohydroxylysine level
HP:6000806.definition: The amount of phosphohydroxylysine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000806.name_cn: 尿中磷酸羟赖氨酸水平升高
HP:6000806.definition_cn: 尿液中磷酸羟赖氨酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6000807.name: Cervical C6/C7 vertebrae fusion
HP:6000807.definition: Fusion of cervical vertebrae at C6 and C7, caused by a failure in the normal segmentation or division of the cervical vertebrae during the early weeks of fetal development, leading to a short neck with a low hairline at the back of the head, and restricted mobility of the upper spine.
HP:6000807.definition_cn: 颈椎C6和C7融合，由胎儿发育早期颈椎正常分节或分割失败所致，导致颈部短缩、后发际线低，以及上段脊柱活动受限。

HP:6000808.name: Periumbilical depression
HP:6000808.definition: The tissue that immediately surrounds the umbilicus is located below the normal plane of the abdomen.
HP:6000808.definition_cn: 脐周组织位于腹部正常平面下方。

HP:6000809.name: Thickened tibial cortex
HP:6000809.definition: Abnormally increased thicknes of the cortical layer of the tibia.

HP:6000810.name: Thickened femoral cortex
HP:6000810.definition: Abnormally increased thicknes of the cortical layer of the femur.

HP:6000811.name: Thickened cortex of the radius
HP:6000811.definition: Abnormally increased thickness of the cortical layer of the radius.

HP:6000812.name: Thickened cortex of the ulna
HP:6000812.definition: Abnormally increased thickness of the cortical layer of the ulna.

HP:6000813.name: Elevated circulating aspartate aminotransferase to alanine aminotransferase ratio
HP:6000813.definition: Aspartate aminotransferase to alanine aminotransferase ratio increased greater than 1.5.
HP:6000813.name_cn: 循环中天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶与丙氨酸氨基转移酶比值升高
HP:6000813.definition_cn: 天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶与丙氨酸氨基转移酶比值升高大于1.5。

HP:6000814.name: Temporomandibular joint dislocation
HP:6000814.definition: The lower jawbone (mandible) pulls away from the temporomandibular joints (TMJ). It is characterized by pain, clicking and functional restriction.
HP:6000814.definition_cn: 下颌骨（mandible）从颞下颌关节（temporomandibular joints, TMJ）处脱离。其特征为疼痛、弹响及功能受限。

HP:6000815.name: Amyloid goiter
HP:6000815.definition: Amyloidosis is defined as the accumulation of amorphous, proteinaceous material in different parts of the body. Amyloid can be deposited in the thyroid gland in such quantities to cause a clinically apparent enlargement of the gland known as Amyloid goiter.
HP:6000815.definition_cn: 淀粉样变性被定义为无定形蛋白质物质在身体不同部位的积累。淀粉样物质可在甲状腺中大量沉积，导致临床上明显的甲状腺肿大，称为淀粉样甲状腺肿。

HP:6000817.name: Melorheostosis
HP:6000817.definition: Regions of sclerosing hyperostosis in the cortex of long bones, which might have a radiologic appearance of dripping candle wax.
HP:6000817.definition_cn: 长骨皮质内硬化性骨肥厚区域，可能呈现放射学上的“滴蜡样”外观。

HP:6000818.name: Transverse terminal limb defect
HP:6000818.definition: A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the extremity. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.
HP:6000818.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，表现为肢体在不同水平上的截肢样缺失。肢体缺失末端（远端）节段，而缺失节段近端的所有节段均保留。

HP:6000819.name: Elevated circulating beta-glucuronidase activity
HP:6000819.definition: The activity of beta-glucuronidase (EC 3.2.1.31) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000819.name_cn: 循环β-葡萄糖醛酸酶活性升高
HP:6000819.definition_cn: 血液循环中β-葡萄糖醛酸苷酶（EC 3.2.1.31）活性高于正常值上限。

HP:6000820.name: Elevated osmolality gap
HP:6000820.definition: Plasma osmolality is determined mainly by Sodium, its counter ions, and uncharged species such as Glucose and Urea. Knowledge of the plasma concentration of these species allows calculation of the plasma osmolality quite accurately. If the difference between the measured osmolality (MO) and calculated osmolality (CO) is known as the osmolar gap (OG) is large (greater than 15) osmolar gap can help identify the presence in plasma of substances such as ethanol, methanol, isopropanol, ethylene glycol, propylene glycol..
HP:6000820.definition_cn: 血浆渗透压主要由钠、其抗衡离子以及不带电物质如葡萄糖和尿素决定。了解这些物质的血浆浓度可以相当准确地计算出血浆渗透压。如果测得的渗透压（MO）与计算出的渗透压（CO）之间的差异（称为渗透压间隙，OG）较大（大于15），则渗透压间隙有助于识别血浆中存在的物质，如乙醇、甲醇、异丙醇、乙二醇、丙二醇等。

HP:6000821.name: Elevated circulating bile alcohol concentration
HP:6000821.definition: The concentration of bile alcohols in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000821.definition_cn: 血液循环中胆汁醇浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000822.name: Elevated CSF tetrahydrobiopterin level
HP:6000822.definition: Concentration of tetrahydrobiopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000822.name_cn: 脑脊液四氢生物蝶呤水平升高
HP:6000822.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中四氢生物蝶呤浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000823.name: Elevated CSF 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid concentration
HP:6000823.definition: The concentration of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000823.name_cn: 脑脊液5-羟基吲哚乙酸浓度升高
HP:6000823.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中5-羟基吲哚乙酸（5-HIAA）浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000824.name: Cerebrospinal fluid eosinophilia
HP:6000824.definition: Presence of at least 10% eosinophils in the total cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leukocyte count.
HP:6000824.name_cn: 脑脊液嗜酸性粒细胞增多症
HP:6000824.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）白细胞总数中嗜酸性粒细胞占比至少为10%。

HP:6000825.name: Reduced C27 3beta-HSD activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000825.definition: Concentration or activity of 3beta-hydroxy-delta5-C27-steroid oxidoreductase (C27 3beta-HSD) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.
HP:6000825.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中C27 3β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶活性降低
HP:6000825.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的3β-羟基-Δ5-C27-类固醇氧化还原酶（C27 3β-HSD）浓度或活性低于正常范围。

HP:6000826.name: Reduced procollagen-lysine,2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 1 activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000826.definition: Concentration or activity of procollagen-lysine,2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 1 (PLOD1; also known as Lysyl hydroxylase; EC 1.14.11.4) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. PLOD1 catalyzes the formation of hydroxylysine in collagens and other proteins with collagen-like amino acid sequences, by the hydroxylation of lysine residues in X-lys-gly sequences.
HP:6000826.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中前胶原-赖氨酸，2-酮戊二酸5-双加氧酶1活性降低
HP:6000826.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的原胶原-赖氨酸，2-氧戊二酸5-双加氧酶1（PLOD1；也称为赖氨酰羟化酶；EC 1.14.11.4）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。PLOD1通过催化X-赖氨酸-甘氨酸序列中的赖氨酸残基的羟基化反应，在胶原蛋白及其他具有胶原样氨基酸序列的蛋白质中形成羟赖氨酸。

HP:6000827.name: Diminished tissue fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase activity
HP:6000827.definition: Concentration or activity of fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase (FAH; EC 3.7.1.2) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000827.name_cn: 组织延胡索酰乙酰乙酸水解酶活性降低
HP:6000827.definition_cn: 延胡索酰乙酰乙酸水解酶（FAH；EC 3.7.1.2）的浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶可在多种组织中测定，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000828.name: Reduced tissue peptidase D activity
HP:6000828.definition: Concentration or activity of Peptidase D (EC 3.4.13.9; also known as prolidase, imidodipeptidase, proline dipeptidase, and aminoacyl-L-proline hydrolase) below the lower limit of normal. The activity of this enzyme can be measured in erythrocytes, leukocytes, or fibroblasts.
HP:6000828.definition_cn: 肽酶D（EC 3.4.13.9；也称为脯氨酸二肽酶、咪唑二肽酶、脯氨酸二肽酶和氨酰基-L-脯氨酸水解酶）的浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶的活性可在红细胞、白细胞或成纤维细胞中测定。

HP:6000829.name: Reduced tissue glycine cleavage enzyme activity
HP:6000829.definition: Concentration or activity of the glycine cleavage enzyme below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000829.name_cn: 组织甘氨酸裂解酶活性降低
HP:6000829.definition_cn: 甘氨酸裂解酶浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶可在多种组织中测定，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000830.name: Diminished alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000830.definition: Concentration or activity of the alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme is a multienzyme complex consisting of 3 protein subunits, oxoglutarate dehydrogenase, also known as alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase or E1k (EC 1.2.4.2.), dihydrolipoyl succinyltransferase (DLST, or E2k; 126063), and dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (DLD, or E3; 238331). The complex catalyzes a key reaction in the Krebs tricarboxylic acid cycle.
HP:6000830.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶活性降低
HP:6000830.definition_cn: 在培养的成纤维细胞中测得的α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合物的浓度或活性低于正常范围。该酶是由三个蛋白质亚基组成的多酶复合物，包括氧化戊二酸脱氢酶（也称为α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶或E1k，EC 1.2.4.2）、二氢硫辛酰琥珀酰转移酶（DLST，或E2k；126063）和二氢硫辛酰脱氢酶（DLD，或E3；238331）。该复合物在三羧酸循环中催化关键反应。

HP:6000831.name: Increased circulating dihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration
HP:6000831.definition: The concentration of dihydroxycholestanoic acid (DHCA) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000831.name_cn: 循环中二羟基胆甾烷酸浓度升高
HP:6000831.definition_cn: 血液循环中二羟基胆烷酸（Dihydroxycholestanoic Acid, DHCA）浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000832.name: Reduced tissue phosphorylase kinase activity
HP:6000832.definition: Concentration or activity of phosphorylase kinase below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000832.name_cn: 组织磷酸化酶激酶活性降低
HP:6000832.definition_cn: 磷酸化酶激酶浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000833.name: Hyperkalemia while symptomatic
HP:6000833.definition: Increased concentration of potassium in the blood circulation specifically measured during a disease flareup, attack, or exacerbation.
HP:6000833.definition_cn: Hyperkalemia specifically measured during a disease flare-up, attack, or exacerbation.

HP:6000834.name: Elevated urinary gamma-glutamylcysteine level
HP:6000834.definition: The amount of gamma-glutamylcysteine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000834.name_cn: 尿γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸水平升高
HP:6000834.definition_cn: 尿液中γ-谷氨酰半胱氨酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6000835.name: Positive CSF mycobacterial culture
HP:6000835.definition: Growth of mycobacteria in a culture derived from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
HP:6000835.name_cn: 脑脊液分枝杆菌培养阳性
HP:6000835.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）培养物中分枝杆菌的生长。

HP:6000836.name: Positive respiratory tract nucleic acid pathogen test
HP:6000836.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of a sputum or pharyngeal sample test such as polymerase chain reaction that is targeted against a nucleic acid sequence specific for a pathogen.
HP:6000836.name_cn: 呼吸道病原体核酸检测阳性
HP:6000836.definition_cn: 痰液或咽拭子样本检测呈阳性（异常）结果，例如针对病原体特异性核酸序列的聚合酶链反应（PCR）检测。

HP:6000837.name: Positive respiratory tract SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus nucleic acid test
HP:6000837.definition: Detection of SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus nucleic acid in the sputum or pharyngeal sample by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000837.name_cn: 呼吸道SARS-CoV-2冠状病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000837.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测痰液或咽拭子样本中的严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）核酸。

HP:6000838.name: Positive fecal cryptosporidium antigen test
HP:6000838.definition: Cryptosporidium antigen present in stool. Tests include direct fluorescent-antibody (DFA), which detects intact organisms, and enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), which detect soluble stool antigens.
HP:6000838.name_cn: 粪便隐孢子虫抗原检测阳性
HP:6000838.definition_cn: 粪便中存在隐孢子虫抗原。检测方法包括直接荧光抗体法（DFA），用于检测完整病原体，以及酶免疫分析法（EIA），用于检测可溶性粪便抗原。

HP:6000839.name: Horizontal position of testicle
HP:6000839.definition: The Bell Clapper deformity is one of the causes for the testicular torsion. In this condition, testis lacks a normal attachment to tunica vaginalis and hangs freely, causing it to sit horizontally rather than vertically in the scrotum.
HP:6000839.definition_cn: 钟摆畸形是睾丸扭转的病因之一。在此情况下，睾丸缺乏与鞘膜的正常附着，呈自由悬挂状态，导致其在阴囊内呈水平位而非垂直位。

HP:6000840.name: Localized soft-tissue swelling on extremity
HP:6000840.definition: Abnormal enlargement (swelling) that is restricted to a specific part of a limb.
HP:6000840.definition_cn: 局部肢体异常肥大（肿胀）。

HP:6000841.name: Abnormal scleral thickness
HP:6000841.definition: Any deviation from the normal height of the sclera, the white part of the eye that forms the tough, fibrous outer layer of the exterior of the eyeball.
HP:6000841.definition_cn: 巩膜高度异常（Any deviation from the normal height of the sclera），即眼球外层坚韧纤维组织——巩膜（the white part of the eye that forms the tough, fibrous outer layer of the exterior of the eyeball）的正常高度出现偏离。

HP:6000842.name: Multiple eyelid beaded papules
HP:6000842.definition: Multiple beaded papules along the eyelid margins and inner canthus.
HP:6000842.definition_cn: 沿睑缘及内眦部多发串珠状丘疹。

HP:6000843.name: Nonexudative conjunctivitis
HP:6000843.definition: A type of conjunctivitis that is not characterized by appreciable exudate, i.e., fluid, cells, or other substances that have escaped from blood vessels and have been deposited around the eyelids.
HP:6000843.definition_cn: 一种非显著渗出性结膜炎，即无明显渗出物（如液体、细胞或其他从血管逸出并沉积在眼睑周围的物质）的结膜炎。

HP:6000844.name: Nematode in retina
HP:6000844.definition: Demonstration of a nematode (roundworm) in the retina, generally by an imaging procedure such as fundoscopy.
HP:6000844.definition_cn: 视网膜线虫（蛔虫）的展示，通常通过影像学检查程序如眼底镜检查进行。

HP:6000845.name: Vascular compression of the eighth cranial nerve
HP:6000845.definition: A condition in which blood vessels adjacent to the eighth cranial nerve (vestibulocochlear nerve) such as the anterior inferior cerebellar artery abnormally contact or compress the vestibulocochlear nerve as it exits the brainstem or travels within the cerebellopontine angle.
HP:6000845.definition_cn: 一种病理状态，其中邻近第八对脑神经（前庭蜗神经）的血管，如小脑前下动脉，在神经自脑干发出或在小脑桥脑角内走行时，异常接触或压迫前庭蜗神经。

HP:6000846.name: Beaded bile ducts
HP:6000846.definition: Multifocal intra- and extra-hepatic bile duct strictures alternating with normal caliber or slightly dilated segments, resembling beads on a string.
HP:6000846.definition_cn: 多灶性肝内外胆管狭窄与正常管径或轻度扩张段交替出现，呈串珠样改变。

HP:6000847.name: Cardiac mass
HP:6000847.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized in the heart. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6000847.definition_cn: 心脏局部异常增大或肿胀。在诊断工作早期，尚未确定肿胀的确切性质时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:6000848.name: Superior olive hypertrophy
HP:6000848.definition: Abnormal increase in size of the superior olive, also known as the superior olivary complex. The superior olive is a collection of brainstem nuclei that is located in pons, functions in multiple aspects of hearing and is an important component of the ascending and descending auditory pathways of the auditory system.
HP:6000848.definition_cn: 上橄榄体异常增大，亦称上橄榄复合体。上橄榄体为位于脑桥的一组脑干核团，在听觉的多个方面发挥功能，是听觉系统上行和下行听觉通路的重要组成部分。

HP:6000849.name: Spinal extradural arachnoid cyst
HP:6000849.definition: Spinal extradural arachnoid cyst is a cyst in the spinal canal that protrudes into the epidural space from a defect in the dura mater.
HP:6000849.name_cn: 脊柱硬膜外蛛网膜囊肿
HP:6000849.definition_cn: 脊髓硬膜外蛛网膜囊肿是一种位于椎管内的囊肿，通过硬脊膜的缺损突入硬膜外间隙。

HP:6000850.name: Temporal cortex localization
HP:6000850.definition: Localization to or predominance in the temporal cortex of the brain.
HP:6000850.definition_cn: 定位于或主要位于大脑颞叶皮层。

HP:6000851.name: Basilar meningeal enhancement
HP:6000851.definition: Abnormal enhancement of CT or MIR contrast medium in the basilar meninges, that is, those located in the basal cisterns or spaces at the base of the brain, due to increased permeability of blood vessels in these areas.
HP:6000851.definition_cn: 基底脑膜CT或MRI造影剂异常增强，即位于基底池或脑底间隙的区域，由于这些区域血管通透性增加所致。

HP:6000852.name: Megacolon
HP:6000852.definition: Persistent and substantial increase in diameter diameter and length of the colon.
HP:6000852.definition_cn: 结肠直径和长度的持续显著增加。

HP:6000853.name: Thyroid cyst
HP:6000853.definition: A fluid-filled sac or cavity that develops due to fluid accumulation within the thyroid tissue.
HP:6000853.definition_cn: 甲状腺组织内因液体潴留而形成的囊性或腔性结构。

HP:6000854.name: Decreased circulating sulfate concentration
HP:6000854.definition: The concentration of sulfate in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000854.definition_cn: 血液循环中硫酸盐浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000855.name: Cold intolerance
HP:6000855.definition: The inability to maintain a comfortable body temperature in a cold environment or cold temperatures.
HP:6000855.definition_cn: 在寒冷环境或低温条件下无法维持舒适体温的能力缺失。

HP:6000856.name: Head and neck distribution
HP:6000856.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the head and neck region.
HP:6000856.definition_cn: 适用于位于（或主要位于）头颈部区域的异常情况。

HP:6000857.name: Symmetric distribution
HP:6000857.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is highly similar on the left and right sides of the body.
HP:6000857.definition_cn: 适用于身体左右两侧高度相似的异常情况。

HP:6000858.name: Muscle extensor surface location
HP:6000858.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in extensor surface of an extremity.
HP:6000858.definition_cn: 适用于位于肢体伸肌表面的异常。

HP:6000859.name: Dermal foam cells
HP:6000859.definition: Presence of lipid-laden macrophages (foam cells) in the inner layer of the skin (dermis).
HP:6000859.definition_cn: 皮肤真皮层内存在脂质沉积的巨噬细胞（泡沫细胞）。

HP:6000860.name: Diminished tissue very long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
HP:6000860.definition: Diminished activity of Very long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), an enzyme that catalyzes the initial step of mitochondrial beta-oxidation of long-chain fatty acids with a chain length of 14 to 20 carbons. VLCAD activity can be measured with biochemical testing using cultured fibroblasts or lymphocytes.
HP:6000860.name_cn: 组织极长链酰基辅酶A脱氢酶活性降低
HP:6000860.definition_cn: 极长链酰基辅酶A脱氢酶（VLCAD）活性降低，该酶催化链长为14至20个碳的长链脂肪酸线粒体β-氧化的初始步骤。VLCAD活性可通过使用培养的成纤维细胞或淋巴细胞进行生化检测来测定。

HP:6000861.name: Diminished tissue glycogen branching enzyme activity
HP:6000861.definition: Activity of glycogen branching enzyme in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts.
HP:6000861.name_cn: 组织糖原分支酶活性降低
HP:6000861.definition_cn: 组织中糖原分支酶活性低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括培养的成纤维细胞。

HP:6000862.name: Parotid adenoma
HP:6000862.definition: A benign tumor of the parotid salivary gland.

HP:6000863.name: Elevated serum-ascites albumin gradient (SAAG)
HP:6000863.definition: An elevation of the serum ascites albumin gradient (SAAG), which is based on the difference between the albumin level of serum and of ascitic fluid, may be used to assess the extent of ascites. The SAAG is thought to reflect the colloid osmotic pressure gradient and the degree of portal hypertension. It has been shown that SAAG is a better discriminator of portal hypertension than ascites. A SAAG of 1.1 gm/dL or higher is considered as high, indicating the presence of portal hypertension, while SAAG less than 1.1 gm/dL is low, indicating the absence of portal hypertension.
HP:6000863.name_cn: 血清-腹水白蛋白梯度（SAAG）升高
HP:6000863.definition_cn: 血清腹水白蛋白梯度（SAAG）的升高，基于血清与腹水白蛋白水平的差异，可用于评估腹水的程度。SAAG被认为反映了胶体渗透压梯度和门静脉高压的程度。研究表明，SAAG在区分门静脉高压方面优于腹水。SAAG≥1.1 g/dL被视为高值，提示存在门静脉高压；而SAAG<1.1 g/dL则为低值，提示不存在门静脉高压。

HP:6000864.name: Transverse smile
HP:6000864.definition: Inability to raise the corners of the mouth during the act of smiling due to facial muscle weakness. The act of smiling is accompanied by a horizontal movement of the mouth.
HP:6000864.definition_cn: 由于面部肌肉无力导致微笑时无法提升口角。微笑动作伴随口部的水平运动。

HP:6000865.name: Hyperphalangy of the 4th finger
HP:6000865.definition: An accessory phalanx of the fourth (ring) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint.
HP:6000865.definition_cn: 第四指（环指）的副指骨与其他指骨呈线性排列。多指畸形是由于掌指关节处存在副骨化中心所致。

HP:6000866.name: Delayed distal femoral epiphyseal ossification
HP:6000866.definition: Developmental delay of ossification of the distal epiphysis of the femur.
HP:6000866.name_cn: 股骨远端骨骺骨化延迟
HP:6000866.definition_cn: 股骨远端骨骺骨化发育迟缓。

HP:6000867.name: Delayed tibial epiphyseal ossification
HP:6000867.definition: Developmental delay of ossification of an epiphysis of the tibia.

HP:6000868.name: Toe hyperphalangy
HP:6000868.definition: Hyperphalangy is a digit morphology in which increased numbers of phalanges are arranged linearly within a toe. That is, there is an accessory phalanx that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges.
HP:6000868.definition_cn: 多指节畸形是一种指（趾）形态学异常，表现为足趾内线性排列的指节数量增多。即存在一个与其它指节线性排列的附属指节。

HP:6000869.name: Sclerotic ilium
HP:6000869.definition: An elevation in bone density in the ilium. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.
HP:6000869.definition_cn: 髂骨骨密度增高。硬化通常在放射线照片上表现为密度增加的区域。

HP:6000870.name: Metaphyseal chevron deformity
HP:6000870.definition: The chevron sign refers to an inverted V-shape metaphyses. It is most commonly seen in the distal femur and tends to disappear with age.
HP:6000870.definition_cn: V形征（Chevron sign）是指干骺端呈现倒V形形态。该征象最常见于股骨远端，并随年龄增长而逐渐消失。

HP:6000871.name: Popcorn calcification
HP:6000871.definition: Popcorn calcifications are areas of amorphous calcifications often with rings and arcs that resemble popped corn kernels in the metaphysis and epiphysis around the growth plate.
HP:6000871.definition_cn: 爆米花样钙化是指生长板周围的干骺端和骨骺区域出现的无定形钙化区域，常呈现环状和弧状，形似爆米花颗粒。

HP:6000872.name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the calvaria
HP:6000872.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence or underdevelopment of the calvaria.
HP:6000872.name_cn: 颅盖骨发育不全/颅盖骨发育不良
HP:6000872.definition_cn: 颅骨发育不全或缺失的发育缺陷。

HP:6000873.name: Bowdler spurs
HP:6000873.definition: Transverse long bone midshaft spurs or osteochondral projections typically occuring in the fibulae and less commonly in the forearms.
HP:6000873.definition_cn: 胫骨中段横向骨刺或骨软骨突起，通常发生于腓骨，较少见于前臂。

HP:6000874.name: Delayed ossification of the clavicle
HP:6000874.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of the clavicle.

HP:6000875.name: Wide sacroiliac joint
HP:6000875.definition: Distance between the sacrum and the ilium bones of the pelvis at the sacroiliac joint is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000875.definition_cn: 骶髂关节处骶骨与骨盆髂骨之间的距离高于正常上限。

HP:6000876.name: Anti-Glutamate Receptor delta2 antibody positivity
HP:6000876.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against glutamate receptor delta2.
HP:6000876.name_cn: 抗谷氨酸受体δ2抗体阳性
HP:6000876.definition_cn: 血清中存在与谷氨酸受体δ2反应的自体抗体。

HP:6000877.name: Anti-dachshund family transcription factor 1 antibody positivity
HP:6000877.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against dachshund-homolog 1 (DACH1) autoantigen.
HP:6000877.name_cn: 抗达克斯猎犬家族转录因子1抗体阳性
HP:6000877.definition_cn: 血清中存在与达克斯猎犬同源物1（DACH1）自身抗原反应的自身抗体。

HP:6000878.name: Anti-potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 antibody positivity
HP:6000878.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against potassium channel tetramerization domain containing 16 (KCTD16).
HP:6000878.name_cn: 抗钾通道四聚化结构域包含16抗体阳性
HP:6000878.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对含钾通道四聚化结构域16（KCTD16）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6000879.name: Anti-regulator of G protein signaling 8 antibody positivity
HP:6000879.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against regulator of G-protein signaling 8 (RGS8).
HP:6000879.name_cn: 抗G蛋白信号调节因子8抗体阳性
HP:6000879.definition_cn: 血清中存在与G蛋白信号调节因子8（RGS8）反应的自身抗体。

HP:6000880.name: Anti-neurochondrin antibody positivity
HP:6000880.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against neurochondrin .
HP:6000880.name_cn: 抗神经软骨素抗体阳性
HP:6000880.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对神经软骨蛋白的自身抗体。

HP:6000881.name: Anti-DCC netrin 1 receptor antibody positivity
HP:6000881.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against Netrin-1 receptors DCC (deleted in colorectal carcinoma).
HP:6000881.definition_cn: 血清中存在针对Netrin-1受体DCC（结直肠癌缺失基因）的自身抗体。

HP:6000882.name: Anti-recoverin antibody positivity
HP:6000882.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against recoverin. Recoverins are calcium-binding proteins primarily expressed in retinal rod photoreceptors and primarily involved in phototransduction.
HP:6000882.definition_cn: 血清中存在与恢复蛋白（recoverin）反应的自身抗体。恢复蛋白是一种钙结合蛋白，主要在视网膜视杆细胞中表达，并主要参与光转导过程。

HP:6000883.name: Recent history of sedation by propofol infusion
HP:6000883.definition: A history of exposure to anesthesia by propofanol infusion recently before the presenting complaint.
HP:6000883.name_cn: 近期丙泊酚输注镇静史
HP:6000883.definition_cn: 近期在出现主诉前有丙泊酚输注麻醉暴露史。

HP:6000884.name: Enlarged humeral head
HP:6000884.definition: Size (volume) of the head of the humerus above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000884.definition_cn: 肱骨头大小（体积）超过正常上限。

HP:6000885.name: Enlarged radial head
HP:6000885.definition: Size (volume) of the head of the radius above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000885.definition_cn: 桡骨头大小（体积）超出正常上限。

HP:6000886.name: Enlarged distal tibial epiphysis
HP:6000886.definition: Size (volume) of the distal epiphysis of the tiba above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000886.definition_cn: 胫骨远端骨骺大小（体积）超出正常上限。

HP:6000887.name: Elevated blood bismuth concentration
HP:6000887.definition: The concentration of bismuth in the blood is above the upper limit of a guidance value for total blood bismuth concentrations that implies possible injurious effects.
HP:6000887.definition_cn: 血液中铋的浓度超过了全血铋浓度指导值的上限，提示可能存在有害效应。

HP:6000888.name: Elevated urine bismuth level
HP:6000888.definition: Detection of a level of bismuth in the urine high enough to raise the suspicion of bismuth toxicity, usually greater than 20microgram per deciliter.
HP:6000888.definition_cn: 尿液中铋水平检测结果足以引起铋中毒的怀疑，通常高于20微克/分升。

HP:6000889.name: Distal radioulnar joint dislocation
HP:6000889.definition: Distal radioulnar joint dislocation is more commonly displaced dorsally (i.e. the distal ulna is dorsally dislocated with respect to the distal radius), but can be volarly displaced.
HP:6000889.definition_cn: 桡尺远侧关节脱位更常见于背侧移位（即尺骨远端相对于桡骨远端向背侧脱位），但也可能发生掌侧移位。

HP:6000890.name: Proximal radioulnar joint dislocation
HP:6000890.definition: he proximal radioulnar translocation means that both the radius and ulna are dislocated from the humerus.
HP:6000890.definition_cn: 桡尺骨近端移位意味着桡骨和尺骨均从肱骨脱位。

HP:6000891.name: Absent toe phalanx flexion crease
HP:6000891.definition: Absence of one or more interphalangeal creases of a toe (i.e., of the transverse lines in the skin between the phalanges of the toes).
HP:6000891.definition_cn: 趾间皱褶缺失（即趾骨间皮肤横纹缺失）。

HP:6000892.name: White matter globoid cells
HP:6000892.definition: Multinucleated phagocytes in the cerebral white matter, typically are 10-15 micrometers in diameter, that contain fatty filamentous inclusions that stain positive for periodic acid-Schiff (PAS), which may be phagocytized myelin, as these cells are often found in proximity to sites where demyelination is prominent. Globoid cells have been to thought to originate from CNS resident microglia and/or infiltrating peripheral macrophages.
HP:6000892.definition_cn: 脑白质中的多核吞噬细胞，通常直径为10-15微米，含有脂肪丝状包涵体，这些包涵体对过碘酸-希夫（PAS）染色呈阳性反应，可能是被吞噬的髓鞘，因为这些细胞通常出现在脱髓鞘显著的部位附近。球状细胞被认为起源于中枢神经系统（CNS）驻留的小胶质细胞和/或浸润的外周巨噬细胞。

HP:6000893.name: Gaucher cells
HP:6000893.definition: Glucosylceramide forms fibrillar aggregates that accumulate in macrophages and result in the cell cytoplasm presenting a characteristic crumpled tissue paper appearance. These cells, known as Gaucher cells, infiltrate various organs (e.g., bone marrow, spleen, and liver) and are responsible for the major signs of Gaucher disease.
HP:6000893.definition_cn: 葡萄糖神经酰胺形成纤维状聚集体，这些聚集体在巨噬细胞内积累，导致细胞质呈现特征性的皱褶纸巾样外观。这些细胞被称为戈谢细胞，它们浸润多个器官（例如骨髓、脾脏和肝脏），并导致戈谢病的主要临床表现。

HP:6000894.name: Breast adenoma
HP:6000894.definition: A benign, well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the breast.
HP:6000894.definition_cn: 乳腺良性、边界清晰的肿瘤。

HP:6000895.name: Breast apocrine adenoma
HP:6000895.definition: A type of breast adenoma composed of benign apocrine cells.
HP:6000895.definition_cn: 一种由良性顶浆分泌细胞组成的乳腺腺瘤。

HP:6000896.name: Fibrocystic breast lesion
HP:6000896.definition: A type of benign cyst or cysts in breast tissue that are typically mobile within the glandular breast tissue, chest wall, and skin and are rubber-like in texture. The main histological features are an extracellular matrix of collagen, peri canalicular patterns of stromal cells with the presence of florid epithelial hyperplasia.
HP:6000896.definition_cn: 一种良性囊肿或乳腺组织中的囊肿，通常在腺体乳腺组织、胸壁和皮肤内可移动，质地类似橡胶。主要组织学特征为胶原蛋白构成的细胞外基质、导管周围模式的基质细胞以及存在旺盛的上皮增生。

HP:6000897.name: Pancreatic VIPoma
HP:6000897.definition: A type of neuroendocrine tumor that originates in the pancreas and secretes excessive amounts of vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP).
HP:6000897.definition_cn: 一种起源于胰腺的神经内分泌肿瘤，其分泌过量的血管活性肠肽（VIP）。

HP:6000898.name: Gastric carcinoid tumor
HP:6000898.definition: Originating from enterochromaffin-like cells, gastric carcinoid tumors are rare tumors that develop within the gastric mucosa. They can present as an isolated lesion or there can be multiple lesions. The tumor can invade locally into deeper structures of the gastrointestinal tract wall. Solitary gastric carcinoids have a greater chance for the development of malignancy and metastasis as compared to multiple gastric carcinoids due to hypergastrinemia.
HP:6000898.definition_cn: 胃类癌起源于肠嗜铬样细胞，是一种罕见的肿瘤，发生于胃黏膜内。可表现为孤立性病变或多发性病变。肿瘤可局部侵袭至胃肠道壁的深层结构。与多发性胃类癌相比，由于高胃泌素血症，孤立性胃类癌发生恶性和转移的风险更高。

HP:6000899.name: Posiitve skin scabies test
HP:6000899.definition: Identification of scabies by means of an examination of the skin such as microscopic identification of scabies mites, eggs, or feces from obtained scales by skin scraping.
HP:6000899.definition_cn: 通过皮肤检查（如显微镜下鉴定从皮肤刮屑中获取的疥螨、虫卵或粪便）来识别疥疮。

HP:6000900.name: Positive mumps virus PCR test in the blood circulation
HP:6000900.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of the mumps virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.
HP:6000900.name_cn: 血液中腮腺炎病毒PCR检测阳性
HP:6000900.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）或逆转录酶（RT）-PCR等方法检测血液循环中腮腺炎病毒的核酸。

HP:6000901.name: Positive bloodstream tuberculosis-induced T-cell-based interferon-gamma release assay
HP:6000901.definition: Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in the bloodstream by means of detection of interferon-gamma secreted by T cells in response to specific antigens from Mycobacterium tuberculosis, commonly 6kD early secretory antigenic target-6 and 10kD culture filtrate protein-10.
HP:6000901.name_cn: 结核病诱导的基于T细胞的γ-干扰素释放试验阳性血液检测
HP:6000901.definition_cn: 通过检测T细胞对结核分枝杆菌特异性抗原（通常为6kD早期分泌抗原靶标-6和10kD培养滤液蛋白-10）反应所分泌的γ-干扰素，以检测血液中结核分枝杆菌的存在。

HP:6000902.name: Positive blood Neisseria gonorrhoeae culture
HP:6000902.definition: Growth of Neisseria gonorrhoeae in a culture derived from circulating blood.
HP:6000902.name_cn: 血液淋病奈瑟菌培养阳性
HP:6000902.definition_cn: 从循环血液培养物中分离出淋病奈瑟菌的生长。

HP:6000903.name: Anti-mumps antibody positivity
HP:6000903.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Mumps virus.
HP:6000903.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对腮腺炎病毒成分的抗体。

HP:6000904.name: Positive Vibrio cholerae stool culture
HP:6000904.definition: Growth of Vibrio cholerae in a culture derived from a feces sample.
HP:6000904.name_cn: 粪便培养阳性霍乱弧菌
HP:6000904.definition_cn: 从粪便样本培养物中分离出的霍乱弧菌生长情况。

HP:6000905.name: Positive cutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test
HP:6000905.definition: Detection of mucocutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid in the skin by a method such as polymerase chain reaction. The sample is usually obtained by swab from skin or mucous membranes.
HP:6000905.name_cn: 皮肤水痘-带状疱疹病毒核酸检测阳性
HP:6000905.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测皮肤或黏膜中的水痘-带状疱疹病毒（Varicella Zoster Virus, VZV）核酸。样本通常通过皮肤或黏膜拭子采集获得。

HP:6000906.name: Positive bloodstream cryptococcus culture
HP:6000906.definition: Growth of Cryptococcus in a culture derived from a blood sample.

HP:6000907.name: Positive bloodstream Borrelia miyamotoi nucleic acid test
HP:6000907.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Borrelia miyamotoi in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000907.name_cn: 血液中伯氏疏螺旋体（Borrelia miyamotoi）核酸检测阳性
HP:6000907.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中的宫本疏螺旋体（Borrelia miyamotoi）核酸。

HP:6000908.name: Positive bloodstream Coxsackievirus nucleic acid pathogen test
HP:6000908.definition: Detection of nucleic acid of Coxsackievirus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).
HP:6000908.name_cn: 血液中柯萨奇病毒核酸病原体检测阳性
HP:6000908.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链式反应（PCR）等方法检测血液循环中的柯萨奇病毒核酸。

HP:6000909.name: Positive stool Cryptosporidium antigen test
HP:6000909.definition: Fecal analysis for Cryptosporidium antigen is abnormal. Tests include direct fluorescent-antibody (DFA), which detects intact organisms, and enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), which detect soluble stool antigens.
HP:6000909.name_cn: 粪便隐孢子虫抗原检测阳性
HP:6000909.definition_cn: 粪便隐孢子虫抗原检测结果异常。检测方法包括直接荧光抗体法（DFA），用于检测完整病原体，以及酶免疫分析法（EIA），用于检测粪便中的可溶性抗原。

HP:6000910.name: Diminished tissue alpha-L-iduronidase activity
HP:6000910.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-L-iduronidase (IDUA; EC 3.2.1.76) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.
HP:6000910.name_cn: 组织α-L-艾杜糖苷酶活性降低
HP:6000910.definition_cn: α-L-艾杜糖苷酶（IDUA；EC 3.2.1.76）的浓度或活性低于正常下限。FECH酶可在多种组织中测定，包括培养的成纤维细胞和白细胞。

HP:6000911.name: Reduced tissue neuraminidase activity
HP:6000911.definition: Activity of neuraminidase (EC 3.2.1.18)in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts. Neuraminidase is also known as lysosomal sialidase.
HP:6000911.name_cn: 组织神经氨酸酶活性降低
HP:6000911.definition_cn: 神经氨酸酶（EC 3.2.1.18）活性在组织中的水平低于正常下限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括培养的成纤维细胞。神经氨酸酶也被称为溶酶体唾液酸酶。

HP:6000912.name: Nummular keratitis
HP:6000912.definition: Nummular keratitis consists of multiple scattered small round anterior corneal superficial stromal infiltrates.
HP:6000912.definition_cn: 钱币状角膜炎表现为多个散在的圆形前角膜浅基质层浸润。

HP:6000913.name: Swelling of inguinal region
HP:6000913.definition: Bulging in the area of the lower abdomen, just above the thigh and near the groin.
HP:6000913.definition_cn: 腹股沟区下腹部膨隆，位于大腿上方近腹股沟处。

HP:6000914.name: Single lesion
HP:6000914.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are solitary and localized to a part of the skin, a tissue or an organ that differs from the surrounding healthy tissue.
HP:6000914.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常，其分布和外观为孤立性且局限于皮肤、组织或器官的一部分，与周围健康组织不同。

HP:6000915.name: Dysorthography
HP:6000915.definition: A specific disorder of spelling. A score on a standardized spelling test is at least two standard errors of prediction below the level expected on the basis of the child's chronological age and general intelligence in the context of scores on reading accuracy and comprehension and on arithmetic that are within the normal range (within two standard deviations from the mean).
HP:6000915.definition_cn: 特定性拼写障碍。在标准化拼写测试中，得分至少比基于儿童实际年龄和一般智力水平预期的得分低两个预测标准误差，且阅读准确性和理解力以及算术得分均在正常范围内（在平均值两个标准差以内）。

HP:6000916.name: Echogenic fetal colon
HP:6000916.definition: A type of echogenic fetal bowel in which the hyperechogenicity is strictly limited to the colon.
HP:6000916.definition_cn: 一种回声增强型胎儿肠管，其回声增强严格局限于结肠。

HP:6000917.name: Bone marrow edema
HP:6000917.definition: Accumulation of excess fluid in the bone marrow.

HP:6000918.name: Transverse terminal upper limb defect
HP:6000918.definition: A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the arm, e.g. humerus, proximal forearm, wrist or finger. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.
HP:6000918.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，表现为上肢不同水平的截肢，例如肱骨、前臂近端、腕部或手指。肢体缺失末端（远端）节段，而缺失节段近端的所有节段均保留。

HP:6000919.name: Trousseau sign
HP:6000919.definition: After inflating a blood pressure cuff from 10 mm Hg to 20 mm Hg over the patient's systolic blood pressure, the Trousseau sign is considered positive if carpal spasm develops, with flexion of the thumb and adduction of the finger within 3 minutes. However, this can be painful, so the time should be noted, and the cuff should be deflated once the test is positive.
HP:6000919.definition_cn: 在将血压袖带充气至超过患者收缩压10 mmHg至20 mmHg后，如果在3分钟内出现腕部痉挛，伴有拇指屈曲和手指内收，则Trousseau征被视为阳性。然而，此操作可能引起疼痛，因此应记录时间，并在测试呈阳性后立即放气。

HP:6000920.name: Craniocervical junction constriction
HP:6000920.definition: Congenital or acquired abnormalities of the occipital bone, foramen magnum, or first two cervical vertebrae that decrease the space for the lower brain stem and cervical cord. These malformations can lead to cranial nerve compression, vertebral artery compression, and obstructive hydrocephalus.
HP:6000920.definition_cn: 枕骨、枕骨大孔或前两节颈椎的先天性或获得性异常，导致下脑干和颈髓空间减少。这些畸形可导致颅神经受压、椎动脉受压以及梗阻性脑积水。

HP:6000921.name: Fibular torsion
HP:6000921.definition: Excessively rotated (also called torsion) position of the fibula (calf bone). An increased external rotation of the fibula in the incisura tibiofibularis of more than 5 degrees may lead to an increased pressure and will negatively affect the cartilage.
HP:6000921.definition_cn: 腓骨（小腿骨）过度旋转（也称为扭转）的位置。在胫腓切迹中，腓骨外旋增加超过5度可能导致压力增加，并对软骨产生负面影响。

HP:6000922.name: Abnormal finger phalanx ossification
HP:6000922.definition: Any abnormal process of ossification of the phalangeal bones, which normally are ossified from the body and proximal extremity. Ossification of the body commences during the eighth week of fetal development. Ossification of the proximal extremity commences in the bones between the third and fourth years.
HP:6000922.definition_cn: 指骨骨化的任何异常过程，正常情况下指骨从骨体和近端开始骨化。骨体的骨化始于胎儿发育的第八周。近端的骨化始于第三至第四年之间的骨骼。

HP:6000923.name: Positive bloodstream EBV monospot test
HP:6000923.definition: The monospot test is a latex agglutination test which utilizes equine erythrocytes as the primary substrate and tests for specific heterophile antibodies produced by the human immune system in response to EBV infection. When these specific antibodies are present in the patient's blood specimen, exposure to equine erythrocytes will lead to clumping of the sample, thus signaling a positive agglutination reaction.
HP:6000923.name_cn: 血液EB病毒单点试验阳性
HP:6000923.definition_cn: 单点试验是一种乳胶凝集试验，其以马红细胞为主要底物，检测人体免疫系统在EB病毒感染后产生的特异性异嗜性抗体。当患者血液样本中存在这些特异性抗体时，与马红细胞接触将导致样本凝集，从而指示阳性凝集反应。

HP:6000924.name: Positive CSF Toxoplasma gondii antibody positivity
HP:6000924.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Toxoplasma gondii.
HP:6000924.name_cn: 脑脊液弓形虫抗体阳性
HP:6000924.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对弓形虫（Toxoplasma gondii）某一组分的抗体。

HP:6000925.name: Positive tuberculin skin test
HP:6000925.definition: A positive result of the tuberculin skin test suggesting previous expouse or infection with mycobacterium teberculosis. A standard dose of five tuberculin units (TU) (0.1ml) is injected intradermally (into the skin) and read 48 to 72 h later. A person who has been exposed to the bacteria is expected to mount an immune response in the skin containing the bacterial proteins. The volar aspect of the forearm is the preferred site of test. The basis of reading is the presence or absence of induration, which may be determined by inspection (from a side view against the light as well as by direct light) and by palpation. For standardization, the diameter of induration should be measured transversely to the long axis of the forearm and recorded in millimeters.
HP:6000925.name_cn: 结核菌素皮肤试验阳性
HP:6000925.definition_cn: 结核菌素皮肤试验阳性结果提示既往暴露或感染结核分枝杆菌。标准剂量为5个结核菌素单位（TU）（0.1毫升），皮内注射（注入皮肤），并在48至72小时后读取结果。暴露于该细菌的个体预计会在含有细菌蛋白的皮肤部位产生免疫反应。前臂掌侧是首选的测试部位。读取结果的基础是硬结的存在与否，可通过视诊（从侧面观察光线照射下的情况以及直接光线照射）和触诊来确定。为标准化起见，硬结直径应垂直于前臂长轴测量，并以毫米为单位记录。

HP:6000926.name: Anti-Treponema pallidum antibody positivity
HP:6000926.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Treponema pallidum.
HP:6000926.name_cn: 抗梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性
HP:6000926.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对梅毒螺旋体（Treponema pallidum）成分的抗体。

HP:6000927.name: Positive CSF Borrelia burgdorferi antibody positivity
HP:6000927.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Borrelia burgdorferi.
HP:6000927.name_cn: 脑脊液伯氏疏螺旋体抗体阳性
HP:6000927.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对伯氏疏螺旋体（Borrelia burgdorferi）某一组分的抗体。

HP:6000928.name: Positive CSF JC-virus antibody positivity
HP:6000928.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of JC-virus (also known as JC-polyomavirus and John Cunningham virus).
HP:6000928.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对JC病毒（也称为JC多瘤病毒和约翰·坎宁安病毒）某一成分的抗体。

HP:6000929.name: Neutralizing anti-rabies virus antibody positivity
HP:6000929.definition: The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that act against the rabies virus function by blocking the binding of the glycoprotein to a receptor or preventing the membrane fusion process.
HP:6000929.name_cn: 中和抗狂犬病病毒抗体阳性
