HP:6000929.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在的针对狂犬病病毒的抗体通过阻断糖蛋白与受体的结合或阻止膜融合过程发挥作用。

HP:6000930.name: Impaired hepatobiliary scintigraphy tracer uptake
HP:6000930.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of radioactive tracer uptake upon hepatobiliary scintigraphy.
HP:6000930.definition_cn: 肝胆显像中放射性示踪剂摄取量的异常减少。

HP:6000931.name: Calcified pulmonary nodule
HP:6000931.definition: A pulmonary nodule with calcium deposits. On radiography, these nodules appear dense.
HP:6000931.definition_cn: 钙化性肺结节。在放射影像学上，这些结节呈现高密度影。

HP:6000932.name: Postprandial exacerbation
HP:6000932.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe following a meal.
HP:6000932.definition_cn: 餐后加重的体征或症状。

HP:6000933.name: Koebner Phenomenon
HP:6000933.definition: The appearance of new skin lesions on previously unaffected skin secondary to trauma. This phenomenon is also termed the isomorphic (from Greek, equal shape) response, given the fact that the new lesions that appear are clinically and histologically identical to the patient's underlying cutaneous disease.
HP:6000933.definition_cn: 继发于创伤后在先前未受累皮肤上出现的新皮损。这种现象也被称为同形反应（源自希腊语，意为相同形状），因为新出现的皮损在临床和组织学上与患者原有的皮肤疾病完全相同。

HP:6000934.name: Glenoid dysplasia
HP:6000934.definition: Glenoid dysplasia is a developmental anomaly of the scapula that is characterized by a bony deficiency of the posteroinferior glenoid and the adjacent scapular neck.
HP:6000934.definition_cn: 肩盂发育不良是一种肩胛骨的发育异常，其特征是肩盂后下部及邻近肩胛颈的骨性缺损。

HP:6000935.name: Prolonged retraction of penile foreskin
HP:6000935.definition: A past medical history of recently having retracted the penile foreskin for a prolonged period of time. Paraphimosis commonly occurs iatrogenically, when the foreskin is retracted for cleaning, placement of a urinary catheter, a procedure such as a cystoscopy, or for penile examination. Failure to return the retracted foreskin over the glans promptly after the initial retraction can lead to paraphimosis.
HP:6000935.definition_cn: 既往病史中曾长时间回缩阴茎包皮。包茎嵌顿通常由医源性因素引起，如清洁、放置导尿管、膀胱镜检查或阴茎检查时回缩包皮。初次回缩后未能及时将包皮复位至龟头上方可导致包茎嵌顿。

HP:6000936.name: Thickened cortex of the clavicle
HP:6000936.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the clavicle.

HP:6000937.name: Thickened cortex of the mandible
HP:6000937.definition: Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the mandible.

HP:6000938.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 1
HP:6000938.definition: Minor hypoplasia (developmental undergrowth) of the thumb, whereby all musculoskeletal and neurovascular components of the digit are present, just small in size (Blauth classification).
HP:6000938.definition_cn: 拇指轻度发育不全（发育不良），其中该手指的所有肌肉骨骼和神经血管成分均存在，仅体积较小（Blauth分类）。

HP:6000939.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 2
HP:6000939.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby all of the osseous structures are present (may be small), and there is metacarpophalangeal joint ulnar collateral ligament instability and thenar hypoplasia.
HP:6000939.definition_cn: 一种拇指发育不全的类型，其中所有骨性结构均存在（可能较小），并伴有掌指关节尺侧副韧带不稳定及鱼际肌发育不全。

HP:6000940.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3A
HP:6000940.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies with the carpometacarpal (CMC) joint intact. Absence of active motion at the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint.
HP:6000940.definition_cn: 一种拇指发育不全的类型，表现为肌肉肌腱和骨骼缺陷，但腕掌关节（CMC）完整。掌指关节（MCP）或指间关节（IP）无主动运动。

HP:6000941.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3B
HP:6000941.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies characterized by basal metacarpal aplasia with deficient carpometacarpal (CMC) joint, and absence of metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint.
HP:6000941.definition_cn: 一种拇指发育不全的类型，表现为肌肉肌腱和骨骼的缺陷，特征为基底掌骨发育不全伴腕掌关节（CMC）缺失，以及掌指关节（MCP）或指间关节（IP）缺如。

HP:6000942.name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 4
HP:6000942.definition: A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb characterized by attachment to the hand only by the skin and digital neurovascular structures.
HP:6000942.definition_cn: 一种拇指发育不全的类型，其特征是仅通过皮肤和指神经血管结构与手部相连。

HP:6000943.name: Femoral osteopoikilosis
HP:6000943.definition: Multiple multiple, small, well-defined radiodense foci of cortical-like bone in the medullary space parallel to the trabeculae located in the femur. The loci correspond to condensations of the lamellar trabeculae on histology.
HP:6000943.definition_cn: 股骨骨髓腔内可见多个、小型、边界清晰的放射密度增高灶，呈皮质样骨结构，与骨小梁平行排列。组织学上，这些病灶对应于板层骨小梁的致密化。

HP:6000944.name: Carotidynia
HP:6000944.definition: Pain or tenderness in the region of the carotid artery.
HP:6000944.definition_cn: 颈动脉区域疼痛或压痛。

HP:6000945.name: Asymmetric blood pressure between arms
HP:6000945.definition: A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left arms.
HP:6000945.definition_cn: 左右臂血压显著差异（例如，20 mmHg）。

HP:6000946.name: Transverse terminal lower limb defect
HP:6000946.definition: A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the leg, e.g. femur, foreleg, ankle or toe. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.
HP:6000946.definition_cn: 一种先天性畸形，表现为下肢不同水平的截肢，例如股骨、小腿、踝关节或脚趾。肢体缺失末端（远端）节段，而缺失节段近端的所有节段均保留。

HP:6000947.name: Hemimelia of lower leg
HP:6000947.definition: A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the lower leg (eg tibia and fibula), ankle and foot.
HP:6000947.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷导致的下肢横向缺失，包括小腿（如胫骨和腓骨）、踝关节和足部的缺失。

HP:6000948.name: Hemimelia of forearm
HP:6000948.definition: A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the forearm (eg ulna and radius), wrist and hand.
HP:6000948.definition_cn: 发育缺陷导致横向缺损，表现为前臂（如尺骨和桡骨）、腕部和手部缺失。

HP:6000949.name: Sodium glucose transport inhibitor exposure
HP:6000949.definition: History of having been treateed with a sodium glucose transport inhibitors such as dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, canagliflozin, sglt-i, SGLT2, bexagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin, jardiance, invokana, forxiga, brenzavvy, steglatro, inpefa.
HP:6000949.name_cn: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白抑制剂暴露
HP:6000949.definition_cn: 曾接受钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白抑制剂（SGLT抑制剂）治疗史，包括达格列净（Dapagliflozin）、恩格列净（Empagliflozin）、卡格列净（Canagliflozin）、SGLT-I、SGLT2、贝格列净（Bexagliflozin）、厄格列净（Ertugliflozin）、索格列净（Sotagliflozin）、Jardiance（恩格列净商品名）、Invokana（卡格列净商品名）、Forxiga（达格列净商品名）、Brenzavvy（贝格列净商品名）、Steglatro（厄格列净商品名）、Inpefa（索格列净商品名）。

HP:6000950.name: Breath-holding spell
HP:6000950.definition: A benign paroxysmal nonepileptic disorder occurring in healthy children 6 to 48 months of age. The episodes start with a provocation such as emotional upset or minor injury, and might progress to breath holding, cyanosis, and syncope.
HP:6000950.definition_cn: 一种良性阵发性非癫痫性发作，常见于6至48个月的健康儿童。发作通常由情绪激动或轻微外伤等诱因引发，可能进展为屏气、发绀和晕厥。

HP:6000951.name: Flared proximal tibial metaphysis
HP:6000951.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the proximal tibia.
HP:6000951.definition_cn: 胫骨近端干骺端节段呈外展（即，外翻）形态。

HP:6000952.name: Delayed toe phalanx ossification
HP:6000952.definition: Delayed maturation and calcification of any of the toe phalanges.
HP:6000952.definition_cn: 任何足趾指骨的成熟和钙化延迟。

HP:6000953.name: Sorbitol ingestion
HP:6000953.definition: A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing sorbitol.
HP:6000953.definition_cn: 既往有摄入大量含山梨醇食物的病史。

HP:6000954.name: Positive peritoneal fluid bacterial culture
HP:6000954.definition: Growth of bacteria in a culture dervied from ascites fluid.
HP:6000954.definition_cn: 腹水培养物中细菌的生长。

HP:6000955.name: Ocular cystine crystal deposition
HP:6000955.definition: Accumulation of cystine crsytals in the eye. Patients present with crystal accumulation affecting the cornea and conjunctiva, but crystals can also be deposited in the iris, ciliary body, choroid and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE), and lens capsule. Corneal crystal deposition starts in infancy in the anterior periphery of the cornea, and progresses centrally and posteriorly. The crystals, which have a fine, uniform needle-shaped structure, are diffusely distributed within the corneal tissues.
HP:6000955.definition_cn: 眼内胱氨酸结晶的积聚。患者表现为角膜和结膜中的结晶积聚，但结晶也可沉积于虹膜、睫状体、脉络膜、视网膜色素上皮（RPE）以及晶状体囊中。角膜结晶沉积始于婴儿期，位于角膜前周边部，并逐渐向中央和后方进展。这些结晶具有细长、均匀的针状结构，广泛分布于角膜组织内。

HP:6000956.name: Exuberant granulation tissue
HP:6000956.definition: A manifestation of abnormal wound healing in which there is formation of excessive granulation tissue, with the granulation tissue rising above the level of surrounding skin and creating a raised, reddish, moist, and bumpy surface.
HP:6000956.definition_cn: 异常伤口愈合的一种表现，其特征为过度肉芽组织形成，肉芽组织高于周围皮肤水平，形成隆起、红色、湿润且凹凸不平的表面。

HP:6000957.name: Oral mucosal papule
HP:6000957.definition: A small (less than 5 mm in diameter), elevated, circumscribed, solid, palpable mass located in thte mucosa of the oral cavity.
HP:6000957.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜内直径小于5毫米、隆起、界限清楚、实性、可触及的肿块。

HP:6000958.name: Excessive piloerection
HP:6000958.definition: Abnormally increased degree of goose bump formation, that is, of involuntary formation of bumps on a person's skin at the base of body hairs.
HP:6000958.definition_cn: 异常增强的立毛反应，即体毛根部皮肤不自主形成丘疹的程度增加。

HP:6000959.name: Scalp edema
HP:6000959.definition: A palpable swelling in the scalp caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid).
HP:6000959.definition_cn: 头皮可触及的肿胀，由间质液体积增加（液体过量）引起。

HP:6000960.name: Serpiginous burrow
HP:6000960.definition: A slightly raised and often reddish serpentine or curvilinear path in the skin.
HP:6000960.definition_cn: 皮肤上略微隆起且常呈红色的蜿蜒或曲线状路径。

HP:6000961.name: Positive brain-tissue rabies nucleic acid test
HP:6000961.definition: Detection of rabies nucleic acid in brain tissue by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000961.name_cn: 脑组织狂犬病核酸阳性检测
HP:6000961.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应等方法检测脑组织中的狂犬病核酸。

HP:6000962.name: Positive respiratory tract Bordetella pertussis nucleic acid test
HP:6000962.definition: Detection of Bordetella pertussis PCR nucleic acid in in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6000962.name_cn: 呼吸道博德特氏菌核酸阳性检测
HP:6000962.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（PCR）等方法检测鼻咽分泌物中的百日咳鲍特菌（Bordetella pertussis）核酸。

HP:6000963.name: Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli in wound tissue
HP:6000963.definition: Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli by microscopic examination of wound tissue. Acid fastness is a physical property that gives a bacterium the ability to resist decolorization by acids during staining procedures.
HP:6000963.name_cn: 伤口组织中抗酸杆菌的检测
HP:6000963.definition_cn: 通过伤口组织的显微镜检查展示抗酸杆菌。抗酸性是一种物理特性，使细菌在染色过程中能够抵抗酸的脱色作用。

HP:6000964.name: Positive tissue encapsulated budding yeast test
HP:6000964.definition: Identification of encapsulated budding yeasts in smears of body fluids, secretions, exudates, or other specimens.
HP:6000964.name_cn: 组织包膜内芽生酵母菌检测阳性
HP:6000964.definition_cn: 体液中包膜芽生酵母菌的涂片鉴定，包括分泌物、渗出物或其他样本。

HP:6000965.name: Positive tissue coccidioidomycosis culture
HP:6000965.definition: Growth of coccidioidomycosis in a culture derived from skin or an organ.
HP:6000965.name_cn: 组织球孢子菌病培养阳性
HP:6000965.definition_cn: 皮肤或器官培养物中球孢子菌病的生长。

HP:6000966.name: Diminished tissue dihydropteridine reductase activity
HP:6000966.definition: Concentration or activity of dihydropteridine reductase (EC 1.6.99.7) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and erythrocytes.
HP:6000966.name_cn: 组织二氢蝶啶还原酶活性降低
HP:6000966.definition_cn: 二氢蝶啶还原酶（EC 1.6.99.7）的浓度或活性低于正常下限。该酶可在多种组织中测定，包括白细胞和红细胞。

HP:6000967.name: Decreased circulating transcobalamin I concentration
HP:6000967.definition: Concentration of transcobalamin I in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000967.name_cn: 循环中钴胺素转运蛋白I浓度降低
HP:6000967.definition_cn: 循环血液中转钴胺素I浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000968.name: Diminished circulating cationic trypsinogen concentration
HP:6000968.definition: Concentration of cationic trypsinogen in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000968.name_cn: 循环阳离子胰蛋白酶原浓度降低
HP:6000968.definition_cn: 血液中阳离子胰蛋白酶原浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000969.name: Diminished circulating hyaluronidase activity
HP:6000969.definition: The activity or concentration of hyaluronidase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000969.name_cn: 循环透明质酸酶活性降低
HP:6000969.definition_cn: 循环血液中透明质酸酶的活性或浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000970.name: Diminished sulfotransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6000970.definition: Rate of proteoglycan sulfation (sulfotransferase activity) is below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP:6000970.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中磺基转移酶活性降低
HP:6000970.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中蛋白聚糖硫酸化率（硫酸转移酶活性）低于正常下限。

HP:6000971.name: Elevated tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
HP:6000971.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) above the upper limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.
HP:6000971.name_cn: 组织α-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶活性升高
HP:6000971.definition_cn: α-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶（EC 3.2.1.50）的浓度或活性高于正常上限。该酶可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。该酶也被称为α-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶、N-乙酰-α-D-氨基葡萄糖苷酶、N-乙酰-α-氨基葡萄糖苷酶和α-D-2-乙酰氨基-2-脱氧葡萄糖苷酶。

HP:6000972.name: Abnormal tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
HP:6000972.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) outside of the limits of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.
HP:6000972.name_cn: 组织α-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶活性异常
HP:6000972.definition_cn: α-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶（EC 3.2.1.50）的浓度或活性超出正常范围。该酶可在多种组织中检测，包括白细胞和培养的成纤维细胞。该酶亦称为α-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶、N-乙酰-α-D-氨基葡萄糖苷酶、N-乙酰-α-氨基葡萄糖苷酶及α-D-2-乙酰氨基-2-脱氧葡萄糖苷酶。

HP:6000973.name: Elevated circulating trihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration
HP:6000973.definition: The concentration of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000973.name_cn: 循环中三羟基胆甾烷酸浓度升高
HP:6000973.definition_cn: 血液循环中三羟基胆甾烷酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000974.name: Elevated circulating glyoxylic acid concentration
HP:6000974.definition: The concentration of glyoxylic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000974.name_cn: 循环中乙醛酸浓度升高
HP:6000974.definition_cn: 血液循环中乙醛酸浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6000975.name: Elevated CSF sepiapterin concentration
HP:6000975.definition: Concentration of sepiapterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000975.name_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中七蝶呤浓度升高
HP:6000975.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中墨蝶呤浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6000976.name: Intrahepatic inclusion bodies
HP:6000976.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within hepatocytes.
HP:6000976.definition_cn: 肝细胞内可染色物质的核内或胞质内聚集物。

HP:6000977.name: Muscle vacuoles
HP:6000977.definition: Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. The vacuoles are often associated with cytoplasmic and occasionally intranuclear eosinophilic inclusions.
HP:6000977.definition_cn: 肌膜内存在异常空泡（膜结合细胞器）。这些空泡常与胞质内嗜酸性包涵体相关，偶见核内嗜酸性包涵体。

HP:6000978.name: Nonrimmed muscule vacuoles
HP:6000978.definition: Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. On histological staining with hematoxylin and eosin, non-rimmed vacuoles lack the prominent dark border (rim) seen in rimmed vacuoles.
HP:6000978.definition_cn: 肌膜中存在异常空泡（膜结合细胞器）。在苏木精和伊红组织学染色中，非边缘空泡缺乏边缘空泡中可见的显著暗色边界（边缘）。

HP:6000979.name: Reduced hepatic glycogen phosphorylase activity
HP:6000979.definition: Activity or concentration of glycogen phosphorylase L in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6000979.name_cn: 肝糖原磷酸化酶活性降低
HP:6000979.definition_cn: 肝糖原磷酸化酶L活性或浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6000980.name: Bone marrow hemophagocytosis
HP:6000980.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the bone marrow.
HP:6000980.definition_cn: 骨髓中观察到组织细胞或巨噬细胞对红细胞、淋巴细胞或其他造血前体细胞的吞噬现象。

HP:6000981.name: Splenic granulomatosis
HP:6000981.definition: Splenic inflammation involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.
HP:6000981.definition_cn: 脾脏炎症涉及肉芽肿反应，即一种非特异性炎症反应，涉及肉芽肿，定义为由成熟单核吞噬细胞（包括上皮样细胞和多核巨细胞）组成的紧密有序的集合。

HP:6000982.name: Immediate detumescence of penis at time of symptom onset
HP:6000982.definition: Loss of erection at the time point of pain or other symptom onset.
HP:6000982.name_cn: 症状发作时阴茎立即消肿
HP:6000982.definition_cn: 在疼痛或其他症状发作时出现勃起功能障碍。

HP:6000983.name: History of aortic valve replacement
HP:6000983.definition: History of having received a surgical replacement of the aortic valve.

HP:6000984.name: Coved type ST segment elevation
HP:6000984.definition: An ST-segment elevation of at least 2 mm in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by an r'-wave and a concave or straight ST segment. The descending ST segment crosses the isoelectric line and is followed by a negative and symmetric T-wave.
HP:6000984.definition_cn: 至少一个右胸导联（V1至V3）中ST段抬高至少2毫米，随后出现r'波和凹形或直线型ST段。下降的ST段穿过等电位线，随后出现负向且对称的T波。

HP:6000985.name: Saddle-back type ST segment elevation
HP:6000985.definition: An ST-segment elevation of at least 0.5 mm (generally at least 2 mm in V2) in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by a convex ST. The r'-wave may or may not overlap the J point, but it has a slow downward slope. The ST segment is followed by a positive T-wave in V2 and is of variable morphology in V1.
HP:6000985.definition_cn: 至少一个右胸导联（V1至V3）中ST段抬高至少0.5毫米（通常在V2导联中至少2毫米），随后为凸起的ST段。r'波可能与J点重叠，也可能不重叠，但其具有缓慢的下降斜率。ST段之后在V2导联中跟随一个正向T波，而在V1导联中其形态可变。

HP:6000986.name: Substantially elevated circulating ethanol concentration
HP:6000986.definition: A blood concentration of ethanol that is consistent with alcohol intoxication, generally assumed to be 0.0800 g/dL or higher.
HP:6000986.name_cn: 循环乙醇浓度显著升高
HP:6000986.definition_cn: 血液中乙醇浓度达到酒精中毒水平，通常假定为0.0800克/分升或更高。

HP:6000987.name: Tortuous appearance of the stomach
HP:6000987.definition: Abnormal twisting or winding of the stomach.

HP:6000988.name: Cochlear nerve aplasia
HP:6000988.definition: A developmental defect causing an absence of the cochlear nerve resulting in sensorineural hearing loss.
HP:6000988.definition_cn: 一种发育缺陷导致耳蜗神经缺失，从而引起感音神经性听力损失。

HP:6000989.name: Slit-like lateral ventricle
HP:6000989.definition: Abnormally small lateral ventricle with a slit-like appearance.
HP:6000989.definition_cn: 侧脑室异常狭小，呈裂隙样外观。

HP:6000990.name: Fetal methamphetamine exposure
HP:6000990.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy (including during the period of conception) of the mother of a fetus or child to methamphetamine.
HP:6000990.definition_cn: 妊娠期（包括受孕期间）胎儿或儿童母亲有甲基苯丙胺暴露史。

HP:6000991.name: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP:6000991.definition: Concentration of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000991.name_cn: 循环中4-羟基丁酸浓度升高
HP:6000991.definition_cn: 血液中4-羟基丁酸浓度高于正常上限。

HP:6000992.name: Elevated urinary 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid level
HP:6000992.definition: The amount of 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000992.name_cn: 尿中2,4-二羟基丁酸水平升高
HP:6000992.definition_cn: 尿液中2,4-二羟基丁酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6000993.name: Pupillary hypersensitivity to parasympathomimetic agents
HP:6000993.definition: A higher than normal tendency of parasympathomimetic agents to induce miosis.
HP:6000993.name_cn: 瞳孔对拟副交感神经药物的超敏反应
HP:6000993.definition_cn: 拟副交感神经药物诱发瞳孔缩小的倾向高于正常水平。

HP:6000994.name: Lack of pupillary response to hydroxyamphetamine
HP:6000994.definition: 4-hydroxyamphetamine is used in eye drops to dilate the pupil, e.g.., to induce mydriasis for fundus examinations. This term refers to a lack of response of the pupil to topical application of 4-hydroxyamphetamine.
HP:6000994.name_cn: 对羟基苯丙胺缺乏瞳孔反应
HP:6000994.definition_cn: 4-羟基苯丙胺用于滴眼液以扩张瞳孔，例如，在眼底检查中诱导瞳孔散大。该术语指瞳孔对局部应用4-羟基苯丙胺无反应。

HP:6000995.name: Subcortical U fiber lesion
HP:6000995.definition: Abnormal morphology of subcortical U fibers, typically as assessed by abnromal intensity on magnetic resonance imaging of the brain.
HP:6000995.definition_cn: 皮质下U纤维形态异常，通常通过脑部磁共振成像中的异常信号强度进行评估。

HP:6000996.name: Intraspinal extradural lipoma
HP:6000996.definition: A lipoma (a benign encapsulated mass with lobulated mature adipose tissue enclosed by fibrous tissue) located within the spine but outside of the dura mater.
HP:6000996.definition_cn: 脊柱硬膜外脂肪瘤（一种良性包裹性肿块，由分叶状成熟脂肪组织构成，周围被纤维组织包绕，位于脊柱内但位于硬膜外）。

HP:6000997.name: Intranasal mass
HP:6000997.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the nasal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6000997.definition_cn: 鼻腔内局部异常增大或肿胀。术语“肿块”通常用于诊断检查的早期阶段，此时尚未确定肿胀的确切性质。

HP:6000998.name: Liver rupture
HP:6000998.definition: Subcapsular hepatic rupture is characterized by the development of a hematoma, often quite large, beneath the liver capsule. An interval of days or hours may elapse between the time of injury and the first appearance of symptoms. A history of injury may be entirely lacking, or may be so unremarkable that it is elicited only by diligent interrogation. The hematoma tends to increase in size.
HP:6000998.definition_cn: 肝包膜下破裂的特征是在肝包膜下形成血肿，通常体积较大。从受伤到首次出现症状之间可能间隔数天或数小时。受伤史可能完全缺失，或者可能非常不显著，以至于只有通过详细询问才能发现。血肿往往有增大的趋势。

HP:6000999.name: Elevated urinary mandelic acid
HP:6000999.definition: The amount of mandelic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6000999.definition_cn: 尿液中扁桃酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6001000.name: Elevated urine malic acid level
HP:6001000.definition: The amount of malic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001000.definition_cn: 尿液中苹果酸含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6001001.name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxysebacic acid level
HP:6001001.definition: The amount of 3-hydroxysebacic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001001.name_cn: 尿3-羟基癸二酸水平升高
HP:6001001.definition_cn: 尿液中3-羟基癸二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6001002.name: Elevated urinary vanillactic acid level
HP:6001002.definition: The amount of vanillactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001002.name_cn: 尿中香草乳酸水平升高
HP:6001002.definition_cn: 尿液中香草乳酸酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6001003.name: Elevated urine 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid level
HP:6001003.definition: The amount of 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001003.name_cn: 尿液中4,5-二羟基己酸水平升高
HP:6001003.definition_cn: 尿液中4,5-二羟基己酸的浓度，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6001004.name: Elevated urine hydroxyphenyllactic acid level
HP:6001004.definition: The amount of hydroxyphenyllactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001004.definition_cn: 尿中羟基苯乳酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常值上限。

HP:6001005.name: Positive gastric CMV intranuclear inclusions
HP:6001005.definition: Demonstration of the presence of cytomegalovirus in the stomach by means of a method such as in-situ hybridization.
HP:6001005.name_cn: 胃组织巨细胞病毒核内包涵体阳性
HP:6001005.definition_cn: 通过原位杂交等方法证实胃组织中存在巨细胞病毒。

HP:6001006.name: Elevated urine dihydroxycholestanoic acid level
HP:6001006.definition: The amount of dihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001006.name_cn: 尿中二羟基胆甾烷酸水平升高
HP:6001006.definition_cn: 尿液中二羟基胆烷酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6001007.name: Elevated urinary bile alcohol level
HP:6001007.definition: The amount of bile alcohol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001007.definition_cn: 尿液中胆汁醇含量，经尿液浓度校正后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6001008.name: Elevated urine glucose tetrasaccharide level
HP:6001008.definition: The amount of glucose tetrasaccharide in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001008.name_cn: 尿葡萄糖四糖水平升高
HP:6001008.definition_cn: 尿液中四糖葡萄糖的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常值上限。

HP:6001009.name: Increased urine 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate level
HP:6001009.definition: The amount of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001009.name_cn: 尿液4-羟基-2-酮戊二酸水平升高
HP:6001009.definition_cn: 尿液中4-羟基-2-酮戊二酸浓度经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。

HP:6001010.name: Inability to protrude lips
HP:6001010.definition: Lack of ability to purse or pucker the lips.
HP:6001010.definition_cn: 口轮匝肌功能障碍导致的唇部闭合不全。

HP:6001011.name: Wet voice
HP:6001011.definition: Wet voice is a perceptual vocal quality that is gurgly or liquid sounding and is due to the voice being produced through moisture. It is commonly used as an indicator of penetration and/or aspiration in clinical swallowing assessments and bedside screening tests.
HP:6001011.definition_cn: 湿性嗓音是一种感知性嗓音质量，表现为咕噜声或液体声，这是由于嗓音通过湿润环境产生。在临床吞咽评估和床边筛查测试中，湿性嗓音常被用作穿透和/或误吸的指标。

HP:6001012.name: Erythema marginatum
HP:6001012.definition: An erythematous (pink-red, depending on the skin color of the affected individual) macule that spreads peripherally and coalesces to form polycyclic or serpentine patches or plaques. Lesions occur in crops over days to weeks and are evanescent. The rate of migration is 2 to 12 mm over a period of a few hours. Erythema marginatum tends to affect the trunk more than the extremities and to not be accompanied by pruritus.
HP:6001012.definition_cn: 一种红斑性（粉红色至红色，取决于患者肤色）斑疹，向周围扩散并融合形成多环状或蛇形斑片或斑块。皮损在数天至数周内成批出现，并呈短暂性。迁移速度为数小时内2至12毫米。边缘性红斑更常累及躯干而非四肢，且通常不伴瘙痒。

HP:6001013.name: Mechanic's hands
HP:6001013.definition: Mechanic's hands are fissured, erythematous, hyperkeratotic eruptions on the hands, resembling the type of occupational dermatosis said to resemble the hands of a manual laborer. The lesions are classically on the lateral edges of the fingers and thumbs, largely sparing the palmar, and dorsal aspects of the digits.
HP:6001013.definition_cn: 机械手表现为手部出现裂隙性、红斑性、角化过度性皮疹，类似于手工劳动者所患的职业性皮肤病。病变典型位于手指和拇指的侧缘，通常不累及手掌和手指的背侧。

HP:6001014.name: Hiker's feet
HP:6001014.definition: Hyperkeratotic scaly fissured plaques on the fingers/palms or soles, generally more evident on the lateral aspect of index fingers.
HP:6001014.definition_cn: 手指/手掌或足底出现角化过度性鳞屑裂隙斑块，通常在食指外侧更为明显。

HP:6001015.name: Anti-HLA-DQ antibody positivity
HP:6001015.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen (HLA-DQ). DQ is one of several antigens involved in antibody-mediated rejection of organ transplants.
HP:6001015.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对人类白细胞抗原（HLA-DQ）的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。DQ是参与抗体介导的器官移植排斥反应的多种抗原之一。

HP:6001016.name: Inappropriate normal or low erythropoietin
HP:6001016.definition: Erythropoietin is produced and released into the blood by the kidneys in response to hypoxemia, and would normally be expected to increase with decreasing hemoglobin levels. This term applies if the increase fails to occur, as may be seen in conditions including chronic kidney disease.
HP:6001016.name_cn: 不适当的正常或低促红细胞生成素水平
HP:6001016.definition_cn: 促红细胞生成素由肾脏在低氧血症的刺激下产生并释放入血，通常在血红蛋白水平下降时预期会增加。如果未能出现这种增加，如可能见于慢性肾脏病等状况，则适用此术语。

HP:6001017.name: Rapid gastric emptying
HP:6001017.definition: A condition in which food moves through the stomach into the small intestine at an abnormally fast rate.
HP:6001017.definition_cn: 胃排空过快症（Gastric Emptying Acceleration Syndrome）

HP:6001018.name: Mediastinal lymph node calcification
HP:6001018.definition: Abnormal deposition of calcium in mediastinal lymph nodes.
HP:6001018.definition_cn: 纵隔淋巴结钙化异常沉积。

HP:6001019.name: Eggshell calcification of lymph nodes
HP:6001019.definition: Eggshell calcification refers to fine calcification seen at the periphery of a mass and usually relates to lamellar lymph node calcification.
HP:6001019.definition_cn: 蛋壳样钙化（Eggshell calcification）是指在肿块周边观察到的细微钙化，通常与层状淋巴结钙化（lamellar lymph node calcification）相关。

HP:6001020.name: Knee joint effusion
HP:6001020.definition: Abnormal accumulation of fluid within the knee joint or around the knee. Symptoms maye include, pain, swelling, and stiffness.
HP:6001020.definition_cn: 膝关节内或膝关节周围液体的异常积聚。症状可能包括疼痛、肿胀和僵硬。

HP:6001021.name: Subcutaneous emphysema
HP:6001021.definition: Skin emphysema/Subcutaneous emphysema occurs when gas or air accumulates and seeps under the skin, where normally no gas should be present. While the presence of air in subcutaneous or mediastinal tissue is not dangerous in itself, prompt recognition of the underlying cause is essential.
HP:6001021.definition_cn: 皮下气肿（Subcutaneous Emphysema）是指气体或空气在正常情况下不应存在的皮下组织中积聚和扩散。虽然皮下或纵隔组织中的气体本身并不危险，但及时识别其潜在病因至关重要。

HP:6001022.name: Elevated bone scintigraphy uptake
HP:6001022.definition: Bone scintigraph is performed with technetium 99m-labeled diphosphonates. The uptake of these radiopharmaceuticals depicts osteoblastic activity and regional blood flow to bone.
HP:6001022.definition_cn: 骨显像采用锝-99m标记的双膦酸盐进行。这些放射性药物的摄取反映了成骨细胞活性及局部骨血流情况。

HP:6001023.name: Diminished long-chain-enoyl-CoA hydratase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6001023.definition: Concentration or activity of long-chain-enoyl-CoA hydratase (EC 4.2.1.74) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal.
HP:6001023.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中长链烯酰辅酶A水合酶活性降低
HP:6001023.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的长链烯酰辅酶A水合酶（EC 4.2.1.74）的浓度或活性低于正常范围下限。

HP:6001024.name: Diminished acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP:6001024.definition: Concentration or activity of acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.16) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. This enzyme catalyzes the reaction acetyl-CoA + an acyl-CoA = a 3-oxoacyl-CoA + CoA. It is also known as 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase and beta-ketothiolase.
HP:6001024.name_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中乙酰辅酶A C-酰基转移酶活性降低
HP:6001024.definition_cn: 培养的成纤维细胞中测得的乙酰辅酶A C-酰基转移酶（EC 2.3.1.16）的浓度或活性低于正常范围。该酶催化乙酰辅酶A + 酰基辅酶A = 3-氧代酰基辅酶A + 辅酶A的反应。该酶也被称为3-酮酰基辅酶A硫解酶和β-酮硫解酶。

HP:6001025.name: Pathological inclusion body
HP:6001025.definition: Pathological inclusion bodies are are composed of glycogen, proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, hemosiderin, and calcium, that accumulate as metabolic by-products, catabolic products of macromolecular complexes, or in the context of cell injury.
HP:6001025.definition_cn: 病理性包涵体由糖原、蛋白质、核酸、脂质、含铁血黄素和钙组成，这些物质作为代谢副产物、大分子复合物的分解产物或在细胞损伤的情况下积累。

HP:6001026.name: Reduced epidermal collagen IV alpha 5 chain staining
HP:6001026.definition: Diminished or absent collagen alpha5(IV) chain staining pattern in the epidermal basement membrane.
HP:6001026.name_cn: 表皮胶原IV α5链染色减少
HP:6001026.definition_cn: 表皮基底膜中胶原α5(IV)链染色模式减弱或缺失。

HP:6001027.name: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 3 chain staining
HP:6001027.definition: Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 3 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney.
HP:6001027.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜IV型胶原α3链染色减弱
HP:6001027.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜中IV型胶原α3链数量的异常减少。

HP:6001028.name: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 4 chain staining
HP:6001028.definition: Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 4 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney.
HP:6001028.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜IV型胶原α4链染色减弱
HP:6001028.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜中IV型胶原α4链数量的异常减少。

HP:6001029.name: Diminished glomerular basement membrane collagen IV alpha 5 chain staining
HP:6001029.definition: Abnormal reduction in the amount of the alpha 5 chain of collagen IV in the basement membrane of the glomeruli of the kidney.
HP:6001029.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜IV型胶原α5链染色减弱
HP:6001029.definition_cn: 肾小球基底膜中IV型胶原α5链数量的异常减少。

HP:6001030.name: obsolete Peripheral nerve metachromasia
HP:6001030.name_cn: 过时的周围神经异染性

HP:6001031.name: Cystine nephrolithiasis
HP:6001031.definition: Deposition of cystine crystals in kidney tissue. Cystine crystals display a pathognomic hexagonal shape.
HP:6001031.definition_cn: 肾组织中胱氨酸结晶的沉积。胱氨酸结晶呈现特征性的六边形形态。

HP:6001032.name: Hepatic cystine accumulation
HP:6001032.definition: Accumulation of cystine in the liver.

HP:6001033.name: Bone marrow cystine accumulation
HP:6001033.definition: The presence of cystine crystals in bone marrow cells as demonstrated in a fresh bone marrow aspiration sample.
HP:6001033.definition_cn: 新鲜骨髓穿刺样本中骨髓细胞内胱氨酸结晶的存在。

HP:6001034.name: Desmoid tumor
HP:6001034.definition: Desmoid tumors are rare, locally aggressive, fibroblastic soft-tissue tumors that are characterized by infiltrative growth and tendency to recur. Desmoid tumors do not metastasize but can arise in any part of the body: extra-abdominal (appear in the head and neck, chest, extremities), and abdominal wall or intra-abdominal (originating in tissue that connects abdominal organs).
HP:6001034.definition_cn: 硬纤维瘤是一种罕见的、局部侵袭性的纤维母细胞性软组织肿瘤，其特征为浸润性生长和复发倾向。硬纤维瘤不发生转移，但可发生于身体的任何部位：腹外（出现在头颈部、胸部、四肢）以及腹壁或腹内（起源于连接腹部器官的组织）。

HP:6001035.name: Tubular jejunal duplication
HP:6001035.definition: A segment of the jejunum that runs parallel to the normal jejunum and communicates with the jejunal lumen at one or both ends.
HP:6001035.definition_cn: 一段与正常空肠平行走行的空肠，其一端或两端与空肠腔相通。

HP:6001036.name: Left ventricular rupture
HP:6001036.definition: A full thickness tear or breakage of the myocardium of the left ventricle.
HP:6001036.definition_cn: 左心室心肌全层撕裂或断裂。

HP:6001037.name: Punctate pontine perivascular enhancement
HP:6001037.definition: Multiple punctate (speckled, patchy spot-like) and/or curvilinear areas of gadolinium enhancement distributed around blood vessels in the pons.
HP:6001037.name_cn: 点状脑桥血管周围强化
HP:6001037.definition_cn: 脑桥内多发性点状（斑点状、斑片状）和/或曲线状钆增强区域，沿血管周围分布。

HP:6001038.name: Intestinal worm
HP:6001038.definition: Presence of one or more adult worms in the intestine as demonstrated by sonography or passage of a worm in the stool. On sonography, worms may appear as linear, echogenic structures within the intestines.
HP:6001038.definition_cn: 通过超声检查或粪便中排出虫体证实肠道内存在一条或多条成虫。在超声检查中，虫体可能表现为肠道内的线性高回声结构。

HP:6001039.name: Scrotal worm
HP:6001039.definition: Demonstration of one or more worms in the scrotum. This finding can be appreciated by sonography, where echogenic, linear structures could be seen moving within the scrotum.
HP:6001039.definition_cn: 阴囊内发现一条或多条蠕虫。此发现可通过超声检查确认，超声下可见高回声、线状结构在阴囊内移动。

HP:6001040.name: Small intestinal adenoma
HP:6001040.definition: A small bowel tumor with adenomatous epithelium.
HP:6001040.definition_cn: 小肠肿瘤伴腺瘤样上皮。

HP:6001041.name: Maternal retinal mottling
HP:6001041.definition: Mottling (spots or blotches with different shades) of the retinal pigment epithelium in the mother of the index patient. Retinal mottling may indicate a mosaic X-linked inactivation state in the mother.
HP:6001041.definition_cn: 索引患者母亲的视网膜色素上皮斑驳（不同色调的斑点或斑块）。视网膜斑驳可能提示母亲存在镶嵌型X染色体失活状态。

HP:6001042.name: Twisted gallbladder pedicle
HP:6001042.definition: A stretched conical-shaped structure found at the gallbladder neck with several linear echoes converging towards its tip. This finding is demonstrated by sonography and can indicate gallbladder volvulus.
HP:6001042.definition_cn: 胆囊颈部发现一拉伸的锥形结构，其尖端汇聚多条线性回声。此超声检查结果提示可能存在胆囊扭转。

HP:6001043.name: Cholecyst-enteric fistula
HP:6001043.definition: Fistula between the gallbladder and the intestine.

HP:6001044.name: Dyschronometria
HP:6001044.definition: Impaired ability to accurately measure or estimate time intervals.
HP:6001044.definition_cn: 时间间隔测量或估计能力受损。

HP:6001045.name: History of recent intermittent breastfeeding
HP:6001045.definition: History of recently intermittent breastfeeding an infant (i.e., on and off).
HP:6001045.name_cn: 近期间歇性母乳喂养史
HP:6001045.definition_cn: 近期婴儿间歇性母乳喂养史（即断断续续）。

HP:6001046.name: Breast cyst
HP:6001046.definition: A benign, fluid-filled sac in the breast.
HP:6001046.definition_cn: 乳腺良性囊性病变（Breast benign cystic lesion）

HP:6001047.name: Circumscribed
HP:6001047.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are well-defined and localized to a specific area.
HP:6001047.definition_cn: 适用于分布和外观明确且局限于特定区域的异常。

HP:6001048.name: Lobulated
HP:6001048.definition: Applies to an abnormality that displays ultiple indentations and/or elevations producing an irregular surface contour.
HP:6001048.definition_cn: 适用于显示多个凹陷和/或隆起，导致表面轮廓不规则的异常情况。

HP:6001049.name: Spiculated
HP:6001049.definition: Applies to an abnormality with irregular, radiating, or spiky edges.
HP:6001049.definition_cn: 适用于边缘不规则、放射状或棘状突起的异常病变。

HP:6001050.name: Whorled
HP:6001050.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance resembles series of a concentric circles or spirals.
HP:6001050.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常，其分布和外观类似于一系列同心圆或螺旋状结构。

HP:6001051.name: Delta brush pattern on EEG
HP:6001051.definition: Delta brushes are transient patterns characterised by a slow delta wave with superimposed fast activity.
HP:6001051.name_cn: 脑电图上的Delta刷状波模式
HP:6001051.definition_cn: Delta刷是短暂的电生理模式，其特征为慢波（delta波）上叠加快速活动。

HP:6001052.name: Tibiotalar synostosis
HP:6001052.definition: Fusion of the junction between the distal tibia, fibula and the talus.
HP:6001052.definition_cn: 胫骨远端、腓骨与距骨连接处融合。

HP:6001053.name: Vertebra plana
HP:6001053.definition: he term given when a vertebral body has lost almost its entire height anteriorly and posteriorly, representing a very advanced compression fracture.
HP:6001053.definition_cn: 椎体前后高度几乎完全丧失，表现为极重度压缩性骨折。

HP:6001054.name: Intoeing
HP:6001054.definition: An abnormal gait caused by a rotational variation anywhere in the lower extremity that causes the foot to point inward, instead of pointing straight ahead or outward, when walking or running.
HP:6001054.definition_cn: 由下肢任何部位的旋转变异引起的异常步态，导致行走或跑步时足部内旋，而非指向前方或外旋。

HP:6001055.name: Palpable thrill on extremity
HP:6001055.definition: A vibration felt upon palpation of a blood vessel over an extremity.
HP:6001055.definition_cn: 触诊肢体血管时感受到的震颤。

HP:6001056.name: Out-toeing
HP:6001056.definition: The feet turn excessively outward when walking, caused by a rotational variation in the leg.
HP:6001056.definition_cn: 步行时足部过度外旋，由下肢旋转变异引起。

HP:6001057.name: Ankle dislocation
HP:6001057.definition: An abnormal separation between the talo-tibial joint.

HP:6001058.name: Anti-neuronal intermediate filament antibody positivity
HP:6001058.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against neuronal intermediate filament.
HP:6001058.name_cn: 抗神经元中间丝抗体阳性
HP:6001058.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对神经元中间丝的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6001059.name: Anti-DREBRIN antibody positivity
HP:6001059.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against dendritic spine scaffolding protein Drebrin.
HP:6001059.definition_cn: 血清中存在与树突棘支架蛋白Drebrin发生反应的自身抗体。

HP:6001060.name: Anti-lipoprotein lipase autoantibody positivity
HP:6001060.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against anti-lipoprotein lipase.
HP:6001060.name_cn: 抗脂蛋白脂酶自身抗体阳性
HP:6001060.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对抗脂蛋白脂肪酶的自体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6001061.name: Anti-apolipoprotein CII autoantibody positivity
HP:6001061.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against apoCII.
HP:6001061.name_cn: 抗载脂蛋白CII自身抗体阳性
HP:6001061.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对载脂蛋白CII（apoCII）的自身抗体。

HP:6001062.name: Eosinophilic neuronal inclusion bodies
HP:6001062.definition: The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neurons that stain with eosin, a red or pink dye.
HP:6001062.definition_cn: 神经元内存在嗜酸性包涵体（可染色物质的聚集体，通常为蛋白质），这些包涵体可被伊红（一种红色或粉红色染料）染色。

HP:6001063.name: Sweaty foot-like odor
HP:6001063.definition: A characteristic smell said to resemble the odor of dirty socks.
HP:6001063.definition_cn: 一种特征性气味，据称类似于脏袜子的气味。

HP:6001064.name: Anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
HP:6001064.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against acetylcholine receptor.
HP:6001064.name_cn: 抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性
HP:6001064.definition_cn: 血液循环中存在针对乙酰胆碱受体的自身抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6001065.name: Hair shaft lesion
HP:6001065.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is located on hair shafts.
HP:6001065.definition_cn: 适用于位于毛干上的异常。

HP:6001066.name: Prolonged use of tightly fitting footwear
HP:6001066.definition: History of use of tightly fitting shoes for a long period of time.

HP:6001067.name: Triggered by high protein intake
HP:6001067.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about ingestion of high quantities of protein.
HP:6001067.definition_cn: 适用于因摄入大量蛋白质而诱发或引起的体征或症状。

HP:6001068.name: Thickened tricuspid valve cusp
HP:6001068.definition: An abnormally increased thickness of a leaflet of the tricuspid valve.

HP:6001069.name: Displaced anterior fontanelle
HP:6001069.definition: Abnormal shifting of the anterior fontanelle fropm its normal central position.
HP:6001069.definition_cn: 前囟异常偏离其正常中央位置。

HP:6001070.name: Subdural hygroma
HP:6001070.definition: Accumulation of cerebral spinal fluid in the subdural space.

HP:6001071.name: Incus ankylosis
HP:6001071.definition: Incus ankylosis refers to congenital or acquired fixation of the incus, which is associated with conductive hearing resulting from impairment of the sound-conduction mechanism (the external auditory canal, tympanic membrane, and/or middle-ear ossicles).
HP:6001071.definition_cn: 砧骨强直（Incus ankylosis）是指砧骨（incus）的先天性或后天性固定，其与声音传导机制（外耳道、鼓膜和/或中耳听小骨）受损导致的传导性听力损失（conductive hearing loss）相关。

HP:6001072.name: Excessive diet restriction
HP:6001072.definition: A tendency to reject a variety of foods and/or to eat a restricted range of foods.
HP:6001072.definition_cn: 食物选择性倾向（Selective Eating Tendency）或限制性饮食行为（Restricted Food Intake Behavior）。

HP:6001073.name: Left ventricular apical dyskinesis
HP:6001073.definition: Dyskinesis is used to describe ventricular muscle segments that bulge outside the left ventricular cavity during systole, as opposed to contracting inwards with the rest of the segments.
HP:6001073.name_cn: 左心室心尖部运动障碍
HP:6001073.definition_cn: 运动障碍（Dyskinesis）用于描述在收缩期时，心室肌段向外膨出而非与其他节段一同向内收缩的现象，通常指左心室腔外的异常运动。

HP:6001074.name: Longitudinal erythronychia
HP:6001074.definition: A longitudinal red band extending from the proximal nail fold or lunula to the distal nail plate.
HP:6001074.definition_cn: 从近端甲皱襞或甲半月延伸至远端甲板的纵向红色条带。

HP:6001075.name: Exacerbated by exposure to sunlight
HP:6001075.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by exposure to sunlight.

HP:6001076.name: Exacerbated by heat
HP:6001076.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is made worse by exposure to heat (high ambient temperatures).
HP:6001076.definition_cn: 应用于因暴露于高温（高环境温度）而加重的体征或症状。

HP:6001077.name: Exacerbated by excessive sweating
HP:6001077.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is made worse by excessive sweating.
HP:6001077.name_cn: 过度出汗导致的病情加重
HP:6001077.definition_cn: 多汗加重的体征或症状。

HP:6001078.name: Malignant pleural effusion
HP:6001078.definition: The accumulation of a significant amount of exudate in the pleural space, accompanied by the presence of malignant cells or tumour tissue.
HP:6001078.definition_cn: 胸腔内大量渗出液积聚，伴随恶性细胞或肿瘤组织存在。

HP:6001079.name: Inappropriately low urine osmolality following challenge
HP:6001079.definition: In diabetes insipidus, affected individuals produce large quantities of dilute urine. In nephrogenic DI, the kidneys do not respond to vasopressin. In a water deprivation test or with administration of exogenous vasopressin, the osmolaltiy of the urine does not increase as normally.
HP:6001079.name_cn: 挑战后尿渗透压不适当降低
HP:6001079.definition_cn: 在尿崩症中，患者会产生大量稀释的尿液。在肾性尿崩症中，肾脏对血管加压素无反应。在禁水试验或外源性血管加压素给药时，尿液的渗透压不会像正常情况下那样升高。

HP:6001080.name: Reduced urine retrahydrocortisol plus 5-alpha-THF to tetrahydrocortisone ratio
HP:6001080.definition: Abnormally low ratio of tetrahydrocortisol (THF) plus 5-alpha-THF to tetrahydrocortisone (THE).
HP:6001080.name_cn: 尿中四氢皮质醇加5α-四氢皮质醇与四氢可的松比值降低
HP:6001080.definition_cn: 四氢皮质醇（THF）加5α-四氢皮质醇（5α-THF）与四氢可的松（THE）比值异常降低。

HP:6001081.name: Elevated urinary 2,4-dihydroxyglutarate level
HP:6001081.definition: The amount of 2,4-dihydroxyglutarate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001081.name_cn: 尿液中2,4-二羟基戊二酸水平升高
HP:6001081.definition_cn: 尿液中2,4-二羟基戊二酸的浓度，经尿液浓度标准化后，高于正常上限值。

HP:6001082.name: Abnormal urine D-xylose test
HP:6001082.definition: An abnormal result of the xylose absorption test that is used to assess the ability of the intestines to absorb D-xylose. D-xylose is a five-carbon monosaccharide found in some plants. The patient drinks a solution containing a specific amount of D-xylose and the concentration of xylose is measured in the blood circulation and then in the urine. A low amount of D-xylose indicates reduced small intestinal absorbtion.
HP:6001082.definition_cn: 木糖吸收试验异常结果，用于评估肠道对D-木糖的吸收能力。D-木糖是一种存在于某些植物中的五碳单糖。患者饮用含有特定剂量D-木糖的溶液，随后在血液循环和尿液中测量木糖的浓度。D-木糖含量低提示小肠吸收功能减退。

HP:6001083.name: Cerebral hemisphere mass lesion
HP:6001083.definition: An abnormal growth or accumulation of tissue in a hemisphere of the cerebrum. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup.
HP:6001083.definition_cn: 大脑半球组织异常增生或积聚。通常，肿块是初步发现，将引导进一步的检查。

HP:6001084.name: T2-hyperintense putaminal rim
HP:6001084.definition: Increased signal on T2 magnetic resonance imaging characterized by a linear region of high signal surrounding the lateral aspect of the putamen at 1.5 Tesla.
HP:6001084.definition_cn: 在1.5特斯拉的T2加权磁共振成像中，表现为壳核外侧周围线性区域的高信号增强。

HP:6001085.name: Posterior fossa mass lesion
HP:6001085.definition: An abnormal growth or accumulation of tissue in the posterior fossa, affecting the cerebellum or fourth ventricle. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup.
HP:6001085.definition_cn: 后颅窝组织异常增生或积聚，累及小脑或第四脑室。通常肿块是初步发现，需进一步检查以明确诊断。

HP:6001086.name: Irregular RR interval
HP:6001086.definition: Abnormal increased variability in the timing between consecutive R-waves on an electrocardiogram.
HP:6001086.definition_cn: 心电图连续R波间期变异性异常增加。

HP:6001087.name: Irregular P-P interval
HP:6001087.definition: Abnormally increased variability in the timing between consecutive P-waves on an electrocardiogram.
HP:6001087.definition_cn: 心电图连续P波间期变异性异常增加。

HP:6001088.name: Fungal hair infection
HP:6001088.definition: Demonstration of fungi growing on hair by a method such as microscopy of hairs mounted on slides with 10% potassium hydroxide.
HP:6001088.definition_cn: 通过显微镜观察法（如使用10%氢氧化钾溶液制片）展示真菌在毛发上的生长情况。

HP:6001089.name: Long hairstyle
HP:6001089.definition: A past medical history of having long, full hair.
HP:6001089.definition_cn: 既往病史：曾拥有长而浓密的头发。

HP:6001090.name: Conjunctival subepithelial fibrosis
HP:6001090.definition: fine white linear scars under intact conjunctival epithelium. This scarring appears in areas of previous conjunctival ulceration or pseudomembrane formation, weeks to months after the insult is healed.
HP:6001090.definition_cn: 完整的结膜上皮下可见细小的白色线性瘢痕。此类瘢痕出现在既往结膜溃疡或假膜形成的区域，通常在损伤愈合后数周至数月内出现。

HP:6001091.name: Conjunctival fornix foreshortening
HP:6001091.definition: Abnormal reduction in depth of the fornix of the conjunctiva. The fornix is the area where the conjunctiva folds back upon itself, thereby creating a recessed space.
HP:6001091.definition_cn: 结膜穹窿深度异常减少。穹窿是结膜反折处形成的凹陷区域。

HP:6001092.name: Strong ultraviolet light exposure
HP:6001092.definition: History of exposure to ultraviolet light, such as may be encountered with outdoor activities, living near equator, radiation.
HP:6001092.definition_cn: 紫外线暴露史，如户外活动、赤道附近居住、辐射等。

HP:6001093.name: Exposure to vaginal douching
HP:6001093.definition: A history of intravaginal cleansing with a liquid solution for personal hygiene or aesthetic reasons.
HP:6001093.definition_cn: 既往有使用液体溶液进行阴道内清洁的个人卫生或美容史。

HP:6001094.name: Exposure to oily lotions or creams
HP:6001094.definition: A history of applying oily lotions or creams to the skin.
HP:6001094.definition_cn: 既往有使用油性乳液或乳膏涂抹皮肤史。

HP:6001095.name: Elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration following branched-chain fatty acid ingestion
HP:6001095.definition: Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. This finding can be observed in Zellweger syndrome. Note that branched-chain fatty acid accumulation depends on dietary intake of phytanic acid, which is minimal in formula- and breast-fed infants. Thus, phytanic and pristanic acid levels are normal in a neonate with Zellweger spectrum disorder.
HP:6001095.name_cn: 支链脂肪酸摄入后循环中植烷酸浓度升高
HP:6001095.definition_cn: 血液中降植烷酸浓度高于正常上限。此现象可见于Zellweger综合征。需注意，支链脂肪酸的积累取决于膳食中植烷酸的摄入量，而配方奶喂养和母乳喂养的婴儿植烷酸摄入量极低。因此，Zellweger谱系障碍新生儿体内植烷酸和降植烷酸水平正常。

HP:6001096.name: Decreased T-cell ZAP-70 protein expression in CD4-positive T cells
HP:6001096.definition: Reduction in the level of ZAP-70 protein CD4-positive T cells.
HP:6001096.name_cn: CD4阳性T细胞中T细胞ZAP-70蛋白表达降低
HP:6001096.definition_cn: ZAP-70蛋白在CD4阳性T细胞中的表达水平降低。

HP:6001097.name: Dorsal flexion contracture of the ankle
HP:6001097.definition: A type of contracture in which the dorsal flexion muscles of the ankle are contracted.
HP:6001097.definition_cn: 一种踝关节背屈肌挛缩的挛缩类型。

HP:6001098.name: Metaphyseal undermodelling
HP:6001098.definition: Lack of the normal diaphyseal constriction (thinning of long bones toward the midshaft area) giving the submetaphyseal areas an abnormally wide appearance.
HP:6001098.definition_cn: 缺乏正常的骨干缩窄（长骨向中段区域变细），导致干骺端下区域呈现异常宽阔的外观。

HP:6001099.name: Iliac vein compression
HP:6001099.definition: Compression of the common iliac vein against the spine by the contralateral common iliac artery.
HP:6001099.definition_cn: 对侧髂总动脉压迫脊柱导致髂总静脉受压。

HP:6001100.name: Positive serum amyloid P scintigraphy
HP:6001100.definition: Detection of abnormal amyloid deposits in the body by 123I-labeled serum amyloid P component (SAP) scintigraphy.
HP:6001100.name_cn: 血清淀粉样蛋白P阳性闪烁扫描
HP:6001100.definition_cn: 通过123I标记的血清淀粉样P成分（SAP）闪烁扫描术检测体内异常淀粉样蛋白沉积。

HP:6001101.name: crossed brainstem sign
HP:6001101.definition: Motor and/or sensory cranial nerve findings ipsilateral to the lesion, and at the same time motor and/or sensory findings on the contralateral side of the body.
HP:6001101.definition_cn: 病变同侧运动性和/或感觉性颅神经体征，同时伴有对侧身体的运动性和/或感觉性体征。

HP:6001102.name: Inability to puff cheeks
HP:6001102.definition: Reduced ability to inflate the cheeks by blowing air into them while keeping the lips closed.

HP:6001103.name: Entoptic phenomenon
HP:6001103.definition: Visual sensations caused by changes within the eye itself, rather than by the normal light stimulation process. Entoptic phenomena are classified in the syndrome as floaters, blue field entoptic phenomenon, photopsia and self-light of the eye.
HP:6001103.definition_cn: 由眼内自身变化而非正常光刺激过程引起的视觉感受。内视现象在综合征中被分类为飞蚊症、蓝视内视现象、闪光幻觉和自发光现象。

HP:6001104.name: Abnormal vestibulo-spinal reflex
HP:6001104.definition: An abnormality of the vestibulospinal (VS) reflexes, which contribute to the control of postural orientation. In this task, they continuously collaborate with reflexes elicited by stimulation of visual and somatosensory receptors. Labyrinthine receptors are sensitive to modifications (i) of the head position with respect to the earth vertical or (ii) of the angular/linear velocity of head motion in space. This information can be used to monitor deviations from the maintained body position.
HP:6001104.definition_cn: 前庭脊髓反射（Vestibulospinal Reflexes, VS）异常，该反射参与姿势定向的控制。在此过程中，它们与视觉和体感感受器刺激引发的反射持续协同作用。迷路感受器对以下变化敏感：（i）头部相对于地球垂直位置的变化，或（ii）头部在空间中的角速度/线速度变化。此信息可用于监测与维持身体姿势的偏差。

HP:6001105.name: Positive probe-to-bone test
HP:6001105.definition: An abnormal result of the probe-to-bone (PTB) test. The PTB test is performed by inserting a sterile, metal surgical probe into the ulcer and is positive if a hard, gritty surface is felt inside. For large wounds, this may require gentle exploration of the wound with the probe.
HP:6001105.definition_cn: 探针触骨试验（Probe-to-Bone Test, PTB）结果异常。探针触骨试验通过将无菌金属手术探针插入溃疡内进行，若探针触及坚硬、粗糙的表面则为阳性。对于较大伤口，可能需要使用探针轻柔地探查伤口内部。

HP:6001106.name: Exposure to repetive hand impact
HP:6001106.definition: A history of exposure to repetitive impact on palm or hand, such as working with a jackhammer.
HP:6001106.definition_cn: 既往有手掌或手部反复冲击暴露史，例如使用风镐作业。

HP:6001107.name: Fractured scaphoid bone
HP:6001107.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the scaphoid bone.
HP:6001107.definition_cn: 舟状骨部分或完全骨折。

HP:6001108.name: Local anesthetic ineffectiveness
HP:6001108.definition: Resistance to the effects of local anaesthesia, with delayed onset or failure of local anesthetics to incude numbness or relieve pain.
HP:6001108.definition_cn: 对局部麻醉效果的抵抗性，表现为局部麻醉剂起效延迟或无法诱导麻木或缓解疼痛。

HP:6001109.name: Palmoplantar location
HP:6001109.definition: Applied to lesions whose distribution is confined or restricted to the palms of the hands and soles of the feet.
HP:6001109.definition_cn: 应用于病变分布局限于手掌和足底的病例。

HP:6001110.name: Oral mucosa plaque
HP:6001110.definition: A raised, flat-topped lesion with a diameter of one centimeter or more that is located in the mucosa of the mouth.
HP:6001110.definition_cn: 口腔黏膜直径一厘米或以上的扁平隆起性病变。

HP:6001111.name: Positive saliva rabies nucleic acid test
HP:6001111.definition: Detection of rabies nucleic acid in saliva by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
HP:6001111.name_cn: 唾液狂犬病核酸检测阳性
HP:6001111.definition_cn: 通过聚合酶链反应（Polymerase Chain Reaction, PCR）等方法检测唾液中狂犬病病毒核酸。

HP:6001112.name: Elevated tissue arylsulfatase A activity
HP:6001112.definition: Activity of arylsulfatase A (EC 3.1.6.8) above the upper limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts and leukocytes or in the blood circulation.
HP:6001112.name_cn: 组织芳基硫酸酯酶A活性升高
HP:6001112.definition_cn: 芳基硫酸酯酶A（EC 3.1.6.8）活性高于正常上限。该活性可在多种组织中测量，包括培养的成纤维细胞和白细胞或血液循环中。

HP:6001113.name: Elevated circulating methysterol concentration
HP:6001113.definition: The concentration of a methysterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001113.name_cn: 循环中甲基甾醇浓度升高
HP:6001113.definition_cn: 血液中甲羟孕酮浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001114.name: Elevated urinary adipic acid
HP:6001114.definition: The amount of adipic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Adipic acid is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,4-dicarboxy derivative of butane.
HP:6001114.definition_cn: 尿液中己二酸含量经尿液浓度校正后高于正常上限。己二酸是一种α,ω-二羧酸，为丁烷的1,4-二羧基衍生物。

HP:6001115.name: EEG with temporal slowing
HP:6001115.definition: Slow-wave activity observed in the temporal area of the scalp electro-encephalogram (EEG).
HP:6001115.definition_cn: 在头皮脑电图（EEG）的颞区观察到慢波活动。

HP:6001116.name: History of high-pressure injection injury of the hand
HP:6001116.definition: Medical history of the hand having come into contact with the nozzle of a high-pressure injecting system such as a paint gun or air compressor.
HP:6001116.definition_cn: 手部接触高压喷射系统（如喷漆枪或空气压缩机）喷嘴的病史。

HP:6001117.name: Hypertrophic ulnar styloid process
HP:6001117.definition: Excessively long styloid process of the ulna.

HP:6001118.name: History of recent peripheral venous catheter
HP:6001118.definition: A history of placement of a peripehral venous catheter in the hours, days, or weeks before the current presenting complaint.
HP:6001118.definition_cn: 既往在本次主诉出现前数小时、数天或数周内有外周静脉导管置入史。

HP:6001119.name: Purulent drainage from skin
HP:6001119.definition: Exudation of a thick, opaque fluid from a wound or skin lesion, typically as a result of infection and taining pus, i.e., dead white blood cells, bacteria, and tissue debris.
HP:6001119.definition_cn: 从伤口或皮肤病变处渗出浓稠、不透明的液体，通常由于感染并含有脓液，即死亡的白细胞、细菌和组织碎片。

HP:6001120.name: Occupational history of putting fingers in other people's mouths
HP:6001120.definition: A history of exposure of fingers by putting them in other peoples' mouths occupationally, e.g., as a dentist or physician.
HP:6001120.name_cn: 职业性手指插入他人口腔史
HP:6001120.definition_cn: 职业性手指暴露史，例如作为牙医或医生将手指放入他人口腔中。

HP:6001121.name: Single-finger involvement
HP:6001121.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are limited to or predominantly affect a single finger.
HP:6001121.definition_cn: 适用于分布和表现局限于或主要影响单个手指的异常。

HP:6001122.name: Multiple-finger involvement
HP:6001122.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance affect more than one finger.
HP:6001122.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常，其分布和外观影响多个手指。

HP:6001123.name: Pain disproportionate to abnormality on physical exam
HP:6001123.definition: Exquisite tenderness in a specific region, beyond what one would surmise from examination.
HP:6001123.name_cn: 与体格检查异常程度不符的疼痛
HP:6001123.definition_cn: 特定区域显著压痛，超出检查预期。

HP:6001124.name: Sphenoid wing dysplasia
HP:6001124.definition: Hypoplasia or aplasia of the greater or lesser wing of the sphenoid bone, typically resulting in widening of the superior orbital fissure, elevation of the [lesser sphenoid wing, and ipsilateral orbital enlargement.
HP:6001124.definition_cn: 蝶骨大翼或小翼发育不全或发育不良，通常导致眶上裂增宽、蝶骨小翼抬高以及同侧眼眶扩大。

HP:6001125.name: Skin laceration
HP:6001125.definition: An injury in which skin and underlying tissues are cut or torn.
HP:6001125.definition_cn: 皮肤及皮下组织切割伤或撕裂伤。

HP:6001126.name: Metacarpal fracture
HP:6001126.definition: A partial or complete breakage of a metacarpal bone.

HP:6001127.name: Pain at the base of the thumb
HP:6001127.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort localized to the base of the thumb, over thenar eminence or thumb metacarpal.
HP:6001127.definition_cn: 一种不适感，其特征为局限于拇指基底、鱼际隆起或拇指掌骨区域的躯体性不适。

HP:6001128.name: History of recent participation in athletics
HP:6001128.definition: Medical history of participation in sports (football, basketball, soccer, skiing) in the hours, days, or weeks prior to the current presenting complaint.
HP:6001128.definition_cn: 既往运动史（足球、篮球、足球、滑雪）在当前主诉出现前数小时、数天或数周内的参与情况。

HP:6001129.name: Remote trauma history
HP:6001129.definition: History of trauma months to years ago, including but not limited to fracture or other orthopedic injury at the symptomatic area.
HP:6001129.definition_cn: 既往数月或数年前有外伤史，包括但不限于症状部位的骨折或其他骨科损伤。

HP:6001130.name: Distal radioulnar joint arthritis
HP:6001130.definition: An inflammatory condition of the joint that connects the far ends of the radius and the ulna, known as the distal radioulnar joint (DRUJ). DRUJ arthritis may be characterized by widening of the DRUJ interval, volar/dorsal displacement of the distal ulna, radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis at the DRUJ joint including osteophytes, subchondral cysts, subchrondal sclerosis, and joint space narrowing.
HP:6001130.definition_cn: 远端桡尺关节（Distal Radioulnar Joint, DRUJ）炎症性疾病。DRUJ关节炎的特征可能包括DRUJ间隙增宽、远端尺骨掌侧/背侧移位，以及DRUJ关节的骨关节炎影像学表现，如骨赘形成、软骨下囊肿、软骨下硬化和关节间隙狭窄。

HP:6001131.name: Radial head fracture
HP:6001131.definition: Fracture of the proximal end of the radius involving the radial head.
HP:6001131.definition_cn: 桡骨近端骨折累及桡骨头。

HP:6001132.name: Elbow lateral collateral ligament tear
HP:6001132.definition: An injury to the lateral collateral ligament (LCL) of the elbow. The LCL is a complex capsuloligamentous structure critical in stabilizing the ulnohumeral and radiocapitellar articulations. LCL injury can result in elbow instability, allowing the proximal radius and ulna to externally rotate away from the humerus as a supination stress is applied to the forearm.
HP:6001132.name_cn: 肘关节外侧副韧带撕裂
HP:6001132.definition_cn: 肘关节外侧副韧带（Lateral Collateral Ligament, LCL）损伤。LCL是一种复杂的囊韧带结构，对于稳定尺肱关节和桡肱关节至关重要。LCL损伤可导致肘关节不稳定，当前臂受到旋后应力时，近端桡骨和尺骨会向外旋转远离肱骨。

HP:6001133.name: Elbow medial collateral ligament tear
HP:6001133.definition: An injury to the medial collateral ligament (MCL) of the elbow.
HP:6001133.name_cn: 肘关节内侧副韧带撕裂
HP:6001133.definition_cn: 肘关节内侧副韧带（MCL）损伤。

HP:6001134.name: Coronoid fracture
HP:6001134.definition: Fracture of the coronoid process on the proximal ulna.

HP:6001135.name: History of spinal cord injury
HP:6001135.definition: A medical history of hving had a spinal cord injury prior to the presenting complaint.
HP:6001135.definition_cn: 既往史中存在脊髓损伤，早于当前主诉。

HP:6001136.name: Femoral nerve distribution
HP:6001136.definition: Paresthesias in anterior/medial aspect of the thigh (anterior and medial cutaneous nerves of the thigh) and/or medial aspect of the lower leg and foot (saphenous distribution). May be accompanied by weakness in the quadriceps.
HP:6001136.definition_cn: 大腿前侧/内侧（大腿前皮神经和大腿内侧皮神经）和/或小腿内侧及足部（隐神经分布区）感觉异常。可能伴有股四头肌无力。

HP:6001138.name: Digoxin exposure
HP:6001138.definition: History of having been treateed with digoxin.
HP:6001138.definition_cn: 既往接受地高辛治疗史。

HP:6001139.name: Upper arm pain
HP:6001139.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the upper arm.
HP:6001139.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于上臂区域。

HP:6001140.name: Capitellum fracture
HP:6001140.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the capitulum of the humerus, which is a smooth, rounded eminence on the lateral portion of the distal articular surface of the humerus.
HP:6001140.definition_cn: 肱骨小头部分或完全骨折，肱骨小头是位于肱骨远端关节面外侧部分的一个光滑、圆形的隆起。

HP:6001141.name: Anterior shoulder pain
HP:6001141.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the anterior (front) part of the shoulder.
HP:6001141.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性或酸痛），局限于肩部前侧区域。

HP:6001142.name: Pain at the anterior aspect of the elbow
HP:6001142.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the front part of the elbow front part of the elbow, that is, on the ventral side of the arm where the arm bends.
HP:6001142.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性或酸痛），局限于肘部前侧，即手臂弯曲处的腹侧。

HP:6001143.name: Posterior fat pad sign of the elbow
HP:6001143.definition: Lateral elbow x-ray showing lucent crescent of fat that indicates a joint effusion in the elbow .
HP:6001143.definition_cn: 侧位肘关节X线片显示透亮的脂肪新月征，提示肘关节积液。

HP:6001144.name: Pain at the anterior aspect of the knee
HP:6001144.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the front part of the knee, that is, the side of the knee where the patella is located.
HP:6001144.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于膝关节前部，即髌骨所在的一侧。

HP:6001145.name: Pain at the posterior aspect of the knee
HP:6001145.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the back part of the knee, that is, opposite to the side of the knee where the patella is located.
HP:6001145.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），位于膝关节后部，即与髌骨所在侧相对的位置。

HP:6001146.name: Biceps tendonitis
HP:6001146.definition: Biceps tendinitis is inflammation of the tendon around the long head of the biceps muscle.
HP:6001146.definition_cn: 肱二头肌肌腱炎是指肱二头肌长头周围肌腱的炎症。

HP:6001147.name: Increased peripheral nerve cross sectional area
HP:6001147.definition: Ultrasonography showing increased cross sectional area (CSA) of a peripheral nerve as it travels through a potential site of compression.
HP:6001147.name_cn: 周围神经横截面积增加
HP:6001147.definition_cn: 超声检查显示周围神经在通过潜在压迫部位时横截面积（CSA）增加。

HP:6001148.name: Pain exacerbated by passive flexion at joint
HP:6001148.definition: Pain in extremity that worsens with joint is passively flexed.
HP:6001148.name_cn: 关节被动屈曲时疼痛加剧
HP:6001148.definition_cn: 肢体疼痛在关节被动屈曲时加重。

HP:6001149.name: Positive hook test at the elbow
HP:6001149.definition: With forearm fully supinated and elbow flexed to 90 degrees, examiner hooks a finger a bit around the distal biceps tendon at the anterior aspect of the elbow. Test is positive when there is lack of appreciable cord like structure to hook around.
HP:6001149.definition_cn: 在前臂完全旋后且肘关节屈曲至90度时，检查者将手指稍微钩住肘前侧的远端肱二头肌腱。当无法钩到明显的索状结构时，测试结果为阳性。

HP:6001150.name: Positive Speed's test
HP:6001150.definition: Manual downward pressure on the arm with the shoulders flexed forward to 90 degrees, elbows fully extended, and palm facing up recreates pain in the anterior shoulder region; named after Dr. Speed.
HP:6001150.definition_cn: 肩关节前屈90度，肘关节完全伸展，手掌朝上，对前臂施加向下的手动压力，可重现肩前区疼痛；此试验以Speed医生命名。

HP:6001151.name: Triangular lunate bone
HP:6001151.definition: A disruption of the greater and lesser arcs of the lunate bone, with the lunate having a triangular silhouette, know as the piece of pie sign. Often caused by falling on an outstretched hand, patients will have tenderness to palpation over the dorsum of the wrist and may have sensory deficits in the median nerve distribution.
HP:6001151.definition_cn: 月骨大弧和小弧的断裂，月骨呈现三角形轮廓，称为“饼片征”。通常由于手部伸展着地所致，患者腕背侧触诊时有压痛，并可能出现正中神经分布区的感觉障碍。

HP:6001152.name: Pain exacerbated by wrist deviation
HP:6001152.definition: Pain worsens with wrist ulnar or radial deviation.
HP:6001152.definition_cn: 疼痛在腕关节尺偏或桡偏时加重。

HP:6001153.name: Pain on the lateral aspect of the foot
HP:6001153.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the side of the foot nearest to the little (fifth) toe.
HP:6001153.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于足部靠近小趾（第五趾）的一侧。

HP:6001154.name: Pain at the medial aspect of the knee
HP:6001154.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the inner side of knee, that is, the region of the knee that faces the other knee.
HP:6001154.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于膝关节内侧，即膝关节朝向对侧膝关节的区域。

HP:6001155.name: Pain at the lateral aspect of the knee
HP:6001155.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the outer side of knee, that is, the region of the knee that faces away from the other knee.
HP:6001155.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性或酸痛），局限于膝关节外侧，即膝关节远离对侧膝关节的区域。

HP:6001156.name: Synovial crystals
HP:6001156.definition: The presence of microscopic crystalline structures in the synovial fluid (the lubricating fluid within joint cavities).
HP:6001156.definition_cn: 滑液（关节腔内润滑液）中存在微观晶体结构。

HP:6001157.name: Occupational exposure to frequent kneeling
HP:6001157.definition: A history of exposure to frequent squatting/kneeling and/or heavy lifting.
HP:6001157.definition_cn: 既往史中存在频繁下蹲/跪姿和/或重体力劳动暴露史。

HP:6001158.name: Trochanteric pain
HP:6001158.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the structures around the greater trochanter (the bony prominence on the outer part of the femur).
HP:6001158.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适为特征的不愉快感觉（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛），局限于大转子（股骨外侧的骨性突起）周围结构。

HP:6001159.name: Pulsatile mass in extremity
HP:6001159.definition: A noticeable lump or swelling in the arm or leg that you can feel with you fingers and this lump is beating or pulsating, similar to the feeling of a heartbeat.
HP:6001159.definition_cn: 在手臂或腿部可触及的明显肿块或肿胀，且该肿块具有搏动性或脉动感，类似于心跳的感觉。

HP:6001160.name: Abnormal R wave
HP:6001160.definition: Any anomaly of the R wave of the EKG, which is the first upward deflection after the P wave. The R wave reflects early ventricular depolarisation.
HP:6001160.definition_cn: 心电图R波异常，即P波后的第一个向上偏转。R波反映心室早期去极化。

HP:6001161.name: Poor R-wave progression
HP:6001161.definition: Absence of the normal increase in size of the R wave in the precordial leads when advancing from lead V1 to V6 of the electrocardiogram.
HP:6001161.definition_cn: 心前区导联从V1到V6导联R波振幅正常递增缺失。

HP:6001162.name: Prominent V1-V2 R wave
HP:6001162.definition: The R wave in leads V1-V2 is normally considerably smaller in amplitude than the S wave in the same leads. Prominent R wave in these leads implies the R wave is larger than the S-wave, which may indicate cardiovascular pathology. This term includes Tall R wave in lead V1, which is defined by a R/S ratio greater than 1.
HP:6001162.definition_cn: V1-V2导联中的R波振幅通常明显小于同一导联中的S波。这些导联中显著的R波意味着R波大于S波，可能提示心血管病理学改变。该术语包括V1导联中的高R波，其定义为R/S比值大于1。

HP:6001163.name: Finger mass
HP:6001163.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to a finger.
HP:6001163.definition_cn: 指端局限性异常增大或肿胀。

HP:6001164.name: Foot mass
HP:6001164.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to a foot.
HP:6001164.definition_cn: 足部局限性异常增大或肿胀。

HP:6001165.name: Abnormal retinal vein morphology
HP:6001165.definition: A condition characterized by structural abnormalities of the retinal veins, including tortuosity, dilation, narrowing, or irregularities in branching patterns. These changes may be associated with systemic or ocular diseases such as retinal vein occlusion, diabetic retinopathy, or hypertensive retinopathy.
HP:6001165.definition_cn: 一种以视网膜静脉结构异常为特征的病变，包括静脉迂曲、扩张、狭窄或分支模式不规则。这些改变可能与视网膜静脉阻塞、糖尿病性视网膜病变或高血压性视网膜病变等全身性或眼部疾病相关。

HP:6001166.name: Spongiosis
HP:6001166.definition: Spongiosis refers to the increased intercellular edema in the epidermis resulting in the pulling away of the keratinocytes from their surrounding desmosomes. Histologically, the spongiotic tissue reaction pattern involves the accumulation of fluid in the intercellular spaces of the epidermis, making the desmosomes junctions more easy to appreciate. Parakeratosis forms above the areas of spongiosis. The foci of spongiosis can be microscopic to grossly identifiable clinically with vesicles or bullae.
HP:6001166.definition_cn: 海绵水肿是指表皮内细胞间水肿增加，导致角质形成细胞从周围的桥粒脱离。组织学上，海绵水肿的组织反应模式表现为表皮细胞间隙内液体蓄积，使桥粒连接更易显现。海绵水肿区域上方可见角化不全。海绵水肿病灶可从显微镜下观察到临床肉眼可见的水疱或大疱。

HP:6001167.name: Discoid adrenal gland
HP:6001167.definition: A congenital finding where the adrenal gland does not form it's typical triangular, Y or V shape and is instead discoid, straight or elongated in shape. It is often found incidentally on renal ultrasound and is associated with renal agenesis and other renal congenital anomalies.
HP:6001167.definition_cn: 一种先天性表现，即肾上腺未形成典型的三角形、Y形或V形，而是呈现盘状、直形或细长形。该表现常在肾脏超声检查中偶然发现，并与肾缺如及其他肾脏先天性畸形相关。

HP:6001168.name: Abnormal optic disc vasculature morphology
HP:6001168.definition: A structural abnormality in the blood vessels of the optic disc, including bleeding, tortuosity, dilation, shunting, or other unusual branching patterns.
HP:6001168.definition_cn: 视盘血管结构异常，包括出血、迂曲、扩张、分流或其他异常分支模式。

HP:6001169.name: Supraclavicular nerve distribution
HP:6001169.definition: Localization of symptoms such as numbness or paresthesias on the skin over the upper chest, specifically above the clavicle and over the lateral aspect of the neck, corresponding to the distribution of the supraclavicular nerve.
HP:6001169.definition_cn: 症状定位于上胸部皮肤区域，具体表现为锁骨上方及颈外侧部的麻木或感觉异常，符合锁骨上神经支配区域分布。

HP:6001170.name: Limited shoulder internal rotation
HP:6001170.definition: Difficulty rotating the lower part of the arm towards the body (tested with the elbow flexed and the elbow held next to the side of the body or shoulder 90 degrees abducted to the side) secondary to pain, weakness, or mechanical block.
HP:6001170.definition_cn: 前臂旋前困难（测试时肘关节屈曲并贴近体侧或肩关节外展90度），继发于疼痛、肌力减弱或机械性阻滞。

HP:6001171.name: Superior displacement of the humeral head
HP:6001171.definition: An anterior posterior (AP) shoulder radiograph shows distance between the the proximal aspect of the humeral head and inferior aspect of the acromion of less than 7 mm.
HP:6001171.definition_cn: 肩关节前后位（AP）X线片显示肱骨头近端与肩峰下缘间距小于7毫米。

HP:6001172.name: Increased compartment pressure
HP:6001172.definition: intracompartmental pressure (ICP) over 30 mmHg. Acute compartment syndrome occurs when there is increased pressure within a closed osteofascial compartment, resulting in impaired local circulation. Acute compartment syndrome is considered a surgical emergency since, without proper treatment, it can lead to ischemia and eventually necrosis. Generally, acute compartment syndrome is considered a clinical diagnosis. However, ICP over 30 mmHg can be used as a threshold to aid in diagnosis.
HP:6001172.definition_cn: 筋膜间室内压（ICP）超过30 mmHg。急性筋膜室综合征是指封闭的骨筋膜间室内压力增高，导致局部循环障碍。由于未经适当治疗可引发缺血并最终导致坏死，急性筋膜室综合征被视为外科急症。通常该病以临床诊断为主，但ICP超过30 mmHg可作为辅助诊断的阈值标准。

HP:6001173.name: Pain at the lateral aspect of the elbow
HP:6001173.definition: Pain localized to the radial aspect of the elbow.

HP:6001174.name: Pain at the posterior aspect of the elbow
HP:6001174.definition: Pain localized to the posterior aspect of the elbow.

HP:6001175.name: Pain at the medial aspect of the elbow
HP:6001175.definition: Pain localized to the medial aspect of the elbow.

HP:6001176.name: Radial nerve distribution
HP:6001176.definition: Applies to the localization of findings corresponding to the distribution of the radial nevrve, such as (i)paresthesias on the dorsoradial aspect of the hand and wrist, including the dorsal thumb, index finger and middle finger and (ii) Weakness in elbow extension, wrist extension, finger extension, thumb extension and/or supination of the forearm.
HP:6001176.definition_cn: 适用于与桡神经分布区相对应的症状定位，包括：(i)手及腕部桡背侧感觉异常，涉及拇指背侧、食指及中指；(ii)肘关节伸展、腕关节伸展、手指伸展、拇指伸展和/或前臂旋后肌力减弱。

HP:6001177.name: Omovertebral bone
HP:6001177.definition: An osseous connection between the superomedial border of the right scapula and C5-C6 spinous processes.
HP:6001177.definition_cn: 右侧肩胛骨上内侧缘与C5-C6棘突之间存在骨性连接。

HP:6001178.name: Clavicular edema
HP:6001178.definition: Swelling on the chest between the neck and the shoulder, above the clavicel (collar bone).
HP:6001178.definition_cn: 锁骨上方、颈部与肩部之间的胸部肿胀。

HP:6001179.name: Positive CSF anti-measles antibody test
HP:6001179.definition: The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of measles virus.
HP:6001179.name_cn: 脑脊液麻疹抗体检测阳性
HP:6001179.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对麻疹病毒组分的抗体反应。

HP:6001180.name: Vogt striae
HP:6001180.definition: Vertical lines in the posterior stroma of the cornea, aligned with Descemet membrane. These lines temporarily disappear with pressure applied to the cornea. Vogt striae are a hallmark feature of keratoconus but have also been observed in healthy eyes. Rare cases of horizontal striae have been reported.
HP:6001180.definition_cn: 角膜后基质层内与Descemet膜平行的垂直条纹。施压于角膜时这些条纹可暂时消失。Vogt条纹是圆锥角膜的特征性表现，但也可见于健康眼。偶见水平条纹的病例报道。

HP:6001181.name: Choroid thickening
HP:6001181.definition: A condition characterized by an abnormal increase in the thickness of the choroid, which may be associated with various ocular or systemic conditions. Choroid thickening can be measured using imaging techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT).
HP:6001181.definition_cn: 一种以脉络膜异常增厚为特征的病症，可能与多种眼部或全身性疾病相关。脉络膜增厚可通过光学相干断层扫描(OCT)等影像学技术进行测量。

HP:6001182.name: Corneal epithelial edema
HP:6001182.definition: A condition characterized by accumulation of fluid within the corneal epithelium, leading to swelling, blurred vision, and discomfort. It is often associated with increased intraocular pressure, endothelial dysfunction, or contact lens overuse. Clinical features may include a hazy cornea and microcystic changes visible on slit-lamp examination.
HP:6001182.definition_cn: 一种以角膜上皮层内液体积聚为特征的疾病，可导致角膜水肿、视力模糊及眼部不适。该病症常与眼压升高、内皮细胞功能失调或隐形眼镜过度佩戴相关。其临床特征包括角膜雾状混浊，通过裂隙灯检查可见微囊样水肿改变。

HP:6001183.name: Retinal shunt vessels
HP:6001183.definition: bnormal blood vessels in the retina that form as a response to vascular occlusion, serving as bypass channels to redirect blood flow around obstructed or damaged retinal vessels. Retinal shunt vessels are often associated with conditions like retinal vein occlusion or diabetic retinopathy and may appear as tortuous or dilated vessels on fundoscopic examination.
HP:6001183.definition_cn: 视网膜分流血管是视网膜内因血管闭塞而形成的异常血管，作为旁路通道以绕过阻塞或受损的视网膜血管重新引导血流。这类血管常见于视网膜静脉阻塞或糖尿病视网膜病变等疾病，眼底镜检查时可呈现为迂曲扩张的血管形态。

HP:6001184.name: Filamentary keratitis
HP:6001184.definition: A condition characterized by the formation of filaments composed of degenerated epithelial cells and mucus attached to the corneal surface. It is associated with symptoms such as pain, foreign body sensation, photophobia, and tearing. Filamentary keratitis is often linked to underlying conditions such as dry eye disease, post-surgical ocular surface disorders, or systemic diseases like Sjoegren syndrome.
HP:6001184.definition_cn: 一种以角膜表面附着由退变上皮细胞和粘液组成的丝状物为特征的疾病。该病伴随疼痛、异物感、畏光和流泪等症状。丝状角膜炎常与干眼症、术后眼表疾病或干燥综合征等系统性疾病相关。

HP:6001185.name: Elevated circulating glucosylsphingosine concentration
HP:6001185.definition: Concentration of D-glucosylsphingosine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001185.name_cn: 循环葡萄糖基鞘氨醇浓度升高
HP:6001185.definition_cn: 血液中D-葡萄糖基鞘氨醇浓度高于正常值上限

HP:6001186.name: Optic disc hemorrhage
HP:6001186.definition: A condition characterized by bleeding at or near the optic disc, visible as a flame-shaped or splinter hemorrhage on fundoscopic examination.
HP:6001186.definition_cn: 一种以视盘或其附近出血为特征的病症，眼底镜检查可见火焰状或线状出血。

HP:6001187.name: Reduced circulating progranulin concentration
HP:6001187.definition: The concentration of progranulin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001187.name_cn: 循环颗粒蛋白前体浓度降低
HP:6001187.definition_cn: 循环血液中颗粒蛋白前体浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6001188.name: Preauricular lymphadenopathy
HP:6001188.definition: Enlargement of one or more lymph nodes located in front of the ear.

HP:6001189.name: Onychoheterotopia
HP:6001189.definition: Growth of nail tissue outside the ungual plate, generally in the finger.
HP:6001189.definition_cn: 甲板外指甲组织生长，通常发生于手指。

HP:6001190.name: Abnormal MHC surface expression
HP:6001190.definition: A deviation from the normal level of major histocompatibility complex (MHC) molecules expressed at the cell surface. The cell-mediated adaptive immune response is regulated by the MHC, which is called human leukocyte antigen (HLA) in humans. HLA molecules are cell surface glycoproteins whose primary function is to present endogenous and exogenous antigens to T lymphocytes for recognition and response. The HLA molecules that present antigen to T lymphocytes are divided into two main classes: HLA class I and HLA class II molecules.
HP:6001190.definition_cn: 细胞表面主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）分子表达水平偏离正常值。细胞介导的适应性免疫应答由MHC调控，在人类中称为人类白细胞抗原（HLA）。HLA分子是细胞表面糖蛋白，其主要功能是将内源性和外源性抗原呈递给T淋巴细胞进行识别和应答。向T淋巴细胞呈递抗原的HLA分子主要分为两大类：HLA I类分子和HLA II类分子。

HP:6001191.name: Forward displacement of posterior cervical dura mater on neck flexion
HP:6001191.definition: Flexion MRI (imaging with neutral and flexed about 30-40 degrees neck position) reveals an anterior shift of the cervical dural sac from the lamina in the region of C4 to C7.
HP:6001191.name_cn: 颈部屈曲时颈椎后硬脊膜前移
HP:6001191.definition_cn: 屈曲位磁共振成像（采用颈部中立位及屈曲约30-40度体位进行影像学检查）显示C4至C7节段区域硬脊膜囊相对于椎板向前移位。

HP:6001192.name: Corneal dellen
HP:6001192.definition: A localized area of corneal thinning typically occurring adjacent to an elevated lesion, such as a conjunctival scar, pterygium, or poorly fitting contact lens. Corneal dellen result from tear film instability and localized dehydration. Without timely treatment, they may progress to epithelial defects or corneal ulceration.
HP:6001192.definition_cn: 角膜边缘变性是一种局部角膜变薄区域，通常发生于邻近隆起性病变（如结膜瘢痕、翼状胬肉或不合适配戴的角膜接触镜）处。该病变由泪膜不稳定及局部脱水导致。若不及时治疗，可能进展为上皮缺损或角膜溃疡。

HP:6001193.name: Conjunctival xerosis
HP:6001193.definition: A condition characterized by dryness of the conjunctiva, often associated with keratinization of the conjunctival epithelium.
