Conjunctival xerosis is commonly linked to vitamin A deficiency, severe dry eye disease, or systemic conditions such as Sjogren syndrome. Clinical features may include a dull, rough conjunctival surface and reduced mucosal secretions.
HP:6001193.definition_cn: 一种以结膜干燥为特征的病变，常伴有结膜上皮角化。结膜干燥症通常与维生素A缺乏、严重干眼症或系统性病变（如干燥综合征）相关。临床特征可表现为结膜表面失去光泽、粗糙以及粘液分泌减少。

HP:6001194.name: Limited shoulder external rotation
HP:6001194.definition: Difficulty rotating the lower part of the arm away from the body (tested with the elbow flexed and the elbow held next to the side of the body) secondary to pain, weakness, or mechanical block.
HP:6001194.definition_cn: 因疼痛、无力或机械性阻挡导致前臂外旋困难（测试时屈肘并将肘部紧贴体侧）。

HP:6001195.name: Occupational exposure to frequent hand trauma
HP:6001195.definition: A history of exposure to repeated hand trauma as observed with occupations in which use of hands is frequent such as construction, food preparation and serving related occupations, and transportation and material moving occupations.
HP:6001195.name_cn: 职业性频繁手部创伤暴露
HP:6001195.definition_cn: 有反复手部创伤暴露史，常见于频繁使用手部的职业，如建筑、食品制备与服务相关职业，以及运输和物料搬运职业。

HP:6001196.name: Inability to fully extend finger at metacarpophalangeal joint
HP:6001196.definition: An inability to fully extend the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint of a finger (extension of an MCP joint straightens the finger).
HP:6001196.name_cn: 掌指关节处手指完全伸展障碍
HP:6001196.definition_cn: 手指掌指关节（MCP关节）完全伸展功能障碍（MCP关节伸展可使手指伸直）。

HP:6001198.name: Scapholunate interval widening
HP:6001198.definition: Widening of the space between the scaphoid and lunate on x-ray; scapholunate dissociation.
HP:6001198.definition_cn: X线显示舟骨与月骨间隙增宽；舟月骨分离。

HP:6001199.name: FInger pulp localization
HP:6001199.definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution is limited to or predominantly affects the fleshy mass on the volar (palmar) aspect of the digit, distal to the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint (known as the pulp of the finger).
HP:6001199.definition_cn: 适用于一种异常情况，其分布局限于或主要影响手指掌侧（手掌面）远节指间关节（DIP关节）远端肉质部分（称为指腹）。

HP:6001200.name: Ulnar wrist pain
HP:6001200.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the ulnar side of the wrist.
HP:6001200.definition_cn: 一种以尺侧腕部局限性躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001201.name: Lunotriquetral interval widening
HP:6001201.definition: Radiographic widening of the space between the lunate and triquetrum bones.
HP:6001201.definition_cn: 月骨与三角骨间隙的X线影像增宽。

HP:6001202.name: Ulnar translocation of the carpus
HP:6001202.definition: Anteroposterior wrist radiograph showing ulnar translocation of the carpus from the distal radius with widening of the radial styloid-scaphoid space.
HP:6001202.definition_cn: 腕关节正位片显示腕骨相对于桡骨远端向尺侧移位，伴桡骨茎突-舟骨间隙增宽。

HP:6001203.name: Snapping sensation at time of injury
HP:6001203.definition: A popping or snapping sensation (noise or feeling) at the time of an injury.
HP:6001203.definition_cn: 受伤时出现弹响或断裂感（声响或感觉）。

HP:6001204.name: Pagetoid spread
HP:6001204.definition: Pagetoid spread connotes the spread of single neoplastic cells, and small nests of them above the basal layer in a variety of melanocytic and nonmelanocytic neoplasms similar to the pattern seen in Paget's and in extramammary Paget disease.
HP:6001204.definition_cn: 派杰样播散是指单个肿瘤细胞及小巢状肿瘤细胞群在基底膜上层扩散的现象，可见于多种黑素细胞性及非黑素细胞性肿瘤，其形态学特征与乳腺派杰病及乳腺外派杰病中所见模式相似。

HP:6001206.name: Scapholunate ligament tear
HP:6001206.definition: A breakage (partial or complete tear) of the scapholunate ligament. The most common cause is physical trauma to the wrist such as a fall onto an outstretched hand. Tear of the scapholunate ligament may lead to carpal instability.
HP:6001206.definition_cn: 舟月韧带断裂（部分或完全撕裂）。最常见病因为腕部遭受物理性创伤，如跌倒时手掌撑地。舟月韧带撕裂可导致腕关节不稳。

HP:6001207.name: Lunotriquetral ligament tear
HP:6001207.definition: A breakage (partial or complete tear) of the lunotriquetral ligament. The most common cause is physical trauma to the wrist such as a fall onto an outstretched hand. Rupture or tear of the the lunotriquetral ligament may lead to carpal instability.
HP:6001207.definition_cn: 月三角韧带断裂（部分或完全撕裂）。最常见病因为腕部物理性创伤，如手掌伸展位跌倒。月三角韧带断裂或撕裂可导致腕关节不稳。

HP:6001208.name: Pisotriquetral arthritis
HP:6001208.definition: Arthritis at the pisotriquetral joint. Radiographic evidence of arthritis at the pisotriquetral joint includes joint space narrowing, osteophytes, subchondral cysts, and/or subchondral sclerosis.
HP:6001208.definition_cn: 豌豆三角关节关节炎。豌豆三角关节关节炎的影像学表现包括关节间隙狭窄、骨赘形成、软骨下囊肿和/或软骨下硬化。

HP:6001209.name: Volar intercalated segment instability
HP:6001209.definition: A type of carpal instability characterized by volar tilt of the lunate bone.
HP:6001209.definition_cn: 一种以月骨向掌侧倾斜为特征的手腕不稳定性类型。

HP:6001210.name: Inaccurate finger pulse oximetry oxygen saturation measurement
HP:6001210.definition: Any substantial discrepancy between the measurement of oxygen saturation with finger probe pulse oximetry as compared to an arterial blood gas, which is considered the gold standard.
HP:6001210.name_cn: 手指脉搏血氧饱和度测量不准确
HP:6001210.definition_cn: 手指探头脉搏血氧仪测得的血氧饱和度与动脉血气分析（金标准）之间存在显著差异。

HP:6001211.name: Finger pulse oximetry lower than arterial blood gas analysis measurement of oxygen saturation
HP:6001211.definition: Inaccurately reduced oxygen saturation as measured by finger or toe pulse oximetry compared to oxygen saturation as measured by venous or arterial blood gas analysis.
HP:6001211.name_cn: 手指脉搏血氧饱和度低于动脉血气分析的氧饱和度测量值
HP:6001211.definition_cn: 手指或脚趾脉搏血氧测定测得的氧饱和度与静脉或动脉血气分析测得的氧饱和度相比不准确降低。

HP:6001212.name: Finger pulse oximetry higher than arterial blood gas analysis measurement of oxygen saturation
HP:6001212.definition: Inaccurately elevated oxygen saturation as measured by finger or toe pulse oximetry compared to oxygen saturation as measured by venous or arterial blood gas analysis.
HP:6001212.name_cn: 手指脉搏血氧饱和度高于动脉血气分析的氧饱和度测量值
HP:6001212.definition_cn: 手指或足趾脉搏血氧测定法测得的氧饱和度与静脉或动脉血气分析测得的氧饱和度相比存在不准确的高估现象。

HP:6001213.name: History of thumb sucking past the age of four years
HP:6001213.definition: Thumb sucking is a behavior that ceases spontaneously in most children between 2 and 4 years of age. If thumb sucking continues, negative consequences can occur, such as a deformity of the nail or paronychia. This term refers to a history of habitual thumb sucking past the age of 4 years of life.
HP:6001213.definition_cn: 吮指行为是一种在2至4岁儿童中大多会自行停止的习惯。若持续存在，可能导致指甲畸形或甲沟炎等不良后果。本术语特指4岁后仍存在习惯性吮指行为的既往史。

HP:6001214.name: Cutaneous granulomatosis
HP:6001214.definition: Skin inflammatory reaction triggered by a wide variety of stimuli, including infections, foreign bodies, malignancy, metabolites, and chemicals. From a pathogenic point of view, they are divided into non-infectious and infectious granulomas. From a clinical point of view, it is useful to divide cutaneous granulomatosis into localized and more disseminated forms, although this distinction can be sometimes artificial.
HP:6001214.definition_cn: 由多种刺激因素引发的皮肤炎症反应，包括感染、异物、恶性肿瘤、代谢产物及化学物质等。从病原学角度可分为非感染性肉芽肿和感染性肉芽肿。从临床角度而言，将皮肤肉芽肿病分为局限型和播散型具有实用价值，尽管这种区分有时可能具有人为性。

HP:6001215.name: Ureteric stricture
HP:6001215.definition: Obstruction of urine flow through one or both ureters caused by issues such as injury, infection, tumours and surgery.
HP:6001215.definition_cn: 单侧或双侧输尿管因损伤、感染、肿瘤及手术等因素导致的尿流梗阻。

HP:6001216.name: Arteriovenous crossing sign
HP:6001216.definition: A retinal vascular abnormality characterized by indentation or compression of a retinal vein at an arteriovenous crossing, leading to changes in venous caliber. AV crossing signs are commonly associated with hypertensive retinopathy and may contribute to retinal vein occlusion. They are indicative of vascular remodeling due to chronic hypertension or other systemic vascular diseases.
HP:6001216.definition_cn: 一种视网膜血管异常，特征为动静脉交叉处视网膜静脉受压或凹陷，导致静脉管径改变。动静脉交叉征常见于高血压性视网膜病变，并可能促进视网膜静脉阻塞的发生。该征象提示慢性高血压或其他全身性血管疾病所致的血管重塑。

HP:6001217.name: Haab striae
HP:6001217.definition: Curvilinear or circumferential breaks in Descemet membrane, typically associated with congenital glaucoma. Haab striae result from elevated intraocular pressure during corneal development, leading to the formation of horizontal or arcuate lines that may be visible on slit-lamp examination. They can contribute to corneal astigmatism and visual impairment.
HP:6001217.definition_cn: Descemet膜上的曲线形或环形断裂，通常与先天性青光眼相关。Haab纹是由于角膜发育期间眼压升高所致，导致形成可在裂隙灯检查中观察到的水平或弓形线条。它们可能导致角膜散光和视力损害。

HP:6001218.name: Positive Legionella sputum culture
HP:6001218.definition: Growth of Legionella bacteria in a sputum culture.
HP:6001218.definition_cn: 痰培养中军团菌的生长。

HP:6001219.name: Positive Streptococcus pneumoniae sputum culture
HP:6001219.definition: Streptococcus pneumoniae growth in sputum culture.
HP:6001219.name_cn: 肺炎链球菌痰培养阳性
HP:6001219.definition_cn: 痰培养中检出肺炎链球菌生长。

HP:6001220.name: Positive Blastomyces dermatitidis sputum fungal stain
HP:6001220.definition: Demonstration of Blastomyces dermatitidis by microscopic examination of a stained sputum specimen.
HP:6001220.name_cn: 皮炎芽生菌痰真菌染色阳性
HP:6001220.definition_cn: 通过染色痰标本的显微镜检查证实皮炎芽生菌。

HP:6001221.name: Posterior shoulder pain
HP:6001221.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the posterior (back) part of the shoulder.
HP:6001221.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，定位于肩部后侧（背部）。

HP:6001222.name: Superior shoulder pain
HP:6001222.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the superior or proximal aspect of the shoulder over the acromion, distal clavicle, and/or acromioclavicular (AC) joint.
HP:6001222.definition_cn: 一种以躯体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，定位于肩部上方或近端，涉及肩峰、远端锁骨和/或肩锁关节区域。

HP:6001223.name: Lateral shoulder pain
HP:6001223.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the localized aspect (on the side) of the shoulder.
HP:6001223.definition_cn: 一种以躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，定位于肩部的局部区域（侧面）。

HP:6001224.name: Shoulder instability
HP:6001224.definition: Subjective or objective feeling of clunking/clicking in the shoulder with movement, shoulder 'giving way', or sensation of shoulder dislocating.
HP:6001224.definition_cn: 肩关节活动时主观或客观感觉到的弹响/咔嗒声、肩关节“失稳”或肩关节脱位感。

HP:6001225.name: Shoulder labrum tear
HP:6001225.definition: A injury with a team (rip, split, or disruption) to the labrum, which is the ring of cartilage that surrounds the socket of the shoulder joint (the glenoid).
HP:6001225.definition_cn: 盂唇损伤（撕裂、裂伤或断裂），即环绕肩关节盂（关节窝）的软骨环病变。

HP:6001226.name: Positive modified dynamic labral shear test
HP:6001226.definition: Sensation of a pain with or without clicking or clunking sensation with the following test. Flex patients elbow to 90 degrees and abduct the arm 120 degrees while maximally externally rotating the arm, then examiner lowers the arm to 60 degrees of abduction. A positive test occurs with pain and/or a painful click along the posterior joint line between 120 degrees and 90 degrees of abduction.
HP:6001226.name_cn: 阳性改良动态盂唇剪切试验
HP:6001226.definition_cn: 在进行以下测试时，患者出现疼痛感，伴或不伴弹响或咔嗒感：将患者肘关节屈曲至90度，同时外展上肢至120度并最大限度外旋上肢，随后检查者将上肢缓慢内收至60度外展位。阳性体征表现为在120度至90度外展过程中，沿关节后缘出现疼痛和/或伴有疼痛的弹响。

HP:6001227.name: Positive O'Brien active compression test
HP:6001227.definition: Pain in shoulder reproduced when examiner applies downward pressure on the arm while patient resists pressure in the following position: elbow extended, shoulder forward flexed to 90 degrees and 10-15 degrees adducted with palm facing down. This can be compared to the same position but with the palm facing up which should be less painful.
HP:6001227.name_cn: 奥布赖恩主动压迫试验阳性
HP:6001227.definition_cn: 检查者在下述体位对患者手臂施加向下压力时，患者抵抗压力可诱发肩部疼痛：肘关节伸直，肩关节前屈90度并内收10-15度，手掌朝下。可与相同体位但手掌朝上的情况进行对比，后者疼痛应较轻。

HP:6001228.name: Positive shoulder apprehension test
HP:6001228.definition: The individual being investigated displays noticeable apprehension (unease) during a test for shoulder instability in which the individual is laying supine with shoulder abducted to 90 degrees, elbow flexed to 90 degrees, and an external rotation pressure with combined downward pressure is applied on the upper arm.
HP:6001228.definition_cn: 受检者在肩关节不稳测试中表现出明显的恐惧不安（不适感）。测试时受检者取仰卧位，肩关节外展90度，肘关节屈曲90度，检查者对上臂施加外旋压力并同时施加向下的压力。

HP:6001229.name: Foamy tear film
HP:6001229.definition: A condition characterized by the presence of foam or bubbles within the tear film, often associated with meibomian gland dysfunction or ocular surface diseases.
HP:6001229.definition_cn: 一种以泪膜内存在泡沫或气泡为特征的病症，通常与睑板腺功能障碍或眼表疾病相关。

HP:6001230.name: Salzmann corneal nodules
HP:6001230.definition: The formation of large, bluish, nodular lesions in the superficial corneal stroma, often associated with chronic keratitis or aging. These nodules may lead to visual impairment.
HP:6001230.definition_cn: 角膜浅基质层形成大而呈蓝色的结节性病变，常与慢性角膜炎或年龄相关。这些结节可能导致视力损害。

HP:6001231.name: Corneal stromal vascularisation
HP:6001231.definition: The abnormal growth of blood vessels into the corneal stroma, often associated with ocular herpes, chronic inflammation, infection, or hypoxia. This condition can lead to corneal scarring and vision impairment.
HP:6001231.definition_cn: 角膜基质内血管异常增生，常与眼部疱疹、慢性炎症、感染或缺氧相关。该病变可导致角膜瘢痕形成及视力损害。

HP:6001232.name: Corneal iron line
HP:6001232.definition: Linear or arcuate deposition of iron within the corneal epithelium or stroma, typically associated with conditions such as keratoconus, corneal degeneration, or postsurgical corneal changes.
HP:6001232.definition_cn: 角膜上皮或基质内铁质呈线性或弧形沉积，通常与圆锥角膜、角膜变性或术后角膜改变等疾病相关。

HP:6001233.name: Conjunctivochalasis
HP:6001233.definition: A condition characterized by redundant, loose conjunctival tissue, typically located between the globe and the lower eyelid, which may cause ocular discomfort, tear film instability, or epiphora.
HP:6001233.definition_cn: 一种以结膜组织冗余、松弛为特征的疾病，通常位于眼球与下眼睑之间，可能导致眼部不适、泪膜不稳定或溢泪。

HP:6001234.name: Conjunctival hyperpigmentation
HP:6001234.definition: Increased pigmentation of the conjunctiva, characterized by brown or black discoloration due to melanocytic proliferation or pigment deposition. It may be associated with benign conditions such as primary acquired melanosis or malignant transformation into conjunctival melanoma.
HP:6001234.definition_cn: 结膜色素沉着增加，其特征是由于黑素细胞增殖或色素沉积导致的棕色或黑色变色。可能与原发性获得性黑变病等良性病变相关，或恶变为结膜黑色素瘤。

HP:6001235.name: Anti-Saccharomyces cerevisiae antibodies
HP:6001235.definition: Antibodies against antigens presented by the cell wall of the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae.
HP:6001235.definition_cn: 抗酿酒酵母细胞壁抗原抗体

HP:6001236.name: Elevated fraction exhaled nitric oxide
HP:6001236.definition: The fractional exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO) is elevated above the upper limit of normal. FeNO is an endogenous gaseous molecule which can be measured in the human breath test because of airway inflammation. It has been studied extensively as a marker of inflammation and has been incorporated into an algorithm for asthma management.
HP:6001236.name_cn: 呼出气一氧化氮分数升高
HP:6001236.definition_cn: 呼出气一氧化氮分数（FeNO）升高超过正常值上限。FeNO是一种内源性气体分子，由于气道炎症反应可在人体呼气检测中测得。其作为炎症标志物已被广泛研究，并被纳入哮喘管理诊疗方案。

HP:6001237.name: Iris hyperemia
HP:6001237.definition: A condition characterized by increased blood flow and congestion of the iris vasculature, leading to a reddish discoloration of the iris. Iris hyperemia is commonly associated with anterior uveitis, angle-closure glaucoma, or ocular inflammation.
HP:6001237.definition_cn: 一种以虹膜血管系统血流增加和充血为特征的病理状态，导致虹膜呈现红色改变。虹膜充血通常与前葡萄膜炎、闭角型青光眼或眼部炎症相关。

HP:6001238.name: Elevated circulating reticulated platelet count
HP:6001238.definition: The number of reticulated platelets per volume of blood in the peripheral circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001238.name_cn: 循环网状血小板计数升高
HP:6001238.definition_cn: 外周循环中每单位体积血液中的网织血小板数量高于正常上限。

HP:6001239.name: Reduced circulating reticulated platelet count
HP:6001239.definition: The number of reticulated platelets per volume of blood in the peripheral circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001239.name_cn: 循环网织血小板计数降低
HP:6001239.definition_cn: 外周循环中每单位体积血液中的网织血小板数量低于正常下限。

HP:6001240.name: Abnormal circulating reticulated platelet count
HP:6001240.definition: The number of reticulated platelets per volume of blood in the peripheral circulation is outside the limits of normal.
HP:6001240.name_cn: 异常循环网织血小板计数
HP:6001240.definition_cn: 外周循环中每单位体积血液中的网织血小板数量超出正常范围。

HP:6001241.name: Flexed posturing of finger
HP:6001241.definition: A sign that can be observed in diseases such as Pyogenic or suppurative flexor tenosynovitis in which the affected finger is held in a flexed position. Often, there is pain on any attempt at passive finger extension. This finding is to be distinguished from a contracture of a finger joint in which the flexed positions is fixed.
HP:6001241.definition_cn: 一种可在化脓性屈肌腱鞘炎等疾病中观察到的体征，表现为患指保持屈曲位姿。被动伸展手指时常引发疼痛。需注意与指关节挛缩相鉴别，后者屈曲位姿为固定性。

HP:6001242.name: Positive synovial fluid alpha-defensin
HP:6001242.definition: Elevation of the the alpha-defensin concentration in synovial aspirate is above the upper limit of normal. The alpha-defensin test is a qualitative immunoassay optimized and validated for synovial fluid. The alpha-defensin protein is an antimicrobial peptide that is naturally released by neutrophils responding to a pathogen in the synovial fluid.
HP:6001242.definition_cn: 关节液穿刺样本中α-防御素浓度升高超出正常值上限。α-防御素检测是针对关节液优化验证的定性免疫分析法。α-防御素蛋白是一种由中性粒细胞响应关节液中病原体时自然释放的抗菌肽。

HP:6001243.name: Physeal fracture
HP:6001243.definition: Salter-Harris fractures (physeal fractures) refer to fractures through a growth plate (physis) and are, therefore, specifically applied to bone fractures in children.
HP:6001243.definition_cn: Salter-Harris骨折（骨骺骨折）是指通过生长板（骺板）的骨折，因此特指儿童骨骼骨折。

HP:6001244.name: Salter I fracture
HP:6001244.definition: A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture line extends through the physis or within the growth plate. Type I fractures are due to the longitudinal force applied through the physis, which splits the epiphysis from the metaphysis.
HP:6001244.definition_cn: 一种骺板（Salter-Harris）骨折类型，其骨折线贯穿骺板或位于生长板内。I型骨折是由于纵向力作用于骺板，导致骨骺与干骺端分离所致。

HP:6001245.name: Salter II fracture
HP:6001245.definition: A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture extends through both the physis and metaphysis. These are most common and occur away from the joint space. When the small corner of the metaphysis is visible, this is known as a corner sign or Thurston-Holland fragment.
HP:6001245.definition_cn: 一种骨骺（Salter-Harris）骨折类型，其骨折线贯穿骨骺和干骺端。此类骨折最为常见且发生于远离关节间隙处。当干骺端小角状骨片显影时，称为角征或Thurston-Holland骨片。

HP:6001246.name: Salter III fracture
HP:6001246.definition: A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture is intra-articular and extends from the physis into the epiphysis.
HP:6001246.definition_cn: 一种骨骺（Salter-Harris）骨折类型，其特点是骨折线位于关节内，并从生长板延伸至骨骺。

HP:6001247.name: Salter IV fracture
HP:6001247.definition: A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture in which the fracture is intra-articular and passes through the epiphysis, physis, and metaphysis.
HP:6001247.definition_cn: 一种骨骺（Salter-Harris）骨折类型，其骨折线为关节内骨折，贯穿骨骺、生长板和干骺端。

HP:6001248.name: Salter V fracture
HP:6001248.definition: A type of physeal (Salter-Harris) fracture that is due to a crush or compression injury of the growth plate. In type V, the force is transmitted through the epiphysis and physis, potentially disrupting the germinal matrix, hypertrophic region, and vascular supply.
HP:6001248.definition_cn: 一种因生长板遭受挤压或压缩损伤所致的骨骺（Salter-Harris）骨折。在V型骨折中，外力通过骨骺和生长板传导，可能破坏生发基质层、肥大细胞区及血供系统。

HP:6001249.name: Nail bed laceration
HP:6001249.definition: A cut or injury to the soft tissue under the fingernail or toenail.
HP:6001249.definition_cn: 甲下软组织切割伤或损伤

HP:6001250.name: History of distal radius fracture
HP:6001250.definition: Recent or remote history of distal radius fracture of the symptomatic arm.
HP:6001250.definition_cn: 症状侧手臂近期或远期桡骨远端骨折史。

HP:6001251.name: History of triangular fibrocartilage complex tear
HP:6001251.definition: Recent or remote history of a tear in the triangular fibrocartilage complex (TFCC). The TFCC is a load-bearing structure between the lunate, triquetrum, and ulnar head. The function of the TFCC is to act as a stabilizer for the ulnar aspect of the wrist. The TFCC is at risk for either acute or chronic degenerative injury.
HP:6001251.name_cn: 三角纤维软骨复合体撕裂病史
HP:6001251.definition_cn: 三角纤维软骨复合体（TFCC）近期或远期撕裂史。三角纤维软骨复合体是位于月骨、三角骨和尺骨头之间的承重结构，其功能为稳定腕关节尺侧。该结构易发生急性或慢性退行性损伤。

HP:6001252.name: Reduced plantar creases
HP:6001252.definition: The creases (wrinkles) on the soles of the feet are less pronounced than normal, or absent.
HP:6001252.definition_cn: 足底皱褶较正常减少或消失。

HP:6001253.name: Skin burn
HP:6001253.definition: Damage to the skin and underlying tissues caused by an agents such as heat, chemicals, electricity, radiation, or friction, resulting in pain, redness, swelling, and sometimes blisters or charring.
HP:6001253.definition_cn: 由热力、化学物质、电流、辐射或摩擦等致伤因子导致的皮肤及皮下组织损伤，临床表现为疼痛、红斑、肿胀，严重者可出现水疱或焦痂形成。

HP:6001254.name: Elevanted carboxysterol concentration in cultured lymphoblasts
HP:6001254.definition: The concentration of carboxysterols in lymphoblastoid cells cultured in cholesterol-depleted medium is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001254.name_cn: 培养淋巴母细胞中羧基固醇浓度升高
HP:6001254.definition_cn: 在胆固醇耗竭培养基中培养的淋巴母细胞中羧基固醇浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6001255.name: Superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition
HP:6001255.definition: An anomaly that can be ascertained by iron-specific magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences such as gradient-echo (GRE) and susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI). Superficial siderosis of the central nervous system is a chronic condition due to persistent or repeated long-term bleeding into the subarachnoid space, leading to subpial hemosiderin deposition. Hemosiderin deposition on MRI is seen as a T2 hypointensity and preferentially outlines the cerebellum and brainstem surface.
HP:6001255.name_cn: 中枢神经系统浅表含铁血黄素沉积
HP:6001255.definition_cn: 一种可通过铁特异性磁共振成像（MRI）序列（如梯度回波[GRE]和磁敏感加权成像[SWI]）确认的异常表现。中枢神经系统表面铁沉积症是一种因蛛网膜下腔持续或反复长期出血导致软膜下含铁血黄素沉积的慢性病变。MRI上含铁血黄素沉积表现为T2低信号，并特征性地沿小脑和脑干表面分布。

HP:6001256.name: Cortical superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition
HP:6001256.definition: A type of superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition that most commonly occurs due to iron deposits in the superficial cortical layers following bleeding from leptomeningeal vessels, most often from cerebral amyloid angiopathy in patients aged 55 or older.
HP:6001256.name_cn: 皮质浅层中枢神经系统含铁血黄素沉积
HP:6001256.definition_cn: 一种表浅中枢神经系统含铁血黄素沉积症，最常见于55岁及以上患者因软脑膜血管出血（多为脑淀粉样血管病）后，铁沉积于大脑皮质浅层所致。

HP:6001257.name: Infratentorial superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition
HP:6001257.definition: A type of superficial CNS hemosiderin deposition that involves the cerebellum and brainstem, most commonly the superior vermis, quadrigeminal plate, and basal cerebral surfaces. Cerebellar atrophy, particularly the superior vermis and anterior cerebellar hemispheres, can also be seen on a computed tomography scan of the head. The MRI of the spinal cord may reveal myelomalacia, syringomyelia, owl-eyes, or snake-eyes signs. The most common etiology for classic or primary infratentorial superficial siderosis is spinal dural defects, often dural tears.
HP:6001257.name_cn: 幕下中枢神经系统浅表含铁血黄素沉积
HP:6001257.definition_cn: 一种累及小脑和脑干的浅表中枢神经系统含铁血黄素沉积症，最常见于上蚓部、四叠体板及大脑底面。头部计算机断层扫描还可观察到小脑萎缩，尤其是上蚓部和小脑半球前部。脊髓磁共振成像可能显示脊髓软化、脊髓空洞症、猫头鹰眼征或蛇眼征。经典或原发性幕下浅表铁质沉着症最常见的病因是脊髓硬膜缺损，通常为硬膜撕裂。

HP:6001258.name: Pulmonary hyperplasia
HP:6001258.definition: Pulmonary Hyperplasia is an absolute increase in the number of alveoli, which are mildly enlarged. Pulmonary hyperplasia has been also referred to as polyalveolar lobe and type 3 cystic adenomatoid malformation.
HP:6001258.definition_cn: 肺增生是指肺泡数量绝对性增多，且肺泡轻度扩大。肺增生也被称为多肺泡肺叶及3型囊性腺瘤样畸形。

HP:6001259.name: Positive protozoan parasite CSF wet mount test
HP:6001259.definition: Demonstration of protozoan parasites in a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) specimen by microscopy.
HP:6001259.name_cn: 阳性原虫寄生虫脑脊液湿涂片检查
HP:6001259.definition_cn: 通过显微镜检查在脑脊液（CSF）标本中证实原虫寄生虫存在。

HP:6001260.name: Gallbladder polyp
HP:6001260.definition: A gallbladder (GB) polyp is a growth that projects from the lining of the inside wall of the gallbladder into the lumen of the GB. GB polyps are a common incidental sonographic finding, the vast majority of which are benign.
HP:6001260.definition_cn: 胆囊息肉是指从胆囊内壁黏膜层向胆囊腔内突出的隆起性病变。胆囊息肉是超声检查中常见的偶发表现，绝大多数为良性病变。

HP:6001261.name: Gallbladder polyposis
HP:6001261.definition: Multiple polyps arising from the gallbladder mucosal wall.

HP:6001262.name: Biceps tendon rupture
HP:6001262.definition: Discontinuity of the biceps tendon as observed by ultrasound or magnetic resonance (MR) imaging.
HP:6001262.definition_cn: 超声或磁共振（MR）成像下观察到的肱二头肌腱连续性中断。

HP:6001263.name: Medial epicondyle apophysitis
HP:6001263.definition: Medial epicondyle apophysitis (MEA), also known as little league elbow, is an overuse injury prevalent among adolescent athletes whose sport involves repetitive overhand throwing, racket use, or other overhead arm motions. The medial epicondyle is a bony protrusion on the medial elbow with its own ossification center, separate from the main distal humeral physis, known as an apophysis. Medial epicondyle apophysitis occurs due to excessive and repetitive valgus stress placed on the apophysis before its closure. Over time, the repetitive strain results in a traction-type injury and may cause pathologic widening and inflammation of the apophysis or even an avulsion fracture.
HP:6001263.definition_cn: 肱骨内上髁骨突炎（Medial Epicondyle Apophysitis, MEA），又称少年棒球肘，是一种好发于青少年运动员的过度使用性损伤，常见于需要重复性过顶投掷、球拍运动或其他上肢过顶动作的体育项目中。肱骨内上髁是肘关节内侧的骨性突起，具有独立的骨化中心（与肱骨远端主要骺板分离），属于牵拉性骨突。该病源于骨突闭合前承受的反复外翻应力作用，长期机械牵拉可导致牵引型损伤，引发骨突病理性增宽、炎症反应，甚至发生撕脱性骨折。

HP:6001264.name: Thumb carpometacarpal subluxation
HP:6001264.definition: A partial (subluxation) loss of alignment at the base of the thumb, where the first metacarpal bone meets the trapezium bone of the wrist. Thumb radiographs showing carpometacarpal (CMC) joint space widening and/or incongruity of the joint space between thumb metacarpal bone and the trapezium bone.
HP:6001264.definition_cn: 拇指基底部分对位不良（半脱位），即第一掌骨与腕部大多角骨连接处。拇指X线片显示腕掌（CMC）关节间隙增宽和/或拇指掌骨与大多角骨之间的关节间隙不匹配。

HP:6001265.name: Localized to the lower eyelid
HP:6001265.definition: A descriptor indicating that a condition, lesion, or abnormality is confined to the lower eyelid. This localization may be relevant for various ocular conditions, including infections, structural abnormalities, or dermatological diseases affecting the lower eyelid region.
HP:6001265.definition_cn: 一种描述性术语，指病变、损伤或异常仅局限于下眼睑区域。这种定位特征与多种眼部疾病相关，包括感染性病变、结构异常或累及下眼睑区域的皮肤科疾病。

HP:6001266.name: Localized to eyelid
HP:6001266.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in an eyelid.
HP:6001266.definition_cn: 适用于位于眼睑的异常情况。

HP:6001267.name: Halo vision
HP:6001267.definition: A visual phenomenon characterized by the perception of bright rings or halos surrounding light sources. Halo vision is often associated with optical irregularities such as corneal edema, cataracts, or intraocular lens complications. It may also occur in conditions affecting the tear film or due to the presence of glare from light scattering within the ocular media.
HP:6001267.definition_cn: 一种以感知光源周围出现明亮环圈或光晕为特征的视觉现象。眩光症常见于角膜水肿、白内障或人工晶体并发症等光学异常情况。亦可发生于影响泪膜稳定性的疾病状态，或因眼内介质光线散射导致的眩光效应所致。

HP:6001268.name: Hematospermia
HP:6001268.definition: The presence of blood in the seminal fluid.

HP:6001269.name: Choledocholithiasis
HP:6001269.definition: Choledocholithiasis is the presence of stones within the common bile duct.
HP:6001269.definition_cn: 胆总管结石症是指胆总管内存在结石。

HP:6001270.name: Axillary nerve distribution
HP:6001270.definition: Paresthesias on the lateral aspect of the shoulder and upper arm. Weakness in shoulder abduction (deltoid) and shoulder external rotation (teres minor).
HP:6001270.definition_cn: 肩部及上臂外侧感觉异常。肩外展（三角肌）和肩外旋（小圆肌）肌力减弱。

HP:6001271.name: Pelvic ring fracture
HP:6001271.definition: X-ray of the pelvis (AP, inlet, and outlet views) showing fracture of the pelvic ring, including iliac wing (ilium), superior or inferior pubic ramus, or ischium, and/or displacement of the pubic symphysis or sacroiliac joints.
HP:6001271.definition_cn: 骨盆X线片（前后位、入口位及出口位投照）显示骨盆环骨折，累及髂骨翼（髂骨）、耻骨上支或下支、坐骨，和/或耻骨联合或骶髂关节移位。

HP:6001272.name: Scapulothoracic dissociation
HP:6001272.definition: An injury consisting of a laterally displaced scapula with separation of the ipsilateral acromioclavicular joint, disruption of the ipsilateral subclavian vessels and brachial plexus, and an intact overlying skin.
HP:6001272.definition_cn: 一种损伤，表现为肩胛骨外侧移位伴同侧肩锁关节分离、同侧锁骨下血管及臂丛神经断裂，但表面皮肤完整。

HP:6001273.name: Pain exacerbated by weight bearing
HP:6001273.definition: Refers to pain that is worse when the individual bears weight with the affected body part.

HP:6001274.name: Thumb sign
HP:6001274.definition: The distal phalanx of the adducted thumb extends beyond the ulnar border of the palm (The thumb protrudes from the clenched fist).
HP:6001274.definition_cn: 内收拇指远节指骨超出手掌尺侧缘（拇指从握拳中突出）。

HP:6001275.name: Tibialis anterior tendon rupture
HP:6001275.definition: Partial or complete breakage (rupture) of the tibialis anterior tendon (TAT). The TAT is the principal dorsiflexor of the ankle joint and secondary invertor of the foot. It has important roles in the different stages of gait; in the swing phase, it concentrically dorsiflex the ankle for foot clearance and during plantarflexion of the ankle in the stance phase, it eccentrically contract to stabilize the ankle and prevent damage to the foot and ankle. Clinically, presentations in acute lacerations or direct trauma cases are straight forward, in chronic and atraumatic cases usually the symptoms at the time of TAT rupture are more subtle. Other manifestations include mild pain, localized mass, palpable gap, loss of strength, instability during gait, gait disturbances with forefoot dropping and stumbling and high stepping gait.
HP:6001275.definition_cn: 胫前肌腱（Tibialis Anterior Tendon，TAT）部分或完全断裂。TAT是踝关节主要的背屈肌及足部次要的内翻肌，在步态周期各阶段具有重要作用：摆动期通过向心收缩实现踝背屈以确保足部离地；站立期踝跖屈时通过离心收缩稳定踝关节，防止足踝损伤。急性切割伤或直接创伤病例临床表现明确，而慢性无创伤性断裂病例的TAT断裂症状通常更为隐匿。其他表现包括轻度疼痛、局部肿块、可触及的断裂间隙、肌力减退、步态不稳伴前足下垂及绊倒现象、以及高抬腿步态异常。

HP:6001276.name: Decreased circulating ADAMTS13 activity
HP:6001276.definition: Activity of the enzyme von Willebrand factor-cleaving protease (ADAMTS13) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001276.definition_cn: 循环血液中血管性血友病因子裂解蛋白酶（ADAMTS13）活性低于正常值下限。

HP:6001277.name: Abnormal methacholine challenge test
HP:6001277.definition: An abnormal result of the methacholine challenge test, which is a bronchoprovocation technique used to evaluate airway hyperresponsiveness, particularly in patients with suspected asthma.
HP:6001277.name_cn: 异常乙酰甲胆碱激发试验
HP:6001277.definition_cn: 乙酰甲胆碱激发试验结果异常，该试验是一种用于评估气道高反应性的支气管激发技术，尤其适用于疑似哮喘患者。

HP:6001278.name: Positive stool glutamate dehydrogenase test
HP:6001278.definition: Detection of the presence of glutamate dehydrogenase produced by Clostridium difficile in a stool sample.
HP:6001278.name_cn: 粪便谷氨酸脱氢酶试验阳性
HP:6001278.definition_cn: 粪便样本中艰难梭菌产生的谷氨酸脱氢酶检测

HP:6001279.name: Retrocorneal membrane
HP:6001279.definition: A retrocorneal membrane is an abnormal, fibrous or cellular tissue layer that forms on the posterior surface of the cornea, typically on or adjacent to the Descemet membrane. It may result from trauma, surgery (e.g., penetrating keratoplasty), inflammation, or endothelial cell dysfunction, and can lead to visual impairment depending on its density and extent.
HP:6001279.definition_cn: 后角膜膜是一种形成于角膜后表面的异常纤维性或细胞性组织层，通常位于或邻近后弹力层。该病变可由外伤、手术（如穿透性角膜移植术）、炎症或内皮细胞功能障碍引起，其密度和范围可导致视力损害。

HP:6001280.name: Adrenal hemorrhage
HP:6001280.definition: Adrenal hemorrhage is bleeding within the capsule of the adrenal gland.
HP:6001280.definition_cn: 肾上腺出血是指肾上腺包膜内的出血。

HP:6001281.name: Optic nerve sheath dilatation
HP:6001281.definition: An abnormal increase in the diameter of the optic nerve sheath, typically due to elevated intracranial pressure or local pathology affecting cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics. It can be detected via imaging modalities such as ultrasound or MRI and may be associated with papilledema, idiopathic intracranial hypertension, or optic nerve tumors.
HP:6001281.definition_cn: 视神经鞘直径异常增大，通常由颅内压增高或影响脑脊液动力学的局部病变所致。可通过超声或磁共振成像等影像学检查发现，可能与视乳头水肿、特发性颅内高压或视神经肿瘤相关。

HP:6001282.name: Right ventricular thrombus
HP:6001282.definition: A blood clot (thrombus) localized in the right ventricle.

HP:6001283.name: Disseminated candidiasis
HP:6001283.definition: A systemic fungal infection by Candida species (most commonly, C. albicans).
HP:6001283.definition_cn: 由念珠菌属（最常见为白色念珠菌）引起的系统性真菌感染。

HP:6001284.name: Phrenic neuropathy
HP:6001284.definition: A functional deficit of the phrenic nerve. Phrenic neuropathy (PhN) is a debilitating condition characterized by impairment of the diaphragm muscle, the primary inspiratory muscle. Diaphragm muscle ultrasound is a noninvasive tool that appears to offer both high sensitivity and specificity for diagnosis. Alternatively, electrodiagnostic studies can assess phrenic nerve health. PhN is commonly diagnosed via diaphragm muscle US or fluoroscopy (sniff test) with paradoxical or significantly decreased diaphragm muscle movement.
HP:6001284.definition_cn: 膈神经功能障碍。膈神经病（PhN）是一种以主要吸气肌——膈肌功能受损为特征的致残性疾病。膈肌超声作为一种无创检查手段，在诊断中展现出较高的敏感性和特异性。此外，电诊断学检查可用于评估膈神经功能状态。临床通常通过膈肌超声或透视检查（嗅探试验）观察到膈肌矛盾运动或活动度显著减低来确诊本病。

HP:6001285.name: Glomerular basement membrane subendothelial remodeling
HP:6001285.definition: New glomerular basement membrane matrix formation under the endothelial cell.
HP:6001285.name_cn: 肾小球基底膜内皮下重塑
HP:6001285.definition_cn: 内皮细胞下新基底膜基质形成

HP:6001286.name: Glomerular endothelium swelling
HP:6001286.definition: Enlargement of the glomerular endothelium (the innermost layer of the glomerular filtration barrier) causing capillary lumen narrowing and loss of fenetrations.
HP:6001286.definition_cn: 肾小球内皮细胞（肾小球滤过屏障最内层）增大导致毛细血管腔狭窄及窗孔结构消失。

HP:6001287.name: Medullary collecting duct ectasia
HP:6001287.definition: Widening of the lumen of the lumen of the collecting ducts in the renal medulla.
HP:6001287.definition_cn: 肾髓质集合管管腔扩张

HP:6001288.name: Reduced circulating ADAMTS13 activity
HP:6001288.definition: Activity of the enzyme ADAMTS13 below the lower limit of normal. ADAMTS13 is an enzyme that acts by cleaving prothrombotic von Willebrand factor (VWF) multimers from the vasculature in a highly regulated manner.
HP:6001288.definition_cn: ADAMTS13酶活性低于正常下限。ADAMTS13是一种通过高度调控方式裂解血管系统中促血栓形成性血管性血友病因子(VWF)多聚体而发挥作用的酶。

HP:6001289.name: Corneal keloid
HP:6001289.definition: A raised, opaque, and fibrous lesion on the cornea resembling a dermal keloid, typically composed of disorganized collagen and fibrovascular tissue. Corneal keloids can impair vision and are often secondary to trauma, surgery, or underlying congenital disorders.
HP:6001289.definition_cn: 角膜瘢痕疙瘩是一种隆起的、不透明的纤维性角膜病变，外观类似皮肤瘢痕疙瘩，主要由排列紊乱的胶原纤维和纤维血管组织构成。该病变可导致视力损害，通常继发于外伤、手术或潜在先天性眼部疾病。

HP:6001290.name: Podocytic mitochondrial proliferation
HP:6001290.definition: An ultrastructural abnormality of the kidney glomeruli characterized by an excessive number or abnormal aggregation of mitochondria in podocytes.
HP:6001290.definition_cn: 肾小球超微结构异常，其特征为足细胞中线粒体数量过多或异常聚集。

HP:6001291.name: Elevated vitamin D metabolite ratio
HP:6001291.definition: The ratio of 24,25(OH)2D to 25(OH)D (also known as vitamin D metabolite ratio or VMR) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001291.name_cn: 维生素D代谢物比率升高
HP:6001291.definition_cn: 24,25(OH)2D与25(OH)D比值（亦称维生素D代谢物比值或VMR）高于正常值上限。

HP:6001292.name: Aggravated by vitamin D supplementation
HP:6001292.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment or supplementation with vitamin D.
HP:6001292.definition_cn: 用于描述因维生素D治疗或补充而加重的体征或症状。

HP:6001293.name: Aggravated by sun exposure
HP:6001293.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that becomes worse with exposure to sunlight.

HP:6001294.name: Tubular accumulation of uromodulin
HP:6001294.definition: Accumulation of uromodulin within renal tubular cells or lumina.
HP:6001294.name_cn: 尿调蛋白的肾小管积聚
HP:6001294.definition_cn: 肾小管内或管腔内尿调节素的积聚。

HP:6001295.name: Elevated stool reducing substances
HP:6001295.definition: Elevated level of reducing substances in the feces. If carbohydrate malabsorption is suspected, a reducing substance should be investigated in the stool using the Benedict or Fehling test. The presence of reducing substances may indicate an abnormality in carbohydrate (e.g., sucrose, lactase) metabolism. The unabsorbed sugars in stool are measured as reducing substances.
HP:6001295.definition_cn: 粪便中还原物质水平升高。若怀疑碳水化合物吸收不良，应采用本尼迪克特(Benedict)或费林(Fehling)试验检测粪便中的还原物质。还原物质的存在可能提示碳水化合物（如蔗糖、乳糖酶）代谢异常。未被吸收的糖类在粪便中以还原物质形式被检测。

HP:6001296.name: Osteochondral lesion of talus
HP:6001296.definition: Osteochondral lesion of the talus (OLT) is an injury involving the articular cartilage and subchondral bone, defined as any damage involving both articular cartilage and subchondral bone of the talar dome. OLT can cause ankle joint pain and can sometimes lead to instability and manifest as an area of abnormal, damaged cartilage and bone on the top of the talus bone (the lower bone of the ankle joint).
HP:6001296.definition_cn: 距骨骨软骨损伤（OLT）是一种累及关节软骨和软骨下骨的病变，定义为涉及距骨穹窿部关节软骨及软骨下骨组织的任何损伤。该病变可导致踝关节疼痛，有时引发关节不稳，表现为距骨（踝关节远端骨性结构）顶部出现异常损伤的软骨和骨组织区域。

HP:6001297.name: Mallet toe
HP:6001297.definition: A mallet toe involves the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint [such that] the distal phalanx is flexed on the middle phalanx.
HP:6001297.definition_cn: 锤状趾累及远端趾间关节（DIP关节），表现为远节趾骨向中节趾骨屈曲。

HP:6001298.name: Bunionette deformity
HP:6001298.definition: The bunionette, or tailor's bunion, is a lateral prominence of the fifth metatarsal head. Most commonly, bunionettes are the result of a widened 4-5 intermetatarsal angle with associated varus of the metatarsophalangeal joint.
HP:6001298.definition_cn: 小趾囊炎（bunionette），又称裁缝趾（tailor's bunion），是指第五跖骨头外侧的异常隆起。最常见病因是第4-5跖骨间角增宽伴发跖趾关节内翻畸形。

HP:6001299.name: Elevated CSF beta chorionic gonadotropin concentration
HP:6001299.definition: The concentration of beta chorionic gonadotropin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001299.name_cn: 脑脊液β人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度升高
HP:6001299.definition_cn: 脑脊液中β-人绒毛膜促性腺激素浓度高于正常值上限

HP:6001300.name: Pigment epithelium detachment
HP:6001300.definition: Separation of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) from the underlying Bruch membrane.
HP:6001300.definition_cn: 视网膜色素上皮（RPE）与下方Bruch膜的分离。

HP:6001301.name: Retinal gliosis
HP:6001301.definition: A pathological condition characterized by the proliferation of glial cells in the retina, often occurring as a reactive response to injury, inflammation, or degenerative changes, and typically resulting in structural and functional alterations in the retina.
HP:6001301.definition_cn: 一种以视网膜内胶质细胞增生为特征的病理状态，常作为对损伤、炎症或退行性变化的反应性应答而发生，通常导致视网膜结构和功能的改变。

HP:6001302.name: Aphakia
HP:6001302.definition: Absence of the crystalline lens in the eye, which may be congenital or acquired (e.g., following surgical removal of the lens for cataracts or trauma).
HP:6001302.definition_cn: 无晶状体症，可为先天性或获得性（如白内障或外伤后手术摘除晶状体所致）。

HP:6001303.name: Pain on thumb extension
HP:6001303.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort that is triggered upon extension (straightening) of the thumb.
HP:6001303.definition_cn: 拇指伸展（伸直）时引发的以躯体不适为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001304.name: Fractured lunate bone
HP:6001304.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the lunate bone.

HP:6001305.name: Fractured triquetrum bone
HP:6001305.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the triquetrum bone.
HP:6001305.definition_cn: 三角骨部分或完全骨折

HP:6001306.name: Fractured pisiform bone
HP:6001306.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the pisiform bone.
HP:6001306.definition_cn: 豌豆骨部分或完全骨折

HP:6001307.name: Fractured trapezium bone
HP:6001307.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the trapezium bone.
HP:6001307.definition_cn: 大多角骨部分或完全骨折

HP:6001308.name: Fractured trapezoid bone
HP:6001308.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the trapezoid bone.
HP:6001308.definition_cn: 小多角骨部分或完全骨折

HP:6001309.name: Fractured capitate bone
HP:6001309.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the capitate bone.
HP:6001309.definition_cn: 头状骨部分或完全骨折

HP:6001310.name: Fractured hamate bone
HP:6001310.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the hamate bone.

HP:6001311.name: Pulsatile abdominal mass
HP:6001311.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen that pulses or throbs.
HP:6001311.definition_cn: 腹部的异常增大或肿胀，伴有搏动或跳动感。

HP:6001312.name: Nonpulsatile abdominal mass
HP:6001312.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen that does not pulse or throb.
HP:6001312.definition_cn: 腹部异常增大或肿胀，无搏动感。

HP:6001313.name: Iatrogenic anophthalmos
HP:6001313.definition: A form of acquired anophthalmos resulting from surgical removal of the eye (enucleation or evisceration), typically performed due to trauma, intraocular tumors, intractable pain in a blind eye, or severe infection. Unlike congenital anophthalmos, the orbit may have previously developed normally and prosthetic rehabilitation is often pursued.
HP:6001313.definition_cn: 一种后天性无眼畸形，由手术摘除眼球（眼球摘除术或眼内容剜除术）所致，通常因外伤、眼内肿瘤、盲眼顽固性疼痛或严重感染而实施。与先天性无眼畸形不同，此类患者的眼眶可能曾正常发育，且常需进行义眼修复治疗。

HP:6001314.name: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione peroxidase
HP:6001314.definition: Activity or concentration of in the level of glutathione peroxidase (EC 1.11.1.9) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001314.name_cn: 红细胞谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶降低
HP:6001314.definition_cn: 红细胞中谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（EC 1.11.1.9）活性或浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6001315.name: Elevated circulating malonyl carnitine concentration
HP:6001315.definition: The concentration of malonylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001315.name_cn: 循环丙二酰肉碱浓度升高
HP:6001315.definition_cn: 血液循环中丙二酰肉碱浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001316.name: Sertoli cell hypoplasia
HP:6001316.definition: Abnormal decrease in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis.
HP:6001316.definition_cn: 睾丸中支持细胞数量异常减少

HP:6001317.name: Posititve talar tilt test
HP:6001317.definition: An abnormal result of the talar tilt test. This test assesses ankle ligament integrity, particularly the calcaneofibular ligament (CFL) and the deltoid ligaments. To perform the test, the foot is placed at an angle of 90 degrees with the leg, the calcaneofibular ligament is perpendicular and the anterior talofibular ligament is parallel to the long axis of the talus. Therefore, inversion in this position results in strain on the calcaneofibular ligament.
HP:6001317.definition_cn: 距骨倾斜试验结果异常。该试验用于评估踝关节韧带完整性，特别是跟腓韧带（CFL）和三角韧带。操作时需将足部与小腿呈90度角摆放，此时跟腓韧带垂直于距骨长轴，而距腓前韧带平行于距骨长轴。因此在此体位施加内翻应力可导致跟腓韧带受到牵张。

HP:6001318.name: Plantar ecchymosis
HP:6001318.definition: A purpuric lesion that is larger than 1 cm in diameter and is located on the sole of the foot.
HP:6001318.definition_cn: 直径大于1厘米且位于足底的紫癜性皮损。

HP:6001319.name: Prolonged exposure to axillary pressure
HP:6001319.definition: History of prolonged compressive pressure in the axillary region.
HP:6001319.name_cn: 长时间暴露于腋窝压力

HP:6001320.name: Lateral ankle pain
HP:6001320.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the outer side of the ankle.
HP:6001320.definition_cn: 一种以踝关节外侧区域出现躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001321.name: Medial ankle pain
HP:6001321.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the inner side of the ankle.
HP:6001321.definition_cn: 一种以踝关节内侧局部躯体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001322.name: Posterior ankle pain
HP:6001322.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the back of the ankle.
HP:6001322.definition_cn: 一种以踝后部局限性躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001323.name: Anterior ankle pain
HP:6001323.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the front of the ankle.
HP:6001323.definition_cn: 一种以踝关节前部局限性躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001324.name: Exacerbated by colchicine
HP:6001324.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with colchizine.
HP:6001324.definition_cn: 应用于对秋水仙碱治疗加重的体征或症状。

HP:6001325.name: Retinal periphlebitis
HP:6001325.definition: A condition characterized by inflammation of the outer walls of retinal veins, often presenting as vascular sheathing or exudates along the venous walls.
HP:6001325.definition_cn: 一种以视网膜静脉外壁炎症为特征的疾病，常表现为沿静脉壁的血管鞘或渗出物。

HP:6001326.name: Purulent pericardial effusion
HP:6001326.definition: Elevated leukocyte count in the pericardial fluid ranging from a a microscopic purulent pericardial effusion to gross pus in the pericardial space.
HP:6001326.definition_cn: 心包液中白细胞计数升高，范围从显微镜下可见的化脓性心包积液至心包腔内明显脓液积聚。

HP:6001327.name: Conjunctival erosion
HP:6001327.definition: A condition characterized by the localized loss or breakdown of the conjunctival epithelium, often resulting in exposure of the underlying tissue. Conjunctival erosion may cause symptoms such as redness, irritation, foreign body sensation, and tearing. It can result from trauma, chemical injuries, ocular surface diseases, or prolonged use of contact lenses.
HP:6001327.definition_cn: 一种以结膜上皮局部缺失或破坏为特征的病变，常导致下方组织暴露。结膜糜烂可引发充血、刺激感、异物感和流泪等症状，其病因包括外伤、化学性损伤、眼表疾病或长期配戴角膜接触镜。

HP:6001328.name: Positive Mycobacterium tuberculosis sputum culture
HP:6001328.definition: Growth of mycobacterium tuberculosis in a sputum culture.
HP:6001328.name_cn: 结核分枝杆菌痰培养阳性
HP:6001328.definition_cn: 痰培养中结核分枝杆菌的生长。

HP:6001329.name: Increased external rotation of shoulder
HP:6001329.definition: Increased rotation of the lower part of the arm away from the body (tested with the elbow flexed and the elbow held next to the side of the body or shoulder 90 degrees abducted to the side).
HP:6001329.definition_cn: 前臂下部远离身体的旋转增加（测试时肘关节屈曲且肘部紧贴身体一侧或肩关节外展90度至侧面）。

HP:6001330.name: Positive trunk flexion test
HP:6001330.definition: The proband is asked to flex the trunk forward with knees straight. The result of the test is considered positive (abnormal) if the palms can be made to rest flat on the floor.
HP:6001330.definition_cn: 嘱先证者双膝伸直并向前屈曲躯干。若手掌可平放于地面，则视为试验结果阳性（异常）。

HP:6001331.name: Tibiotalar arthritis
HP:6001331.definition: AP, oblique, or lateral view x-ray of the ankle showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the tibiotalar joint.
HP:6001331.definition_cn: 踝关节正位、斜位或侧位X线片显示胫距关节存在骨关节炎的影像学证据，如关节间隙狭窄、软骨下硬化、软骨下囊肿和/或骨赘形成。

HP:6001332.name: Anterior ankle osteophyte
HP:6001332.definition: Imaging study of the ankle revealing osteophyte (bone spur) formation at the anterior aspect of the ankle (tibial or talar neck).
HP:6001332.definition_cn: 踝关节影像学检查显示踝关节前方（胫骨或距骨颈）存在骨赘形成。

HP:6001333.name: Midfoot arthritis
HP:6001333.definition: AP, oblique, or lateral view x-ray of the foot showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis in the midfoot (tarsometatarsal (TMT) joints, naviculocuneiform joint, intercuneiform joints, and/or metatarsal cuneiform joints), such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the tibiotalar joint.
HP:6001333.definition_cn: 足部正位、斜位或侧位X线片显示中足（跗跖关节、舟楔关节、楔间关节和/或跖楔关节）存在骨关节炎的影像学证据，如关节间隙狭窄、软骨下硬化、软骨下囊肿和/或胫距关节骨赘形成。

HP:6001334.name: Decreased circulating reverse T3 concentration
HP:6001334.definition: Concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001334.name_cn: 循环反向三碘甲状腺原氨酸浓度降低
HP:6001334.definition_cn: 血液循环中反三碘甲状腺原氨酸（3,3',5'-三碘甲状腺原氨酸或rT3）浓度低于正常值下限

HP:6001335.name: Stocking-glove distribution
HP:6001335.definition: Distribution of findings in hands and feet with a distal to proximal gradient of severity (being more severe in the more distal locations).
HP:6001335.definition_cn: 手足表现呈远端至近端严重程度梯度分布（远端部位更为严重）。

HP:6001336.name: Hairy kidney sign
HP:6001336.definition: A radiological sign related to infiltration of histiocytes into the kidneys and perirenal fat. This infiltration, along with thickening of fibrous bands within the perirenal fat, creates a hairy appearance on cross-sectional imaging studies.
HP:6001336.definition_cn: 一种与组织细胞浸润肾脏及肾周脂肪相关的放射学征象。该浸润现象伴随肾周脂肪内纤维束增厚，在横断面影像学检查中呈现毛糙样外观。

HP:6001337.name: White appearance of duodenal mucosa
HP:6001337.definition: On a typical diet (e.g., no dietary fat restriction), the intestinal mucosa may have a gelee blanche or white hoar frosting appearance on endoscopy.
HP:6001337.name_cn: 十二指肠黏膜白色外观
HP:6001337.definition_cn: 在常规饮食（如无膳食脂肪限制）情况下，肠黏膜在内镜检查中可能呈现"gelée blanche"（白色凝胶样）或白霜样外观。

HP:6001338.name: Acromioclavicular joint separation
HP:6001338.definition: An acromioclavicular (AC) joint joint separation, often called a shoulder separation, is a dislocation of the clavicle from the acromion. This feature is ascertainable radiographically by AC joint x-ray views including bilateral anteroposterior (AP) view, axillary lateral view, and/or Zanca view showing either superior, posterior, or inferior displacement of the distal clavicle in relation to the acromion at the AC joint.
HP:6001338.definition_cn: 肩锁关节分离（acromioclavicular joint separation），俗称肩关节脱位（shoulder separation），是指锁骨自肩峰处发生脱位。该病变可通过肩锁关节X线检查确诊，包括双侧前后位（anteroposterior, AP）投照、腋侧位（axillary lateral view）投照及/或Zanca位投照，影像学表现为锁骨远端相对于肩峰在肩锁关节处出现向上、向后或向下的移位。

HP:6001339.name: Acromioclavicular joint arthritis
HP:6001339.definition: Degenerative disease of the acromioclavicular (AC) joint that manifests radiographically as Zanca view X-ray of the AC joint showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the AC joint.
HP:6001339.definition_cn: 肩锁关节退行性疾病，影像学表现为Zanca位X线片显示肩锁关节骨关节炎的影像学证据，如关节间隙狭窄、软骨下硬化、软骨下囊肿和/或肩锁关节骨赘形成。

HP:6001340.name: Positive shoulder cross-body adduction test
HP:6001340.definition: A test used with suspected chronic acromioclavicular joint lesions (which are a common source of pain and disability in the shoulder). The test is considered positive with pain in the ipsilateral acromioclavicular joint when patient straightens the affected arm forward and reaches for the contralateral shoulder with extra manual cross body (adduction) pressure on the arm from the examiner.
HP:6001340.name_cn: 肩关节阳性交叉内收试验
HP:6001340.definition_cn: 一项用于疑似慢性肩锁关节病变（此为肩部疼痛和功能障碍的常见病因）的检查。当患者伸直患侧手臂前伸并试图触及对侧肩部时，检查者额外施加跨体内收压力于手臂，若同侧肩锁关节出现疼痛则视为试验阳性。

HP:6001341.name: Proximal humeral epiphysiolysis
HP:6001341.definition: Proximal humeral epiphysiolysis (Little League shoulder) is a shear or stress injury of the epiphyseal cartilage of the proximal humerus. Anteroposterior (AP) view of the shoulder in external rotation showing widening of the proximal humerus physis in comparison to contralateral shoulder with possible metaphyseal bony irregularity.
HP:6001341.definition_cn: 肱骨近端骨骺滑脱（少年棒球肩）是一种肱骨近端骨骺软骨的剪切或应力性损伤。肩关节外旋位前后位（AP）片显示，与对侧肩关节相比，肱骨近端骺板增宽，并可能伴有干骺端骨质不规则。

HP:6001342.name: Positive anterior drawer test
HP:6001342.definition: A test for ankle instability in which an anterior pull on the calcaneus with is applied with one hand while stabilizing the end of the tibia/fibula with the other hand. The test is considered positive (abnormal) if it results in more than one cm of anterior translation of the foot compared to the healthy, contralateral ankle.
HP:6001342.definition_cn: 一种用于检测踝关节不稳的试验，操作时一手稳定胫骨/腓骨远端，另一手向前牵拉跟骨。若与健侧踝关节相比，患足前移超过1厘米，则视为试验阳性（异常）。

HP:6001343.name: Peroneal tendon tear
HP:6001343.definition: Injury to a peroneal tendon, as can be ascertained by an MRI study of the ankle showing partial or complete tear of one or both of the peroneal tendons.
HP:6001343.definition_cn: 腓骨肌腱损伤，可通过踝关节MRI检查确认，显示单侧或双侧腓骨肌腱部分或完全撕裂。

HP:6001344.name: Fifth metatarsal apophysitis
HP:6001344.definition: Iselin's disease is a traction apophysitis of base of fifth metatarsal. The apophysis is within the peroneus brevis tendon insertion site and appears radiographically at about age 10 in female and age 12 in male and usually fuses by age 11 in female and by age 14 in male. Repetitive microtrauma from the peroneus brevis tendon, as occurs in sports activities is the cause of traction apophysitis. It can be ascertained by oblique foot radiographs showing apophyseal irregularity (enlarged apophysis, disordered ossification, widened chondro-osseous junction) at the base of the fifth metatarsal.
HP:6001344.definition_cn: 伊塞林病是第五跖骨基底部的牵拉性骨突炎。该骨突位于腓骨短肌腱附着点内，影像学上女性约10岁、男性约12岁出现，通常女性11岁、男性14岁时融合。腓骨短肌腱反复微创伤（如体育活动所致）是引发牵拉性骨突炎的原因。可通过足部斜位X线片确诊，显示第五跖骨基底部骨突不规则（骨突增大、骨化紊乱、软骨-骨交界处增宽）。

HP:6001345.name: Tibial tubercle apophysitis
HP:6001345.definition: Lateral knee radiograph showing tibial tuberosity apophysis irregularity and fragmentation; tibial tubercle osteochondrosis; traction apophysitis of the tibial tubercle.
HP:6001345.definition_cn: 膝关节侧位X线片显示胫骨结节骨骺不规则及碎裂；胫骨结节骨软骨病；胫骨结节牵拉性骨骺炎。

HP:6001346.name: Enteric anendocrinosis
HP:6001346.definition: Near absence of small intestinal and colonic endocrine cells. This feature can be ascertained histopathologically and may also be manifested as a lack of staining for enteroendocrive markers such as synaptophysin.
HP:6001346.definition_cn: 小肠和结肠内分泌细胞几乎完全缺失。这一特征可通过组织病理学检查确认，也可表现为肠内分泌标志物（如突触素）染色缺失。

HP:6001347.name: Metatarsal head osteochondrosis
HP:6001347.definition: Avascular necrosis of a metatarsal head, most commonly involving the second, but also the third or fourth, metatarsal.\nComment: Affected individuals may present with foot pain on weight-bearing, swelling, and tenderness. Radiological features include widening of the metatarsophalangeal joint space and flattening of the affected metatarsal head, at later stages metatarsal head sclerosis, cortical thickening, and intra-articular loose bodies. Osteochondrosis is a condition resulting from an epiphysis injury that alters enchondral ossification and produces irregularity at the joint surface. Freiberg disease is characterized as osteochondrosis of the metatarsal heads (primarily the second).
HP:6001347.definition_cn:
跖骨头缺血性坏死，最常累及第二跖骨，亦可累及第三或第四跖骨。
注释：患者可表现为负重时足部疼痛、肿胀及压痛。影像学特征包括跖趾关节间隙增宽及受累跖骨头变平，晚期可见跖骨头硬化、皮质增厚及关节内游离体。骨软骨病是由骨骺损伤导致的一种疾病，可改变软骨内骨化过程并造成关节面不规则。Freiberg病以跖骨头（主要为第二跖骨）骨软骨病为特征。

HP:6001348.name: Hallux sesamoiditis
HP:6001348.definition: Inflammation of the sesamoid bones of the hallux ( two ovoid-shaped ossicles embedded within the tendons under the big toe). This feature can be ascertained by MRI of the foot, revealing edema within one or both of the hallux sesamoids.
HP:6001348.definition_cn: 拇趾籽骨炎（位于拇趾下方肌腱内的两枚卵圆形小骨）。此特征可通过足部磁共振成像（MRI）确认，显示单侧或双侧拇趾籽骨内存在水肿。

HP:6001349.name: Os trigonum
HP:6001349.definition: Os trigonum (OT) is one of the most common accessory ossicles in the foot and ankle region. In clinical practice, OT is a considerable factor that may predispose patients to posterior ankle impingement syndrome (PAIS). Lateral ankle x-ray with foot in plantarflexion reveals an accessory ossicle at the posterior aspect of the talus, between the posterior distal tibia and calcaneal tuberosity.
HP:6001349.definition_cn: 距后三角骨（Os trigonum，OT）是足踝区域最常见的副骨之一。在临床实践中，OT是导致患者发生踝关节后方撞击综合征（Posterior Ankle Impingement Syndrome，PAIS）的重要诱因。通过足跖屈位踝关节侧位X线片可显示距骨后方、胫骨远端后缘与跟骨结节之间存在的副骨影。

HP:6001350.name: Positive heel squeeze test
HP:6001350.definition: The squeeze test is the most common examination for diagnosing calcaneal apophysitis (Sever disease) and is conducted by compressing the medial and lateral aspects of the calcaneus. The test is considered positive (abnormal) if squeezing elicits pain.
HP:6001350.definition_cn: 挤压试验是诊断跟骨骨骺炎（Sever病）最常用的检查方法，通过挤压跟骨内外侧面进行。若挤压引发疼痛则视为阳性（异常）。

HP:6001351.name: Calcaneal apophysitis
HP:6001351.definition: Inflammation of the calcaneal apophysis (bony projection where the Achilles tendon attaches to the heel). Lateral foot x-ray shows increased density in the calcaneal apophysis or fragmentation of the apophysis.
HP:6001351.definition_cn: 跟骨骨突炎（阿基里斯腱附着于跟骨的骨性突起）。足部侧位X线片显示跟骨骨突密度增高或骨突碎裂。

HP:6001352.name: Decreased circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration
HP:6001352.definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001352.name_cn: 循环胍基乙酸浓度降低
HP:6001352.definition_cn: 循环血液中胍基乙酸浓度低于正常下限。

HP:6001353.name: Elevated circulating C-triol concentration
HP:6001353.definition: The concentration of cholestane-3beta, 5alpha, 6beta-triol (C-triol) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. C-triol is a diagnostic biomarker for Niemann-Pick disease type C.
HP:6001353.definition_cn: 血液中胆甾烷-3β,5α,6β-三醇(C-triol)浓度高于正常值上限。该物质是C型尼曼-匹克病的诊断性生物标志物。

HP:6001354.name: Germinal vesicle oocyte maturation arrest
HP:6001354.definition: A type of oocyte maturation arrest that occurs prior to the breakdown of the germinal vesicle (which is a hallmark of reinitiation of meiosis I and entry into M phase).
HP:6001354.name_cn: 生发泡卵母细胞成熟阻滞
HP:6001354.definition_cn: 一种发生于生发泡破裂前的卵母细胞成熟阻滞（生发泡破裂是减数分裂I重新启动并进入M期的标志性事件）。

HP:6001355.name: Metaphase II oocyte maturation arrest
HP:6001355.definition: The morphologic classification of MII generally denotes an oocyte that is mature, having arrested in metaphase II and is presumed to be capable of fertilization. However, there are subsets of women who produce oocytes with MII morphology that are not capable of embryo formation even with fertilization. This incongruence between morphologic maturity and capacity could be attributed to either the inclusion within the morphologic classification immature oocytes arrested at any stage between PBI formation and metaphase II, which are not capable of fertilization, or oocytes arrested normally at metaphase II that do not possess the ability to complete meiosis.
HP:6001355.name_cn: 中期II卵母细胞成熟阻滞
HP:6001355.definition_cn: MII期的形态学分类通常指成熟的卵母细胞，停滞于第二次减数分裂中期（metaphase II），并假定具备受精能力。然而，部分女性产生的卵母细胞虽呈现MII形态学特征，却无法形成胚胎，即使完成受精过程。这种形态学成熟度与功能能力的差异可能归因于两类情况：一是形态学分类中混入了未成熟卵母细胞，这些细胞停滞于第一极体（PBI）形成至第二次减数分裂中期之间的任何阶段，不具备受精能力；二是虽正常停滞于第二次减数分裂中期，却缺乏完成减数分裂功能的卵母细胞。

HP:6001356.name: Mixed oocyte maturation arrest
HP:6001356.definition: A type of oocyte maturation failure whereby oocytes arrest at more than one stage of meiosis.
HP:6001356.name_cn: 混合性卵母细胞成熟阻滞
HP:6001356.definition_cn: 一种卵母细胞成熟障碍类型，表现为卵母细胞在减数分裂的多个阶段停滞。

HP:6001357.name: Dorsal forearm pain
HP:6001357.definition: Pain localized to dorsal (non-palmar) aspect of the forearm.
HP:6001357.definition_cn: 前臂背侧（非掌侧）局部疼痛。

HP:6001358.name: Volar forearm pain
HP:6001358.definition: Pain on the volar (palmar) aspect of the forearm.

HP:6001359.name: Cholesterol gallblader polyp
HP:6001359.definition: A non-neoplastic gallbladder polyp that is hyperplastic and consists of a lipid deposit. Cholesterol polyps are generally less than 10 mm. often multiple cholesterol polyps are present. They are often associated with vesicular cholesterolosis and are thought to have no malignant potential.
HP:6001359.definition_cn: 一种非肿瘤性胆囊息肉，呈增生性改变并由脂质沉积构成。胆固醇性息肉通常小于10毫米，常为多发性病变。此类息肉多与胆囊胆固醇沉着症相关，目前认为其无恶变潜能。

HP:6001360.name: Hyperlordotic gait
HP:6001360.definition: A gait abnormality characterized by excessive lumbar lordosis (swayback posture, i.e., an inward curvature of the lower spine) and gait pattern with forward tilt of the pelvis and increased lumbar curvature. Hyperlordotic gait is often as a compensatory mechanism for hip extensor weakness, proximal muscle weakness, or hip flexion contracture.
HP:6001360.definition_cn: 一种步态异常，特征为腰椎前凸过度（即下脊柱向内弯曲的摇摆背姿势）以及骨盆前倾和腰椎曲度增加的步态模式。过度前凸步态通常作为髋关节伸肌无力、近端肌无力或髋关节屈曲挛缩的代偿机制。

HP:6001361.name: Radioulnar interosseous membrane tear
HP:6001361.definition: A tear in the fibrous sheet connecting the radius and ulna bones in the forearm.
HP:6001361.definition_cn: 前臂桡骨与尺骨间纤维片撕裂

HP:6001362.name: Fleck sign of elbow
HP:6001362.definition: A radiograpzhic sign in which small bone fragments detached from the olecranon are seen on lateral radiographs in cases with avulsion of the tendon.
HP:6001362.definition_cn: 一种放射学征象，在肌腱撕脱病例的侧位X线片上可见从尺骨鹰嘴分离的小骨碎片。

HP:6001363.name: Resisted wrist flexion provokes pain
HP:6001363.definition: Active wrist flexion against resistance increases pain in the arm.
HP:6001363.definition_cn: 对抗阻力主动屈腕会增加手臂疼痛。

HP:6001364.name: Lateral epicondylitis of the elbow
HP:6001364.definition: A chronic symptomatic degeneration of the wrist extensor tendons involving their attachment to the lateral epicondyle of the humerus, and is associated clinically with lateral elbow pain (tennis elbow). This term refers to the associated imaging finding. Ultrasound imaging showing extensor carpi radialis brevis (ECRB) tendon thickening and hypoechoic areas with increased vascularity or MRI showing increased signal intensity or tear at the insertion site of the ECRB on the lateral aspect of the elbow.
HP:6001364.definition_cn: 一种慢性症状性腕伸肌腱退行性病变，累及其肱骨外上髁附着处，临床表现为肘关节外侧疼痛（网球肘）。该术语特指相关影像学表现：超声检查显示桡侧腕短伸肌(ECRB)肌腱增厚伴低回声区及血流信号增强，或磁共振成像显示肘关节外侧ECRB附着处信号强度增高或存在撕裂征象。

HP:6001365.name: Medial epicondylitis of the elbow
HP:6001365.definition: Medial epicondylitis, often referred to as golfer's elbow, is a common pathology. Flexor-pronator tendon degeneration occurs with repetitive forced wrist extension and forearm supination during activities involving wrist flexion and forearm pronation. This term refers to the associated imaging finding. Ultrasound imaging showing ECRB tendon thickening and hypoechoic areas with increased vascularity or MRI showing increased signal intensity or tear at the insertion site of the common flexor tendon.
HP:6001365.definition_cn: 内侧上髁炎（俗称高尔夫球肘）是一种常见病变。在涉及腕关节屈曲和前臂旋前的活动中，反复强制腕背伸及前臂旋后动作可导致屈肌-旋前肌腱退行性变。该术语特指相关影像学表现：超声检查显示桡侧腕短伸肌腱增厚伴低回声区及血流信号增强，或磁共振成像显示屈肌总腱附着处信号强度增高或撕裂征象。

HP:6001366.name: Popeye sign
HP:6001366.definition: Exaggerated bulging of the belly of the biceps muscle upon contraction.
HP:6001366.definition_cn: 肱二头肌收缩时肌腹膨隆过度

HP:6001367.name: Distal biceps tendon ruptre
HP:6001367.definition: Rupture (tear) of the distal biceps tendon. Ultrasound imaging showing complete discontinuity of the distal biceps tendon or MRI revealing complete distal biceps tendon discontinuity or increased signal intensity in the distal biceps tendon.
HP:6001367.definition_cn: 肱二头肌远端肌腱断裂（撕裂）。超声影像显示肱二头肌远端肌腱完全中断，或磁共振成像显示肱二头肌远端肌腱完全中断或信号强度增高。

HP:6001368.name: Proximal biceps tendon rupture
HP:6001368.definition: Rupture (tear) of the proximal biceps tendon. MRI reveals a tear of the proximal aspect of the biceps tendon near its site of origin at the supraglenoid tubercle.
HP:6001368.name_cn: 肱二头肌近端肌腱断裂
HP:6001368.definition_cn: 肱二头肌近端肌腱断裂（撕裂）。磁共振成像显示肱二头肌腱近端于盂上结节起点处发生撕裂。

HP:6001369.name: Positive bursal fluid infectious agent test
HP:6001369.definition: Detection of an infectious agent, or evidence thereof, in aspirated bursal fluid using microbiological, molecular, or antigen-based testing methods.
HP:6001369.name_cn: 滑囊液病原体检测阳性
HP:6001369.definition_cn: 采用微生物学、分子生物学或基于抗原的检测方法在抽吸的滑囊液中检出感染性病原体或其证据。

HP:6001370.name: Acute retinal necrosis
HP:6001370.definition: A condition characterized by the death of retinal tissue due to ischemia, infection, or inflammation.
HP:6001370.definition_cn: 一种以视网膜组织因缺血、感染或炎症导致坏死为特征的病变。

HP:6001371.name: Cystic changes in greater tuberosity of the humerus
HP:6001371.definition: Cystic lesions of the proximal humerus are commonly encountered on routine shoulder magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). True cysts are defined as fluid-filled structures or lesions with an epithelial lining, whereas pseudocysts are fluid-filled lesions without epithelial lining. Cystic lesion encompasses both true cysts, pseudocysts and other lesions which could mimic the appearance of a cyst on MRI, with increased signal on fluid sensitive sequences.
HP:6001371.definition_cn: 肱骨近端囊性病变在常规肩关节磁共振成像（MRI）检查中较为常见。真性囊肿被定义为具有上皮衬里的液性结构或病变，而假性囊肿则为无上皮衬里的液性病变。囊性病变包括真性囊肿、假性囊肿以及其他在MRI上呈现类似囊肿表现的病变（于液体敏感序列中信号增高）。

HP:6001372.name: Positive Hawkins test
HP:6001372.definition: Manual internal rotation on the forearm with the shoulders flexed forward to 90 degrees, elbows bent to 90 degrees so that the forearm is parallel to the ground, and palm facing down recreates pain in the shoulder region; named after Dr. Hawkins.
HP:6001372.definition_cn: 前臂手动内旋，肩关节前屈90度，肘关节屈曲90度使前臂与地面平行，手掌朝下可诱发肩部疼痛；以Hawkins医生命名。

HP:6001373.name: Hallux weakness
HP:6001373.definition: Reduced ability to exert force or power with the hallux (big toe), i.e., reduced strength of the hallux.
HP:6001373.definition_cn: 拇趾（大脚趾）施加力量或动力的能力减弱，即拇趾肌力减退。

HP:6001374.name: Hallux dorsiflexion weakness
HP:6001374.definition: Reduced ability to lift the big toe (hallux) upward toward the shin.
HP:6001374.definition_cn: 大拇趾（踇趾）向胫骨方向上抬能力减弱。

HP:6001375.name: Hallux plantarflexion weakness
HP:6001375.definition: Reduced ability to push the big toe (hallux) downward, away from the shin.
HP:6001375.definition_cn: 大拇趾（踇趾）背屈能力减弱。

HP:6001376.name: Forefoot pain
HP:6001376.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized about the metatarsal heads in the front part of the foot.
HP:6001376.definition_cn: 一种以足部前段跖骨头区域局限性躯体不适（如刺痛、搏动痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感觉。

HP:6001377.name: Spur at inferior pole of patella
HP:6001377.definition: A bone spur (osteophyte), i.e., de novo bone formation at the lower edge of the patella (knee cap). Radiographically, it is visible as calcification at inferior pole of the patella.
HP:6001377.definition_cn: 骨赘（骨刺），即髌骨（膝盖骨）下缘的新生骨形成。影像学上表现为髌骨下极钙化。

HP:6001378.name: Urinary ascites
HP:6001378.definition: The presence of urine in the peritoneal cavity, an entity that typically results from bladder rupture or damage to the ureters.
HP:6001378.definition_cn: 腹腔内尿液存在，通常由膀胱破裂或输尿管损伤所致。

HP:6001379.name: Abnormal mixed venous oxygen saturation
HP:6001379.definition: Abnormal oxygen saturation in mixed venous blood (SvO2). SvO2 can be measured in a sample of mixed venous blood drawn from the distal lumen of a catheter placed in the pulmonary artery. The SvO2 is dependent on arterial oxygen saturation, hemoglobin concentration, cardiac output, and tissue oxygen demands.
HP:6001379.name_cn: 异常混合静脉血氧饱和度
HP:6001379.definition_cn: 混合静脉血氧饱和度异常（SvO2）。SvO2可通过从肺动脉导管远端管腔抽取的混合静脉血样本进行测定。SvO2取决于动脉血氧饱和度、血红蛋白浓度、心输出量以及组织氧需求量。

HP:6001380.name: Elevated circulating lysosphingomyelin concentration
HP:6001380.definition: The concentration of lysosphingomyelin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. Acid sphingomyelinase deficiency (ASMD) or Niemann-Pick type A/B is a lysosomal disorder caused by the deficiency of acid sphingomyelinase (ASM) due to pathogenic variants in the SMPD1 gene. Sphingomyelin (SM) is the substrate for ASM that cleaves the phosphorylcholine linkage of SM producing ceramide. SM is a major compound of most cell membranes and coupled with cholesterol constitutes most of the membrane rafts. In the deficiency of ASM, there is primary storage of SM, and the concentration of lysosphingomyelin in dried blood spots and in the blood circulation is typically elevated.
HP:6001380.name_cn: 循环溶血磷脂酰胆碱浓度升高
HP:6001380.definition_cn: 循环血液中溶血鞘磷脂浓度高于正常上限。酸性鞘磷脂酶缺乏症（ASMD）或尼曼-匹克病A/B型是由于SMPD1基因致病性变异导致酸性鞘磷脂酶（ASM）缺乏引起的溶酶体贮积症。鞘磷脂（SM）是ASM的作用底物，ASM通过裂解SM的磷酸胆碱键生成神经酰胺。SM是大多数细胞膜的主要组成成分，与胆固醇共同构成膜筏结构。当ASM缺乏时，主要表现为鞘磷脂贮积，干血斑及循环血液中溶血鞘磷脂浓度通常升高。

HP:6001381.name: Abnormal lens capsule morphology
HP:6001381.definition: A structural anomaly of the lens capsule, the smooth, transparent, acellular basement membrane that envelops the lens of the eye and serves as the attachment site for the lens zonules and the lens epithelium.
HP:6001381.definition_cn: 晶状体囊的结构异常。晶状体囊是一种光滑、透明、无细胞的基底膜，包裹着眼球的晶状体，并作为晶状体悬韧带和晶状体上皮的附着部位。

HP:6001382.name: Posterior capsule opacification
HP:6001382.definition: Posterior capsule opacification, also known as secondary cataract, is the most frequent complication following manual extracapsular cataract extraction. Secondary cataract results from the proliferation and migration of residual epithelial cells in the posterior region of the lens capsule into the visual axis, leading to thickening and reduction in transparency (opacification), which in turn can cause a decrease in visual acuity.
HP:6001382.definition_cn: 后囊膜混浊，又称继发性白内障，是白内障囊外摘除术后最常见的并发症。继发性白内障是由于晶状体后囊区域残留上皮细胞增殖并向视轴区迁移，导致后囊膜增厚和透明度降低（混浊），从而引起视力下降。

HP:6001383.name: Bronchial stenosis
HP:6001383.definition: A narrowing (constriction) of the lumen of a bronchus, which may involve one or more of the major airways branching from the trachea.
HP:6001383.definition_cn: 支气管管腔狭窄（缩窄），可能累及从气管分出的一个或多个主要气道。

HP:6001384.name: Skin tenting due to fracture
HP:6001384.definition: Skin tenting may occur in the setting of a fracture when a displaced bone fragment pushes on the skin, causing it to bulge outward in a tent-like shape.
HP:6001384.name_cn: 骨折导致的皮肤帐篷样改变
HP:6001384.definition_cn: 皮肤帐篷样隆起可能发生于骨折情况下，当移位骨片压迫皮肤时，导致皮肤向外凸起形成帐篷样形态。

HP:6001385.name: Follicular conjunctivitis
HP:6001385.definition: A type of conjunctivitis characterized by the formation of conjunctival follicles, which appear as raised domes on the are round collections of lymphocytes, and are often most prominent in the inferior fornix (interior part of the lower eyelid).
HP:6001385.definition_cn: 一种以结膜滤泡形成为特征的结膜炎，表现为隆起的圆顶状淋巴细胞聚集，通常在下穹窿（下眼睑内侧部分）最为明显。

HP:6001386.name: Granulomatous conjunctivitis
HP:6001386.definition: A type of conjunctivitis characterized by the formation of conjunctival granulomata, i.e., localized nodular inflammatory lesions of the conjunctiva, characterized histologically by aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes, often with multinucleated giant cells, surrounded by lymphocytes and fibroblasts.
HP:6001386.definition_cn: 一种以结膜肉芽肿形成为特征的结膜炎，即结膜局部结节性炎性病变，组织学特征为上皮样组织细胞聚集，常伴有多核巨细胞，周围环绕淋巴细胞和成纤维细胞。

HP:6001387.name: Areas of hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation that follow Blaschko lines
HP:6001387.definition: Linear streaks of hypopigmentation or hyperpigmentation that are distributed according to Blaschko lines, which are V-shaped, S-shaped, or linear patterns on the skin that reflect the embryonic migration pathways of epidermal cells (keratinocytes, melanocytes, etc.) during early development.
HP:6001387.name_cn: 沿Blaschko线分布的色素减退和色素沉着区域
HP:6001387.definition_cn: 沿Blaschko线分布的色素减退或色素沉着性线状条纹，Blaschko线是皮肤上呈V形、S形或线状的图案，反映了胚胎发育早期表皮细胞（角质形成细胞、黑素细胞等）的迁移路径。

HP:6001388.name: Retinal drusen
HP:6001388.definition: Small focal extracellular deposits underneath the retina, visible ophthalmoscopically as yellow dots.
HP:6001388.definition_cn: 视网膜下小的局灶性细胞外沉积物，检眼镜下可见为黄色点状病灶。

HP:6001389.name: Intrauterine amputation
HP:6001389.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by partial or complete absence of a limb or digit at birth, resulting from interruption of normal limb development in utero.
HP:6001389.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为出生时肢体或指（趾）部分或完全缺失，由子宫内正常肢体发育过程中断所致。

HP:6001390.name: Intrauterine digital amputation
HP:6001390.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by partial or complete absence of a finger or toe at birth, resulting from interruption of normal development in utero.
HP:6001390.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为出生时手指或脚趾部分或完全缺失，由宫内正常发育过程中断所致。

HP:6001391.name: Intrauterine limb amputation
HP:6001391.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by partial or complete absence of an arm or leg at birth, resulting from interruption of normal development in utero.
HP:6001391.definition_cn: 一种发育异常，其特征为出生时上肢或下肢部分或完全缺失，由宫内正常发育过程中断所致。

HP:6001392.name: Proximal interphalangeal joint arthritis
HP:6001392.definition: Inflammation and deterioration of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints. Radiographically, PIP arthritis can be characterized by PIP joint space narrowing, subchondral cysts, and osteophytes.
HP:6001392.definition_cn: 近端指间关节（PIP关节）炎症及退行性变。影像学表现为PIP关节间隙狭窄、软骨下囊肿及骨赘形成。

HP:6001393.name: Dorsal intercalated segment instability
HP:6001393.definition: A nondissociative form of carpal instability, in which the lunate bone angulates to the dorsal side of the hand.
HP:6001393.definition_cn: 非分离型腕关节不稳，其中月骨向手背侧成角。

HP:6001394.name: Disruption of carpal arcs
HP:6001394.definition: The arcs of the Gilula are used on PA wrist radiographs as part of assessing the normal alignment of the carpus. The 1st arc (red) outlines the proximal surfaces and the 2nd arc (yellow) the distal surfaces of the scaphoid, lunate and triquetrum. The 3rd arc (white) outlines the proximal surfaces of the capitate and hamate. Disruption of carpal arcs (i.e., the arcs appear broken or discontinuous on radiographs) indicates a fracture or ligamentous injury in the wrist.
HP:6001394.definition_cn: Gilula弓线用于腕关节后前位X线片，作为评估腕骨正常对位的一部分。第一弓线（红色）勾勒出舟骨、月骨和三角骨的近端关节面；第二弓线（黄色）勾勒上述三块腕骨的远端关节面；第三弓线（白色）则勾勒出头状骨和钩骨的近端关节面。腕弓线中断（即X线片上显示弓线断裂或不连续）提示可能存在腕部骨折或韧带损伤。

HP:6001395.name: Spilled teacup sign of the wrist
HP:6001395.definition: Dislocation of the lunate bone, generally as a result of trauma. Volar displacement of the lunate is said to result a tipped teacup.
HP:6001395.definition_cn: 月骨脱位，通常由创伤引起。月骨向掌侧移位被称为“倾斜茶杯征”。

HP:6001396.name: Positive Finkelstein sign
HP:6001396.definition: Finkelstein's test produces severe tenderness and usually pain on the radial aspect of the wrist when the thumb is flexed into the palm and the wrist is ulnar deviated.
HP:6001396.definition_cn: 芬克尔斯坦试验中，当拇指屈曲至掌心且腕关节尺偏时，桡侧腕部会出现明显压痛并通常伴有疼痛。

HP:6001397.name: Forefoot abduction
HP:6001397.definition: Outward deviation or turning of the front part of the foot away from the body's midline. An anteroposterior foot x-ray shows increased Simmon angle (angle between the talus and first metatarsal, normal is 7 degrees plus/minus 4 to 5 degrees) or increased talonavicular uncoverage of over 30 to 40 percent. A common clinical observation is the too many toes sign; when viewed from behind, more than two toes will flare out laterally due to the valgus alignment of the foot.
HP:6001397.definition_cn: 足部前段向外偏离或转向身体中线以外。足部前后位X光片显示Simmon角增大（距骨与第一跖骨之间的夹角，正常值为7度加减4至5度）或距舟关节覆盖度减少超过30%至40%。常见的临床表现为"多趾征"；从后方观察时，由于足部外翻对线，可见超过两个脚趾向外侧展开。

HP:6001398.name: Posterior tibial tendon injury
HP:6001398.definition: Damage to the posterior tibialis tendon, which runs along the inside of the ankle and foot, supporting the arch of the foot. MRI or ultrasound of the ankle/foot shows posterior tibial tendon degeneration such as tendinosis, tenosynovitis, edema around the tendon, or tendon tear.
HP:6001398.definition_cn: 胫后肌腱损伤，该肌腱沿踝关节和足部内侧走行，支撑足弓。踝关节/足部磁共振成像或超声检查显示胫后肌腱退行性改变，包括肌腱病变、腱鞘炎、肌腱周围水肿或肌腱撕裂。

HP:6001399.name: Plantar pain
HP:6001399.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to palpation of plantar aspect of the foot (the sole).
HP:6001399.definition_cn: 一种以足底（足跖面）触诊时出现的局部躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感觉。

HP:6001400.name: Flexor hallucis longus tendon injury
HP:6001400.definition: Damage to the flexor hallucis longus (FHL) tendon. The FHL tendon is a long tendon that runs from the deep calf muscle down through the ankle to the big toe, enabling toe flexion and supporting foot mechanics.. MRI or ultrasound of the ankle/foot shows degenerative changes of the FHL tendon such as fluid around the tendon at the level of the ankle joint, intra-substance tendinous signal, tendon thickening, tendonitis, or tenosynovitis, or tendon rupture.
HP:6001400.definition_cn: 拇长屈肌腱损伤。拇长屈肌腱是一条长肌腱，起自小腿深层肌肉，经踝关节延伸至足大趾，负责足趾屈曲运动并维持足部力学结构。踝关节/足部MRI或超声检查显示拇长屈肌腱退行性改变，包括：踝关节水平腱周积液、肌腱内信号异常、肌腱增厚、肌腱炎或腱鞘炎，以及肌腱断裂。

HP:6001401.name: Hallux pain
HP:6001401.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the big toe (hallux).
HP:6001401.definition_cn: 以局限于拇趾（踇趾）的躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动痛或酸痛）为特征的异常感觉。

HP:6001402.name: Pain on the medial aspect of the foot
HP:6001402.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the side of the foot nearest to the big toe (hallux).
HP:6001402.definition_cn: 一种以身体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉，定位于足部最靠近拇趾（hallux）的一侧。

HP:6001403.name: Hallux sesamoid injury
HP:6001403.definition: Damage affecting one or both of the two small, pea-shaped bones (sesamoids) embedded in the tendons beneath the first metatarsophalangeal joint of the big toe. Foot x-ray shows fracture, subluxation, or dislocation of the sesamoid of the hallux.
HP:6001403.definition_cn: 累及第一跖趾关节下方肌腱内两颗豌豆状籽骨（单侧或双侧）的损伤。足部X线检查显示踇趾籽骨骨折、半脱位或脱位。

HP:6001404.name: Radial wrist pain
HP:6001404.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the radial side of the wrist.
HP:6001404.definition_cn: 一种以桡侧腕部局限性躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感觉。

HP:6001405.name: Volar wrist pain
HP:6001405.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the volar side of the wrist (i.e., to the palm side - front - of the wrist).
HP:6001405.definition_cn: 一种以腕部掌侧（即手腕掌面-前方）局部躯体不适（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不适感觉。

HP:6001406.name: Dorsal wrist pain
HP:6001406.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the dorsal side (back) of the wrist.
HP:6001406.definition_cn: 一种以腕关节背侧（手背侧）局限性躯体不适感（如刺痛、搏动性疼痛或酸痛）为特征的不愉快感觉。

HP:6001407.name: Peroneal tendon tenderness
HP:6001407.definition: Pain elicited with palpation along the course of the peroneal tendons, located posterior to the lateral malleolus and extending distally toward the base of the fifth metatarsal.
HP:6001407.definition_cn: 沿腓骨肌腱走行处触诊诱发疼痛，该肌腱位于外踝后方并向远端延伸至第五跖骨基底。

HP:6001408.name: Peroneal tendon subluxation
HP:6001408.definition: Dynamic ultrasound of the lateral ankle showing subluxation or dislocation of one or both of the peroneal tendons out of the peroneal groove.
HP:6001408.definition_cn: 动态超声显示外踝处腓骨肌腱单侧或双侧从腓骨沟半脱位或脱位。

HP:6001409.name: Peroneal tendon injury
HP:6001409.definition: Ankle MRI or ultrasound showing edema or thickening of peroneal tendon(s), fluid within peroneal tendon sheath, partial or complete tear in one or both of the peroneal tendons, or subluxation/dislocation of one or both of the tendons.
HP:6001409.definition_cn: 踝关节MRI或超声显示腓骨肌腱水肿或增厚、腓骨肌腱鞘内积液、单侧或双侧腓骨肌腱部分或完全撕裂、或单侧/双侧肌腱半脱位/脱位。

HP:6001410.name: Elevated circulating succinylacetone concentration
HP:6001410.definition: The concentration of succinylacetone in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001410.name_cn: 循环琥珀酰丙酮浓度升高
HP:6001410.definition_cn: 血液中琥珀酰丙酮浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001411.name: Flat palate
HP:6001411.definition: Reduced height of the palate. A flat palate is present with a palatal index angle below 30 degrees, a normal palate with an angle between 30 and 45 degrees, and a steep palate with an angle above 45 degrees.
HP:6001411.definition_cn: 腭高降低。平坦腭的腭指数角低于30度，正常腭的角度介于30至45度之间，而高拱腭的角度则超过45度。

HP:6001412.name: Elevated circulating C-terminal telopeptide cross-link of type1 collagen concentration
HP:6001412.definition: The concentration of C-terminal telopeptide cross-link of type1 collagen in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001412.name_cn: 循环中1型胶原C端交联肽浓度升高
HP:6001412.definition_cn: 血清1型胶原羧基端肽交联浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001413.name: Exacerbated by pulmonary vasodilator exposure
HP:6001413.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with a pulmonary vasodilator medication such as prostacyclin analogs, endothelin receptor antagonists, and phosphodiesterase-5 (PDE5) inhibitors.
HP:6001413.name_cn: 肺血管扩张剂暴露加重
HP:6001413.definition_cn: 应用于经前列腺素类似物、内皮素受体拮抗剂及磷酸二酯酶-5（PDE5）抑制剂等肺血管扩张剂治疗后加重的体征或症状。
