HP:6001415.name: Urinoma
HP:6001415.definition: Encapsulated collections of urine around the kidney in the retroperitoneum, most commonly in the perirenal space, as a consequence of renal tract leakage caused by urinary obstruction, trauma, or post-instrumentation.
HP:6001415.definition_cn: 肾周尿囊肿是指尿液在腹膜后间隙（最常见于肾周间隙）形成的包裹性积聚，通常由尿路梗阻、外伤或器械操作后导致的泌尿系统渗漏引起。

HP:6001416.name: Umbilical discharge
HP:6001416.definition: Abnormal fluid draining from the umbilicus (from wounds, surgical sites, or fistulas).
HP:6001416.definition_cn: 脐部异常液体引流（源自伤口、手术部位或瘘管）。

HP:6001417.name: Abnormal biparietal diameter
HP:6001417.definition: Abnormal biparietal diameter (BPD) refers to a fetal head width measurement, taken between the outer edge of the proximal parietal bone and the inner edge of the distal parietal bone on an ultrasound image, that lies outside the expected range for a given gestational age. The expected range typically falls between the 10th and 90th percentiles, with microcephaly defined as a BPD below the 3rd percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations below the mean) and macrocephaly defined as a BPD above the 97th percentile (or more than 2 standard deviations above the mean).
HP:6001417.definition_cn: 异常双顶径（Biparietal Diameter, BPD）是指超声影像中测量的胎儿头部宽度值偏离特定孕周预期范围，该测量值为近端顶骨外缘至远端顶骨内缘的距离。正常参考范围通常介于第10至第90百分位数之间，其中小头畸形定义为BPD低于第3百分位数（或低于均值2个标准差以上），巨头畸形则定义为BPD高于第97百分位数（或高于均值2个标准差以上）。

HP:6001418.name: Abnormal fetal femur length
HP:6001418.definition: Femur length is measured between the outer border of one end of the the femoral diaphysis to the other outer border, excluding the epiphysis or other artifact. Abnormal femur length is defined as being more than two standard deviations away from the mean.
HP:6001418.definition_cn: 股骨长度的测量是从股骨干骺端一端的外缘至另一端的外缘，不包括骨骺或其他伪影。股骨长度异常定义为偏离平均值超过两个标准差。

HP:6001419.name: Pain exacerbated by wrist ulnar deviation
HP:6001419.definition: Pain worsens with wrist ulnar deviation (i.e., the pain is exacerbated if the hand is moved towards the side with the fifth finger).
HP:6001419.definition_cn: 疼痛在腕关节尺偏时加重（即手部向小指侧移动时疼痛加剧）。

HP:6001420.name: Pain exacerbated by wrist radial deviation
HP:6001420.definition: Pain worsens with wrist radial deviation (i.e., the pain is exacerbated if the hand is moved towards the side with the thumb).
HP:6001420.definition_cn: 疼痛在腕关节桡偏时加重（即手向拇指侧移动时疼痛加剧）。

HP:6001421.name: Ulnar positive variance
HP:6001421.definition: A phenomenon whereby the distal ulna articular surface is more distal than the distal radius articular surface.
HP:6001421.definition_cn: 尺骨远端关节面相对于桡骨远端关节面更向远端突出的现象。

HP:6001422.name: Negative ulnar variance
HP:6001422.definition: Negative ulnar variance is a condition in which the ulna is relatively shorter than the radius at the carpus. AP wrist X-ray shows the distal ulna articular surface more proximal than the distal radius articular surface.
HP:6001422.definition_cn: 尺骨负变异是指腕关节处尺骨相对桡骨较短的一种情况。腕关节正位X线片显示尺骨远端关节面较桡骨远端关节面更靠近近端。

HP:6001423.name: Flexor carpi radialis tendonitis
HP:6001423.definition: Inflammation of the flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon, which traverses the carpus through a narrow fibro-osseous tunnel.
HP:6001423.definition_cn: 桡侧腕屈肌（FCR）肌腱炎，该肌腱穿过腕部狭窄的纤维骨性隧道。

HP:6001424.name: Transillumination test shows high light transmission
HP:6001424.definition: A transillumination test involves shining light through an area of the body or a mass. This term refers to a transillumination test that shows especially high (positive) transillumination, which may be observed when a mass or swelling contains clear fluid rather than solid tissue or blood.
HP:6001424.name_cn: 透照试验显示高透光性
HP:6001424.definition_cn: 透照试验是指将光线照射穿透身体某部位或肿块的检查方法。该术语特指显示高度透光（阳性）的透照试验结果，此种现象多见于内含清亮液体而非实性组织或血液的肿块或肿胀部位。

HP:6001425.name: Hyperleukocytosis
HP:6001425.definition: Hyperleukocytosis is commonly defined as a white blood cell (WBC) count of greater than 100,000 luekocytes per microliter.
HP:6001425.definition_cn: 高白细胞血症通常定义为白细胞计数超过每微升100,000个白细胞。

HP:6001426.name: Elbow instability
HP:6001426.definition: Impairment of the ability of the elbow joint to maintain proper anatomical alignment and functional mechanics. Elbow instability is a spectrum from subluxation to dislocation, with corresponding clinical and pathologic features and therapeutic implications.
HP:6001426.definition_cn: 肘关节维持正常解剖对位及功能力学的能力受损。肘关节不稳是一个从半脱位到全脱位的连续谱系，具有相应的临床病理特征及治疗学意义。

HP:6001427.name: Valgus instability of the elbow
HP:6001427.definition: A type of elbow instability that arises through injuries to the medial collateral ligament (MCL), specifically the anterior bundle (AMCL). In the valgus stress test, the elbow is placed in 20 to 30 degrees of flexion with the forearm supinated and a valgus stress is applied. The test is positive when no firm end point is palpated, greater than 1 mm of medial joint opening is noted (fluoroscopically), or there is reproduction of the patient's pain.
HP:6001427.definition_cn: 一种因内侧副韧带（MCL）损伤导致的肘关节不稳定，尤其累及前束（AMCL）。进行外翻应力试验时，肘关节屈曲20至30度，前臂旋后并施加外翻应力。当触诊无明确终末点、透视下显示内侧关节间隙增宽超过1毫米或诱发患者疼痛时，该试验结果为阳性。

HP:6001428.name: Varus instability of the elbow
HP:6001428.definition: A type of elbow insttability characterized by abnormal widening or gapping of the lateral (radial) side of the elbow joint when a varus stress is applied, due to insufficiency of the lateral collateral ligament complex.
HP:6001428.definition_cn: 一种肘关节不稳定类型，其特征为在外翻应力作用下因外侧副韧带复合体功能不全导致肘关节外侧（桡侧）异常增宽或间隙形成。

HP:6001429.name: Limited foot eversion
HP:6001429.definition: Decreased foot eversion secondary to pain, weakness, or mechanical block.
HP:6001429.definition_cn: 因疼痛、肌力减弱或机械性阻滞导致的足外翻活动度下降。

HP:6001430.name: Limited foot inversion
HP:6001430.definition: Decreased foot inversion secondary to pain, weakness, or mechanical block.
HP:6001430.definition_cn: 因疼痛、肌力减弱或机械性阻滞导致的足内翻活动度下降

HP:6001431.name: Positive synovial Tropheryma whipplei bacteria microscopy
HP:6001431.definition: Demonstration of Tropheryma whipplei bacteria in the synovial (joint) fluid by microscopic analysis.
HP:6001431.name_cn: 滑膜组织显微镜检查发现惠普尔养障体阳性
HP:6001431.definition_cn: 通过显微镜分析在滑膜（关节）液中检出惠普尔养障体细菌。

HP:6001432.name: Positive calf squeeze test
HP:6001432.definition: An abnormal result of the calf-squeeze test (also known as the Thompson test), which is considered a sign of Achilles tendon rupture. The test is positive (abnormal) if no plantar flexion of the foot occurs at calf squeezing.
HP:6001432.definition_cn: 小腿挤压试验（亦称Thompson试验）结果异常，提示跟腱断裂。若挤压小腿时足部无跖屈动作，则试验结果为阳性（异常）。

HP:6001433.name: Achilles tendon tear
HP:6001433.definition: A partial or complete break in the Achilles tendon (the tendon that connects the gastrocnemius and soleus to the calcaneus). This feature can be ascertained by magnetic resonance imaing (MRI) of the foot/ankle showing partial or complete tear of the achilles tendon.
HP:6001433.definition_cn: 跟腱（连接腓肠肌和比目鱼肌至跟骨的肌腱）部分或完全断裂。该特征可通过足部/踝关节磁共振成像（MRI）显示跟腱部分或完全撕裂予以确认。

HP:6001434.name: Positive bursa fluid gram stain
HP:6001434.definition: Demonstration of the presence of bacteria by gram staining of bursa fluid. The sample is generally obtained by bursal fluid aspiration.
HP:6001434.definition_cn: 通过滑囊液革兰氏染色证实细菌存在。样本通常通过滑囊液抽吸获取。

HP:6001435.name: Abnormal medial epicondyle morphology
HP:6001435.definition: A structural anomaly of the medial epicondyle, which is the site of the attachment of various muscles, including the radial and ulnar flexor of the wrist, the superficial flexor of the fingers, the palmaris longus and the pronator teres muscle.
HP:6001435.definition_cn: 内侧髁结构异常，此处为多块肌肉附着点，包括桡侧腕屈肌、尺侧腕屈肌、指浅屈肌、掌长肌及旋前圆肌。

HP:6001436.name: Medial humerus epicondyle avulsion fracture
HP:6001436.definition: An avulsion fracture of the medial epicondyle of the elbow. Radiological examination in the anteroposterior and lateral projection can be used to make the diagnosis and to determine the degree and direction of the fracture displacement.
HP:6001436.name_cn: 肱骨内上髁撕脱性骨折
HP:6001436.definition_cn: 肘关节内上髁撕脱性骨折。可通过前后位及侧位放射学检查进行诊断，并确定骨折移位的程度和方向。

HP:6001437.name: Hand mass
HP:6001437.definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the hand. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP:6001437.definition_cn: 手部局限性肿胀或增大。在诊断检查的早期阶段，当肿胀的确切性质尚未明确时，通常使用“肿块”一词。

HP:6001438.name: Tenosynovitis
HP:6001438.definition: Inflammation of the synovial sheath that surrounds a tendon.

HP:6001439.name: Tigroid fundus
HP:6001439.definition: Enhanced visibility of large choroidal vessels through the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). This reticulated pattern is commonly observed on fundus examination and color fundus photography. Such hypopigmented areas alternate with hyperpigmented zones in a tigroid pattern. Fundus tessellation is often associated with myopia and choroidal thinning.
HP:6001439.definition_cn: 透过视网膜色素上皮层可见脉络膜大血管增强。这种网状模式在眼底检查和彩色眼底摄影中常见。此类色素减退区域与色素沉着区域交替出现，形成虎纹状图案。眼底豹纹状改变常与近视及脉络膜变薄相关。

HP:6001440.name: Decreased myocardial glycogen content
HP:6001440.definition: The amount of glycogen in the myocardial tissue of the heart is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001440.definition_cn: 心肌组织内糖原含量低于正常值下限。

HP:6001441.name: CSF anti-myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody positivity
HP:6001441.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein.
HP:6001441.name_cn: 脑脊液抗髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白抗体阳性
HP:6001441.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中存在针对髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白的自身体抗体（免疫球蛋白）。

HP:6001442.name: Spinal cord H sign
HP:6001442.definition: The H sign can be ascertained by spinal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and represents spinal cord myelitis isolated to the gray matter. A longitudinally extensive T2 hyperintense spinal cord lesion from C6 to T10, predominantly involving the gray matter. The appearance of the anomaly is said to resemble the letter H.
HP:6001442.definition_cn: H征可通过脊髓磁共振成像（MRI）确认，代表局限于灰质的脊髓炎。表现为从C6至T10节段的纵向广泛性T2高信号脊髓病变，主要累及灰质。该异常影像学表现形似字母"H"。

HP:6001443.name: Abnormal testosterone
HP:6001443.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of testosterone and estradiol (the primary sex steroids) to each other. The testosterone:estradiol ratio is derived from total testosterone in ng/dL and total estradiol in pg/mL, and expressed as T:E. Normal ranges are affected by sex, age, and other factors.
HP:6001443.definition_cn: 睾酮与雌二醇（主要性类固醇）正常比例的任何偏离。睾酮：雌二醇比值由总睾酮（ng/dL）与总雌二醇（pg/mL）计算得出，以T:E表示。正常范围受性别、年龄及其他因素影响。

HP:6001444.name: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor 3 concentration
HP:6001444.definition: The concentration of IGFBP-3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor-Binding Protein 3) in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.
HP:6001444.name_cn: 循环胰岛素样生长因子3浓度异常
HP:6001444.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白3（IGFBP-3）浓度超出正常范围。

HP:6001445.name: Decreased circulating insulin-like growth factor 3 concentration
HP:6001445.definition: The concentration of IGFBP-3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor-Binding Protein 3) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001445.name_cn: 循环胰岛素样生长因子3浓度降低
HP:6001445.definition_cn: 循环血液中胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白3（IGFBP-3）浓度低于正常值下限。

HP:6001446.name: Airway chondritis
HP:6001446.definition: Inflammation of the cartilage of the airway, including especially the trachea and bronchi.
HP:6001446.definition_cn: 气道软骨炎，尤指气管和支气管软骨的炎症。

HP:6001447.name: inflammation of the costal cartilage, the cartilage that connects the ribs to the sternum (breastbone).
HP:6001447.definition: inflammation of the costal cartilage (the cartilage that connects the ribs to the sternum). The typical presentation of costochondritis is bilateral parasternal chest wall pain exacerbated by deep breaths, coughing, and stretching. The upper (predominantly second through fifth) costochondral and/or costosternal junctions are most commonly involved. The areas of tenderness are not generally accompanied by heat, erythema, or localized swelling.
HP:6001447.name_cn: 肋软骨炎，即连接肋骨与胸骨（胸骨）的软骨发生炎症。
HP:6001447.definition_cn: 肋软骨炎（连接肋骨与胸骨的软骨发生炎症）。肋软骨炎的典型表现为双侧胸骨旁胸壁疼痛，深呼吸、咳嗽和伸展动作可加剧疼痛。最常累及上段（主要为第二至第五）肋软骨和/或肋胸关节。压痛区域通常不伴有发热、红斑或局部肿胀。

HP:6001448.name: History of ocular surgery
HP:6001448.definition: Past medical history of surgical procedure on the eye or its surroundings.
HP:6001448.definition_cn: 眼部或周围区域手术史。

HP:6001449.name: Increased plantar fascia thickness
HP:6001449.definition: Increased thickness of the plantar fascia. This finding can be ascertained by ultrasound or magnetic resonance imaging.
HP:6001449.definition_cn: 足底筋膜增厚。此发现可通过超声或磁共振成像确认。

HP:6001450.name: Increased mixed venous oxygen saturation
HP:6001450.definition: Oxygen saturation in mixed venous blood (SvO2), as measured in a sample of mixed venous blood drawn from the distal lumen of a catheter placed in the pulmonary artery, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001450.name_cn: 混合静脉血氧饱和度升高
HP:6001450.definition_cn: 混合静脉血氧饱和度（SvO2），通过肺动脉导管远端管腔抽取的混合静脉血样本测得，高于正常值上限。

HP:6001451.name: Decreased mixed venous oxygen saturation
HP:6001451.definition: Oxygen saturation in mixed venous blood (SvO2), as measured in a sample of mixed venous blood drawn from the distal lumen of a catheter placed in the pulmonary artery, is below the lower limit of normal.
HP:6001451.name_cn: 混合静脉血氧饱和度降低
HP:6001451.definition_cn: 混合静脉血氧饱和度（SvO2），通过肺动脉导管远端腔抽取的混合静脉血样本测得，低于正常值下限。

HP:6001452.name: Chocolate brown blood
HP:6001452.definition: Characteristic chocolate-brown color of circulating blood with an elevated methemoglobin content.
HP:6001452.definition_cn: 循环血液呈特征性巧克力棕色，伴高铁血红蛋白含量升高。

HP:6001453.name: Elevated pCO2 gap
HP:6001453.definition: The difference between the venous-to-arterial carbon dioxide saturation (Pv-aCO2) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001453.definition_cn: 静脉-动脉血二氧化碳分压差（Pv-aCO2）高于正常值上限。

HP:6001454.name: Putaminal eye sign
HP:6001454.definition: An imaging anomly of the putamen that is thought to be pathognomic for MEGDEL syndrome (3-MethylGlutaconic aciduria, Deafness, Encephalopathy, Leigh-like syndrome MIM #614739). In stage 1 of the disease, T2 signal changes of the pallidum are present. In stage 2, swelling of the putamen and caudate nucleus is seen. The dorsal putamen contains an eye that shows no signal alteration and (thus) seems to be spared during this stage of the disease. It later increases, reflecting progressive putaminal involvement. Sparing of the mid dorsal putamen (showing normal signal surrounded by T2 hyperintense signal) is referred to as the putaminal eye.
HP:6001454.definition_cn: 一种被认为对MEGDEL综合征（3-甲基戊烯二酸尿症、耳聋、脑病、Leigh样综合征，MIM #614739）具有病理特异性的壳核影像学异常。在疾病第一阶段，可见苍白球T2信号改变。第二阶段出现壳核与尾状核肿胀。壳核背侧区域存在一个未显示信号改变的眼状结构（因此）在此疾病阶段似乎未受累。后期该区域逐渐扩大，反映壳核进行性受累。壳核中背侧区域保留（表现为被T2高信号环绕的正常信号区）被称为“壳核眼征”。

HP:6001455.name: Decreased coracohumeral distance
HP:6001455.definition: Axial view on shoulder X-ray or MRI showing decreased distance between posterior border of the coracoid process and anterior border of the humeral head of less than 6 mm; subcoracoid impingement; decreased coracohumeral interval.
HP:6001455.definition_cn: 肩部X线或磁共振成像轴位视图显示，喙突后缘与肱骨头前缘之间距离减小至小于6毫米；喙突下撞击征；喙肱间隙变窄。

HP:6001456.name: Abnormal deltoid muscle morphology
HP:6001456.definition: Any structural anomaly of the deltoid muscle, the large triangular intrinsic shoulder muscle, so named because its shape resembles the inverted Greek letter delta.
HP:6001456.definition_cn: 三角肌结构异常，即肩部内在的大三角形肌肉，因其形状类似倒置的希腊字母delta而得名。

HP:6001457.name: Deltoid muscle tear
HP:6001457.definition: An injury of the deltoid muscle of the shoulder or its tendon characterized by partial or complete rupture.
HP:6001457.definition_cn: 肩部三角肌或其肌腱损伤，特征为部分或完全断裂。

HP:6001458.name: Glenohumeral arthritis
HP:6001458.definition: Anteropostrior (AP), axillary, or Grashey (true AP) view X-ray of the shoulder showing radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis such as joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, and/or osteophyte formation in the glenohumeral joint.
HP:6001458.definition_cn: 肩关节前后位（AP）、腋位或格拉斯海（真性前后位）X线片显示骨关节炎的影像学证据，如关节间隙变窄、软骨下骨硬化、软骨下囊肿和/或盂肱关节骨赘形成。

HP:6001459.name: Dental root fusion
HP:6001459.definition: An anomaly of the roots of a multi-rooted tooth (such as a molar) in which the roots are not physically divided by bone or periodontal ligament space.
HP:6001459.definition_cn: 多根牙（如磨牙）的牙根异常，表现为牙根之间未被骨组织或牙周膜间隙物理性分隔。

HP:6001460.name: Difficulty floating in water
HP:6001460.definition: A phenomenon whereby an individual struggles to float, cannot swim despite adequate training, or simply sinks. This phenomenon may be observed in individuals with conditions such as osteopetrosis that are characterized by substantially increased bone mineral density (which implies reduced bouyancy).
HP:6001460.definition_cn: 一种个体难以漂浮、即使经过充分训练也无法游泳或仅能下沉的现象。该现象可见于骨硬化症等疾病患者，此类疾病以骨矿物质密度显著增高为特征（这意味着浮力降低）。

HP:6001461.name: Aortitis
HP:6001461.definition: Aortitis refers to inflammatory changes to the wall of the aorta and incorporates both infectious and non-infectious etiologies.
HP:6001461.definition_cn: 主动脉炎是指主动脉壁的炎症性改变，包括感染性和非感染性病因。

HP:6001462.name: Upper extremity claudication
HP:6001462.definition: Pain in an arm that is triggered by muscular exertion.

HP:6001463.name: Tongue claudication
HP:6001463.definition: Pain in the tongue induced by speaking or chewing.
HP:6001463.definition_cn: 言语或咀嚼诱发的舌痛。

HP:6001464.name: Cerebral perivascular enhancement pattern
HP:6001464.definition: Focal, regional or diffuse magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) enhancement of intracranial perivascular spaces (PVS). This enhancement pattern is recognizable by its topography that follows PVS distribution, particularly identifiable in regions where PVS predominate (centra semiovalia, basal ganglia and the brachium pontis)15 although it can be found throughout the whole brain. Depending on the perpendicular or parallel orientation of MRI sections to the long axis of PVS, enhanced PVS appear as dots or curvilinear elements respectively. Depending on the causal pathology, PVE may appear more linear or nodular.
HP:6001464.definition_cn: 颅内血管周围间隙（PVS）的局灶性、区域性或弥漫性磁共振成像（MRI）强化。这种强化模式可通过其遵循PVS分布的地形学特征进行识别，尤其在PVS主要分布区域（半卵圆中心、基底节区和脑桥臂）更为明显，尽管在全脑范围内均可发现。根据MRI切面与PVS长轴的垂直或平行方向，增强的PVS分别呈现为点状或曲线状结构。根据病因病理的不同，PVS强化可表现为更线状或结节状。

HP:6001465.name: Long head of biceps tendon dislocation
HP:6001465.definition: Dislocation or subluxation of the long head of the biceps tendon out of the bicipital groove (as documented by magnetic resonance imaging of the shoulder) or dynamic ultrasound of the shoulder showing subluxation or dislocation of the long head of the biceps tendon out of the bicipital groove.
HP:6001465.name_cn: 肱二头肌长头肌腱脱位
HP:6001465.definition_cn: 肱二头肌长头腱自肱骨结节间沟脱位或半脱位（经肩关节磁共振成像证实）或肩关节动态超声显示肱二头肌长头腱自肱骨结节间沟半脱位或脱位。

HP:6001466.name: Elevated circulating somatostatin concentration
HP:6001466.definition: The concentration of somatostatin in the blood corculation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001466.name_cn: 循环中生长抑素浓度升高
HP:6001466.definition_cn: 生长抑素在血液循环中的浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001467.name: Lack of attached gingiva
HP:6001467.definition: Absence of attached gingiva. The gingiva is subdivided into the nonattached free gingiva (which includes the gingival margin and the papillae) and the attached gingiva. The attached gingiva is tightly and unmovably bound to the periosteum via collagen type I fibers. The gingiva is keratinized and thicker than the mucosa to provide mechanical protection. The border between attached gingiva and mucosa constitutes the mucogingival junction. In vivo, it is sometimes visible as a white line . The oral mucosa is loosely connected to the periosteum and nonkeratinized. It is movable, thin, more fragile, translucent, and blood vessels are visible.
HP:6001467.definition_cn: 附着龈缺失。牙龈可分为非附着游离龈（包括龈缘和龈乳头）以及附着龈两部分。附着龈通过I型胶原纤维紧密固定于骨膜，不可移动。牙龈呈角化状态，且较黏膜更厚，以提供机械保护。附着龈与黏膜的分界称为膜龈联合，在活体组织中有时呈现为白色线条。口腔黏膜与骨膜连接疏松，呈非角化状态，具有可移动性，质地较薄、脆弱、半透明，且血管清晰可见。

HP:6001468.name: Spontaneous diaphragmatic rupture
HP:6001468.definition: A full thickness tear of the diaphragm without significant trauma.
HP:6001468.definition_cn: 膈肌全层撕裂，无明显外伤史。

HP:6001469.name: Elevated alveolar-arterial (A-a) oxygen gradient
HP:6001469.definition: An increase in the difference between the oxygen concentration in the alveoli and arterial system above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001469.name_cn: 肺泡-动脉氧分压差（A-a梯度）升高
HP:6001469.definition_cn: 肺泡与动脉系统之间的氧浓度差超过正常上限的升高。

HP:6001470.name: Abnormal concentration of circulating metanephrines
HP:6001470.definition: Adrenaline, noradrenaline and dopamine are degraded by catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) to form their inactive metabolites metanephrine, normetanephrine and 3-methoxytyramine (3-MT). When there is an indication for biochemical testing, such as suspicion of pheochromocytoma, metanephrine and normetanephrine metabolites are measured in plasma or 24-hour urine. This term represents an elevation of the concentration of metanephrine and normetanephrine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001470.name_cn: 循环变肾上腺素类物质浓度异常
HP:6001470.definition_cn: 肾上腺素、去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺经儿茶酚-O-甲基转移酶（COMT）降解，形成其无活性代谢产物甲氧基肾上腺素、甲氧基去甲肾上腺素和3-甲氧基酪胺（3-MT）。当存在生化检测指征时（如疑似嗜铬细胞瘤），需通过血浆或24小时尿液检测甲氧基肾上腺素与甲氧基去甲肾上腺素代谢产物。该术语指血液循环中甲氧基肾上腺素与甲氧基去甲肾上腺素浓度超过正常上限的状态。

HP:6001471.name: Elevated circulating 3-O-methyldopa concentration
HP:6001471.definition: The concentration of 3-O-methyldopa in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001471.name_cn: 循环3-O-甲基多巴浓度升高
HP:6001471.definition_cn: 血液循环中3-O-甲基多巴浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001472.name: Elevated CSF 3-O-methyldopa concentration
HP:6001472.definition: The concentration of 3-O-methyldopa in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP:6001472.name_cn: 脑脊液3-O-甲基多巴浓度升高
HP:6001472.definition_cn: 脑脊液中3-O-甲基多巴的浓度高于正常值上限。

HP:6001473.name: Fixed fetal head flexion
HP:6001473.definition: An unchanging bending forward of the fetal head in the uterus as visualized by prenatal sonography. This sign can be defined as a lack of change in this position during the 30 min of observation. Additionally, identical head flexion is observable several times at intervals.
HP:6001473.definition_cn: 产前超声检查下，胎儿头部在子宫内呈现持续性前屈状态。此征象定义为在30分钟观察期间该体位无变化，且相同头部屈曲姿势可间歇性重复出现。

HP:6001474.name: Abnormal rectosigmoid index
HP:6001474.definition: The rectosigmoid (R/S) ratio, a measure comparing rectal to sigmoid colon diameter, is below the lower limit of normal on prenatal ultrasound. The rectosigmoid is normally the widest segment of the fetal colon. If the rectosigmoid is narrower than the ascending or transverse colon above it), this is called a reversed rectosigmoid ratio or abnormal rectosigmoid index. The RS ratio is calculated by dividing the transverse rectal diameter by the sigmoid diameter. An R/S ratio of 1 or more is considered normal.
HP:6001474.name_cn: 直肠乙状结肠指数异常
HP:6001474.definition_cn: 直肠乙状结肠比（R/S比）是在产前超声中用于比较直肠与乙状结肠直径的测量指标，该数值低于正常值下限。直肠乙状结肠通常是胎儿结肠中最宽的节段。若直肠乙状结肠的宽度小于其上方的升结肠或横结肠，则称为直肠乙状结肠比倒置或直肠乙状结肠指数异常。R/S比通过横结肠直肠直径除以乙状结肠直径计算得出。R/S比大于或等于1通常被视为正常。

HP:6001475.name: Umbilical cord edema
HP:6001475.definition: Visible edema (swelling) in a cord with a minimal cross sectional area of 1-3 cm2. This may result from an excessive accumulation of Wharton jelly, resulting in a thick or edematous umbilical cord.
HP:6001475.definition_cn: 脐带可见水肿（肿胀），横截面积最小值为1-3平方厘米。该现象可能由沃顿胶过度积聚导致脐带增厚或水肿性改变所致。

HP:6001476.name: Fetal enterolithiasis
HP:6001476.definition: Enterolithiasis (concretions or stones forming within the gastrointestinal tract) is a prenatal sonographic sign defined by hyperechogenic foci within the - often distended - fetal bowel.
HP:6001476.definition_cn: 肠结石（胃肠道内形成的凝结物或结石）是一种产前超声征象，表现为在常常扩张的胎儿肠管内出现强回声灶。

HP:6001477.name: Malignant cells in CSF
HP:6001477.definition: The identification of malignant cells in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), generally by microscopic examination of the CSF.
HP:6001477.definition_cn: 脑脊液（CSF）中恶性细胞的鉴定，通常通过脑脊液的显微镜检查来实现。

HP:6001478.name: Greek warrior helmet sign
HP:6001478.definition: A prenatal sonographic finding characterized by a high forehead, prominent glabella, and a broad, un-tapered nasal bridge that merges directly into the brow line. This appearance is said to resemble a Greek (Corinthian) warrior helmet because the wide, solid vertical column down the center of the face is said to resemble the fixed, protective nose guard of a Corinthian helmet.
HP:6001478.definition_cn: 产前超声检查表现为前额突出、眉间隆起、宽而平直的鼻梁直接延伸至眉弓。此形态被描述为类似希腊战士头盔（科林斯式头盔），因面部中央宽而直的垂直柱状结构被视为等同于科林斯头盔上固定的防护鼻护。

HP:6001479.name: Somatostatinoma
HP:6001479.definition: Somatostatinoma is a rare, functional neuroendocrine tumor (NET) that primarily arises in the pancreas and duodenum, characterized by excessive production of somatostatin.
HP:6001479.definition_cn: 生长抑素瘤是一种罕见的功能性神经内分泌肿瘤，主要起源于胰腺和十二指肠，其特征是过量产生生长抑素。
